phyag chen la mos zhen che zhing sems ngo goms 'dris yang de ga'i zhes pa ltar skyong ba yin pas/ de la bka' brgyud pa gong ma rnams kyi zhal nas phyag chen rtogs pa'i sne zin dge sbyor skyes kyang de skabs brtson pas ma skyongs na sgom 'grib 'gro gsungs pa de yang shin tu nas thugs chad 'dug de la mkhas grub sog bzlog pa yab sras rnams kyi ni/ sems phyogs kyi man ngag spyi btang yul lam du byed pa dang / klong chen po yan yul can lam du byed pas rdzogs chen snying thig lugs la ngo bo mthong phyin mi 'grib zhes gsungs pa de yang ci lta ba mkhyen pa'i legs bshad yang dag par mngon no/ / bsod nams mthu yi bde chen gling dang mjal/ /rgyu des chos kyi srog rtsa byin rlabs zhugs/ /smon lam stobs kyi kun mkhyen gsung la mos/ /rkyen des rdzogs chen grub mthar mos gus brnyes/ /de dag stobs kyi nyams len rkang pa tshugs/ /skal pa dman yang skal med min tsam mngon/ /bzang ngan las kun bslu med rgyal bas gsungs/ /ji bzhin ma 'dres snang la ya mtshan skyes/ /zhes so/ /nyams myong de ka'i rgyun la brten nas bla ma gong ma mang zhig gi bzhed pa ltar na bde stong dpe yi ye shes yang de skabs cha mthun skyes par rlom yang / rgyud sde chen po'i dgongs don ltar na de cung zad min par snang yang / gang ltar nyams myong brtan por skyes pa'i nus pas phyi nang rten 'brel gcig pa'i gnad kyi phyi na yang rang nyid gar gnas de ru sprin smug na bun 'ja'i rang bzhin ya mtshan pa dang / rlung yang dal bar g.yo zhi bag dro yid du 'ong ba'i rnam pa dang / rang gi drung na 'khod pa kun bag phebs pa dga' 'dzum gyi ngang tshul du snang ste/ don la rang sems la bde nyams kyi shar lugs tsam las nges bzung tshad ma ni phyir yod gang ltar de skabs su bde sdug snyan mi snyan tsha grang gi myong reg rnams kyang rnam rtog gi rang gzugs las gzhan pa'i rang rgyud bye brag par ma 'grub pa'i ngang tshul du rtogs pas de dag kun kyang rig ngo ro mnyam nyid du shar ba dang / lha la chags pa 'dre la sdang zhen yang re dogs kyi 'char cha phra mo tsam las gzhan rang sar zhi zhing sngon zhen re dogs kho rang yang rang shar rang grol chos nyid kyi yo long las gzhan du med pa ni nges shes gting tshugs pa sogs gzhan blor 'gal ba rang blor ma 'gal ba'i myong ba du ma zhig shar te/ de ngang zla ba gsum tsam bar du nyams de ka brtan par gnas song / 'di skabs su dben pa'i gnas brten gtum mo rlung thig gnad du bsnun nas bogs 27

bston dgos rgyu la/ de ltar ma 'grub pas phyis dge sbyor la bogs bskyed shin tu chung ba byung / spyir ni mi brtan pa'i myong ba rnams nyams dang brtan pa ni/ rtogs pa yin zhes smra yang don la sems nyid rigs rgyun rang gsal gyi ngo bo la ni nam yang 'pho 'gyur med kyang / gnas skabs su kun rdzob rtsa rlung thig le 'phel 'grib kyi rten 'brel dang rkyen dbang rnam rtog rlung gi byed las kyi dge 'byor la 'phel ba dang 'grib pa'i ngang tshul du ma zhig ni ston mod/ 'phel 'grib snang yang 'phel 'grib kyi rnam rtog kho re'i rang ngo mnyam nyid du shes pas rba rlabs rgya mtshor ngo shes pa lta bur snying nas thag chod cing the tshom phra ba ci byas ku yangs zol bde ba rtogs pa yin la de ma yin par ngo bo 'gyur med de rnam rtog 'gyur bcas kyi bsgribs nas 'phel 'grib nyams la blang dor dang gang shar de thog tu mi bde ba'i yid gnyis phra mo yod phyin nyams myong phyogs su rang lugs la bzhag go/ /de lta'i rnam bzhag dang rang gi nyams myong phran bu skyes pa'i ngang tshul rgyas par yi ge 'jigs pas 'dir ma bkod kyi gzhan du smra bas der rtogs par bya'o/ /'di lo zur mang du 'gro thag chod rtsis kyi rje gdan drung la thon phyag zhu ba'i phyir nyi ma phug tu slebs skabs gdan sa nas pho nya mched mngags kyi phyag mdzod ri bkra gnas nang 'gro lam du glo bur gnam rdo zhig spyi bor lhungs nas tshe'i dus byas par ji myur du gshed 'phral dad lam bstan yongs dgos tshul phebs pas de phral du sku zhogs su bcar nas gshed phral lam bstan rnams kha zhe med par bsgrub/ de skabs lan gcig nyams kyi snang bar 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal khru gang pa tsam dang / rmi lam du 'od kyi rnam par rdo rje khro lod dkar po zhig kyang 'jal phyag mdzod kyi gshegs rdzong grub phral du zur mang du 'gro brtsis yin yang phyag mdzod gshegs stabs kyi gdan drung nas re zhig bka'i ma gnang zhing / de nas bya ba gcig grub tshe gcig shar ba chu'i gnyer ma bzhin sangs dus med pas dus 'das nas rang gi blo 'dod la yod pa'i ri dwags smas ma lta bu dben pa'i gnas su rtse gcig tu bsgrub pa la gzhol nas lus/ rten 'dir grub pa thob pa zhig cis kyang bya'o snyam yang ma grub pa der gda'/ gang ltar gong gi nyams kyi 'phros su 'di skabs ci snang kun lha yi rang bzhin du rang shar ba zhig byung / de skabs dge sbyor skye tshul tsam las gzhan du ma dmigs yang / dus phyis rgyud gzhung gi don cha shas thos tshe/ rgyud nas bshad bzhin sa'i lus dben rnal pa de skyes pa yin 'duga'adir smras pa/ bcos med chos nyid bcos ma'i sems kyis bsgribs/ /ma bcos rang rig rang ngo shes pa'i tshe/ /cir snang bde chen lha yi rol par shar/ /zhal phyag can dang zhes las 'das pa'i lha/ /gzo med gnyug ma'i mkha' la rang grub 'di/ /lha sku phyag rgya chen po'i rang 'gros te/ /rdo rje theg pa'i 28

spyi gzhung gsang 'dus kyi/ /rgyud la thugs zhes 'phags bod shing rta che/ /kun gyi bzhed bzhin nges shes snying nas skyes/ /srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i/ /mtha' bral phyag rgya che 'di rmad du byung / /tshul 'di rang yang skal bzang nyid du sems/ /zhes so/ /lhag tu 'di dus zur mang gter ston rin po che badz+ra la lī ta dang mjal dgos yod kyang rang dbang du ma gyur te/ rin chen chos dag dkon la rtag tu 'tsho ba mang / zhes pa ltar phyag mdzod dus las yom ba des nged rang la ni gdan sa'i khur gyis chos kyi bar chad shin tu che ba byung / phyis chos bsgrub bzhed rnams phyi bshol dbang du yud tsam yang btang mi rung bar gda'o/ /lo der gsal gyi nang 'phrug stobs che ba de yang bzlum pas thog mar dka' 'tshegs che yang rang gi 'bad pa chen po byas shing mthar 'grig la nye skabs 7rje gdan drung dang kun rnam yang byon pa yin/ lo de'i ston gzhug la kaḥthog tu phyin rgyal ba'i sras bsod nams lde'u btsan zhabs mjal zhing lha mas bab pa'i dus bzang por tshangs spyod dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa zhus nas skra phud yang de skabs su phul bas ming bsod nams theg mchog bstan 'dzin dpal bzang por btags/skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya sdom pa ni sngar nas yang yang thob mod/ skra phud ni de skabs bar phul rgyu ma byung /yin pa ni grogs kyi mig srol ngan pa'i skyon dang rtsa ba'i bla ma zhal ma bzhugs phyin gang 'byung du 'bul par blo ma phyogs pa'i don kyang yin/ de bas sngon la pho mo skra bcad ni mang du byung yang / rang gi rgyud la skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa yod pas ltung ba chen po ni mi 'gyur rung rang gi skra ma gcod par gzhan gyi skra breg par ni nyes byas ni yong bar byed dgos/ lar skyabs 'gro nas tshangs spyod kyi dge bsnyen bar blangs yul ma 'byor na/ dkon mchog rten gyi drung du rang gis blangs bar yang rung bar bzhed pas so/ /'di res rig 'dzin rol pa rdo rje nyag gshis phyogs su bzhugs yod 'dug pa 'jal 'dod skom nad can chu'i gdung ba lta bus rgyu shas gru kha bar phyin kyang zla bo gnyis 'gro ma 'dod pa'i g.yo rgyus de nas log dgos byung / de min nged rang gcig pur 'gro chog mod kyang / mi rnams kyi smyo 'dug zhes pa'i kha zer la 'jigs nas 'grol btub/ tshe 'di'i gtam mi snyan par dgos pas bslus pa yin/dam pa'i lha chos snying nas bsgrub pa rnams tshe 'di snang lo 'dod kyi gtam mtha' dag rgyab tu bor dgos 'dug go/ /mi tshe yud tsam las mi yi phya khrel ngan brjod ci byung bzod par lha chos gsha' la zhig dgos par gda' ste/ da res nged blo tshan an chung bas bla ma ma mjal gyis phung ngo / /de yang grogs ngan spyang gi rgyab ser rkyen las byung ba yin/ chos kyi gegs byed pa'i grogs de lta bu'i dbang du 'di nas byang chub nam thob bar du mi 'gro bar smon gyis 'grub pa'i dpang po rgyal ba sras dang / slob ma des gsung bka' lung rnams kyis mdzod cig 'di bris dge bas mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun/ /rje 29

btsun bla ma'i rnam thar rjes bzhugs te/ /sa dang lam gyi yon tan rim rdzogs nas/ /kun tu bzang po'i go 'phang thob par shog /maṅga lo/༄ga /yongs rdzogs thugs kyi bsgrub pa gu ru rdo rje drag rtsal rgyun khyer rnal 'byor nyams len yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāste/ yongs rdzogs thugs kyi bsgrub pa gu ru rdo rje drag po rtsal rgyun khyer rnal 'byor nyams len yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba/ bde gshegs dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs 'dus pa'i dpal/ /bla mas bla ma sangs rgyas kun gyi gzugs/ /dran tsam 'khor ba'i 'khrul 'khor bcom nus pa/ /rdo rje drag po rtsal 'chang zhabs mthil du/ /srid gsum bdag po rnams kyi gtsug nor gyi/ /dog por gyur pas bdag gi spyi bo yi/ /btud ma nus kyang dpal mgon mchog nyid kyi/ /thugs rje'i zhabs kyi bdag gtsug dog 'di rmad/ /bdag gi tshe rabs yun gyi lha/ /khyed las gzhan med dengs nas yang / /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /srog gi phyir yang mi btang ngo / /des na de yi sgrub thabs gang / /gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig nyid las/ /snying po khyer bde rnal 'byor rgyun/ /gsung gi rgyun bzhin 'dir spel bya/ /de yang sgrub pa po bla ma'i dkyil 'khor du smin zhing de'i bcas pa yang nyams pas yid mthun sogs rgyun gyi rnal 'byor gnas gang rung du nyams len la yid rtse gcig pas/ dang po sngon du 'gro ba skyabs skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ /yon tan kun 'byung dngos grub mchog gi gnas/ /bla ma rin po che la skyabs su mchi:gang la gang 'dul 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: yi dam lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi: sangs rgyas gsung rnams sprul pa'i yi ger byon: nyon mongs 'joms mdzad chos la skyabs su mchi: thugs rje chen pos 'gro don stobs chen mdzad: byang chub sems dpa' rnams la skyabs su mchi: gdul bya'i don du drag po'i skur ston pa: chos skyong dam can rnams la skyabs su mchi: sems bskyed pa ni/ bdag gi dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba yi: 'gro ba ma lus byang chub mchog thob shog: rang byung rig pa rang shar chos kyi sku: yang dag snying po myur du rtogs par shogoḥ bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung tshe rabs su: 'gro ba 'dren pa'i ded dpon byed par shog: bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ bdag lus der 'dzin med pa yi: spyi bor pad+ma nyi zla dang ཿོ dar chen ltab khri brtsegs pa'i gdanoḥ de steng gu ru drag po rtsal:mthing nag 'jigs pa'i cha lugs loḥ zhal gcig phyag gnyis brjid pa'i sku: phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje gdeng : g.yon pa dril bu dku la brten: zhabs gnyis dor stabs ru tra brdzis: zhal 30

bsgrad mche gcig ag tshom 'bar: spyan gsum nyi zla lta bur gzigs: dbu skra'i thor tshugs dar gyis bcing : rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dbu la brgyanoḥ rin chen rus rgyan dur khrod chas: thams cad sku la legs par brgyanoḥ zab chen brjid pa'i na bza' gsol: gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa la: 'gying bag rol pa'i stabs su bzhugs: zhal nas hūm̐ gi sgra chen sgrogs: thugs ni drag po'i ngar dang ldan:dus gsum sangs rgyas yi dam lha: rnam dag brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams: bkrag mdang 'od du me re re:ma : gu ru'i sku la 'dus: kun 'dus bla ma'i ngo bo la: rtse gcig dad pas phyag 'tshal lo: gnyis med rol pas mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: bla ma 'od du mer kyi zhu: bdag gi spyi bor thim pa las: tha mal lus 'di 'od du zhu+oḥ bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum po: ma : gu ru'i ngo bor gyur: rang rig bla ma'i ngang der ni: dar gcig ma yengs slod la bzhag: de nas bla ma'i rnam par ldang : thams cad sku gsum bla mar blta: zhes pa rnams sngon 'gro ste lam gyi dus rgyun gyi nyams len des kyang tshang ba zhig go: de nas gnyis pa dngos gzhi rdo rje gsum gyi/ dkyil 'khor nyams su len pa la dang po ni gter gzhung rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig mang tig gces sgron las/ ma : gu ru rdo rje drag po rtsal: nga yi sku tshab yin pas gsal bar bsgom: zhes gsung bzhin lus lha'i dkyil 'khor du gsal btab pa ni/ oṃ ma tā shu n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra su bhā wa at+ma kau3haṃ/ haṃ: stong nyid snying rje dbyer med rang rig r+ghaṃ: de las r+ghaṃ 'phros 'byung lnga rim brtsegs steng : r+ghaṃ las rang byung lhun grub gzhal yas dbus: ma chags pad+ma thabs shes nyi zla'i gdan: srin po ru tra brdzis pa'i gdan steng du: ma : gu ru rdo rje drag po rtsal: rang rig rang byung rang shar gsal bar bsgom: sku mdog mthing nag 'jigs pa'i cha lugs la: phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu bsnams: phyag g.yon gser gyi dril bu dku la brten: rin chen rus rgyan zab chen ber la sogs: mkha' 'gro dam can dbang bsdud rgyan gyis brgyan: dur khrod chas brgyad brjid pa'i gar dgu ldan: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las kyi: lha tshogs thams cad nyid kyi sku la rdzogs: bde gshegs kun 'dus rdo rje drag po rtsal: zhabs gnyis khyad kyi 'gying bag stabs su bzhugs: zhes brjod cing de ltar gsal ma theb par du bsgom:slar yang sgyu ma ltar byin rlabs nus mthu bskyed pa'i phyir spyan 'dren gsol ba btab pa ni: r+ghaṃ/ sngon gyi bskal pa dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyis: byin gyis rlobs phyir gshegs su gsol: r+ghaṃ/ dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling du: drag po brtul zhugs mdzad pa'i tshe: sangs rgyas kun gyi dbang bskur mdzad: mkha' 'gro dam 31

can dbang du bsdus: rdo rje phag mo yum dang rol: lha srin sde brgyad bran du bkol: bdud dang log 'dren thams cad bsgral: gsang mtshan rdo rje drag po rtsal: rdo rje srin po'i lha tshogs rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dam ye dbyer med lha la phyag 'tshal mchod bstod bya ba ni/ r+ghaṃ/skye 'gag 'gyur med 'phrin las thams cad rdzogs: rang byung thugs rjes 'gro drug sgrol bar mdzad:yid bzhin nor bu'i dngos grub char ltar 'bebs: rdo rje thod 'phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: r+ghaṃ sgo lnga'i longs spyod phyi yi mchod pa dang : dug lnga rnam dag rang byung dag pa'i rdzas: bde chen rang grol gsang ba'i mchod pa rnamasoḥ rdo rje drag rtsal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: oṃ ā:ha ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha puṣ+pe dhu pe a lo ke ghadhe ne+e wi bya shaja pu dza ho: pañtsa ka ma gu na pū dza ho: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta ba lin+ta khā hi: ma hā: badz+ra pad+ma yo gi ni a ho su kha ho: r+ghaṃ/ dur khrod chen po rab tu 'jigs pa'i tshal:nyon mongs 'jom mdzad me dpung 'bar ba'i klong : chags med pad+ma thabs shes nyi zla'i gdan:dregs pa srin po rdzis pa'i gdan steng du: 'jigs byed chen po rdo rje drag po rtsal: sku mdog mthing nag 'bar ba'i gar dgu ldan: spyan bsgrad mche gcigs ag tsom me ltar 'bar: gyad kyi dor stabs 'gying bag stabs su bzhugs: dbu skra'i thor tshug nam mkha'i sprin ltar gtib: rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi dbu la brgyan: rin chen 'bar bas dbu dang phyag zhabs spras: phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu 'phyar: phyag g.yon gser gyi dril bu dku la brten: dur khrod chas brgyad sku la legs par brgyan: zab chen ser smug dbang gi na bza' gsol: rus pa'i rgyan drug rtags kyi mdzes par rgyan: bde gshegs thams cad 'dus pa'i sku gsung thugasoḥ mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag mang po'i ded dpon mdzad: rdo rje drag po rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: gnyis pa ni/ rtsa ba yang tig gces sgron las: yang tig dpa' bo 'bru gcig sngags kyi 'bru: gsung gi tshab yin rgyun chad med par bzlos:zhes pa ltar/ nga rlung sngags kyi dkyil 'khor rdo rje'i bzlas pas rgyud bskul ba ni/ r+ghaṃ/ skye med ngang las 'gag med skur gzhengs la: thugs srog r+ghaṃ las grags stong gsung gi sgra: rang byung thugs las lhun grub dbyings kyi ngang : sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las 'dzab kyis bskul: hūṃ hūṃ rgyu: don dam smra brjod las 'das skye med : da r+ghaṃ gi sgra dbyangs rdo rje'i brda' skad du la zla ba nyid dang gnas skabs dmigs pa'i bye brag la nges par 'jug ste de ltar tshig gi gsal gdab pa ni/ r+ghaṃ/ brjod byed rgyu mtshan r+ghaṃ de las: r+ghaṃ gi 'phreng bas bdag lung khengs/ r+ghaṃ/ bdag gi ba spu'i bu ga nas/ r+ghaṃ 'phros snang srid r+ghaṃ gi kheng / r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ/ snang srid rgyu rnams trī:sa bskul bas: mkha' 'gror gyur nas hūṃ glu ldir r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ hūṃ r+ghaṃ: mgrin r+ghaṃ 'od dmar gyis mkha' 'gro/ bro gar snang srid kun dbang bsdus: r+ghaṃ hūṃ hūṃ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ:32

zhes man ngag bzhin zhag dang thun dang gdan thog gcig tu yang bsgom bzlas bya bar/ bzlas pa sum brgya nyer gcig gi: dbang gi nus pa bskyed par bya/ zhes pas gsal bar bstan par bzhed do/ /bzlas pa'i bar mtshams rnams su dzab mchod 'bul ba ni/ r+ghaṃ/ ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i dzab bsnyen mchod pa 'bul/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las bstod/ /nyams chags 'gal 'khrul ci mchis mthol lo gshags/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: zhes dang / thun skabs su/ ngal gso'i dus su rtsa bral ngang la bzhag: zhes pa ltar gnas lugs rang ngo skyong ba dang / yang bsdu rim la 'jug pa na/ hūṃ/ da ni dkyil 'khor gsal loḥ phyi nang snod bcud thams cad kun: yig 'bru hūṃ la hril gyis bsdu: r+ghaṃ yang mi dmigs 'ja' ltar yal: de nas bdag nyid lha ru gsal: rtag chad gnyis kyi mtha' gsal lo: des rjes kyi rnal 'byor lam du byed pa'o/ /gsum pa yid chos nyid byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du la zla ba ni/ yang tig bces sgron las/ pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi thugs kyi bcud len la: lus kyi gnad ni mnyam bzhag drang por bsrang : rtsa yi gnad ni mig gnyis thad kar blta: rlung gi gnad ni steng rlung 'og rlung bcun: shes pa'i gnad ni ma bcos lhug par bzhag: ces gsung pa ltar nyams len gyi rkang nyid de lus rnam snang chos bdun/ mig thad dkar phyed bkab phyed blta rlung kha sna'i rgyu ba rang bab ngang / bar rlung 'ching ba/sems rnam rtog gsum bral cing grol las 'das rang rig gsal stong dbyer med ngo bo nyid la mnyam par bzhag pa ste/ de yang gu ru pad+mas nam mkha'i snying po'i gdams pa/ 'di ltar yid kyi yul du gyur pa yi/ nyon mongs dug lnga'i rtog pa ci shar yang / /sngon bsu rjes dpyod blo yis bcos mi bzhugasoḥ'agyu ba rang sar bzhag pas chos skur grol/ /zhes pa ltar dang / nyams len mthar thug gi gnad ni/phyi ltar bzung ba'i yul snang dag pa dang / /nang ltar 'dzin pa'i sems nyid grol ba dang ཿོ bar du 'od gsal rang ngo shes pa ru: dus gsum bde gshegs rnams kyi thugs rje yisoḥ bdag 'dra'i rang rgyud grol bar byin gyis rlobs: zhes pa'i don/ bla ma'i zhal lung bzhin rtag tu 'bad pas bsgom pa dang : nyams len gyi gegs sel bogab 'don la mkhas par bya ste/ de'i rtsa ba bla ma'i mos gus nyid stobs bskyed pa kho nar nges shes spyod lam kun tu lam khyer yang dag dran pa dang / sgyu ma ltar snang ba'i sems can rnams la brtse ba'i snying rjes zin pa yang gal che ba nyid do/ /de ltar bskyed rdzogs nyams su len pa'i thun mtha' kun tu lam bsgom pa'i dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo zhing smon lam bzang pos rgyas btab pa dag kyang rgyas bsdus ci ltar rung ma chad pa dang / gzhan yang 'gro sdod kha zas nyal ldang gi rnal 'byor chos spyod spyi ltar dang / 'grub na tshogs kyi 'khor los mchod pa yang ci nus su bya'o/ /33

'dir smras pa/ phyag rgya gcig dang yig 'bru gcig /rig pa nyag gcig ngo bo la/ /bde gshegs yongs rdzogs sku gsung thugs/ /gcig tu dril ba rdzogs pa che/ /rang byung rang shar dgongs pa'i bcud/ /thugs kyi bsgrub pa 'di rmad byung / /de yi rgyun khyer rgyas 'bring bsdus/ /dam pa rnams nas mang mdzad mod/ /'on kyang lam 'dir rang nyid gus thob dang / /skal mnyam gzhan gyi legs par bskul ba bcas/ /rgyun gyi rnal 'byor nyams len snying po'i don/ /gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig las legs par btus/ /'di bgyis dge ba mchis rnams mkha' khyab kyi/ /sems can pha ma'i rang bzhin la bsngo mthus/ /kun kyang lam mchog 'di lta la zhugs nas/ /bla med bla ma'i go 'phang myur thob shog /ces byang gter thugs bsgrub drag po rtsal zhes gu ru bde gshegs 'dus pa'i ngo bo rang byung rang shar don gyi 'phrin las nas nyams len rgyun khyer btus pa yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba 'di ni rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus me stag gi lo nag pa zla ba'i yar ngo dga' ba gnyis pa'i snga thun la stod lung mdo gu ru'i gnas chen gzhong pa lha chur grub par bkod pa dge legs su gyur cig sarba maṅga lo/ bha waskyo/dge'o/ / 34

rog /mkha' 'gro ne gu'i zhal gdams zab lam chos drug gi snying po thog gcig tu dril nas nyams su len pa'i man ngag yang zab bcud kyi thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ne gu ma'i zhal gdams so/ /pha bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsol ba 'debs so skyabs su mchi'o/ /byin gyis rlobs shig /kun khyab bde chen ye shes sku/ /dga' bzhi lhan skyes rdo rje 'chang / /snying po'i don ston 'gro ba'i mgon/ /rtsa ba'i bla mar snying nas 'dud/ /grub pa bye ba'i gtsug rgyan mkha' 'gro ma/ /ni gu'i thugs bcud rgyud sde lnga yi srog /zab lam chos drug grags pa'i snying po'i mchog /gdan thog cig dril man ngag 'di kho na'o/ /zab lam chos drug stan thog gcig tu dril ba ni 'di yin te/ de yang sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la thun mong dang / thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/ dang po thun mong ba ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gnyis yin la/gnyis pa la dag byed a'i stong ra dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de ltar na skyabs sems dag byed stong ra gsum/ spyir khrid yig rgyas pa dang 'dra b.las/ skyabs yul gyi bla ma ma bsdus par bzhag pa la sems skyed kyi rjes su/ stong ra'i gsol 'debs byas nas rang la stim/ de rjes stong ra sgom pa yin/ gnyis pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkha' la gdan bzhi rdzogs kyi stengs su/ bla ma dngos kho na bsgoms/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus su/ ye nas grub par bsgom pa las tshur bstim pa sogs dmigs pa'i spros pa mi dgos/ mos gus kyi gdung shugs drag pos dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor bla ma rin po che/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gi 'dzin blos thongs par mdzad du gsol/ dgos med rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ sgyu lus mi lam 'byongs par mdzad du gsol/'od gsal phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub da lta nyid du/ myur ba nyid du 'dug sa 'di nyid du thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa kho nas gsol ba drag tu btab/ 'di la sems can thams cad snying khongs su bcug pas chog 'gro drug gi dngos su gsol ba 'debs pa'i dmigs pa mi dgos/ mthar bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la bstem pa'i ngang du cung zad mnyam par bzhag go/ /dngos gzhi la gtum mo bsgom par 'dod na/ lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun spyi dang 'dra bar bya ba las/ mig thad kar blta/lag mthil pus mo mnan no/ /rang nyid rdo rje phag mo rang lus dang bzhugs tshul mthun pa gcig 35

bsgom/ rang gi lus kyi nang stong sang sang ba/ lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma chos bzhi ldan ring thung sogs dkyus dang 'dra/ de'i nang lte 'og sor bzhi na ram̐ dmar nag nas 'bru tsam/ lte bar mi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor kyi sran chung tsam gyi steng du a shad dmar ser ring thung sor gang tsam phra mo cig bsgom/de rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i ngo bo yin snyam mos gus dung pa bya/ de nas spyi bor haṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du blta ba dang / steng gi nam mkha' la rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma sku mdog dkar zhing zhal 'dzum pa gzi brjid 'bar ba gcig bsam/ thun gyi mgor rlung ro dgu sprugs su 'bud/ de nas rlung sbyor ba bzhi ldan drag tu bsgom/ dmigs pa ni rlung nyid dbu ma'i mas sna nas zhugs/ ram̐ la bus de las me lce dmar nag ser bzhir 'bar/ bla ma'i ngo bo lte ba'i a shad la bskul/ a shad las me dmar ser 'ur gyis 'bar/spyi bo'i haṃ cung zad zhu/ me lce tshangs bug nas thon te rgya cher 'bar/ me lce'i rtse mo las mchod pa sna tshogs sprul/ bla ma la mchod pa bzhi rdzogs kyi mnyes par byas/ me lce'i 'od las bde drod kyi mchod pa phul/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo bla ma de yang byang chub kyi sems kyi bdud rtsir zhu/ me lce dang lhan cig tshur byon/ tshangs bug nas zhugs/ bdud rtsi spyi bo'i haṃ yig la 'dres/ thig le'i rgyun nar gyi bab/mgrin par sleb pas dga' ba bum dbang / snying gar sleb pas mchog dga' gsang ba dbang lte ba'i shad la thim pas khyad dga' sher dbang / de las kyang bdud rtsi bab pa ram̐ la thim pas/ lhan skyes dang dbang bzhi pa'o/ /zhes dran par bya/ de nas kyang 'bar 'dzag skra shad 'dzings pang kyus dang 'dra ba bsgoms gsungs te/ de yang 'di yin gyi dbu ma'i dbus su 'bar 'dzag gnyis ka rgyun mi chad par me mdun phyogs su 'bar ba dang / byang sems rgyab kyi phyogs su 'bab zhes gsung yang / de shas che ba la dgongs pa yin kyi de yang me'i 'od kyi lus tsha 'u re dang / /byang sems 'od skya ya le bas lus bde cham bsgom pa yang re mos su bya'o/ /'dir khyad par ni ram̐ gyi me dang a shad yi me gcig tu 'dres pa 'bar ba dang / haṃ gi thig le yang a shad brgyud de ram̐ la thim par bsgom pa ni khyad par ro/ /'di ni gtum mo zas su za ba/ byin rlabs bla ma'i gtum mo/ /srid pa'i dbang zhu ba ste gsum dkar dmigs pa gcig la dril ba yin pas gnad shin tu che'o/ /thun 'tshams su dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ yang 'di la gtum mo 'bar ba la sems gtad de rlung drag tu bus pa'i phyi 'dzin khongs 'dren drag po dang / thig le 'bab la sems gtad nas drag tu thubs nas thur sel gyi sgo gnyis la gzir ba dang / de thams cad la sems can nam mkha' la yas su bcug lto ba phyir skyed nas lus bcu zhing / rtsal sprugs drag po byed pa dang / hal zhes brjod pa ni/ thabs lam gnyis pa'i man ngag rlung sbyor gcig la lam rdzogs pa ste/ 'di nye brgyud bka' gsar ba gcig yin no/ /gtum mo gcig ston tshad rang la 'di 'chad pa min/ 36

shin tu gsang ba'o/ /spyir 'di la chos drug stan thog cig ma zer/ gtum mo'i rnal 'byor 'di la yang rgos su gtum mo stan thog cig mar ming 'dogs mdzad/ gzhan sgyu lus sogs re re nas phral ba la de dang de stan thog gcig ma'i tha snyad mi byed do/ /gnyis pa sku lus ni/ rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid mdun nam spyi bo 'am snying gar bsgom kyang rung /gang na bzhugs pa'i phyogs sam mkha' khyab tu bzhugs pa la gsol ba btab kyang rung ste/ pha bla ma pha bla ma bla ma rang mkhyen drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma khyed la gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes mos gdung drag po snying la 'brab pa gcig bsgom nas de'i ngang la lhod kyi bzhag rang lha skur lam tsam gsal btab ste/rang gzhan snang ba thams cad la dmigs nas 'di thams cad med bzhin du snang ba 'khrul pa'i snang ba yin pa la bzang ngan bde sdug chags sdang mtho dman nye ring 'byor rgud dga' mi dga' gtam snyan mi snyan sogs la a 'thas kyi zhen pas spang blang dgag sgrub byed pa 'di rang a re 'khrul/ gtad pa rang ci yod/ rmi lam lta bu rang yin ang zhes sbyangs nas/ g.yas med du chal song de ka la bzo bcos med par bzhag dbang po rab 'bring gi nyams len thams cad de la 'dus/ de ma thag rang lhar gsal ba'am/ tha mal gyi rnam pa gang yin yang rung ste nang stong sang nges ba'i lte 'og tu chos 'byung dang rigs drug bsgom pa sogs 'gro drug sgyu mar 'char byed dang mthun par bsgom ste/ de yang 'di ltar yin kyi lte 'og tu chos 'byung gru gsum kha dog dkar zhing gsal ba/ rtsa ba phra ba/ mthur bstan de gnang sgo'i thad tsam nas mar la zug pa/ gdengs ka che ba gyen du bstan pa'i zur mdun ma de lte ba'i thad dang / zur gzhan gnyis mkhal khung g.yas g.yon gyi phyogs su bstan pa/ dngas gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can gcig bsam/ de la sems gtad pas de'i nang du 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems rnams pa sna tshogs pa rnams lus longs spyod mdog dbyibs cha lugs/ bya byed rnams spyi tshul tha dad pa rang rang gi bde sdug myong tshul sna tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis chos 'byung gi nang khrig mer gyis gang bar bsam/ de yang rang rgyud la 'gro ba tha dad du skye ba len pa'i rgyu las nyon mongs kyi bag chags thams cad rigs drug so so'i gzugs su shar ba yin snyam pa dang / lte 'og na rigs drug gi snang ba 'char ba'i rtsa yig yod pa rnams gzugs brnyan de dang / der shar ba yin pa'i mos pa yang cung zad bya/ de rjes rnam nyid rigs drug dngos yin pa'i tshul du mos pa las sems kyi rtsi kang lte ba'i rigs drug la gtad cing / spyir mkha' khyab kyi sems cad thams cad dmigs yul du byas nas ga re 'di rnams snang ni snang / bden mi bden zhes bden med kyi 'dun pa drag tu sbyangs/ yang 'di rnams bden med la bden par bzung bas 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje snyam/ snying rje brtse lhag pa bsgom/37

yang 'di rnams 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bla mas bskyab tu gsol/ pha bla ma mkhyen snyam pa bla ma'i mos gus kyi gdung shugs dang 'brel bar gsol ba gcig kyang btab bo/ de nas de rnams la sems che re gtad pa na/ rigs drug gi sems can de dag gcig yal/ gnyis yal/ re re nas rim pas yal te/mthar chos 'byung gi nang stong sang song ba la sems gtad/ de rjes nas lus dang chos 'byung la yal ba sogs kyi dmigs pa'i spros pa'ang mi dgos te/ gtad so thams cad dang bral ba'i 'dzin med la shig ge bzhag yang de la ma gnas na rang gzhan snod bcud thams cad la dmigs te sgyu ma lta bu'o/ /med bzhin du snang ba'o/ /snang bzhin du ma grub pa'o zhes shes par bya'o/ /des dmigs pa tshar gcig song / de nyid yang yang bsgom pa'o/ /'di la dmigs pa gtad so'i gnas brgyad yod de/ chos 'byung la dmigs pa/ rigs drug la dmigs pa/ 'gro drug bden med du sbyang ba snying rje bskyed pa/ bla ma'i gsol 'debs/ rigs drug stong par sbyong ba/ rang bab skyong ba snang srid sgyu ma'i 'dun pa'o/ /lar dmigs pa gcig la 'di bas zab pa med ces gsungs/ mthun mtshams kyi nyams len ni/ 'di la'ang 'dun pa sum sgrags kho na ste/ de yang dang po nyid nas 'dun pa gsum po gang rung cig sleb par bya snyams pa tsam gyis gar yang mi rung bas/ thog mar gang yang rung ba gcig thun mtshams su slebs pa'i thabs la 'bad/ tshul de gsum kar la re re bzhin du bslabs nas/ mthar gsum po gang rung re dang ma bral bar bya snyams pa'i 'dun pa btang na gang rung re dang ma bral bar yong ba yin/ dper na/thog mar thun mtshams su 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i 'dun pa rtag tu sleb par bya snyams pa'i go cha gyon nas thun mtshams su mi rtag pa gang dran thub thub bya/ tshul de lta bu'i thun mtshams su dran pa'i bya ra bas gzhur na zla ba gcig gam gnyis tsam na/ thun 'tshams phal cher du mi rtag pa'i 'dun pas sleb 'ongs/de byung na re zhig de bor nas tshul de khas bla ma'i mos gus la bslab/ de yang byung ba na/ yang re zhig gnyis ka bor naspu sgyu ma'i 'dun pa la tshul de kas bslab/ de yang thun mtshams phal cher du byung na/de rjes gsum po gang rung gcig dang ma bral ba'i 'dun pa tsam btang bas/ gsum po gang rung re dang ma bral bar yongs ba yin no/ /'di la dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyi gnad so sor tshang ba yin kyang gcig tu dril nas bsgom pa yin pas dmigs skor cig kho na'o/ / gsum pa zi lam la/ bzungs ba dang / sbyangs ba dang / yul snang blta ba'o/ /dang po ni/rang zin thig le dbang bzhi yi gnad kho na ste/ de yang 'di lta ste/ rang lus lha sku gsal stong du shar ba'i lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma kha dog dkar la dngas gsal shel gyi spubs lta bu/ yar sna spyi bo dang /mar sna gsang bar gzugs pa/ dbu ma'i nang gi yas snar haṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du blta ba dang mas 38

snar hūṃ dmar po mgo gyen du blta ba gcig gsal btab/ gang shar la spyir bden med dang / rgos su rmi lam du shes pa'i rtsis bzung nas bsgom pa gcig thams cad du gal che/ spyi bo'i haṃ las thig le dkar po sran ma tsam gcig hril gyis chad snying gar slebs/ nyon mongs pa gti mug dag /snying ga yan chad khog stod yang chod pa'am/ bde chos kyis song bar bsam/ gsang ba'i hūṃ las thig le dmar po sran rdog tsam gcig yar chad snying gar slebs/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dag rkang pa man chad khog smad yang chod pa'am bde chod kyis song / dkar dmar gnyis po snying gar 'dzoms/ zhe sdang ni rang dag la seng / snying gi thad bde song ba dang yang chod kyi song bar bsam/ de nas dbu ma'i nang snying ga'i thad kyi khong stong der/ thig le 'bros 'dod kyi tshul du 'khor ba la sems gtad/ 'khor tshul g.yasajibaskor dang g.yon bskor rang gi blo la gang bde yin/ de la sems gtad de/ rmi lam yin snyams pa'i 'dun pa gsum bzhi zhig bya/ de nas thig le gnyis pa de gcig rjes gcig gis zin pa'i tshul gyi reg tsam reg tsam 'dug cing 'khor ba la sems gtad/ rmi lam yin snyam 'dun pa drag tu sbyangs/ de rjes yang sngar bzhin las reg pa la brten nas lus sems bde chil yong bar mos/ de la'ang sgyu ma'i 'dun pa sbyangs/ de nas dkar po dmar po la thim/ dkar po yal ba'am/ de go bzlog kyang rung ste/gang ltar yang gcig la gcig shos thim/ de yang gtad yal du song bar bsam/ de ka'ingang la ci yang mi bsam par cung zad bzhag de nas yang rang gzhan snang ba thams cad la sems gtad de/ 'di thams cad snang ni snang / bden ni mi bden snyams pa dang / khyad par du yang nga gnyid du song 'dugasnang ba 'di thams cad rmi lam rang yin pa 'dug snyams pa'i 'dun pa drag tu sbyong ste/ dmigs pa tshar gcig song / yang rtsa dbu ma gsal 'debs pa sogs yangatshonas yang du de kho na bskyar kyin bsgom/de ltar dmigs pa de tshar gsum tsam re bsdud nas 'jur bar bsgom pa'i rjes su/ rang gzhin snod bcud dgra gnyen longs spyod thams cad la zhen med kyi 'dun pa drag tu sbyangs zhing / de ka'i ngang la gang shar gzo med du 'jog tshul de lta bu yang yang goms par byed pa yin no/ /gnyis pa sbyangs ba ni/ 'dun pas sbyangs ba kho na yin te/ de yang / nga'i lus na tsha sdug bsngal bskyed par byed pa de mal na yod par 'dug snang ba 'di rmi lam gyi snang ba yin/ lus 'di rmi lam gyi yid lus yin/ rmi lam gyi snang ba dang / yid kyi lus la ci sbyangs sbyangs su 'gro ba yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po rgyun chags su byas nas rang gi mdun 'dug pa'i ka ba gyang brtsigs pa thog phug sogs la yar thal mar thal tshur thal thogs med du sbyangs/ gzhan yang dkar khungs phra mo la 'dzul ba sogs dang / g.yang sa dang / chu dang / me dang / gcan zan sogs la thog brdzis su byed pa dang / 39

nam mkha' la 'phur pa dang / sa la 'dzul ba dang / chu'i steng nas chags pa sogs mdor na ci dran dran gyi tshul gyis sbyangs bas chog pa las/ khyad par du rnam rtog 'tshom dka' ba'i rigs/ 'dzin chags kyi dngos po dang / 'jigs skrags dang / ya nga dang / ngo tsha dang / skyug bro skye ba'i rigs rnams la/ res 'ga' thugs 'phrad du thog brdzis bya/ res dga' sgyu ma rmi lam gyi 'dun pas bza' gtad med par bya/ /res 'ga' nyams nga med par bzlog bsgom bya/ /res 'ga' skad cig gcig la thogs med du brtsom ste/ /kun kyang sgyu ma lta bu'i 'dun pa dang / /rang bzhin dbyings kyi ngang skyong ba de gal che'o/ /gsum pa yul snang ni/ rang gi snying gar rdu yig dkar po dngas gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin gcig bsgom/ /rmi lam sgyu ma'i 'dun pa dang / /yul snang lta 'dod drag tu bya/ /r+ghaṃ las 'od kyi thag pa lta bu gcig rgyangs te 'phros/ gang lta 'dod pa'i dngos po de zhags pas drangs pa ltar tshur byung nas snying ga'i rdu la thim/ phroṃ gi 'od kyis snang ba thams cad khra gsal le gsal ba la sems gtad de bsgom/skabs 'dir bum can bsgom pa gal che lar/ ma zin 'byams dang gol pa gsum/ bsod nams tshogs kyis bcad par bya/ ces 'byung ba/ mi lam sgyu lus kyi skabs su gal che ba bzhed/bzhi pa 'od gsal la/ 'od gsal 'dzin pa'i dmigs pa'i gtso bo yin pas/ bla ma la brten nas 'dzin pa de nges par bsgom dgos te/ rang nyid tha mal 'am yi dam lhar gsal ba'i snying gar pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma sku sha gdangs dkar zhing 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/ zhal 'dzum mu le/ spyan sims me bzhugs pa gcig bsgom/ sku che chung gi tshad kyang che na sor bzhi tsam/ chung na mthe bo'i tshad tsam/ de bar ci ltar 'os pa bsgom/ de yi thugs kar thig le dkar la dmar mdangs chags pa'i shin tu dkar ba gang bsgom kyang rung / tshad kyang bla ma'i sku las dpag nas bya ste/ sku gzugs sor bzhi tsam bsgom na de rgya sran tsam sku mthe bong bsgom na/ de sran chung tsam bsgom/ des bar ma rnams la'ang mtshon/ gang ltar bla ma'i thugs ka'i theg le 'od 'phro ba de la sems gtad de yud tsam mnyam par bzhag thugs ka'i thig le las 'od 'phros sku khra gsal te khyab/thugs brgyud bde bas gang / sku'i cha thams cad nas 'od zer byung / rang lus kyi nang shin tu gsal bar khyab/ rang gi ba spu'i khung bu nas 'od zer 'phros/ snang ba thams cad khra gsal gyi khyab par bsam/bla ma'i thugs ka'i thig le la 'gyang tsam sems gtad/ de nas 'od zer spro ba'i dmigs pa re byed pa slar nas slar du gom par bya'o/ /nyal tshe bla ma'i thugs ka'i r+ghaṃ las sems gtad de nyal ste/ de kas zin na legs/ ma zin na rno khyad du a yig la brten nas 'dzin pa yin te/ rang gi dbu ma'i mas snar a dkar po bsgom/ steng rlung nan nan 'og rlung then then byas pas/ a de gsang ba'i rtsa bar lhan lhan 40

song / gsang ba'i rtsa lam nas gcud kyog kyog pa'i ngang nas rdo rje nor bu'i dbus su kha dog sngon po 'od 'tsher ba gcig tu gyur/ mgo nang stan du log shugs drag pas phyi la 'gro 'dod kyang bu ga dog po la ma shong bas 'gro mi thub par lhan lhan 'dug pa la yud cig sems drag tu gtad/ yang de ka'i snang ba ma 'gags tsam la had de chad de bzhag de ltar yang yang bsgom/ 'od gsal 'dzin lug spyi dang 'dra/ 'dzin pa la lhag par bsngags so/ /'di kho nas gnyid kyi 'od gsal zin 'ong / ston thog gcig ma rang gi gsal gyi dmigs pa de phyi ma 'di kho na yin/ bla ma la brten pa'i dmigs pa de/ spyi'i khog phubs rgyab rten yin gyi/ stan thog gcig ma'i skabs kyi dmigs pa rang min no/ /a la brten pa 'di rten bud med kyis bsgom na/ lte 'og sor brgyad tsam du dbu ma'i mas snang sleb pa'i mas sna de kar bsgom/ rlung gi gnad sogs gzhan 'dra'o/ /de ltar gdan thog gcig dril rtsa ba'i chos bzhi po de thams cad cha tshangs bsgoms na/ thog mar re re bzhin zla ba gnyis gsum sbyangs bas nyams myong sne re rnyed 'ong / de rjes nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi nang du bzhi bcar bsgom na/ tho rangs nas snga thun la gtum mo/ /gung thun la sgyu lus dgong thun la rmi lam/ sred thun la 'od gsal bsgom zhes khrigs ka 'di bzhin yang mdzad/ 'on kyang mtha' gcig tu ma nges so/ /de bzhin du bzhi car bsgom par mi nus na/ gsum sdeb sam/ gnyis sdebs sam/ re re bsgom pas kyang don khyad par can 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /stan thog gcig ma ces pa yang rtsa ba'i chos bzhi po la rtsi ba yin te/ 'pho ba bar do kha skongs yin pas rgyas bsdus gang bstan kyang 'dra'o/ /gsung nas go babs lhod yangs su mdzad kyang lag len du 'di ltar mdzad de/ 'pho na ni spyi bo tshangs bug brgya mthong kha phye ba bzhin du yod par bsgom/ a la brten pa'i 'od gsal 'dzin pa de kho na bzhin las/ lte 'og sor bzhi a de rlung phyir 'bud pa dang / lhan gcig dbu ma'i lam nas brgyud/ nam mkha'i dbus su mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du seng nas mkha' dbyings mthon por yal bar bsgom/ yang a de nam mkhar grub/ mar babs tshangs bug nas zhugs te dbu ma'i mas snar phyin par bsam/ 'di la 'gro 'ong spel ma rang bsgom pas chog sgo dgag pa'ang mi dgos gsung ngo / /drug pa bar do ni/ rang gi mdun du chos 'byung bsgom pa nas/ spyi bor bla ma bsgom pa'i bar gzhung khrid kyi dbang po 'bring dang 'dra ba ste tshul de yang ci ltar bsgom na thog mar rang dang sna ba thams cad la bltas te/ srid pa bar do dngos yin snyams pa'i 'dun pa'ang drag po sbyangs/ 'gro drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang / chags sdang nyon mongs kyi nyes dmig dran pa'i skyo shas drag po yang bya/bar do'i skabs 'dir 'khrul na 'khrul tshabs che ste chags sdang gi rnam rtog re res kyang skad cig la 41

dmyal bar yang skyur thub/ lam bsgom na 'grol tshabs yang che ste/ da lta sad dus su lo zlar bsgom pa las kyang / 'dir dar cig re bsgom pa yang bogs dang chod che ba yin/ da nyon mongs kyi dbang du mi gtong bar ma 'khrul ba gcig byed dgos/ bla mas gnang ba'i bar do rgyal ba longs sku bsgom par bya snyams du bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du chos 'byung sngon po rtsa ba phra zhing gdeng kha gyen du bstan pa cig bsgom/ 'di rang bzhin ma rtogs pa rnams la ma'i mngal du 'dug rtogs pa rnams la 'og min chos kyi pho brang rang yin ang snyam du bsam par bya/ de nas rang nyid de'i dbus su phyin/rang sems hūṃ yig sngon po che zhing 'od 'bar ba gcig tu gyur/ de las 'od 'phros chos 'byung la phoga'adas pa'i mngal skyes kyi lan chags dang bag chags thams cad sbyangs/ da lta ba'i mngal skyes kyi las thams cad dag ma 'ongs pa skye bar 'gyur ba sgo bkag skye gnas gzhan gsum gyi bag chags rnams zhor la rang dag par bsam/ bar do yin ang snyam rdu de yongs su gyur pa las rang skad cig gis 'khor lo bde mchog lhan skyes bsgom/ bar do yin ang snyam spyi bor gdan bzhi rdzogs steng du bla ma bsgom/ bar do'i skabs 'dir longs sku thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes rtse gcig tu gsol ba btab/de ltar dmigs pa bsgom pa'i skabs thams cad du bar do rang yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa rgyun chags gal che/ gnad chug med kyi dod la 'gro ba'i rigs drug gi gnas dang / gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya bzang ngan thams cad la sgyu ma dang / bar do'i 'dun pa sbyangs/ mngal sgong gi gnyis sbyor sogs gsal btab nas bar dor shes pas yi dam yab yum du gyur/ de la'ang mngon zhen med par sgyu ma lta bu'o/ /zhes dran par byed pa yin/ yan lag gi chos 'di gnyis kyang nye brgyud kyi cha shas cung zad yin/ de ltar na ston thog cig mar bsdud tshul 'di sngon chad yi ger 'khod pa cher med pa'i zhal rgyun yin/gtum mo'i rlung sbyor gnyis pa dang yul snang dang / a yi 'od gsal dang / yan lag gi chos 'di gnyis la dmigs pa'i lte bsgyur cung zad te yod pa 'di nye brgyud yin gsungs te/ yul snang dang 'od gsal yang yig snying gis zin pa lags/ gzhan rnams ni man ngag snying po kho na'o/ /zhes rje btsun bla ma dam pa sgrol ba'i mgon pos gsungs so/ /de ltar ne gu'i zab chos rtsa ba dang yan lag bcas pa nyams su len pa spyir gces pa'i gnad du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor shes shing /sangs rgyas las kyang lhag pa'i mos gus ldem rgyang med pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin la/ yan lag bla ma kun kyang de yi sgyu 'phrul du rtogs pas/ dag snang sbyangs ba ni lam gyi srog rtsa dam pa med thabs med pa dang / rang gi sems nyid kyang rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba/ de yang stong pa chos sku/ snang ba sprul sku/dbyer med rang rig rang gsal longs skur shes te/ de nyin mtshan kun tu ma yengs dran pas lam khyer 42

du spyod cing / de yi ngang du rlung bum can 'jam rlung / bar rlung ji nus bcas pas/ gsal stong /bde stong kun sgyu ma lta bur shes shing / sgyu ma lta bur 'dzin pa yang / 'dzin med phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du bzhag ste/ de mnyam bzhag gyi nyams len/ rjes thob spyod lam thams cad du bsre/ bar bya ni gnad dam pa yin la/ rgyun du kun da byang sems mi nyams pa dang / rnam rtog tha mal rang khar mi 'chor ba yang rnal 'byor pa'i dam tshig lags/ de bzhin nyams myong gi ye shes/ gsal stong 'dzin med snang stong rang shar/ bde stong zhen bral du skyong ba la/ rnam rtog sems/ sems skye med mtha' bral du shes pa'i nus pas gang shar la gzo med du bltas pas 'char sgo'i rang tshug zhig nas snang stong ris med kyi rang 'gros su 'jog pa dang / skabs su snang rig chos kun sgyu ma lta bur ar la gtad de bsgom pa yang gal che ba ste/ gzhan yang bsgos pa'i nus pas/ lus nyams 'jam rtsub/ ngag nyams smra rgod/ sems nyams bde sdug ci byung yang / de la dga' mi dga' med pa sgyu ma ltar shes nas byung / rgyal du brkyang pa dang / rig pa'i rang rtsa dge sbyor ci tsam skyes pa de bla ma'i bka' drin du shes nas gsol ba btab cing / de ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje bskyed pa rnams ni bogs 'don gyi rtsa ba'o/ /de ltar bsgom pas dge sbyor ched gtad kyi rtsol ba ma byas par/ rang shar ba'i sems gsal stong bde ba mi rtogs par shar ba ni 'od gsal dang / blos bskyed 'dod kyi blo mngon 'gyur drag po med bzhin/ lha sku'i snang ba gsal dngas wa ler shar ba ni sgyu lus kyi lha sku rang shar zhes bya ste/ bsgom chen rnams kyi glen gtam du gda'/ 'di 'drar rtog ge mgo 'khregs po tshos brgal yang thang stong kyi zug par gtad pa med pa ltar go zhing / rgyud sde mkhyen pa'i nga rgyal can tsho mi 'gu yang / tshe gang bsgug sdud byas yang 'byung bar dka' ba'i chos go yul gyi bshad pa khrig khrig kam kam zab zab legs legs kyi sgyu lus 'od gsal che la khos pa las/ las dang po nas phan thogs pa'i tshegs chung don che ba rkyen dang 'phrad dus sleb cing / sems la phan pa 'di 'dra/ nged sgom chen du grags pa rnams kyi chos skal du byung /rang sa nas blo gtad thub par 'dug pas mkhas pa tshos rkyen yang 'jigs rgyu ni mi 'dug la/ lar rgyud sde chen po nas gsungs pa'i sgyu lus 'od gsal gyi rtsa ba yang 'di yin par 'dug pas 'bras bu la smon zhing rtsa ba la smod pa de mi mdzad pa zhu/ zhes pa yang skabs kyi gtam ste de dag kyang gal che bar bstan pa'o/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas bsgrub la dam pa'i chos/ /gcig chog rin chen dbang gi rgyal po bzhin/ /ma nor rmad byung zab lam 'di 'dra ba/ /bskal bzang bu yod 'di la nyams len rig /tshul 'di 'gro kun sgrol mgon gsungs/ /bdud rtsi'i mtsho las bcud len du/ /phyung bstan dge mchis 'gror bsngo mthus/ /kun kyang 'chi med rgya thob shog /de skad tshe dbang nor bus te/ /nyes mchis srid 43

na mkha' 'gro yi/ /nyes med dbugs dbyung rtsal nas kyang / /'gro phan rgya chen grub gyur cig /ces ye shes mkha' 'gro ne gu'i zhal lung zab lam chos drug gdan thog gcig tu dril ba'i nyams len yi ge 'di jo nang rje btsun dam pa sgrol ba'i mgon po'i gsung zab thang mar brdal ba ma bu las khyer bde bar shākya'i dge bsnyen rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus rang lo bzhi bcu'i bsgrangs bya la reg nye ba me sbrul mgo zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi tshes 7mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus chen nyi ma me bzhi'i 'grub sbyor skabs su gu ru'i bsgrub gnas yul yar lung shel gyi brag phug tu sbyar ba ste ye shes gnyis par spel ba po dge slong kun bzang gzhan phan no/ /dge'o/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i nyams len nus na chos 'di kho nas kyang chog par brdog nges kyi/ yi ge 'di bkod pa'i dus mkha' 'gro'i ltas dang cho 'phrul rgyun mi chad par byung bas gnyan la byin brlabs chen po yod pa'i nges shes skyes so/ /bkra shis/dge'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/

༄ga /rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che byang phyogs su 'byung ba'i rtsa lag bod rje lha btsan po'i gdung rabs tshig nyung don gsal yid kyi me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ suste/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che byang phyogs su 'byung ba'i rtsa lag bod rje lha btsan po'i (gdung )rabs tshig nyung don gsal yid kyi me long zhes bya ba/ na mo lo ke shwa rā ya/ o ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/de yang ri kha ba can gyi ljongs mi yi bdag po 'phags mchog sprul pa'i sku 'jig rten dbang phyug srong btsan sgam po me glang lor sku bltams/ dgung lo bcu gsum pa sa glang la rgyal srid bzung / dgu bcu rtsa bzhi lcags pho khyi yi lo la sku 'od kyi gong bur gyur nas 'phags pa'i thugs kar thim/ bar der lha sras gung srong bcu bdun mthar khrir bkod de dgung lo bcu dgu bzhes nas sku zhi bar gshegs zhes grags pas/ lo ngo gsum rgyal srid mdzad kyang sras sku na phra bas rgyal srid rags pa yab nas bzhes pa dang / de nas sras gshegs pas slar rgyal srid bskyar nas mdzad cing / de ltar dgu bcu rtsa bzhi la lo bcu gnyis kyis 'phris shing sras kyis rgyal srid skyong ba'i lo hril po gnyis ma bsgrang na srid dngos la lo brgyad cu dang / sras kyi de yang lo khongs su brtsis na brgyad cu rtsa gnyis te/ bka' chems las/ brgyad cu rtsa gnyis rgyal po'i lo/ /lon nas rgyal po 'gro gsungs te/ /zhes pa yang de la dgongs shing / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud nas rgyal srid lo brgyad cu mdzad par lung bstan pa dang yang 'grig phyis kyi mkhas pa kha cig gis sa glang la 'khrungs zhes gsungs te/ de ni sa glang yin pa'i sgrub byed lcags khyi la gshegs par byed na lo rgyus de rigs thams cad mthun par me glang la 'khrungs zhes gsungs pas de gnyis gcig gis gcig ga la 'gog nus/ chos rje g.yam bzang pa'i gsung rgyun la byed na/ deb sngon du de yi lung drangs pa/ nga nyid lnga brgya tha ma'i tshe/ /bzhi brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga na/ /lho phyogs g.yor po'i rgyal khams su/ /glang chen gser gyi lo la 'khrungs/ /mtshan ni dharma pra ṇi zhes/ /rgyal po 'di skad gsungs zhes par//dam pa'i chos rnams 'chad par byed/ /ces gsungs pa de yang zhal du 'don zhes bris mod/ de ni rgyal po lcags glang la gshegs nas bzhi brgya nyi shu rtsa lngar shing stag gam shing yos gang rigs 'char bar nges pas g.yam bzang ba'i 'khrungs lo sa glang dang bsgrigs mi nus te mngon sum nyid du 'gal lo/ /g.yam bzang chos rje'i lung bstan bka' chems tho ling mar yod pa ni/ deb sngon du bris pa dang lo tshigs mi mthun te/ 'di skad du/ gson cig blon po 'gar gyis sna drangs nang blon bdun/ /bdag ni 45

lcags pho khyi yi lo la 'das gyur nas/ /gcig nas gnyis su bsgrangs pa'i lnga brgya nyi shu na/ /g.yor po'i rgyal khams gangasdo kyi ri rgyud du/ /dge slong dharma pra ṇi zhes bya bar/ /glang chen gser gyi lo la sku 'khrungs nas/ /khyod kyis sna drangs nang blon bdun po rnams/ /sras su khyod 'khrungs gzhan yang mjal bar gyur/ /zhes glegs bam rnying nges rnams su tshig zur 'dra min 'dug kyang dngos don lo tshigs gcig tu byung bas/ lnga brgya nyi shu ni lcags khyi nas sa glang dang 'grig par ma zad/ bdag gis 'dir bkod lo grangs dang ched du ma bsgrigs bzhin rang bzhin gyis shin tu 'grigs pas ya mtshan no/ /deb sngon sogs kha cig gi 'dod pa ltar na lo drug cu skor gcig 'phris dgos par gsal lo/ /gang ltar g.yam bzang bas sa glang la 'khrungs rgyur gsungs pa las/ chos rgyal sa glang la 'khrungs pa'i sgrub byed med la 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud kyis lung bstan pa ni/ rgyal srid mdzad pa'i tshad las sku tshe'i tshad ma yin pa/ lo ni brgyad cu rgyal srid byas/ /zhes tshig mngon sum pas gsal ba ste/ des na 'khrungs lo dang rgyal srid bzung ba'i lo phyed pa gal che la/ 'dir bshad pa ni sngar gyi yig rnying khungs ldan mtha' dag par me glang la 'khrungs zhes mgrin gcig tu yod pa rang bzos rtogs mi dgos shing / lcags khyi la gshegs pa bcas 'thad cing rig la yid 'ches pa'i gnas so/ /de ltar 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bod kyi rgyal por sprul pa de nyid gdung rabs ji snyed bcas 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud du 'di skad ces lung bstan te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan 'di la//rnam pa sna tshogs bya ba byed/ /byang gi phyogs la brten nas ni/ /de yi tshe na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /lha ldan yul zhes bya ba yi/ /gangs can ri yi nang gnas pa'i/ /rgyal po mi yi lha zhes pa/ /li tsa byi rnams rigs su 'khrungs/ /de yang sngags kyi don sgrub ste/ /longs spyod tshe dang ldan par gyur/ /rig pa longs spyod ldan zhes bya/ /mi yi bdag po de yang grub/ /lo ni brgyad cur rgyal srid byas/ /des ni rkun ma rnam par spangs/ /rgyas po des ni srog spangs nas/ /de yang sngags ni myur 'grub ste/ /zhi dang rgyas pa bsil byed pa'o/ /'jig rten sgrol ma zhes grags dang / /lha mo gos dkar mo dang ni/ /dkar mo chen mo gzhan phan btson (brtson/) rtag tu yid ni mi skyo ba'o/ /de la sogs pa gsungs pa yi/ /de bzhin rgyal po mang po ni/ /rnam pa du ma mang po dag kha dog sna tshogs sna tshogs gzugs/ /kha ba can gnas kla klo'i rgyal/ /de yang ston pa mchod byed pa'o/ /khyu mchog khyu mchog bzang po dang / /sa 'od de bzhin sa 'od bzang / /de bzhin pha rol gnon nyid dang / /rkang pa'i 'gros shes bstan pa yin/ /sa srung dang ni be'u dang / /'od ldan nyid ni phyi ma yin/ /tha mar 'char rgyal ngang tshul te/ /kla klo'i rnam pa sna tshogs yin/ /de 'og lugs/ ni rnam zhig cing / /phyi rol skye dgu'i nye bar spyod/ /ces lung bstan pa yin te/ /de la bod kyi 46

mkhas pa du ma mthun pa nyid dang / 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal bas 'di skad gsungs te/ byang gi phyogs dang kha ba can ni grags che zhing / lha ldan ni lha sa'o/ /lo brgyad cu rgyal srid byed pa ni lo brgyad cu rtsa gnyis bzhugs shing bar du gung srong gung btsan gyis kyang rgyal srid cung zad mdzad pa'o/ /sgrol ma dang gos dkar mo dang dkar mo chen mo ni btsun mo'i mchog gsum ste/ kong jo dang bal mo bza' dang 'bring bza' ma thod dkar ro/ /li tsa byi'i rigs su byung ba ni/ yangs pa can pa'i rgyud yin pa'o/ /kla klo'i rgyal po ni nub phyogs ta zhig (zig )gi yul la dbang byed pa'o/ /de bzhin du rgyal po mang po ni 'og nas 'byung ba rnams te/ khyu mchog ni mang srong ngo / /khyu mchog bzang ni klung nam mo/ sa 'od ni mes ag tshom mo/ sa 'od bzang ni khri srong lde'u btsan no/ /pha rol gnon ni mu ne btsan po'o/ /rkang pa'i 'gros ni khri lde srong btsan no/ /sa srung ni ral pa can no/ /be'u ni glang dar ma'o/ /'od ldan ni 'od srung ste/ ldan pa dang srung ba la a ba ti zer ba'i phyir ro/ /tha ma 'char rgyal ngang tshul ni/ nyi ma 'char ba'i phyogs nas bod la dbang byed pa'i hor rgyal po yin zhes 'ga' zhig 'dod la/ shar kha zhes pa'i lung 'dir rgyal po dpal 'khor btsan yin yang rung ngo / /de nas bod spyi la dbang byed pa'i rgyal po med pas lugs rnam par zhig go/ /zhes smras pa gzhan ni de ltar mi 'thad pa med kyang btsun mo'i skabs rgya bal bza' dang mang (mong )bza' khri lcam bsgrangs dgos la/ gung btsan gyi rgyal srid lo gnyis srong btsan gyi rgyal srid lo khongs su ma bsdus pa rung yang srong btsan gyis rgyal srid mdzad pa'i brgyad cu sku tshe'i tshad du byas pa ni mi legs pa dang / gong du gung srong gi lung bstan hor khongs su bzhag nas pha rol gnon mu ne btsan por 'dzin pa yang mi 'thad de/ pha rol gnon khri srong lde btsan dang / rkang pa'i 'gros ni khri srong gi sras rnams kyis rgyal srid rim pas mdzad pa la dgongs par bdag gi rnam rtog ste/ don du yang der nges la/ 'char rgyal ngos 'dzin yang dpyad byar snang ngo / /de ltar 'jig rten dbang phyug bod rje'i mi yi lha srong btsan sgam po'i zhabs lcags khyi la sprul pa bsdus pa'i skabs mang srong sa khyi lo pa bcu gsum bzhes shing / de nas rgyal srid lo nyer drug bzung /me byi la gshegs/ yab gshegs nas zhag bdun lon pa na sras 'dus srong mang po rje bltams zhes lo rgyus mang zhig tu 'byung yang / thang gi yig tshangs sogs kha cig tu mes gshegs pa'i lcags khyi nas lo sum cu bar rgyal srid mdzad nas sa yos lor gshegs/ lo de la mang srong khrir 'khod smras pa 'thad par sems la/ 'dus srong 'khrungs lo byi ba yin zhes gtan tshigs phal cher 'grigs pas de tshe dgung lo bzhi lon pa'i skabs su zhes so/ /'dus srong mang po rjes rgyal srid lo so brgyad mdzad pa'i 'brug lo'i dpyid sras khri lde gtsug brtan bltams/ dgun der yab gshegs nas lo phyi mar khri lde gtsug 47

brtan rgyal por mnga' gsol zer ba yi ge mang bas de tshe mes kyi dgung rta (rtags )me 'brug tu song /des rgyal srid lo don bzhi byas pa dang / re brgyad dang re gsum dang nga lnga dang nga gcig byas pa sogs du ma mthong zhing mang (po )zhig yab gshegs skabs su sras khri srong lde'u btsan dgung lo bcu gsum lon par 'dod pa thang yig sogs dang mthun rung / rgyal rabs kha cig tu yab gshegs nas sras lo bdun pa'am brgyad par khri la 'khod ces byung ba blon po gdug pa rnams kyis khrims bu chung bca' tshul la dpag (na )sku na phra mor yab gshegs par 'thad pas (de ni rgyal thabs ji bzhin rang nyid kyis skyong nus pa'i dus brnyes pa'i thog ma la dgongs par 'don ('dod )la/ chos dbang zhabs kyis gnam skas kyi gter lo lnga brgya rtsa gsum na 'dod par gsungs pa yang rgya dkar du rgyal po da lta ba'i lo brtsi ba'i lugs srol ltar bcu gsum lcags rta nas bsgrangs pa gsal (dpal )gyi bsam yas kyi rmang bting ba'i dus de las lo brgyad kyi phyi ba sa stag la yin zer yang gnam skas kyi gter sba ba'i dus rags rtsis su 'gal ba med la/ 'on kyang 'di la zhib mor bya dgos pas 'dir bri mi long bas gzhan du spro'okhrides na mes kyis me sbrul nas rgyal srid lo re bdun byas pa'i chu phag dgongs (dgung )lo re brgyad par sku gshegs/ de tshe sras khri srong lde'u btsan sa rta lo pa dgung lo drug bzhes shing / bdun pa shing byi lor khrir 'khod pa'o/ /gzhan thang gi yig tshangs ltar na mang srong gi rgyal srid lo sum cu/ 'dus srong gis rgyal srid lo nyer drug mes ag tshom can gyis nga gcig byas pa tshal pa'i deb dmar du bris pas/ de tshe srong btsan gshegs pa'i lcags khyi nas mes ag tshom can gshegs pa'i shing lug bar lo brgya dang nyag drug song / 'dir bstan chu phag las lo nyer brgyad kyi nyung ba tsam ste/ lo 'di la lhag chad yod par mngon pas slar rgya nag gi yig tshang zhib mo gzhan du dpyad nas bgyid yang (bgyid kyang )'dod do/ /'dir khri srong lde'u btsan dgung lo bdun la khrir bzhugs/ rgyal srid lo zhe dgu byas/ lnga bcu chu glang lor lha sras mu ne btsan por rgyal srid gtad/ rgya yi yig tshangs ltar na chu glang de nas brgyad lon pa re gsum lcags sprel la gshegs zhes dang / sngags rnying ma'i lo rgyus mang (po )zhig dang / bu ston zhabs nas re dgu me stag la sku gshegs par bzhed la gter lung kha cig par re brgyad glang lo 'brug zla'i nya la gshegs par gsungs te/ de gsum las re zhig phyi ma bzung na sras la rgyal srid gtad nas lo bcu gnyis 'das shing / (lo )ngo bcu gsum pa shing glang lor sku gshegs/ 'phags mchog srong btsan sgam po lcags khyi lor gshegs nas lo brgya dang nyer brgyad 'das pa'i sa rta lor khri srong lde'u btsan 'khrungs/ de shing glang la gshegs tshe mes gshegs nas brgya go lnga 'das so/ /de rjes sras mu ne btsad pos rgyal srid lo gcig dang zla ba dgu'am bdun nam gsum bzung zhes dang / yab gshegs nas zla ba drug na sku gshegs zhes kyang yod la/ de nas mu rug btsad po rgyal srid du bzhugs par brtsams kyang mi rings bar chibs kyis brdabs te grongs zhes mang ( 48

po )zhig mthun yang mu rug gshegs pa'i bang so rgyal po khri rabs kyi gnas su yod pas yun ring thung las rgyal srid kyi khrir bzhugs par byas pa nyid 'thad do/ /yang kha cig nas mu rug dang mu tig gcig par 'dod pa ni mi legs so/ /de nas mu khri dang mu tig tha dad kyis rgyal srid rim par byas zhes dang /mu khri dang mu tig gcig par 'dod pa'i lugs gnyis las 'dod pa phyi ma rang gi blo la ran pas slar dpyad dgos dang / re zhig 'dir snga ma nyid bzhed pa po mang bas de dang phyogs mthun du bkod na mu khri btsan po yab gshegs pa'i skabs su dgung lo nyer gnyis te/ de nas lo gsum 'das pa rang lo nyer lnga sa 'brug la khrir byon/ de nas lo drug pa chu bya la gu ru rin po che srin po 'dul du gshegs/ mu khris rgyal srid lo brgyad mdzad nas so gnyis shing phag la gshegs/ de'i tshe gcung khri lde srong btsan nam mtshan gyi rnam grangs mu tig btsad po ste shing stag lo pa dgung lo bzhi ba'i skabs nyams sad pa'i phyir khrir bkod nas yab kyis nor bu'i cod pan bcings pas bkra shis pa'i ltas mang du byung zhing / dbu rgyan nor bu'i ljid kyis dbu cung zad yo bas sad na legs 'jing yon tu mtshan gsol ba de bcu gnyis par yab khri srong lde'u btsan gshegs/ nyer gnyis la gcen gshegs pas seng ge'i khrir mnga' gsol/ rgyal srid lo ngo snga phyi gnyis bsdoms pa'i nyer gcig mdzad/ skar (dkar )chung rdo rje dbyings kyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ zhe gnyis shing lug lor gshegs/ mu khri dang sad na legs gnyis ka'i rgyal srid kyi lo gang po ni nyer bdun te/ khri srong lde'u btsan gshegs nas sum cu tham pa 'gro/ kha cig mu tig gi sras khri lde srong btsan nam sad na legs yin par sems pa ni skar (dkar )chung rdo rings kyi yi ge (dang )dngos su 'gal bas sad na legs khri srong lde'u btsan nyid kyi sras su nges par yang dag par bzung bar bya'o/ /lha sras khri ral yab sad na legs kyi nyer dgu chu rta lor 'khrungs/ bcu bzhi la yab gshegs/ lor der khri la bzhugs/ skyid rtag lo dang por ming btags/ rgyal srid rgya nag gi yig tshangs ltar na lo nyer gnyis byas/ me 'brug la gshegs zer yang bod spyi yi lcags bya la gshegs pa mthun pas de tshe rgyal srid lo nyer bdun byas pa'o/ /lha ral pa can 'di ni chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi skye bar nyang dang chos dbang gnyis ka'i gter lung skye 'phreng du gsungs te/ de yang khri srong lde'u btsan sku gshegs pa'i de ma thag sum cu rtsa gsum dbang po brgya byin gyi sras lha dbang 'od mtha' zhes su 'khrungs nas mi lo bcu drug 'das pa na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che (cher )srid (sri )zhu mchog tu bgyis pa'i slad/ slar yang rang gi rigs sras kyi rgyud du bltams par byed dgos pas de rtsa gsum pa'i chu tshod gcig gi yun 'das par 'pho tshul ston (bstan )pa shes so/ /snod sbyin dar ma 'u dum btsan shing lug lo pa skyes nas zla ba gnyis nas yab gshegs/ nar son pa na gcen gyis 'u 49

shangs rdo yi gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa na grogs stobs kyi dar mas kyang 'bri yi gtsug lag khang sogs bzhengs/ nyer bdun lcags bya la rgyal srid thob nas lo gcig 'jig rten phal spyod rnal ma dang / de nas sdig pa'i grogs pos bskyod cing nag phyogs gdon gyis bskul nas tshul ngan la spyod pa zla ba drug dang / de nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che la 'tshe ba kho nar lhur len pa zla ba phyed bdun (bcas )byas nas/ lo ngo gsum (song ba'i )chu phag lor shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa lhas lung dpal gyi rdo rjes nyag phran 'khrul ('phrul ) 'khor gyis lngad+ku'i lam du brdzangs/ rgyal po be'u dar ma lnga lam du btang ba'i lo gtan tshigs kha cig tu lcags bya dang chu khyi dang yang shing glang dang me stag byas pa yod kyang snga ma gnyis mi 'thad la phyi ma dag rung / yang dkyus su bstan pa nyid khungs su che'o/ /lhas lung dpal gyi rdo rje 'di ni dzñā na ku mā ra'i slob ma dpal gyi ming can brgyad kyi ya gyal yin par yongs grags dang / lo bcu bdun par spa gro stag tshangs su gu ru pad+ma'i zhal mjal zhing / mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis rjes su bzung / yi dam lha dang bla mas bdud 'dul dpa' bor lung bstan par lhas lung du grags/ lha sras mu rub sku gshegs ma thag tu skye ba'i nyin (nying )mtshams sbyar ba yin zhes bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi lung bstan bka' rgya mar gsal bar gsungs pas/ de tshe me stag gam me yos gang rig tu 'khrungs dgos la/ rgyal po sdig can sgrol dus dgung lo nga brgyad tsam du phebs pa dang / khams su bla chen dge ba (dgongs pa )rab gsal gyis bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i kha skongs kyi dge slong rgya nag nas ha shang gnyis 'bad pas btsal ba'i grogs kyang mdzad cing / dus phyis gnam lde 'od srung la sman lha (bla )bde gshegs bdun gyi (brgyad kyi )mdo chog gi lung byin pa yang bshad pas sku tshe brgyad cu lhag nges shig bzhugs par snang ngo / /gangs can 'dir rgyal bstan rin po che (cher )bya ba bla lha ga tu mdzad pa po khyad par 'phags pa gcig ste/ bka' drin rnam pa kun tu dran nas rtag tu phyag bya ba'i gnas so/ /sa gnas 'phags chen rnams kyi sprul pa'i sku/ /sa skyong mtho ris mdzes rgyan mi yi lha/ /rgyal ba'i lung bstan rgyal bstan 'dren pa po/ /rgyal sras rgyal blon rnams la rtag phyag 'tshal/ /dam chos yun rings gnas par bya ba'i phyir/ /dam pa'i rnam thar 'dzin la ches btson (brtson )ba/ /dpal gyi rdo rje la sogs 'jig med lha/ /dpal chen rnams la gus pa cis mi bskyed/ /ces so/ /bod rje lha btsan po'i rigs dri ma med pa be'u dar ma la slas kyi btsun mo gnyis mnga' ba'i chun ma 'tshe (tshe )spong bza' btsad mo 'phen la lcags bya lor mngal du chags nas chu khyi 'char ba na khye'u mtshan dang ldan pa zhig btsas pa chen mas 'phrog gam bsad (gsod )par dogs nas mal rtse 50

(mel tshe )dang mtshan mo mar me'i phreng bas bskor nas bsrungs bas mtshan yang 'od bsrung (srung )du chags/ 'di spyod lam legs shing ngang tshul bzang bas de skabs blon 'ga' khri ral gyi sras yin par yang byas skad/ 'od bsrung (srung )bltams pa'i lo phyi ma rgyal po be'u gshegs skabs sna nam bza' la khye'u zhig byung ba blon po rnams la bstan pas skye ma thag swo (so )yod pa the tshom yang yum gyi bka' btsan pas brtan du chugs smras pas mtshan yang yum brtan du chags/ nag phyogs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa'i sdig blon rnams kyis rgyal po be'u gshegs rjes kyang bstan la 'tshe ba brtsams rung rgyal po'i skabs ltar ngag mi btsan zhing mi rings bar lus tshal pa du mar mngon du zhig nas (tshe'i )dugobyas pa sogs bzod dka' mi srid (bzad )'jigs rung gis phal cher kha dag pas mi rnams bsngang zhing (dngangs shing /) chos la dkar ba'i blon po rnams kyis kyang bskul bas/ shing glang lo mthar chos la 'tshe ba'i 'phro chad/ shing glang 'di chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gshegs lo drug cu skor gcig 'das nas yang zhing glang shar ba de yin/ me stag la 'od srung dang yum brtan yang rten gyi spyan sngar skyabs 'gro blangs nas dkon mchog rten la mchod pa byas/ rgyal bu de nyid nar son nas gnam sde 'od srung gi bus g.yor ru bzung / sman bla'i mdo chog la yi dam snying po mdzad cing / dkon mchog gsum la gus pa chen po byas/ dgung lo re gsum dang zhe dgu dang so dgu byas pa mthong yang phyi ma 'thad par sems/de yi btsun mo chog (lcog )ro bza' rgyal mo la yab kyi nyer bzhi shing bya lor sras dpal 'khor btsan 'khrungs/ yab gshegs pa'i phyi lo lcags glang la rgyal sar 'khod/ blon po 'bro gtsug dgra lha snang dang cang 'a pho gnyis kyis byas/ gtsug lag khang brgyad bzhengs/ gab rtse mkhan bsam rgyal gyis lug la gshegs zer bas dgung lo so lnga'o/ /gling rje ge sar du grags pa yang gnam lde 'od srung nas 'di yab sras kyi rings la byung bar mngon no/ /rlang gi (rlangs kyi )a me (mes )byang chub 'dre bkol gyi sbyin bdag ge sar gyis byas shing / byang chub 'dre bkol rang nyid gu ru pad+ma'i sprul pa dang / ge sar khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sprul par khas blangs shing / ge sar lo gya brgyad thub pa'i lung bstan mdzad tshul rlangs kyi po ti bse rur yod pas ge sar nam byung gi dus des shes pas de las dus snga ba dang phyi bar ma sems shig rnying ma kha cig gis ge sar mnga' bdag sprul par 'dod pa rlangs kyi tshig ris dang mthun rung bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla mas ge sar skyes bu rdo rje legs pa'i rnam 'phrul du gsung ba don la gnas par nges shing / de bod khams bde ba'i phyir mnga' bdag khri srong gi bka' lung ngam smon lam gyi mthus rdor legs kyis mi yi srid pa bzung bar byas na 'gal ba can yang ma yin no/ /phyis byung lo rgyus 'chad pa po mang (po )zhig gis a 51

menu/ byang chub 'dre bkol 'di/ gu ru pad+ma bod du bzhugs dus kyi dngos slob yin zhes gsungs kyang /gu ru pad+mas rlangs dpal gyi seng ger lung bstan pa/ khyod rlangs kyi mi rgyud skal ldan la/ /nga yi thugs rjes khyab par byed/ /khyod ni skyes bu skal ldan yin/ /khyod lha rigs rlangs kyi mi rgyud la/ /byang dang chub ces bya ba yi/ /mi'u khyad par 'phags par yong / /de ni nga yi thugs kyi sras/ /zhes lung bstan cing /byang chub 'dre bkol gyis gu ru pad+mas sbas pa'i chos rnyed par yang bshad pas gdul bya spyir btang ngor bod du bzhugs dus kyi dngos slob ni ma yin par go la/ byang chub 'dre bkol lo brgya dang brgyad me 'brug zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcur gshegs zer la/ de la sras bzhi yi gnyis pa gnyan thog (thon )a khrom (krong )ste/ de nas mi rabs drug pa yon chen rgyal ba skyabs/ ྾ de yi sras rlangs lha gzigs kyi phag gru bzung ba'i thog mar ྾ rje spyan snga ni phag gru gshegs nas lo drug pa shing lug lor 'khrungs nas dgung lo so bzhi sa 'brug lo phag gru gdan sa mthil gyi khrir phebs lo nyer bdun bzhugs/ de rjes shing lug lor spyan snga'i gdung dbon rgyal ba thog rdug khrir phebs/ de nas rim pa bzhin dbon rgyud rgyal po sne'u gdong par grags pa'i zhabasadrung nor bu zhes pa'i bar rim gyis byung nas deng dus gdung rdzogs te rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i nang du'o/ /zhes zhor du 'phros la/da ni dkyus su 'jug ste/ mnga' bdag dpa' 'khor btsan gyi khab tu btsun mo che chung gnyis la sras re re byung ste chun ma 'chims (mchims ) bza' btsun ne la gcen khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal dang / chen ma sna nam bza' legs btsun la gcung skyid lde nyi ma mgon bltams/ gcen gyis gtsang nyang (myang )stod rgyal mkhar rtse bzung / de yi btsun mo gcog (lcog )ro bza' mgon dpal la sras dpal lde 'od lde skyid lde gsum byung / de la smad kyi lde gsum du grags/ gcen dpal ldes gcog (lcog )ro bza' 'ba' re khab tu bzhes pa la gcen 'od dpal lde dang gcung dharma tsakra gnyis yin/ 'od dpal lde gung thang du phebs par (pa )gung ston dpal mjes kyis byas pa'i yi ger yod zer/ gzhan mang (po )zhig gis ni dpal lde gung thang du phebs zer yang mi 'thad par mngon/ gung thang mnga' bdag nor bu ldes mdzad pa'i rgyal rabs su dpal lde'i sras dmar po btsan du gsung bas de tshe (ni )'od dpal lde'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs su byed dgos/ de nas gung thang rgyal po'i rabs rings shig tu byung ba rnam grangs mdor byas nas 'dir smras pa/ 'od dpal gung thang phebs sras 'od zer lde/ de nas rim bzhin bde spyod lde dbang lde/ btsan lde de sras gsum mnga' gcen 'od lde/ /'di dang mi la'i sku tshe smad dus mtshungs/ /de sras rim pas dbang phyug lde skyobs lde/ /mgon lde btsun lde de yi btsun mo ru/ /chos rgyal 'phags pa'i gcen mo nyi 'bum ste/ /de la chos rgyal 'bum lde mgon zhes bltams/ /de 52

sras gsum gyi bar ma rin chen bzang / /de sras chos skyong lde ste gung thang du/ /chags pa'i gdung rabs bcu gsum dus yin zhes/ /gu ru'i lung dang 'di nyid mthun par 'grig /chos skyong lde sras bkra shis lde zhes pa/ /gter ston rgod lde'i chos bdag nyid mtshungs yin/ /de nas phun tshogs lde dang bsod nams lde/ /lha dbang rgyal mtshan mnga' bdag rnam rgyal lde/ /bsam lde kun dga' blo gros kun dga' grags/ /bsam lde phyi ma de sras bsod dbang lde/ /de ltar mched dang khri rabs ma bsgrang bar/ /yab sras rkyang bsgrangs rgyal rabs nyer gsum mthar/ /rab byung bcu pa'i lcags po sprel lo la/ /gtsang pa rgyal po'i dpung gis gung thang blangs/ /gu rus bsngags pa gung thang rgyal po'i gdung / /gangs can bsod nams bgo bas (skal )de tsam gyur/ /de nas nyer gcig lo 'das lcags sbrul la/ /o rod dpung gis gtsang pa'i rgyal srid blangs/ /lcags sbrul de nas da lta'i shing glang bar/ /mi ‘ོpo brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lnga song / /zhes dang / mnga' ri (ris )paṇa chen sku mched kyi rnam thar lo rgyus su gung thang rgyal po'i gdung rigs las 'khrungs par bzhed cing / de yang mnga' bdag rnam rgyal lde (la )sras mang du byung ba'i thu bo dam pa nor bu lde glo bor yun ring bzhugs dgos byung skabs kyi sras 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan yin zhes gsungs shing / de la sras bdun byung ba'i gcen mnga' ris paṇa chen ni rtsod med kyi gter ston chen po ste/ sku tshe ril po dge slong gi bcas pa lhur blangs shing / gcung legs ldan zhes mnga' ris rig 'dzin du grags pa yang gter ston yin la/ sras pad+ma rgyal po zhes (pa )byon rung de nas gdung (rgyud )ma 'phel/ sku mched bar pa kha cig gi rgyud da lta glo bo ma thang gi dbon rgyud rgyun phra mor gnas pa 'di rnams yin zer bas de tsho gung thang rgyal po'i gdung rigs su rtogs dgos so/ /dpal lde'i sras gcung dharma tsakra'i rgyud lha rtse ba gla lung rtsa gor ba klu rgyal ba spyi pa rnams yin par grags/ lde gsum gyi 'bring ba 'od lde la sras bzhi byung zhing / de yi rgyud gtsang rong dang / yar lung dang / khams kyi gtsang khar yang yod skad/ chung ba skyid lde 'dzad rta nag tu phog (phebs/) sras drug byung ba'i rgyud sogs lde gsum gyi gdung rigs de skabs ches mang ba 'phel te yod ces smras so/ /yang mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan gyi sras chung ba skyid lde nyi ma mgon mnga' ris phyogs su phebs/ pu rong (spu rang )du sku mkhar nyi ma gzungs brtsigs/ de grub pa'i zhal spro mnga' gsol gyi skabs su nam mkha' nas lung bstan pa'i sgra 'di skad du/ sems can spyi mthun las la legs grub pa/ /nyi ma zhes bya de yi grogs su ni/ /spu rang zhes byar bod kyi rgyal khab byung / /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i nyi ma deng 'dir shar/ /zhes kun gyis thos par grags pa dang / gzhan yang bkra shis pa'i ltas ngo mtshar can mang du byung / de la sras stod kyi mgon gsum du grags pa byung ste/ rig pa mgon/ bkra shis mgon/ lde gtsug 53

mgon/ che ba rig pa mgon gyis mar yul 'bru sha'i bar dang / 'bring ba bkra shis mgon gyis zhang zhung ya rtse dang bcas pa/ chung ba lde gtsug mgon gyis pi ti cog 'ang zangs dkar sgo gsum bcas bzung zhes 'di ni rig cing 'thad la khungs dang ldan pa ste/ gzhan gu ge dang spu rang gnyis su mgon gnyis phog (phebs )pa de ni ma yin no/ /bkra shis mgon gyi sras srong nge dang 'khor re gnyis/ srong nges gu ge dang / 'khor res spu rang bzung / srong nge dang 'khor re'i ming dngos gzhi drang srong lde dang /'khor lo lde yin zhes mnga' ris gung thang du dpe hrul ka ni (kak+ṇi )ka rnying par brdzangs ba zhig tu 'dug pa 'thad nges su snang / drang srong lde yi sras nā ga rā dza dang / de wa rā dzar grags/ khong gis paṇ+ḍi ta kha shas spyan drangs/ lo chen rin bzang sogs rgya dkar du brdzangs pas bstan pa la ches phan/'on kyang deng sang lo rgyus thams cad du de ltar grags mod/ de tshe lha bla ma de lo brgya'am brgya la nye ba zhig bzhugs dgos te/ jo bo bod du phebs skabs lo chen brgyad cu rtsa lnga bzhes pas/ lha bla ma de bas bsgres (bgres )pa zhig nges par dgos pas so/ /lha bla ma lug lo pa dgung lo don brgyad bzhugs zhes mnga' ris gung thang lo rgyus su drangs pas/ de tshe lha bla ma dang lo chen lo khyad gcig las ma byung zhing /lo rgyus der nā ga rā dza dang / de wa rā dza rab tu byung bas byang chub 'od dang zhi ba 'od yin zer ba sogs lo rgyus khungs ma da dung btsal dgos par snang / sku tshe smad rang gi rgyal srid gcung 'khor rer gtad de/ yab sras gsum ka rab tu byung / yab la lha bla ma ye shes 'od du grags/ 'khor re'i sras lha lde/ de la sras gsum/ da lta'i lo rgyus spyir bar pa byang chub 'od yin smras la/ des jo bo rje bod du spyan drangs pa sogs bstan pa la bka' drin shin tu che/ gcung 'od ldes kyang paṇ+ḍi ta dzñā na shri sogs spyan drangs/ 'od lde'i sras rtse ldes rngog lo rgya dkar du brdzangs pa sogs bstan pa la phan par mdzad/ de yi sras rabs lnga pa'i skabs gdung zhig ya rtser byon/ rgyal rabs brgyad lhag cig byon nas sangs rgyas bstan pa gus pas mchod pa byung / de nas gdung rdzogs te mon gyi blon po ba li ra dza bya bas rgyal srid thob pa da lta dzum lir grags pa 'di yin/ spu rang du gdung rabs rings su byung zhing mthar rab byung bcu gcig pa'i nang du gdung rigs kyi rgyud rdzogs pa yin zhes zer/ zhang zhung gi mthil gu ger gdung rabs rim can byung bcu gcig pa'i me 'brug lo la 'khrungs/ re brgyad pa rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i mtha' la nye ba chu phag lor sbo (dbo )zla ba'i tshes la gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs bsngo rten bla ma khag la phul ba nged kyi skal ba rkong (kong )yul gtsang po mgo dgur sdod skabs sde pa gzhung brgyud de byung / de nas gu ge gdung rgyud chad de sras mo gnyis kyi tha chung mar yul la dwags rgyal po'i khab tu bzung bar sras gnyis mnga'o/ /mar yul bdag po rig pa mgon la sras mang du byung ba'i rgyud la dwags rgyal po 54

yang yin zer la rtsod pa med pa ni mnga' bdag stag shams can de yi rigs rgyud da lta stobs 'byor shin tu dbul yang 'bras ljongs nub ri gro shod sogs su thor bu yod pa rnams so/ /lha rigs chos skyong rgyal po'i gdung / /ji snyed byung ba mdo tsam du/ /yid ches deb ther mang po dang / /bstun nas byung ba 'di na kwa /zhes so/ /mnga' bdag khri yum brtan gyi sras khri lde mgon/ de sras rig pa mgon/ de sras rdo rje 'bar/ de la sras gnyis/ gcen khri dbang phyug btsan/ gcung khri pa/ gcen gyi sras lha btsad po lo tsā ba ye shes rgyal mtshan te legs sbyar la shin tu byang bas kha rag gnyos kyi lo tsā yang khong gi slob ma yin/ jo bo ma phebs gong lo nyi shu'i skabs tsam la paṇ+ḍi ta pad+ma gsang ba byon pa na/ zhabs lugs grol tig sogs bsgyur ba'i lo tsā mdzad/ khri dbang phyug btsan dang khong yab sras kyi sku rings su khams nas dbus gtsang mi lnga'am bcus sdom rgyun blangs nas bstan pa phyi dar dbu tshugs pas bka' drin yang che ba yin/gcung khri par sras bzhi'i chung tha bho dhe rā dza yin/ jo bo bsam yas su phebs skabs dang khong dus mtshungs/ de yi rgyud bla dag tu da lta lha btsan sngon mo zhes mtshan dngos lha dbang rgya mtsho'i blo gros te bsam yas dbu rtse nas 'chi bdag srog 'khor gter nas 'don pa (po )de dang / lha 'bri sgang pa sogs mang du byung ba snang / 'dir bshad (pa )ni lo rgyus khungs ldan las drangs pa ste/ ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi sras khri pa byas pa sogs kyi (la )mgo rmongs par mi bya'o/ /yum brtan gyi rgyud bsam yas dang / rdo dang / 'on sogs dang / khams phyogs su yang mang du yod par grags pa dang / rkong (kong )po rkyen rgyal po yang yum brtan gyi rgyud yin/ dwags po e lha rgya ri ba kha cig gis 'od srung gi rgyud par mdzod kyang gzhan mang (po )zhig lha 'bri sgang ba'i rgyud par smra'o/ /spyir gnam lde 'od srung dang / khri lde yum brtan gyi rgyud pa mang du byung bar grags kyang / mnga' ris dbus gtsang rnams su da lta ji bzhin ngos zin pa ni thor bu 'dir smos pa tsam las mi snang ste nyung ngur zad do/ /bar khams ngom shod a nu zhes mang du yod pa rnams mnga' bdag gi rigs su gnas mod/ dge slong karma chags med kyis mdzad pa'i yul phyogs de yi yig tshang ngam ngag rgyun nyid la brtag 'os dang / mdo khams smad btsad po ur gyi rigs ni mnga' bdag sad na legs gyi sras zur byung zhig gi rgyud yin zhes grub thob chen po karma pak+shi'i gsungs su nges pa'o/ /kwa ye sngon rabs bzang po'i gtam nyid dang / /dam pa'i lugs srol 'phags pa'i nor bzang po/ /ya rabs dra ma'i gdung rigs dri med rnams/ /ston gzhug me tog bzhin du gyur 'di skyo/ /gangs ri ra bas bskor ba'i ljongs 'di ru/ /skal bzang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /thub dbang nyi ma'i rings lugs ji bzhin pa/ /'dren mdzad chos rgyal rnams la cis mi 55

bsngags/ /gang gi gdung rigs rin chen gser gyi phreng / /rim byon rgyal ba'i bstan pa (la )lhag bsam thugs/ /zhum med chang thub ('chang bar )gyur pa mi'i seng ge/ /dam pa rnams la bdag blo cis mi 'jug /de bas de dag rnams la gus pa'i blos/ /snying nas rtag tu bsngags pa brjod pa'i gtam/ /smras pa 'di yang don med ma yin te/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa spel la bsngags pa yin/ /zhes so/ /bod 'dir bstan pa phyi dar du grags pa dge 'dun 'dul ba'i sde snod byung ba yang grub thob o rgyan pas phag gru yi rgad po zhig gi ngag rgyun la brten (nas )bstan pa snga dar nyams nas phyi dar bar lo nyer lnga'am sum cu tsam mdzad pa dang / rje gtsug lag 'phreng bas chu glang lo la dbus gtsang gi mi bcu las klu mes tshul khrims shes rab/ mkhan bu gru mer dang bcas pa mon mkhar 'bras bur phebs pa 'di phyi dar gyi thog mar klu mes rnams 'dod gsungs shing / mkhan chen dharma shri yang nyin snang du phyi dar 'das lo 'di dang mthun par byas te/ lcags bya nas lo nga gnyis 'das pa'i chu glang yin no/ /bu ston chen pos dbus kyi rgan mo zhig gi ngag rgyun la brten (nas )lcags bya nas phyi dar gyi bar bdun cu'am don gsum dag tu bzhed pas/ phyi ma ltar na chu bya dang snga ma byas tshe lcags rta yin dgos so/ /'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis lcags bya nas bar stong bdun cu don bdun sa stag la bstan pa phyi dar gyi dbu yin par bzhed pa dang / sa skya'i bla ma dam pas ni/ rgyal po bka' chems las/ dpal zhes bya ba'i dge slong gis/ /sdig can rgyal po sgrol bar 'gyur/ /de nas lo skor brgyad kyi bar/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa med par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa la dgongs te/ lcags bya nas bstan pa bar stong lo skor brgyad byung bas/ de la lo rgan gcig dang lo rkyang pa brgyad de/ khyon dgu bcu go brgyad yin la/sa khyi la phyi dar byung ba bzhed/ nel pa paṇa chen smon lam tshul khrims kyis lcags bya nas lo brgya dang brgyad kyi bar du 'dul bstan ma thung bas/ phyi dar thog ma sa bya yin par bshad do/ /de ltar 'dul bstan dge 'dun gyi sde phyi dar gyi lo grangs 'dod tshul rim pa lnga las/ snga ma ni grub thob o rgyan sa lug lor yar lung du byon skabs ral pa can mthong nas de yi bar lo nyis brgya dang bcu bdun song bar dgongs pa'i lug lo 'di ni karma pak+shi gshegs pa'i chu lug de yin par snang bas chu lug de nas yar la bsgrangs bas rje spyan snga 'khrungs pa'i shing lug bar brgya dang dgu/ de nas yar phag gru 'khrungs pa'i lcags stag bar re lnga/ de nas jo bo rje bod du phebs pa'i chu rta bar re brgyad/ de rnams dril ba'i lo mngon sum pas dpyad mi bzod kyang 'on te lcags bya nas nyer lnga'am sum cu lhag tsam na phyi dar tshugs tshe shing bya'am chu 'brug bar 'dod dgos pas/ der bla chen po rang nyid rab tu byon pa'am 56

(byung ba'am /) des mkhan bu skyong ba'i dus lta bur bzung nas 'dul bstan dbu brnyes par song bas rung bar sems so/ /gnyis pa ni/ klu mes kyi dngos slob bam de nas yun ring ma song ba'i yi ger gsal na khungs che zhing / dbus gtsang gi mi lnga'am bcus bla chen po rang nyid la sdom pa blang bar byas tshe dus snga phyi 'grig rung de lta min na 'dod pa gsum par dpyad bzhin no/ /gsum pa ni/ kha cig gis lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug dang / tshongs btsun shes rab seng ges dge 'dun gyi sde gnas gzhi tshugs pa la dgongs skad kyang klu mes kyis bla chen po'i slob ma mtshur shes rab mchog las sdom pa blang ba klu mes kyi dngos slob ba shi gnas brtan gyis smras pa dang / gzhan yang klu mes dang sum pa ni dus mtshungs par ba shi gnas brtan gyis 'di skad du/ bdag gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po klu mes shes rab tshul khrims dang / sum pa ye shes blo gros gnyis kyis dang po kho nar klung shod 'byim pa'i lung du gnas btsug pas ma tshugs/ de nas bya yi lo la mo ra snyel btsug ces bris yod par snang zhing / 'brom ston gyis dbus kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la jo bo bsu bar bskul ba'i yi ger/ dang po'i dge slong lugs 'byin dpon/ btsun chen ye shes blo gros dang / zhes gsungs pas snga dar chu glang lor byas tshe 'di skabs jo bo bod du chu rta lor phebs skabs lo dgu bcu lon cija de gong dge slong sgrub pa'i lo tshigs kyang lon dgos par bsgrangs na brgya dang bcu lhag tu nges par 'gyur bas/ klu mes kyang tshe yun ring bzhugs par grags pas sum pa yang de mthun sku tshe yun ring bzhugs par grags pas sum pa yang de mthun sku tshe yun ring bzhugs na las (de min )'grig dka' bar shes shing / gong gi mkhan rabs nyid dang / lo grangs spyi btang gyi dpyad na (la dpyad tshe spyir btang byas na )phyi dar dbu sa stag nyid du mi 'gal te/ de yang bla chen po'i dngos slob kyi mkhan bu kha shas gtsug lag khang brtsigs pa'i nus pa med kyang chu glang lor phebs/ de nas lo nyer lnga lon pa'i sa stag lor byang chub sems dpa' smon lam gyi mthu chen po mnga' ba klu mes dang sum pa sogs byon nas dge slong gi dge 'dun sde 'phel zhing gtsug lag khang rgya cher brtsigs par byas na 'thad par rig go/ /bzhi pa ni/ re zhig lha sar dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde ma tshugs pa la dgongs zer/ lnga pa klu mes kyi sa bya lo la mo ra snyel gyi gnas gzhi brtsigs pa la bstan pa phyi dar gyi lo mgor 'khrul ba yin zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar bstan pa phyi dar gyi lo mgor 'khrul ba yin zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar bstan pa phyi dar gyi dbu chu glang gi lo yin na lo chen rin bzang rab tu ma byung ba'i lo bcu bdun gyi gong dang / sa stag yin na rab tu byung nas lo brgyad 'das te lo chen gyi rnam thar khri thang dzñā nas bris par sa rta la 'khrungs nas bcu gsum lcags rta la rab tu byung bar bshad pas so/ /gang ltar 'brom gyis phyi dar du bzhed pa'i sa stag de nas lo drug cu rtsa 57

bzhi 'das pa chu rta la jo bo rje mnga' rir phebs/ skar rtsis pa rnams kyis rab byung dang po tshugs nas lo bco lnga song bar shes la/ rab byung dang po me yos 'di 'char ba'i tshe 'phags mchog srong btsan sgam po bltams nas bzhi brgya bdun cu tham pa dang / gshegs nas sum brgya don bdun 'das shing /rje khri srong 'khrungs nas nyis brgya zhe dgu/ gshegs nas brgya dang gya gnyis yin la/ dam pa'i chos la sdig can glang rgyal blon gyi 'tshe ba de chad nas lo brgya dang nyer gcig lon pa ste/ de phyin gyi lo rab byung dang po sogs nas bsnan 'os rim par bsnan pas rtsis mgo mi 'khrul zhing bde bar spyod pa yin no/ /rab byung dang po brtsams pa'i rtsis gzhi byed pa'i lo dag me mkha' rgya mtsho zhes rgyud nas gsungs pa de yi thog ma nyi sgrol byed cing sbrel nas brtsam pa ste/ lo tshigs de la nyi sgrol drug cu skor longs pa drug dang ma longs pa gcig bcas bdun yod pa'i dang po ni/ 'phags mchog srong btsan zhabs kyi dgung lo re brgyad bzhes skabs dang / gnyis pa 'dus srong mang rje dang / gsum
