pa mes ag tshom can gyi dus dang / bzhi pa kha cig gis gu ru pad+ma ka ra srin yul 'dul du gshegs pa'i lo shing sprel yin zer bas de tshe der bzung dgos la/ lnga pa gnam lde 'od srung gi dus dang / drug pa lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po dgung lo nyer bdun dang smad 'dul dar nas lo bdun pa'i steng yin la/ bdun pa drug cu skor ma longs pa'i shing sprel der/ dpal ldan jo bo rje dgung lo bzhi pa'i steng ste/ shing sprel de nas zhe gsum 'das pa na rab byung dang po shar/ de tshe jo bo rje'i dgung lo zhe drug steng yin no/ /rtsis lo don du gnyer na bde blag phyo (yong )ba (ba'i )phyir skabs 'dir cung zad spros pa'o/ /da ni dkyus kyi don ni/ gong ltar shing sprel de nas lo gnyis lon pa na me mkha' rgya mtsho la lag do zla bas sbyangs lhag lo nyis brgya nyer gcig gi mgo me khyi shar ba de yin no/ /gong gi 'phro shing sprel/ de yang phyi dar la 'dul ba'i sdom rgyun gsum byung ba sde pa gzhi yod smra 'ba' zhig pa snang zhing / de las stod 'dul ni ha cang 'phel ba ma byung bar mngon/ smad 'dul du grags pa'i mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho nas brgyud pa 'di nyid gong du bshad pa'i chu glang gi lo la dbu brnyes/ sa stag nas da bar gyur te rab byung gsum pa'i shing bya bar mi lo nyis brgya dang don gnyis rings dge bsnyen dang rab byung dge tshul dge slong rnams sdom rgyun 'di kho nar brten pa shas che zhing / bka' gdams kyi dge bsnyen 'brom dang /dge slong khu rngog gnyis/ sku mched gsum/ glang ri thang pa/ sha ra ba/ snar thang ba sogs mtha' yas pa dang / bka' brgyud kyi 'byung khungs chen po dwags po lha rje dang / khams pa mi gsum/ 'bri stag 'brug pa sogs kyis mtshon sgrangs bar dka' ba dang / rnying ma yi zur chen 'dzam 'gro ba'i mgon po/ kaḥ 58

dam pa bde gshegs sogs 'byams klas pa dang / gzhan du mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor yang rdo rje gdan pas lung bstan pa la brten glang ri thang pa la bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad pa dang / bka' gdams gsar par grags pa gangs ri'i 'khrod 'dir 'dul 'dzin rnams kyi gtsug nor mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho yi gdung 'tshobs shar gtsong (tsong )kha pa chen po yang smad 'dul gyi sdom rgyun 'dzin par grags pas mtshon yun ring du chos dar bar gyur zhing / da lta yang sdom rgyun ma chad par gnas pa 'di ni rgyal bas mtha' 'khob bod yul 'dul bar thugs rjes sprul pa'i sku u pā dh+ya ya bo dhi sa twa yi smon lam gyi mthus rgyun ldan du byin gyis brlabs par nges pas snying nas gus pa chen pos rtag tu phyag bya ba'i yul lo/ /'dir 'phros pa sngon dus kyi skye bo skal bzang shes rab dang / btson (brtson )'grus mchog dang ldan pa mang zhing / chos 'dul ba la shin tu mkhas par sbyangs ba/ 'dul ba'i mkhan po chen po kha skong dad pa'i dge slong yang blang dor gyi don gsal bar byas te/ 'bad pas rgya nag nas ha shang dag 'gug par mdzad pa sogs dri ma med pa'i lugs srol lhur len pa de yi slob tshogs chos 'dul ba la mkhas pa spyi dang bye brag dbus gtsang mi bcu sogs bzhugs bzhin pa'i mdun sar shin tu rmongs pa'i ngang tshul gyi ྾ chu gtor ma dang dar bas mas ྾ sdom rgyun du 'dod pa yang mi nus te/ de ltar byas par grags pa 'a 'bre gnyis kyang skyes bu dam pa yin par snang bas deng skabs kyi mkhan po nang phan tshun phyogs kyis bslad pa'i gtam rgyun chags pa zhig tu zad kyi log rtog srung ba de dag la yang dag pa'i snang ba sbyangs par 'dod ces so/ /bar 'dul du grags pa ni bskal bzang sangs rgyas bdun pa rab gsal gyi rnam 'phrul paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shri rab byung gsum pa'i nang shing byi la bod du phebs nas lo bcu bzhugs pa'i ring bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta sogs bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dge slong ji snyed pa zhig byung / de las stan gcig gi brtul shugs (zhugs )'dzin pa rdo rje dpal dang byang chub dpal gnyis las dge 'dun tshogs sde bzhi 'phel ba la brten 'jig rten mgon po jo nang pa dang mkhas mchog bu ston sogs phyis phyung (byung )gi dam pa mang po zhig gi sdom rgyun de la brten par mdzad pas rab tu dad pas 'dud par bya'o/ /phyi dar bstan zhes 'dul bstan nub pa slar/ /sos te dge 'dun tshogs gyur byung ba las/ /gos hrul nang du gser gyi sku brnyan bzhin/ /sngags bstan ma nub gnubs so zur gyis mtshon/ /don bsgom snying po a ro'i rings lugs la/ /dpal ldan jo bos bsngags pa yang yang mdzad/ /ces so/ /jo bo rje bod du byon pa'i skabs snying po don rgyud kyi bstan pa byang chub sems kyi man ngag 'dzin pa mang yang grags che ba a ro ye shes 'byung gnas yin la de yi bstan bcos theg pa chen po'i rnal 'byor la tshig snyan don bzang 59

zhes mchog tu dgyes shing / a ro'i slob ma zangs dkar mdzod khur la yang gus pas phyag mdzad pa dang / a ro'i yang slob sba bsgom la kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi bogs bton nas don dam byang chub sems kyi bogs 'jam dpal dang byams pas 'don par dbugs dbyung ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen pu (po )to ba chen pos sba sgom la sems phyogs kyi man ngag legs par gsan cing dus phyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen por gyur pa na de dam pa'i chos rnam dag nyid du dgongs te yi dam du mdzad pa sogs sngags kyi bstan pa rnam dag ma nub pa rgyu mtshan du ma dang bcas shing / 'on kyang so skye kha cig bdud kyi byin gyis brlangs por spyod pa re zung byung ba jo bo byon pa nas zhi ba de'i bka' drin gyis khyab pa yin no/ /zhes pa yang 'dir 'phros pa'o/ /de skad chos kyi rgyal po btsad po'i rabs/ /bstan pa phyi dar dus kyi ngang tshul bcas/ /rang bzo'i skyon med gzhung mang mthong las btus/ /'on kyang skyon mchis spyan ldan mchog la bshags/ /dge mchis 'gro la yongs su bsngo ba'i mthus/ /chos rgyal lo paṇa bka' drin rab dran nas/ /de yi dgongs pa bskangs phyir dam chos la/ /legs spyod 'jig rten mgon po myur 'grub shog /ces lha btsad po'i (gdung )rabs dam pa'i chos ci (ji )ltar byung ba'i rim pa mdo tsam smos pa 'di yang rig pa 'dzin pa rgyal khams pa dpal tshe dbang nor bus rab byung bcu gnyis rdzogs par nye bar kro dha zhes shing mo glang gi lo smin drug zla ba'i dkar phyogs dga' ba gsum par shar phyogs shing lo'i tshal kong yul nyang kha ljon pa klung bsam gtan gyi khang bur snang gsal gyi mdangs su bkod pa'o/ /'di ni rang stobs rig pa kho na'i spyod yul ma yin par gtan tshigs kho na la rag las pa'i phyir/ slar yang deb ther khungs btsan khul kha shas mthong ba la brten nas dpal gdong chu bya lor stod mnga' ris mang yul waṃ ler sdod skabs tshig sna bsring zhing zhus dag cung zad bgyis pa ste 'di la da dung rgya nag thang gi deb ther 'gyur (bsgyur )dag pa zhig mthong na dpyad pa 'os pa ni yod la/ bod kyi lo rgyus sngar grags chung ba'i dpe rnying khungs ma 'dra rnyed na ma rtogs (gtogs )da lta yongs grags la ni gong du dpyad byar byas pa de rnams las gzhan 'ga' yang med par sems pa'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ / 60

rog /bod rje lha btsad po'i gdung rabs mnga' ri (ris )smad gung thang du ji ltar byung ba'i tshul deb gter (ther )dwangs shel 'phrul gyi me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/a tha/ rgyal rigs lha rdzings dbus na mngon mtho lha rigs btsan po sum btsan (rtsen )dbang po'i grong khyer lta na sdug /gang gi snying po mdzes byed rnam par rgyal ba'i ba gam mngon mtho mnga' ri mang yul gung thang khab/ /mnga' bdag bsod nams 'dren byed stong gis nyer spras rgyal bstan zho 'thung rus pa'i rtse brgya 'degs mkhas shing / /chos bzhin khrims srol gnyis 'thung dbang po sum cu rtsa gsum yan lag mchog 'chang bdag por cis mi bsngags/ /de ltar ched du brjod pa'i tshig gis mdun bsus nas 'chad par bya ba ni/ mnga' bdag khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal gyi sras smad kyi lde gsum du grags pa'i gdung yul tha dad du gyes pa las bod yul stod mnga' ri'i cha mang yul gung thang zhes nyi sras nam mkha' nyi ma'i gung du slebs pas gung thang dang / srid pa'i ma mo bdun sogs gnas pas ma yul dang / grub pa'i gnas chen mang du yod pas mang yul du grags pa der gangs ri rgyal po gdan la bzhugs pa lta bu sku lha dpal rdzong gi 'dabs su mnga' bdag rgyal po'i rgyud pa byung ba ni o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad ma 'byung gnas kyi gsung las/ mang yul gung thang gangs ri'i 'dabs 'di ru+oḥ nyid kyi gdung rgyud phyi ma byon pa rnams: gdung rus ma nor chos kyi rgyal srid skyong : zhes sogs gter kha du ma nas lung bstan pa ltar te/ de yang gung thang gi yul de lung pa'i phu byang phyogs gu ru rin po che lho nub srid po'i kha gnon du 'phur te gshegs pa'i gnas gung thang la yin/ ri rgyud rje'u lha btsan dang / jo mo re gza' (bza' )zhes pa'i gangs ri la gtad pa/ lung pa'i mda' lho phyogs bal yul la gtad pa/ chu klung yang skyid rong nas bal po rdzong gi mdo brgyud de chu bo chen po gaṅgār 'bab pa zhig go/ /spyir mang yul gyi sa tshig ni/ gung thang la thog gangs ri rje'u lha btsan nas bal po'i yul mtshams ting wa ri yan yin te/ de yi nang tshan lho nub gung gsum du grags pa ni ting wa ri nas mtshams kyi bar lho phyogs te skyid grong gi cha skyo la nas se rib kyi sa mtshams rod kyi gangs ri chen po dpung rgyan nam dbang po'i brag ces pa de yi bar nub ri'i cha dang mtshams nas rje'u lha btsan gyi ri rgyud stag khyer la yi bar gung thang gi khyon yin te/ de yang gung thang gi yul thog mar 'dzin pa po ni/ sngon rgyal po gnam ri srong btsan gyi sku rings tsam du dbus 61

gtsang nas mi gtso gsum 'khor dang bcas te yul tshol la 'ongs nas gung thang shar la'i rtser slebs tshe bltas pas ljongs bzangs po mthong nas rmog la chol phor byas te yul rgyan du dor te bsgos (bgos )pas/ rgyan po che rim gyi 'dzang gshong lha sdong gsum (gyi )mes po pha tsher 'thug pos (por )'dzang gzhung thob/ mes po 'dam seng g.yu ral can gyi (la )gshong gzhung thob/ sa nam gyi mes po stag rgya bo chu ral can gyi (la )lha sdong thob ste/ sa nam rgyan pham ste yid ma tshim par slar yang sho la smad du yul tshol la phyin pas yul bzang la mang ba rnyed de yid dga' bas glu blang ba/ rtsa mda' ron mda' dgun mda' gsum/ /sngon mo nas kyi skye sa yin/ /rtsa phu ron phu dgun phu gsum skad/ /gsal le 'bri yi 'chang sa yin/ /zhes sogs kyang smras skad/ de nas rim pas skyid rong du phyin nas yul bzung bas sgar btab pa'i gnas la sgar dang / spang zhing du rmos pa la spang zhing zhes su da lta yang grags/ gra sogs su yul bzung zhing lho rong nas stag rtol mu (po )zhig bzung nas byang btsan mchod pa'i phyir khyer bas stag khyer la ru grags/ des byang btsan dgyes nas mi tshan dar rgyas su gyur skad gang ltar rim pas mi grong rgya cher chags/de nas nam zhig gi dus bod spyi la dbang ba'i rgyal po med par yum brtan 'od bsrung (srung )'khrugs te bod sil bur song ba'i skabs su gung thang gi yul mi rnams gros su 'cham nas 'u cag thun mong du skyong ba'i rje gcig dgos 'dug ces lde gsum las gcen dpal lde de la btsun mo cog rong (ro )bza' 'bar re khab tu bzhes pa'i sras gnyis kyi thu bo 'od zer lde dang / gcung bde spyod lde zhes bya ba'i snga ma spyan 'dren pa la mes po stod kyi khri rje dang zhang brjid ldan rings mo bya ba phyin te mnga' bdag 'od zer lde gung thang du phebs zer la lo rgyus kha cig tu dpal lde'i sras dmar po btsan nam dmar po lde zhes bya la/ de yi sras 'od zer lde yin zhes kyang brjod pas/ de yang mi 'thad pa med de/bya mung po'i thugs gter gyi zhus lan du/ la stod dpal (pad )ma'i sprul pa de: dus dang 'byung lugs bshad kyis nyon: rje khri srong lde btsan gdung rgyud ni: mang yul gung thang zhes pa'i sar:gdung rabs bcu gsum song nas 'byung : zhes dang / chos skyong zhes bya sku 'das nas: zhes pas mung po gter ston sku 'khrungs pa'i dus gung thang gi rgyal rabs bcu gsum 'das pa/ de yang chos skyong lde gshegs pa'i dus su gsungs pas/ dmar po lde nas chos skyong lde yi bar bcu gsum 'grig pa'o/ /gung thang gi dbus nub ri gzar zhing mtho ba/ g.yas ri rgyal po khri la bzhugs pa lta bu/ g.yon ri btsun mo bu khur 'dra ba/ thang stod tho le zhes par gdan phab ste sku mkhar brtsigs/ spyan 'dren pa po gnyis kyis blon po byas nas chab srid bskyangs par grags so/ /'di la lo rgyus kha cig tu gung thang (du ) 62

thog mar phebs pa khri bkra shis brtsegs pa yin zhes dang / de'i sras dpal lde yin par 'dod pa mang du byung yang / de dbang la mi 'grig pa'i gnod byed re yod la/ spyan 'dren pa po yang pha tsher 'thug po dang / 'dam seng / stag rgya sogs 'dod pa yang mi 'thad par go zhing / 'dir bshad pa nyid sngar yig rnying zhig tu mthong bas khungs dang ldan par shes so/ /de ltar 'od zer lde yi sras dbang po lde/de'i sras dung dkar lde/ de'i sras btsan lde/ de rnams skabs sde go bzhi btsad chung khab sa dang lnga zhes tshogs 'du gyen long gdongs su byed cing khab sa ha cang mnga' thang mi che mod/ 'di la mang (po )zhig tu dmar po lde dang / dung lde mi 'byung bar/ dpal lde'i sras 'od lde dang / 'od lde'i sras bde spyod dang / de sras dbang lde/ de sras btsan lde zer yang gong du bkod pa nyid 'thad la/ gang ltar btsan lde la sras gsum ste/ gcen lha mchog lde'am 'dol le/ bar pa dkon mchog lde/ gcung 'od lde'am rtse mo zhes bya ste/ tha chung gi rgyud pa ni jo bo 'dzad ('jad )pa yin zhes dang / phal cher sde pa tsha mda' ba yin zhes kyang brjod do/ /gcen lha mchog lde'i sku rings su mnga' thang yang sngar las 'phel bar gyur cing / gshongs dbus nub ri stong po che dar yol bres pa lta bur pho brang phyis khab gong du grags pa sku mkhar lcags ri 'ob dang bcas pa byas/ de tsam na rje btsun chen po myi la ras pa yang grub pa brnyes te za 'og phug tu phebs pa dang dus mtshungs zer ba yang don la gnad (gnas )pa nyid do/ /'od lde'i sras dbang phyug lde/ de'i sras skyob pa lde/ de la sras mo gsum dang / sras po gcig byung ba mgon po lde ste ('di'i )phyag la sha mtshan dmar po yod pas dpung dmer zhes kyang grags/ rgyal po de'i sku rings su spad zhod chos grags kyis ye tsho'i yul nas mon gyi dmag drangs pa dang 'thab pas ma thub/ mnga' bdag skyid grong du bros pa mtshams nas zin/ khab kyi sku mkhar mthong sar bgrongs/ dbu khyer ba'i khrag thig zag pa'i sa la mchod rten re re yang bsgrubs par grags/de'i btsun mo dngos la sras med cing / ra la'i btsun ma byang chub 'dren zhes mkhar chen byang chub gzungs kyi dbon gyi sras mor gyur pa zhig dang 'brel ba la mngal chags nas yod pa pha rol po la 'jigs te bros pas klong rtser slebs/ der btsun ma brgyad kyis gzeb kyi nang du bcug ste rgyab tu khyer nas dpal mo skyid phug tu bskyal bar phu rir rang gi khu bo mkhan chen chos rje gnyos ston byang chub gzungs kyi spyan sngar phyin/ mkhan pos kyang gdung rgyud 'di shin tu gces pa yin zhes phu ri dang gyam gyi dge 'dun rnams la sku rim sgrub bcug (pa )bzhin rgyal bu mtshan dang ldan pa zhig lug rar bya ther nang du 'khrungs/ yab gshegs pa'i lor brtsas (btsas )pa'i khye'u la dbus su lto bor ba dang / mnga' rir sgro spangs su 'bod la/ rgyal bu sgro spangs de btsun pa'i chas su bcug nas ming btsun pa lder 63

btags/ de skabs rgyal srid kyi bya ba ni ne ne chung shos btsun mar bzhugs pa lha rin chen mtsho zhes pas byed/ de ni dgra gnyen la ngar thon zhing blo gros kyi lang tsho brtas pa zhig ste gcen mo lha gcig mdzes ma bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa gyi gcung zangs tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi btsun mor yod pas sngar nas gnyen stabs dang / de'i sras mo tsha bo btsun pa lde'i khab tu gnyen brtsegs te/ sa skyar phyag rten btang zhing phrin las bcol nas dmag khyer chen pos ye tsho'i phyogs la mi sha blan (klan )phyir mi mang du bsad/ de'i sdig sbyangs la khab gong gi lha khang dmar po dang / nor gnas gsar gyi lha khang dang / de dag tu ka ni (kak+ṇi )chen po re re/ gzhan yang mchod rten phra mo mang du brtsigs/ chos mkhar du rgyud brtag gnyis dang / 'om phug tu rgyud gsang snying bshad grwa btsugs/ sgos gzhis gdung phug tu mdzad de/ der mdo mang glegs bam bzhi bcu bzhengs shing gsung sgrogs nar mar btsugs pa dang /tshe smad thugs dam la rtse gcig tu gzhol ba sogs bud med gcig la ya rabs kyi gtam dper 'os pa byas/ des sa skya dang gnyen brtsegs pa'i tshul ni/ rang nyid skye ba dman zhing tsha bo sku na phra bas gnyen dbon zhig btsal dgos par snyam pa na/ rang gi gcen mo mdzes ma la sras mo bsod nams 'bum dang nyi ma 'bum zhes gnyis yod pa nyi ma 'bum chu mig sde dpon gyi btsun mor gshegs nas sras mo gcig yod kyang thugs ma song nas stod gtsang po thang chung ba shākya seng ge'i snyan pa gsan nas rang gi ming po chos rgyal 'phags pa la skyid grong wa ti mjal ba'i zol gyis gnang ba zhus pa la 'phags pa'i zhal nas/ma zhag gtsang po'i phyogs 'di/ long gtam tshig la smra lce bde/ la stod lho yi phyogs 'di/ ar rkun jag pa'i 'jigs pa che/ skyid rong bal po'i phyogs 'di/ zas skom btung bcas tshad pa che/ zhes gsungs shing don du gnang nas yar lam thang chung du byon kyang khong gi bzhed pa med par rig nas gung thang du gnyen 'phrad dang 'phags pa wa ti mjal bar byon pas khab kyi chu tshan khar rgyal bu dang mjal/ sru mo lha rin chen mtshos tsha bo na phra yang / sa paṇa khu dbon rgya hor rgyal po'i mchod gnas su gyur pas stobs che ba yi/ de skabs su bab par sems nas btsun pa lde dang mtshams sbyar nas khab tu bzhugs par byas/ de tshe 'gro mgon 'phags pas a lce la mar yongs ('ongs )dgos tshul pho nya sbran par nyi ma 'bum gyis zhu yig tu gsol ba/ skyid grong bal po'i yul 'di tshad pa tsha gsung ba ltar gda' bas bdag skom nas chu mig gcig nas chu 'thung pas ste'u (nyi'u )zhig khog par shor ba yis kho mo myur du yong thabs ma byung bas de la brtse ba'i bslab bya zhig zhu zhes zhus par/ chu mig legs par brtag la gyis/ nya chung la gces spras 'tshal/ re zhig der sdod na rung / zhes gnang (ba )bzhin bdag mo nyi ma 'bum la chu mo glang gi lor rgyal po btsun pa lde yi sras khri rgyal 'bum lde mgon zhes bsod nams kyi mthu 64

dang ldan pa de mngon par bltams so/ /'bum lde mgon 'khrungs pa'i chu glang 'di grub thob o rgyan pas nyer bzhi dang / 'gro mgon 'phags pa bcu dgu bzhes pa'i lo de yin/ de yang o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po'i lung bstan las/ de nas gdung rabs mang du brgyud pa'i mthar: mang yul gung thang stod kyi sa phyogs su: drag shul snying rjer ldan pa'i rgyal po 'byung : de yi rings la bod khams dga' spro skye: zhes 'byung balhar te/ rgyal po 'di dgung lo brgyad pa'i skabs chos kyi rgyal po 'gro mgon 'phags pa rgya nag hor gyi rgyal po'i ti shri chen por gyur te bod chol kha gsum dbang bsgyur ba'i lung dang bcas te sa skyar phebs pa na/ yum sras gnyis nas phyag rten bzang po bsnams nas mjal du phyin zhes gung thang gi rgyal rabs kha cig (tu )'byung yang / 'bum lde dgung lo brgyad pa lcags sprel lor hor se chen gyis rgyal srid thob cing 'phags pa yang de yi bla mar gyur nas hor yul (du )bzhugs skabs te mi 'grigs la/ mnga' bdag khri 'bum lde dgung lo bcu gnyis la chos rgyal 'phags pa sum cu bzhes pa'i shing byir/ rgya nag nas bod du phebs pa'i lo der mjal bar gsal/ de rjes 'phags pa rin po che bod du lo ngo bzhi bzhugs te me yos lor gong nas spyan 'dren byung (ba )bzhin phebs pa yin/mnga' bdag 'bum lde mgon sku zhang mjal bar sa skyar slebs pa na chos khri thang du khrom tshogs shin tu che ba 'dug pa khong la zhe sa byed pa po ma byung bas g.yas kyi dong pa nas nyag phran blangs te gnam ru'i dkyil 'khor khengs pa'i 'dom bkang ba nam mkha' la 'phangs pas gar bab brtol med kyis khrom tshogs rnams ca co sgrogs bzhin kun tu g.yos te sa skya ba'i tsha bo 'di glang dang 'dra ba 'dug ces grags/ de yi sang nyin 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa thog mar mjal bar sku zhang sa skya'i zhal ngo rnams la zab gos kyi gdan brtsegs ma dang / dbon mnga' bdag sras chung rang la 'bol drum (grum )zhig las med par gzigs nas cung zad ma rang bas 'gro mgon 'phags pa la phyag ma byas par bsnyun gsol bas 'phags pa'i zhal nas kha sang khrom la mda' bdeg pa dang / da ring phyag 'bul mi byed pa tsha bo 'di glang sha thag (stag )tu 'dug ces gsung zhing / gnas skabs gzhan gyis smod pa ltar gyur kyang don du dpa' bo dor thabs can zil gyis gnon pa'i snyems pa 'chang ba zhig tu thams cad kyi yid dang rna bar 'jags par byas/ 'gro mgon 'phags pas kyang skabs su babs pa'i dbang byin rlabs dang dngos po'i gnang skyes gya nom pa lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya bdud rtsi lta bu (dang )bcas lcams kyi ljongs su chags pha bzhi dud chen brgya ste don du stong 'khor gcig gnang nas/ yar byon khar sku tsha gzhon nu la lo gsum ma smyo na grags pa'i gtam mi thob ces pa yin pas yid la ji ltar 'dod 65

par byos shig pa'i bka' shed bskur du bstsal/ rgyab gnyer dpon chen shākya bzang po dpung dang bcas pa btang nas yum sras mnga' ris gung thang du phebs/ gung thang go bzhi zhes ban de dbang shed shin tu che bas sngar mnga' 'og tu 'du ba med pa thog mar de rnams rnal du phebs par bzhed pa yi/ sde go bzhi'i mkhan po bzhi bkug ste khab gong gi sgo bzhir an bcug ste/ chen po hor gyi srol ltar khrims rnga brdungs/ tho sta phyar/ rnga thug bhengs nas nga ro chen po tsham rngam 'jigago'ajigs ltar du 'di skad ces/ kyai/ thams cad nyon cig gnam la nyi zla zung gcig sa la gong ma mchod yon zhes snyan pa 'brug ltar du sgrogs pa de ma thos sam/ da lta'i gung thang khab pa 'di bod rgyal po'i gdung rgyud dri ma med pa chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po dang / khri srong lde'u btsan/ khri ral pa can sogs kyi rgyud pa mang pos bkur ba'i rigs yin par ma go'am/ de la deng sang sde go bzhi btsad chung khab pa dang lnga zhes ngo mthon du smra ba khrims chen po dang 'gal ba mi bzad pa yin pas chad pa sna dgu thob pa go dgos zhes khrims tshig tu bsgrags nas phag tu nyan rna rtog chen pa btang bar/ ban de tsho na re/ 'o cag gi mkhan po rnams kyi sku la nyes pa byed na bzod pa med par srog dang bsdos te rgol bar bya'o/ /sdig mo tsam byed nas 'jags la 'gel na deng sang sa skya pa'i khud sus kyang mi thegs pas ci zer nyan pa las ma 'das zhes zer ba go nas sang nyin khrims gtam du/ 'o khyod rnams kyi sngar gyi byed pa la dpags na khrims ci yang thob par snang na'ang / nged rang gi chos kyi rje srid zhi la byams pa'i thugs mnga' zhing khyod rnams kyang bde bar gshegs pa'i ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan bzung ba'i tshul can du 'dug pas da lam nyes med du 'jog na/ da phyin chad rgyal rje khab pa'i zhabs spyi bos longs/ ji gsung bka' sgrub gang bsgo ba'i phrin las sgrubs/ dad gus kyi zho she phul cig 'di las 'gal na drag po'i gzher yong nges pa yin zhes gnad la phab ste rtsig (gcigs )blangs shing / zang zing gis kyang yid mgu bar byas pas de rnams kyis kyang sngar gyi spyi brtol tho co'i spyod pa dor nas des shing gus pa'i 'bangs su byas/sde go bzhi ni lo paṇa gyi che ba yang thogs/ mthu yi che ba go 'cho/ de gnyis khab rdzong dkar gyi 'dab 'dzangs gzhungs su yod/ 'bangs kyi che ba ro gam gshong na yod de/ de gsum gung thang pa dang / zam 'phrang (gi )che ba gsar tsho nub ri na yod par snang / de ltar gung thang rtsa ba'i mi sde yang dag par 'jags nas/ rim pas phas kyi phyogs so so na 'khod pa rnams kyang btul/ 'ga' zhig ni bya dga' dang tshig gi sbyor ba bzang pos kyang yid bzhos nas 'bangs su bkod de mnga' 'og sde tshan brgya tsho bcu gsum du gtan la phab par byas/ de yang brgya tsho bcu gsum gyi grangs ni/ gung thang skyid grong nub ri gsum/ ma zhang rgya tshang pa dang bzhi/ rtsa ba'i mi sde rnam bzhi yin/ glo stod glo smad dol gru gsum/ 66

bzang rgyud pa dang rnam pa bzhi/ ral gris bcad pa'i sde bzhi yin/ gnyams dngul gnyis dang phu ri mtsho 'khor dang / gtsang po zangs tsha ba ste rnam pa bzhi/ gus pas btud pa'i mi sde yin/ pha bzhi chags kyi brgya skor gcig lcams kyi rdzong la byung ba ste/ brgya tsho bcu gsum de ltar grags/ zhes pa ste 'di yang bsgrang tshul cung zad mi 'dra ba snang yang 'dir mthun pa mang ba'i phyogs bzung ste bris pa'o/ /'dir bsgrang ba'i brgya tsho yang don du bcu tsho brgya ru byas pa ste stong phrag la bzhag pa yin gyi/ hor khrims skabs bod kyi stong skor kha cig de dang 'dra la/ deng sang gzhung khral la them bkung (skung )byed pa dang cha mthun no/ /de nas gzhon nur gyur pa des ma 'ongs gdung rabs rnams la 'di phyi kun tu dge ba'i brtsas (btsas )su phyogs der rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che yun du gnas pa'i sri zhu bgyid pa'i ched du mngon par mtho zhing nges par legs pa'i pho brang chen po zhig gsar du btab par dgongs shing / de yang me rdo thang du grags pa de rgyab ri tho le zhes rgyal po gdan la bzhugs pa lta bu dang / phyogs bzhi byang nas btsam (brtsam )ste snod rin po ches bkang ba dang / 'bras spungs pa dang / sa yi brtan phur dang /dar gyi yol ba lta bus bskor ba/ steng dgung sngon 'khor lo'i rnam pa la/ 'og (sa )gzhi pad ma ltar 'khyil ba'i lte bar/ phong kha khyung lding ba lta bu dang / gzhan yang shar phyogs su e waṃ gyi gzugs/ lhor nyi zla/ nub tu bya khyung / byang du spyan ras gzigs/ nub byang du tshogs kyi bdag po rnams rang byung du gnas pa gzigs nas sa yi bdag po yang thog par bdag gi sku mkhar gdab pa'i gnas su tshong zhes gsungs par/ rin mi zhu/ snom nas bdag cag la yang khang pa gcig zhu gsol bas/ da phyis khyad yong zhes pa'i rin du rin po che'i phreng ba dngul gyi ga ṭa/ rta rgod ma dkar po/ dar yug bzang po rnams bstsal nas phu lag gi sngags pa bdud rtsi mgon po dang khro rgyal regs tshig gnyis la sa yi 'dul thabs dge ba'i rten 'brel dag gyis shig gsungs pa sngags pa de dag me rdo thang sa yi bdag po yang thog pa la 'jigs te bsnyad du bsnyen pa kha gso dang / dus kyi theb ltog (lto )yang zhu dgos shing gtor chas yo byad kyang shin (tu )mang ba dgos tshul zhus par/ rgyal po khros nas nyid cag sngags pa rnams re tsa na 'gyan par 'dug pas mi mang du 'tshogs pa'i lag stabs chag pas 'gug (sgug )sdod mi thub/ da nga yi rta yi rmig rjes bzhin rtsig pa'i rmang tshugs/ rkya bskor 'cham pa re byas pa'i sar spe'u lcog re brtsigs gsungs nas/ mnga' bdag rang nyid kyi sku la ber nag po zhig gsol/ dar sna lnga yi thod bcings/ mdung dar nag po zhig phyag tu bsnams te chibs rta nag po khyung phrug 'dra ba zhig la chibs/byang shar nas brtsam ste g.yas bskor gyi chibs 'gros sar ldem me bzhud pas rgya sgo lho yi thad der 67

phebs pa na sbal pa cid bu tsam zhig thon nas (par )'gro mal khyod pas nga dbang che bas rang gnas su bde bar sdod gsungs pas der sa la thim/ 'di cung zad gnyen par 'dug kyi mchod rten zhig rtsigs gsungs/ 'og gi lu ma dmar po 'di jo bo sku lha dpal rdzong gi lcam mo yin 'dug pas de ru klu khang zhig rtsigs/ jo bo sku lha dpal rdzong ni rje yi mgur lha bcu gsum gyi nang tshan yin cing chos la dkar bas mchod gsol ba 'bad dgos 'dug gsungs/ de tshe mnga' bdag rang nyid dgung lo bcu bdun yin zhes dang / phal cher dgung lo bco brgyad pa lcags pho rta yi lo la yin zhes zer/ de nas brgya tsho bcu gsum gyi so so'i dpe'u (spe'u )lcog dang / thun mong du dbus su rgyal po'i khab pho brang dkar po dang / btsun mo'i slas khang mo che phyi'i lcags ri chen po lcags skor rdeg pa bcas grub par mdzad cing /phong ka khyung lta bu rtsig pa'i rmang du byas pas ming rgyal po'i khab bkra shis khyung rdzong dkar po zhes btags pa yi da lta yang mnga' ris rdzong dkar du grags pa'o/ /ji skad du/ me rdo thang du khyung rdzong dkar po zhes/ dbus su rgyal po'i pho brang lhun po bzhin/ /mtho la rab dkar gangs la nyi shar 'dra/ /logs bzhin zur bzhi lcog bzhis rab tu mdzes/ /de phyi yul grong gling dang gling phran tshul/ /mtha' skor lcags ri mtho brjid dkar 'tsher la/ /spe'u bcu gsum gangs ri'i phreng ba bzhin/ /yid 'ong sum rtsen dga' ba'i skyed tshal mtshungs/ /zhes zer ro/ /de lta bu rdzong gi bya ba phal che tshags su tshud pa'i skabs su 'gro ba rnams kyi bsod nams kyi zhing / yab yum gyi dge rtsar dgongs nas rgyal ba shākya seng ge'i bstan pa la bya ba lhag par mdzad pa rgyal ba'i gtsug lag khang mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung rten dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten gyi rjes su snyegs pa dang / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab rin chen ri bo'i chos kyi mdzod lta bu bsgrubs par mdzad de/ de yang ji skad du/ bkra shis sgo mang gtsug lag khang / /ka chen bcu phrag drug gi ni/ /khyon tshad dag dang ldan pa la/ /phugs na gtsang khang bskor khang la/ /ka ba drug bzhi nyer bzhi'i khyon/ /mdo khyams gtsug lag khang chen la/ /ka ba sum cu so drug yod/ /ka gdan rdo yi snying po la/ /sa bdag kha gnon rus sbal gzugs/ /pad ma 'khor los mtshan pa dang / grags pas mkha' khyab sgra chen ni/ /'brug gis 'khyud pa'i ka gdan steng / /ka ba rgyan 'phyang mu tig bres/ /gzhu chung gzhu chen gdung gdan dang / /de steng sngas gdung sad gdung gnyis/ /mchod rten brkos dang seng gdan gnyis/ /de steng seng chen brjid pa'i gzugs/ /bar mtshams mkha' lding dbang po'i sku/ /lto 'gro dbang pos gus bsnyen nas/ /mchod pa phul tshul mtshar du dngar/ /de steng seng khrebs (kheb )'od kor dang / /de steng rgyug gdan nor bu'i phreng / /de steng rgyug dang kha khyam phubs/ /de sogs sra brtan shing brdar (star ) 68

sgrigs/ /gzhan yang rgyal srid bkra shis pa'i/ /rtags dang rdzas bkod cir yang bkra/ /mthil zhal rgya mtsho dwangs pa la/ /logs zhal me long lnga bu'i ngos/ /bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems dang / /'dod lha chos skyong la sogs pa'i/ /sku brnyan sna tshogs las pa yi/ /rdzu 'phrul mthu yis bskrun pa bzhin/ /zhes so/ /gtsug lag khang 'di yi kun dga' ra ba dri gtsang khang skor bcas mtha' dag gi rtsig bzo gyeng (gyang )bzo shing cha'i bzang rngam brkos dang bsgrigs tshul bri 'bur gyi nyams 'gyur rnams shin tu ngo mtshar zhing de yang sra brtan brling bar mdzad pa'i mthus gtsug lag khang gi rmang rab byung lnga pa'i nang gi lcags rta la bting nas da lta rab byung bcu gsum pa'i me yos yan la lo bzhi brgya dang bdun cu don bdun 'das shing / dus phyis gtsug lag khang la srid (sri )zhu ches brtson pa yang dkon rung zhig ral rdib 'khyom yo 'chug cung zad kyang ma song bar gnas pa 'di ni ngo mtshar ba'i yul du snang ngo / de lta bu'i gtsug lag khang phyi yi bya ba grub pa'i skabs su mnga' bdag 'bum lde mgon des gtsug lag (khang )gi rten gtso ji lta bu zhig bgyid snyam pa na/ mdun gyi nam mkhar 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mngon sum du byon te shel gyi mchod rten dri ma med pa zhig bstan (te )'di lta bu zhig bzhengs shig ces bka'i gnang (ba bstsal )zhing rang la thim pa'i snang ba byung ba yis de ltar bsgrub pa'i ched du bal po nas lha yi bzo bo las sna tshogs pa lta (lha )bu u sir+pā zhes pas gtso byas bzo bo brgyad bkug nas sa skya rin chen sgang gi mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang dang cha mthun par bzhengs zhes grags te/ de la yang 'di skad du/ gtsang khang dbus su bkra shis sgo mang yod/ /rmang gzhi pha lam lta bu'i sra mkhregs rdo/ /de steng rang byung zangs la dzasbu'i gser/ /lan bdun sbyang ba'i chu yis nyer byug pa'i/ /mchod rten 'od 'bar gser gyi lhun po bzhin/ /rgyab yol dang bcas rgyal thog gnyis kyi tshad/ /mchod rten rmang ni dge ba bcu/ /de steng bang rim dang po ni/ /dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi/ /gnyis pa yang dag spong ba bzhi/ /gsum pa rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi/ /bang rim bzhi pa dbang po lnga/ /bum rten mgur bcu stobs lnga dang / /bum pa byang chub lan lag bdun/ /bre ni pha lam yan lag brgyad/ /srog shing shes pa bcu ru mtshon/ /chos 'khor bcu gsum stobs bcu dang / /dran pa nye bar bzhag pa gsum/ /'degs byed pad ma mi 'jigs bzhi/ /char khebs gdugs ni thugs rje che/ /gdugs 'degs ma 'dres chos bco brgyad/ /tog ni dri med chos kyi sku/ /bkra shis 'byung gnas gsal ldan du/ /chos 'khor bskor ba'i mchod rten bzhin/ /de la mtshan dpe rgyal ba'i sku/ /du mas legs par rgyan byas pa/ /bre dprog dngul gyi rdo rje 'chang / /rim pas lam 'bras bla rabs tshogs/ /bum par longs sku rnam snang mdzad/ /gzhan yang bang rim sgo khyim du/ /sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun dang ni/ /sman lha bde gshegs rnam pa brgyad/ /des 69

mtshon dkyil 'khor dbang phyug dang / /chags bral de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha sogs/ /rnam pa du ma bkod legs shing / /sgo khyim ka bas mdzes par byas/ /rgyab yol ngos su byin rlabs bla ma yi/ /rgyud rim yid bzhin nor bu'i 'phreng ba 'dra/ /mchod rten de la mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon cha/ /bzo sgros rtsing zhib cung zad ma mchis par/ /lha yi bzo bo'i 'phrul las byung ba bzhin/ /blta bas chog mi shes pa kho nar gnas/ /de la phra rgyan rin po che/ /be+eḍūr+ya dang dbang sngon dang / /sarma ra ga man shel nel/ /g.yu rnying mu men byu ru dang / /mu tig la sogs du mas spras/ /zhes tshigs su bcad pa de rnams sngon gyi yig rnying la zur ma dag pa cung zad bcos te bkod pa'o/ /zhes so/ /mchod rten chen po de'i nang du gzungs rten yang ches khyad par 'phags pa mang du mnga' ba gtso bor rgyal bstan 'dren pa'i shing rta 'dzam gling rgyan drug gi ya gyal slob dpon chen po ba su ban+dha nelpa la yi yul du zhi bar gshegs pa'i dbu thod bal po'i rgyal po'i mdzod du gnas pa chos kyi rgyal po 'di yi bsod nams kyi lcags kyu rnon pos drangs nas phyag tu 'byor ba yang rin po che'i sgrom bur bcug ste bzhugs su gsol ba dang / de bzhin 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi thugs dam gyi rten mthing shog la dzam bu chu gser gyis bris pa'i sher phyin brgyad stong pa'i glegs bam chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi skabs su byung ba dang / o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad ma 'byung gnas kyi thugs dam rdo rje/ bod kyi slob dpon bai ro tsa na'i phyag mkhar ('khar/) mkha' 'gro ma ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi sku rgyan sna drug sogs rgya cher bzhugs par bshad do/ /yang mnga' bdag 'bum lde des rgyal ba'i gsung rab dri ma med pa'i glegs bam mang du spel ba'i rten 'brel du dgongs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma stong phrag brgya pa gnam sngon zhu ba'i kha dog can gyi shog bu la 'char kha'i 'od kyang zil gyis gnon pa'i gser zhun gyi gzab bris blta bas chog mi shes pa mig 'phrul lta bu'i glegs bam bcu drug la zab chen gyi sku rags dang glegs bu'i shing gdong rgyab tu ri mo'i rnam 'gyur khyad par can tshon rtsis byugs te mig gi dga' ston cir yang byed pa/ gzhan yang zhal khebs shub sogs chas dang mdzes pa'i bya ba du mas klubs pa yang bsgrubs par mdzad de/ mchod rten dang yum gyi glegs bam 'di nyid yab dang yum gyi bka' drin bsab pa'i ched du dgongs zhes kyang grags so/ /gang ltar gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa dgung lo nyi shu rtsa lnga pa me mo glang la legs par 'byongs shing / lo der 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa yang chen po hor gyi rgyal khab nas slar yang bod du phebs pa dang dus mtshungs pa nyid kyi rten gsum la rab tu gnas pa mdzod pa'i ched du gung thang phyogs su phebs par gsol ba btab kyang zhal snga nas co ka'i tshang du glang po che'i rmig pa mi shong gi/ nged kyi sgar 70

khyod kyis 'degs par mi nus pas des na sangs rgyas kyi dus chen sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lngar rten gsum gyi drung du rab tu gnas pa'i sta gon mchod bshoms gyis shig dang / ngas 'di nas rab tu gnas pa bya'o/ /zhes bka' gnang bas de bzhin gung thang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen glang ri bka' bcu ba dang / ri rab pa sogs sde snod du mas mgrin pa brgyan cing sngags kyi rdo rje slob dpon gyi go 'phang brnyes pa lnga bcu skor gyis kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor rdul tshon gyis legs par bris te sgrub cing mchod pa'i rim pa bzang po dang bcas rab tu gnas pa'i bkod pa legs par sgrigs pa'i dus tshes gong gi de nyid la kun gsal gyi 'gram pa'i ngos nas rab tu dkar ba nas kyi sbrang char dpung gis mi dman pa rten gsum rnams la babs pa der 'dus pa'i skye bo thams cad kyi mthun snang du gyur pa dang / gzhan yang 'ja' tshon gyi bla bre/ me tog gi char/ lha yi bdug spos kyi ngad ldang gis phyogs kun khyab pa sogs dge ba'i mtshan ma du mas yongs su khyab pa byas zhes grags pa nyams pa med pa da lta'i bar du gnas pa nyid do/ /dus der phas kyi rgol ba ni ming mi grags/ nang gi mnga' thang ni sum rtsen la 'gran pa'i skabs su gyur kyang gong gi mdzad pa de rnams kyi bar skabs snga phyi ci rigs par gdung rigs phyi rabs rnams la sman pa'i slad du rnam par rgyal ba'i btsan rdzong bcu phrag lhag 'debs par mdzad de/ de yang ji skad du/ gu ge pu rong (spu rang )kha gnon du/ /dkar dum gnam gyi khyung rdzong brtsigs/ /phyi 'brog mon zhang kha gnon du/ /bya rtsi rnam rgyal thar po dang / /mtsho dbar nye ba'i glo stod du/ /ni ri g.ya' rdzong dkar po brtsigs/ /glo bo mtsho bzhi'i kha gnon la/ /gtsang rong bya pho'i ze ba brtsigs/ /ta mang se mon kha gnon du/ /glo smad mu khun srin rdzong brtsigs/ /dol po mon gyi kha gnon du/ /dol po'i yi ge drug ma brtsigs/ /la stod byang pa'i kha gnon la/ /la ru'i gad rdzong dkar po brtsigs/ /la stod lho yi kha gnon la/ /khun tsho gad rdzong dkar po brtsigs/ /skyid rong go bzhi kan 'jim khar/ /rag mar gyad non thar po dang / /skyid rong mthil du seng ge rdzong / /glang mkhar gsal ba'i yang rtse brtsigs/ /rgyal bal gnyis kyi kha gnon la/ /bal po rdzong gi rdzong dmar brtsigs/ /snyi shong rong gi kha gnon la/ /bong tshogs gnam gyi ka ba brtsigs/ /nub ri mtha' 'khob kha gnon du/ /rod kyi brag rdzong nag po brtsigs/ /phyag pa pha bzhi'i btsan sa ru/ /chu dbar rdzong chung 'dzum shor brtsigs/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di la bsgrangs tshul dang ngos 'dzin mi 'dra ba ji rigs 'dug kyang 'dir zhib mor byas te bkod pa yin la/ 'on kyang skyid rong glang seng gi mkhar sogs kha cig gdung rigs phyi mas btab bam snyam pa yang 'dug sngar sa skyar phebs skabs mtshan gyi bla gdags su glang zhes grags pa ltar mnga' bdag rang nyid kyi mdzad pa rnams glang gi las stabs su zhal gyis 'ches pa'i glu yang mdzad do/ /gzhan yang dpal ldan sa skya'i bla 71

chen po chos rgyal 'phags pa yi spyan ltos ltar chen po rnams la 'os pa'i las tshan bcu gsum yang bsgrigs par mdzad de de yi grangs nges ni/ dam gnyer gnyis/ gsol gzim gnyis/ mjal yig gnyis/ rkya rnga gnyis/ thab 'dren gnyis/ rta mdzo gnyis/ gdugs 'dzin pa dang bcu gsum yin zer/'di ni bsgrang tshul mi 'dra ba mang du 'dug pas dpyad byar gnas so/ /de ltar srid na mngon par mtho ba'i 'phrin las bzang po dang nges par legs pa rnam par dkar ba'i phyag rjes rgya chen pos brgyan par gyur kyang srid zhi las nye bar ldog pa byang chub mchog gi nye lam nang gi yang dag 'jog kho nar nges par 'jug dgos par gzigs nas de'i ched du gong gi bya ba las kyi 'khor lo de rnams sgrub pa'i bar skabs ji snyed par ling ba brag dmar du bzhugs par zhang sgom ri pa chen po dang / ron mda' rdzong sgo glang ri grub pa'i skyes bu brtson 'grus rgyal po dag gi spyan sngar ched du zhabs bskyod de phyag dang zhe sa chos bzhin gyi bsnyen bkur yang dag pas bla ma bsnyen par byas te smin byed kyi rim pa dang grol byed kyi zhal lung zab mo 'degs par 'jos te (nod de )nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan sa ra zla ltar rgyas par byas zhes yongs su grags so/ /de ltar chen por brlom pa gzhan kha cika gis lo brgya phrag gi ring du ngal bas bsgrubs kyang dka' bar gyur pa de dgung lo bcu bdun nas nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar lo brgyad kyi rings la mthar son par mdzad de sku tshe 'di yi 'phrin las de tsam du dgongs nas dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bdun pa'i mthar son pa rtsa brgyad lcags 'brug gi lo mgor (spyi lo 1280)sngon gyi las kyi rgyu bas 'bangs mi srun pa zhig gi gsol ngan gyi sbyor bas sku thim ste gnam gyi lhar gshegs so/ /'di la kha cig gis dgung lo nyer lngar gshegs zer ba ni ma dag la nyer bdun la gshegs zhes pa ni nyer brgyad kyi lo mgor gshegs pas dus nye ba la grags par snang ngo / /khri 'bum lde mgon gshegs pa'i dus dang mtshungs par 'bri gung gcung rdo rje grags kyang sku gshegs shing /lcags 'brug gi lo gzhug 'dir sa skya'i 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa yang sku gshegs la/ lo de'i phyi ma lcags sbrul bya rog rdzong hor dmag gis bskor zhing dpon chen kun dga' bzang po khrims la gtugs pa'i dus te bod khams spyi'i rten 'brel gung thang btsad po'i rigs la rag las zhes gu ru pad mas lung gis bstan (nga༈ )ltar 'dis mtshon mang (po )zhig mthun rung du byung bar snang ngo / rgyal po 'bum lde (mgon )'di dpal gsang ba'i bdag pos byin gyis brlabs zhes dang / dpal nag po chen po yi sprul pa yin zhes kyang grags so/ /mngon mtho shar ri'i phrag nas 'phos pa yi/ /nges legs rta dmar gyis drangs phun tshogs kyi/ /zer brgyas skye rgu'i bde skyid pad mo'i tshal/ /rgyas byed sa dbang mchog der cis mi bsngags/ /zhes so/ /72

de ltar mnga' bdag khri lde 'bum ('bum lde mgon )la sras gsum mnga' ba'i thu bo se ma 'bum skyong rgyal mo la bltams pa khri rin chen bzang po dang / gzhan khri lde 'bum dang / tha chung bsam lde ste/lo rgyus mang (po )zhig tu khri lde 'bum gcen yin yang zer la/ yum mi gcig pa la lo khyad cher med pa zhig yin nam sems/ lha rin chen bzang po des yon tan bkod pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan mi tshad rin po che'i phra rgyan du mas mdzes par byed pa ngo mtshar ba sogs rnam rtaprer dkar ba la thugs gzhol ba'i mdzad pa ci rigs mdzad cing / rgya nag hor gyi rgyal po'i pho brang du lung las rtags zhu bar bzhed de rgya yul du phebs par der sku gshegs/ rgya nag tu bzhud skabs thog mar sa skyar phebs te cung zad bzhugs pa na mdza' ba'i bshes shar pa kun dga' rin chen pas na re/ mnga' bdag pa khyed yul thag rings su gshegs pa 'dug pas sku tshes zin par yang dka'/ de tshe gdung rgyud chad par phangs pas nga yi khyim bdag mo 'di la sras gcig 'tshol zhes mtshams sbyar (ba )bzhin ma gcig lha mo 'bum dang rtsen pas rings por ma thog par bud med de yang sbrum par gyur te lha rin chen bzang po gshegs pa'i lor sras sgro spangs su byung ba mtshan chos skyong lder btags/ mnga' bdag khri lde 'bum ni snying stobs blo gros phun sum tshogs pas rgyal srid kyang yun rings skyong bar mdzad cing / yab kyi dgongs rdzogs su rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya seng ge'i sku brnyan dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i tshad dang mnyam pa bzo sgros khyad par 'phags pa dang / lo zla dus kyi mchod pa sogs rnam par dkar ba dge ba'i phyag las bzang po rgyun mi chad par mdzad/ dus phyis rgya nag hor gyi rgyal po'i lung las rtags zhu ba'i ched gong du bzhud par dgongs te chos mkhar mkhan chen byang sems snying po yab kyi thugs brnyes (mnyes )yin pas de rings yul gyi gzhi go chod pa gyis/ rgyam gyi mkhan po byang rgyal dang / chos lding mkhan po byang chub grags pa gnyis nga yi gros grogs la 'gro dgos gsungs nas zhabs rim pa lnga dang khyon rje blon brgyad gong du byon pas ta yi tur se chen gyi sras kyi thu bo hu'ang tha'i ci'am jin gin zhes pa'i sras rgyal bu'i skabs su thi mur dang / cod pan bcings nas rgyal thabs su dbang bskur ba'i mtshan che tsung ku'ang ṣi'o'u hu'ang dhi ul je'i thu zhes gsol ba bod kyi yig tshangs rnams su yang mtshan ol je thu zhes brjod de 'di ni bsod nams kyi mthu chen por gyur pa yi rgya nag tshin gyi (jin gin )rgyal po'i tham ga mi 'gyur g.yung drung rin po che rnyed pa'i mthus rgyal srid kyi go 'phang chen po rang shugs kyis brnyes pa ste/ de yi mdun du bcar bar rgyal po chen po des kyang thugs la btags te khyed rang bod la dbang bsgyur ba'i rigs rgyud chen po yin 'dug pas gnam gyi shed mo ster ba'i 'os su snang zhes bod shing sgo btsugs pa'i rgyal po du dben sha gsum gyi bdag po mnga' ris tsho bcu gsum gyi mnga' thang la dbang 73

bsgyur ba'i mnga' bdag gi ming dang / rin po che las grub pa'i tham ka gling bdun ma/ tham g.yogatham shu bcas shing (dang /) rgyal thabs mi 'gyur g.yung (drung )rin po ches spras pa'i gser yig mar 'bod pa'i 'ja' sa/ tho sta che rtags gnang skyes khyad par 'phags pa bcas tshegs med par thob nas bod du bde bar 'khor/ khri lde 'bum gyis tham ka thob pa'i dus dgung lo bzhi bcu'i skabs yin zhes yig tshangs kha cig tu byung ba de tsho mnga' bdag 'di yab kyi bcu drug pa sa 'brug la 'khrungs nas bzhi bcu me lug lor hor gyi rgyal po ol je thu'i rgyal srid lo bcu gsum mdzad pa'i dus mthar mnga' bdag la lung las gnang ba mngon/ sku mched gnyis la sras mi mnga' bas yar lam gdan sa chen po sa skya nas gcen gyi sras chos skyong lde la bdag rkyen mdzad de gung thang du phebs/ de skabs kyi zhabs rim blon po ni/ 'dzangs kyi go che tshangs pa/ lha rigs go che tshangs pa/ gnyan rgyud go che tshangs pa dang gsum yin zer/ dus der bod kyi chen po rnams hor gyi rgyal po kho na la ltos par byed pas sngar ta ji'i (si'i )lung tsam las med pa 'di res du dben sha chen po'i lung dang las rtags kyis mnga' thang mthong (mtho )zhing dbu rmog ches btsan pa'i brtsas (btsas )dam par gyur/ lha sras chos skyong lde yi btsun mor sa skya nas bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal ba'i sras mo kun dga' 'bum zhes lha gcig re mda' ma la bltams pa dbang kun dga' legs pa'i gcen mo de khab tu bsus/ bdag mo pha ming gis dregs te thog mar rgyal po dang thugs mi mthun pa'i rnam pa byung yang bdag nyid chen po yab sras thugs brling zhing byams pa'i zhal ta bzang pos khyab pa yis phyis thugs mdza' zhing gshim (gshin )pa'i sras o rgyan gu ru'i gter kha du ma dang khyad par rig 'dzin rgod ldem can gyi rtsa ba'i chos bdag gter ston nyid dang mnyam pa lung bstan pa khri bkra shis lde sku bltams/ de yang ji skad du/ khyad par mang yul sku lha'i byang shar du: sa mkhar dung gi lo mang 'dra ba 'byung ཿོ de ru rgyal rigs bong thung byang sems canoḥ chos rgyal bkra shis lde zhes bya ba dang : gter 'di 'phrad na bod yul bstan pa ni: mi lo lnga bcu rtsa gsum bsrings nus so: zhes pas mtshon mang du byung ba nyid do/ /khri chos skyong lde chu 'brug gi lo la sku gshegs nas bkra shis lde la cod pan bcings nas rgyal thabs kyi bdag por mnga' gsol ba'i btsun mo dbang kun dga' legs pa'i sras mo bsod nams 'bum khab tu bsus/lo shas rings yab yum ha cang thugs gshin pa ma byung yang / nang blon rgyam chen po dang sa gtso ba dkar po dpal sogs 'dzangs pa rnams kyis legs par bsdums nas shin tu mthun gshin du gyur/khri bkra shis ldes yab kyi dgongs rdzogs su ston mchog shākya seng ge'i sku brnyan dang yum gyi ched du 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sku brnyan gnyis ka mi tshad las ches mtho zhing g.yu rnying khyad par can sogs rin 74

po che'i phra rgyan gyis shinangatu mdzes par byas pa dang / gzhan yang rdzong dkar gyi lcags ri phyi ma dang lcags ri chen po'i lcags skor/ stag tshangs dpe'u (spe'u )chen gyi lcags khang / lcags ri'i 'og (gi )sa 'og nas rgyang ring por 'thon pa'i gsang sgo/ chu spe'u rdzong gi dbus dang / chos sde nang gi khron chu bzang po bton pa dang / rdo kyong chen po sogs nye bar spyod pa'i zhib tshags du ma mdzad/ de skabs mnga' thang yang gong du 'phel zhing lhag tu stod gangs ri te se'i shar phyogs dra la nye bar dra lung ring mor bud med rgan mo shing thun zhig gis dra ma'i sdong po 'then pas gser thig chen po gcig rnyed pa la brten gser khung bzang po (rnyed/) lho sde khri dpon byir ma gser dpon du bskos pas/ des gser bsil ma ka ṭo ra chen po zhig phyur bur bkang ba'i steng du gser thig chen po ra mchin tsam zhig bkal te phul bas mnga' bdag dgyes nas gsung 'phros kyi mthar nga la 'di tsam ster phod pa khyod rang la ci tsam yod gsung ba na/ khri dpon gyis phyag btsal ('tshal )te nged rang la 'di las lhag nges shig yod mchis zhus pas drangs (drang )por smra ba mi yi dam pa yin gsungs nas sku la gsol 'phro'i ber phyam gcig gis mtshon gnang skyes bzang po byas par grags/ khri dpon byir ma'i rigs rgyud glo bo khri dpon du grags pa rim can da lta'i bar byung ba de rnams yin zer ro/ /de ltar mnga' bdag rang nyid kyi bsod nams mthu la brten gser gyi 'byor pa rgya po rnyed pa la thugs kyi dgongs par 'jig rten 'di snang gi bya ba la snying po med par ya ma brla (ba )kho nar nges shing / tshe 'di'i 'byor pa yang skye ba snga ma'i sbyin 'bras dkon mchog gi thugs rje kho nar grub pas des na gser 'di chud zos su ma song ba dkon mchog gi sri zhu ched kho nar btang bar dgongs nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la bsod nams kyi tshogs gang gi che dris pas na re/ tshogs kyi zhing mchog ni phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che kho na yin cing / de yi rtsa ba gsung rab kyi dgongs pa yang bstan bcos tshad ldan rnams kyis gsal bar 'grel ba yin cing / yig tshogs kyang che la mtha' dag tshang ba yang dkon pas bstan bcos bod du bsgyur ro 'tshal bzhengs nas (na )dkon (pa )bzhin phan yon che zhes gsol bas de thugs la 'jug cing dgyes pa yi bka' yang dag pa'i dgongs 'grel bstan bcos kyi glegs bam rnams be+eḍūr+ya yi kha dog lta bu'i gan shog la btso ma gser gyi yang zhun gyis legs par bzhengs pa la mkhas pa'i khyu mchog mkhan chen byang chub rtse mo dang / bo dong lo tsā ba shes rab me lce dpon slob dag dang / gzhan yang pu rong (spu rang )lo tsā ba/ 'dzangs pa lo tsā ba sogs mkhas par gyur pa du mas tshig 'bru lhag chad kyi zhu btags (dag )dang / go rim phyogs ma 'khrug pa so sor bkod pa sogs yig gnyer do dam yang dag pa mdzad cing / glegs bam de rnams gser chu byug pa'i glegs shing / si 75

tha hu'i glegs thag zab chen gyi gtan khebs/ ras bzang po'i phyi sgril so sor na bza' gsum bsgrag (sbrag )bcas sgrub nas chu mo yos kyi lo dbyar zla 'bring po sa ga zla ba'i yar ngo gza' skar bzang po la rab tu gnas pa dang bcas legs par grub par mdzad do/ /de ltar bstan 'gyur gser gyi gad pa grub nas de bzhin rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog kyang bzhengs par thugs su dgongs nas skyid rong du shog bu'i gra sgrig grub pa'i mtshams su bod spyi'i bsod nams kyis ma theg par mnga' bdag chen po dgung du thegs te/ de yang gshegs pa'i lo shing sbrul yin par gter ston rig 'dzin chen po rgod kyi lde (ldem )'phru can gyi gter 'byung las byung ngo / /(shing sbrul de'i phyi lo me rta la rig 'dzin chen po rgod ldem can gyis byang gnyen yul zang zang lha brag nas gung thang rgyal rgyud skyob pa mdzod lnga'i gter chen bton pa'i phun tshogs lde dang rten 'brel bsgrigs kyang ji bzhin bsgrig par ma thub zer/)khri bkra shis lde yi sras khri phun tshogs lde dpal bzang po ni bdag mo bsod nams 'bum la sa pho stag gi lor bltams/ des ni yab kyi dgongs rdzogs su de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku brnyan mi tshad bzhugs khri rgyab yol dang bcas pa bzo sgros khyad par 'phags pa bzhengs pa sogs sna mang (rnam par )dkar ba'i mdzad pa dang / rgyal thabs kyi bya ba yang sa skya dang sku gnyen rim can stabs srid 'phel 'dun ma gcig pa'i bca' yig mna' bsgrigs kyang mdzad/ de la sras gnyis mnga' ba'i gcen sa skyar bzhugs skabs jo mo re mda' ma dang mthun pas khri mchog grub lder grags pa dang / btsun mo dngos byang rta (ta )dben gyi sras mo nam mkha' 'bum khab tu bzhes/ gyod (gyos )po rta (ta )dben gyi log pa'i bsam pas phra ma bcug nas zhang sna tshags pa smon lam rgyal mtshan gyis khri phun tshogs lde dgung lo sum cu so gsum lcags khyi lor bkrongs pa'i lo phyi ma lcags phag lor rta (ta )dben gyi sras mo la khri rgyal bsod nams lde sgro spangs su 'khrungs te/ de yang slob dpon chen po pad ma 'byung gnas kyi bka' las/ de nas gdung rabs 'ga' song mtshamasoḥ e ma gung thang rgyal po'i rgyud: mtha' la bab tshe pad ma ngas: brtse ba'i thugs rjes skyob par nges: pha ni lha la ma ni srin: brtsed (btsad )po gdug pa'i lo can gcig: rgyal srid rtsa ba cung zad 'dzin: zhes so/ /de skabs ta dben gyis gung thang gi rgyal srid lo lnga bzung ste/ sgo mang mthil la rta ra byas/ gung thang la shin tu 'tshe ba che zhing mthar kho rang yang skyid rong du phyin par rong pa rnams dang 'khrug ste mda' dgu lus la zug nas mtshams su tshe'i dus byas par grags/ gung thang gi blon po lha rje chos skyong dang / chen po snang mdzad sogs bsam pa che ba bzhis 'bad pas byang pa bton nas lha btsan po'i sras sku mched rgyal sar bzhugs su gsol ba yin la/ mi yi dbang po mchog grub lde yi btsun mor mar yul nas mnga' bdag 76

ras chen gyi sras mo bdag mo ras chen du grags pa blangs kyang sras med pas rang yul du ldog par mdzad/ skabs der bsod nams lde dang sku mched gnyis kyang cung zad thugs mi mthun pas/ gcung khri rgyal bsod nams lde spu rang du 'byon pa bzhed de yar la phebs pa na/ khri mchog grub lde chibs bcag par tho le thang khar byon pas chibs kyis skyur te sku gshegs/ gcung stod du phebs pa zhabs bskyil nas spyan drangs pa'i slad du pho nya btang bas gro shod kyi 'dabs shri dkar mo dang nye ba'i re lar rjes zin nas tshur phebs te gcen gyi gshegs rdzongs rnams legs par bsgrubs/ rgyal po de ni thugs dgongs zab cing shes rab rno ba phyir rgol ba 'joms pa la dpa' zhing srid skyong la shin tu mkhas shing /mchog tu dam pa'i chos la gzhan gyi yid 'phrog pa'i dad mos gus pas stobs su gyur pa zhig ste/ thog mar rgyal thabs kyi khri la bzhugs pa nasnesngar yab mes nas sku la brdo ba'i phas rgol la stod lho byang sher pa sogs yang dag par btul nas mi sde phyir 'khyar song ba kun kyang bsdus/ gsar du pu hreng yang mnga' 'og tu chud/ pu hreng dbang du mdzad pa'i dmag dpon khri dpon byir ma'i gcung chos skyong 'bum gyis byas pas de yi bya dgar glo bo dor po'i mi dpon du bskos pa'i rigs rgyud glo bo rgyal por grags pa da lta'i bar rgyun ma chad pa 'di'o/ /mnga' bdag des mnga' 'og bzhi tshor bcad cing sdug 'phang ('bangs )skyob phyir mi sde bkren phyug lan gsum bar du snyoms/ dus kun chos bzhin gyi rgyal khrims skyong zhing / nges par legs pa'i mdzod pa yang dgung lo bcu dgu sa sbrul la gu ru pad ma'i rgyal tshab gter ston rig 'dzin chen po rgod ldem can spyan drangs nas mang yul ri bo dpal 'bar gyi dgon gnas gzhis bcas phul/ /rig 'dzin chen pos sbas yul skyid mo lung gi sgo phyes/ dpal 'bar dang skyid mo lung du yang gter mang du sbas/mnga' bdag la phur pa srid gsum bdud 'dul sogs byin rlabs khyad par can gter rdzos du ma dang gter chos ji rigs pa'i dbang bskur gdam ngag kyang gnang zhing bkra shis mnga' gsol rgyas par mdzad pas sngar yab kyi skabs rten 'brel 'chug pa ji rigs sor chud par grags/ yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes gnyen gtso bor bo dong mkhan chen lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan zhal snga nas gtsug gi nor bur bkur/ gzhan yang rje seng ge bzang po dang / lo tsā ba ngag dbang grags pa/ red mda' ba gzhon nu blo gros rnams gus pas bla mar bsten par mdzad/ lo de'i phyi ma lcags rta lor mnga' bdag bsod lde (dgung )lo nyi shu par mkhan chen grags rgyal gyi gsung gis kyang bskul zhing mnga' bdag rang gi dgongs bzhed khyad par bas gung thang du bshad grwa dang 'brel ba'i chos sde chen po grwa tshang bcu drug gi khungs btsugs/ mnga' bdag rang nyid kyi bzhugs gnas mthil ma rdzong gi dbus dbu rtse 'du khang 77

dge 'dun 'dus tshogs so so'i spyi khang la sbyar zhing / mkhan chen lo tsā ba chos dpon du mnga' gsol te bzhugs su gsol/ dbyar chos zhag bzhi bcu/ dgun chos zla ba gcig rnams kyi gzhis (gzhi )rten 'brog nag tshang / chos khag rnams la yang tshugs ston/ bar ston/ grol ston/ tshad 'bras blo bskyed/dge 'dun nyi shu'i spyi skyur gyi bsnyen bkur/ rtsam tshul thug tshul/ grwa bskor ba'i brdzong ba/ mkhan po'i gsol zhib/ grwa tshang so so'i gzhis la snon pa/ gzhis sdeb la khral chag che chung sogs gnang / btsun pa rnams bag med pa'i spyod pa ma 'dres pa'i khrims bsdams shing / sha btson gsod nges pa yang chos sde'i sgo nang yan srog thar bas thar pa gling du mdzad/ de ltar gung thang chos sde chen po 'di rdzong dkar gyi rmang bting nas lo brgya nyi shu 'das shing gtsang nyang stod sidhu rab brtan 'phags kyis rgyal mkhar rtse dpal 'khor bde chen lcags sprel la btab nas lo bcu 'das pa'i skabs dang / lcags rta de nas lo bdun 'das pa'i me glang la bdag po sidhu rab brtan gyis la stod lho shel dkar chos ste btab ces dus 'khor ba mang thos rdo rjes byas pa'i rgyal rabs su byung la/ yig tshang gzhan du ni lcags rta de nas lo bzhi 'das pa shing khyi la yin zhes kyang zer/ gzhan yang chos rje seng ge bzang po'i bzhugs gnas shag tu sgrub sde gtso bor byas pa bsam gtan gling yang legs par spel te mthun rkyen bzang po yang sbyar/ skyid grong me tog mdangs can sogs rje re mda' ba chen po'i bzhugs gnas zhabs tog phun sum tshogs pa mdzad/ yum gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs su shākya tog gi sku mi tshad las lhag khri rgyab yol dang bcas yab mes kyi spyan ltos bzhin yang bzhengs/ gzhan yang dus kun sku gzugs bri 'bur du ma dang / bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur nas nye bar mkho ba'i glegs bam/ khyad par sngags chos ches mang ba bris pa/ skyid grong 'phags pa la mchod sprin rgya mtsho spel ba sogs bya ba las kyi 'khor lo ji bzhin mdzad pa'i ngang dgung lo sum cu rtsa bzhi shing sprel lor sku gshegs/ gsung gi rdo rje rgyal ba pad ma yi/ /lung gis yongs 'du'i me tog thod bcings pas/ /legs byas bdud rtsi btung bas gzhan sde yi/ /mtshon gyis 'jig min mnga' bdag sgra can rgyal/ zhes so/ mtshan don dang ldan pa khri mnga' bdag bsod nams lde de'i btsun mo gu ge nas mnga' bdag ma chen mo chos skyong rgyal mo ste/ des kyang khri bsod lde gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs su thog mar sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan khyad par 'phags pa snga dzābs dpe 'dre dang / de nas bka' 'gyur ro cog mthing shog la gser gyis bris pa legs par bsgrubs shing / de rjes mkhas mchog re mda' ba chen pos bstan 'gyur bzhengs na 'grub pa'i lung bstan dang / rgyu tshogs cha shas bcas brtsal (ba )bzhin bstan bcos 'gyur ro 'tshal yang legs par bzhengs/ bdag mo chos skyong rgyal mo de la sras gnyis mnga' ba/ mnga' bdag lha gcig ces mtshan 78

dngos bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes kun gyi yid 'phrog pa'i khyad par can zhig byung yang dgung lo bcu gnyis par gshegs/ mnga' bdag lha btsun zhes byung ba yang gzhon nu zhig nas thegs par snang /zur du chos rje lha mdun pa'i dbon mo mi skya'i skabs dbon 'jam dbyangs dang btsun ma'i ming byang sems sangs rgyas bzang mo la yab gshegs skabs sras gcig sbrum yod pa yum 'jigs nas nub ri lha mdun du bros/ sgro spangs su shing sprel lo der sras gcig btsas pa khri lha dbang rgyal mtshan du grags/ de dgung lo bco lnga pa'i skabs yum dang bcas rgyal khab tu bsus shing / lo bcu drug pa sa phag lor rgyal srid du mnga' gsol/ bla chen chos dpal bzang po dang / rje bzang po rgyal mtshan dang / khyad par bo dong thams cad mkhyen pa rnams ti shri ru bsten/ bla chen chos dpal bzang po 'di khri mchog grub lde dang yum gcig pa'i sku mched/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi nye gnas chen po rin rgyal zhes rwa lo'i rigs de yi sras su lcags phag la sa skya ru sku 'khrungs/ lo bcu bdun skor la gung thang du byon/ lo shas nas mchog grub lde gshegs nas slar sa skya bo dong sogs su chos kyi phyir bzhud/ slar gung thang du phebs nas mnga' bdag snga ma rnams kyi sku rim pa byas/ dgung lo lnga bcu par khri lha dbang rgyal mtshan gyi bla mar gyur/ khyon re dgu sa lug bar bzhugs pa'o/ /khri lha dbang bas pho brang byang thog drug ma rtsa ba nas brtsigs/ bkra shis sgo mang chen po'i dbu rtse steng 'og tu nang gsang sngags kyi lha khang / phyi bir wa pa sogs rgya bod kyi grub chen/ sa skya bla chen gong ma rnams kyi sku brnyan gyis brgyan pa/ bar khang du thugs dam lhag pa'i lha bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs mdzad dang bde dgyes sogs dpal he ru ka'i sku mi tshad bzo sgros khyad par can dang / gzhan yang sngags thang thog tshad ma sogs sku gsung thugs rten sngags kyi nyer spyad du ma bcas gsar du bzhengs sgrub mdzad nas der mthu stobs can bla chen chos dpal bzang po bzhugs su gsol/ yang / bo dong 'jigs bral thams cad mkhyen pa bzhugs pa'i gnas chos sde chen po'i gzim khang dkar po dang / 'jigs med thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku brnyan/ de'i bstan bcos chen po de nyid 'dus pa rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi glegs bam/ dus 'khor ye shes mchod rten/ rgyud sde bzhi yi mngon rtogs dkyil 'khor gyi rnam nges sogs gsung par mtha' yas pa dang / de bzhin bkra shis nam ling 'debs pa'i sbyin bdag mthil len mdzad/ nam ling 'di chu byi lor grub zer/ gzhan yang pho brang phyi nang kun tu lha khang bris 'bur gyis khengs shing / yi dam lhag pa'i lha sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku zi khyim gser dngul gar bus grub pa du ma dang / rdo rje 'chang gi sku thog tshad khri rgyab yol dang bcas pa 'di chos rje bzang po rgyal mtshan 79

gyi dgongs rdzogs nang rten du bzhengs pa yin yang zer/ bla bre nam mkha' yid 'phrog dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs khro chen mo/ bshad grwa dang sngags gsar rnying gi sgrub sde/ 'khor ba ma stong bar du nyin mtshan thun cha drug gi cha rkyen dang / sangs rgyas kyi bka' 'gyur ro cog gi glegs bam/ dgongs 'grel bstan gyur gyi glegs bam bcas bzhengs pa / sangs rgyas kyi cho 'phrul dus mchod lo mjug tu bstan pa'i rim gro gnad smin spros pa dang bcas pa de'i nyer mkho 'cham chas rnga rol/ g.yag se/ gi 'cham gsob sogs mdzes brjid du ma dang / skyid grong jo bor mchod sprin gser gyi gañdzir / dka' ba'i lam 'phrang la dge zam 'dzugs pa sogs rnam par dkar ba'i mdzad pa rgya che zhing / spyir dkon mchog la mos gus yang dag pa chub cing / bla ma'i dam tshig la gces spras phul du byung ba mdzad ces khri lha dbang rgyal mtshan gyis srid skyong ba'i dus nyid du shes rab grus (grub )bya bas sbyar ba'i deb gter ltar ro/ /phyis sku tshe'i smad seng ge byang chub bla mar bsten cing dgung lo drug cu rtsa gcig bar du bzhugs/de'i btsun mo lha rgyal mo zhes pa la sras lcam dral gsum byung ba'i sras gnyis khri rnam rgyal lde dang nam mkha' nor bu yin la/ lcam sring ā grol chos kyi sgron me zhes rdo rje phag mo'i sprul par grags shing /dus der bo dong 'jigs bral gyis rjes su bzung nas yang dag pa'i ye shes brnyes pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mar gyur pa zhig ste/ de'i skye rgyud da lta ya 'brog rje btsun mar grags pa 'di'o/ /sras kyi thu bo khri rnam rgyal lde ni rje bzang po rgyal mtshan gyi lung bstan ltar chu pho stag gi lo la bltams/ 'di gu ru pad mas mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sprul par lung bstan pa yod zer/ byis sba'i (pa'i )skabs nyid nas thugs kyi 'char sgo gsal zhing / gsung brjod pa gtsang ba/ sku gzi byin che zhing 'phong dang sgyu rtsal la mkhas pa/ snying stobs brtul phod ngar dang ldan pa zhig byon la/ dgung lo bco lnga par khrir phebs/ 'on kyang gzhon nu'i skabs thugs rgyud rtsub pa'i las kyi rgyu bas mdzad pa mi legs pa cung zad byung ba yi lho bdag po sgrol ma skyabs dang byang bdag po la yang mjal phyag mdzad (pa )dang / ding ri sgang dkar khri tshang du lo shas bzhugs dgos byung / slar gung thang du rgyal srid skyong bar spyan drangs pas lugs gnyis kyi blo gros kyi nyams 'gyur ci yang rgyas pa'i rang gzugs mdzad pa stobs po che yis rong sher sogs phal (phas )rgol skya btsun rnams tshar bcad de/ de rnams kyi sa gzhis khang gang yod par dpya khral bsdud sgo rtsigs (gcigs )su phab pa sogs mnga' thang bar skabs cung zad nyams pa las grol te dpal 'byor dbyar mtsho bzhin rgyas par gyur te/ zhal nas tshe 'di'i bu rgyud kyi don 'di tsam gyis chog phyi ma'i don du 'dren pa bla ma gcig 'tshol gsungs nas/ bo dong 'jigs bral thams cad mkhyen pa rtsa ba'i bla mar mdzad/ de la zhu don gal chen du/ ngas sdig pa mang po bsags/ pha ma 80

yang gsod pa byung na bsad snyam pa byas/ bdag ngan song du mi 'gro ba zhig cis kyang zhu zhes zhus par/rje thams cad mkhyen pas kyang sdig pa sbyang ba'i thabs lung bstan cing ngan song du mi skye ba'i zhal bzhes mdzad/ gung thang chos sde spyi yi chos dpon du rje thams cad mkhyen pa mnga' gsol te gtsug gi nor bur bsten nas mnga' 'og phal che de yi bka' srol 'dzin pa la bkod/ gzhan yang mkhas grub dpal ldan sangs rgyas/ grub chen rgyal mtshan 'bum/ gtsang smyon he ru ka sogs kyang gus pas mchod/chos sde 'du khang ka ba drug cu re bzhi pa logs ris zhing bkod phun sum tshogs pa/ rig lung gi grwa rgyas par spel ba/ dus dus su dge 'dun brgya phrag gi rgyud sde bzhi'i sgrub mchod/ bshad sgrub kyi sde so so'i bdag rkyen/ mchod gzhis gtan 'jags/ khro chen gnyis/ mchod rten ka ni (kak+ṇi'i )sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan dkyil 'khor ris su bris pa ches mang ba dang / sgo mang du ngan song sbyong ba'i sgrub mchod mi 'khrug pa'i gzungs dang sangs rgyas kyi mtshan 'bum thun cha/ sku mkhar byang dge brtan dang / spe chen rnams su nyin mtshan thun cha brgyad byas pa/ sprin zam ka ni'i (kak+ṇi'i )mdun du sangs rgyas byang sems kyi mtshan 'bum dang gzungs sngags byin rlabs can rnams skye 'gro sems can kun gyis thos par thun cha bzhir byas pa/ skyid grong rang byung 'phags pa'i spyan sngar sbyongs rgyud rtsa rigs dang / yi ge drug ma'i thun dus ji srid du rgyun 'dzugs thebs/ ri 'dabs (dang )pad ma chos lding / jo bstan go bzhi (bcas )la bsnyen bkur bdag rkyen phun sum tshogs pa dang / mngon dga'i bde chen rab rgyas 'debs pa'i mthun rkyen du shing cha gang dgos/ logs ris byed/ cho 'phrul dang dbyar gnas kyi dge rgyun spel ba/ dgon zhing gi 'brel gang yod la khral 'ul med pa mdzad la/ mngon dga' 'debs tshul ni 'di skad zer te/ gung thang gnas 'dir sangs rgyas bstan pa yi/ gzhi 'dzin dam chos 'dul ba dgos pa la/ /kan pa dpon btsun bsod nams bzang po yis/ /dbus gtsang la phebs 'dul ba'i rnam dpyad btsal/ /jo nang sgrub chen ma la brtag pa zhus/ /legs zhes bsngags brjod rten 'brel thams cad 'grig /de yi rgyu mtshan bla zhang dpon gsum la/ /bka' bsgros zhus pas kun gyis legs so gnang / /zhal bkod mthun rkyen thams cad legs sgrub nas/ /dpal ldan mngon dga'i sde chen 'di nyid btsugs/ /de yi phrin las rnam par dkar ba las/ /'dul 'dzin chen po rnam pa bzhi dang ni/ /mkhas grub chen po dpal ldan sangs rgyas dang / /rje btsun shri man sedha yan chad kyis/ /srid gsum mchod rten rang byon 'di nyid drung / /smon lam chen mo bzhi yi bsgrub tshul ni/ /dkar chag so so gsal ba 'di bzhin mdzad/ /ces kyang 'byung ngo / /rdzong dkar lha khang dmar po ru rgyud sde lha tshogs rab 'byams kyi sku brnyan dang / bka' 'gyur gser rkyang gis sgrub pa (dang )skya bris bcas tshar gnyis/ 81

yang / sman rgyud yan lag brgyad pa/ ma ṇi bka' 'bum/ o rgyan gyi thang yig mi la'i bka' 'bum rnams glegs bam grangs med spel ba'i phyir par/ skal bzang lha khang du mnga' bdag rang gi lus bskyed (skyes )pa'i yum lha rgyal mo'i dgongs rdzogs su 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sku brnyan dang / rigs sras thu bo nor bu lde gshegs pa'i nang rten thub dbang sku gzhu 'dom dgu pa bzo sgros khyad par 'phags pa/btsun mo lha mtshams dang sangs rgyas rgyal mo gshegs pa'i rjes sgrub byams pa mi bskyod pa/ rdo rje 'chang / 'od dpag med khri rgyab dang bcas pa zangs gser las grub pa thog tshad/ mchod pa'i yo byad bla re sogs dpag tu med pa de'i rab gnas kyi slob dpon dpal bzang pos mdzad zer/ sa ga'i yar ngo la chos sgo jo bstan go bzhi rnams la kun rig dang gsang 'dus sgrub mchod phyag len rnam par dag pa stong tshar du ma/ gzim khang byang la de nyid 'dus chen gyi glegs bam/ dge rten du gsang sngags gsar rnying gi glegs bam du ma/ nang rten dngul dkar gyi rdo rje 'chang dang / rnam par snang mdzad/sgrol ma rin chen phras brgyan pa/ mchod rdzas du ma/ phas rgol bzlog pa'i bstan rim/ gshin rje 'char kha'i bzlog pa gnad smin/ skyid grong 'phags pa rang byon drung du le'u dgon glang phug pa (dang )brag ka'i bla ma res gtso byas/ btsun ma nyis brgya la don zhags kyi cho ga bsnyung gnas dang 'brel ba cho 'phrul zhag bco lnga sogs sangs rgyas kyi dus chen rnams su nar ma dang / mar me'i 'phreng ba rgyun mi chad pa/ nya stong brgyad la kong spos kyi bdag rkyen du ྾ len de grwa ྾ spang zhing / tshong 'dus su 'bri mdzo mo brgya dang bcu phrag drug re rgyun 'dzugs byas pa/ mnga' 'og kun tu ri dwags gshor du med pa'i ri rgya/ nya sgong bsrung ba/ rtsam tshul rgyun mi chad pa/ zam 'phrang lo re ther chags su bcos pa'i thebs dang / dge 'dun gyi sde so so'i gzhis yin nges dang / de la snon pa mdzad pa bcas la gtsang yig mi 'gyur ba bem bzhag tha dad du legs par brtsal zhing / lhag tu rab tu byung ba rnams dang khyad par rten bsnyen par rdzogs pa gzhung lugs smra ba'i mkhas pa rnams la mchog tu dgyes pa'i bkur bzos phu dud shin tu che ba mdzad pa sogs lugs gnyis kyi mdzad srol phul du byung ba mnga' zhing / /'di yi rnam par thar pa rgya che ba las rags pa tsam yin zhes smra'o/ /dgung lo yang brgyad cu gya gcig bar du bzhugs so/ /mnga' bdag rnam rgyal lde 'di la snga phyi sras mang du byung ba la/ btsun mo'i gtso bo gnyis rim par bzhes pa'i dang po bdag mo lha mtshams rgyal mo la sras gnyis sras mo gcig dang gsum ste gcen chos rgyal nor bu lde dpal bzang po bya ba o rgyan gu ru'i lung gis zin pa'i skyes bu dge mtshan du mas brgyad pa de lcags pho rta yi lor gung thang du bltams shing / phyis nar son nas rgyal srid du mnga' gsol ba'i 82

btsun mo zur tsho nas bdag mo rin chen dpal sgron khab tu bzhes/ rnam par dkar ba'i mdzad pa 'ba' zhig la thugs dgyes pas sgo mang du lam 'bras lha khang dang / sa skya bka' 'bum gyi glegs bam rnams bzhengs/ sde gnyis chos ldan du bskyangs pa zhig byung yang gzhon nu nas sku zhi bar gshegs/btsun mo dngos la sras med la zur du bltams pa lha btsun kun dga' rnam rgyal zhes dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhig byung / nor bu lde'i gcung khri rgyal bsam grub lde sa mo yos kyi lor yab yum rnams ding ri sgang dkar du bzhugs pa'i dus su sku bltams/ des na ding ri sgang dmar skye lha ru mchod par mdzad zer la/ spyir ni mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyi gdung rigs rnams la btsan rol pa rkya bdun 'di ches 'go ba'i sku lha yin par bshad (pa )bzhin/ sgang dmar 'di rol pa rkya bdun gyi gtso bo dang rgyud gcig pas don gyi 'brel chags pa'o/ /rgyal po de'i btsun mor zur tsho bza' bdag mo bzang dkar khab tu bzhes/ gzim khang lho gsar du bcos shing dkon mchog gi sku brnyan logs ris mtshar du dngar ba dang / zangs gser gyi rdo rje 'chang gzhu tshad/ lam 'bras bla med (rgyud )khru tshad li ma gzhi (zhe )gcig de bzhin sa skya gong ma'i gsung 'bum tshang ma/ dngul 'bum/ gser thang / gos thang sogs gsar bzhengs dang / rgya dkar dang rgya nag nas byung ba'i rten gsum mchod chas khyad par can gyi sgrigs 'tshol/ gsung rab ji snyed pa bzhengs pa dang / nam ling dge 'dun rnams la rnam rgyal 'bum gter/ mngon dga' chos sder kun rigs sgrub mchod sogs rnam par dkar ba'i mdzad pa rgya che zhing /rje gtsang smyon he ru ka dang mkhas grub dpal ldan seng ge sogs bla mar bsnyen (bsten )cing lugs gnyis kyi dpal 'byor rgyas pa yin no/ /bdag mo zur tsho ma la sras mi mnga' bas kan pa bza' shes rab rgyal mo bzhes pa'i sras khri bkra shis dpal 'bar/ bar pa lha btsun nam mkha' dpal mgon/ tha chung gong ma kun dga' blo gros gsum byon/ nor bu lde dang bsam lde gnyis kyi yum gcig pa'i lcam sring don grub rgyal mo ste/ dbus su gong ma chen po glang (rlangs )lha gzigs sne'u gdong pa ngag dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi btsun mor byon/ de skabs rgyal po sne'u gdong pa gdung shin tu nyag phra ba'i skabs te mnga' bdag ma 'di la sras ngag dbang bkra shis grags pa bltams pa yi sne'u gdong pa'i gdung dus rings por gnas pa'i brtsas (btsas )su byas/khri rnam rgyal lde yi btsun mo gnyis pa btsun mo snga ma'i sku mched sangs rgyas rgyal mo zhes pa la yang sras lcam dral gsum ste gcen gong ma shes rab dpal bzang dang / gcung kun dga' rnam rgyal lde gnyis mang yul skyid rong glang po mkhar du bltams/ gong ma shes rab dpal bzang de nyid dpa' zhing brtul phod pa'i snying stobs 'phangs ('phong )(dang ) sgyu rtsal du mas brgyan pa yis phas kyi rgol ba 83

mtha' dag gzhom nus pa zhig byung ste/ gung thang gi mnga' 'og nas brgya dpon pa ngo log nas thon pa nag tshang nas dpung gi bsu ma stobs tsheb dang bcas byang du bgrod pa'i rjes 'ded mnga' bdag rang nyid ngos kyis gung thang gi dmag tshan nyung ngu zhig 'khrid de shri byang la rgyab kyi bar du brdas (bdas )nag tshang gi mgo mi rgyal skyes g.yul ngor bsad/ a jo lha phrug sogs mang po zhig btson du bzung /brgya dpon rang gnas su bzlog pa sogs snga phyi dpa' mdzangs 'phrul gyi mdzad pa de lta bu ches mang zhing / phyis skyid rong jo bo la gser gyi rgya phibs shig phul bar dgongs te/ de'i sta gon tshang bar bsgrigs zin pa'i skabs sku gshegs/ rgyal po de dang yum gcig pa'i gcung gong ma kun dga' rnam rgyal lde gu ru rin po che'i lung bstan du/ de nas gdung rabs bzhi lnga song ba na: nga yi sbas yul nags rong dben pa ru: smon lam stobs dang ldan pa'i rgyal po 'byung : bstan pa khom bur dar zhing sems can skyid: ces pa yod zer/ sku btsad (btsas )ma thag tu go bzhi'i skyes pa gang yod la btsas ston phye mar phul re gnang zhing / dge mtshan bzang pos byab (khyab /) byis pa nyid nas de yi spyod tshul las 'das pa gsung thar brling zhing tha mal gyi tshig mi 'dre ba don chen po kho na dang gang zag khyad par can zhig gi skye ba yin par yang don gyi zhal gyis 'che' bar mdzad/ tshad ma rig gter dang / sher phyin/ mngon pa rtogs pa'i rgyan dgung lo brgyad pa'i skabs su tshig don gnyis kar legs par bshad pa spro nus pa zhig byung / nar son nas rgyal thabs kyi bya ba mdzad pa'i btsun mor gu ge bdag mo dkon mchog bskyang mo khab tu bzhes shing / mnga' thang (dang )byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bzang pos cho bzhin gyi khrims kyis bskyang bar mdzad pas kun gyi yid 'phrog pa dang / yongs 'dzin du sde snod du mas mgrin pa brgyan cing rigs sngags grub pa gnas pa nor bu phun tshogs dang / gzhan yang mkhas pa'i khyu mchog kun dga' bzang po/ mkhas grub dpal ldan bkra shis sogs spyi bor mchod cing pho brang dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba 'char kha'i 'od snang la 'ja' tshon pir gyis bris pa lta bu'i gzhal med khang chen por dkon mchog gi sku brnyan cir yang bkra bar byas shing / yab kyi dgongs rdzogs la chos sgo shag mngon dga'i mkhan po rnams la thugs dam gsal 'debs nas bzung nyin zhag zhe dgu'i bar mnga' ris su gnas pa'i dge 'dun mchis so cog la nyin re bzhin kun rigs rnam snang gi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod phyag len rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas mtshan byang bzhi re bcag pa khyon stong dgu brgya nyi shu rtsa gcig 'gro ba dang / gung 'gyed/ phyi rten du kak+ṇi'i lha khang tshar du dngar ba byang chub chen po'i mchod rten/ nang rten dngul bre bcu gsum la brdung ba'i rdo rje 'chang gi sku khri rgyab yol dang bcas pa thog tshad g.yu rnying sogs rin po che'i phra rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ gser zangs gzhi (zhe )gcig gi lam 84

'bras bla rabs khru tshad ma/ sku brnyan re re'i spyan sngar chos rgyal 'phags pa'i skabs kyi dril bu rgya nag ma sogs re re/ gur gu sha'i nang mchod kyi snod spyi blug spos sgam/ dam dpe/ spyi mchod du dngul skongs (kong /) dngul bum/ ting bdun cha/ mchod rdzas rgya hor nas byung ba 'ba' zhig dang / lha lam khengs pa lta bu'i bla bre rnam (gnam )rgyan/ dar gyi ba dan/ sa skya gong ma'i gsung 'bum/ gser zhun kho nas bsgrubs pa'i glegs bam glegs shing gser chu kho nas byug pa/ si ta hu'i glegs thag na bza' dar gyi gtan khebs/ ras sgril/ ti bi'i shub bcas yod pa/ sgo mang gtsug lag khang gi logs ris mthing zhal sogs sngar legs po yod pa byang rta (ta )dben gyis bzung skabs ci rigs nyams pa'i zhig gso gdung rtsi logs ris tshar du dngar zhing yid du 'ong ba/ gnam rgyan glang rgyab ma sogs phul du byung ba'i yo byad kyis brgyan pa bsgrubs pa'i rab gnas mkhas mchog kun dga' bzang po dang dpal ldan bkra shis sogs rdo rje slob dpon du gyur pa du mas tshul bzhin du mdzad/ gzhan yang nam ling du sman 'jim gyi rdo rje 'chang la lam 'bras bla rabs khru lhag gis bskor ba dang / pho brang dge brtan du kyai rdo rje (dang )gur gyi mgon po'i sku brnyan/ skyid grong dge brgyad lha khang gi rgya phibs mdun ma gser zangs kyis legs par g.yogs pa sogs rang byung 'phags pa la zhabs tog phun sum tshogs pa dang /gong gi gtsug lag khang chen po de rnams su snang gsal rgyun mi chad pa'i mthun rkyen sbyar zhing / gzhan yang rang byung 'phags pa'i zhabs tog lho kha tshar gyi srid 'dzin du dgongs/ skyid grong 'tshong 'dus kyi zong mkhar rtse la khams gsum rnam rgyal zhes pa'i rdzong lta na sdug pa 'chi med dbang po'i pho brang (sa la )'phos pa lta bu dang / chos sde thang du grags pa zhing du rmod pa sogs mdzad pa rkya che la bzang po'i rang bzhin gyis dus 'da' ba zhig byung / rgyal po de dang gong ma shes rab dpal bzang gi yum gcig pa'i lcam mkha' 'gro rgyal mo zhes la stod lho bdag po kun dga' rnam rgyal gyi btsun mor byon nas rigs rgyud phyis rgyal mkhar rtse'i bdag por gyur/ gzhan yang khri rnam rgyal lde de la yum mi gcig pa'i sras mang du yod par snang zhing / gong gi sras bzhi las nor bu lde ni yab kyi sngon du gshegs/ gzhan gsum so sor gyes te gong ma bsam ldes pho brang lho dang / gong ma shes rab dpal bzang gis pho brang byang bzung / gong ma kun dga' rnam rgyal dge brtan du bzhugs nas mnga' zhabs kyang gsum du bgos/lho byang zhal ngo thugs mi mthun pas blon mo dbu rtse ba dpon btsun grub pa sogs kyis khra (phra )mas dkrug pa yis gong ma shes rab dpal bzang rkyen lam (du )bkrong bas bar skabs mi legs pa yang byung 'dugagong ma khri kun dga' rnam rgyal lde yi btsun mo gu ge ma dkon mchog bzang mo la sras khyad par 85

'phags pa 'byung zhes gtsang smyon ho ru kas lung bstan pa ltar/ shing pho khyi'i lo sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga yi tho rangs khar me tog gi char sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma (dang )bcas khri kun bzang nyi zla grags pa bzang po'i lde bltams/ sku na phra mo nas byis pa'i kun spyod spangs te zab cing dkyel che ba/des shing 'dzangs pa/ blo gros kyi 'jug pa legs par rgyas pa zhig byon cing / rgyal bstan rin po che ris med la gus shing bye brag snga 'gyur rnying ma'i ring lugs la bag chags mchog tu sad pa/ gzhon nu nas rgyan po 'gyed pa dang 'dus la blta ba sogs grags pa nyams pa'i rgyu drug ye nas spang ba/ dgung lo bcu drug pa'i skabs rgyal srid du mnga' gsol ba na rang sde bde 'jam dar zhing rgyas te/ gzhan sde thams cad mtshan tsam gyis zil gyis non cing dbang du 'dus pa sogs yon tan 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rjes su 'gro ba byung la/ de yang sprul pa'i sku mchog kun skyong gling pa'i gter lung las/ dus mtha'i dus su mang yul gung thang du: bstan pa rgyas dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: chos rgyal rgyal ba'i sras po khyi lo ba: bcu drug lo la mnga' bsgyur 'gro ba'i mgon: 'brel tshad don ldan o rgyan sprul pa 'byung : zhes dang /gzhan yang gter lung du ma nas zin cing lha sras mu khri btsan po'i sprul par grags/des mtha' dbus kun tu sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyal khams bde ba'i rten 'brel ji snyed pa bsgrigs/ bod yul dbus 'gyur 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang jo bo shākya mu ne'i spyan sngar gser gyi maṇ+ḍal shin tu legs pa dang dngul gyi rgyal srid sna bdun/ skyid grong 'phags pa rang byung la gser ljang brdungs kyi pa ta ka (ṭa ha )shin tu che ba/ gung thang bkra shis sgo nang du o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad ma sam bha'i sku rgyal thog gi tshad dang mnyam pa/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog glegs bam gser rkyang gis bsgrub pa/ skya bris kyi bstan 'gyur tshang ma/ pho brang dga' ldan bkra shis rab brtan phyi la laṅka pu ri'i ljongs lta bu/ nang lha'i gzhal med khang chen po bdag cag gi ston pa'i rnam par thar pa'i zhing bkod kun tu rgyas pa dang / gangs ri'i khrod kyi dbang phyug chen po chos kyi rgyal po rim par byon pa'i rabs legs byas kyi rnam thar zhib 'khod dang 'brel ba sogs rnam par dkar ba'i mdzad phrin lha lam khengs pa lta bus mtshon cing / gzhan yang bstan pa rin po che phyogs dang ris su ma lhung ba'i sbyin bdag ces pa yang ming tshig tu ma lus (pa )ji bzhin phyag tu blangs ba'i (te )mnga' 'og grwa rigs lta grub rang rang gang mos dang / mdo sngags kyi grwa sa rnams su sdod cing 'gro ba la phyogs ris kyi dgag sgrub ye mi mdzad/ chos dang mi mthun pa rnams la tshar gcod dang / chos mthun yon tan dang ldan pa rnams la gzengs bstod bya dga' bzang po gnang zhing / khyad par gung thang gi chos grwa chen por mdo sngags rab 'byams kyi grwa bskor ba'i bka' srol bzang po btsugs pa yis/ gangs can stod smad kyi 86

'dzin ma'i khyon du 'khod pa'i grwa sa ris med nas shes bya rig pa'i gnas la mkhas pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams mkhas pa'i dgos pa sgrub pa dang / chos rgyal 'di nyid kyi rnam dkar mdzad pa'i dri bsung zhim pos yid 'phrog nas legs bshad rol mo sgrogs pa la gcig tu rengs pas sde snod 'dzin pa'i 'du ba bar mi chad (par )dge ba'i lang tsho rgyas pa yi grags snyan srid pa'i rtse mor 'phyo zhing bstan pa rgyas pa'i btsas su 'gyur pa dang / yongs 'dzin dam pa yang gu ru pad ma'i rgyal tshab rig 'dzin chen po mchog ldan mgon po dang gter ston chen po bstan gnyis gling pa sogs ti shrir bsten cing / gzhan yang rigs sngags 'chang ba'i dbang po bsam yas dkar chen kun dga' grags pa dang / yol mo ba shākya bzang po/ sngags 'chang ba gsang sngags rdo rje sogs nus pa ldan pa mang po yang bla yi mchod gnas su bkur nas bod yul bde ba'i bstan rim yang rgya cher mdzad cing / sku tshe smad gong ma bsam lde'i sras khri bkra shis dpal 'bar sku mched la mnga' thang phog nas gsol thabs gcig tu dril ba'i srid na legs byas kyi dper 'os pa gnang nas re zhig rang nyid sgo mang gi chos dpon mdzad pa dang /phyis 'da' med gsum gyi mtshams bcad dam po kho nar bzhugs shing / ye shes khyad par can rgyud la skyes pa yi rol pa'i cho 'phrul rgya skar chung ngu nas phyir thon te g.yang za (gzar )ba'i gcong rom ngam 'brog tu 'dab chags rgyal po ltar lding ba dang ḍa dril dang yol go sogs shugs ldan gyis rgyang rings por dor yang 'chag gas med pa dang / thol byung du lung bstan sna tshogs pa bstsal ba sogs grub pa'i spyod pa la gnas pa zhig byung zhing / de lta bu'i sku tshe smad kyi mdzad pa la blo mig ma dag pa kha cig gis de la thugs rlung gi skyon yin no zhes pa yang gleng skad/ dgung lo yang bzhi bcu rtsa bdun bzhugs te lcags pho sprel gyi lo la gshegs so/ /de yi btsun mo ya 'brog sna dkar rtse nas lcam tshe ring rgyal mo khab tu bzhes pa la sras lcam sring gsum ste/ gcen ldang ma shes rab kun dga' rgyal phur gyi 'grub sbyor bzang po la ngo mtshar ltas dang bcas 'khrungs shing rnam dpyod dang ldan pa zhig byung yang chung ngu nyid nas sku gshegs/ gcung lha kun bzang rnam 'phrul rgyal po lugs gnyis kyi blo gros dang ldan pa gzhan gyi yid 'phrog pa zhig byung zhing de yi bdag mor glo bo nas bsod nams rgyal mo bzhes/ lha rnam 'phrul de nyid sku gzhon nu nas gshegs par snang / lha sras sku mched de gnyis gshegs pa'i skabs su me tog gi char dang ltas khyad 'phags du ma byung zer/ de gnyis kyi yum gcig pa'i lcam sring bde legs bzang mo glo bo sde par gnang yang phyis ma 'jags/ yum mi gcig pa sher bza' zhig la byung ba'i sras mo phun tshogs rgyal mo byang pa bdag po nam mkha' rgyal po'i btsun mor phebs nas byang pa'i gdung rabs spel ba'i ma mar gyur/ 87

yang / gong ma bsam lde'i sras kyi thu bo bkra shis dpal 'bar gyi mdzad pa yang rong sher sogs phas rgol rnams tshar bcad cing / la stod lho yang mnga' dbang du gyur/ dkon mchog gsum la mi phyed pa'i dad pas rnam par dkar ba'i mdzad pa yang gtsug lag khang gi logs ris khyad par can dang /bstan 'gyur gser rkyang las bzhengs pa/ bde bar gshegs pa brgyad kyi mchod rten sogs dge ba'i spyod pa rgya che ba mdzad/ de yi gcung lha btsun nam (mkha' )dpal yang mngon dga' yi chos rje dpal ldan dar la rab tu byung zhing lung rtogs kyis mngon par mtho ba zhig go/ /tha chung kun dga' blo gros bar skabs sgo mangs kyi chos dpon mdzad cing sku gsung thugs rten mang du bsgrubs pa sogs rnam dkar gyi mdzad pa shin tu rgya che ba yod zer/ gong ma kun dga' rnam rgyal lde gshegs pa'i 'og tu khri kun bzang nyi zla grags pas gong ma bsam lde'i sras po sku mched de rnams la mnga' ris phog ste snga sor gzim chung mnga' zhabs so sor yod pa thams cad gcig tu dril nas bzhugs pa la/ yum gu ge bza' dkon mchog bzang
