mo dang khri bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dus pa'i sras mo dkon mchog rgyal mo bltams pa phyis rgyal mkhar rtse'i btsun mor (byon/) de rjes khri kun dga' blo gros dang gu ge ma rtsen pa'i sras kun bzang grags pa rdo rje dpal bzang po sa pho byi ba'i lo la 'khrungs/ 'di thog mar bkra shis nam ling du 'jam dbyangs kun dga' 'phel gyi drung du sku chos mdzad de dge 'dun gyi bya ba bgyid 'os rnams rim bzhin bgyis te chos dpon dang mkhan po'i bya ba yang mdzad/ phyogs gdung rgyud dkon cing gzhan rkyen du mas lha rnam 'phrul rgyal po'i grogs su khyim na gnas te rgyal thabs kyi bya ba mdzad dgos shar/ de yang shing stag lor bdag mo ya 'brog ma yi thugs la gdon gsol nas mi ngan gzhan dang gros su stubs (btub/) bdag mo gu ge ma bgrongs/ khri nyi zla grags pa dang kun bzang grags pa rdo rje gnyis bgrong nas gung thang khab rdzong dkar ba gtsang rin spungs pa la sprod rgyu byas te gshed ma bkyes kyang / sgo mang nam ling phu lag gsum gyi ra mdas slebs te gong ma sku mched gnyis bkrong ma thub (par )sku srog thon/ bdag mo gu ge ma bkrongs pa'i mi thams cad drag sbyor la btang / ya 'brog ma rang yul du bzlog pa sogs zhabs phyi yang dag zhus nas rdzongs dkar gyi tsho zin pa byas/ yang de'i lo rjes ma shing yos la bdag mo la 'brog mas gzhis dga' (ka )rin spungs pa'i dmag drangs te dpal khud bar du bcom/ la stod lho yang dbang du 'dus pa la/ gom pa kun bzang grags pa rdo rjes chibs lga (sga )bsgron te dpung gi tshogs dang bcas g.yul du zhugs pa'i zhabs 'degs tsha mda' sde pa bsod nams rgyal pos kyang zhus shing rin spungs pa'i dmag shin tu pham par byas/ lho bdag po'i rgyal lu (bu )gnyis snga sor nas rin spungs (pa'i )lag tu gte'u 'dzin du yod pa dang / lho shel 88

drangs nas gung thang du lo gcig bzhugs/ chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor zhing bsnyen bkur gyis dgyes par byas nas gdan sa chen por phyir phebs/ lo shas song ba chu mo sbrul la khri rgyal bsam lde dang bdag chen ma yab yum gnyis ka sku gshegs/ de yi dgongs rdzogs su khri rgyal bsod nams lde nas gangs la nyi ma shar ba lta bu'i dngul gyi mchod sdong sogs rnam par dkar ba'i dge ba 'byams klas pa mdzad cing / rgyal thabs kyi khrir bzhugs pa'i btsun mo dpal ldan shar dka' ba'i rigs lhun po rtse nas bdag mo dbyangs can bsod nams sgron khab tu bsus/ mnga' thang dar rgyas su gyur/ skabs shig lcang sher rong gsum gcig tu dril nas spang zhing dmag gis bskor ba sogs bsnyad 'tshol du ma byung bar rta lo zla ba bdun par rje blon gyi dpung (gis )rag mar spyod glang bu mkhar bzung / dol por dmag bcug ste sher pa'i bla mkhar phab/ sher pa dang lcang pa'i mi gtso sna bsdus rdzong dkar (du )gte'u 'dzin du bcug de res mang yul skyid grong du zla ba drug lhag bzhugs nas lug lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu dgu la lcang sher rnams kyis gus pas btud pa'i phud zhu zhal dkar phul ba shel dkar gyi gtsug lag khang du bzhes nas mnga' ris bde bar mdzad/ spyir mnga' bdag 'di thugs dam pa'i chos la shin tu 'jug pa yis g.yul sogs drag po'i bya ba la ha cang mi dgyes shing dge ba'i spyod pa kho nas dus 'da' ba yi/ yongs 'dzin du gtso bo kun dga' lung rig dang / gzhan sa skya khri chen bsod nams dbang po/ yol mo sprul sku nam mkha' brgya byin sogs bsten cing / snga sor sku na phra mo nas ri bo dpal 'bar du kye rdo rje'i bsnyen chen bskul (bskyal )ba sogs bsnyen grub kyang ci snyed pa gnang / sku tshe'i smad du yol mo sprul sku bstan 'dzin nor bu la yang bka' chos ji rigs pa gsan/ bar skabs bod spyi'i rten 'brel gyis khab pa la 'tshe ba byed pa mang du byung ba kun thabs mkhas kyis 'dul ba mdzad kyang / mthar nang blon kha cig blo las su ma rung bashras gtsang stod rgyal po dang sel bcug ste gtsang pa rgyal po'i dpung (gis )gung thang rdzong dkar bskor ba la/ dpung 'khrug brtsams na mi mang po 'chi ba yi de la thugs kyis ma gzod pa yi (bzod par )bab gtad pas gtsang pas la stod lho shel dkar rdzong du spyan drangs nas lo ngo gcig tsam nas sku gshegs par gyur/de ltar khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal nas khri bsod nams dbang phyug lde 'di yan khug pa'i dbang du byas na mang du yod kyang rkyang par byas na dpal lde'i sras dmar po lde bsgrang na nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang de ma bsgrang na rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum mo/ /khri bsod nams dbang phyug lde'i btsun mo dngos la sras mo gcig las sras ma byung zhing / sras mo lha gcig de phyis yol mo sprul sku bstan 'dzin nor bu'i rigs mar gyur/ de la sras mo ma cig rwa ma'i sprul par par grags pa nor 'dzin dbang mo zhes mkha' 90

khro'i ('gro'i )mtshan dang ldan pa zhig byung ba ngo mtshar gyi ltas du ma dang bcas dgung lo nyer lnga'i skabs mkha' la spyod pa'i grong khyer du gshegs zhes zer/ bsod nams lde'u zur sras shig thang chung brag nas chos rje'i sras mo zhig la byung ba mtshan chos rje kun tshang du grags shing phyis gtsang sar spyan drangs nas sku thim par gyur/ de la gung thang zhol nas sras mo tshe ring rgyal mo zhes cho 'brang dag pa'i bud med cig la sras gcig byung ba thog ma'i mtshan rdo rje bdud 'dul dang / phyis chos sgor zhugs nas gzhung lugs smra ba'i rab 'byams pa byas shing / ming rab 'byams pa rgyal dbang seng ge zhes su grags/ sku tshe smad khyim btsun tshul du sku tshe rings rab bzhugs shing rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i gung sa byi lor gshegs so/ /de la yang sras mo dag las sras ni ma byung ste gung thang chos rgyal zhes snyan par grags pa'i ba dan can de yi gdung rabs de yan chad kyis grub par gyur/de ltar gtsang stod rgyal po'i dpung gung thang du bcug skabs gtsang sde srid phun tshogs rnam par rgyal ba zhes bsod nams dang blo gros kyi lang tsho can de bod dbus 'gyur gyi rgyal khams 'dul bar der bzhugs shing / gtsang du khrims kyi gtong len a lce'i drung zhes sde srid kyi gcen mo rten btsun ma yin pa zhig gis byed pa byung 'dug pa de skabs su yin par gsal/ gang ltar gung thang khab pa phab pa'i lo der byang gi sog dmag dpung shin tu che ba rdol zhing / lo phyi mar sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gshegs te byang hor sog dmag gi rgyu 'khrul ('grul )yang je mang gis bod dang bod chen por sde dpon rnams kyang phan tshun zol (bzod )mi bde zhing / dmag 'khrug ze re mang ba'i ngang de nas lo nyi shu song ba lcags 'brug la o rod kyi dpung khams nas brgyud dga' ldan pho brang gis drangs te lcags sbrul gyi lor gtsang stod rgyal po'i rdzong dmag gis bskor nas chu pho rta la gtsang pa'i gzhis ka bsam grub rtse dga' ldan pho brang gis rtsis blangs shing / rgya nag gi yul du rta (tā )ming gi rgyal srid kyang jag dpon zhig gis 'phrog cing de yang slar man ju'i rigs shar phyogs 'bog do rgyal pos shing sprel gyi lor bcom nas rgya nag gi rgyal srid byas pa sogs srid na mngon par mtho ba'i bde ba mtha' dag 'gyur bcas kyi rang bzhin de dang de 'dra'o zhes rang gzugs gsal bar ston pa'i me long du byas pa ste/des na 'khor ba'i chos la yid nges par 'byung ba yi thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam bzang po la 'jug ste 'chi ba med pa'i rgyal thabs kho na la yid rtse gcig tu gtod pa kho na 'os so/ /'dir smras pa/ltar snang 'byor pa sgeg mo'i bzhin ras kyi/ /nyer bslus sdug bsngal srin gling lhung 'di skyo/ /dal 'byor dus bzang bshes gnyen rta mchog la/ /brten nas bde gling bgrod par cis mi byed/ /bod kyi skye rgu 'dzin ma'i me long ngos/ /gung thang btsad po'i bde sdug bzhin ras gzugs/ /ji bzhin 'char zhes rdo 91

la ri mo bzhin/ /sangs rgyas pad 'byung gsung la som nyi ci/ /sngon dus gung thang rgyal po'i khab ces kyang / /da ni ྾ re ro'i ྾ grogs po nyid du nye/ /dri med rin chen gdung rabs 'phreng ba yang / /snyan pa'i ming tsam lhag mar gyur 'di soms/ /des na 'khor ba'i 'jigs pas 'brog dgon du/ /mtshan don mthun pa seng ge dbang phyug gi /rgyal thabs de la rtse gcig yid 'jug pas/ /rgyal de'i go 'phang 'gro bas yongs thob smon/ /zhes bar skabs tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /spyir rgya gar du rgyal rigs sogs mi'i rigs la 'dres pa so sor yod cing / de dag kyang rang rang gi las kyi mtha' la spyod par byed kyang 'on kyang kla klo'i grub mthas gar khyab pa der rigs dang spyod lam sogs mi gtsang 'chol bar 'gro bar sga/nga la/ bod 'dir 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i gdung shākya'i rigs li tsa (byi )nas chad (chas )pa'i rgyal rigs dri ma med pa ni lha btsad po mnga' bdag chos kyi rgyal po'i rigs 'di gcig pur nges la / gzhan bod kyi rgyal rigs bye brag pa chen por 'dod pa mtha' dag kyang sngon chos rgyal gyi blon po dang sku 'khor byas zhes rigs gtsang ba'i khungs der gtugs dgos pa yin pas des na mnga' bdag gi rigs ni ches mchog tu gyur pa dang / da lta bod na dam pa'i chos legs par spyod pa ni chos kyi rgyal po mes dbon rnam gsum gyi bka' drin kho nar shes pa yi dwangs shing gus pas bsngags par bya ba'i gnas yin la phyis byung gi bod kyi dpon chen phal che ba ni sa skya dang sne'u gdong gi blon po dang las tshan che khar 'khod pa nas bsgrang ba shas che zhing / gzhan glo bur rgyal bo rnams ni rang rang bsod nams dpung gi mi dman pa'i stobs kyis rgyal po gyur te dkon mchog gsum bla mar byed pa la ches bsngags shing rjes su yi rang ba bya ba'i gnas su 'gyur ba las rigs la brten par gyur pa ni ma yin no/ /gang zhig sdig spyod rgyal po rnams stobs dang 'byor pa rgya cher ldan kyang de la yid smon pa dang bsngags pa'i gnas ma yin te/ ko'u shasnyir sdig spyod rgyal blon gyi gnas su zas gos rin po che'i char babs pa'i mthar sa yi phung pos g.yogs te mngon sum dmyal ba'i gnas su bskal pa du mar me'i duḥkhas mnar ba bzhin no/ /mnga' thang yul 'khor gyi khyon la ma ltos par rgyal khrims chos bzhin du spyod cing dkon mchog gsum bla mar bkur nas phu dud byed pa kun byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi smon lam gyi mthus mi'i rje bor gnang bar shes nas gus pa bskyed cing dge ba la rjes su yi rang zhing bsngags par bya'o/ /de yang sa la dbang byed pa mi'i bdag po dra ma rnams kyi mtshan nyid ni/ khong zab cing dkyel che ba/ byas pa gzo zhing phyi thag ring ba/ dpyad pa zhib cing tshig btsan pa/ nye ring chung zhing gzu bor gnas pa/ spyod pa 'jam la snying khams che ba/ phyi ru dpa' zhing brtul phod nus pa/ blang dor mkhas shing khrims la gnas pa/ nor dang bud med (kyi )dbang du mi 92

'gro ba rnams ni mngon mtho rgyal khrims 'dzin pa rnams kyi rigs kyis spyod par nges par tshang dgos shing / nges par legs pa dkon mchog gsum bla mar mchod cing bsod nams kyi las la 'bad cing mnga' 'og dge ba bcu'i khrims la 'god pa ni dam pa chos las byung ba'i khrims te/ tshul de lta la legs par 'jug na dpon po khrims kyi bya bas sangs rgya zhes pa 'jig rten skye bo'i ngag nas rgyu ba yang don ldan nyid do/ /rgyal rigs dra ma'i ngang tshul dpa' mdzangs sgam/ /tshig btsan khrel yod ngo tsha phyi thag rings/ /chos bzhin khrims kyis skye rgu bde 'tsho ba/ /dam pa'i srol la mi bdag kun 'jug shog /sdig spangs dge sgrub rigs rgyud mi chad 'phel/ /dkon mchog rnam gsum blar mchod dge ba'i las/ /nyams med snga phyi 'gran 'dra yar zla bzhin/ /rgyal blon 'bangs bcas kun gyis rtag spyod shog /ces de rnams bar skabs su 'phros pa'o/ /da ni dkyus su 'jug par bya ba mnga' ris gung thang chos rgyal zhes phyi ma'i dus su mnga' bdag rgyal po'i gdung rigs las grags che bar gyur kyang de yi rgyal rabs zhib mor byas pa gzhan du cher mi snang bas nged rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa 'brug gi lor bal yul mchod rten chen po bya rung kha shor gyi zhig gso sngon med khyad par 'phags pa sgrub ste de yi zhor mang yul gung thang za 'og phug tu dam pa chos kyi bgyid 'os khyad par ba du mas lo ngo gcig sdod par shar skabs phyogs der gung thang khab gyi rgyal rabs yig rnying ci rigs pa khungs bcad pas rgyal rabs rgyas pa ci snyed yod tshod kyang da lta ma rnyed la/rgyal rabs mdor bsdus 'gyur pa mnga' bdag nor bu ldes mdzad pa'i tshigs bcad cig dang / khri lha dbang rgyal mtshan gyi skabs nyid du blo ldan shes rab grub kyis byas pa'i rgyal rabs dang / khri nyi zla grags pa'i skabs mkhan po nam mkha' chos dbang gis byas pa dang de'i sku tshe'i smad du gzhan zhig gis byas pa rgyal rabs che long zhig dang / yang de skabs nyid du byung ba'i rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas lhun grub kyis byas pa'i tshigs bcad sogs rnam grangs gzhan yang gsum tsam dang / bsam lde phyi ma'i sku tshe'i smad tsam du dus 'khor ba mang thos rdo rjes byas pa rnams mthong zhing / de rnams khungs dang 'brel ba kun phyogs gcig tu yi ge la ma rtsegs par legs pa dpyad bzod pa'i lugs su dam pa'i rigs dang chos bzhin spyod par bsngags pa'i gnas dang blang dor gyi 'jug sgo yang ma nor gsal ba'i ched du 'bad pas/ dkar po zhes sa sbrul gyi lo gro zhun zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi thob pa gnyis par 'phags yul gyi mu khun k+ṣe trar 'bod pa'i glo bo yi yul smon thang rgyal po'i khab tu rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus bkod par byas pa ste/ smras pa/ mang bskur (bkur )rgyal rigs gser gyi gzhi las rigs mchog shākya li tsa wi (byi )gyur dpag bsam yongs 'du lha yi shing / /phan bde'i lo 'dab kun tu rgyas 93

gyur rgyal pa'i rgyal tshab sprul pa'i snye ma mtshungs pa med pas kun tu dud/ /khyad par rigs gsum rnam 'phrul mes dbon bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu gangs can skye rgu 'chi med sar bkod bka' drin gang / /rjes dran de rigs las byung bsngags 'dis mi yi bdag kun rin chen gsum mchod dger brtson bzang po'i srol 'dzin shog /shulha/ dge'o/ /dge'o/ /sarba maṅga lam̐/ /

rog / bod kyi rgyal rabs gser gyi phreng bar grags pa las mnga' ris stod mar yul bdag po'i deb ther bzhugs so/ /na mo bud+dha ya/ na mo lo ke shwa ra ya/ oṃwakye dan nā ma/ bod kyi rgyal rabs gser phreng du grags pa las mnga' ris stod mar yul bdag po'i deb ther/ 'di skad du/ mdo las/ mkha' la rlung brten/ de la chu yi phung po brten/ de la sa chen 'di brten/ de la 'gro ba 'di dag brten/ zhes pa ltar snod kyi 'jig rten 'di sngon gyi 'jig rten stongs pa'i rjes nam mkha' la bskal pa nyi shur stong par gnas/ de nas g.yo 'gul rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyis mas btegs/ dga' bde chu'i dkyil 'khor gyis kun nas bsdus/ rtog dpyod me'i dkyil 'khor gyis drod phebs/ snang ba nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyis go phyes/ de la dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi rgya che la 'khod snyom/ dgung sngon po khog yangs la mtha' med pas yas phub/ dog mi 'gyur ba dbus kyi ri rgyal lhun mos mnan/ gling bzhi mtha' nas mi byer bar 'byung ba lnga yi gzer btsugs/ nam zla dang dus bzhi mi 'gyur ba srid pa'i rgyal mo bzhis tshod bzung nas sems can lha nas dmyal ba'i bar du chags pa yin no/ /de yang 'dzam bu gling pa'i tshe lo brgyad khri'i dus dmyal bar sems can gcig skyes pa yin la des bcud kyi sems can chags pa'i dus rdzogs te 'jig rten phyi chags pa'i yun la bar bskal gcig dang / nang bcud chags pa'i yun du bar bskal bcu dgu ste nyi shu'i yun yin/ de ltar phyi snod kyi 'jig rten mas nas yar chags/ nang bcud kyi sems can yas nas mar babs kyi chags/ de yang 'od gsal gyi lha tshe dang dbang thang dman pa lha rnam gyer rgyal po ye mkhyen chen po lags skad/ de'i bu lha srid ber chen po/ de'i bu lha nam ber chen po/ de'i bu lha 'od gsal/ de'i bu lha mkhar gsal/ de'i bu lha 'char byed pa/ de'i bu lha gsal byed/ de'i bu lha bdun tshigs/ de'i bu lha rgyal srid bya ba la/ bu brgyad skyes pa'i nang gi bu pho (phu )bo lha skar chen dang / dkar la 'od gnyis shar lus 'phags por babs/ de'i 'og ma 'od chen dang 'od ma rogs gnyis byang sgra mi snyan du babs/ de'i 'og ma sman bu dang sman la rogs gnyis nub ba glang spyod du babs/ de'i nang nas ri rab kyi lho phyogs be+eḍūr+ya sngon po'i 'od kyis khyab pa stong 'khor los sgyur ba'i ྾ le tshe ྾ thar lam bsgrod (bgrod )pa'i gling rdo rje gdan byang chub kyi snying po can gling shing rta'i dbyibs su snang ba'i snying po dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa 'byung ba'i gnas 'di shin tu nyams dga' bar rtogs te/ lha shed chen dang shan ma rogs gnyis dus der babs so/ /dus de na mi la yon 95

tan bcu dang ldan pa yin te/ lus 'od dang ldan pas nyin mtshan gyi ming med/ nad med/ tshe rings/khams kyi zas la mi ltos/ nyon mongs chung / rdzu 'phrul che/ mngon shes ldan/ pho mo'i dbye ba med/ dgra gnyen med/ nor gsog 'jog med/ spyod lam lha dang mthun par gnas so/ /de dus shed po'i spyi bor lba ba zhig skyes te btol (brtol )nas mi dkar po zhig byung bas rgyal rigs su byas/ tshul des lkog ma nas mi dmar po zhig byung ba bram ze/ snying kha nas mi ser po zhig byung ba rje'u/ bol gong nas mi nag po zhig byung ba dmangs rigs su gyur te/ de rnams las rgya gar gyi mi rigs byung / nu bo shed la rogs las chad (mched )pa ni gying gi srid dang / gnod sbyin gdong dmar ba gnyis/ gying gi srid la bu pho (phu )bo rlung rje bam pa dang / nu bo brag srin gnyis/ rlung rje bam pa'i bu rgyud ni/ o rgyan/ za hor/ kha me (che/) bal po/ stag gzig khrom ge gar/ ldan ma/ sna nam/ thon mi/ gru gu/ rak+shi la sogs pa rga'i rigs mi'u rigs bzhi'i zhang yin no/ /nu bo brag srin la bu pho (phu )bo thang rje thon pa dang / nu bo spre'u bu rting gnyis so/ /spre'u bu rting la 'brog chol gyi sde bco brgyad/ de las chad (mched )pa mtha' 'khob dgu bcu rtsa gnyis su chad do/ /phu bo thang rje thon pa la bu gnyis/ phu (bo )brag mi skyin pa dang /nu bo 'brang rje ded gnyis/ nu bo las chad (mched )pa yang 'khob drug cu'i mi lags skad/ phu bo srang (brag )mi skyin pa la bu bzhi (yi )nang gi phu bo smra zhang zhung gi mes po skyon pa thang rje/ de'i 'og ma se zha'i mes po gling sher thang rje/ de'i 'og ma tong gsum pa'i mes po gting rje'u dang / tha chung ldong me nyag gi mes po sku rje khug pa dang bzhi'o/ /bzhi po de las mi rigs phal cher gyes so/ /sku rje khug pa la sras bzhi ste/ sku gzugs thog ta dang / dmangs ma rje dang / gur bu rtsi dang / khab rje dang bzhi ste/ sku gzugs thog ta la bu gsum/ rtse ma dang / rje dang / rje mi dang gsum/ dmangs ma rje la bu lnga/ khra mo dang / rtsogs mi dang / drag rje dang / zas rje dang / zhang rje btsan dang lnga/ gur bu rtsi la bu lnga ste/yang rje dang / ring rje dang / smon rje dang / yangs dang / rtso dkar rje dang lnga/ rgyal rigs yin/ blon rigs la/ ldong po che yongs ru dang / ya chen dang ldong / nam chen ldong dang / thog rgyud ldong dang bzhi'o/ /rje rigs la thog rgyud ldong la chung ma drug blangs pas bu bco brgyad skyes/ de la ldong rus chen bco brgyad dang / nyos ldong la sogs pa mi rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig chad (mched )do/ /de yang spyir 'dzam bu gling na/ yul chen po lnga/ mtha' 'khob drug cu rtsa gnyis/ yang 'khob bcu drug 'brog chol gyi mi sde chen po bco brgyad/ rgyal phran phra mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi 'o skol gyi 'dzam bu gling na mchis so de yang dbus ri rab kyi lho phyogs 'dzam bu gling sog kha'i yu ba/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan byang chub kyi snying po can der bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis kyi 'phrin las mdzad pa/ 'khor los bsgyur 96

ba'i rgyal po rnams kyi che ba dben (en )tsam gcig brjod na/ 'khor los bsgyur rgyal rin po che ྾ sgo ngal zhing/྾ gnas ni ri rab kyi khog pa la gnas/ dus ni sangs rgyas re re bstan pa la byon tsa na/de'i cha rkyen du byon/ lha mi grong bdun gyi mi ni/ ri mu khyud 'dzin gyi rtse khog la gnas/ bdud rtsi za zhing bcud la sbyor/ me tog spubabs gnas kyi mi ni dpag bsam gyi me tog la skyes nas shing thog la spyod/bdud rtsi bcud 'thungs kyi mi ni/ shing 'dzam bu py-i k+ṣa'i yal ga la skyes te 'dzam bu py-i k+ṣa'i khu ba la spyod/ mi'am ci la bzhi ste/ ja ljon pa'i me tog gi 'bras bu za/ rgya mtsho'i kha zhag 'thung / sdig rtsub srin po rnams dang 'thab mo byed/ zas su sha dang khrag za/ skyes drug byis pa g.yar (dbyar )ltar drod la skye/ dgun la 'chi/ mgo gnyan (brnyan )ni lus dud 'gro sna tshogs kyi mgo so (bo/) zas su rtsa shun za ba yin gyi chu mtsho na gnas so/ /skye gnas bzhi la/ lho 'dzam bu gling mngal las skyes/ shar lus 'phags po drod gsher las skyes/ nub ba glang spyod sgo nga las skyes/ byang sgra mi snyan brdzus te skyes so/ /'tshams kyi mi'u thung rigs bzhi ni/ gam shang rgya/ gyim shang hor/ ha le mon/ spu rgyal bod dang bzhi'o//nang gi mi'u rigs bzhi ni/ sgra zhang zhung / gtong gsum pa/ ldong me nyag se zha dang bzhi'o/ /khyal ba'i mi'u rigs bzhi la/ rmig pa rmang rigs nas khyal zhes pa la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gcig chags pa yin no/ /gzhan yang rgyal khams nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang / rigs gnas khyal pa mang du byung ngo / /dus de'i tshe bdud rtsi sa'i bcud ces bya ba kha dog dmar ser ro sbrang rtsi 'dra ba gcig byung bas/ de lha bshed bus myangs pas zhim po tshor nas yang yang du sred pas/ de la kun gyis kyang de'i rjes su 'brangs nas ldags pa/ lus sra ba dang lci ba la sogs pa zhung (byung )ste lus kyi 'od nyams pa dang /nam mkha' la 'gro mi nus pa dang / mun par gyur te mya ngan byed pa'i tshe/ spyi mthun gyi las kyi bsod nams kyis bshed can gyi sku ring la nyin mo'i snang ba me shel gyi nyi ma byung / de dang dus mnyam du bshed rogs kyi sku ring la mtshan mo'i snang ba chu shel gyi zla ba byung / bshed bu'i sku ring la dgu tshigs byung / de'i tshe zas de mang du zos pa rnams mdog ngan la/ nyung du zos pa rnams mdog bzang bas/nga ni mdog bzang la khyod ni mdog ngan no/ /zhes nga rgyal gyis nyon mongs pa rnams rtsod pa'i thog ma de yin no/ /de dag kyang nga rgyal de'i rnam smin gyis sa'i bcud de nub pa dang / kun 'dus te bya ngan byas pas sems can spyi mthun gyi las kyis/ sa chen po 'di'i steng du/ sa'i zhag ro phun sum tshogs pa/kha dog dong ka'i me tog lta bu byung ste/ de yang za ba dang myang ba nas ྾ khyod song kyi ྾ bar sngar bzhin byas pas de yang nub bo/ /de yang kun 'dus te mya ngan byas pas sems can spyi mthun gyi las kyis/ sgyu (myu )gu'i tshal zhes bya ba ro sbrang rtsil skol ba lta bu/ kha dog kang ma phug ka'i me tog lta bu gcig byung 97

ngo / /de la yang za ba dang myang ba nas ྾ khyod song gi ྾ bar sngar bzhin byas pas de yang nub par gyur te/ de nas mi rnams tshogs nas mya ngan byed byed pa la sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje dang spyi mthun gyi bsod nams las grub pa'i ma rmos pa'i lo thog 'bras sa lu tshal zhes bya ba shun pa dang phug ma med pa/ nangs rtas (btab)na nangs skye/ nub rtas (btab )na nub skye/ 'bras bu snye ma re re la yul ma ga ta'i bre bzhi bzhi yong ba/ rdog ma re re la sor bzhi bzhi yod pa/ de la yun ring du longs spyod par byed pa'i tshe/ zas de nang ldang bas (snga ma bas )rags pa yin pas/ sha lci ba (bcang gci )dang snabs lud la sogs pa byung bas/ skyes pa dang bud med kyi dbang po dag byung ngo / /de dag gis gcig gis gcig la mig tshugs su bltas pas/ log par zhugs nas de sems can gzhan dag gis mthong nas sems can gyis sems can la log par zhugs so/ /zhes zer zhing rdo dang bsag (gseg )ma 'phen par byed pas/de mi mthong bar byed pa'i phyi ngo tsha khang bu brtsigs pas/ khyim brtsigs pa'i ma de yin no/ /de yang lha mi rjer gyur rgyal rigs la/ /rgyas par phye na sum brgya drug cu yod/ /de la bsdus pa rnam pa gnyis bshad de/ /dag pa sangs rgyas rje dang ma dag sems can rje/ /sangs rgyas rje ni sku gsung 'gro don mdzad/ /sems can rje la rnam pa lngar phye nas/ /stong gsum dbang byed spyi phud rgyal po dang / /sa 'dzin rgyal po phyogs skyong rgyal po dang / /rigs drug rgyal po 'dzam gling rgyal dang lnga/ /de yang stong gsum mi mjed kyi rgyal po shākya thub pa/ stong spyi phud kyi rgyal po lha tshangs pa/ phyogs skyong rgyal po rgyal rgyal chen rigs bzhi dang / rigs drug rgyal po gshin rje chos rgyal dang / /'dzam gling gdung rgyud rgyal po mang (bkur )rgyud/ 'khor lor bsgyur rgyal spyi bor skyes la sogs/ gser dngul zangs lcags dbang bsgyur rgyal po yin/ de yang dbus ri rab kyi lho phyogs na 'dzam bu gling sog kha'i yu ba/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan/ byang chub kyi snying po can der/ bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis kyi 'phrin las mdzad pa/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po rnams kyi che ba dben (en )tsam gcig brjod na/ de yang mkhas pa rnams kyi chos 'byung rnams dang / rgyal rabs che chung rnams las rgyal rigs sum brgya drug cu yod par bshad kyang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rgyal po dang ma 'das pa'i rgyal po gnyis su 'dus/'jig rten las 'das pa ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams la dbang byed cing srid pa la dbang thob nas 'jig rten rtogs pa'i yul 'das pa na shākya thub pa lta bu'o/ /'jig rten las ma 'das pa'i rgyal po lnga ste/ bem po'i rgyal po/ rigs can gyi rgyal po/ bskos pa'i rgyal po/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po/ spu rgyal bod kyi rgyal po dang lnga'o/ /de yang bem po'i rgyal po lnga ni/ ri'i rgyal po/ shing gi rgyal po/ chu'i rgyal po/ me'i rgyal po/ rlung gi 98

rgyal po dang lnga'o/ /de la dang po ri'i rgyal po ri rgyal lhun po/ rin po che sna lnga las grub cing steng nas 'og tu dpag tshad 'bum phrag drug khri yod/ steng lha/ bar lha srin/ 'og lha 'chi bdag rgyal po'i pho brang / logs la rgyal chen bzhi'i bzhugs gnas/ gza' dang rgyu skar rnams bskor bar byed pa de ni ri'i rgyal po/ shing gi rgyal po ni dpag bsam gyi shing ste/ lha rnams kyis dga' bde la spyod cing zas gos thams cad de las byung bas na shing gi rgyal po/ chu'i rgyal po ni rgya mtsho chen po yin te/ 'thung na lto ba dang mgrin pa gang la'ang mi gnod/ klu'i rgyal po rnams kyi bzhugs gnas nor bu rin po che rnams kyi 'byung sa yin pas na chu'i rgyal po/ me'i rgyal po ni bskal pa'i me yin te/ me 'bar ba'i dus na bsam gtan gnyis pa man chad bsreg par byed/ mthur du 'bar bas dmyal khams gser gyi sa gzhi chu dang rlung gi dkyil 'khor bsreg cing ri rab lhun po yang 'jig nus pa de me'i rgyal po/ rlung gi rgyal po ni stong gsum 'degs byed kyi rlung yin te/ sems can rnams la dbang grub cing 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir gnas te/ de'i rngams su dpag tshad sa ya drug 'bum/ rgyar grangs med/ rlung gi stobs kyis chu'i dkyil 'khor yang mthur la mi 'jig yog la mi g.yo bas na rlung gi rgyal po/gnyis pa rigs can gyi rgyal po la gnyis te/ mi ma yin pa dang mi'i rgyal po/ mi ma yin pa lnga ste/lha/ lha ma yin/ dud 'gro/ yi dwags/ dmyal ba dang lnga'o/ /dang po lha'i rgyal po ni dbang po brgya byin yin te/ gzhan las khyad par du 'phags shing mig stong dang ldan pa/ stobs dang rdzu 'phrul dpag tu med la/ nye dbang dang / rgyal chen bzhi/ rgya mtsho'i klu rnams kyis dpung byed cing bsrung bar byed pa de lta bu ni lha'i rgyal po/ gnyis pa lha ma yin gyi rgyal po thag bzang ris yin te/ rin po (che )sna bzhi'i go cha lus la gon te mtshon sna tshogs thogs shing lha dang 'dra ba rnams la 'thab cing rtsod pas na lha ma yin gyi rgyal po/ gsum pa dud 'gro'i rgyal po ni glang po che sa srung yin te/ mgo chu shel 'dra ba/ mche ba drug pa'i glang po che de la rdzing bu bdun bdun/ rdzing bu re re (la )sdong bu bdun bdun/ sdong bu re re la pad+ma bdun bdun/ de lta bu'i glang po che de la lus dpag tshad phyed dang gsum/ bang ni bskal pa 'jig pa'i rlung las mgyogs pa/ g.yul ngor zhugs na lha ma yin rnams kyang zlog par byed pa de dud 'gro'i rgyal po/ bzhi pa yi dwags kyi rgyal po ni las kyi chu chen yin te/ ri rab kyi rmang lcags mkhar sgo med kyi nang na 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs nas bsam pa tsam gyis gang 'dod kyi gnas su phyin cing / gcer bu'i lus la gsod gcod kyi sgra sgrogs shing / khams gsum zas su zos kyang mi 'grangs pa de yi dwags kyi rgyal po/ lnga pa dmyal ba'i rgyal po ni gshin rje chos rgyal yin te/ 'dzam bu gling nas sa 'og dpag tshad stong phrag nyi shu bcal ba'i 'og na/ a wa glang mgo can dang stag mgo can gnyis kyis 99

gtso byas pa'i las byed sprul pa'i pho nya mang po 'gyed cing / zangs rgyal mo khro chu khol ma/ lcags kyi bshal mar ri'i sdong po ral gri'i so lta bu/ chu bo rab med la sogs par sems can sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa la 'jug pa de dmyal ba'i rgyal po/de nas bsod nams che ba mi'i rgyal po la mkhas pa rnams kyi bshad lugs mi 'dra ba mang du yo da kyang / ma rmos pa'i lo tog 'bras sa lu de/ snga dro bza' rgyu snga dro (dang )phyi dro za rgyu phyi dro len gyi yod tsa na/ bol gong nas byung ba'i mi dang / gnod sbyin gdong dmar ba gnyis kyis zhag bcu dang zla ba phyed kyi 'tsho rgyags kyi phyir bsdod shes (bzlos rtsod )'thab mo byas pas med par song nas skye ma 'dod do/de nas mi rnams kyis de ni sa lu ma rmos par mi skye ba 'dug pa'i sa gzhi sgo (bgo )bar byed do zhes bar mtshams bcas nas so sor bgos so/ /de nas sa lu btab dgos zer nas sa lu btab/ sa bon 'di nas mar la zhing bdag tu 'dzin pa dang mu tshigs bral ba'i mgo rtsom pa'i dang po de yin no/ /zhing 'debs pa'i thog ma de yin no/ /de ltar btab kyang la las btus nas zos/ la las dngos su 'phrogal las rang la yod kyang gzhan gyi de rkus nas zos pas bdag po des mthong nas khyod rang gi yod bzhin gzhan gyi sa lu ma byin par len par mi rigs so/ /zhes smras pas/ ngas ma khyer zhes rdzun zer bas/ de'i gzhi la rtsod pa dang drag pa (po )dang / ma byin par len pa dang / rdzun du smra ba dang / srog gcod pa la sogs las mi dge rtsom pa'i dang po yin no/ /de la sogs pa'i rtsod pa grangs mang du byung ba dang thams cad gros byas nas/ da ni 'o skol gyi nang nas mi legs nyes kyi shan 'byed pa/ brtson 'grus dang snying stobs che ba/ thams cad la byams shing spyi snyom che ba/ spyod pa smra ba thams cad la mkhas shing tshod rig pa gcig zhing dpon du bsko dgos zer nas/ zhing pa thams cad kyis thon shas phul nas bsod nams dang ldan pa de skye bo'i tshogs thams cad kyis bkur bas mang pos bkur bas mang bkur ba zhes mtshan gsol nas/ de yang mdo las/ le los gsog 'jog byas nas ni/ 'dzin chags rnams kyi zhing dpon stabs/ zhing dang sa lu ma byin par len pa rnams la skyob par byed pa la rgyal rigs dang / chos kyis skye rgu skyong ba'i tshul khrims dang shes rab nyams su blangs te gnas pa la rgyal po zhes smras so/ /mtshan yang mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal po zhes bya'o/ /dus skabs 'di tsam nas mi rigs bzhi lngar gyur pa yin te/ de yang 'khor lo sna bdun las/ sngon ni 'di dag thams cad kyis/ /las dang bya ba'i khyad par las/ /rigs ni bzhi'am lnga ru gyur/ /zhes pa ltar/ sems can de dag (las )dge ba bcu spyod cing / khrus dang gtsang sbra la dga' ba rnams la bram ze zhes bya ba'i rigs su gyur ro//dge ba bcu spyod cing ngo tsha shes (pa/) shes rab che ba/ snying rus che ba rnams la rje'i rigs zhes bya'o/ /100

mi dge ba bcu bab 'chol du spyod cing / ngo tsha chung ba/ sdig la mi 'dzems pa/ rdzun du smra ba rnams la dmangs rigs zhes bya'o/ /de dag las khrel dang ngo tsha shin tu chung ba/ mi dge ba bcu la sogs pa 'jig rten na shin tu dman pa'i dam pa'i spyod pa dang 'gal bar byed pa rnams la gdol pa rigs ngan zhes bya'o/ /mi rigs so sor rtsom pa'i dngos po de yin no/ /rgyal po mang pos bkur ba'i sras 'od mdzes/ de'i ring la gza' dang skar ma byung / de'i sras dge ba/ de'i ring la 'od dmar po byung /de'i sras dge mchog de'i ring la sgra snyan brag cha byung / de'i dus su tshe lo dgu khri thub/ de'i sras po (gso )sbyong 'phags/ de'i ring la 'brug gi sgra byung / rgyal po de lnga la bskal pa dang po'i rgyal po sde lnga zer/ gso sbyong 'phags la sras 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po rnams 'khrungs pa'i snga ltas spyi bor sha sme gcig byung / de brdol ba'i nang nas khye'u gzugs bzang ba/ mdzes pa lta na sdug pa/ sems can thams cad la byams pa/ mtshan dang ldan pa zhig byung ste/ yab kyi spyi bo las skyes pas spyi bo skyes zhes ming btags so/ /rgyal po 'di rin po che sna bdun dang ldan pa yin te/ rin po che sna bdun ni 'khor lo rin po che/ nor bu rin po che/ btsun mo rin po che/ blon po rin po che/ /glang po rin po che/ / rta mchog rin po che/ dmag dpon rin po che ste rin po che sna bdun dang / gzhan du dmag dpon rin po che'i tshab tu khyim bdag rin po che zhes so/ /'dis rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun dang zas gos kyi char phab ste/ 'dzam bu gling lo brgyad khri lon nas/ gnod sbyin lha shes kyis bskul nas/ 'khor lo rin po ches sna grangs (drangs/) btsun mo rin po che 'khor dang dpung gi tshogs dang bcas pa nam mkha' la song nas/ shar dang / nub dang / byang dang / rgyal chen bzhi'i bar du rgyal srid byas te/ de lta na'ang 'dod chen gyis gdung ste sdug bsngal bas/ brgya byin tha ma de la ngan sems skyes pas/ bsod nams zad pas lus de nyid du sa la lhungs te grongs par gyur to/ rgyal po 'dis sems can gyi mtshan nyid la brtag cing bzo bo'i gnas dang las kyi bye brag mang po byas pa yin no/ /de'i dus su tshe lo brgyad khri thub/ spyi bo skyes kyi phrag pa g.yas su sha sme las khye'u gcig byung / ming la mdzes pa zhes bya'o/ /gser gyi 'khor los bsgyur ba gling bzhi la dbang ngo / /mdzes pa'i phrag pa g.yas su sha rme (smre )las khye'u gcig byung / de la mtshan nyer mdzes zhes bya ste/ dngul gyi 'khor los bsgyur ba gling gsum la dbang ngo / /nyer mdzes kyi brla g.yas par sha smre las khye'u gcig byung / ming mdzes can zhes bya ste/ zangs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba gling gnyis la dbang ngo / /mjes can gyi brla g.yon par sha sme las khye'u gcig byung /ming mdzes ldan du btags/ lcags kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba gling gcig la dbang ba yin no/ /de'i dus su tshe lo bdun khri thub/ de lnga la stong 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po sde lnga zer/ de'i sras rgyal byed/101

de'i sras mdzes dga'/ de'i sras mi srid pa/ de'i sras btang bzung / de'i dus su tshe lo drug khri thub/sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jigs ston par byon/ btang bzung gi sras khus stob gser thub yin no/ /de'i gdung rabs stong phrag dgu nas rgyal po rgyal byed chen po'i dus su/ sangs rgyas gtsug gtor can ston par byon/ de nas gdung rabs stong phrag stong dang brgya phrag gnyis nas rgyal po me sde ldan zhes bya ba byung / de'i bu dang tsha bo'i rgyud kyis rgyal rabs 'bum tshor rgyal rigs mnga' thang du ma la dbang byas so/ /de'i dus su tshe lo bzhi khri thub/ sangs rgyas thams cad skyob ston par byon/ de nas gdung rabs stong phrag bdun nas rgyal po bzod pa dka' thub ces bya ba byung / de'i dus su tshe lo sum khri thub/ ston pa log par dad sel byon/ chos spyod rgyud gsungs/ de nas gdung rabs 'bum dang drug khri nas rgyal po glang chen spyi byung / de'i dus su tshe lo nyis khri thub/ de'i dus su rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gser thub byon/ de nas gdung rabs 'bum dang khri tsho lnga nas rgyal po kri kri zhes bya ba byung / tshe lo khri dang lnga stong thub/ sangs rgyas 'od srung ston par byon/ chos rnal 'byor rgyud gsungs/ kri kri'i sras legs skyes/de'i rgyud brgya tham pa nas yul gru 'dzin du rgyal po rna ba can zhes bya ba byung / de la bu gnyis te/ go'u ta ma dang / bha ra dh+wa dza dang gnyis/ che ba go'u ta ma ni chos dang chos ma yin par 'dres par rgyal srid byed pa mthong nas/ bdag kyang rgyal srid bzung na 'di ltar 'gyur snyam nas thugs skyo ste drang srong mdog nag la rab tu byung ngo / /chung ba bha ra dh+wa dzas rgyal srid byas so/ /de'i tshe yul de na smad 'tshong ma 'gro ba bzang mo zhes bya ba gcig yod pa la/ skyes bu g.yo can pad+ma'i rtsa lag dang gnyis dga' mgur spyad kyin yod pa la/ de'i bar la tshong pa gzhan gcig dang 'dod log spyad pas pad+ma'i rtsa lag khros nas bzang mo'i mgo bcad nas khrag gis gos pa'i ral gri dang gnyis go'u ta ma'i phug sgor bzhag pa dang / chad pa bcad (gcod )pa'i mi rnams kyis rjes nas snyeg pas/ khrag gis gos pa'i ral gri dang bzang mo'i mgo de na yod pas/ de'i chad pa go'u ta ma la phog nas gsal shing la bskyon to/ /de drang srong gdong nag gi mngon par shes pas mkhyen nas go'u ta ma'i rtsa bar phyin nas bu khyod kyis 'di lta bu myong ba'i las ci byas gsungs pa dang / mkhan po nga la nyes pa ci yang med/ nyes pa med pa'i bden tshig gis mkhan po'i zhal gser bzhin du gyur cig smras pas/ de ma thag drang srong mdog nag po de gser bzhin du gyur pas/ de phyin chad drang srong gser mdog can du grags so/ /de nas drang srong gis bha ra dh+wa dza'i rigs rgyud chad par shes nas 'khor los bsgyur ba'i gdung mi nyams pa'i phyir go'u ta ma'i sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba rlung 'phrul gyi zil gyis mnan/ lus bde bar byas te mkhan po'i bkas gnang ba'i ngor 'dod chags kyi rtogs pas khu khrag 'dres pa thig pa gnyis sa la lhung rjes go'u ta ma 102

tshe'i dus byas so/ /khu khrag thig pa gnyis drang srong gis bu ram shing gi lo mas dril te bzhag pa nyi ma'i drod dang zla ba'i bcud kyis smin pas khye'u gnyis byung / de gnyis la ming bu ram shing dang / nyi ma'i gnyen du btags/ nyi ma'i gnyen rab tu byung zhing / bu ram shing rgyal srid byas pa'i rgyud pa brgya tham pa na/ rgyal po 'phags skyes po bya ba byung / de'i btsun mo che ba la sras bzhi dang / chung ba la sras mo bzhi byung / nam zhig btsun mo gnyis grongs te pha rol rgyal po zhig gi bu mo slong ba na/ de na re/ nga yi bu mo la bu byung ste rgyal srid la bkod na byin no/ /zhes smras pa de ltar dam bcas nas btsun mor blang ba'i bu rgyal srid dga' byung / de nas sngon gyi dam bca' yi bu rnams rgyal srid la bab pa'i tshe pho (phu )bo bzhi sring mo dang bcas sgyugs pas/ de rnams chu bo skal ldan shing rta'i 'gram grong khyer ser skya'i gnas dang ha cang mi ring bar lo ma'i spyil po byas te gnas so/ /gzhon nu de dag lang tsho rgyas pas skya sing sing po gyur pa drang srong gis mthong nas dris pas/ de rnams na re/ bdag cag rnams 'dod chags kyis gdung nas 'di ltar gyur smras pa/ de lta na khyed rnams rang gi ma gcig pa'i sring mo spongs la/ mas dben pa'i sring mo dang lhan cig rtses shig de dag na re/ de ltar bgyid rung ngam zhus pas/shes ldan dag rgyal rigs rgyal srid spangs pa rnams kyis de ltar bya rung ngo gsungs pas/ tshig de tshad mar bzung ste ming sring 'grogs pa'i rigs rgyud mang du 'phel ba yab kyis gsan nas gzhon nu rnams kyis de ltar byed phod pa zhes shākya'i ming thog mar des grags so/ /de'i rgyud lnga khri lnga stong grong khyer ser skyar byung ba'i mthar rgyal po shing rta bcu pa'o/ /de'i rgyud nyi shu rtsa lnga'i mtha' ma rgyal po gzhu ston/ de yi sras gnyis seng ge 'gram dang seng ge sgra'o/ /seng ge 'gram ni 'phong skyen pa'i mchog ste 'dzam bu gling pa'i gzhu thogs kyi dbang po'o/ /seng ge 'gram la sras bzhi ste/ zas gtsang / zas dkar/ bre bo zas/ bdud rtsi zas dang bzhi'o/ /zas gtsang ni gzugs bzang zhing mdzes pa/ lta na sdug pa/ stobs po che/ dpa' ba/ brtan pa/ mkhas shing mdzangs la bsal (gsal )ba/ spro ba/ snying stobs che ba le lo dang spyod pa ngan pa'i rjes su mi 'gro ba/ chos kyi rgyal po chos dang ldan pa/ chos bzhin du rgyal srid byed nus pa yin no/ /rgyal po de la rgyal po legs pa rab gsal gyi bu mo sgyu 'phrul ma dang sgyu 'phrul chen mo gnyis g.yog mo lnga brgya lnga brgya dang bcas te blangs so/ /dus gzhan zhig na rgyal po seng ge 'gram grongs nas zas gtsang gis rgyal srid mdzad do/ /de'i tshe mi thams cad 'byor zhing rgyab (rgyas )pa/ mi nad phyugs nad med cing phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ thams cad bu bzhin du bskyangs so/ /dus de'i tshe lha bu dam pa tog dkar po/ rigs dang / yul dang / rus dang / rgyud dang / yum dang lnga la gzigs nas/ rgyal po zas gtsang gi btsun mo sgyur 'phrul chen mo lhums su bzhugs so/ /de 103

yang zla ba bcu gnyis bzhugs pa nas/ mngal gyi dri mas ma gos par/ dpyid zla tha chung / tshes brgyad/skar ma rgyal la yum gyi mchan khung g.yas pa nas 'khrungs so/ /de skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa gcig 'dug go/ /de'i tshe bkra shis pa'i ltas sna tshogs pa dang / yul chen po bzhir rgyal phran bzhi btsas te/ ma ga dhar pad ma chen po'i bu gzugs can snying po/ ko sa lar tshangs sbyin gyi (bu )gsal rgyal/ bang sa lar dmag brgya pa'i bu shar pa/ 'phags rgyal du mu khyud mtha' yas kyi bu gtum po rab snang ngo / /gzhan yang ya rabs kyi rigs lnga brgya/ grags 'dzin ma sogs bu mo brgyad brgya/ mdun sa la sogs bran lnga brgya/ rti'u khri dang / rti'u mo khri dang / ba glang khri yang skyes so/ skyed mos tshal lnga brgya dang / gter lnga brgya yang byung ngo / /dbus su byang chub kyi shing skyes pas sras kyi ming la don thams cad grub par btags so/ /de nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i mdzad pa 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa nye bar son pa las 'jig rten phul byung gi mdzad pa'i skabs btsun mo dam pa grags 'dzin ma la khyim spang ste gshegs la khad kyi mtshan dang por sras kyi sa bon bskrun te mtshan thun de'i tha mar rab tu byung bar gshegs te lo drug dka' ba spyad de rdo rje gdan du sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lngar srod la bdud btul/ nam gung mnyam par bzhag pa'i dus/ sa ga zla ba la sgra gcan zhugs pa dang grags 'dzin ma la sras bltams pas ming ni sgra can 'dzin no/ /de'i tho ras (rangs )su shākya thub pa mngon par sangs rgyas pa'o/ /sgra can 'dzin yang rab tu byung ste srid pa'i rgyun chad do/ /spyir mang pos bkur ba nas sgra can 'dzin yan chod la/ rgyal po 'bum phrag bcu dang drug khri drug stong lnga brgya dang bcu gcig bcom ldan 'das yab sras dang bcu gsum byung bar grags so/ /da ni pur rgyal bod kyi rgyal po ji ltar byung ba'i tshul ni/ 'di bshad pa lugs mang du mchis te/rgyal rabs yun po gsum zhug blon po'i rgyal mtshan/ gsang ba'am 'bru btus la sogs pa mang du yod kyang bsdus na gnyis lags skad/ bsgrags pa lha rabs bon lugs dang / gsang ba mi rabs chos lugs so/ /gzhung 'di nyid kyi lugs nas dbyen (en)tsam zhig brjod na/ 'o skol lho 'dzam bu gling gi lte ba/ yul gyi dbus/ sa yi sgang / gangs ri rgyud kyis skor ba'i ra ba/ gangs te se shel gyi mchod rten gyi rtsa/ mtsho ma bang (pham )g.yu'i maṇ+ḍal gyi 'gram/ rin po che gser gyi 'byung sa/ chu bo chen po bzhi'i mgo/ yul bod ka gling drug ri mtho la sa gtsang ba'i gnas 'di la/ dang po dbang byed rim pa dgu byung zhes gtam rgyud rnams las bshad na'ang / bod rgyal phran bcu gnyis kyis mnar ba'i dus su/bcom ldan 'das kyi gdung rgyud yul ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la sras lnga mda' ('da' )ba'i bar ( 104

pa )bud+dha shri zhes pa mig bya ltar yes (mas )'gebs pa/ rkang lag ngang pa ltar 'brel ba/ smin ma g.yu'i smin ma skyes pa/ dus so 'khor (ma )gcig 'khrungs pas/ bram ze smin mkhan la bstan pas/bram ze na re/ rgyal bu 'di mtshan dang yang ldan/ sku bsod kyang shin tu che ste/ yab ma grongs gong du rgyal srid byed par 'gyur zhes lung bstan pas/ nga bsad pa'am yang na spun zla bsad nas/ kho rgyal srid byed par gyur snyam nas/ phyir sgyugs bsam pa la/ bram ze rnams na re/ rgyal po 'di byang phyogs kha ba can du bskyal na sems can la phan thogs par 'gyur zhes lung bstan pas/ rkang mgyogs bzhi'i gnya' ba la khri byas nas byang gi ri dang rags (rab )bsgral nas bod yul dbus kyi lha ri gyong (gyang )mtho'i kha la bskyal nas bzhag go/ /'di la yang bshad lugs mi 'dra ba mang du yod kyang shākya'i rigs yin par mthun no/ /de ling pa rnams kyis mthong nas khyod su yin byas pas/ btsan po zer/ gang nas 'byon byas pas/ skad ni ma shes te nam mkha' la mdzub mo bsgrad de/ de ling pa rnams kyis yul mi la skad smras te mi mang po phyin nas bstan pas/ rgyal phran bcu gnyis pas/ bzang zhing dpa' brjid che ba/yid du 'ong ba mthong nas/ kun mthun par 'o skol la rje med kyi rje'u spyon dgos zer nas/ btsan khyungs dang snubs gnyis/ gnyar ra rtse dang gtso gnyis/ khu sregs gnyis te 'bangs rus drug gis spyan drangs/ ra sangs dar pa dang khyung pos khod pa byas/ me nyag gi bshes gnyen blon por bskos/ de mgo nag yongs kyi rgyal por mnga' gsol te mtshan yang gnya' ba'i khri la btegs pas rje gnya' khri btsad po zhes mtshan du gsol te/ yul yar lung sba ka bzung zhes smra'o/ /sku mkhar ྾ phyi dbang (phying dbar )stag rtse'i ྾ (pho brang yum bu gla sgang yin nam sems/ dpe sgrig pa'i mchan )mnga' thang dang bka' khrims kyis sku brgyan mdzad/ 'jig rten chos bzhin du bskyangs pas rgyal khams bde zhing skyid/ sku srung sde bzhis sku bsrungs/ rgod ldong sde mi bzhi bcu rtsa bzhis phyi dgra 'dul/ g.yur (g.yung )ldong sde bzhi bcu rtsa bzhis ni nang gi tsha kha snyoms/ so kha bzhir ni so 'dzugs/ khrom kha brgyad kyis ni so kha'i dgra 'dul/ rong dor khab so nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyis bang mdzod 'gyings/ tshong 'dus bcu gnyis nas nor gyi dbyig 'bul/ legs nyes kyi bya dgas dpa' mdzangs kyi shan 'byed/ nongs kyi chad pas ngan g.yo'i khungs snubs/ mdzangs sna lnga gser g.yu dang yig tshang gis bstod/ dpa' sna lnga seng ge dang gung stag gis brgyan/ mgyogs sna lnga phyibs (chibs )mdzad nas rgyugs su spro/ rje'i bka' khrims ni gangs la nyi ma shar ba dang 'dra/ mdzad pa las su pho brang 'om bu bla sgang brtsigs/ rku 'phrog pa/ rdzun spong zhing /tshong dang khe spogs la lta/ rgyal khams thams cad bde zhing mnga' thang thams cad skyid pas/ de ltar tsho che zhing khungs btsun pa yin no/ de'i sras mu khri btsan po/ de'i sras ding khri btsan po/ de'i sras so khri 105

btsan po/ de'i sras me khri btsan po/ de'i sras gdags khri btsan po/ de'i sras sribs khri btsan po/'di bdun la gnam gyi khri bdun zer/ de yang 'khor sna bdun las/ khri bdun dbang po (bang so )gnam du btab/ /lha lus ro med 'ja' ltar yal/ /zhes de dag la dbu la 'od kyi lha dag yod pas dgung lo mang du bzhugs shing / sras 'og chibs kha thub tsa na/ yab gong ma gong ma rnams nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin bde bar gshegs so/ /sribs khri btsan po'i sras gri gung (gum )btsan po/de'i sras sha khri/ nya khri/ bya khri gsum/ bya khri la spu de gung rgyal du mtshan gsol nas yar lung gi sku mkhar chen mor bzhugs nas/ rgyal po 'di'i dus su g.yung drung bon byung ngo / /gzhan yang / shing bsregs pa'i snying po sol ba/ ko ba bzhu ba'i snying po la spyin byung / lcags rdo zangs rdo dngul rdo gsum rnyed nas/sol bas rdo gsum bzhus nas/ dngul zangs lcags gsum ston (bton/) shing la bug pa phug nas shol dang gnya' shing bcos/ mthun gnyis gnya' ru sdebs nas thang rnams zhing du rmos/ rgya mtsho yur la drangs nas chu la zam pa 'dzugs/ de la sogs pa'i las thabs mang du byung / de yi sras a sho legs/de'i sras e sho legs/ rgyal po 'di yis pho brang phyi dbang (phying dbar )stag rtse brtsigs/ pho brang sku mkhar brtsigs pa'i snga shos de yin no/ /de'i sras de sho legs/ 'di'i rings la glu dang bro dar/ de'i sras gyu (gung )ru legs/ de'i sras 'brong rje legs/ de'i sras thong sho legs/ 'di rnams la sa'i legs drug zer/ de'i sras zin lde dang / lde 'phrul gnam gzhung btsan/ lde rgyal po btsan/ se snol nam lde/ se rnol po lde/ lde lam (lde rnol nam/) lde rnol po/ sprin btsan lde/ 'di rnams ni sa'i lde brgyad do/ /de'i sras tho tho re long btsan (rgyal to ri long btsan )zhes bya ste/ yab yan chad yum lha mo dang klu mo yin no/ /'di man chad 'bangs dang gnyen bsres te tho tho re long btsan (rgyal to ri long btsan dang )sma tsha klu rgyal zhes pa'i sras khri btsan/ 'di'i rings la bsrung dang ldem (sgrung dang lde'u )dar/ de'i sras khri thog rje thog btsan/ de yi sras lha tho tho ri snyan bshal zhes pa 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i sprul pa des dgung lo drug cu re gnyis kyi bar du rgyal srid bskyangs te/ ma brtsigs lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang chen po 'um bu rdzong mkhar la bzhugs pa'i dus su bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba'i snga ltas la/ nam mkha' nas za ma tog cig babs pas za ma tog bkod pa'i mdo/ pang kong phyag rgya pa/ snying po yi ge drug pa/ gser gyi mchod rten khru gang / tshi rnam ma ṇi tsha tsha dang / mu tra'i phyag rgya rnams nyi ma'i 'od zer la 'grogs te rgyal po'i pho brang du bab pas/ bon rnams chos sam ci yin ni ma shes/ gser skyems dang g.yu phud kyis mchod pas byin rlabs byung ste dgung lo brgya dang nyi shu thub bo/ /rgyal po 'di'i ring la dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes pa yin no/ /de'i sras khri snyan bzung btsan/ 106

de'i ring la 'brog skyong ba dang / zhing gi thul sdebs dang / mtsho la star ka byas nas yur bar drangs pa dang / phu chu rdzing la bskyil nas mtshan chu nyin la drangs pa sogs de'i dus su byung ngo / /de'i sras 'brang ('brong )snyan lde ru/ de'i sras stag ri snyan (gnyan )gzigs/ rgyal po 'di'i rings la mdzo dang dre'u sre ba/ nor gyi rin thang gcod pa/ ri'i rtswa la chun po bya ba sogs byung ngo / de yi sras gnam ri srong btsan/ rgyal po 'di'i dus su rgya nag nas sman dang rtsis byung / rgya dang gru gu/ nub phyogs gnya' zhur gyi rgyal po la sogs pa btul/ byang nas tshwa rnyed/ sku mkhar khri rtsegs 'bum gdugs bya ba brtsigs so/ /de yi sras byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa srong btsan sgam po/ rgyal po 'di'i rings la/ mtha'i rgyal khams thams cad dbang du bsdus te rgyal phran thams cad kyis so so nas sku skyes 'bul zhing 'phrin yig bskur ro/ /rgyal po 'dis mdzad pa phyag rjes kyi rgya bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad kyang / phyogs kyi phrin yig rnams kyi lan bskur ba la/ bod la yi ge med pa dang / mes tho tho ri snyan shal gyi mchod gnas gnyan po gsang ba yang rgya gar gyi yi (ger )'dug pas bod yig tu byas te bsgyur dgos par dgongs nas/ thon mi a nu'i bu la gser bre gang bskur nas g.yog 'khor bcu drug dang bcas te kha cher yi ge slob tu btang ngo / /de dag (gis )bram ze li byin las yi ge bslabs/ paṇ+ḍi ta seng ge las sgra bslabs te bod skad dang bstun nas gsal byed nyi shu rtsa bzhi drug rings bcos nas sum cur mdzad/ gzhan yang kha che nā ga ra'i yi ge dang bstun nas bsgyur ro/ /de nas thon mi bod du phebs/ rgyal po u (dbu )ru'i btsun mo tshal du bzhugs pa dang mjal/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ khyed kyis yi ge dang sgra lobs sam/ spyan ras gzigs la bstod pa gcig gyis dang smras pas/ thon mis/ zhal ras gsal la ngo (ngang )mdangs gang ba bzang / zhes pa'i pa'i sho lo ka bris te phul bas rgyal po shin tu mnyes te/ byin gyi khog mar rdo'i gtsug lag khang brtsigs te spyan ras gzigs kyi mdun du yi ge rdo la bris te bzhag go/ /bod du yi ge dang gtsug lag khang la snga ba de gnyis yin no/ /de nas bal po nas khro gnyer ma'i sprul pa bal mo bza' khri btsun blon po thon mi sam bho ṭas gdan drangs/ de'i rdzongs la jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje/ byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo/ tsan dan gyi jo mo sgrol ma rnams spyan drangs/ rgya nag nas sgrol ma'i sprul pa rgya mo bza' kong jo blon po rig pa can gyis gdan drangs/ de'i rdzongs la jo bo rin po che/gzhan yang 'jig rten lugs kyi 'bras chang / nas chang / mdor na zas kyi yo byad tshang ba/ 'o ma zho ru bsgyur ba/ zho la mar dang da ra/ da ra mthud (thud )du bsgyur ba/ kham sa rdza ru bsgyur ba/ rang 'thag chus bskor ba/ thags khri thags dang / bzo'i rig pa mang du byung ngo / /gzhan yang lha sa ra mo che la 107

sogs pa'i gtsug lag khang dpag tu med pa bzhengs/ dmar po ri dang lcags pho (po )ri la pho brang btab/ ri gnyis kyi bar lcags thag gis sbol ba'i ldem (zam )btsugs/ gtsug lag khang dang mkhar dgu brgya tsam brtsigs so/ /de'i tshe rgya gar nas slob dpon ku ma ra dang / bal po'i slob dpon shri mañdzu dang / kha che'i slob dpon ta bu ta dang / gha nu ta dang / bram ze li byin dang / rgya nag gi slob dpon ha shang ma hā de ba rnams spyan drangs/ lo tsā ba thon mi dang / dharma go cha dang / lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje rnams kyis chos ci rigs su bsgyur cing gtan la phab/ rgyal po 'di'i ring la shar tsa mi dang shing mi/lho glo bo dang zhang zhung / byang hor gyi rgyal khams la sogs pa dbang du bsdus nas/ dam pa chos kyi srol bstod (gtod )pa yin no/ /de'i sras mang srong mang btsan/ de'i sras gung srong gung btsan/ de'i sras 'dus srong mang po rje/ rgyal po 'di'i dus shar rgyal po'i chu/ lho'i bal po'i shing khug byang hor gyi kra krag dar chen/ nub la bo chun rings/ sbal ti gyi srang gi nang gong / smad kyi shing dkar tshun chad mnga' 'og tu 'dus te/ rgya nas ja dang / ja dha man/ sur rna/ 'bur sko/ rgya gling la sogs byung ngo / /gzhan yang rtsal po che'i mi bdun byung ste/ khri bdun yul byin gyis brag shongs 'dom dgu la 'phyongs (mchongs )nus/ gsal snang dung grags kyis g.yag rgod kyi rkang pa nas brteg ('degs )nus/ a thog rgod btsan gyis seng ge stag spu nas bzung nus/ cog ro (klu )gong gis shing sbom 'dom do la mda' yis 'bigs nus/ 'bro ltag bzang gis mkhar skya chus 'bebs nus/ 'gos g.yag chung gis sha ba'i brud (rlid )bu gser gyis bkang nas klad la bskor nus/ snga gong bod kyi rgyal po rnams las mthu stobs che ba yig yin no/ /de'i sras khri lde gtsug brtan mes ag tshom rgyal po/ rgyal po de'i rings la lha sa kha brag dar phu khar btab/ mdo smad sgang / gling bcu khri rtse/ brag dmar du ga chu shar sgo/ phad thang ka med/ ka chu pan chung / brag dmar mgrin bzang la sogs pa'i gtsug lag khang mang du bzhengs/bran ka su dgu sho ka dang gnyags dzñā na ku ma ras lo tsā byas te mdo gser 'od dam pa dang las brgya pa gnyis bsgyur/ pi tsi tsan+d+ra shris sman dpyad dang rtsis la sogs pa bsgyur nas chos srol chen mo btsugs so/ /de'i sras byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa khri srong lde'u btsan/ rgyal po des rgya gar nas mkhan po bho dhi sa twa spyan drangs nas kha che a nan tas lo tsā byas nas/ dge ba bcu/ khams bco brgyad/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi chos bshad pas/ bod kyi lha srin 'khrugs pas dmar po ri la thog brgyab/ phang thang chus khyer/ mi nad phyugs nad mang po byung bas/ mkhan po'i zhal nas/ ngos chos bshad pa la bod kyi lha srin mi dga' bar 'dug pas/ lha srin 'dul ba la o rgyan gyi yul nas slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas spyan drongs/ 'o skol gsum sangs rgyas 'od srung gi mchod rten gyi drung du 108

smon lam gcig pa yin gsungs pas/ sba gsal snang dang / lcog ro legs sgra gnyis btang nas slob dpon gdan drangs nas/ bod kyi lha srin thams cad dam la btags nas/ rgya gar gyi o tan+ta pu ri'i gtsug lag khang la dpe byas nas bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi mang po dang lo tsā ba sad mi bdun gyis sde snod gsum dang / gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde dang po gsum dang / mdor na rgyal po yon mchod gsum gyis bod mun pa'i gling 'dra bar dam chos gtsang la ma nor bar dar zhing rgyas par mdzad do/ /'bangs kyi nang nas rab tu byung ba la'ang zhabs 'og gi rde'u dbu'i gtsug tu khur ba'i khrims mdzad nas/ bsam yas la bshad grwa dang mching (mchims )bu la sgom grwa btsugs/ pho brang rlung tshugs su grong khyer skyid pa'i 'byung gnas dang tshangs pa'i 'byung gnas gnyis btab/ de'i dus su slob dpon pad mas rgyal po la rig 'dzin gyi tshe chu gnang bas/ blon po de la mi dga' ba rnams kyis rgyal po la mon gyi smyo chu dug yin pas mi gsol bar zhu zhus pas/ rgyal po yang the tshom du gyur te ma gsol/ nad du mdze mi yong ba'i phyir klu'i rgyal po ma dros gzi can dam la btags nas rdo rje bsnun pas/ zil chen khye'u gcig tu sprul nas rgyal po la grogs po bcol nas ci 'dod pa'i dngos grub gtor (ster )bar khas blang pas/ rgyal pos klu'i ngo chen mdzad pas thugs dam glod do/ /de nas slob dpon lho nub rnga yab tu srin po 'dul du bzhud pa yin no/ /de'i dus du bod thams cad bde zhing skyid pa/ skye bo'i tshogs mang ba/ lo legs pa/ dus kyi 'khrugs pa med pa/ mtha' bzhi'i sde thams cad mnan te/ shar rgya nag lho rgya gar/ nub sbal ti dang 'bru shal/ byang hor gyi sa yi cha o don kas dkar rnams dbang du bsdus te chos khrims dang rgyal khrims gnyis ka shin tu btsan par mdzad nas/ rgyal po 'di'i rings la bon snubs shing dam pa'i chos dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa yin no/ /des na/ rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab dam pa zhi ba 'tsho/ /sngags 'chang bla med dge sbyong pad ma 'byung / /mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan ka ma la shi la/ /khri srong lde'u btsan lhag pa'i bsam pa can/ /bod yul mun pa nyi ma shar ba bzhin/ /dam chos snang ba phyogs mthar rgyas mdzad pa/ /bka' drin 'khor med dam pa bzhi ka la/ /bod rnams rtag tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes kha ton yang byas so/ /de yi sras mu khri btsan po/ rgyal po de yis yab kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i phyir du bsam yas su 'dul ba mngon pa mdo sde gsum gyi mchod pa btsugs/ chos byed pa la 'tsho ba bla nas sbyor/ bod kyi phyug ltogs lan gsum snyoms/ rgya dang gnyis ka'i cha nas yab la 'dud pa tsam gyi (du )rang ma byung yang bzang mdzad/ rgya dang bod sa bgos byas nas bod (la )dbang ba'i rtswa thams cad rtse mo bod du bltas nas skyes so/ /de'i sras sad na legs/ rgyal po des rgya sde'i skar (dkar )chung rdor dbyings kyi gtsug lag 109

khang bzhengs/ paṇ+ḍi ta ka ma la shi la sogs gdan drangs/ gnyags dzñā na ku ma ras lo tsā byas te sngar med pa'i chos mang po bsgyur ro/ /de'i sras gtsang ma/ ral pa can/ glang dar ma/ btsun mo chung ba gcig la lha rje dang lhun grub gnyis dang lnga 'khrungs so/ /sras che ba gtsang ma chos la dga' ste rab tu byung nas mi chos la gdams pa'i bstan bcos gcig kyang mdzad/ dar ma ni sdig la dga' ste rje'i 'os min/ bar pa ral pa can la rgyal srid gtad do/ /des 'u shang rdo'i grong khyer btab nas gtsug lag khang rgya phibs g.yu sngon can bzhengs/ sngon yab mes kyi ring la rgya dang / li dang / za hor dang / kha che la sogs pa sna tshogs nas chos mang po bsgyur bas brda mi 'dra ba mang po 'dug pas/ chos slob dka' ba yin gsung nas/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra/ shi lan+d+ra bho ti/ dha na shi la sogs pa gdan drangs/bod kyi lo tsā ba bka' (ska )cog gnyis dang / ban de ye shes sde rnams kyis thams cad skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab/ tha na bre dang srang la sogs pa rgya gar dang mthun par bcos/ rab tu byung ba rnams re re la 'bangs mi khyim bdun bdun phul/ rgyal po dbus la bzhugs pa la dbu'i ral pa g.yas g.yon gyi sna la dar yug btags nas rab tu byung ba rnams der bzhugs bcug pa dang / g.yas gral g.yon gral gung gral dang gsum/ yon tan can la de'i dus phud pa yin no/ /rgyal po de'i ring la shar phyong po lo shan gyi ri rgyud dar dkar gyi yol ba 'dra ba rgya nag po zad pa'i sa mtshams la gtugs te dbang du 'dus/ der rdo ring btsugs teng 'di man chod dbang ba yin zhes pa'i yi ge bris te bzhagalho phyogs glo bo mon/ rgya gar li/ za hor/ gaṅga'i rgya mtsho lcags kyi pa tra gdong tshun chod dbang du 'dus/ nub phyogs stag gzig gi mtshams gru sha la sogs dbang du bsdus/ byang hor gyi rgyal khams thams cad dbang du 'dus te/ lho 'dzam bu gling sum gnyis la mnga' mdzad cing mtha' dbus kun tu gtsug lag khang brgya rtsa bzhengs so/ /'di yan chad bstan pa snga dar yin no/ /de (nas )mnga' bdag dar ma dbyig dur ('u dum )btsan gyi sku ring la chos kyi bstan pa nub pa la bod yul du mnga' bdag ral pa can gyis paṇ+ḍi ta mang po spyan drangs pa dang / gser bres phul ba dang / bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba mu stegs kyi bram zer bzhis ma theg nas bod yul phung ba'i phung 'gong bzhir skye bar smon lam btab nas lcebs pas 'dod pa ba ste/ mnga' bdag dar ma dbyig dur ('u dum )btsan dang / cog ro legs sgra dang / dbas do re stag snya dang / 'bal 'khor zher legs pa dang bzhi'i thugs yid du phung 'gong nag po dang / gnam de'u dkar po dang / sa the'u nag po dang / byang rong gi te bzhi'i gdon zhugs te/ rab tu byung ba kun phab/ lha shākya mu ne chu la bkal ba la bsgul yang ma nus pas sa 'og tu sbas/ byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo byed ma'i 'og tu sbas/ lha sa bsam yas 'phrul snang 110

rnams kyi sgo brtsigs te zhal ba byas te btsun pa chang 'thung ba'i yi ge bris/ btsun pa'i rtags ma bor ba la la sgyugs/ la la bros/ lus pa rnams la rnga shang dang mda' gzhu khyi (bcas )gtad de ling la btang / la la la shan pa bcol/ phyis chos byed pa'i srol ma btsugs/ 'bangs rnams la yang ma gnongs par bka' chad phab pas bka' khrims mgo nas bshig mnga' ris mtha' nas 'gras pa yin no/ /de tshe rgya na bod (la )dbang ba'i ri gcig yod pa rdib/ bod nas rgya la 'bab pa'i chu bo chen po rma chu skyangs bya ba yar la zhag gsum log de la sogs pa'i ltas ngan mang po byung ngo / /de nas ring zhig nas yer pa'i lha ri snying po la/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje sgom gyis (gyin )yod pas tshor te btsan po la snying rje khyad par can skyes nas bkrong skad/de ltar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsnubs pa na/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi tshul ni/ glang dar ma'i sras 'od srung / khong gis lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje nas sman bla'i mchod thog zhus nas smon lam btab/ sman bla'i byin rlabs kyis rgyal srid kyang zin/ mes gong ma rnams kyi bka' drin ltar chos khrims dang chos rtsigs (gcigs )dam du zhes (bzhed )de mnga' ris chos bzhin du bskyangs so/ /gzhan yang rtsang rab gsal dang / yo (g.yo )dge 'byung / dge ba rab gsal dang / spa rab (sba rag )sogs bcus bsnyen par rdzogs nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par gyur to/ gzhan yang gtsug lag khang gnam gyi skar ma lta bu bzhengs so/ /de'i sras lde dpal 'khor btsan/ rgyal po 'di'i ring la stod mnga' ris kyi gtsug lag khang la sogs pa gtsug lag khang brgyad bzhengs/ 'bum la sogs pa'i gsung rab kyang mang du bzhengs nas chos rtsigs (gcigs )kyi dbu snyung ba yin no/ /de'i sras skyid lde nyi ma mgon dang khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal dang gnyis/ skyid lde nyi ma mgon ni bod kheng log gi ྾ 'bal ma zug gar ྾ khyung dpal ldan grub dang me nyag pa ā kā badz+ra gnyis kyis gtso byas pa'i rta pa brgya stong mnga' ris su byon pa'i lam khar nya dang sgo nga gsol dgos pa byung nas der ras kyis phur nas drangs pas/da lta kha gyad ras phur rgyal po'i lugs su song ba yin no/ /de nas ra la'i rgyud du phebs/ rta'i lo la ra la mkhar dmar brtsigs/ lug gi lo la rtsi tho rgya ri brtsigs nas/ dam lag gi gzhung rnams la yul dang grong khyer mang po btab dgongs/ mar yul la gnod pa ma mdzad/ de'i dus su mar yul gyi la dwags stod ge sar gyi rgyud pas 'dzin/ smad rnams rang dga'i sil bur yod pa yin no/ /de tshe dge bshes bkra shis btsan gyis pu (spu )rang du zhus te 'bro bza' 'khor skyong btsun mor phul ba khab tu bzhes pa la sras gsum byung zhing / sku mkhar nyis gzungs brtsigs te rgyal sa btab nas mnga' ris skor gsum chab 'og tu bsdus te rgyal khrims chos bzhin du bskyangs so/ /sras gsum ni/ lha che ba dpal gyi mgon/111

bar pa bkra shis mgon/ chung ba lde gtsug mgon dang gsum mo/ /de nas sras gsum la mnga' ris so sor gnang ste/ lha che ba dpal gyi mgon la mnga' ris mar yul/ 'bangs khu nag btsan/ shar ru thog dang gser kha gog lad kyi bde mchog dkar po/ mtshams kyi rwa ba dmar po/ wam le yi mig gi pha bong g.yag lder/ rdo phug pa can yan chad/ byang gser kha mgon po/ nub kha che'i la rtsas rgyal rtogs pa rnams yin no/ /bar pa bkra shis mgon gyis gu ge pu (spu )rang rtse dang bcas pa la mnga' mdzad/ chung ba lde gtsug mgon gyis zangs kar sgo gsum sri ti spi chog dang bcas pa la mnga' mdzad/lha chen dpal gyi mgon gyi sras 'gro mgon dang chos mgon gnyis/ 'gro mgon gyi sras bla chen grags pa lde/ de'i sras bla chen byang chub sems dpa'/ de'i sras bla chen rgyal po/ rgyal po de'i dus su/klu 'khyil gyi dgon pa btsugs nas dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ gangs ri gsum mang dus lnga brgya/ nyung dus brgya tsam re sgrub pa mdzad pa la 'tsho ba'i yo byad skyo dub med pa yun ring mdzad do/ /de'i sras bla chen ud pa la/ rgyal po de'i dus su/ la dwags stod gsham gnyis kyis dmag sdongs nas nyung ti la brgyab/ nyung ti rgyal pos ti se nam bzhu dang ma dpang (pham )nam skam bar du mdzo dang lcags la sogs pa'i khral dang spya (dpya )'bul mna' byas nas dus da lta'i bar du yang yod do/ /gzhan yang glo bo pu (spu )rang man chod lho phyogs bre srang gi yul chu la me 'bar tshun chad/ nub phyogs ra shan 'grengs shing / stag khu mtshur yan chod/ byang phyogs ka brus phan chod mnga' 'og tu bsdus te lo re la khral sogs 'bul zhing zhal lta ru yong ba yod do/ /de'i sras bla chen nag lug rgyal po des stag gi lo la ban (wan )les mkhar brtsigs/ 'brug gi lo la kha la rtse brtsigs so/ /de'i sras bla chen dge bhe dang dge 'bum/ de'i sras bla chen jo rdor/ de'i sras bla chen bkra shis mgon/ de'i sras bla chen lha rgyal/rgyal po 'dis rgyud rdo rje rtse mo dang / ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud/ rgyud 'bum tshang ma gser la bzhengs so//de'i sras bla chen jo bo dpal/ rgyal po 'dis rgyal khrims dang chos khrims kyi mdzad pa mthar phyin par mdzad do/ /de'i sras bla chen dngos grub/ rgyal po de'i dus su rab tu byung ba dbus gtsang du 'gro ba'i srol btsugs nas/ yab mes kyi gtsug lag khang rnams la zhig gso mdzad pa dang / khyad par du chos kyi rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i drung du gser dngul zangs byu ru mu tig la sogs pa'i brgya 'bul dang / bka' 'gyur tshar gnyis dang gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor mang du bzhengs so/ /de'i rgyal bu rin chen/ de'i sras lha chen shes rab/ rgyal po 'di'i rings la/ sa bu'i hang rtse ma zhes pa'i kha la grong khyer seng ge sgang zhes pa brtsigs nas mang yul sa bu spyang mkhar du btags so/ /de'i sras bla chen khri gtsug lde/ rgyal po des gle ru mchod rten brgya rtsa bzhengs/ sa bu ru brgya rtsa gnyis bzhengs so// /de'i 112

sras bla chen grags 'bum lde dang grags pa 'bum gnyis/ grags 'bum ldes gle la sogs pa mnga' mdzad/ rgya ma phyag rjes su gtsug lag khang dmar po bzhengs nas/ rgyal ba byams pa mgon po dgung lo brgyad pa'i sku tshad dang g.yas g.yon gnyis su 'jam dbyangs phyag na rdo rje gnyis thog tshad bzhengs/logs bris rnams la bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi 'dra sku dang / 'jig rten rten bzhag dang / rang nyid mos pa'i lha rnams tshang ba dang / lha khang gsum brtsigs mtho gling dpe ru bzhengs (bzhes/)gsung gi rten du gzungs 'bum chen mo dang / dkon mchog brtsegs pa/ lang kar gshegs pa sogs bzhengs/ thugs kyi rten la te'u gser po gle'i yul la gnod pa gcig yod pa la de btums nas phyi mchod rten gyi tshul/ nang lha khang brgya rtsa yod pa bzhengs/ mchod rten ming la te'u bkra shis 'od 'phro zer/ gzhan yang gle'i mdo de na te'u glang po che 'dra ba zhig yod pa la/ rgyal po des ri ma gi la dge slong bzhi sde gcig btsugs nas shi yang 'gyod pa med gsungs pa la/ bsnyigs dus kyi kun mkhyen tsong kha pa chen pos rang gi shangs khrag la 'khrungs pa'i tshe dpag med mtheb tshigs tsam yod pa bya bral gnyis la bskur nas/ yang na grags pa'i mtshan can/ yang na lde'i mtshan (can )phyag tu phul gsungs pa la/ khong gnyis mar yul du slebs nub de na grags pa zhes bya ba yod pa la khong gi drung du phyin pa dang / bya bral gnyis la spyan log kyang ma gzigs par gle ru yong / de'i tho rangs rgyal po'i zhal nas de ring nga'i zhal lta ba la/ bya bral 'be dhe pha mon/ ri shi su yang ma bgag ('gag )gsung bas/ bya bral gnyis byung bas/ rgyal po bzhengs nas bya bral gnyis la bsu ba mdzad/ bya bral gnyis kyis kyang sku skyel phul nas/ rgyal po shin tu dgyes te sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che la dpe nas dpe thub kyi dgon pa ma brtsigs lhun gyis grub pa de brtsigs nas dge 'dun gyi sde mang po btsugs so/ /de'i sras blo gros mchog ldan rgyal po/ de'i dus su gu ge nas dmu khrab zil pa/ ma mo'i mun sgribs/ khrab chung ka ru/ lha khrab dkar pos gtso byas khrab bco brgyad/ nam mkha' khrag ldog 'brong rtse rings/ glog dmar me gsod la sogs pa'i ral gri bco brgyad/ bdud gri nag po/ dam khri gzhungs brgyad rnams kyis mgo byas pa'i skyed (sked )gri bco brgyad/ g.yu 'od ldan/ lha g.yu dkar pos gtso byas pa'i g.yu bco lnga/ sga ma ji khri steng / bkra shis 'od ldan sogs sga nyi shu/ phyibs (chibs )gro bo lnga bcu/ ngang pa lnga bcu/ 'ol ba nyi shu/ khra bo sum cu/ 'bri zal mo nyi shu/ g.yag kham pa nyi shu/ lug la sogs pa'i phal spya (khral dpya )'bul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / mnga' ris skor gsum chab 'og tu bsdus nas dar zhing rgyas pa yod do/ /bla chen grags pa 'bum gyis rab brtan lha rtse dang te ya sogs la mnga' mdzad/ rgyal sa gting sgang brtsigs/ de'i sras lha chen bha ra/ de'i sras lha chen bha gan/ rgyal po de 'khrug pa la shin tu 113

dga' ba gcig yod pas/ shes pa dang sdongs nas/ bla'i rgyal po blo gros mchog ldan/ drung pa a li/ sla brtan dar rnams phab nas mnga' 'og tu bsdus/ de'i sras bla chen lha dbang rnam rgyal dang bkra shis rnam rgyal (gnyis/) lha dbang rnam rgyal sku stobs dang sgyu rtsal shin tu che ba yod pa la/ chung ba bkra shis rnam rgyal g.yo che ba yod pas spyan bton nas gdung rgyud kyi phyir btsun mo dang bcas ling sked du bzhag go/ /de la sras gsum 'khrungs/ tshe dbang rnam rgyal/ rnam rgyal mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gsum po de sku skyed shin tu che bas/ gzhan gyi zla skyed las khong gi zhag skyed che/ gzhan gyi lo skyed las khong gi zla skyed che ba re byung ngo / /de yi tshe rgyal po bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis rgyal srid mdzad do/ /rgyal po des pu rig gyen chad/ gro shod man chad mnga' 'og tu bsdus nas rta khyu bsam gyis mi khyab pa khyongs/ sku mkhar gle'i rnam rgyal rtse mo dang chu bo'i grong khyer btab/ hor gyi dmag byung ba la 'thab pas hor mang po bsad/ rnam rgyal rtse mor mgon khang bzhengs nas hor gyi ro thams cad mgon po'i 'og tu mnan/ gzhan yang mgon khang bzhengs nas 'bri gung nas chos rje ldan ma zhes pa'i sangs rgyas dngos de gdan drangs nas sgang sngon bkra shis chos rdzong zhes pa'i dgon pa btab/ yul nas btsun khral btab nas sgrub rgyud kyi bstan pa btsugs/ dgon pa mthong ba'i mtshams su dar chen phyar nas/ 'di'i mdun du rkun ma/ rdzun ma/ mdor na rgyal po'i sku mkhar sku srog la brdo ba'i mi yod kyang de'i nang du chud pa tsam gyis nag las thar bar mdzad do/ /gzhan yang 'bri gung / sa skya/ dge ldan/ lha sa/ bsam yas rnams su gdan bzhugs/ gser chab/ dar chen/ mang ja/ brgya 'bul sogs dang / bka' 'gyur/ bstan 'gyur/ gzhan yang glegs bam mang po dang / mchod rten mang po bzhengs so/ /de nas sprul pa'i rgyal po tshe dbang rnam rgyal de rgyal srid la mnga' gsol nas sku na gzhon nu la dmag mdzad pas byang ngam rings dang glo bo/ pu (spu )rang / gu ge la sogs pa mnga' 'og tu bsdus/ lho phyogs dzum lang dang nyung ti/ nub phyogs shing dkar dang khab gar tshun chod mnga' 'og tu bsdus/ byang hor la dmag brgyab gsung ba la/ nub ra ba kun gyis zhu ba phul nas ma mdzad/ gzhan de rnams kyi jo bo kun lte ba la khyongs/ mkhar rnams la sku tshab bzhag nas mar yul thams cad dar zhing rgyas pa yin no/ /gu ge nas khral dang spya (dpya )'bul ba la/ lo re la gser zho sumabargya dgu/ ru thog nas gser zho nyis brgya drug cu/ tsher mo brgya chibs gcig rtsos (gtsod )kyi rkyal pa bcu/ mkhar o ldong dang zhing dar chen dar chung rnams dang / gzhan yang khral spya (dpya )la sogs pa phyogs phyogs nas 'bul ba bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /rgyal po de'i thugs dgongs la/ /lha sa dang gu ge'i mtho gling rnams kyi thig tshad byas nas sngar yab mes rnams kyis sangs rgyas glang po'i gdung yang rtse mor bzhag pas (kyang )mi rnams kyis 114

rgyab tshun chod la brgyab/ rta g.yag ra lug la sogs pas sa gzhi bkang nas khyongs/ de'i rting gu ge nang la dmag mdzad nas sha nga dang zha ye gnyis ar jag la btang nas da dgas (la dwags )thams cad g.yag lug gis khengs/ ru shod bdag mo skal bzang rgyal mo khab tu bzhes/ grub thob kyi rgyal po stag tshangs ras chen zhes bya ba/ rgya dkar nag o rgyan/ kha che sogs dang grub thob brgyad cu thams cad kyi zhal kha mngon sum du gzigs pa'i 'ja' lus grub pa'i sangs rgyas de gdan drangs nas/ gser zangs kyi byams pa dgung lo brgyad pa'i sku tshad rin chen sna tshogs kyis spras pa dang / rgya shar nub thams cad kyi rgya lha thams cad spyan drangs nas byams chos sde lnga po ti lnga bzhengs/ rgyun mchod dge slong lnga bskal pa nam gnas su btsugs nas mchod pa mar me nyin 'bar mtshan 'bar/ rgya gos ya sa mang po'i phan ('phan/) rgyal mtshan dar chen la sogs pa btsugs/ gzhan yang 'phags pa rab 'byor kyi sku'i skye ba paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ yum gyi dgongs rdzogs la gser gyi 'bum tshang dang dngul gyi 'bum tshang / spos shel gu shu tsam brgya rtsa/ de bas phra ba brgya rtsa/ bye (byu )ru bya mo'i sgo nga tsam brgya rtsa/ mu tig rgya sran tsam brgya rtsa dang / gzhan phra mo mang po dang / gur gum khal dang /khyad ras btso dar sogs kyi brgya 'bul mang po dang / gsung gi rgyun du stong phrag brgya pa/ mdo sde skal bzang / byams chos sde lnga tshar lnga/ gra tog gser gsum tshar gnyis/ stag tshang ras chen gyi rnam thar mgur 'bum rnams gser dngul zangs gsum la bzhengs nas ma ṇi dung phyur sogs mang du mdzad cing / de rnams la brgya 'bul dang stong 'bul/ gzhan yang rtag (stag )sna dang 'an (wan )le'i dgon pa ma brtsigs lhun gyis grub pa de brtsigs nas sgrub rgyud kyi bstan pa btsugs/ de la sras gsum 'khrungs/ bde ldan rnam rgyal/ in+d+ra bho ti/ bde chen rnam rgyal rnams 'khrungs so/ /dge'o/ /cho ga'i yan lag phran bu/ skyabs sems dang tshogs bsags mthar/ dzaḥhūṃḥbam̐ḥhoḥ tshigs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ zhes tshogs zhing bsdus pa'i rjesaḥ o badz+ra ma hā shrī he ru ko3hoḥ bdag nyid rdo rje khro ba'i skur gyur/ ram̐ yam̐ khaṃḥ o swā bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥ swā bhā wa shurjo3haṃḥ stong pa'i ngang las ṭ+wāṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ā r+ghaṃḥ lan gsum gyis bka' bgegs gnyis byin gyis brlabs te/ bhu mi pa thi sa pa ri bā ra badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ zhes drangs la/ s+thā na pa ti k+ṣe ṭa pañtsa na maḥ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥ bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ uta ga te spa ra ṇi hi rma ga ga na khaṃ swā hāḥ lan gsum/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang kluḥ gnod sbyina'am srin po gzhan dag paḥ dkyil 'khor don du sa phyogs 'diḥ bdag zhu khyod kyis stsal du gsolaḥ zhes mjug dkar gtor gshegs la zhi rol bya/ bhu mi pa ti ya hi 116

gats+tshaḥsarba bhu ta a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes lan gcig lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bca'/ sarba bispyon na maḥ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥ bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ uta ga te spa ra ṇi hi me ga ga na khaṃ skṛsne e rda ba lo ta ye swā hāḥ zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum gyis bsngo/mtshams bcad pa ni/ r+ghaṃḥr+ghaṃḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas byin rlabs rmad po cheḥ yi dam lha tshogs ting 'dzin cho 'phrul 'baraḥ mkha' 'gro dam can mthu rtsal drag po yisaḥ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bar gcod bgegasaḥ bden pa'i stobs kyis rdul bzhin brlags par byaḥ rtsa sngags dang / o sum+bha ni sum+bha r+ghaṃḥ dzoṇ+ḍa skṛṇ+ḍi hūṃḥ n+t+raṇ+ḍa pa ya n+t+raṇ+ḍi pa ya hūṃḥ ā na ya hoḥ bha ga bān bibyā rā dza gro ta ya hūm̐ḥ srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ r+ghaṃḥ bdag nyid rdo rje 'dzin rgyal khros pa yiḥ thugs las spru ba'i mtshon cha rdo rje meḥsteng 'og phyogs mtshams ma lus kun tu gtamaḥ bskal ba las kyi rlung yang ldang mi 'gyuraḥ badz+ra rak+ṣa r+ghaṃ phaṭaḥ zhes pa'i mthar sngon 'gro'i chos tshan yongs rdzogs grub nas dngos gzhi'i lha bskyed mthar/ spyan 'dren ni/r+ghaṃḥ phyogs bcu dus gsum bde gshegs bcom ldan 'dasaḥ skyabs gnas dkon mchog ma lus skur bzhengs shigaḥ rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang ཿ rang mdangs rol ba'i cho 'phrul zhi khro'i tshogasaḥ 'gro ba'i don du so so'i skur sprul nasaḥ yab yum sras dang bcas te gshegs su gsolaḥrtsa sngags mthar/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃḥgu ru de wa ḍā ki nī sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ hūṃḥr+ghaṃḥ tse tseḥ rā rā rā rāḥtsa lā ya tsa lā yaḥ do shā ya do shā yaḥ ā be sha ya a aḥ bzhugs gsol ni/ sa ma ya ā be sha ya tiṣ+ṭha lhanaḥ brda sgo dbye ba ni/ ṭ+wāṃḥdzñā na pra be sha ya phaṭaḥ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ a ti pu hoḥ pra ti dza hoḥ ya mi na maḥ mchod pa 'bul ni/ r+ghaṃḥ mchod yon brgyad dang rgyal srid rin chen bdunaḥ 'dod yon lnga dang phyi mchod sna tshogs 'bulaḥ lha mo bcu drug sman raka bdud rtsi dang ཿ dug lnga ye shes sbyor sgrol nang ma chod 'bulaḥ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā bye puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gadhe ne+e wi bye shardo rū pa shalda gadhe rā sa sparnye sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta ba lin+ta rū tra ma ha su khā dharma dha tu pū dza hoḥ bstod pa ni/ na mo skye 'gag 'gyur med skuḥ 'gyur med sku gsung thugs dang ldanaḥ rang byung thugs rje'i 'gro rnams bsgral slad duḥ phrin las rnam bzhi'i yid bzhin re ba skong ཿ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying mthar/ ram̐ yam̐ khaṃḥ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃḥ lan gsum gyi byin gyis rlabs la/ bsdu na gzhung las bzhung ba'i mchod bstod kyis 'thus so/rjes chog ni/ r+ghaṃḥ mchod yon brgyad dang rgyal srid rin chen bdunaḥ 'dod yon lnga dang phyi mchod sna tshogs 'bulaḥ lha mo bcu drug sman raka bdud rtsi dang ཿ dug lnga ye shes sbyor sgrol nang mchod 117

'bulaḥ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā byi puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gadhe nai wi byā shardo rū pa shaja gadhe rā sa span+de sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta ba lin+ta rū tra ma ha su khā dharma dha tu pū dza hoḥ bstod pa ni/ na mo skye 'gag 'gyur med sku gsung thugs dang ldanaḥ rang byung thugs rje'i 'gro rnams bsgral slad duḥ phrin las rnam bzhi'i yid bzhin re ba skong ཿ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ yig brgya lan gcig brjod pas nongs pa bshags/ rgyun gyi bsngo ba ni/ 'di ltar bgyis pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthusaḥ 'gro kun byas bsags sdig ltung rgyu 'bras byang ཿ tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs rang gzhan don gnyis 'grubaḥ bde gshegs snying po tshe 'dir mngon gyur shogaḥ dngos grub len pa ni/ hūṃḥ ye nas rnam dag rang byung rang shar dbang ཿsku gsung thugs dang yon tan dngos grub niḥ sgrib gnyis dag shing sku gnyis lhun gyis grubaḥ rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams dbang thob shogaḥ kā ya sirnyi oṃḥ wā ka sidhi āḥ tsit+ta sikhyi r+ghaṃḥ dngos grub kyi gnas gsum du gtug la byin rlabs zhu/ bsdu rim ni/ r+ghaṃḥ snang srid 'od zhu sgyu lus dkyil 'khor thimaḥ dkyil 'khor rim bzhin gnas gsum yi ger thimaḥ de yang phra ba'i thugs srod nyid la thimaḥ de yang dmigs med chos dbyings klong du āḥ bkra shis ni/ r+ghaṃḥ ye shes lnga ldan 'od lnga'i pho brang naḥ sku gsum mi 'gyur lhun grub bkod pa'i rgyanaḥ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams kun nas bkraḥ rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha yis bkra shis shogaḥ ces pa yang man ngag bcu gsum gyi sgrub thabs khol bur nyams su len pa'i las dang po rnams 'jug bde ba'i phyir rig 'dzin yongs 'dus dang bka' 'dus snying po sogs las btus pa'o/ /

sto /rnal 'byor tshe dbang nor bu'i rgyun spyod dge ba'i lam rim glu ru blangs pa thar ba'i 'jug ngogs ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /ha ho: mi bdag gi bde chen 'khor lo'i steng / /skyabs kun 'dus ngo bo pad ma 'byung / /sku dkar dmar pad zhwa gser mdangs can/ /rtse rma bya rgod ldem rdo rje'i mtshon/ /mdun rgya gram nyi zla nor bus brgyan/ /phyag g.yas na rig stong rdo rje gsor/ /g.yon bde stong thod pa tshe bum bsnam/ /sku sngags phod mdo yi chos gos gsum/ /'khor bsgyur chas ber chen lnga ldan gsol/ /gsang gos dkar rdo rje'i sku reg bcings/ /mgul nor bu phyag zhabs gser gdub 'khrol/ /zhabs sag lham rin chen phra yis brgyan/ /zhal 'dzum mdangs spyan gsum lta stangs gzigs/ /grub kha ṭ+wāṃ brda rtags du mas brgyan/ /sku 'od dang 'od zer rab 'bar gang / /ma mtsho rgyal dkar sngo mdzes 'dzum 'khyud/ /dbu lcang lo nor bu'i thor tsug can/ /dar cod paṇa dmar brgyan prog zhu gsol/ /rgyu rin chen rgyan drug dar dpyang phur/ /phyag rdo rje thod pa bdud rtsi stobs/ /yab yum gnyis dgyes bde zag med rol/ /de g.yas su gsang 'dus he ru kaḥ dpal bde gling dmar smug rnal 'byor chas/ /phyag gsang rnga bar+ghaṃ bdud rtsi'i bkang / /sku stag sham rus pa'i rgyan gyi brgyan/ /g.yon phyogs su bde mchog 'khor lo sdom/ /rje pad+ma rig 'dzin gsung rab zhabs/ /sku dkar gsal chos gos rnam gsum gsol/ /phyag rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnol/ /de lta bu'i rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /'khor rtsa gsum mchog gsum sprin du 'khrig /thugs tshad med snying rjes rab dgongs pa/ /dus rgyun chad med pa spyi bo ru/ /bzhugs bsgom shing gsol ba 'debs yul yin/ /mi nga la skyabs yul khong bas med/ /blo lings kyi bor pa 'di rang yin/ /tshe 'di phyi bde sdug ci byung dang / /yul mtho dman gar btang khong rnam shes/ /de nga yi chos kun snying po'o/ /mi bdag gi bskyed rim bsgom pa ni/ /gzhi mngon byang lnga dang ting 'dzin gsum/ /de skad cig dran rdzogs he ru ka /sku snang stong zhen med chu zla bzhin/ /sems phyogs 'jog yin snyam ma yin par/ /dbu skra rtse man nas rkang mthil yan/ /phra zhib gsal sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan/ /tshul ma 'dres sems dpa' gsum ldan pa/ /rjen lhang nger rtag thub bkod pa ste/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub bsgrub phyir dang / /sems nyams dang rtog pa bogs 'don phyir/ /mi nga yi bskyed rim bsgom tshul yin/ /yang bdag gis bzlas pa bzla ba ni/ /sngags ma dag bzlas pa'i skyon lnga spang / /sems ma yengs myur bul zhan drag ran/ /sgra che dang shub bu gsang 'gog bzlas/ /don ma 'dres rang rang skabs bab 119

ltar/ /mi nga yi gsang sngags bzla tshul yin/ /mi bdag gi thun mtshams dge sbyor ni/ /dngos yid kyi mdun mkha' seng khri'i stengs/ /dkon mchog rten grangs med gsal ngang du/ /phyag bskor ba maṇ+ḍal bstod pa phul/ /lam theg pa chen po'i smon lam bcas/ /yig 'bri dang kha thon don sems sogs/ /de thun mtshams bya las tshul yin no/ /mi kho bo'i nyams len snying po dang / /lus dal 'byor bco brgyad rin chen 'di/ /dus nam yang mi thob da res tsam/ /de gser gling stong log mi byed par/ /tshe phyi ma ci 'gyur cha med kyi/ /lus 'di yi thar pa 'grus nges gces/ /don de phyir chos la 'bad blo yis/ /phyi 'byung ba bskal pa chags 'jig bcas/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas byang sems tshangs brgya byin/ /kun mi rtag gshegs pa'i tshul bstan na/ /rang chu sbur lus can dus snyigs ma/ /tshe sum bcu kha ral skyes pa'i mi/ /dus myur du 'chi bar thag chod pas/ /tshe 'dir snang rgyu rdzas zas nor dang / /gnas khang zhing bran 'khor 'bangs la sogs/ /chos dge ba'i phyir du ma gtogs par/ /tshe 'di yi lo 'dod khe grags phyir/ /spyod don med bya ba gang la yang / /chog shes shing 'bad bkag med pa 'di/ /rje bka' brgyud gong ma'i gshegs shul te/ /mi nga rang 'jug lam zab khyad shar/ /mi bdag gis za zhing bsgom tsa na/ /'di phyi nang gsang ba'i go rim gyis/ /zas bza' shes tshul ni mang na yang / /mdo don dril rang lus rgyal ba'i dal/ /sgos khyad par mgrin par pad zla'i steng / /skyabs mtshungs med pad+ma yab yum la/ /mchod tshul du lag sor mchod lha mos/ /zas tshogs 'khor shes nas zhal gru gsum/ /lce me lha ya rkan snang mtha' yas/ /rkan 'og ma gos dkar ya so ni/ /dpa' bo dang ma sogs mkha' 'gro mar/ /shes byas te zas bzos bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /rje u rgyan yab yum dkyil 'khor lha/ /mchod bsam pa 'di ni tshogs 'khor mchog /nang gsang sngags gnad kyi lag len ste/ /sdig dkor sgrib mi 'byung tshogs bsags thabs/ /mi nga yi za lugs snying po yin/ /skom btung ba bdud rtsi dkar dmar du/ /shes byas te rang lus lhar mchod pas/ /zag med pa'i bde chen rgyas mos 'di/ /mi bdag gi btung ba btung tshul yin/ /yang bdag gi 'gro zhing bsgom tsa na/ /mi kho bo'i 'phrag g.yas nam mkha'i klong / /sku gzugs dang glegs bam mchod sdong bcas/ /lha rtsa gsum rgya mtsho sprin du 'khrigs/ /lhag mchog tu u rgyan yab yum gsal/ /de bskor bar bsam nas gom pa 'dor/ /des 'gros la chud zos mi 'gyur zhing / /lus sgrib pa sbyang ba'i man ngag 'di/ /bdag tshe dbang nor bu'i 'gro bsgom yin/ /mi kho bos 'dug cing bsgom tsa na/ /lus rnam par snang mdzad chos bdun dang / /dbugs 'gro 'ong rtags bcas bum pa can/ /steng 'og rlung kha sbyor srog ru dril/ /rngub dgang gzhil 120

'phang bcas sbyor ba bzhi/ /gnad ma 'chug ngang nas spyod pa 'di/ /rlung dhu tir gcun pa'i man ngag ste/ /mi bdag gi 'dug nas bsgom tshul yin/ /bdag nyal zhing nyal nas bsgom pa ni/ /gzhog g.yas phab seng ge'i nyal stabs la/ /mgrin 'khor lo'i dbus su aḥdakar la/ /sems gtad nas chos kun rmi lam ltar/ /shes ngang der ma yengs dran pa bcas/ /gnyid log nas rmi lam 'dol sbyang / /de nyal nas bsgom tshul cha shas lags/ /e ma/ mi tshe dbang las kyi rdo rje nga/ /dus lan re gti mug ngang du bsgom/ /de skad cig rtog med phra ba de/ /lam rim pa 'od gsal ngang du sbyang / /btang snyoms gnas ngang du
