wa le de/ /sems mi rtog rang gshis ngang du sbyang / /gnyid bag chags rmi lam 'jug po de/ /don rtsol med chos nyid ngang du sbyang / /spyir rmi lam zin pa 'di nyid kyang / /'jam bag chags rtsub mos zin pa 'ga'/ /khong la la dga' brod rlom pa zhugs/ /de ma zin mi dga'i snang ba 'char/ /don rmi lam mi bden sgyu ma'i dpe/ /der dga' sdug de tsam 'phel ba na/ /dngos a 'thas 'khrul snang ci phyir chod/ /don de na rmi lam snang ba 'di/ /nyin nyams rtog mtho dman gang yin gyi/ /tshod rmi lam dag la bzung tsam las/ /nyin ma bsgom mtshan la ci phyir rtogs/ /mi la las rmi lam zad do skad/ /mi la las rmi lam mi rmi skad/ /'di tha dad ci bzhin rtogs pa'i mthus/ /'khrul rmi lam rgyun thag chad pa ni/ /dus deng dus rgya lam re 'ga' tsam/ /nyams rtog pa 'dra min mang ba'i phyir/ /'dra nyams dang don nor byis pa 'ga'/ /tshul 'di 'drar zhen pa ya re mtshan/ /mi nga ni rmi lam zin dga' dang / /zin ma thub 'gyod pa'i sems kyang med/ /gang byas kyang bde'o ran 'byor pa/ /lar nyin mor 'khrul med bsgom yod na/ /mtshan rmi lam ma zin na yang zod/ /nyin 'khrul pa'i snang ba 'byams pa na/ /mtshan rmi lam zin kyang dgos pa chung / /don des na 'khrul snang bag chags dbang / /btang mi bya 'bad rtsol ma mchis ngang / /yengs med pa'i bya ra btang la 'bungs/ /lung ma bstan snyoms las spang 'tshal te/ /mi kho bo'i gti mug nyams len yin/ /mi bdag gis 'dod chags dang bsgom pa/ /rgyu zang zing dngos po'i zhen chags de/ /'khrul mig yor sgyu mar ltar du sbyang / /sems 'dod smon bzang ngan du ma de/ /de zhen med nam mkha'i rlung ltar sbyangs/ /yul chags sems bud med brten pa yang / /sems chags mkhan ngo bo cer bltas shing / /chags bral ba stong nyid don la sbyang / /de ngang las ma g.yos rig pa'i rtsal/ /lha yi dam yab yum lam gyi bsgoms/ /gsang rdor pad rtsu sam phaṭaḥkyis mtshan/ /sku snang stong dbyer med 'khril sbyor gyi/ /spyi btsug tu bla ma pad ma 'byung / /longs sku'i chas mtsho rgyal yum dang 'khril/ /rang zhen med yum dang sbyor byas te/ khams thig le dbab bskyil bzlog dang dgram/ /gnad mkhas pa bzhi yi sbyangs byas te/ /121

bde dga' ba bzhi la nyams len nas/ /don rang byung rtogs pa'i bogs 'don 'di/ /dug sman du bsgyur ba'i bdud rtsi 'dra/ /grogs bud med brten pa'i sngags 'chang gis/ /sems 'dod chags nyams len byed tshul lo/ /yang zhe sdang ngang du bsgom pa'i tshe/ /rkyen gyis dkrug rnam rtog rag pa de/ /rang ngo bo nyid la cer klod pas/ /phyi yul dang nang gi rang sems gnyis/ /dmigs mtshon med zhen med gnyis snang bral/ /'di 'di'o spros pa'i ming las 'das/ /gzung 'dzin bral rig pa rjen par 'char/ /de ngang du bzhag las gzhan 'gyu ba/ /zhe sdang ba dgag sgrub spang bsgyur sogs/ /blos bcos bral yengs med ci dga' 'di/ /mi nga yi zhe sdang nyams len yin/ /spyir dug gsum ngo bo de dag dang / /nga rgyal ba phrag dog la sogs pa/ /kun sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i 'khrul 'khor bzhin/ /spang blangs bral a 'thas ma zhugs par/ /sems rang gshis ka dag gdod ma'i khams/ /gzhi bde gshegs snying por lta ba 'di/ /bu tshe dbang nor bu'i nyams len yin/ /mi bdag gis thun bzhir nyams len na/ /dus tho rangs dang por bab pa'i tshe/ /gnyid gti mug 'khrul pa bskrog byas te/ /lus stong ra gsal dang rlung gsum 'bud/ /sems ting nge 'dzin gyis bdag dbang len/ /ngag bzlas brjod sngags bzhi tshar bdun bsgrag /rje gu ru'i gsol 'debs tshig bdun bklag /de ma yengs ngang nas snying po bsgrang / /sngags yang snying yig brgya brgya phrag bzla/ /lha rdor sems bsgom nas bstod bshags byas/ /rjes rang rig rdor sems dbyer med bsre/ /blo shes rab 'phel phyir 'jam dkar dang / /sdig sgrib pa sbyang phyir spyan ras gzigs/ /bar chad pa sel byed phyag rdor sku/ /bsgom byas na bzlas pa gang nus bskyal/ /de tho rangs thun gyi bya las yin/ /nam langs tshe skad cig lhar gsal ngang / /thugs ye shes sems dpa'i snying ka ru/ /srog mi shig sa bon ka ba btsugs/ /sngags bzla lugs bzhi yis 'khrul 'khor bskor/ /phrin las bzhi gang 'dod dmigs pa bsgyur/ /de ngang nas thugs dam lhag pa'i lha/ /sngags dza sa ti dbyangs grangs ldan sgrogs/ /skabs 'ga' ru 'phral gyi spyod pa dang / /tshig 'brel 'byung 'ga' yang smra ba yin/ /zhar bab byung dge sbyor 'ga' yang byed/ /mdor dril ba rang gzhan dge la bskul/ /de nyin mor spyod pa'i thun yin no/ /dus dgong mor bsrungs mar gtor bsngos dang / /rang 'khor bcas bsrungs dang bstan don du//bsrung bzlog dang bsad pa'i drag sngags bzlas/ /gnas zhi bdag dkar dmar gsur gyis mchod/ /yul ris med mchod sbyin gtor mar 'bad/ /de dgong mo'i dus kyi thun spyod do/ /srod babs tshe skad cig gtum mo'i skur/ /ldang byas te bla ma'i rnal 'byor spyod/ /lus rtsa yi stong ra bum can sbyang / /rjes 'bar ba aḥshad bya las dang / /bde bskyed pa haṃ gi rgyun 'babs la/ /yid gtad nas nyams len rlung 122

la 'bad/ /rjes dmigs med ngang du mnyam bzhag ngang / /bsngo smon lam bzang po'i 'tshams sbyor dang / /lus phung po mchod sbyin zhen med gtang / /don nyams len ma yengs lta ba'i ngang / /mtshan gung du rang bab ngang du rnal/ /de rnams ni srod dang dgong thun yin/ /e ma/ mi nga yi nyams len mdor dril na/ /lus zhen med lha skur gsal ba 'di/ /de bskyed rim yongs kyi 'du so yin/ /gtum ham a 'bar 'dzag srog rtsol 'di/ /rlung thabs lam bsgom pa'i 'du so yin/ /ngag sngags la rtag tu brtson pa 'di/ /lha yi dam nus bsgrub 'du so yin/ /sems ma yengs rig pa rgyun chags 'di/ /chos bskyed rdzogs yongs kyi 'du so yin/ /sems rang babs brjod bral blo 'das gshis/ /'di lta ba yongs kyi 'du so yin/ /gang shar kun rtsol med mnyam bzhag 'di/ /bsgom nyams len kun gyi 'du so yin/ /dgag sgrub bral rgyu 'bras phra zhib 'di/ /'di spyod pa yongs kyi 'du so yin/ /re dogs bral rig pa rang gdengs thob/ /'di 'bras bu yongs kyi 'du so yin/ /rje bla ma mi brjed dran pa rgyun/ /chad med 'di nyams len 'du so yin/ /dus rtag tu dad pa 'gyur med 'di/ /chos rnam dkar ma lus 'du so yin/ /dus rtag tu 'da' med dam tshig 'di/ /chos gsang sngags bsgrub pa'i srog rtsa yin/ /las dkar nag rgyu 'bras gzhib pa 'di/ /bka' rgyal gsung mus 'du so yin/ /dus rtag tu bag yod spyod brtson pa/ /'di thar pa bsgrub pa'i grogs mchog yin/ /dus rtag tu gzhan phan sems bskyed pa/ /'di sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i sa bon yin/ /dus rtag tu ma bcos dran pa yi/ /bsgom nyams rtogs myur rdzogs snying po yin/ /dus rtag tu rang gzhan dge sbyor ba/ /'di bka' brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar yin/ /sems g.yo sgyu med pa'i drang po 'di/ /spyod pa ya rabs yongs kyi 'du so yin/ /rang 'dod pa khe grags chung bslab 'di/ /chos gsha' ma bsgrub pa'i lam rkang yin/ /rkyen ci byung ro snyoms gang nus 'di/ /khong rtogs ldan yongs kyi rnam thar yin/ /'di rnal 'byor tshe dbang nor bu yis/ /nyams len tshul brjod pa'i snying po yin/ /e ma/ mi bdag gis bsgom tshul ci 'dra na/ /lha a 'thas bsgom pa rtag lta yin/ /a ma 'thas stong gzugs chu zla bzhin/ /sems skye med mkha' nas 'gag med rtsal/ /dbyings 'ja' tshon ltar du rang rtsal sbyangs/ /'di la las bskyed rim bsnyen bsgrub las/ /rdzogs rim la mos blo mi byed 'dug /'di rtag lta'i phyogs su 'khyam dogs che/ /yang kha cig rdzogs rim stong pa skad/ /lha bskyed rim bsgom pa mi mos shing / /sems rnam rtog yo langs ci bya zer/ /'di stong pa phyang chad chad lta'i rgyur/ /'gro dog pas yang yang gzab dgos mthong / /ci phyir zhes sems kyi rnam rtog rgyun/ /'phral mi 'char thabs ni ma mchis kyi/ /de bag yangs rgyal bas ma gsungs zhing / /gnas 'gyur tshe sor rtog ye shes bzhed/ /123

sems ma dag dngos po'i rtog pa la/ /dus ye nas goms te da bar 'khrul/ /de ngo shes tsam gyi ngang chog na/ /kho thar pa nag po ci phyir gol/ /sa brgyad pa'i sems dpa' yin par grags/ /don des na ma dag dngos zhen 'di/ /sbyang phyir du rgyal ba thabs mkhas des/ /lha bskyed rim sgyu lus mang du gsung / /thabs bskyed rim shes rab rdzogs rim la/ /zung 'jug nas nyams len khyad chos yin/ /de zung 'jug kyang sngar yin yin las/ /sngar mi gcig pa gsar du bsres pa min/ /sems nyid kyi ngo bo ye stong de/ /rdzogs rim gyi tha snyad ma lags sam/ /rang mdangs ni rnam pa thams cad pa/ /'gag med du shar ba'i lha sku de/ /bskyed rim zhes tha snyad mi gdags sam/ /bskyed rdzogs gnyis don de ye nas gcig /da bskyed rim gcig bsgom kyang rdzogs rim dngos/ /rdzogs rim zhig bsgom kyang bskyed rim nyid/ /nga rnal 'byor smyon pa ni gtad med ste/ /gtad med kyi nyams la de ltar mdog /bskyed rdzogs ni ro gcig ngang du song / /zab gsal gyi ngang du ta la ta la/ /rig stong gi ngang du rjen ne ne/ /bya ba kun chos nyid khrol lo lo/ /gang byas kyang sgyu mar 'al ma 'ol/ /'di kho bo yi rnam thar yang tig ste/ /tig tig cig smyon par ci la yong / /tig tig zhig med kyang rang nyid spro/ /mjal dgos kyi mtshan ldan bla ma mjal/ /dam tshig la ngos lkog spu tsam med/ /thob dgos ni phyag rdzogs man ngag thob/ /ma go ba'i khong sran rdul tsam med/ /mthong dgos kyi sems ngo phyogs tsam mthong / /the tshom zhig gcod dgos da ni med/ /rang yin lugs ni cung zad da rnyed bas/ /skye skye dang sprul sprul min kyang chog /nyams myong ni bde chen gling par skyes/ /rtogs pa ni gsung rab rgya mtshor thug /nyams myong gang chen gdams pas shar/ /rtogs gdengs ni rdzogs chen gzhung gi chud/ /grub mtha' ni klong chen rab 'byams lugs//dag snang ni rgyal bstan spyi la phyag 'byongs/ /rang gdengs ni sems la chud pas bde/ /nyin mtshan kun dge la gang brtson byas/ /dge ba kun byang chen rgyu ru bsngos/ /rang 'dod kyi blo ngan shin tu chung / /phrag dogs ni de bas yang ni phra/ /chags sdang gi zhags pa mi dam pas/ /rang sems 'di gu yang phyal ma phyol/ /skye sngon nas theg chen smon lam thebs/ /skyes mchog gi bla ma 'ba' zhig mjal/ /nges don bsgom bag chags rtag tu bzhag /ci nus kyi 'gro don kho nar spyod/ /'di dag ni kho bo'i ngang tshul ste/ /rang nyid kyi nyams len tshul ji bzhin/ /yin lugs kyi glu dbyangs de skad ni/ /ri mgo kun gangs dkar mche gcigs 'dra/ /klung nags ni dom lpags brgyang 'dra ba/ /chu bo kun sba klong drag 'khrug 'beb/ /mi kun kyang khro gtum gdug pa che/ /sbas yul mchog brag skas ljongs zhes pa'i/ /yul gru'i dbus mkhar chu'i dben gnas su/ /nag pa zla tshes bzang bco lnga la/ /rig pa 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i smras/ /yi ge pa lha lding go pā'i rigs/ /dag 'gyogs skyen blo dbang gis bgyis so/ /dge ba ci 124

mchis pas rang gzhan kun/ /dge blo gang bskyed nas dge sbyor 'bad/ /dge 'bras kun myur smin rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /dge legs kyis dbang phyug yongs thob shog /ces rgyal khams pa tshe dbang nor bus rang gi rgyun spyod kyi dge sbyor glur smras pa rang lo nyi shu'i dkyil du snyegs pa sna tshogs dbyig zhes shing sbrul nag zla'i tshes bzang por spru rkong sa yi mtshams brag skas ljongs su smras pa ste/rang gzhan blo rgyud chos la phyogs pa'i rgyur gyur cig maṅga lo/rog /badz+ra gu ru nyams su len thabs nor bu tog gi blo gros ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /na moḥpad+ma badz+ra ya/ 'dir badz+ra gu ru'i nyams su len thabs snying po nyung ngu dril ba zhig smra na/spyir rgyal ba ma lus pa'i ngo bor gyur cing / phrin las kyi bdag nyid chen por dpal pad+ma 'byung gnas su nges shing grub la/ de yi thugs kyi yang snying badz+ra gu ru yin la/ de nyams su len par 'dod pas/skyabs sems yan lag bdun sngon du song zhing / rang gi phung khams dbang yul rnams gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor yin pa la yin bzhin du shes par byas pa'i spyi bo'am mdun gyi nam mkha' sogs bsgom gang bde ba der/ pad+ma ge sar 'bum ldan nyi zla'i steng du/ dus gsum rgyal ba yongs kyi spyi gzugs gsung gi rdo rje chos 'od dpag med mgon bla med bla ma'i gzugs su snang ba o rgyan gu ru bde ba chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sku rgyan cha lugs ma 'dres pa yongs su rdzogs pa 'od lnga'i gur khang dbus su bzhugs pa'i/ dpral mgrin thugs kar rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin oṃ āḥhūṃ dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi mtshan pa gsal btab la bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo'i gsung / tshig bdun gyi gsol ba btab ste/ hūm̐/ o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams/ pad+ma ge sar sdong po la/ /ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ /pad ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags/ /'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor/ /khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi/ /byin gyis rlabs phyir gshegs su gsol/ /gu ru pad+ma sirnyi hūṃ/ /zhes dad pa'i gdung shugs kyi brjod pas gu ru'i gnas gsum las 'od zer lcags kyu'i dbyibs can 'phros pas/ rang bzhin dag pa'i zhing khams nas/ sangs rgyas sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad dang / khyad par rang gi rtsa ba yan lag dang brgyud pa'i bla ma'i yi dam dkyil 'khor ma lus pa gu ru pad+ma'i rnam par spyan drangs/ spyi bo'i gu rur thim/ dam tshig ye shes ro mnyam du bzhugs pa'i mdun du bdag gi lus longs spyod tshe dang bsod nams dus gsum gyi rtsa bcas 'bul bar kha zhe med pa'i blo 'dun bskyed cing / de nas gu ru'i sku la rig pa rtse gcig tu gtad pa yid rnam rtog gzhan gyi 125

ma bskyod par ngag nas/ o āḥrgyu badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi r+ghaṃ/ zhes dal brel che chung snyoms shing lhag chad med par dag seng seng bzlas pa ci nus kyi mthar bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bla ma chos kyi sku la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bla ma sprul nga/'i sku la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥsarba sirnyi pha la r+ghaṃ āḥ zhes brjod cing bla ma'i gnas gsum nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum gyi dbang thob/ ye shes rdo rje mngon du byas par bsam la/ rjes kyi spyod lam la 'jug shing dus kun bla ma yid dang mi 'bral bar skyong / de yang lha bskyed byed sems nyid gshis lugs ye stong rtsal bral ngo bor gnas pa ni rdzogs rim yin la/rang mdangs ma 'gags pa'i snang cha gu ru'i skur lam mer snang ba bskyed rim ste/ de yang snang stong zung 'jug chen por ye gdod ma nas grub cing / dbyer nam yang med pa ni bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug ste/ de las gzhan pa'i bskyed rdzogs zhes nam yang med pas/ de tshul bzhin skyong ba sacig shes kun grol gyi chos thams cad la rang byan tshud par 'gyur ro/ /de yang sdod dus spyi bor bla ma/ 'gro dus phrag pa g.yas kyi nam mkhar/ zas za dus mgrin pa dang / gnyid log dus spyi bo'i bla ma mar byon/snying 'od kyi gong bu bum sku lta bu'i dbus su bzhugs par bsam la gnyid log cing / nam sad dus gsal 'debs re byed/ lang ba'i tshe snying kha'i bla ma dbu ma'i lam rgyud/ spyi bo'i nam mkhar sngar bzhin bzhugs par bsam ste/ des ni bskor ba/ tshogs 'khor rmi lam 'od gsal/ 'pho ba'i gnad tshang zhing / nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus su yang spyi bo'i bla ma'i thugs kar 'dun pa rtse gcig gtad cing gsol 'debs kyi 'pho ba khyad par can du 'gyur cing / tshe bsgrub pa sogs las gang bsgrub kyang bzlas pa badz+ra gu ru la dngos grub gang yin de la 'dun pa bsgyur bas thog pa med par 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /spyir yang 'dus byas chos kun mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin snying la bcang nas 'di snang zhen pa skyug nad can gyi snum mthong ltar ldog pas rgyu 'bras yid ches shing / smon 'jug byang chub sems kyi rtsa ba snying rje dang / khyad par bla ma sangs rgyas kun 'dus ngo bor snying nas thag chod pa'i dad pa ldem rgyang med par dam tshig ched du lus srog 'dor nus pa yi spyi brtol gang gi yang mi byed pa dang ldan pas lha mang blo brel ma yin par yi dam dkyil 'khor kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma'i ngo bo gu ru pad+mar gsol ba phur tshug tu gdab cing blo lings kyi 'gel nas bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug lam 'dir 'bad na tshe 'di la sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang thob par gdon mi za la/ nyams su ma blangs pa'i chos pu ste 126

brgya la shar sbyang bar ma chad kyang 'chi 'dus phan par dka' bas chig dril gyi nyams len 'bad pa rab tu bces so/ /7zhes badz+ra gu ru nyams su len thabs yid bzhin nor bu tog gi blo gros zhes pa 'di ni rnam 'dren bstan 'dzin rin po che yi sprul pa'i sku bskal bzang pad+ma chos ldan gyi gsung gi bskul ba dang / tshul 'di lta bu don du gnyer ba mang po dag la phan pa'i slad du/ rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung gsal dag 'dus par rang gi nyams len bzhin dbus kyi g.yon tu'i cha dpal chen chu bo bzhi yi lcags zam bla drangs garjo la yi rtser bkod pa'i yi ge pa dge slong kun bzang gzhan phan no/ /bkra shis/rog / phyag rdor don gyi sgrub thabs gang shar thol skyes kyi glu rdo rje'i gad rgyang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /o susti/ 'khor 'das kyi ming btags glo bur ba/ /rang ngo nas ma grub gzhi rtsa stong / /rang rig ni gdod ma'i dag pa che/ /kun gzhi mchog kun tu bzang por grub/ / 1 de nyid ni rnam pa thams cad pas/ /rang rig gi ngo bo gsang bdag yin/ /chos nyid la zhal phyag ma dmigs kyang / /med pa yang ma yin zhal phyag snang / / 2 snang sems zhes tha dad ye nas med/ /med bzhin du snang lugs ngos cig nas/ /bcom ldan dpa' khrag 'thung ho ru kaḥ /sku mdog mthing chos nyid 'gyur ba med/ / 3nyag gcig gi zhal la bden gnyis phyag /mtha' bral gyi zhabs ni bskyangs shing bskum/ /gzung 'dzin gyi gza' klu gdan du brdzis/ /stong nyid kyi rdo dril mkha' la phyar/ / 4 snying rje yi me zhags g.yon na bsnams/ /srid grol gyi ral pa gyen du brjes/ /chags sdang gi seng glang lpags pa gsol/ /tshogs brgyad dag dur khrod dpal chas rdzogs/ / 5 ye yin gyi sku ru de ltar shar/ /thugs klong du ye shes rdo rje ni/ /sku gsum gyi bdag nyid rtse mo gsum/ /nyag gcig gi ngo bo lte ba ru/ / 6 gnyis med kyi ye shes hūṃ gi spras/ /r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ rtsu/ zung 'jug dngos badz+ra rwa ma mtshon/ /rtog 'joms kyi yi ge rtse mor phaṭā/ r+ghaṃ badz+ra phaṭā/7 rang rig gi me dpung 'bar ba yi/ /gnyis snang gi gdon bgegs ma lus bsregs/ /zhe sdang mdangs steng gdon thal bar rlog /'dod chags mdangs 'og gdon phyi mar 'thag / 8 phaṭāḥ'akhor 'das kun nga yi cho 'phrul ste/ /sregs bya dang bsregs byed ro mnyam 'dres/ /nga nyid las gzhan pa'i 'khor 'das su/ /gza' klu yang gsang bdag nga nyid do/ / 9 nga rang gi ngo bo la tshur ltos dang //nga nyid zhes dngos po'i mtshan 'dzin stongs/ /bem stong du ma yin shin tu brjid brlid yin pas bsrad/ /yod med kyi khas blang gang yang med/ / 10 'di don gyi gnad la ma reg pa'i/ /mtshan nyid kyi dge bshes skam po 'ga'/ /sngags lam la zhugs pa'i rlom 'chang yang / /chos nyid la khas len med do zhes//127 (

11 med lugs kyi bsgrub gzhir 'dzub tshugs med/ /sgom yon gyi sangs rgyas bem stong bsgrub/ /'phags klu yi khas blang yin rdzu nas/ /yang dag gi don la 'phags klu 'gog / 12 ma nor ba 'phags klu'i rjes 'brang na/ /lam dus kyi mtshan nyid gong smos bzhin/ /'bras dus kyang de dang rjes mthun du/ /zab brling gnad rgya cher bshad yod kyang / / 13 'di skabs mi spro yi ges 'jigs/ /de dag ni skabs kyi 'phros don ste/ /gsang bdag gi bsgom bzlas thun mtha' ru/ /phyi snod kun gzung ba'i rtog pas stong / / 14 nang bcud kun 'dzin pa'i gzhi yi stong / /stong nyid ngang sgyu lus 'od gsal zhugs/ /mi 'gyur bde thig le'i dbyibs su 'dus/ /'od gsal gyi ngang de gnas lugs yin/ / 15smon lam gyi 'phen pas ye shes sku/ /gnas lugs las ma g.yos ngang du ldang / /dge tshogs kun sgyu ltar 'gro la bsngo/ /de skad ces gsang bdag bsgrub thabs mchog / 16 rgyal ba dang rgyal sras kun gyi shul/ /ma nor zhing 'khrul yung nyung ngu'i ngag /tshul bzhin yi ge'i bkod pa 'di/ /lang 'gro yi rig 'dzin mchog gi gdungs/ / 17 sgrol ma ba zhes snga 'gyur gsal byed gtso/ /de nyid rigs la dam pa yid/ /skye srid mchog pad+ma kun gsal gyi/ /gsung ngo ru mdo khams kaḥthog pa/ / 18 re khe ljongs chos smra rig pa 'dzin/ /tshe dbang dpag nor bu zhes grags pas/ /dbus 'gyur gtsang zab bu lung du smras/ / 19 maṅga lo/ oṃ tum bu li tum bu li rak+ṣa ra hu la su su mel mel shig shig khrol khrol swā hā/ /128

༄ga /rdzogs pa chen po mkha' 'gro snying thig gi brgyud pa'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs nges don snying po'i bcud len zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /a ho/ ma bcos mtha' bral gdod nas snang ba'i mgon/ /g.yo med ye shes rgyal ba kun kyi dpyid//ma skyes 'gags med brdal khyab kun tu bzang / /gsol ba 'debs so mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ /dmigs med spros bral 'od mi 'gyur yab yum/ /rgyal kun thugs mchog rdor sems gsang ba'i bdag /mtshan dpe yongs rdzogs mchog sprul dga' rab rje/ /gsol ba ྾ rang rig dbang thob rig 'dzin shrī seng / /rdzogs sangs rgyas dngos gu ru pad ma 'byung / /zag med 'ja' gus mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal ma/ /gsol ba ྾ gsang gter snying thig sgo 'byed las 'brel rtsal/ /bstan pa'i sgron me rgyal sras legs ldan par/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa rang byung rdo rje 'chang / /gsol ba ྾ gsang sngags grub pa'i dbang phyug yu ston dpal/ /thams cad mkhyen gzigs karmā ka rol rdor/ /gnas lugs mngon sum don gzigs chos rdor rje/ /gsol ba ྾ rtogs ldan rgyal po nam mkha' rdo rje mchog /lung rtogs bstan pa'i gsal byed tshul khrims 'bum/ /yang dag don rnyed tshul khrims rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /gsol ba ྾ nges gsang 'phrin las spel mkhas chos 'bum zhabs/ /gdul dka' yongs 'dul ye shes rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /'gro la brtse gzigs chos rje byang chub seng / /gsol ba ྾ rdza yig kun mkhyen chen po tshul khrims rgyal/ /rtse le rin 'dzin bsod nam rnam par rgyal/ /rgyal ba'i thugs sras bstan 'dzin mchog dbyangs zhabs/ /gsol ba ྾ chos nyid mngon gyur kun bzang dpal 'byor ba/ /gsang sngags grub brnyes mdo sngags bstan 'dzin bzang / /rim gnyis mngon gyur 'phrin las lhun grub la/ /gsol ba ྾gsang chen ston pa 'gyur med rdo rje rtsal/ /thugs kyi sras mchog o rgyan rnam grol bzang / /snying po'i don ster dpal ldan bla ma rje/ /gsol ba ྾ rab 'byams rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun kyi gtso/ /byin rlabs rtsa bar rgyud pa'i bla ma dang / /yi dam zhi khro mkha' 'gro chos skyong la/ /rtse gcig gus pa'i sems kyi gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag ni deng nas rdzogs sangs ma rgyas bar/ /ngan song gnas spongs bde 'gro rtag thob cing / /mtho ris yon tan 'phags nor bdun gyi phyug /yang dag lam nas phyir mi ldog par shog /skye kun mtshan nyid kun tshang bla ma dang / /legs 'phrad thugs kyi dgyes dgu bdag gi 'grub/ /zab gsang 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i don/ /ma lus yongs rdzogs bdag gi thob par shog /129

chos min las la skad cig mi 'jug shing / /chos bzhin spyod par nyin mtshan dus 'da' nas/ /sa lam drod tshad ma lus tshe gcig rdzogs/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'bad med lhun grub shog /khregs chod lta ba'i gnas lugs mthar thug rtogs/ /thod rgal mngon sum bsgom pa zad sar 'khyol/ /rnam dag spyod pas 'gro la phan chen 'grub/ /mi slob pa mchog tshe 'dir nyid brnyes shog /chos kun gdod ma'i gnas lugs spros dang bral/ /mtha' brgyad las 'das theg dgu'i yongs rtse mchog /yid spyod byar med 'od gsal rdzogs pa che/ /mngon gyur gdongs bcas 'od skur yal bar shog /dmigs bsal blo yi bcos mas ma gos pa/ /yid kyi kun bral chos nyid mngon sum du/ /snang ba brda' don lta sgom dbyer med lam/ /rtsod bral a ti'i rtogs pa mngon gyur shog /dus kun sgyu 'bras las la yid ches shing / /rgyu 'bras las 'das lta ba'i gdengs tshad thob/ /nam yang gsang sngags dam tshig nyams med brtan/ /ye bsrung spros bral chen por rtag gnas shog /tshe 'di'i bslu ba'i chos la mi zhen par/ /nges gsang bla med lam mchog la zhugs nas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis grub pa'i dbang phyug che/ /sku gsum rgyal ba'i go 'phang mchog brnyes shog /tshe rabs rtag tu yang gsang rdzogs chen don/ /dbang 'byor rgyal bstan 'gro la phan chen grub/ /'phags nor bdun ldan rgyud 'dzin slob bu'i rgyas/ /tshom bu cig tu 'gro kun byang chub shog /ces rdzogs chen mkha' 'gro snying thig gi gsol 'debs su rnam par dkar ba'i las la mchog sku mngon zhing nges pa'ang rdzogs pa chen por mi phyed pa'i gus pa can skal ldan mi mchog lcags sprag sde pa lha bu tshe ring don ldan nam kun bzang nges don rang grol dbang po'i gsung gi bskul ngor/ mdo khams kaḥthog gi lho phyogs lha ban tshe dbang nor bus mang yul skyid rong grwa bu tshes gling ri khrod du me lug ston ra'i tshes bzang por bris pa dge'o/ /phyag bris dngos nas zhus dag byas/༄sha /zhing skyongs chen po'i 'phrin las dpa' bo dgyes pa'i rol mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /r+ghaṃ bh+yoḥ bde chen ye shes 'khor lor yongs snang ba/ /rgya bod sa 'tshams tsā ri ko tra ya/ /mkha' spyod dur khrod chen po'i zhing skyongs ni/ /mi bzad nag po chen po seng ge'i zhal/ /drag po drag shul rmad byung gzi ldan nag /ga ya dhā ra rdo rje las rab rtsal/ /gnas gsum dpa' bo sa bcu'i nye ba'i mgon/ /dpal ldan srin gtso bdud rje thod pa'i 'phreng / /gsang ba'i yum chen seng gdong si na ra/ /bka' nyan dug mtshon ming srid dregs pa brgyad/ /khyed rnams sngon tshe bcom ldan he ru kaḥ /rta mchog gsang bdag spyan sngar dam nod zhing / /de bzhin pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal 'chang drung / /ma ra ri ka stag tshang 130

'chims phu dang / /gzil chen gsang ba'i phug par dam bzhag nas/ khas blang tha tshig gnyan po dran gyis la/ /dam can rnal 'byor bdag gi spyan 'dren na/ /ma thogs myur ba nyid du 'dir byon dzaḥ /ting 'dzin gyis sprul dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ /dam tshig gcig tu bsre phyir lha phyag 'tshal/ /phyi ltar nye spyod nang ltar 'dod yon lnga/ /gsang ba sman gtor rak+ta'i mchod pa dang / /khyad par ta na ga ṇa'i longs spyod rdzas/ /dpag med nam mkha' gang ba 'bul gyi bzhes/ /mthun rdzas bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus pa rkang / /klad pa ba su tsit+ta dbang po lnga/ /'bul gyi dges bzhes bar chad sel ba dang / /mthun pa'i dngos grub ma lus bdag la stsol/ /r+ghaṃ bh+yoḥ gdod nas g.yo med rgyal ba kun tu bzang / /nang mdangs he ru kaḥdapal chen po'i gar/ /sprul pa zhing skyong chen po'i skur snang ba/ /nag po drag po che la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /nges pa'i don du ho ru kaḥnyid de/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrungs phyir las kyi tshul/ /mi bsrun seng gdong gtum pa'i rtsal 'chang ba/ /rgyal 'gong rgya 'dre'i gshed ma khyod la bstod/ /gnyis med yum chen dpal 'bar me lce'i 'phreng / /seng gdong dmar mo khams gsum dbang gi bdag /bka' nyan ming sring lha srin sde brgyad sogs/ /mthu ldan 'khor dang bcas pa phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dam rdzas dza gār mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /bdag la 'tshe byed mi dang mi min thul/ /byad kha rbod gtong thams cad phyir la zlog khams gsum dbang bsdus 'dod dgu char du phob/ /las bzhi lhun grub grub chen brgyad sogs bstsol/ /sa lam 'gal rkyen bar chad mtha' dag gsol/ /tshe rabs rtag tu nye ba'i mgon khyod kyi/ /byang chub bsgrub pa'i 'phrin las g.yel med mdzod/ /ces snga 'gyur bstan pa'i gsal byed sgrol phug pa pad+ma kun gsal zhal snga nas bskul ba'i rkyen byas 'phral shugs 'byung nyid du tsā ri phra dom tshar rong du dpal tshe dbang nor bus sbyar ba ste me sbrul gro zhun zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum pa la'o/ /maṅga lo/ 7shin tu 'gyogs bris bgyis pa'i yi ge/ /gzugs tsam dod pas gzhan du ci zhig /'di ni bya bral yan pa blo des/ /dom tshangs te 'dabs khang bur krun no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rje btsun sgrol ma pa'i phyag bris kyi shog gri du rgyas 'dir phab pa'o/ /

༄ga /chos zab dgu kun gyi yang zhun bla bsgrub kyi dmigs pa'i rkang grangs 'dzin tshul pad+ma'i zeng ba bzhugs so/ /chos zab dgu kun gyi yang zhun bla bsgrub kyi dmigs rkang grangs 'dzin tshul pad ma'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ bde chen 'khor lo'i dbang phyug pad+ma 'byung gnas yab yum sras brgyud par bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yang mtshan ldan rdo rje slob dpon kyi bskal bzang slob ma rnams lam zab bla bsgrub srog gi dngos ma'i khrid bskyongs bar byed pa'i skabs su sla chos tshar skyen du ma song bar smin khrid du byed par shin tu gal che la/ thog mar khrid zhu tsho 'dus dus yig brgya 'ur ldir bklag nas 'dus shing gral la mtho dman nges nges tig tig med par spung 'dus su byas na tshogs pa dar rgyas kyi rten 'brel yod gsung / de nas phyag dang bcas grol la 'khod nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor skad rta gdangs dbyangs mthun par tshar gcig bton mthar chos skyong spyi dang khyad par sgos kyi bsrung ma mgon po ma ning / ma gza' dam gsum la gtor ma rgyan ldan dzā gar bcas ngos par 'bul dgos/ de nas yan lag bdun pa sngon du 'gro bas maṇ+ḍal phyag len ltar tshom bu so bdun ma dus rtag tu re re dang / ngo sprod sogs chos khrid gnad che ba la gsum gsum 'bul/ de nas chos bshad kyi 'tshams sbyor ci ltar 'os pa brjod zhing /khyad par khrid rkang gi tshig rnams/ ma nor ba/ ma 'khrul ba/ ma 'dzing bar/ dag pa gtsang ba/ gsal ba sgros dod par rang gi blo gros dang / nyan pa po'i blo dang bstun nas bshad par gces so/ /dmigs rkang thun mthar dge ba byang chen du bsngo ba maṇ+ḍal bcas chos thun byung res bzhin de dag ma chag pa rten 'brel kyi gnad zab mo yod pas gal che'o/ /de nas dmigs pa rkang grangs bstan pa ni/ dang po blo chos su 'gro ba'i khrid la/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' tshul/ rgyu yi sgo nas rnyed par dka' ba/ de bzhin don dang / dpes gtan la phab te bsgom pa ste/ thun chen gcig 1 mi rtag par bsam pa la pha ma gnyen tshan dgra bo/ btang snyoms bar ma'i 'gro ba sde dpon yul khams/ rgyal po/ bla chen/ 'khor los bsgyur ba/ tshang dang brgya byin mi rtag pa dang / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyang mya ngan 'da' tshul ston pa dang / snod kyi 'jig rten chags 'jig la bsam pa ste/ dmigs rkang thun chen gcig 2las 'bras bslu med kyi ngang tshul gtam rgyud dang bcas pa dmigs rkang thun chen cig 3 thar pa'i phan yon la chos la brtson 'grus bskul ba dmigs rkang thun gcig 4 de ltar sngon 'gro blo ldog rnam bzhi ni chos pa'i rkang yin pas blo rgyud chos dang ma 'dres bar du dpe don lo rgyus du mas bstan ste smin 132

khrid skabs dmigs rkang sa bcad bzhi yin dang thun grangs dang zhag grangs nges pa med kyi slob ma'i blo 'di snang dgos med ma shar bar du bskyong 'jug la/ rkyang khrid kyi skabs su yang blo ldog bzhi po re re la zhag bdun lnga gsum gang rig rkyang 'jug pa shin tu gal che'o/ /ā+o bī/ gnyis pa chos lam du 'gro ba la dang po skyabs 'gror/ thog mar skyabs 'gro dang dge bsnyen sdom pa gang rung 'bog la/ de nas bsgom rim la/ phyi mdo lugs/ 1 nang sngags lugs/ 2 gsang ba mdo sngags dril ba/ 3 de kho na nyid don dam pa ste/ 4 dmigs rkang bzhi thun bsdu rim rnams rtsa ba la/ yan lag gi ci snyed spros chog go/ /ā+o shrī/gnyis pa sems bskyed la/ thog mar sems tsam dang dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed 'bog pa'i chog gong ltar nod pa shin tu legs mod/ de ltar ma thob kyang sems bskyed kyi khrid bka' ston pas mthus la/ de yang rtsa ba smon 'jug gnyis su 'dus yang / khrid tshul phyag len la byams pa bsgom pa/1 snying rje bsgoms pa/tre 2 byang chub sems bsgom pa/ 3 gsum ni rtsa ba yin zhing / de nas smon pa tshad med bzhi bshad pa/ 4 'jugs pa phar phyin drug kyi go don dang / 5 thams cad ye shes tshogs su bsgyur tha bstan pa/ 6 kun gyi don dril nas bshad pa ste/ 7 rtsa ba'i sa bcad bdun yin la/sems bskyed kyi phan yon rgyas par bshad/ spros na tshad med bzhi la thun bzhi/ phar phyin drug la thun drug sogs rgyas par bstan par bya'o/ /ā+o bī/gsum pa tshogs bsags khyad par can maṇ+ḍal kyi khrid la/ phyag chen mthong ba rgyud par ltar du lus kyi las tshom bu bkod/ ngag gi las tshigs bcad brjod/ yid kyi las dmigs pa gsal ba gsum bsgrags nas phyi yi maṇ+ḍal 'bul ste/ de yang tshogs zhing gsal nas phyi yi maṇ+ḍal phul ba/ 1 nang gi maṇ+ḍal phul ba/ 2 gsang ba'i maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba/ 3 de kho na nyid du la bzla ba ste/ 4 rtsa ba'i dmigs rkang bzhi la maṇ+ḍal kyi phan yon rgyas par bstan zhing / spros na snod bcud 'jig rten chags tshul mngon pa dang mthun par bshad do/ /zhi shrī/bzhi pa sgrib sbyangs rdor sems kyi bsgom bzlas ni/ thog mar rdor sems kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang thob na legs la/ de ltar ma gyur kyang ting 'dzin dbang bskur cig byas na ston che bas bya la/ de nas phyi bya rgyud ltar bsnyen pa/ 1 nang spyod rgyud ltar nye bar bsnyen pa/ 2 gsang ba rnal 'byor ltar bsgrub pa/ 3 yang gsang bla med ltar bsgrub pa chen po/ 4 kho na nyid bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug la bzla ba bstan la/ 5 sdig pa bshags pa gnyen po stobs bzhi'i tshul legs par bshad zhing ci rigs pa spros so/ /de ltar blo ldog nas bzung dmigs pa gong 'og thams cad la thog mar sems 133

bskyed rjes su rang 'dod med par bsngo smon bzang pos 'tshams sbyar ba ni dmigs thun thams cad ma chag par che bar bya'o/ /zhi bī/ de lta ra chos lam du 'gro ba dmigs chen nyi shu tham pa ste tshogs kyi lam che 'bring chung ngu rnams bsgrod par byed pa'o/ /spyi don gsum pa lam kyi 'khrul pa zhi bar byed pa bla ma'i bsgrub pa dngos bzhi la/ thog mar rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bla med rgyud sde gang yang rung ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs thob par byed pa ni shin tu gal che ba yin la/ de nas bla bsgrub kyi rtsa ba'i tshogs bshad/ khyad par zhal gdams te/ dong la rdo rje slob dpon gyi phyi bsnyen pa/ nang bsgrub pa/ gsang ba nye bar bsgrub pa/ yang gsang bsgrub pa chen po ste rtsa ba'i sa bcad rnam pa bzhi yin la smar khrid du dang por phyi bsgrub pa la yang / rang lus yi dam lhag pa'i lha yi skur gsal zhing snang stong du sbyong pa/ 1 de nas spyi bor 'khor lo'i dbang phyug rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom pa'i thog mar 'od gur gdan dang sa bon bskyed pa/ 2 de yi 'od zer kyi rigs drug kyi gnas kun khyab zhing snod dag pa bcud dag pa sku dang zhing khams su sbyangs nga ste/ dmigs rkang zhib mor bstan bskabs/ dmyal ba'i blug snod sbyangs ba/ 3 yi dwags/ 4 byol song / 5 lha srin/ 6lha/ 7 mi yi blug snod sbyang ba/ 8 de drug thun chen cig yin no/ /de nas 'od zer kyi rgyal ba sras bcas dgyes par byed pa/ 9 sa bon la rtsa gsum rab 'byams thams cad bsdu ba/ 10 sa bon bla ma'i skur sgyur ba/ 11 bla ma'i thugs ka dang / 12 dung khang / 13 mgrin pa/ 14 lte ba/ 15gsang gnas su lha yi dkyil 'khor rim kyi gsal btab pa/ 16 sku yi gnas thams cad du lha yi gsal btab pa/ 17 brgyud pa'i bla ma phreng bar bsgom pa/ 18 'khor mkha' 'gro tshogs yi dam sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun bsgom pa/ 19 de mdun blo ling gtang kyi maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba/ 20 yid rtse gcig pas rtsa sngags kyi thugs rgyud bskul ba/ 21 gsol 'debs tshigs bcad dang gdung shugs 'o dod kyi gsol 'debs/ 22 dzabra sngags kyi gsol ba 'debs pa/ 23 ste de yan kyi phyi ltar bla ma bsnyen pa blo sbyang lha khrid kyi dbang dman rjes su bzung ba ste sbyor lam kyi drod thob bar byed pa'o/ /skabs 'dir rdo rje slob dpon kyi dbye ba rtsa ba yan lag kyi bla ma'i tshul/ /bla ma'i bsten tshul/ dam tshig bsrung tshul/ nyams na bso tshul rnams shin tu nan che bas bshad do/ /zhi bī/gnyis pa nang bla ma bsgrub pa la 'khor yi dam sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun rnams gtso bo la bsdu ba/1 de rnams dge 'dun oṃ chos āḥ sangs rgyas r+ghaṃ yi dam hrīḥ'am ho ru gsal nas gtso bo'i gnas bzhi'i yi ger bstem pa/ 2 de nas bum dbang blang ba/ 3 gsang dbang blang ba/ 4 sher dbang blang ba/ 5 tshig dbang blang ba/ 6 mthar chig char kyi spro bsdus te/ 7 de nang bla ma bsgrub pa ting 134

nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur mchog tu zab pa dbang po bar ma rjes su bzung ba ste/ sbyor lam kyi rtse mo thob par byed pa'o/ /skabs 'dir dbang spyi yi rnam bzhag dang / khyad par du ting nge 'dzin dbang bskur ba'i phan yon/ de dag gi sa bcad rnams spros nas bshad do/ /ā+o bī/gsum pa gsang ba bla ma nye bar bsgrub pa ste/ bla ma rdo rje bzhi yi rang bzhin can dhu ti nas snying dbus su spyan 'dren pa/ 1 bdag nyid lhag pa'i lha yi nga rgyal 'pho ba/ 2 bla ma yab yum kha sbyor du blta ba/ 3 sa bon la yid bzhag pa ste/ 4 skabs 'dir sems dpa' gsum brtsegs kyi go don legs par bshad/ 5 de nas sngags phreng bkod pa/ 6 dzabra kyi dgongs pa legs par bstan pa 7ste/ de ni bla ma gsang ba rdo rje gsum dkyil 'khor du nye bar bsgrub pa bskyed rim thams cad kyi don gcig pu dril zhing 'khrul 'khor rgya che ba/ dbang rab rjes su 'dzin pa ste sbyor lam gyi bzod pa thob par byed pa'i rim pa'o/ /skabs 'dir lha bskyed rim sngags bzlas pa dmigs pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam bzhag rgyas par bshad par bya'o/ /ā+o bī/bzhi pa yang gsang bla ma bsgrub pa chen po nyams su len pa la/ bla ma yab yum kyi sku 'gyur med thugs kyi sa bon du bsgyur nas gsol ba btab/ 1 las bzhi lhun grub kyi dgongs pa/ 2 zhi ba/ 3rgyas pa/ 4 dbang / 5 drag po/ 6 mchog don du gnyer ba/ 7 ste de ni yang gsang bla ma bsgrub pa chen po lha sku gcig sngags 'bru gcig ting nge 'dzin zer gcig gis grol ba dbang rnon rjes su bzung ba ste sbyor lam kyi chos mchog thob par byed pa'i rim pa'o/ /skabs 'dir bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug myur lam thabs kyi man ngag kyang ci rigs bshad par bya'o/ /ā+o bī/ de ltar lam gyi 'khrul pa zhi bar byed pa/ man ngag kun gyi mthar thug bla ma bsgrub pa'i zab chos srog gi dngas ma lta bu'i zab khrid dngos gzhi'i rim pa spyi don bzhi la chos thun gyi rkang sdom pas bzhi rtsa bzhi pa ste sbyor lam kyi nges 'byed bzhi dang sbyor nas bstan pa'o/ /zhi bī/ gnyis par khyad par ba zhal gdams la 'ga' zhig ni gong gi sa bcad skabs su song la/ shin tu gsang ba rgya che ba'i don mdor bsdu na/ bum dbang dang 'brel pa/dkyil 'khor bskyed rim gyi man ngag sngags kyi zhal gdams dang bcas bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug du bsre ba/ gsang dbang dang 'brel ba rdor bzlas gtum mo'i rim pa/ sher dbang dang 'brel ba thabs lam pho nya'i gdams pa rnams yin la/ tshig dbang dang 'brel ba ni 'og tu bstan ste 'dir ni sa bcad tsam ste/ chos thun kyi rkang grangs ni zhal las shes so/ /gam+bir u pa de sha ghu h+ya ā+o bī/ spyi don bzhi pa 'khrul snang ye shes su 'char ba bla ma de kho na nyid kyis bsgrub pa la/ snying ga'i bla ma r+ghaṃ yig du gnas pa hril bsdud dam rim bsdud kyi mthar thig le stong pa nā dar gzhil ba/ 1 phung khams yongs 135

su sbyang ba/ 2 sgo gsum bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med ngang du bzhags pa/ 3 ste rtsa bas bstan pa'i dmigs rkang gsum yin la/ de dang 'brel ba stong nyid lhar pad pa'i gdams pa dang /1 gzhan yang yan lag du/ bza' ba/ 2 gyon pa/ 3 'gro ba/ 4 'dug pa/ 5 gnyid pa/ 6dmigs pa kha bsgyur/ 7 rnams kyang skabs 'dir spros te bshad pa gnad che/ de ltar skyabs sems nas bzung rtsa ba'i dmigs rkang 'di rnams la khrid lugs rab 'bring tha ma gsum ste/ de yang rab la dngos nyams rmi lam gyi rtags mtshan thob pa/ 'bring la zhag grangs bdun lnga gsum le lo med par sbyang ba/ tha ma yang zhag re rer sbyang nas dmigs rkang ma 'dzol zhing zin nges par bya la/ yam khrid shad shud ye nas mi rung ngo / /sems la rdo rus thugs nges par sbyang ba shin tu gal che'o/ /de yang sbyor dngos kyi khrid rim thams cad la thog mar 'gro don du sems bskyed pa/ bar du dge sbyor la yid rtse cig du 'jogs pa/ mthar dge ba la mi zhen zhing rnam smin re dogs med par byang chub chen por bsngo ba rnams shin tu gal che bas dus rtag tu ma chags par bya'o/ /de ltar bla ma de kho na nyid kyi bsgrub pa sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gsum sgo gsum dang gnyis med la bzla ba ni mthong lam kyi yon tan thob par byed pa'i rim pa'o/ /ā+o bī/ 'dir khyad par kyi gdams pa bla ma dang rang sems ro cig tu bsres nas dbu phyag khreg chod kyi gnad sems dang po mi gnas pa gnas par byed pa/ gnas pa brten pa/ brtan pa grol bar byed pa gsum las/ thog mar dngos po phra mo/ 1 lha sku/ 2 yig 'bru/ 3 phyag mtshan/4 thig le/ 5 rlung dang / 6 thig le 'bar 'dzags bslab pa/ 7 sogs pa'i man ngag bla ma'i phyag bzhes ltar bstan nas gnas 'gyu rig pa ngo zin nges byas nas zhi gnas gtan la dbab/ gnyis pa byung gnas 'gro gsum rtsad gcod drag po byas nas sems nyid kyi ngo bo gtan la phab nas ngo sprad cing zhi lhag zung 'jug gis nyams skyongs/ gsum pa nyams zhen kyi blo zhig nas ma bcos skye med spros bral lhag mthong gi rtogs pa ngo mthong ba dang / rtsal bskyed pa dang / mthun 'jug mngon gyur 'od gsal 'khor yug ma bu cig tu ma 'dres bar bskyong ngo / /de dag kyang rgyal ba'i bka' lung kyi don ma 'khrul bar/ rtogs ldan bla mas nyams khrid du ston pa las rang gi rtogs chos su rloms nas bka' don dang 'gal ba'i blos bcos kyi khrid dang / rang nyid kyi ma rtogs par dpe bshad yam dang / rtog ge'i brtag dpyadasnakyi bsre bslad byed pa ni nam du yang mi rung la/ rgyal ba'i bka' zung 'jug thob pa rnams kyi gsung3 ma 'ukhrul bar bstan par bces so/ /de yang khrid ston pa po rab rtogs pa can 'bring nyams skyes la/— tha ma yang bla ma'i gsung ma nor bar ston nus shing gzhung don go nges pa zhig dgos/ de bas rang gi myong chos yin par rlom zhing rgyal ba'i bka' las 'das par bstan na rdo rje dmyal ba'i rgyu yin 136

pa gzab 'tshal/ des na nyams rtogs brten pa ma thob yang khrid kyi go don ma nor ma 'khrul go ba zhig ni shin tu gal che'o/ /blo rmongs nyams bring bring skyes pas chos bshad pa las/ blo gros ldan pa go ba yang dag thob pas bstan pa phan yon che bar 'gyur zhing / lar slob ma'i mos gus kyi gnad kho nar rag las pas/ bka' chos zhus pa'i bla ma ni nam du dad pa ldem rgyang med par rdo rje sems par lta bar bya zhing spyir nyams dang rtogs pa'i shan 'byed zhing 'dra 'tshung gol shor dbang du ma song ba shin tu gal che'o/ /ā+o bī/ bla ma rang sems bsre ba'i gnad thun mong ma yin pa khreg chod thod rgal kyi don zung 'jug du nyams su len pa ni bla ma dam pa'i zhal las blang bar bya'o/ /yī shrī/ de ltar bla bsgrub kyi sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi dmigs pa'i rkang la/ chos bzhi'i dngor dmigs rkang bzhi/ gnyis par nyi shu gsum par bzhi bcu zhe bzhi/ /bzhi par rtsa ba gsum/ yan lag bdun ste dmigs rkang bdun bcu rtsa brgyad tham pa'o/ /de nas dang po phra mor thun kyi rtsa bar byas la/ de nas sku la nyi shu rtsa lnga/ yig 'brur lnga/ phyag mtshan bdun/ thig ler bdun/ rlung gi bslab pa lnga/ thig le'i sbyang bar bzhi ste dmigs rkang dril bas drug bcu ste/ gong ma dang sdom pas brgya dang sum bcu rtsa bdun kyi rdzogs pa ste/ slob ma'i rgyud tshod dang bstun te dmigs pa'i bsgyur bkod ni mtha' cig tu ma nges pas slob dpon myong ba can kyi blos bstan la/ zhal shes gdams pa 'ga' zhig ma rtogs/ dmigs rkang ma tshang med pa yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /de ltar nyams su len pa la go ba dang nyams myong shan dbye nyams dang rtogs pa ma nor bar dpal ldan bla ma nyams rtogs ldan pas myong khrid nyid du bya la/ spyir nyams dang rtogs pa'i nor so gol sa 'dra 'dra ni dbang po 'bring man chad la shin tu mang zhing / gzhung nas bshad pa'i nyams len kyis sa 'tsham dang mtshungs mi mtshungs ci rig pa 'byung la/ dbang po rab rnams la de lta bus mi rdzi zhing / blo gros mchog thob pa rnams kyi yang shan 'byed pa la mkhas pa'o/ /de ltar ma yin pa rnams ni nyams 'dra min gol shor med par rtogs ldan bla ma'am rgyal ba'i bka' yi bla ma la zhun thar bcad pa mchog tu gces pa ste/ phyi rol mu stegs gi grub mtha'i lta 'dod la la dang / dbu ma 'dzin pa rnams la khyad cha shas phra mo res byed pa yin zhes/ shing rta mchog gyur rnams kyi bzhed la/ spyir lta ba ma 'khrul spyod pa ma log pa ni mchog tu rgyal ba rnams kyi gsung ba'i gal 'gag go/ /mdor na lta ba nam mkha' lta bu la/ rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu/ chos kun rang sems su thag chod zhing /rgyu 'bras rten 'brel du shes pas mdor len la mkhas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma ni sangs rgyas kun las lhag par shes shing lus srog ltos pa med par dad gus zhabs tog dam tshig gi ye nas g.yel ba med par snying khong rus pa'i gting nas/ kha sems med pa ngos lkogs med pa skyid sdug med pa zhig shin tu nas gal 137

che'o/ /gal che'o/ /de ltar chos dran pa'i mi gcig la chos gcig gi chog pa/ chos gcig ni tshe gcig la zung 'jug rdo rje sems dpa' thob par byed pa'i lam ma tshang ba med pa/ don zab pa rgya che ba bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgrub thabs ches cher rmad du byung ba/ chig chog ri chos zab pa'i mthar thug pa ste/yang dag pa'i lam don du gnyer ba rnams srog ster bar byed pa bdud rtsi lta bu chos 'di kho na'o/ /de bas las bskal mchog dang ldan pa rnams kyis brtson 'grus drag pos nyams su longs shig bsgom cig bsgrub cig ston cig shod cig chos kyi snying por zung cig shin tu gces par gyis shigatsit+ta dha thim/ phar phyin theg pa rnams kyi bskal pa grangs med bsgrang nas byang chub bsgrub pa sngags 'og ma rnams skye ba grangs can kyi thob par byed pa dang / bla med rnams kyi 'di phyi bar dor byang chub chen po rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang brnyes par 'dod par yin ste/ de yi gnad bla ma la mos gus dam tshig gi rnam par dag pa gal che zhing / dam tshig gi rnam par ma dag na rdo rje dmyal bar skye bas dper na sbrul sgyug dong du bcug pa lta bu rdo rje theg pa'i lam ste dad mos dam tshig la rab tu brtson par gces so/ /spyir tha snyad kyi gzhung lugs la lo brgyar 'bad pa las/ nges don rtogs par blo phyogs nas glegs bam spyi bor bzhags pas byang chub la nye zhing / thos bsam 'dus byas kyi dge ba ci snyed bgyis pa las/ yang dag 'jog thun cig gi byang chub la nye zhing / rgyal ba'i bka' mdo rgyud du ma nas gsung zhing zung 'jug brnyes pa rnams kyis yongs su bsgrags pa yid ches pas nyams len don gyi snying po bsgom bsgrub la 'bad par byos shig 'bad par byos shig bdag lta bu'i skye bo la deng sang yid brten par mi byed pa bden na yang / bdag gi smra ba 'di dag ni rgyal bka' dang mchog brnyes pa nor kyi dbang phyug rnams ci ltar gsung pa'i don/ rang bzos ma rtogs par gzhan phan kyi lhag bsam 'ba' zhig gi bshad pa yin pas des na chos kyi tshig don la yid brten du bya bar rigs so/ /de ltar bla ma bsgrub pa'i khrid rim gyi sa bcad mig long gi sna khrid lta bu shin tu gsal bar bkod pa zab bo/ /'di bris nyes gyur thams cad 'khor lo yi/ /dbang phyug dran mchog rdo rje sems dpar bshags/ /'di phyi'i sgrib bral rnam dag dbugs dbyung zhing / /legs dges 'gro kun bla ma'i sa bsnyes shog /ces bla bsgrub dmigs rkang pad+ma'i phreng ba 'di nyid ni sa skal mchog dang ldan pa slob ma dad dam brtson 'grus can rnams kyi lan gcig ma yin par yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ dpal chen po rdo rje khrag 'thung thod phreng rtsal gyi thugs dang gnyis su med pa snub nam mkha' snying po yi mtshan rtsam kho nas gyi brlab pa yul mdo khams pa lha rigs dngul yi bya bral rig sngags 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu 'jam 138

dpal rgya mtsho 'am ming gzhan du pad+ma theg mchog bstan pa'i gsal byed nges grub pa'i shing rta phyogs las rnam rgyal grub mchog dbang po'i sde zhes bya ba phyogs kun rgyu ba yi rang lo sum cu'i sne la zin nye ba zhi ba zhes bya ston zla ra ba'i tshes bzang nyer gsum la bod yul stod mnga' ri cha glo mon bod kyi 'tshams gung thang nub ri'i bas mtha' ta la yi yang rtse tu bkod pa'i yi ge ris ni mdo khams stag bu'i btsun pa bsod nams rab brtan bgyis pa'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /maṅga lo/ shu lha/

༄sho /zhal gdams snying po bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāste/ mtshan tsam brjod kyang duḥkha'i 'khrul 'khor 'jig /gsol 'debs thar pa'i lam la yongs sbyong mdzad/ /mtshungs med bla ma pad 'byung bde ba che/ /bdag gi bla ma yin no gus phyag 'tshal//skal ldan thar 'dod bdag dang las mthun pa/ /yod na kho bo'i snying gi gtam 'di nyon/ /dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu rnyed dka' ba/ /u dusmra ra lta bur rab tu dkon/ /nam 'chi cha med tshe la nges med pa/ /bar snang glog ltar skad cig 'gyur nas 'gro/ /rgyu 'bras las 'di nam yang mi bslu bas/ /dge sdig spang blang las la mkhas par byos/ /thar pa'i mthun 'jug sangs rgyas go 'phang ste/ /de yi mthun 'jug sngags kyi lam yin la/ /dam tshig chos kyi srog rtsa dmar pos grags/ /'di dag kun la gces pa'i zhal gdams yin/ /nyams len snying po gnas lugs phyag rdzogs yang / /rang gi sems kyi ngo bo rig pa nyid//rang ngo rang gi shes las gzhan pa med/ /de yang sems nyid ngo bo 'di lta zhes/ /dpe gzugs mtshan nyid brjod pa'i yul ma grub/ /med do zhes na 'khor 'das thams cad 'char/ /yod do zhes ni mdzug tu 'dzugs pa med/ /de ni sems nyid gdod ma'i gshis lugs te/ /gshis lugs de las tshol rgyu gzhan ni med/ /de ka ma yengs rang ngo shes bzhin bskyong / /yang dag don la bskyong bya bskyong byed med/ /'on kyang gzhi lam 'od gsal ma 'dres bar/ /ma yengs dran pas sangs rgyas kun gyi lam/ /yin no yin nges des na dran pa bskyong / /de yang blo 'das lta ba'i mthar thug yin/ /dmigs gtad med pa bsgom pa'i mthun 'jug yin/ /ma yengs dran pa spyod pa'i mthun 'jug yin/ /re dogs med pa 'bras bu'i ngo bo lags/ /mang po brjod na zad pa'i mtha' med yang / /mdor bsdus snying gtam des kyang phan thogs 'gyur/ /de skad lho yi gter bston las 'phro gling / /gang gi gdung rigs dri ma med pa las/ /'khrungs pa'i sngags 'chang pad+ma tshangs dbyangs dang / /dbus gyur lho rgyud rgyal rigs bya ba yi/ /blon gyur dad gus blo gros lang tsho can/ /tshe ring rnam rgyal zhes par phan slad du/ /rgyal dbang pad+ma ka ra'i pho nya ba/ /rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu zhes/ /gangs can ri bo'i khrod du grags pa des/ /gnyal yul sa yi thigale bra gor du/ /skad cig ma la brjod par byas pa ste/ /tshig 'di ma brjed rtag tu dran byas na/ /thar pa mchog gi lam la 'dzeg pa dang / /kun tu dge legs dpal la spyod par shog /maṅga lo/ 140

spro+o / /nyams len snying po'i zhal gdams snying khrag dngas ma'i shog dril mgul khug ma yod chig chog ri chos zab/ /bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rtag tu phyag byas de yi gsang ba'i don/ /rang gi go myong dang bstun man ngag gnad/ /snying khrag thig pa lta bu 'dir ston no/ /rgyal chos bye brag grangs med kun 'du'o/ /rang rig ngo rtogs sangs rgyas thabs yin no/ /de thabs mchog ni dbu phyag rdzogs pa che/ /yang zhun rdzogs chen nyid do ngo mtshar che/ /de don mdor dril lta bsgom spyod 'bras bzhi/ /nyams len sbyor ba 'khor bar yin sun pa/ /nges 'byung bsam pas skyabs sems tshogs bsags dang / /sgrib sbyangs khyad par bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'bad/ /dngos gzhi sgom thog lta ba nges bzung ste/ /sgom pa'i ngo bo khreg chod yin no kye/ /khreg chod ngo bo ka dag ye shes de/ /nyams su len pa'i thog mar bzhag thabs ni/ /'khor ba snang ba phyi nang phra rag gi/ /'gyu rtogs nyid dang mi rtogs gnas pa dang / /bsam nyid gzung 'dzin blo yi brtag gzhib dang / /bcas bcos dgag sgrub gang yang ma byed kye/ /rang gi rang bsgrib gser nyid g.ya' yi bsgrib/ /dang pa'i chu bo bzo bcos rnyog mas bsgrib/ /rang rig ngo bo glo bur sems kyi bsgrib/ /gnyug ma'i ngo bo gzung 'dzin bcos mas bslad/ /kye hoḥ rang byung gdod nas ka dag rdzogs pa che/ /glo bur dri bral rang bzhin ngo bo gshis/ /'di la dpe mtshon brtag dpyad tshig gi yul/ /ma yin yin no mtha' dang bral lo kye/ /mi rtogs gnas pa bsgrub dang de nyid bshig /gang yang dri ma yin no ci gnas chug /'gyu ba rtogs tshogs dgag dang de 'phro mthud/ /gang yang rnam rtog yin no rang thog klod/ /dus gsum dus med rtogs pa'i ngo bo 'di/ /sngags 'das rtogs pa'i 'phro rjes la ma zhen/ /phyis 'byung rnam rtog langs pa'i sngon ma bsu/ /da lta'i rtog pa brtag dpyad bcos bslad spangs/ /rnam rtog ma 'gag ku yang klong du zhog /rnam rtog ma bsgrub rang ngo nyid la ltos/ /the tshom ma byed gang shar gdong de thong / /blo yi ma bzo ci shar nyid du zhog /zhog ces ched gnyer med do ci bder chug /yan zhes phul so med do lhan ner zhog /yengs med rang rig ngo bos rtag tu 'tsho/ /bsgom med shar grol khyab la yan mdzod kye/ /he ho/ bsgom med bsgom pa'i ngo bo de mthong tshe bag med 'khrul dbang thun mtshams ma shor bar/ /mnyam rjes chig dril dus kun ye shes che/ /zang thal ka dag nyid la rtag gnas mdzod do/ /gser gling pa rdo phal pa nub pa bzhin/ /gang shar chos sku'i ngang du rtogs gyis shig /gnyen po med kyang rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin gyis/ /phra rag dri kun gzhol par mdzad do 141

nyu)/e ma/ lta ba yid spyod las 'das rdzogs pa che/ /lhun grub thod brgal snang ba de ltos shig /rdo rje lus kyi rten 'brel bzhugs stang gsum/ /gang rung 'am ni gtso bor drang srong stang / /mang 'gul kha sna rlung sbrel dal byas te/ mig zim dbyings 'od stong pa thig le dang / /shes rab rang byung sgron mdangs rdo rje sems/ /lugs rgyud shel lam mu tig phreng ba'am/ /rta rnga'i mdud 'dra 'gro 'ong ldan pa de/ /dus gsum rgyal ba yongs kyi zhal yin kyi/ /de mthong de ni sangs rgyas yongs kyi sras/ /yin zhes kun bzang rdo rje'i ljags kyi gsung / /des na de la rtag tu ma yengs ltos/ /blta bya blta byed gcig min gnyis kyang min/ /ma bzung ma 'dzin brtag dpyad yang ma byed/ /snang yul nyid la ched du ma zhen la/ /ched du ma klod ku yangs blo bde'i ngang / /rang bab rang gshis der ltos ngo mtshar kye/ /khreg chod ma rtogs snang yul 'ja' 'od la/ /ched du 'thas na gzugs khams sa bon dang / /mtshungs zhes kun tu bzang mos rgyud du gsung / /zhen med snang ba 'di ni ye shes te/ /kun bzang gdod ma'i sangs rgyas de nyid kyi/ /thugs kyi rang mdangs 'di yin e ma kye/ /de ltar thod brgal nyams su len pa la/ /mi 'gul gsum gyi gzhi bca' sdod pa gsum/ /tshad du bzung bas rim bzhin ye shes la/ /goms tshad snang ba bzhi ru 'char ba ste/ /mdor dril snang sems lus ngag yid kyi rtags/ /ci byung chos nyid rol rtsed nyid shes nas/ /bzang por dga' ba ma byed sing nger klod/ /ngan par sdang ba ma shar phyi mer zhog /rtag chad re dogs med pa khyab brdal ngang / /nyams len le lor ma shor dril gyis shig /btang bas mi 'gro bzung bas mi zin pa/ /'di la btang bzung byed par rlom pa ni/ /blun las chos blun rig pa rang bab ngang / /ris/ mdangs lugs rgyud btson du da bzung cig /gnad 'di lta ba thod rgal yang zab don/ /yin pas rab tu gces pas nyams su longs/ /spyod pa blo las nus lam zung 'jug chos/ /zab lam gtum mo'i gdams pa 'dir ston nyon/ /rang lus mi dmigs rten brten stong pa'i ngang / /skad cig gnam pa chos 'byung o rgyan yul/ /dbus su e dmar pad nyi bam ro'i steng / /āḥlas phag dmar khro mo'i chas rdzogs pa/ /g.yas g.yon gri thod zhabs gnyis gar thabs rol/ /lus nang stong ra dar dmar gur phub 'dra/ /dbus su rtsa mchog dbu ma shel sbug ltar/ /mchin nad bzhi ldan g.yas g.yon ro rkyang zung / /mar sne lte 'og nyer nas dbu mar chud/ /dbu ma'i phar sne tshang bug ro rkyang sna/ /'khor lo bzhi bcas gsal ngang 'dus gsum kha/ /lte 'og sor bzhi nyi steng bla ma dang / /dbyer med ram̐ḥdamar me 'bar yid gtad ngang / /bla mar gsol btab gnad ldan rlung dgu 'bud/ /dal rngubs dar cig klod bzhag slar rngubs 'dod/ /shar tshe 142

rngubs chung bsnan bcas lte 'og mnan/ /ro rkyang nas brgyud dbu mar rlung zhugs pas/ /ram̐ḥlas me 'bar lte ba'i rtsa 'dabs gang / /rim bzhin goms nas gsang gnas snying ga khengs/ /bsam byas pho bskor rnyed bskor skabs skabs bya/ /mi thub snyams tshe mig zim rig pa nyid/ /lte 'og la gtad rlung ro lhag med 'bud/ /de ltar rngubs gang gzhil 'bud sbyor ba bzhi/ /gsum pa rlung dgang mi thub pa snyams tshe/ /ba spu'i bu ga khrol tshag ltar gsal nang / /rlung rnams sngo thul song dmigs lus 'dar bton/ /de nas 'bud bya rlung dgang ran tshod gces/ /'di dus 'khrul 'khor yan lag lnga sbyangs ni/ /rtsa mdud grol phyir 'bad ces gsung pas bya/ /de la goms nas ye shes gtum mo ni/ /lte 'og a shad me yi spyi bo ru/ /zla ba haṃ mgo mthur bstan drod kyi zhud/ /bdud rtsi bab pa med dang bros ded mthar/ /snying khar 'dres te rim bzhin byang sems rgyas/ /mgrin snying lte gsang 'khor lo rtsa 'dab gang / /dmigs nas dga' bzhi ngos bzung yas brten brtags/ /slar bzlog rig pa spyi bo'i mkha' la gtad/ /sbyor ba drug gi 'dren byas mas brten dga'/ /'khor lo bzhir myong dud 'gro 'gyur bzhi yi/ /tshang pa'i sar bskyal seng rol chos 'byung gis/ /bkram byas khu tshur thug pas rtsa mig ba/ /de nas bde stong chos nyid klong yangs su/ /dmigs brjod zhen bral ngang klod 'di ni sngags/ /thabs lam rtsa ba bogs 'don spyod gtso yin/ /de bas thun mong thun min spyod pa ni/ /kun 'dar kun bzang brtul zhugs rnam rgyal spyod/ /gang zag dbang rim gsum mthun tshogs rim spyod/ /mdor dril spyi ltar tshangs spyod 'dul khrims bstun/ /nang ltar sems bskyed snying rje gtso bor 'don/ /gsang ba thabs lam gsang sngags zab mor spyod/ /kun kyang tho co bag med cing spyod dang / /grags snyan lo 'dod rgyu mig zhan bral ngang / /rang gi rang ma bslu ba'i gdeng ldan pa/ /bag yod rgyal bas gsung mthun don la spyod/ /e ma 'bras bu zhes grags sgra chen de/ /sngar med gzhan nas byung ba zhig min kye/ /kun rdzob glo bur dri ma rang sangs te/ /rang rig sgrib bral mthong ma 'brur btags/ /'khrul pa sangs tshe sku dang ye shes rgyas/ /de la sangs rgyas zhes su brjod pa ste/ /brtson 'grus ldan pas rdzogs chen nyams blang mthar/ /re dogs 'phrang las grol tshe 'bras bu yin/ /de ltar lta sgom spyod 'bras mdor dril na/ /lta ba rgya mtsho nang gi gza' skar ltar/ /de 'dzin shes pa rtsis gdab bral bar zhog /bsgom pa nam mkha' yangs pa'i klong bzhin du/ /phyogs ris blos byas bsgom dang bral bar zhog /spyod pa sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'khrul 'khor bzhin/ /zhen bral rang bab bag yod ngang du zhog /'bras bu ri bo chen po ji bzhin du/ /gang bgrod gtos gzhi re dogs med par zhog /gsang sngags chos kun rtsa ba byin rlabs yin/ /byin rlabs bla mar rag las mos gus gces/ /theg chen gzhi yin gzhan phan sems bskyed gces / /chos kyi srog shing sdom dang 143

dam tshig gces/ /bstan pa'i gzhi yin tshogs gnyis zung 'jug gces/ /chos kyi lam grogs brtson 'grus snying rus gces/ /kye ma spyir yang chos bzhin spyod pa la/ /dam tshig mi bsrung sangs rgyas re ba ni/ /sol ba phyi ltar byas nas dung 'dod 'dra/ /rgyu 'bras mi bsrung byang chub thob 'dod ni/ /bye ma bcir nas mar khu 'dod pa 'dra/ /bla ma ma dgyes dge ba gang bsgrub kun/ /sa bon me la bsreg pa'i ljang bu 'dra/ /de bas rtag tu bla mar gus gyis shig /de ltar zhal gdams tshul 'di rang 'dra ba'i/ /blo rmongs nyams myong dman la phan snyams phyir/ /rgyal bka' grub thob zhal lung khyad par du/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i gsung gi man ngag nyid/ /rang gi nyams su myong bdang bstun nas/ /smras las mi shes mkhas 'dod tshe 'di yid/ /bstod snyan grags pa bsgrub pa'i ched du min/ /de ltar ston la gtan tshig lung dang ni/ /man ngag che ba'i tshig tshogs mang po zhig /brjod par yi ge 'jigs pas ma smras shing / /spyir yang nyams su ma blang tshig skam po'i/ /'brug stong ldir yang 'chi dus stong skad yin/ /nyams len mthun na rgyal gsung tshig res chog /rgyal ba'i gsung chos rgya mtsho lta bu la/ /blo rmongs bdag gi tshig gis ci zhig bya/ /'on te bskul ngo ma gcog tsam 'di smras/ /'di ni ci bzhin nyams len bu re las/ /'khyar chos byas na de srog dam ma gzas/ /rol mdzod badz+ra sa ma yā dam dzaḥ /nyams len bu la rtag tu grogs mdzod cig /ces mdo khams kaḥthog lho phyogs stag bu'i yul du skyes pa'i lha rigs rgyu'i rnal 'byor tshe dbang nor bu'i shing sbrul hor zla bcu pa'i tshes nyer dgur bod yul gyi rdo rje'i gdan bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyi gtsug lag khang shar 'jam dpal gling gi sa ga la ba der sbyar ba'i yig ris o rgyan blo gros dbang po'i bgyis pa dge'o/ /sarba maṅga lo / 144

rog /bla ma'i rnal 'byor snying gi thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ trīḥ skyabs mchog kun 'dus ngo bo/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje pad 'byung / /yab yum sras bcas rnam 'phrul/ /rtsa ba'i bla mar skyabs mchi/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro kun pha ma/ /de dag 'phrul snang gsal nas/ /byang chub lam la bkod phyir/ /zab lam bla ma bsgrub bgyi/ /bdag lus 'dzin med gdan gsum lhar gsal/ /spyi bo'i nam mkhar pad ma nyi zlar/ /dran mchog rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu/ /dmar smug khro chags 'dres pa'i nyams ldan/ /smin 'tsham hūm̐ dang thugs kar as mtshan/ /stod sngon bsham dkar rngul gzan dmar gsol/ /rdor dril rnam rol rdo rje skyil krung / /rin chen prog zhu rtus pa'i brgyan can/ /de yi spyi gtsug pad+ma'i sdong po/ /yal ga bzhi ru gyes pa'i dbus su/ /gsung gi rdo rje pad+ma 'byung gnas/ /rnam rol phyag rgyas rdo rje thod 'chang / /he ru'i chas can rdo rje'i skyil krung / /mtsho rgyal gri thod 'dzin dang mnyam 'khyud/ /g.yas g.yon pad ma'i yal ga gyes par/ /dri med 'od zer rdo rje gling pa'i/ /ngo bo bi ma la dang bai ro/ /mdun rgyab pad+ma gyes pa'i dbus su/ /karma rig pa 'dzin dang sgrol mgon/ /ngo bo ri khrod zhabs dang nag po/ /kun kyang rig ma mnyam rol brjid ldan/ /pad 'byung spyi bo pad stong steng du/ /'od dpag med la rigs lngas bskor zhing / /de yi dbu steng kun bzang yab yum/ /gzhan yang dgongs brda' snyan brgyud bla ma/ /rig 'dzin rgya mtsho sprin du 'khrigs bzhugs/ /kun gyi gnas lngar 'bru gsum trīḥphaṭaḥ /thugs ka'i 'od kyi ye shes bkug bstim/ /phyi nang gsang mchod kun bzang sprin 'bul/ /rtse gcig mos gus drag pos gsol 'debs/ /byin gyis rlob cig dran mchog dngas ma/ /'khor lo'i mgon po thugs rje can no/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ trīḥphaṭaḥ dkon mchog rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i/ /ngo bo gcig chog bla ma/ /dran pas srid bzhi'i gdung sel/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma mkhyen no/ /sku yi gnas lnga'i 'od kyi/ /dbang bskur sgrib dag lam 'byongs/ /'bras bu mngon byas bla ma'i/ /byin rlabs bdag la rdzogs gyur/ /mthar ni 'khor tshogs rim bzhin/ /gtso la 'dus de yang / rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ de bdag ro mnyam 'dres gyur/ dge ba 'di yi myur bdag /sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma 'grub nas/ /dbang phyug brgyad thob gyur cig /ces rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs tshul 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes/ gtsang la stod byang bkra bzang bas/ rin po che kun bzang ye shes zhal mnga' nas/ lho pha drug ra bzhi sngags 'chang pad ma 'gyur med dang / grong chen bco brgyad 'dzin pa'i rab 'byams pa pad ma rig 'dzin sogs dad skal ldan pa mang pos gsol ba btab pa'i ngor kun dga' dbang phyug zla'i tshes bco lnga la brag stod chos sku'i pho brang du rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus smras pa maṅga lo/ /145

bsam lhun sngon 'gro/ 7lhan thabs/ 7bsam lhun rtsa sngags/ 7dag snang sgrol ma/ 7gsang ba ye shes/ 7man ngag nor bu'i tog 7tshe sgrub rdo rje rgya mdud dbang / 7zhwa chos/ 7rtsa rlung yig med gsol 'debs/ 7rtsa rlung rtsa ba/ 7nam mkha' sum phrug 7'od gsal snang ba rdo rje'i mthol glu/7gsang ba lam skor gyi rnam thar/ 7gsang rnam smin rgyu'i chu bo/ 7gsang rnam bag chags yid kyi rang gzugs/ 7rtsa gsum rab 'byams la 'jug pa'i dbang / 7bdag dbang nyer bsdus/ 7rtsa gsum rab 'byams kyi me mchod/ 7rtsa gsum rab 'byams kyi tshogs/ 7rig 'dzin skyes rabs gsol 'debs/ 7bsam lhun bsdus pa/ 7yang dag cho ga 7yang dag gi grib sel/ 7thugs chen/ 7rnam rgyal thig nag 7yi dam bcu gsum dril sgrub/ 7a tsār+ya'i bka' lan/bsam lhun sngon 'gro ni/ hūm̐ḥgazod nas spros bral stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ lhun grub snang cha ma 'gags ye shes rtsalaḥ snod bcud dag pa bde chen pad+ma 'odaḥbakod pa rab rdzogs dkyil 'khor chen por sharaḥ de dbus rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor maḥ zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar gsal gri thod 'dzinaḥ zhabs gnyis gar stabs pad nyi bam ro'i steng ཿ snang srid dbang sdud dpa' mo'i rnam par gsalaḥ rang mdun mkha' la srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbusaḥ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho pad sdong rgyas pa'i kharaḥnyi zla'i gdan la sangs rgyas kun 'dus skuḥ pad+ma 'byung gnas dkar dmar zhi ma khroḥ zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje thod bum bsnamasaḥ zhabs gnyis rol stabs brjid pa'i tshul du 'gyingasaḥ pad zhwa ber phod chos gos rnam gsum gsolaḥ shes rab rang bzhin kha ṭ+wāṃ mchan du bstenaḥ phung khams skye mched gdan gsum tshang pa'i lhaḥ rab 'byams rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor sku la rdzogasaḥ mtha' skor yum mchog dgyes sde mched lnga dang ཿ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can sprin ltar gtibaḥ gnas gsum rdo rje gsum las 'od 'phros pasaḥ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus paḥ bla ma pad+ma'i rnam par yer gyis byonaḥ tshig bdun spyan 'dren/ phyag 'tshal bstod pa/ gsol 'debs bcas grub par byas laḥ gsol ba btab pas dbang bskur ye shes rgyasaḥ bla ma dgyes pa chen pos 'od du zhuḥ rang la thim pas rang nyid bla ma'i skuḥ bde stong gnyis med bla ma'i sku ru gsalaḥ dzapa niḥ gu ru'i thugs kar pad+ma zla gdan kharaḥ rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang baḥ de yi thugs kar rgya gram phyogs mdog giḥ lte ba mthing gar 'bru gsum brtsegs bar gnasaḥ de mthar gsang sngags rgyal po gser gyi mdogaḥ g.yas su 'khor bas 'phags mchod 'gro sgrib sbyang ཿ snang grag rig gsum bla ma'i sku gsung thugasaḥ ye yin lta ba'i ngang nas sngags sgra ldiraḥ yi ge bcu gnyis bzlaḥ bsdu na 'di nyid kyis grub pa yin no/ /shu r+ghaṃ/146

༄sto /dgongs gter bsam pa lhun grub ma'i dbang sgrub kyi lhan thabs rim gnyis shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na maḥsha ri nā thā ya/ dgongs gter bsam pa lhun grub ma'i dbang sgrub skabs/ rgyal ba kun 'dus las gzhung bsrangs nas badz+ra brgya stong sogs bzlas mthar/ skad cig gis mdun bskyed lha tshogs gzhal yas khang 'od du zhu zhing yongs su gyur pa las ye shes kyi rang snang las grub pa'i rdo rje'i gur khang srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'ang mi shigs pa rdo rje'i chos bdun dang ldan pa/phyi dang nang du khro bo'i tshogs kyis srung zlog gi las mdzad pa/ de'i phyi rol mtshon cha sna tshogs pa'i gur/de'i phyi rol du me dang rlung dang chu'i gur khang ste 'byung ba'i rang bzhin gyi srung 'khor/ gur khang gi nang du rin po che'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa/ de dag kyang don dam par gnod byed gang yang mi dmigs pa ye shes kyi srung 'khor te sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las ye shes kyi gur khang gi dbus su/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho sngo zhing dwangs pa brgya khyon dang gting mtha' 'byams klas pa'i klong nas 'thon pa'i pad+ma'i sdong po 'dab ma 'bum dang ldan pa yal ga lo 'bras phun sum tshogs shing / ge sar mngon par mtho ba'i steng du nyi ma dang zla ba'i gdan la dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can zhi 'dzum yid tsam khro ba'i rnam pa/ phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar bsnams shing / g.yon mnyam gzhag gi steng na ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa'i gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga rtse gsum brten pa/ dbu la she'u'i snyan zhu can pad 'dab can rtse mor rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang / rma bya'i mdongs dang rgod ldem gyis brgyan cing / me long dang gser gyi nyi zla dar gyi cod pan gyis spras pa gsol zhing / sku la mdo dang mthun pa'i cha lugs chos gos dmar po gser gyi ri mo can dang sngags kyi na bza' phod ka mthing ga dang gsang gos/ 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyi chas zab chen ber smug gser gyi ha ris can gsol ba/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung du bzhugs pa'i sku'i cha shas re rer yang bskal bar bltas kyang chog mi shes shing mi ngom pa'i mtshan dpe mchog tu rgyas pa'i gzi brjid nyi ma 'bum dang mtshungs shing / mthong thos dran pa tsam gyis byang chub kyi 'bras bu 'grub nus pa zhig tu byin thibs se bzhugs par bsgom/de'i mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du pad+ma dmar po'i steng du zla nyi srin po pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan la che mchog pad+ma drag po zhal gsum g.yas dkar/ g.yon ljang / dbus dmar ba/ phyag drug gi 147

g.yas na rdo rje tho ba me dpung / g.yon na thod khrag lcags sdig phur pa bsnams pa/ zhal bzhi 'dor stabs su bgrad pa/ dpal dang dur khrod kyi chas rdzogs shing yum rdo rje phag mo mthing nag gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud cing / sku la me dpung khro tshogs lcags sdig 'phro ba/ 'khor sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs kyi bskor ba/pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du sangs rgyas sman gyi bla sku mdog sngon po/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na a ru ra rigs lnga bsnams pa/ g.yon mnyam bzhag gi steng na be+eḍūr+ya'i lhung bzed 'chi med bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams shing / zhabs rdor skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan dpe yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku la chos gos rnam gsum klubs pa/ 'khor bde gshegs brgyad dang / bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong rtsa/sman gyi lha mo/ drang srong rig 'dzin dpag tu med pas bskor ba/pad zla la gter bum zung dang nyi dkyil steng du rmugs 'dzin sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig pa gzhon sha rgyas brjid pa/ phyag g.yas yid bzhin gyi nor bu thugs kar 'dzin cing / g.yon ne'u le dkur brten pa/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis bzhengs stabs su bzhugs pa'i pang du yum bde rgyas ma dmar po g.yas nor bu/ g.yon thod khrag bsnams pas 'khyud cing / yab yum gnyis ka dar dang rin chen du mas brgyan pa/ 'khor nor lha yab yum brgyad sogs ye shes las dang 'jig rten gyi nor lha bye ba 'bum gyis bskor ba/pad+ma 'dab ma 'bum ldan gyi lte bar zla nyi bdud bzhi'i gdan la dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu mthing nag zhal gsum g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing / phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu dang rtse lnga g.yon kha ṭaṃ dang me dpung / mtha' gnyis phur pa 'dril ba/ zhabs bzhi'i mdun gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang / rgyab gnyis g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum gyis bzhugs pa/ gsang ba nas phur bu rgyan gyi tshul du 'phyar bas bgegs kyi snying gar zug pa/ dur khrod dang dpal gyi chas rnams rdzogs pa/ yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs dril bu thod khrag bsnams pas 'khril zhing / 'khor dpal chen ho ru ka yab yum brgyad sogs yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor/ pad nyi'i steng du gu ru pad+ma zil gnon drag po rtsal sku mdog dkar dmar khrol 'dzum pa/ dbu la pad zhwa khyung ldem can gsol zhing za ber gsang gos dang chos gos gsol ba/ g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu rwa gdengs pa 'phyar zhing / g.yon snying phreng bsnams pa/ zhabs 'dor thabs kyis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar 'jam dpal/ mgrin par rta mgrin/ thugs kar gsang bdag lte bar ye shes mgon po/ gsang bar khyab 'jug rā hu la/ 'khor du zhing skyong seng ge'i gdong can sogs dge bsnyen brtan ma sde brgyad yul lha'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ 148

pad zla nyi ma'i steng du dgra bgegs bsnol pa'i gdan la gsang bdag seng ge sgra sgrogs sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu 'phyar zhing / g.yon sdigs mdzub thugs kar mdzad pas yum bdud 'dul drag mo seng gdong ma dmar nag gri thod 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/khro gtum 'jigs pas gzugs can/ dbu skra'i gseb nas seng zhal byung ba/ dpal dang dur khrod kyi chas can/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ dpa' bo dpa' mo ging chen sde bzhi sogs 'khor bye ba grangs med kyis bskor ba/theg pa rim pa dgu mtshon pa'i gdan gyi steng du sangs rgyas thod pa rtsal sku mdog dmar po zhal gsum g.yas dkar g.yon mthing dbus dmar spyan dgu khro 'dzum dang ldan pa/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rdor dril/ bar pa gnyis ral gri bhar+ghaṃ/ tha ma gnyis tshe bum dang kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams pa/ zhabs bzhi 'dor stabs su bgrad pa/ dpal dang dur khrod kyi chas rnams rdzogs shing / gtsug tu rigs dag 'od dpag med bzhugs pa/ yum gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo ḍā ma ru dang bhar+ghaṃ bsnams pa sku la 'khril zhing / 'khor de bzhin gshegs pa he ru ka'i chas can yab yum brgyad dang 'byung ba bzhi'i lha mo rnams kyi bskor ba/rgya mtsho chen po sngo la dwangs pa'i dkyil du me dpung 'bar ba/ de'i steng du keng rus dang ru dra pho mo brtsegs pa'i gdan dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dpal chen rta mgrin nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis seng ldeng gi rnga pus mo g.yon pa'i steng du brdung ba/ zhabs gnyis mi'u thung gel pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ keng rus kyi snyan cha dang / ral pa'i gseb nas rta mgo ljang zhur 'tsher ba/ spyi bor pad+ma thod phreng dmar nag ḍā dril 'dzin pas/ yum rdo rje phag mor 'khyud pa'i 'khor mkha' 'gro sde bzhis bskor ba/ yum khros ma sngon mo gri thod can gyis 'khyud pa/ dpal dang dur khrod kyi chas rnams rdzogs shing / phyogs bzhir phyag rgya rnam bzhi 'dzin pa'i mkha' 'gro bzhi sogs khro bo khro mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ye shes me'i klong du pad nyi'i gdan la khro rgyal lo kot+ta ra sku mdog dmar smug khro bo 'chol ba'i sku can zhal gdangs mche gcigs ljags 'dril r+ghaṃ sgra sgrogs pa/ spyan gsum nam mkhar gzigs pa/ thod skam dbu rgyan dang / thod rlon do shal zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pas gar skabs ling ling mdzad pa/ sku la za 'og mthing ga'i ber phod dang / chos gos dmar po/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang dung gi snyan rgyan/ phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje/ g.yon gnam lcags phur bu bsgril ba/ rngam brjid khros pa ye shes me yi tshwa tshwa 'khrugs shing / 'khor bdud 'dul khro bcu yab yum dang khro chung mang pos bskor ba/149

pad+ma 'dab ma 'bum ldan gyi steng du pad+ma rgyal po gang chen mtsho ste/ de'ang sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis thal sbyar ut+pal dmar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor 'od dpag med dang / thugs kar rdo rje sems dpas mtshan pa/ yum gsang ba ye shes dmar mo gri thod can gyis 'khyud pa/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ 'khor nye ba'i sras brgyad dang / gzhan yang sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pas bskor ba/pad zla'i gdan la sangs rgyas 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgyas lhung bzed 'dzin pa/ zhabs skyil krung chos gos rnam gsum sogs sprul pa'i sku'i cha lugs can/ 'khor mi 'khrugs pa sogs sangs rgyas rab brgyad dang / gzhan yang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang gā'i glung gi bye ma snyed kyi bskor ba/ pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la chos sku kun tu bzang po sku mdog mthing gsal (nal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag mdzad pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung can/ gzung 'dzin sgrib g.yogs bral phyir sku gcer bu rgyan cha spangs pa/ yum chos dbyings kun tu bzang mo ljang gu rdor dril 'dzin pas 'khyud cing 'khor rgyal ba rigs lnga zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/pad+ma 'dab stong rgyas pa'i ge sar nyi zla'i gdan la gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas zhal cig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi steng na yid bzhin nor bu bsam phel dbang gi rgyal po bsnams pa/ yum mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal sku mdog dkar la sngo ba'i mdangs ldan gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ zag med kyi bde ba mchog tu rgyas shing / ye shes lnga'i 'od klong du rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin sogs rig 'dzin bzhi/shes rab rgyud kyi slob dpon sogs slob dpon bzhi ste brgyad ka'ang yum khril zhing / gzhan yang grub thob pho mo brgyad bcu rtsa bzhi/ rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga/ gter chen brgya dang rtsa brgyad/ gter phran stong dang rtsa gnyis sogs gsang sngags gsar rnying gi rig 'dzin bye ba 'bum gyis bskor ba/ gtso 'khor de dag thams cad kyi spyi bor o dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar rgyu sngon pos mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros pas bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas mgon po 'od dpag med kyi thugs rje'i dwangs ma gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi lha tshogs bsgom pa dang 'dra ba 'khor rgyal rab 'byams kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ hūṃḥ.o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshamasaḥ pad+ma ge sar sdong po laḥ ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyesaḥ pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su gragasaḥ 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskoraḥ khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyiḥ byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsolaḥ gu ru pad+ma sirnyi r+ghaṃḥ lan gsum brjod/ ye shes pa rnams dam tshig pa so sor thim pas gnyis su med par gyur par mos la/ slar yang thugs ka'i 'od kyis bskul bas dbang lha nams spyan drangs/ dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu zhabs spyi bor brtan 150

la bsam yas su byon/ mnga' bdag rgyal po dang zhal mjal ba tsam gyis bsnyun las grol ba'i tshul dang /gdam pa dang rjes su gdam pa mang du gsan pa'i tshul thang yig rnams las bshad pa ltar sngon gyi smon lam dbang gi dus skabs 'dir rje rig 'dzin dbang 'di nyid kyis kyang mchog gi gter lnga bzhes thub pa byung na rten 'brel zab mo 'grig pas kha ba ri'i ljongs 'dir bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgya chen po 'byung bar nges la/ khyad par gyi gdam pa dus de dang der gnad du che ba dag yod pas yang chig shugs kyi bstan pa bzhin dus tshigs rim par 'gal rkyen du snang ba'i tshul ji rigs pa dag rgyal ba'i dbang po thams cad mkhyen gzigs nyid kyi gsang ba'i rnam thar dang / lo rgyus gzhan du yang gsal bas go bar nus so/ /gzhan yang gangs can ljongs kyi srid skyong ba po mi'i dbang po pho lha ba bsod nams stobs rgyas yab sras dang / bod chen po'i yul mdo smad sde dge'i sa skyongs ba'i dbang phyug dang /rgya nag brag sgo'i rgyal po/ mnga' ris mar yul rgyal po rnams dang / bal yul yam bu'i rgyal po/ lho 'brug sde srid/ glo bo stod kyi rgyal po sogs rgyal po dang rgyal phran du ma chos bzhin spyod pa gsung gi bdud rtsis grol ba mdzad pa dag dang / rgya gar ti ra hu ti'i rgyal po/ kha chur na sab/ ḍi li/ sa cha/ mon stod 'dzum li ra dza/ mon smad gor+ṣa rgyal po rnams ni dngos dang brgyud nas bka' bzhin du bsgrub pas phan tshun 'khrug rtsod kyi g.yul 'gyed pa dag mdza' mthun bde la bkod par mdzad pa yin la/ de ltar yang gsung mgur rgyal khag bcu gsum mar grags pa las/ rgyal kun thugs rje gcig bsdus/ /gu ru pad+ma'i thugs rje/ /'dzam gling chos kyis yul dbus/ /bod khams bde ba'i bkra shis/ /bod kyi gru 'dzin mthon poske/ /gangs can 'gro ba'i mgon po/ /rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho/ /nor bu'i khri la bzhugs yod/ /mi rje bka' yi blon po/ /dpa' 'dzang 'khor gyis bskor yod/ /'dzam gling bde zhing skyid pa/ /gu ru pad+ma'i thugs rjes/ /bod yul bde zhing skyid pa/ /lha yi dpal la spyod yod/ /mnga' ris mar yul rgyal po/ /mdza' mthun bde la bkod yod/ /stod hor rgyal po'i dmag dpungs/ /kho rang gnas su bzlog yod/ /ḍilbi sa cha'i rgyal po/ /mnyes pa'i grogs po gyis yod/ /kha chur na bab rgyal po/ /nyan pa'i 'bangs su bkod yod/ /mon stod 'dzum li rgyal po/ /zhabs kyi stegs bur sbyar yod/ /mon smad gor+ṣa rgyal po/ /phyag las dge la bsgyur yod/ /bal yul yam bu rgyal po/ /chos kyi slob mar gyis yod/ /rgya gar ti hur rgyal po/ /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag bgyid rgyu/ /mdo smad sde dge rgyal po/ /dge ba'i sku mkhar brten yod/ /rgya nag zab sgo'i rgyal poske/ /gzhan stong chos la spyod yod/ /spa gro mon gyi rgyal po/ /chos kyi rdzing bun skyil yod/ /shar phyogs rgya nag rgyal po/ /bod yul byams pas bskyangs yod/ /ces gsung pa ltar shar phyogs tsi ṇi yul nas/ lho phyogs 'phags pa'i yul dbus 'gyur 'chang marga dha/ nub phyogs kasmi ra'i grong khyer tshun/ byang phyogs sta 151

gzig gi yul gru tshun gyi dregs ldan mtha' dag gi ral pa'i lan bus gang gi zhabs kyi pad+mo la gus pas gtud par byed na gzhan dag gi smos ci 'tshal/ 'on kyang yid bsrub bdag pos byin gyis brlab kyis myos pa'i ser skya log snang gi rab rib thug pos dad pa'i 'dren byed ldong pas dam pa'i skye bo la rgyab kyi phyogs te bsam sbyor tshul bzhin ma yin pas log par 'khu zhing bkur 'debs byed pa dag ni rang rang ngan 'gro'i gting ring gi g.yangs sar 'phyongs bar ring pa kho na te/ gsang ba'i lung byang las/ skal ldan dam pa phal cher de la 'du: skal med skye bos de la log par blta: bdud rigs rnams kyi mgrin gcig bshe bar byed: kun kyang mdun nas gus shing rgyab nas dmod: 'brel can phal kun the tshom lan gnyis skye: de la smod byed 'phags pa yin kyang rung : bskal pa gsum tu dmyal bar nges par ltung : de la the tshom med par 'du byed kun: pad+ma nga dang smon lam 'brel ba yin: the tshom skyes kyang bar chad 'phral du 'jug: 'gro ba phal cher bsod nams dman pa yis: de la the tshom med par gus pa dkon: 'on kyang de dang smon lam mthun 'gyur pa'i: bskal bzang skyes bu brgya dang bdun bcu lnga: rim par 'byung 'gyur rkyen dbang ma song na: de dag kun gyi 'gro 'dul grogs su spyod: /zhes dang / rje nyid kyi gsung las/ mdor na gzugs can mi'i 'gro ba/ /'dul bya dung gsum gsung na yang //sngar phan chos 'brel thob pa 'bum/ /khrid bka' thob pa gsum khri rtsis/ /yod snyam rags rtsis dbang gi yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'di ltar mtha' dbus kyi phyogs gang yang tshad ldan gyis skyes bu dam pa dag la log rtog ches sdang zhing dmod pa dang / rnying ma bar rlom pa'i gter rdzus/ 'dres khyer/ dam log zog 'khyal mkhan mang po zhig la tshang mar mthong zhing de dag gis dog tshang gi mchog dman bar ma'i yid can du ma zhig gi dbu gdugs ltar skor te slad kyis rnying ma'i bstan pa dang slob dpon chen por log rtogs gis ches smod pas 'gal rkyen du gyur pa sngon dus nas bzung da lta'i bar 'byung ba ni kun tu gsal bas dpyod ldan bzu bor gnas pa rnams kyi mkhyen par 'tshal lo/ /mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa mtha' dag thugs su chud pas gang la'ang chags thogs med pa'i ngag gi dbang phyug chen por gyur te bstan bcos bka' rtsom gyi rim pa'ang ji snyed cig yod par nges kyang phal cher yig char ma 'khod cing 'ga' zhig so so'i 'dod ngo de dang der rtsal ba rnams ni kha thor bas phyogs gcig tu ma 'dus par snang la/ 'on kyang phyogs 'dir mthong thos spyod yul du gyur pa'i bka' 'bum rin po che pusta ka lngar bzhugs pa las rje lo ri ba chos kyi rgya mtshos dkar chag yan lag drug sbyar dang / de rjes grwa 'jam dpal gling pa sngags 'chang shes rab 'byung gnas kyi 'bad rtsol chen pos gsung rtsom rigs ji tsam snyed pa rnams phyogs stebs su bkod par sde mtshan bcu gnyis su phye ba'i dang por rnam thar rtogs 152

ra sarba sirnyi hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭaḥ oṃ badz+ra gu ru gro bo lo ta lo ka sarba sirnyi hūṃ rgyu hūṃḥ o āḥhūṃ trīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃḥ o a mi ta bha trīḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta hri da yaḥ a nu ka teḥ oṃ ku ldu gi ni swā hāḥ na mo rat+na tra yā yaḥ o kai ka ni kai ka niḥ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa ni tro ṭa ni/ tā sa ni tā sa niḥ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/ sarba karma pa ram̐ pa rā ṇi me sarba satwa nāñtsa swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūṃḥ.aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥhaḥ.oṃ āḥr+ghaṃḥgu ru dh+wa ki nī dzñā na sarba sisnyi pha la hūṃḥ bkra shis dge/༄ga /mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyi gsang sgrub bde chen rgya mtsho bzhugs/na mo dzñā na ḍāki ni ye/ spyan ras gzigs dbang dgyes pa'i yum/ /sor rtog ye shes gsang ye ma/ /gsang ba phyag gnyis sgrub pa'i thabs/ /bde chen rgya mtsho 'di ni 'khyil/ /maḥrang sems gdod nas mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i dal/ /ye yin thag chod ngang nas skyabs su mchi/ /snang srid bde chen klong du grol ba'i phyir/ /mkha' spyod btsun mo'i grong du 'jug par bgyi/ /trīḥskye med dbyings las bde ba'i cho rol las/ /snang srid chos 'byung dbang gi gzhal med khang / /thabs shes nyi zla gzung 'dzin bam ro'i steng / /trīḥyig yongs gyur mkha' 'gro gsang ye mar/ /'dod pas rab myos bcu drug lon pa'i lus/ //zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis gar stabs can/ /phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon pas thod khrag 'dzin/ /rin chen pad+ma rus pa'i rgyan gyis mdzes/ /nyon mongs lam byed kha ṭ+wāṃ mchan du brten/ /ma rig gnyid slong spyi bor phag zhal ngur/ /zag pa kun bral sna tshogs gzugs kyis rgyu/ /'khor ba'i mkha' la thog med nyi zla bzhin/ /lus dbus gnas lnga phag mo rigs lnga dang / /spyi bor snang ba mtha' yas rdo rje chos/ /rā ga'i mdangs ldan phyag gnyis ḍā dril dang / /zhabs gnyis phyed skyil 'ja' 'od klong du bzhugs/ /dam ye dbyer med thugs srog 'od zer gyis/ /don gnyis lhun rdzogs srid zhi'i dwangs bcud bsdus/ /rang thim snang sems gdod nas mkha' spyod zhal/ /bde chen 'dus ma byas pa'i ngo bor sad/ /snying dbus rta mgrin dmar gsal gcer bu'i sku/ /phyag g.yas phreng ba g.yon na pad+ma 'dzin/ /zhabs gnyis 'dor stabs dbu gtsug rta skad 'tsher/ /thugs kar nyi gdan trīḥl sngags kyi bskor/ /oṃ āḥr+ghaṃḥtrī ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa trī ya dza hūṃḥ 'bru bzhi brtsegs mthar sngags kyi phreng / /g.yon du bkod la dal gyis bzla/ /gzhan yang gsang ye sgos kyi sngags/ /rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa'i bcu cha bzla/ /oṃ dhu ma gha ye na ma swā hāḥha ri ni sa ra tsa trī ya r+ghaṃḥdzaḥ /phyi nang gsang ba spyi dril sngags/ /dgos sngags de yi bcu cha bzla/ /oṃ r+ghaṃ 153

tram̐ trī aḥ.e yo ram̐ baṃ loḥtrī ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa trī ya tsit+ta hri hri dza dzaḥ zhes bzlas snod bcud mkha' 'gro'i sku/ /yum gyi bde klong yangs par bzhag /spro na rtsa rlung lha dang sngags/ /don dam thig le'i rdor bzlas bya/ /mtha' mar mchod bstod rgyas 'debs ni/ /trīḥ gdod nas lhun grub bde chen mchod pa'i sprin/ /rang snang ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul/ /'khor 'das kun gyi gshis lugs gsang ye'i zhal/ /gzung 'dzin spros pa'i sprin dang bral labastod/ /'dis ni srid kun bde chen ma/nyam nyid che/ /gsang ba ye shes stong pa'i mkha' klong du/ /sbyor byas zag bral gdod ma'i rgyal
