po'i sar/ /myur du 'khod nas gdul bya 'dren par shog /de ltar gsang sgrub byin rlabs rmad byung ba/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro grogs su thob pa yi/ /nam snying sprul pa sngags kyi dge sbyong che/ /gar dbang bde chen rol ba rtsal gyis bris/ /sa mā yaḥ ces pa 'di rje rig 'dzin chen pos mdzad/mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyi rgyun khyer bde chen gter mdzod ni/ na mo/ snang srid bde stong shar ba gsang ye'i zhalaḥ rtogs pas skyabs mchi 'gro kun bdag gis bsgralaḥ lan gsum dang ཿ hrīḥ rnam thar gsum ldan bde stong dbyer med ngang ཿ 'ja' 'od me dpung 'khrigs pa'i gur khang dbusaḥ rgyal yum ye shes mkha' 'gro sku mdog dmaraḥ gcer bu rus brgyan phyag gnyis gri thod bsnamasaḥ bam steng zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum kha ṭ+wāṃḥ 'khyud/ bde drod me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na 'gying ཿ spyi bor rdo rje mkha' 'gro dkar mo dang ཿ lte bar rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo dang ཿ mgrin par pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar mo dang ཿ snying dbus rdo rje mkha' 'gro sngon mo dang ཿ gsang bar las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang mo rnamasaḥ rang rtags phyag mtshan yu ba gri thod bsnamasaḥ gcer bu rus brgyan kha ṭ+wāṃ yab kyi tshulaḥ gzhon nu bcu drug nu 'bur bha ga rgyasaḥ zhabs rnams brkyang bskum gar stabs ling ling bzhugasaḥ gnas gsum dhā ki grangs med 'khor gyis bskoraḥ thugs las 'od 'phros 'og min chos dbyings nasaḥ rang 'dra'i ye shes spyan drangs ro gcig gyuraḥ snying dbus mi shig dga' ba 'khyil ba'i klong ཿ trī mthar sngags 'khor snang srid bde bas khyabaḥ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃḥ trī ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa trī ya dza rgyuḥ'abar 'dzag dga' ba bzhi yi ting 'dzin laḥ rol bzhin bzlas pas 'khrul snang sdug bsngal zhiḥ bde chen gling pa'i chos sku'i gter mdzod lasaḥ tshe dbang nor bu 'bar bas gter 'di btonaḥ sa mā yaḥgasang ye ma'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus/ na mo dzñā na ḍā ki nī ye/ /de yang mkha' 'gro'i gtso mchog gsang ba ye shes kyi lo rgyus bsnyen sgrub dang 'brel bar gleng bar bya ste/ khong la ye shes kyi sku dang / 'gro ba rnams 'dul ba'i phyir gang 'dul der snang gi sku bsam las 'das pa yod pa las rags rim tsam brjod na/ sprul gzhi ni/ smin gling gter chen gyi gter byon/ yum gsang ba ye shes kyi 154

lo rgyus las/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas pho rnams 'dul ba'i don du spyan ras gzigs dang / pho rnams 'dul ba'i don du gsang ba ye shes dang / gdug pa gdul ba'i don du dpa' bo rta mgrin rnams sprul lo/ /de gsum dgongs pa gcig tu gyur pa ni o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas su sprul nas gdul bya rigs gsum spyi dang khyad par mtha' 'khob bod kyi yul gdong dmar 'dre srin thams cad 'dul bar byin rlabs dbang bskur te/ bdag gis sdong grogs bgyi'o zhes dam bca' dang lung bstan pa ltar rgya gar gyi yul mtha' dbus kun tu 'gro don dpag med mdzad doḥzhes dang / khong ni gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas dang bla slob tha mi dad par snang ba'i tshul yang / rtse le sna tshogs rang grol gyis/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes sam nyi zla dngos grub ces kyang bya ba/ gcod yul brgyud pa'i skabs su ni su kha sirnyir grags shing rnying lugs la ni mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang chen zhes grags pa des/ gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas la dbang bskur tshe/ /gu ru nyid yi ge r+ghaṃḥ zhig tu bsgyur nas mkha' 'gros zhal du bzhes/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ gsang ba'i pad+mo phyung pas dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs su thob te phyag rgya chen po'i grub pa brnyes/ zhes sogs gsungs pa'i lo rgyus kyi khungs pad+ma bka' thang shel brag ma'i le'u so bzhi par/ de nas mkha' spyod rig 'dzin gnas su phyinaḥ bden gsang lam mnol ba'i dur khrod naḥmakha' 'gro nyi zla dngos grub ces kyang byaḥ mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo gsang ba ye shes zhesaḥ dge slong kun dga' smon lam zhes kyang byaḥ mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang mo che'i drung phyinaḥ thod mthar sgo bcad nang du ma thar nasaḥ g.yog mo ku mā ra la 'phrin brgyud pasaḥ lan ni ma byung brjed dam smras pa yiḥ shel gyi bum pa khur nas chu len 'dugaḥ ngas bskur byas pas bum stegs kha ru bzhagaḥ rgyal bas bum stegs bum par 'byar du bcugaḥ langs par ma gyur khug khug lan 'ga' byasaḥ bum thag phud nas rgyal ba'i mdun du 'ongasaḥ shel gyis gri gus brang gshags kha phyes nasaḥ zhi ba rdo rje dbyings kyi lha tshogs rnamasaḥ bkra lam bstan nas ngag nas 'di skad gsungasaḥ khyod kyang sngags pa nus mthu can 'dug steḥ de bas nga'i 'di ya mtshan mi che'amaḥ de skad zer bas phyag 'tshal bskor ba byasaḥ mchog dang gong ma bdag la bskur du gsolaḥ nga ni g.yog yin nang du 'dengs zer phyinaḥ nyi zla'i khri brtsegs nyi zla'i gdugs phub paḥ nyi ma zla ba'i rgyan drug sku la gsolaḥ dge slong ma bzhugs phyag 'tshal bskor ba byasaḥ gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong phul nas niḥ phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang bskur zhu gsol bsaḥ lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar khra chems byung ཿ skal ldan rigs ldan da lta dbang zhus gsungasaḥ bla ma med pa'i gong rol naḥ sangs rgyas bya ba'i ming yang medaḥ bskal pa stong gi sangs rgyas dgaḥ bla ma dag la brten nas byung ཿ dpal ldan bla ma yon tan mtshoḥ bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor 155

legs bstan nasaḥ thugs rjes slob ma la gzigs zhuḥ dbang ni lha la mi zhu bla mar zhuḥ de skad smras pas dge slong ma'i zhal nasaḥ dbang zhu shes gsungs lha tshogs thugs gar bsdusaḥ rdo rje gro lod yi ge r+ghaṃḥdu bsgyuraḥ zhal du mud nas byin gyis brlabs pa yisaḥ phyi ltar sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas skuḥtshe yi rig 'dzin grub pa'i dbang rnams thobaḥ khong pa'i nang slebs byin gyis brlabs pa yisaḥ nang ltar 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi skuḥ phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa'i dbang rnams thobaḥ gsang ba'i pad+mor bton nas byin rlabs pasaḥ lus ngag yid gsum shes sgrib dag par sbyangasaḥ gsang ba ltar na rta mgrin dbang gis skuḥ dregs pa'i lha 'dre dam la 'dogs dbang thobaḥ ces grub pa'i dbang phyug mtsho skyes zhabs kyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes mdun nas dbang zhus pa'i tshul mdor bsdus shig gsungs pa dang / yang gzhan du gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas brag phug ma rā ti kar 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i skabs kyi tshe lam phyag rgya mo lha lcam man+d+ra ra ba yang yin par gsungs te/ ras chung ba'i rnam thar du/ gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas mjal/ /zhes sogs tshig gis gu ru'i slob ma dang / gsang yum yin par bstan pa'i bshad srol gnyis ka mi 'gal ste/ rdzogs chen gyi lo rgyus sogs su bi ma mi tra gu ru'i bla ma dang slob ma gnyis ka yin par gsungs pa dang / gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas dang mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyi sprul pa'i rol gar yang bsam gyis mi khyab te/ pad+ma bka' thang las/ 'jig rten re re'i phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad naḥ gu ru mtshan ni brgyad brgyad sum cu drugaḥ ces dang / mdzad tshul rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab kyang ཿ 'di ru spros te ma 'ongs sems la glanaḥ zhes dang / mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyis/ ngas ni zhing khams brgyar yang phyin/ /zhes dang 'og nas byung ba'i gnas ris sna tshogs su mdzad pa sna tshogs bstan pa'i tshul la legs par go na bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i gnas la ngas shes gting zab mo 'khrungs par 'gyur ro/ /bod du mkha' 'gro dngos kyi zhal slob tu gyur pa grub thob o rgyan pa sogs byung mod lo rgyus cung zad rgyas par bshad pa ni ras chung rdo rje grags pa ste/ /khong gi rnam thar las mkha' 'gro'i lo rgyus ches gsal bar gsungs pa 'di ltar/ ti phu gsang sngags kyi sdong po'i zhal nas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yum du gyur ba bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rgyal yum gos dkar mo'i rnam par sprul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pas brjod kyi mi lang mod/'on kyang da ltar gnas skabs kyi rags pa zhig brjod na ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul khams zhes bya ba zhing khams lag mthil ltar khod snyoms pas na/ byang chub kyi shing dang 'bras bu can gyi shing gis brgyan pa/ u dum wa ra la sogs pa'i me tog mang po'i tshal/tsan dan ljon pa'i tshal dang seng ldeng 'thug po'i nags tshal rgyas pa/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog dang yan 156

lag brgyad ldan chu bo 'bab pa pho skyes thams cad dpa' bo dang / mo skyes thams cad dpa' mor yod pa/ yid la bsam pa tsam gyis 'dod dgu 'byung ba/ rgyan dang longs spyod thams cad rang bzhin gyis 'byung ba/ de'i dbus na me tog bkod pa'i gnas yod pa/ yid du 'ong zhing gan rnyo la'i gzhal yas khang brgyan dang bkod pa tshad med pa'i rnam pa yid du 'ong ba'i sems can sna tshogs pa yang 'dzum zhing skad snyan pa sgrog pa/ sil snyan dang rol mo'i sgra skad rnam pa sna tshogs snyan pa sgrog pa yid du 'ong zhing dpag tu med pa/ de'i dbus su pad+ma'i sdong po zhig la me tog chen po zhig 'khrungs pas mkha' 'gro ma thams cad ya mtshan skyes so/ /de la bskor ba dang tshogs mchod mang po byas/ /phyag dang mchod pa mang po phul/ de'i tshe me tog gis char babs/ rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs pa rang bzhin gyis byung / /sa g.yo ba chen po byung ste/ mkha' spyod kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams bar snang la lhags te/ rdo rje'i glu len gar bsgyur/ sa spyod ma dang sa 'og gi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad 'tshogs te/ a la la hi hi zhes pa'i nyams 'bar zhing rus pa'i rgyan cha sna tshogs byas te gar sna tshogs bsgyur/ de'i u dum wa ra'i me tog de la bu mo lo brgyad kyi na tshod 'gro ba'i rnam pa zhig 'khrungs so/ /de mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi rus rgyan dang / dar gyi cod paṇa phul nas zab mo'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing / gan dho la'i gtsug lag khang du gdan drangs te/ rdo rje phag mo sprul pa'i sku sems can gyi don du rin chen sna lnga'i khri mthon po'i steng du bzhugs su gsol/ /mtshan ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mor gsol te/ /mkha' 'gro mang po'i tshogs dpon mdzad do/ /de nas rdzu 'phrul lus kyi bkod pa mang por sprul te zhing khams thams cad du byon/sangs rgyas thams cad la chos gsan zhes grags so/ /zhes 'jig rten 'dir sku'i bkod pa snang bar mdzad pa'i tshul gsal bor gsung ba dang / yang sprul pa tha dad pa'i gnas dus tha dad par sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i tshul yang snga ma las/ rdo rje phag mo sprul pa'i sku/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal yum gos dkar mo/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yum/ /grub pa'i rgyal mo la phyag 'tshal/ /rgya gar yul gyi nub phyogs su/ /yul ni nub phyogs o rgyan yul/ /gnas ni me tog bkod pa'i gnas/ /me tog pad+ma las 'khrungs shing / /mtshan mchog sum cu rtsa gnyis ldan/ /dkar dmar 'od ldan yid 'ong ma/ /'ja' lus rdo rje'i rnam par mdzes/ /lang tshor ldan zhing bde ster ma/ /rin chen rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol/ /gri gug bdud rtsi thod pa bsnams/ /dar gyi lhab lhub cod paṇa can/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs dbus su/ /gan dho shel gyi gtsug lag tu/ /rin chen sna lnga'i khri steng du/ /ma cig grub pa'i rgyal mor grags/ /lo grangs lnga brgya song zhes kyang / /na tshod bcu drug tshul du bzhugs/ /bde chen pad+mo bkod pa ru/ /tshe lha yongs kyi zhal gzigs te/ /tshe dbang khrid dang bcas pa gsan/ /rig 'dzin tshe yi dngos grub thob/ /157

ming ni gos dkar zhes su grags/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor/ /'og min stug po bkod pa ru/ /longs sku rdo rje 'chang chen mjal/ /gsang sngags dbang bzhi rdzogs par zhus/ /bla med sku bzhi mngon du gyur/ /rdo rje phag mo zhes su grags/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /gan dho shel gyi gtsug lag tu/ /bde mchog 'khor lo dang mjal te/ /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa gsan/ /gsang sngags mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhes su grags/ /gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bskor/ /me tog cher rgyas zhing du byon/ /bcom ldan rgyal ba rigs lnga mjal/ /dug lnga 'dul ba'i chos rnams gsan/ /ye shes lnga ru mngon sangs rgyas/ /rnal 'byor chen mo zhes su grags/ /mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /ri bo ta la'i rtse mor byon/ /byams mgon spyan ras gzigs dbang mjal //theg pa chen po'i chos rnams gsan/ /'gro ba 'dul ba'i dngos grub brnyes/ /'gro 'dul mkha' 'gro zhes su grags/ /sems dpa' sems ma'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod du/ /gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas mjal/ /gsang sngags zab mo'i chos rnams gsan/ /gsang yum gsang ba'i mchod pa phul/ /dga' ba'i bde stong nyams myong rgyas/ /chos nyid zab mo'i dngos grub brnyes/ /gtsug gi rgyan gcig zhes su grags/ /'khor ni mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor/ /yul ni nyi shu rtsa bzhir byon/ /mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis mjal/ /man ngag gdan gyi gdams pa gsan/ /grub chen brgyad kyi dngos grub brnyes/ /nam mkha' dbyings phyug zhes su grags/ /ḍāki dkar mo 'bum gyis bskor/ /dur khrod brgyad kyi gnas la byon/ /mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma dang mjal/ /bde chen gsang ba'i ngo sprod gsan/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub brnyes/ /dur khrod ro zan zhes su grags/ /mkha' 'gro sprul pa'i stag gzig dang / /dom dang lce spyang mang pos bskor/ /rgya gar yul rnams kun la byon/ /rnal 'byor grub chen brgyad cu mjal/ /chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong gsan/ khams gsum dbang sdud dngos grub brnyes/ /mkha' 'gro bde byed ces su grags/ /skal ldan las can mang pos bskor/ /pad+ma dbang gi gnas la byon/ /dpa' bo dbang chen rta mgrin mjal/ /rgyud sde stong phrag mang po gsan/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub brnyes/ /gsang ba ye shes zhes su grags/ ḍā ki stong phrag mang pos bskor/ /de ltar ngo bo gcig la mtshan yongs su grags pa bcu tham pa yin te/ grub pa'i rgyal mo'i zhal nas/ ngas ni zhing khams brgyar yang phyin/ rdo rje 'chang chen la sogs te/ /rgyal ba rigs lnga yab yum mjal/ /bde mchog 'khor lo la sogs te/ /rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs mjal/ /sa ra ha dang klu sgrub dang / /grub chen rnams dang nga gtam byas/ /zhes gsungs shing 'ja' lus rdo rje'i skur bzhugs pa yin no/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan pas 'og min dang mngon dga' dang bde ba can la sogs pa'i zhing khams thams cad du byon nas/ la lar 158

ni gtso mo'i tshul/ /la lar ni 'khor gyi tshul/ /la lar ni sprul pa'i tshul la sogs te yang dag pa'i rnam par thar ba ni bsam las 'das pa yin no go 'am zhes dang / gzhan ma rtogs phyogs rtogs log rtog gis mngal skyes su 'dod pa sogs tshad ma'i gtan rtsis dang 'gal phyir 'dir brjod pa ma yin no zhes pa'i don ci bzhin gsal bo ma byung la/ de'i 'phror/ gang ltar yang rje btsun dang mjal tshe mi lo lnga brgya lon zer na tshod ni lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod tsam gzhon tshul lang tsho dang ldan pa/ mkha' 'gro'i rtags tshang zhing 'gro ba so so'i skad du chos ston pa dang bde ba'i nyams dang rnam 'gyur sna tshogs su ston pa gsang sngags kyi spyod pa mtha' dag tshad pas skal ldan rnams la grol ba ster nga// re 'ga' ni mang por sprul/ re 'ga' ni nam mkha' la byon sku lus kyi bkod pa bsam gyi mi khyab pa mdzad cing rdo rje'i glu len/ /mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag mang po la chos gsungs/ nyi ma gcig gam dus gcig la mkha' 'gro brgya phrag mang po la sogs pa'i tshogs dpon mdzad/ ces sogs mdzad pa 'ga' zhig bsal bor gsung pa ltar ro/ /dmigs bsal zab chos 'di nyid kyi lo rgyus ni/ gu ru'i thugs sras las can dag pa'i 'khor lnga la be+e ro bcas la gnang ba'i gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa ste/ sngon chad bai ro'i rnam sprul pad+ma bde chen gling pa'i rgya rong dmu rdo'i brag nas gter du bzhes pa'i klong gsal ḍāk+ki snying thig dngos bstan phyag bzhi ma dang de'i gter mjug nam snying sprul ba rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i dgongs gter rgyun khyer phyag gnyis ma 'di nyid do/ /pad+ma bde chen gling pa'i zab gter las kyang phyag gnyis kyi sgrub thabs 'di dngos su bstan te/ bka' 'dus zhi khro nges don snying las/ rgyal yum ye shes mkha' 'gro sku mdog dmar/ gcer bu rus rgyan phyag gnyis gri thod bsnams/ zhes gsung pa 'di nyid gsang sgrub kyi dgongs pa yin no/ /gsang ba ye shes kyi chos sde gu ru'i rje 'bangs la gtad pa'i tshul ni/ smin gter gsang ye'i lo rgyus las/ pur rgyal bod kyi btsan po khri srong sngon las kyi 'phro sad pas spyan drangasaḥ gdug pa can thams cad 'dul ba sogs 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi gang gis gang 'dul ba dang de dang de'i sgo nas 'gro don mdzadaḥ dam pa'i chos kyi srol btodaḥ khyad par btsan pos tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen pos mchodaḥ rin po che'i ma dha phul nas gsol ba btab pa lasaḥ slob dpon gyis zab mo'i gdams pa sgrub thabs kyi gnad snying por dril te btsan po dang ཿ jo mo mtsho rgyal dang ཿ bai ro bdag rnams la gnang ba rnams las khyad par ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi sgrub pa'i thabs rtsa ba yan lag dang bcas pa rnams dge slong be+e ro tsa nas yi ger btab nas phyi rabs kyi don du gter du sbas pa'oḥ gsang ba zab mo'i snying po'i donaḥ gnad du sgril ba'i gdams pa 'diḥdus kyi mtha' mar phyogs pa naḥ skal ldan gcig la gtad par byaḥ zhes pa ltar ro/ /cho ga'i dmigs 159

pa/ 'dir phyag gnyis pa yin kyang cho ga rgyas par phyag bzhi ma yin pas sku gang ltar dmigs kyang rung la bsnyen dmigs sogs la khyad par med do/ /bsnyen pa ji ltar gtong tshul/ rje rig 'dzin chen po'i dpa' bo rin po'i che'i dri lan las/ klong gsal mkha' 'gro snying thig gi bzlas pa ni phyi nang gsang ba'i sngags spyi dril yin 'dug la/ de yang oṃ āḥhūṃḥgasum ni bde gshegs spyi dril kyi snying po ste phyi dang /oṃ r+ghaṃ tram̐ trī aḥ.e yam̐ ram̐ baṃ loḥ bcu ni rigs lnga yab yum bcu ste nang gi dang / hrī ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa trī yaḥbacu ni mkha' 'gro yab yum bcu ste gsang ba'i snying po'o/ /tsit+ta hri hri dza dzaḥni lha dbang du bsdus shing las la gcun pa ste yang gsang yin par mngon/ des na spyi dril gyi sngags kyi dbang ci ltar mtshams pa las dmigs bsal gyi grangs bzung mi dgos/ nang bsgrub kyi snying po 'di ni mkha' 'gro thod brgal du bsgrub pa ste shin tu rno zhing myur ba bzhed/ dus rgyun chags su bzlas pa'i gtso bo ni yig 'bru bco lnga pa ste/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ trī ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa trī ya dza r+ghaṃḥ yang na/ oṃ āḥhūṃḥhrī ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa trī ya tsit+ta hri hri dza dzaḥ zhes kyang bzla ba ste de gnyis rgyun bzlas la khyad med pas gang bde gtso bo bzla ba lags/ zhes so/ /gong gi phyi nang gsang ba spyi dril gyi sngags gi mgor 'bru gsum yod par gsungs kyang rgyun khyer bsdus pa rang gzhung la oṃ las med pas 'ga' zhig gis chad pa yin pas 'bru gsum tshang bar dgos pa bzhed/ 'ga' zhig gis oṃ gcig pos chog par bzhed pa sogs rang gi mos pa dang bstun nas bya/ med kyang chad pa'i skyon du mi 'gyur zhes bla ma dus mas gsungs phyir re dogs bya mi dgos so/ /sngags kyi mjug gi dza r+ghaṃḥzhes pa ni dngos grub sgrub pa'i skabs dang / tsit+ta hri hri dza dzaḥzhes pa ni dngos grub bskul ba'i dus su bzla ba yin no/ /bzla ba'i skabs/ dmigs pa dang po srog snying 'bru bzhi la yid dal gyis bzhag nas yid bzlas brgya rtsa dang / rlung kha sbyor du bcings nas brgya rtsa/sngags phreng las 'od dmar thon nas khams gsum 'gro ba'i snying rje chen pos dbang du bsdus/ snod bcud kyi dwangs ba 'od dmar dang mnyam du rang gi pad+ma nas zhugs nas srog yig la mer gyis thim par bsam nas rlung dang 'brel yid bzlas brgya rtsa/ de nas snod bcud thams cad sgyu ma dang rmi lam lta bu thams cad rang nyid gsang ba ye shes kyi rol bar bsam la rlung bum chung bzungs shing bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ 'dir yid bzlas brgya rtsa bya ba yang dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba brgya rtsa brgyad kyi yun tsam la bshad pa las grangs de kho nar 'grig ma 'grigs kyi re dogs mi byed par dus tshod phyogs tsam nges pa'i sgo nas dad pa dang dmigs gnad mi 'bral bar bag phebs dal kyis bzla ba gces so/ /bzlas pa'i grangs/ gtso bo yig 'bru bco lnga ba bzla ba man ngag yin la phyi ma rnams sgrub thabs su bcu cha bzla bar gsung pa rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la dgongs pa yin gyis bsnyen sgrub skabs yig 'bru bco lnga dang las 160

sbyor skabs las gang yin pa de'i sngags gtso bor byed dgos so/ /bsnyen grangs 'bru 'bum byung na rab dang ma byung rtsa na rlung thig le'i nyams len gtso bor 'don pa yin na 'bum gsum gyis 'thus so/ /bzlas pa gtso bor byed na/ gzhung ltar go rim dngos grub sgrub pa la 'bru 'bum sogs legs par grub pa dang / bskul ba de'i bcu cha tsam gsungs ba 'grub na bzang yang ma byung na 'bum phrag gcig bgyis kyang chog la/ de bzhin phyi nang gsang ba spyi dril sngags kyang bsdu tshe khri bzhi tsam byas kyang rung ngo ske/ /mthar bsdu rim ni/ thugs ka'i 'bru bzhi las 'od zer 'phros pas snod bcud dgra gnyen dmigs yul thams cad me long la ha btab pa'am 'khyag rom chur zhu ba bzhin rang thim zhing gnyis su med par gyur/ rang nyid sngags 'khor/ mgo nas mjug bar bsdu/ de 'bru bzhi la bsdu/ 'bru gsum yas rim nas gliḥl bsdu/ trīḥms rim nas thig le la bsdu/ de gug gu nas nā da'i bar bsdus nas 'ja' yal ba ltar chos nyid rnam par mi rtog pa 'od gsal rlung ba nyid la mnyam par 'jog de nas skad cig gis lhar ldang nas spyod lam la 'jug rgyun khyer nyid grub brnyes rig 'dzin brgyud pa bar ma chad pa'i thugs dam kyi gtso bor bsnyen pa yin pas spros pa rgya chen po med kyang byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun nyams pa med pas gsang ba ye shes kyi gdams pa la mos pa'i 'jug pa kun gyi thugs dam gyi dwangs mar 'dzin par 'tshal/ ces pa'ang rig 'dzin chen po gang gi mtshan gyi byin rlabs las sprul pa'i skur grags kyang don du dug gsum gyi khol por gyur pa rig 'dzin pad+ma dbang chen gyis ye shes mkha' 'gro'i bsnyen sgrub kyi thun seng zhig la dam pa gang gi gsungs la kha skong gi tshul du sbyar bas bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes la spyod pa'i rgyur gyur cigagag /man ngag yid bzhin nor bu'i tog gi blo gros ces bya ba bzhugs/na mo gu ru badz+ra ma hā mu drwa ya/ skyabs 'gro ni/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃḥ dus 'di nas bzung byang chub ma thob paraske/ /skyabs gnas mchog gyur rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /lan gsum/ sems bskyed ni/ sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don tu/ /bla ma sangs rgyas sgrub nas ni/ /gang la gang 'dul 'phrin las kyis/ /'gro drug sgrol bar dam bca' 'o/ /bshags pa ni/ /rgyal ba kun 'dus gu ru'i sku lus las/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs bdag sogs sdig sgrib dag yi ge brgya ba ni/ /mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yi/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon po skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ lan gsum/ bla ma bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin bdag la thim/ /bdag gi ma dag phung po stong par gyur/ /mnyam par bzhag r+ghaṃḥ161

chos dbyings mkha' khyab ye shes 'od snang dbus/ /seng khri pad+ma stong ldan nyi zla'i gdan/ /rgyal kun sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje sems/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas sangs rgyas 'od dpag med/ /sku mdog dkar dmar mtshan dpe yongs su rdzogs/ /phyag gnyis rdo rje thod pa tshe bum bsnams/ kha ṭ+wāṃ gru 'khyud zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil/ /gsang phod chos gos za 'og ber phyam klubs/ /dbu la pad zhu ḍā ki'i sprin phung gsol/ //rgyan tshogs bsam 'phel nor bu du mas spras/ /gnas gsum rdo rje gsum gyur oṃ āḥr+ghaṃḥ lte bar ye shes rdo rje trī yis mtshan/ /de las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs gyur/ /rdo rje'i tshig bdun ni/ r+ghaṃḥ o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams/ /pad+ma ge sar sdong po la/ /ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags/ /'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor/ /khyed kyis rjes su bdag sgrub kyis/ /byin gyis rlabs phyir gshegs su gsol/ /gu ru pad+ma sidhi hūm̐ḥ zhes ci lcogs dang / mchod pa ni/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃḥ mkha' khyab kun bzang rol ba'i sprin phung nyid/ /dgyes mchod spyi dang khyad par dam tshig rdzas/ /bde stong kha sbyor rol pa'i mchod par bcas /zab gsal bde chen dbyings su mchod par bgyi/ /zhes dang khyad par du/ bdag gi 'khor gnyen gces pa'i lus don dbang / /tshe srog bsod nams dus gsum dge tshogs bcas/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus gu ru mchog la 'bul/ /thugs rje brtse bas kun tu bzhes su gsol/ /gang zhig mi srun spyi dang khyad par du/ /theg mchog bstan dang ston la sdang ba yi/ /log sred can kun bdag mthu nus pas btul/ /gu ru'i bka' bzhin 'bangs su bzhes su gsol/ /bla ma rgyang 'bod ni/ kye kye bla ma rin po che//sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /'gro ba kun gyi gnyen gcig po/ /mgon med bdag la thugs rjes zungs/ /bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' che/ /re zhing ltos pa'i gnyen gcig po/ /bdag la re sa gzhan na med/ sdug bsngal 'dam las drangs du gsol/ /rje btsun pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /khyed la bdag nyid bran du 'bul/ /skyid sdug re ltos khyed shes pas/ /bla med mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ /bla ma sangs rgyas 'phrin las mdzad/ /bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs/ /mtha' yas sems can ma lus kun/ /'dren pa'i bla mar bdag gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sidhi rgyuḥzhes mang du bzla/ dbang len pa ni/ gu ru'i sku yi 'bru bzhir 'od zer bzhi/ /dkar dmar mthing ljang bdag gnas bzhir thim pas/ /dbang thob sgrib dag lam 'byongs sku bzhir smin//gu ru pad+ma'i go 'phang myur thob shog /oṃ āḥr+ghaṃḥhrī sarba sirnyi pha la r+ghaṃ āḥbasngo ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /gu ru pad+ma 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /rang bzhin dag pa'i dge ba 'dis/ /'khor ba ngan song dong sprugs te/ /srid na 'ga' yang mi gnas par/ /thams cad sangs rgyas nyid thob shog /162
'ayu

gag /tshe sgrub rdo rje'i rgya mdud kyi don dbang 'chi med bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /tshe dpag med mgon bde chen gling / /dad gsum rgyal mtshan rtser mchod nas/ /'gro la srog gi dpal sbyin pa'i/ /dbang gi chu rgyun 'di nas 'bebs/ /snyigs 'gro'i dpal mgon dam pa pad+ma bde chen gling pas gnas mchog dmu rdo'i brag nas skyes chen dam pa bcu phrag gsum gyi mdun sar khrom gter du spyan drangs pa'i tshe sgrub rdo rje'i rgya mdud kyi dbang rgyas pa ni gzhan du yod la 'dir don dbang skur na/ cho ga sngon du 'gro bas bum sgrub bdag 'jug bcas grub pa dang / bgegs gtor dang las bum/ gtso bum/ tshe ril/ tshe chang bcas gra 'grig pa byas la/ me tog dang mig ras 'gyed/dbang gi sngon 'gro ni/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas/ dag pa khrus nas ma bton par/ /gsang sngags dbang gi sgo mi dbye/ /byur dang mi shes ma bsal bar/ /gsang sngags dbang gi gral mi ston/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo ma bsgom par/ /gsang sngags dbang gi chos mi 'chad/ /ces gsungs pa'i dang po las bum gyi chus slob ma rnams la khrus bya ba ni/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ / lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de ring khyod la khrus bgyi'o/ /nas yi ge brgya brjod nas slob ma rnams snod rung byas/ gnyis pa byur gsal ba ni/ /oṃ trīḥpad+ma kro dha h+ya spyi ba hūṃ phaṭaḥ rang nyid rig pa trīḥlas rta mchog dpalaḥ dmar gsal thod dbyug g.yas la dung khrag g.yonaḥ dur khrod chas brgyad spyi gtsug rta skad 'tsheraḥ me dpung dbus su rang snang yum bcas gsalaḥ bgegs gtor la chab bran laḥ re yo khaṃḥ gtor ma'i dngos 'dzin dri ma yongs sbyangs teḥ rat+na'i snod yangs rgya cher kha dog driḥ nus pa phun tshogs 'dod dgu yid bzhin 'byung ཿ bgegs rnams tshims byed longs spyod mang por gyuraḥ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ lan gsum/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs/ sasgyu ra'i sngags lan gsum gyis bsngo/ bka' bsgo ba ni/ r+ghaṃḥ nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren mi min bdudaḥthams cad nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byedaḥ gal te nga yi bka' las 'da' byed naḥ bdag khros lha yi nga rgyal ting 'dzin bskyedaḥ khro tshogs rab spros dpag med stong khams gang ཿ log 'dren dgra bgegs 'byung po lta ci smosaḥ khams gsum skad cig yud tsam de nyid laḥ ma lus gtan nas brlag par the tshom medaḥ de bas mchod sbyin glud gtor 'di khyer laḥ gnas 'dir ma 'dug rang rang gnas su dengasaḥ gdon byed 'byung po u tsa ya phaṭaḥ zhes rtsa sngags dang rgyuḥbazhi drag sngags so lnga ba dang 164

thun gyis brab/ gu gul bdug gsum pa srung ba'i 'khor lo ni/ r+ghaṃḥ bdag nyid dbang chen rta mchog thugs ka nasaḥ khro bo khro mo'i phyag mtshan yig 'bru dang ཿ ye shes me 'od 'ja' zer mtshon cha'i tshogasaḥrab spros phyogs bzhir zug cing mtshams bzhir bkramaḥ steng 'og kha sbyor srung ba'i 'khor lo'i guraḥsra brtan 'gyur med lhun gyis grub par gtamasaḥ badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sneḥ sems bskyed gsal 'debs su gzhug la/ /chos bshad pa ni/ 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ sa gzhi spos chu'i sogs brjod/ 'jug pa'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ /thal mo me tog dang ldan pas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i drung du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod//kyeḥbla ma tshe dpag med dang dbyer med pasaḥ bdag cag dus min 'chi ba las sgrol phyiraḥ 'chi med ka dag mi 'gyur rdo rje'i tsheḥ de ring mgon po khyod kyis stsal du gsolaḥ lan gsum brjod/ mig dar sbyin la/ oṃ tsak+ṣa bhad+dha bā ra ma ḍā ye swā hāḥ me tog sbyin la/ oṃ ā khaṃ bī ra r+ghaṃḥ de nas rgyud dag pa'i slad du rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus 'dus pa'i bdag nyid gu ru tshe dpag med pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi spyan sngar pha ma sems can ma lus sgrol ba'i phyir du skyabs su 'gro zhing byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed snyams pas 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ /na moḥ 'chi med tshe yi lha la skyabs su mchiḥsems bskyed 'gro ba kun don tshe dbang zhuḥ lan gsum/ de nas dam tshig gi rim pa rnams tshul bzhin blang nas srung ba'i slad du rjes bzlos mdzod/ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsolaḥ dus 'di nas bzung byang chub b.raḥ sems can kun gyi don gyis phyiraḥ sdom gsum blang zhing srung bar bak+ṣi lan gsum/ thams cad rdo rje'i rnal 'byor du sems bskyed pa'i mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā miḥ dkyil 'khor gyi sgo nas lha rnams la phyag 'tshal ba mos la thal mo gnas gsum du sbyar bas 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzodaḥ oṃ na ma te rduḥ na ma me rduḥ na mo na ma r+ghaṃḥ lan gsum/bla ma dang tshe dpag med tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka nas mgon po tshe mtha' yas pa gnyis pa zhig 'phros te khyod kyi snying gar zhugs par mos shig dam chu thogs la/ hoḥ de ring bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag medaḥ khyod kyi snying gar yang dag zhugs pa steḥ tshul min smras na nyams te ltang bar 'gyuraḥ de phyir khyod kyis shin tu gsang bar byaḥ sa ma ya na ra kanaḥ de nas dngos gzhi'i dbang skur zhu ba'i slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsolaḥ bdag ni 'gro la phan phyir duḥ de bzhin gshegs kun byin gyis rlobasaḥ bdag la 'chi med tshe dbang stsolaḥ lan gsum/ de nas slob ma lhar bskyed pa ni/ khyod rang rnams kyis dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gyis shig oṃ su bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shukau3 haṃḥ gzung 'dzin gnyis bsdus kyi chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong 165

pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams kyi rig pa snying rje sgyu ma lta bu'i rkyen la brten nas rgyu'i sa bon trīḥdamar du gyur/ de nyid skad cig gis tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa longs spyod rdzogs sku kha dog dmar po pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po bye ba'i 'od 'phrog cing nyi zla phrag khrig zil gyis gnon pa/ mtshan dpe mchog tu 'bar ba'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i cha lugs can/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo drung dang phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi mthil na 'chi med ye shes kyi gang ba'i bum pa dpag bsam shing gi kha brgyan can 'dzin pa/ rang 'od kyi yum dang bcas pa'i thugs kar zla ba sen gang ba'i lte bar trī gser zhun lta bu 'od du 'bar pa de las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang sems rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs thams cad gtso bo'i rnam par spyan drangs nas khyod rang la thim pas gnyis su med par mos mdzod/ rtsa sngags dang ye shes dbab pa'i sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha ya a āḥ zhes spos dang rol dbyangs gis byin dbab/ ye shes dbab pa de nyid byang chub snying po'i bar du brtan par mos mdzod/ rdo rje rgya gram bcas/oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hāḥ zhes me tog 'thor/ rigs kyi lha la mjal ba'i phyag rten du me tog phul mdzodaḥ puṣ+pe pra ti badz+ra hoḥ zhes phul/ ma rig pa'i sgrib pa mig dar dang lhan cig tu bsal nas lha zhal mjal bar mos shig badz+ra tsak+ṣa pra be sha ya phaṭaḥ ces mig dar bsal/ 'o bum pa'i gzhal yas khang 'di'i nang du khyod rnams kyi rigs kyi bdag po mgon po 'od dpag med bde gshegs yum lnga bcas pa bzhugs pa'i sku lus bdud rtsi dkar dmar gyi rgyun babs pas tshe yi bar chad bsal zhing tshe srog rdo rje'i brag ri ltar gyur bar mos mdzod/ rnam bum thogs la/ r+ghaṃḥ bcom ldan rigs lnga tshe dpag medaḥ gsang ba'i yum mchog lha mo lngaḥ sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nasaḥ 'chi med tshe yi dbang bskur cigaḥ gsang ba thugs kyi ga'u nasaḥ mi 'gyur ā yu tshe yi bcudaḥ skal ldan bu la bstsal du gsolaḥ mi 'gyur gsang ba'i rgyas thob cigaḥ oṃ gu ru hūṃ oṃ swā ā+o hāḥ sbo lī māṃ paṃ ṭ+wāṃḥ a mā ra ṇa dzī brnyi ā yu ṣe a gi ṣiñtsa hūṃḥ tshe ril dang tshe chang thogs la/ 'o brtan g.yo'i dwangs bcud bsdus pa'i thabs shes kyi rdzas la longs spyod pas rtsa rlung thig le'i dwangs ma sgrib bral du smin/ lcags la gser 'gyur gyi rtsis thebs pa ltar rdo rje gsum du brtan par mos shig r+ghaṃ trīḥ stong gsum srid pa kun gyi bcudaḥ thabs mchog tshe ril shes rab 'chang ཿ 'chi med tshe yi dam rdzas 'diḥ skal ldan bu la sbyin pa yisaḥ rtsa rlung thig le'i stobs 'phel nasaḥ mchog thun dngos grub kun thob shogaḥ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī brnyi ā yu ṣe rat+na tsā na a bhi ṣiñtsa r+ghaṃḥ ces sbyin/ mtha' ma rgyas 'debs pa ni/ tshe mda' 'am rdo rje nam mkhar rgya gram gyi tshul du bkod nas/ r+ghaṃ trīḥ rigs lnga bde gshegs tshe dpag medaḥ nyon mongs gsal dag ye shes ngang ཿ tshe 'dir bstim mo bsod nams dpal bskyed cigaḥ mi'u rnams la 166

bkra shis shogaḥ 'byung ba lnga yi bdag nyid yumaḥ 'byung lnga'i khams nas tshe nyams naḥ yum chen bzhi yis dpal bskyed cigaḥ skal ldan bu yi sgo gsum laḥ tshe dpag med mgon rig lnga yisaḥ sku gsung thugs kyi rgyas thob laḥ bla tshe nyams pa sor chud cigaḥ pad+ma 'khor lo rin chen dang ཿ rdo rje rgya gram phyag rgya lasaḥ mi 'gyur gsang ba'i rgyas thob cigaḥ 'byung ba tshe srog dpal bskyed laḥ mi 'gyur rdo rje'i dbang bskur bsaḥ skye 'chi med pa'i don rtogs shogaḥ oṃ āḥhūṃḥ.a mā ra ṇi dzī brnyi badz+ra ā yu ṣe a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃḥ nang phung po khams lnga'i tshe nyams paḥ phyi rol gyi 'byung ba lnga'i bdud bsdus nas rigs lngas rgyas btab pas cis kyang mi shigs par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod cig de nas dam tshig gi rim pa ni gzhung rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang lasaḥ rab ni sāts+tsha nar ma ruḥ thebs tshad gdab ste 'bum ther ramaḥtha ma lo re stong tsho tsamaḥ gdab pa shin tu gal che'oḥ gzhan yang mchod rten na bza' gsolaḥ sems can srog slu tshe thar btang ཿ tshe dpag med kyi gzungs sngags 'donaḥ lam 'phrang zam pa bcos pa sogasaḥ mdor na dkar po'i dge la 'badaḥ ces sogs gsungs pa'i dam tshig rnams ci nus su srung snyam pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bo'i ji ltar/ lan gsum/ dbang yongs rdzogs thob pa'i bka' drin gtang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ dge ba byang chub tu lhan cig bsngo bar zhu/ /bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod/ e ma bla ma'i thugs rje ljon bzang las/ /tshe 'phel 'chi med 'bras bu 'di 'khrungs pas/ /dpag yas 'gro la 'chi med srog gi zungs/ /sbyin pa'i 'phrin las srid mthar gnas par 'gyur/ /ces pa'ang rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus gzhung rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang rnams 'jug bde bar bsdus te bkod pa dge'o/ /167

gag /tshe sgrub rdo rje'i rgya mdud kyi tshe dbang bsdus pa bum gcig gtor gcig 'chi med srog gi rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba bzhugs/na mo gu ru a mi tā bha ya/ de la 'dir mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa sngon du 'gro bas dbang rdzas byin gyis rlabs shing las bum bsgrub/ bgegs gtor/ khrus kyi bum pa/ tshe gtor bcas nyer mkho'i dbang chas rim pa ltar bkod la/ dbang gi sngon 'gro ni/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas/ dag pa khrus nas ma bton par/ /gsang sngags dbang gi sgo mi dbye/ /byung dang mi shes ma gsal bar/ /gsang sngags dbang gi gral mi ston/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo ma bsgom par/ /gsang sngags dbang gi chos mi 'chad/ /ces gsungs pa'i dang po las bum gyi chus slob ma rnams la khrus bya ba ni/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi ni/ lha rnams gyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de ring khyod la khrus bgyi'o/ /zhes yi ge brgya brjod nas slob ma rnams snod rung byas/ gnyis pa byur bsal ba ni/ oṃ trīḥpad+ma kro dha h+ya spyi wa r+ghaṃ phaṭaḥ rang nyid rig pa trīḥlas rta mchog dpalaḥ dmar gsal thod dbyug g.yas la dung khrag g.yonaḥ dur khrod chas brgyad spyi gtsug rta skad 'tsheraḥ me dpung dbus su rang snang yum bcas gsalaḥbagegs gtor la chab bran la/ re yi khaṃḥ gtor ma'i dngos 'dzin dri ma yongs sbyangs teḥ rat+na'i snod yangs rgya cher kha dog driḥ nus pa phun tshogs 'dod dgu yid bzhin 'byung ཿ bgegs rnams tshims byed longs spyod mang por gyuraḥ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃḥhoḥ lan gsum/ a kā ro lan gsum byin gyis rlabs/ /sasgyu ra'i sngags lan gsum gyis bsngo/ /bka' bsgo ba ni/ rgyuḥ nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren mi min bdudaḥ thams cad nga yi bka' las 'das ma byedaḥ gal te nga yi bka' las 'da' byed naḥ bdag khros lha yi nga rgyal ting 'dzin bskyedaḥ khro tshogs rab spros dpag med stong khams gang ཿ log 'dren dgra bgegs 'byung po lta ci smosaḥ khams gsum skad cig yud tsam de nyid laḥ ma lus gtan nas brlag par the tshom medaḥ de bas mchod sbyin glud gtor 'di khyer laḥ gnas 'dir ma 'dug rang rang gnas su dengasaḥ gdon byed 'byung po u tsa ya phaṭaḥ zhes rtsa sngags dang rgyuḥbazhi drag sngags so lnga ba dang thun gyis brab/ gu gul bdug gsum pa srung ba'i 'khor lo niḥ r+ghaṃḥbadag nyid dbang chen rta mchog thugs ka nasaḥ khro bo khro mo'i phyag mtshan yig 'bru dang ཿ ye shes me 'od 'ja' zer mtshon cha'i tshogasaḥ rab spros phyogs bzhir zug cing mtshams bzhir bkramaḥ steng 'og kha sbyor srung ba'i 'khor lo'i guraḥ sra brtan 'gyur med lhun gyis grub par gtamasaḥ badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa r+ghaṃḥ sems bskyed 168

gsal 'debs su gzhug la/ chos bshad pa ni/ 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ sa gzhi spos chu'i sogs brjod/ de nas gsol ba 'debs shing sdom pa bzung ba ni/ rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus 'dus pa'i bdag nyid gu ru tshe dpag med pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi spyan sngar pha ma sems can ma lus sgrol ba'i phyir du skyabs su 'gro zhing byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed snyams pas 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ na moḥ 'chi med tshe yi lha la skyabs su mchiḥ sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don tshe dbang zhuḥ lan gsum/ de nas dam tshig gi rim pa rnams tshul bzhin blang nas srung ba'i slad du rjes bzlos mdzod/ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsolaḥ dus 'di nas bzung byang chub b.raḥ sems can kun gyi don gyis phyiraḥ sdom gsum blang zhing srung bar bak+ṣi lan gsum/ de nas slob ma lhar bskyed pa ni/ khyod rang rnams kyis dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gyis shig oṃ su bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmaḥ swa bhā la shurjo ྅ haṃḥ gzung 'dzin gnyis bsdus kyi chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur/stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams kyi rig pa snying rje sgyu ma lta bu'i rkyen la brten nas rgyu'i sa bon trīḥdamar du gyur/ de nyid skad cig gis tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa longs spyod rdzogs sku kha dog dmar po pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po bye ba'i 'od 'phro cing nyi zla phrag khrig zil gyis gnon pa/ mtshan dpe mchog tu 'bar ba'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i cha lugs can/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung dang phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi mthil na 'chi med ye shes kyi gang ba'i bum pa dpag bsam shing gi kha brgyan can 'dzin pa/ rang 'od kyi yum dang bcas pa'i thugs gar zla ba sen gang ba'i lte bar trī gser zhun lta bu 'od du 'bar ba de las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang sems rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs thams cad gtso bo'i rnam par spyan drangs nas khyod rang la thim pas gnyis su med par mos mdzod/ rtsa sngags dang ye shes dbab pa'i sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha ya a āḥ zhes spos dud rol dbyangs kyis byin dbab/ ye shes dbab pa de nyid byang chub snying po'i bar du brtan par mos mdzod/ rdo rje rgya gram bcas/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye ṭ+wā hāḥ de nas gtor ma thogs la/ 'o brtan g.yo'i dwangs bcud bsdus pa'i thabs shes kyi rdzas la longs spyad pas rtsa rlung thig le'i dwangs ma sgrib bral du smin/ lcags la gser 'gyur gyi rtsis thebs pa ltar rdo rje gsum du brtan par mos shigaḥ r+ghaṃ trīḥ stong gsum srid pa kun gyi bcudaḥ thabs mchog tshe ril shes rab chang ཿ 'chi med tshe yi dam rdzas 'diḥ skal ldan bu la sbyin pa yisaḥ rtsa rlung thig le'i stobs 'phel nasaḥ mchog thun dngos grub kun thob shogaḥ oṃ āḥhūṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī brnyi ā yu ṣe rat+na dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa r+ghaṃḥ zhes sbyin/ de nas dam tshig rnams ci nus su srung snyam pa 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ gtso bo'i ji ltar sogs/ lan gsum/ dbang yongs rdzogs thob pa'i 169

bka' drin gtang rag gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ sa gzhi spos chu'i sogs/ dge ba byang chub tu lhan cig bsngo bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod/ ces pa'ang skyes mchog 'ba' ra ba'i gsung bskul ngor spros med kyi rnal 'byor pa dang 'phrin las rgya che ba'i bla ma rnams kyis tshe dbang byin rlabs byed pa sogs la 'dis kyang phan pa rgya chen ster bar mthong nas rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus bkod pa dge/ /

gag /zhwa chos don ldan legs bshad ces bya ba bzhugs/cod paṇa rin po che snang srid zil gnon gyi yon tan brjod pa srid zhi'i phun tshogs sdud pa'i lcags kyu 'bar pa 'brel tshad rnam grol byin rlabs 'od 'phro dge/ na mo gu ru pad+ma ka rā ye/ thabs shes zung 'jug zla ba'i ma ma las/ /legs 'khrungs sku thugs dbyer med rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'od mtshan stong 'bar dpag bsam dbang po yi/ /'phrin las 'bras bu spyan ras gzigs dbang mchog /de dang mi gnyis snang srid zil gnon sku/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas bde chen gling pa dang / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas karma gsung rab zhabs/ /rigs kyi bdag por bsnyen no dgos 'dod stsol/ /'od dpag med pa kun gzigs zhwa dmar pa/ /thugs rje spyan ras gzigs dbang karma pa/ /dgongs pa dbyer med snang tshul sku tha dad/ /bla slob tshul gyis bskal pa srid du gnas/ /rnam gnyis dbang rtags rā ga'i cod paṇa ni/ /skal ldan skye bo'i dbang po'i spyod yul las/ /tshul mthong byis pa'i mig la mi shar bas/ /mtshon byed dmar nag zhwa yi 'phrin las kyis/ /grangs med gdul byar thar ba'i sa bon bskrun/ /de yang shar phyogs rgya nag 'dul don du/ /rnam gnyis zhabs pad 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i tshe/ /mthong grol dbu zhwa kho bo'i mgor bzhag cing / /smon lam gtad rgya nan tan gnang ba'i mthar/ /dam pa gnyis ka'i byin rlabs thob snang shar/ /skyabs mchog che tshang drug pa gsung rab kyis/ /dag pa'i snang ngor dmar nag gnyis ka'i zhwa/ /kho bo'i gtsug gi rgyan du babs pa dang / de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer kha dog lngas/ /yangs pa'i sa chen khyon kun khyab pa dang / /kar bstan la sdang 'byung po phra mo 'ga'/ /gus pa'i bkar nyan dam la 'dogs pa sogs/ /nges don dar ba'i rten 'brel shar ro gsungs/ /de nas khong gis mnab pa'i dwags zhu yi/ /lcags ri sngon po byas te kho bor gnang / /de nyid dad pa'i rten du mchod pa las/ /mgo la sgron pa'i tho co ngas ma byas/ /nyin zhig rdo rje 'chang chen che tshang pas/ /zhwa de gyon cig rten 'brel cher yod gsungs/ /kho bos deng dus dbu zhwa thob kyi tshul/ /kho bor thob dang dbang thang dgos pa med/ /gu yangs bya bral sprang po phyogs med rgyu/ /bla ma'i ci gnang thams cad byin rlabs yin//zhwa yang kho bo'i byin rten kho nar zhu/ /de skad zhus pas khong gis zhal na re/ /zhwa 'di'i 'jig rten srid dbang mtshon pa min/ /dam chos phyag rdzogs bstan pa dar ba dang / /rgyal ba yab sras rigs bdag byed pa dang / /karma ka yi 'phrin las spel ba mtshon/ /zhes pa'i bka' lung ma 'ongs lung bstan te/ /yab sras gnyis kyi yang srid 'tshol ba sogs/ /lus srog karma'i bstan don la btang ba'i/ /'phrin las 171

sad sud rgyas byed de ru nges/ /de nas bla ma'i bka' ltar dwags zhu nyid/ /phyag chen gdams pa ston dus rgyun du gyon/ /nyin zhig dpal mgon brtse ba chen po'i zhabs/ /ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i nyams snang du/ /zhwa dmar zhwa sgrom zhwa nag lcags ri can/ /yab sras gnyis kyis phyag tu bsnams nas su//'di nyid tshe dbang nor bur sprod gsungs pa'i/ /gsung skad chen po thengs gsum gnang song pas ri lung thams cad 'ur sgras gang song gsung / /de nas da lta'i zhwa khra 'di bzos te/ /mtshan la mkha' 'gro ma yis gnang ba ltar/ /cod paṇa rin chen snang srid zil gnon gsol/ /bka' brgyud bla ma mang pos mgrin gcig tu/ /byin rlabs zhwa dbang lo ltar dgos gsungs ltar/ /bde chen gling pa'i gsang ye'i cho ga la/ /brten nas byin rlabs dmigs pa byed khul bgyis/ /rjes su dpal ldan che tshang zhi dbyings su/ /mnal rjes snga phyir gnang ba'i dbu zhwa gnyis/ /gdung rten nang rten nyid du bzhugs su gsol/ /skye bo thun mong phyag mchod yul du bzhag /de rjes rang gi chos kyi bur gyur pa/ /lnga rig smra ba si tu paṇa chen gyis/ /dag pa'i snang ngor 'chi med lha mchog gnyis/ /dmar nag dbu zhwa bcings shing phebs pa dang / /de gnyis dbu zhwa gcig 'dus bdag gi mgor/ /babs shing skye ba srid du yab sras kyi/ /chos kyi gsang mdzod 'dzin pa nyid 'gyur ces/ /lung bstan dbugs dbyung gsal bor byung ngo gsung / /khong gis phyag sor 'du byed la brten nas/ /zhwa khra gyon pa'i thang ris che chung gsum/ /bris shing nga yis byin rlabs lag rtags phabs/ /gzhan yang rnga sgra'i rgyal po 'brug chen zhabs/ /dpa'— bo mchog dang lo ri sprul pa'i sku/ /'ba' ra chos rje la sogs bka' brgyud pa'i/ /bla ma du mas dag snang gcig mthun dang / /zhwa khra gyon pa'i gsol ba btab pa ltar/ /si tu mchog gis thugs bkod ltar zhwa bzos/ /rjes su kho bo'i snang brnyan phal mo cher/ /cod paṇa de nyid gyon pa byas pa yin/ /de nas zhwa yi bkod pa cung gleng na/ /zhwa snying dmar po mtho dman ran pa 'di/ /kun gzigs zhwa dmar pa yi dbu zhwa yin/ /zhwa 'dab sngon po lcags ri byas pa 'di/ /rgyal ba karma pa yi dbu zhwa yin/ /mdun ngos pad+ma'i 'dab ma bkra ba 'di/ /zhu rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas dbu zhwa yin/ /mdun nang chos 'byung gyen du bstan pa 'di/ /ma rgyud mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi dbu zhwa yin/ /g.yas g.yon pad 'dab yig bcu'i mtshan pa 'di/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yongs kyi dbu zhwa yin/ /nang ma dkar po dri ma med pa 'di/ /ras chung rdo rje grags pa'i dbu zhwa yin/ /rtsa ba gsum gyi gnang pa'i dbu zhwa yin/ /brgyud pa'i byin rlabs chags pa'i dbu zhwa yin//mthong tshad dad pa skye ba'i dbu zhwa yin/ /'brel tshad dge la sbyor ba'i dbu zhwa yin/ /rkyen ngan bar chad sel ba'i dbu zhwa yin/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dbu zhwa yin/ /smon pa'i don kun 'grub pa'i dbu zhwa yin/ /snang srid zil gyis gnon pa'i dbu zhwa yin/ /172

de nas zhwa yi grub tshul cung zad gleng / /zhwa klad zur gsum lnga 'brel yin/ /'brel mtshams btsag kha'i bcad kyis bgo/ /zhwa 'dab zlum po khor ma yin/ /mdzod spu'i mtshams su 'chos 'byung dgod/ /klad dang zhwa 'dab phyi mdog dmar/ /lcags ri sngo nag sne gnyis dang / /ltag pa'i mtshams su chos 'byung mtho/ /gser skud phra mo'i kha chun dgos/ /pad 'dab o rgyan pad zhu 'dra/ /dmar po gser gyi kha chun can/ /nang na chos 'byung dmar ser la/ /'og zur gnyis la nyi zla dang / /rtse mor nā da gser mdog bya/ /zhwa yi nang sha dkar po la/ /klad pa'i mtshams su dgongs 'dus dang / /gsang ye sgrol ma dmar mo dang / /btags grol srung 'khor tshad ldan pa/ /zhwa sha'i rang mdog kho na bya/ /lcags ru'i g.yas g.yon rna gnyis la/ /gser gyi pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i nang / /g.yas su raḥtsaḥtrīḥyaḥdang / /dkyil du hrīḥ'am rgyuḥgis mtshan/ /g.yon du haḥriḥniḥsaḥdang / /lte bar maḥ'am baṃḥgyis mtshan/ /che chung 'tshams la mdzes par bya/ /ma byung dmigs pa byas kyang chog /zhwa 'di mchod dang bzos pas kyang / /byin rlabs dbyar mtsho ltar du 'phel/ /de nas zhwa yi mtshon don bshad/ kha dog gcig pu la mtshon na/ /dkar po chos sku dri ma med/ /ye nas skyon gyis ma gos pa/ /sngon po longs sku lhun gyis grub/ /rgyan gyi nam mkha' ji bzhin du/ /nges pa lnga ldan kun la khyab/ /'dod 'byung yon tan ma lus ldan/ /dmar po sprul sku thugs rje che/ /chags pa bral yang 'gro la chags/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis 'gro don byed/ /bsam mi khyab pa'i 'phrin las mnga'/ /btsag kha snying po 'dus pa ste/ /dper na srog gi dwangs khrag bzhin/ /las ldan brgyud pa 'dzin nus pa/ /kho na'i zhwa 'di spyod pa yin/ /gser mdog ston pa'i bstan pa ste/ /gser sbyang btso ma ji bzhin du/ /skyon bral yon tan phun tshogs pa'i/ /mdo sngags yun du gnas pa'o/ /li khri bde ba chen po ste/ /gnas skabs dang ni mthar thug gi/ /zag dang zag pa bral ba'i bder/ /'gro ba thams cad 'god pa'o/ /dbyibs kyi sgo nas bshad pa na/ /dbus ni ri bo mchog rab la/ /lcags ri de rang mtshon pa dang //pad+ma bskal pa bzang po mtshon/ /chos 'byung nyi zla nā da can/ /mdo sngags bstan pa mtshon pa'o/ /mdor na phyi nang 'khor 'das chos/ /phyi dbyibs gcig gi mtshon nus so/ /gzhan yang zhwa yi phyi nang gi/ /bshad pa rgya che don 'dril na/ /phyi ltar zhwa yi kha dog drug /'gro drug 'dren pa'i skyes bu yi/ /dpal du shar zhing gdul bya kun/ /dman dang log par mi ltung bar/ /thar ba'i lam la 'jug pa mtshon/ /nang ltar phyin drug spyod pa yis/ /theg chen sa lam myur du bsgrod/ /ji srid 'khor ba ma stong bar/ /de srid 'gro don byed pa mtshon/ /gsang ba khams drug dag pa ste/ /bskyed dang rdzogs rim gdams pa yis/ khams drug sbyangs pa'i yon tan brgyad/ /thob cing rdzu 'phrul 173

ya zung bcas/ /zung 'jug rgyal sar bsnyegs gyur mtshon/ /yang gsang ye shes rnam pa drug /'khor 'das kun gyi rtsa ba ste/ /de nyid mthong bas srid zhi la/ /mi gnas sgrib bral chos kyi sku/ /tshe 'di nyid la thob pa mtshon/ /zhwa yi klad par mtshon don lnga/ /ling tshe lnga ru bgos pa ni/ /phyi ltar 'byung ba rnam lnga dang/ /nang ltar rgyal ba rigs lnga dang / /gsang ba mkha' 'gro sde lnga dang / /yang gsang dbyings phyug rtsa lnga mtshon/ /de bzhin btsag kha'i bcad de nyid/ /rtsa gnas drwa ba mtshon pa'o/ /zhwa 'dab 'di la mtshon don lnga/ /zlum por yongs su 'khyil ba ni/ /phyi ltar 'dod don yongs su 'grub/ /nang ltar mdo sngags chos kun mkhyen/ /gsang ba sdom gsum nyams chags bral/ /yang gsang smin mtshams chos 'byung gis/ /lugs 'byung 'khrul pa'i 'gro kun skyobs/ /kho na nyid du don dam pa/ /chos kun theg le gcig tu bzlum/ /zhwa yi lcags rir mtshon don drug /phyi lta sbyin pa'i gter mdzod yin/ /nang ltar tshul khrims lcags ri yin/ /gsang ba bzod pa'i go cha yin/ /yang gsang brtson 'grus gshog zung yin/ /nying gsang bsam gtan mkhar rdzong yin/ /kho na nyid du phyi'i chos 'byung / /lugs ldog myang 'das shes rab gri/ /zhwa yi pad 'dab mtshon don lnga/ /phyi ltar skyon dang bral ba mtshon/ /nang ltar rigs bdag pad 'byung mtshon/ /gsang ba snying rje rgyas pa mtshon/ /yang gsang shes rab dri med mtshon/ /kho na nyid du rang gi sems/ /sgrib gnyis 'dam gyis ma gos pa'o/ /zhwa pad chos 'byung mtshon don lnga/ /phyi ltar khams gsum thugs rjes 'dzin/ /nang ltar mchog gsum gtsug tu bkur/ /gsang ba sku gsum lam du khyer/ /yang gsang rnam thar gsum ldan mkha'/ /kho na nyid gzhi gnas kyi/ /ye shes rnam gsum mngon du gyur/ /mdor na bka' rnying sngags bstan dang / /grub thob kun gyi dgongs pa dang / /rdzogs rim gdams pa'i che ba kun/ /chos 'byung thabs shes nyi zla can/ /nā das brgyan pa 'di nyid la/ /ma 'dus pa zhig yod ma yin/ /des na 'di yi yon tan nyid/ /brjod na glegs bam chen por 'gyur/ /re zhig snying por dril ba na/ /de kas shes la de kas chog /g.yas g.yon pad+ma 'dab bzhi la/ /snying po 'bru bcus mtshan pa yi/ /bshad pa mkha' 'gro las rgyud sogs/ /ma rgyud nas na ches gsal bas/ /ma 'ongs skal ldan slob bu yi/ /chos skal gyur phyir ma brjod do/ / zhwa yi phan yon legs brjod na/ /rigs bdag 'od dpag med pad 'byung / /rgyal ba karma zhwa dmar nag /dpal ldan brtse chen zur mang pa/ /kun gyis thugs smon zab mo yod/ /des na de dag byin rlabs kyang / /thob la the tshom bya mi dgos/ /dad pa can la dgos dgu 'byung / /ngas kyang smon lam 'di bzhin btab/ /'grub par rgyal ba rnga sgra ba/ /kun mkhyen si tus thugs smon gnang / /khyad 174

par rtsa gsum srung ma yis/ /bden tshig rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs bsgrags/ /zhwa 'di gyon nas slob 'bangs kun/ /las smon lam tshig 'brel gyur na/ /rgyal bstan dar zhing bstan 'dzin gyi/ /thugs smon ma lus 'grub pa yin/ /khyad par pad+ma'i ring lugs dang / /karma pa yi 'phrin las rgyas/ /phyi snod 'byung ba'i phya g.yang gso/ /nang bcud skye 'gror bde skyid 'byung / /sdig can rnams la 'gyod pa skye/ /gdug pa can gyi bsam ngan zhi/ /dkor zan rnams kyi sgrib pa dag /lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du 'du/ /nad mug 'khrugs rtsod zhi ba dang / /dpal dang 'byor ba phun sum tshogs/ /bar chad rkyen ngan grogs su 'gyur/ /rtsa rgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug /yi dam lha yis dngos grub ster/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin bzhin 'du/ /chos skyong srung mas 'phrin las sgrub/ /thams cad rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod/ /tshe 'dir dge ba'i sa bon thebs/ /phyi ma byang chub lam la 'gro/ /tshe rabs kun tu nga'i gdul byar/ /gyur nas ring bor mi thogs par/ /nam snying pad 'byung thugs klong du/ /dbyer med 'tshang rgya'i rten 'brel 'grigs/ /nyin mtshan bkra shis dge mtshan 'bar/ /de skad brjod pa'i smon lam kun/ /'grub par rgyal bas lung bstan yod/ /skal ba ldan gyur dga' bar gyis/ /'di bris dge ba'ang nam mkha' nyid/ /ji srid bar du 'gro ba'i don/ /mdzad cing sems can ma lus pa/ /gtan bde sangs rgyas sa 'god shog /ces pa'ang rgyal ba yab sras kyang thugs kyi sras dang chos kyi bur gyur ba'i rnal 'byor pa tshe dbang nor bu karma theg mchog bstan pa gsal byed du 'bod pas 'og min mtshur gyi gasdo lar bris pa'o/ /zhwa brngo tshul/ zhwa klad zur gsum lnga 'brel dgos/ /'brel mtshams btsag kha'i bcad kyi bgo dgos/ /zhwa 'dab zlum po khor ma yin/ /mdzod spu'i mtshams su chos 'byung dgod/ /klad dang zhwa 'dab phyi mdog dmar/ /lcags ri sngo nag sne gnyis dang / /ltag pa'i mtshams su chos 'byung mtho/ /gser skud phra mo'i kha chun dgos/ /pad 'dab o rgyan pad zhu 'dra/ /dmar po gser gyi kha chun can/ /nang na chos 'byung dmar ser la/ /'og zur gnyis la nyi zla dang / /rtse mor nā da gser mdog bya/ /zhwa yi nang sha dkar po la/ /klad pa'i mtshams su dgongs 'dus dang / /gsang ye sgrol ma dmar mo dang / /btags grol srung 'khor tshad ldan pa/ /zhwa sha'i rang mdog kho na bya/ /lcags ra'i g.yas g.yon rna gnyis la/ /gser gyi pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i nang / /g.yas su raḥtsaḥtrīḥyaḥdang / /dkyil du hrīḥ'am hūṃḥgis mtshan/g.yon du haḥriḥniḥsaḥdang / lte bar maḥ'amaḥbaṃḥgyis mtshan/ /che chung mtshams la mdzes par bya ma byung dmigs pa byas kyang chog /zhwa 'di mchod dang bzos pas kyang / /byin rlabs dbyar mtsho ltar du 'phel /175

yi ge 'god tshul/ g.yas su raḥtsaḥtrīḥyaḥbazhi g.yas skor dang de'i dkyil du trīḥ'am hūṃḥyig dgos/ /g.yon du haḥriḥniḥsaḥbazhi dang de'i lte bar maḥ'am baṃḥyig dgos so/ /de yang lañtsa dang bod yig gang rung ngo / /bkra shis/ /rtsa rlung thig le'i gdams pa snyan brgyud yig med kyi don brgyud gsol 'debs bde chen rang 'bar bzhugs/ oṃ ā r+ghaṃḥspros bral dbyings rig snang mtha' gos dkar mo/ /bde stong zung 'jug rta mchog rdo rje phag /zag med 'ja' sku pad 'byung mtsho rgyal ma/ /gsol ba 'debs so smin grol byin dbang stsol/ /brtul zhugs grub gtso maṅga a yu'i zhabs/ /zang thal spyod pa'i mnga' bdag gter bzhad snying / /rim gnyis mchog brnyes pad+ma ma ṇi'i mtshan/ /gsol ba 'debs so smin grol byin dbang stsol/ /chos kun ro snyoms pad+ma bde chen gling / /zab gsang mdzod 'dzin bi bhu ti shrī/ /bka' drin mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so smin grol byin dbang stsol/ /zab gsang brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam lha/ /mkha' 'gro srung mar bcas la gsol btab mthus/ /dbang bzhi'i chu bo'i bdag rgyud rab tu smin / /bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug thabs lam pho nya yis/ /zag bral bde ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dmigs med chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen po'i/ /go 'phang mchog la tshe 'di nyid 'khod de/ /'ja' lus 'od gsal rdo rje'i sku brnyes shog /ces gtsang snye mo'i sgrub chen kun bzang nyi mas bskul ngor rang bzhin rnal 'byor gyi gzugs 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu gar dbang 'gro 'dul gyis gtsang ru shangs kyi stag sta cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes nyer drug la bkod pa'i yig ris o rgyan blo gros dbang po'o/ /

༄ga /rdzogs rim rtsa rlung thig le'i man ngag gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i thugs rje kun la khyab pa'i 'od zer gsang chen bcud kyi thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /ma hā shrī he ru ka na ma/ 'khor 'das kun khyab bde chen btsun mo'i mkhar/ /sna tshogs sgyu 'phrul rol ba'i sprin 'phro ba/ /bde ba chen po pad+ma badz+ra gyis/ /zag med bdud rtsi'i gru char dbyings nas phobs/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i thugs rje nyi ma'i 'od/ /srid gsum khyab par spros pa'i thabs kyi lam/ /shin tu gsang ba chen po'i man ngag gis/ /zag med rdo rje'i sku mchog brnyes rnams mchod/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug bdud 'dul nus ldan gling / /grub pa'i khyu mchog klong gsal snying po'i zhabs/ /rnam par snang mdzad bde chen gling pa sogs/ /ma rgyud gdams pa'i gter mdzod che rnams rgyal/ /tshe gcig mkha' spyod go 'phang mngon gyur pa'i/ /rdzogs rim bka' babs kun bzang rin chen dang / /bdag blo gdams pa'i gter du bsgrub mdzad pa'i/ /drin can bla ma byang chub bar du mchod/ /yang phur rdzogs rim bdud rtsi'i btung ba dang / /bde mchog dus 'khor man ngag ro brgya'i zas/ /gter chen rnam gsum thugs kyis rgyas btab pa/ /kho bo'i dad dam gser gyi snod du 'khyil/ /dpag med rgyud sde 'dod 'byung chu gter che/ /bla ma'i man ngag thur mas dkrugs pa las/ /byin rlabs lang tsho rdzogs pa'i 'od dkar can/ /mthong nas mun sel gdams zab 'gyed kyis nyon/ /sngon 'gro/ skye ba gtan gyi legs nyes ni/ /dam pa'i chos la rags las pas/ /nges par 'byung ba'i blos bskul nas/ /mchog gsum skyabs 'gro chos kyi mgo/ /bla ma mtshan ldan 'tshol ba dang / /rang nyid slob ma dam ldan du/ /bsgrub nas bsam sbyor chos mthun gyis/ /tshul bzhin bsten pa gnad du che/ /de yang blo ldog rnam pa bzhis/ /'khor ba'i rdzun rkub ma phud na/ /yon tan bdud du sdang nye bas/ /spyod pa theg pa dman dang bstun/ /gzhan phan byang chub sems med na/ /lha sgrub 'dre ru gyur dogs pas/ /bdag gzhan mnyam par brje ba sogs/ /go yul tsam min rgyun du sbyongs/ /so thar dang ni byang chub sems/ /gsang ba sngags kyi sdom pa ste/ /'di dang bral na dngos grub nyid/ /mi 'byung nges pas rtag tu srungs/ /gsang bsngags la zhugs pa nas/ /sgrub gnas grogs dang thabs bzang pos/ /phyi nang rten 'brel 'du byas te/ /skabs babs zab chos tshul bzhin sgrubs/ /sngags kyi khyad chos/ /theg chen yon tan rgya mtsho dang / /theg pa chung ngu ba rjes chu/ /mdo dang 177

sngags kyi khyad par yang / /dpe des gzhal nas shes par bya/ /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / /myur la 'bras bu lam du byed/ /shes rab can dang dad pa brtan/ /gnyis ka tshe 'dir grol byed chos/ /gsang ba sngags la ma brten par/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi thob pa/ /mdo rgyud kun nas gsung bas phyir/ /'di la mi 'jug blo ldan min/ /sngon 'gro blo sbyong gzhi brtan tshe/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa la brten nas/ /snod bcud ma dag snang ba'i cha/ /sbyangs shing rdzogs pa'i rim par 'jug /rdzogs rim khyad chos/ 'di ltar chos rnams thams cad ni/ gdod nas 'khor 'das dbyer med par/ /bden gnyis zung 'jug yongs grub zhal/ /rdzogs rim bde stong lhun grub yin/ /chags bral dag la rang lus dang / /chags ldan rnams la gzhan lus te/ /nyon mongs ma spang lam khyer thabs/ /gsang ba sngags las gzhan du med/ /dbang rab skad cig gcig gi cha/ /gzhan rnams zla ba'am lo gsum nang / /dbu ma'i rtsa mdud kun grol nas/ /sa bcur slebs 'di e ma rmad/ /lus grub tshul/ /rdo rje phung po'i grong khyer nyid/ /ci ltar bzhugs tshul la rmongs na/ /sa lam yon tan thams cad ni/ /dmus long la ni gzugs ston 'dra/ /de phyir rgyud las 'di skad gsungs/ /pha dang ma yi rgyu rkyen las/ /mer mer po dang nur nur po/ /ltar ltar po gang gor gor po/ /mkhrang 'gyur nyid dang nya lta bu/ /rus sbal bzhin dang sbal ba bzhin/ /rim bzhin zhag ni bdun phrag rer/ /lte ba nas ni rim bzhin grub/ /phal cher zla dgu ngo bcu nas/ /lus rdzogs ma yi mngal nas thon/ /rtsa dang rlung dang thig le gsum/ /lus dang lhan cig nyid du grub/ /de bzhin yon tan cha rnams kyang / /sbas pa'i tshul gyis lus la gnas/ /nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus su yang / /snang mched thob pa'i rim pa dang / /bar do bzhi yi 'char tshul sogs/ /kun kyang rlung sems byed las nyid/ /phyi nang gi dag pa/ phyi nang dag pa sbyar ba'i tshul/ /cha shas tsam zhig 'dir brjod na/ /mdo dang rgyud sde du ma nas/ /phyi rol ci bzhin nang de bzhin/ /nang bzhin phyi rol snang ba ste/ /dag pa sbyor tshul mang du gsungs/ /khyad par dpal ldan dus 'khor lor/ /'jig rten phyi dang nang bcud lus/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rang bzhin gzhan/ /gzhan las zhib pa'i tshul du bshad/ /srid pa thog mar grub pa ni/ /lte ba'i rtsa 'khor las byung phyir/ /lte ba'i bar 'dab rtsa 'khor gang / /bcu gnyis khyim dang dus sbyor ba/ /rtsa ba'i 'khor lo nyid dang ni/ /phyi rol rgyu ba'i rtsa drug cu/ /lo rgan drug cu tham pa nyid/ /'byung ba lnga yis lus bskyed phyir/ /shing me chu lcags phyogs rim yang / /dus 'khor shar rlung lho me dang / /byang chu nub phyogs sa yi khams/ /dbus kyi sa yang dus 'khor las/ /ri rab nyid de nam mkha'i khams/ /kun la khyab pa'i bdag nyid can/ khams drug ldan pa rdo rje'i lus/ /dbu ma dag pa ye shes 178

khams/ /rtsa kun la ni rnam par khyab/ /phyi rol mkha' yang de bzhin te/ /a wa dhu ti dung can ma/ /sgra gnyan dus me ma ning khams/ /ro ma dang ni rkyang ma gang / /dkar dmar thig le 'dzin byed rtsa/ /nyi ma zla ba thabs shes rab/ /der brten rtsa ba'i 'khor lo drug /'byung lnga ye shes khams dang drug /gtsug tor la ni rtsa 'dab bzhi/ /thun mtshams bzhi yi rnam par mtshon/ /dpral bar rtsa yi 'dab bcu drug /tshes grangs bco lnga ye shes bcas/ /mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab sum cu gnyis/ /rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / /ye shes cha las dbyu gu bzhi/ /snying gar rtsa 'dab rnam pa brgyad/ /thun brgyad dang ni gza' ched brgyad//lte bar rtsa 'dab drug cu bzhi/ /dbyu gu drug cu stong ba bzhi/ /dus sbyor la sogs gong bzhin bstan/ /gsang ba'i rtsa 'dab so gnyis par/ /dkar dmar bcu drug phyogs so gnyis/ /yan lag tshig chen 'khor lo gang / /bcu gnyis zla ba nyid du mtshon/ /nying lag tshig 'khor drug cu de/ /zhag gcig gi ni dbyu gu dang / /re rer 'dab ma drug ldan pa/ /sum brgya drug cu dbyu gu dbugs/ /phyi rol ci bzhin nang du'o/ /mchog tu thig le 'khor 'das srog /srid dang zhi ba myang 'das kun/ /kun rdzob dang ni don dam gyi/ /byang chub sems kyi 'phrul las grub/ /de yang kun rdzob rgyu'i thig le/ /chu dang me khams dkar dmar gyi/ /dwangs ma spyi thig e waṃ dang / /a haṃ phyi rol nyi zla yin/ /phra rags rlung dang 'dus pa'i khams/ /sgra gcan dus me thig le nyid/ /sna tshogs la ni thig le khams/ /sna tshogs rgyu ba rgyu skar tshogs/ /dkar dmar 'phel 'grib rol ba las/ /dkar dmar lho byang phyogs bsgrod pa/ /dbyar dgun ston dpyid tsha grang sogs/ /rnam pa du ma ston par byed/ /khu rdul rlung gsum dbu ma ru/ /yongs 'jug gnas mthun skabs yod bzhin/ /khams drug dus tshigs zla drug mthar/ /zla nyi la ni sgra gcan 'jug /mdor na snod bcud chags 'jig dus/ /'phrel 'grib bde dang sdug bsngal ba/ /legs nyes mtha' dag thig le yi/ /byed las nyid du rgyal bas gsungs/ /khyad par du ni rlung gi las/ /mtha' dag stobs dang ldan pa ste/ /rtsa dang thig le'i byed pa yang / /ma lus par ni rlung gis byed/ /des na de kun bdag po yang / /rlung nyid du ni rab tu gnas/ /g.yas na rgyu ba'i dkyil 'khor lnga/ /drag gza' lnga yi rang bzhin dang / /g.yon na rgyu ba'i dkyil 'khor lnga/ /zhi gza' lnga yi rang bzhin can/ /srog thur gnyis ni nyi zla dang / /gza' rnams rgyu ba'i khyim tshogs kyang / /lte ba'i g.yas g.yon rtsa 'dab ma/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi pad+ma'i tshul/ /'dab bzhi lte lnga khyon drug cu/ /'dab ma lte ba las 'pho chung / /lnga ste bsdoms pa'i 'pho chen gcig /de yi dus sbyor gcig de yang / /g.yon gnyis mnyam dang mi mnyam las/ /sngar bshad bzhin de de las khyim/ /zhag dang zla ba lo la sogs/ /phyi 179

rol dus kyi bya ba bzhin/ /rlung khams bsgrod pa nyid las grub/ /srid gsum skye 'jig 'khor 'das chos/ /kun kyang rlung gi mthu las so/ /spyi bshad pa/ gdan bzhi dus 'khor dgos don bzhin/ /dam pa'i zhal gdams zab mo ni/ /skyes bu dar la babs pa'i dbugs/ /nyin zhag gcig la rgyu ba'i grangs/ /phyi rol rags rtsis lo gcig gi/ /chu tshod tshad du 'gyur ba yin/ /kun gyi rtsa ba ye shes rlung / /sna nas rgyu ba'i dbugs gcig la/ /dum bu sum cu so gnyis dbye/ /de yi cha gcig ye shes rlung / /zhag gcig la ni ye shes rlung / /drug brgya bdun cu rtsa lnga ste/ /de ni zhag gcig dbugs kyi grangs/ /nyi khri chig stong drug brgya nyid/ /dum bu sum cu so gnyis su/ /bgos pa'i thob nor nyid dang mtshungs/ /'di la rnam bzhag mang yod kyang / /mang thos nyams myong ldan pa'i yul/ /las dang po yi gnas skabs su/ /lag len gnad du 'khel ba gtso/ /dus sbyor phyi nang sbyar ba'i tshul/ /rgyud rgyal rdo rje phreng ba dang / /dgongs pa lung du ston pa dang / /sdom 'byung la sogs rgyud sde nas/ /nang gi rnal 'byor mtshon pa'i phyir/ /'pho ba zhes pa brda yis/ /de yang 'pho chen nyi shu bzhi/ /nyin mtshan mo mnyam pa'i dus/ /nyin mo bcu gnyis mtshan bcu gnyis/ /'pho chen re la dbugs kyi grangs/ /brgya phrag dgu re rgyu ba yin/ /de la 'pho chung bzhi ru dbye/ /nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dbugs/ /'pho chen re la mgon po re/ /nyin gsum lan gsum nyid du 'khor/ /mgon po bzhi yi g.yas dang g.yon/ /mnyam 'gyur rtsub dang 'jam po'i srog /rim bzhin pad+ma mgon po dang / /las dang rin chen rdo rje mgon/ /'pho chung lha mo bzhi yi rlung / /steng ngos mkhur tshos sna dbus mchu/ /rgyu rim gos dkar sgrol ma dang / /spyan ma bdag mo nyid du gsungs/ /'pho chen nyer bzhi 'pho chung ni/ /dgu bcu drug tu dbye ba ste/ /de nyid nyin zhag phrug gcig tshad/ /nyi khri chig stong drug brgya srog /de ltar 'dus sogs dgongs pa dang / /rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i man ngag las/ /yul chen nyer bzhi'i rtsa dang rlung / /'pho chen nyer bzhi nyid dang sbyor/ /de yang 'pho chen re re la/ /dbang dang longs spyod 'jug pa gsum/ /cig char nyid du 'char ba ste/ de ltar 'pho ba'i rnam grangs ni/ /du ma gsungs pa shes slad du/ /skabs 'dir cung zad 'phros pa ste/ /dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo las/ phyi nang gzhan gsum mnyam sbyor phyir/ /dus sbyor bcu gnyis phyir rol du/ /mkha' la bcu gnyis khyim 'khor lo/ /nyin zhag gcig dang 'char nub dbang / /sa la dus kyi sbyor bar 'gyur/ /khyim gyi gnas lugs nges pa yis/ /nyi ma gang la nges pa'i khyim/ /des drangs lag na zhes dus sbyor/ /bcu gnyis tāṅgāl rim pa 'byung / /de yang lug 'khrigs seng srang gzhu/ /bum pa mi mnyam dus sbyor drug /sna bug g.yon na rgyu ba'i rlung / /dbus steng sna gshog sna yi 'og /rgyu ba'i dkyil 'khor lnga bskyed rim/ /180

mkha' rlung me chu sa rim pa/ /de la 'char gza' sgra gcan dang / /lhag pa pa sangs ke tu yin/ /glang po bu mo sdig chu srin/ /nya ni mnyam pa'i dus sbyor te/ /sna bug g.yas na rgyu ba'i rlung / /'og dang sna 'gram sna steng dbugs/ /rgyu ba'i dkyil 'khor lnga bsdud rim/ /sa chu me rlung nam mkha' ste/ /de la 'char gza' spen phur bu/ /mig dmar nyi ma dus me'o/ /gzhan yang dus sbyor mtshan nyid ni/ /g.yo dang brtan dang mnyam pa ni/ /lug dang kar+ha srang chu srin/ /g.yo ba bzhi yin brtan pa ni/ /glang dang seṅge sdig pa bum/ /gnyis mnyam bzhi ni 2khrig bu mo/ /gzhu dang nya ru kun tu grags/ /de ltar yongs su shes byas nas/ /phyi ru nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i dus/ /dus sbyor nyin drug mtshan drug ste/ /dus sbyor de yi yun tshad ni/ /rags pa dbyu gu lnga lnga yin/ /dus sbyor re la 'pho chen re/ /mnyam ste dbugs stong brgyad brgyar 'gyur/ /dbyu gu 'pho chung tshad du rdzogs/ /des na sum brgya drug cur nges/ /da dung cung zad gsal bshad na/ /mkha' la khyim gang 'char ba'i dus/ /de srid de yi dus sbyor yin/ /khyim re la ni rkang ba dgu/ /skar ma bzhi la rkang pa gcig /rkang re 'char yun dbugs nyis brgya/ /des na bar skar gcig rdzogs yun/ /rags rtsis dbugs ni brgya phrag brgyad/ /de ltar 'phel 'grib med 'char yang /nyin mtshan ring thung bzhed pa mang / /zhib tu brtsi tshul gzhan las shes/ /'on kyang rgyud las srang tshad skabs/ /nyin mtshan ring po'i mthur rag dus/ /chad lhag med par dus sbyor drug /gsal bar bzhag nyid nges par bya/ /rten 'brel/ rlung gi 'pho ba'i cha bcu gnyis/ /rten 'brel nyid dang 'grog pa'i tshul/ /rten 'brel rnam pa bcu gnyis ni/ /ma rig 'du byed rnam par shes/ /ming gzugs skye mched reg pa dang / /tshor ba sred pa len pa dang / /srid pa skye ba rga shi'o/ /'di ltar lugs 'byung 'khor ba'i chos/ /lugs las ldog pa myang 'das so/ /de nyid phyi rol lo zla zhag /dus te rnam la sbyor ba ste/ /lo ni ma rig byi ba dang / /'du byed glang dang rnam shes stag /ming gzugs yos la skye mched 'brug /sbrul reg rta tshor lug sred pa/ /spre'u len pa bya srid pa/ /skye ba khyi la rga shi phag /7zla bar rten 'brel 'char tshul ni/ /rgyal zla ma rig chu srin khyim/ /mchu zla 'du byed bum pa'i khyim/ /de ltar lugs 'byung tshu du sbyar/ /7'dir ni zhag la spyod pa'i tshul/ /chu srin nya glang dang sbal ba/ /bu mo la sogs mnyam zla drug /mnyam la yang ngo g.yon skye ba/ /lugs 'byung spro ba srid rten 'brel/ /mar ngo g.yas pa 'chi ba ste/ /lugs ldog bsdud pa bzhi rten 'brel/ /bum lug 'khrig dang seṅge dang / /srang gzhu la sogs mi mnyam drug /mnyam pa nyid las go ldog go/ /de yang mnyam pa dper bkod na/ /yar ngo lugs 'byung mar ngo ldog /rgyal zla'i tshes gcig ma rig pa/ /gnyis pa 'du byed sogs rim bzhin/ /bcu gsum bcu bzhi bco lnga la/ /rang 181

gi tshes gsum bzhi lnga la/ /'char ba'i rten 'brel ci bzhin bkod/ /dmar phyogs ma rig rga shi nas/ /lugs ldog lhag ma sngar bzhin bskang / /skabs rer yar ngo zhag lhag ste/ /bcu drug byung tshe reg pa bsnan/ /chad nas bcu bzhir song ba na/ /bco lnga bton shul reg pa sbyor/ /mi mnyam mchu zla dper bkod na/ /yar mar tshes gcig 'du byed de/ /yar ngo lugs ldog mar lugs 'byung / /yar ngo'i tshes gnyis ma rig pa/ /gsum pa rga shi rim bzhin sbyar/ /mar ngo'i tshes gnyis rnam shes te/ /gsum la ming gzugs sogs rim bzhin/ /chad lhag dkar phyogs ma rig pa/ /dmar phyogs la ni tshor ba sbyor/ /mdor na chad lhag bskang pa'i tshul/ /tshes grangs drug pa'i rten 'brel yin/ /7dus kyi rten 'brel dus sbyor ni/ /tāt+pāl gang la bab pa yi/ /de de'i dus sbyor 'char ba ste/ /chu srin ma rig sbyar bas shes/ /chos rnams rten cing 'brel 'byung phyir/ /nang 'byung dang ni phyi'i 'jig rten/ /gdod nas ngo bo gcig nyid du/ /rtogs pa'i skyes bu skal ba bzang / /ma rig rlung sems byed las kyis/ /'khrul zhing ci ltar grol ba'i tshul/ /rten 'brel shes la rag las pas/ /mdo sngags gcig tu dril bar mdzod/ /rnal 'byor rtsa thig rlung gsum gyi/ /nyams len gnad du bsnun shes na/ /lus ldog rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyis/ /mngon sangs rgya la the tshom med/ /rtsa yi gtso bo rnam pa gsum bshad pa/ /dbu ma lus dbus khang stong ka ltar gnas/ /gang du ma yo pas na dbu ma dang / /bde ba kun bskyed kun dar ma yang zer/ /'di ni kun rdzob ltar na phra ba'i rtsa/ /rtsa rnams gyes pa'i ma mo dngos yin kyang / /don du bsgom pa las byung ye shes rtsa/ kha dog dbyibs sogs rten 'brel stob kyis bzhag /lte ba las skyes yar sna gsum du gyes/ /dbu ma tshangs bug rtse g.yas rna der zug /yal ka phra gnyis sna bug so sor gyes/ /rtse g.yon phyogs de'i nang du gnas pa'o/ /mar sna phra ba gsang ba'i gnas su 'phyangs/ /de la mdud pa bzhi'am nyer gcig ste/ /lte bar lus bskyed thig le dkar cha dang / /snying gar dran pa 'gyu byed dmar cha dang / /mgrin par 'byed byed rlung gi thig le dang / /spyi bor snang ba 'od kyi thig le sogs/ /ma dag gnas skabs mdud pa'i sbubs su 'thum/ /dag tshe stobs rgyas blo gsal gzi mdangs 'phel/ /ro ma skyes pa rnams la g.yas nas 'byung / /bde ba kun gyi ro bcud 'dzin pa dang / /'dod chags las gyur thabs kyi rang bzhin can/ /gtems pas zas mchog bzhin tu ro mchog myong / /rkyang ma snying gi rtse nas g.yon tu thon/ /gzhan dang mi 'brel ring bur gnas pa'i rtse/ /mig g.yon la zug rtog bral nyams bskyed phyir/ /zhe sdang las gyur shes rab ye shes mtshon/ / rtsa gsum rgyud du thabs grol khyad par gyis/ /'khor lo bdun drug lnga 'am bzhir grags te/ /nyon 182

mongs dag dang ye shes 'phel ba'i cha/ /phri snan sna tshogs sbyang gzhi sbyong byed tshul/ /lte ba'i rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi las/ /nyon mongs dang ni ye shes 'char ba'i rtsa/ /rnam par gyes pa sum brgya rtsa brgyad de/ /dbye na nyis stong bzhi brgya so gnyis yod/ /snying gar rtsa ba'i 'dab ma rnam brgyad kyi/ /shes rab 'od rtsa dang ni nyon mongs rtsa/ /rnam par gyes pa sum cu rtsa brgyad de/ /dbye na rtsa phran stong dang dgu brgya yod/ /mgrin par rtsa ba'i 'dab ma bcu drug gi /rig pa shes rab dang ni nyon mongs rtsa/ /rnam par gyes pa sum brgya bzhi bcu dang / /de las dpag med 'khor lo kun tu 'brel/ /spyi bor rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi/ /ye shes 'char ba'i sgo dang nyon mongs rtsa/ /rnam par gyes pa sum brgya drug cu dang / /de las nyis stong dgu sogs grangs med gyes/ /khyad par gzhan lus myur bde pho nya'i lam/ /bde stong zung 'jug ye shes bskyed pa'i gnas/ /gsang ba'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab nyer brgyad las/ /rnam par gyes pa bdun cu rtsa gnyis yod/ /'di la rigs dang pho mo'i khyad par gyi/ /thabs lam dbu ma'i mar sna phra ba'i rtsa/ /lam du byed pa brgyud pa'i man ngag las/ /'dod chen kun gyis rang dgar spyod nus min/ /de nas rlung gi gnas tshul bshad pa ni/ /rtsa ba'i rlung lnga yan lag rlung lnga dang / /nyi khri chig stong rgyu ba drug brgya'i rlung / /mang du gsungs kyang gtso bor rlung bcur 'du/ /de yang rtsa ba yan lag gnyis phyes pa'i/ /srog 'dzin rnam shes chu khams snying la rgyu/ /dkar po mi bskyod ngo bo dbyibs zla gam/ /srog gi rten byed yid kyi dbang po chags/ /gyen rgyu 'du shes me khams mgrin par gnas/ /dmar po snang mtha'i ngo bo dbyibs grub gsum/ /dbugs kyi rten byed smra brjod bya ba gang / /phyi nang 'byung ba gcig tu 'dres par byed/ /thur thel tshor phung sa khams 'dom la gnas/ /ser po rin 'byung ngo bo dbyibs gru bzhi/ /'gro 'dug dri chu dri chen 'dor byed cing / /thig le dkar dmar 'beb dang 'dren par byed//mnyam gnas 'du byed rlung khams lte bar gnas/ /ljang ser don grub ngo bo gzhu yi dbyibs/ /lus la drod 'bebs grang pa'i nad kun sel/ /zas skom bzhu zhing gtum mo 'dren par byed/ /khyab byed gzugs phung mkha' khams lus kun khyab/ /sngon po rnam snang ngo bo dbyibs bzlum po/ /dga' sdug nyams brtas 'chi ba'i tshe na rgyu/ /de ltar rlung lngar dbang bas sku lnga thob/ /srog 'dzin dbang po lnga ru rgyu ba yi/ /yan lag lnga yi rlung gi bzhugs tshul ni/ /rgyu ma klu sbrul 'khyil 'dra gnas pa'i rlung / /gdug pa'i nad sel mig shes gzugs dang sprod/ /mchin pa rus sbal dbyibs la gnas pa'i rlung / /yan lag brkyang bskum rna shes sgra dang sprod/ /glo ba rtsang pa lta bur gnas pa'i rlung / /g.yal 'dar chags bskyed lce shes dri dang sprod/ /mkhal ma gzhu dbyibs lta bur gnas pa'i rlung / /srog 'dzin sbrid pa lus dang 183

rig bya sprod/ /rlung gi byed las dang ni 'pho ba'i cha/ /rgyud don rin chen gter gyi mdzod chen po/ /dam pa'i zhal dang rgyas 'grel la ltos phyir/ /dpe thog bro brdung tsam la ma re 'ig / thig le'i rim pa rnam pa mang mod kyang / /gtso bo mtshan bcas rdzas kyi thig le dang / /mtshan med lhun grub 'od gsal thig le gnyis/ /gsung ba'i dang po thabs kyi lam 'di bstan/ /thabs lam rtsa ba thig le'i bzhugs tshul ni/ /spyi bo dkar cha thabs kyi thig le dang / /lte bar dmar cha shes rab thig le yod/ /rtsa ba 'od gsal spros bral thig le dang / /'khrul ba kun btags ma rig thig le dang / khams lnga 'dus pa rdzas kyi thig le gsum/ /gsung pa'i phyi ma mtshan bcas dzogs pa'i lam/ /de yang thig le gnad du bsnun pa'i tshul/ /lo dang zla ba tshes dang dus tshod bzhin/ /dga' ba bcu drug stong nyid bcu drug dang / /lha mo bcu drug 'bras bu sku bcu drug /lo la rgyu tshul/ dbyar nyi bzlog nas zla ba drug gi bar/ /zla ba byang chub sems nyid 'phel zhing rgyas/ /mtshan mo ring zhing bsil ngar rim bzhin 'phel/ /rig pa dwangs shing thig le dbang du 'du/ /dgun nyi ldog nas zla ba drug gi bar/ /nyi ma gtum mo'i dmar cha 'bar zhing rgyu/ /nyin mo ring zhing tsha ngar rim bzhin langs/ /'dod chags sdang zhing gnyid che dbang po 'thib/ /zla ba la rgyu tshul/ tshes gcig mthe bong g.yas la a thung ngu / /tshes gnyis byin pa'i gnas su ā ring po/ /tshes gsum brla yi gnas su i thung ngu / /tshes bzhi gsang ba'i gnas su ā+o ring po/ /tshes lnga lte ba'i gnas su u thung ngu / /tshes drug snying gi dbus su u ring po/ /tshes bdun nu ma'i ngos la ri thung ngu / /tshes brgyad lag pa la gnas rī ring po/ /tshes dgu lkog ma la gnas li thung ngu / /tshes bcu mchu sgros la gnas lī ring po/ /bcu gcig mkhur tshos la gnas e thung ngu / /bcu gnyis mig tu gnas pa i ring po/ /bcu gsum rna bar gsan pa o thung ngu / /bcu bzhi spyi bor gnas pa au ring po/ /bco lnga spyi bo'i ro mar e du gnas/ /bcu drug 'phel ba'i cha kun yongs rdzogs te/ /'grib pa'i mgo brtsams tsheg drag bcas pa'i aḥ dbu mar thim zhing lus kun khyab par byed/ /yar ngo'i tshes gcig skyes pa'i g.yas pa dang / /bud med rnams kyi mthe bong g.yon nas 'pho/ /mar ngo'i tshes la de gnyis go bzlog cing / /bco lngar spyi bo'i rkyang mar brten cing 'phel/ /de ltar kun rdzob thig le shes byas te/ /dbab bskyil 'dren bkram gnad du bsnun pa yis/ /stong bzhis drangs pa'i 'od gsal 'char ba dang / /bde chen rdo rje'i sku mchog thob par 'gyur/ /dbu ma'i mar snar gtum mo zhes grags pa'i/ /ma las thob pa'i dmar cha aḥ thung gzugs/ /las su rung bas bde chen thig le 'dren/ /spyi ltar dbye na gtum mo rnam pa gsum/ /sku yi gtum mo'i 'khril 'khor la brten nas/ me ru sbar zhing drag tu 'bar ba dang / /gsung gi gtum mo yig 'bru rlung 184

si/ dbyibs/ /ci bzhin dmigs bde ltar 'bar ba dang / /thugs kyi gtum mo dmigs med stong pa'i dbyings/ /shes rab sgron me shugs kyis 'bar ba'o/ /thugs kyi gtum mo la'ang rnam gsum ste/ /drod bskyed dam tshig phyag rgya'i gtum mo dang / /bde bskyed chos kyi phyag rgya'i gtum mo dang / /bde stong dbyer med phyag rgya chen po sogs/ /rnam pa gsum dang sgom tshul gyis bzhag pa'i/ /gtum mo sna tshogs chen rnams kyis bzhed/ /rnal 'byor drug gser rdo ma bzhus gser du mi 'gyur la/ /'o ma ma dkrugs mar mi 'byung ba bzhin/ /rtsa rlung thig le lus dang mi 'bral yang / /'khrul 'khor man ngag med na don mi 'grub/ /mdo sngags kun nas bsngags pa'i lus kyi gnad/ /'khrul 'khor kun gyi rtsa ba rmad byung ba/ /rnam par snang mdzad chos bdun zhe grags pa/ /sna tshogs snang yang lam gyi skabs thob bzhin/ /rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung bcas pa yis/ /thur sel sa yi rlung rnams dbu mar 'dren/ /mthe bong rtse mos srin lag mnan pa yis/ /me mnyam rlung gi rlung rnams dbu mar 'dren/ /sgal tshig yo med drang bor bsrang ba yis/ /srog 'dzin chu yi rlung rnams dbu mar 'dren/ /mgrin pa lcags kyu lta bur gug pa yis/ /gyen rgyu me yi rlung rnams dbu mar 'dren/ /dpung ba rgod gshog lta bur brkyang ba yis/ /khyab byed mkha' khams rlung rnams dbu mar 'dren/ /mig gnyis dal gyis sna rtser bzhag pa yis/ /phra ba yan lag rlung rnams dbu mar 'dren/ /dmigs gnad lus kyi de nyid shes pa yi/ /chos bdun 'dis kyang dgos pa mang 'grub kyang / /gzhan du chos brgyad 'dug tshul brtan po dang / /gsang ba'i man ngag med la dgos pa chung / /phyi lus grim po chun dang ldan pa dang / /nang sems bag lhod lta gdengs ldan pa'i ngang / /rlung sems gcig tu 'dus pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /phyi nang 'byung ba kun la rang dbang 'gyur/ /dang po srung ba rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ni/ /rdo rje'i skyil krung bcas pa'i chos bdun gyis/ /yi dam gsal ba'i dmigs pa'i gnad dang bcas/ /rlung khug re bzhin bca' bshig lug sprugs bya/ /de yis phyi nang gegs rnams sel ba dang / /nyams len lam la bar chad med par byed/ /gnyis pa nyes tshogs rang grol rnal 'byor ni/ /chos bdun pa'i lag gnyis sdig mdzub rgya/ /brla nas pus mor lag ngo lus dang sbyar/ /g.yas kyi rtsa brgyud rna rtag g.yas nas thon/ /spyi bo'i gtsugs brgyud smin ma'i mtshams su phab/ /gung mos sna bug g.yas mnan rlung ro bsal/ /pad skor dang bcas 'phen sdud lan gsum dang / /g.yon dang lag gnyis mnyam du'ang de bzhin no/ /de yis rlung ngo rtsa la rgyu ba yis/ /khog pa'i nad zhi phyi nas dwangs ma 'dren/ khams dang dbang po gsal zhing bying rgod sel/ /ting nge 'dzin la 'jug pa'i sngon 'gro byed/ /gsum pa sku gsum bdud rtsi'i rnal 'byor ni/ /chos bdun ldan pas 'jam rlung dal gyis bzung / /rlung 185

khug re bzhin bca' bshig re re bya/ /sdi nyid grub pas tshe ring gzhon nyams 'dzin/ /bzhi ba stong sbyang 'ja' lus rnal 'byor ni/ /chos bdun ldan pas rlung sems gcig tu dril/ /phyi lus nang rtsa gsang ba sems nyid de/ /re re bzhin du bcas bshig lus sprug bya/ /des ni snang ba rgyu mar shar ba yis bzang ngan kun la re dogs chod par byed/ /lnga ba 'chi med bum can rnal 'byor ni/ /chos bdun rlung sbyor bzhi dang ldan pa yis/ /g.yas nas pho rlung g.yon nas mo rlung bcag /dbus nas ma ning rlung bcag mda' ltar 'phen/ /bum chung 'bring dang chen po go rim bzhin/ /snga ma 'byong nas phyi ma sbyangs bar byed/ /bum chen drug gi tshad la bca' bshig re/ /sbyar bas rlung bcu rim gyis 'dren pa dang / /tshe tshad shes shing 'chi med bcud len 'grub/ /'di nyid man ngag ldan pa bslab bya'i gnad/ /drug pa gtum mo bde drod rnal 'byor ni/ /chos bdun ldan pas rlung rig lte bar gtad/ /mtshan nyid bzhin ldan gtum mo sbar ba dang / /rtsa rgyud bla ma phag mor bstem pa dang / /thams cad bde chen thig ler bzhu ba gsum//sbyang tshe so so rlung khug re re dang / /gsum po tshar rjes bca' bshig lus sprug sogs/ /dgos kyang goms tshe rang gi nyams dang sbyar/ /des ni grang ba'i nad kun sel ba dang / /shes rab 'phel zhing mi rtog bde chen bskyed/ /de ltar rtsa rlung thig le'i rmang gzhi mchog /rnal 'byor drug gis lus kyi rtsa slong zhing / /nyams pa sor chud bzang po gong du bskyed/ /zab lam rdzogs rim bsgom pa'i snod rung byed/ /gsang ba 'dus pa gshin rje gshed skor sogs/ /pha rgyud rnams las rlung sbyar gtso bor 'don/ /rlung lnga dag pas gsal stong ye shes bskyed/ /de yi man ngag bdud rtsi'i rnal 'byor nyid/ /yang phur bde mchog dgyes pa rdo rje sogs/ /ma rgyud rnams las thig le gtso bor 'don/ /zhu bde stobs kyis dga' ba'i ye shes bskyed/ /de yi man ngag gtum mo'i rnal 'byor nyid/ /gsang ba snying po dus kyi 'khor lo sogs/ /gnyis med rgyud las rtsa thig rlung gsum dril/ /skye 'gag gnas bral ye shes mngon du byed/ /de yang gtum mo'i rnal 'byor nyid la tshang / /de phyi bla med sngags kyi rdzogs rim kun/ /man ngag 'di yi lugs la 'du ba'i phyir/ /khams gsum nor bu dus gcig spung na'ang / /zab chos 'di yi cha tsam gzhal mi nus/ /skal ba ldan pa'i skyes bu'i lag mthil du/ /rang byung nor skal yin pa shes par gyis/ /yan lag lnga'i 'khrul 'khor/ /dang po drod bskyed me yi 'khor lo ni/ /rdor bsor pus gtad chos drug ldan pa yi/ /g.yas g.yon gnyis su pho skor gsum re dang / /mdun rgyab bcag pa'i 'bebs chung lan gsum bya/ /des ni rgyu ma pho ba'i nad sel zhing / /sbas pa'i rtsa rnams mngon du 'byin par byed/ /186

gnyis pa stobs chen rlung gi 'khor lo ni/ /rdor bsor pus steng bzhag pas chos drug gis/ /rked pa g.yas skor lan gsum g.yon de bzhin/ /g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab bcag 'bebs chung gsum/ /de yis rtsa 'chug 'gram dang gas pa gso/ /rlung las gyur ba'i nad rnams zhi bar byed/ /gsum pa rnam grol chos kyi 'khor lo ni/ /chos bdun ldan pa'i dpung mgo gyen du bstod/ /mgo bo g.yas g.yon dal gyis gsum re skor/ /mdun rgyab dgye 'gug gsum dang g.yas g.yon bcag /'bebs chung gsum brgyab yang dag don la blta/ /ltag rtsa 'chus dang mig dang sna nad sel/ /bzhi ba gdung sel bde ba'i 'khor lo ni/ /rdor bsor phyag rgya g.yas mdun g.yon rgyab bcas/ /chos drug ldan pas pad skor mchan rdeb gsum/ /de bzhin lag g.yon mdun dang g.yas pa rgyab/ /pad skor mchan rdeb stel ba lan gsum dang / /lag gnyis rked par bros 'ded
