bshal chung gsum/ /'bebs chung gsum brgyab lta ba'i ngor bskyangs pas/ /snying khrag rgyu ba ngan pa brgyal gzer sel/ /lnga ba dri med pad+ma'i 'khor lo ni/ /chos bdun ldan pas rlung bzung dmigs gnad bcas/ /lag gnyis shad brkyangs pad skor thal rdebs 'phur/ /mdzub gung brkyangs pa'i rdo rje'i khu tshur bya/ /lag g.yas mdun dang g.yon pa rgyab byas te/ /thod pa'i skra la byugs pa lan gsum dang / /lag g.yon go ldog mnyam du ngo byugs gsum/ /bca' bshig 'bebs chung gsum brgyab gnas lugs bskyangs/ /des ni mkhris pa bad kan srin nad dang / /mgo dang byang khog stod kyi nad rnams sel/ /drug pa rab myur glog gi 'khor lo ni/ /phyed skyil bcas pa'i chos drug bzhugs stang gis/ /mchan rdeb dang bcas lag gnyis shad kyi brkyang / /dpung bdeg lag g.yon g.yas pa'i sor rtser bzhag /sor rtse bar byugs g.yas pa'i mchan du brdabs/ /g.yas su lan gsum g.yon pa'ang de bzhin/ /bca' bshig gcig dang 'bebs chung lan gsum bya/ /lag pa'i rtsa dang tshig gi nad rnams sel/ /bdun pa rnal 'byor dga' ba'i 'khor lo ni/ /rkang g.yon phyed skyil g.yas mthil sa la phab/ /lag g.yas steng bcas g.yas pa'i pur mor 'khyud/ /'phags chung dang bcas rkang g.yas mdun du brkyangs/ /lag gnyis bral nas pus mo'i bar byugs rjes/ /lag g.yon rang phyogs su pus mo'i steng du 'jog /g.yas pas rang phyogs dpyi thad lan gsum bdeg /lag g.yas khu tshur rang phyogs pus steng bkod/ /g.yon pa'i mtheb gung sbyar ba'i phyag rgya yis/ /g.yas kyis rkang pa'i srin lag nas 'khyud cing / /g.yon pa'i brla steng bkod dang chab gcig tu/ /khod stod g.yas su gcus te rlung ro dor/ /slar yang g.yon du de bzhin lan gcig sbyangs/ /'bebs chung gsum brgyab gnyug ma'i rang ngo bskyangs/ /des ni bstod smad kun gyi nad spyi dang / /'khrul 'khor skabs kyi gegs rnams sel bar byed/ /brgyad pa snang byed 'od gsal 'khor lo ni/ /rdor bsor pus steng bzhag 187

pa'i chos drug gis/ /'phags chung dang bcas phral du gyen la langs/ /khu tshur mdun rgyab skor ba gsum re dang / /pad skor thal rdebs mthil 'phur lan gsum bya/ /skra byugs ngo 'phur khu tshur phrag brdeg bcas/ /gsum re bca' bshig langs 'bebs che gsum dang / /bar 'bebs 'bebs chung gsum re ha sprug gsum/ /de ltar yan lag lnga yis 'khrul 'khor brgyad/ /nyams su blang pas lus kyi nad zhi zhing / /lus la drod 'bar sems la bde ba rgyas/ /rnam par mi rtog ye shes rgyud la skye/ /dngos gzhi'i 'khrul 'khor/ dngos gzhi dbabs bskyil bzlog bkram gegs sel sogs/ /rnam grangs mang yang thog mar gtum mo dang / /thig le'i 'khrul 'khor gnad du tshud dgos pas/ /sbyang tshul sku gsum bdud rtsi'i 'khor lor mtshungs/ /7'bebs pa'i 'khrul 'khor/ /las la sbyar tshe 'debs bskyil ldog pa yi/ /dmigs pa gsum po lam gyi rtsa bar zungs/ /7dang po rtsal ldan khyung gi 'khrul 'khor ni/ /rdor bsor pus steng bzhag pa'i chos drug gis/ /bca' bshig 'phags chung dang bcas rkang gnyis brkyang / /lag gnyis bsnol bas brla nas sor rtser byugs/ /khu tshur brla thad gsum bdeg phyir 'bebs gcig /'bebs chung dang rkyang 'bebs gcig gi rjes/ /khu tshur pus mor gtad la rlung ro dor/ /des ni thig le gnas nas g.yo ba dang / /sdug bsngal bde bar 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod/ /7rtsa 'don 'khrul 'khor lnga las bzlog pa'i 'khrul 'khor gnyis ni/ /gnyis pa glang chen chu 'thung 'khrul 'khor ni/ /rdor bsor pus steng bzhag pa'i chos drug gis/ /bca' gshig 'phags chung dang bcas shad kyis langs/ /pus mo gru gnyis dpral ba bcas sar phab/ /sor mo ltag bsnol u sgra lan gsum dang / /bar 'bebs gsum bcas rlung ro lhag med dor/ /7gsum pa stag mo ha sgra'i 'khrul 'khor ni/ /rdor bsor pus steng bzhag pa'i chos drug gis/ /bca' bshig 'phags chung dang bcas shad gyis langs/ /lag gnyis mtheb gung rkang pa'i srin mdzub bzung / /hā hag gsum brjod bar 'bebs lan gsum dang / /khu tshur pus gtad rlung ro g.yon du dor/ /de ltar ldog pa'i 'khrul 'khor rnam gnyis kyis/ /srid kyi rgyun gcod lus la gzi mdangs 'bar/ /7bzlog bkram zung gi 'khrul 'khor/ /7bzhi pa wa mo'i dri snom 'khrul 'khor ni/ /rkang g.yon 'og tu byas pa'i chos drug gis/ /'phags chung bca' bshig bcas pas gyen du langs/ /gung mo stel ba'i lag pa ltag par 'khyud/ /pus gru sar phab dpral ba gyen du bstan/ /snom tshul gsum dang bar 'bebs lan gsum brgyab/ /khu tshur pus mor gtad de rlung ro bsal/ /des ni thig le ldog bkram bde chen bskyed/ /7bskyil bkram zung gi 'khrul 'khor/ /7lnga ba g.yang mo'i lus sprug 'khrul 'khor ni/ /rdor bsor pus steng bzhag pa'i chos drug gis/ /bca' bshig 'phags chung dang bcas shad kyis langs/ /mthil bzhi sar phab mgo bo 188

g.yas g.yon du/ /lan gsum bskor zhing dgye 'gug yang de bzhin/ /rkang mthil g.yas pas 'phong mgo lan gsum brdeg /g.yon pa de bzhin lag g.yas khu tshur gyis/ /phrag par gsum brdeg g.yon pa'ang de bzhin/ /lus sprug lan gsum bar 'bebs de yi grangs/ /khu tshur pus mor gtad de rlung ro dor/ /des ni thig le 'gag dang khrag sran sel/ /lus gnas kun la bde bas khyab pa yi/ /bzod mi shes pa'i bde ba khong nas 'bar/ /7'dren dgram gyi 'khrul 'khor drug ni/ drug pa rtag pa chos 'khor 'khrul 'khor ni/ /rdor bsor pus mor gtad pa'i chos drug gis/ /lag gnyis bca' bshig mthe bong rna bar sbyar/ /gung mo dang ni mdzub mo mig la bkab/ /srin mdzub sna dang the'u chung kha la bzhag /mgo bo g.yas g.yon gnyis su lan gsum bskor/ /dgye 'gug gsum dang bar 'bebs lan gsum bya/ /des ni thig le mgo ru khyab par byed/ /7bdun pa seṅge 'gyings stabs 'khrul 'khor ni/ /rdor bsor pus steng bzhag pa'i chos drug gis/ /bca' bshig 'phags chung dang bcas gyen du langs/ /rkang mthil sbyar zhing sor mo sa la brtan/ /pus mo phyir brkyangs khu tshur nang du gtad/ /mgo bo btegs shing g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du/ /phyi 'dzin gsum re lus po lan gsum sprug /drag 'bebs gsum brgyab rlung ro lhag med dor/ /des ni theg le gyen ldog bde chen 'phel/ /rtsa gnas kun la bde ba 'phel bar byed/ /7brgyad pa g.yu 'brug 'khyil ba'i 'khrul 'khor ni/ /rdor bsor pus steng bzhag pa'i chos drug gis/ /bca' bshig 'phags chung rkang gnyis mdun du brkyangs/ /lag gnyis khu tshur dpyi thad gdan la brten/ /rkang pa g.yas g.yon brkyang skum gsum re dang / /'bebs chung gsum rjes rlung ro phyi ru dor/ /des ni thig len yan lag gnas su bkram/ /khrag shugs rgyu ba ngan pa sel ba byed/ /7dgu ba gyi ling sil sprug 'khrul 'khor ni/ /rdor bsor pus mor gtad pa'i chos drug gis/ /bca' bshig 'phags chung dang bcas rgyab tu log /nya bzhi nam mkhar 'phang ba'i sgal 'bebs gsum/ /rtsa 'dar bton zhing bar 'bebs lan gsum brgyab/ /thig le pag par bkram zhing rlung sran zhi/ /7bcu ba gyi ling gan 'dril 'khrul 'khor ni/ /rdor bsor pus steng bzhag pa'i chos drug gi/ /bca' bshig 'phags chung dang bcas rgyab tu log /ha zhes nya bzhi nam mkha'i mthongs la 'phang / /ha3 zhes sgra dang bcas pas g.yas su 'dril/ /g.yon du de bzhin sdom pas lan gsum 'dril/ /bar 'debs gsum brgyab rlung ro lhag med bsal/ /des ni thig le ba spu'i bu gar bkram/ /dwangs ma skyon du gyur pa'i nad rigs sel/ /7bcu gcig seṅge rnam rol 'khrul 'khor ni/ /rdor bsor pus mor gtad pa'i chos drug gis/ /bca' bshig dang bcas gyen du shad kyis langs/ /rdo rje 'chang gi phyag rgya thugs kar bca'/ /rkang mthil sbyar zhing sor mo sa la brtan/ /pus mo phyir brkyangs khog stod gzengs su bstod/ /mgo bo 189

btegs shing g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du/ /snom tshul phyi 'dzin gsum re lan gsum sprug /rdo rje'i thogs 'bebs brgyab cing rlung ro bsal/ /'di ni bzlog bkram 'khrul 'khor thams cad kyi/ /snying po yin ces grub thob rnams kyis bsngags/ /7kun gyi yan lag bcu gnyis kun bzang dgyes pa'i 'khrul 'khor ni/ /chos bdun ldan pa'i mgo bo g.yas g.yon du/ /lan gsum bskor zhing phyogs gnyis bcag re dang / /gru mo shed bskyed khu tshur nu steng brdeg /pad skor dang bcas rdor bsor pus mor gtad/ /g.yas g.yon rked skor gsum dang bar 'bebs gsum/ /langs te rkang ba'i rting gis 'phong mgo brdeg /khu tshur nu steng brdab pa lan gsum dang / /langs 'bebs gcig dang bar 'bebs gnyis bcas brgyab/ /'khrul 'khor kun gyi cha shas 'di la tshang / /dbab bskyil ldog bkram las kun 'di yis byed/ /ting 'dzin ldan nartsond rnams gnyen por 'gyur//khyad par dmigs med lta ba'i gdengs ldan par/ /bskyil bzlog bkram pa sgyu ma'i ltad mo bzhin/ /gang shar phyag rgya gang snang bde ba che/ /'khor 'das gnyis med lhun grub bde chen 'grub/ /dngos gzhi'i 'khrul 'khor rnam pa bcu gnyis kyis/ /dus sbyor bcu gnyis dbu ma'i dbyings su dag /rtsa ba re las yan lag re gyes pas/ /nyer bzhi'i gnas kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du/ /'od gsal nyi ma snying gi dbus nas 'char/ /tshe 'dir mkha' spyod 'grub pa rdo rje'i bka'/ /rjes kyi bya ba bogs 'don gegs sel dang / /bkra shis gsum gyis lam gyi gnad rnams bsdus/ /dang po rab 'bar nyi ma'i 'khrul 'khor ni/ /rkang g.yon nang du byas pa nya gnyis bsnol/ /lag g.yas rgyab tu byas pa'i grub gnyis kyis/ /pus mor 'khyud pas rdor 'chang phyag rgya bca'/ /bum chen lan ma bdun dang bca' bshig re/ /rlung ro dal gyi bsal bas me drod bskyed/ /gnyis pa dwangs bsil zla ba'i 'khrul 'khor ni/ /zhabs gnyis pad skyil rdor bsor pus mor gtad/ /mgo bo gzengs bstod ha sgra lan gsum 'don/ /des ni tsha ba'i nad zhi rig pa dwangs/ /tha ma bkra shis 'khor lo'i 'khrul 'khor ni//chos bdun bca' bshig chos 'chad phyag rgya dang / /mchog sbyin mnyam bzhag skyabs sbyin phyag rgya dang / /sa gnon la sogs rgyal ba rigs lnga'i rgya/ /rang phyogs brgyab te gdan skor lan gsum dang / /'bebs chung 'bring dang chen po gsum re brgyab/ /des ni gnas dus kun du bkra shis shing / /rgyal bstan mdo sngags yun du gnas pa mtshon/ /nyams kyi rim pa mtha' dag mdor bsdu na/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i nyams gnyis te/ /snang nyams stong nyams 'jam rtsub gnyis re 'byung / /gang la re dogs zhen pa med na grol/ /gegs sel bogs 'don man ngag khyad par can/ /gang zag dbang po'i khams dang rim pa bzhin/ /rnam grangs mang yang sman dang rtsa bcos dang / /bla mar gsol 'debs stong sbyang 190

khyad du 'phags/ /rtsa rlung grub pas thun mong dngos grub dang / /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing nyams rtogs 'phel/ /las rlung dbu ma'i dbyings su grol ba yis/ /mchog gi dngos grub kha sbyor bdun ldan 'grub/ /mchog tu gsang ba 'og sgo'i gdams pa mchog //mkha' 'gro'am dpa' bo brtags 'gugs sbyang ba dang / /gsang thur gdams pa rdo rje chu 'thung dang / /pad+ma dung 'bud nus pa thon par bya/ /de nas yid mthun dben pa'i nags khrod du/ /dam tshig thub pa'i grogs dang chab gcig tu/ /dga' ba bzhi yi nyams rtsal sbyang ba yis/ /zla drug gam lo gsum nang du bde chen rnyed/ /'di nyid ci bzhin slob pa'i snod mchog ni/ /bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su blta ba dang / /dam tshig srog gi phyir yang mi gtong pa'i/ /gcig gnyis kho nar snyan brgyud yin phyir bzhigade ltar gsal rgyas gdams pa bstan zin nas/ /rgyun du nyams len gnad du dril ba'i tshul/ /tho rangs 'du ba snyoms pa'i dus skabs su/ /bla mar gsol 'debs skyabs sems sngon du 'gro/ /de nas rang lus gnas yul stong pa'i ngang / /skad cig gnam sa chos 'byung mkha' spyod zhing / /dbus su e dmar pad nyi bam ro'i steng / /aḥ las phag dmar khro mo'i chas rdzogs pa/ /g.yas g.yon gri thod zhabs gnyis gar stabs rol/ /lus nang stong ra dam dmar gur phub 'dra/ /dbus su rtsa mchog dbu ma shel bum ltar/ /mtshan nyid bzhi ldan g.yas g.yon ro rkyang zung / /mar sna lte 'og gnyer nas dbu mar tshud/ /dbu ma'i yar sne tshangs bug ro rkang sna/ /'khor lo bzhi bcas gsal snang 'dus gsum kha/ /lte 'og sor bzhi'i nyi steng bla ma dang / /dbyer med ram̐ḥ dmar me 'bar yid gtad ngang / /bla mar gsol btab gnad ldan rlung dgu 'bud/ /dal rlung dar cig slod bzhag slar rngub 'dod/ /shar tshe rngub chung bsnad bcas lte 'og mnan/ /ro rkyang nas brgyud dbu mar rlung zhugs pas/ /ram̐ las me 'bar lte ba'i rtsa 'dab gang / /rim bzhin goms nas gsang gnas snying ga kheng / /bsam byas pho skor rked skor skabs skabs bya/ /mi thub snyam tshe mig zim rig pa nyid/ /lte 'og la gtad rlung ro lhag med 'bud/ /de ltar jub dgang gzhil 'bud sbyor ba bzhi/ /gsung pa rlung dgang mi thub pa snyams tshe/ ba spu'i bu ga khrol tshag ltar bsam nang / /rlung rnams sngo bsang gton dmigs lus 'dar bton/ /de nas 'bud bya rlung dgar ran tshod ces/ /'di dus 'khrul 'khor yan tshag lnga sbyang ni/ /rtsa mdud glor phyir 'bad ces gsung pa bya/ /de la goms nas ye shes gtum mo ni/ /lte ba'i aḥ shad me yi gtum mo yi/ /zla ba haṃ mgo thur bstan drod kyis bzhu/ /bdud rtsi babs pa medang bros 'ded mthar/ /snying gar 'dres te rim bzhin byang sems rgyas/ /mgrin snying lte gsang 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab gang / /dmigs gnad dga' bzhi 191

ngos bzung yas brtan brtag /slar bzlog rig pa spyi bor mkha' la gtad/ /sbyor ba drug gis 'dren byas mas brtan dga'/ /'khor lo bzhir myong dud 'gro'i 'gyur bzhi yis/ /tshangs pa'i sar bskyal seng rol chos 'byung gis/ /bkram byas khu tshur zug pas rtsa mig gdab/ /de nas bde stong chos nyid klong yangs su/ /dmigs bsam brjod bral ngang klod 'di ni bsngags/ /thabs lam rtsa ba bogs 'don spyod gtso yin/ /de bas thun mong thun min spyod pa ni/ /kun brdar kun bzang brtul zhugs rnam rgyal spyod/ /gang zag dbang rim gsum mthun tshogs dben spyod/ /mdor dril phyi ltar tshangs spyod tshul khrims bstun/ /nang ltar sems bskyed snying rje gtso bor 'don/ /gsang ba thabs lam gsang sngags zab mor spyod/ /kun kyang tho cog bag med rtsing spyod dang / /snyan grags lo 'dod rgyu min zhen bral dang / /bag yod rgyal ba'i gsung bstun don la spyod/ /e ma 'bras bu zhes grags sgra chen de/ /sngar med gzhan nas byung ba zhig min kye/ /kun rdzob glo bur dri ma rang sangs ste/ /rang rig sgrib bral mthong la 'bras bur btags/ /'khrul pa sangs tshe sku dang ye shes rgyas/ /de la sangs rgyas zhes su brjod pa ste/ /brtson 'grus ldan pas bskyed rdzogs nyams blang mthar/ /re dogs 'phrang las grol tshe 'bras bu yin/ /de ltar lta bsgom spyod 'bras mdor dril na/ /lta ba rgya mtsho'i nang gi gza' skar ltar/ /der 'dzin shes pa rtsis gdab bral bar zhog bsgom pa nam mkha' yangs pa'i klong bzhin du/ /phyogs ris blos byas sgom dang bral bar zhog /spyod pa sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i 'khrul 'khor bzhin/ /zhen bral rang bab bag yangs ngang du zhog /'bras bu ri bo chen po ci bzhin du/ /gong bsgrod ltos gzhi re dogs med par zhog /gsang ngag chos kun rtsa ba byin rlabs yin/ /byin rlabs bla mar rags las mos gus gces/ /theg chen gzhi yin gzhan phan sems bskyed gces/ /chos kyi srog yin sdom dang dam tshig gces/ /bstan pa'i gzhi yin tshogs gnyis zung 'jug gces/ /chos kyi lam grogs brtson 'grus snying rus gces/ /e ma spyir yang chos bzhin spyod pa la/ /dam tshig mi bsrung sangs rgyas re ba ni/ /sol ba phyi bdar byas nas dung 'dod 'dra/ /rgyu 'bras mi bsrung byang chub thob 'dod ni/ /bye ma bcir nas mar khu 'dod pa 'dra/ /bla ma ma dgyes dge ba gang bsgrub kun/ /sa bon me la bsreg pa'i ljang bu 'dra/ /de bas rtag tu bla mar gus gyis shig /de ltar rdzogs rim bskor las 'phros pa'i gtam/ /nyams len 'dod la rtogs pa'i bogs 'don phyir/ /rgyal bka' grub thob zhal lung khyad par du/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i gsung gi man ngag nyid/ /rang gi nyams myongs dang bstun smras pa yin/ /mi shes mkhas 'dod tshe 'di'i mi chos dang / /stod smad grags pa sgrub pa 'i ched du min/ /'di ltar ston la gtan tshig lung dang ni/ /man ngag che ba'i tshig tshogs mang po zhig /brjod par 'os kyang gsang ba srung phyir bzhag spyir yang 192

nyams su ma blang tshig skam po/ /'brug stong ldir yang 'chi dus stong skad yin/ /nyams len thub na rgyal gsung tshig res chog /rgyal ba'i gsung chos rgya mtsho lta bu la/ /blo rmongs bdag gi tshig gis ci zhig bya/ /'dir ni bdud 'dul rdo rje klong gsal snying / /'dren mchog pad+ma bde chen gling pa ste/ /gter chen gsum gyi man ngag rtsa ba dang / /bde gsang dus 'khor sbas don 'di la tshang / /o rgyan rje nas dam pa bde gshegs dang / kaḥthog bla rabs gong ma rim byon kyi/ /sbas nas nyams su len pa'i man ngag ste/ /ring brgyud bka' yi rgya mtsho chen po'ang 'di/ /de phyir gangs can brtol nas rgya gar nyul/ /o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling du slebs na'ang / /rdzogs rims gdams pa 'di las lhag pa med/ /'di nyid ci bzhin nyams len bu re las/ /'phyar chos byed na de srog ma dam gzas/ /rol mdzod badz+ra sa mā ya dam dzaḥ nyams len bu la rtag tu grogs mdzod cig /gsang zhing tshul bzhin nyams su len pa por/ /bka' srung dreg pa'i tshogs kyis rtag bsrung zhing / /mthun rkyen dngos grub dbyar mtsho lta bur 'phel/ /tshe 'dir grol ba thob pa rdo rje'i lung / /'di ltar bris pa'i dge bas 'gro ba kun/ /theg mchog dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes bzungs shing / /rim gnyis nyams rtogs yar ngo'i zla la 'grogs/ /don gnyis lhun grub sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med tshom bu gcig tu 'gro ba 'dul ba'i smon lam gyi mthu grub pa gnyag rigs kyi rnal 'byor ma nam mkha' ye shes gsal sgron ngor bris pa'i zhal gdams snying khrag gi dwangs ma de nyid kyi gtum mo'i nyams len thad rgyas pa zhig dgos zhes rang gi chos kyi bu du mas lan gcig ma yin par yang yang bskul ba dang / slar yang rnal 'byor ma de nyid dang skyes mchog 'ba' ra ba sogs kyis mig sman mdog gi cang shes/ /thabs shes kyi rdor dril/ /gser dngul gyi bdog pa/ gzhon nu ma'i ston mo sogs tshogs kyis mchod pa/ /rdzogs rim 'di nyid rgyun chags su nyams su len pa'i thugs dam mdzad pa dang / /chos bzhin spyod pa'i grwa ba bdun tsam gyis dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya ba 'bum phrag gtong ba'i dam bca' byas pas yid mgu ste/sngags kyi dge sbyong rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu 'phrin las 'gro 'dul rtsal gyis dkar phyogs dga' ba dang por rgyal ba lo ras kyi sgrub gnas bya gnam dbu rir bris pas kun gyi rgyud la bde stong spros pa dang bral ba'i ye shes skye bar gyur cig 193

༄sto /rdzogs chen yang gsang bla med kyi gdams pa nam mkha' gsum gyi nyams len bdud rtsi'i thig le zhes bya ba/ shin tu zab pa shog dril gong khug ma bzhugs so/ /ithiḥ.ā tha/ gdod nas rnam par dag pa ye shes lus/ /kun khyab spros pa bral ba kun tu bzang / /rang rig rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal ba/ /dang po'i mgon po rtsa ba'i bla ma 'dud/ /nges 'byung theg pa gsum bsgrod rtse mo ru/ /'bras bu rgyud lung man ngag snying po'i bcud/ /rdzogs chen yang gsang bla med rmad byung lam/ /gnad gyur mkha' gsum man ngag 'di na bstan/ /de la rgyal ba'i gsung pa'i chos ma lus pa'i rtse mor gyur pa ni rdzogs pa chen po zhes bya la/ de yi nang tshan sems klong man ngag gsum gyi mthar thug yang gsang bla med kyi gdams pa snying por dril na khregs chod thod rgal gnyis te/ de yang gnad nam mkha' gsum phrug gi man ngag 'dir 'dus shing / /de nyams su len pa la/ nam mkha' gsum ngos 'dzin pa/ ji ltar nyams su len pa/ bogs 'don pa/ mnyam rjes kyi mtshan nyid/ lam gyi tshul ngo sprad pa/ gegs bsal ba ste drug tu dbye nas 'chad par bya ste/ dang po ni/ phyi yi nam mkha' 'byung ba lnga yi nang tshan gyi ye nas 'dus ma byas pa'i nam mkha' glo bur gyi dri mas ma gos dwangs gsal du gnas pa de yin la/ nang gi nam mkha' ni nang gi rtsa a wa dhu ti'i nang tshan shel gyi sbu gu can zhes dag pa'i snang 'dzin par byed pa'i rtsa mig dbang sgo nas snying dbus su rtsa rgya mtsho gser gyi nyi ma dang 'brel nas snang ba de yin cing / /gsang ba'i nam mkha' ni/ yul phyi nang gi nam mkha' gnyis la khyab byed kyi rten snying chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus sku dang ye shes gnyis su med pa/ gdod nas rnam dag chos nyid stong gsal rig pa spros bral gyi ngo bo 'dus ma byas pa ni/ nam mkha' las 'das pa'i nam mkha' gzhan de yin la/ 'di ni rdzogs chen gsang skor gyi man ngag mthar thug pa yin pa dang / yang gsang bla med chos nyid mngon sum gdams pa'i gzhi yang 'di la blan pa ste/ rgyud kyi rgyal po bltas pas grol ba tshig gsum gyi dgongs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sems nyid kyi ngo bo skye 'gag gnas gsum gcig tha dad dang bral ba'i rig pa ngo shes thag chod par 'dod pa yis/ rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur cing / kun nas lhag pa'i nges shes drag po 'di nas byang chen bar rgyun mi chad ldem rgyang bral bar lta ba'i gdung shugs drag po bcas gsol ba phur tshugs su btab cing / mthar bla ma'i thugs gnyis med ro gcig mnyam par dar cig bzhag nas/ lus gnad 'khrul 'khor thams cad kyi rgyal po 194

dha na dhasmraḥ sabha bcas la rlung ro lan gsum mam dgur bsal ba'i mthar/ rlung gnad rang babs ye shes kyi rlung sbyor can du byas la/ sgo yi gnad mig ha cang bkab pa yang ma yin zhing / gdangs pa yang min par rang babs 'byed 'dzum bral zhing cung zad gyen du phyogs te mig 'bras mi 'gul bar phyi yi nam mkha' la ce rer lta la/ sems kyi gnad/ shes pa mig la gtad/ mig nam mkha' la gtad pa de la g.yo byed 'pho bcas rnam par rtog pa sngon rjes da lta gang la yang dpyad pa med par/ rang bab rig stong gi ngo bo la sa ler bzhag de la gnas 'phro bde rtsub ji ltar yang ma bcos cog bzhag ngang las gzhan pa'i tshig tsab tsub spangs te rang ngo shes tsam pa de ka skyong / de yang lus g.yo med ri bo cog bzhag mig zhen med rgya mtsho cog bzhag sems bsam med rig pa cog bzhag te/ /cog bzhag gsum gyi gnad 'dir 'du zhing / gzhan yang / me long dwangs pa/ mda' mkhan gyi mig /chu dwangs nor bu'i dpe don gtan la phab te gnad ma 'chug par bcings grol spro bsdu dang bral bar rig pa'i ngo shes bzhin ngang chu bo'i rgyun ltar 'bral ba med par bsgom pa ste/ ji skad du/ bsgom pa ma yin goms pa yin/ goms pa klong du gyur na bsgom pa'i mchog ces pa ltar ro/ /gsulipa ni/ nyin mo nam mkha' sngo thing la sems bzhag pa bzhin/ mtshan mo lus lta stangs sems gnad nyin mo bzhin du mdun gyi nam mkha' mun nag thing nge bar sems g.yo med du bzhag spyir yang sprin dang ser bu mi sogs kyi rgyu 'grul klag cor gyis bsgom ma bde ba'i tshe dben pa'i gnas su mun pa'i rnal 'byor kho na gtso bor 'don pa legs shing / mun khrid du grags pa'i gnad kyang yin no/ /gzhan yang skabs su lta stangs g.yas g.yon gyen thur thad ka rnams su bsgyur zhing / spyod lam yang 'gro sdod/ phyag skor/ kha 'don/ sngags mdo sogs ring thung / gtam smra ba/ tshogs kyi bya ba/ spyod pa sna tshogs dge sbyor 'jur po byed cing / de rjes nam mkha' gsum du bzhag cing bskyang bas yun mi ring bar mnyam rjes 'dres par bogs thon pa'i gnad yin no/ /bzhi pa/ spyir sems nyid kyi ngo bo rang rig 'od gsal ngo shes ngang la gnas pa mnyam bzhag dang / de yi ngo shes bral ba la rjes thob zer yang / rjes thob btags pa ba yin la/ 'phro ba gtad yal rang grol ni rjes thob dngos yin cing / der ma zad mnyam bzhag gi cha yang yin pas mnyam rjes ro mnyam zhes bdag gi bla ma gong ma rnams kyis gsum pas/ gnad dang mthun par rtogs/ de yang ma yengs pa'i khul gyi dran pa yal yul la/ rnam rtog 'og 'gyur zam dz+rengs ba dang / mi rtog brang breng la phra ba ma slong ba ni mnyam bzhag tu rloms kyang a thang chad de rjes thob tshad mar gyur ba de yang min/ des na mnyam bzhag gi mtshan nyid mi rtog pa gsal rig tu 'char ba rjes thob kyi mtshan nyid rang grol mtsho rlabs mtshor zhi ba lta bu ste/ de yang mnyam bzhag gtad med 195

nam mkha'i dbyings lta bu la/ rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu rang bzhin gyi snying rje dang 'brel ba zhig shar na mnyam rjes rnal ma yin gyi/ de yang 'dir rnal 'byor gyi mtshan nyid du gyur pa'i sne zin pa'i mnyam rjes yin la/ gzhan du las dang po ba nas rgyun mtha'i bar mnyam rjes dbye ba re yod mod/ /gang ltar yang rang re rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi mnyam rjes dbyer med nyin mtshan 'khor yug tu ma song bar du 'bad dgos par gda'o/ /lnga pa ni/ gnas pa'i rkang tshugs nas 'gyu rtog bag gis bri ba ni ltar snang gi gnas pa yin la/ gnas pa skye med du 'gyu ba 'gag med du nges shes gting nas skyes shing gnas 'gyu ro mnyam pa ni sgom gsha' ma skye ba'i sne nas zin pa yin/ de yang / da dung gnas pa'i cha shas che zhing gsal stong bde ba yid dpyod dang bral ba lta bu la don bsgom 'dun yid shes gnyis snang gi cha phra mo g.yo ba bcas shing zag bcas kyi yon tan du ma lus ngag sems la bskyed nus pa ni gnas pa'i nyams yin la/ de nas bde gsal gyi zhen pa zhig pa'i yul gnyen tha dad kyi 'dzin pa med lta bu la bying rmugs 'phro rgod kyis mi brdzi bar rnam rtog drag pos rang ngo la gsal lhag par btab pa ltar 'gyur zhing stong pa nyid bde ba'i gshis dang ma bral ba ni/ mi g.yo ba'i nyams zhes bya la/ de yang yul gnyen tha dad 'dzin pa med par mi zad snang sems ro mnyam nas bdag gzhan gyi 'dzin pa ci rigs dbyings su yal zhing bde stong sgyu ma lta bur shar nas 'khor 'das kun rig mdangs su rtogs pa ni mnyam pa'i nyams yin la/ de yi mthar gnyis chos thams cad chos nyid dbyings su thim ste bya rtsol zad pa ltar zab zhi spros bral du snang zhing cung zad kyis zad pa'i zil gnon thob pa'i rgyu ni lhun gyis grub pa'i nyams te 'phags pa'i go 'phags pa'i go 'phang dngos thob pa'o/ /gzhan yang snang ba'i 'od gsal gyi cha du ba/ smig rgyu/ mkha' snang / thig le sogs 'khor 'das kyi gzugs brnyan rnam pa thams cad par 'chad zhing / de la thog mar yul ltar du snang ba dang / rim bzhin yul sems ro mnyam pa'i blo dang /ro gcig gi nges pa gting nas tshugs pa dang / de ltar gyi yang zhen pa spangs zhing / des drang pa'i bde ba dang / stong pas sgo gsum yongs su sbyangs shing / mthar rtsa thig rlung rab tu dag nas mi 'gyur bde chen ye shes kyi sku mngon du 'gyur pa'o/ /de bzhin thun mong ma yin pa'i snang ba'i 'od gsal chod nyid mngon sum thod brgal gyi tshul du 'char tshul ni rtags tshad gnad kyi yi ge snying thig nas bshad pa ltar te 'di rgyas par ma smos so/ /drug pa ni/ las dang po pas lus gnad ma 'byong pas mi bde ba dang /lta stangs kyi mig na zhing sgom mi 'dod na/ dang po ngang gis bslab la/ phyis sgyid ngan gyi dbang du ma shor bar mi bde ba byung bar bzod pas bsgom na lus gnad lta stangs rnams 'byong nas bde bar 'gyur la/ de bzhin rnam rtog za zi mang po chod du med pa lta bu'i sgom snying mi 'dod pa yang 'byung srid 196

pas/ sngar 'og 'gyu 'ba' zhig tu shor ba ngos zin pa'i 'go tshugs par shes nas thun chung la grangs mang bar bsgom/ yang skabs su/ 'phro ba med pa ltar bying na shes pa sgrim/ de bzhin rtog pa rgod na shes pa klod/ 'on kyang nam mkha' gsum gyi man ngag 'dis bying rmug rang sar sel zhing /'phro rgod ngang gis zhi bar byed pa'i gdams pa rang gnad kyi che ba yin pas/ kho gnad du 'gro ba zhig sgom shes tshe kho rang gis gegs rang sar sel nus pa yin la/ gzhan yang bde gsal mi rtog gi myong ba la zhen pa cher cher po mi byed par rang babs su skyong ba dang / stong gzugs kyi snang ba yang yul 'dzin bral ba zhig dgos la/ /gegs sel mtha' dag yi ger ga la lang / myong ldan bla ma'i zhal las blang bar bya zhing / khyad par gegs sel bogs 'don thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa ni/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la mos gus kyi snying dkyil du zug nas ldem rgyang med par gsol 'debs la brtson pa kho na gal che la/ /spyir bla ma la mos gus ma skyes na sgom skye ba'i re che dang bral/ /log lta cung zad skyes kyang ngan song gi rgyu drag po 'phel bas/ nan tan ltar bla ma'i mos gus la 'bad pas/ ci mdzad legs mthong / ci gsung tshad mar bzung nas gsol ba 'debs pa gal che'o/ /gzhan yang 'gro ba la snying rje dang mi 'bral ba dang / /'jig rten snang la zhen log dang / zhe bcad ldan cing dam pa'i chos la dka' thub lam khyer nus pa zhig cis kyang dgos la/ de bzhin blta bsgom gyi man ngag zab mo'i gnad skye bo phal ba ni smos kyang mi 'tshal/ bla ma gcig cing gdams pa lhan cig tu thob pa ma yin pa la shin tu gsang dgos shing / spyod lam kun tu dge sbyor skyong dgos pa gzhir bcas kyang / skye bo'i dbus su lus gnad lta ltangs sogs mngon gyur ba spangs shing / dus kun rang sems dam pa'i chos dang zhu dag pher ba'i rang gis rang la ma khrel ba zhig dgos pa yin gyi gnad thams cad der 'du'o/ /de ltar rgyal ba'i bka' rtsa ba'i bla ma'i man ngag gis brgyan pa/ rang gis blo nus kyis ci ltar go myong rtogs par gyur pa dang bstun nas/rdzogs chen yang gsang bla med nam mkha' sum phrug gi nyams su len thabs mdo don tsam bstan pa ste/'di la phyis byung gang zag gi blo rtogs dman pa'i ngag sgros kyis bsre slad ni med do/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/kho bo cag gis dal 'byor gyi rten thob cing bsod nams rnam par dag pas rdo rje sems dpa' dang gnyis su med pa'i bla ma dam pa rjes su bzungs/ rang gi skye ba du mar rdo rje theg pa'i lam la zhugs pa'i nus pas rgyud lung gi dgongs don rgya bod kyi shing rta chen po'i man ngag phyin ci ma log par go zhing myong ba gzugs brnyan tsam pa yang skyes/ des na bstan bcos mtha' dag la mi dpyad par 'jug cing ngag sgros gang yod bsdu ba zhig ma lags te/ rgyal ba'i lung bstan nges pa'i shing rta chen po rnams kyi rjes su 'brangs nas lam ma 'khyog par 'gro ba zhig yin mchi'o/ /rgyal kun bgrod gcig mthar thug rdo 197

rje theg /rtse mor gyur pa yang gsang rdzogs pa che/ /gang gi man ngag gnad gyur snying po 'di/ /bla ma'i mthu las tshe dbang nor bus te/ /dus snyigs 'di na yang gsang rdzogs chen tshul/ /ji bzhin bshad par nus 'di pad 'byung dang / /bi ma dri med 'od zer byin rlabs te/ /bsam bzhin bka' drin rnam kun 'gran zla bral/ /de skad rang dang skal mtshungs mos pa can/ /du mar sman pa'i slad du bris pa 'dir/ /nyes mchis 'phags gyur rig 'dzin bka' srung la/ /bzod gsol sgrib med dge legs su dbugs dbyung stsol/ /legs gyur dge bas 'gro kun lam mchog 'dir/ /'jug byas bla mar sangs rgyas dngos mthong zhing / /gdams pa nyams su blang nas tshe gcig la/ /sangs rgyas kun bzang ci bzhin mngon gyur shog /ces pa 'di ni gangs ri'i khrod kyi spyi yi 'dren pa mchog lag na pad dkar 'chang ba'i sgyu 'phrul gru 'dzin bdag po thams cad mkhyen pa chen po gang gi zhabs pad kyi rim gro pa rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi dge slong rnal 'byor spyod pa su ma dhī pad+ma shā sa na dha ra dang / i shwa ra dh+wa dza gang gi do gal chen pos bskul bas rkyen byas/ tshul 'di lta bu don gnyer ba dag la phan pa'i bsam pas/ mdo khams kaḥthog lho rgyud du lha yi rigs su skyes shing / gnas lnga cha tsam rig pa rdzogs chen gyi rnal 'byor tshe dbang nor bu dpal gyi rgya mtsho'i sdes/ nam mkha' gsum gyi man ngag dag gsal 'dus par me 'brug gro zhun zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi gang ba'i nya la khyab bdag rtsa ba'i bla ma dwangs ma'i mgon po pad+ma bde chen gling pa'i dus chen gyi skabs su gangs can dus 'gyur gyi g.yo ru'i cha grub chen thang stong rgyal po'i gdan sa dpal chen chu bo ri lcags zam bla brang garnyo la'i yang rtser bkod pa ste/ yi ge 'di rang gi lta grub mi 'dzin pa dang / khrid lung ma thob pa la mi bstan pa'i gsang rgya bya la/ rang gi rjes su 'jug pa rnams kyi gces par bya ba'i chos so/ /sngags kyi bdag mo snying zan rag gdong ma dang / gza' mchog rā hu la/ skyes bu rdo rje legs pas yi ge 'di bdag po gyis la nyams su len pa rnams kyi grogs mdzod cig /sa ma yaḥdha thimaḥdage'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /mchan/ de yang skyes bu'i rgyangs stabs su 'phangs zhes pa ni/ /nyams len byed rtsa na/ tsham tshom med par rkang pa gnyis shad kyis brkyangs/ lag gnyis sor mo ltag pa nas bsnol te rgyab tu 'phangs/ /mig blta stangs bcas nam mkha'i 'ben la zug 'gro bar byas te 'jog dgos/ /'di la lag khrid dgos pas gang byung du byas na nyen che'o/ /rgya na dharma sabha ni bsam gtan ngal gso'i chos bdun/ su ma dhī pad+ma shā sa na dha ra ni/ blo bzang pad+ma bstan 'dzin/ i shwa ra dh+wa dza ni/ rgyal mtshan dbang phyugabade chen gling pa ni/ rong ston lcags rna can no/ /maṅga lo/ /bdud 'joms pa'i nam mkha' sum phrug 'di dang gcig yin pas de la rgyu mtshan bzhi yod/ gcig dgongs brda dbyer med du byung ba/ 198

gnyis/ bla ma'i zhal gdams snyan brgyud yin gsungs pa ltar na khams mgo log phyogs su rig 'dzin chen po'i nam mkha' sum phrug 'di dar srol che bas bdud 'joms zhabs kyi bla ma rdza phu khang sprul sku nges don dbang po mchog gi thugs dam rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i 'di nyid yin nam/ gsum/chos rgyun la dgongs te bdud 'joms zhabs kyi rig 'dzin chen po'i gsungs la zhu dag mdzad de rang gi chos sder bcug pa yin nam/ bzhi/ rig 'dzin chen po'i gsungs 'dir mtshan byang zol yang ba'i ched du slob ma dag gis rje rig pa 'dzin pas mdzad ces pa tsam las med pa du ma yod pas de lta bu'i dpe zhig bdud 'joms pa'i chos brgyud 'dzin pa zhig gis rig 'dzin zhes pa bdud 'joms pa'i mtshan la 'khrul nas gsung gi nang du bcug pa gang yin ma nges pas dpyad 'tshal/ /spyir rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i gsung la kha bskong mdzad cing so so'i gsung 'bum du bzhugs pa du ma yod ste/dper na dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi khrid yig kong sprul zhabs kyis mdzad pa lta bu dang / snga phyi'i mkhas pa mang pos sangs rgyas gling pa'i dgongs 'dus kyi sgrub thabs rgyas bsdus sna tshogs pa la kha bskong mdzad de rang gis gsung 'bum la btsud pa mang po yod pas 'gal ba med do/ /'chan/ snyan brgyud ḍāk+ki'i gan mdzodaḥ rdo rje snying po'i skor lasaḥ don dam thig le ye shes kyi dgongs paḥ 'od gsal snang ba brjod paḥ rnal 'byor gyi rdo rje'i thol gluḥ zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥ a hoḥ rang rig chos sku ye snang ka dag gshisaḥ rang mdangs longs sku 'od gsal lhun grub gdangasaḥrang byung sprul sku rang shar rig pa'i rtsalaḥ rang rig bde chen chos nyid dbyings su mchodaḥ de gnyis gzhi snang ka nas dag pa laḥ rang rtsal ma 'gag bag chags ldan pa'i dusaḥ kun gzhi zhes de ma rig sangs pa'i tsheḥ don dam thig le ye shes rig par brjodaḥ zung 'jug kun rdzob thig le bcu drug chasaḥrig snang de shar ngo ma zin pa'i tsheḥ nyon mongs rags pa'i rtog pa zhes su byaḥ ngo zin rang gdangs 'od gsal bde bar sharaḥ don la rang rig gu yangs spros bral baḥ zang kha rjen ne bde sdug rang rtsal ngang ཿ dga' bzhi brjod med skad cig cer grol klong ཿ rig pa brjod med bde klong gcig tu 'dres/ /stong pa cham chad ma yin bde lhang ngeḥ bde ba ther zug ma yin stong sangs ngeḥ bde stong ro gcig 'od gsal dbyings su thimaḥ thim bya thim rgyu gud med 'di klong rolaḥ thabs shes dbyer med sku gsum sgrub kyi klong ཿ thabs ro ma/ shes rkyang ma/ gnyis med dbu ma/ sbub rtsa'o/ /don dam thig le ye shes 'od du 'khyilaḥ rang gdangs sku bzhi'i lam nas dbyings su thonaḥ rang rig stsol rtsod yongs bral rdo rje'i thegaḥnam mkha' gsum klong mngon sum dbyings su 'dresaḥ brjod tshig dpyod bral snod bcud 'byung lnga dang ཿ dug lnga dag lus yid brogs thams cad paḥ brogs pa bzang ngan rtog pa gcod pa la'o/ /rig pa 199

'od gsal bum pa'i klong las niḥ gud du btsal bral 'od gsal 'khor yug ngang ཿ ri rgyal rtse nas ri phran ltad mo bzhinaḥ brjod med ye shes 'od gsal klong yangs suḥ rig pa rang rtsal nor bu'i 'od bzhin duḥ dbyer med khyab brdal dbyings su e ma hoḥ de ltar don dam 'od gsal zung 'jug paḥrang rig mchog la chos nyid la bzla zhing ཿ rtsol med dbang por 'char ba rdzogs pa cheḥ nges don rang nyams ci bzhin thol glu steḥ rdo rje snying po 'di las gzhan ci zhigaḥ de bas snyan brgyud rin chen mdzod las niḥ nor bu mchog 'di lta bu blang byas teḥ gang shar rig pa'i gdangs las snang byas soḥ zhes ḍāk+ki'i zab lam gyi skor las don dam gyi bde ba rang rig 'od gsal gyi dgongs pa rang nyams mnyam bzhag ngang las sngags kyi rnal 'byor tshe dbang nor bu kun bzang 'od gsal gyis rang lo nyi shu tham pa rtsa gcig la 'pho ba'i skabs ri bo bya khyung gi mgul se'u dgon du bris pa'i yi ge'i rigs byed kyang pad+ma nor bu'i sprul sku tshe dbang nor bu rang nyid kyis bgyis pa'o/ /maṅga lo/gsang ba gnal lam skor gyi rnam thar/ 7sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa tshe dbang nor bu pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug bde chen nus ldan drag po rtsal gyi gsang ba'i rnam thar lags/ badz+ra gu ru bibyā dha ra dza ma yā tsar+ha mu la a gra na maḥ ye nas bdag 'dzin gyis 'khrul srid pa'i bar/ /yongs su phol mig ltar grub so so'i skye/ /rang snang dag pa'i rang ngo ma shes par/ /ma dag 'khrul mun 'thib pos rab g.yogs shing / /der snang zhen pas rab 'khyog rmi lam zhes/ /mi rtog gti mug bar 'thums pa la/ /rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i zer gyis rab dkrol nas/ /'di snang bden med sgyu ma chen po la/ /rtog bral chos dbyings ye shes rol pa'i klong / /'od gsal dbu ma'i sbubs su 'jug byas te/ /cir snang rang rig chos sku phyam brdal bar/ /'khor 'das mnyam nyid rang grol byin gyis rlobs/ /de yang bdag 'dra so skyes bla ma'i tshul/ /brdzus gyur sngags smyon tshe dbang nor bu bdag /ma rig srid pa'i 'khor lor las kyi ni/ /sha gzugs grub de'i nyin 'khrul mtshan snang du/ /shar gyur nyon mongs rang gzugs ston pa'i sde/ /brjod mi lang yang mdor bsdus thar thor gcig /'di ru bkod rung bdag sngon las bzang 'phro/ /da lta'i rim gnyis sbyangs sgoms med pas mthus/ /dag pa'i nyams rmi 'bri rgyu med lags kyang / /'on te rnyed dka' mtshan ldan bla ma mjal/ /zab gsang bla med phyag rdzogs chos sgor zhugs/ /chung nas dad dam mig 'bras ltar du bsrungs/ /nyams myongs med kyang chos tshul cung zad go/ /des na lam rtags gang zag dbang po'i khyad/ /rab 'bring dngos nyams yin kyang bdag 'dra ni/ /dbang dman tshad ma rmi lam bzung lags kyi/ /rmi lam bden med 'khrul ba yin zhes na/ /nyin snang 'di 'ang bden med 'khrul bar gsungs/ /rtogs pa'i tshe na bden bzung ga la yod/ /ma rtogs bar du rten 'brel thams cad bden/ /200

des na sgyu ma'i skyes bu sgyu ma'i 'khrul/ /yongs su bkod ltar rmi lam yid gzugs sogs/ /'di ru rdzun med drang bor bkod na'ang / /gzhan dag gis 'phya 'di la su zhig mgu/ /de yang bdag rigs lha ldan dkar po ru/ /skye med pha dang 'gyur med ma yi ming / /a dang rdo rje/bu ru dgung lo hasti sa stag mtshams/ /skyes te bags chags bzang po legs sad cing / /sidhi in+d+ra'i sprul bar zhal kyang 'ches/ /rtags su pad+ma'i gzugs brnyan legs 'jal zhing / /mig gi bdud rtsi 'od gsal 'phrul chen pos/ /byis pa'i skabs kun 'brel ba'i snang ba shar/ /lan gcig rang lo lnga tsam lon pa'i skabs/ /dngos 'dra'i nyams snang bud med gzugs 'chang zhing / /man ro dred 'dra gnyis kyis bdag bdas bred/ /'di ni sha za dha ki'i cho 'phrul go/ /de bzhin re zhig khro rgyal mgor sdod dus/ /lcags sreg lta bu'i ku ku zhig gi khar/ /ra ma khrag gi gzer bu thor bzung nas/ /bdag drung yang yang nyul mthong phur srung snyams/ /de nas rang lo bdun tsam lon pa'i skabs/ /stag 'u se'u lung du a ma'i rjes/ /song skabs nub gcig phyugs bsdu song ba na/ /dngos sam rmi lam yin snyam rtogs pas snyad/ /de nas bzung ste sgyu ma lta bu ru/ /dngos snang 'dzin zhen med par bun zhig ste/ /de nas smyo rgyu yin 'dug snyam nas zhed/ /deng bsam rtse gcig rnal 'byor skyes par 'dug /de nas bswo phyin rol lam ri khrod du/ /ru ba sdod skabs dgon du song ba'i nub/ /brag ri ngos bzang zhig logs gyen 'phur nas/ /song tshe bdag lus rjid yur theg ma thub/ /de tshe bdag drung bud med gcig 'dug des/ /khyod rang gu rur gsol ba drag thob dang / /rnam sprul yin pas thugs rjes bzung ngo zer/ /de yi phyi nub a phyi nged gnyis ni/ /song lam rdo ni sha wa'i rwa 'dra zhig /'dug pa a phyi'i reg nas 'di skad zer/ /'di yi nang du yid bzhin nor bu yod/ /smras byung bdag gis de bcag bsam pa la/ /ma gcog min pa dug sbrul 'ong ngo zer/ /de'i mod khang chung zhig nang slebs pa la/ /skyes bu rta nag zhon pa gsum byung bas/ /su yin smras pas 'di yin pi sha ci lha 'dre'i dpon te khral sdud byung ba yin/ /zhes zer bdag bred de mod bla ma rje/ /bzhugs 'dug de drung tshogs 'khor rdzas rol mod/ /sdong pa'i rgang der shing skyel dag slebs nas/ kha nas gtor chu zhal du skyugs song te/ /bla ma seng ldeng phur pa gyur rmi sad/ /'di brda da dung ma 'byed brtag par 'os/ /re zhig 'bum skyes zhes su sdod pa la/ /bram ze yin zhen rgan po ag tshom dkar/ /zhud can zhig gis na re bal yul du/ /ma yis bu gsod 'dug pa snying rje zer/ /ga/ na smras pas nga yis mig ltos zer/ /bltas pas rang nyid bal yul skyes pa'i tshul/ /gsal zhing rang nyid shin tu skyo bas sad/ /de nas rang lo brgyad pa tsam gyi skabs/ /khyi bswo zhes su ru ba sdod pa'i tshe/ /rang gi zhang po gter ston pa byon byung / /rjes su pha mas bshol bar ma thub 'brangs/ /yul der bsod 201

snyoms sgar btab bdag la'ang / /grwa ba re bcol bsod snyoms gyis zhes gnang / /re zhig lta zhes sgar btab sdod pa'i skabs/ /yul de'i gzhi bdag seng khrom yin zhes pa/ /skyes bu gzhon nu rta dkar ldan gcig byung / /bdag gi gnas su khyod nyid byon dgos zhes/ /khong gi rta de nga la bskyon de nas/ /lung khog dog mo zhig nang song ba'i phur/ /mkhar chen dgung la bsnyegs zhig 'dug nang phyin/ /bdag nyid khri la sdod bcol sngar gzhon nu/ /btsun rgan yig drug 'dren pa zhig tu song / /bdag la gro btang dga' gus dpag med byas/ /de mod phyir 'ong gong gi mkhar de g.yas/ khang bzang zhig 'dug blon po'i mkhar yin zhes/ /gzhon nu gzugs bzang mang pos 'gro zer kyang / /ma song phyi ru 'ong snyam rmi lam sad/ /nub gcig 'dre yi bdas pas drag sngags kyi/ /gzir bas klag lta ma nus phyir song rmis/ /de nas dgon du slebs nas nub gcig la/ /bdag gi rnga gcig zhon byas mkha' la lding / /lha yul yin zhes sa gzhi khod snyoms bde/ /gsal zhing bsil srod ran la bde gsal nyams/ /rang bzhin 'bol zhing nyams dga' tshal dbus der/ /khri chen steng du dge slong zhi dul sku/ /de g.yon lha dbang yin zhes rgyal po'i chas/ /dpung bcas 'dug pas bdag la dri thed mdzad/ /dge slong zhal ras ma gsal sku lus gsal/ /rang gi sgrib pa 'thug pas sgrib par go/ /dge slong ngo bo byams mgon yin nam sems/ /phyir 'ong skad cig mas thon bsam tshe sad/ /nub gcig khye'u gzhon nu'i lcags kyi ni/ /mda' gzhu 'chang bas mda' gzhu bdag la sbyin/ /bdag gi mda' gzhu lag bzung brag ri gcig /rgyab tu khur mis bla ma la zhus pas/ /ye shes mgon po'i cho 'phrul 'dug go gsungs/ /'di skabs bla mas bdag rgyud byin rlabs te/ /shugs 'byung tsam pa thar thor 'ga' yang shes/ /de nas a ma bsu byung ru ba ni/ /'brog gu zhes su 'dug pa der song ste/ /dgon la spro yang re zhig thabs ma rnyed/ /lan cig nya gu zhes par sdod pa'i skabs/ /mi lam za zi lta bur kun bzang nyid/ /sku yi mtshan ma bzung du med pa cig /lhang nger shar la rang sgra 'di skad thos/ /e ma ho kun bzang gzhan min rang rig snang la stong / /'khor 'das so sor ma 'dzin rang gi sems/ /gsung mod rkyen la brten nas mnal sad shor/ /kun bzang mjal ba'i rmi lam 'di 'dra ni/ /brjod par ma spobs rdzun du rtogs la gsang / /ngag 'chal bsags pa'i rgyu ru 'gyur bar go/ /'on te rang gi rdzun du yin re kan/ /nub gcig zang mdog dpal ri yin zhes pa/ /ri rtse na bun gyis g.yog brag dmar zangs/ /zhig 'dug 'di ru gu ru pad+ma ni/ /bzhugs zhes mjal 'gro sems nas song ba la/ /ri de'i mtha' mar chu chen zhig gis bskor/ /'dug pas ma thar de tshe sprin gseb nas/ /pad 'byung mtsho rgyal yin zhes gnyis byon nas/ /snyug spug zhig nang 'bru gcig bcug nas bcad/ /de yi mod sad brda de dpyad ma thub/ /nub gcig chu chen po drung bdag 'ga' zhig /202

'dug pa kun gyis pad rgyal byon no zhes/ /bltas pas ber phod dmar can bla ma byon/ /bdag cag rnams la phyag dbang gnang byung rmis/ /de nas rang lo bcu ba'i steng tsam der/ /pha ma rdzi bo spang nas bla ma'i drung / /dgon du sdod rtsis de skabs rmi lam du/ /brag ri ngam grog zhig nas thon rtsis pas/ /da dung btsan dang rgyal po'i bar chad yod/ /thos mod mnal sad de nas ba zur du/ /bla ma rnam gnyis bum sgrub mdzad sar phyin/ /nub gcig bka' brgyad drag sngags me dpung gis/ /yig 'bru cung zad ma tshang 'chos 'dod pa/ /'dug las me 'bar bdag lus tshig pa rmis/ /de nas phyir 'ong rol lam bla ma yi/ khang pa g.yar nas re zhig sdod pa'i tshe/ /nub gcig rmi lam tho rangs dag la ni/ /bud med sngo bsang nad rkyal thogs pa zhig/ /bar chad brtsams byung bdag nyid che mchog gi/ /nga rgyal gyis ni dum bur gtub byas mod/ /gang de'i ming po klu btsan yin zhes pa/ /mi dmar gzugs ni thang shing tsam 'dug pa/ /dam btags spyi bor gleg bam bzhag pa mis/ /de bzhin nub gcig rta sngon bzhon pa yi/ /skyes bu gcig byung gnod pa byed grab la/ /bdas nas snying blang zos te khyod su yin/ /smras pas bdag ni gdengs kar dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /klu btsan yin zer dam la bzhag pa rmis/ /nub gcig rta dkar la zhon skyes bu gcig /ral gri thogs 'khros bdag la bdeg brtsam tshe/ /bdag nyid lha yi nga rgyal gcig bskyed pas/ /mi de khros pa zhi nas rtar babs te/ /bdag ni lha yi gnod sbyin drag shul can/ /gcig yin bstan pa srung la brtson pa lags/ /khyod kyis dus chen rnams su bskang gso 'bung / /bdag gis khyod la sdong grogs byed do zer/ /ngas smras khyod mtshan 'khor g.yog du tsam yod/ /byas pas nga la sde tshan bzhi yod de/ /bdag ni gtso bo nyid dang dbye ba med/ /dus mtshan ma zhes ming brjod mi rung yod/ /gzhan yang gnod sbyin gza' btsan dregs pa mang / /zer mod mnal sad 'di ni bstan srung cig /bdag gi ting 'dzin drod tshun nyul bar go/ /chos skyong gang yin da dung dbye ma thub/ /res zhig skyes bu sol ba'i rta zhon pa/ /mang byung khyed rnams su yin smras pa la/ /nged rnams dgong po yin la dbus gtsang du/ /bdag gi grogs 'ga' sngags pa tshos mnan pa/ /da res lha bzang gis byung bros thal zer/ /nga yis lhar bskyed phyag mtshan gyis bsdig pas/ /rlung nag 'tshub mar gyur nas shar phyogs su/ /bros thal rmi zhing sad tsa sems ma bde/ /de ni 'gong po'i bod khams dkrugs par go/ /'di'i dpe da snga thob tshad bsdur ba yin la kha shas 'phro can byas 'dug la kha shas la ldebs grangs bcas 'di rdzogs pa yin pa'i tshul bris 'dug pas dpyad 'tshal/203

tshog /ma bcos gnyug ma'i zog po ming gi bla btags rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'i 'khrul snang rdzun gyi ri mo cha shas tsam bkod pa smig rgyu'i chu bo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo ma hā gu ru mu la pad+ma sam+bha wa/ mtshungs med sangs rgyas rgyal dbang pad+ma 'byung / /gsang bdag bde chen dbyings bdag mtsho rgyal ma/ /rigs 'dus thugs kyi rdo rje bde chen gling / /rtsa ba'i bla mar gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yang sngags 'chang zol 'dzin rmongs rgan bdag /tha mal rigs skyes thos bsam sgom pa dben/ /nyon mongs rags cing sngon las ma dag 'thug /yang nan dkor sgrib bag chags ngan pas g.yogs/ /'khrul tshab che zhing mi dge'i las kyang bsags/ /pho zob g.yo sgyu chos brgyad shugs kyi tshangs/ /khe grags lo 'dod skyid 'dod rab tu dga'/ /bag med btang snyoms stobs che sdom kyang lhod/ /des na rang gi spyod la rang bltas pas/ /nges par bdud kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'am/ /dge zad dmyal bar 'gro ba'i rigs cig ni/ /yin snyam rang nyid yang yang sems gyur mod/ /'on kyang sar gnas sems dpa' rdo rje 'dzin/ /dam pa mang mjal smin grol gdams pa mnos/ /las can skyes bur dbugs dbyungs thugs sras bzung / /dam sel skyon med bdag rkyen khyad 'phags gnang / /de la dpag na rang gi sems rgyud la/ /stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug rten 'brel gnad/ /ma nor ma 'chug mang po rgyud la 'char/ /chos tshul rang rdol shes rab 'ga' yang rgyas/ /dka' ba'i gnad gyur 'ga' yi don kyang rtogs/ /dad mos gus pa 'gyur med rab tu brtan/ /sems rgyud sdig pa'i las la cher ram 'bags/ /chos min gzhan mgo ma g.yogs drang bor bsrong / /des na da lta bdag la yon tan cha/ /med rung skye sngon las 'phro dam chos la/ /bzhag pa zhig gi byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ /srid mtha' ma bkag tsam du 'gyur ram snyam/ /de tshe rang gi tshe 'dir legs nyes kyi/ /'jug sgo nyid las zab dang rgya che ba'i/ /dag snang mos gus med rung 'khrul ba yi/ /'khrul snang dpyad dngos nyams dang mi lam gyi//shar tshul zhar byung gsang bar 'os pa'i skor/ /'ga' bcas tho tsam rdzun med nyid bri na/ /bla ma lha dang dhā kis yongs gnang zhing / /bar chad nyes bral dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /zhes phyag 'tshal ba dang bshad par dam bca' sngon du btang nas/ /de yang rmongs las ches rmongs pa'i gti rgan don med ming dang ldan pa'i bla gzugs bdag 'dra'i 'khrul snang kha 'khyal gyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba'i tshul las 204

spyad rabs cung zad cig smra na/ /sngon gyi gnas dang phyi ma'i tshul rnams ni gsal bar brjod pa rngo ma thogs shing / cha shas ni gzhan du brjod par 'gyur la/ tshe 'dir yang sngon gyi las 'phro smon lam gyi mthus kun bzang rdo rje sems dpa' dang zhal mi gnyis pa'i bla ma mchog rnams kyi rjes su bzung nas smin grol gyi gdams pa thos shing byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma cung zad rnyed pa/ yi dam gyi lha'i zhal yang yud tsam yud tsam mthong ba dang / mkha' 'gro chos skyong yang 'du zhing sdong grogs kyi mtshan ma mngon gyur ji snyed pa thob par gyur pa yongs su smra ba'i go skabs ni med kyang cha tsam slad mar bri ba yang srid la/ 'dir rang gi snang tshul 'ga' zhig gis bskul ba po'i ngo dang / dgos don phran bu yang mchis pas bkod la/ de yang bde gshegs snying pos khyab pa'i rnam shes dge 'bras thob pa bar dor srid 'tshol ba zhig sprul gzhi gang yin pa de'i byin gyis brlabs nas da lta'i lus 'di grub pa snyam byed cing / /skye ba du mar rdo rje theg pa'i lam la mos pas spyod pa'i bag chags ni sad rgyu nges pas 'grub/ rten 'di'i snga mar gu ru pad+ma badz+ra gyis dngos nyams rmi lam du mar rjes su yang dag par bzung ba dang / /rdo rje slob dpon chen po ho ru ka'i go 'phang la mngon sum du reg pa su ga ta sa mā dza so kra ma yis dbang bskur zhing de kho na nyid mngon par byas pa byis pa'i dus su shin tu gsal bar yid la 'char bas rdo rje slob dpon de dang tshe 'di'i rtsa ba'i bla ma tha mi dad par shes pas de'i chos rgyud la mos zhen chen po ka bdog la/ chung ngu'i skabs su des rjes su bzung ba'i ltas ci rigs pa'ang mngon zhes mngon gyi tshul las cung zad tsam gleng bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang skye ba snga ma'i yang snga ma gang rung zhig gi las kyi bcom ldan 'das dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i dbang bskur skabs su dge mtshan mthong zhing bskyed rdzogs la yang go ba bzang po chags pa dang / dpal che mchog la yang de dang cha mthun tsam pa byung la/ /'jam dpal dkar po/ dbyangs can ma dmar mo/ mi g.yo dkar po rnams yang skye sngon yi dam du byas pa'i mtshan ma cung zad re mthong / rgyal ba'i bstan srung chen por skur bstan pa ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug mgon po bram gzugs/ zhing skyong seṅge nag po/ dbyings kyi ma mo ral pa gcig ma/ drang srong chen po rnams rab tu nye ba'i ltas shar yang skye ba snga ma'i las 'bras su go/ /ci yang lo bcu gnyis tsam man chad du dngos snang thams cad sgyu ma lta bu bden 'dzin med pa dang / skabs 'gar gzhan rgyud la wal wal shes shing / 'dun pa gtad tsam nas rmi lam rgyun mi chad par zin pa lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos lha 'dre dregs pa can rnams dam la btags pa'i snang ba mang du byung / phyis pad+ma nor bu'i sprul sku yin min cha med kyang ming btags pa'i rjes su 'brangs te gdan sa'i khungs ri bkrar slebs nas bzung rim gyis gzhan rgyud shes pa ni lta ci smos rang gi gnas skabs kyi dpyad pa thig po tsam yang 'grab cing nyin 205

mtshan 'khrul pa rgya 'byams rnam g.yengs kyi 'khor los dam pa'i chos dang rgyab gyes su gyur pa 'di ka gyur song / 'on kyang skye ba snga ma'i las 'bras bzang po yongs su 'doms pa'i rgyal kun 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs dran mchog srog gi dwangs ma dpal bde ba chen po dang karma rig pa 'dzin pa ste rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam gnyis kyi thugs rjes bzung mthus yon tan cha shas tsam bdog 'di'o/ /gzhan o rgyan pad+ma'i zab gter mchog la spyod par lha dang bla ma mkha' 'gros mgrin gcig tu dbugs dbyung kyang gdan sa'i rgyun srol gyis gzhan don gtso bo yul mi 'khrugs bsdum/ /grong chog sogs kyi bya bas lo shas dus 'da' pas dus de dang der gter sgrub sogs phyis rten 'brel ci bzhin ma byung ste bya ba chung ngu phran tshegs kyis bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che de bshol song nas lus pa da lta yan chad 'di yin no/ /zhes gnas tshul spyi don du gleng nas thor bu 'ga' zhig brjod na/ rang lo nyer gcig sne zin skabs byed cing rten 'brel gyi gnad dang / bla ma'i byin rlabs kyi de bzhin nyid kyi rtogs pa cha shas ngo 'phrod cing snang nyams shes nyams 'jigs pa la ya mtshan mang du byung yang ut+ta ra bi muk+tor gnas nyi ma phug tu bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi dbang lung tho re tsam zhig mnos/ de skabs nub gcig mig sman ltar gnag pa'i shugs 'chang gi stegs la bsdad nas gyen zhig tu phyin pa'i lam du dgon sde rnying pa lta bu skya ham zhig 'dug pa'i nang nas yid du mi 'ong pa'i btsun gzugs/ bud med/ zha bo/ long pa/ sprang po/hral hrul gos can mang po zhig thon byung ba la bdag gi zhu snang ba bud med cig 'dug pa des 'di rnams 'gong po spun dgu yin pas dam la thogs ces bskul bas dpal chen po nag po rta skad can gyi snyems pa dang bcas lag tu glegs bam zhig 'dug pa de rnams kyi spyi bor bkod nas dam tshig la bkod pa'i bden stobs drag pos gcun pas de rnams kyi bka' las mi 'da' bar khas blangs shing srog snying phul ba ni/ ya tri dzaḥ ya tri dzaḥ ma tri dzaḥ ma tri dzaḥ ma khu tri dzaḥ ma khu tri dzaḥ tri dzaḥ tri dzaḥ bram dzaḥ bram dzaḥ zhes phul ba'i mthar rmi lam sad/ rang lo nyer gnyis pa'i skabs shin tu ting rir rig 'dzin pad+ma dbang rgyal la gtum mo'i khrid 'bul skabs nub cig rje btsun ma dza ya mu tra lta bu'i rigs sngags 'chang ba zhig gis nye ba'i mgon po seṅge nag po'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur gnang ba'i 'jug pa'i skabs rigs pa'i me tog lhor bab song bas khri la dbang par lung bstan zhing gsang mtshan pad+ma stobs ldan rtsal du btags pa rmis so/ /lo de nyid kyi dbyar dus brtsen du yod skabs 'od gsal dang 'dres pa'i rmi lam zhig tu gnas gtsang kha gro lod lta bur phyin pa'i snang ba shar zhing / der skyes bu bse rmog bse khrab can g.yas zangs gri dang g.yon bswe phub bzung ba lus rlung nag 'tshub ma 'khrigs pa'i dkyil du gnas pa des srog gi snying po phul ba ni/ tsa tri tsa triḥ tsa mun tri 206

shu laḥ zhes dang gsang mtshan bshad tsa na ma rdzogs par nyams yal lo/ /yang rang lo nyer gsum pa'i sne son skabs/ ci rong zal dgon du mgo nad drag po zhig gis rab tu gzir tshe rgyal 'gong gdug pa can de bla ma rang byung chas ldan du brdzus byung ba la bdag che mchog rdo rje gro lod kyi ca rgyal brtan pos rdo rjes kho'i lus zang thal du khrol tshag ltar ma gyur bar bsnun pas/ phyag 'tshal zhing dam las mi 'da' khas blang bro bor bar gyur/ de nas bdag gis 'di skad dris te/ /bdag nad 'di las thar ram/nad 'di'i rgyu gang yin dris smras pas/ /kho na re/ gson dang rig 'dzin dam pa lags/ /nad 'di'i rgyu ni srung ma yis/ /'khu ldog dag dang khyad par du/ /grib can bud med phyag rgya ru/ /brten pas mkha' 'gro ma dgyes nas/ /'byung bzhi 'khrugs pa'i nad du shar/ /da res 'chi rkyen mi yongs te/ /rim grol mkha' 'gro'i grib sel gtses/ /zhes zer/ yang dris pa/ deng dus kha cig gis rgyal po pe har sangs rgyas tshwar zer ba bden nam byas pas/ chos 'khor rgyal po pe ha ra/ /da lta bsam yas sgyugs drung na/ /o rgyan yul la kha bsgyur te/ /'dug mod sangs rgyas ga la zer/ /sum cu'i lo'am sum brgya'i mtshams/ /bsam yas me yis bshigs te 'gro/ /de nas pe har rgyal po yang / /o rgyan gtsug lag khang du 'gro/ /zhes zer/ yang dris pa/ rgyal po pe har lkorgyan chen po'i drung du dge bsnyen bsgrub nas 'gro ba la gnod 'tshe spangs bar dam bcas pa dang sa brgyad kyi byang chub sems dpa' yin par grags tshe sems can spyi dang chos mdzad rnams la 'tshe don yod dam/ 'khor bdug pa can gyis 'tshe bar byed pa gtso bos shes sam byas pa'i lan du/ /rgyal po 'khor 'das sa mtshams nas/ /kho rang chos bzhin spyod pa la//gnod 'tshe chen po mi bskyal yang / /kho yis sems la ci 'gyu ba/ /phan gnod thams cad sprul pas bsgrub/ /gtso bo'i thugs la gang dgongs te/ /'khor gyis thogs med brtson pa yin/ /des na phal cher khong gis shes/ /bdag ni rgyal phran tshul du ni/ /rgyal po chen po'i sprul ba yi/ /zhes zer/ gzhan lkog gyur gyi gnad 'ga' re dris pa'i lan yang brjod byung rung / /la la ni sne zur thag thug 'gro 'gro 'dug pas mi brjod la/ 'ga' zhig ni yun ring bas brjed song / mthar phaṭa drag po brjod pa dang kho shar phyogs su song snyam pa'i ngang la sad/ yang skabs der nyams kyi 'od gsal khral khrol 'dres pa'i snang ba zhig tu sta ma ste'u so kho skyes bu lang tsho dar la bab pa rin po che'i brgyan du mas spras pa rta ngang ser la zhon pa cig dang bud med g.yu g.yu'i rgyan cha can cig kyang byung nas de dang lhan du bdag kyang kho bo'i gnas su 'gro ba la dro zhing 'jam la rab tu yangs pa zla zhun ltar dkar ba'i gos sprad byung ba bgos nas song ba'i lam du 'byung po khra bar yin zhes zhub chen rta zhon mang byung bas gtso bo des stu ma ste'u so mthong ba tshe lam der kha spubs su nyal nas lus gnad du bting ba mthong / de nas bdag cag mtsho 207

chung zhig gi khar g.yu'i them skas sgrigs su yod pa'i mdun du slebs te khos gus pa'i zhe sa phul nas o rgyan chen po'i zab gter nyi shu rtsa lnga'i lde'u mig gnyer gtad bka' yi bsrung mar bskos tshul dang /gsang ba'i mtshan rdo rje 'gyur med rtsal yin zhes skad pa dang / gzhan yang 'phros gleng 'ga' re byung smos na gzhan la gnod dogs re zhig 'dir ma bris/ /spyir yul lha 'di gzhan dang mi mtshungs par che ba'i dregs pa can zhig tu gda'o/ /yang chu stag lor la stag yul se'u lung du chos khrid 'chad skabs/nub gcig tho rangs khar thog mar bla ma gzhan zhig dang mthar smin gling gi zhal ngo 'dra ba dpon g.yog mang du byung bar bdag chen mchog rdo rje gro lod kyi nga rgyal brtan pos de dpon g.yog gi nang du thal gyis phyin nas gtso bo'i skra la bzung bas badhe gzhon nu rid pa gcig tu gyur te phyag 'tshal bar bdag gis smras pa/ khyod ming gang yin/ srog sngags gang yin/ gnas gang yin/ las ci nus/ 'khor gang yin shod cig byas pas/ kho na re/ bdag ni chos skyong gi 'gab 'dre byed pa'i rgyal po shelu ging dkar po yin/ srog sngags ni/ tri ra tsa ging ka raḥ gnas yul khams kun tu nges pa med/ las chos skyong gi sna 'dren byas nas dgra bo sgrol ba la rno/ 'khor ni 'gong po dang yul lha rnams yang grogs 'khor sdong zla byed pa lags zer/ yang kho bos/ deng nas spyi dang khyad par bdag gi rigs chos kyi rjes su 'jug pa la bar chad mi byed cing sdong grogs byed par bro bor cig smras pas khos kyang de ltar byed pa badz+ra na ra kan gyi bra bor/ slar yang dmod pa mang pos gcun zhing dam pa bzhag pa'i mthar yal song //snga sor sa khyi la me long dgon du phyin skabs dkor bdag chen pos gtag stong 'bru gnyis gnyis khrag las grub pa g.yo 'dar can phu la yin rung rgyud mi gcig pa yin nam yang yang dam la 'dogs dgos pa bka' byung / chu stag lo mjug der ba khrod kyi dkor bdag gdug pa can yang dam la bzhag mchas/chu yos lor kaḥthog gi nged dam can khang nyid du skyes bu chen po'i spyi bor dam tshig rdo rje bkod cing ljags la a mṛ ta'i chu bzhag nas dam tshig bsres pa ste chos rgyun la 'go bar 'gyur snyam/ shing sbrul lor spu bo brag skas rdzong gi sgo srung shin tu mi bsrun pa'i mgron thang bdud de nyid 'gro ba la rab tu 'tshe bar thos tshe ting nge 'dzin gyis bcun pas kho'i rang gzugs khyi nag gdong dkar zhig tu bstan nas srog snying phu byung ba la/ phyis kho bo'i gnas su phyin nas gcun nas pas slar yang srog snying gdong gsol du phul ba ni/ ma ra du tri dza hu lu hu lu rgyu phaṭaḥ zhes so/ /gzhan yang brtags chags kyi lha 'dre phyi nang gi dregs pa mang pos gus pa'i zhe sa gsol ba dang / srog gi snying po phul ba zhing 'phrin las sgrub par khas blang pa ni dus rtag tu 'byung 'dug rung / de la dga' brod dang snyems pa sogs cher 'jug tu med pa sgyu ma lta bur shes pa bzhin lags shing yongs su brjod pa'i dgos pa cher ma mthong 208

lags/ 'ga' dang 'ga'i sdig bsogs pa'i rgyu ru yang 'gyur bar dogs pas brjod par ma byas so/ /'on kyang de skad cha shes gleng 'di yang / rang nyid che dang gzhan la 'gran 'dod min/ /ma byung byung dang ma mthong mthong ngo zhes/ /mi chos bla ma'i brdzun gyi yongs ma gos/ /des na bden brjod ngang tshul phran 'di'i kyang / /zag zog brdzun gyis 'phreng ba spel ba'i gtam/ /glegs bam chen por long pa thams cad kyang / /nyi ma'i 'od kyis me khyer bzhin du byas/ bla ma'i drin gyis sems nyid ngo mthong pas chos kun sgyu 'dra 'di snang zhen chen med/ /rjes dpag gtam la bden rdzun gtam 'dres pa'i/ /nyes yod srid na bla ma lha la bshags/ /cal col mu cor tshig gi skyon med pas/ /nongs pa ma mchis dge tshogs 'gro la bsngo/ /zhes rang nyid kyi snying gi bu las smon rnam par dag cig rdo rje slob dpon la sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba'i dad mos dam tshig mchog dang ldan pa gser bzang sprul pa'i sku pad+ma 'gyur med nor bu dang / mdo khams pa o rgyan 'phrin las bstan 'dzin zung gis bskul ngo ma lcogs tsam cha shas 'di ni mnga' ris glo bo sa'i thig le smon thang rgyal po'i khab dang nye ba bsam 'grub spug du sa bya lor zla bcu pa'i tshes bzang por tshe dbang nor bu rang nyid kyi rgyus rang gis gleng par byas pa'i yig ris ni bskul ba po sprul sku 'phrin las bstan 'dzin gyis bgyis so/ /shur+ghaṃ/ 209

dze /rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'i rang myong thun mong ma yin pa gsang ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa bag chags yid kyi rang gzugs gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ su ste sirnyi rastu/ dngos grub thams cad kyi 'byung gnas dpal rdo rje slob dpon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir gtad med smyon pa tshe dbang nor bu sla chos dang 'grog pa'i gtam/ sgyu ma ji bzhin rang myong ji bzhin pa re zhig bar tu yig ches par yang rung ba zhig brjod par bya ste/ de yang 'khor ba thog ma med pa'i dus nas ma rig pa'i las dbang gis 'khor ba'i 'khrul 'khor snang duḥkha drag po mnar bzhin pa las/ bdag gi rnam par shes pa dam pa'i rkyen la rten khams kyi nus pa phra'u sad pa'i ngang tshul cung zad zhig gleng na/ de yang skye ba'i phreng ba ji lta ba ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang 'phags pa'i skyes bu rnams las bdag lta mos spyod la gnas pa zhig gis rngo ci phyir thog /'on kyang 'ol spyi tsam zhig la brten/ bdag gi sems kyi rgyun 'di sngags rnying lugs kyi rgya bod kyi rig 'dzin brgyad dang grub chen brgyad du grags pa'i ya gyal thugs kyi rig 'dzin r+ghaṃḥka ra dang / grub chen gnub ban nam snying gi sprul pa yin zhes gu ru pad+ma'i gter lung rtsod bral rnams nas bstan mod/ de ltar na yang rang nyid kyi blo la ni des byin gyis brlabs pa tsam la sprul pa'i tha snyad du khas blang bar bya/ des na byin gyis brlabs pa po de nyid sprul gzhi'i tshul du ngos 'dzin te/ de yang slob dpon r+ghaṃ ཿka ra dang nam snying gnyis thugs rgyud gcig pa las skye ba rim can lta bu ni ma yin gyis dus mtshungs par ma zad r+ghaṃḥkar gyi slob ma nam snying yin/ nam snying sprul gzhi ni dpa' bo thugs kyi rdo rje zhes bya ba ste/ don kyi gsang ba'i bdag po jo bo gcig cing / gnas skabs su rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dngos kyi slob ma o rgyan gyi rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti gsang ba'i bdag por gyur ba de yin la/ de nyid bzhugs pa'i gnas ni 'og min chos dbyings pho brang me ri 'bar ba'i dur khrod na yin pas kun na snang ba'o/ /bye brag deng sang rgya bal phal gyis dza ga ba zhes bya la/ legs par sbyar bas o ḍi yā na dang zur chag gi or yan dang / o rgyan du 'bod pa'i yul de mi yi mthun snang du ma kha dang nye ba'i yul zla phyed kyi lam gru gsum gyi lung ba can la/ mi ma yin pa'i mkha' 'gro 'byung po phal gyi snang ngor bde ba can dang phyogs 'dra ba'i dpag tshad bye ba 'bum gru gsum pa'i dbus der/ bsti gnas dpag tshad 'bum phrag gsum dang / pho brang dpag tshad stong dang /snying po'i dkyil 'khor dpag tshad brgyar yod pa de na bzhugs pa ste/ rdo rje sems dpa' ho ru ka'am 210

pad+ma badz+ra yang pho brang de na bzhugs la don gyis dgongs pa yang gcig pa nyid do/ /de ni rig sngags 'dzin pa'i gnas mkha' spyod kyi zhing zhes sprul sku'i zhing mchog gyur rnams dang rjes mthun pa yin la/mi yi lo kar 'gro don mdzad pa mang po zhig de nas byon pa ste/ rje btsun sgrol ba'i mgon po yang rang nyid kyi gsang ba'i rnam thar du o rgyan gyi zhing gi bkod pa 'di kho na ltar gsung zhing / dbus kyi pho brang gi phyi rol shar lho na lcam dpal mdzad ma la 'khor phrag khrig bcu gnyis yod pa'i nang nang 'khor gser gyi rigs can ma'i dpa' bo biṇ+ḍa rā dza (khyab 'jug rgyal po )zhes rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa la brnyes pa de yi skye bar zhal gyi bzhes la/ gzhan yang rnying ma'i gter ston shas che ba zhig kyang de nas yin la/mngon gyur du ma dang lkog gyur bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod/ bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / chos 'brel yod pa'i bla ma kha shas kyang zhing de nas 'gro don du byon par rtogs/ /de ltar gnas de yi gtso bo gsang bdag thugs kyi rdo rje yi sprul pa dpal nam mkha'i snying po yin par rta mchog gsang ba rdzogs pa chen po 'khor 'das rang grol gyi rgyud du bshad pa bzhin byin gyis brlabs pa'i sprul gzhi yin gyi/gzhan la la na rgyal ba pad+ma ka ra'i thugs kyi sprul par 'dod pa'ang gong du bshad pa dang dgos don gcig pa'o/ /gzhan yang gter lung 'ga' na/ sangs rgyas kyi nyan thos dgra bcom chen po nye bar 'khor dang / theg chen gyi slob dpon 'dul 'dzin yon tan 'od dang / rgyal ba'i sras shan+ta de wi sogs dpal chen po nam mkha'i snying po'i skye rgyud du gsungs mod/ skye phreng dngos yin nam thugs rgyud gcig pa la dgongs bdag gis bsam par ma nus la/ sprul gzhi gtso bo ni gong du bshad pa nyid do/ /dpal nam mkha'i snying po'i thugs rgyud kyi skye ba snga ma dngos ni rgya gar nam mkha' rdo rje bya bar gyur cing / de la slob dpon pad+ma ma ku ta yi brag phug tu phyi yi dbang bskur gnang bar bshad do/ /nam snying gi sku lus rten de/ ka gdul bya'i ngor yun ring bar bzhugs shing / mthar mchog gi dngos grub ci bzhin pa 'phags lam zung 'jug rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang sku las des brnyes par mdzad/ des na 'phags pa'i go 'phang brnyes pa'i sprul ba ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang 'phags pa nyid las gzhan su zhig gis shes nus/ 'on kyang zur tsam zhig ni rig 'dzin snga ma'i lung ltar na/ zur chung shes rab grags pa/ dwags po sgom tshul/ lha ri nam mkha' 'od/ gnub lo tsā ba byams pa dpal/ thang dbon grags pa dpal/ gzho lung kun rin pa dang / de bzhin zla ban gzi 'bar/ grwa ba badz+ra/ rnal 'byor tsa ri/ rig pa 'dzin pa e ma sogs yongs su grags pa dang ma grags pa ci rigs rgyun mi chad pa byung mod/ /gzhan yang sa skya bzang po dpal/ kaḥthog tshul khrims 'bum/ 'bras yul skyed tshal gyi kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel/ /bdag smyon kun legs sogs kha shas ni bla ma gong mar rig 'dzin nus ldan 211

rdo rje'i ngos 'dzin gnang 'dug pa de ltar yang yin la/ de bzhin kaḥthog gi gong ma mchog zhig dang /shangs pa'i rgyud 'dzin dam pa zhig kyang gong mas khas len mdzad pas rgyud gcig par ni sems so/ /de rnams thog mtshungs pa dang bla slob tu gyur pa ci rigs par snang bas na don la rgyud gcig pa dang de dang des byin gyis brlabs pa la yang yang dgongs pas skye ba dngos brgyud yin min ci rigs par mngon/ gzhan khungs thub gter lung du mar skye 'phreng bgrang 'os pa mang du snang yang mtha' dag 'bri dgos rigs kyang mi 'dug lags/ 'dir ni rang rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa po dang 'brel ba'i snying po kho na mdor smos pa yin no/ /nged kyi yid ngor snang ba ni 'di ltar te/ nam mkha'i snying po'i skye sprul min yang byin gyi brlabs pa'i nus pa zhig yin te 'ong / chung ngu nas da lta'i bar de yi bag chags yad yud zhig nges par shar/gzhan go rim snga phyi ma nges par rgya gar shar phyogs kyi ljongs zhig tu sdig spyod kyi rgyal por skyes pa nang pa'i grub thob zhig gis de las bzlog nas rgyal ba'i bstan la gus pas mchod pa dang / yang grub thob chen po la li ta badz+ra gyi skabs su sngags 'chang ma nus pa che ba zhig tu skyes pa grub chen gyi tshogs kyi gzung mar sngags kyis bkug nas las kyi phyag rgyar byas shing byin gyis brlabs pas da lta rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud la mos shing bag chags sad pa dang / in+d+ra bhu ti chung ba'i slob ma kam bha la zhes mkha' 'gro ni gu ma yi bla mar gyur pa des rjes su bzung ba'i lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram tu tshong dpon gyi rigs la byung ba'i rnal 'byor pa zhig tu gyur pa dang / bal yul ye rang du skyes pa'i ma rgyud chos kyi bdag po dza ya se nar (rgyal ba'i sde )gyur pa yang dran/ bod du yang gong du smos pa rnams ni gu ru pad+ma'i lung gi bstan pa ste/ de dag gi grwal nas yud yul snang ba re re tsam byung ba ni der zad/ gzhan yang gu ru chos dbang rin po che'i slob ma ma ṇi rin chen yin snyam wal wal dang / gzhan chung ngu'i dus shig tu karma pa rang byung zhabs dang / zhwa dmar grags seng gi slob ma ri khrod dar rgyas su grags pa bag chags de gsal byung zhing / de dang dus mtshungs par kun mkhyen dol po ba'i slob ma sa bzang ma ti (blo gros rgyal mtshan )paṇa chen du skyes pa yang yad yud du dran pa dus phyis su byung ba de gnyis rgyud gcig par khas blangs/ de bzhin kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel dang dus 'ol spyir mtshungs pa'i shangs pa bsod nams mchog gyur zhes 'jigs med gsang ba sbyin gyi slob ma de yang yin snyam byed/ dpal khud bya mang po'i gter ston byang chub gling pa yin par lung las gsung ba ltar rjes dpag lta bu ci rigs dang /kong yul snying phur gter ston byang chub gling pa'i gdung gyur sangs rgyas blo gros zhes dpal rta mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa de re gsal dran yang dge lugs kyi dge bshes chen po snar thang gi mkhan po 212

bzod pa dpal grub bya bar skyes pa dang / khyad par jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha (sgrol ba'i mgon po )yi slob ma'i thu bo gting skyes rgyal po'i sras dzñā na sā ka rar ('jam dbyangs ye shes rgya mtsho )skyes pa gsal bor dran pas/ de yi grub mtha' la dga' tshor shin tu che zhing mi phyed pa'i dad pas bstan par lhag par sems pa'i rgyu yang de kas yin/ rang re'i skye ba dran tshad cig la bag chags der 'thug par gda'/ rje ye shes rgya mtsho ba de/ brag dkar sems dpa' chen po bsod nams rin chen pa yin par rje btsun sgrol mgon gyi ngos bzung zhing / kho rang gi khas len yang gnang 'dug pas/ de ltar na grol mchog zhabs dang rje btsun sgrol mgon te sku skye snga phyi gnyis ka'i rtogs brjod du brag dkar sems dpa' chen po dang thug rgyud gcig par zhal gyis bzhes pas/ de na rje btsun tā ra nā tha dang thugs rgyud gcig cing slob dpon chen po nag po spyod pas kyang byin gyis brlabs par mngon no/ /mdo khams kaḥthog dang nye bar 'khrul zhing rang grol dbang drag rgya mtsho dang / gter ston rat+na gling ba'i gdung las kun dga' bstan 'dzin du grags pa de yang rgyud gcig tu khas blangs/ yang dbus pa pad+ma kun skyong gling pa'i sras nyi zla bzang po yang yin par 'dod/ skye ba'i phreng ba de dag la chung ngu'i dus su dran pa dang / la la phyis su sad byed kyi rkyen la brten nas dran pa yang mang du byung mod/ /gzhan yang rgya gar/ rgya nag li bal rnams su/ rgyal blon/ bud med/ rigs ngan/ ri khrod pa sogs ci rigs skyes pa dang / de bzhin byol song sogs dang / dmyal ba yi dwags rnams kyi lus blang zhing du kha yis mnar ba yang mang du dran mod kyang 'dir ma smos/ bdag chung du smra shes tsam nas rig 'dzin pad+ma ma ṇi yin pa yang yang smras shing grags 'dug pas/ de ka yin pa yang khas blang du rung mod/ gzhan mthu stobs chen por grags pa warnyi bi dza ya (rnam rgyal )yang yin snyam byed/ gang ltar yang rang thog mtshungs pa'i snyan grags chen po dang ldan pa khams pa sku skye zhes/ ngag dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin pa yang bdag dang rgyud gcig par khas blangs kyi/ des na khong gi sprul gzhi yang nam mkha'i snying por gcig de bzhin rgya gar gyi lho 'gro lding gi gling na/ rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i sku yi skye ba dngos yin pa/ su kha nā tha (bde ba'i mgon po )bya ba'i slob ma tsi kra nā tha (sna tshogs mgon po )bya ba zhig nged dang rgyud gcig par yod/gzhan yang / rgyal po/ dge bshes/ sngags kyi rnal 'byor gyi gzugs su byas pa yang yod mod kyi/ zhib par brjod ma btub/ sngon rig 'dzin pad+ma ma ṇi'i skabs su/ de dang rgyud gcig pa'i stod ta stag gzigs kyi ma kha'i yul na jing gi mi gan zhes rgyal po dang / 'bras ljongs kyi phyogs su mon gyi ling pa'i tshul dang / lha ldan du bud med mjo yi gdung ba'i tshul can du yod gsungs pa ltar/ da lta yang zhang zhung gi yul mthar mon gyi ling pa dang / ma hā tsi na'i phyogs smad 'tshong gi gzugs su yod par 'dod/213

spyir 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir dpal chen po nam snying gi dngos brgyud byin gyis brlabs pa khyon lnga phrag lnga re dus phal cher byon par bzhed/ de las kho bo cag ni kun gzhi'i rgyud la byang chub lam gyi bgo skal yod pa zhig dpal chen po nam snying gi byin gyis brlabs nas/ mngon gyur yon tan med par sbas pa'i tshul tha mal so skye rang gzugs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa ci nus su 'dzin cing 'gro phan phra'u phra'u bsgrub pa po 'dir gda'/ kho bo tshe 'dir gu ru pad+ma'i zab gter la spyod pa'i skal ba mchog dang ldan pa zhig yin la rten 'brel ma 'chug na bstan 'gror phan pa rgya chen 'grub yod kyang sngon las rkyen dbang gis sngon du rngo ma thog par der gda'/ slad mar zab gter rten 'brel gyi sgo legs par 'grigs shing bstan 'gror sman pa chen pos gu ru'i dgyes pa 'grub par snying nas smon pa lags/ gter ston rig 'dzin chen po'i rdo rje 'chang pad+ma bde chen gling ba'i zhal nas bka' 'dus snying po yid bzhin nor bu 'di khyod kyi gter skal yin yang nged la bka' babs nged kyi gter zhabs khyod la dbang ba yin zhes gsungs pa yang de ltar la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa 'dir skye ba mang por las smon dag pas bla slob res mos su gyur cing phyi ma'i tshe rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas na'ang tshom bu gcig tu byang chub pa yin/de bzhin rgyal ba'i sras po karma pa yang tshe rabs du mar bla ma 'brel bas byin gyis brlabs pa'i rgyu mtshan thun mong ma yin pa mang du yod kyang 'dir ma smos/ kho bo cag skye ba 'di yi 'og tu yul sna tshogs par las dang smon lam dbang gis/ dge bshes mkhas pa nus pa can dang / sgrub pa po nyams rtogs kyi brgyan pa gnyis ka yang sdom gsum gyi bcas pa rnam pa dag pa 'chang ba ste/ lhag tu 'dul ba la mkhas shing bslab sdom la gnas pa/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig la shin tu mkhas brtson zhing gtsang mar spyod pa yi bstan pa'i mig srol la phan par byed pa de lta'i skye ba 'ga' zhig dang / gzhan yang sa la dbang ba'i rgyal po dang / de yi kha lo pa dang / dmangs khyims pa chos ldan gyi skye ba yang re zung blangs zhing / re 'ga' tsam na rang gi sgrib pa'i lhag ma sbyang ba dang der gnas pa'i 'gro ba yang smin pa'i ched du dmyal ba dang byol song du yang skye bar byed do/ /yang skye ba ha cang mi mang ba'i skabs shed du theg chen gyi lam la spyod pa rus pa'i rgyan gon/ rdo rje'i glu len/ mkha' 'gro'i 'du ba thob cing /skabs phal mo cher mngon du gyur gyi rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung ston pa/ yul nyer bzhir spyod pa rgyu ba zhig skye nas 'gro ba'i don rlabs po che la spyod par byed do/ /gang ltar yang skye ba mang po mi 'gor bar dpal chen po he ru ka nam mkha'i snying po'i thugs klong du nyi ma la zer 'du ba bzhin ro gcig tu thim par the mi tshom pa'i nges pa can yin no/ /mthar ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing nam mkha' rnam par bkod pa na/214

sangs rgyas nam mkha' rnam par rol ba zhes bya ba'i rgyal bar gyur nas 'brel bcas kyi 'go ba rnams der byang chub kyi sa rnyed par byed do/ /de ltar skye ba'i tshul gong du smos pa sa bon tsam de dag dang gzhan yang ci rigs skabs 'ga' dang 'gar yid ngor wal wal snyam byed cing / slad ma'i tshe na yang rtog tshogs su 'ga' zhig snang bar gor mi chags so/ /de dag la cher cher po yang med la/ mtha' dag yang smon rin chog pa yang mi 'gyur zhing / nges pa'i don la rnam par mi rtog gi ri mo de dag sgyu ma lta bur zad kyi snying po rtag brtan ther zug zhig kyang ga nas yod/ de ltar ma zad dngos nas ji bzhin gtan la phebs nus pa yang dka' ste/ rnal 'byor gyi rtsa rlung thig le'i byed pas khams 'dus kyi rol pa sna tshogs 'byams klas shar ba nyid kyis so/ /de na gzhan yang grib gyis ma gos shing dben par mnyam bzhag la 'da' ba'i gnas skabs rnams su yang pha rol gyi rnam rtog dang / spyod lam/ de bzhin dus kyi 'gyur ba sogs gsal snang gis shes snyam byed rung de dag kyang sha khrag gi lus dngos rang rgyud 'di mi 'gyur bde stong ting nge 'dzin gyi lus su ma gyur bar dngos gnas ji bzhin yin pa'am dka' la/ kha shas tsam bden par srid kyang rmi lam gyi snang ba ltar shes pas dngos zhen dga' brod dang ngo mtshar ches cher 'dzin pa yang ma bdogs lags/ tshul 'di rnal 'byor lam zhugs kun gyis go dgos nges tig can no/ /gong du skye phreng gi tshul du rang gi yid la dran nas brjod pa de yang mtha' dag skye srid gcig nas gcig tu brgyud ldan yin pa ni dka' la/ yin pa yang ci rigs yod cing phal cher de dang de yi byin gyis ni nges par brlabs pa'o/ /bdag tshe 'dir byis pa'i skabs phal che bar sgyu ma rmi lam lta bu yad yud kyi snang ba las 'jig rten tha mal gyi dngos 'dzin dkon cing / stong nyid snying rje'i myong ba bzang po rtag tu 'char ba dang / stong gzugs mtshan rtags kyi las snang sgrib thub tsam gyi yid sun sun du 'char ba dang / gzhan gyis bslabs par rang shugs kyi bla ma dkon mchog la dad gus dam tshig mi byed pa'i rkang tshugs shing / rgyu 'bras la yid ches 'dor len la 'bad pa dang rtsa ba'i bla ma las man ngag thob pa cing zad re bsgom pas kyang yon tan bzang ba rgyud la skye ba dang / tshe 'di snang ba zhen pa chen po mi skye zhing mi rtag skyo shas kyis nyin mtshan 'khor yug 'brel ba sogs skye ba sngon ma'i bag chags bzang po ci rigs pa byung yang phyis chos brgyad kyi bla gzugs 'dzin pa 'dis rim gyis 'grib song / 'on kyang phyag chen du grags pa'i gnas lugs zab mo'i lta ba'i nyams rtogs rjes mthun pa rgyud la tshegs chung ngu'i skyes pa dang / dbang bzhi pa'i phyag chen phyag chen zab gsal bde ba chen po ma nor tshul bzhin du go bas sangs rgyas kyi ye shes bzhugs tshul phyogs mthun pa gtan la phabs pa dang / deng sang phal ba gzhan gyis ma go zhing ma rtogs pa'i gnad mdo rgyud kyi rdo rje'i tshig gi dgongs 215

don 'ga' yang tshe 'dir bslab sbyang zhu tig kho na la yang ma ltos par/ tshe rabs rigs kyi bdag po pad+ma ka ra'i sgyu 'phrul skye sngon gyi rmad byung bla ma shing rta chen po 'ga' dang 'ga' yis byin rlabs tshe 'di'i rtsa ba'i bla mas mtshams sbyar bas de dag gi bzhed pa ji bzhin pa rnam rtog gi rkang tshugs pa dang /rang nyid gcig po zhi bde dang thar 'dod kyi bsam pas ma bslad par theg chen gyi smon lam rgya mtsho 'debs shing / 'brel bcas kyi 'gro ba byang chub lam la sbyor ba'i bsam pa lhur len pa dang / 'gro kun gyis 'jigs shing ya nga ba'i gnas su byed pa'i 'chi ba dang bar do yang ha cang de tsam gyis 'jigs pa dang ya nga med pa rnam rtog gi rang gzugs tsam du rang grol gyi gdengs rnyed pa dang / de bzhin las 'bras la yid ches shing ngan 'gro'i gnas ya nga ba shes rung / der nam phug bdag 'khyams yong snyam pa'i rtsi gum gum de yang mi 'char mod/ der ma zad 'gro ba la phan pa rgya chen 'grub na dbyar bar yang rang nyid 'jug mi spro ba ches che ba med la/ gzhan yang byang sems 'phags pa'i sa chen po ni dus dus myur du thob 'dod kyi blo thun mongs ma yin pa rgyun du yod la/ de yang sangs rgyas go 'phang thob dgos pa gzhi bcas shing thob 'dod kyi dge ba kun 'bras bu der bsngo yang / 'phral dge ba gang 'bras bu der bsngo ba gang rang du thob 'dod dung dung ha cang gi re ba cher che ba ni mi bdogs te/tshul de dag ci lta bu zhig yin kyang rung la rdzun zog dang ma 'dres par rang gi rgyud la rtog bcas kyi 'gros 'char lugs de 'dra zhig ni gda'/ de lta bu'i rtogs tshogs mang du yod mod kyang mtha' dag ni 'dri bar ga la spobs/ /'dir ni sngon rabs kyi tshul ci rigs pa dran pa'i sa bon tsam brjod pa ste/ ji skad du/ grol mchog zhabs kyis/ dran pa gsal dus ma bris na/ /shi nas sus kyang rtogs par dka'/ /gsungs pa dang tshul mtshungs pas son/ tshe 'di yi 'char myong snang tshul rgyas pa ni gzhan du 'chad par bya'o/ /gzhan ngor ji ltar yang rang myong thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam par rtog pa'i yi ge drang po'i sa bon 'di ni dad pa'i skal ba can rnams kyis gsang ste bzung bar bya yi ha cang gi 'char g.yengs su shor bar mi bya la/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ log par lta ba dang the tshom can 'ga' yi sgro skur spyod cing ngan 'gro'i rgyu bsags pa dang / de bzhin blun po 'ga' ni tshig 'di lta bu'i rjes su ma brtags par mu cor gya tshom med du smra ba dang / 'ga' zhig ni blun po grags rjes 'brangs pas dregs shing khong pa rnams rang gdengs med bzhin phal gyi 'char sgrogs 'di lta bu'i tshul mthun du de rang bab kyi sdebs pa dang /khyad par ches snyigs ma'i dus dbang gis phal che mi chos bla rdzun gyi nyes pa ma go'am go yang ma 'dzem pa shes che zhing / lhag tu bdag lta'i bla chung che 'dod can tsho'i bdud du de rang bab kyis 'dug ste/ yi ge 'di lta bu mthong na lhag par kha drag gdon gyis zin nas de lta las lhag pa'am mnyam par 'dod pa'i 216

blos zog rdzun tho co'i pha rol po de'i yi ge dang 'dra mtshungs su bsta ba yang mang du 'thong bas/ des na yi ge 'di lta bu rgyu 'bras rtsing por spyod pa'i che 'dod can rnams kyi thar ba'i srog rtsa gcod pa'i spu grir 'gyur bas gsung rab tu dam par bya'o/ /de yang yi ge 'di nyid dregs pa'i gtso bo ma ning drag shad me yi kha rlangs can/ sring gcig re ti nag mo khrag 'dzag bka' nyan mon pa pho mo'i tshogs dang / ma mo sngags bdag ral gcig ma/ shan pa nag mo/ gza' rgod chen po/ gnod sbyin dmar nag dam can thig le rtsal gtso 'khor rnams dang / bdud kyi mgon po kun dga' gzhon nu/ yum mchog si na rā ma/las mkhan dus mtshan pho mo gcas la gnyer du gtad kyi g.yel med du 'chang bar gyis shig sā mā yā gnyer rgyaḥ dam rgyaḥ sbed rgyaḥ des na pad 'byung nam mkha'i snying po'i gdul byar gyur ba'i skal ba can rnams kyis glegs bam 'di nyid la gus shing dad pas gsang ste bcang zhing the tshom med par gsol ba btab na tshe rabs kyi yongs 'dzin mgon du pad 'byung nam mkha'i snying po thob cing dngos rgyud sprul bas rjes su bzung nas gtan bde byang chub la sbyor bar 'gyur gyi smon lam gyi mthu btsan pa nyid kyis so/ /sā mā yā gtad rgyaḥ 'chang rgyaḥ spel rgyaḥ de lta ma yin par the tshom skur 'debs 'gran sems 'dra len gyi rgyu ru 'gro ba la spel ba dang / de yi ched du yi ge 'di blta ba'am 'bri klog byed pa po byung na/de ma thag de yi bla rten so sor khrol la/ tshe srog drod dbugs mthu chen dregs pa rnams kyi rngam zas dang / snying dang snying khrag dgyes pa'i ston mor ha ha hi hi'i gad rgyangs bcas te rol bar gyis shigaḥsā mā yāḥ dam dzaḥ gsang rgyaḥ bka' rgyaḥ gnyan rgyaḥ.e ma/ sngon nas goms pa stobs su 'phos/ tshul 'di dad pas lang tshos rab 'byor zhing / /mi byed dge ba yin gyi sgeg gyur gang / /tshe rabs lhan cig 'grogs phyir mgul gyi rgyan/ /spyin gyis rin thang bral ba'i nor bur zungs/ /gus shing dad pas 'di klog 'di 'chang kun/ /skye kun pad 'byung nam mkha'i snying po yi/ /dngos brgyud sprul pas rjes bzung dus myur du/ /de yi thugs dang ro mnyam sangs rgyas shog /de ltar smos kyi pad+ma ka ra yi/ /bden tshig bslu med rdo rje lta bu dang / /rgyal dang srayobacas slob mar bcas rnams la/ /de 'grub gsol ba gdab kyi ji bzhin shog /bdag ni so skyes lam zhugs ches dman zhing / /mngon gyur yon tan med rung sems rgyud la/ /dam pas byin gyis brlabs mthus bag chags bzang / /gzhan gyis rtogs dka' rang gis myong ba ste/ /tshul te rang sems slad med rnam rtog gzugs/ /ci ltar shar bzhin brjod par sems na yang / /rjes dpag tho co'i skyon dang 'dres srid tshe/ /de yang sgrib med dge tshogs dbugs dbyung gsol/ /tshul 'di bdag nyid sgrogs phyir kho na min/ /'gro 'ga' rnam dkar 'brel ba'i rgyur dmigs nas/ /brjod pa'i dge gang zla ba'i ri mchog bzhin/ /217
