bdag gzhan rnam dkar smon lam mthun spyad shog /de skad rang myong thun mong ma yin pa lkogs gyur gsang ba'i gnas ji bzhin par gdong dmar bod kyi sham+bha la rtsang ri khrod chen po jo nang stod nas cung zad bris shing / de 'phro la stod lho brang mtsho bsam rdzongs dgon du rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu rang lo sum cu'i gung du slebs pa kun dga' shing stag smin drug zla ba'i tshes bcu nas thun la slebs skabs grub par byas pa ste/ /'di ni rang la mos pa'i slob ma dam pa mang pos nan tan dang bcas te dus yun ring nas bskul ba don yod par bya ba dang / gzhan yang las skal mthun pa'i gdul bya ci rigs pa mchis tshe de rnams kyi byang chen lam gyi sa bon dad pa'i gsos su lhag pa'i bsam pas bkod pa ste/ dge ba des kyang tshul 'di mthong thos dran regs kyi 'gro ba kun pad 'byung nam mkha'i snying po'i thugs klong du grol bar gyur cig maṅga la bi dza yaskyo/

༄ga /rtsa gsum rab 'byams la 'jug pa'i dbang chog gsang chen sgo brgya 'byed pa'i 'phrul gyi lde'u mig rtses bya ba bzhugs so/ /sngon tshe sangs rgyas ston pa la/ /dbang bskur nus ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /gang de'i sprul ba bde chen gling / /smin cing grol ba'i byin rlabs stsol/ /gsang chen sngags bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug par 'dod pa zhig yin tshe dbang ni med thabs med phyir 'jug sgor gsungs shing / de bskur ba'i thabs yang rgyas bsdus du ma zhig gsung ba'i lag len dag ma 'phyugs par ci bzhin gnad du thebs nges pa yod tshe sla chos ni mi rung mod/ bdag bskyed dang cho ga bsdus pa sogs kyi sgo nas bsnyen mtshams sam kha 'don bgyi ba la dbang chen re skur dgos na de yang 'byor bar dka' bas mang po zhig dbang med par gya tshom du sngags la 'jug pa 'di dge sdig gang che ba brtags dgos pa zhig yin te/ rgyud las/ dbang ma bskur la dngos grub med/ /gsungs pas bsnyen sgrub la 'jug tshe gal te dbang med na bde ba gshegs pa'i bka' la ris chod dang dbang yod bgyis pa yin pas sgrub pa la 'bras bu 'byin pa phar zhog bka' gdams pas chos chos bzhin ma byas pas chos rje slar ngan song du ltung gsungs pa'i stengs su mi slebs pa yang mi srid pa min no/ /dbang zhes pa ni rgya che bas re re bzhin 'bri bar rngo ma thog kyang gtso bo bla mas dgongs rgyud kyi byin rlabs slob ma la 'phos shing / slob ma'i sgo gsum smin nas las su rung ba/ rtsa gsum rab 'byams gang gi dbang yin pa de dang de'i bskyed rdzogs la 'jug pa'i dbang cha'am gnang ba bstsal ba'i don yin no/ /des na bla slob kyi rten 'byung 'dzoms shing bla mas dgongs pa gtad pa sogs la dbang chog gi mang nyung la mi ltos pas 'di tsam gyis kyang dgos pa chen po 'grub pas gzhan la phan 'dod kyis blos dbang chog 'di nyid 'bri bar dam bca' 'o/ /de la gsum/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa/ dbang bskur ba/ rjes kyi bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/dbang bskur ba la dkyil 'khor med du mi rung bas rab na lha rang rang gi gzhung nas gsung pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / sgrub rten gtor ma'am/ phyag mtshan dang snying po bkod pas kyang rung ste/ dkyil 'khor la sku gsung thugs mtshon byed du ma chog go/ /mdor bsdu na dkyil 'khor thams cad rigs lnga la ma 'dus pa med pas stegs bu'i khar 'bru'i pad+ma 'dab bzhi bar yab kyi rigs la oṃ r+ghaṃ tram̐ trī aḥdang yum gyi rigs la phroṃ lo m+bi po rtswaḥ dang yang na bai ha ri ni saḥ zhes pa bkod/ lha so so'i rigs gang du gtogs pa'i snying po dkyil du bya/ de'i shar phyogs nas rim par g.yas skor du/ dam chu/ mig dar/ 219

me tog las kyi bum pa'am chu gtsang / sku'i tsagli'am bum pa/ gsung bgrang phreng ngam bhar+ghaṃ/ thugs rdo rje 'am pusti/ ye shes me long ngam sher rdo/ yon tan gtor ma'am nor bu/ 'phrin las dril bu'am ral gri/ bkra shis pa'i rdzas rtags brgyad dam g.yang bshos/ mdun du rnam lnga sogs ci 'byor mchod pa bshams la/ slob dpon gyis bdag mdun bum gsum dbyer med du bsgrub/ snod bcud dag mnyam gyi lta bas dbang rdzas yi dam kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las su byin gyis brlabs shing reg grol myong grol thos grol gyi rten 'brel gsal bar bya/ las bum bsnyen skabs su/ a las bum pa dmigs med stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho'i 'khyil ba'i gzhal med khang / /dbus su hūṃḥlas khro bo bdud rtsi'i 'khyil/ /ljon sngon 'jigs gzugs rdor dril sdig mdzub mdzad/ /zhabs gnyis bgrad cing klu brgyad zil gyis gnod/ /dpal gyi chas rdzogs me dpung klong na bzhugs/ /thugs gar nyi dkyil r+ghaṃ mtshan sngags kyis bskor/ bzlas pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs bum pa kheng / /oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭaḥces ci mang bzlas/ mthar badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bstod par 'os pa sogs kyis bstod/ lha 'od du zhu ba bum chu dang ro gcig tu gyur/ zhes se gol bcas gshegs shing / dge ba 'di yis nas/bdud rtsi 'khyil ba 'grub gyur nas sogs bsngo/ las bum la yi dam gang rung gi drag po'i cho ga sgrub pa dang / rnying lugs la rta mgrin yang mang bar mthong bas de ltar byas kyang rung mod/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba thugs bskyed dang dam bca'i khyad par grib mi gtsang 'joms pa'i gnyen po stobs kyi lha yin pas rtsa gsum rab 'byams la sbyar chog phyir 'dir bkod pa yin no/ /bdag 'jug la/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya o/ āḥbadz+ra sa ma ya āḥ r+ghaṃḥbadz+ra sa ma ya r+ghaṃḥ swā badz+ra sa ma ya swāḥ hāḥbadz+ra sa ma ya hāḥ o ye shes rgyal po'i sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan 'phrin las rmad po che/ /de nyid du ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /phyag rgya chen por bdag sbyor cig /o badz+ra sa ma ya r+ghaṃḥ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ o badz+ra sa ma ya hoḥ zhes dbang rdzas gnas gsum tu gtug cing bdag dbang zhu/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma nas/ sku gsung thugs kyi dbang mchog bskur du gsol/ ces bla ma dang yi dam dbyer med pa'i nga rgyal bzung nas thams cad dag pa ye shes kyi rol bar blta/ gnyis pa dbang bskur pa dngos la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po sngon 'gro la khrus dang byur bsal/ srung 'khor/ lo rgyus brjod cing maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ste bzhi yod do/ /de yang tshogs mchod sogs yod tshe drang ba'i mgo nas smon lam byas shing ngal gso/ de nas slob ma rnams nang du 'khod/ bla ma spos rol bcas bsu/ khrir bzhugs su gsol ba dang / slob mas phyag 'bul bcas gral du 'khod/ 'dus pa la me tog 'gyed/ ji skad du slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas/ dag pa khrus nas ma bton par/ /gsang sngags dbang gi sgo mi phye/ /byur dang mi shis ma 220

bsal bar/ /gsang sngags dbang gi gral mi ston/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo ma bsgom par/ /gsang sngags dbang gi chos mi 'chad/ /ces dbang la spyi'i sngon 'gro'i chos gsum gsung ba las/ /dang po khrus kyi rim pa la dmigs pa ni/ khyod rang rnams spyi bor rdo rje sems dpa' gsal thob la bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi sdig sgrib bkrus te dbang bskur ba'i snod rung du gyur bar mos mdzod/ ji ltar bltam pa nas/ yig brgya lan bdun dang 'dus pa'i mang nyung la ltos nas khrus kha bshal ma tshar bar bzla/ 'dis dam grib rab chad sel ba dang slob ma snod ldan du sgrub pa yin pas 'dus pa ci tsam mang yang cho ga 'di ma 'grub par 'og gi bya ba rnams mi bya'o/ /gnyis pa bgegs bskrad pa'i dmigs pa ni/ /lan chags shing glags blta ba'i 'byung po'i rigs su gyur ba rnams sbyin pas tshim par byas shing / slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi rdo rje me kun tu 'bar ba 'phros te khyod rang gi lus tshal bur phug phyogs dang phyogs mtshams thams cad r+ghaṃ ཿyig dang khro bo'i tshogs kyis gang bar mos mdzod/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis gtor mar chab bran nas/nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags lan gsum dang / hūṃ bzhi'i sngags kyis gtor ma brlabs la/ rang nyid yi dam kyi nga rgyal bcas/ r+ghaṃḥ rnal 'byor chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ gsang ba'i dam can so so nas/'du ba'i lha ni ma gtogs pa/ /thams cad thugs rjes bskang zin gyis/ /da lta nyid du so sor dengs/ /gal te mi 'gro 'dug gyur na/ /rdo rje 'dzin rgyal khros nas kyang / /de ma thag tu bkas nas ni/ /bdun rgyud rigs kyang brlag par 'gyur/ /rtsa sngags dang / rgyuḥbazhi/ drag sngags so lnga ba'i mjug rdo rje'i slob ma 'di la smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo bgyi ba la bar du gcod pa thams cad sarba u tsa ta phaṭaḥ ces brjod/gsum pa srung ba'i dmigs pa ni/ bla ma'i shangs dang thugs srog las hūṃ yig dang 'od zer mkha' khyab tu 'phros te steng rdo rje'i bla bre/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ snang srid rdo rje'i gur/ rang lus rdo rje sngon po me 'bar bar gyur nas bgegs gang gis kyang glag mi rnyed par gyur bar mos mdzod/ hūṃḥng yi dkyil 'khor brtan pa'i phyir/ /khro rgyal byin rlabs las byung ba'i/ /mtshon cha rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /dkyil 'khor rim pa bzhin du bsrung / /hūṃḥsteng yang rdo rje'i bla bre la/ /'og kyang rdo rje'i sa gzhi ste/ /phyogs mtshams rdo rje 'bar bas gtam/ /rdo rje'i mtshams las ma 'da' zhig /rtsa sngags dang rdo rje'i phyag rgya bcas/ badz+ra badz+ra rachuzhes me tog 'thor zhing bsrung ba brtan par bya/bzhi pa lo rgyus brjod pa ni/ lo rgyus mdor bsdus brjod na chos dang bla ma brgyud pa tsam gyis chog la cung zad spro na/ spyir dam pa'i chos kyi yon tan/ sgos gsang ba sngags kyi che ba/ khyad par yi dam 221

'di rigs gang du gtogs/ bsgrub te grub pa thob tshul/ brgyud pa'i khyad par rags rim/ rang la gang nas thob pa/ dbang zhu ba'i dgos pa yang jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha'i zhal nas/ bgegs kyi bar chad kyis mi tshugs pa/ sgrib pa 'dag pa/ theg dman sel ba/ sgom bzlas kyi snod du rung / zhi sogs kyi las bsgrub pa la mthu dang ldan pa/ byang chub kyi sems nyams pa gso ba/ dam tshig dang sdom pa nyams pa gso ba/ ma 'ongs par rang nyid la sangs rgyas kyi dngos su dbang bskur bar 'gyur ba/zhes sogs rdo rje'i ljags kyis bsngags pa'i dgos pa chen por brgyad yod par gsungs pas 'brel thogs pa'i sems can kun gyis gnas skabs kyi bar chad sel/ mthar thug thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam la sbyor ba yin pas dga' ba dang bcas pas sgo nas dbang bskur zhu dgos la/ de yang slob dpon gyi bgyi ba rnams sngon du song zin pas khyod rnams kyi dngos skal du gyur pa'i maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ maṇ+ḍal rgyas pa'am bsdu na/ sa gzhi spos chu'i sogs tshom bu bdun ma phul/ de nas dngos gzhi'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug par yan lag brgyad las/ dang por gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /ji ltar mchod chen bgyis pa ltar/ /bdag kyang rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /lan gsum gyis zhus/ slob dpon gyis/ khyod ni su yin ci la dad/ slob mas/ skal bzang bdag ni de chen la'o/ /zhes lan btab spyir bde chen la go ba mang yang 'dir ni thar bar 'dod pa la mos kyang rung ngo / /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor du 'jug par byed pa la/ bshags pa bya ba ni/ rdo rje slob dpon sogs lan gcig gam gsum brjod/ brgyad pa sdom bzung ni/ /ho/ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /gsang sngags nang gi sdom pa rnams/ /ma lus bdag gis yongs su bzungs/ /lan gsum/ gsum pa byin rlabs ni/ slob ma'i snying gar yi dam kyi sa bon gnas pa las 'od 'phros lus 'chag pa chur zhu ba ltar stong par gyur/ slob dpon kyi thugs las 'od 'phros pas tha mal gyi snang ba gnas 'gyur nas snod bcud dag pa rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor phun sum tshogs pa lnga yi rang bzhin du gyur pa'i pad+ma'i gdan la slob ma rang nyid khams dang skye mched gtsang zhing dag pa gnyug sems phra ba'i lus kyi rang bzhin can du gyur bar mos la/bzhi pa dam la bzhag pa ni/ ho 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ dam tshig 'das na bsreg par byed/dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub thob/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'di 'thung / /oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa ma ya r+ghaṃḥ oṃ a dadhe na ra kan sarba pa ti trī da ya hūṃ trī ṭhaḥ lnga pa ye shes dbab pa ni/ khyod kyi phung khams skye mched thams cad stong pa'i ngang las (lha gang yin )skad cig gis lhag pa'i lha de nyid kyi rnam par gsal ba'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum dang slob dpon gyi sku las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu zhing rab 'byams 222

nas rtsa gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas ka'i dkyil 'khor lhag pa'i lha'i sku dang yig 'bru 'ja' 'od kyi rnam pas khyod kyi lus la sims sims thim par mos shig ces brjod cing spos rol dang dbyangs bcas/ oṃ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes thugs/ /sku dang gsung sprul las mdzad pa/ /phyag rgya'i cho ga de dag gis/ /de ring 'di la dbab tu gsol/ rtsa sngags dang / oṃ ā hūṃḥgu ru de wa ḍā ki ni sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ hūṃ hūṃḥ tse tseḥ rā rā rā rāḥ tsa lā ya tsa lā yaḥ do shā ya do shā yaḥ ā we sha ya a aḥzhes dbab cing / tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes rdo rje rgya gram gyi rgyas me tog 'thor zhing ye shes pa brtan par bya/ /drug pa me tog 'bul ba ni/ sngon tshe tshe rabs grangs med nas/ /dge ba'i las kyis brten pa'i lha/ /lhag pa'i lha ni gang yin pa/ /da lta nyid du dbab par shog /oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ho/ zhes phul/ bdun pa mig dar gsal ba ni/ sngon gyi mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /gser gyi thur ma thogs nas ni/ /'jig rten ling thog bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod mi shes rmongs pa yi/ /ling thog rgyal bar rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra tsak+ṣa ka ma la su ra ta s+t+waṃḥ ces bsal/ brgyad pa lha zhal bstan pa ni/ de ring rigs kyi bu khyod kyis/ /rtsol ba'i sems stobs ma chung bar/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor gzugs brnyan ni/ /kun rdzob gzugs su bstan pa yin/ /'di la dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /rtse gcig yid kyis gnas gyis la/ /sems kyi gzhan du ma yengs na/ /dngos grub gzhan du mi 'gyur ro/ /a a a/zhes brjod/ dngos gzhi dbang la rim pa bdun las/ dang po maṇ+ḍal phul ba ni/ bla mas/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur zab mo zhu ba'i slad du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ sa gzhi spos chu'i sogs brjod/ /gnyis pa gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ byang chub rdo rje sogs lan gsum rjes zlos bya/ slob dpon gyis/ dus 'di phyin chad rgyal ba'i sras/ /ngan song thams cad med pa dang / /tshe ring bde ba phun sum tshogs/ /mtho ris thar ba'i bdag por 'gyur/ /ces spro ba bskyed/ gsum pa sku'i dbang ni/ tsagli'am bum pa thogs la/ oṃ dpal ldan rdo rje sku 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgom pas/ /deng bdag khyod la byin brlabs pas/ /rdo rje'i sku nyid thob par shog rtsa sngags mthar/ badz+ra kā ya a sgyi ṣiñtsa oṃḥ des sku bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag snang stong lha sku sgom pa la dbang ba yin no/ /bzhi pa gsung la/bgrang phreng ngam bhar+ghaṃ thogs la/ āḥchos kyi ngag lam dpal dang ldan/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgom pas//deng bdag khyod la byin brlabs pas/ /rdo rje'i gsung nyid thob par shog /rtsa sngags mthar/ badz+ra wā ka a gi ṣiñtsa āḥ bzlas lung sbyin/ des gsung gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag grags stong bzlas brjod kyi bya ba la dbang ba yin no/ /lnga pa thugs la/ rdo rje'am puste thogs la/ hūṃḥdapal ldan thugs kyi rdo rje 'chang / /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgom pas/ /deng bdag khyod la byin brlabs pas/ /rdo 223

rje'i thugs nyid thob par shog /rtsa sngags mthar/ /badz+ra tsit+ta a rnyi ṣiñtsa r+ghaṃḥ des thugs kyi dbang thob/yid kyi dri ma dag bde stong ye shes bsgom pa la dbang ba yin no/ /drug pa yon tan la/ gtor ma'am nor bu thogs la/ swāḥ'adod 'byung yon tan rdo rje 'chang / /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgom pas/ /deng bdag khyod la byin brlabs pas/ /rdo rje'i yon tan thob par shog rtsa sngags mthar/ badz+ra sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa swāḥ des ka dag tshig gi dbang thob/ shes bya'i dri ma sbyang / rig stong zung 'jug bsgom pa la dbang ba yin no/ /bdun pa 'phrin las la/ dril bu'am ral gri thogs la/ hāḥ lhun grub 'phrin las rdo rje 'chang / /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgom pas/ /deng bdag khyod la byin brlabs pas/ /rdo rje'i 'phrin las thob par shog rtsa sngags mthar/ badz+ra karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hāḥ des las rab 'byams sgrub pa'i dbang thob/ /lam gol shol gyi phrang las brgal/ /rgyal ba kun gyi 'phrin las kyi byed por mnga' gsol ba yin pas gzhan don phun tshogs sgrub pa'i thabs la 'bod cig gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba mtha' rten rim pa bzhi las/ dang po bkra shis ni/ bkra shis pa'i rdzas rtags brgyad dam g.yang bshos thogs la/ hoḥrin chen bkra shis rdzas mchog 'di/ /skal ldan khyod la gtad pa yis/ /dus rnams kun tu dge legs shing //phyogs las rnam rgyal dbang thob shog rtsa sngags mthar/ maṅga lo a bhi ṣiñtsa r+ghaṃḥ gnyis pa dam tshig bsgrags pa ni/ gtso bo'i ji ltar bka' stsal ba/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ lan gsum/deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ /lan gsum/ gsum pa gtang rag maṇ+ḍal ni/ dbang yongs rdzogs thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ rgyas pa'am/ sa gzhi spos chus brjod/ bzhi pa bsngo ba ni/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ sogs brjod/ bla ma la tshogs kyi drang ba phul/ cho ga rgyas pa yin na lhag ma dang rjes chog bya/ bsdus pa la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs sman rag gtor gsum bcas phul/ rang gzhung gi bstod pa yod na de bya/ med na/ bstod par 'os pa sogs kyis bstod/ bsdu rim dngos bstan med tshe/ r+ghaṃḥ gsum gyis snang cha'i lha 'od gsal gyi dbyings su bsdu/ phaṭaḥgasum gyis snang grag rig gsum lhag pa'i lha'i 'khor lor bzhengs la bsngo smon ci rigs bya dgos/ dbang chog 'di nyid kho bos brtsams pa dang / dag snang chos sde/ gter chos mtha' dag dang / chog 'grig byas pa'i cho ga rgyas bsdus/ tha na bdag bskyed tshun chad la sbyar chog mod/rang nyid la lha de dang de'i dbang lung dang bsnyen bsgrub sogs dgos nges kyi chos dang ma ldan par gzhan la sbyin du med pas/ tha na cho ga'i tshig brgyud bar ma chad par thob/ de'i steng du bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi puste ka'i lung dbang tshun chad thob/ rtsa gsum gyi bsnyen pa mthar 'khyol nas dngos nyams rmi lam gyi rtags rdzogs pa zhig nges par dgos rgyu tan tan yin no/ /bsdus pa byed na/ sngon 'gro'i chos 224

gsum tshang ba gzhir bzhag ye shes dbab pa'i mjug nas dngos gzhi'i sku gsung thugs gsum gyi dbang sbyar te/ mthar bkra shis man chad gzhung ltar byas na'ang rung ngo / dbang bskur spyi'i bskur tshul ni/ rtse le'i dris lan las/ dbang bskur byed pa'i tshe/ gsar ma rnams ni chog khrig sogs las rim mtha' dag gzhung nas bshad pa bzhin dgos pa yin gsungs nas/ bdag 'jug sogs las rim kho na la nan tan mdzad/ rnying ma rnams ni byin rlabs sngags la rag pa yin gsungs nas 'dzab bsnyen la gtso bor mdzad pa'i phyag srol 'dug rung / rang nyid kyis blun tshod la ni/ de thams cad 'dzom dgos pa yang gzhir bcas te/ khyad par du ni/ bla ma'i byin rlabs dang slob ma'i mos gus 'dzoms pa'i mthu la brten te byin rlabs zhugs zhing dbang don ngo 'phrod pa kho na gal che bar go zhing / de lta bu'i byin rlabs shig zhugs na gnas skabs kyi rdzas dbang 'di lta bu bskur ma bskur gcig pu la rag ma par snang ste/ dper na/ til+li pas na ro pa la ras yug me stag gi bsreg pa sogs brda bcu gnyis bstan pa'i mthus dbang bzhi'i don mngon du mdzad tshul dang / zhi byed brgyud pa'i dam pa sgom smon gyi/'chus pa dar brtson la ja phor ba gang dang phye skyal ba gang gnang nas dbang bskur gyi dod po yin gsungs pas bla ma dang rtogs pa mnyam pa'i byin rlabs zhugs tshul sogs/ /'di 'dra ba'i lo rgyus brjod las 'das pa'i byung ba'i phyir/ dbang gi gtso bo ni byin rlabs zhugs te ye shes rgyud la shar ba zhig gal che bar snang ngo / /zhes dbang bskur ba'i lo rgyus mang po zhig gsungs pa ltar bla slob kyi dam tshig gtsang na cho ga 'di tsam gyis kyang phan pa chen po 'grub po/ gal te bla ma la byin rlabs med/ slob ma la dad pa zhan na spros pa ci tsam che yang don chung ngu las mi 'byung ste/ rtse le sna tshogs rang grol zhal nas/ dbang don 'di bzhin ma shes phyin chad/ dkyil 'khor gyis yul khams kheng bar bsham nas/bum sogs kyi dbang rdzas khri 'bum mang po mgor bzhag cing / bum chus khyer thub pa tsam du sbyin yang /slob ma'i rgyud ni sngar tha mal pa'i 'jig rten gyi 'khrul 'dzin grwa ma nyams pa de kar lus pa las 'os med cing / bum dbang tsam gyi dbang don rgyud la ma skyes na/ dbang gong ma bskur ba'i yul du'ang mi rung zhing slar yang mi gshis/ de lta bu dag la smin byed kyi sa bon ma thebs par grol byed kyi lo 'bras 'byung rgyu ga la 'ong tshe/ dpon slob gnyis ka don med kyi las su zad la/ stabs nyes na gsang sngags gsang sgrog gi nyes ltung dang bka' chad kyi rgyu rkyen las ma mchis so/ /de bas na de lta bu ma yin par/dpon slob snod bcud kyi rten 'brel 'dzoms pas/ bum dbang gi lus smin te phung po dang rtsa khams dag cing dug lnga ye shes su shar ba'i mthus/ gsang dbang gi snod du rung bar gyur pa de la/ bla ma yab yum gyi lus dkyil la brten nas gsang rdzas lce la bzhag cing dbang don ngo sprad pas/ ngag tha mal gyi 225

'khrul zhen dag nas/ gsung rdo rje lhun grub tu ye nas yin tshul rtogs tshe/ sgra grags mtha' dag sngags kyi 'khor lor shes shing / bzlas brjod spro bsdu dang / rdor bzlas 'gog bzlas sogs gang la'ang rang dbang thob/ gtum mo 'bar 'dzag thig le zhu btul dbab bskyil bzlog dgram la goms pas mngon du gyur pas sher dbang gi snod du gyur pa de la/ dngos sam yid kyi phyag rgya la brten nas dga' ba bzhi mngon sum du 'char zhing nyams su myong du bcug la bde stong lhan skyes ye shes ngo spras pas/ des mtshon bde sdug tsha grang 'jam rtsum dga' mi dga' chags sdang la sogs sems kyi rtogs tshogs mtha' dag kyang lhan skyes ye shes su ro gcig par rtogs nas dbang gsum pa'i don ji bzhin rgyud la skyes pas/ yid thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo yin pa'i yin lugs rig tshe tshig dbang gi snod rung du gyur pa de la/dbang thams cad kyi rgyal po bde ba chen po'i dbang ngam/ tshig dbang rin po che rdzogs chen rnams su rig pa'i rtsal dbang zhes pa'i ming du brjod pa de nyid tshul bzhin ngo sprad pas/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad sku bzhi dbyer med du ye shes rdo rje rang rig gnyug ma ma bcos lhun grub khyab brdal chen por ngo shes/ thag chod/ la bzlos te gzhi lam 'bras gsum/ lta bsgom spyod gsum sogs mdor na chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong thams cad kyi gnad don rjen pa da lta'i tha mal gyi shes pa'i thog tu hril gyis 'dus pa'i don mngon sum bde blag tu rtogs nas/ re dogs gnyis 'dzin dgag sgrub kyi yul las 'das shing / gang shar ye shes kyi rnam rol du btsan sa zin par 'gyur ba ste/ de ltar dbang bzhi tshul ldan du bskur zhing thob pa'i tshul ni de 'dra zhig dgos par snang la/ rnying lugs rdzogs chen rnams las ni/ dbang bzhi po 'di dag re re la lo zla'i bar du bcad de skur zhing dbang don nyams su len lugs dang / de ltar byas pas dbang bzhi rdzogs pa dang / slob ma de grub thob tu gyur ba dus mnyam du 'byung bar gsungs mod/ deng sang ni gsar rnying gi gang zag rnams la ni ci zhu/ gzhan phal che ba rnams ni sngags kyi chos rnams lta phyir dang rnyed tshol gyi zong du byed de/ dang po nas sngags kyi gzhung tshig rnams kha khyer dang spros bcas kyi lag len sgrigs rim tsam zhig lobs na des chog par brtsi zhing / smin grol dang bskyed rdzogs kyi don dgos gal che ba rnams ni rna ba'i lam du thos kyang ma myong bzhin du/ ltar snang du skad gdangs dbyangs rol sogs gang bzang 'gran zhing / sbyin bdag rnams kyi sar 'gro sa gang rnyed du phyin te/ bsngos sha dang chang la gtso bor byas pa'i bza' btung yon dang bcas pa kho na don du gnyer ba 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' ba dang / bdag 'dra bla ma'i ming du btags pa rnams kyang rang gi rgyud la skyabs 'gro tsam gyi don ci bzhin med rung / skye bo mgu byed kyi cha lugs dang spyod tshul bcos ma byi la'i brtul zhugs lta bu la brten zhing / zang zing yong sgo 'ba' zhig snying khongs su 226

bcings nas/ chos bshad/ dbang bskur/ khrid 'debs/ sdom pa 'bogs/ rab gnas dang / gshin don la sogs te/ mdor na rdo rje slob dpon byed pa'i nus pa ci yang med bzhin rnyed tshol kho na'i ched du/ pho zo dang spobs pas kun nas bslangs te mi byed pa'i sna med pa cig byas pa'i 'bras bu zas nor cung zad rnyed pa dag gnas min gyi phyogs su zag par byed pas dus 'da'/ zhes sogs snyigs ma'i chos pa rnams kyi mtshang 'don pa'i gdams pa mang du gsungs so/ /de ltar dbang bskur ba de yang gzhi dbang ste rang la gnas pa'i ye shes bla ma'i ngo sprad nas de ji bzhin shes pa yin la/ rtog grol dus mnyam lta bu lam la bsgrod mi dgos pa ni re zung las med pas rjes su dbang gi skabs su ngo sprad pa'i ye shes de rgyun skyongs thub na mthar 'bras bu'i dbang stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa bzhi ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa yin no/ /zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pa'i don 'di nga lta bu'i tha mal ba slob dpon gzugs 'dzin kun kyis snying la nyar dgos so/ /ces pa'ang sngags kyi rnal 'byor spyod pa phyogs kun tu nyul ba'i rgyal khams pa rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus lcags khyi rgyal zla'i tshes bco lnga la glo bo rgyal po'i khab smon thang du chos bzhin skyong gyur rgyal po chen po yab yum sras dang sras mor bcas dang rgyal bal bod sogs kyi dzo ki mang pos rig gtad dang dbang bskur dgos zhes dang kho bo'i rtogs chos yongs rdzogs kyi dbang lung dgos zhes bskul ma byung tshe mkho nas bka' tshad ma rgyud sde dag gi snying po bsdus te khungs dang ldan par bris pa don dang ldan par gyur cig bi dza yan+tu/thugs dam bskul zhing bdag dbang len tshul rdo rje gsum sgrub ni/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo yi dam gang rung gi bdag dbang len par 'dod pas thog mar yi dam kyi las byang btang zhing bsnyen pa bum bsgrub bcas 'grub pa dang / dkyil 'khor la dmigs te/ sa gzhi spos chu'i sogs chos rgyal chen po'i gsungs byin rlabs can gyi maṇ+ḍal phul la/ trīḥbla ma lha dang ḍā ka'i tshogasaḥ dmigs med brtse bas dgongs su gsolaḥ khyod ni thugs rje che lags naḥ nus rtsal sprugs pa'i dus la babasaḥ sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor bdag cag laḥ dbang mchog bskur ba'i dus la babasaḥ rjes 'dzin skal ldan bu slob laḥdangos grub stsol ba'i dus la babasaḥ ris/sa drug lam log gol ba naḥ lam sna 'dren pa'i dus la babasaḥ sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad rnamasaḥ myur du bsgral ba'i dus la babasaḥ sku yi dngos grub lus la stsolaḥ 'ja' lus mkha' spyod 'grub par mdzodaḥ gsung gi dngos grub ngag la stsolaḥ tshangs dbyangs drug cu thob par mdzodaḥ thugs kyi dngos grub sems la stsolaḥ skye med chos sku mngon gyur nasaḥ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shogaḥ o uhūṃḥgu ru de wa ḍā ki nī kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sirnyi hūṃḥ sarba a bhi 227

ṣiñtsa rtsaḥr+ghaṃḥ zhes mang du bzlas la dbang rdzas rnams re re bzhin gnas gsum du gtug bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i gnas bzhi las 'od zer byung zhing rang la thim/ rang nyid bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha gnyis su med pa'i lta ba'i klong chen kor mnyam par bzhag la/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ bdag gi snying gar pad+ma'i gdan bzhugs la/ /bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbang mchog bskur du gsol/ /zhes dang / slar yang gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal gong bzhin phul/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs bsngo smon bya/ de ltar stabs shin tu bde la byin rlabs mchog tu che ba'i bdag 'jug len tshul 'di ni mnga' ri'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i gter gzhung dang /pad+ma bde chen gling pa/ sprul sku rol ba'i rdo rje sogs kyi gter gzhung nas byung la rang gi nyams chos dang tshig don gcig 'dres su song bas byin rlabs rang la yid ches thob pa byung ste rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus bdag gzhan smin grol gyi slad du bris pa shu r+ghaṃ/rtsa gsum rab 'byams kyi las sna tshogs pa'i sbyin bsreg yid bzhin nor mchog bzhugs so/ /bsreg rdzas 'byor tshod 'du bar byas la/ yi dam gang rung gi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i nga rgyal bcags/ roḥyiḥkhaṃḥ o āḥhūṃḥ mang du brjod la thab dang rdzas sogs yo byad kun la chu gtor nas sbyang / rang nyid yi dam thugs las roḥdamar 'phros/ /mdun gyi thab khung dkyil 'khor chen por bsgyur/ /o asne ye dz+wa la dz+wa la r+ghaṃḥphaṭaḥ de dbus me lha drang srong cha byad can/ /phyag bzhi g.yas gnyis lcags kyu bgrang phreng dang / /g.yon gnyis dbyug pa ril ba sbyi blugs 'dzin/ /zangs kyi ra skyes steng na dgyes bzhin bzhugs/ /de yi lto ba gzhal med khang gi nang / /rtsa gsum lha tshogs bde stong dbyings su rol/ /bsreg rdzas bdud rtsi 'dod yon ye shes sprin/ /'bar ba gos dkar yum gyi mkha' nas 'bul/ /shes nyon 'khrul ba'i snang ba dag pa dang / /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob pa dang / /zhi rgyas dbang drag las rnams 'grub pa dang / /ched du dmigs pa'i don kun grub lhun mdzod/ /na ma sa man+ta bun+ta rna sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ba lin+ta asne swā hāḥ oṃ khre te ha na badz+ra ye swā hāḥ oṃ dzñā na badz+ra dz+wa la roḥsogs re re lan bdun gyis rdzas phul/ de nas lha gang rung gi rtsa sngags dang / dzñā na badz+ra dz+wa la roḥsarba pu dza kha hiḥ zhes brjod bzhin phul/ las bzhir kha bsgyur gzhan las shes/ mchod bstod byas shing rol mo dgrol/ mthar rtsa sngags dang / kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la r+ghaṃḥ zhes cha shas dngos grub du myang / sbyin bsreg zin nas thab khung la bskor ba byas nas lha gang rung de'i bstod pa dang yi ge brgya ba bzlas/ badz+ra mu brjod pas chab rom chu zhu ba bzhin dkyil 'khor bsdus la/ spro na thab khung gi phyogs bzhir 'phrin las bzhi'i bro brdung zhing dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo/ ces pa'ang rgyud don bzhin kaḥthog 228

rig 'dzin chen pos sbyar ba dge/rtsa gsum rab 'byams kyi tshogs mchod tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs zhes bya bzhugs so/ /na mo ma hā mu dā ya/ rtsa gsum rab 'byams la sbyor tshogs pa'i tshogs mchod bya ba la/ thog mar sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i phab rgyun khongs dag gi ril bu thob na bdud rtsir gtam/ sha chang la sogs pa'i rdzas med mi rung yang / o rgyan chen pos/ rtsi shing dmar po 'byung ba'i khrag thams cad dag pa dbang gi rdzas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dmar ba thams cad sha dang gsher ba thams cad khrag tu dmigs pas 'grub phyir ched du bsad pa'i sha sogs rtogs pa mchog ldan min na spang nas sdig med chos dang mthun pa'i longs spyod 'du bar byas te/ rdzas rnams la bdud rtsi gtor te/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i thugs ka nas/ ram̐ yo khaṃ 'phros me rlung chur gyur pas/ /dngos 'dzin nyes skyon thams cad bsreg gtor bkrus/ /rlung me thod pa'i sgyed pur a yig las/ /byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che'i nang / /sha lnga bdud rtsir sa bon bcu yis mtshan/ /rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas 'khor rlangs pa yis/ /'khor 'das bdud rtsi'i dwangs ma zhu ba'i rgyun/ /'dres pa zag med 'dod yon bdud rtsir gyur/ /oṃ āḥr+ghaṃḥha ho trīḥbyin gyis rlabs la/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis mdun gyi mkhar/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos srung tshogs/ /sprin phung 'thib pa bzhin du spyan drangs nas/ /tshogs zhing rnams dang dbyer med bzhugs par gyur/ /o badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥr+ghaṃ bam̐ hoḥ de nas phud cha bzhir bgos la/ dang po mchod pa ni/gzugs sgra dri ro reg ldan pa'i/ /'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di/ /gus pa'i blo yis 'bul legs na/ /dgyes pa'i gar gyis bzhes su gsol/ /ga na tsakra pū tsa kha hiḥ bar ba bshags pa ni/ thog med dus nas da lta'i bar/ /sgo gsum mi shes bag med pas/ /nyams chags 'gal 'khrul ci mchis pa de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /yig brgya yang bzla/ tha ma bsgral bstabs ni/ cha gsum pa'i 'dod yon lha mo r+ghaṃḥzhes rang la bsdu/ dṛ tri badz+ra aṅga sha dzaḥ dzaḥr+ghaṃḥboḥhoḥsaḥ bsgral bya bstim la/ r+ghaṃḥng ni za byed chen po ste/ khams gsum ma lus bsgral ba dang / /gdul dka' ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir/ /sha rus la sogs bza' bar bya/ /mā ra ya phaṭaḥ zhes dwangs ma ye shes kyi 'khor lor spar la/ snyigs ma dum bur gtub cing bdud rtsir sbar te/ ma hā rma sa rak+ta ke ni ri ti a mṛ ta khyi hiḥ zhes bstab po/ de nas rol ba ni/ rang lus lha'i dkyil 'khor du gsal la/ gtum mo sbar zhing tshogs rdzas dang spyi bo'i haṃ yig zhu ba'i bdud rtsi dkar dmar gyis rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor mnyes shing bde stong lhan skyes kyi ye shes rtsol med du shar ba'i dbyings su mnyam par bzhag nas/ ho/ bla ma dpa' bo chen po dgongs su gsol/ /'dir ni chos rnam bzang por ltos/ /'dus pa rnams la the tshom med/ /bram ze khyi 229

dang gdol ba phag /rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol/ /ho/ bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku/ /'dod chags la sogs dri ma spangs/ /gzung 'dzin rnam par bral ba yi/ /de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /a la la ho/ zhes thabs shes mnyam sbyor gyi rgya bcas blangs la/ ho bdag lus phung khams skye mched ni/ /gdan gsum tshang pa'i ngo bo ste/ /dam pa rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor lha/ /'gul spyod thams cad bde ba che/ /rdo rje'i dam tshig bla na med/ /byang chub sems kyi sprin chen por/ /gnyis med mnyam pa'i ngang du rol/ /rnal 'byor lam gyi tshogs rdzogs shing / /zas kyi sgrib pa mi 'byung bar/ /gtan pa med pa'i sbyin bdag kyang / /theg chen 'bras bu thob par shog /ces rol la/ smon lam ni/ he ru ka dpal dkyil 'khor du/ /tshogs kyis mchod pa phul ba yis/ /bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog /ches smon lam btab/ gtsang lhag dang btsog lhag cha bzhi bcas bsres la/ oṃ āḥhūṃḥha ho trīḥ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas dam tshig gi kha phru btab cing byin gyis brlabs te/ r+ghaṃḥ mkha' 'gro ging dang dbang phyug ma/ /ma bdun sring bzhi 'bar ma brgyad/ pho nya la sogs lhag sdud tshogs/ /dpal gyi pha 'bab 'di gsol la/ /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /oṃ uts+tshaṣ+ṭa ba ling ta kha kha khy-i tiḥ zhes phyi rol du 'bul lo/ mthar bsngo ba ni/ 'dis mtshon bdag gis dus gsum dge ba rnams/ /rang don zhi bde'i dri mas ma gos par/ /mtha' yas sems can sdug bsngal las bsgral te/ /bla med byang chub thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /ces bsngo smon gang lcogs ci shes 'don par bya'o/ /zhes tshogs mchod nyung ngur bsdus pa kun la 'jug bde ba zhig yod na zhes rang slob dus mas bskul na'ang tshogs mchod sad sud mang po sngar byas yod pas de dag gis ma chog pa zhig cher ma mchis smras nas bzhag rung / 'on kyang nye char dag snang chos sde 'ga' zhig phab grub pa dang de dag la sbyar ba'i tshogs mchod cig yod na rjes 'jug dad ldan rnams la bsod nams chen po 'byung ba'i rgyur 'gyur zhes gter bdag gling pa'i thugs kyi sras grub dbang 'gyur med klong grol gyis bskur ngor kaḥthog pa rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus bdud rtsi phug tu sprel lo hor zlar ba'i tshes nyer lnga la bris pa 'dis nyams len mkhan kun la kha dge zhing bkra shis pa gdon mi za'o/ /shur+ghaṃ/rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i skyes rabs gsol 'debs bsdus pa bzhugs/ oṃ swā ste/kun bzang he ru kaḥdang gnyis med mgon/ /dpa' bo thugs kyi rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /lung rtogs bstan pa'i rtsa lag rmad byung ba/ /rgyal sras shan+ta de bar gsol ba 'debs/ /brtul zhugs rol ba'i gar gyis 'dzam gling brgyan/ /grub chen nag po spyod par gsol ba 'debs/ /phyag rgya che mchog rig 'dzin sar gshegs pa/ /bod grub nam mkha'i snying por gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas lnga kun gzigs 230

dregs pa bran du bkol/ /rong zom chos kyi bzang por gsol ba 'debs/ /rdzogs chen snying thig nyi ltar brdal mdzad mgon/ /dri med 'od zer 'phro der gsol ba 'debs/ /rnam smin rig 'dzin mchog brnyes mkhyen pa'i gter/ /rje btsun sgrol ba'i mgon por gsol ba 'debs/ /kun kyang las las ma yin sprul ba'i gar/ /smon lam dbang gis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /rlabs chen rgyal ba'i 'phrin las byed pa po/ /tshe dbang nor bu'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bka' drin sum ldan rdo rje slob dpon ni//rgyal kun ngo bor rgyal bas yongs bsngags na/ /rdo rje 'dzin dbang de kun dus 'di ru/ /rtsa ba'i bla mar shes bzhin gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal ldan bla mar snying nas gsol btab mthus/ /byang chen grangs med lam la mi ltos par/ /skye ba gcig la lam lnga sa bcu rdzogs/ /byang chub chen po'i 'bras bu myur thob shog gnas skabs tshe 'dir nad med 'byor ba rgyas/ /dbang phyug che thob 'dod don 'bad med 'grub/ /bya byed kun kyang byang chub lam du gzhol/ /'brel bcas gtan bde mchog la 'god par shog/smon lam de dag bslu med nyid grub par/ /dkon mchog kun 'dus bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /ces rgyal po dad pa dang ldan pa ā na tha yis dad pa'i rten dpal nam mkha'i snying po'i sku brnyan ri mor 'god pa'i rgyab byang du rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus rab myos lcags rta gsar du bzhad pa'i cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bzhi la mnga' ris smad kyi rgyal phran smon thang gi khab tu brjod pa'o/ /yang zab yid bzhin nor bu u pa de sha lasaḥ bsam lhun don bsdus dngos grub kun 'byung bzhugasaḥ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃḥbadz+ra gu ru pad+ma sidhi r+ghaṃḥ e ma hoḥ skye med chos dbyings ngang nas sgyu ma'i 'phrulaḥ 'gro ba'i bsam don 'grub pa'i bdag nyid canaḥ thugs bskyed stobs kyis 'phrin las khyad par myuraḥ pad+ma 'byung gnas zhabs la gsol ba 'debasaḥ yid bzhin nor 'dra ma hā gu ru rjeḥ gang 'dod dngos grub stsol ba'i skur ston paḥ gtum drag me phreng dregs pa'i sde dpon brgyadaḥ o rgyan sman bla de bzhin gshegs pa brgyadaḥ drwa ba sdom pa gnod dbang po brgyadaḥ rdo rje gzhon nu yi dam sgrub sde brgyadaḥ zil gnon drag rtsal gzhi bdag skyong ba brgyadaḥ gsang bdag seng sgrog dpa' bo ging bzhiḥ pad+ma badz+ra khrag 'thung rdo rje brgyadaḥ gu ru rta mgrin gsang ye phyag rgya bzhiḥ rdo rje khro lod bdud 'dul khro bo bcuḥ pad+ma rgyal po nye sras sems dpa' brgyadaḥ 'od dpag med mgon mi 'khrugs dpa' bo bdunaḥ kun bzang rdor sems rigs bzhi bdud 'dul bzhiḥ rtsa ba'i bla ma rig 'dzin slob dpon bzhiḥ thugs dam bskul lo brtse bas dbyings nas gzigasaḥ rgyal ba kun 'dus bla ma'i dkyil 'khor laḥ mi phyed rtse gcig gus pas gsol ba 'debasaḥ phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen ma lus zhiḥ bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobasaḥ ces pa 'di'i nang du yang gsang bsam pa lhun grub kyi yi 231

dam kun 'dus pasaḥ 'di ltar dad dam brtan pos rgyun du gsol ba 'debs pa dang ཿ kha ton du bgyid paḥ yi ger 'bri baḥ par tu bskrun paḥ rgyal mtshan gyi rtse la phyar baḥ gcig nas gcig tu spel sogs byas pas nad gdon sdig sgrib zhiḥ tshe bsod ye shes rgyasaḥ snang sems dbang du 'duḥ dgra gdon bar chad selaḥ 'khor dang gdul bya rgyasaḥ chos dang srid kyi bsam don lhun gyis grub nas bsod nams kyi g.yang 'khyilaḥ srung mas sdong grogs byedaḥ gang du gnas kyang yid bzhin nor bu ltar 'dod yon thams cad rjes su 'brangs shing 'gro ba kun kyis bkur bar 'gyur roḥ zhes pa'ang rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu bdag la o rgyan pad+ma gnang ba'i man ngag zab mo'iḥ dge'oḥ bsam lhun sngon 'gro'i bskyed chog shin tu bsdus pa niḥ mchog gsum kun 'dus bla mar skyabs su mchogaḥ 'gro kun srid las sgrol phyir byang sems bskyedaḥ yan lag bdun pa phulaḥ hūm̐ḥ snod bcud ye nas rdo rje gsum gyi ngang ཿ rang snang dag pa 'og min pad+ma 'odaḥ rang nyid rnal 'byor mar gsal mdun mkha' ruḥ pad+ma nyi zla rgyas pa'i gdan gyi kharaḥ pad+ma 'byung gnas sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i skuḥ zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje balja bsnamasaḥ rgyal ba zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor sku la rdzogasaḥ gnas gsum 'od kyis ye shes lha tshogs bkugasaḥ tshig bdun spyan 'dren niḥ skyabs gnas kun 'dus o rgyan chen po laḥ phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul nyes ltung snying nas bshagasaḥ gsang ba gsum gyi yon tan dran pas bstodaḥ tshe rabs kun tu brtse bas rjes su zungasaḥ gsol 'debs byaḥ gsol ba btab tshe bla ma 'od du zhuḥ rang la thim pas rang nyid bla mar gsalaḥ snying dbus ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka ruḥ rgya gram lte bar 'bru gsum brtsegs pa'i mtharaḥ snying po g.yas 'khor snod bcud bla mar sadaḥ zhes yi ge bcu gnyis pa bzlas la dbang bzhi blang nas dge ba bsngo/dpal chen yang dag he ru ka'i sgrub thabs bde chen rol mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs/ bde ba'i bdag nyid yang dag he ru kaḥ bde chen 'byung gnas gal po chen po yi/ /bde stong ci bzhin ngo sprod bla ma rje/ /bde chen gling pas byin rlabs dbang bskur stsol/ /he ru ka gal po ni yang dag gi rgyud kun gyi rtsa ba yin la de yi dgongs pa nyams su len tshul la/ yang dag zla gam gcig pa/ dgu ba/ bco brgyad pa/ lnga bcu pa/ khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad pa sogs rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa yod pa ni gdul bya 'dul byed kyi 'phrin las rmad du byung ba yin no/ /'dir bstan dkyil 'khor zla gam dgu pa la/sgrub thabs bsdus pa'i lugs su byas te ku sa li pa rnams 'jug bde ba'i cho ga bshad par bya'o/ /he ru kaḥdapal nyams su len par 'dod pa dag gis dkyil 'khor dang sgrub rdzas sogs gzhung bzhin bshams/ sgrub par byed pa'i thabs la gsum/ sngon 'gro'i cho ga /dngos gzhi'i cho ga /bsdu ba'i 232

rim pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mchod rdzas rnams la oṃ ru lu ru lu hūṃḥbh+yo phroṃḥram̐ yam̐ khaṃḥ.o āḥrdzuḥ zhes lan gsum mam bdun brjod la/ aḥ thams cad stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang / /spyoḥlas rin chen snod nang du/ oṃ las phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /so so'i lha mo'i rol ba las/ /rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur/ /o badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā ju puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gadhe nai wi byā shaja rū pa shardo gadhe rā sa sparnye pā tits+tsha ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta ba li ta o āḥr+ghaṃ swā hāḥzhes rlabs/ rgyud sbyang ba ni/ rang gi snying gi'i r+ghaṃ gi 'od zer gyis bla ma rig 'dzin rgyal ba zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥmakha' khyab tu sad par mos la/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes sogs yan lag bcu ba lan gsum brjod/ tshogs zhing rnams bsdus la mnyam par 'jog bgegs bskrad pa ni/ r+ghaṃ rgyu r+ghaṃḥ nga ni dpal chen he ru kaḥ srid pa 'di na che ba'i rje/ /gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ /song zhig lha min lha yang rung / /sgrub la bar gcod byed pa'i bdud/ /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par byos/ /rtsa sngags dang hūṃḥbazhi drag po'i sngags so lnga bas brab la bskrad/ srung 'khor ni/ /rdo rje'i thal mo la mtheb mdzub rtse sprad pa rin po che'i khang bu'i rnam pa'i phyag rgya bcas/ rgyuḥ nga yi dkyil 'khor brtan pa'i phyir/ /khro rgyal byin rlabs las byung ba'i/ /mtshon cha rnam pa lhan tshogs kyis/ /dkyil 'khor rim pa bzhin du bsrung / /hūṃḥsteng yang rdo rje'i bla bre la/ /'og kyang rdo rje'i sa gzhi ste/ /phyogs mtshams rdo rje 'bar bas gtam/ /rdo rje'i mtshams las ma 'da' zhig /rtsa sngags dang rdo rje'i phyag rgya bcas/ oṃ badz+ra te dza tīkyā tsakra r+ghaṃ phaṭaḥ ces me tog 'thor/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ zhi ba sgrub pa dang / drag por sgrub pa'o/ /dang po zhi ba ni/ aḥspros bral stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /'od lnga 'khyil ba ye shes dal/ /phyogs dang dbus med mkha' ltar brdal/ /chos rnams 'byung ba'i gzhal med khang / /spros pa'i mtshan ma bral ba'i dbus/ /pad dkar zla ba rgyas pa'i steng / /med pa'i rgyu las mngon byung ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba che/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdor dril 'dzin/ /snyem ma dmar skya gri thod can/ /chags pa chen pos mgul nas 'khyud/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /rang byung bde ba'i ngang du rol/ /phyogs bzhir rdor sems rigs bzhi po/ /kun kyang gtso 'dra longs spyod rdzogs/ /rdo rje pad+ma mnyam par sbyor/ /chags pa'i sgra yis snang shes gcod/ /gzhan yang zhi ba'i rigs kyi lha/ /ma 'dres chu la zla gzugs bzhin/ /phyogs kun go mtshams med par gtam/ /gtso bo'i thugs gsang zla dkyil dbus/ /rdo rje rtse lnga langs pa'i lter/ /'bru bzhi 'khor bas 'khrul shes sbyang / /bde chen ye shes rab 'bar gyur/ /o badz+ra su twa aḥ zhes mang du bzlas/ gnyis par khro bo bsgrub pa ni/ sneḥ yab yum sbyor ba'i sna rtse nas/ /cir yang bsgyur ba'i yig 'bru 'phros/ /e yo bo lo ro ka las/ /gru gsum mthing 233

nag nam mkha' la/ /'degs byed rlung nag rgya gram gtam/ /chu me sa yi dkyil 'khor brtan/ /rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba klong 'khyil/ /rus pa brtsegs pa'i ri rab la/ /dur khrod me ri smug nag 'bar/ /zla gam dbang chen maṇ+ḍal/ /'byung lnga dag pa yum lnga'i mkha'/ /bde chen pad+mo rgyas pa'i spubs/ /byang sems zhu ba'i gzhal med khang / /phyi ni gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ /nang na zla gam dgu ba yi/ /dbus cha dkar dmar byang sems mkhar/ /zla gam dmar po sgo gcig pa/ /nyi zla bam gyi gdan steng du/ /rdor sems 'od zhu yongs gyur ba/ /rdo rje mthing nag r+ghaṃ gis mtshan/ /de nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su/ /'das pa'i dus nas sngon byung ba'i/ /rgyal kun thugs kyi ye shes che/ /dpal chen yang dag ho ru kaḥ mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing nagaḥ rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rngo'i chung g.yas/ /dril bu thod khrag rgyu zhag g.yon/ /rdo rje'i khyung gshog rab tu gdengs/ /spyan gsum dmar zlum mche ba gcigs/ /he ru kaḥyi chas bcu dang / /rin po che yi rgyan gyis brgyan/ /zhabs bzhi g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs kyis/ /lha chen pho mo'i gdan la brdzis/ /de yi pang du dgyes byed yum/ /badz+ra gro dhī shwa ri ma/ /mthing skya zhi khro'i nyams 'gyur rdzogs/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje/ /g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stobs/ /sku la gzig gi sham thabs dang / /phyag rgya lnga dang nor bu'i spras/ /zhabs gnyis g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum gyis/ /yab la 'khyud cing gar gyis smyo/ /gnas gsum rdo rje'i yi ge las/ /dbang lha spyan drangs dbang bskur te/ /khrag 'thung rigs lnga'i cod paṇa la/ /rgyas btab sku lnga'i dbang phyug gyur/ /brda bzhi ldan pa'i sbyor ba yi/ /yab kyi byang sems thugs rje'i rgyun/ /pad+mor spros pa'i rol ba las/ /ha brgyad ma mo brgyad du shar/ /shar phyogs dkar mo g.yas zhing dbyug /g.yon pa bhan dmar 'dzin pa mthing / /lho phyogs rkun mo mda' gzhu 'geng / /mda' rtse gtso la gtod pa ser/ /nub tu sbos mo g.yas chu srin/ /rgyal mtshan bhan dmar 'dzin pa dmar/ /byang du rmongs mo g.yas rgya gram/ /g.yon pas zhing dbyug g.yob pa mthing / /shar lhor rgan byed g.yon zhing chung / /g.yas pas rgyu 'dren ma dmar ser/ /lho nub thal byed g.yas rdo rje/ /g.yon pas dung khrag dkrug pa ljang / /nub byang ma tshogs phyag gnyis kyi/ /zhing chung bzung nas za ba mthing / /byang shar dur khrod g.yas zhing chung / /g.yon pas mgo 'dzin ma ser skya/ /thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /rnam 'gyur ma nges cir yang ston/ /gcer bu zhing lpags na bza' can/ /phyogs mtshams zla gam 'bar ba'i nang / /bam chen steng na gar stabs 'gyed/ /gzhan yang khrag 'thung sprul ba'i lha/ /ma lus mtsho la gza' skar bzhin/ /rang byung dkyil 'khor chen po ru/ /ye nas 'bral ba med par bzhugs/ /srin po'i gzugs la dag pa'i thugs/ /'gro la bu gcig bzhin du gzigs/ /de ltar gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi/ /gnas gsum sngags kyi 234

'khor lo las/ /'od 'phros 'og min chos kyi dbyings/ /sems nyid skye 'gags bral ba nas/ /rig pa'i rtsal gyi ye shes pa/ /rang shar tshul du spyan drangs gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes se gol dpung mgor bsnol la gdab nas/ spyan 'dren pa ni/ r+ghaṃḥye shes spyan gyi spyod yul las/ /dpal chen khrag 'thung 'khor dang bcas/ /sems can don slad dam tshig dgongs/ /gnas 'dir ma lus gshegs su gsol/ /hūṃḥ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshul gshegs tshul gshegs te ru kaḥ chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las kyang ཿ gzugs sku 'jigs gzugs bstan du gsol/ /thugs rje che la thabs mkhas pa/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol/ /tshogs rje tshogs bdag dbang dang ldan/ /tshogs kyi slob dpon gshegs su gsol/ /ye shes rtogs pa'i khyad par las/ /sprul pa'i tshogs kyang gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri bā ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wān dzaḥr+ghaṃ bam̐ hoḥ ru lu ru lu dṛ sh+ya hoḥs ma ya s+t+waṃḥ sa ma ya hoḥ oṃ e badz+ra ā ra li hoḥ trī trī trīḥkā ya wā ka tsit+ta tiṣ+ṭha badz+raḥ zhes rang gi sgo gsum tu brtan par bzhugs su gsol la/ mchod pa ni/ phyi nang gi mchod pa re re bzhin phul na legs shing khyad par 'di la sman mchod gtso che bas rgyas pa byed pa'am mi lcogs na/ o ā r+ghaṃḥ 'dod yon lnga ldan phyi'i mchod pa/ /sman raka gtor gsum nang gi ste/ /thabs shes sbyor sgrol gsang ba che/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir lha la 'bul/ /oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pāju puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gadhe nai wi t+yā shaja rū pa shalda gadhe rā sa spak+ṣe ṅgā tits+tsha ma hā sarba pa.ā+oṃ a mṛ ta rak+ta ba li ta ma hā sarba pu dza hoḥ zhes thams cad bsdus te phul zhing sman myang ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya sidhi oṃḥ wāka sirnyi āḥ tsit+ta sidhi r+ghaṃḥ bstod pa ni/ r+ghaṃḥbadag med phyogs bral don dam thugs chud cing / /byams dang snying rje'i dgra zin mi mnga' yang / /gdug pa 'dul phyir dus las mi 'da' ba'i/ /'jigs byed he ru kaḥl phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khro mo dbang phyug sku la nyer gnas shing / /thabs dang shes rab 'brel ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /mkha' 'gro mi bzad 'bar ba'i sprin 'phro ba/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad yum la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /nam mkha'i lus can gar yang thogs med cing / /'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i gzugs can 'phrul mo che/ /ma sring byams pa'i tshul gyi grogs mdzad ma/ /phyi nang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'dzab ni/ hūṃḥdapal chen thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi/ /nyi zla ga'u kha sbyor klong / /rin chen zur brgyad 'bar ba'i nang / /zla ba'i gdan la rdo rje ni/ /rtse dgu sngon po phyed pa'i lter/ /r+ghaṃḥyig dmar ljang 'od zer 'phro/ /rwa dgu ru lu 'bru dgus mtshan/ /de bzhin gi ri ma brgyad kyi/ /thugs gsang bhar+ghaṃ til tsam steng / /rang srog haḥyig mtha' skor du/ /ru lu'i sngags kyi phreng ba 'bar/ /'phro 'dus 'od kyis don gnyis byas/ /snang grag khrag 'thung chen po'i dal/ /bde ba'i ye shes 'bar bar gyur/ rtsa ba'i sngags 'bru brgyad pa ni/ /235

oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ḥbh+yo hūm̐ḥ zhes pa 'di gtso 'khor chig sgril gyi sngags yin pas 'bad pas bzla/ yang yab kyi sngags/ oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka hūṃḥ yum gyi sngags/ oṃ badz+ra gro ti shwa ri s+t+waṃḥ zhes lan kha shas dang /o badz+ra go rī haḥ oṃ badz+ra tso rī haḥ oṃ badz+ra pra mo he haḥ o badz+ra be+e tā lī haḥ o badz+ra puk+ka sī haḥ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī haḥ oṃ badz+ra sma sha nī haḥ o badz+ra tsad+dha lī haḥ lan bdun nam nyer gcig bzla/ bzla ba'i tshe dman pa dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor sku'i gsal snang la sems bzung nas gzugs snang he ru ka'i sku ru lam gyis shar bar byed pa dang / zab pa sngags kyi rnal 'byor srog 'khor dang sngags sgra la dmigs pa rtse gcig tu gtad pas 'byung ba'i sgra yang ru lur grags pa dang / mthar thug chos kyi rnal 'byor snying ga'i mi shigs pa'i thig le la sems bzung pas las rlung dbu mar thim zhing mi rtog pa'i ye shes khongs nas 'bar bar byed pa gsum gdams pa'i ching yin pas shes par bya ba dang / spyir 'dir/ gtum mo/sgyu lus/ 'od gsal/ rmi lam/ 'pho ba bar do bcas chos drug gi rnal 'byor la nyin mtshan 'khor yug tu brtson pa byas na mchog thun gyi dngos grub gdon mi za bar thob par 'gyur la/ he ru ka gal po las rim pa lnga'i nyams len byung ba sogs shes na mchog tu 'gyur zhing / las dang po ba'i skabs rnal 'byor gsum dang ru lu 'bru brgyad kyi dgongs pa lam du slong ma nus shing chos drug gi nyams len blos mi lcogs na dang po sngags 'khor la sems 'dzin dang thig le spro bsdu dang / gtum mo'i rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas 'jug dgos/ bzlas bya'i sngags du ma yod kyang sngags gtso bo ni ru lu ste 'di'i nang du che mchog yang dag gi bskyed rdzogs 'phrin las dang bcas pa 'du bar shes dgos/ de la ru lu dkyil 'khor du shes pa/ lhar/ sgra/ 'phrin las/ mchod pa/ dbyangs/ bsnyen pa/ chos nyid du shes pa brgyad kyis 'gag bsdam nas don la byang chub na cho ga rgyas bsdus dang dmigs pa'i bye brag gang zhig yin kyang mchog thun gyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa rjes chog ni/ bsnyen pa'i mthar/dbyangs gsal yig brgya sogs kyis sku gsung thugs kyi chad lhag bskang zhing rten 'brel snying pos brtan par bya/ ram̐ yi khaṃḥ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃḥ zhes mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ r+ghaṃḥ ar+ghaṃ me tog bdug spos dang / /mar me dri chab bshos dang sgra/ /phyi nang gsang ba sbyar ba rnams/ /bdag dang mnyam pa'i tshogs la 'bul/ /oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā bye puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gadhe ne+e li byā shaja rū pa shabha gadhe rā sa sparte mā tits+tsha ma hā sarba pa.ā+oṃ a mṛ ta rak+ta ba lo ta ma hā sarba pū dza hoḥ zhes mchod/ bstod pa ni/ r+ghaṃḥ bde gshegs mnyam nyid chos kyi dbyings/ /ma skyes rdo rje kun tu bzang / /thabs mkhas khro bo skur ston pa/ /dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /o ni 'bar ba'i seṅge brjid/ /ma tshogs sprin dang skar ltar 'phro/ /r+ghaṃ chen nyi zla'i tshogs rgyun 'dra/ /ma nor re skong mkha' la 'gro/ /oṃ ni ye shes lnga dang ldan/ /ru 236

ni 'bar srog chags sdang 'joms/ /lu ni kun bzang bde ba'i yum/ /r+ghaṃḥni ye shes tshad med bzhi/ /bh+yo ni gnas gyur ma 'gags pa/ /r+ghaṃ gis byin rlabs sdud par byed/ /ru lu 'di ltar ya mtshan che/ /ru lu rtogs pa gong du 'phel/ /ru lu dngos grub ma lus ster/ /zhes yi ge brgya ba bcas bstod la bzod par gsol/ /rdzogs rim/ r+ghaṃḥ phyi snod gzhal khang dang 'khor la bsdu/ /de yang yum dang yab kyi sku la bsdu//yab kyang sngags 'khor thugs srog nyid la thim/ /srog yig gyen rdzogs nā da chos dbyings mkhar/ /r+ghaṃḥr+ghaṃḥr+ghaṃḥ slar yang rjes thob snying rje chen po'i rtsal/ /'od gsal snang ba chu las nya 'phar ltar/ /snang grag rig gsum yang dag he ru ka'i/ /gsang gsum 'khor lor shar ba'i ngang nas spyod/ /phaṭaḥphaṭaḥphaṭaḥ o ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo r+ghaṃḥ badz+ra ka ba tsi rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃḥ bsngo smon ni/ he ru ka dpal sgrub pa'i byin mthu yis/ /rnal 'byor gsum gyi don la rang byan tshud/ /ru lu 'bru brgyad dgongs pa ma lus rtogs/ /dbang bzhi'i bstan don bskyed rdzogs yan lag bzhi'i/ /rig 'dzin bzhi dang sku bzhi mngon byed shog /bkra shis ni/ skye med chos sku'i rang bzhin rnam dag las/ /thugs dam dbang gis gzugs kyi skur sprul pa/ /bcom ldan he ru ka dpal yab yum gyis/ /skye shi med pa don gyi bkra shis shog /ces dpal chen po nam mkha'i snying po'i thugs dam snga 'gyur rig 'dzin dam par gyur ba rnams kyi gsang ba'i skog chos/sa rnying gi bla ma gong ma rnams grub pa'i sa mthon po la skyel bar byed pa'i zab chos khyad du 'phags par/rang dang skal mnyam rnams 'jug bde ba'i cho ga rgyas bsdus ran pa bka' gter tshad ldan rnams kyi snying po bsdus te bkod pa 'di nyid kyang / glo bo rgyal po'i blon chen puṣ+yo dharma wadhes phyag rgya ma'i mchod pa bcas nan gyis bskul ngor lcags phag lo nag zla'i dmar phyogs bde ba 'phel ba'i thun skabs la rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu rnal 'byor dgyes pa rdo rjes spel bas 'gro kun bde ba mchog gi lam nas dpal chen yang dag ho ru ka'i go 'phang la 'god nus par gyur cig sarba maṅga lo/(dpal yang dag zhi khro la brten pa'i grib sel mi gtsang snyogs ma sel byed ke ta ka yi me long 〉zhes bya bzhugs so/ /ye nas grib dang lhan du mi gnas pa'i/ /bde gshegs snying po rang sems bla ma che/ /'bras bu yang dag pad+ma bde ba che/ /lta ba rnam dag ngang nas gus 'dud do/ /'dir grib sel bya ba la gsum/ /thog mar rang nus ldan du bsgrub pa/ bar tu gzhan gyi grib bsal ba/ tha ma shis par brjod pas bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la'ang / dang po rdzas 'du bar bya ba ni/ stegs bu gtsang ma'i khar/dpal yang dag gi sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams bshams/ /sgrub gtor gyi g.yas su rin po che'i bum pa la bla med bum rdzas so lnga'am bdud rtsi chos sman gyi gtam pa dang / g.yon du chu gtsang ba la byung lnga khungs ldan thob na rab min kyang bzang drug sogs dri bzang gi chus bkang kha la rma bya'i gdong dang ku 237

shas brgyan/ de'i mdun bsang chu/ mtha' skor du me long / dku mar/ khrus ras/ spos por/ rnga yab/me tog sna tshogs sogs mchod rdzas ma tshang ba med par bshams/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'og gam nye 'gram tu/dri glud/ chang bu/ glud rdzas/ khrus gzhong / nab bza' gsar ba'am dri med bcas tshogs par byas/gnyis pa sgrub pa ni/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i bsang chu byin gyis brlabs te dkyil 'khor dang gnas khang yo byad thams cad la gtor/ yang dag zhi ba rdor sems dang khro bo badz+ra he ru ka'i cho ga rgyas bsdus gang rung la 'jug zhi bsnyen mjug las bum la a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ a las bum pa'i gzhal yas dbus/ /bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' gsal/ /sku las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun byung / /bum pa yongs su khengs par bsam/ /o badz+ra sa twa aḥ zhes dang yi ge brgya ba yang ci mang bzla/ mthar mchod bstod byas la/ bum lha 'od du zhu ba bum chu dbyer med gyur/ badz+ra mu/ zhes se gol bcas bsdu/ khro bsnyen mjug sngar ltar bsang sbyang byas la/ sneḥlas bum pa bdud rtsi'i gter/ /phyi ni bum pa'i rang bzhin la/ /nang ni bkod pa gzhal med khang / /dpal chen khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor bzhugs/ /gnas gsum yi ge'i 'od zer gyis/ /ye shes lha tshogs spyan drangs bstims/ /snod bcud bkrag mdangs gzi brjid bsdus/ /bum bdud bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor 'khyil/ /slar yang rang gi thugs ka las/ /'od 'phros gzungs thag la 'khril te/ /bum pa'i lha tshogs thugs rgyud bskul/ /dgyes pas sku las bdud rtsi'i babs/ /oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ḥbh+yo r+ghaṃḥ zhes stong rtsa las mi nyung ba dang / oṃ badz+ra go rī haḥ oṃ badz+ra tso rī haḥ.o badz+ra pra mo he haḥ oṃ badz+ra be+e tā lī haḥ oṃ badz+ra puk+ka sī haḥ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī haḥ oṃ badz+ra sma sha nī haḥ.o badz+ra tsad+dha lī haḥzhes gau rī ma brgyad kyi sngags kyang ci mang bzla/ /mthar mchod bstod byas la/ lha 'od du zhu ba chu'i rdul phra rab tu gyur/ o āḥr+ghaṃḥ zhes brjod/ gsum pa lha khrus bya ba ni/ las slob gyis khrus dar gyi lcibs ldan me long dang gtso bum thogs la/ khrus kyi khang ba shin tu dri zhim pa/ /shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba bstar/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan/ /mu tig 'od chags bla bre bres pa der/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la/ /rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus/ /yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni/ /rol mo bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃḥ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye r+ghaṃḥ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs mchog la/ /nyon mongs sgrib pa mi mnga' yang / /bdag sogs sgo gsum sgrib byang phyir/ /gtsang ma chab kyis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a gi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye r+ghaṃḥzhes pa nas ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che sogs dang / rtsa ba gsum srung mar bcas pa gang 'os 238

sbyar la/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o/ /oṃ rgyu ṭ+wāṃ trīḥ.āḥkā ya bi sho dha na ye swā hāḥ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing / /gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur gyur pa'i/ /gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir 'bul/ /bzod pa dam pa gos kyis brgyan par shog /oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra ye swā hāḥ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan/ /thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med/ /byin rlabs ye shes chu yin te/ /ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye r+ghaṃḥ de ltar rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la khrus chab gsol bas khrus chu byin rlabs dang nus ldan du gyur/ ces sku khrus gsol ba'i chu phyir bum pa gnyis la thig pa re blugs/ bzhi pa grib khrus bya ba ni/ slob ma'i spyi bor rdor rje sems/ /yab yum gsal ba'i sbyor mtshams nas/ /bdud rtsi babs pa tshangs bug zhugs/ /nyams tshig chag nyams mi gtsang grib/ /ma lus 'og gi sgo gnyis dang / /ba spu'i gsang nas nag nyil thon/ /sa 'og rim pa dgu ru song / /lan chags bdag po tshim par bsam oṃ badz+ra sa twa aḥ zhes bzlas bzhin khrus chu spyi bor blugs nas/ /sdig sgrib thams cad shihaṃ ku ru ye swā hāḥ'og ma rnams la 'gre/ nad thams cad/ gdon/ 'khon/ grib/ byad/ byur/ skal ba ngan pa/ ltas ngan pa/ rmi lam ngan pa/ mtshan ma ngan pa/ bkra mi shis pa/ nye bar 'tshe ba/ dus min 'chi ba/ gza' dang rgyu skar/ rgyal po dang chom rkun/ bdud kyi zhags pa/ gshin rje pho nya/ bgegs dang log 'dren/bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shirnye ku ru ye swā hāḥ ces re re'i mthar yi ge brgya ba bzlas kyang rung ngo / /de ltar lan gsum bskyar nad pa tshab chen sogs yin tshe rang gi sha drod dang mthun pa'i chu dang khrus chu bsres la lus yongs rdzogs bkru/ bsdu ba tsam bya na gdong dang skra ma lus par bkrus/rma bya'i sgro lag tu thogs te/ rten 'brel rdzas kyi bum sgro'i steng / /sngags phreng 'od zer tshwa tshwa 'phro/ /rlung g.yos mi mthun phyogs thams cad/ /thal ba bzhin du ded par bsam/ /zhes rma bya'i chun po dmigs bya'i steng la byabs bzhin rtsa sngags dang yi ge brgya ba'i mthar/ sdig sgrib thams cad shudhe shudhe ho/ 'og ma rnams la 'gre/ nad thams cad/ gdon/ 'khon/ grib/ byad/ byur/ skal ba ngan pa/ ltas ngan pa/rmi lam ngan pa/ mtshan ma ngan pa/ bkra mi shis pa/ nye bar 'tshe ba/ dus min 'chi ba/ gza' dang rgyu skar/ rgyal po dang chom rkun/ bdud kyi zhags pa/ gshin rje pho nya/ bgegs dang log 'dren/ bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shudhe shudhe hoḥkhrus ras sbyin pa ni/ khrus ras kyis lus kyi chu thams cad gtsang bar phyis la/ aḥrdo rje sems dpas byin rlabs pa'i/ /ras dkar dri ma med pa 'dis/ /slob ma'i lus rten phyis pa yis/ /sgrib kun bral ba'i rten 'brel shar/ /oṃ badz+ra sa twa aḥ sa ma ya shudhe aḥ zhes du ma zlas te snum la sngags btab 239

nas sbyin pa dang dmigs bya'i lus snum gyis byugs/ sngar gyi gos phud nas gos gsar dri med bgod/lnga ba grib glud gtong pa ni/ sngar gyi khrus chu dang glud/ mar me chang bu sogs glud rdzas thams cad lhan du bzhag nas bsang chu gtor zhing / oṃ su bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmaḥ swa bhā wa shurnyo3haṃ/ na ma:sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ uṅga te spa ra ṇa i me ga ga na khaṃ ṭ+wā hā/ o badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na r+ghaṃ phaṭa: o na ma: sarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra r+ghaṃ/ o dzñā natsho.a wa lo ki te na maḥ sa man+ta rasmi bha wa sa ma ha ma ya ma ni du ru du ru hri da ya dz+wa la ni hūm̐/ na moḥs man+ta bud+dha māṃ gra he shwa ra pra bh+ya rdzu ti ma hā sa ma ya swā hā/ zhes sngags drug phyag drug gis byin gyis brlabs la/ kyeḥmi las lhag pa'i ngar glud 'di'i/ /lus kyi brjid nyams ye re re/ /mdzes pa'i nyams 'gyur ya la la/ /dar gyi gos rgyan 'od chems chems/ /rin chen rgyan cha si li li/ /ral ba lcang lo nyi li li/ /dar gyi dpyang thag pu ru ru/ /lus kyi gar stabs shigs se shigs/ /snyan pa'i glu dbyangs kyu ru ru/ /brtse ba'i sems rgyud drod lam lam/ /khang bzang skyed mos tshal dang sman/ /grogs dang spyan gzigs yo byad dang / /sha chang gos rgyan rdzongs pa sogs/ /'dod pa'i yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /rnal 'byor sngags dang phyag rgya yis/ /mig 'phrul lta bu'i longs spyod kun/ /phangs pa med pa khyod la gtad/ /dga' zhing mgu la tshim gyis la//rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po 'di/ /bzung pa thongs la bcings pa khrol/ /bsdams pa bshig la mnan pa khyogs/ /khyer ba sprod la gnod pa skyur/ /zos pa skyugs la 'chi ba gsos/ /lus la nad du ma bzhag cig/srog la 'tshe ru ma sems zhig /rang gi lus la dpe longs la/ /gzhan dag bde zhing skyid du chugs/ /ces dang / oṃ badz+ra sa twa aḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ud+ku te spa ra ṇa i me ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ zhes sngags re dang glud rdzas tshom re bsngo/ bcu re'i mtshams/ bde gshegs rin chen mang dang gzugs mdzes dang / 'jam klas 'jigs kun bral la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bgegs chen bzhi dang stong phrag brgyad cu'i gdon/ /glo bur ye 'brog sum brgya drug cu dang / byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga la sogs pa/ /mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba'i byin rlabs stsol/ /kyeḥ khyer cig khyer cig stobs ldan rnams/ /sred dang chags dang zhen pa dang / /dran dang gzugs dang bsam dang reg /glod dang zhi dang grol bar mdzod/ /ces rab byung na brgya rtsa bar bskyar nas bsngo/ /mthar glud rdzong ni/ glod dang zhi dang grol bar mdzod nas/ /chos rnams thams cad rgyu lus byung sogs dang / 'byung po gang dag 'dir ni sogs brjod cing bskyal ba dang lhan du drag sbyong ni cho ga gang yin de'i bka' bgo bgegs bskrad nas srung 'khor bar gtong ba yin no/ /drug pa grib sel bya ba la drug me sbyang / bdug pa/ bdud rtsi/ srung ba/ bden brjod/ bkra shis 240

so/ /dang po me sbyang ni/ dmigs bya me la 'gom bcug gal te mi lcogs na me 'bar ba'i snod las la skor ba gsum du byed du bcug la/ ram̐ḥ ye shes me ni kun nas 'bar/ /gos dkar yum gyi rang bzhin nyid/ /nad gdon bags chags ma lus pa/ /'bar ba'i dbus su bsreg par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra sa twa ru lu ru lu r+ghaṃḥbh+yo r+ghaṃḥ.o badz+ra shrī he ru ka hūṃḥ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhi smi ku ru ye dz+wa la ram̐ ram̐ḥ lan bdun brjod/gnyis pa bdug pas sbyang ba ni/ bdug spos slob ma la g.yas skor gsum dang g.yon skor gsum byas te bdug nas/ aḥ ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya las/ byung ba'i lhan cig skyes sbyar spos/ /bdug pas mi gtsang rnam rtog sbyangs/ /sku gsum shel bzhin dag gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra sa twa ru lu ru lu r+ghaṃḥbh+yo hūm̐ḥ.oṃ badz+ra shrī ho ru ka r+ghaṃḥ badz+ra dhu pa sirnyi pha la hoḥ sa ma ya bhu shudhe hoḥ gsum pa bdud rtsis bran pa ni/rang nyid he ru ka'i nga rgyal bcas spyi bo'i gtsug tu gtso bum gyi chab gtor la/ /hūṃḥng ni yang dag ho ru kaḥ khams gsum 'di na su yang rung / bka' las 'da' ba'i skabs med pas/ /'khrul ba'i 'dzin rtogs dbyings su choms/ /ye nas dag pa'i sgo gsum po/ /don la grib gyis sgrib pa med/ /'dzin pa'i dbang gis byung ba'i grib/ /'dzin med chos nyid klong du song / /o badz+ra sa twa ru lu ru lu rtsuḥbh+yo hūṃḥ.o badz+ra shrī he ru ka rgyuḥ sa ma ya bhu shudhe hoḥ lan bdun bzlas la rang gi thugs las he ru ka gnyis pa dmigs bya'i spyi bor zhugs nas 'dzin rtog sgrib pa las byung grib dang mi gtsang ba'i tshogs bcom par bsam/ bum chu lte bar gtor la/ r+ghaṃḥ nga ni khro mo dbyings phyug ma/ /rnam dag sku la chags mi mnga'/ /dgyes mdzad dpal chen sku la 'khril/ /shes rab gnyis med bde chen rdzogs/ /mnyam nyid dbyings la re dogs bral/ /gtsang dang smre ba'i grib bral yang / /gzung rtog dbang gis byung ba'i grib/ /dmigs med chos dbyings klong du song / o badz+ra sa twa ru lu ru lu hūṃḥbh+yo r+ghaṃḥ o badz+ra kro ti sho ri s+t+waṃḥ sa ma ya bhu shudhe hoḥ ces bzlas la khro mo dbyings phyug ma'i sku gnyis pa zhig lte bar thim par dmigs/ bum chu dpral bar gtor nas/ haḥkhro mo dkar mo zhing chen gdan la 'gying / /'khor ba'i rnam rtog gzhom phyir zhing dbyug phyar/ /shar phyogs dri za'i grib rnams bzlog cing bsgyur/ /go rī dkar mo'i thugs dam dbyings nas bskul/ /kun gzhi'i rnam shes las byung rnam rtog grib/ /ting 'dzin stobs kyis yi ge ra la bsdus/ /tshangs dbang grib kun me long ye shes dbyings/ /'dzin med rang yal ngang du dag gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra sa twa ru lu ru lu r+ghaṃḥbh+yo r+ghaṃḥ oṃ badz+ra go rī haḥ sa ma ya bhu shudhe hoḥ zhes lan bdun nam nyer gcig bzla/ grib rnams yi ger ra la 'dus pa 'od thugs ka'i 'od kyis dag par sbyar la go rī dkar mo dpral bar thim pas gnyis su med par bsam/ de ltar 'og nas kyang yi ge dang gnas mi 'dra ma gtogs sde brgyad kyi sa bon sbyang ba dang lha 'od du zhu nas byin gyis brlabs pa sogs dmigs pa 241

sogs mtshungs pas rigs 'gre bar bya/ bum chu snying gar gtor nas/ haḥ khro mo gser mo zhing chen gdan la 'gying / /thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i mda' gzhu 'geng / /lho phyogs gshin rje'i grib rnams bzlog cing bsgyur/ /tso rī ser mo'i thugs dam dbyings nas bskul/ /yid kyi rnam shes las byung rnam rtog grib/ /ting 'dzin stobs kyis yi ge ya la bsdu/ /gshin rje'i grib kun mnyam nyid ye shes dbyings/ /'dzin med rang yal ngang du dag gyur cig o badz+ra sa twa ru lu ru lu rtsuḥbh+yo rgyuḥ o badz+ra tso rī haḥ sa ma ya bhu shudhe hoḥ snying gar thim pa'i dmigs pa bya/ mgrin par chu gtor la/ haḥ khro mo dmar mo zhing chen gdan la 'gying / /'khor bar mi gtong chu srin rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /nub phyogs klu dbang grib rnams bzlog cing bsgyur/ /pra mo dmar mo'i thugs dam dbyings nas bskul/ /nyon mongs rnam shes las byung rnam rtog grib/ /ting 'dzin stobs kyi yi ge phu laḥl bsdus/ /klu bdud grib kun sor rtog ye shes dbyings/ /'dzin med rang yal ngang du dag gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra sa twa ru lu ru lu hūm̐ḥbh+yo r+ghaṃḥ oṃ badz+ra pra mo he haḥ sa ma ya bhu shudhe hoḥ mgrin par thim pa'i dmigs pa bya/ /gsang bar bum chu gtor la/haḥ khro mo ljang nag zhing chen gdan la 'gyings/ /chos nyid 'gyur med rdo rje bhar+ghaṃ 'dzin/ /byang phyogs gnod sbyin grib rnams bzlog cing bsgyur/ /be+e ta lī yi thugs dam dbyings nas bskul/ /lus kyi rnam shes las byung rnam rtog grib/ /ting 'dzin stobs kyis yi ge tri la bsdus/ /gdon sbyin grib kun bya grub ye shes dbyings/ /'dzin med rang yal ngang du dag gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra sa twa ru lu ru lu r+ghaṃḥbh+yo hūṃḥ o badz+ra bai tā lī haḥ sa ma ya bhu shudhe hoḥ gsang bar bsdu/ mig la bum chu gtor la/ haḥ khro mo dmar ser zhing chen gdan la 'gying / /nyon mongs gnas nas 'dren phyir rgyu ma gsol/ /shar lho'i nad gdon grib rnams bzlog cing bsgyur/ /puk+ka sī yi thugs dam dus la babs/ /mig gi rnam shes las byung rnam rtog grib/ /ting 'dzin stobs kyis yi ge du la bsdus/ /ya bdud grib kun dmigs med chos kyi dbyings/ /'dzin med rang yal ngang du dag gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra sa twa ru lu ru lu rtsuḥbh+yo hūṃḥ oṃ badz+ra puk+ka sī haḥ sa ma ya bhu shudhe hoḥ mig la bsdu/ rna bar bum chu gtor la/ haḥ khro mo ljang nag zhing chen gdan la 'gying / /'khor ba zhal du gsol phyir dung khrag 'thung / /lho nub nad gdon grib rnams bzlog cing bsgyur/ /ghasma rī yi thugs dam dbyings nas bskul/ /rna ba'i rnam shes las byung rnam rtog grib/ /ting 'dzin stobs kyis yi ge ti la bsdu/ /gza' bdud grib kun dmigs med chos kyi dbyings/ /'dzin med rang yal ngang du dag gyur cig o badz+ra sa twa ru lu ru lu hūṃḥbh+yo hūṃḥ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī haḥ sa ma ya bhu shudhe hoḥ rna bar bsdu/ sna la bum chu gtor la/ haḥ khro mo mthing nag zhing chen gdan la 'gying / /'khor ba rten dang bral phyir bam chen phral/ /nub byang nad gdon grib rnams bzlog cing 242

bsgyur/ /sme sha nī yi thugs dam dbyings nas bskul/ /sna yi rnam shes las byung rnam rtog grib/ /ting 'dzin stobs kyis yi ge tsa la bsdus/ /btsan bdud grib kun dmigs med chos kyi dbyings/ /'dzin med rang yal ngang du dag gyur cig o badz+ra sa twa ru lu ru lu r+ghaṃḥbh+yo r+ghaṃḥ o badz+ra sma sha nī haḥ sa ma ya bhu shudhe hoḥ sna la bsdu/ lce la bum chu gtor nas/ haḥ khro mo ser skya zhing chen gdan la 'gying / /log rtog dbral phyir bam ro mgo lus phral/ /byang shar nad gdon grib rnams bzlog cing bsgyur/ /tsad+dha lī yi thugs dam dbyings nas bskul/ /lce yi rnam shes las byung rnam rtog grib/ /ting 'dzin stobs kyis yi ge ma la bsdus/ /ma mo'i grib kun dmigs med chos kyi dbyings/ /'dzin med rang yal ngang du dag gyur cig o badz+ra sa twa ru lu ru lu hūm̐ḥbh+yo r+ghaṃḥ oṃ badz+ra tsad+dha lī haḥ sa ma ya bhu shudhe hoḥ sna la bsdu/ re re bzhin sngags dang dmigs pa rten 'brel rdzas kyi sbyor ba phun sum tshogs na grib las grol ba'i mtshan ma 'phral du byung ba chos nyid yin/ gong gi ma mo brgyad kyi mjug gi lho nub dang nub phyang la gong 'og gi khyad par du ma mchis la sde brgyad phyogs so sor 'god tshul yang rang phyogs dang srog dang gshed kyi phyogs byed tshul mchis pa thams cad la dgos pa dag dgongs gzhi mchis la/ 'dod chags chu/ zhe sdang me/ nga rgyal sa/ phrag dog rlung / gti mug nam mkha' sogs kyi gnad shes na dregs pa sde brgyad kyi srog la rang dbang sgyur ba dang de'i gnod pa zhi bar tshegs med la/ khyad par tshogs brgyad ka nas dag pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs yang dag gi don ci bzhin slong nus na grib tshogs nyi ma'i mdun mun pa mi gnas pa ltar sel ba smos ci zhig la dgos/ de ma yin pa'i grib sol dang song zhig sogs phyag len dang spros pa mang mang rdzigs rdzigs ci byas rung bsngags nus kyis mi phan bcos thabs ci byas rung yang phan thogs rgya chen po zhig 'byung bar bka' bas gzugs brnyan tsam mo/ /bzhi pa srung ba ni/he ru ka'i snying po 'bru brgyad ras sam shing shun la bris te mgul du btags nas rab gnas 'thor ba'am dar dmar gyi skud pa la sku gsum mtshon pa'i mdud pa gsum brgyab te sngags btab la/ r+ghaṃḥrgyal ba rnams kyi byin rlabs ni/ /'gro kun dad pa'i sgor bzhugs pas/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags 'phreng 'di/ /btags pas khyod lus rdo rjer 'gyur/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa ru lu ru lu r+ghaṃḥbh+yo hūṃḥ oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka hūṃḥ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa r+ghaṃ/ zhes phus gdabs nas srung bya'i gdul bya'i mgul du btags/ /lnga pa bde bden brjod ni/ slob dpon gyi rdo rje mkha' la gdengs nas/ hoḥ sangs rgyas rnams ni bdud las rgyal/ /chos ni chos ma yin las rgyal/ /dge 'dun mi rtag rnams las rgyal/ /dbang po lha ma yin las rgyal/ /lha min zla ba rnams las rgyal/ /nam mkha' lding ni mtsho las rgyal/ /me ni shing rnams kun las rgyal/ /chu ni me las rgyal ba ste/ /rlung ni sprin las rnam par rgyal/ /rdo rje yis ni 243

rin chen phug /lha rnams bde bar rab tu gnas/ /sangs rgyas dang ni chos kyang bden/ /bden pa rgyal gyur rdzun ma lags/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams ma lus pa/ /zhi zhing rnam par rgyal gyur cig dza ya dza ya sidhi sikhyi bi dza ya swā hāḥ drug pa bkra shis ni/ me tog 'thor la/bde gshegs mnyam nyid chos kyi dbyings/ /ma skyes rdo rje kun tu bzang / /thabs mkhas khro rgyal skur ston pa/ /he ru ka yis bkra shis shog /rnam dag sku la chags mi mnga'/ /dgyes mdzad dpal chen sku la 'khril/ /shes rab gnyis med bde chen rdzogs/ /dbang phyug ma yis bkra shis shog /me long mnyam nyid so sor rtog/ /bya grub ye shes rang bzhin dang / /'byung bzhi rnam par dag pa yi/ /lha mo rnams kyi bkra shis shog brjid pa'i sku la dpa' ba'i zhal/ /bdud dang log/ 'dren kun gyi gshed/ /chos ldan bu bzhin skyong mdzad pa'i/ /srung ma'i tshogs kyis bkra shis shog /rgyal po'i dbu 'phang mtho ba dang / /chab srid dbu rmog btsan pa yis/ /rgyal khams 'khrugs rtsod kun zhi nas/ /lo legs bde ba'i bkra shis shog /nad rnams kun las thar ba dang / /grib rnams ma lus sangs ba dang / /byang chub sems kyi shes rgyud phyugs/ /gzhan phan spyod pa'i bkra shis shog /mchog gsum bden pas mi bslu zhing / /sngags kyi bden pas yang mi bslu/ /chos nyid bden pas mi bslu phyir/ /snod bcud bkra shis 'bar gyur cig /gdod nas mi 'gyur chos kyi dbyings/ /bdag gzhan 'dzin pa ka dag pa'i/ /'khor gsum dmigs med lta ba yis/ /mnyam brdal chen po'i bkra shis shog ces pa'ang yul 'dir bram ze rnams kyis khrus gsol dang grib sel gyi cho ga shin tu dar srol che 'dug pas rgyal po'i sku grib sel ched de dang mtshungs pa zhig khyod tsho gangs can pa'i dzo ki la yod dam zhes bka' 'dri byung bar bod chen po mdo sngags kyi rgya mtsho yin pas ci yang yod la khyad par rnam 'joms dang rme brtsegs kyi zhabs khrus khyod cag rnams las rgyas spros can mang po yod kyang re zhig 'dir dpe mi 'byor rung / bal yul gyi nang pa rnams kyi khrod na yang dag nyams len mkhan ches mang zhing cho ga dam dum re yod pa nged cag bod dang gcig mtshungs yod pas spros pa dgos na de la man ngag gis lhan thabs byed chog byas pas/ de ltar bgyid par dbu'i bla ma bram ze chen po rnams kyis gsol ba ltar bal yul gyi rgya gzhung 'ga'i 'gros dang rang lugs sngar yod kyi cho ga la gzhi byas te chog 'grigs byas shing khrus gsol tshar ba dang rgyal po'i sku grib zla ba sprin las grol ba bzhin song bas phyag kyang 'gyel bzhin 'tshal/ 'bul ba'i dngos po bstabs te khyod kyi gdams pa de yi ger bkod nas nged rgyal blon dang nyid kyi zhabs grwas pa 'ga' la sgos chos su gnang ba dang yi ge mi 'khyal bar gsol ba btab pa ltar bod chen po'i rigs sngags 'chang ba tshe dbang nor bu dpal gyi rdo rjes chu sprel nag zla'i dmar phyogs mkha' 'gro'i dus chen la 244

bal yul yam bu rgyal po'i skyed mo'i tshal khrus kyi rwa ba dang me tog sna tshogs kyis mdzes pa'i dbus kyi khang bzang am+bil du rdzogs par bris pas 'gro ba'i rtog sgrib bag chags ngan pa'i grib rnams sel ba'i rgyur gyur cig /༄ga /rgyal chen rnam mang thos sras gsang bdag phyag mtshan bzhi ba'i mchod chog 'dod dgu'i gter 'byung zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /na mo badz+ra pā ṇi ya/ rgyal ba kun gyi gsang ba'i bdag /lag na rdo rje la btud nas/ /gang gi rnam 'phrul gnod sbyin gyi/ /gtso mchog ngal bso'i mchod chog bshad/ /de yang gnas khang yid mthun par/bris sku sogs rten rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor mchod gtor nyer spyod spyan gzigs ci 'byor bshams shing /tsan+dan dkar dmar a ka ru spos dkar sā lu'i phye ma'i spos dud btang la/ bdag nyid gdong bkrus shing mchod pa byin rlabs bdag skyed sngon du 'gro bas mdun rten la/ o badz+ra a mṛ ta kaṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na rgyuḥr+ghaṃḥrgyuḥphaṭaḥswā hāḥ oṃ swa bhā la shud+dha sarba dharmaḥ swa bhā wa shurnyo ྅haṃḥ zhes bsang sbyang bya/ baiḥbadag mdun mkha' la srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus/ /'byung ba bzhi brtsegs gling bzhi ri rab steng / /rin chen pho brang sgo gru rta bab bzhi/ /nang lta khor phug ka ba khri yis mdzes/ /dbus su rin chen khang bzang sum brtsegs la/ /sa 'og gter gyi khang pa bco lngas brgyan/ /khor sa rim gsum dang por khang bzang brgyad/ /pho brang lte dbus tsaḥ las seṅge'i steng / /ṭ+wāṃḥ las rnam mang thos sras sku mdog dmar/ /phyag gnyis dmar bzlum zhal gdangs mche ba gcigs/ /phyag g.yas stag gi rgyal mtshan mdung dmar phyar/ /g.yon na ne'u le dang lcags kyu 'dzin/ /dar gyi na bza' bse khrab rdo rje'i spras/ /bswe yi rmog zhu dar dmar cod pan 'phur/ /phyogs bzhir ṭ+wāṃḥ las nor rgyun dbyangs can ma/ /nor skyong bha ra li dmar zhi ma khro/ /rus pa'i rgyan sras lcags kyu rnga yab 'dzin/ khang bzang brgyad du rta bdag gnod sbyin brgyad/ /g.yas pa rang rtags mtshon dang mdung dmar bsnams/ /ne'u le dang lcags kyu g.yon na 'dzin/ /ser nag dkar ngang rang mdog rta la bcibs/ /khor sa bar mar klu brgyad tha ma'i nang / /sde dpon nyer brgyad stobs chen so gnyis phyi/ /lha srin sde brgyad 'khor tshogs dpag med bskor/ /bdag gi thugs las khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal/ /dmar po lcags kyu zhags pa thogs 'phros nas/ /lcang lo can nas gnod sbyin bdag po che/ /ma lus skad cig nyid la spyan drang gyur/ /badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ mgon po kun gshegs thugs dam can/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ /thams cad nyon mongs 'dams byings bas/ /mtshams med lnga ni kun spyod cing / /gzigs shing gshegs pa'i 245

gnas ngan yang / /shākya seṅge'i spyan sngar khyod/ /thugs dam gang bzhes de dgongs la/ /'dren pa'i bstan pa srung ba dang / /sems can kun la sman slad du/ /byang phyogs gnas na bzhugs pa rnams/ /sems can don phyir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ be+e shra ma na ye sa pā ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃḥbaṃḥhoḥ oṃ bai swā hāḥ oṃ be+eḥ shra ma ṇa a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ baiḥ ring po brjid dang ldan pa mig 'byed 'dzum sum cu so gnyis kyi yun tshad du brjod/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kaṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭaḥ ces sngags kyis phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ rgyal po'i thugs kar pad+ma'i 'dab ma re re la baiḥ bzhi bzhi/ bdag mdun kyi thugs 'od zer gyi lcags kyus sbrel bar gyur/ o rat+na mu ku ṭu a bhi ṣiñtsa meḥ zhes cod paṇa gyis dbang bskur/dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃḥgis byin gyis brlabs/ hūṃḥri rab chen po'i gzhal yas 'dir/ /nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan khri la/ /gnod sbyin rgyal po 'khor dang bcas/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhugs su gsol/ /sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhanaḥ zhes bzhugs su gsol/ gsang bdag gnod sbyin 'khor dang bcas/ /dam tshig can gyi lha tshogs la/ /gnyis med dngas pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /rtse gcig gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /a ti pū hoḥ pra ti dza hoḥ zhes phyag rgya bya/ hūṃḥgasang bdag gnod sbyin chen po 'khor bcas la/ /spos dang me tog mar me zhal zas dang / /sil snyan rnga chen byug pa mchod pa'i sprin/ /dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul pas mchod/ /oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā bye puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gadhe nai wi t+yā shalda pū dza me gha sa mu tra spa ra na sa ma ye hūṃḥ zhes pas mchod/ bstod pa ni/ baiḥ ri rab lhun po'i byang phyogs nas/ /rgyal po chen po rnam thos srasaḥ gling bzhi'i byang phyogs skyong tsa na/ /in+d+ra nī la'i mdog dang ldan//sa brgyad sems dpar bzhugs pa po/ /gnod sbyin pho mo mang po dang / /klu yi sde dpon mdzad tsa na/ /rin chen gser gyi kha dog dang / /mkha' 'gro ma dang klu mo dang / /bdud mo'i sde dpon mdzad tsa na/ /be+eḥ ḍūr mthing ka'i sku mdog can/ /gsang ba'i gnad nas bskul tsa na/ /pad+ma rā ga'i mdog 'dra ba/ /mi thung bzheng pa'i cha lugs la/ /leb rgan dar gyi cod paṇa can/ /sku la bswe khrab dmar po gsol/ /phyag g.yas mdung dmar rgyal mtshan thogs/ /g.yon pas ne'u le lcags kyu 'dzin/ /'gro ba'i rnam shes dbang du sdud/ /sku las 'od zer dmar po 'phro/ /srid pa gsum yang dbang du sdud/ /'gro ba mi yi rnam shes 'gugs/ /nor bdag rnams kyi lag pa bsgul/ /bdag la zas nor dngos grub stsol/ /khyod kyi sprul pa'i rgyal phran rnams/ /'gro ba rnams kyi snying la zhugs/ /rnam shes bsgyur la dbang du bsdus/ /sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol/ /zhes bstod cing bskul lo/ /bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rgyal po 'khor bcas kyi thugs kar nyi ma gnas pa'i be+eḥ yig sngags kyis bskor ba bdag gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis bskul bas ci 'dod pa'i 'phrin las thogs med du bsgrub par bsam la/ oṃ ma hā rā dza yak+ka sa ma ye be+e shā ma ṇa ye 246

sarba tsit+ta rat+na hri hri dzaḥ dzaḥ zhes ci nus bzla/ gtor ma bsang sbyangs ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kaṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na rtsuḥr+ghaṃḥr+ghaṃḥphaṭaḥswā hāḥ o ṭ+wā bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmaḥ swa bhā wa shurnyophohaṃḥ stong pa'i ngang las rlung me thod pa'i sgyed pu la gnas pa'i aḥ las ka pa lar bcud sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar gnas pa la/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis gnod byed thams cad bkug ste thim pa'i sha khrag gi gtor ma 'dod yon gyi phung por bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūṃḥ lan gsum dang / oṃ a ka ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā tsā ābya nut+pan+da tot+ta oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa ṭ+wā hāḥ zhes byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ be+e shā ma ṇa sa pā ri wa ra ma hā ba lin+ta ma hā pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hiḥzhes pa bdun gyis phul la/ be+eḥrin chen mdzes pa'i pho brang na/ khams gsum dbang du byed pa'i lha/ /rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras/ /mdung dmar 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang phyogs rgyal po rnam thos sras/ /sras dang blon po sgo ma dang / /gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs dang bcas/ /'khor bcas ma lus thams cad la/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /bu sdug bzhin du skyong ba dang / /tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par shog /gzhan yang bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /log par zhugs pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ /de yi phru ma gzhom pa dang / /gtan nas brlag pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /de ltar bcol ba'i las de dag / dam tshig ldan pa khyod rnams kyi/ /sngon gyi dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ /ma g.yel da lta 'grub par mdzod/ /ces 'phrin las bcol/ yi ge brgya bas chad lhag bskang / /be+eḥring po brjod pas pad 'dabs kyi baiḥ rnams gshegs/ /'od kyi lcags kyu bkrol bar bsam/ rten med na/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad par du gsol/ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa byang phyogs su gshegs/ /rten yod na/ 'dir ni rten dang lhan gcig tu/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang / /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ /zhes ye shes pa rten la bstim/ /dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ smon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs brjod do/ /de ltar gsang bdag gnod sbyin rje/ /yang gsang phyag mtshan bzhi'i mchod chog /nyer mkho 'di bris dges 'gro kun/ /dbul sel byang chub che thob shog /ces rnam sras yang gsang phyag mtshan bzhi ba'i mchod chog 'dod dgu'i gter 'byung zhes mang nyung skyon med khyer bde 'di ni gtsang nyang smad dpal 'byor lhun po'i sde ba mi phyed dad gus can tshe dbang bsam 'grub rdo rje zhes pas yang yang gsol ba btab pa dang don gnyer can 'ga' la yang phan thogs pa mthong nas/ bod chen po'i phyogs su skyes pa shākya'i dge bsnyen tshangs par spyod pa chos smra'i gzugs 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus gtsang ru lag gi cha 'bras spung dgon du kun dga' zhes pa shing stag sa ga zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad kyi phyi thun gyi skabs chu tshod gcig la 247

grub par bgyis pa'i yi ge pa ni stag dpon bsod nams rab brtan no/ /maṅga lo bha wan+tu/༄ga /thugs rje chen po'i cho ga 'brel tshad rang grol bzhugs/thog mar skyabs sems ni/ rkang gnyis gtso bo bde gshegs bcom ldan 'das/ /chos dang dge 'dun bcas la skyabs su mchi/ /ma bsgral ma grol dbugs ma dbyung rnams ched/ /smon 'jug byang chub sems mchog bskyed par bgyi/ lan gsum/ lha bskyed ni/ oṃ su bhā
