wa shud+dha sarba dharmaḥ swa bhā wa shukau3 haṃḥtrīḥ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig dran rdzogs su/ /snod bcud dag pa po ṭa la yi zhing / /phun tshogs bkod pa'i yon tan bsam las 'das/ /de dbus pad zla 'ja' 'od 'khrugs pa'i klong / /trīḥlas rang nyid 'phags mchog snying rje'i mdzod/ kha sar pa ṇi zhal gcig phyag gnyis dkar/ /mchog sbyin pad dkar 'dzin cing skyil krung bzhugs/ /zhi tshul dgu ldan sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras/ /thugs kar zla steng trīḥ la sngags kyis bskor/ /'od 'phros 'phags mchod 'gro ba'i las sgrib sbyangs/ /thams cad dag pa rab 'byams 'khor lor 'gyur/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me r+ghaṃḥ ci nus bzla/ bum sgrub ni/ āḥlas bum pa'i gzhal yas su/ /'phags pa thugs rje chen po gsal/ /thugs ka'i sngags las bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /babs pa'i bum pa gang bar gyur/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me r+ghaṃḥ ci nus brjod/ mchod bstod ni/ oṃ ar+sā lo ke shwa ri maṇ+ḍal sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pā bye puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gadhe ni wi byā shari pā tits+tsha ye swā hā/ zhes dang / skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis dbu la rgyan/ /thugs rje spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs/ /spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lha 'od du zhu nas bum chu dang dbyer med du gyur par bsam se gol bcas gshegs/ bsngo smon ni/ dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag /thugs rje chen po 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog gshin po rjes 'dzin ni/ o su bhā stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po gsal ba'i mdun du pad dkar 'dab ma bzhi ba'i gdan la dmigs yul 'brel thogs pho mo zhes bya ba phung po khams dang skye mched yongs su tshang ba gson gyi gnas skabs ci lta ba bzhin du gyur bar bsam la/ hrīḥ bdag nyid thugs rje chen por gsal ba yi/ /thugs ka'i 'od kyis tshe 'das rnam shes te/ /mdun du bkugs nas mtshan byang rten la bstim/ /bag phebs gus pa'i tshul gyis gnas par gyur/ /na mo dkon mchog rtsa ba gsum dang chos nyid rnam dag chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bka' bden pa dang / khyad par 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pas/ dmigs yul che ge mo 'brel thogs pho mo'i 248

rnam par shes pa khams gsum skye gnas bzhi/ rigs drug bar ma do gang du gnas kyang skad cig gis dmigs pa'i rten 'di la khug cig na mo/ dkon mchog rtsa gsum chos nyid rnam dag dang / /chos can rgyu 'bras bslu med nus mthu yis/ /tshe 'das rigs drug bar do gar gnas kyang / /skad cig dmigs pa'i rten 'dir tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ lan gsum gyis rnam shes bstem/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa r+ghaṃḥ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhadzha ra ṇa phroṃḥphaṭa/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ ā hūm̐ḥ lan gsum brjod/ o sarba bisnan maḥsarba ta thā ga to bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yo sarba t+yad khaṃ uta ga te spa ra ṇa hi me ga ga na khaṃ skṛ ha na i rda bā li t+ya swā hāḥlan gsum/ o sum+bha ni sum+bha r+ghaṃḥ n+t+ra ha na skṛ ha na hūṃḥ n+t+ra ha na pa ya skṛ ha na pa ya hūm̐ḥ a na ya ho bha ga wa ti bir+ya rā dza kro ta ya r+ghaṃḥphaṭaḥ lan gsum/ gshed dang bral ba ni/ trīḥ nyon cig gnod byed srog gcod gshed ma'i rigs/ /tshe 'das thar lam sgrub pa'i gegs ma byed/ /mchod sbyin khyer la rang rang gnas su dengs/ /bka' las 'das na rdul du brlag par gyur/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me r+ghaṃḥ oṃ sum+bha sum+bha ni hūm̐ḥ skṛ ha na skṛ ha na rduḥ skṛ ha na pa ya skṛ ha na pa ya r+ghaṃḥ a na ya ho bha ga wan ti bibya rā dza kro ta ya rtsuḥphaṭaḥ badz+ra ma hā gro ta gnod byed za 'dre shi gshed srog gcod dbugs len mtho ris dang thar ba sgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa thams cad sarba u tsu ta ya phaṭaḥ ces bskrad la/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta rak+ṣa rak+ṣa rgyuḥ ces srung 'khor bsgom/khrus bya ba ni/ trīḥ gsung mchog yi ge drug ma'i chu rgyun gyis/ /tshe 'das rigs kyi bu la khrus bgyis pas/ /nyon drug sgrib sbyang rigs drug skye sgo chod/ /pha rol phyin drug yon tan thob par shog yig drug dang gzungs ring brjod/ dug sbyong ni/ hrīḥ 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor dang / /dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /tshe 'das las nyon bag chags dug bcom nas/ /sku gsum ye shes mngon du gyur bar shog rtsa sngags dang gzungs ring brjod/ 'don yon byin rlabs ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na r+ghaṃḥphaṭaḥ bsang / oṃ su bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmaḥ su bhā wa shukaupho haṃḥ sbyangs la/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las tram̐ḥ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥ hūṃḥ'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i 'dod yon gyi dngos po gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa zad mi shes pa'i gter chen po nam mkha' mdzod kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ o āḥhūṃḥ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma māṃ ā bya nut+pan+da twa ta oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hāḥ zhal zas ro brgya ldan cing yid 'phrog la/ /legs sbyar 'di ni rgyal ba sras bcas la/ /dad pas phul ba'i 'gro ba 'di dag gis/ /'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog /oṃ badz+ra s+t+ya wi byā ā r+ghaṃḥ kye ma gson cig tshe 'das lus brjes rigs kyi bu/ /249

sngon bsags las kyis 'brel ba'i pha ma dang / /brtse zhing gdung pa'i nye du thams cad kyis/ /bshams pa'i bza' btung gos rgyan 'dod yon rdzas/ /rdo rje slob dpon byams pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i gzugs sgra dri ro reg /'dzad med longs spyod nam mkha' mdzod du spel/ /tshe 'das rigs kyi bu la bsngos pa yis/ /gang 'dod bde ba'i dpal la tshim par rol/ /'di snang 'khor ba'i gnas la ma chags par/ /bden pa'i chos la gus pa'i yid kyis nyon/ /bde chen dag pa'i zhing mchog dam pa ru/ /the tshom med pa'i 'dun pa rtse gcig gis/ /bu khyod dad pa'i sems kyis 'gro bar gyis/ /'di ni pha rol phyin drug zas/ /'brel thogs rigs kyi bu khyod kyang / /zas mchog 'di la longs spyod cing / /phyin drug yon tan thob par shog /rtsa sngags dang gzungs ring / yig brgya/ mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs/kun rig rtsa sngags/ brjod/ thams cad nam mkha'i mdzod bzhin du/ /longs spyod chad pa med pa yang /rtsod pa med cing 'tshe med pa/ /rang dbang du ni spyod par shog /lam ston pa ni/ zhing khams 'di nas nub kyi phyogs rol na/ /bde ba can gyi zhing khams zhes bya yod/ ston mchog rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor tshogs grangs med bcas/ /kun kyang theg chen chos la longs spyod cing / /zhing der bkod pa'i yon tan bsam las 'das/ /bu khyod zhing mchog de ru lam bstan nas/ /the tshom med par gus pa'i thugs bskyed la/ /skad cig nyid la me tog pad+ma'i sbubs/ /brdzus skyes sprul pa'i sku ru 'tshang rgya shog /de nas tshe 'das kyi rnam par shes pa aḥ dkar por gyur pa snying ka nas byung ste rang nyid 'phags pa'i thugs kar thim pas 'od kyi thig le gsal zhing 'tsher ba zhig tu gyur nas dbu ma'i lam nas spyi bor thon te nub bde ba can gyi zhing du me tog pad+ma'i sbubs su gshegs par bsam la/ āḥphaṭaḥ phaṭaḥphaṭaḥ sangs rgyas nas slar yang sems can thams cad kyi don thogs pa med par byed nus par gyur cig hrīḥ tshe 'das 'byung bzhi'i grub pa'i bud shing la/ /thabs dang shes rab gsal ba'i me sbar bas/ /las dang nyon mongs bag chags kun bsreg nas/ /ye shes snang ba'i kun du khyab gyur cig rtsa sngags dang gzungs ring / yig brgya/ mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs/ kun rigs rtsa sngags/ rigs drug klong grol lan gsum brjod/ rgyuḥtrīḥ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs rje dang / bdag cag lhag bsam dag pa'i byin mthu yis/ /rgyu sbyor yon bdag mi nor 'khor bcas la/ /bkra shis dpal 'bar bde legs phun tshogs shog rjes kyi mchod bstod ni/ oṃ at+yā lo ke shwa ri maṇ+ḍal sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pā ju puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gadhe ne+e wi t+yā shaja mā tits+tsha ye swā hā/ zhes dang / skyon gyi ma gos sku mdog dkar/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis dbu la brgyan/ /thugs rje spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs/ /spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bzod gsol ni/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang dang / /gang yang nyes pa mang mchis pas/ /'dir ni bgyi ba gang swā~X0 pa/ /de kun khyod kyis bzod mdzod cig /ga brgya/ rten snying / bkra shis ni/ trīḥ mkha' dang

mnyam pa'i 'gro ba'i don/ /bstan dang bstan 'gro 'dul byed kyi/ /thugs rje chen po'i 'phrin las kyis/ /mkha' mnyam yongs la bde legs stsol/ /bsngo ba ni/ trīḥ thugs rje chen po sgrub pa'i dge ba gang / /nam mkha'i khyab tshad 'gro ba yongs la bsngo/ /smon lam ni/ trīḥ nam mkha'i khyab tshad lus can skye 'gro kun/ /myur du rnam mkhyen mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas shog bsdu rim ni/ hrīḥ bdag dang dam tshig ye shes gnyis med lha/ /nam yang mi gtong yun du brtan par bgyi/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa mā ya lhanaḥbasod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas te/ /skye rga na 'chi'i rba rlabs 'khrugs pa yis/ /srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgrol bar shog / ces bsngo smon gyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ / zhes pa'ang rje grol mchog zhabs kyi rdo rje'i gsung la rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus kha bskong lhan thabs cha tshang don 'dril du sbyar ba dge/ /

rog /thig nag rgyal mtshan gyi khungs lung 'dzugs tshul bcas gsal bor smos pa mi mthun phyogs kun las rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mtshon thub bstan rin po che'i go cha zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo bi dza ya/ rgyal ba'i yab gyur kun bzang zhi dang khro/ /bdun brgya nyer lnga'i grangs gyur de dag la/ /sgo gsum rab dad chen pos phyag bgyis nas/ /rnam par rgyal gyur thig nag khungs lung smra'o/ /de la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che 'gro ba lhar bcas kyi skyabs su gyur ba de nyid bzung zhing rgya cher spel na sems can dpag tu med pa phan bde'i dpal chen po la longs su spyod par 'gyur gyi/'on kyang de nyid ji ltar 'dzin na mdo las/ dad pa dang / brtson 'grus/ bag yod pa gsum gyis 'dzin dgos par gsungs shing / 'dzin par bya ba'i chos ni lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa gnyis so/ /bag yod pa ni sems gzhan du mi g.yengs shing sgo gsum chos dang bstun pa yin la bsrung ba kun gyis mchog tu gyur pas rdzas dang ting nge 'dzin gyi srung 'khor yang 'di'i khongs su bsdu'o/ /sngags kyi rgyud sde las dge 'dun bsdu ba/ bstan pa 'dzin pa/ dam chos spel ba/ chos 'khor srungs pa/ bstan pa la dgra byung na 'bod rbad bsad pa sogs kyi las rgya cher byed pa'i thabs gsungs yod do/ /de dag kun kyang rgyal ba'i phrin las yin phyir gal chung mi bya bar khungs dang ldan pa zhig don du gnyer rgyu de ka bstan 'dzin rnams kyi mdzad pa gtso bo yin/ 'dir 'phrin las rgya chen ma dros pa'i mtsho chen po lta bu'i nang gi cha shas shig brtags cing dpyad de blo gros kyi skra rtser blang nas brjod par bya ba rnam grangs bzhis bstan te/ dang po lo rgyus yid ches gong 'phel byed pa/ gnyis pa dgos pas brtson 'grus rtsom par bskul ba/ gsum pa bzo tshul mthong brgyud kyi man ngag gtan la dbab pa/ bzhi pa rgyal mtshan btsugs shing rnam par rgyal bar byed pa'o/ /dang po lo rgyus ni/ 'dir bshad tshul rgya chen zhig yod pa de dag mdor bsdus snying dril du smos na bzhi ste/ rgya gar tu dar tshul/ bon gyi bshad pa/ snga 'gyur gyi khungs/ phyi 'gyur gyis dar spel byas tshul yin no/ /rgya gar nas dar tshul ni 'di ltar thos te/ dpal ldan shar kha'i yig tshang gi bstan pa rtags kyi che ba bshad pa'i skabs su/ rgya gar yul du paṇa grub kyis//mi rtags rnams dang rtsod pa'i skabs/ /rang gi srog dang bstan pa dang / /'khor dang slob ma gta' mar byed/ /bden pa bslu ba mi srid phyir/ /lha min g.yul las rgyal ba bzhin/ /nam zhig nang pa rgyal 'gyur gyi/ /de tshe rnam rgyal rgyal mtshan slong / /mu stegs rnams kyi ral ba breg /phyag dar gos gyon bar 252

bu thogs/ /mgo reg zhabs rjen spyi bo yis/ /nang pa dag gi zhabs la btud/ /dbang phyug mtshon pa'i ral ba yi/ /lan bu thu gu srin mdzub tshad/ /byas shing rgyal mtshan rtse la 'dogs/ /nang pa rnams kyi sngags dang ni/ /bden pa'i tshig gis bkra shis bya/ /mu stegs lan mang pham byas pa'i/ /paṇa chen bskyil bu dang dgon sde'i/ /mtha' ru'i thig nag mang bar bshad/ /thig nag mang pa'i dgon sde la/ /mu stegs lha dang bcas pa'i tshogs/ /'jigs cing nye bar mi btud pa'i/ /che ba'i rtags 'di mi nyams par/ /nang pa kun gyis longs su spyod/ /ces bshad pa bzhin mu stegs pa dang nang pa'i bstan pa dpang du byas te brtsad pa'i lo rgyus dang / srog tshad du btsugs te brtsad pa'i lo rgyus rgya bod kun la yongs su grags mod/ ral ba bcad pa'i lo rgyus ni dkon la/ 'on kyang rang rer rgya gar gyi chos sde chen po dag mu stegs pa dus btab te rtsod pa'i khrims dang bya spyod mtha' dag zhig 'gyur med phyir brjod kyis ga la langs/ sngar mu stegs pa'i rgol ba mtha' dag sun phyung ste mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs la bkod de ral ba bregs nas rgyal mtshan gyi rtse la phyar ba'i lugs shig kyang yod par 'dug pa 'dis gsal lo/ /de ltar ral ba'i rgyal mtshan de gang du sprengs pa'i sa der mu stegs pa'i grub mtha' kun kyis rnam rtog byed cing ltas ngan du brtsi bas de'i lha srung 'byung po'i tshogs kyang phyogs su btud mi nus pa'i dgos pa chen po zhig par bshad do/ /gnyis pa bon gyi bshad tshul ni/ bon gyi lha srung chags pa'i rten mkhar dang slob ma la dam tshig gi rten du sngar bon kyi sngags pa rnams kyi rang gi dbu skra cha shas re slob mar gnang ba'i srol dar zhing /slob ma dag gi khang ba'i sgo dang / sbra sgo/ de shin tu byin rlabs che zhing gnyan pa mtshon byed du mdung gi rtse la btags te phyi rol du btsugs na jag rkun/ gcen spyang / lha 'dre sogs kyis gnod pa byed mi phod zer/ g.yul bkye ba'i tshe yang mdung gi rtse la bon kyis byin rlabs byas pa'i dbu skra dang srung mdud/ bal thig dang rnga ma sogs btags pa re khur nas 'gro ba de g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i rtags yin zer/ phyis su mdung dar du 'gyur ba de yang bon ston rnams kyi na bza' yin pa'i bshad rgyun 'dug kyang bsam dgos pa zhig la/ de na rgya gar dang rgya nag bal po sogs kyi mdung dar de yang bon las byung ngam ma byung brtags pa bya dgos so/ /'di kong yul gyi bon ston kha cig gi bshad srol yin pa las bon du gyur ba thams cad kyis de skad 'dod pa yin min ma shes so/ /thig nag kyang kong yul gyi bon gyi sgrub sde khag las mnga' ri khul sogs kyi bon po rnams kyis sbrengs pa nyung zhing / khyad par dol po khul du bon po rnams kyis dar mdung sbrengs pa gtso bor byed pa las thig nag yod pa shin tu nyung la/ nye ba'i lo shas nang dar rgyas 'gro ba zhig yin par 'dug go / 'dir ma gtogs pa'i 253

bshad srol khungs dang ldan pa zhig da bar lag son ma byung pas da rung nan tan du dpyad dgos/ /gsum pa snga 'gyur gyi khungs ni/ /sgrol ma bsam 'grub rdo rjes/ /g.yul las rnam rgyal skra yi rgyal mtshan 'di/ /phyi ltar rgyud mgon chen po chags pa'i rten/ /nang ltar sgrub sde brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs/ /gsang ba rnam shes tshogs brgyad dag pa'i ltas/ /'phags pa'i yul du pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /mu rtug pa dang mu stegs lnga brgya lhag /rtsod pas bzlog cing nus mthus tshar bcad nas/ /skal dman sna tshogs thabs kyis gzhug par mdzad/ /dug gsum rdul dang mun pa snying stobs la/ /grub mthar 'cha' dang khyi yi dka' thub sogs/ /log pa'i brtul zhugs 'chal spyod rtsad nas bcad/ /rma bya'i gdugs phyar skra yi rgyal mtshan ni/ /stong phrag btsug pas snyan pa phyogs bcur khyab/ /bod du byon tshe bon nag rtsod pa dang / /mthu yis btul te ral ba'i rgyal mtshan bslangs/ /deng dus bstan pa rgas pa'i pra ltas su/ /bstan pa 'dzin rnams dbu 'phangs dma' ba dang / /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzug pa nyung mthong nas/ /rdzas sngags dkyil 'khor tshad dang ldan pa byas/ /mdo rgyud sems gsum sgrub sde rnam brgyad kyi/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan deng dus nga bslangs kyis/ /bstan la kha zer yi dwags brten rnams ni/ /rtsod par nus pa med pa mthu nus sdug /ma 'ongs pad+ma'i rjes 'jug nga yi sras/ /'chad rtsod rtsom dang mthu dang nus pa yi/ /rgol ba choms shig rgyal rtags ral ba chod/ /rgyal mtshan tshugs shig bstan pa gnas par gyis/ /zhes 'jigs pa med pa gdong lngas sgra bsgrags te bod snga rabs la rtsod dang mthu nus 'gran pa'i tshogs rnams tshar bcad thig nag rgyal mtshan brgya rtsa btsugs pas bod yul gyi grub mtha' nyi tshe ba 'dzin pa mang zhig gis gu ru pad+ma'i ring lugs 'di nyid legs par rigs nas de la zhugs pa dang gsang bdag sgrol ma ba bsam grub rdo rje'i zhal slob tu gyur ces grags/ 'dir bstan la gu ru pad+mas rgya gar tu mu stegs lnga brgya lhag btul zhing de dag gi ral ba'i rgyal mtshan byas pa sogs gsungs shing rjes su bod du phebs tshe mu stegs dang phyogs mthun pa'i bon rigs pa'i lam nas rtsod pa dang / sngags dang nus rtsal rdzu 'phrul gyi sgo nas med par byas te rgyal mtshan btsug pa gsungs/spyir yongs grags la bon dang brtsad de rgyal ba dang bon logs bsnubs shing lha g.yang skor gsum sogs bon dkar bzhag pa'i tshul rgyas par gsungs pa dang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs tshul yang skabs rer gsungs yod pa las skra yi rgyal mtshan btsug pa'i tshul ngag rgyun dang mkhas gyur re zung gsungs min pa las mi 'byung mod/ bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bslab pa gsum ldan gyi sde dang lung rtogs kyi dam chos 'chad nyan byas pa la go yang skabs rer rgyal mtshan dngos su mi go ba'i nges pa'ang med snyam/ bsam yas brtsigs ris su gu ru'i chos gsungs pa'i phyogs so sor thig nag 254

rgyal mtshan phyar ba 'di yang bden dpang du dngos su zhal bzhugs pa yin la/ sgrol ma ba 'di snga 'gyur gyi bstan 'dzin gyi dbus su 'chad rtsod rtsom pa/ mthu dang nus pa/ rten bzhengs dge bskul sogs gang gi cha nas kyang rgyal mtshan gyi tog lta bu zhig yin pas khong gi gsungs pa 'di yang khungs dang ldan pa yin nges/ de skad smra ba yang gang gi phyag bris 'khrul med yab gzhis kyi lag tu mchod sdong chen por nyar ba'i nang nas bshus pa yin pas gzhan las khungs dag pa yin pas yid ches byed 'os/snga 'gyur gyi dgon sde phal mo cher thig nag med mi rung ba lta bur byed pa yang gu ru'i phyag srol rma med zhig yin par nges phyis su chos gzhis che chung ci tsam yang bkra shis pa'i rten 'brel thig nag re bslang na chos thams cad rten cing 'brel 'byung yin pas bstan pa yun tu gnas pa dang bstan 'gro'i bzhed don 'grub pa'i dgos pa shin tu che/ gong du gsungs pa ltar deng dus bstan pa'i dbu 'phang dma' ba'i ltas su bla ma rnams kyi khri je dma' dang dgon pa'i thig nag dang rgyal mtshan sogs la mdzes mdzes ltar snang gtso bor byas nas rang nyid dga' ba'i dngos po bud med kyi 'bags dang bya bye'u ri dwags sna tshogs pa'i dbyibs su bsgyur ba ni mi shis pa 'bod pa'i g.yab mo dngos yin 'dug chos 'khor ri dwags mchod pa'i lha mo sogs dkyil 'khor dang gzhal yas khang la dgos par gsungs yang de'i thig nag rgyal mtshan gyi tshab byed rung bar ma gsungs pas gal chen spang nas gang yin gyi gnas su des gang bar byas shing sgros nyams 'don pa ni don ma go ba'o//bzhi pa phyi 'gyur gyi dar spel byas tshul ni/ lha gcig 'jam dpal dpa' bo mi yi zol 'chang /bod tsam du ma zad skabs der rgya gar na'ang mdo sngags rigs gnas thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan drug gi rgyal tshab dam pa lta bu gyur ba/ dpal sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta zhes mtshan snyan rgya bod tsi na dang hor gyi yul sogs 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan drug gi rgyal tshab dam pa lta bur gyur ba/dpal sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta zhes mtshan snyan rgya bod tsi na dang hor gyi yul sogs 'dzam gling chung ngu'i khrod 'dir yongs su grags shing don dang ldan pa de nyid/ sku chung ngu'i dus nas sngon sbyang gi 'phro sad cing rig pa'i gnas yod do cog bshes gnyen kyi rkyen phran bus sad cing rtsol ba'i ngal pa med par gyur/rgya gar 'phags yul du song nas mu stegs 'phrog byed dga' bo lung dang rigs pas pham par byas/paṇa chen mchog dang grub thob 'dar phyar bas nus stobs kyis mu stegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul brlags shing dbang du bsdus pa'i grags pa sa gsum du bsgrags/ 'ga' zhig gis sa paṇa la nus pa med par 'dar phyar bar re ba zhe sdang can gyi lce gnyis skyong ba kho na las bden pa'i dbang po ci yang med de grub thob 'dar 'phyar ba chen po mthu stobs nus pa'i bdag nyid yin pa su zhig gis 'gog kyang / sa paṇa chen 255

de nyid ni chung nga'i dus nas skye bo gzhan las 'phags pa'i rdzu 'phrul la mnga' mnyes shing / yab chos yang phur sogs la grub thob pa/ bde dgyes sogs yi dam gyi lhas zhal gzigs pa/ lhag par tu 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed po dngos yin pas de mthu sdug pa zhig ga la srid kyang de bzhin gshegs pas phyag na rdo rje la gdug pa 'dul ba'i dbang bskur ba bzhin/ sku nyid btsun pa'i rnam thar skyong ba dang bod kyi grong sngags pa rnams kyi 'phrin las dar ba/ bod yul gyi mi nag skye bo'i khrod na'ang grub pa thob pa'i skyes bu yod pa gsal bor mdzad pa'i phyir du 'dar 'phyar ba la bka' babs shing phyag phyir khrid pa yin zhes grags pa don la gnas pa yin no/ /de ltar 'phros su mol nas/ 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa chen gyis 'phrog byed dga' bo pham par byas shing bod du khrid pa'i lam bar du brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi thog phab te bgrong ba'i ral ba g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i rtags su bzhes te dpal sa skya'i chos sde chen por phebs/ der 'phrog byed kyi ral ba'i cha shas sngags pa stong gi dbu skra dang bsres te thig nag gi rgyal mtshan bzos nas dpal sa skya'i chos sde chen po gtso bor gyur bar thig nag gi rgyal mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad bslang bar grags so/ /'di skabs sgrub thabs gang la brten na dam pa gang gi phur ba rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rgya dpe gzigs shing bsgyur ba'i smra ba ngan pa'i tshogs rdul du brlags pa sogs kyi dgos pa la brten dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sgo nas byin rlabs byas pa yin zhes da lta'i sa skya'i mkhas gyur kun la grags so/ /phyis sa skya tshang la thig nag re med mi rung pa lta bur gyur cing dpal sa skya'i dbu 'phangs dar rtser phyin nas rgya hor bod gsum gyi dbu na gdugs ltar 'khor ba yin no/ /'ga' zhig gis sngags grwa dang sa skya'i sngags 'chang chen po'i bla brang 'ga' las med par smra ba ni rang gi lugs ci bzhin ma nges pa'i gtam 'chal kho na ste/ kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel gyis/ dam chos dar zhing dge 'dun sde 'phel ba/ /nag po'i phyogs las rgyal zhing mi mthun srungs/ /srung ma'i dgyes zhal ston byed srog gi rten/ /srung ba'i mchog yin chos sde'i dbu 'phangs mtshon/ /khyad par sa rnying bstan pa'i dgos chos yin/ /sngar gyi chos sde kun kyis phyag srol 'dis/ /thig nag rgyal mtshan 'chad grwar med do zhes/ /smra ba'i bab stegs gshin rje'i khram ltar 'gyur/ zhes gsungs shing thig nag bslang ba'i lo rgyus lha yi rnga chen zhes pa mdzad pa'i nang du bsam sbyor ngan pa'i mthu byad la brten dgon sde la nad yam mched cing rtsod pa phran bu re sogs byung zhing / de bzlog pa'i phyir du srung ba'i rim pa bgyis tshul/ mthar bka' brgyad kyi grub thob cig dang / sa skya'i phyogs la gshin rje mi dang mi bzhin grub pa zhig yod pa de gnyis kyis rgyal mtshan bcu drug bslang skor ldeb grangs lnga yod pa zhig mchis so/ /gnyis pa dgos pas brtson 'grus rtsom par bskul ba ni/ de ltar gong du gsal ba ltar rten 256

'brel lus la bsgrigs na rtogs pa sems la 'char zhes pa'i dpe ltar/ 'di nyid thub bstan rin po che'i dbu 'phangs mtshon pa yin pas gang du bstan pa gnas pa der btsugs na chos byed rnams kyi dbang thang rgyas pa/ 'phrin las dar ba/ pha rol ba'i byad ma rbod gtong ngan pa'i rigs bzlog cing bsgyur nas thos bsam sgom gsum gyi mi mthun phyogs zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /lhag par da lta snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus 'dir byang chub sems dpa'i lam dang rgyab gyes sngags kyi dam tshig ci mi snyam nas bla ma bslus shing dmyal bar skye ba'i rgyu 'bad nas bsags pa'i rigs kyis bstan pa dang 'gro la phan pa'i skyes bu re gnyis yod pa mthong tshe de la dag snang mi skye/ rjes su yi rang mi byed/ ngan sems dang 'gran 'dod kyis kun nas bslangs shing rgyab tu chos gos gyon de thub pa'i rjes 'jug tu 'ud sgrog byed na'ang don du blo snying brang gsum 'jig rten 'dre ngan yi dwags rnams la gtad nas skyabs bcol bar byed mkhan mang zhing / de dag gis 'jig rten gyi ngos nas gdul bya dang 'phrin las rgyas pa'am/ chos kyi phyogs nas thos bsam rang gi gong du 'gro nges pa zhig yod phyir de la 'bad pa chen pos gnod ci thub kyis bsam sbyor ngan pa'i gtad mnan/ 'phang bsreg sogs rang gi ci shes byed pa mthong chos mngon gyur du gyur/ 'byung bo'i g.yog gyur de dag gis skyes bu dam pa dang rigs sngags kyi mthu dang ldan pa/bsod nams kyi dpung btsan pa sogs la rang gi bsam ngan gyi ngan song la nye ru song ba las gnod pa lta ci byad phyir la bzlog nas rang gi kha rje bsod nams la gnod pa 'byung bar 'gyur la/ las dang po ba'i chos pa nyams chung mang po'i dam chos sgrub pa la bar du gcod cing dgon sde'i tshogs chos sogs la gnod par 'gyur phyir/ bsam ngan de dag la glag blta ba'i gnas med par bya phyir thig nag gi rgyal mtshan slong dgos so/ /thig nag gi rgyal mtshan tshad ldan bsgrub te bslang ba tsam gyis mi mthun pa'i g.yul las rgyal ba dang / kha rmas gtam ngan bsgyur ba/ mthu dang byad bzlog pa/ yul der gnas pa'i 'byung po che phra thams cad dam la 'du zhing bgos pa'i bka' ltar bgyid pa/ dge 'dun pa'i sde'i dam sri ngan pa'i rigs su gyur ba tshar gcod cing thugs mthun khrims gtsang yong ba/ de la dad pa dang dwangs pa byed pa'i skye bo ma lus srung gur du tshud pa/ thar pa byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad zhi nas mchog thun gyi dngos grub gegs med du 'grub pa la sogs pa'i yan yon bsam las 'das pa mang po yod pa shes par byas nas brgyud ldan gong ma'i phyag bzhes bzhin 'di nyid tshad ldan sgrub pa la 'jug dgos so/ /gsum pa bzo tshul mthong brgyud kyi man ngag gtam la dbab pa la bzhi/ rdzas bsgrigs pa/ bzo tshul gyi lag len/ mtshan nyid bshad pa/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po rdzas bsgrigs pa ni/ sgrol 257

ma ba'i yi ge las/ rnam par rgyal ba'i rdzas ni/ mu stegs dang lta ba log pa dbang du bsdus pa de'i skra gtso bor byed dgos kyang / bod 'dir de mu stegs pa dngos med pa'i de'i phyogs mthun rnams kyi4 khar/srung ba'i rdzas ni/ sngags pa nus ldan brgya/ bud med mtshan ldan brgya/ dge slong khrims ldan brgya/stag shar dpa' ldan brgya ste phrag bzhi yi dbu skra/ g.yag rog zhol ldan stong / /rta pho 'gros ldan stong /lug nag spyi dkar stong / khyi nag snying dkar stong ste stong phrag bzhi yi rnga ma/ btsun ma khrims gtsang bcu/ sgrub po dam ldan bcu/ mkhas pa shes ldan bcu/ rgyal phran dbang chen bcu ste bcu phrag bzhi yi dbu skra/ rgya stag ru bkra bzhi/ seṅge dar ma bzhi/ glang chen dkar po bzhi/ ru phag mche ldan bzhi ste bcu tshan bzhi yi rnga ma/ rtogs pa mchog ldan gcig grub pa'i gdung rgyud gcig yul gyi rgyal chen gcig mu stegs 'brel med gcig bcas ste bzhi tshan gcig gis dbu skra/ khyad par gyi rdzas thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i ku sha'i chun po zil ba mnyam ste rdzas tshan gtso bo gsum ldan pa dgos so/ /de dag ma 'dzoms na srung ba dang khyad bar gyi rdzas kyi tshab sngags pa nus ldan bud med mtshan ldan dge slong khrims ldan gang rnyed cig gi dbu skra dang khyad par kyi rdzas ku sha bcas g.yag rog gi rnga mas bskyed kyang chog ces gsungs so/ /gnyis pa bzo tshul ni/ rdzas de dag bsdus pa dang sngar gyi rdzas byin rlabs byas grub rnams ma gtogs pa gsar ba rnams so sor ma 'dres par 'jog thog mar bum pa bsgrub pa'i chu dang rtsa brgyad stong sbyar gyi bdud rtsi'i byin brlabs shing rlan phab/ phyir byin rlabs tshad ldan phyis na rlung gis ma zad par du rul mi srid ces sgrol ma bas gsung ba don la gnas kyang da lta'i lag len la rta rnga gang mang bsres na char chus gnod pa mi 'gro ba phan pas de ltar byed/ rdzas bca' thams cad byin rlabs byas tshar ba dang / skud pa 'phel mkhan/ bud med stag lo pa dang 'brug lo lo pa/ skyes pa stag lo pa dang 'brug lo pa bzhi ka grong chos kyis ma gos shing dkon mchog gsum la dad pa ldan pa/ yi dam lha'i dbang thob cing bsnyen pa las rung re btang yod pa dgos so/ /sngar bsnyen pa sogs gtong myong med na skabs der rdo rje slob dpon zhig dang mnyam du sgrub pa tshang bar bya/ bsnyen pa grub pa dang dam ldan mang po zhig bsdus te drag sngags so lnga pa'i lung zhig gnang / de dbyangs dang bcas gyer bzhin skud pa 'khel ba'i gnas dang cung zad bar thag ring ba tsam du 'jug khye'u pho mo bzhi'i skud pa mkhal/sngags pa dang sgrub dpon ma gtogs gzhan kyis rdzas la mi reg rog mi byed/ skud pa re re tshar ba dang khye'u pho mo bzhi lag 'brel gyis skud pa nam mkhar btegs te/ e ma/ e ma/ rtsa gsum dam can srung ba'i tshogs kyis/ /thig skud 'di la byin rlabs stsol cig /bla ma lha dang chos nyid bden pas/ /rgyal 258

bstan dar zhing 'gro rnams skyid do/ /zhes dbyangs su len dgos par gsungs/ skud pa tshang ma brgyad dkris sha stag dgos/ /thig nag cig gi 'khor la skud pa khra khra brgyad dang nag po nyi shu rtsa brgyad yod/ring tshad du slob dpon gyi gru gang nas bzhi bar gnas dang 'byor ba dang bstun par byed/ skud pa re re'i mar sne la rgya mdud dang de'i nas rtsud pa dkar po'i kha tshar 'dogs/ rgya mdud ces pa'i rgya ni rgya gar nag gang la mi go bar dam tshig 'gyur ba med par rgyas btab pa'i mdud nag bzhin ral na ma gtogs mi zhig pa'i don yin ces dam pa rnams kyi zhal las byung / ras dkar dri med kyi kha chun dang sked dkris byas pa'i bar du ras zheng du rkyang sor bzhi ba 'phan gyi tshul du phyogs bzhi na snar nas yod pa kha ching sked ris dang mnyam du bzo/ de'i phyogs bzhi'i sne la rje bzhi 'bri/ ras de'i ngos su yi dam gyi sngags lañtsa 'am bod yig dbu can gang rung bzo grub bam kha dog nag po byas nas chus mi 'jig pa'i rtsis 'bri/ rgyugs che ba seng gdong ma'i snying po yi ge bcu bzhi pa ste aḥ saḥ maḥ 'bri yang sngar gyi thig nag rnying pa rnams dpal karma pa'i rten khrod du nyar ba'i nang du sa skya nas byung dang / lho brag nyang gi gdan sa las byung ba hrul po gnyis 'dug par/ tog dang nye ba'i kha chun la oṃ a gro dhe ka ya man+ta ka hūṃ phaṭaḥ ces dang / sked dkris la/ oṃ trīḥpad+ma ta kri ta badz+ra kro dha ya skṛ wa hu lu hu lu rgyu phaṭaḥzhes pa dang / 'og gi kha chun la/ r+ghaṃḥbadz+ra phaṭaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā ni hūṃ phaṭaḥ zhes pa'i mthar spel tshig cig yod pa 'dra 'dug tog gi 'og gi 'khor chus 'jig pas gsal bo mthong na'ang 'khor lo'i rtsibs sogs la dpyad na phal cher gshin rje dang phyag rdor bka' brgyad sogs yin pa 'dra/ tog gi 'og klad phor nang du rnying lugs nas ni srog shing brtan pa'i tsakra dang / bka' brgyad kyi tsakra bzhugs pa yin/sa lugs la phur ba dang sor 'brangs bzhugs su gsol ba yin ces sa skya'i mkhan chen zhal nas gsungs/ bka' brgyud la sngar rnying ma nas brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes tshad ldan yod 'dug ste re zhig rgyu bca' yang rta spu dang g.yag gang thob kyi rtsid pa la byed/ sgrub pa sogs phar zhog rab gnas yang mi byed/ /lugs yang ci yin 'di yin med par mdzes nyams sgeg 'phyos kho na gtso bor 'don/ /dus gsum mkhyen pa karma pa chen po'i rten khrod kyi byin can gyi rten sogs mjal ba'i bsod nams med par snying khams gang mtho byed gyin 'dug 'on kyang si tu mchog sprul dang dpal ldan dpa' bo'i zhabs gnyis kyis 'di phyogs la thugs khur mdzad cing sngar gyi rnying ba rnams la gzhi byas bka' brgyud pa'i dgon pa du mar thig nag 'dzugs par kho bo bskul ba ltar bgyis pas slar yang khungs dang ldan pa bka' brgyud pa'i nang du 'jag yod/ thig nag gi srog shing shing bzang po a ka ru thob na de dang / ma thob na mkhregs shing chus 'jig dka' ba zhig dgos/ 'ga' zhig gis dug shing dgos par bshad 259

kyang da lta lag len la shug pa dmar po 'dzer ba dang mthud ma med pa zhig la byed/ spyir zur bzhi la rtse bzlum po/ klad pa'i 'khor lo'i nang zla gam/ 'og sa dang nye ba'i mtshams nas phur ba'i lugs su byas par zur bzhi dang zur gsum gyi mtshams su zur brgyad rgya mdud byas pa yang 'dug gang yin yang rtse nas bzung bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro bcas pa'i srog sngags spel tshig dang bcas pa bris shing phyi nas gzung dang srung 'khor khungs ldan sna tshogs kyis g.yog de'i phyi logs su dar mtshon sna lnga dkris/ de'i phyi logs su go ba mnyes ma g.yog te dam por bzo/ de'i phyi la rus pa'i zhags rtsi 'thug po sor gang tsam byugs/ rtse mor/ mdung byed mkhan dang / rtse gsum byed mkhan/ thod skam byed mkhan sogs rigs gsum byung 'dug sa rnying mang che shos kyi rtse gsum byed/ gu ru'i mu stegs pa'i tshogs pham par byas shing kha ṭ+wāṃ ngos la de dag gis ral ba btags nas g.yul las rgyal ba'i glu blangs pas de ltar dar zer srol 'dug mdung yang kha ṭ+wāṃ gi rtse dbus ma nyid yin pas chog ces sa skya'i mkhan pos gsungs na'ang yig cha ni gang yang ma mthong rung ba yang yin nges/ rtsa bar spyir dam sri'i ling ka spel tshig dang bcas pa zhig bzhag cing de'i snying ka nas gdan bkod/ dmigs bsal gza' klu sde brgyad sogs dam la 'jog dgos rgyu yod na de'i gzugs srog shing gi rtsa ba'i mdun ngos su bris shing nang du srog yig dang snying po bkod/gnyis pa mtshan nyid bshad pa/ thig nag bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan yin/ /yar kyi sna de rtse gsum pa//phyi ru mchog gsum nang rtsa gsum/ /gsang ba sku gsum 'bras thob yin/ /snyigs 'gro'i skyabs lha gu ru yi/ /phyag mtshan dang ni ho ru ka'i/ /dam tshig rten yin bslu ba med/ /rtse mo gsum gyi don de ltar/ /srog shing zur bzhi sbom la brtan/ /las bzhi'i dngos grub thob pa dang / /gling bzhi dbang du rab bsdus te/ /sku bzhi lam la 'dren pa yin/ /yar rtse zlum pa zhi ba la/ /mar rtse gru gsum drag po mtshon/ /gzhung shing gru bzhi rgyas pa ste/ /klad gor zla gam dbang yin no/ /'og gi rgya mdud dam mi 'gyur/ /skra nag gu ru'i dur khrod du/ /spyod byed mkha' 'gros phul dbang sdud/ /mu stegs btul ba'i rgyal ba mtshon/ /gu ru'i dbu skra srung ba'i mchog thig khra brgyad po dpal brgyad dang / /thu gu nyer brgyad dbang phyug ma/ kha 'og sked gsum chun srung 'khor/ /phyogs bzhi'i phan ni rgyal chen bzhi/ kha tshar 'phrin las bsam las 'das/ /rdo rje'i re kha mi shig pa'o/ /rgyang nas bltas na brjid pa dgos/ /zur du bcar na mjes pa la/ /don du byin rlabs zhugs pa gzab/ /'og gi kha chun 'khor rgya che/ /steng gi klad 'khor chung ba ni/ /gtor rtse gnam la bstan par bshad/ /dregs pa dbang du sdud du dgos/ /de nyid go ldog rtse mo che/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan brtan pa ste/ /'chad pa'i grwa la shis pa yin/ /rtse 'og 260

khyad chen bya mi rung / /rtse rting med pa drang shad de/ /yon tan lhun grub mtshon pa ste/ /dgon sde phyi yi srol du byed/ /kun la dge zhes mkhas grub gsungs/ /zhes pa 'di yang mkhas gyur gong ma rnams kyi gsungs tshigs su bcad par spel ba yin/sgrub pa byed skabs/ lha gang gi sgo nas sgrub pa yin gsal cha mi 'dug na'ang sa skya phal cher gyis gur mgon dang phur pa'i sgo nas sgrub par snang / snga 'gyur pa'i sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi sgo nas sgrub pa byed/ thig nag gcig gis lo nyi shu lhag thub cing de la lo re bzhin kha gsos byas tshe lo drug cu skor zhig la lan tsam las byed mi dgos pas 'di sgrub pa'i go skabs nyung zhing phyag len shin tu dkon par snang / sngar rje lo tsā ba 'dan ma rtse mang gi sprul pa'i zlos gar sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po/ kun bzang rin chen rnam grol chos kyi rgyal po zhes kaḥthog dang sa skya'i chos byang chub pa de nyid kyi mdun nas yun ring bar mnog chos mang po nyams bltar skabs/ /thig nag kha shas slong ba'i zhor du lag len dmar khrid byed skabs khong la bka' brgyad kyi sgrub srol phyag bzhes yod pa de'o/ /gang yin yang sgrub pa'i bya ba rtsom tshe/ /sgrub g.yog phud thun bzhir nyi le bskrod pa'i bla slob bskyed rdzogs kyi gding dang ldan pa bzhi dang / sdom gsum gtsang ba'i sngags pa nus ldan nyung mthar yang brgyad tshogs pas dben pa'i gnas su mtshams tho brtsegs/ sgrub pa ma tshar bar gyi mkho ba'i yo byad bza' btung thams cad bsgrigs/ khyi dang bud med byis pa/ shan pa dam sel yod pa'i rigs sogs dang rgyang bsring /rdul mtshon dang ras bris gang rung gi dkyil 'khor du this/ nag rnams bkram ste ril bu sgrub pa ltar nyin mtshan bar med du dzab dbyangs ma chad par bya/ skabs skabs su nyu le bas gu gul bdug cing bgegs bskrad/ byin 'debs byas shing bden pas rgyas btab/ de ltar sgrub pa yun ring bar byas te grub pa dang tshogs mchod phul/ bsang gtong / thig nag dngos grub kyi tshul du len/ sgrub pa po tshang mas dbu gtug /smon lam gdab pas sgrub pa'i bya ba rnams grub pa yin no/ /bzhi pa rgyal mtshan btsugs shing rnam par rgyal bar byed pa ni/ de yang tshes bzang po rgyal phur 'dzoms pa'am/ ston pa'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen sogs/ o rgyan chen po'i mu stegs dbang du bsdu ba'i dus chen snron zla ba'i tshes bcu/ o rgyan rjes bod yul lha 'dre dbang du bsdud pa'i dus smin drug zla ba'i tshes bcu/ 'di 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa chen gyis mu stegs dbang du bsdu ba'i dus yang yin par grags pas sa rnying gi dgon sde phal mo che'i dus chen de la khel thabs byed/ min kyang 'phrod sbyor dge ba zhig ni dgos par snang ba'i dus tshod gtan la khel bar bgyis nas/ gang du 'dzug pa'i gnas la mkho ba'i sa rdo sogs tshags grub pa dang dgon sde ser mo spyi'i snang brgyad/ gza' yum/ skar yum/261

bsam lhun sogs sna sel gyi cho ga grub pa dang chos rnams gyon ser sbreng bsgrigs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i srog snying yi ge bcu pa'am yi dam gang rung gi snying po dbyangs su gyer nas bsu/ sgrub po rnams kyis thig nag rnams 'khyog la btegs shing g.yas g.yon du 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan bla bre sogs phyar/mdun du sngags pas zhwa nag dang gos nag sogs gyon zhing phur bu dang ho zhal thogs nas bgegs bskrad pa'i tshul/ keng rus rnams kyi gar rtsed dang gling bu rnams dang rol mo ba rnams kyis dbyangs bcas drangs/ sbrengs pa'i gnas la g.yas skor gyi tshul du dang po nas rim par btsug 'dzug pa'i skabs sngags dbyangs ma chad pa dang sgrub po rnams kyis 'og nas byung ba'i shis tshig brjod/ re re bzhin btsugs nas yongs su grub pa dang / shis tshig 'di bzhin brjod/ ston mchog dam pa sogs dang / rgyal glu 'di yang len/ ho/ sangs rgyas rnams ni bdud las rgyal/ /chos ni chos ma yin las rgyal/ /dge 'dun mu stegs rnams las rgyal/ /dbang po lha ma yin las rgyal/ /lha min zla ba rnams las rgyal/ /nam mkha' lding ni mtsho las rgyal/ /me ni shing rnams kun las rgyal/ /chu ni me las rgyal ba ste/ /rlung ni sprin las rnam par rgyal/ /rdo rje yis ni rin chen phug /lha rnams bden par rab tu gnas/ /sangs rgyas dang ni chos kyang bden/ /bden pa rgyal rgyur rdzun ma lags/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams la lus pa/ /zhi zhing rnam par rgyal gyur cig /dza ya dza ya sikhyi sirnyi bi dza ya swā/ mthar slob dpon kun gyis lha rgyal lo/ /bdud pham mo/ don 'grub po/ /bkra shis so/ /ces re re brjod pa dang 'dus pa kun kyis rjes bzlos lta bur skad chen pos bsgrags/ de nas srung ma la bsang mdor bsdus btang zhing rgyal gyi ku gnam sa ral ltar btab/ tshogs pa kun la tshogs rdzas dang srung mdud sbyin bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyis mtha' brgyan nas dga' mgu'i ngang grol bar bya/smras pa/ a ho/ bstan pa 'di la ngo mtshar rmad byung ba'i/ /'phags bod paṇa grub mkhas pa'i dbang phyug tshogs/ /mu stegs g.yul rgyal snyan grags rgya che'i rabs/ /lnga brgya'i dus la ma nyams pa de dga'/ /sngon byon rig 'dzin bar ma chad pa las/ /byung ba'i khungs ldan mthong ba snyan nas brgyud/ /gang thob phyogs gcig bkod pa'i dge tshogs kyis/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams kun las rnam rgyal shog /ces pa'ang rnam dpyod snying stobs phul byung rtse pho brang gi mgron gnyer nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis rang gnas sgrub khang la thig nag rgyal mtshan bslang ste thugs bskyed mtha' ru phyin pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs skabs dgos pa rgyu mtshan bkod par gsol ba la sngar o rgyan smin grol gling du bstan dgra jun dkar ba'i g.yul las rgyal zhing bstan pa nyams gso byed skabs kho bo la rgyal mtshan slong bar bskul ba ltar bgyis pa'i zin bris la kha bskang mthar chag tu byas pa bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal te rnam grol sangs rgyas 262

thob pa'i rgyur dmigs/ shing mo phag gi lo'i zla brgyad pa'i tshes dge bar rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu 'gro ba yongs 'dus rtsal gyis mang yul byams sprin gyi gtsug lag khang gi nye zhol nas legs par bgyis te bskul ba po gang gi snyim par bzhag pa gtad rgya/ sbas rgya/ spel rgya/ dza yan+tu/bal yul rgyal bstan rin po che'i bdag po chen po bka'i mdun na 'don pa badz+ra atsār+sā'i dris lan gser gyi phreng ba/ na mo gu ru pad+ma ka rā ye/ bal yul gyi thub bstan rin po che'i rtsa lag rang gi chos kyi bur gyur bas bka' 'dri byung ba la snying nye bas gdams pa/ kha sang ngag thog nas gang bshad pa de dag mi brjed pa'i phyir dang bdag gi ngo tshab tu dad rten yi ge phobs ces bskul ba ltar 'dir bshad pa/bsam lhun skor/ bsam pa lhun grub kyi chos sde ci ltar kha sgyur dgos dris par/ las bzhi'i kha bsgyur dang dmigs gsal gyi yul dang / 'dod don/ rang ngam gzhan gyi ming chen du bcug nas gsol ba 'debs tshul rgyal ba'i bkas gnang ba dang rgyud kyi dgongs par mthun pa zhig yin yang /bsgyur chog mi chog gnyis ka bsgyur na byin rlabs yal zhing bstan par bsre slad kyi sel zhugs pa 'gyur bas gzab dgos/ de yang kha bsgyur ba'i skor dang sngar gyi yig rnying gnyis ka ma 'dres pa 'jog rgyu gal che ste/ gter ston 'ja' tshon snying pos/ nga'i gter chos la yig nor bsal ba tsam las zhu dag mi dgos/ chog 'grig dang mtshams sbyor rang rang gi spros pa che chung dang bstun pa byed chog kyang gud du bya ba las gter chos kyi rming gzhi dkrug mi rung / zhes dang / khyab bdag pad+ma bde chen gling pas/ngas gter chos dag chos bdag las can gyi skyes bu rnams la gtad pa yin pas/ man ngag dang ldan pas 'grel ba chog 'grigs kha bskong ci dgos kyis/ bka' snga ma ni gu ru pad+mas zhu dag byas pa yin pas de las lhag par phal tshig gis bslad na byin rlabs nyams par 'gyur bas ma bslad par 'jog par 'tshal/ zhes gsungs pa ltar gter gzhung rtsa ba ma bcos sor bzhag la de'i dgongs pa dang mthun par zur du kha bsgyur dang chog 'grigs/ 'grel zin ci dgos bla ma dang lhag pa'i lhas gnang ba thob pas bya yi gang thon thon min no/ /tshigs bcad sogs kha skong dgos tshe la de mchan gyis brgyan pa dang chog 'grig gang yin brten pa'i khungs gsal ba zhig gal che bar 'gyur/ bsam lhun nang gi/rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan man chad nas/ /zhes pa bsgyur dgos pa mi 'jug te slob dpon chen pos gdams pa thugs sras rje 'bangs grogs gsum la bka' ma gtad pa zhig med pas so/ /chos rgyal gdung rgyud mtha' nas ma stongs bar/ zhes pa mnga' ri'i la dwags/ mang yul/ mdo khams sogs kyi chos rgyal chen po'i gdung rigs rgyun ma chad par zer ba yin kyang de la chos kyi gdung rgyud ces kha 263

bsgyur na chos rgyal chen po'i gdung yang nang du 'du bas legs par sems/ bod kyi chos skyong rgyal po'i gnyen gcig pu/ /zhes par chos bzhin spyod pa yongs kyis zhes dang / rgyal po chos spyod la brgyud 'dzin chos ldan zhes bsgyur/ thugs rjes bod kyi sems can yongs la gzigs/ zhes pa 'dir bal yul sems can dang / mon gyi sems can/ sog yul sems can sogs kha bsgyur ba mthong yang de thams cad gnas ris phran bu re yin pas 'gro drug sems can yongs la gzigs ces kha bsgyur ba shin tu legs par sems te gu ru'i thugs rje ma khyab pa'i yul med pa sa phyir ro/ /nang re dgongs re bod kyi don la byon/ zhes pa 'gro ba'i don la byon byas na khyab che bar mngon/ hor sogs dmag dpung zhes pa stod hor la go bas re zhig bsgyur bar mi bya ste/ bal bod rgya gar sogs gang yin yang stod hor gyi dmag 'di nyen che bas yul phyogs 'di dag nas de ltar smon na stod hor mdun gros 'joms pa'i dgos pa che/ nam zhig las 'bras bslu ba med pas stod hor gyi stobs dang dbang thang mtho rting bsgyur nas sil bur 'thor ba'i dus zhig nges par 'ong bas de skabs/ nag phyogs 'jigs pa'i dmag ces kha bsgyur na legs so/ /khyad par bod kyi rje 'bangs sdug bsngal na/ /zhes pa bdag sogs dpon slob dang /bdag sogs 'gro ba sdug bsngal na zhes bsgyur bar 'tshal/ bsam pa lhun grub 'di kho bo'i chos thams cad kyi nying khu yin pas nyid sogs bal yul gyi slob ma rnams kyis 'di nyid nyan bshad dang nyams len la brtson na bdag dang o rgyan rje 'bangs bcas pas byin gyis rlobs nges pa yin/srung dmag skor/ sku srung kha shas bod du gtong dgos e yod dris par/ sngar nyid sogs mdun na 'don pa rnams bdag la gus 'dud che ba dang rten 'brel lta bu'i rgyal po chen po'i bsnyun bzhi sel ba sogs kyis bdag la bal yul rgyal po'i dbu bla'i ming btags/ nyer mkho'i yo byad gnas khang /gtsug lag khang dang bskyed mos tshal sogs phul/ srung dmag sum brgya dang zlos gar mchod khag cig bstsal ba sogs bka' drin che yang bya bral ba la de dag dgos mkho med pa dang / gson gshin gyi dad zas rnams de dag gi lto rgyab tu btang ba yang dgos pa cher ma mchis pas rgyal po la dgos pa med pa'i gnas tshul yang yang bshad kyang 'tsho chas rgyal gzhung nas 'bul/ de dag dbu bla'i thob dang go sa yin pas bal yul du sdod ring che ba'i rtags sogs med tshe rgyal pos bkur bzo ma bgyis pa'i rnam pa byung bas thabs med yin tshul nan tan byas pa ltar bdag tu blang ba yin/ rjes su la dwags su 'gro tshe mar yul nas 'phrin byung bar bal yul gyi dmag dpung dang bod kyi dmag khrid nas mi yong pa'i re zhus kyi bya ma rta 'phrod pas srung dmag rnams bal yul rgyal gzhung la phyir rtsis sprad/ bod nas lhag pa'i rang gi ltos bcas mang zhig phyir brdzangs/ rang nyid spro ba'i sgar che chung ran pa zhig byas nas song ba nyid 264

kyi mkhyen gsal ltar lags/ rjes su yang bal yul rgyal blon gyi dmag dang 'khor nam dgos dus su gtong zhes pa de byung ba thugs rje che yang bod 'di dogs pa che bas mang yul sogs su bal bo khrid nas byung na ci zer mi shes pas mi dgos/ dmag mi mang zhig rang la dad pa brtan pas rab tu byung dgos pa dang ri khrod 'grim tshul sogs byung ba dang / 'ga' zhig gis bu smad ma sos pas gsol phog sogs gnang sbyin zer mkhan byung bar snying nye yang bya thabs zad/ da cha ngas rgyab tshab tu badz+ra a tsāt+yā khyod gsol ba yin pas chos 'dod rnams la gdams pa dang / nyam thag rnams la brtse gzigs/ ma hā rā dza la ci ltar dgongs pa bskor khyod rang shes pas thugs nas ma bgyid/zhal da'i skor/ sku'i phyag rgya zhal da rnams ma 'ongs par ji ltar byed dris par/ sngar rgyal pos bstsal ba'i mchod khag gi nang nas bu mo gnyis rang khyim du shin tu gdung ba che 'dug pa snying rjes ma bzod nas gser gyi rdzongs pa bcas tshe mjug rang gi gang 'dod du byed chog pa'i yi ge rgyal po la ngo chen byas te bstsal ba yin pas 'khor ba las gzhan re zhig bcing ba thams cad las grol yod/ gzhan sa mu dang / burnyi/ ma ya dang / me na bcas bu mo bzhi chos la mos pa dga' bar cig yod pas dbang lung gis rgyud smin par byas te ri khrod du 'grim bcug pa yin pas de dag gi 'tsho ba'i yo byad la gzigs skyong gnang rogs/ bu mo gzhan rnams ni bdag dang mnyam du bod du yong dgos zhes ngu ngag mang du bton pas snying rje bar 'dug kyang / bod kyi sa chu mi 'phrod pa'i khar/ khong tsho da bar rgyal khang nas glu len gar rtsed las dka' ba spyad ma myong ba yin pas kho bo'i 'tsho ba gang byung des chog de yang 'phrod pa zhig mi yong la/ ngo shes med cing skad brda yang mi 'phrod pas dka' ngal che ba'i gnas tshul bsnyad pas re zhig bal yul rang du sdod 'char byas te 'tsho ba 'ding nges kyi dngos po ca noms pa bstabs yod/ bdag ni rga bas mnar/ chos gzugs kyi bya ba brel che pas bud med la bdag byed pa'i long skabs med cing dgos pa yang med pas tshang ma khyod la phul ba yin/ rjes su 'di dag la mgon skyabs yang nyid la bcol ba yin pas slar yang rgyal khang gi bka' khrims dam po'i 'og tu mi 'jug pa zhig dang chos dang 'jig rten gang byas kyang rang gi gces pa'i 'khor bzhin brtse gzigs byed 'tshal/mchod rten skor/ mchod rten rnam gsum 'di bstan 'gro spyi dang khyad par bal bod kyi bde rtsa rmad du byung ba yin pa kho bos yang yang bsnyad pa ltar lags la/ nyid sogs kyis brtson pa la brten mchod rten bya tri ma kam sho legs par 'grub cing / na maḥbud+dha sār yang zhabs tog mi dman pa byung /da rang byung mchod rten chen po'i zhig gso 'phro lhag pa de ma 'grub par bal yul rgyal po so so'i bar 'khrugs rtsod mi byed pa'i tha tshig rang rang gi yi dam gyi lha dpang du gtsug te byas yod pas 'gal rkyen 265

cher med par sems/ dngos rdzas kyang srung ma rnams kyi 'phrin las sgrub pa'i zhal bzhes yod pa'i skabs dang skabs su nor rdzas glo bur ba yong nges pas thugs khral tshidagos/ las ka ci dgos rgyal ba'i dbang po yab sras lnga la bka' 'dri byas te gsung ltar sgrub pa'i thabs la 'bod/ mchod rten 'di grub tshe bdag dngos su slebs pa zhig mi 'byung yang kun gzigs zhwa dmar ba chen po dang / byams mgon si tu/ rgyal ba rnga sgra'i mtshan can/ dpal ldan dpa' bo'i zhabs/ skyes mchog 'ba' ra ba lo ri sprul pa'i sku sogs kho bo'i slob mar gyur ba rnams kyis bsti stangs byed par 'gyur bas bdag la khyad par du 'phags/ rab gnas sogs de dag gis ci ltar dgongs pa ltar gyis/dad rten skor/ rus pa'i rgyan cha de kho bo'i gsang spyod byed skabs kyi de yin la/ mi rkang gi gling bu 'di rig 'dzin mi 'gyur ba'i brla pad+ma bde chen gling pa'i rten gtso kho bor dad rten du bstsal ba yin/ bdag gis kyang mi tshe 'dir spyad cing byin rten rtsa che shos yin pas phangs yang dad pa brtan pos bla ma dbang du sdud zer ba ltar nyid dam ldan gyi slob bu yin pas mi sbyin thabs med lags/gter chen rol ba'i rdo rje'i sked phur yang nyid kyi chos spyod kyi mdzad par bar chad med pa'i ched du sbyin pa yin/ rdor dril mchod chas/ sku gsung thugs rten dang kho bo'i ngag rtsoms/ sngon bya bral skabs kyi khur shing dang nyer spyad/ bzhugs gdan dang go bo'i gos rnying cha tshang / gor+ṣa rgyal pos phul ba'i rma bya'i gdugs dang bcas khyod la sbyin te sku'i rgyal tshab/ gsung gi bstan pa/ thugs kyi byin rlabs gtad de nga yi tshab tu mnga' gsol ba yin pas rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang kho bo'i ring lugs spel ba'i thugs bskyed mi dman par mdzod/bstan pa'i skor/ grub mtha' gang gi rjes 'brangs dang bstan pa'i 'phel 'grib ji ltar skye srid 'byung ngam dris par/ bdag gi grub mtha' ni bka' rnying zung du 'jug pa zhig yin tshul sngar bris yod pa'i ngag rtsom dag las ha go thub pas zhib par der gzigs/ mdor bsdus te zhu/ o rgyan slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ kha che'i paṇa chen bi ma la/ rgya gar grub chen nag po spyod pa dang zhi ba'i zhabs kyi gang bstan pa de kho bo'i grub mtha' yin/ bod kyi chos rgyun nang gi kaḥdam pa bde bar gshegs pa zhes bka' rnying zung 'jug byed pa de dang / kun mkhyen klong chen pa/ rje btsun tā ra nā tha rnams kyi bzhed srol kho bo'i skye ba kun tu 'dzin par smon/ chos brgyun dang grub mtha' yang de rang du nges pas kho bo'i brgyud pa'i lo rgyus las shes dgos/ rgyas par thos bsam byed pa dag de'i rjes su zhugs shigagadams pa de dag thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa kho bo'i dgongs gter bsam pa lhun grub kyi bskyed rdzogs man ngag gi nang du yod/ gu ru'i zhal gzigs lan mang 'ong nas gdams pa thams cad 'gal 266

med chig sgril kyi zab gter gnang ba de kho na ltar 'cha'/ 'di nyid kyi dbang lung brgyud pa yod tshe nga'i grub mtha' dang bstan pa gnas pa yin/ de tshul bzhin 'dzin skyongs spel ba'i skyes bu thams cad nga'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i phrin las kyi sprul ba yin/bstan pa'i 'phel 'grib/ bstan pa spyi'i 'phel 'grib sngar bris pa'i lung bstan bka' rgya can du yod/ rang nyid kyi chos brgyun la dgos lung dgos pa cher ma mchis kyang nyid kyi bka' mi bcag pa tsam zhu ba bya ba/ kho bo re zhig mi gnas 'das pa'i tshe/ /nag phyogs thams cad ku co che/ /yab sras thugs rjes ma bzlog na/ /bal bod phyogs la dmag 'khrugs sdang / /nga yi bstan pa nyi shur tsam/ /sbas yul grub thob rnams kyis 'dzin/ /mang zhig 'ja' lus 'od sku 'byong / /chos brgyun ma chad tsam zhig 'gyur/ rgya bod g.yul chen shom pa'i skabs/ /karma'i sprul pa snying rje can/ /lo ngo lnga phrag lnga yi bar/ /mdo khams phyogs su dar bar byed/ /bod yul nang dme dar ba'i dus/ /bal yul rgyal bstan nyams pa'i dus/ /lho mon bal yu yam bu ru/ /bubya'i ming gis 'dzin skyong byed/ /de rje pad+ma'i mtshan 'chang ba//sde dge'i phyogs 'byung bstan pa spel/ /skabs der nam mkha'i ming can gyis/ ma hā ṭī na'i phyogs su spel/ /rgya dmag bod du 'phyo nye'i skabs/ /khams bla gu ṇa'i mtshan 'chang bas/ /zab don snying po dar rgyas byed/ /a bha'i mtshan 'chang snying stobs can/ /des kyang snying po'i bstan pa 'dzin/ /skabs der dharma'i mtshan 'chang bas/ /stod kyis phyogs su dar bar byed/ /de rjes nga sprul rnam gnyis 'byung / /ma nges phyogs bcur bstan pa spel/ /badz+ra ming can zab gter bdag /glang lo shes rab ldan pa dang / /shrī yi ming 'dzin lnga rig 'chang / /btsun pa'i mchog gyur cig gis 'dzin/ /dbus nas glang lo rat+na'i ming / /shes rab ldan pas bstan pa 'dzin/ /rgya nas sprel lo dharma'i mtshan/ /lte rme can gyis bstan pa spel/ /rgya gar yul nas sharnyi'i ming / /gnas gsum rme ba can gyis 'dzin/ /sog gi yul nas a yi ming / /brtson 'grus ldan pa'i zab gter 'dzin/ /mnga' ri'i phyogs nas bsod nams ming / /snying the gzhung lugs mkhas pas 'dzin/ /lho brag phyogs nas maṅga'i mtshan/ /ljags la a yig can gyis 'dzin//mdo khams smad nas saṅga'i mtshan/ /sprel lo gnas lnga rig pas 'dzin/ /mi nyag phyogs nas a yi mtshan/ /lug lo brtul zhugs ldan pas 'dzin/ /re kha'i phyogs nas dpal gyi ming / /bya lo snying the ldan pas 'dzin/ /de nas lo ngo nyis brgya'i mtshams/ /'dzam gling shar lho'i khyon kun 'khrugs/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma nub rir 'gro/ /de tshe rgya yi yul phyogs nas/ /dh+wa dza'i ming 'dzin sa sprel lo/ /mkhas shing btsun pa zhig gis 'dzin/ /skabs der khams pa 'brug lo ba/ /badz+ra ming gis sbas nas 'dzin/ /ma chad tsam zhig gnas par 'gyur/ /de dag nga yis sprul pa'am/ /byin gyis brlabs pa gang rung dang / /sngon smon 267

smon lam mthun pa yis/ /gsang gsum byin rlabs gzhan las che/ /de nas bstan pa dar ba'i tshe /rang byung skyes bu lnga phrag gcig /byon nas gter gyis 'gro ba 'dren/ /'di nyid 'khrul snang lags mod kyang / /bden pa 'byung ba rim bzhin gsal/ /de ltar bshad pa las/sa/ /kho bo'i skye sprul ni/ 'di nas skye rabs bzhi brgyud pa'i skabs der yul tha dad du lnga 'byung / smad 'tshong ma zhig dang / phyi pho gcig shan pa gcig dge bshes gcig sngags pa gcig 'byung / de 'das pa'i 'og tu sprul pa bcu 'byung / brtul zhugs kyi gding thob pa'i sngags 'chang gcig yul gyi dpon chen gcig gzhan rnams skye bo phal ba'i khrod du skyes ba dang bud med ma nges par 'byung / de 'das pa'i sprul pa nyer lnga 'byung / dge bshes sdom gsum gtsang ba gcig dang sngags pa bzhis nga'i grub mtha' 'dzin/ / shan pa gcig phyi pho gcig smad 'tshong lnga/ ma nges pa du ma yang 'byung / de 'das pa'i 'og tu sprul pa brgya rtsa brgyad 'byung / dag pa'i sprul ba rang byung gi sprul sku gsum snang tshul du spun mched kyi zol gyis 'ong / dge slong bcu byung ba'i khrod nga'i grub mtha' 'dzin mkhan lnga las mi 'byung / gzhan skye bo chos ldan dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas 'dzin pa yang du ma 'byung / thams cad 'gro ba'i don 'grub pa'i smon lam grub/ kho bo 'das ma thag bal yul dang bod du 'ang sprul ba 'byung mod de dag gsang ba'i yig chung na yod/ kaḥthog phyogs la kun gzigs zhwa dmar ba'i rten 'brel 'grig na kho bo'i skye ba srid kyang de gzhan dbang du gyur na re zhig sprul ba sogs mi 'byung / 'on kyang mdo khams smad nas skye ba bdun len pa'i snang ba shar yang sprul sku'i mtshan yod med kun 'byung / de ltar 'khrul ba lab rdol byas pa yin 'di dag re zhig gsang ba gal che/ nga dang khyod gnyis 'bral ba med pas sems khral mi dgos/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis rgyun du khyod 'khor bcas la srung 'khor bsgom nas byin rlabs byed kyin yod/ bal yul gyi nga'i gdul bya yongs la skye ba kun tu chos dang mi 'bral ba'i smon lam btab yod pas de ltar 'grub pa'i smon pa yod/ bde bar bzhugs shing dam ldan slob ma'i tshogs/ rje btsun mi la ras pas/ ri la sdod pa'i sgom chen dang / /'tsho ba sbyor ba'i yon bdag gnyis/ /sangs mnyam por rgya ba'i gdams ngag yod/ /gdams ngag gi snying po bsngo ba yin/ /zhes pas gtam gyi mjug bsdu'o/ /zhes shing phag lo'i sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes la rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus dam phrug dang lag sor gyi rgya gnyis kyis mnan te phul ba dge ba gyur cig shur+ghaṃ/268

༄ga /bka' rdzogs pa chen po yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi las byang don gsal khyer bder bsgrigs pa 'phrin las kun khrab ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /kun khyab rang byung 'od gsal chos kyi sku/ /lhun grub bde chen rnam snang longs spyod rdzogs/ /gang 'dul sgyu 'phrul drwa ba sprul pa'i gar/ /dkon mchog spyi 'dus ma hā gu ru 'dud/ /zab mchog chos 'dis rgyal khams phal cher khengs/ /lugs gcig rnam par bzhag tu ma mchis kyang / /bla ma'i bka' dang rang gi mos pa bzhin/ /don gsal khyer bde'i las byang bklags chog bsdeb/ /gu ru za hor ma'i sgrub thabs phyis byon thams cad kyi phyi mo'i shing rtar gyur cing gter ston nyid chos 'di las snang bzhi zad sar 'khyol ba'i dbang gis byin rlabs dang phrin las bod kyi gter byon tsam la 'gran zla dang bral ba yang zab bla ma'i sgrub pa dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi phrin las bya ba la gnyis/ rgyas pa dang /bsdus pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sgrub pa dang dbang bskur sogs kyi dus de dag dang 'bral ba'i dkyil 'khor bum pa dbang rdzas gtor mchod phyi mchod bskor te bsham pa sogs byas la/ 'og tu smos pa'i las byang mthar chags su btang zhing /gal te drag seng gi gtor zlog lta bu dang 'bral na de dag gi bskul dang gdab kha zor las sogs sbyor tshul sgam po dang chags med zhabs kyi gsung ltar bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bsnyen sgrub kyi thun phyi ma rnams dang rgyun khyer lta bu la/ sngon gtor/ sman mchod/ phrin las bzhi sgrub/ tshogs rjes 'bral bcas bor/ shin tu bsdu na brgyud 'debs/ srung 'khor/skyabs sems/ yan lag bdun brtsam las sngon 'gro gzhan rnams kyang mi bya bar mchod pa byin rlabs la 'jug kyang chog cing / tshe sgrub drag sang bcas sbyor min skabs dang bstun/ tshes bcu'i dus mchod lta bur ni rgyas bsdus gang byed dal khoms dang bstun pa las par bka' rad mi dgos so/ /gang ltar skyor ba gud du gu ru rin po che'i snang brnyan bris 'bur/ 'di nyid kyi glegs bam/ rdo rje bde spyod dam tshig gi rten du bsgrubs pas mtshon sku gsung thugs kyi rten gang 'dzom dgram pa'i mdun du stegs gtsang mar sgam po lugs sems rang lugs gang bde'i bla ma'i gtor ma rgyan spros tsa na/ de'i g.yas g.yon sman raka/ de mdun chu gnyis nyer spyod phreng char du bsham/ rgyas par spro na drag seng gtor ma bla gtor g.yas g.yon du bzhag gter srung 'bul gtor bsdus pa dkar dmar gnyis/ bgegs gtor sha gzugs ma/ tshags dang chad brtan/ nyer mkho'i yo byad rnams tshogs par bya'o/ /dngos gzhi'i phrin las la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi rim pa'o/ /dang po la'ang bdun las/ thog mar bgegs bskrad pa ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis dbang chen rta mgrin 'bar ba'i nyams dang ldan pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ trīḥpad+man+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya zhwa wa hu lu hu lu r+ghaṃ phaṭa: bgegs gtor bran la/ ro yo khaṃ/ bgegs gtor mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las: rin chen snod du bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur: sreg sbyong gtor ba ro yo khaṃ 269

gsum 'phros: o āḥhūṃ gis 'dod yon dpag med gyur: oṃ ā :hūṃ lan gsum/ deng 'dir dkyil 'khor mchod pas 'byung po kunoḥ gnas 'dir ma 'dug gtor mas tshim gyis loḥ rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir dengs shig: gal te mi 'gro bar chad byed pa na: da nyid dbang chen pad+ma rta skad 'tsher: khams gsum srid gsum kun kyang 'dar zhing sdangs: gdon bgegs 'byung po ma lus rdul du brlag: oṃ pad+ma n+ta kṛ r+ghaṃ phaṭa: gnod byed sarba shā lha mā ra ya rbad nan zlog cigoḥ ces gtor ma dor/r+ghaṃ bzhi'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad/ gnyis pa srung 'khor ni/ trīḥbadag nyid 'gyur med ye nas rdo rje'i sku:phyi nang snod bcud gzhal yas skye 'gro'i lha: phyogs dang phyogs mtshams 'ja' 'od mtshon chas gtam: rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur me ris bskor: oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa dz+wa la rom̐ḥ gsum pa skyabs sems ni/ oṃ ā:rgyu: skyabs gnas dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi: rgyud drug 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i pha ma rnams: bzod med gdung bas sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir: kun kyang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ bzhi pa sgrib sbyong ni/ rang nyid tha mal spyi gtsug tu: rigs 'dus rdor sems 'od kyi sku: dkar 'tsher rdol dril rin chen brgyan: skyil krung zhal 'dzum brtse ba'i nyams: thugs kar r+ghaṃ la yig brgyas bskor: 'o rgyun lta bu'i bdud rtsi bab: spyi gtsug rkang mthil yan chad kyi: nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dgoḥ shel bum zho yis gang ba ltar: gsal stong 'od kyi rang bzhin gyur: yi ge brgya dang mang snying yig drug ci 'grub bzla/ mthar/ rdor sems 'od zhu rang la thim: lnga pa tshogs bsags ni/ e ma ho: rang lus 'od phung rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /mdangs gsal me 'od gsal stong lhag ge'i ngang / /phyogs mtshams nam mkha' 'ja' 'od zer gyi klong / /spyi bor bla ma gu ru yid bzhin nor/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma pad 'byung spyan ras gzigs/ /rigs kyi bdag po snang ba mtha' yas dang / /gzhan yang mdo rgyud bstan bcos man ngag sogs/ /rgya bod mkhas grub bla ma thams cad bzhugs/ /oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ: chos rnams thams cad sku gsum rang bzhin la: gnyis med klong yangs chen por phyag 'tshal lo+oḥ ma bcos mtha' bral mnyam pa nyid kyis mchod: rang sems sangs rgyas ma rtogs mthol lo bshags: gnas lugs rang rig ngang du yi rang ngo : 'dzin med khyab brdal rol ba'i chos 'khor bskor: 'khor 'das dbyer med bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs: chos dbyings lhun grub chen por bsngo bar bya: zung 'jug kun khyab bde chen mchog thob shog: ces yan lag bdun pa dang / oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ:chos dbyings maṇ+ḍal rig pas brgyan pa 'di: bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku la 'bul/ /rang lus maṇ+ḍal dbang pos brgyan pa 'di: bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la 'bul: rin chen maṇ+ḍal gser gsum brgyan pa 'di: bla ma thugs rje sprul pa'i sku la 'bul: gu ru rat+na maṇ+ḍal kainir+ya ta yā mi/ drug pa gsol 270

'debs ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ thog ma'i sangs rgyas kun bzang snang mtha' yas/ /gangs can mgon po kha sar+sha ṇi dang / /'ja' lus snang srid dbang sdud pad+ma 'byung / /ye shes mtsho rgyal nyang ban ting 'dzin bzang / /yang sprul rig 'dzin chen po 'ja' tshon snying / /bdud 'dul gling pa klong gsal snying po'i zhabs/ /bde chen gling pa tshe dbang nor bu'i dpal/ /phrin las shin rta thugs kyi rdo rje rtsal/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag pad+ma nyin mor byed/ /don gnyis mthar phyin rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /ka dag lhun grub gzhi thog pheb pa dang / /khregs chod thod rgal lam la rtsal 'byongs nas/ /sku dang ye shes dbyer med mngon gyur te/ /mtha' yas 'gro kun sprul pas 'dren par shog /kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sidhi rgyu/ zhes dbang len cing bla ma'i lha tshogs rang la bstim/ bdun pa mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ ram̐ yo khaṃ: oṃ āḥrdu: rang gi gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum gyis mtshan: de las zer ma phyogs bcur rab 'phros pasoḥ mchod rdzas dngos 'dzin rnam rtog bag dang / /nyes skyon bsregs gtor sbyangs bkrus bdud rtsir gyur: sman raka gtor mchod 'od phung ldems se ldems: bla med mchod pa dpag yas bsam mi khyab: oṃ sne ṭ+wāṃ trī:ā: gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bdun las/ dang po phyi zhi ba ltar sgrub pa la ting 'dzin rnam pa gsum ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ: 'di ltar snang srid gnyis bsdus chas rnams kun:ye nas stong zhing nam mkha' lta bu la: gzung 'dzin spang blang bya byed mtha' las 'das: pad+ma saṃ bha bdag ni de ltar smra: dhad+ma dhā tu su bha wa āḥrdzu: trī: bdag nyid tha mal rang sems bzo med 'di:dkon mchog spyi 'dus pad+ma 'od 'bar sku: dkar gsal mdangs lnga mdzes 'dzum rgyan gyis spras: rdo rje thod pa tshe bum rin chen brgyan: pad zhwa rgod ldem kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yon nas 'khril: phong ka chos gos za 'og ber phyam can: mtshan dpes rab brgyan 'od kyi dkyil 'khor mdzes: mnyam nyid bde chen 'khyil ba'i skyil krung bzhugs: 'od kyi lus la ye shes snying po can: gsal stong thugs rje'i 'od zer kun la snyoms: mkha' 'gro 'ja' sprin rnam mang 'khrigs pa'i dbus: sku yi sprul pas zhing khams yongs la khyab: nam mkha'i lus can gar yang thogs pa med:bde gshegs kun gyi bkod pa sku la rdzogs: kun kyang rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor zang thal la: bgegs dang bar chad ces bya'i ming yang med: snang stong sgyu ma tsam du gsal bar bskyedoḥ de ltar du gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ: mgrin par ā:thugs kar r+ghaṃ: de las 'od zer 'phros pas zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas: o rgyan gyi gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas la 'khor rgyal ba rab 'byams gyis bskor ba til gyi gong bu kha bye ba ltar dpag tu med pa spyan drangs: ye shes pa spyan drangs pa ni/ trīḥsngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la:o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes:271

pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang po bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi skur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dza:sirnyi pha la hūṃ ā: dam ye gnyis med du gyur ba la phyag 'tshal ba ni/ na moḥ skye 'gag 'gyur med phrin las rdzogs: rang 'byung thugs rjes 'gro ba rnams sgrol: yid bzhin dngos grub char 'bebs pa'i: pad+ma 'od 'bur sku la phyag 'tshal lo: mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ o āḥr+ghaṃ: mchod 'os phyi nang snod bcud kun: blo yis sprul lam lhun gyis grub: ting 'dzin mnyam nyid chen po ru: dkon mchog spyi 'dus rgyal bar 'bul: gzhan yang mchod rdzas bye brag ni: mdzes pa'i me tog dbu la 'bul: dri zhim bdud spos shangs la 'bul: snang gsal mar me spyan la 'bul: mchod yon dri chab sku la 'bul: ro ldan zhal zas ljags la 'bul:snyan pa'i rol mo thugs la 'bul: phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa 'bul: bstod dbyangs glu yi mchod pa 'bul: 'dod yon ma spangs phyi mchod 'bul: nyon mongs ma spangs nang mchod 'bul: 'du 'bral med pa'i gsang mchod 'bul: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar sman mchod 'bul: dug lnga bsgral ba'i rak+ta 'bul: ba lo gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul: dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul: blang dor med pa'i mchod pa 'bul: ar+ghaṃ: pāju: puṣ+pe: dhu pe: ā lo ke: gadhe: ne wi t+yā: shari pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐: ma hā pañtsa rak+ta ba lo ta khā hi: bar 'dir spro na sman mchod bla sgrub gzhan ltar kha cig gis sbyor bar snang bas/ r+ghaṃ: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas la: dug lnga sel phyir ye shes lnga rdzogs rdzas: dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol:gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi: chos sku snang ba mtha' yas zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha ram̐ khā hi/ longs sku thugs rje chen po'i zhal du྾ sprul sku pad+ma 'od 'bar zhal du྾ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal zhal du ྾ nyang ban ting 'dzin bzang po'i zhal du྾ rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying po'i zhal du྾ khrag 'thung bdud 'dul rdo rje'i zhal du ྾ gter chen klong gsal snying po'i zhal du ྾ pad+ma bde chen gling pa'i zhal du ྾ rdo rje tshe dbang nor bu'i zhal du ྾ bka' brgyud phrin las shing rta'i zhal du ྾ rig 'dzin thugs kyi rdo rje'i zhal du ྾ pad+ma nyin byed dbang po'i zhal du ྾ drin can rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhal du ྾ bka' bab chos bdag skyes bu'i zhal du ྾ bla med dkon mchog spyi 'dus zhal du ྾ yi dam pad+ma drag po'i zhal du ྾ mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can zhal du ྾ chos skyong dam can mtsho'i zhal du ྾ gzhan yang mchod 'os rgya mcho1re zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha ram̐ 272

khā hi/ bstod pa ni/ trī: rgyal ba thams cad ye shes klong du gcig: chos nyid don la cha lugs mi mnga' yang : thabs mkhas gang 'dul so so'i skur ston pa: thugs rjes sprul bsgyur 'gyed la phyag 'tshal bstod: bde gshegs kun 'dus gzhon nu lo brgyad tshul: 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs mgon pad+ma 'byung : 'gyur med sku mdog gangs la nyi shar ltar: dmar mdangs cung zad 'tsher la phyag 'tshal bstod: thabs shes dbyer med rdo rje thod pa dang : zung 'jug tshe dang ye shes bum pa 'dzin: dug gsum rtsad gcod kha ṭ+wāṃ yum gyi tshul: khro 'dzum 'gro 'dul mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod: chos gos dmar po gser gyi ha ris can: she'u'i snyan zhu rgod ldem dar sna 'phyang : pad+ma'i gdan la mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar: phyi nang yon tan rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku dang zhing khams ye nas 'du 'bral med: phyogs bcu kun kyang rgyal ba'i cho 'phrul las: che chung ma nges sku gsum ngang du bzhugs: sprul pa'i glog stong 'khyug la phyag 'tshal bstod: gzi brjid nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od zer gyis: tshe yi dngos grub rang bzhin gnas nas 'gugasoḥ dgos 'dod re skong yin bzhin chog gi ngang : 'chi med rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: de ltar mchod dang bstod bya mi dmigs kyang : glo bur dri ma'i rnam rtog gsal phyir du: thabs shes dbyer med chu la chu bzhag tshul: gnyis med rol pa chen por phyag 'tshal bstod: des bskyed pa'i rim pa rjes 'bral bcas song / gnyis pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor la phyi sgrub ni/ rang gi gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas mchog gsum rtsa ba gsum po thams cad gu ru pad+ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya 'od zer gyi rnam par kha ba babs pa ltar byon/ rang la sib sib thim pas byin gyis brlab par gyur: oṃ āḥrgyu badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsirnyi pha la rdu ā: zhes dbyangs dang stangs stabs bcas bzla'o/ /nang sgrub ni/ rang gi thugs kar pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūṃ yig dkar pos mtshan pa rdo rje'i mtha' bskor du sngags phreng 'od lnga'i mdangs dang ldan pa g.yas bskor du 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ zhing khams rab 'byams kyi rgyal ba thams cad la mchod pa bla na med pa phul/sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad rang la 'dus/ bar du lha srin dregs pa can thams cad dbang du bsdus/ ci bsgo ba'i las thams cad rtsol med du bsgrubs/ mar rigs drug gi sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ bde bas tshims par byas/ 'od zer 'phro 'dus snod bcud lha sngags ye shes kyi rol pa chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sidhi r+ghaṃ: 'di bzlas pa'i dngos gzhi yin pas ci 'grub bya/ gsum pa de'i yan lag tu tshe sgrub nyams su len par spro na/ nang sgrub bzlas pa khyug tsam sngon du song nas/bdag mdun skad cig gis rig 'dzin tshe dpag med pad+ma 'od 'bar du gsal bar gyur/ trīḥdus 273

gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid: 'gro rnams ma lus sgrol ba'i ded dpon mchog: o rgyan pad+ma rig 'dzin tshe dpag med: bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum byin rlobs la: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol: gsol 'debs lan gsum bya/ bdag mdun gyi thugs kar pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ze'u 'brur pha lam gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar nyi zla'i gwa'u kha sbyor gyi dbus su trī:dkar po dz+ra dang ā:sa mtshan pa/ de'i mthar sngags phreng 'od lnga'i mdangs dang ldan pas g.yas bskor du 'khor ba dang / gnas lngar phyag mtshan lnga yig 'bru lngas mtshan pa las 'od zer spro bsdus phyi nang snod bcud thams cad lha sngags su gsal ba'i gzi brjid kyis/ sangs rgyas byang sems rtsa ba gsum dang chos skyong srung ma thams cad kyi tshe'i byin rlabs dang / 'byung ba'i bcud kyi dwangs ma thams cad dang / drang srong rig 'dzin tshe la dbang ba thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs/ mdor na sems can bsod nams can dkar po dge ba'i las sgrub cing dbang che ba/ rtsal drag pa/ 'khor mang ba/ yon tan che ba/ stobs dang snyan grags ldan pa/ gdul bya phrin las can rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams thams cad yi ge dz+ra'i rnam pa dang 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs kyi li li bdag mdun bum pa'i lha la thim par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sikhyi ā yu ṣe r+ghaṃ dz+ra dza: zhes tshe bsnyen gang 'grub bzla/ mthar smon lam gdab pa ni/ nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi dang : rkyen ngan nyi khri chig stong dang : ye 'drogs sum brgya drug cu dang :bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu sogs: tshe yi bar chad mi mthun phyogs: thams cad byang zhing dag gyur cig: tshe 'gugs ni mda' dar g.yab la/ trīḥ phyi ni bum pa nang du bdud rtsis gang : gsang ba'i don ni pad+ma tshe dpag med: gnas lngar phyag mtshan lnga dang yig 'bru lnga: 'od zer dpag yas nam mkha' gang bar 'phros: trī: shar phyogs dri za'i lag nas lcags kyus khug: lho phyogs gshin rje'i lag nas zhag pas khug: nub phyogs klu bdud lag nas lcags sgrogs khug: byang phyogs gnod sbyin lag nas dril bus khug: steng phyogs tshangs pa brgya byin lag nas khug: 'og phyogs dga' bo 'jog po'i lag nas khug: tshe srog chad pa mthud la yar ba khug: gas pa sbyor la nyams pa thams cad gsos:'od zer dkar la 'tsher zhing snum la 'dril: spyi bo'i gtsug nas lus la sib sib thim: 'od 'bar 'chi med tshe yi dbang thob shog: 'dir rgyun bzlas lta bu la mdun rten tshe rdzas dmigs bsal bshams pa med kyang gangs brag nags ri nyi zla gza' skar mtsho sogs la dmigs pa'i rten bya ba rdo rje'i gsung gi nges don yin no/ /bzhi pa gsang ba gu ru drag por sgrub pa ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis pad+ma 'od 'bar 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gu ru drag po gtum drag dmar nag me yi phreng ba can gyi skur gyur pa'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu khro bo'i zhing dang rnga yab/ pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas ye 274

shes kyi 'khor lo bdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par gyur/ spyan 'dren ni/ hūṃ: chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang : gzugs sku pad+ma 'od 'bar skad cig la: rngam brjid khros pa'i ngar skad phyogs bcur sgrogs: sprul pa yang sprul dpag yas 'jigs tshul ston: che mchog dmar nag me yi phreng ba can: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi grogs la byon: dzaḥ chos kyi dbyings nas sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs pa: dug gsum 'bar ba'i khro gtum 'jigs gzugs can: dregs pa sde brgyad 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: rgyal bsen dam sri 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: gnyan lhog smyo 'bog 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: mtha' yi dmag dpung bzlog phyir gshegs su gsol: snang srid bran du bkol phyir gshegs su gsol: dbang dang dngos grub stsol phyir gshegs su gsoloḥ mchod pa ni/ r+ghaṃ:srid gsum ye nas gtor gzhong du: snang srid thams cad gtor mar sbyar: 'khor 'das yongs sgrol chen po'i tshogs: dbang drag 'bar ba khyed la 'bul: stong gsum stong gi gtor gzhong du: ri rab 'bar ba'i dpal bshos btsugasoḥ skye 'gro sems can grangs las 'das: dbang drag 'bar ba khyod la 'bul: bhad+dha 'bar ba'i gtor gzhong du: dgra bgegs sha khrag thod tshil spungs: zhag dang rlangs pa chi li li: dbang drag 'bar ba'i thugs dam bskang : bdud rtsi gtor chen rak+ta'i mtsho: sbyor sgrol ting 'dzin tshogs mchod dang : phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin gtibs: dbang drag 'bar ba'i thugs dam bskang : bstod pa ni/ rgyu: bde chen rang bzhin khros pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: dkon mchog spyi 'dus dmar nag 'bar ba'i sku: zur zhal g.yon gzigs zhabs gnyis 'dor thabs bsgrad: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rno dkar mche ba gcigs: dgra bgegs sha khrag rus pa krum krum gsol: spyan gsum dmar skum sdang mig phyogs bcur 'khyil: dregs pa pho mo 'dar zhing sdang bar byed: shangs nas rlung 'tshubs 'brug sgra ldir ba yis khams gsum srid gsum dbang sdud zil gyi gnon: ral pa kham nag nam mkha'i dbyings la bsgrengs: khro chung mang pos dgra bgegs thal bar brlags: phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rjes mtha' dmag zlog: g.yon pas lcags steg nag po'i sprul ba 'gyed: klu rnams 'dul phyir sbrul rigs lnga yis brgyan: 'khor ba stong mdzad mgo phreng lnga bcus brgyan: glang chen ko rlon stobs bcu lhun gyis rdzogs: stag sham nga rgyal dregs pa dbang du sdud: rin chen rus rgyan mkha' 'gro rol du khrid: ba spu'i rtse nas khro chung tshwa tshwa 'phro: me dud zer gyis srid gsum skar ltar 'khrugs:gu ru drag po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dbang drag 'bar ba'i thugs dam dus la bab: rnal 'byor bdag gi sngon gyi dam tshig gis: lha mchog khyed la gdung bas 'bod lags na: khyed kyi thugs dam gnad nas da skul cig: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i dus la babs: nag po klu gnyan 'dul 275

ba'i dus bab: dregs pa gza' rgod 'dul ba'i dus la bab: sde brgyad lha srin 'dul ba'i dus la baboḥ be har srog bdag 'dul ba'i dus la bab: mtha' yi dmag dpung bzlog pa'i dus la bab:mi nad phyugs nad bzlog pa'i dus la bab: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: ye shes pa rang la thim pas/ rang gi dbu gtsug na rigs bdag gu ru zhi bas mtshan pa/ thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du r+ghaṃ dmar nag gi mtha' bskor du sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor ba las 'od zer dmar nag ye shes kyi me dang mtshon cha la sogs pa 'phros/ ma rung gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ snang srid thams cad rig 'dzin drag po'i skur gsal bar gyur/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ: a rtsig ni rtsig na mo bha ga wa te r+ghaṃ rgyu phaṭa: mthar sde brgyad sham bu ni/ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa ma ya rdu rgyu phaṭa phaṭa bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog bh+yo zlog cig: rtsa sngags dang sbrel la de'i bcu cha bzla'o/ /lnga pa yang gsang mkha' 'gror sgrub pa ni/rang nyid rig 'dzin drag po 'od du zhu ba las ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi skur gyur pa'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum las 'od 'phros/ nub phyogs o rgyan sprul pa'i pho brang dang gnas yul dur khrod kyi zhing nas ye shes pa spyan drangs par gyur/ hūṃ bh+yo: ma skyes rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings nyid las: skye ba'i cho 'phrul 'bar ba'i skur ston pa: 'gro ba'i don mdzad ye shes mkha' 'gro ma:nam mkha'i mdog can dbu ni seng ge'i gdong : gcer bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mnga' ma: phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon pas thod khrag 'dzin: dug lnga gcod cing skye med dbyings su rol: rtse gsum mchan du bzung nas dug gsum sgrol: rus rgyan me long rgyan gyis ḍā ki dbang du sdud: ye shes me ris ma rig mun pa 'joms: g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang thabs shes dbyer med dang : pad+ma nyi zla bam ro'i gdan la bzhugs: rang bzhin gnas nas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsoloḥ bh+yoḥ sku gsung thugs sprul mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: phrin las sprul pa ma mo'i tshogs: kun kyang yang sprul bsam mi khyab: gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo: na mo: lcang lo bcas pa'i bhad+dha ru: dmar gtor khrag dang zhag gis brgyan: sha sna snyid sna'i rgyal mtshan btsugasoḥ mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : rak+ta'i rba klong phya ra ra: 'o mtsho dkar dwangs kyi li li: zhag gi rgya mtsho me re re+oḥ zhun chen gsur dud chi li li: rnga dung rol mo'i di ri ri: rkang gling thod rnga khro lo lo: dgra bo'i sha khrag dmar nyi li: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : dam nyams dgra bgegs myur du sgrol: ḍā ki si ha mu kha ar+ghaṃ pā bye puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gadhe naiwi bya shalda pra tīts+tsha ā:r+ghaṃ: ma hā māṃ sa tsit+ta rak+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta ba li ta khā hi: ye shes pa bstems pas/ rang gi dbu gtsug na gu ru zhi ba/ gru mor rig 'dzin drag po mtshon byed kha ṭ+wāṃ gas mtshan pa/ pha lam las grub pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa mtshon cha'i gur dang ye shes kyi me phung 276

'khrigs pa'i dbus su rang 'dra'i sprul pa du ma dang bcas te bzhugs pa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ sngon po g.yon tu 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ dam chos bsgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad spu gris skra bzhar ba lta bur song bar gyur/ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥspros bcas spros med gang gi tshe'ang zlog dmigs sbyar bar spro na/ spyi bor aḥkaḥmagrin par saḥmaḥdang / /snying khar raḥtsaḥlte bar shaḥdaḥste/ /gsang bar raḥsaḥbarla gnyis maḥraḥyaḥ phaṭaḥkyis mtshan las me 'od mtshon cha 'khrugs/ /bar chad thams cad rdul bzhin brlag par gyur/ /zhes mos la yi ge bcu bzhi pa bzla/ mthar thal deb spro na lag gnyis nyi zlar gsal ba lang brdabs pas gnod byed thams cad sgo nga brag bar du bcang ba bzhin song bar bsgoms la/ mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can khyod kyi rig sngags bzlas pa'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag slob dpon 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la sdang bar byed pa'i dgra/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs/ bar du gcod pa'i rkyen/ mdor na bkra mi shis pa'i phyogs ris ngan pa thams cad phyir zlog par gyur cig lan gsum bya/ zlog dmigs dang thal deb 'di dgongs mo'i cha dang dgu gsum dus gnyan lta bur ched du dgos na ma gtogs tshes bcu'i tshogs mchod bsnyen sgrub skabs sogs la mi sbyar ro/ /drug pa phrin las bzhi sgrub ni/ bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin pa'i las sbyor gyi skabs ma gtogs gzhan la sbyar mi dgos kyang / rgyun khyer lta bur sbyor yang 'gal ba med pas de ltar na/ zhi ba ni/ rang nyid pad 'byung thugs srog r+ghaṃ bcas dkar/ /spyi bor pad dkar 'dab ma so gnyis lter/ /zla steng oṃ mthar sngags phreng 'od zer dkar/ /rgyud bskul nus bskyed sdig sgrib 'jigs brgyad zhi/ /snod bcud rdo rje sems dpa'i zhing du gyur/ badz+ra gu ru'i sham du/ oṃ shārnyi ku ru ye swā hā: zhes bzla/ smon lam ni/nad gdon sdig sgrib bag chags ngan: sdang dgra gnod byed gdug pa'i dpal: rno ba'i mtshon dang sbyor ba'i dug: stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs kun dang : bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams dang : rmis ltas mtshan ngan thams cad kun: myur ba nyid du zhi gyur cig rgyas pa na/ rang nyid pad 'byung thugs srog rdu bcas ser/ /lte bar pad ser 'dab ma re bzhi'i lter/ /rin chen r+ghaṃ mtshan sngags phreng 'od zer ser/ /rgyud bskul nus bskyed tshogs gnyis 'byor drug rgyas/ /snod bcud rin chen sems dpa'i zhing du gyur/ rtsa sngags sham du/ sgro puṣ+ṭi ku ru ye swā hā+oḥ zhes bzla/ smon lam ni/ tshe dang bsod nams snyan grags stobs: 'khor dang bu slob phrin las rgyas: mnga' thang longs spyod yon tan kun: myur ba nyid du rgyas gyur cig: dbang ni/ rang nyid pad 'byung thugs srog hūṃ bcas dmar/ /mgrin par pad dmar 'dab ma bcu drug lter/ /nyi steng trī:mthar sngags phreng 'od zer dmar/ /rgyud bskul nus bskyed 'khor 'das mos bzhis bsdus/ /snod bcud pad+ma sems dpa'i zhing du gyur/ /rtsa sngags sham du/trīḥwa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes bzla/ smon lam ni/ rgyal ba'i thugs rje byin rlabs dang : skye 'a~X snathong

thos dran reg sogs: khams gsum dbang du 'dus gyur cig: drag po ni/ rang nyid pad 'byung thugs srog r+ghaṃ bcas mthing / /gsang bar pad ljang 'dab ma nyer brgyad lter/ /ral gri hūm̐ mtshan sngags phreng 'od zer nag /rgyud bskul nus bskyed dgra bgegs dug lnga brlag /snod bcud las kyi sems dpa'i zhing du gyur/ / rtsa sngags sham du/ hūṃ mā ra ya phaṭa: zhes bzla/ smon lam ni/ dam sri 'byung po ma rungs pa: bstan dgra sgos dgra la sogs pa: zhing bcu ldan rnams brlag gyur cig: ces las gang sgrub mang du mang du bzla ba'am dmigs bsal med na cha snyoms pa bzla/ de dag gi mthar lhag chad kha skong zhing byin rlabs kyi rgyun brtan pa'i phyir dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying rnams kyang lan gsum gsum bzla'o/ /bdun pa thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ ro yam̐ khaṃ/ bdag nyid pad+ma 'od 'bar thugs ka nas/ /me rlung chu byung gtor ma'i nyes skyon sbyangs/ /a las pad+ma bharnya yangs pa'i nang / /'bru gsum las byung ye shes bdud rtsi'i mtsho/ kha dog dri ro nus bcud phun gsum tshogs/ /'dod yon mchod sprin dpag med 'phro ba'i gyur/ /oṃ ā:rgyu: lan gsum/ r+ghaṃ trī: dkon mchog spyi 'dus pad+ma 'od 'bar rje/ /brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /gtor ma zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /bzhes nas dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ che mchog dmar nag me yi phreng ba can/ /rgyud sde bzhi drug yi dam lha tshogs kyis/ /gtor ma zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /bzhes nas mchog thun dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /ye shes ḍā ki seng ge'i gdong pa can/ /gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas kyis/ /gtor ma zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /bzhes nas phrin las rnam bzhi myur 'grub mdzod/ /dpal mgon lcam dral gza' mchog rdo rje legs/ /rgyud gsum dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /gtor ma zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /bzhes nas sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po
