srungs/ /rdo rje de mo brtan ma bcu gnyis sogs/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba'i gzhi gnas gter bdag gis/ /gtor ma zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /bzhes nas bod yul mtha' dbus bde bar mdzod/ /khyad par gter srung dge bsnyen mthu stobs che/ /hom 'phrang klu bdud mtsho sman 'khor bcas kyis/ /gtor ma zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /bzhes la yang zab bstan pa rgyas par mdzod/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i spyan sngar zhal bzhes shing / /bstan pa skyong mdzad dam tshig ldan rnams kyis/ /gtor ma 'di bzhes 'gal rkyen bar chad sol/ /mchog thun dngos grub 'grub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ ces pa tsam mam/ spro na rtse le rin po ches mdzad pa sogs bya'o/ /gsum pa rdzas kyi rjes kyi bya ba la'ang bdun las/ dang po tshogs kyi mchod pa ni/ thabs shes kyi rdzas tshogs par byas te chu chang nang mchod kyis sbyangs la/ trīḥ bdag nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: yi ge ram̐ yo khaṃ gsum 'phos: dngos 'dzin rnam rtog bag chags kun: bsregs gtokā ḍi8krus nas bdud rtsir gyur: oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ: slar yang snying po 'bru gsum 'phros: 'dod yon zag

med snang srid gang ཿོ rang bzhin sku gsum zhing khams nas: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang : chos skyong dam can gter bdag rnams: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas la:'khor du dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bskor: dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldem: rin chen rgyan cha si li li: glu len gar stabs khyugs se khyug: nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi gang : gnas khang 'di la byin cig phob: tshogs gtor 'di la bcud cig phob: dur khrod gnas mchog nyams re dga': rnal 'byor pho mo dam tshigs gtsang : tshogs dang mchod rdzas dang re spro+oḥ lhun grub 'od khyim bkrag mdangs mjes: oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ: tshogs mchod 'od phung 'bar ba 'di: mchod 'os skyes mchog rnams la 'bul:nyams chags 'gal 'khrul thams cad bshags: gnyis 'dzin 'khrul snang ru dra 'di: zhal du bstab bo kha ram̐ khā hi: oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ: gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki nī ki ni ri tig ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: skong ba cung zad rgyas par spro na/ trīḥ ma bcos spros bral gnas lugs mngon gyur pa'i: rgyal ba dgongs pa brgyud pa'i thugs dam bskang : ting 'dzin mchog brnyes brda yi brgyud pa ste: rig 'dzin rig pa brgyud pa'i thugs dam bskang : bka' lung lhag chad med pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: snyan khung brgyud pa'i bla ma'i thugs dam bskang : bka' brgyud gter du sbas pa'i bya ra mdzad: mkha' 'gro gtad rgya brgyud pa'i thugs dam bskang : ma 'ongs las 'phro ldan pa lung du bstan: smon lam dbang bskur brgyud pa'i thugs dam bskang : shes bya thams cad rnam pa kun mkhyen pa'i: dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : 'gro kun zhi bde'i gnas su 'dren mdzod pa'i: gsung mchog dam chos rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : sa dang lam la gnas nas bstan pa skyong : 'phagasaṭapa'i dge 'dun rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : lta sgom mkhyen pa mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i: skyes mchog bla ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : dngos grub thogs pa med par stsol mdzad pa'i: yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : phyi dang nang gi bar chad kun sel ba'i: mkha' 'gro dam can rnams kyi thugs dam bskang :ma skyes gdod nas rang bzhin rnam par dag: skye mar mngon gyur chos sku'i thugs dam bskang : dug lnga ye shes lnga yi ngo bor smin: zhi khro longs spyod rdzogs sku'i thugs dam bskang : rang snang ma 'gags gzhan snang der ston pa'i: sprul sku 'gro don mdzad pa'i thugs dam bskang : trīḥ zhi ba lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis rgyal ba'i thugs dam bskang : khrag 'thung rol ba'i dur khrod chen po nas: lnga bcu rtsa brgyad khro bo'i thugs dam bskang : rgyu: sku mchog 'gyur ba med pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : gsung mchog 'gags pa med pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : thugs mchog g.yo ba med pa'i 279

dkyil 'khor nas: yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : yon tan lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: bdud rtsi yon tan lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : phrin las drag pos bsgral ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /phur pa phrin las lha tshogs thugs dam bskang ཿོ sha khrag rgya mtsho 'khyil pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : thugs rjes gdung 'tshob sku yi dkyil 'khor nas: rig 'dzin slob dpon lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : dam rdzas rdza ltar lhags pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : dgra bgegs gdug pa 'dul pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bsdu na 'di man chad kyis 'thus/ trī: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid: bla med dkon mchog spyi 'dus thugs dam bskang : lha srin sde brgyad 'dul ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: gu ru drag po'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : a ti bla med bka' yi bya ra ma: mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can thugs dam bskang : sangs rgyas kun gyi bstan pa srung mdzad pa: chos skyong ma mgon lcam dral thugs dam bskang : dpal gyi spyan sngar rang rtags srog snying phul: dam can rgya mtsho yongs kyi thugs dam bskang : sgrub pa po la dngos grub char 'bebs pa'i: rgyal chen rnam thos sras kyi thugs dam bskang : stobs bsam 'di na drag rtsal ldan pa yi: gza' bdud rā hu la yi thugs dam bskang : gsang sngags rgyud sde kun gyi gnyer kha gtad: dam can rdo rje legs pa'i thugs dam bskang : o rgyan pad+mas bka' yi gnyer du bskos:gter bdag gter srung rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : tshul bzhin sgrub pa byed pa'i grogs mdzad poḥgazhi bdag gzhis srung rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : r+ghaṃ: gzhan yang thugs dam skong ba'i dam rdzas ni: rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i bdud rtsi dang : pad+ma māṃ sar sbyar ba'i rak+ta dang : khyad par rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma dang : tshogs kyi yo byad longs spyod rgya chen 'disoḥ khyed rnams thugs dam gnyan po bskang gyur cig:khyed rnams thugs dam gnyan por bskangs gyur nas: bdag gi g.yar dam gnyan po sor stsol cig: bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol: r+ghaṃ: bskang du med de skye med ngang du bskang : mchod du med de gnyis med rol pas mchod: sbyor du med de zung 'jug chen por sbyor:sgrol du med de mnyam nyid dbyings su bsgral: ye sbyor ye sgrol chen po'i thugs dam bskang : tshogs bshags ni/ hoḥ dkon mchog spyi 'dus dgongs su gsol/ /pad+ma 'od 'bar la phyag 'tshal/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang bla ma'i lung : ji bzhin ma spyad slob dpon smad: rdo rje'i mched dang lcam dral la: lta log gcod sems ngan du smras: brdog bcog gnod pa dngos su bgyis: lha dang dkyil 'khor nyams ma gsol: 'dzab bzlas ma dag zur chag g.yel: gsang bar 'os dang gnyer gtad smras: gsang 280

bcu bsgrags shing bla ma bslus: rtsa ba'i dam nyams mthol zhing bshags: gzhan yang spyad bya'i dam tshig lnga: mi spang lnga dang dang len lngoḥ shes bya lnga dang bsgrub bya lnga: yan lag dam nyams mthol zhing bshags: bsnyen sgrub ting 'dzin dam g.yel zhing : nya shi dus drug dus mchod chags: le lo gsog 'jog tshogs spyang byas: phud lhag nyams shing kha tshar shor: tshor dang ma tshor rkyen dbang gis: sgo gsum bag med dam 'gal bshags: dam tshig nyams dang tshogs 'dres dang : bskangs shing chos bshad 'grogs la sogs: nyams chags skyon gyis gos pa rnams: 'gyod pas bshags so dag gyur cigoḥ yid kyi dam nyams lta bas bshags: de yang kun gzhi byang chub sems: yin pa med pa'i lta ba rtogs: min pa med pa'i sgom nyams lon: yin min med pa'i spyod pa rtogs: re dogs med par byang chub nas: rtsa ba yan lag thams cad kyi: nyams chags ma byung ma skyes pas: bshags bya bshags byed gnyis med grol: oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya: sogs nas/ badzi bha wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥ'adi'i tshig rkang dang po gnyis gsung rgyun 'phros gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi rgyud tshig go/ (bdag cag gis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las ngan pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag nas: kun bzang yangs pa chen po'i klong du kha bskang zhing bde chen chos nyid kyi dbyings su sor chud par gyur cig gnam phud 'thor la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ: bla ma rgya mtsho tshogs la rol: yi dam rgya mtsho tshogs la rol: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho tshogs la rol: chos skyong srung ma tshogs la roloḥ nor lha gter bdag tshogs la rol: snang srid lha 'dre tshogs la rol: yul lha gzhi bdag tshogs la rol: rigs drug pha ma tshogs la rol: lan chags bgegs rigs tshogs la rol: la la phyi yi tshogs la rol: la la nang gi tshogs la rol: la la gsang ba'i tshogs la rol: de kho na nyid kyi tshogs bde ba chen po la rol: ga ṇa tsa kra pū dza khā hi: las rdor gyis/ hoḥ tshogs kyi mchod pa rgyan ru rol/ zhes stob/ len pa pos/ a la la ho: zhes blangs la nang gi sreg blugs kyis rol/ lhag ma ni/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ: lhag ma dbang ba dregs pa'i tshogs: sprin ltar gtibs shing hab sha rgyug: sha khrag brgyan pa'i tshogs lhag bzhes: sngon gyi dam bca' ji bzhin du: bstan dgra dam nyams zas su zo: rtags dang mtshan ma myur du ston: sgrub pa'i bar chad bzlog pa dang : phrin las thogs med 'grub par mdzod: usnaṣ+ṭa ba lo ta khā hi: drag po'i las dang 'bral ba'i bskul ba dgos na skabs 'dir sbyar bar bya ste gzhan du shes so/ /gnyis pa gtor skyong las chang mdo bya ba ni/ gtor ma la dgra bgegs 'gugs bstems byas te bdud rtsir dmigs la/ r+ghaṃ: sngon tshe bar dang tha ma'i bskal pa dang : snyigs ma rtsod ldan dus dang lha mi'i gnas: kun bzang snang ba mtha' yas pad+ma 'byung : rgyud gsungs gter du sbas dang bton pa'i tshe: snang srid so sos khas blangs dam bcas 281

bzhin: mchod gtor bzhes la phrin las 'grub par mdzod: 'gong po spun dgu rgya 'dre'i gnod pa dang : hor sogs 'jigs pa'i dmag dpung bzlog tu gsol: bshal chus brtan ma skyong ba ni/ khyad par slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' sgrub pa: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma chen mo ni: bdud mo bzhi dang gnod sbyin sman mo bzhi: 'khor dang lhab lhub sil snyan sgra dang bcasoḥ 'dir gshegs bka' yi gtor ma'i bshal chu bzhes: bod khams dkar po'i chos la 'god pa dang ཿོ yang zab bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang : mthong thos dran reg smin cing grol bar mdzod: dkyus ma phyag len tu mi mdzad kyang drag las sogs kyi mjug tu rta bro bya ba ni/ gtor gzhong 'og tu dmigs bya bkug la/ r+ghaṃ: stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na: zhing bcu bsgral ba'i gdan steng du+oḥ dbang drag lha tshogs bro brdungs pas: dgra ni thal bar rlag pa'i bro: bgegs ni phye mar 'thags pa'i bro: gnod byed dam sri 'dul ba'i bro:bar chad med par brdung bar bya: oṃ sum+bha ni sogs r+ghaṃ bzhi'i sngags mthar/ hūṃ r+ghaṃ lo lo stam+bha ya nan: gsum pa mchod bstod ni/ mchod pa kha gsos te/ oṃ āḥhū+oṃḥ mchod 'os phyi nang nas/ rgyal bar 'bul: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shari'i bar/ ma hā pañtsa a bṛ ta rak+ta ba lo kha khā hi: trī+oḥ rgyal ba thams cad sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis bstod/ mchod bstod 'di chos bcu'i tshogs mchod sogs la mdzad srol med do/ /bzhi pa dngos grub blang ba na/ e ma ho: bdag gzhan bla med tshogs mchod 'di dag gis: sdig sgrib nyams chags ma lus kun byang nas: tshe 'di nyid la rig 'dzin mchog 'grub cing : byin rlabs rtsal dbang gzi byin nus mthu ldan: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sirnyi rgyu: nongs bshags brtan bzhugs gzhung 'grel gang du'ang ma gsungs pas tshes bcu'i tshogs mchod sogs la phyag len mi mdzad kyang / sgrub mchod dang dbang sgrub kyi skabs su yig brgya bzla zhing nongs bshags dang / tshogs mgron sogs brtan bzhugs spyi ltar bya'o/ /lnga pa smon lam ni/ oṃ āḥrgyu: skyabs med mgon med skye 'gro 'di dag kun: 'khor ba'i 'khrul 'khor kun gyi gzhi rten loḥ rten 'brel bcu gnyis shing rta lta bu yi: 'phang lo 'dra ba myur du zhig gyur cig: bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub myur thob shog: drug pa bkra shis ni/ e ma ho: shes bya'i don la ma rmongs pa'i: bla ma dam pa'i bkra shis shog: gang la bsam pa de yis 'grub: yi dam lha yi bkra shis shog:sku gsung thugs kyi bha ga la: phyag rgya chen po'i bkra shis shog: bdun pa bskyed rim bsdu ldangs ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ: snod bcud snang srid thams cad kun: sgyu lus gzhal yas khang du bsdu: de yang yas mar 'od du zhu: sngags phreng gser gyi rdo rjer bsdu: de yang 'ja' 'am mchu bur ltaroḥ dmigs med rgya yon lhug par bzhag: rang bzhin dbyings rig ma bu 'dres: gdod ma'i kun bzang mjal bar 'gyur:o āḥhūṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi rgyu: gzugs snang thams cad gsal stong lha yi sku/ /sgra grags thams cad brjod bral sngags kyi sgra/ /dran rtog thams cad rang grol ngos bzung bral/ /dmigs med khyab brdal 282

lhun grub chen por shog /ces brjod la khyer so gsam gyi grub mtha' bskyang bar bya'o/ /rtsa ba'i gzhung dang dkar ༄'grel yang 'grel bcas/ /rig 'dzin brgyud pa du ma'i bzhed srol gyi/ /snying po bsdus te dad pas sbyar na yang /rmongs blos nyesalhakun rtsa gsum lha la bshegs/ /dbang lung thob pas rgyas bsdus gang byas kyang / /'gal ba med par rjes su gnad pa'i mthus/ /'dis kyang lus can bye ba dung phyur snyed/ /pad+ma 'od 'bar go 'phang sgrub nus shog /chos 'dir 'bral kun dag pa'i zhing gcig tu/ /thugs yid gcig 'dres 'od gong khyab brdal che/ /lhun grub thig ler mngon par 'tshang rgya bar/ /rdo rje'i gsung bzhin bslu med 'grub gyur cig ces pa 'di'ang khyab bdag kun mkhyen bla ma mtsho skyes dgyes pa'i zhabs kyis gser gyi me tog bcas bka'i cod pan spyi bor phebs pa dad pas gtsug tu bkod de/ pad+ma'i zhal tshab si tu pad+ma dbang chen gyis rjes su bzung zhing tshes 'di'i rigs sngags 'chang ba pad+ma gar dbang phrin las 'gro 'dul rtsal gyis de bī ko ṭi tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi sgrub gnas su smin zla'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes bcu'i mchod pa dang rjes su 'bral bar grub par bgyis pa zab chos 'di nyid nam yang mi nub dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig dge legs 'phel/ / 283

gag /dkon mchog phyi 'dus kyi dbang bskur bklags chog tu bkod pa gu ru'i dgongs gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ na mo gu ru pad+ma ka rā ya/ gdod ma'i sangs rgyas tshe bdag 'od dpag med/ /'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i gter/ /kun 'dus bla ma nor bu pad+ma 'byung / /de la btud de dbang chog 'dir bshad bya/ 'dir bla ma'i sgrub thabs thams cad kyi nying khu yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi dbang bskur ba'i tshul la/ yang zab rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u brgyad pa las/ dbang bzhi gdan thog gcig tu bskur: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi: rdzas bshams bdag gzhan dbang blangs na: byin rlabs myur 'bebs smin grol 'gyur: dbang gi le'u gsum pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sbyor ba yo byad kyi bsham bkod dang / dngos gzhi bsgrub cing dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po yo byad bsham pa 'di/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad pa pod lnga'i mu khyud dang rdo rje'i phreng ba me ris bskor zhing lte bar nyi zla rdo rje thod pa'am trīḥyig thig le gang bde bkod la/ de tsam ma lcogs ni 'bru dkar tshom bu bkod pa'i dbus kyi stegs bur lnga tshan bdun gyis bkangs pa'i bum pa rgyan ldan bshams pa'i mthar skor du dbang rdzas thod pa bdud rtsi/ kha ṭ+wāṃ/ shel rdo/ sgrub skor glegs bam/ gter srung gi gtor ma rnams dang / gzhan gang mchod gtor sman gnyen spyod phyi nang gi mchod pa tshogs kyi 'khor lo bcas bshams shing /slob dpon gyi mdun du las bum rdor dril ḍa ru 'thor nas rnams kyang 'du bya'o/ /gnyis pa bsgrub cing dbang bskur ba ni/ de yang gter gzhung las/ rang la dbang len pa dang gzhan la sbyin pa sogs thams cad la mtshams gcod srung 'khor skyabs 'gro nas las gzhung tshogs babs dang bcas pa sgrub pa'i bskul brtson par bya'o: zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thog mar skyabs sems nas brtsams te bzlas pa'i bar rtsa ba'i las byang bzhin bdag mdun phyam gcig tu bsgrub nas bzlas pa ci nus/ mthar gu ru drag po dang seng gdong ma'i gtor 'bul dang bzlas pa ci rigs byas la/las bum yang rdor sems ma rta mgrin lta bu bskyed la sngags kyi byin gyis brlab/ tshogs phud 'bul/ skong ba bya grub nas 'og tu slob ma la bya ba bzhin ting 'dzin gsal pos bdag 'jug legs par blang ngo / /de ltar bdag 'jug blang ba ni spyir sngags sdom gso ba'i yan lag tu nges par dgos gal che bas slob mar dbang bskur skabs kho na tsam ma yin par tshes bcu sogs dus bzang khyad par can rnams su nges par ci nus blang ba yin la/ 'dir gter gzhung rtsa bar/ bdag gzhan dbang blang na: zhes dang / rang la dbang len pa dang gzhan la byin pa zhes gsungs pas don 'di gsal bar bstan pa yang yin no/ /de nas slob ma rnams khrus nas phyung / bgegs la gtor ma byin bka' bsgos mtshams gcod srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkye bsdu rnams byas la slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces brjod de/ 'o na/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du yang dag par rdzogs 284

pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du yang zab bla ma'i sgrub thabs dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi byin rlabs dbang bskur zhu snyam pa'i rtog pa bsdus te yid rtse gcig mos pa brtan pos gsan par zhu/ de yang bdag cag gi ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thabs la mkhas shing thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa des gdul bya'i blo dang 'tshams par thar pa'i 'jug sgo dam pa'i chos tshul ji snyed gsungs pa las mchog tu gyur pa 'bras bu gsang sngags rnal 'byor bla na med pa ste/ de'i yang spyir byin rlabs kyi 'jug sgo rmad du byung zhing khyad par dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi gtso mchog bde bar gshegs pa yongs su 'dus pa'i ngo bo chig dril lam zab mo bla ma'i sgrub pa kho na yin la/ de yang bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ lha sku 'bum phrag bsgom pa bas/ /bla ma gcig po sgom pa mchog /ces dang /rgyud chen dra ba las/ bla ma sangs rgyas kun gyi rje/ /rgyal ba'i man ngag gsang chen rnams/ /ston pa rdo rje'i thugs la gnas/ /gtso ru bla ma rdor 'dzin bsgom/ /zhes dang / sangs rgyas 'dus pa las/ gang gi gdul bya'i yid bzhin du/ /bla ma sgrub pa'i thabs brtsams te/ /de nyid don du sus gnyer ba/ /theg chen bla ma'i sa yis non/ /kun gyi bdag nyid chen por 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ nam mkha' che'i rgyud las/ tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs snying po yi/ /don rtogs 'dod na bla ma bsgrub/ /ces sogs lung 'byams klas par 'byung ba bzhin bla ma'i sgrub thabs ni mchog dang gtso bor gyur pa ste/ de yi sgrub thabs kyi sgo bsam gyis mi khyab pa las 'dir rgyal ba thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nus gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i rang gzugs gdod ma nyid nas chos sku kun tu bzang por mngon par byang chub pa nyid pad+ma rnam par bkod pa'i zhing du 'od snang dpag med gangs chen mtsho sogs longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang thugs rje'i gdul zhing 'byams klas par sprul pa'i bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa las mi mjed 'jig rten 'dir yang bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong la dbang bskur nas lung ston par byed pa po sangs rgyas nus ldan rdo rjer gyur cing bskal bzang sangs rgyas re re bzhin de yi phrin las mtha' dag gi byed po rgyal ba'i bstan la ston pa gnyis pa lta bur rtag tu sprul bzhin bdag cag gi ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i bstan pa la yang srid pa gsum dang 'dzam gling 'gro ba rnams la rgyal ba nyid dang dbyer med pa'i phrin las bzhis sems can gyi don mdzad pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che lta bu'i gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sgrub thabs te/ rgyal ba de nyid la gangs can gyi rje 'bangs skal ldan las can rnams kyi gsol ba btab par brten zab rgyas chos tshul ji snyed gsungs shing snyigs ma'i don du zab mo'i gter du bcas par mdzad pa las/ 'di ni gter ston chen po 'ja' tshon snying po'am las 'phro gling pas rngod hom 'phrang lcags kyi sgo mo nas spyan drangs pa'i yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi skor te/285

de yang gter ston nyid nas rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang mchog gi brgyud pa bar ma chad pa drin can bla ma dam pa'i bar rim par brgyud pa dang / de bzhin rig 'dzin chen po bdud 'dul nus ldan rdo rjes sgro brag ban ri pad+ma 'od nas bton pa'i bla sgru ba pad+ma 'od 'bar gyi byin rlabs kyang rje bla mas gsan pa 'di dang tshig don phal cher mtshungs ba'i phyir chu bo gcig 'dres su yang 'gyur zhing / bla ma dam pa de thams cad kyi thugs nyams su bstar zhing byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun chen po ma nub par gnas pa lags/brgyud pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa 'di nyid kyi dbang du byas na/ gter gzhung las/ e ma hoḥdakon mchog spyi 'dus dam chos yang snying 'di: dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi dgongs pa 'dus: theg pa'i yang rtse rtsod med a ti che: rgyudakhrug 'khor ba'i sems can sgrol ba'i chos: zhes dang / nyang ban gyi zhus lan las kyang / rtsod ldan snyigs dus kyi ngang tshul mang du gsungs pa'i mthar sdug bsngal de rnams las skyob pa'i thabs ni kho bo pad+ma'i thugs rje byin rlabs thams cad de yi tshe shugs che bas sa steng chos kyis bkang yod pa yang de rnams la dgongs pa yin: khyad par thugs sgrub kun gyi yang gsang dkon mchog spyi 'dus 'di yang nyang ban ting 'dzin bzang po'i sprul pa zhig gis rnyed nas dus ngan gyi sems can 'ga' zhig la phan par yong: chos 'di zhal phyes pa tsam gyis mtha' dmag phyir bsring nus: sa phyogs der yang lo phyugs legs pa dang : rlung 'tshubs chung : dad 'dun pa byed pa'i dud 'gro yan chad bde chen dag pa'i zhing du 'gro'o: gzhan yang zab gter 'di nyid byin rlabs kyi so ma nyams par dang ldan rnams la dbang lung ston pa na dus mtha'i skye 'gro rnams yid bzhin nor bu rnyed pa las kyang 'tshengs che'o: der ma zad 'di nyid 'chang ba dang mchod bstod bsngags pa brjod cing snyan pa thos pa tsam yang bde bar gshegs pa'i sras dam par 'gyur ro: las sgrib thams cad dung dkar phyis pa ltar 'gyur ro: tshogs gnyis kyi bya ba skar tshogs rgyas pa ltar 'gyur ro: rgyal po'i chad pa la sogs 'jigs pa brgyad las grol bar 'gyur ro: mdze la sogs pa'i rnam smin gyi nad thams cad srab cing byang ba dang : gcong nad zha grum dang mig nad la sogs pa thams cad las grol bar 'gyur ro: tshe dang bsod nams la sogs pa'i 'byor pa drug ldan du 'gyur zhing : bu 'dod pa yang rigs brgyud 'phral du 'phel bar 'gyur ro: mos tshul bzhi'i dbang dang ldan zhing lha srin sde brgyad dpung dang bcas pa'ang phyi bzhin du 'brang ba dang bka' nyan par 'gyur ro: tshe zad pa dang nyams pa yang gso nus shing blo gros mi zad pa dang shes rab phyogs med du 'bar bar 'gyur ro: drag po'i las thams cad kyang 'phral du 'grub cing : dus kyis 'chi ba yang bar dor rang ngo shes shing bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro: chos 'di la the tshom dang ཿོ yon tan 'byung bar mi rigs par blta ba 286

kun kyang thugs rjes zin te las ngan myong rjes su lam sna thar pa la sbyor bar 'gyur ro+oḥ des na bsgrubs mchod bsgoms pa lta ci smos: zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ thugs sgrub gzhan las kyang / nga bsgrubs sangs rgyas thams cad 'grub: nga mthong sangs rgyas thams cad mthong : nga ni bde gshegs 'dus pa yin: zhes pa'i don bzhin bla sgrub thams cad kyi rtsa ba kun 'dus yid bzhin nor bu'i dbang bskur sgrub par byed pa la slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams sngon du song / khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la byin rlabs dbang bskur zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu/ zhes brjod/ slob mas kyang maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ gsol ba gdab pa la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ /rang re rnams kyi gnas 'di ni tha mal pa ma yin pa dag pa'i zhing khams 'og min pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas khang chen po dang / slob dpon sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi spyi dpal ma hā gu ru pad+ma 'od 'bar dngos su gsal ba la/ mi phyed dad pa'i gdung shugs chen pos gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ e ma ho: dkon mchog spyi 'dus bla ma ni: rigs rnams kun bdag che ba'i mchog: dpa' bo chen pos rjes su zungs: dbang gi smin grol dngos grub stsol: lan gsum brjod de/ gnang ba sbyin cing dam la bzhag pa ni/de ltar yin na he ru ka'i: dal du su zhugs smin par bya'o: bla med yang gsang byin rlabs 'di:gnas khang 'di yi phyi rol du: dam med pa la smra mi rung : de phyir snying nas bro bor cig: zhes rdo rje spyi bor bzhag cing snying gar reg la/ badz+ra rak+ṣa sī hūṃ sa ma ya i dan na ra kan: zhes rjes zlos kyis slob mas bro bor ro: de nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa ni: khyed rang rnams kyi mdun gyi bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gu ru pad+ma 'od 'bar dbyer med pa la 'khor brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam zhi khro sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa mngon sum du bzhugs pa la skyabs su 'gro zhing nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i sems can 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral te sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par bya: de'i ched du yang zab bla ma'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing bsgrub par bya snyams pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: oṃ āḥhūṃ: skyabs gnas dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o: rgyud drug 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i pha ma rnams: bzod med gdung bas sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir: kun kyang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: lan gsum dang / yan lag bdun pa ni/skyabs yul de rnams kyi spyan sngar thabs khyad par can yan lag bdun ldan gyi sgo nas tshogs bsags par bya snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzodaḥ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ: chos rnams thams cad sku gsum rang bzhin la:gnyis med klong yangs chen por phyag 'tshal lo: ma bcos mtha' bral mnyam pa nyid kyis mchod: rang sems sangs rgyas ma rtogs mthol lo bshags: gnas lugs rang rig ngang du yi rang ngo ཿོ 'dzin med 287

khyab brdal rol pa'i chos 'khor bskor: 'khor 'das dbyer med bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs:chos dbyings lhun grub chen por bsngo bar bya: zung 'jug kun khyab bde chen mchog thob shog: ces lan gsum/ ye shes dbab pa ni slob ma la las bum gyi bsang chus gtor la/ oṃ swā bhā wa shud+dhā sarba dharmā:swā bhā wa shurnyo3haṃ: o ma hā shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+makolhahaṃ/ bdag gzhan dngos 'dzin gyi rtog pa mtha' dag stong pa de las skad cig gis pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar nyi zla'i gdan la/khyed rang rnams rang sems rig pa'i ngo bo lhug par gnas pa de nyid ma hā gu ru pad+ma 'od 'bar du snang ba tshig 'dis gsal btab bzhin du sgoms shig /trīḥ bdag nyid tha mal rang sems bzo med 'di: dkon mchog spyi 'dus pad+ma 'od 'bar sku: dkar gsal mdangs ldan mdzes 'dzum rgyan gyi sprasoḥ rdo rje thod pa tshe bum rin chen brgyan: pad zhwa rgod ldem kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yon nas 'khril: phod ka chos gos za 'og ber byam canoḥ mtshan dpes rab brgyan 'od kyi dkyil 'khor mdzes: mnyam nyid bde chen 'khyil pa'i skyil krung bzhugs: 'od kyi lus la ye shes snying po can: gsal stong thugs rje'i 'od zer kun la snyoms: mkha' 'gro 'ja' sprin rnam mang 'khrigs pa'i dbus: sku yi sprul pas zhing khams yongs la khyab: nam mkha'i lus can gar yang thogs pa med: bde gshegs kun gyi bkod pa sku rdzogs: kun kyang rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor zang thal la: bgegasadang bar chad ces bya'i ming yang med: snang stong sgyu ma tsam du gsal bar bskyed: de ltar gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ mgrin par āḥthugs kar rtsu/ slob dpon dang dkon mchog spyi 'dus pad+ma 'byung gnas dbyer ma mchis pa'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis nam mkha'i khams khengs/ dus gsum gyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems ma lus shing lus pa med par spyan drangs/ de thams cad gu ru pad+ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi rnam pa 'od zer dang bcas shing / de yang sku'i byin rlabs thams cad pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sku'i rnam pa che ba ri rab tsam chung ba nyung 'bru tsam dang til 'bru tsam/ gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad yig 'bru ā li kā li rgya yig bod yig la sogs kha dog sna tshogs dang / thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad rdo rje dril bu dang / pad+ma rin chen kha ṭ+wāṃ dbyug to la sogs pa steng 'og bar gsum them mer nem mer til gyi gong bu ltar gang zhing nyi zer gyi rdul 'khrigs pa ltar byon nas khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pa'i mos 'dun drag po mdzod cig /hrīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyi: byin gyis rlob phyir gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang zhig bskur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar 288

chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: o āḥhūṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsidhi pha la r+ghaṃ: ā we sha ya a āḥ zhes ye shes pheb pa'i rtags ma byung bar bskyar nas 'bebs/ spro na gar 'khrab dbyangs dang bcas te bya'o/ /mthar tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra gyis rdo rje spyi bor rgya gram du bzhag nas brtan par bya'o/ /de ltar ye shes dbab pa ni shin tu gal che ba dbang gi rtsa ba la/ rdzas dbang phal cher de brtan byed du sgrub pa yin/ de nas dbang dngos gzhi zhu bar skabs phyed pa'i phyir du maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug la/ dbang bzhi rim pas bskur ba yi dang po bum pa'i dbang la/ de yang bskur mkhan gyi bla ma ni pad+ma 'byung gnas sprul pa'i sku yi bdag nyid/ bskur ba'i gnas ni khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor/ ji ltar skur ba'i tshul ni/ bla ma'i smin mtshams kyi oṃ dkar po las 'od zer dkar po skar mda' chad pa ltar 'phros khyed rang gi dpral bar thim pas lus snang stong pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sku dang dbyer med du gyur pa'i mos pa byed pa rtsa ba dang / de mtshon byed du rdzas kyi rnam pa bum pa 'di yang phyi bum pa mtshan nyid kun tshang / nang dkon mchog rtsa gsum kun 'dus gu ru rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur pas khyed rang rnams kyi dri ma 'khrud cing dbang bskur thob pa'i 'dun pa mdzod/ ces brda sprad la bum pa thogs te/ trīḥ dkon mchog spyi 'dus rigs kyi bdag: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: sku gsung thugs mchog rin po che: byin rlabs klong yangs rang bzhin 'bar: oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ: sku yi smin mtshams oṃ dkar las: 'od zer skar mda' 'chad pa ltaroḥ skal ldan bu la gnyis med thimoḥ bum dbang thob nas snang stong bsgomoḥ pad+ma 'byung gnas sku yi dbang thob shog: o ā:r+ghaṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sikhyi r+ghaṃ: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa o: zhes bum pas dbang bskur/ bum chu sbyin/ de yang gter gzhung rtsa bar rdzas dbang bum pa dang yang 'grel du gu ru'i sku 'bag gsungs pa yang gdam ka can du shes so/ / de ltar bum pa'i dbang thob lus kyi sgrib pa dag /sa brgyad pa mi g.yo ba non/ /'bras bu sprul pa'i sku thob cing skal pa can du gyur/ /lam dus su bskyed rim ma hā yo ga'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang ba'o/ / zhes don ngo sprad/ gnyis pa gsang dbang ni/ skur ba po bla ma ni pad+ma 'byung gnas longs spyod rdzogs skur shes pas/ bskur ba'i gnas khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa/ ji ltar skur ba'i tshul ni/ gu ru'i ljags steng gi āḥdamar po las 'od zer dmar po mar me'i rtse mo lta bu byung / khyed rang gi mgrin par thim pas ngag grags stong gu ru pad+ma'i gsung dang dbyer med du gyur pa'i mos pa byed pa rtsa ba dang / mtshon byed du rdzas kyi rnam pa thod pa'i bdud rtsi 'di yang bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi kha ṭ+wāṃ ga yum ye shes mkha' 'gro mar gyur pa dang snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgra dang 'od zer gyis rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs sku'i rtsa gnas rnams brgyud/ rjes su chags pa'i mes zhu dkar dmar byang 289

sems bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du mkha' gsang las babs/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang ngo gcig pa oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs pa de lce steng du myong bas dbang bskur thob pa'i 'dun pa mdzod cig byas la thod pa'i bdud rtsi thogs te/ hrīḥ dkon mchog spyi 'dus rigs kyi bdag: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: sku gsung thugs mchog rin po che: byin rlabs klong yangs rang bzhin 'bar: oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ: gsung gi ljags steng āḥdamar las: 'od zer mar me'i rtse mo ltar: skal ldan lce la gnyis med thim: gsang dbang thob nas ngag rlung bsgomoḥ pad+ma 'byung gnas gsung gi dbang thob shog: oṃ āḥrtsu badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sikhyi hū+oṃḥ wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes bdud rtsi byin pa myang / de ltar gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag /sa dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros non/ 'bras bu longs sku thob pa'i skal pa can du gyur/ lam dus su rdzogs rim a nu yo ga ste rang byin gyis rlabs pa bsgom pa la dbang ba'o/ /zhes don ngo sprad/ gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang la/ dbang bskur ba po bla ma pad+ma 'byung gnas chos sku spros bral gyi bdag nyid can du nges pa/ bskur ba'i gnas khyed rang gi snying ga /ji ltar skur ba'i tshul ni/ gu ru'i thugs ka'i r+ghaṃ yig sngon po las 'od zer sngon po spos reng gi du ba lta bu byung /khyed rang gi snying gar thim pas yid gsal stong pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi thugs dang dbyer med du gyur pa'i mos pa rtsa ba dang / mtshon byed kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'di yang ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mar shes nas 'dod chags chen po bzhi yongs su bskyed de yas bab dang mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong bar byed pa'i dbang bskur thob pa'i mos pa mdzod cig / ces brda sprad nas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga thogs la/ hrīḥ dkon mchog spyi 'dus rigs kyi bdag: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: sku gsung thugs mchog rin po che:byin rlabs klong yangs rang bzhin 'bar: oṃ āḥrgyu: thugs kyi hūṃ sngon 'od 'bar lasoḥ 'od zer spos rang du ba ltar: skal ldan sems la gnyis med thim: sher ye dbang thob gsal stong bsgom:pad+ma 'byung gnas thugs kyi dbang thob shog: oṃ āḥrgyu badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sikhyi r+ghaṃ: tsit+ta a sgyi ṣiñtsa r+ghaṃ:zhes kha ṭ+wāṃ ga snying dkar nag mtshams su gtan/ de ltar shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag/sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin non/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku thob pa'i skal ba can du gyur: lam dus su a ti yo ga ste byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgom pa la dbang ba'o/ / zhes dbang don ngo sprad/ bzhi pa ni/de yang dbang bskur ba po bla ma pad+ma 'byung gnas sku gsum dbyer med ngo bo nyid sku'i bdag nyid can/bskur ba'i gnas ni khyed rang rnams kyi lte ba sogs gnas lnga/ ji ltar skur pa'i tshul ni gu ru'i lta ba la sogs gnas lnga nas 'od zer chu la 'ja' tshon shar ba lta bu byung / khyed rang gi gnas de dag tu thim pas sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las yongs rdzogs kyi dbang thob par mos pa rtsa ba dang / mtshon 290

byed kyi rdzas kyi rnam pa shel rdo 'di'i brda la brten nas ngo sprad pas brda don thabs shes zung 'jug gnyis med ye shes tshig las 'das pa chos sku ru ngo shes par byed pa dbang bzhi rtsal rdzogs su thob par byas byung snyam pa'i mos 'dun mdzod cig ces brda sprad la shel rdo thogs la// trīḥdakon mchog sku gsung thugs yon tan: phrin las 'dus pa'i 'od zer ni: nam mkha' chu la 'ja' shar bzhin: skal ldan gnas lngar gnyis med thim: dbang bzhi ye shes rdzogs chen bsgom: pad+ma 'byung gnas rang bzhin dbang thob shogoḥ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sidhi r+ghaṃ: sarba dharma a bhi ṣiñtsa ho: 'di'i mtshon byed rdzas kyang yang 'grel las shel dang rdo rje thod pa gsum pa la brten nas ngo sprad par gsungs/ de ltar dbang bskur bas sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa dag thob bya bcu gcig kun tu 'od kyi sa dang / 'bras bu ngo bo nyid du sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas/ lam dus su a ti yang dag gsang rdo rje snying po rdzogs chen bya rtsol bral ba'i don ka dag lhun grub kyi ye shes bsgom pa la dbang ba'o/ / zhes ngo sprad/ dbang bzhi pa dang 'bral ba'i rgyab rten du srog phur gyi le'u 'don gsungs pa ni 'di lta ste/ de nas pad+ma'i srog phur bstan: sems nyid pad+ma 'byung gnas te: logs nas bsgom dang bsgrub tu med: rang sems gsal la ma 'gags poḥ rang byung rang shar cir yang snang : zhi ba tshe dpag med du snang : 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs su snang : khro rgyal dbang chen rta mgrin snang : zhal dang phyag ni cir yang snang / de dag sems kyi cho 'phrul yin: rang byung rang shar rang sar grol: ngo bo stong pa chos kyi sku: ma 'gags rang gsal longs spyod rdzogs: rig rtsal 'gags med sprul pa'i sku: sku gsum rang chas ma bsgrubs 'grub: rang nyid ye nas pad 'byung yin: srog phur le'u lnga pa'o: zhes pa ni/ dbang bskur thams cad kyi snying por gyur pa ste/ de yang pad+ma'i srog phur zhes pa'i mtshan don ni/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar snang ba de yi snying po bzhin rig pa rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal 'dus ma byas pa'i rtag brtan g.yung drung chen po 'khor 'das thams cad kyi srog tu gnas pa/ de rang ngo tshul bzhin shes pas glo bur bag chags kyi dri ma sangs nas tshogs brgyad gnas 'gyur te bral 'bras chos sku mngon du byed pa ste/ de yi lam bzhi cha gsum bral chos kyi sku ngang dwangs dgongs pa shar grol chen po zab gsal bde ba dbyer med gnad du phur pa don gyi mthar thug 'di kho na'o/ /zhes pa yin pa yang shes par bya'o/ /de nas lnga pa mtha' rten rdo rje slob dpon bdag po'i dbang ngam/ 'chang dbang ni puste lung sbyin du grags pa'i sgo nas bsgrub pa ste/ glegs bam mi dmigs pa stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma 'dab ma 'bum ldan gyi steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la ā li bcu drug gis mtshan pa de'i 'og tu nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor kā li so bzhis mtshan pa ste nyi zla gwa'u kha sbyor/ de'i dbus su r+ghaṃ dkar po la yang snying badz+ra gu rus bskor ba ngag 291

las 'od zer 'phros chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gi don thams cad badz+ra gu ru dang a li kā li'i rnam par spyan drangs thim par gyur/ badz+ra gu ru dbyangs gsal dang brtan byed yig brgya rten 'brel snying po brjod de/ me tog gtor bas/ nyi zla ak+ṣaḥbadz+ra gu ru rnams 'od du zhu glegs bam du gyur/ de nas glegs bam thogs la/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ: sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo pad+ma 'byung : zab gter thugs sgrub yid bzhin nor bu 'di: las can rnams la sgrub bshang bstan nas kyang ཿོ ma 'ongs don ldan 'gro kun grol bar shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sikhyi r+ghoṃḥ zhes dang / ā li kā li yig brgya rten 'brel snying po brjod cing /gnas gsum dbang bskur nas lag par gtad/ dbugs dbyung ba gzeng bstod pa dang / dung 'bud pa dar 'phyar ba sogs dngos sam yid kyi sgo nas slob ma'i ngo skal dang 'tshams par bsgrub bo/ /de nas drug pa gter srung mkha' 'gro'i srog gtad ni/ mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma seng gdong mar bskyed bstem mchod bstod byas nas/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gcig seng gdong ma: nam mkha'i mdog can 'od zer sprul pa 'gyed: mthong dang dran pa tsam gyis ye shes skyedoḥ skal ldan bu la lus dang grib ma'i tshul: mi 'bral byin rlabs phrin las dbang thob shog: oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ ḍā ki sau ha mu kha a gi ṣiñtsa r+ghoṃḥ gzhan yang phyi nang gi gter srung rnams kyis skal ldan 'di la bsrung pa dang / bskyab pa dang / sbed par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gtor ma gnas gsum dang lag par gtad pa ci rigs pa bya'o/ /de nas bdun pa lta ba'i rtsal dbang ni/ dbang gzhung las/ gud du spas pa slar tshig dbang rin po ches don gyi ngo bo bstan pa zhes gsungs te/ des na 'di bskur yul slob ma sngon 'gro thun mong thun min gyis rgyud sbyangs shing sems rnal dbab sor gzhug gi rjes mthun skyes pa la 'di ston par dgongs nas slar zhes pa'i tshig nus des ston pa yin gyi/ dbang bskur tshul rgyas pa phyag bzhes kyi rtogs dgos la/ 'dir rtsa ba gter gzhung ltar bkod pa ste/ slob mas gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ ye shes dbab ste/ bu yi snying gar yi ge a dkar po sran ma tsam/ ye shes kyi 'od lnga 'phro ba'i stobs kyis lus nam mkha' yod par bsgom/ bla mas thod rnga sgrog cing / a ni skya ba med pa la: lus ni ye shes lnga yi lus: nam mkha'i klong las rang gsal 'baroḥ lus med nyams kyi ngo bor ltos: zhes brjod pas nyams skye'o: de nas rnam snang slob bu chos bdun byed du bcug ste/ lta stangs dang rig pa nam mkhar gtod cig byas la/ bu khyod sems kyi ngo bo ltos: bltas pas mi mthong ngang du zhog: khyod kyi rig pa phyogs bzhir thor: btang tshe phyi nang 'gro 'ong med: 'gro bar snyam yang rang gi sems: sems ni ngos bzung 'dzin pa braloḥ ngo bo stong la rang bzhin gsal:bu khyod 'di yi rang zhal ltos: 'di zhes mtshan mar ma grub kyang : de don rtogs na rtsal dbang ste+oḥtshe gcig thar lam bgrod par 'gyur: rgyas par 'dod na srog phur le'u bshad par bya'o/ /'di ni gu ru sbas pas sgrub pa nges par byed pa ma gtogs gzhan la mi bskur dam par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don rnams tshig tsam ma yin par bla ma myong ldan gyis slob ma'i rgyud la ngo 'phrod par gdams pa yin gyi/ don des gong gi tshig dang skabs 292

srog phur le'u 'don zhes pa dang 'dir bshad ces pa tshig nus che chung ni 'dir ji bzhin pa go ba tsam du ma zad myong thog tu gtan la phab cing ye shes skyed par byed pa'i ched du zhib mor bshad ces pa'i don yin no/ /de ltar 'chad pa dang / srung ma'i gtor dbang / rig pa'i rtsal dbang rnams go rim bzhin nus pa dang bsrung ba dang / spel ba'i dbang ste skal ba dang nges par ldan pa la sbyin par bya'o/ /de nas rjes dbang gi dam tshig bsgrag pa ni/ de ltar yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi dbang bzhi mtha' rten dang bcas pa legs par grub/ de yang chos thams cad kyi rtse mo gsang sngags de yi mthar thug rdo rje theg pa yin la/ de yang gsang sngags kyi rtsa ba ni dbang / dbang gi rtsa ba ni dam tshig /dam tshig de yang rtsa ba yan lag dang bcas pa gsang sngags nang ba spyi ltar dang / bye brag snying po gyur pa bla ma'i mos gus gnad du bsnun pa dang / /de'i mtshon byed gu ru'i sku 'bag /sgrub thabs kyi glegs bam rnams mi 'bral bar bcangs pa/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa la brtson pa la sogs bla ma'i sgrub pa la 'bad 'tshal/ de ltar dam tshig phra rags thams cad mnyam par bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid/ /dang gtang rag maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ /khyed la bdag gi 'bul lags na/ /khyed kyi slob mar bzung ba dang / /cha shas kyang ni spyad du gsol/ / lus 'bul/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ de nas tshogs la rol zhing / lhag chog sogs rjes kyi bya ba las byang bzhin bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ zab mo'i chos 'di gangs can ri bo'i khongs/ /ris med tha grur rlung bzhin grags gyur cing / /mchog dman du mas chog khrid mang mdzad na/ /bdag ltas ngal ba bskyed pas ci zhig bya/ /'on kyang dbang bskur rab dbye'i brda' don gnad/ /ma shes lngas tsam kho na yul yul pos/ /byang chub nye lam rtsa ba smin byed dbang / /'grub par nus min de bas thar 'dod kun/ /nan tan chen pos dbang la brtson par rigs/ /des na yongs 'dzin skagon gyi dgongs bskang slad/ /dbang chog ma nor ji bzhin legs bshad 'dir/ /mgon po nyid kyi mthu las bdag gis smras/ /dge des mkha' khyab 'gro ba ma lus kun/ /sangs rgyas pad 'byung bstan la nyer zhugs shing / /dam tshig rnam dag smin grol bdud rtsir spyod/ /'chi med rgyal ba'i go 'phang myur thob shog /de ltar dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi dbang chog bklags pas grub pa gu ru'i dgongs gsal zhes pa 'di yang dpal ldan stod 'brug bka' rgyud kyi sdong po skyes mchog 'bar ba'i khrir bzhugs shing rang gi slob ma dam pa mang yul skyid rong 'dzam gling bla ma o rgyan ngag dbang ye shes dpal bzang pos kho bo'i ngag sgros zin bris byas 'dug pa de la zhu dag gis legs par gtan la phab par byas pa 'di ni rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu 'gro 'dul rdo rje sems dpa' rtsal gyis chos 'di nyams su len par 'dod pa rnams la shin tu mkho zhing phan che bar mthong nas rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i nang khongs drag po lcags sprel gsar du shar nye ba rgyal zla'i nyer gsum gyi thun mtshams su grub par sbas yul pad+ma bkod pa'i 'dabs klo lam dkar nag gi dbus rtag brtan rin chen de'u yi rtser bkod pa ste yi ge'i ris byed dge tshul shes rab bstan 'dzin mo/ /'dis kyang chos 'dir zhugs rnams/ grol 'bras mngon du byed pa'i/ /smin byed gsos su gyur 293

nas/ /don gnyis lhun grub shog cig dge'o/ /sog /pad+ma 'od 'bar gyi tshe sgrub ṭ+wāṃgs kyi ri bo gud du phyes nas bskur tshul bltas chog bsdus te byas pa bzhugs so/ /mchod gzhi'i steng du nas kyi pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i steng / bum pa spyi ltar dang / tshe gtor zan bum/ tshe ril/ tshe chang / mda' dar/ tshe nas rnams bsham/ mchod pa sna bdun/ sngon 'gro cog rdog /'dzom na tshogs gtor 'bul bsham/ med kyang chog skyabs sems spyi ltar dang / pad+ma 'od 'bar las kyang tshar gcig gis bdag dang / tshe gtor bum lha/ rgyas pa byas na/ dbang rdzas ngo bo pad+ma 'od 'bar sku: zhes mdun bum bskyed pa spyan 'dren mchod bstod tshar gcig bya/ dmigs pa bdag mdun gyi 'od zer spro bsdus phyi nang snod bcud lhar gsal ba'i gzi brjid kyis/ sangs rgyas byang sems rtsa ba gsum dang / chos skyong thams cad kyi che'i byin rlabs dang /'byung ba'i bcud kyi dwangs ma thams cad/ drang srong rig 'dzin tshe la dbang ba thams cad kyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs/mdor na tshe bsod nams can dkar po dge ba'i las sgrub cing / dbang che ba / rtsal drag pa/ 'khor mang ba/ yon tan che ba/ stobs dang snyan grags dang ldan pa/ gdul bya phrin las can rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams thams cad yi ge dz+raḥyig rnam par 'od kha dog sna tshogs kyi li li bum pa'i nang du 'khyil par bsam zhing / sngags 'di bzlas pa la brtson/ rab 'bum/ 'bring khri/ tha ma stong phrag re bzla gsungs te/ 'phral du dbang bskur na yang brgya rtsa brgyad las nyung ba bzla ste/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi ā yu ṣe r+ghaṃ dz+ra dza: de ltar dbang sgrub tshar nas/ slob ma rnams mdun du 'tshogs nas/ khrus chab blang / me tog nas bkye/ sngon 'gro gtor ma kun rig ltar ram gang rung gcig btang / hrīḥ bdag nyid 'gyur med sogs nas/ rak+ṣa dz+wa la ram̐ gyi bar btang / sum bha sogs brjod cing nas lcag brab/ ḍā dril rol mo drag tu bya'o/ /de ni sngon du lan gcig gis chog /rgyun du mi dgos so/ /'o na da lam khyed rnams la dbang bskur ba la rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa'i zhal nas/ 'khor bar srog las gces pa ni/ 'ga' yang yod pa ma mthong bas/ des na myur du thabs mang pos/ /'chi ba bslu ba yang dag sbyor/ zhes dang / thugs rje chen po gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud las/las tshogs rim par bstan pa ni: thog mar rig 'dzin tshe nyid bsgrub: ces gsungs pas/ spyir yang tshe bsring ba'i thabs la 'bad dgos shing / khyad pa deng sang tshe tshad kyang bzhi bcu kha ral sum cu la nye ba'i dus yin te/ lung bstan rnams las/ bzhi bcu kha ral sum cur nye: ngan spyod steng 'og bar gsum 'khrugs: zhes sogs gsungs te/ dus snyigs ma lnga'i mtha' la thug pas/ lha gzhan gyi thugs rje rdugs: chos gzhan gyi byin rlabs yal/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams ri rab la zhal gzigs/bdud dang lha srin thams cad kha dar/ mi rnams tshe thung nad mang / glo bur du 'chi ba'i dus 'dir/ 294

o rgyan rin po che thugs rje dang byin rlabs shugs che bas tshe dbang 'di thob na tshe dang bsod nams 'byor pa drug rgyas shing / tshe zad pa dang nyams pa yang gso nus/ mdze la sogs rnam smin gyi las thams cad srab cing byang ba dang / gcong nad zha grub dang mig nad la sogs pa'i thams cad las grol bar 'gyur ro/ /yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi tshe sgrub lcags kyi ri bo zhes bya ba/ o rgyan gyi mkhan po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis shar phyogs mā ra tī ka'i brag phug tu/ mgon po tshe dpag med la tshe'i rgyud sgrub thabs bye ba phrag zhus pa la brten nas/ kha ba can du tshe sgrub lnga brgya dang rtsa gcig sbas pa'i nang nas 'di snying po lta bu yin no/ /e ma hoḥ de ltar bsgrubs pa'i yan yon ni: rkyen ngan bar chad thams cad bzlog: dus zad pa yi ma yin kyang : tshangs pa'i tshe dang ldan par 'gyur: 'chi ba rnams la brgyad mi 'byung / las 'phro ldan rnams nyichazla'i tshe: rdo rje g.yung drung lta bu yi: tshe yi rig 'dzin e ma ho: zhes gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i tshe dbang zab mo zhu ba'i phyir maṇ+ḍal/ sa gzhi spos kyi sogs/ gu ru pad+ma 'od 'bar dkon mchog gsum po gcig tu 'dus pa'i drung du/ skyabs su 'gro zhing byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i mos pas rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ: skyabs gnas dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi: sogs nas/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: gsum/ da dbang zhu ba'i phyir gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ e ma ho: dkon mchog spyi 'dus bla ma ni: rigs rnams kun bdag che ba'i mchog: dpa' bo chen pos rjes su zung : dbang gi smin grol dngos grub stsol:lan gsum zhes pas bla mas lan/ kye ma: de ltar yin na ho ru ka'i: dal du gzhug cing smin par bya'o:bla med yang gsang byin rlabs 'di: gnas khang 'di yi phyi rol du: dam med pa la smra mi ring : de phyir snying nas bro bor cig: dbang thob nas dam tshig bsrung snyam pa'i mos pas rjes zlos mdzod/ badz+ra rak+ṣa si r+ghoṃḥ sa ma ya: i dan na ra kan: ku sha'i yu pas slob ma bran pa'i tshul byas la/ da slob ma khyed rang rnams skad cig gis pad+ma 'od 'bar 'di ltar skyed cig /hrī: slob ma'i ngo bo pad+ma 'od 'bar sku: dkar gsal mdangs lnga mjes 'dzum rgyan gyis spras: sogs nas/ til gyi gong bu kha phye ba lta bu dpag tu med pa spyan drangs: khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim par sgoms shig dbyangs rol mo spos dud dang bcas/ trī: sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: nas/ sirnyi pha la r+ghaṃ āḥ zhes sngags de bdun nam gsum brjod cing rol mo drag tu bya'o/ / de ltar byin 'bebs byas pa'i ye shes pa de mi nyams brtan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rdo rje mgor bzhag la/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: tshe dbang brgya rtsa sogs la de yan de/ da nangs dang po re res chog la/ 'di man dngos gzhi 'di la grangs bzung ngo / / da dngos gzhi tshe'i dbang zhu ba'i phyir gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ trī: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid: 'gro rnams ma lus 295

sgrol ba'i ded dpon mchog: o rgyan pad+ma rig 'dzin tshe dpag med: bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum byin rlobs la: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol: gsum mam gcig da mos gus kyis smon lam 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi dang ཿོ rkyen ngan nyi khri chig stong dang : ye 'drogs sum brgya drug cu dang : bgegs rig stong phrag brgyad cu sogs: tshe yi bar chad mi mthun phyogs: thams cad byang zhing dag gyur cig lan gcig go/ /da tshe 'gugs pa ni bum lha pad+ma 'od 'bar gyi dpral mgrin thugs ka lte ba gsang gnas lngar 'khor lo pad+ma rdo rje rin chen rgya gram o āḥhūṃ ṭ+wā hās mtshan pa las/ 'od zer lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu'i dbyibs can phyogs bcur 'phros pas tshe yang ba dang 'khyams pa/ gdon bgegs kyis 'phogs pa thams cad 'od kyi thig le dkar 'tsher gyi rnam par bsdus nas/ spyi bo nas zhugs lus la sib sib thim par sgoms shig ces mda' dmar po'am dkar po'am smon tshe sogs sna lnga g.yab cing dbyangs dang bcas/ trīḥphyi ni bum pa nang du bdud rtsis gang : gsang ba'i don ni pad+ma tshe dpag med: gnas lnga ra phyag mtshan lnga dang yig 'bru lnga:'od zer dpag yas nam mkha' gang bar 'phros: trī:shar phyogs dri za'i lag nas lcags kyus khug: lho phyogs gshin rje'i gnas nas zhags pas khug: nub phyogs klu bdud lag nas lcags sgrogs khug: byang phyogs gnod sbyin lag nas dril bus khug: steng phyogs tshangs pa brgya byin lag nas khug:'og phyogs dga' bo 'jog po lag nas khug: tshe srog chad pa mthud la yar ba khug: gos pa sbyor la nyams pa thams cad gsos: 'od zer dga' la 'tsher zhing snum la 'driloḥ spyi bo'i gcug nas lus la sib sib thim/ 'od 'bar 'chi med tshe yi dbang thob shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi ā yu ṣe r+ghaṃ dṛ dzaḥ zhes rol mo bya/ tshe gtor thogs la/ da tshe gtor 'di nyid pad+ma 'od 'bar gsal ba las 'od zer nam mkha' gang bar 'phros pas/ 'byungatshob sa chu me rlung gi bcud thams cad 'od zer ser dkar dmar ljang gi rnam par bsdus nas/ khyed rang rnams la thim pas sha khrag drod dbugs kyi tshe nyams pa thams cad sor chud nas lus bkrag mdangs dang ldan par sgoms shig dbyangs dang bcas/ trī:bum pa'i ngo bo pad+ma 'od 'bar bzhugs: 'od zer dpag yas nam mkha' gang bar 'phros: sa chu me rlung bcud rnams rang mdog gsal: sha khrag drod dbug nyams pa sor chud nas: slar yang zla ba yar ngo ci bzhin du: stobs rtsal yon tan tshe yi dbang thob shog: gtor ma mgor bzhag la/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/gter ston r+ghaṃ nag me 'bar/ rgyal ba dgongs pa brgyud pa/ rig 'dzin brda'i brgyud pa/ gang zag snyan khung brgyud pa/ mkha' 'gro gtad rgya brgyud pa/ bka' babs don gyi brgyud pa/ gter chos smon 296

lam brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang / khyad par du gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas/ tshe dpag tu med pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyis/ rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams la 'chi ba med pa'i tshe'i dbang bskur du gsol/ tshe mi shigs pa rdo rje lta bur mdzad cig /tshe mi 'gyur ba g.yung drung lta bur mdzod cig tshe mi nub pa rgyal mtshan lta bur mdzod cig 'chi ba med pa tshe'i dbang dam pa thob par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sidhi ā yu ṣe rdu dz+ra dza: zhes sngags lan gsum brjod/ de nas bum pa lag tu thogs la/ da bum pa 'di'i nang na gu ru pad+ma 'od 'bar bzhugs pa'i sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ 'khor 'das lam gsum kyi tshe dang bsod nams thams cad bsdus te che'i bdud rtsir zhu ba de/ khyed rang rnams kyi tshangs bug dang kha nas zhugs/ lus 'chi med bdud rtsis ltem gyis gang bar sgoms shig /trīḥ bum pa'i bdud rtsi pad+ma 'od 'bar zhu: 'od zer dpag yas nam mkha' gang bar 'phros: rgyal ba rab 'byams rigs gsum mgon po dang : 'jig rten longs spyod mnga' thang bsod nams can:zag bcas zag med mthu stobs nus pa kun: deng 'dir bu la tshe yi dbang thob shog: bum pa spyi bor bzhag la/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ badz+ra gu ru sogs sngags brjod/ bum chu blud do/ /de nas tshe ril lag tu thogs la dbyangs dang bcas/ trīḥ sngon byon dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis: sgrub rdzas ril bu 'di la brten nas mdzad: gu ru'i byin rlabs ril bu 'du 'bral med: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la zas su sbyinoḥ dam rdzas ma spangs bcud len snying por spyodoḥ za thang longs spyod tshe yi dbang thob shog: ril bu sbyin cing / oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ badz+ra sogs sngags brjod pa de nas tshe chang lag tu thogs la/ dbyangs dang bcas/ trīḥ sngon byon drang srong rig 'dzin thams cad kyis: tshe sgrub bdud rtsi 'di la brten nas mdzadoḥ rgyal bas byin rlabs bdud rtsi 'du 'bral med: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la skom du sbyin: phyi nang byang sems khams rnams 'phel zhing rgyas: bde drod rab 'bar tshe yi dbang thob shogoḥ bdud rtsi sbyin cing / oṃ āḥhūṃ badz+ra sogs sngags brjod do/ /de nas me tog nas gtor zhing / lus la rdo rje'i go khrab gyon nas 'od kyil ler sgoms/o badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa rgyu/ mda' la dar dkar po'am dmar po la rdo rje rgya gram mdud pa byas pa btags pa yod na rab/ med na sngon gyi mda' dar de g.yab cing spyi bor bzhag pa ste dbyangs rol mo dang bcas/ trīḥdang po chos kyi dbyings kyi rgya: gnyis pa thabs dang shes rab rgya: gsum pa sku gsung thugs kyi rgya: bzhi pa ye shes bzhi yi rgya: lnga pa rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas rgya: drug pa bcom ldan thub drug rgya: bdun pa sangs rgyas rabs bdun rgya: phyag rgya bdun gyis rgyas btab bo+oḥ zhes mda' dar spyi bor gtug go/ brgya rtsal de man bar skabs de dus re re la bcu gsum tsam mam/ bcu re tsam byas la de nas yang dbang sgrub wig par bya/ lan du bskur gyi mjug tu/ 'o des tshe dbang gcig gam du song grangs kha 'di tsam song / thob pa yin pas/ de'i 297

dam tshig tu o rgyan rin po che yi dam gyi lhar bzung la/ sngags badz+ra gu ru la thugs dam bya snyam pas rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ zhes sogs brjod la grol lo/ /rang gi rim gro la yang de ltar brgya rtsa byas na tshe dbang brgya rtsa'i go chod cing / gzhan la brgya rtsa bskur ba sogs la rjes rang gis bdag 'jug dbang blangs pas byin rlabs mi nyams pa'i gnad do/ /zhes pa go 'jo rtogs ldan lhun grub kyis bskul nas rā ga a sus khyer bde bar byas pa la nyes 'gal lha dang gter srung la bshags shing / dge bas blo dman rnams la phan pa rgya chen por gyur cig sarba maṅga lo/ /

༄ga /yang zab dkon mchog phyi 'dus kyi bsnyen yig mdor bsdus su bkod pa nyer mkho'i don gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so//na mo gu ru pad+ma bhā sa dz+wa lā ya/ /mtshan dang chos 'khor gang 'dul phrin las kyis/ 'gro drug dbyings su sgrol mdzad rigs brgya'i bdag /bla med bla ma mchog la gus btud de/ /bsnyen thabs nyung gsal nyer mkho'i dpyid du spel/ bla ma'i sgrub thabs rgya mtsho las phrin las mkha' ltar khyab pa yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus nyid rtsa ba'i yi dam du bzung ba lta bur sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes tshang gi bskyed rdzogs cha tshang nyams su len dgos la/ de'i tshe bskyed rim lha khrid dang 'bral ba'i bsnyen sgrub rgyas par bya ba'i tshul rnams sngar bkod pa'i bsnyen yig pad+ma'i zhal lung las rtogs par bya ba gal che/ 'dir las byang kho na la brten te grangs bsnyen mdor bsdus las rung tsam bya ba'i tshul bshad pa la gsum/nyer bsngogs sta gon dang / sgrub pa dngos/ rjes kyi bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ 'di nyid kyi dbang lung khrid rnams legs par nos te sgrub pa la 'jug khar/ sā ts+tsha/ chu gtor/ bsang brngan/ rdor sems sgom bzlas/ bshags rgyud sogs bar chad sel cing dngos grub nye ba'i rgyab skyor rigs nus pas gang lcogs gal chung med par bsgrub/ gu rus byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas sam bkra shis shing yid dang mthun pa'i sgrub khang gi gung du gu ru'i sku brnyan dang rtsa gsum gyi zhal thang sogs rten bkram pa'i mdun tu stegs gtsang ma'i dbus dang g.yas g.yon tu 'bru'i tshom bu lnga re bkod pa'i dbus su/ pad snod du bla ma gtor ma zlum po 'khor dang 'dra ba bzhi dang theb kyus bskor ba/ g.yas su gur drag la dpal bshos zur gsum dmar po 'khor rang la lnga dang theb kyus bskor ba/ g.yon tu seng gdong ma la gru gsum dmar po rang 'dra bzhi dang theb kyus bskor ba'i mdun g.yas klu bdud dmar gtor sprul dkris/ mdun g.yon mtsho sman dkar skum bu khur/ de dag gi g.yas su chos sman btab pa'i bdud rtsi dang / g.yon tu rak+ta so lnga'am ma rnyed nas sid+dha ra btab pa'i rak+ta'i snod/ mdun du chu gnyis nyer spyod phreng tshar du bsham bgegs gtor gtor 'bul dkar dmar/ tshogs zhal zas/ chad brtan sogs mthong brgyud ltar 'du bya/ rang gi gdan 'og 'bras sam sa dkar gyi g.yung drung g.yas bskor bri/mal bde bar bcas te gzhi dang zhal sprod du 'khod la/ rnam 'joms bzlas pa'i khrus chu 'thor 'thung 299

bya ba dang / bdud rtsi 'khyil pas bsngags pa'i gu gul dkar nag gi dud pas bdug pa sogs bya/ sgo drung du tho dkar po brtsigs pa rkyal chen bzhir mos nas gtor 'bul phrin bcol brtan bzhugs shis brjod gsang ba spyi chog ltar bya'o/ /gnyis pa sgrub pa dngos la lnga/ phyi nang / gsang ba/ yang gsang /las mtha' rgyas rnams so/ dang po ni/ dgongs thun nas dbu ba btsugs te/ tshig bdun dang /'ja' tshon gsol 'debs sngon du 'gro bas/ rang nyid rta mchog he ru ka'i skur gsal bas bgegs gtor btang / drag sngags g.yung thun rdzas dud rol mo bcas pas bgegs bskrad cing srung 'khor gsal zhing brtan par bsgoms la/ mtshams 'grol rgyu'i thun tha ma'i thar mi bsdu bar thun mgo thams cad du gsal 'debs yang bskyar byed/ de nas skyabs sems/ yig brgya maṇ+ḍal/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams grangs mang nyung gang 'grub re btang la/ mchod pa byin rlabs/ lha bskyed 'di ma hā'i a ti dang mthun par skad cig dran rdzogs la ting 'dzin rnam gsum yang gsal bar tshang bas de ltar dam tshig pa bskyed/ ye shes pa bstim/ phyag mchod bstod pa'i bsnyen bskur gyis yan lag tshang bar byas nas bzlas pa'i thog mar/ rang nyid pad+ma 'od 'bar du gsal ba'i gnas dus gsum du sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūṃ mthing gsal 'tsher 'od 'phro ba la yun ring sems bzung / bgrang phreng tshad ldan bsang sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las trīḥ yig las byung ba'i bgrang phreng lha'i ngo bor mos pa'am/ lag gnyis nyi zla'i thal mo'i bar du phreng ba dbyangs gsal gyi yig 'brur bsam pas kyang rung / oṃ ru tsi ra ma ṇi pra badhen ye swā hā/ zhes lan bdun bzlas la phus 'debs shing dbyangs gsal lan gsum brjod/ de nas thod phreng rtsal gyi 'dzab sngags thog mar bdun gsum nyer gcig tsam ḍā dril dbyangs dang stangs stabs bcas pas bzla/ de nas shub bur bzla ba'i tshe na'ang zo klod du ma song bar dad mos spro ba chen pos lus ngag yid gsum chun gcig bsgril la bag dro byin thibs byung byung gi bar du bzla/ de'i tshe dmigs pa ni/ 'bru gsum dang khyad par thugs ka'i r+ghaṃ las 'od zer nam mkha'i khams khyab par 'phros/ phyogs dus kyi mchog gsum rtsa gsum thams cad la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ thams cad kyang gu ru pad+ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi rnam par gyur te de'ang sku'i byin rlabs thams cad pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sku che ba ri rab tsam/ chung ba yungs 'bru dang til 'bru tsam/ gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad yig 'bru k+ṣiṃli kā li badz+ra gu ru rgya yig bod yig kha dog sna tshogs pa'i tshul can/ thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dril bu bum thod kha ṭ+wāṃ kha sogs pa'i phyag mtshan gyi tshogs su gyur pa dang / khyad pa rang nyid gang la dad pa'i bla ma dkon mchog thams cad gu ru'i rnam par byon te nyi zer gyi rdul ltar 'khrigs shing kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar rang gi lus 300

ngag yid gsum la sib sib thim pas gnyis med du gyur par bsam/ thun mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying rnams lan gsum gsum bzlas la mchod bstod sho lo ka re re/ bsngo smon bkra shis bsdu rim yan bya/ skabs 'dir sngags phreng bsdu rgyu med kyang lhar snang thugs ka'i hūm̐ la bsdu zhing hūm̐ nā da'i bar du bsdu/ nā da 'od gsal du gzhug badz+ra gu ru lan gcig brjod pa'i rkyen gyis pad+ma 'od 'bar gnas gsum 'bru gsum dang bcas par mos la thun mtshams gnyug ma'i lhar ldangs shing / gzugs snang thams cad sogs brjod la khyer so gsum dang ma bral ba bya'o/ /de nas srod thun la srung 'khor/skyabs sems/ yan lag bdun pa/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas bstod pa'i bar gter gzhung zhi rkyang lugs su btang la dz+rab bzlas nas thun mtshams bar sngar ltar ral srung ma'i gtor 'bul yang skabs gang 'os zhig tu byas te nyal ba'i rnal 'byor la 'jug /tho rangs ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis langs la rlung ro bsal/ ngag byin rlabs dang bdud rtsi myang / bgegs gtor nub dang po las mi dgos/ sngon 'gro rgyas pa nas brtsam gzhan thams cad khar sang dgongs thun ltar bya/ snga thun sogs khar sang srod thun ltar bya/ dgongs srod gang rung gi thun mtha'i mchod bstod grub pa dang / rtsa gsum srung ma'i gtor 'bul rgyas bsdus gang lcogs dang / 'grub na tshogs mchod re yang gal che zhing / mi 'grub nas mtshams dang po tshugs pa'i dgongs srod gang rung gi thun mthar dang / sgrub pa snga ma rnams grub cing phyi ma rnams tshugs pa'i thog mtha'/ tshes bcu gang byung ba tshogs mchod re nges par gal che'o/ /de ltar thun bzhir bcad pa'i zhag bdun phrag gcig grangs 'bum phrag gcig ma mtha' byas pa bzla zhing mang na ji tsam 'grub kyang dgos pa phan yon tshad med de/ 'di nyid kyi gter gzhung las/ 'dis ni snang srid g.yo bar 'gyuroḥ dus gsum rgyal ba gcig tu sdud: bla ma kun dang 'du 'bral med:'byung po dregs pa brgyal zhing 'dar: mkha' 'gro chos skyong sprin bzhin 'du: dpa' bo pho tshogs mo tshogs kun: rang dbang med par mngon sum 'ong : mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ster: 'di nyid 'grub rtags med pa na: pad+ma bdag gis sems can bslu dang zhes sogs dang / bla ma gsang 'dus las kyang rgyal ba kun gyi dril sgrub tu sngags so/ /'grub pa'i rtags kyang ma hā yo ga'i bskyed rim las/khyad par du snying po 'di 'dren pa dang spyan 'dren thun drug tu ma chags par sgrub na pad+ma 'byung gnas rang bzhin gyis bab cing nges med du 'od 'khyug pa dang / gzungs sngags rang byung gi sgra sgrogs pa dang / rang bzhin ka dag gi nyams bzang po rtsol med du 'byung ngo / /zhes so/ /gnyis pa nang sgrub ni 'di nyid kyi bsnyen sgrub dngos gzhi yin pas de la gnyis/ dngos dang / tshad bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/phyi sgrub rjes de nyid du mchod bsham kha gso/ brgyud 'debs dang bgegs gtor btang / srung 'khor 301

nas bstod pa'i bar cho ga dang thun bzhi'i 'gros snga ma ji lta ba bzhin la/ spyan 'dren skabs dmigs pa dang bcas thod phreng brgya rtsa'am nyer gcig sogs bzla/ dngos gzhi 'dzab bzlas skabs thog mar gzhi dgod pa ni/ rang dam tshig sems dpa'i thugs kar pad dkar 'dab brgyad kyi ba dan la sla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i dbus su ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bo gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'greng thabs su gnas pa/ rdo rje'i lte bar 'od lnga'i thig le'i dbus su ting 'dzin sems dpa' r+ghaṃ dkar po 'od zer lnga ldan mtha' yas pa 'phro ba/ rdo rje'i lte ba'i/ rgyab ngos kyi mutha' bskor du badz+ra gu ru'i sngags phreng dkar po g.yas bskor du 'khod par bsgoms la gsal ma thebs kyi bar du nan tan bya/ de la gsal ci rigs thebs nas de nyid la ha cang rdul drag pa dang klod drag pa ma yin pa ma yengs tsam gyi sems 'dzin gyi rten du byas nas badz+ra gu ru'i bzlas pa bya ba ni bsnyen pa'i yan lag go/ /de la cung zad brtan nas yig 'bru rnams rang sgra di ri ri sgrog par bsam pa ni khog chen rang bzhin sgra 'khor dang / hūṃ yig las zla ba'i 'od dang sngags phreng las skar ma'i 'od lta bu dkar hram hram 'phro ba ni/ zla ba skar phreng dam mu tig phreng ba lta bu dang / thog mar 'od zer 'khor/ de nas sngags phreng dang po dal bu/ rim par je bral gyi tshul du 'khor ba ni 'gal me klad la bskor ba lta bu ste nye bar bsnyen pa'i yan lag go/ /de la brtan pa thob nas spro bsdu'i bzlas pa bya ba ni/ bzlas pa'i rkyen gyis sngags phreng gi 'od zer hūṃ yig la phog /de las 'od zer sna lnga rdo rje'i yas rwa nas brgyud/ mdzod spu nas 'thon/ mkha' khyab kyi bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa spyi dang khyad par bla ma sku gsum rtsa gsum gyi zhing sku'i bkod pa 'byams klas pa rnams la bla na med pa'i mchod sprin tu gyur pas mnyes shing thugs rgyud bskul/ gsang ba gsum gyi byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad sku phyag rgya gsung yig 'bru thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam par char bab pa ltar byon nas rang dang sa bon sngags 'khor la thim pas gzi mdangs 'od du 'bar bsam pa ni spro bsdu dang po'o/ /yang sngags phreng sa bon las dmar po shas che ba'i 'od zer lcags kyu'i rdul ldan phram phrom mas kyi rwa rtse brgyud/ lte ba nas 'phros pas srid pa gsum gyi sde brgyad 'byung po mthu bo che rnams la phog pas gnod sems gdug rtsub skad cig la zhi/ rang srog dwangs ma 'ub kyis bsdus te rgyu gi zhabs kyu la thim pas dregs byed rnams kyi srog gta' ru tshud de ci bcol pa'i phrin las thogs med du bsgrub par bsam pa ni gnyis pa'o/ /yang sngags phreng sa bon las 'od zer kha dog drug pa rdo rje'i rwa yas mar dang sku'i gnas thams cad nas thon/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi gnas ma lus par khyab/ sdig sgrib ma lus pa sbyangs nas gu ru'i sku 'ba' zhig tu gyur/ 'od zer tshur 'dus 'khor 'das mnyam nyid 'gyur med bde chen gyi phyag rgyas theb par bsam pa ni gsum pa'o/ /'di la dmigs skor rgyas par phye 302

ba'i bcu gnyis kyi tshul sogs spro na bsnyen yig rgyas pa las rtogs par bya ste 'di rnams sgrub pa'i yan lag go/ /de rnams legs par goms nas/ phyi'i 'byung bzhi'i rdul phra rab re re nas dang / nang bcud skye 'gro thams cad gu ru pad+ma'i skur gyur pa'i zhal dang ba spu'i bu ga tshun chad nas sngags sgra dir dir sgrogs pas mkha' khyab kyi rtsa gsum 'khor lo rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyis kyang 'dzab sgra 'ur dir bsgrags/ byin rlabs nus mthu ji snyed yod pa thams cad rang srog sa bon la thim pas sems can thams cad da lta nyid du rgyal ba pad+ma'i go 'phang la 'god pa'i nus pa thob snyam du mos pa ni mkha' khyab bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor te sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag go/ /yang skabs su spro bsdus skyon/ rdo rje sa bon la sems rtse gcig tu gtad pa dang / des khams 'dus sogs byung na sngags phreng klog pa'i tshul gyis bzla ba dang / des kyang ngal na sku'i dkyil 'khor cha med kun 'gro la sems gtad cing gsal snang 'don pa dang / rgyal ba thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje yig 'bru sngags kyi rnam par shar ba la nges pa'i shes pa brtan pos yig 'bru re re bzhin dbyibs dang gdangs la sems yun ring du gtad pas stong srog gcig char du 'phrog pa thob pa'i dgos pa yod cing / skabs rer 'dzab sgra che chung ran par bzlas pa'i gdangs rna bar son pa la sems gtod pa dang / dbyibs mi gsal ba dang sgra gdangs kyis sun nyams byung na dad pa rtse gcig pa dang mos pa brtan pos bzlas kyang mchog tu 'gyur la/ mdor na yengs 'khrul rgya 'byams sum song ba'i gnad du gang 'gro bya/ dmigs pa de rnams kyang snga ma la brtan pa thob nas phyi mar rim gyis 'jug pas don 'bras 'grub pa yin no/ /des na thog mar bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi lha'i gsal snang dang spro bsdu ba'i gzhi 'dzin pa la nan tan bya/ de nas spro bsdu dang po la byin rlabs thob pa'i rtags mthong nas/ bar pa cung zad dang tha ma dang mkha' khyab bzlas pa gtso bo/ gzhan rnams kyang skabs su gang bab bya yi thams cad khrigs chags ma mi dgos shing / gtso bor mchog sgrub pa'i nyams len gyi snying po rang rig gnyug ma gsal stong rgya yan chen po'i rang mdangs lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa rang shar de nyid dran tsam dang / rang sems ma bcos yengs med 'dzin med kyi ngang na sa bzlas pa chu bo'i rgyun ltar bya ba tshig don gyi snying po'o/ /thun gyi rjes bsdu sogs phyi sgrub dang mtshungs shing / lha sku bsdu ldangs gzhung tshig gi dngos bstan ltar byas la/ thun mtshams rnams su'ang snang grags rig gsum gnyug ma'i lha sngags ye shes las mi 'da' ba bya'o/ /gnyis pa bzlas pa'i tshad dus grangs rtags gsum las/ dus ni/ mchog sgrub pa la tshad med cing /nges pa bzung na/ 'di nyid kyi gzhung las/ yid ches brtson 'grus dang ldan pas bsgrubs na zla ba drug gis zag med 'od phung du grol bar nges so zhes gsungs pa ltar da lta dus bsnyen zla drug tu grags pa 303

'grub na grangs bsnyen rgyas pa dang yang 'grigs par 'gyur la de tsam mi nus na/ zla ba gsum mam/ zla gcig gam zhag bdun gyis mtha' rten par mos gus dang bcas te bsgrubs pas kyang phan yon chen po thob par 'gyur bas 'bad par bya ba kho na'o/ /grangs tshad ni/ 'bru re rer 'bum phrag re bzlas pas 'bum phrag bcu gnyis/ rtsod dus kyi dbang du byas te de bzhi 'gyur byas pas 'bum phrag bzhi bcu zhe brgyad kyi grangs bsnyen rgyas par bshad pas de ltar 'grub na mchog yin cing 'bru 'bum ni grangs tshad dngos dang / ma mthar yang / gu ru nyid kyi zhal nas/ sidhi bye bas rig 'dzin gnas su skye+oḥ zhes gsungs pa'i bye ba ni 'bum phrag bcu la brtsi ba'i lugs te zla ba gcig gis 'grub pas de tsam ni cis kyang brtson par 'os te/ rang gzhung las kyang / mi tshig gis bar ma chod par bzlas pas rig 'dzin gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis rang dbang med par byin gyis brlab par 'gyur ro: ci'i phyir na bdag nyid pad+ma'i thugs rgyud kyi byin rlabs thams cad yig 'bru 'di rnams la bstims yod pa'i phyir ro: zhes sogs phan yon tshad med par gsungs so/ /rtags tshang bla sgrub spyi dang mthun cing / 'di nyid las kyang / brtson 'grus shes rab snying rje ldanoḥ las can rnams kyi nyams blangs noḥ thugs sgrub gzhan las khyad par 'phags: lo ru mi 'gyang zla zhag la: yid ches dad pa dbang med yong : zhal mjal chos gsung lung bstan thob: gang du bsgrub pa'i sa phyogs der: 'ja' tshon sprin bkra rgyun ldan 'byung : spos dri ngad ldan tho le boḥ zhes sogs gsungs so/ /de nas nang sgrub thems pa'i thun tha mar gtor 'bul tshogs mchod dngos grub blang ba sogs rgyas par bya ba zhing sgrub la 'jug go/ /gsum pa gsang sgrub ni/ mchod pa gsar du brje ba'am kha gso/ slar yang brgyud 'debs bgegs gtor nas brtsams cho ga tshang bar btang ste gu ru zhi ba'i bzlas pa cung zad byas rjes zhi ba nyid gnas 'gyur te skad cig la ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i klong pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la gu ru drag po gtum drag dmar nag me'i phreng ba can dpal gyi chas rdzogs shing rngams brjid tshad med pa ba spu thams cad khro chung gi go chas gtams pa/ g.yas na khro bo g.yon na khro mo rgyab tu mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis drag sngags hūṃ phaṭa kyi nga ro sgrogs pa/ lha srin sde brgyad bran bzhin du khrid cing yang sprul lcags sdig rlung ltar 'tshubs pa/ srid pa gsum na che btsan 'gran zla dang bral ba'i skur gyur pa'i gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum las 'od 'phros/chos dbyings dur khrod me ri 'bar ba dang / laṅka dpal gyi pho brang la sogs pa nas bla ma drag po'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo spyan drangs mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par mos la spyan 'dren dang / rang gi thugs ka nas sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod bstod byed par bsgoms pa la brda don rtags gsum gyi mchod bstod byas nas ye shes pa rang la thim/ dbu gtsug tu gu ru zhi ba rigs bdag gi tshul du 304

bzhugs par bsam/ 'dzab bzla ba'i skabs/ thog mar gzhi dgod pa ni/ rang gi thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ting 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ yig dmar po 'od zer 'phro ba mtha' skor du yig 'bru bcu drug pa lcags bsregs kyi kha dog lta bu gyen langs g.yas bskor 'od zer hram mer 'khod par bsam la gsal snang thon par bya/ de nas drag sgrub nyid rkang tshugs byed pa'i skabs su dzab khang phyes te do li'i bzlas pa gtsor bya dgos kyang / 'dir ni zhi sgrub kyi cha lag lta bur bya ba'i tshe spro bas bsdu'i bzlas pa kho nas chog pas/ sngar gu ru zhi ba'i skabs kyi rtsa ba'i dmigs pa gsum po de la bsgyur ba rigs pas 'phrul te dngos gzhi bya/ mthar khro bzlas sam las sbyor gyi tshul du/sngags phreng las khro chung me phung mtshon cha la sogs pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ byang chab sgrub pa'i bar chad log 'dren dgra bgegs bya dam pa'i tshogs lcags kyus bkug zhags pas bcings/ mtshon cha dang 'khor los gtubs/ khro bo khro mo lcags sdig rnams kyi hab thob tu rol/ lhag ma me rlung gis bsregs shing gtor bas rdul phran tsam yang ma lus par bsam/ gzhan yang snang srid thams cad gu ru drag po'i skus gtams pa'i zhal nas drag sngags 'brug ltar sgrogs par bsam pa mkha' khyab kyi bzlas pa sogs zhi ba'i skabs su bshad pa thams cad dmigs gnad cung zad 'phrul te skabs ci rigs par 'dir yang sbyar/ thun gyi rjes sdud dang thun mtshams kyi bya ba sogs sngar dang 'dra ba las/ 'dir ni bskyed chog dang mthun pa'i bsdu rim yin pas dmigs med ka dag gi ngang du bzhag pas kyang chog go/ /thun rjes ma rnams la srung 'khor skyabs sems tshogs bsags mchod pa byin mtshams/ skad cig gis drag po'i skur gsal gdab nas drag po'i las byang la 'jug pas chog cing gtor 'bul dang tshogs grol kha'i bya ba sogs sngar dang 'dra/ snga thun thams cad la sngon 'gro rnams dang gu ru zhi ba rgyas par btang / grangs bsnyen tsam rdzogs nas sde brgyad sham 'dogs ci rigs pa'ang sbyar zhing dmigs gnad khro bo'i bzlas pa ltar la/ grangs tshad ni/ gzhi bsnyen ji tsam bzlas pa'i bcu gnyis cha gcig bzla bar bzhed pas/ dper na gzhi bsnyen 'bum phrag bcu gnyis la drag po 'bum phrag gcig go/ /bzhi pa yang gsang de kho na nyid du bsgrub pa ni/ drag po 'grub pa'i rjes thog de nyid du mchod gtor gsar du bsham/ thun dang po la bgegs gtor nas brtsams mthar chags su btang ste gu ru zhi drag gi sgom bzlas khyug tsam re grub nas/ gu ru drag po 'od zhu ba las rang nyid ye shes mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can yi dam che mchog drag po'i ngo bo kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang bcas shing bskal pa'i me dpung rdo rje mtshon cha'i gur khang gi nang du rang 'dra ye shes ḍā ki sprin gtibs pa lta bu'i dbus su bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum las 'od 'phros/ u rgyan mkha' spyod kyi grong khyer la sogs pa nas ye shes pa 'khor bcas spyan 305

drangs mdun mkhar bzhugs par mos la/ spyan 'dren mchod bstod byas mthar rang dang gnyis med du thim pa'i dbu ral gyi gseb tu rigs bdag bla ma pad 'byung gis brgyan par bsam/ bzlas dmigs la/ spro bsdu'i gzhi dgod pa ni/ thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'bar 'tsher gsal ba'i dbus su r+ghaṃ yig mthing kha 'od 'phro ba/ mtha' bskor du yi ge bcu bzhi pa'i sngags phreng sngon po 'od zer tsha tsha hrom hrom g.yon bskor du 'khod pa sbrul dkyus pa lta bu lta bas mi bzod pa sems la gtad/ gsal snang thon pa na sngags bzlas pas hūṃ yig gi 'od zer tshwa la rtsub pa rno la ngar bas sngags phreng bskul/ de las 'od zer glog gi zhags pa dmar gar gyi tshwa tshwa lta bu 'phros te rgyal ba rnams mchod cing byin rlabs bsdu ba sogs spro bsdu dang po dang / 'od zer gyis bdag cag dpon slob byang chub bsgrub pa la 'tshe zhing bar du gcod pa'i gnod byed mi dang mi min byad kha rbod gtong bdud dang dam sri thams cad rtsa srung mi la btab pa bzhin rmigs med du brlag dwangs bcud tshur 'dus/ sngar las kyang mthu stobs gzi brjid rab tu 'bar ba bsam pa spro bsdu bar ba'i khyad par dang / 'od zer gyis 'gro ba rigs drug gi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ seng gdong ma'i skur gyur bar bsam la spro bsdu phyi ma dang / sku gsung thugs bzlas sogs zhi ba nyid dmigs gnad bsgyur ba ni dngos gzhi yin la/ grangs thems nas las sbyor gyi dmigs bzlas ched du spro na/ phyi rol pha lam las grub pa'i rdo rje dang mtshon cha'i gur khang bskal pa'i rlung gis kyang gzhig par mi nus shing / me ri dang khro chung gi tshwa tshwa 'phro bas gnod byed kyis nyer yang mi nus pa'i nang du bsrung bya rnams kyang khro mo'i skur gyur/ thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis rgyal ba'i byin rlabs bsdus/ rang dang bsrung bya phyi rol gyi gur khang la thim pas byin gyis brlabs/ ba spu thams cad khro chung dang lus rdo rje'i go khrab kyis gtams par dmigs la bzla/ zlog pa ni/ rang gi spyi bor aḥkaḥmagrin par saḥmaḥ snying gar raḥtsaḥ lte bar shaḥdaḥ gsang gnas su raḥsaḥ brla g.yas su maḥraḥbarla g.yon du yaḥphaṭaḥzhes pa'i sngags 'bru gsal gdab/ sngags bzlas pas de rnams las me 'od mtshon cha 'khrugs shing mched pas dam chos bsgrub pa'i bar chad dang / gnas skabs mi mthun pa'i phyogs nad gdon bar chad byad phur sri ngan lo zla zhag kag mo rmis ltas ngan bdud bgegs dam sri sogs thal ba rdul bzhin brlag par bsam/ thun mtshams su bden stobs brjod cing lag g.yas gnam zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ g.yon nas gzhi nyi dkyil du bsam pa'i steng du dgra bgegs rnams bkug/ thal mo brdab pas sgo nga brag la bcar ba bzhin phye mar 'thag lhag ma'ang ye shes me rlung gis sbyang bar bsam/ bsad pa ni/ rang nyid gu ru drag po rigs bdag bcas gsal ba'i mdun tu/sngon mo gtso mor gyur pa'i seng gdong rigs lnga sprul pa yang sprul gyi tshogs bcas bzhugs par bsam/ 306

bskul dang drag sngags bzlas pas de dag las rang 'dra'i sprul pa nyi zer gyi rdul ltar 'phros/ dgra bgegs byad ma thams cad skad cig la bkug bcings bsdoms myos/ lha dang phyes/ gzugs la dbab/byad du bcug smor gzhug rnam shes spar/ mtshon chas gtubs/ gtun tu brdungs/ sha khrag lhag med du rol bar bsam pa'o/ /thun mjug mchod bstod sogs zhi drag gi rigs 'gre zhing / rjes sdud kyang drag po ltar ro/ /thun rjes ma rnams su srung 'khor nas mchod rlabs par dang / de nas seng gdong las byang la 'jug de'ang thog mar rtsa ba'i dmigs bzlas kho na dril/ spro bsdu bar pa gtsor 'don/ bsnyen grangs thems nas las sbyor gsum bya ba yin kyang / srung ba ni spyir las sbyor yin kyang bsnyen pa ma song bar dmigs bzlas mi rung ba min zhing dgos pa che bas thog ma nas thun gsham rnams su ci rigs par sbyar/ bsnyen sgrub grub nas srung dmigs ched du bsgom pas srung ba mchog tu 'gyur zhing / zlog dmigs ni bsnyen sgrub ma song bar du mi bya/ grub nas bzlog pa'i dmigs bzlas kyang ched du bya ba'am/ srod thun la nges par bya'o/ /bsad pa ni 'dir cha lag tshang ba'i ched du smos par zad kyi drag las dmigs gsal ba'i skabs las bsnyen sgrub skabs su mi dgos so/ /grangs tshad ni drag po'i phyed cha bzla bar bzhed pas drag po 'bum phrag gcig byed na 'di khri tsho lnga bzla'o/ /lnga pa phrin las mtha' rgyas kyi rim pa la gnyis/ las bzhi spyir sgrub pa/ bye brag che'i sgrub pa dmigs su bya ba'o/ /dang po la bzhi/ zhi rgyas dbang drag ste de re re la'ang dus kha dog phyogs gnas sngags smon lam gyi khyad par ro/ /de'ang bsnyen sgrub grangs rtags thems nas las la sbyar dgos pa yin pas/ dang po zhi ba'i phrin las khyad par bdud ldan ni/ rtsa ba gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub grub ma thag par 'don 'grigs sogs dkyus bzhin la/ thun dang por zhi drag seng gsum ka bsnyen pa thung tsam re bcas btang nas/ slar rang nyid pad+ma 'od 'bar du gsal/ thun phyi ma rnams la zhi ba'i las byang kho na 'thus te las bzhi rtsa ba gsum ka la sbyor ba yin mod kyi skabs 'dir zhi bsnyen la btags pa kho nas tshog ste yi dam dang mkha' 'gro gnyis ka gu ru nyid kyi ye shes rol pa kho na las gzhan du ma dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /de'ang zhi ba dus tho rangs/ kha shar phyogs su bltas la/ thog mar las byang skabs su bskyed la de nyid skad cig gis gnas 'gyur te sku mdog cha lugs thams cad dkar po zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lta bu/ phyag g.yas shel gyi rdo rje/ g.yon thod zhal/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa'i thugs kar pad zlar rdo rje r+ghaṃ dkar bsgom/ sngags phreng mi dgos/ spyi bo dung khang du pad dkar 'dab ma so gnyis pa'i lte bar zla dkyil oṃ dkar gyis mtshan pa'i mtha' bskor du badz+ra gu ru zhi ba'i sngags sha dang bcas pas g.yas su bskor ba/sngags de nyid bzlas pas thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer dkar po 'phros spyi bor phog sngags phreng 307

g.yas su 'khor/ de las kyang 'od zer dkar pos rgyal ba sras bcas mchod/ thugs rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyi dpral ba nas 'od zer dkar po byung / dpral bar thim/ nus pa bskyed/ de las slar yang 'od dkar zla ba lta bu 'phros/ bdag gzhan kun gyi las nyon sdig sgrib 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad mun pa la nyi ma shar ba lta bu sangs rgyas kyis dag par bsam/ thun mthar smon lam yang brgya rtsa'am bdun gsum la sogs pa brjod/ snod kyi 'jig rten rdo rje'i zhing dang bcud kyi sems can rdo rje sems dpa' gsal/ rjes sdud sogs dkyus ltar la spyi bo'i 'dzab dkyil snying gar bsdu ba sogs bya'o/ /grangs ni gong bsnyen ji tsam song ba'i bcu cha gcig spyir btang la/ dmigs bsal nad gdon zhi ba'i dgos ched sogs yod tshe rtags ma mthong gi bar du bzla rung ba nyid do/ /'di dag la dus dang kha lta phyogs sogs thog mar dbu 'dzug skabs las rgyun du ma 'grub kyang skyon med ces chags med rin po ches gsungs/ 'on kyang tho rangs zhi ba/ nyi dros rgyas pa sogs nyin zhag gcig la las bzhi cha bsgos kyang rung ba nyid do/ /gnyis pa rgyas pa ni/ zhi ba dang spyi 'gros mtshungs la/ khyad par dus nyi dros/ kha lho phyogs/ sku mdog cha lugs ser po gser ri la nyi ma shar ba lta bu/ g.yas rin chen zur brgyad zhabs rgyal po rol stabs/ thugs kar pad rdor r+ghaṃ ser/ lte bar pad ser 'dab ma re bzhi pa'i dbus su rin po che cha dgu pa r+ghaṃ ser pos mtshan pa'i mthar rtsa sngags las sngags dang bcas pas bskor ba/ sngags bzlas shing 'od zer ser po'i spro bsdu sngar bzhin la byin rlabs 'od ser lte ba nas 'byung lte bar thim slar yang 'od zer gyis bdag gzhan tshogs gnyis dang 'byor drug rgyas/ mthar smon lam dang snod rin po che'i zhing bcud rin chen sems dpar gyur pa sogs so/ /gsum pa dbang ni/ dus dgongs ka kha nub phyogs/ sku mdog cha lugs dmar po byu ru lta bu/ phyag g.yas pad+ma lcags kyus mtshan pa/ zhabs pad+ma'i skyil krung / thugs kar rdor r+ghaṃ dmar/ mgrin par pad dmar 'dab ma bcu drug pa'i lte bar nyi dkyil hūm̐ dmar gyi mthar rtsa sngags las sngags dang phrel bas bskor ba/ sngags bzlas 'od dmar spro bsdu dang byin rlabs 'od dmar mgrin pa nas byung mgrin par zhugs/ slar yang 'od dmar 'phro bas mthong thos dran reg dbang du 'dus/ mthar smon lam dang snod pad+ma'i zhing bcud pa pad+ma sems dpar gyur par mos pa sogs so/ /bzhi pa drag po ni/dus srod chen/ kha byang phyogs/ sku mdog cha lugs nag po stang zil bcag pa lta bu/ phyag g.yas ral gri g.yon thod khrag zhabs phyed skyil pus mo g.yas bslang ba/ thugs kar pad rdor r+ghaṃ mthing / gsang gnas sku pad ljang 'dab ma nyer brgyad pa'i lte bar ral gri rdo rje phyed pa'i yu ba can gyi lte bar hūṃ nag po/ mthar rtsa sngags las sngags spel mas bskor ba/ 'od zer mthing nag spro bsdu dang byin rlabs 308

gsang ba nas gsang ba bsnyim/ slar yang 'od zer mthing nag me mtshon khro chung spros pas dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad par bsgom/ mthar smon lam dang snod las rab zhing bcud las kyi sems dpar bskyur ba sogs gong bzhin no/ /skabs 'di dag tu kha bskong ba dang 'dod pa'i dngos grub myur du 'byung ba'i phyir bsnyen bsgrub ji tsam song ba'i bcu cha gcig gi sbyin sreg nges par bya dgos pas/zhi ba la zhi ba'i sbyin sreg las so so'i skabs sbyin sreg so sor 'grub na mchog tu 'gyur zhing / de'i tshe rdzas so so rnams kyang so so'i sngags sham dang spel tshig gis grangs gsog tu 'bul/ de ltar ma
