'grub na spyi ltar kho na'am las bzhi lhun grub kyi sbyin sreg kun gyi mthar blug de'i yig cha rnam gsal gud du bkod yod pa las shes par bya/ shin tu spros pa la mi dga' ba'am ting nge 'dzin brtan pa dang /'byor pa chung ba'i rigs can sbyin sreg mi 'grub pa rnams kyi rdzas kyis rdzas gcig sbyin sreg byas pas kyang kha skong du rung ba nyid do/ /gnyis pa las bye brag tshe sgrub pa'i rim pa la'ang gnyis/ spros med bsnyen pa/ spros bcas sgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ spyir 'di nyid sger du bsgrub kyang chog mod kyi zhi ba'i las kha tshar gyi bye brag yin pas zhi bsnyen brgyas bsdus gang rung nges par sngon du 'gro dgos la/ rtsa gsum bsgrub pa'i mu mthud yin na bgegs gtor srung 'khor tsam gyis 'thus la/ dus gzhan du byed na sngar bshad sgrub pa la 'jug pa'i sngon 'gro rnams ci rigs sbyar/ bsnyen pa'i bar zhi ba'i skabs ltar zhi bsnyen cung zad bzlas nas/ bsnyen bzlas dngos la thog mar drug dam bskul ba'i phyir gsol ba lan gsum gdab/ de nas rtsa ba'i spro bsdu'i dmigs pa'i gzhi dgongs pa ni/ rang nyid pad+ma 'od 'bar du gsal ba'i thugs kar pad dkar ze'u 'bru'i dbus su pha lam las grub pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa mas kyi rwa rnams ze'u 'brur nub pa/ de'i lte bang nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor gyi dbus su dwangs ma lnga 'dus kyi rang bzhin trīḥyig dkar po 'od 'phro ba'i khog par dz+ra ljang gu/ de'i nang du a dkar po/ mtha' skor du sngags phreng dkar po 'od lnga'i nu khyud can g.yas su bskor ba'am/ dmigs pa de tsam gsal mi thebs na thugs kar pad dkar 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba trīḥdakar po/ de'i mthar sngags phreng 'od lnga'i mdangs dang ldan pa bsgoms kyang gter gzhung gi dngos bstan yin pas rung zhing / gang ltar gsal snang ma thon bar bskyar nas bsgom/ de brtan pa na spro bsdu ni/ bzlas pa byas pas sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor ba'i 'od kyis trīḥyig bskul/ de las 'od zer lnga ldan bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/phyi snod nang bcud kyi dri ma sbyangs shing rgud pa bsal nas snod dag pa'i zhing dang bcud lha'i rang bzhin du byas te che'i bcud kyis me re re gang bar bsgom ste yul sbyang ba'o/ /slar yang 'od 'phros phyi 'byung ba sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i dwangs bcud thams cad bdud rtsi'i thig le kha dog lnga dang 'od zer 309

ser dkar dmar ljang mthing kha zab chen gyi skud pa lta bu dpag med bsdus nas rang la thim pas sha khrag drod dbugs sems kyi tshe nyams pa sor chud/ 'byung lnga'i dwangs ma stobs su gyur nas yum lnga'i tshe thob par bsam/ yang 'od 'phros/ nang bcud kyi skye 'gro/ drang srong rig 'dzin tshe la dbang ba lha klu mthu chen 'khor los sgyur bas gtsor byas tshe ring ba/ bsod nams dang dbang thang che ba/ 'khor dang longs spyod mang ba/ shes rab dang snyan grags ldan pa/ stobs rtsal gzi brjid yon tan can rnams kyi tshe bsod dwangs ma thams cad yi ge hrīḥdz+ra a gsum dang bdud rtsi 'od lnga'i rnam par bsdus te rang lus dang tshe rten la thim pas tshe bsod zla ba yar ngo ltar rgyas par bsam/ yang 'od 'phros gzugs snang lha/sgra grags sngags/ dran rtog chos nyid bde ba chen por gyur pa'i gzi byin gyis phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams nas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi tshe dang ye shes byin rlabs kyi dwangs ma thams cad rdo rje rin chen pad+ma rgya gram 'khor lo bum pa mda' dar g.yung drung 'khyil ba yig 'bru sku gzugs 'ja' zer la sogs pa'i rnam par spyan drangs/thugs srog la sib sib thim pas 'chi med rdo rje'i sku thob/ tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin dngos su gyur par bsam pa ste tshe sgrub dngos gzhi rtsa ba'i spro bsdu 'di gsum la nan tan du bya'o/ /tshe 'gugs pa ni/skabs 'dir thun 'jog khar cung zad bya ba ste/ rang gi spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po'i lte bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin pa pad+ma dmar po'i lte bar āḥdamar po/ snying khar rdo rje sngon po hūṃ sngon po/ /lte bar rin chen ser po ṭ+wā ser po/ /gsang gnas su rgya gram ljang gu hā ljang gus mtshan pa rnams gsal bdag/bzlas pa byas pas de rnams las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ser ljang gu nam mkha'i khams khengs pa dang / sprul pa'i lha mo lcags kyu dkar mo/ zhags pa ma ser mo/ lcags sgrogs ma dmar mo/ dril bu ma ljang mo/ thams cad phyag g.yas pas mda' dar rang mdog dang rang rtags phyag mtshan/ g.yon tshe bum 'dzin pa'i nyi zer gyi rdul lta bu 'phros/ phyi snod nang bcud rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i tshe dpal byin rlabs mtha' dag dang / khyad par rang gi bla tshe sde brgyad 'byung po mthu chen rnams kyis 'phrog pa/bskus pa/ yar ba/ stong ba/ bros ba/ 'khyams pa la sogs pa lcags kyu ma'i tshogs kyis shar phyogs dri za'i lag na bkug de bzhin du/ zhags pa mas lho gshin rje/ lcags sgrog mas nub klu dbang / dril bu mas byang gnod sbyin/ thams cad kyis steng 'og lha klu sa bdag la sogs pa'i lag nas bkuga'od kyi thig le dkar la 'tsher ba snum la 'dril ba trīḥdz+ra a yig la sogs pa'i rnam dpag tu med par rang 'od kyi rdo khab len gyis lcags blangs pa ltar bsdus shing / lha mo rnams kyis phyag gi bum par bskyil te rang gi spyi bo nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun lhub lhub bab pas rang lus 'chi med bum roms gang ba 310

ltar khengs/ lus rdo rje pha lam gyi rang bzhin du gyur/ tshe srog nyams pa sor chud/ ba spu thams cad rdo rje phyed pa res gtams par bsams la bzlas pa dang / tshe 'gugs kyang spro na brjod cing dbang bskur ltar smon lam gdab/ thun mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying mchod bstod sogs zhi sgrub dkyus ltar la/ thun mtshams lha skur ldang ba'i tshab tu rang lus pha lam gyi rdo rje rtse lnga par bsam la ka dag gi ngang du ci gnas su bzhag pa nyid yang yung bya ba ni khyad par ro/ /bsnyen tshad ni/ tshe sgrub ched du byed na rtags ma mthong bar 'bad dgos la/ zhi sgrub kyi yan lag tshang ba tsam byed na zhag bdun dang grangs 'bum phrag yan chad gang lcogs bya/ rtags ni gzhung las/ chu bo brgal ba/ gyen la 'gro ba/ lus gos gyon pa/ nyi zla shar ba/ 'bras bu la longs spyod pa/ lcags kyi rdo rje mthong ba la sogs pa byung na 'grub pa'i rtags yin pas dngos grub blang bar bya zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa sgrub pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin brtan pa'i rnal 'byor pas gzhung las/ de ltar bdag mdun bum pa gtor ma dang : tshe ril tshe chang nyi zla gza' skar dang : rdo rje'i brag gam ri bo lhun chags dang :gangs ri 'gyur med g.yu mtsho gtan 'khyil dang : de sogs gang la brten nas bsgrub kyang rung : re re'i phan yon brjod par mi nus te: kun dril rang lus lcags kyi pho brang che: zhes gsungs pa ltar nyi zla brag ri sogs gsal mdun bskyed kyi rten byas nas spro bsdu bzlas pas bdag nyid kyis che'i dngos grub thob par bsam zhing mthar rang la bstem pa ni byin rlabs nus mthu lhag par che'o/ /'on kyang da lta las dang po pa rtogs pa dang shes rab kyi khong chub ba rnams dang bstun nas yongs grags phyag len ltar/ stegs la tshom bu bkod pa'i dbus su bum pa nyer lnga'i bcud ldan kha rgyan mgul chings gzungs thag dang ldan pa/ mdun tu phye gtsang dkar mngar gyis spus pa'i tshe'i 'brang rgyas bum gzugs/ g.yas su tshe ril/ g.yon tu tshe chang / kun la gong mas bsgrubs pa'i tshe ril sogs dam rdzas kyi phab rgyun btab pa/ rgyab tu tshe mda' tshad ldan du bcas pa/ thams cad kyang gas chags sogs skyon med pa/mdun tu bla gtor gyi g.yas g.yon sman rag nyer spyod bskor bsham dang kha gso rgyu brang tshar bcas 'dzom na cha gnyis bsham/ mchod gtor sogs kyang 'du bya'o/ /cho ga'i 'don 'grigs snga ma ltar la tshar gcig gis bdag dang mdun bskyed bum chu'i steng dang gtor ma bcas so sor gsal ba'am/yang na rnying ma spyi'i bka' srol ltar cho ga'i skabs su bdag mdun dbyer med du bsgrubs nas bzlas pa la 'jug pa'i tshe 'dzab khang dbye bar bya'o/ /bzlas pa'i 'phro 'du ni gong du bstan pa nyid bdag mdun gnyis ka la sbyar/ khyad par mdun bskyed phyag g.yon thod pa'i tshe bum nang du bdud rtsi'i dbus dz+ra yig 'od 'bar ba bsgom/ bzlas dmigs dngos gzhi gnas lnga phyag mtshan lnga dang yig 'bru lnga sogs tshe 311

'gugs pa'i dmigs pa de gtso bor bya zhing / tshe bcud thams cad bdag mdun gtor ma tshe chang tshe ril tshe mda' dz+ra yig rnams la thim/ tshe rdzas rnams kyang ye shes kyi bdud rtsi mthong tshor myong reg tsam gyis tshe'i dngos grub ster nus pa'i bcud len tu gyur par mos/ dus bzhi kar mda' dar g.yab cing tshe 'gugs dbyangs dang bcas pa bya/ thun mtshams su dz+ra yig rang gi thugs srog sa bon la bstem/dus grangs rtags sogs gong mtshungs ji tsam nus par byas pas phan yon tshad med de/ gzhung las/de ltar bsgrubs pa'i yon tan ni: rkyen ngan bar chad thams cad zlog: dus zad pa yi mi yin kyang :tshangs pa'i tshe dang mnyam par 'gyur/ 'chi ba rnam pa brgyad mi 'byung : las 'phro can rnams nyi zla'i tshe: rdo rje'i g.yung drung lta bu yi: tshe yi rig 'dzin e ma ho+oḥ zhes so/ /sgrub pa zin nas sbyin sreg 'grub na legs pas drurla'i rdzas gtso bor gyur pa'i sreg blugs bzlas pa'i bcu cha'am grangs mang du 'bul lo/ /rtsa ba'i gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ tshe sgrub sprel min gang ltar yang sbyin sreg 'grub pa'i rjes de nyid du dngos grub len chos bya ba yin te/ tshogs la skong bshags rgyas par bya/ rtsa gsum bsnyen sgrub ring sbrel skabs/ 'dir gu ru zhi ba'i bdag 'jug dang sbrel nas tshe sgrub dbang len bya/ de lta na zhi drag seng gsum mchod gzhi sngar ba sham steng du bdag 'jug gi dbang rdzas gsar du bshams nas las byang btang las bum bsgrub pa sogs zin nas gzod bdag nyid 'jug gal te tshe sgrub khol 'don yin na sbyin sreg grub rjes las byang tshogs skor bcas btang nas che'i dbang len bya/ slar yang tshe 'dzab bzlas la mchod bstod dang bum gtor lha 'od bzhu byas nas bum chu sogs phyi mi la mi sbyin par dngos grub tu rol/ nongs bshags dang / bsngo smon bkra shis rgyas par brjod cing / srung 'khor dang bcas pa'i lha sku bsdu ldang / dga' ston gnas srung tho 'grol ba sogs spyi ltar bya'o/ /de ltar bsnyen sgrub legs par thems pa'i lha de'i sgom bzlas de nas bzung ste ji srid bar gcog tu mi rung ba 'dir yang gter gzhung kha rkyang gi zhi drag seng gsum tsam chags med grub na legs/ mi 'grub na gzhung 'di nyid las bskyed rim gyi rjes 'bral du gsungs pa'i a nu dang a ti'i nyams len tsam 'dor du mi rung bas/ 'di ltar phyi snod thams cad gzhal yas khang / snang tshad kun gu ru pad+ma'i sku sgyu ma lta bu'i rang bzhin/ grags pa thams cad badz+ra gu ru'i gdangs gzhom du med pa'i rang sgra/ rtog tshogs thams cad rang shar rang grol chos nyid kyi rang mdangs su mos pa lam byed chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor las mi 'da' ba khyer so gsum gyis lam du khyer ba dang / rang nyid pad+ma 'od 'bar du gsal ba'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyi 'od zer 'ja' tshon lta bus sku'i nang dang zhing khams thams cad la khyab pas 'od dang zhing khams dbyer mi phyed pa/ zhing gi bkod pa rab 'byams rgya mtsho mtha' dag rang lus 'od gsal rdo rje'i 312

sku dang dbyer med gdod3sa zung 'jug sku'i rnam 'gyur che chung ma nges pa rnam pa thams cad pa'i bdag nyid du mnyam par bzhag la rlung 'byin 'jug gnas gsum dang sbyar ba'i rtsa bsnyen nas 'bru gsum la rdor bzlas bya ba'am/ bar rlung bzung ba'i yid bzlas dang / rlung dang bab tu bzhag nas sems ma yengs par rang byung rdo rje'i sgra sngags rtsol bral lhun grub tu bzla ste sku dang zhing khams 'dul bral med par la bzla/ mthar zhing khams 'od snang dang bcas pa lha sku la bsdu/ de 'bru gsum/ de'ang o āḥl/ de hūṃ la/ r+ghaṃ nā da/ nā da stong nyid du yal ba la ci nus su bzhag stong pa'i ngang las lhar wa la gyis ldang ste sku dang zhing khams ro mnyam la blo bzhag nas zung 'jug lam du byed pa rnams ni a nu'i dgongs pa dang / sems nyid stong pa nyid kyi rang mdangs gu ru pad+ma'i skur wal gyis shar/ shar ba de'ang sems las gzhan tu ma grub/ sems nyid ngo bo stong ba dang / snang ba'i rang mdangs gu ru'i sku gnyis gdod nas dbyer med sku gsum lhun grub gyi gnas lugs rtogs pas rig stong lhun grub zang thal a ti khyab brdal chen po'i dgongs nyams skyong ba ste/ de dag ni bsnyen sgrub dngos gzhi'i skabs su'ang bskyed rim spyi'i rgyas 'debs kyi tshul du bsgom pa gal che zhing grangs bsnyen sogs thems nas rgyun tu nyams su len bya'i snying po ni 'di nyid do/ /las dang po pa gnyis 'dzin la a 'thas pa rnams kyis snang srid dag pa rab 'byams kyi 'khor lo go ba tsam yang gnad du mi 'byor bas tshogs mchod sogs kyi skabs/ mdun bskyed gtso bo pad+ma'i 'od 'bar la rtsa brgyud bla ma/ g.yas su gu ru drag po la yi dam rgyud sde bzhi drug g.yon tu seng ge'i gdong can la dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ mtha' bskor du 'dod lha skabs sbyar dang dam can chos skyong gsal gdab pa'ang rig 'dzin chen po nyid kyi gsung las 'byung ngo / /sngags kyi rnal 'byor pas rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig phra rags rnams dus rtag tu srog bzhin btsa' ba kho na gal che ba gzhir bzhag khyad par 'di nyid kyi dam tshig zab gnad yo ga gsum gyi sgrub thabs las/ sku'i dam tshig tu gu ru pad+ma'i sku che chung gang yin gcig dang mi 'braloḥ gsung gi dam tshig tu dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi yi ge dang mi 'bral: thugs kyi dam tshig tu thun drug gam gsum mam tha na'ang nyi shar gyi dus su spyan 'dren bzlas pa dang mi 'bral bar bya'o: zhes gsungs pa'ang dgos pa khyad par can dang 'bral pas lag len tu gdab pa gal gnad che/ mtshams kyi spang blang sogs bsnyen bsgrub spyi'i gnad rnams ni 'brir ma langs pas 'di nyid kyi na yig rgyas pa sogs las rtogs par bya dgos so/ /tshe gcig spyi 'dus klog la brtson rnams kyang / /lta dgongs gnad kyi gzer bu lta ci zhig /spro bsdu'i ting 'dzin ji bzhin mi gsal ba/ /'dab chags ne tso'i bzlas pa'i rjes 'gror mthong / /des na mkhas pa'i spyan sngar mi brims kyang / /blo dman nyam chung rang 'dra'i gsal 'debs 313

bkod/ /'di ltar tshul bzhin sgrub rnams tshe gcig tu/ /pad+ma'i gsang gsum phrin las kun 'grub shog /ces blo dman nyams len 'dod pa la phan pa'i sems kyis rang nyid kyis sngar bkod pa'i bsnyen yig rgyas pa las nyer mkho'i lag len dang dmigs rim rnams khol du phyungs te/ o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa blo gros mtha' yas kyis rdzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sgrub gnas chen por bkod pa dge legs 'phel// 314

༄ga /bka' rdzogs pa chen po yang zab dkon mchog spyo 'dus kyi cha lag thun mong gi sngon 'gro zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥsngon 'gro bzhi sbyor ni: dal 'byor rnyed par dka' boḥ 'chi ba mi rtag pa: las rgyu 'bras:'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rnams bsam pa yin te+oḥ de la thog mar dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che 'di:shin tu rnyed par dka' ste: zhi ba lha'i zhal nas: dal 'byor 'di ni rnyed pa shin tu dka': skyes bus don sgrub thob par gyur pa la: gal te 'di la phan pa ma bsgrub na: phyis nas yang dag 'byor par ga la 'gyur: ces gsungasoḥ de yang dal ba brgyad ni: sdud pa las: mi khom brgyad spangs de yis dal ba rtag tu rnyed: ces gsungs: mdo dran pa nyer gzhag las: dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang : kla klo tshe ring lha dang ni: log lta sangs rgyas kyis stong pa: lkugs pa 'di dag mi khom brgyad: ces gsungs: 'di dag ji ltar mi khom pa yin zhe na: dmyal ba ni rtag tu sdug bsngal ba'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir dang : yi dwags ni sems tshig pa'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir dang : dud 'gro ni kun tu rmongs pa che ba'i phyir dang : de dag gsum tshar yang ngo tsha med pa dang : khrel med pas rgyud ma rungs par gyur ba'i phyir: chos nyams su len pa'i go skabs med pa yin no: lha tshe ring po zhes bya ba ni:gnas kyi bde ba chags nas dge ba la 'bad mi khom pa'o: de ltar 'gro ba rigs drug la dal ba med par bshad pa yin no: mi yin du zin kyang : kla klo ni skyes bu dam pa dang 'phrad par dka' ba'i phyir ro: log lta can ni: dge ba mtho ris dang thar pa'i rgyur ma mthong ba'i phyir ro: sangs rgyas kyis stongs pa'i 'jig rten du skyes pa ni: bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa ston pa med pa'i phyir ro: lkugs pa ni legs par bshad pa dang nyes par bshad pa'i chos rang nyid kyis shes par mi nus pa'i phyir ro: de ltar brgyad po de dag dang bral ba ni: dal ba phun sum tshogs pa zhes bya'o: 'byor ba ni rang gi 'byor pa lnga: gzhan gyi 'byor pa lnga ste bcu'o: de la rang gi 'byor pa lnga ni: ji skad du: mi nyid dbus skyes dbang po tshang : las mtha' ma log gnas la dad: ces pa rnams so: de la mi nyid ni:mi rnams dang skal pa mnyam pa: skyes pa dang bud med kyi dbang po dang ldan pa'o+oḥ yul dbus su skyes pa ni: skyes bu dam pa rnams la brten du yod pa'i sar skyes pa'o: dbang po tshang ba ni: glen pa dang lkugs pa ma yin pa ste: dge ba chos sgrub pa'i skal pa yod pa'o: gnas la dad pa ni: ston pas 315

gsungs pa'i dam pa'i chos 'dul ba dkar po'i chos thams cad kyi gnas su gyur pa la dad pa'o: las kyi mtha' ma log pa ni: tshe 'di la mtshams med pa'i las ma byas pa'o+oḥ gzhan gyi 'byor ba lnga ni:sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa dang : dam pa'i chos bstan pa dang : chos bstan pa rnams gnas pa dang ཿོ chos gnas pa rnams kyi rjes su 'jug pa dang : gzhan gyi phyir snying brtse bar byed pa yod pa'o: de ltar rang bzhin gnyis kyi bcu po de dag dang ldan pa ni 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa ldan pa zhes bya'o: de ltar dal 'byor rnam gnyis 'dzom pa de mi lus rin po che yin no: ci'i phyir de la rin po che zhes bya zhe na: yid bzhin nor bu rin po che dang chos mthun pa ste: rnyed par dka' bas na rin po che zhes bya: phan 'dogs che bas na rin po che zhes bya'o: de la rnyed par dka' ba ni: byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod lasoḥ mi 'gyur ba ni dka' ba ste: mi srog thob pa'ang dka' ba yin: dam pa'i chos thob dka' ba ste: sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i dka' ba yin: zhes gsungasoḥ dpe ji ltar rnyed par dka' na: spyod 'jug lasoḥ de nyid phyir na bcom ldan gyis: rgya mtsho cher g.yeng gnya' shing gi: bu gar ru sbal mgrin chud ltar: mi nyid shin tu thob dka' gsungs: zhes pa ltar ro: gang zag ni:ngan song gsum du skyes pa rnams kyis rnyed par dka' ba yin no: phan 'dogs che ba ni: slob dpon tsan+d+ra go rī'i zhal nas: gang zhig thob na skye ba'i rgya mtsho mthar 'byin zhing : byang chub mchog gi sa bon dge ba'ang 'debs byed la: yid bzhin nor bu bas kyang yon tan ches lhag pa'i: mi nyid de ni su zhig 'bras bu med par byed: bde gshegs lam brten 'gro ba 'dren par chas gyur cing : sems kyi stobs chen mi yis rnyed pa gang yin pa'i: lam de lha dang klu yis mi rnyed lha min dang : mkha' lding sha za mi'am ci dang lto 'phyes min: zhes gsungs pas: dal 'byor gyi mi lus 'dis: mi dge ba spang nus poḥ dbe ba sgrub nus pa: 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las brgal nus pa: byang chub kyi lam bgrod nus pa: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob nus pa yin no+oḥ zhi ba lhas: mi yi gru la brten nas ni: sdug bsngal chu bo che las sgrol: ces gsungs pas: dal 'byor thob pa don dang ldan pa zhig byed dgos te: de nyid las: gru 'di phyis nas rnyed dka' bas: rmongs pa dus su gnyid ma logoḥ ces pa dang : 'di 'dra'i dal ba rnyed nas ni: bdag gis dge goms ma byas na: 'di las bslus pa gzhan med de:'di las blun pa'ang gzhan med do+oḥ zhes pa dang : mdo las: shin tu rnyed dka'i dal 'byor thob dus 'dir: gtan gyi bde ba sgrub la mi sgrim par: snyoms las don med bya bas g.yeng byed na:de ni skyes bu snying yod ji ltar yin: dus 'dir 'bad na gtan gyi bde thob cing : ma 'bad sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khyams: gtan gyi bde sdug gdam du yod dus 'dir: mi 316

nyid yin na dus 'dir 'bad par rigs: zhes gsungs: de ltar rnyed par dka' 'dir phan 'dogs che yang : 'jig par shin tu sla ste: tshe srog la gsos 'debs mkhan ni med: 'chi ba'i rkyen ni mang : dus skad cig ma ni mi sdod pa'i phyir ro: de ltar yang spyod 'jug lasoḥ de ring kho na mi 'chi zhes: bde bar sdod pa rigs ma yin: bdag ni med par 'gyur ba'i dus: de ni gdon mi za bar 'byung : zhes gsungasoḥ de yang spyir 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa yin te: sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas dge slong dag 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa'o: ji ltar mi rtag pa ni: ched du brjod pa'i tshoms las: bsags pa kun gyi mtha' 'dzad cing : bslang ba'i mtha' ma 'gyil bar 'gyur: 'phrad pa'i tha ma 'bral ba ste: gson pa'i tha ma 'chi bar 'gyur: zhes gsungs so: de yang phyi snod kyi 'jig rten 'di yang mi rtag ste+oḥ chags 'jig sna tshogs byed: nam zla dus bzhir 'gyur zhing gnas skabs mi gcig par 'gro: nyi zla 'char nub sogs skad cig kyang mi rtag: nang bcud kyi sems can rnams kyang mi rtag ste: 'phags pa rgya cher rol pa lasoḥ srid gsum mi rtag ston ka'i sprin dang 'dra: 'gro ba'i skye 'chi gar la lta dang mtshungs: zhes gsungs: de yang 'jig rten 'dir yun ring por mi sdod: nams kyang 'chi dgos shing : mi 'chi ba'i rkyen du gyur pa ni gang yang med: kha zas la sogs pa mi 'chi ba'i rkyen yin yang brnang ste 'chi ba yod: rdzas dang yo byad la sogs pa rang 'tsho bar byed pa'i mthun rkyen yin yang : de bsgrub pa'i thog sha la 'chi ba dpag tu med pa yod: tshe mi sdod pa ni: chu bo'i rgyun nam spos rgya'i tshigs pa dang 'dra ste+oḥ spyod 'jug las: nyin mtshan sdod pa yong med par: tshe 'di rtag tu god 'gyur zhing : snon pa gud nas yong med na: bdag lta 'chi bar cis mi 'gyur: zhes gsungs:shi ba'i dus su nye 'bral dang nor rdzas dang lus la sogs rtsis po che rnams dang : 'grogs dkar mi yong ste myur du 'phral ba yin no: spyod 'jug las: thams cad bor te 'chi dgos par: bdag gis de ltar ma shes nas: zhes sogs gsungs so: de yang 'chi ste nges par 'chi: nam 'chi cha med: dus la bab pa'i 'chi ba la: cis kyang mi stong par 'chi ste: rgan pa 'chi ba yol rgyu med: gzhon pa lam ran bya ba med: dar bab pa la 'chi bas mi tshugs bya ba med: khams che chung drag zhan med par 'chi ba'i rgya las ma 'das te: slob dpon dpa' bos: ci ste sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku: mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa'i: rdo rje'i sku yang mi rtag na: chu shing snying po 'dra ba yi: lus can rnams la smos ci dgos: zhes gsungs: bsags pa'i nor gyis kyang mi stong ste: yang de nyid las: rnyed pa mang po thob gyur nas: yun ring dus su bde spyad kyang : chom pos 'phrog pa ji bzhin du: sgron mo lag pa stong par 'gro: zhes gsungs: de bas rang gi lus kyang mi stong ste: spyod 'jug las: dka' ba mang 317

pos bsgrubs pa yi: zas dang skom gyis bskyangs pa'i lus: rang dang mi 'grogs bya khyis za: yang na 'bar ba'i me yis tshig: yang na chu yi nang du 'brul: yang na sa yi dong du sba: zhes gsungs so: de ltar 'chi ba nam yong cha med de: mdo las: sangs dang 'jig rten phyi ma gnyisoḥ sngon du gang 'ong gtol med pas: sang gi chis la ma 'bad par: phyi ma'i don la 'bad par rigs: zhes gsungs:da lta lus ni stobs dang ldan: byad bzhin mdangs dang ldan pa: tshor ba ni bde ba dang ldan pa: 'chi ba yid kyi dgu la mi byed pa cig: de ring lta bu 'chi nad kyis btab nas: lus kyi stobs shor nas tsog pu yang mi nus: byad kyi bkrag shor te: 'om po bkrag med du song : tshor ba sdug bsngal te na tsha la tshugs thabs med: zug gzer la chog pa med: sman dang dpyad kyang ma zug: cho ga dang rim gros kyang ma phan: 'chi bar ni shes: bya thabs ni med: gnyen gyi mtha' mas ni bskor: zas kyi tha ma ni za: gtam gyi tha ma ni zlo: de nas dbugs de chad nas de ring phan chad ji ltar gces pas khyim der med du mi btub pa cig yin yang ཿོ ro de khyim du zhag mang du bzhag ma 'os par: mal du khur thag shar gyis bras nas ro khur gyis ro khur ti phyir 'don te: la las ni ro de la 'jus shing mchong ba ltar byed: kha cig ni ngu zhing gom pa ltar byed: la la ni 'bog cing rgyal ba ltar byed: gzhan kha cig na re: 'di ni sa yin: 'di ni rdo yin: khyod de ltar ma byed col chung ba skad zer: de them pa thal gyis brgal nas: rnam pa thams cad du nang du mi ldog cing dur khrod du bskyal nas: 'bus zhig pa'am:khyi lce spyang la sogs zos keng rus 'thor ba dang : skra rnams kyang phyogs su 'thor zhing : sha la sogs pa bya rog gis khyer nas: gog gog zer ba mthong ba dang : che ge mo shi bo: ro gcig 'dug go zer nas gzhan gleng bar 'gyur te: mdo las: bdag ni gdon mi za bar 'chi 'gyur te: shi nas gzhan gyi gtam du 'gyur te 'ong : zhes gsungs: de ltar shi bas mi chog las rjes su 'brangs te+oḥ bsags pa'i nor rdzas zhing khang dang chung ma la sogs gzhan gyis longs spyod do: de yi ched du bsags pa'i sdig pa mi dge ba rang rang gi rjes su 'brangs te: rgyal po la gdams pa las: —dus kyis bsnyen te rgyal po 'gro gyur na: longs spyod rdzas dang nye du rjes mi 'brang : skyes bu de ni gar gnas gar 'gro yang : las ni grib ma bzhin du rjes su 'brang : zhes dang : mdo las: lus ni 'jigs rung nyid du 'gyur nges te: sems ni dbang med las kyis khrid par byed: ces gsungs: de yang las dkar nag gi 'bras bu nam yang chud mi za bar smin te: las brgya pa las: lus can dag gi las rnams ni:bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za: tshogs shing dus la bab pa na: 'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur:zhes gsungs so: de yang las 'bras kyi dbye ba ni: bsod nams ma yin pa'i las rgyu 'bras: bsod 318

nams kyi las 'bras dang : mi g.yo ba'i las 'bras so: dang po ni: spyir mang yang : las kyi lam bsdus mi dge bcu ste+oḥ lus kyi sgo nas srog gcod pa la sogs gsum: ngag gi sgo nas rdzun la sogs pa bzhi: yid kyi sgo nas brnab sems la sogs pa gsum mo: de re re la yang don gsum gsum ste:dbye ba dang : 'bras bu dang : khyad par sogs rgyas par shes par bya'o: de dag thams cad la yang nyon mongs pa'i sgo nas rnam par bzhag pa dang : grangs kyi sgo nas rnam par bzhag pa dang ཿོ yul gyi sgo nas rnam par bzhag pa'o: de la dang po ni+oḥ zhe sdang gi sgo nas mi dge ba de dag spyad na dmyal bar skye bar 'gyur ro: 'dod chags kyi sgo nas spyad na yi dwags su 'gyur ro: gti mug gi sgo nas spyad na dud 'gror skye bar 'gyur ro: ji skad du: chags pas yi dwags 'gro par 'gyur: zhe sdang gis ni dmyal bar 'phen: rmongs pa phal cher dud 'gror 'gyur: zhes pa dang : 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum: des bskyed las ni mi dge ba: mi dge ba las sdug bsngal dang : de bzhin ngan 'gro thams cad do: zhes gsungs: spyod 'jug las: mi dge ba las sdug bsngal 'byung : 'di las ji ltar nges thar zhes: nyin mtshan rtag tu bdag gis ni: 'di nyid 'ba' zhig bsam par rigs: zhes gsungs so: bsod nams kyi las rgyu 'bras la: las ni mi dge ba bcu spangs pa ni dge ba bcu yin la: gzhan yang 'jug pa'i las dang bstun na: gzhan gyi srog 'don pa dang : sbyin pa rgya chen gtong ba dang : tshangs par spyod pa la gnas pa dang : bden pa drang por smra ba dang : gzhan mi mdza' ba rnams bsdum pa dang : zhi des dang gsong por bshad pa dang : don dang ldan pa'i tshig smra ba dang :chags pa chung zhing chog shes pa dang : byams pa la sogs pa bsgom pa dang : yang dag pa'i don la 'jug pa'o: de'i 'bras bu la yang : rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu: rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bu: dbang gi 'bras bu sogs rgya cher gsungs shing : de yang dge ba rgyal dang 'dres pas lhar skye: dge ba phrag dog dang 'dres pas lha ma yin du skye: dge ba'i 'dod chags dang 'dres pas mir skye bar gsungs:de bas na las phra mo dag la'ang spang blang bya dgos te: de yang tshom las: sdig pa chung ngu byas pas kyang : 'jig rten pha rol 'jigs chen dang : phung khrol chen po phyed 'gyur te: khong par song ba'i dug bzhin no: zhes gsungs: dge ba'i las chung ngus kyang 'bras bu chen po 'byin te: tshom las:bsod nams chung ngu byas pas kyang : 'jig rten pha rol bde chen 'dren: don chen dag kyang byed 'gyur te: 'bru rnams phun tshogs smin pa bzhin: zhes gsungs so: las kyi rnam par smin pa nam yang chud mi za bar smin par nges te: dran pa nyer gzhag tu chung ba lasoḥ me ni grang bar 'gyur yang srid: rlung ni zhags pas zin yang srid: nyi zla thang la lhung yang sridoḥ las kyi rnam smin bslu mi srid 319

ces gsungs: de ltar las bzang ngan gyis 'khor ba'i bde sdug sna tshogs bskyed par byed de+oḥ las brgya pa las: las rnams kyang ni sna tshogs pas: de yis 'gro 'di sna tshogs byas: zhes gsungs: de yang 'khor ba'i mtho dman gar skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin te: gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi gnasoḥ gang dang 'grogs kyang sdug bsngal gyi grogs: gang la spyad kyang sdug bsngal gyi longs spyod ma gtogs bde ba'i go skabs cung zad kyang medoḥ dmyal ba la tsha grang gi sdug bsngal drag la rgyun ring ba yod de: bshes spring las: 'di na mi gcig mdung thung sum brgya yisoḥ rab tu drag btab sdug bsngal gang lags poḥ des ni dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal chung ngu la'ang : 'ol yang mi bgyid char yang mi phod do: zhes gsungs: yi dwags la bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal bsran mi bzod pa yod de: ji skad du: kha cig kha ni khab kyi mig tsam loḥ lto ba ri yi khyon tsam bkres pas nyanoḥ mi gtsang gyi nang bor cung zad tsam: 'tshal ba'i mthu dang ldan pa ma lags so+oḥ zhes gsungs: dud 'gro la glen zhing gti mug pa dang : bkol spyod kyi sdug bsngal mi bzad pa yod de: ji skad du: dbang med gzhan dag rdog pa lag pa dang : lcags dang lcags kyu gdab pas 'debs te bkol: kha cig mu tig bal dang rus pa khrag: sha dang pags pa'i ched du 'chi bar 'gyur: ces gsungs: de gsum sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal bya ba yin: bde 'gro lha mir skyes kyang sdug bsngal las mi 'da' ste: 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal zhes bya ba mi yi rgyal po 'khor los sgyur ba lta bu'i spyod yul thob kyang : mthar sdug bsngal du 'gyur te+oḥ ji skad du+oḥ 'khor los sgyur rgyal nyid du gyur nas kyang : 'khor ba dag tu yang bran nyid du 'gyur: zhes gsungs: der ma zad lha yi dbang po lta bu'i lus dang longs spyod thob kyang : mthar 'chi 'pho zhing ltung ba yong yin te: ji skad du: brgya byin 'jig rten mchod 'os gyur nas kyang : las kyi dbang gis slar yang sa steng lhung : zhes gsungs so: der ma zad lha yi rgyal po tshangs pa lta bu 'dod chags dang bral nas: bsam gtan snyoms 'jug gi bde ba thob kyang mthar lhung ba yang yin te: ji skad du: tshangs nyid chags bral bde ba thob nas slar: mnar med me yi bud shing gyur pa yi: sdug bsdul rgyun mi 'chad pa brten 'tshal lo: zhes gsungs so: de la mi yi sdug bsngal gyi dbang du bgyis na: skye rga na 'chi'i chu bo bzhis thog drangs nas sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa yod de: ji skad du: mngal 'jug gi mdo las: de bzhin skye ba yang sdug bsngal lo: rgas pa yang sdug bsngal yin no: na ba yang sdug bsngal yin no: 'chi ba yang sdug bsngal yin no: sdug pa dang bral ba yang sdug bsngal yin no: mi sdug pa dang 'phrad pa yang sdug bsngal yin no: gang 'dod pa btsal te ma rnyed pa yang sdug bsngal yin no: yod pa bsrung dka' ba yang sdug bsngal yin no+oḥ zhes gsungs so: de la 320

dang po ni skye ba gzhan thams cad kyi rtsa ba yang yin la: de la skye gnas bzhir gsungs kyang : phal cher mngal nas skye'o: 'di'i dbang du byas na: dang po srid pa bar do nas mngal du 'jug par yang sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod cing : mngal du zhugs nas kyang : tsha grang nad dang sdug bsngal dpag med yod do: gzhan yang mi gtsang ba'i 'du shes dang : dri mi zhim pa'i 'du shes dang : mun nag gi 'du shes dang ཿོ btson ra'i 'du shes dang : yongs su skyes nas phyir 'byung ba'i 'du shes skye bar 'gyur ro: mngal nas phyir byung ba'i dus su pags pa bshus nas rtsig zur la brang ba tsam gyi sdug bsngal yod de: slob spring las: shin tu mi gtsang dri nga gtse bas 'gag: rab tu dogs pa mun nag 'thib por 'dug pa yi: mngal gnas dmyal ba lta bu'i nang du de zhugs nas: lus kyang bskums la sdug bsngal chen por gnas dgos so: zhes gsungs: rgas pa'i sdug bsngal yang dpag tu med de:mdor na bcu'o: de yang gzugs yongs su 'gyur ba dang : de bzhin du skra dang : pags pa dang :kha dog dang : mthu stobs dang : gzi brjid dang : bsod nams dang : nor med pa dang : sems yongs su 'gyur ba dang : gnas skabs 'das shing tshe'i 'jug bsdu bas so: de ltar yang 'phags pa rgya che rol pa las: rgas pas gzugs sdug gzugs ni mi sdug byed: rgas pas gzi brjid 'phrog cing mthu stobs nyams: rgas pas bde ba 'phrog cing sdug bsngal bskyed: rgas pas 'chi byed rgas pas mdangs kyang 'phrog: ces gsungs so: na ba'i sdug bsngal yang dpag tu med de: mdor na bdun te: de yang na zug drag pos btab pas sdug bsngal dang ཿོ dpyad rtsub mo byed pa dang : sman tsha ba bsten pa: bza' btung 'dod pa 'gog pa: sman pa'i ngo bsrung ba: yo byad zad pa: shi dogs pa'i sdug bsngal rnams yod do: de yang rgya che rol pa las: nad brgya ma spangs nad 'thibs sdug bsngal gyis: 'gro ba gtsos te mi yi yi dwags bzhin: ces gsungs so: 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal yang dpag tu med de: rgyal po la gdams pa'i mdo las: rgyal po chen po+oḥ de bzhin du 'chi bdag gi gsal shing gis zugs te: rgyags pa dang ni braloḥ skyabs ni med: mgon ni med: dpung gnyen ni med: nad kyis ni gdung: kha ni skam: bzhin 'gyur: rkang lag ni g.yob: las ni mi nus: kha chu 'ong :snabs dang : gcin dang ngan skyugs kyis ni lus la gos: sgra ngar ngar po ni 'don: sman pas ni bor: mal gyi tha mar ni nyal: 'khor ba'i chu rgyun du ni nub: gshin rje'i mis ni 'jigs shing skrag:dbugs rgyu ba ni chad: kha dang sna ni gdangs: 'jig rten 'di ni 'dor: 'jig rten pha rol du ni 'gro: skyes chen po ni 'degs: mun nag chen por ni zhugasoḥ g.yangs chen por ni lhung : rgya mtsho chen pos ni khyer: las kyi rlung gis ni bdas: sa tshugs med pa'i phyogs su ni 'khyams: nor bgo 321

bsha' bya ba ni med: kyi hud pha: kyi hud ma: kyi hud bu+oḥ zhes ni zer te: de yi tshe rgyal po chen po chos ma gtogs pa skyabs mgon dang dpung gnyen ni gzhan med de: zhes gsungs: sdug pa dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal ni: pha ma bu tsha la sogs pa yid la gcags pa shi ba'i tshe: mya ngan dang : gdung ba dang : smre ngag dang : ngu 'bod la sogs pa sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa yod do: mi sdug pa dang 'phrad pa'i sdug bsngal ni: dgra sdang bas nyen pa'i tshe 'thab rtsod dang : brdeg btsog la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal mang po yod do: sdug bsngal phyi ma gnyis ni go sla'o: lha min la lha'i sdug bsngal dang cha mtshungs pa'i steng du nga rgyal dang phrag dog dang : 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal yod do: de ltar yang :lha min dag ni rang bzhin gyis lha yi: dpal la sdang phyir yid kyi sdug bsngal che: zhes gsungs:'dod khams kyi lha la yang lha min dang 'thab pa'i sdug bsngal dang : 'dod pas ma ngoms pa'i sdug bsngal dang : spa bkong ba'i sdug bsngal dang : bcad pa dang 'bral ba dang : gsod pa dang : sgyug pa dang : 'chi 'pho ba dang : de lta bu'i sdug bsngal myang bar 'gyur te: ji skad du: lha'i bu 'chi ba na ltas lnga 'byung bar 'gyur te: gos dri ma can du 'gyur: me tog gi phreng ba rnying par 'gyur: mchan khung gnyis nas rngul 'byung bar 'gyur: lus la dri nga ba 'byung bar 'gyur: rang gi stan la mi dga' bar 'gyur: zhes gsungs: bsam gtan pa rnams ting 'dzin gyis myos pa la sogs pa gnas ngan lan gyi sdug bsngal dpag tu med de: des na 'khor ba'i gnas 'di ni sdug bsngal chen po'i rang bzhin me 'bar ba'i khang pa lta bu yin no: dpal mgon byams pa'i zhal nas: sems can dmyal ba ngamyal sems nyams: yi dwags bkres shing skom pas nyams: dud 'gro gcig la gcig zas nyams:mi dag 'tsho ba thung bas nyams: lha dag bag med pa yis nyams: 'khor ba khab kyi rtse tsam la: bde ba nam yang yod ma yin: ces gsungs: ces pa 'di yang rig 'dzin chen po sangs rgyas gling pas gter tshab tu sbas pa yin nam bsam/ rngod hom 'phrang lcags kyi sgo mo'i g.yon zur nas rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying pos 'phral du gdan drangs pa'o/ / 322

gag /rdzogs pa chen po yang zab bla sgrub dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi khrid yig gu ru'i dgongs rgyan nyin byed snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ swaste/ na mo gu ru ā di bud+dha pad+ma pra bhā sa dz+wa la tsa ra ṇa ya/ /bla ma gdod ma'i sangs rgyas pad+ma 'od 'bar gyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdzogs pa chen po yang zab bla sgrub dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi khrid yig gu ru'i dgongs rgyan nyin byed snying po zhes bya ba dpal mgon rtsa ba'i bla mar phyag 'tshal lo /kun khyab spros bral ye shes chos kyi dbyings/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal lhun rdzogs bde ba che/ /phyogs dus cha med kun 'gro gdod ma'i mgon/ /sangs rgyas kun tu bzang por phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /srid zhi byang chub sems kyi phun tshogs ma lus dbyings gyur pa/ /gcig dang du ma'i spros bral chos nyid yongs grub rtag brtan khams/ /rgya chad phyogs lhung yongs bral mtshan dpe yongs rdzogs rdo rje'i sku/ /'od snang mtha' yas mgon po gang der 'dud do dge legs stsol/ /rgyal kun thugs kyi ye shes gcig tu 'khyil pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /don dam 'od gsal las skyes dmigs med brtse chen pad+mo'i dbus/ /rang byung rdo rje'i sku mchog rnam kun mchog ldan rnam pa thams cad pa/ /res 'ga' rdo rje slob dpon tshul shar mgon der snying nas 'dud/ /gang gi gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul 'ja' tshon ltar bkra snying po'i gar/ /'gro 'dul nus ldan bde gshegs mchog gi sa 'dzin rdo rje can/ /ye shes klong gsal sku gnyis snying po'i spyi dpal bde ba che/ /pad 'byung ngo bo bla mas bdag snying dbus su rtag rtsen mdzod/ /gang gi thugs sgrub rin chen mchog gyur brgya phrag du ma yi/ /snying po lta bu yang zab bsam 'phel yid bzhin nor bu ltar/ /dkon mchog rgyal ba spyi 'dus dgongs pa'i bcud gyur gsang ba che/ /man ngag khrid rim bla ma'i zhal lung gzhung don gsal ba zhig /bdag gi 'dren mchog chos 'dir rtag dgyes de yi zhabs tog ched/ /lam 'dir mos pa'i skal ldan rnams kyi yid kyi re skong du/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs mthu la brten nas 'bad pas bgyis pa 'di/ /don med ma yin don ldan phun tshogs rgyal ba'i btsas su sems/ /gzhan ni chos 'di 'dzin pas bod kun khengs/ /khrid 'chad po yang sde tshogs 'thug por gyur/ /des na bdag gi ngal bas ci bya yang / /lhag bsam dag pas brjod la skyon yod min/ /de yang dam pa'i chos tshul mtha' dag pa'i gal mdo rdo rje theg pa ma lus pa'i snying po sgrub 323

thabs thams cad kyi gnad dril ba/ yo ga gsum gyi dgongs bcud phyung ba yang gsang rdzogs pa chen po'i man ngag /dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ /rnal 'byor rig pa 'dzin pa mtha' dag gi dgangs nyams/ yang zab rmad du byung ba bla na med pa'i chos bla ma'i sgrub pa las khyad par du gyur pa rig 'dzin chen po 'ja' tshon snying pos rngod hom 'phrang lcags kyi sgo mo brag ri rdo rje gyen langs lta bu nas spyan drangs pa'i yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi khrid bka' zab mo bstan par bya ba la dpon slob gnas dus kyi rten 'brel legs par 'grigs pa'i skabs su khrid la 'jug par bya ste/ de la spyir sngon 'gro ba sbyor dngos thams cad kyi thun mgor bar chad zhi zhing byin rlabs 'jug pa'i chad du dben pa'i gnas bde ba'i gdan la lus gnad dkyus mthun bcas rlung ro lan gsum bsal nas sgo gsum gyi bar chad sdig sgrib zhi zhing dag par bsams la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du pad+ma 'byung gnas dang rtsa ba'i bla ma dbyer ma mchis pa'i ngo bo rig 'dzin r+ghaṃ nag me 'bar rab byung cha lugs paṇa zhu chos gos can phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'gyings stabs kyis 'dzin cing g.yon lcags kyi phur pa zur gsum gdengs pa zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dpung pa g.yas g.yon du ye shes kyi rang 'od 'ja' tshon gyi gshog pa bkra zhing / g.yas nas khro bo dang g.yon nas khro mo'i tshogs skar ltar 'phro ba/ shangs sgor yi ge a dkar po zla ba 'bum gyi 'od zer zil gyis gnon pa ye shes kyi rlung dang 'grogs te gnas pa/ de lta bu'i sku yi gnas gsum du o āḥhūṃ dkar dmar mthing gsum gyis spras shing sku'i 'od zer gyis rang gi tho phyi gnas yul thams cad gtams par bsams la/ ngag nas/ bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bla ma chos kyi sku la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bla ma sprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs so/ /skyabs mchog kun 'dus bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa myur du stsal du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba phur tshugs su 'debs shing oṃ āḥhūṃ ci rigs bzlas pa'i mthar dmigs med kyi ngang du dar cig mnyam par bzhag cing / de nas khrid thun gang rung la 'jug par bya ste sngon 'gro ba spyi'i chos so/ /bye brag sngon du 'gro ba la/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa dang khyad par gyi sngon du 'gro ba gsum mo/ /de rnams rim pa bzhin nyams len gyis rgyud sbyang par bya ste/ de yang thog mar thun mong gi sngon du 'gro ba sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i rten dal 'byor rin po che rnyed par dka' ba'i ngang tshul la sems pa dang / 'dus byas kyi chos thams cad mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin myur du 'chi ba'i ngang tshul bsams pa 324

dang / las rgyu 'bras kyi rang gzugs bslu ba med pas 'khor sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du gnas shing 'khor ba'i bde ba la yid brtan mi thub pa'i tshul la sems pa dang / des na gtan gyi bde ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bsgrub 'dod thun mong ma yin pa thar pa'i phan yon la nan tan du bsam pa sogs byang chub lam gyi rim pa skyes bu gsum gyi khrid spyi dang mthun par 'chad cing nyams su len pa gal che zhing / chos bka' 'di dang 'bral mtshungs sngon 'gro ba bzhi sbyor zhes gter ston sangs rgyas gling pas yang gter du btsas pa rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying pos bton pa de nyams khrid du byas pas kyang 'bral chags shing chos thun gyi rnam grangs ni rags rtsis su bzhi dang / gzhan ci rigs ltar skabs dang sbyar te bya'o/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon du 'gro ba la bzhi ste dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ rang nyid gang na gnas pa'i sa phyogs dag pa'i zhing khams su gyur pa'i mdun gyi bar snang gi mkha' la shin tu mdzes pa'i sprin kha dog lnga ldan gyis leg/sa par btegs pa'i steng du rin po che sna tshogs las byas pa pad+ma'i 'dab ma las 'dab ma 'bral pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus kyi ge sar ze'u 'bru'i steng du nyi zla'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer ma mchis shing / dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo pad+ma 'byung gnas mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku ber phod chos gos pad zhu rin chen rgyan cha can rdo rje bum thod kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'chang ba zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung du bzhugs shing 'od zer dpag med 'phro ba'i snying por gnas pa'i phyi rol pad+ma'i sa gzhi bang rim gyi rnam pa mtho dam na cung zad gyur pa'i rim pa gsum gyi dang po la/ kun tu bzang po 'od dpag med thod phreng sde lnga gu ru mtshan brgyad sogs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams mtshan dpe gzi brjid 'bar ba tshom bu'i tshul du bzhugs pa dang / pad+ma'i sa gzhi gnyis pa la/ yi dam drag po me'i phreng ba can dang rta phag yid bzhin nor bu la sogs pa'i bla med rnal 'byor bya spyod kyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus pa dang / pad+ma'i rim pa gsum par bcom ldan 'das ma seng ge'i gdong pa can sogs mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor bar bsam zhing / de ltar pad+ma'i gdan dbus kyi phyogs bzhir de dang ma mthun pa'i gdan re gnas pa'i mdun dbus su rgyal ba shākya seng ge la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chags bral mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i cha byad can bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / g.yas kyi dbus su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun gyi tshogs dang /g.yon gyi dbus su shā ri'i bu la nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i tshogs bgrang las 'das pas bskor ba/ rgyab kyi pad+mar rgyal ba'i gsung rab ma lus shing lus pa med pa dam pa chos kyi glegs 325

bam gaṅgā klung gi bye ma'i nyag ma bzhin bgrangs kyis mi langs shing ri rab kyi ngos ltar yangs shing brjid pa ā li kā li'i rang skad di ri ri sgrogs te gnas pa/ gzhi sprin gyi gseb nas lha'i bu dang / bu mo mang pos mchod sprin sna tshogs pa thogs nas skyabs yul mchod pa la brtson pa/ skyabs yul gyi mdun du khams gsum 'gro ba rigs drug nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyis bdag dang lhan cig par dus 'di nas bzung byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du skyabs kyi dam pa dkon mchog gsum la snying khong rus pa'i gting nas skyabs su 'gro ba'i lus kyi spyi bor thal mo pad+ma kha 'bus pa ltar sbyar zhing dag snyan cing 'jebs pas skyabs 'gro'i tshigs brjod par mos pa dang / khyad par bdag gis snying brtse bas sems can de rnams 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las myur du sgrol ba'i phyir skyabs su 'gro ba'i blo dung rtse gcig pas gnas/ o ā r+ghaṃ: skyabs gnas dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o: zhes gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig dang ཿོ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos: de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun nyid: bla ma dpal chen he ru ka: kun byed rgyal po bla ma yin: dkon mchog rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i gtso: gu ru rat+nar skyabs su mchi'o+oḥ zhes rgyud tshig gi mtha' cung zad gsos pa ste de ltar ci nus su brjod/ de nas thun bsdu ba'i skabs su/ skyabs yul rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dkar po byung bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can rnams la phog sdig sgrib dag lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur skyabs yul rnams la thim/ skyabs yul yang 'khor rnams gtso bor 'dus shing de yang gu ru la thim/gu ru yang 'od kyi gong bu nam mkha'i snying por thim par bsam la sems spros bral gyi ngang du rtsig nas mnyam par bzhag pa ni don dam pa'i skyabs 'gro'o/ /de ltar skyabs su 'gro ba'i dge ba bsngo smon gyis rgyas btab pa ni/ dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ bsngo ba'i mchog tu gang la bsngag sa pa des/ /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di kun kyang / /bzang po spyod pa'i phyir du bsngo bar bgyi/ /bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas nas/ skye rga na 'chi'i dba' rlabs 'phrugs pa yi/ /srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgrol bar shog /ces brjod do/ /nub mo nyal ba'i skabs su skyabs yul rnams ma bsdus pa'i mdun pad zla'i gdan la rang nyid nyal bar bsam pa ni skyabs 'gro'i dmigs pa'i yan lag go/ /des ni dkyus kyi khrid rim dmigs skor dang po ste skyabs 'gro'i khrid tshar/ mgyogs khrid skabs zhag gsum sogs ci ltar 'os pa skyabs 'gro la nan tan 'bad cing rjes su yang thun mgo thams cad du rgyas bsdus ci rigs ma chad par bya'o/ /skabs 'dir slob mas kyang 'chang pa'i don go zhing dgos pa dang bla mas kyang chos la 'chang nus shing gnyis kas 'chad nyan spro na skyabs su 'gro ba'i rnam bzhag phan yon sogs rgya cher bshad par bya ste/ sngar de 326

ma gos bas blo sna chos la ji bzhin ma zhugs/ da go bas blo sna chos la yang dag zhugs pa sogs dgos gal yang che ba yin/ gnyis pa sems bskyed pa'i khrid ni/ skyabs 'gro'i dmigs pa grub 'phral legs par bsam ste/ 'di ltar nam mkha'i mtha' mdzad pa med pa tha dag sems can gyis yongs su khengs shing de rnams bdag gi pha ma'i rang bzhin yin la kun gyis bde ba 'dod kyang de'i thabs la mi mkhas pas nyon mongs pa'i rgya mtshor bying zhing / sdug bsngal gyi me 'obs chen por ltung ba snying re rje/ /de rnams 'khor ba sdug bsngal las ci nas kyang bdag gis sgrol bar bya dgos la de'i ched du yang zab bla ma'i sgrub pa dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi man ngag rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la mchog tu 'bad de myur du sangs rgyas thob par bya snyam nas/ ngag tu/ rgyu drug 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i pha ma rnams: bzod med gdung bas sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir: kun kyang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: zhes ci nus bklag cing bar skabs rnams su bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad 'od zer zla ba'i zhun ma lta bur dbugs phar btang ba dang 'grogs te sems can rnams la phog bde ba mchog gi go 'phang brtas/ tshur dbugs rngub pa dang lhan cig sems can gyi sdig sgrib sdug bsngal ma lus pa dud 'tshubs kyi rnam pa lta bur 'dus nas bdag la thim/ bdag gis kyang lam zab mo yid la byas pas skad cig de ma thag tu byang bar bsam ste dbugs 'byin 'jug gi sgo nas dge sdig btang len gyi dmigs pa 'di rgyal sras rnams kyis bslab 'os mchog dang / phul du gyur pa yin na nan tan gyis 'bad par bya zhing / thun bsdu ba'i tshe dmigs med spros bral gyi ngang du ci gnas bzhag ste de ni don dam pa'i sems bskyed do/ /spyir dus rtag tu sems can thams cad bdag gi yid du 'ong ba 'ba' zhig bsam pa byams pa/ bdag gi shin tu gces pa'i bshes me la 'tshig pa blos mi bzod pa lta bu sems can thams cad la snying rje/ bu gcig pu g.yul du song nas rang gnas su log tshe yi sems la bde ba thob pa bzhin bdag gi yid la dga' ba bskyed pa/ gnas skabs kyi dgra gnyen sogs la yid brtan mi thub pa sgyu ma lta bur shes shing phyogs ris med par sems can gyi don spyod pa btang snyoms te/ de ltar tshad med bzhi la rtag tu sems shing bslab par bya ba yang gal che zhing / gzhan yang spyod lam kun tu mchod 'os mi bslu ba dang sems bskyed pa la mi smod pa dang / sems can la g.yo sgyu spong ba dang dge ba'i las la 'gyod pa skyed pa ste dkar po'i chos bzhi zhes de la yang nan tan chen pos rtag tu bslab par bya'o/ /mthar bsngo smon sogs kyang skyabs 'gro'i skabs ltar bya/ dmigs thun gnyis pa sems bskyed kyi khrid tshar/ 'di yang gong ltar zhag gsum sogs ji ltar rigs pa bsgom zhing / spyir skyabs sems gnyis ni chos spyod thams cad kyi sngon 'gro yin pas thun la 'jug res kyi sngon du bya ba gal che'o/ /'dir yang dgos shing nus pa 327

dang spro na byang chub sems kyi rnam bzhag smon 'jug tshad med bzhi phar phyin drug byang sems kyi bslab pa phan yon dang bcas rgyas par bshad do/ /gsum pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas kyi khrid ni/ thun mgo'i skyabs 'gro sems bskyed grub 'phral/ rang nyid tha mal du gnas pa'i spyi bo'i steng thad pad+ma dkar po'i snying po ge sar ze'u 'bru dang bcas shing de'i 'dab ma la 'dab ma 'bral ba'i pad 'dab tshad bzung las 'das pa nam mkha'i khyon yongs su khengs pa lta bu/ 'dab ma re re'i 'og tu sems can re re gnas shing 'dab ma re re bzhin dang ge sar ze'u 'bru'i snying por zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re dang / de re re'i steng du rigs thams cad 'dus pa'i bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' mtshan dpe yongs rdzogs phyag na rdor dril 'dzin cing rin po che dang rgyan gyi chas yongs su rdzogs pa sems dpa'i skyil krung can/ thugs kar zla steng r+ghaṃ mthar yi ge brgya pa'i phreng bas bskor ba de las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba rnams la sku gsum thugs dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ thugs rje byin rlabs thams cad sngags kyi 'khor lo'i rnam par spyan drangs/ thugs ka'i sngags 'khor la thim pas/ de las sku gsung thugs kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung /rdo rje sems dpa'i sku lus khangs nas ma shong lud pa'i tshul gyis ba spu'i bu ga dang zhabs kyi sor rtse nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs lus kyi nang thams cad khengs pas nad thams cad rnag khrag chu ser/ gdon thams cad shig sro sdom sdig sdig sgrib dud khu 'ja' tshon sngo dmar gyi rnam par bu ga dgu dang ba spu'i sgo nas thon/ sa rim pa dgu'i 'og tu song rang lus sha khrag rus pa ljan ljin dngos po dang bral ba phyi nang zang thal shel gyi gong bu lta bur bsams la yi ge brgya pa la nan tan du 'bad par bya ste/ de ltar rtsa ba gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig gis gsal btab pa ni/ rang nyid tha mal spyi gtsug tu: rigs 'dus rdor sems 'od kyi sku: dkar 'tsher rdor dril rin chen brgyan: skyil krung zhal 'dzum brtse ba'i nyams: thugs kar r+ghaṃ la yig brgyas bskor: 'o rgyun lta bu'i bdud rtsi bab: spyi gtsug rkang mthil yan chad kyi: nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dag: shel bum zho yis bkang ba ltaroḥ gsal stong ngang nas bzlas pa bya: o badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su toṣ+yo me bha wa/ su poṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sarba sirnyi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+t+waṃ/ shri yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wā na sarba ta tha ga ta badz+ra mā me muñtsa/ badzi bha wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa ā r+ghaṃ/ 'bum khri stong brgya nyer gcig bdun: rab 'bring tha ma rtags dang sbyar: zhes pa ltar ci nus bzlas shing thun mthar thal mo sbyar la/rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /rdo rje dang po kun tu bzang / /328

phyag 'tshal rdo rje sems dpa' la'o/ /zhes pas bstod/ mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis/ /dam tshig la ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ni/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi'o/ /zhes bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa nyes ltung bshags pas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal nas rigs kyi bu khyod kyi gtso byas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dus de ring nas dag go zhes bka' yi gnang ba byin nas rdo rje sems dpa'i mdzod spu dang thugs ka dang zhabs kyi mthe bong nas 'od zer byung bdag dang sems can rnams la phog sdig sgrib dag ste rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur/ rang gi spyi bo'i rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs kar thim/ 'dab ma la gnas pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' rnams pad+ma'i ze'u 'brur gnas pa'i rdo rje sems dpar thim/ de yang thugs ka'i zla ba sngags phreng r+ghaṃ yig la thim/ r+ghaṃ yig kyang thig le nā da'i mthar stong pa nyid la ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag de la ldang nas/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus la/ /thams cad de yi sa la 'khod par shog /ces dang gong bzhin bsngo smon gyis rgyab gdab/ /dmigs skor gsum pa rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas kyi khrid tshar/ 'di la long khyab dang ldan na sgom bzlas zla ba kha shas kyi bar du gnyug bsring zhing sdig sgrib dag pa'i rtags spyi dang mthun par dngos nyams rmi lam du yid ches thob pa yang yang ma byung gi bar nan tan du bya'o/ /mgyogs khrid skabs su yang 'di'i sgom bzlas zhag gsum mam bdun sogs ci ltar 'os par bya zhing khrid ma rdzogs kyi bar du thun dang po'i mgo ru sgom bzlas 'jur ba re chad par bya'o/ /skabs 'dir dgos nus spro na/ sdig pa'i nyes dmigs bshags sdom byed tshul/ sgom bzlas ci ltar bya ba'i tshul rgyas par bshad do/ /bzhi pa maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid ni/ skyabs sems sngon du song ba'i rjes thog tu/ de nas tshogs zhing skyabs yul lhar gsal btab pa'am/ yang na rin po che'i sa gzhi maṇ+ḍal bar snang du bzhag pa lta bu'i dbus su seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas sprul pa'i sku'i cha byad phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa de'i steng thad du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs longs spyod rdzogs pa a ro blaka gi cha byad can gangs chen mtsho'i bdag nyid can/ de'i spyi bo'i steng thad du dang po'i sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur ba dmar po rgyan med mnyam gzhag rdo rje'i skyil krung can/ de ltar sku gsum tho brtsegs su bzhugs pa la bla ma chos kyi sku'i mtha' bskor du rgyal ba dgongs brgyud sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku zhi ba dang khro bo dang zhi ma khro yab yum kha sbyor dang 'khyud pa dang rgod pa dang lta ba'i tshul can rgyud sde'i lha dang rdzogs chen ston pa bcu gnyis mchog gi sprul pa'i sku chags bral go zlog yum dang 329

bcas pa sogs dgongs brgyud bla ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la rig 'dzin brda brgyud rgyal ba sa bcu rgyun gyi tha ma la gnas pa'i tshul can 'jam dpal 'jig rten dbang phyug gsang ba'i bdag po sgrib pa rnam sel sogs rgyal sras thu bor grags pa rig 'dzin che mchog rnams dang / gzhan yang dag pa'i sa gsum la gnas pa'i 'phags tshogs rig 'dzin rgya mtshos bskor ba/ bla ma sprul pa'i sku la gang zag snyan brgyud mkha' 'gro gtad rgya bka' babs lung bstan smon lam dbang bskur byin rlabs rtogs pa'i brgyud pa sna tshogs kyis bskor ba ste rgya gar gyi rig 'dzin brgyad grub chen brgyad cu 'dzam gling rgyan drug bod kyi rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga/ sprul sku gter ston brgya rtsa sogs grub pa mchog gi sa la gshegs pa'i tshom bu 'bum sde bye ba phrag ji snyed pa dang dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs mkha' 'gro rgya mtshos bskor bar gsal zhing / de'i phyogs gzhir rin po che'i khri la mdun rgyab tu sangs rgyas dang dam chos/ g.yas g.yon theg pa che chung gi dge 'dun/ de rnams kyi mtha' bskor mu khyud kyi tshul du chos skyong srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams bzhugs te yod par bsams la/ de'i mdun du bdag dang sems can thams cad bya byed spyod lam mthun pas thog mar yan lag bdun 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ: chos rnams thams cad sku gsum rang bzhin loḥ gnyis med klong yangs chen por phyag 'tshal lo: ma bcos mtha' bral mnyam pa nyid kyis mchod: rang sems sangs rgyas ma rtogs mthol lo bshags: gnas lugs rang rig ngang du yi rang ngo : 'dzin med khyab gdal rol pa'i chos 'khor bskor: 'khor 'das dbyer med bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs: chos dbyings lhun grub chen por bsngo par bya: zung 'jug kun khyab bde chen mchog thob shog: ces bdun rnam par dag pa dang / de nas maṇ+ḍal lag tu blangs te rdul phyis pas bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dag par bsam/ de nas dri bzang gi chus brlan te byang chub sems kyis rgyud brlan par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra khyu mi āḥhūṃ/ zhes brjod cing me tog sil ma bkram pas maṇ+ḍal gzhi gser gyi sa gzhi yangs shing rgya che ba dri bzang chu yan lag brgyad ldan gyi rgya mtsho grub par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥr+ghaṃ/ zhes pas srin lag gi maṇ+ḍal mtha' bskor bas phyi rol rdo rje'i rwa ba mu khyud can gyis bskor bar bsam/ dbus su hūṃ zhes dri bzang chus thig le byas pas maṇ+ḍal gyi bgegs sbyangs shing bsrung bar bsam/ de nas ri gling mchod pa'i lha mo rgyal srid nyi zla sogs tshom bu bkod cing dag 'don ltar yid kyis gsal btab ste maṇ+ḍal rgyas par 'bul mthar/ sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis/ /'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /ces lan grangs ci nus su dkon mchog rtsa gsum spyi 'dus 'bul/ /de nas sku 330

gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/ gter gzhung rtsa ba yo ga gsum gyi sgrub thabs las/ maṇ+ḍal ni zhi khro sku gsum maṇ+ḍal sogs gang rung bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sprul sku gter ston chen po rang nyid kyis sngon 'gro ngag 'don du gong bzhin gyis 'bul te/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ: chos dbyings maṇ+ḍal rig pas brgyan pa 'di: bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku la 'bul: zhes pas bla ma chos sku dgongs brgyud sangs rgyas dkon mchog rnams la dmigs te 'bul/ rang lus maṇ+ḍal dbang pos brgyan pa 'di: bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la 'bul: zhes pas bla ma longs sku brda brgyud chos dkon mchog rnams la dmigs te 'bul/ rin chen maṇ+ḍal gser g.yus brgyan pa 'di: bla ma thugs rjes sprul pa'i sku la 'bul: zhes pas bla ma sprul sku snyan brgyud sogs theg pa che chung gi dge 'dun dkon mchog rnams la dmigs te 'bul/ de nas spyir dmigs la/ thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /gu ru rat+na maṇ+ḍal kai nir+ya ta yā rmā/ /zhes maṇ+ḍal gyi 'don don gsol ba gdab pa'o/ /de ltar bla ma sku gsum sku yi bkod pa tha dad las don gyi ngo bo tha dad dang bzang ngan gtan nas med pa shes dgos shing 'khor rnams kyang nyi ma dang 'od zer gyi tshul de dang de yi sgyu 'phrul gyi rol pa shar ba yin la/ chos skyong srung ma ye shes kyi spyan ldan rnams ni theg chen dge 'dun gyi nang tshan du 'du la/ yang na sku gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal yang spyi khyab tu 'bul ba shin tu legs par 'gyur bar yin no/ /'dir bshad pa'i dgongs brda snyan brgyud kyi rnam bzhag spyi dang mi mthun no snyam pa'i log rtog mi bya ste sangs rgyas sku gsum la dgongs brda snyan brgyud tshar re sbyor du yod pa sngags rnying ma'i gzhung rnam par dag pa nas 'byung na 'gal ba med pa'i legs bshad kho na yin no/ /de nas thun bsdu ba'i skabs su tshogs zhing rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros sems can rnams la phog pas sdig sgrib dag dag pa'i zhing du gshegs par gyur/ tshogs zhing 'khor rnams gtso bo la thim/ de yang gu ru'i sku la thim/ gu ru rin po che 'od kyi gong bur gyur te rang gi spyi bo nas mar zhugs/ bdag gi bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs shing gu ru'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med du gyur par bsam la ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag de nas dge ba sngo ba sogs spyi ltar bya/ /dmigs skor bzhi pa maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid tshar/ long khyab ldan na dmigs thun 'di la zla ba sogs bsod nams 'phel ba'i rtags nyams snang gsol po'am rmi lam yang yang btud mar ma byung gi bar du bya zhing dngos su yang rdor sems sgom bzlas dang 'di gnyis kar shes pa gsal zhing gnyid dang le lo chags sdang chung / rig pa dwangs/ nges 'byung skyo shas skye/ dad pa dang mos gus sar las che ba skye zhing brtan par 'gyur na khyad par gyi rtags so/ /mgyogs khrid skabs su zhag gsum sogs kyi rigs nyams su len zhing khrid ma tshar 331

gyi bar thun dang po'i mgor ma chags par nyams su len no/ /chos thun 'di'i skabs su yang dgos nus spro na maṇ+ḍal gyi tshul 'jig rten khams kyi rnam par gzhag pa dang / sku gsum maṇ+ḍal gyi go don yang dag pa tshogs bsags pa dgos pa'i tshul phan yon dang bcas pa rgyas par bshad do/ /gsum pa khyad par gyi sngon du 'gro ba ni/ rdo rje theg pa'i dgongs snying yang zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su len pa ste/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas rang nyid gnas pa'i sa phyogs dag pa'i zhing khams 'ja' zer 'od gur 'khrigs pa'i dbus su bdag lus yi dam lha'i sku ru gsal btab par bya ste/gter ston rig 'dzin mchog gi zhal gsungs yang zab kyi sngon 'gro rgyun khyer du yi dam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsgom par gsung zhing chos 'di 'dzin pa'i sprul pa'i skyes mchog khyad par can gzhan gyis kyang de dang mthun par mdzad pa shas che yang phyis byung kha cig gis gur drag byas pa yod kyang don mi phyugs mod/ 'on kyang 'di ni gter ston rin po che'i gsung rgyun kho na ltar bya ste/ de yang pad+ma dang nyi ma dang zla ba dang bam ro brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du rang rig pa'i ngo bo rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba chos sku ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku'i rnam par gyur ba ni sku mdog dmar ser o rgyan ga dza ni yi sid+dha ra'i kha dog lta bu zhi ma khro chags pa'i nyams can bzhad pa'i zhal tshems phreng dkar zhing mche ba'i myu gu bzhi gcigs pa/ spyan gsum nam mkhar hrig ge gzigs shing gzhon nu bcu drug lang tsho rgyas pa'i nyams can nu ma 'bur zhing gsang gnas rgyas pa/ phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rjes yu ba byas pa'i zangs gri ngom thabs su 'phyar ba/ g.yon dung chen khrag gis bkang ba thugs kar 'dzin cing zhal du gsol ba/ zhabs gar stabs g.yas bskum pa'i rting pa bha ga la gtad pa/ g.yon bskyang pas bdag med ro yi snying gar brdzis pa/ dbu skra ral pa dmar ser gyen du brjes pa'i dbus su phag zhal nag po rngams la brjid pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag rgya lngas mdzes shing dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ snyan cha gser gyi 'khor lo dril bus mtshan pa dang /phyag zhabs gser gyi gdu bu g.yer kha 'khrol ba/ blta bas mi bzod pa'i ye shes kyi 'od zer lnga dang me dpung gi dbus su bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i spyi bor pad nyi zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo gu ru pad+ma yid bzhin nor bu'i cha lugs can/ mtshan dpe lhun sdug gzi brjid 'od du 'bar zhing phyag mnyam gzhag yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'dzin cing spyan lta stangs ting nge 'dzin las g.yo ba med par bzhugs pa de'i steng nas yar la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams gdung tshug gam mtho brtsegs kyi tshul du bsgom par bya ste/ gter ston nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar rang rang gi brgyud tshul tha dad pa las 'dir rtsa ba'i bla ma'i spyi bo'i thad steng du pad nyi zla gdan la rig 332

'dzin chen po pad+ma bde chen gling pa sku mdog dmar smug stod g.yogs sngon po sham thabs dkar po mnab gzan dmar po gsol ba/ dbu la paṇa zhu mdzes pa/ phyag g.yas gnam lcags kyi phur ba dang g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba 'dzin pa/ de'i spyi bor pad nyi zla gdan la rig 'dzin klong gsal snying po sku mdog sngo sangs ag tshom brang gi rgya mdor snyegs pa/ spyan 'bru tshugs can/ dbu la ras dkar gyi la thod dang sku la 'dung dmar bzhes shing za 'og gi ber phyam gser gyi kha dog can gsol ba/phyag gnyis rdo rje dang sdig pa 'dzin pa'o/ /de'i spyi bor khrag 'thung bdud 'dul nus ldan rdo rje sku mdog dkar gsal spyan zim bus gzigs pa/ dbu la pad zhu pad+ma mthong grol dang / sku la phod ka dang sham thabs dkar po can/ za 'og gi ber phyam gsol ba/ phyag g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam gzhag thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba 'dzin pa'o/ /de'i spyi bor rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying po rab tu byung ba'i cha byad can sku mdog dkar smug dbu la pad zhu dang sku la chos gos gsol ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje 'gying thabs kyis 'dzin cing g.yon gnam lcags kyi phur pa gsor ba/ dpung pa na 'ja' tshon gyi gshog pa can/ de'i spyi bor pad nyi zla gdan la rgyal yum ye shes mtsho rgyal sku mdog dkar la sngo ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zar ma'i me tog lta bu dbu skra phyed gyen du bcings shing phyed thur du 'phyang ba za 'og gi 'dung gos rin po che'i rgyan du mas nye bar spras pa/ phyag mnyam gzhag thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba 'dzin pa'o/ /de'i spyi bor pad nyi zla gdan la slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas sku mdog dkar dmar mtshan dpe yongs su rdzogs pa rgyan cha lugs spyi dang mthun pa/ de'i spyi bo'i thugs rje chen po gangs chen mtsho kha sar pa ṇi'i cha byad can/ de'i spyi bor kun bzang snang ba mtha' yas sku mdog dmar po gcer bu phyag mnyam gzhag zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung can/ rang 'od 'od gsal phyag rgya chen mo la 'khyud pa/ de thams cad kyang gzi brjid mchog tu 'bar zhing gnas gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje gcig tu bsdus pa'i rang bzhin oṃ dkar āḥdamar rdu mthing gsum gyis mtshan pa/ sku 'od khyim thig le 'ja' tshon gyi dbus su bzhugs pa'i mtha' bskor du sangs rgyas byang sems rig 'dzin grub thob yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams gangs kyi ri bo la sprin gyi phung po gtib pa lta bur bzhugs par bsam zhing / rgyun khyer gyi ngag 'don tshigs bcad gter ston gyi zhal gsungs kyis gsal btab pa ni/ e ma hoḥ rang lus 'od phung rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /mdangs gsal me 'od gsal stong lhag ge'i ngang / /phyogs mtshams nam mkha' 'ja' 'od zer gyi klong / /spyi bor bla ma pad 'byung spyan ras gzigs/ /rigs kyi bdag po snang ba mtha' yas dang / /gzhan yang mdo rgyud bstan bcos man ngag sogs/ /rgya bod mkhas grub bla ma thams cad bzhugs/ /de la yid rtse gcig mos 333

gus kyi gdung shug drag po bskyed nas de'i mdun du rang gi lus longs spyod dus gsum gyi dge rtsa dang bcas te ltos pa med par ling gis 'bul zhing legs nyes skyid sdug ci mdzad khyed shes/ skyabs dang re sa gzhan na med do snyam pa'i blo dung dung pos phur tshug ner tshug gi sgo nas gsol ba gdab par bya ste/de yang gsol 'debs rgyun khyer gyi rnal 'byor las byung ba ni/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ/ thog ma'i sangs rgyas kun bzang snang ba mtha' yas/ /gangs can mgon po kha sar pa ṇi dang / /'ja' lus snang srid dbang sdud pad+ma 'byung / /yang sprul rig 'dzin snying po'i mtshan can la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /ka dag lhun grub gzhi thog phebs pa dang / /khregs chod thod rgal lam la rtsal 'byongs te/ sku dang ye shes dbyer med mngon gyur zhing / /mtha' yas 'gro kun sprul pas 'dren par shog /ces gter ston gyi zhal gsungs te 'phri bsnan med par de kho na bzhin bklags la/ gzhan bla ma brgyud rim gyi gsol 'debs gong du yod pa ltar skabs 'dir sbyar bar bya la/ mthar mos gus stobs kyis bla ma brgyud rim rnams gong ma 'og ma la rim par mthar rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ de sku gzi brjid 'od du 'bar zhing thugs brtse bas bdag la dgongs te byin gyis brlab par bsams nas tshig bdun gsol 'debs dang / oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsirnyi pha la hūṃ āḥ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi hūṃ: zhes sems gzhan la ma yengs par mos gus kyi shugs bskyed la brgya rtsa sogs ci nus bzla/ de yang rig 'dzin 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ bsnyen dus bla ma spyi bor bsgom/ /gsol 'debs tshul du dzapra 'di bzla/ /zhes gsungs pa'i man ngag gi snying po yang 'di kho nar 'du'o/ /de nas bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od zer zla ba zhun ma lta bu rang gi dpral bar thim pas/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag /sa brgyad pa mi g.yo ba non/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku thob pa'i skal ba can du gyur/ lam dus su bskyed rim ma hā yo ga'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang bar gyur/ mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer mar me'i rtse mo lta bu byung / bdag gi mgrin pa thim pas/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ngag gi sgrib pa dag /sa dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros non/ 'bras bu longs sku thob pa'i skal ba can du gyur/ lam dus su rdzogs rim a nu yo ga ste rang byin gyis brlab par bsgom pa la dbang bar gyur/thugs ka'i r+ghaṃ las 'od zer spos reng gi dud pa lta bu byung ba bdag gi snying khar thim/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin non/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku thob pa'i skal pa can du gyur/ lam dus su a ti yo ga ste dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgom pa la dbang bar gyur/ sku yi gnas lnga ka nas 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan nam mkha' nas 'ja' shar ba lta bu byung / bdag gi gnas lngar thim/ bzhi pa ye shes chen po'i dbang thob/ sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa dag thob bya bcu gcig kun tu 334

'od kyi sa dang 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas/ lam dus su a ti yang gsang rdo rje snying po rdzogs chen bya rtsol bral ba'i don ka dag lhun grub kyi ye shes bsgom pa la dbang bar gyur/ de nas bla ma rang gi tshangs pa'i bu ga nas mar byon/ /snying pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su bzhugs shing sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs nas bdag gi lus mer gyis khengs/ de mtha' bla ma yang bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin 'od du zhu/ bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum dang bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed par ro mnyam thig le nyag gcig tu gyur par bsams la rig pa stong gsal du ci gnas mnyam par bzhag /yang gong ltar bskyar zhing yang nas yang du bsgoms pa la nan tan du bya/ thun mthar/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /bdag gi snying khar pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru la/ /'bral ba med par rtag tu bzhugs nas kyang / /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / /'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing / /sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang myur thob shog /dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /dpal ldan bla ma 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /thams cad de yis sa la 'khod par shog zhes pa sogs bsngo smon bzang pos rgyas btab/ dmigs skor lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid tshar/ 'di ni byin rlabs kyi 'jug sgo dge sbyor skye ba'i rten khyad par can yin pas lo dang zla ba sogs yun ci ring du nyams su len pa gal che zhing / mgyogs khrid kyi skabs su yang gzhan las 'di cung zad gnyug bsrings te bya/ khrid mthun 'dzin pa'i thun mgo kun tu ci rtsogs re ma tshad par byed/ 'di skabs su bla ma'i mtshan nyid slob mas bsten tshul dam tshig gi rnam bzhag mos gus kyi phan yon/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor la 'bad dgos tshul rnams slob mas sngar ma thos shing mi shes na ci nus kyis bshad par gces so/ /de ltar sngon du 'gro ba'i rim pa rnams gter gzhung rtsa ba lta sgom spyod gsum gyi gzhung khrid las/ rgyas par khrid tshul ni/ 'byung ba lnga las grub pa'i mi lus gtsang ma la: bde gshegs snying po bya ba de yod pas: de la 'chi ba mi rtag pas bskul te gdod bya dang long spyod thams cad sgyu ma'am mi lam ltar shes par byas: gar skyes gar gnas thams cad sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig tu go bas las rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa la 'phrig tshud cing skyabs 'gro dang yig brgya la rtags thon par nyams len skyong : byang chub mchog tu sems kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin par bskyed de rgyu tshul khrims gtsang ma la bslab: smon 'jug tshang ba'i sgo nas bla ma mtshan ldan la gsol ba 'debs kyin bka' sgrub: ces pas khrid kyi sngon 'gro rnams nges par bstan cing de bzhin gter ston rig 'dzin chen po rang nyid kyis skal ldan slob ma'i ngor rgyud kyi yang 'grel mdzad pa'i khrid kyi rkang sdom las/ khyad par du zab khrid dang bstun na/ dang po yid ches khungs btsun lo rgyus 335

rnams bka' 'grel dang rnam thar nas bshad/ sngon 'gro thun mong ni/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang /'chi ba mi rtag pa dang / las rgyu 'bras bslu med/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ thar ba'i phan yon rnams zhus lan nas bshad cing / de'i rgyab chos su pad+ma thang yig dang rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i rnam thar la sogs so so'i skabs dang bstun la bshad do/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la skyabs sems/ yig brgya/ maṇ+ḍal bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams ma hā yo ga'i bskyed rim nas bshad/ gong du bstan pa bzhin du sngon 'gro rnams rtags thon par bya'o/ /zhes pas sngon 'gro'i sa bcad gsal bar phyes pa bzhin/ de'i ngag 'don/ skyabs sems/ yan lag bdun pa/ rdor sems/ maṇ+ḍal gyi go rim yo ga gsum gyi sgrub thabs dbur bzhugs pa dang rgyud kyi bka' 'grel ri rgyal lhun por skyabs 'gro phyi nang gsang gsum/smon 'jug don dam gyi sems bskyed/ gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba'i sdom bzung dam bca' tshul/ yan lag bdun pa maṇ+ḍal yig brgya sgom bzlas bsngo smon gyi rnam bzhag bla ma bsgom pa'i phan yon rnams mdo rgyud lung 'dren bcas rgyas par bkral zhing / mdo don nyang ban gyi zhus lan du/ gu ru'i zhal lung lhug par stsal ba sogs rdo rje'i gsung gis legs par zin pa de rnams kyi dgongs don/ sgom rim gnad rags pa rnams bsdus te 'dir bshad pa yin la/ gzhan gyi gdul bya'i blo yi bab dang mthun par dmigs pa'i rnam grangs du mar 'gyur ba yang go zhing rtogs par bya'o/ /gzhan yang sngon du 'gro ba 'di rnams sgo gsum gyi dge sbyor dang 'grus par bya ba shin tu gal che ste/ yang 'grel le'u bzhi pa'i bshad pa las/ sgrub pa phyi nang gsang ba de nyid las mtha' dang bcas par/ mdor na bskyed rim rdzogs rim gang dang gang la 'jug kyang rab kyi sngon 'gro la/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang / sems bskyed dang / phyag 'bum ste/ yig brgya 'bum ste/ maṇ+ḍal 'bum sde/ gsol 'debs 'bum sde la sogs sngon du song na/ dngos gzhi shugs kyis bsgrub pa rnams bar chad med cing rtags myur du thon pa dang / sgrub thabs su ci ltar gsungs pa bzhin du 'bras bu 'byin nus so/ /de ni gu ru rin po che'i zhal lung /bdag 'ja' tshon pas nyams myong nges pa can du lags/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ji bzhin lag len du gdab pa gal che la/ lar ni sngon 'gro'i yon tan cha shas zhig rgyud la ma skyes na dngos gzhi'i yon tan rgyud la skye bar mi 'gyur bas/ sngon 'gro la nan tan du byed pa shin tu gces so/ /'dir smras pa/ gu ru'i thugs sgrub gdams ngag snying po'i don/ /bla ma'i bka' las gsal bar phyes pa gang / /sngon 'gro'i rim pa legs par bshad pa'i gtam/ /'dis kyang thar 'dod gsos su cis mi 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho brgal 'dod rnams kyi gru/ /rnyed dka'i dal 'byor myur du mi rtag 'jig /skyo bas bsam bzhin dge sdig las 'bras gzhig /thar mchog lam la da res cis mi 'gyur/ /mchog la skyabs 'gro 336

dman la snying brtse ba'i/ gdams pa 'di ni rgyal kun 'jug sgo yin/ /sgrib sbyong tshogs bsags tshegs chung don che ba/ /yig brgya maṇ+ḍal 'di yang rmad byung nyid/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gshegs shul snying po'i chos/ /med thabs med pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor te/ /ye shes 'pho ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bebs 'di/ /skal ldan snying gi bum par cis mi 'dzin/ /tshul 'dir spyod rnams tshe ldan 'bras yod de/ /myur lam dbang gis ring min bde ba'i btsas/ /tshogs gnyis lhun grub nor bu thob des na/ /kun gyis spro bzhin 'bad pas bsgom par shog /ces rdzogs chen yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi khrid yig gu ru'i dgongs rgyan nyin byed snying po'i sngon du 'gro ba bshad pa'i skabs te dang po'o/ /rgyal kun ye shes rang gzugs rdo rje'i sku/ /mtshan dpe yongs rdzogs 'od 'bar thod phreng rtsal/ /ma byas lhun rdzogs chas gsum zung 'jug phyag /rdo rje thod pa 'chang der phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /de nas da ni spyi don gnyis pa khrid rim dngos gzhi ston par byed pa la yang gter gzhung rtsa bar ma hā a nu a ti yo ga gsum dang lta sgom spyod pa gsum gyi khrid rim gtum mo 'pho ba rnams rim par bstan pa las/'dir de rnams kyi dgongs pa khrigs su bsdebs nas bstan na sprul sku lam du byed pa sku rdo rje ma hā yo ga ltar bskyed rim bsgom bzlas ting nge 'dzin gyi khrid/ longs sku lam du byed pa gsung rdo rje a nu yo ga ltar rdzogs rim thabs lam tsaṇ+ḍa lī yi khrid/ chos sku lam du byed pa thugs rdo rje a ti yo ga ltar rdzogs chen ka dag khregs chod phyi khrid/ ngo bo nyid sku lam du byed pa ye shes rdo rje yang gsang bla med rdo rje snying po ltar lhun grub 'od gsal thod rgal gyi khrid de/ de ltar rdo rje bzhi yi khrid spyi don bzhir bzhag ste dbang bzhi'i las rim dang gung mthun par 'chad pa yin la/ de yang khrid zhu slob ma rnams dngos gzhi la 'jug pa'i skabs 'dir gsang sngags bla med spyi'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba tshul ldan dang /bye brag yang zab bla ma'i byin rlabs rtsa ba'i dbang bzhi bum pa thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ rdo rje sems dpa'i me long la brten pa tshig gi na yam tsam ma yin par ting nge 'dzin gsal zhing brda don 'phrod pa thob par byed pa ni sngags kyi 'jug sgo med thabs med pa yin pas nges par gal che la/ de bzhin sgrub pa lung byin glegs bam dbang dang srung ma'i gtor ma dbang yang bskur/ de nas bskyed pa'i khrid la dngos dang rjes 'bral gnyis/ de'i dang po la yang ting nge 'dzin rnam pa gsum gyi gzhi bzung ba/ phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang gi sgrub pa'i gzhung bsrang ba/ phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i kha tshang gdab pa/ tshe yi sgrub pas mtha' rgyas su byed pa ste bzhi'o/ /de la dang po ni/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su bde pa'i stan la 'khod de skyabs sems bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs sngon du 'gro ba'i rim pa rnams grub par byas shing de 'phral lus bsam gtan gyi chos dang mthun pa mig lta stangs g.yo med dang thog mar rlung ro legs par 337

bsal la/ de rjes rang bab tu glod/ de nas ting 'dzin rnam gsum gyi dang po mnyam par bzhag pa de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ni/ thog mar rdo rje'i tshig 'dis gsal btab ste/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ: 'di ltar snang srid gnyis bsdus chos rnams kun: ye nas stong zhing nam mkha' lta bu la: byed spyod blang dor 'dzin pa'i mtha' las 'das: zhes ngag tu brjod nas de yi don 'di ltar bdag gzhan 'khor 'das snang srid gnyis bsdus kyi chos rnam par shar ba kun ye nas stong zhing spros pa dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu de la skye 'gag gnas pa dang rgyu rkyen 'bras bu las 'das pa gdod ma'i khams rnam par dag par chos kyi dbyings 'dus ma byas pa'i rang bzhin 'od gsal stong nyid gzung 'dzin bya byed spang blang mtha' las 'das pa nyid du shes par byas nas/ rnam rtog gsum bral stong nyid 'od gsal gyi ngang du ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag pa ste dmigs thun dang po'o/ /gnyis pa mnyam ldang kun tu snang gi ting nge 'dzin ni/ gong gi stong nyid las ldangs nas nga rgyal bzung ba'i tshul gyi rdo rje'i tshig 'dis bstan te/ pad+ma saṃ bha bdag ni de ltar smra: dharma dhā tu su bhā wa āḥr+ghaṃ: zhes brjod/ de yang sems can rnams kyi khams glo bur mi gtsang ljan ljin gyi dbus su gdod nas rnam par dag pa chos khams ka dag bde gshegs snying po rnyog bral pad+ma ltar ma skyes rang byung yon tan kun ldan du gtsang rtag bde ba'i rang bzhin bdag med pa don dam pa'i bdag lhan skyes ye shes kyi ngo bo ni nam yang bri gang med par de ltar gnas zhes dpe tshig smra brjod las 'das kyang thabs la mkhas pas de ltar tshig gis smra ba ste/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams ma rig gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i snang bar zhen pas khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la spyod pa snying re rje/ de ltar na yang de rnams rnam par dag pa chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pas glo bur dri ma mtha' dag bsal nas bral 'bras chos sku la cis kyang bkod par bya snyam pa'i dmigs med snying rje sgyu ma lta bu la sems ci gnas su bzhag dmigs thun gnyis pa'o/ /de ltar dmigs thun de gnyis po mgyogs khrid kyi skabs su gcig tu bsdams pas dngos gzhi bskyed rim lha khrid kyi dmigs skor gcig pa'o/ /gsum pa mnyam langs zung 'jug rgyu las 'bras bu lha skur ldang ba rtsa ba rags pa'i tshul du gsal btab pa dang yan lag phra zhib kyi tshul du bstan par bsgom pa gnyis las dang po gter gzhung rdo rje tshig gis gsal btab pa ni/ trīḥ bdag nyid tha mal rang sems bzo med 'di: dkon mchog spyi 'dus pad+ma 'od 'bar sku: zhes pa ste/ de yang rgyu yi rkyen rgyal ba thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gnyis su med pa ye shes rdo rje'i rang sgra hrīḥzhes gzhom med nā da'i dbyangs kyis bskul bas gong du bshad pa ltar ma rig pa'i chas bsdus pa'i gzung 'dzin gyi bdag 'khor dang bcas pa spangs pa'i chos dbyings 338

kyi bdag 'khor 'das thams cad la khyab ste bzhugs pa'i ngo bo nyid 'gro ba rnams kyi chos khams tha ma la gnyug ma zhes ma bcos rang byung byang chub sems kyi gshis lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes sangs rgyas dang sems can gyis gsar du bzo bcos kyis bzang ngan byar med pa 'di ka rnam pa kun mchog dang ldan pa'i stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po'i skur shar ba ste/ de yang ye shes kyi rang mdangs mtha' dang mu med pa'i 'od zer 'byams klas pa'i klong du rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur me 'od mtshon cha 'phro ba'i dbus su bde stong zung 'jug rdo rje btsun mo'i mkha'i rang bzhin pad dkar zla ba'i gdan la rig pa'i ngo bo dkon mchog yongs kyi spyi dpal ku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi 'dzad rgyan gyi 'khor lo gcig tu 'dus pa'i bdag nyid/ dmigs med snying rje bde ba chen po'i pad+ma rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid 'od gsal zung 'jug tshad med pa'i yon tan mchog tu 'bar ba bla ma yid bzhin nor bu thun mongs dang khyad par gyi mtshan dpe yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku de yang / bdag nyid 'gyur med ye nas rdo rje'i sku:zhes pa ltar gdod nas rang byung lhun grub chen por gnas pa la rang gsal gdab pa'i tshul gyis snang stong sgyu ma lta bur skad cig mar wal gyis bskyed la ci gnas su bzhag dmigs thun dang po'o/ /de ltar ting 'dzin gsum gyi gzhung gter byon rdo rje'i tshig phal rnams kyis cung zad rtogs bka' bar snang bas 'bru bkral te don gyi gnad gsal bar phyes pa yin la/ gzhan yang ting 'dzin gsum gyis mar sbyang bya 'khor ba'i skye 'chi bar do'i bag chags dag par byed cing / yang sbyangs 'bras sku gsum gyi gsos 'debs shing / bar rnal 'byor sad rmi gnyid 'thug sgyu lus 'od gsal zung 'jug gi lam du byed cing / mthar thug sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje sgrub pa'i tshul khyad par can te/ zhib par gzhung don bla ma'i zhal lung mnyan par bya la rang lugs sngags kyi spyi gzhung chen po rnams su/ ston pa chen po dang snying rje sgyu ma dang phyag rgya gcig pa zhes gsungs pa yang 'di dang gnad don gcig pa kho na yin no/ /gnyis pa yan lag phra zhib kyi tshul du bstan par bsgom pa la/ thog mar rdo rje'i tshig ngag nas brjod de sems la gsal btab pa ni/ dkar gsal mdangs lnga mdzes 'dzum rgyan gyis spras: rdo rje thod pa tshe bum rin chen brgyan: pad zhwa rgod ldem kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yon nas 'khril: phod ka chos gos za 'og ber phyam can: mtshan dpe rab rgyas 'od kyi dkyil 'khor mdzes: mnyam nyid bde chen 'khyil pa'i skyil krung bzhugs: 'od kyi lus la ye shes snying po can: gsal stong thugs rje'i 'od zer kun la snyoms:mkha' 'gro 'ja' sprin rnam mang 'khrigs pa'i dbus: sku yi sprul pas zhing khams yongs la khyab: nam mkha'i lus can gar yang thogs pa med: bde gshegs kun gyi bkod pa sku la rdzogs: kun kyang rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor zang thal la: bgegs dang bar chad ces bya'i ming yang mod: snang stong sgyu ma tsam 339

du gsal bar bskyed: zhes brjod la gu ru rin po che'i sku mdog nyams 'gyur rgyan cha phyag mtshan cod pan khyad par gyi phyag rgya na bza' mtshan dpe ye shes kyi 'od snang dag sbyor bcas zhabs kyi bzhugs tshul gdan yang de yi shugs kyis bstan pa sku dang ye shes zung du 'jug cing phrin las kyi tshul 'khor tshogs tshom bu bkrags gsal 'thug po dang bcas gsal bar bsgom zhing / de yang sku gsum gyi rol pa sprul pas gdul bya yongs la khyab pa/ chos sku mkha' khyab spros bral gdal pa chen po/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor longs spyod mtha' dag sku la rdzogs pa/ sku gsum dbyer med ngo bo nyid sku zang thal snang srid dag pa'i dkyil 'khor can ltar snang sgyu ma lta bur gsal btab pa nan tan du bya dgos te dmigs thun gnyis pa'o/ /dmigs thun de gnyis po mgyogs khrid kyi skabs su gcig tu bsdams pas
