dngos gzhi bskyed rim lha khrid kyi dmigs skor gnyis pa'o/ /de ltar bskyed pa'i rim pa la mtshan nyid gsum gyis legs par bsgrub pa bya dgos te/ de yang rnam pa gsal ba nga rgyal brtan pa/ rnam dag dran pa gsum ste de rim pa cig car ci nus su nyams len bya la/ de yi dang po rnam pa gsal ba ni/ res pad dkar zla gdan nas rgod ldem gyi bar du gsal btab cing / ris rgod ldem nas gdan gyi bar du gsal btab/ res thugs ga nas phyag sor rtse dang /phyag sor nas thugs ka'i bar thog mar sku dang rgyan cha lugs chas re re nas gsal btab cing mthar me long ngos la tsagli'i gzugs gcig car du 'char ba bzhin cha med kun 'gro rnam pa shin tu gsal ba la thog mar yun thung grangs mang dang mthar yun ci ring gsal bzhin du bsgom pa ste dmigs thun gcig go/ /nga rgyal brtan pa ni/ rang gi rigs rus gzugs brnyan ming gi bla btags kyi 'dzin rtog yongs su spangs te lha sku'i rnam pa gsal mi gsal ji ltar yang gzi brjid 'od dpag tu med pa'i ngo bo gu ru pad+ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi bdag nyid nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal dang / de bzhin sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu gcig tu bsdus pa'i spyi dpal bdag nyid do snyam pa'i sems brtan por bzung ba ste dmigs thun gnyis pa'o/ /rnam dag dran pa la/ sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs kyi rnam dag dang / lha sku gsal stong zung 'jug don dam gnyis kyi rnam dag dran pa ste gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ de yang mngon rtogs kyi 'don tshig re re bzhin don la sems na dri ma mtha' dag spang ba chos dbyings rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal bas sku mdog dkar zhing rnyog bral gsal la dwangs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes rang gdangs ye shes bzhi lhan skyes rang chas su snang ba'i mtshon don dang gu ru pad+ma rgyal ba rigs lnga gcig tu 'dus pa gsang chen rigs gcig gi ngo bor 340

grub pa'i brdar shel gyi 'od mdangs nang na gnas pa'i kha dog bzhin zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dkar gsal la blta bas mi bzod pa'i 'od mdangs lnga rnam par 'gyur/ byang chub sems kyis gdul bya'i yid 'phrog pas mdzes pa dmigs pa med pa'i snying rjes 'gro la chags pa'i tshul gyis 'dzum pa/ 'dod yon ma spang rkyen du shar ba rin chen du ma'i rgyan gyis spras pa ste/ dkar gsal mdangs lnga mdzes 'dzum rgyan gyis spras/ zhes gsungs pa'i ngag sbyor snying po tsam smos pa de yis dper mtshon te/ snang stong sgyu ma tsam du gsal bar bskyed: ces pa'i bar spro zhing nus na tshig so so'i don dag sbyor byas na legs par 'gyur mod kyang 'dir yig tshogs mang por byung dogs nas ma spros pa gnas skabs mdo don sa bon tsam smos na/ de yang chos thams cad thig le nyag gcig gi zhal/ bden pa gnyis kyi phyag /thabs dang shes rab kyi zhabs 'khor 'das mnyam nyid rdo rje skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ srid pa'i skyon gyis ma gos pa shes rab rang 'od gsal ba'i sku mdog dkar po/ zhi ba la mi gnas pa thugs rje 'gro la chags pa'i sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags shing ye shes kyi 'od lnga rnam par 'gyur ba/dbyings rig 'du 'bral med pa rdo rje'i spyan thad dkar gzigs shing tshad med pa'i thugs rje zhal gyi dkyil 'khor lta bas chog mi shes pa/ pha rol phyin pa drug gi yon tan ma lus rdzogs pas mtshan dang dpe byad kun nas rgyas pa/ cir snang ye shes kyi rgyan du shar bas rin po che'i rgyan chas spras pa/ bslab pa gsum gyi yon tan yongs su rdzogs pas chos gos gsum dang / chos nyid 'gyur ba med cing nye lam gyis sems can sgrol bas phod mthing gsang gol dang / ye shes lnga la dbang sgyur ba'i za 'og gi ber phyam gsol ba/ sku gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs rje phrin las yon tan rtsal rdzogs su dbang bskur ba'i pad zhwa rgod ldem can dgu la bzhes pa/ chos kyi dbyings stong pa nyid rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin brnyes pas phyag g.yas thugs kar rdo rje dang / mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i brdar thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba dang / bdud bzhi mtha' dag gtan nas bcom pas 'chi med tshe'i bum pa don gnyis lhun grub yid bzhin nor bu'i kha rgyan can phyag g.yon mnyam gzhag gis 'dzin pa/ dug gsum ye shes gsum du sgrol ba'i brdar kha ṭ+wāṃ ga kha bye ba kha sbyor sogs yan lag bdun dang ldan pa mtshon phyir gru mo g.yon na 'chang ba/ spros pa'i mtha' thams cad las 'das pa chos kyi sku las ma g.yos bzhin sems can gyi don mdzad pa sku lus drang por nyid du sku dang zhing khams ye nas 'du 'bral med par 'ja' 'od thig le'i dbus su bzhugs pa sogs te rang rgyud kyi zhen pa bzlog phyir rnam dag de ltar dran par bya'o/ /dmigs thun gsum pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni de ltar lha sku bsgoms pa de yang a 'thas gdos bcas kyi phung por sgom pa ni smos kyang ci 'tshal te/ tha mal rang snang gi zhen pas kyang bcing bar mi bya la/341

de yang yang dag par ni 'dus byas yongs su 'das pa chos nyid dbyings me long lta bu'i ye shes can rang mdangs pra phab pa'i gzugs brnyan ltar rnam pa thams cad pa snang la rang bzhin med pa chos kyi sku 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi gzugs rang snang dag pa'i 'khor lo rgyun mi 'chad cing / smon lam dbang gis gzhan snang du gzugs kyi sku sgyu ma tsam du shar ba rnam kun mchog ldan zab gsal dbyer med kyi ngo bor mi 'gyur bde chen gdod nas lhun grub nyid du rang shar rang gsal ba bskyed bya skyed las 'das kyang gnas skabs re zhig de nyid lam byed ltar snang tshul tsam du bskyed pa yang don gyi ngo bo de ltar yin pa rtogs dgos mod/ 'on kyang re zhig las dang po bas de ltar ji bzhin khong du ma chud tshe lha sku snang yang rang bzhin stong pa zhen med sgyu ma tsam du chu snod dang me long gi gzugs brnyan ji bzhin gsal bar bskyed par bya ste/ de yang sems nyid stong pa lha skur shar zhing lha sku'i ngo bo sems nyid stong pa las gzhan du ma gyur pa shes pa de ni dag dran thams cad kyi snying po yin la/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig las/snang stong sgyu ma tsam du gsal bar bskyed: ces dang / shes rab snying po las/ gzugs stong pa'o/ /stong pa nyid gzugs so/ /gzugs las kyang stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin no/ /stong pa nyid las kyang gzugs gzhan ma yin no/ /zhes pa'i dgongs don te/ de lta bu'i don la nan tan gyis khong du chud par bya'o/ /dmigs thun bzhi pa'o/ /de ltar dmigs thun bzhi mgyogs khrid kyi skabs su thun chen gcig tu bsdams pas dngos gzhi'i bskyed rim gyi dmigs skor gsum pa'o/ /de ltar gsal dran dag pa gsum ni mgyogs khrid skabs go nges pa dang / slar nan tan gyis bsgom pa rtags thon byed pa gal che la/ 'di bskyed rim gyi khrid thams cad la khyab pa'i spyi chings yin pas 'og nas 'byung ba'i drag po dang seng gdong ma la sogs par yang lha rang rang gi ngo bo sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs gsal btab tshul dang / de'i dag dran khyad par ba tha dad las gzhan rigs 'gre nyid du sbyor dngos la der ma zad/ yi dam bskyed rim gzhan mtha' dag la yang tshul 'di'i rgyas gdab tshul shes par bya'o/ /de yan chad bskyed rim gyi gzhi gal che shos yin pas gnad don ci rigs kho bos gsal bar phyes te bshad pa yin no/ /da ni spyi don gsum pa phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang gi sgrub tshul gzhung bsrang ba la/ de yang dang po phyi sgrub ltar ni/ rang nyid gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas su gsal ba'i gnas rtse mo ro 'dus dran bkod du sgrib pa gsum gtan nas spangs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i bdag nyid yi ge 'bru gsum du byin gyis brlabs pa oṃ āḥrgyu bai ḍūr+ya dang pad+ma rā ga dang in+d+ra nī la ltar dwangs gsal dkar dmar sngo ba'i 'od zer 'phro zhing gsal ba la yun ci gnas su sems gtad/ de nas rang 342

gi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu'i dbyibs can nam mkha'i khams khyab cing khengs par 'phros/phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' nyan rang gi 'phags pa dgra bcom ye shes spyan ldan dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi thugs kar thog pas thams cad gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rnam par gyur te/ da yang dkon mchog rtsa gsum thams cad kyi sku'i dbyings su bsdus pa'i yon tan byin rlabs nus mthu ma lus pa kun pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi rnam par gyur te/ che ba ri rab tsam nas chung ba yungs 'bru dang til 'bru tsam/ gsung gi dbyings su bsdus pa'i yon tan byin rlabs nus mthu ma lus pa kun yi ge'i rnam pa ā li kā li badz+ra gu ru rgya yig bod yig gi tshul kha dog sna tshogs pa dang / thugs kyi dbyings su bsdus pa'i yon tan byin rlabs nus mthu ma lus pa kun phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dril bu bum pa thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ dbyug to la sogs pa'i tshogs su gyur pa nyi zer gyi rdul ltar 'khrigs shing kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la sib sib thim pas gnyis su med par gyur pa yang nas yang du bsam zhing / khyad par rang gi mos gus stobs su gyur pa'i yul rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams dang nyams su len bya'i glegs bam lha so so'i phyag mtshan rnams rang la gtso bor bstem pa yang bya la/ de yi skabs su tshig bdun gsol 'debs dang thod phreng rtsal gyi dzapra kyis bskul ba gal che ste/ de yang / trīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi skur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsirnyi pha la r+ghaṃ āḥ de ltar tshig bdun gsol 'debs dzapra bcas tshar nyer gcig gam bdun nam gsum sogs ci ltar nus pa gdangs dbyangs kyis brjod cing gar 'chams stangs stabs kyang bya/ de yang kyal kha rtsed mo'i tshul dang yid zhum pa dang tho cor ma song ba gong gi byin rlabs 'bebs pa'i dmigs pa gsal ba dang / snang grags rtog tshogs kun rang gi rig rtsal sgyu ma tsam du shes bzhin par bya/ des ni bar chad sel byin rlabs 'jug mchog gi dngos grub myur du thob/ thun mong du yongs 'grel las/ zang zing longs spyod la sogs gnas skabs kyi yon tan thams cad kyi sgrub kyi phan yon du gsungs pa lung mthun du 'dug ces 'byung ba ltar lha 'dre mi dang zas nor chos bzhin 'du bar nges shing / rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du nyi shar sogs thun drug thun gsum skabs dang / dkyil 'khor sgrub pa la 343

zhugs pa yin tshe thun skabs gang bde rnams sum chag cing ma chad par byas na gong gi yon tan rnams nges par thob cing / dkyil 'khor sgrub pa gzhan dang 'bral ba yin yang de ltar grub na yi dam gyi rgyud bskul ba'i mchog tu 'gyur zhing dngos grub myur du thob pa'i 'jug sgo bla na med pa'o/ /de yang phyi sgrub 'di la bsnyen tshul gnyis su rgyud kyi yang 'grel las 'byung pa ste/ ji skad du/'di la bsnyen tshad med/ thun rnams la ci nus tsam gar dbyangs dang bcas te bzlas pa la/ phyi sgrub ming du btags pa tsam don la byin 'bebs yin 'dug go/ /zhes gsungs pas bsnyen pa'i grangs nges med par thun dang thun mtshams su ci nus skyong ba'i lugs gcig dang / yang de nyid las/ / rang nyid la mchod bstod dang bzlas pa bya zhing sgrub pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas dzapra bzlas rim pa nges can du bzhed par snang bas/ de'i tshe snga ma'i dgongs don ni gong du bshad pa ltar dang / phyi ma'i don ni gong gi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs bsdus zin pa'i rjes su rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus lus pa med pa gcig tu 'dus pa'i spyi dpal ngo bo bdag nyid yin pa'i nges shes brtan po dang bcas las gzhung nas byung ba ltar kyi mchod bstod byas shing / slar yang gong gi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dbab pa'i dmigs gsal btab bzhin thod phreng rtsal gyi bzlas pa ci nus su bya ba ste/ de yang / rtsa gzhung rdo rje'i tshig phrin las bzhi sgrub las/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsidhi pha la r+ghaṃ ā:'dis ni snang srid g.yo bar 'gyur: dus gsum rgyal ba gcig tu sdud: bla ma kun dang 'du 'bral med: 'byung po dregs pa brgyal zhing 'dar: mkha' 'gro chos skyong sprin bzhin 'du: dpa' bo pho tshogs mo tshogs kun: rang dbang med par mngon sum 'ong : mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ster:'di nyid 'grub rtags med pa na: pad+ma bdag gis sems can bslusoḥ de phyir ma 'ongs las can bu: snying la chongs shigs sa ma ya: zhes dang gu ru chos dbang gi gter byon bla sgrub gsang 'dus las/res 'ga' thod phreng rtsal gyi sku: nam mkha' gang bar char phab nas: sgrub pa po yi spyi bor thim: sha med 'od kyi gzugs can ni: pad+ma 'byung gnas sku ru bsgom: de dus che ba'i nga rgyal bskyedoḥ srog gi snying po thod phreng rtsal: brag kha dag nas chu 'bab bzhin: drag po bar mtshams med par drongs: nga nyid rang dbang med par byon: zhes dang / snying po bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sngags: rgyal ba kun 'dus dril sgrub yin: sa ni bco lnga lam lnga yang : nga bsgrub thod phreng bzlas pas bgrod: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: gsung rab thams cad bklags dang mtshungs: zhes pa'i dgongs pa nyid du nges pas nan ltar du byin rlabs che ba zhig go: de ni dngos gzhi bskyed rim gyi dmigs skor bzhi pa'o/ /'di ni mgyogs khrid kyi skabs su zhag gsum sogs dang khrid ma rdzogs par nyin re bzhin thun 344

mtshams rnams su ci rtsogs nyams su len la/ ji bzhin bsgrub pa la 'jug pa'i skabs su thod phreng rtsal gyi bzlas pa 'bum phrag gcig gam gsum mam bdun sogs thog mar bzlas na phan yon lhag po thob pa las cho ga lhag pa'i skyon med pa kho bo'i rnam par rtog pa'o/ /de ltar phyi sgrub kyi tshul du gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig gis gsal bar zin pa phrin las bzhi sgrub las/ zab snying 'di ni dbyangs chung du: skabs su thun bar 'khrab cing bzla: zhes pa nas gong du drangs ltar thod phreng rtsal gyi dzapra sngags phan yon dang bcas te gsungs pa dang / ma hā yo ga'i sgrub thabs las/ khyad par du snying po 'di 'dren pa dang spyan 'dren thun drug tu ma chag par bsgrubs na pad+ma 'byung gnas rang bzhin du bab cing : nges med du 'od 'khyug pa dang : gzungs sngags rang byung gi sgra sgrog pa dang : rang bzhin ka dag gi nyams bzang po rtsol med du 'byung ngo : zhes dang / thugs kyi dam tshig tu thun drug gam gsum mam ma mtha' yang nyi shar gyi dus su spyan 'dren bzlas pa dang mi 'bral: zhes nan tan chen pos gsungs shing las gzhung nas tshig bdun dang thod phreng rtsal gyi dzapra sngags bcas te bstan pa rnams yin te/ 'on kyang gzhung tshig tu sgrub pa'i thun mtshams su bya ba dang rgyun khyer tshul gsungs pas yang 'grel du bsnyen tshad ma mdzad pa ni phyogs 'di dang mthun par dgongs so/ /spyir yang phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi sgrub pa'i rnam par bzhag pa ni gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig las shugs kyis bstan par snang zhing ji bzhin gsal ba ni gu ru pad+ma yab yum gyis rig 'dzin chen po 'ja' tshon snying po la dngos su gdams pa'i zhal lung dri ma med pa rgyud kyi yang 'grel du mdo don du khrid rim gyi skabs su shin tu kha gsal bar gsungs pas man ngag gi mtha' can las 'byung ba'o/ /gnyis pa nang gi sgrub pa ni/ rang nyid pad+ma 'od 'bar gyi sku ru gsal nas phyi sgrub kyi dmigs pa bzhin spyan 'dren yan chad bgyis te spro na mchod bstod kyang bya la/ gang ltar lha sku gsal brtan dag pa gong du bshad pa ji bzhin nges par byas nas/ ye shes sngags kyi 'khor lo dgod pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ rang gi thugs kar snying gi rtsa 'dab brgyad pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad du gyur pa'i ge sar ze'u 'bru'i steng kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems zla ba'i dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyas pa'i dbus su don dam byang chub kyi sems gser zhun ma'i kha dog lta bu pha lam gyi rdo rje rtsa lnga pa lte ba kun rlum thig le'i nang dbus su dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa ye shes kyi ngo bo r+ghaṃ yig dkar po nor bu rin po che bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po bzhin dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga mtha' yas par 'phro ba/ rdo rje'i lte ba phyi rol gyi ngos sam mtha' skor du 'od lnga'i 'khor lo kun tu mdzes pa'i ngo bor rgyal ba thams cad kyi gsung gi chos yan lag bcu gnyis kyi ngo bo yi ge 'bru bcu gnyis pa man shel dwangs 345

ma'i kha dog can gyen 'grengs sngags kyi rang sgra sgrog pa g.yas skor du 'khod pa bsgom ste pad zla rdo rje r+ghaṃ dang sngags phreng rnams ji bzhin ma gsal gyi bar du rim pa bzhin du mthar cig char du gsal ma thebs kyi bar yang yang bskyar zhing nges par gsal btab pa gal che bas nan tan du bya'o/ /gong gi sngags phreng rdo rje'i lte ba'i nang hūṃ yig gi mthar bkod pa yang mi 'gal la/ man ngag dmigs pa'i rnam grangs su shes par bya ste dmigs thun gcig pa'o/ /de ltar dzapra sngags kyi dkyil 'khor gsal ci rigs thebs nas r+ghaṃ yig rdo rje sngags phreng zla pad la sems ma yengs gsal le'i ngang ngag nas yi ge 'bru bcu gnyis pa'i bzlas pa mgyogs bul skad gdangs che chung ma yin pa chu rgyun bzang po 'bab pa ltar sngags gtsang dag lhung lhung bzlas la/ gal te sngags bzlas pa'i tshe sngags kyi dkyil 'khor mi gsal snyam byed na gsal gdab cing / rim pas sngags bzlas dang lhan cig par bslab/ de yang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor sgom phyin gtso bor r+ghaṃ yig 'od zer lnga pa dang rdo rje tsam mi gsal na ye mi nyan pas gsal ba la 'bad pa gces so/ /de ltar dzapra dkyil sngags bzlas tshun gcig tu brtan na sngags phreng gi 'khor tshul ni rgyud kyi yang 'grel las/ dbang po rab 'bring tha gsum sngags 'khor yang : khog chen rang bzhin sgra 'khor dang : 'gal me lta bu mu tig phreng ba lta bu dang gsum las ci bder bya'o:zhes 'byub ba ltar bsgom ste/ de ltar dzapra dkyil bzlas pa dang lhan cig bslab pa'i rim pa dmigs thun gnyis pa'o/ /de ltar sngags kyi dkyil 'khor bzlas pa zung 'jug tu brtan par gyur nas spro bsdu'i bzlas pa ni/ zla sngags phreng dang bcas pa'i 'od zer rdo rje dang rdu yig la phog /r+ghaṃ yig las 'od zer bun bun phroṃ phroṃ nar gyi spos ring gi dud pa ltar rdo rje'i rwa rtse nas 'thon/ longs spyod dang bde chen 'khor lo brgyud mdzod spu'i gnas nas phyir thon mkha' khyab sku gsum rgyal ba'i zhing ci tsam pa de na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba gsum btsun mo sras dang slob ma g.yog bcas dkon mchog rtsa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyi dang khyad par de rnams kyi thugs rje'i rang gzugs rang nyid gnas pa'i steng gi cha nas nam mkha'i gnas su sprin gyi phung po 'khrigs pa ltar bzhugs pa la gong gi dzapra dkyil gyi 'od zer phog pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul sngags kyi 'od zer las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa kun tu bzang po rgyan gyi rol pa las byung bas mchod/ dgyes shing tshims te sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi mdzad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo mthu stobs byin rlabs nus pa ma lus shing lus pa med pa sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan thig le 'od zer gyi tshul du bun bun thib thib sha ra ra byung nas rang gi lus kyi cha kun dang khyad par mdzod spu'i gnas nas zhugs snying rje'i lam brgyud rgyu yig la sib sib thim 346

pas rgyal ba thams cad kyi byin rlabs gcig tu bdag la 'dus pas dzasdo dkyil sngar bas kyang gzi brjid 'od du 'bar bar bsams la bzlas pa bya ba ste spro bsdu'i dmigs pa dang po dmigs thun gsum pa'o/ /yang dzapra dkyil sngags phreng gi 'od zer rdo rje rdu la phog r+ghaṃ las 'od zer dmar po gtso bor gyur pa'i kha dog lnga 'od zer thig gi sner lcags kyu'i rdul phrom phrom brang brang 'phros te rdo rje'i mas kyi rwa nas shar te thon/ srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po lha ma srin sde brgyad mthu rtsal nus pa dang ldan pa rnams kyi spyi bo'am sna bug nas brgyud snying ga bzhugs pas rang srog dwangs ma mdangs gsol rang rang gi gzugs dang srog sngags sa bon phyag mtshan gyi tshul rdo khab len gyis lcags phye bsdus pa ltar 'od zer gyi sne ru bungs kyis 'dus/ tshur byung rang gi lte ba nas rdo rje'i mas kyi rwa nas brgyud snying gis sa bon r+ghaṃ yig gi zhabs kyu la thim pas dregs pa can mtha' dag kyang srog gta' ru tshud/ dam tshig la 'da' ba med par bdag gi bka' nyan gsung sdod rnam bzhi'i phrin las thogs pa med par sgrub par bsams la bzlas pa ci nus bya/ spro bsdu'i dmigs skor gnyis pa ste dmigs thun bzhi pa'o/ /yang dzapra dkyil 'khor 'od zer sngags phreng rdo rje r+ghaṃ la phog la gong ltar/ de nas thugs srog r+ghaṃ las 'od zer kha dog drug pa rdo rje'i rwa yas mas dang sku'i cha thams cad nas thon/ 'gro ba drug gi gnas ma lus par khyab/ de na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib ba mo la nyi ma phog pa ltar skad cig gis dag /mi 'gyur bde ba chen pos khyab/ gu ru'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ 'od zer sku'i cha nas tshur 'dus/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad sgrib bral mnyam nyid mi 'gyur bde chen mchog gi phyag rgyas yang dag par thebs nas phyir mi ldog par bsams la/ 'di la dmigs skor zhib mor phye na thugs srog nas 'phro ba'i 'od zer drug rim bzhin kha dog mthing ga zhabs mthil nas thon dmyal ba'i 'jig rten du phog pas snod rdo rje bkod pa'i zhing dang bcud rdo rje thod phreng rtsal du gyur par bsam zhing / de bzhin 'od zer dmar po gsang nas/ mthing skya lte ba/ ljang gu ltag pa/ ser po smin mtshams/ kha dog 'dres pa thugs ka nas 'phros/ yi dwags byol song / lha min/lha mi yi 'jig rten du phog snod bcud pad+ma 'khor lo rgya gram rin po che bkod pa dang rgyan 'thug po bkod pa'i zhing du gyur/ sems can rnams pad+ma bud+dha karma rat+na thod phreng rtsal dang rigs 'dus pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sku ru gyur par bsam par bya ste/ de ltar rgyas bsdus ji ltar byas kyang spro bsdu'i dmigs pa gsum pa ste dmigs thun lnga pa'o/ /yang skabs su mkha' khyab bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor zhes phyi 'byung bzhi rdul phra rab re re nas dang / nang sems can thams cad gu ru'i skur gyur pa mtha' dag gi zhal gyi sgo nas ma zad dbu skra dang 347

ba spu'i bu ga nas sngags kyi sgra dang / nam mkha'i khams khengs pa'i dkon mchog rtsa gsum thams cad kyis kyang bdag gi dzapra sngags sgrog pa'i grogs mdzad cing de thams cad kyi rig sngags byin rlabs nus mthu bdag gi sngags phreng sa bon la thim zhing bdag gi rig sngags kyi nus pas mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad bla med sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur ba nyid du 'grub par bsams pa dzapra bzlas te dmigs thun drug pa'o/ /yang skabs su sku'i dkyil 'khor cha med kun 'gro la sems ma yengs par gtad de sngags bzla ba dang / de bzhin sngags kyi phreng ba klog pa'i tshul gyis bzla ba dang / rdo rje rgyu bcas sems rtse gcig tu gtad nas bzlas sogs gnad du gang 'gro bya zhing / gtso bor thugs srog hūṃ la sems rtse gcig tu gtad nas bzla par bya ste/ des ni sku gsung thugs kyi bzla tshul du yang 'gyur zhing / yang skabs su dzapra che chung ran par bzlas pa'i/ de'i sgra rang gi rna bar son pa de kho nar sems gtad cing gzhan du ma yengs par bzla ba yang bla ma'i man ngag las byung bas de ltar gyis kyang rtsal sbyang ngo / /de ni dmigs thun bdun pa'o/ /yang thun skabs 'jog pa la bab pa'i tshe snod gzhal med khang bcud lha sku'i rang bzhin la thim/lha sku'i tshogs bdag nyid gu ru pad+ma'i sku la thim/ de yang yas mas 'od kyi gong bur 'dus te pad zla sngags phreng rdo rje hūṃ yig gi bar gcig la gcig thim/ rgyu yig kyang klad kor thig le la thim/ de yang je phra mthar skra rtse brgya stong du gshags pa tshal pa'i bar tsam mos pas gzhil nas/ de yang nam mkha'i dbyings su stong par yal bar bsams la rnam rtog gi spros pa dang bral bar sems ji gnas su mnyam par bzhag cing gal te rnam rtog skyes tshe snod bcud bsdu ba sngar bzhin gyi mthar stong nyid la bzhag pa yang yang bya la/ mthar de las ldang bar 'dod tshe/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sidhi r+ghaṃ: zhes brjod pas skad cig gis gu ru pad+ma'i sku sgyu ma lta bur sdang ba la bslab par bya'o/ /dmigs thun brgyad pa'o/ /de ltar dmigs thun brgyad rim pa bzhin dmigs pa re re la goms nas re re la slob pa yin mod kyang deng sang chos thob mgyogs khrid la dga' ba rnams kyi ngor thun chen gcig tu bsdams pas dngos gzhi bskyed rim dmigs skor lnga pa'o/ /mgyogs khrid skabs su yang zhag grangs ji ltar rung dmigs pa'i go don blo la 'jags nges bya dgos pas 'og ma rnams la yang des rigs 'gres su shes pa dang / slar ci bzhin sgrub pa'i skabs nang sgrub 'di dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi rtsa ba'i sgrub pa dngos gzhi'i mthil phur yin pas bsnyen tshad 'bum phrag bcu gnyis dang / de lan bzhir bldabs pas 'bum phrag bzhi bcu zhe brgyad de dus bsnyen zla drug kyang 'di dang 'grigs par 'gyur la/ mchog sgrub 348

pa yi ni dung phyur sogs tshad med pa nyid du bzla ba'o/ /de ltar bzla bya dzapra ni/ gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig phrin las rang gzhung nas bzlas pa bskul ba ni/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi hūṃ: zhes bzla'o:zhes pas sngags kyi ngo bo dang yo ga gsum gyi sgrub thabs rnal 'byor chen po las/ de yang bzlas pa ni:o āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sidhi rgyu: tshig bar mchod par bzlas pas rig 'dzin gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis rang dbang med par byin gyis brlab par 'gyur ro: ci'i phyir na bdag nyid pad+ma'i thugs rgyud kyi byin rlabs thams cad yig 'bru 'di rnams la bstem pa yin pa'i phyir ro: zhes pa'i phan yon dang bcas pa bstan nas de ma thag par khyad par snying po 'di 'dren pa dang : zhes sogs phyi sgrub skabs su drangs pa ltar gyi thog mar bsnyen pa'i tshul dang / de nas mun khang brten pa ni: spyod lam thams cad du pad+ma 'byung gnas dngos sam nyams rmi lam la mjal ba dang chos gsung lung bstan pa'i snang ba 'byung ste:de'i tshe dga' bod kyi bdud ma zhugs par rang bzhin ka dag lhun grub tu shes pa gal che'o: zhes sgrub pa la zhugs tshul dang / de dang skabs su sgrub rtags 'byung tshul de la zhen med du gdams pa bcas tshig nyung don gsal dang / de'i 'phror spros med sgrub rten dang / sku gsum thugs kyi lam khyer dang mos gus kyi stobs bskyed de rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la 'bad par gdams pa sogs dgos pa mang pos mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig gsum yang bstan par mdzad mod/ gzhan ni nang sgrub tu grags pa 'di'i dzapra dkyil dmigs pa'i spro bsdu sogs kyang rtsa ba gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig las ji ltar 'byung zhe na/ las gzhung gi rdzogs rim bsdu skabs/ sngags phreng gser gyi rdo rjer bsdu: zhes pas mdor bstan yo ga gsum gyi sgrub thabs rnal 'byor chen po'i skabs su/ rang gi thugs kar pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar rdo rje rgyu gis mtshan pa'i mthar mar sngags phreng zhes pas dzapra kyi 'khor lo ji ltar bsgom gsal bar phyes shing sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros: zhing rab 'byams kyi rgyal ba thams cad la mchod pa bla na med pa'i phul: sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad rang la bsdu: zhes pas spro bsdu dang po bsdun/ bar du lha srin dregs pa can thams cad dbang du bsdus ci bsgo ba'i las thams cad thogs med du bsgrubs: zhes pas spro bsdu gnyis pa bstan/ mar rigs drug gi sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sgyangs/ bde bas tshim par byas: 'od zer 'phro 'du'i dmigs pa gsal bar bsgom: zhes pas spro bsdu gsum pa bstan/ de ltar bsgrubs pas phyi snod gzhal yas khang dang nang bcud lha yi 'khor lor mthong : zhes de dngos bstan lha sngags bsgoms pa'i mthu las gnas skabs su phan yon ji ltar 'byung gsungs pa yin yang de'i tshig shugs kyis mkha' khyab bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor yang legs par bstan pa yin la/ 'od gsal rjes sdud kyi rnal 'byor ni las gzhung gi mthar gsal bar gsungs shing de rnams 349

kyi man ngag ni rgyud kyi yang 'grel las gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig gi don gsal gu ru'i zhal lung bzhin gter ston rin po ches dka' ba'i gnad zhib mor phyes te bkod pa rnams yin la/ de ltar zab khrid man ngag gi don gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig la sbyor tshul blo dman rnams kyis go bde ba'i slad du tshig tshogs la ma 'jem par cung zad tsam smras pa yin no/ /gsum pa gsang ba'i sgrub pa ni gong du bshad pa ltar gu ru zhi ba'i sku stong pa las ldang ba'am/yang na stong par ma gzhil ba'i thog ma nyid nas kyang rung ste/ gong ltar gu ru'i zhu ba 'od du zhu ba las bdag nyid gu ru drag po gtum drag dmar nag me'i phreng ba can du gsal btab ste/ de yang pad+ma zla nyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bdag nyid dus gsum rgyal ba'i mdzad phrin nus mthu gcig bsdus dkon mchog spyi 'dus khros pa'i sku rdo rje srin po'i gzugs can sku mdog dmar nag dus mtha'i me yang zil gyis gnon pa/ ljags 'dril mche ba gangs ri ltar gcigs shing shangs nas bskal pa'i 'thor rlung 'phyo ba/ spyan gsum sdang mig bar snang glog ltar 'khyugs cing zur zhal g.yon du phyogs pa/ smar smin ag tshem dmar ser me ltar 'bar zhing me skar 'khrugs pa/ dbu skra ral pa dmar ser shod ma'i me ltar gyen du 'phyo zhing / phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu ram̐ dgu dang r+ghaṃ dgus mtshan pa nam mkha' la 'phyar nas dngos 'dzin gyi rtog pa mtha' dag skad cig tu phyi mar rlog pa/ phyag g.yon lcags kyi sdig pa nag po mgo dgu rwa bco brgyad kha nas me 'bar ba gdengs thabs kyis bsnams pas sa bdag klu gnyan rgyal bsen gdug pa can gyi srog 'phrog pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa'i 'og tu snang srid lha ma srin sde brgyad dregs pa can mtha' dag kha bub gan rkyal du 'dam ltar brdzis pa/ glang stag ma'i pags pa'i gos dang thal khrag zhag gis byugs shing thod skam lnga yi dbu rgyan/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal/ klu chen brgyad kyis snyan mgu phyag zhabs kyi mdzes rgyan du byas pa/ gzhan yang rin po che'i rgyan dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gis nye bar spras pa ba spu'i bu ga thams cad khro chung gi go chas spras shing sprul pa khro bo'i sprin 'phro ba/ ye shes kyi 'od zer rab tu 'tsher zhing me dud kyi rtse nas mtshon cha'i tshwa tshwa 'phro ba'i dbus su bzhugs pa/ g.yas g.yon du khro bo khro mo dang rgyab tu mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis drag sngags r+ghaṃ phaṭa kyi nga ro sgrog cing / mdun du lha ma srin sde brgyad bran bzhin du nyan nas gnod byed thams cad thal bar rlog pa/ phyogs mtshams thams cad du yang sprul lcags kyi sdig pa rlung ltar 'tshubs pas dam nyams rnams kyi snying khrag 'thung ba/ srid pa 'di na che btsan 'gran zla dang bral ba'i khro bo thams cad kyi rgyal por gsal ba'i gnas mi 'gyur yi ge gsum gyis rgyas btab nas gsal ba dang brtan pa dang dag pa la ma goms bar du nan tan gyis bslab par bya ba ste/ de yi thun mtshams rnams su rang bzhin 350

rnam par dag pa'i zhing chos dbyings dur khrod me ri 'bar ba dang / 'khor ba yongs sgrol gyi dur khrod sogs khro bo'i zhing khams bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas gdod nas rnam dag gu ru drag po ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor 'khor lo spyan drangs/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la rang dang zhal spod kyi tshul du bzhugs par gsol nas mchod bstod byas pa'i mthar/ bdag dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor la gnyis su med par bzhugs par bsam pa yang byin rlabs 'jug pa'i rgyu khyad par ba yin no/ /de ni dmigs thun dang po'o/ /de yang rgyud kyi yang 'grel las/ gsang sgrub ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis zhi ba 'od du zhu ba las byung ba gu ru drag por bskyed/ spyan 'dren mchod bstod bya zhing ye shes sems dpa' rang la thim/ mdun bskyed bsgrub na rang dang mdun bskyed gnyis ka la thim/ zhes gsungs pa'i don bzhin te/ 'di'i mdun bskyed ni gtor ma'am maṇ+ḍal la brten pa'i spyi mthun la dgongs kyang skabs 'di ni dzaspru khong phye bas kyang mdun bskyed nyid kyi don tshang bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /de nas dzapra sngags ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gsal gdab pa ni rgyud kyi yang 'grel las/ rang gi dbu gtsug na gu ru zhi ba rigs bdag gi tshul du bzhugs shing / rang gi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du rgyu dmar nag gi mtha' bskor sngags phreng zhes 'byung ba ltar/ bdag nyid che mchog drag po'i spyi gtsug mtshog mar gu ru zhi ba mngon rtogs ltar gsal gdab cing thugs kar ye shes sems dpa'i rang bzhin nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rab tu tsha zhing 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa 'bar 'tsher rtsub ba kun tu 'phro ba'i lte bar ting 'dzin sems dpa'i ngo bo yi ge r+ghaṃ dmar la dwangs pa nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bu ye shes kyi 'od zer mtha' dang mu med par 'phro zhing phrin las rnam pa bzhi yid bzhin du byed pa ni de yi mthar rgyal ba thams cad kyi gsang rig gzungs sngags kyi nus mthu gcig tu bsdus pa gu ru drag po'i yang snying oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ artsig ni rtsig na mo bha ga wa te r+ghaṃ rgyu phaṭa: ces yi ge 'bru bcu drug gyen langs g.yas skor du hram me 'od zer dang bcas te 'khod par bsams la dmigs pa ma gsal bar du bskyar zhing bsgom pa ste dmigs thun gnyis pa'o/ /gu ru'i drag sgrub phal che bar dzapra sngags kyi gzhi 'di kho na la sngags 'bru mang nyung cung zad 'byung yang phan tshun bsre bslad mi bya ste 'dir ni yig 'bru bcu drug par nges pa'o/ /de ltar sngags 'khor gyi dmigs pa brtan nas re zhig dzapra khong phyes nas do li'i bzlas pa bya ste mar me gcig las gnyis mched dam me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba bzhin rang ji 'dra ba drag po'i sku/ mdun du ye shes pa'i tshul du me ri 'dab sbyor bzhugs pa'i thugs kar gong bzhin thugs srog dzapra kyi 'khor lo dgod/ de nas bdag gis bzlas pa byas pas sngags phreng 'od zer dang bcas te r+ghaṃ yig la g.yas su 351

lan gsum bskor/ rdu yig las 'od zer byung nas tal le brgyud nas bdag gi longs spyod 'khor lo'i dbus su r+ghaṃ dmar po gcig bsam ste/ de la yang g.yas su lan gsum bskor nas sngags phreng 'od zer dang bcas pa zhal thon/ mdun gyi ye shes khro bo chen po'i zhal du zhugs/ gong bzhin mgrin par hūṃ gsal ba la g.yas su bskor te thugs ka'i r+ghaṃ yig gi 'od zer la brgyud nas rdu gi mthar sngags phreng 'khod de g.yas su lan gsum bskor dbu ma'i lam brgyud sngags phreng lte ba nas 'thon/ rang gi lte bar zhugs dbu ma'i lam brgyud snying gar sngar bzhin du 'khod/ de ltar bar mtshams med par ci nus su sgom gyin bzla/ gal te dub na bdag mdun gang bde'i thugs srog mthar sngags phreng bkod pa la sems ma yengs par bzhag par dzapra bzla ba dang spel ba gang bde bya/ thun mtshams su do li'i bzlas pa kha shas mthar mdun gyi ye shes pa rang la gzhug brtan pa'i nga rgyal bzung / de ni do li'am khyog gi bzlas pa'am 'gal me klad 'khor du bzlas pa'i lugs su ste dmigs thun gsum pa'o/ /de nas spro bsdu'i bzlas pa ni/ gu ru'i sku zhi drag dang sngags bsgyur ba las spro bsdu gsum ka gong du zhi ba'i skabs su bshad pa kho na ltar la dmigs pa'i gnad cung zad re 'phrul shes te bya ba yin no/ /'dir spro bsdu gnyis pa grub pa'i skabs sam gzhan yang nam 'os su khro bo'i bzlas pa bya ba ni/ de nas sngags phreng 'od zer las mtshon cha me phung 'phros bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi chos byang chub sgrub pa la 'tshe zhing bar du gcod pa'i dgra dang bgegs byad ma'i tshogs ma lus pa lcags kyus bkug zhags pas bcings lcags kyi sdig pas snying khrag 'jibs/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs la bskyon mtshon chas gtubs/ khro bo khro mo sde brgyad rnams kyis sha khrag glo snying tshogs su rol/ lhag ma me rlung gis rdul phran cha med du bsregs gtor bar bsam la bzlas pa ni khyad par ste drag po'i bsnyen sgrub rkang tshugs mi byed par zhi ba'i las tshogs sngags sham tshul du sbyor tshe spro bsdu gzhan zhor byung dang / spro bsdu gnyis pa dang 'di gnyis rtsa ba'i dmigs pa yin pa shes par bya dgos la mthar zhi ba'i skabs mkha' khyab bzlas pa dang / sku gsung thugs kyi bzlas pa sogs gang bde gtso bor byas nas ci nus su bzla ba ste dmigs thun bzhi ba'o/ /de yang rgyud kyi yang 'grel las/ sngags phreng las 'od zer dmar nag ye shes kyi me dang mtshon cha la sogs pa 'phros pas ma rung gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ ces pas khro bo'i bzlas pa bstan/ snang srid thams cad rig 'dzin drag po'i skur gsal te/ zhes pas mkha' khyab kyi bzlas pa bstan la/ bsnyen tshad ni snying po 'bum phrag gcig te bsnyen pa'o/ /zhes 'byung ba zhi ba 'bru 'bum gyi bcu gnyis cha drag po la bzla bar dgongs mod/ 'on kyang sngags 'di byin rlabs phan yon bsam gyis 352

mi khyab par khrag 'thung khro bo rol pa'i rgyud dang drag sgrub gzhan du rgya cher 'byung bas ci tsam bzlas kyang bzang zhing legs pa yin no/ /sde brgyad 'dul sngags sogs skabs dang bstun zhes gsungs pa ni go sla ba de kho na ltar ro/ /drag po la rjes sdud kyi rnal 'byor dngos su ma gsungs kyang zhi drag seng gsum gdan thog gcig tu thun gcig la sgom bzlas spungs pa yin na/ gong ma 'od du zhu nas 'og ma bskyed pa mu mthud du yang 'grel gyi dgongs par snang yang thun gcig nga ma yin par so sor sgom bzlas phyin rjes sdud kyang zhi ba'i skabs gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig gis zin pas bya dgos par rtogs la/des na rjes sdud zhi ba'i skabs de 'phrul shes par bya'o/ /yang dmigs med du ka dag rab la bzhag kyang bskyed chog dang mthun pa'i sdud rim ste 'gal ba med pa nyid du shes so/ /de ltar drag po'i dmigs thun bzhi thun chen gcig tu bsdams pas dngos gzhi bskyed rim gyi dmigs skor drug pa'o/ /bzhi pa yang gsang ngam de kho na nyid ltar sgrub pa ni/ thun dang po'i mgor gu ru zhi drag gi sgom bzlas ci rigs byas pa'i mthar rang nyid drag po 'od du zhu ba las ye shes dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi skur gyur pa ni/ de yang pad nyi mi ro'i gdan la ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro sku mdog mthing ga nam mkha' dwangs pa'i kha dog lta bu zhal 'phrog byed seng ge'i gzugs su gnas pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba zang yag tu gcigs pa ral pa ljang dmar gyen du 'phyo ba'i gseb nas sprul pa'i khro mo seng chung mang po skar ltar 'phro ba/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes yu ba byas pa'i gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon du byad ma rbod gtong mkhan dang bdud dang mu stegs kyi snying khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin cing zhal du gsol ba/ zhabs g.yas bskum pa'i rnying pa bha ga la gtad pa g.yon brkyangs pas bdag med ro'i snying gar brdzis pa/ thod skam lnga yis dbu brgyan cing bdud rigs brgya yi mgo bo'i phreng ba se ral khar 'phyang ba/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang me lo ta dang gser gyi dril chung g.yer khas mdzes par byas pa/ ye shes mkha' 'gro yongs kyi 'khor los sgyur ma'i sku ru gsal ba'i spyi bor rigs bdag bla ma kun 'dus gu ru pad+ma dang / gru mo g.yon du thabs bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin che mchog dmar nag dwag pa rtsal gyi ngo bo kha ṭ+wāṃ ga'i rnam pa la 'khyud pa/ ye shes bskal pa'i me phung pha lam las grub pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa'i mtshon cha'i gur khrang 'khrigs pa'i dbus su rang 'dra ye shes mkha' 'gro du ma'i 'khor tshogs kyis bskor te bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin rdo rje'i yig 'bru gsum gyis byin brlabs nas zhing gi skabs sus bskyed ltar brtan dag dran la bslab cing / skabs su ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan 'dren mchod bstod rang la gzhug pa rnams kyang ci nus bya/ dmigs thun dang po'o/ /353

de nas dzasra kyi dkyil 'khor gsal gdab pa ni/ rang gi snying gar ye shes pa ting 'dzin sems dpa'i tshul nyi ma rgyu yig drag po'i skabs ji bzhin pa las/ 'dir r+ghaṃ yig gi kha dog mthing ga yid bzhin gyi nor bu mthon ka chen po ji bzhin par gsal ba'i mthar ye shes dam tshig 'jig rten las kyi srog snying bcud du byung ba'i rang sngags rdo rje'i sgra 'dogs dang bu drug gang yang med pa sbrul bcus pa'am spu gri'i phreng ba lta bu yig 'bru tshegs par bcu bzhi pa ste phyi mo phyed dang bco lnga pa aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥ ces pa mgo bo gyen bstan kha dog mthing nag g.yon du phram mer 'khod pa ma gsal bar du nan tan gyis bsgom zhing / de ltar gsal thebs tshe r+ghaṃ yig las 'od zer tshu la tsub pa rno la ring ba blta bas mi bzod pa 'phros te sngags kyi phreng ba la phog /sngags kyi phreng ba las kyang de lta bu'i 'od zer mgar gyi tshwa tshwa ltar 'phros/ rgyal ba rnams la phog pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ sems can rnams la phog pas sdig sgrib sbyangs/ bdag cag dpon slob kyi thar ba'i gegs byed gnod byed byad ma rbod gtong bdud dang mu stegs dam sri rnams la phog pas spu gris skra bzhar ba'am/bya sgro zhun khang gi me la bsregs pa bzhin skad cig de ma thag tu rmeg med thal ba rdul phran nyid du brlags shing / 'od zer tshur 'dus snying ga'i sngags kyi dkyil 'khor la thim pas byin rlabs nus mthu gzi brjid sngar las kyang ches cher rgyas par bsams la/ de lta bu'i spro bsdu'i dmigs pa lngang yang bcas dzapra sngags bzlas shing / skabs su gong gi mtshon cha'i gur khang gang gis kyang gzhig par mi nus pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsam la sngags bzla ba ni srung 'khor gyi mchog go/ /zhi drag gi zhor byung sham bu tsam du bzla na dmigs pa'i rim pa de tsam gyis chog cing bsnyen tshad kyang khri phrag lnga'o/ /bla ma yi dam gyi bsnyen pa 'grub pa'i rnal 'byor pas seng gdong ma'i bsnyen sgrub rkang tshugs byed na spro bsngu gsum dang mkha' khyab sku gsung thugs kyi bzlas pa rnams gong du bshad pa rnams kha bsgyur te bya zhing /do li'am khyog gi bzlas pa la'ang spro na mi rung ba med la/ bsnyen tshad kyang 'bru 'bum nas bye ba sa ya ci nus so/ /de ltar rgyun gyi nyams len srung ba mchog sgrub dang 'bral ba'i dmigs skor te thun gnyis pa'o/ /bzlog pa'i skabs su sngags kyi go cha lus la dgod pa ni yang 'grel las gsungs pa bzhin spyi bor aḥkaḥmagrin par saḥmaḥ snying gar ra tsaḥ lte bar shaḥdaḥ gsang gnas su raḥsaḥ brla g.yas su maḥraḥ g.yon du yaḥphaṭa: de rnams las 'od zer me 'od mtshon cha 'khrugs te mched pas thar pa'i bar chad dgra bgegs byad ma thams cad thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bsams nas drag sngags ci nus bzlas/ thun mtshams su bden stobs bcas thal mo gnam sa nyi zlas mtshan pa'i bar du 354

dgra bgegs byad ma kun sgo nga brag la bcar ba bzhin phye mar gzhig par bsam la thal mo brdab/ de ni bzlog pa'i mchog tu gyur pa'o/ /thun mtshams dmigs med ka dag gi ngang du bzhag pa'am yang na rjes sdud kyi rnal 'byor gong du bstan pa ltar la mthar lha skur ldang tshe srung ba'i 'khor lo yang gsal gdab par bzhed/ thang bsad kyi skabs su rang nyid gu ru drag po zhi ba'i rigs bdag can gyi mdun du seng gdong ma rigs lnga sprul pa yang sprul bcas gsal btab/ de rnams las rang 'dra'i sprul pa spros/dgra bgegs byad ma rnams phyag rgya bzhi yis bkug lha dang dbye/ gzugs la dbab/ byang du gzhugasmyo ru bcug gtun du brdungs/ sha khrag ye shes las byed mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis lhag med du bzhes par bsam la bskul dang drag sngags ci nus su bzla ba ste/ tshul 'di gnas skabs 'dir rgyas par smos ma dgos kyang rgyud kyi yang 'grel du bskyed rim gyi zab khrid 'phros su gnang 'dug pa bzhin skabs 'dir yang sa bcad tshul du bzlog dmigs kyi zhar byang du smos pa ste dmigs thun gsum pa'o/ /de ltar seng gdong gi dmigs thun gsum thun chen gcig tu bsdams pas dngos gzhi bskyed rim lha khrid kyi dmigs skor bdun pa'o/ /de yang bka' srung ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sgrub pa la yang gsang dam de kho na nyid kyi sgrub par bzhed pa'i rnam gzhag go rim la kha cig nas dpyad pa skad byed kyang sa bcu'i dbang phyug lta bu nges par dag pa'i sa la bzhugs pa'i srung ma kha cig gi sgrub thabs la yang gsang de kho na nyid kyi sgrub par bzhag pa la skyon ye nas med do/ /da ni gsum pa las kha tshar phrin las bzhi'i sgrub pa bshad par bya ste/ de yang gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig las/ 'phro 'du'i phrin las sbyor shes na: gang ltar bsam pa de ltar 'grub: dper na yid bzhin nor bu 'dra: des na dus dang kha phyogs sogs: gnas sngags smon lam shes par bya: dang po zhi ba'i phrin las bsgrub pa la dus ni tho rangs kyi dus su yin la kha shar phyogs su bstan nas rang nyid gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas kha dog zla ba'i zhun ma 'khyil ba lta bu dkar ba la pad zhu chos gos ber phod gsang gos rnams kyang dung dang ku mud kyi kha dog can gsol ba/ phyag na zla ba chu shel gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba 'dzin cing gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'phyang ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung du bzhugs par gsal la dzapra dkyil gyi gnas thugs kar pad dkar zla steng rdo rje'i lte bar hūṃ yig dkar pos mtshan pa dang / bye brag tu spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo pad dkar 'dab ma sum cu so gnyis pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ yig dkar po/ de'i mthar sngags kyi rim pa oṃ āḥhūṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi r+ghaṃ: zhes rtsa ba'i sngags dang / oṃ shārnyi ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes sham bu las sngags te sngags phreng yig 355

'bru gyen langs bklag thabs su gnas su gnas par bsams la/ de nas spro bsdu ni/ dzapra sngags bzlas pas thugs ka'i zla ba rdo rje r+ghaṃ yig las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ spyi bo'i zla dkyil sngags phreng oṃ yig la phog pas sngags phreng drag tu 'khor zhing oṃ las zla ba'i 'od zer lta bu nam mkha'i khyon khengs zing sngags kyi sgras rgyal ba sras dang slob 'bangs bcas dgyes par byas shing thugs dam kyi rgyud bskul bas de rnams kyi dpral ba nas 'od zer dkar po byung / rang gi spyi gtsug gi sngags kyi dkyil 'khor la thim pas mthu stobs nus pa shin tu nas kyang bskyed par byas te/ de las slar yang 'od zer pad rtsa mu tig ltar dkar zhing zla ba'i dbyibs can sogs 'phros/ 'gro ba rnams la phog pas bdag gzhan gyi las nyon sdig sgrib 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug mtha' dag zhi bar byas so bsams nas bzlas pa brgya rtsa'am stong tshig dang / thun mtshams rnams su smon lam gdab par yang bya ste/ de ni/ nad gdon sdig sgrib bag chags ngan: sdang dgra gnod byed gdug pa'i dpal: rno ba'i mtshon dang sbyor ba'i dug: stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs kun dang : bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams dang : mis ltas mtshan ngan thams cad kun: myur ba nyid du zhi gyur cig: ces tshar gsum bdun bco lnga sogs ji ltar rigs par brjod: mthar snod kyi 'jig rten rdo rje'i zhing dang bcud kyi sems can rdo rje sems dpa' bsams la/ snod bcud kyang rim bzhin bdag la thim nas dmigs med ka dag gi ngang du bzhag pa'am/ bdag gi spyi bo'i dzapra dkyil snying ga'i sa bon la thim/ rang lus kyang 'od kyi gong bu snying ga'i thugs srog la 'dus te stong par gzhil ba dang / slar ldang ba gong du rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs su bstan pa ltar bya ba ste zhi ba'i las kyi dmigs thun dang po'o/ /de nas rgyas pa'i phrin las bsgrub pa'i dus ni nyi dros kyi skabs su kha lho phyogs su bstan nas rang nyid gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas kha dog gser gyi lhun po la nyi mas 'khyud pa lta bu ser la 'tsher ba blta bas mi bzod pa pad zhu chos gos ber phod gsang gos rnams kyang be+eḍūr+ya ser po'i kha dog lta bu phyag na rin po che cha dgu 'od zer mchog tu 'bar ba dang thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba 'dzin cing gru mor kha ṭaṃ 'chang ba/ zhabs rgyal po rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs par bsams la/ dzab dkyil gyi gnas thugs kar zhi ba'i skabs bzhin las pad rdor r+ghaṃ ser/ bye brag pa mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo pad+ma ser po 'dab ma bcu drug pa'i lte bar yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che cha dgu pa'i dbus su r+ghaṃ yig ser po gnas pa'i sngags kyi rim pa rtsa ba'i dzapra gyi mthar/ rgyu puṣ+ṭi ku ru ye ṭ+wā hā: zhes las sngags te bklag thabs su 'khod par bsam la/ de nas spro bsdu ni thugs ka'i dzapra dkyil las 'od zer ser po 'phros/ mgrin pa'i rin chen sngags phreng rgyu yig la phog pas sngags phreng drag tu 'khor zhing r+ghaṃ 356

las 'od zer ser pos nam mkha'i khyon khengs shing sngags kyi rang sgras rgyal ba rab 'byams dgyes te thugs rgyud bskul ba sogs zhi ba'i skabs ltar la/ de rnams kyi mgrin pa nas 'od zer ser po byung rang gi mgrin pa'i dzapra dkyil la thim pas nus pa bskyed/ de las slar 'od zer rdo rje pha lam dang spur len gyi kha dog lta bu nor bu rin po che'i dbyings can la sogs pa 'phros 'gro ba rnams la phog pas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs kun tu rgyas shing gnas skabs kyi 'byor pa drug 'phel bar bsam la bzlas pa'i bar dang thun mtshams rnams su smon lam gdab pa ni/ tshe dang bsod nams snyan grags stobs: 'khor dang bu slob phrin las rgyas: mda' thang longs spyod yon tan kun: myur ba nyid du rgyas gyur cig: ces tshar ji ltar rigs pa brjod mthar snod kyi 'jig rten rin po che'i zhing nang bcud kyi sems can rin chen sems dpar gyur nas snod bcud kyang rim bzhin bdag la thim pas dmigs med du bzhag pa'am/ yang rjes sdud mgrin pa'i dzapra dkyil snying ga'i sa bon la thim pa las gzhan zhi ba'i skabs su bshad pa ltar bya ba ste/ rgyas pa'i las te dmigs thun gnyis pa'o/ /de nas dbang gi phrin las bsgrub pa la dus dgongs kha'i skabs su kha nub tu phyogs la rang nyid pad+ma 'byung gnas kha dog byu ru'i lhun po la nyi mas 'khyud pa lta bur dmar la pad zhwa chos gos ber phod gsang gos rnams pad+ma dmar po ltar lhun chags shing mdzes pa phyag na pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma stong ldan ze'u 'bru'i ge sar la lcags kyus mtshan pa thod pa bdud rtsi can dang kha ṭ+wāṃ gar 'khyud pa/ zhabs sems skyil lam pad+ma'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par bsam pa'i dzapra dkyil gnas thugs kar gong bzhin pad rdor dang rdu dmar bye brag pa ste ba la sprul pa'i 'khor lo pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i dbus su nyi ma'i la dkyil 'khor la trīḥyig dmar pos mtshan pa'i mthar sngags kyi rim pa rtsa ba'i dzapra la/ trīḥwa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes las sngags bcas sdang bzhin 'khod par bsam la/ spro bsdu ni thugs ka'i dzapra dkyil sa bon las 'od zer dmar po pad+ma rā ga'i kha dog lta bu byung ste lte ba'i nyi dkyil sngags phreng trīḥyig la phog sngags phreng drag tu 'khod/ hrīḥ yig las 'od zer glog 'khyug pa lta bu byung nam mkha'i khyon khengs pa sogs sngar dang 'dra ba'i lha rnams kyi lte ba nas 'od zer dmar po byung rang gi lte ba'i dzapra dkyil la thim pas rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs dbang du 'dus dzapra kyi nus pa bskyed/ de las slar 'od zer ut+pal dang mu tig dmar po'i kha dog can lcags kyu zhags pa la sogs pa 'gugs byed mtshon cha'i rnam par 'phros/ dbang du bya ba'i sems can rnams kyi spyi bo snying ga dang gsang gnas rnams su phog pas de rnams kyi yid rang dbang med bskul te bdag gi dbang du 'dus shing kun kyang phyir mi ldog pa thar pa mchog gi lam la bkod par bsam la/ dzapra sngags bzlas 357

shing sngags kyi grangs mtshams dang thun mtshams rnams su smon lam gdab pa ni rgyal pa'i thugs rje byin rlabs dang : skye 'gro mthong thos dran reg sogs: khams gsum dbang du 'dus gyur cig: ces tshar ci nus brjod/ mthar snod kyi 'jig rten pad+ma can gyi zhing dang bcud kyi sems can pad+ma sems dpar gyur par bsams la dmigs med du bzhag pama'i lta ba'i dzapra dkyil snying gar bstim ba rjes sdud gong du bshad pa ltar bya ba ste dbang gi las rim dmigs thun gsum pa'o/ /de nas drag po'i phrin las bsgrub pa ni/ dus ni srod kyi dus su kha byang phyogs su bstan te rang nyid pad+ma 'byung gnas kha dog stong zil bcag pa lta bur gnag pa pad zhwa chos gos ber phod gsang gos rnams mig sman gyi g.yung drung lta bur gsol ba/ phyag na ral gri me 'bar ba dang thod khrag gis bkang ba 'dzin pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la 'khyud pa zhabs phyed skyil la pus po g.yas tsog bur bslangs te bzhugs par bsam la dzapra dkyil gyi gnas thugs kar gong ltar pad rdor dang r+ghaṃ mthing bye brag pa gsang gnas bde skyod 'khor lo pad ljang 'dab ma nyer brgyad pa'i lte bar ral gri rdo rje byed pa'i yu ba can gyi lte ba khong seng du rgyu yig nag po de mthar rtsa ba'i sngags dang las sngags rgyu mā ra ya phaṭaḥkyis bskor bar bsam la spro bsdu ni/ thugs ka'i dzapra dkyil las 'od zer mthing nag me ltar 'khrugs pa 'phros/gsang gnas ral gri sngags phreng r+ghaṃ yig la phog /sngags phreng drag tu 'khor hūṃ las 'od zer mthing nag gis nam mkha'i khyon khengs shing rgyal ba rnams dgyes bskul byas te/ lha rnams kyi gsang gnas nas 'od zer mthing nag tsha la rtsub pa mtshon cha sna tshogs pa'i dbyibs can lta bu byung nas rang gi gsang gnas kyi dzapra dkyil la thim pas khams gsum 'khor ba dus gcig tu sgrol nus pa'i mthu dbang thob par bsam la/ slar yang de las 'od zer gnam lcags zhun ma dang mgar gyi sol me dang rdo rje'i char lta bu'i mtshon cha dang las byed khro tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa phyogs thams cad 'phros nas bdag cag dpon slob kyis chos byang chub sgrub pa gnod cing 'tshe bar byed par byed pa'i dgra bgegs 'byung po byad ma rbod gtong bdud dang dam sri gdug pa can thams cad lcags kyus bzung zhags pas 'ching lcags sgrog gis bsdoms dril bus myos su bcug mtshon cha'i char gyis phye mar gtubs te dug gsum rang bzhin sha khrag rus pa las byed khro bo'i tshogs kyis hab sgra di ri ri lhagi ma med par gsol ba yang yang bsam ste rtsa sngags las sngags spel kyin bzlas/ bzlas pa'i bar dang thun mtshams rnams su dmod pa gdab pa ni/ dam sri 'byung po ma rungs pa: bstan dgra sgos dgra la sogs pa: zhing bcu ldan rnams brlag gyur cig: ces ci ltar 'os pa brjod/ mthar snod kyi 'jig rten sna tshogs rdo rje'i zhing dang bcud kyi sems can spyi dang bye brag tu gong du bsgral ba'i 'gro ba de rnams kyi sems rgyud 358

yongs su dag par byas te las kyi sems dpar gyur par bsam la/ de nas rim bzhin snod bcud 'od kyi gong bur bdag la thim nas dmigs med ka dag ngang du bzhag pa'am gsang ba'i dzapra dkyil snying gar bstems te rjes sdud bsgom pa gang bde bya la drag po'i las te dmigs thun bzhi pa'o/ /de ltar las bzhi'i dmigs thun bzhi thun chen gcig tu bsdams pas dngos gzhi bskyed rim lha khrid kyi dmigs skor brgyad pa'o/ /de ltar phrin las bzhi sgrub kyi rim pa phyogs su dus kha dog nas sngags spro bsdu smon lam ste don dam bdun gyis bsdus pa 'di ni gter gzhung rtsa ba las dngos su bstan pa ltar gsungs pa nyid gtso bor byas shing shugs bstan du rnam grangs gzhan yang 'byung bar go la thugs sgrub gzhan nas las byed rigs bzhi thugs ka nas spra ba dang / yang las byed kyi lha gnas bzhir bkod pa sogs kyang 'byung mod/ 'dir ni gong du bshad pa nyid gtso bo yin no/ /da ni bzhi pa las mtha' rgyas che'i sgrub pa'i rim pa ni/ de yang bdag bskyed gcig pu la brten nas sgrub pa dang / mdun bskyed la brten nas sgrub pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ de yang gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig las/ bdag bskyed rkyang sgrub byed na: rang nyid kyi thugs kar pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba trīḥdakar po de'i mthar sngags phreng 'od lnga'i mdangs dang ldan pas 'khor bar dmigs te bzla'o: zhes 'byung ba ltar yin la/ 'on kyang 'dir bla ma'i man ngag gis cung zad kha bskangs te gsal bar bshad na/ rang nyid gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas su gsal ba'i thugs kar pad dkar ze'i 'bru'i dbus su pha lam rdo rje rtse lnga pa mas kyi rwa rnams ze'u 'bru'i dbus su nub pa lte bar nyi zla ga'i kha sbyor gyi dbus su dwangs ma lnga ldan gyi ngo bo yi ge trīḥdakar po rnyog pa dang bral ba'i khrog par yi ge groḥljang gu/ de'i nang du yi ge aḥdakar po gnas pa'i phyir la mtha' skor du oṃ āḥrgyu badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi ā yu dza r+ghaṃ dz+ra dzaḥzhes yig 'bru gyen 'greng re re bzhin lnga ldan 'od zer gyi mu khyud a long dz+rel pa lta bu'i nang du gnas te bklag thabs su 'khod par bsam la dzapra dkyil ji bzhin ma gsal bar du nan gyis bsgom/ de nas dzapra bzlas pas sngags kyi phreng ba las rang sgra dang bcas te 'od zer byung trīḥyig la phog /de las 'od zer bun bun phrom phrom nar te byung phyi snod kyi 'jig rten 'byung ba lnga'i bcud dwangs ma/ nang bcud khams gsum sems can ma lus pa'i tshe dpal 'byor pa khyad par sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang 'phags tshogs rnams kyi thugs rje las grub pa'i tshe bcud kyi dwangs ma rnams 'od zer rdo rje lcags kyu dang zhags pa bum pa thod pa'i rnam pas bsdus nas tshe bcud 'od zer zab chen gyi skud pa lta bu dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ga dang / bdud rtsi kha dog lnga dang yi ge trīḥdz+raḥ.āḥyi rnams par byung ba rang gi smin mtshams dang dbang po'i sgo nas zhugs/ thugs srog trīḥdang tshe rten sa bon 359

la sib sib thim pas 'chi ba med pa rdo rje'i sku tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin dngos su grub par bsam las bzlas pa ci nus su 'bad par bya ste 'di ni bdag bskyed rtsa ba'i dmigs pa ste dmigs thun dang po'o/ /yang skabs su pad+ma 'od 'bar gyi gnas lngar phyag mtshan lnga dang yig 'bru lnga ste spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po āḥyis mtshan pa/ snying gar rdo rje r+ghaṃ gis mtshan pa/ lte ba nor bu swā yis mtshan pa/ gsang gnas su sna tshogs rdo rje hā yis mtshan pa de rnams las 'od zer sna tshogs pa nam mkha'i khyon khengs pa dang / pho nya lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ /'byung ba lnga yi bcud bsdus phyogs skyong sogs mthu chen tshe la dbang ba rnams kyi lag nas tshe bkug lha klu mi'i rig 'dzin drang srong tshe la mnga' brnyes pa rnams kyi 'chi med grub pa'i tshe g.yang dang rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa rnams kyi byin rlabs nus pa las byung ba'i tshe dpal mtha' dag pa bsdus/ 'od zer dkar la 'tsher bsnum la 'dril bar rang dang dmigs bya bla ma mched lcam pha ma la sogs pa'i spyi bo nas mar lhub lhub bab rkyal ba zho yis khengs pa ltar lus bdud rtsis khengs/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba mchog tu rgyas pa'i 'chi med rdo rje lta bu'i skur gyur lus rdo rje pha lam gyi rang bzhin bsdu rdo rje phyed pa rjes gtams par bsams la bzlas pa ci nus bya ste dmigs thun gnyis pa'o/ /'di ni gzhung rdo rje'i tshig las/ gsang ba'i don gyi pad+ma tshe dpag medoḥ gnas lnga phyag mtshan lnga dang yig 'bru lnga: 'od zer dpag yas nam mkha' gang bar 'phros: zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa skabs 'dir cung zad gsal bar phyes pa yin la/ gzhan dmigs pa rgyas pa ni bum pa tshe dbang bskur skabs su rdo rje'i gsung gi tshig zin ltar sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i bcud rnams so sor sdud cing bstem pa dang / nang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bye brag so so'i tshe bcud bsdus nas bstem pa sogs spyi dang mthun pas 'dir rgyas par ma spros shing rgyun khyer snying po ni gong du bshad pa kho nar 'dus so/ /rjes thun mtshams la 'jug pa'i skabs su rang lus pha lam gyi rdo rje rtse lnga par bsams la/de nas dmigs med ka dag gi ngang du ci gnas su bzhag pa ni khyad par nyid do/ /gnyis pa mdun bskyed kyi rim pa ni/ nyi zla gza' skar la rten byas te tshe sgrub pa dang / gangs ri rtag chags la brten te tshe sgrub pa dang / de bzhin ri bo lhun stug dang / bag ri sra brtan dang / g.yu mtsho rtag 'khyil rnams la brten te tshe sgrub par gsungs shing / de rnams bdag bskyed ji bzhin mdun du gsal ba btab ste gong gi dmigs pa nyid spro bsdu'i sgo nas bdag mi che'i dngos grub thob par bsams la bzlas pa byed 360

pa nyid de tshul 'di nan tan byin rlabs dang nus mthu chen po yin pas rim par 'bad par bya'o/ /yang gnas skabs bum pa dang gtor ma dang tshe ril tshe chang re re la yang brten te sgrub par gsungs mod/ 'on kyang gtso bo bum pa la brten te sgrub par bcas shom dang dmigs rim gyi skabs su gsal bar gsungs pas/ de nas gza' skar bzang por bum pa mtshan ldan rgyan gyis spras pa chu dang bum rdzas kyis sum gnyis gang ba bshams la dmigs pa'i rim pa ni gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig las 'di skad ces gsungs te/ bdag mdun gyi 'od zer 'phro 'dus phyi snod nang bcud thams cad lha sngags su gsal ba'i gzi brjid kyis sangs rgyas byang sems rtsa ba gsum dang chos skyong thams cad kyi che'i byin rlabs dang / 'byung ba'i bcud kyi dwangs ma thams cad dang : drang srong rig 'dzin tshe la dbang ba thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs: mdor na sems can bsod nams can dkar po dge ba'i las sgrub cing :dbang che ba: rtsa la drag pa: 'khor mang ba: yon tan che ba: stobs dang snyan grags ldan pa gdul bya phrin las can rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams thams cad yi ge dz+raḥ'i rnam pa kha dog sna tshogs kyi li li bum pa'i nang du 'khyil bar bsam: zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ de yang bdag mdun zhes pa'i sgras bdag bskyed dang mdun du bum chu'i steng du gu ru bsgoms pa gnyis ka'i phyag g.yon pa'i thod pa'i nang na bum pa 'chi med bdud rtsis khengs pa'i dbus su dz+raḥ'od 'khyil le ba bsgom zhing / bdag don yin na thun mtshams rnams su rang gi snying gar thugs srog la bstem pa dang / gzhan don yin na dmigs bya de la bstem pa'am bum pa'i chu dang dbyer med byas na tshe dbang bskur ba yang yin no/ /tshul de lta bu yang gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig las/ phyi ni bum pa nang gi bdud rtsis gang : gsang ba'i don ni pad+ma tshe dpag med: ces gsungs pa'i dgongs pa nyid du'ang 'gyur ba'o/ /khrid kyi skabs su bdag bskyed kho na 'chad pas rung mod 'phros byung na mdun bskyed kyi tshul cung zad smos pa ste dmigs thun gsum pa'o/ /de ltar tshe khrid dmigs thun gsum thun chen gcig tu bsdams pas dngos gzhi bskyed rim lha khrid kyi dmigs skor dgu pa'o/ /de nas spyi don gnyis pa bskyed pa'i rim pa dang rjes su 'bral ba'i man ngag khyad par bdag brjod pa bya ste/ de yang gter gzhung rtsa bar yo ga gsum gyi sgrub thabs 'grigs chags su gsungs shing / ma hā a nu a ti yo ga'i don bskyed dang rdzogs dang rdzogs pa chen po'i brdar bzhag cing skabs 'dir rdzogs dang rdzogs chen yang bskyed rim dang rjes su 'bral ba'i tshul du gsungs par snang la dngos bstan rdzogs dang rdzogs chen ni 'og tu bshad par 'gyur ba'i gtum mo dang ka dag lhun grub kyi khrid bka' nyid yin mod/ 'dir bstan bya bskyed rim rjes 'bral tshul du gsungs pa ni/ a nu rdzogs 361

rim tshul gyis nyams su len pa dang / a ti rdzogs chen gyis la bzla bste gnyis so/ /dang po la yar khyer so gsum gyis lam du khyer ba dang / sku dang zhing khams 'du 'bral med par la bzla ba dang / 'od gsal rnal 'byor gyi dbyings su bsdu ba ste gsum mo/ /de la dang po ni gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig rtsa rgyud le'u drug par/ a nu yo ga'i rdzogs rim ni: spyod lam rnam bzhir ting 'dzin gsal: zhes dang /yo ga gsum gyi sgrub thabs lhag pa'i rnal 'byor las/ /rang nyid pad+ma 'od 'bar gyi bskyed rim la gnas pas: gzugs snang thams cad lha sku: sgra grags thams cad gsang sngags: dran rtog thams cad chos nyid: gar bzhugs thams cad gzhal yas khang : su 'gro thams cad yi dam mkha' 'gro:spyod lam thams cad chos nyid rdzogs pa chen po las ma 'das so: zhes gsungs pa ltar bskyed rim lha khrid dngos gzhi'i skabs su bshad pa bzhin gu ru pad+ma'i sku gsal brtan dag pa la yun ring goms par byas shing / de la brten nas sems zhi ba yang ci rigs 'grub cing / lha sku rang shar du 'byung ba nyid ni lam 'di yi rnal 'byor rjes mthun pa yin la/ tshul de lam du byed pa khyer so gsum la spyod pa ste/de yang 'di ltar mthong yul gzugs su snang ba kun sgyu ma lta bu la gu ru pad+ma'i sku yi rang bzhin grags pa sgra snang kun gzhom du med pa badz+ra gu ru'i rang sgra/ rtog tshogs blo yi byed pa kun kyang rang rig rang gsal spros bral chos nyid kyi rang mdangs su ngo shes shing / de lta bu'i mos pa lam byed rang bab dran shes mi 'jal bar chu bo'i rgyun bzhin nyams su len par bya ste/ des ni ma dag pa'i dngos zhen bzlog/sgo gsum gyi sgrub pa sbyangs/ bsod nams ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs/ gnas gar sdod gzhal yas khang /grogs su 'grogs yi dam lha/ spyod lam ci byed chos nyid kyi rol par 'grub pa sogs phan yon tshad med pa nyid de dmigs thun dang po'o/ /de ltar khyer so gsum la ci nus su blo bzhag cing / sku dang zhing khams 'du 'bral med par la bzla ba ni/ gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig las/ rang gi 'od zer gyis zhing khams thams cad la khyab pa:zhing khams kyi bkod pa'i yon tan thams cad rang lus snang stong dbyer med la ye nas gnas pa: sku che chung dang rnam 'gyur ma nges par mdzod do: zhes gsungs pa ltar nyams su len pa ni/ rang gi lus gnas gsum rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin yig 'bru gsum las 'od zer 'phros sku yi nang khengs/ sku las 'od zer kha dog lnga pas zhing khams thams cad rang bzhin gyis khyab cing 'od snang dang zhing khams gdod nas dbyer mi phyed pa rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa zung 'jug chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos shing / zhing khams mtha' dag pa'i bkod pa dang / yon tan kun kyang rang gi lus 'od gsal dri ma med pa'i snying po rdo rje'i sku dang dbyer mi phyed pa ye nas lhan skyes bde ba chen po'i ngo bor gnas pa 362

sku'i rnam 'gyur che chung tshad med rnam pa thams cad pa'i bdag nyid can yin nas yin bzhin du ngo shes shing thag bcad de/ de'i ngang du ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag pa la 'bad par bya de'i skabs su bzlas pa la yang brtson pa/ gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig las/ de'i tshe rlung dang yid kyi bzlas pa la brtson pa bya'o: zhes gsungs pa ltar rlung 'byin 'jug gnas gsum dang / 'jam rlung gdang stong dang /rtsub rlung bum pa can gyi sbyor ba la brten/ 'bru gsum mam rtsa bsnyen la rdo rje'i bzlas pa bya ba dang /rlung rang bab tu bzhag nas sems ma yengs rang byung rdo rje sgra sngags la mnyam par bzhag pa yang gal che bas gong dang zung 'jug tu nyams su blang ba ste dmigs thun gnyis pa'o/ /'od gsal rnal 'byor gyis dbyings su sdud pa ni/ gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig las/ spros bcas kyi rdzogs rim yang dbu zhabs nas rim bzhin zhu ba rang sems dang nam mkha' dbyer med khyab gdal chen po'i nyams pa bskyang : zhes pas 'od gsal gyi gdams pa dngos su hril 'dzin bstan pa dang /slar yang chu las nya ldang ba'i tshul gyis snang stong dbyer med du bskyang : zhes pas 'od gsal gyi grub 'bras zung 'jug gi sku lam du byed pa bstan/ rjes gzhig ni stong gsal gyi nyams rang lus med pa dang / 'byung ba rang dbang thob pa'i rtags mang du 'byung ngo : zhes gnas skabs kyi phan yon mdor bstan nas gsungs pa ste/ de yang thog mar hril 'dzin ji ltar bsgom pa ni/ rang nyid gu ru'i sku ru gsal ba de yi sku yi mtha' nas rim pas yal te sku'i cha stod la 'dus/ 'od zer phrig phrig blta bas mi bzod pa de yang gor bur zhu nas sems dpa' gsum brtsegs rim par thim pa'am yang na gnas gsum gyi ye ger thim/ de yang stong pa'i ye shes 'bru gsum go rim bzhin 'dus shing r+ghaṃ yig thig le nā da'i mthar stong nyid spros bral bde ba chen por sems ci gnas su bzhag cing slar yang de ltar bskyar zhing yang yang bsgoms pas rlung dbu mar thim zhing rgas dkar tshe ring 'chi ba 'od gsal ngos zin mthar thug don dam pa'i 'od gsal la mtshams sbyor ba sogs phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ 'di gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig gi don bla ma'i man ngag snyan brgyud khyad par can gyis kha bkang ste bstan pa yin no/ /'di dang 'bral ba rjes gzhig gi rnal 'byor ni/ snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim zhing / de 'od gsal ru gzhig pa gong du rtsa ba'i sgrub pa zhi ba'i rjes sdud du bshad zin pa ltar nyams su blang bar bya la/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis slar lha sku'i ldang ste gong du sku dang zhing khams 'du 'bral med pa'i don la bsam ste mnyam par bzhag pa yang zung 'jug lam du byed par shin tu gal che ba ste/ de rnams bsdams pas dmigs thun gsum pa'o/ /a nu'i dmigs thun gsum pa de thun chen gcig tu bsdams pas dngos gzhi'i dmigs skor bcu pa'o/ /de ltar a nu yo ga'i rdzogs rim 363

lam khyer gsum sogs rim pa bzhin 'dus pa la sogs pa'i rim lnga dang cha mthun par go ste/ lam khyer gsum ni dben gsum/ sku dang zhing khams dbyer med snga ma ni sgyu lus/ lha sku sdud rim ni 'od gsal/ lha skur ldang nas sku dang zhing khams dbyer med phyi ma ni slob pa'i zung 'jug gi don du 'gyur ba'o/ /de yang sku dang zhing khams 'du 'bral med pa dngos gnas ni mi slob pa'i zung 'jug skabs dang / de tshul bzhin nyams 'og tu chub pa ni slob pa'i zung 'jug gi skabs/ de 'od gsal spyi yi tshul du rtogs pa ni sems dben gyi mthar thug ma dag sgyu lus su grags pa yan chad nas yod pa shes par bya'o/ /skabs 'dir gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig tu/ gu ru'i sku'i rnam 'gyur mtshan brgyad sogs ci snyed bstan kyang ngo bo kun 'dus yid bzhin nor bu pad+ma 'od 'bar kho nar 'dus pas des na dkon mchog spyi 'dus su mtshan gsol ba'i rgyu mtshan che thang dang bcas te gsung na dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi chos bka' 'di la mtshan brgyad sgos sgrub kyi kha bskang sogs ni mi dgos par rtogs so/ /de ni spyi don gnyis pa a ti rdzogs chen ltar nyams su len pa ni/ rtsa rgyud rdo rje'i tshig las/ a ti khyab gdal chen po ni: gu ru pad+ma 'od 'bar de: logs na yod pa ma yin no: zhes dang / de yi sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las kyang / rang nyid lha ru snang ba de: lha nyid rang la rang nyid lha: sems nyid rtogs na sangs rgyas te: sems las sangs rgyas gzhan ma tshol: zhes dang / ma bsgrubs ye nas rang byung gnas: ma btsal bzhag pas rang sa zin: de ltar rtogs na o rgyan mkhan: chos nyid don gyi pad 'byung yin: zhes dang / pad+ma 'byung gnas kyang rang sems kyi mdangs cha yin te: rang sems ni dus gsum gyi spros pa dang bral te ka dag ngos bzung med pa rang bzhin lhun grub chen po sangs rgyas kyi ma glod: sems can gyis ma bsgrims pa de bzhin du rtogs na pad+ma bdag dang dgongs pa gcig tu 'tshang rgya ba yin no: zhes gsungs pa ltar rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo rnam pa kun mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid spros bral skye ba med pa la rang gdangs 'gag pa med pa'i snang cha gu ru pad+ma'i sku wa ler shar ba de yang sems nyid stong pa las gzhan du ma grub cing / sems nyid stong pa yang gu ru'i sku las gzhan du ma 'das pa ste gdod nas zab gsal dbyer med bde ba chen po'i ngo bor shar ba de ka sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi ngo bo yin la yin par shes bzhin du ma yengs pa'i dran pas rtag tu skyong nas nyams su len par bya ba ste dngos gzhi'i dmigs skor bcu gcig pa'o/ /'di ni bskyed rim mtha' dag la rgyas 'debs byed gnad gal po che yin pas go myong rtogs gsum gyis gtan la phab par bya ste/ des na snying por dril nas bstan pa yin la gzhan gong gi gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig gi 'bru don rgya cher bkral na legs mod kyang yi ge'i ngal bas brir ma long zhing gnas lugs kyi don khong du chud pas ni shugs 364

kyis rtogs par 'gyur zhing / de'i tshul 'ga' zhig ni 'og tu rdzogs rim dngos gzhi bstan pa'i skabs su 'chad par 'gyur bas der shes par bya'o/ /de ltar dngos gzhi bskyed rim lha khrid kyi skor ting 'dzin gsum rjes 'bral bcas la dmigs bskor brgyad dang phyi sgrub la dmigs skor gcig nang sgrub la dmigs skod brgyad/ gsang sgrub la dmigs skor bzhi/ yang gsang la dmigs skor gsum/phrin las bzhi sgrub la dmigs skor bzhi/ tshe sgrub la dmigs skor gsum/ rjes 'bral a nu la dmigs skor gsum/ a ti la dmigs skor gcig ste thun chung sum cu so lnga dang thun chen bcu gcig ste des bskyed rim lha khrid kyi dmigs skor legs par grub pa yin la/ de dag gi cha rkyen rnal 'byor du ldang ba'i tshe na zung 'jug sgyu ma lta bu'i lha skur ldang ba dang / gos oṃ āḥhūṃ gi byin gyis brlabs nas bdag nyid lhar blta bas gyon pa dang / zas 'bru gsum gyi byin gyisabarlabs nas phung po lha dkyil gyi tshogs su rol pa dang / 'gro tshe phrag g.yas kyi nam mkhar rtsa gsum gsal btab nas skor ba dang / sdod sa gnas khang ye shes kyi gzhal yas khang dang / gnyid log tshe rjes sdud rnal 'byor gyis gnyid 'od gsal du gzhugs pa sogs lam gyi yan lag kyang ji ltar 'os pa nyams su len par bya'o/ /de yang bskyed rim gyi rnam par bzhag pa mtha' dag ni dam k+ṣa mchog gi zhal lung legs par mnyan pa las 'dir yi ger bri bar ma long zhing / zab pa'i gnad phra mo yang bla ma'i gsung las gnyan dgos mod/ 'on kyang bsgom bya nyams len gyi snying po zab gsal lhag pa nyid du chos 'di'i zhabs tog gi ched du dmigs nas bklags chog gi tshul du bdag gis gsal bar phyes te bshad pa yin no/ /'dir smras pa/ rgyal bas gdul byar gyur la sman slad du/ ma dag dngos 'dzin zhen pa yongs 'gog phyir/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgom dang bzlas/ /thabs tshul sngags rgyud kun tu rtag par gsungs/ /des na blo ldan rnams kyis dngos grub las/ /rab 'byams khyad par phyag rgya mchog nyid kyi/ /go 'phang bzang po ring min bsgrub slad du/ /rtag tu 'bad pa'i gnas su nges par 'gyur/ /des na sngags kyi dkyil 'khor mtha' dag gi/ /gtso mchog dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /gang gi sgrub thabs khyad par 'phags pa 'di/ /skal bzang dad pa'i gtsug gis cis mi bsten/ /rnam gsum ting 'dzin mchog gi dkyil 'khor la/ /phyi nang gsang yang grub pa'i tshom bu bkra/ /phrin las bzhi ldan 'chi med tshe mchog rgyas/ /lhag par phul byung rnal 'byor 'bras bu smin/ /tshul 'di tshe rabs sngar goms bla ma'i byin/ /snying la zhugs mthus shes dbang bzang po yis/ /ma 'khrul zab gdams nor bu 'di spel na/ /skal bzang yid bde'i dpal du spyod par shog /ces rdzogs chen yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi khrid yig gu ru'i dgongs rgyan nyin byed snying po las bskyed rim lha khrid kyi skor bshad pa'i skabs te gnyis pa'o/ /sarba maṅga lo// 365

rna༄ga /gu ru'i skub thabs yid bzhin nor bu bsam pa lhan grub ma'i gsal byed zin ris don gsal nyi ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī/ phyogs dus sras bcas rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /spyi gzugs skyabs gsum ngo bo bka' drin can/ /dran mchog mgon po tshe dbang nor bu'i zhabs/ /byang chub bar gyi gtsug gtor rgyan du mchod/ /mchod khyed pad 'byung dngos dang mi gnyis kyang / /gdul bya'i mos ngor sgrib bral dgongs pa'i mtshor/ /byin rlabs zla gzugs gsal ba'i yid bzhin gter/ /rmad byung zab lam gdams mchog 'gro ba'i dpal/ /gang 'dir zab brling dpag dka'i don/ /ma nor go sla dgongs 'grel tshul/ /rags rim dam pa'i gsung gi bcud/ /zin tho cung zad 'dir bkod bya/ /'dir gu ru'i gsol 'debs kyi sgrub thabs bskyed rdzogs kyi zab lam ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba 'di 'chad pa la spyi don gsum ste/ phun sum tshogs pa lnga dang ldan pa'i sngon 'gro bstan pa dang / rtsa ba dang yan lag gi sgrub thabs dngos bshad pa dang / gdams pa'i rgyu mtshan che brjod smon lam dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ mchod par brjod pa dang / rtsa ba'i gzhung dang bcas pa'i man ngag bshad par dam bca' ba/ sngon du 'gro ba'i rim pa bstan pa'o/ /dang po gnyis go sla/ gsum pa ni/ de la spyi dang bye brag gnyis kyis bstan: de sogs sho lo ka gcig gi don bshad pa la/ zab mo'i lam sgrub pa la phun sum tshogs pa lnga dang ldan dgos pas/ 'chad pa po slob dpon ni byin rlabs brgyud par ldan pa ston pa phun tshogs dang / nyan pa po slob ma dam tshig dang dad gus ldan na 'khor phun tshogs te/ de ltar snod bcud mtshan nyid dang ldan pa 'dzom na dus phun tshogs yin pas chos phun sum tshogs pa shugs las 'grub/ gnas ni yid du 'ong zhing snod min dang nyer 'tshe med pa'i dben gnas su blo sbyong phyag rgya bzhi'am/ lta ba bka' rtags kyi phyag rgya bzhi zhes bya bas khog phub ste/ 'di ltar 'dus byas kyi dngos po thams cad 'jig pa'i chos can mi rtag par lta ba dang / 'khor ba'i bde 'byor sogs gnas skabs thams cad ni zag pa dang bcas pa ste/ sdug bsngal du shes par byas te 'khor ba las yid dbyung /chos thams cad ni bdag med pa dang / zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa nye bar zhi ba'i thar pa don gnyer gyi blos kun nas bslangs te dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang 'chi ba mi rtag pa dran pas rgyud bskul/ las 'bras 3ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ med dang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsams te 'khor ba la blo ldog /thar pa'i phan yon dang

dkon mchog gi yon tan dran pas spro ba dang dad pa bskyed de skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ phyag mchod/bshags sdom/ gsung rab bklag pa/ sāts+tsha 'debs pa/ srog bslu/ sbyin gtong sogs bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya cher bsag pa dang / sdig pa sbyong ba'i thabs la 'bad rtsol sngon du 'gro bas rang rgyud dag par byas la gsang ba zab mo'i snod du rung bar bya ba'i phyir/ 'di nyid kyi rtsa ba'i dbang thob na mchog /de min rnal 'byor bla med kyi dkyil 'khor gang rung du dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa'am/ gu ru gsang ba 'dus pa lta bu'i dbang gis smin par bya ba rnams so/ /spyi don gnyis pa sgrub thabs dngos bshad pa la spyi sgrub dang / yan lag gnyis kyi dang po ni/ de nas dngos gzhi rtsa ba'i sgrub pa la: zhes sogs blo ka brgyad kyis bstan pa'i rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs kun 'dus nor bu lugs su sgrub pa la sdom ni/ tshogs zhing gsal btab skyabs sems dang / /yan lag bcu phul ye tshogs bsag /srung 'khor drug bsgom sngon 'gro'i sdom/ /zhes sa bcad drug gi dang po tshogs zhing gsal gdab pa ni/ stan bde ba la skyil krung gis 'dug nas/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i gu ru pad+ma la bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang bcas pas bskor te bzhugs par bsams la/ gnyis pa skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ khyed shes kyi dad pa re ltos ling bskyur gyis ngag tu/ /bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku: dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin la: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams: byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi: zhes brgya stong sogs ci mang bya/ gsum pa sems bskyed pa la ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can pha dang ma'i rang bzhin drin can 'di rnams sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang 'bras bu la longs spyod cing rtag tu 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje/ ma rnams sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa zhig nam yod na snyam du smon pa sems bskyed/ ma rnams byang chub thob phyir bdag gi sgo gsum dge ba la bkol te bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par bya/ de'i ched du gu ru'i sgrub pa nyams su len par bya'o snyam pas/ sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don du: bla ma sangs rgyas bsgrubs nas ni: gang la gang 'dul phrin las kyis: 'gro drug sgrol bar dam bca' ba'o: zhes snying thag pas bya ste 'jug pa sems bskyed dang bde sdug gi btang bzhin gnas nas bla yi dam skyabs gnas mchod yul thams cad spyan drangs par mos pa sogs tshig gi don dran pas/ na mo/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol/ /nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod tshogs 'bul/ /nyams chags 'gal 'khrul mthol lo bshags/ /'khor 'das dge ba rjes yi rang / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo/ /yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog /367

ces yang yang bya ste/ spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol yan lag bdun/ /mthar smon lam ste yan lag bcu pa 'bul ba tshogs bsags gi mchog yin la/ spro na sku gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal yang 'bul lo/ /mthar tshogs zhing rnams rang la bsdus te bsngo ba bya/ /zhar byung rdor sems yig brgya'i sgom bzlas bya ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang gi spyi gtsug tu bsgoms nas stobs bzhi tshang pa bshags pa'i tshul du bzla ba bya rgyud/ snying ga la sogs pa bsgom pa spyod rgyud/ rang lus rdor sems su bsgom pa rnal 'byor/ snang grags lha sngags su gsal ba'i ngang nas bzla ba bla med kyi tshul bzhi po gang ltar bsgom yang chog gsung ngo / /lnga pa ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa ni/ tshogs zhing rang la bstems rjes/ ye shes kyi tshogs kyi ngo bo yang dag pa'i don gyi gnas lugs bsgom pa yin/ de yang phyi gzung ba'i yul gyi snang ba bem po rnams dang sems can sogs pa 'di ni 'di'o zhes nang 'dzin pa'i sems rnam rtog gi snang ba gang la yang bzang ngan sogs kyis rtsis gdab med par shes pa khong glod cing don de yang yang bskyar rtsal ba dang / phra mo'i rtog dpyod kyi rnam rtog thams cad ni yan lag ste mdor na phra rags kyi rnam rtog gang shar thams cad lang bdag tu 'dzin pa med par stong pa nyid du sbyong ba ste/ snang yul dang 'dzin sems gang la yang der 'dzin ma zhugs pa de ka sbyong ba'i don yin pas gang shar la rtog dpyod kyi blo dang bral ba'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag go/ /drug pa srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ rnam grangs drug ste/ rang nyid gang du yod pa'i gnas de'i 'og gzhi rdo rje rtse dgu rgya gram du yod pa'i rwa rtse rnams gyen du langs shing / steng nas rdo rje'i gur rgya gram gyi rwa rtse rnams mthur du 'phyang ba phyogs mtshams thams cad du bsnol te drwa mig lta bu'i bar gseng rnams su zlog pa'i las mdzad pa'i khro bo mang po zhal phyir gzigs shing / srung ba'i las mdzad pa'i khro bo mang po zhal nang gzigs su yod par bsams te sku'i srung 'khor/ de'i phyi rol tu rdo rje ral gri gri gug dgra sta/ kha ṭ+wāṃ phur bu mda' mdung sogs mtshon cha'i gur rtse mo phyir gzings pa'i phyi nas me ri me dpung gcus thabs su 'ur 'ur 'bar ba'i rtse dang / khro bo rnams kyi zhal nas kyang r+ghaṃ dang phaṭa kyi sgra 'brug stong ldir ba tsam gyis sngags kyi sgrar bsgom pa gsung gi srung 'khor/ rdo rje'i gur khang / de rkyen gang gis kyang bshig par mi nus pa rdo rje'i chos bdun dang ldan pa ste/ mi chod pa/mi shigs pa/ bden pa/ sra ba/ brtan pa/ phar thams cad du thogs pa med pa/ tshur gang gis kyang mi tshugs bsam pham pa'i don bsams te thugs kyi srung 'khor/ gur khang gi nang du yang 'od lnga'i thig le thig phran nam/ rin po che'i gzhal yas khang ngam/ pad+ma'i gur khang gang mos zhig bsgom pa yon tan gyi srung 'khor/ de thams cad kyi phyi rol tu bskal ba'i me dpung gi gur/ de'i phyi rol tu rlung spu gri reg gcod kyi gur/ de'i phyi rol tu chu'i gur te 'byung ba'i rang bzhin phrin las kyi srung 'khor/ de ltar 368

sems snang du bsgom pa'i srung 'khor rnams dang / gnod byed kyi dgra gdon sogs don dam gyi gshis su gang yang ma grub la kun rdzob tu snang ba de yang ma 'gags pa'i ngo bo ye shes kyi rang snang yod med rtag chad dang bral ba sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag ste don dam pa ye shes kyi srung 'khor ro/ /sgrub pa dngos la sdom ni/ rten bskyed spyan 'dren dbang rgyas btab/ /phyag mchod bstod pa gsol 'debs dang / /dbang len 'dzab bzlas rjes sdud dang / /rdzogs rim bcu gcig dngos gzhi'i sdom/ /zhes sa bcad bcu gcig gi dang po gsol 'debs kyi rten bskyed pa la/ srung ba'i gur khang yangs shing rgya che ba'i lte bar rang lus 'di yi dam gdan gsum tshang ba'i don dran par byas te/gdan zhes pa sgyu ma'i lus kyi rten la kun gzhi bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po byang chub kyi sems brten pa'i tshul du gnas pas na gdan zhes bya/ gsum zhes pa ni sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i gdan/ rig ma dang lha mo'i gdan/ khro bo dang khro mo'i gdan zhes pa/ bdag gi gzugs sogs phung po lnga ni sangs rgyas lnga/ mig gi rnam shes sogs tshogs brgyad sems dpa' brgyad de sangs rgyas byang sems kyi gdan/ sa sogs 'byung ba lnga ni yum lnga/ gzugs sogs yul brgyad sems ma brgyad de rig ma dang lha mo'i gdan/ tshigs chen bcu ni khro bo bcu/ yul bcu ni khro mo bcu ste khro bo khro mo'i gdan no/ /de ltar phung khams skye mched thams cad lha'i rang bzhin du gdod nas gnas pa'i mos pa tsam las sku mdog phyag mtshan dang bcas pa'i lhar bsgom mi dgos gsungs/ de ltar mos pa'i spyi bo'i gtsug gam mdun gyi nam mkha' gang mos su bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho sngo zhing dwangs ba rgya khyon gting mtha' 'byams klas pa'i klong nas thon pa'i pad+ma'i sdong po 'dab ma 'bum dang ldan pa/ yal ga dang lo 'bras phun sum tshogs shing ge sar mngon par mtho ba'i steng du nyi ma/ de'i steng du zla ba'i gdan la dus gsum sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can/ zhi 'dzum yid tsam khro ba'i rnam pa phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje lnga pa thugs kar bsnams shing g.yon mnyam gzhag gi steng na ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa'i gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga rtse gsum bsten pa/ dbu la she'u'i snyan zhu pad 'dab can rtse mor rdo rje rtse lnga dang rma bya'i gdongs rgod kyi thel chung gis brgyan cing / me long dang gser gyi nyi zla dar gyi cod pan gyis spras pa gsol zhing / sku la mdo dang mthun pa'i cha lugs chos gos dmar po gser gyi ri mo can dang / sngags kyi cha lugs na bza' phod kha mthing gdangs gsang gos/ 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyi cha lugs zab chen gyi ber skug gser gyi ha ris can gsol ba/zhabs rdo rje skyil krung du bzhugs pa'i sku'i cha shas re rer yang bskal par bltas kyang chog mi shes shing mi ngoms pa mtshan dpe mchog tu rgyas pa'i gzi bajid nyi ma 'bum dang mtshungs shing mthong thos dran pa 369

tsam gyis byang chub kyi 'bras bu 'grub nus pa zhig tu byin thibs se bzhugs par gsal gdab/ gnyis pa ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ gu ru'i dpral bar oṃḥ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar r+ghaṃ gis mtshan par bsgoms pa'i r+ghaṃ las 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros pas bde ba can nas mgon po 'od dpag med kyi thugs ka nas/ thugs rje'i dwangs gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas spyan drangs/ gzhan yang zhing khams rab 'byams thams cad nas rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad gu ru pad+ma'i rnam par byon par bsam zhing / r+ghaṃḥ o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams/ zhes sogs tshig bdun gsol 'debs ci rigs pa brjod cing spyan drangs/ dam tshig pa la thim pas dam ye dbyer med ro mnyam du bzhugs par bsam/ gsum pa dbang bskur rgyas gdab ni/ yang thugs ka nas 'od 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dbang gis lha
