yin te/ don la sprul pa dang sprul gzhi'i khyad par tsam las dbyer med la/ 'di ni spyan ras gzigs yin/ gangs chen mtsho zhes pa ni mdzad pa dang gdul bya zhing khams bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i don yin pas rnam snang du ma zad rigs lnga car la sbyar du rung gsungs/ de yang sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung can/ phyag gnyis thal sbyar gyi bar du ut+pal dmar po sdong bu 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ rus pa'i rgyan dang stag sham gsol ba/ zhal dang spyan zhi ma khro'i rnam pa/ de'i pang du yum gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 399

'gro ma dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'am ut+pal dmar po'i cod pan dang do shal gyis brgyan pa/ spyi bor 'od dpag med dang thugs kar rdo rje sems dpa'/ pad 'dab brgyad la shar dus snying dkar po rin po che'i myu gu/ shar lhor phyag rdor ljang gu rdo rje/ lhor nam snying dkar po ral gri/lho nub tu spyan ras gzigs dmar po pad+ma/ nub tu sgrib sel ljang gu puste/ nub byang du kun bzang dmar po rin po che/ byang du byams pa dkar ser klu shing / byang shar du 'jam dpal dkar ljang ut+pal bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pa'i 'khor gyis bskor bar bsgom/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs kyis spyan 'dren/ bzhugs gsol/ dbang bskur/ rgyas gdab/ mchod bstod sngar dang 'dra/ gsol 'debs ni/nam zhig tshe zad 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe: ces sogs dang rgyun chags kyis gsol ba btab pas gu ru gtso 'khor gyi sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi gnas thams cad byang /de dag gi sdig dang sdug bsngal thams cad sbyangs/ rigs drug sems can thams cad mos pa spyod pa'i sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpar gyur/ 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus de dag thams cad bde ba can gyi zhing khams su drangs/ kun kyang me tog pad+ma'i sbrubs su skyes nas mgon po 'od dpag med kyi zhal mthong / mos spyod la gnas pa thams cad kyang sa bcu rgyun mtha'i byang chub sems dpar gyur par spangs rtogs kyi yon tan rtsal rdzogs te sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la reg pa bsam/ dbang len pa spyi dang mtshungs/ mthar rang la thim pas rang nyid 'phags pa pad+ma'i rgyal po'i skur gyur pa'i thugs kar rdo rje sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar pad+ma'i nyi zla la/ lte bar dz+rīḥ de'i g.yas su oṃ: g.yon du ā:mdun du r+ghaṃ: mtha' bskor du yi ge drug pa'i sngags phreng gis bskor ba gsal gdab/ yang na 'bru bzhi brtsegs byas kyang rung / oṃ snyar+ghaṃ/ gang ltar yang sngags phreng ba las 'od zer 'phros sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa'i tshogs thams cad la mchod pa phul/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad bsdus te rang la thim/ yang 'od zer gyis rigs drug gi gnas kun tu khyab pas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ kun kyang pad+ma rgyal po'i skur gyur par bsams te/ lam khyer rnam gsum las/snod bcud thams cad gzhal yas khang dang lha/ sgra grags thams cad 'phags pa'i gsung yi ge drug ma/ dran rtog thams cad 'phags pa'i thugs kyi rol pa las mi 'da' ba'i dran pa dang shes bzhin gyi sgo nas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ trī:oṃ ma ṇi pad+me r+ghaṃ/ zhes bzla zhing rjes sdud lhar ldang bsngo smon ltar ro/ /rdzogs rim ni/ spyir bskyed rdzogs kyi lam thams cad skye 'chi bar do gsum lam du byed pa las/ 'dir 'chi ba 'od gsal gtso bor bstan pa yin te/ 'chi ba zhes bya ba 'od gsal ba'i rgyu ni 'pho ba dang bcas pa'i rnam 400

pa rtog pa yin/ de la spyir kun rdzob rgyu'i thig le 'pho ba med par bcings te zag med kyi bde ba rgyud la skye bar byed pa'am/ mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i dge bsgrub pa zhes dpal dus kyi 'khor lo sogs nas gsungs la/ kun rdzob rgyu'i thig le 'ching ba de 'pho med yin nam zhe na ma yin te/ 'pho bcas zhes pa/don la snga ma'i rnam rtog 'gag rgyu zhig dang / phyi ma'i rnam rtog skye rgyu zhig 'dug ring la 'pho bcas kyi rnam rtog yin/ snga phyi'i rtog pas bar mi chod pa'i mnyam gzhag khor yug nyin mtshan gyi bar mtshams med pa zhig tu song na 'pho med kyilpe shes yin/ des na 'pho bcas kyi rnam rtog yod pa de srid du dran 'dun gyi rtsis yang dag par bzung nas nyin mo'i snang ba la rgyas gdab cing / mtshan mo'i gnyid 'thug gi 'od gsal sbyang ba 'bad dgos/ 'od gsal de 'byongs pa'i sngon du/ rmi lam gyi 'od gsal/nyams kyi 'od gsal/ srab mo'i 'od gsal gsum po zin dgos/ de bzung ba'i thabs la bzhi/ bla ma'i mos gus la brten nas bzung ba dang / rjes gzhig la brten nas dang / hril 'dzin la brten nas dang / dkar dmar 'du 'phrod la brten nas bzung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rang lus pad+ma'i rgyal po'i skur gsal ba'i snying nang du rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam pa rdo rje sems dpa' sngar bzhin bsgom/ de'i thugs kar gliḥdakar po 'od kyi rang bzhin can zhig bsams la bla ma la mos gus thun mong ma yin pa'i sgo nas gsol ba btab pas/ trīḥlas 'od zer nyi ma shar ba lta bur 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad 'od kyis gang bas lus 'ja' 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ rim par gnas khang dang lung pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyang bkra sal le yod par bsam zhing 'od gsal shar ba ngos zin par bya snyam pa'i 'dun pa yang yang gsal btab ste gnyid do/ /gnyis pa ni/ snod bcud thams cad rim gyis bsdus nas rang lus yi dam du gsal ba la thim/ de pad gdan nas yang rim par me long la has btab pa ltar bsdus te trīḥl thim/ de gi gu'i bar du thim/ gi gu je phra je phrar mi dmigs par bzhag /rtog pa nam shar yang yi dam gyi skur wal gyis ldang / yang sngar bzhin bsgom/ 'od gsal zin par bya snyam pa'i 'dun pa yang yang bya/ gsum pa ni/ snod bcud thams cad skad cig la 'ub kyis 'dus nas rang la thim ste mi dmigs par bzhag /de gnyis la rim gyi bsdu ba dang / skad cig la bsdu ba'i khyad par tsam mo bzhi pa ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma gsal btab pa'i yar rtser thig le dkar po dang / mar sner thig le dmar po sran ma tsam re bsgoms la/ dkar po mar byung / dmar po yar byung nas snying ga'i thad du reg la khang du byas/ yang so sor dgyes/ gnyis yur byung ba dang / yang reg la khad du byas so sor gyes/ mthar dkar dmar gnyis khrug gis 'dres nas dbu ma'i nad thams cad khams dwangs mas gang bas lus thams cad bde mer gyur pa'i ngang la ma yengs par gnyid cing / 401

'dun pa ni yang nas yang du bya'o/ /de ltar nyams su blangs pas 'khrul snang dag ste 'od gsal gyi gdams pa rang byan tshud nas/ 'chi kha zhes rnam shes 'od gsal la thim pa dang lhan cig 'chi ba chos sku'i zhing khams la sangs rgya bar 'gyur te grol ba thob pa zhes bya'o/ /bskyed rdzogs gang gi'ang thun mtshams rnams su sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyi mtshan brgya dang / za ma tog gi mdo bklag /nyin mtshan thun drug tu 'chi khar gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal mi 'byung ba dang / bde ba can du skye ba'i smon lam gdab bo/ /gu ru pad+ma rgyal po'i sgrub pas 'chi ba lam du khyer ba yid bzhin nor bu dang 'dra ba'i man ngag le'u bcu pa'o/ /shulha/man ngag bcu gcig pa gu ru snang mtha'i sgrub pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bde ba can gyi zhing khams lag mthil ltar mnyam pa gser gyi sa gzhi la be+eḍūr+ya'i mig mang ris su byas pa'i snying por dpag bsam shing rin po che pad+ma rnam par snang ba zhes bya ba rin po che'i rang bzhin dpangs su dpag tshad stong dang drug brgya pa lo ma re re yang bkra shis rtags brgyad dang / 'bras bu re rer rgyal srid sna bdun gyi bkod pas mdzes pa/ sprul pa'i bya tshogs mang pos sgra skad snyan par sgrogs pa de lta bu la sku rgyab brten nas pad+ma'i sdong po 'dab stong ldan pa dang zla gdan la/ gu ru pad+ma rnam pa sangs rgyas 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgyan can/ chos gos gsum gsol ba/ mdzod spu sum cu rtsa gnyis dkar zhing dwangs la rnyogs pa dang bral ba/ phyag zhabs 'khor los mtshan pa sogs mtshan dpe rdzogs pa/ de'i shar du sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa sngon po sa gnon dang mnyam gzhag gi steng na rdo rje bsnams pa/ shar lhor rnam gzigs sa gnon mnyam gzhag /lhor gtsug tor can mnyam gzhag /lho nub tu thams cad skyob skyabs sbyin mnyam bzhag /nub tu 'khor ba 'jig ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya/ nub byang du gser thub chos 'chad mnyam gzhag /byang du 'od srung g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon chos gos kyi grwa ri dwags kyi rna ba lta bu 'dzin pa/ byang shar du shākya thub pa chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya can/ thams cad zhabs rdo skyil chos gos gsum gsol ba/ mtshan dpe thams cad rdzogs shing rang rang gi byang chub shing drung na bzhugs pa bdun ka'ang gser btso ma'i mdog can no/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma'i grangs tsam pa mtha' yas pas bskor bar gsal gdab/ gnas gsum du yi ge gsum dang / thugs ka'i nang du pad zla la rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar trīḥdamar po bsam/spyan 'dren nas mchod bstod kyi bar sngar bzhin dang / gsol 'debs/ sgyu lus g.yar po zhig pa'i bar do ru: zhes sogs dang rgyun chags kyis gsol ba btab pas gu ru gtso 'khor thams cad kyi mdzod spu dang thugs ka gtsug tor las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas rigs drug gi gnas 402

thams cad khyab/ rigs drug spyi dang khyad par srid pa bar dor 'khyams pa'i sems can yid lus thams cad la phog pas sdug bsngal gyi 'khrul snang thams cad skad cig la sbyangs/ de dag thams cad bde ba can gyi zhing du drangs nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la reg bar bsam mo/ dbang bzhi sngar bzhin blang / mthar 'khor rnams gtso bo ra 'dus/ gtso bo 'od kyi gong bur ltem gyis zhu nas rang la thim pas rang nyid 'od dpag med kyi skur gyur pa'i rang 'dra ye shes kyi thugs kar rdo rje trī:dang bcas pa'i tha mar/ oṃ a mi ta bhā gli: zhes pas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod cing dgyes pa bskangs/ srid pa bdun gyi sems can thams cad la phog pas de thams cad sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi skur gyur par bsams la gong gi sngags dang mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa dang / na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta dzo da ya/ a nu ga te/ oṃ ku sum̐ gi ni swā hā/ zhes de bzhin gshegs pa bdun spyi'i sngags/ kai ka ni ci nus bzla zhing / rjes sdud lha ldang sngar bzhin bya/ rdzogs rim ni/ bar do'i snang ba'i gzhi'am rtsa ba kun 'od gsal gyi ngang du gnas ma nus par rnam rtog las kyi rlung gis bskyod pa las/ bar do'i 'khrul snang shar te sdug bsngal nyams su myong ba yin pas/ de lam du khyer ba'i nyams len gyi snying po rmi lam bzung ba dang / zin nas sbyang ba/ spel sgyur bcad pa dang lnga nyams su len pa gal che/ de la bzung ba ni/ rang gi mgrin par trīḥdamar po mar me ltar gsal ba zhig bsgom/ de la shes pa rtse gcig tu gtad la mi lam la mi lam du ngo shes par bya snyams pas bzung / des ma zin na spyi bor trīḥdakar po dang 'og sgor dmar po bsam/ de gnyis yar mar 'ong nas phrad pa dang dmar pos dkar po deng nas 'bros 'ded bsgom/ mthar dkar po la dmar po thim nas dmar skya gcig tu gyur pa de wal gyis yal bas lus kyi nang thams cad 'od kyis khengs par bsams la 'dun pa gong bzhin bya/ des kyang ma zin na thun mong ma yin pas bzung ste/ rlung bum chen nyi shu rtsa gcig bzung / 'dun pa drag po nyer gcig btang / kha mchil mag gis bkang la 'dun pa gong bzhin byas pas zin nges gsungs so/ /de yang yang gi brtan pa thob par bsgom pa ni sbyang ba/ nyung du mang po dang / mang po nyung du dang / me chu ru sgyur ba sogs ni spel sgyur dang / bcad pa ni mi lam la mi lam du ngo shes bzhin pas mnyam gzhag tu lhod de rgyud ring por gnas nus pa la zer ba yin cing / rmi lam bsgoms pa'i grub 'bras 'di kho na yin gsungs so/ /de ltar nyams su len pa'i thun mtshams rnams su dkon brtsegs nas gsungs pa'i 'od dpag med kyi mdo bklag cing / sems bskyed 'gyur ba bcu pa 'bad/ bde chen zhing smon ma chag par 'don/ des gu ru 'od dpag med kyi sgrub pas bar do'i sdug bsngal rang sar zhi ste bde ba can du skye bar byed pa yid zhi nor bu dang 'dra ba'i man ngag le'u bcu gcig pa'o/ /shur+ghaṃ/ 403

'gyur ba cu ni/ sku'i rten du lha khang bzhengs pa/ gsung gi rten du glegs bam/ thugs rten mchod rten/ sems can spyi'i don du zam pa 'dzugs pa/ gcig gi don du srog bslu ba ste rtsa ba'i 'gyur ba lnga/ rgyun par lha khang la mchod pa/ glegs bam klog pa/ mchod rten la bskor ba/ zam pa 'dzugs pa/zam pa gso ba/ srog bslu gzhan srog la mi gnod pa rnams rgyun mi chad par bya ste/ yan lag gi 'gyur ba lnga ste 'gyur ba bcu'o/ /man ngag bcu gnyis pa gu ru kun tu bzang por sgrub pa ni/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar ye shes lnga'i rang 'od 'ja' zer gyi klong du pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la gu ru kun tu bzang po sku mdog mthing gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'am/ zhal brgyad steng zhal brtsegs ma gnyis te bcu gang mos bsgoms te rgya chad phyogs lhung bral bas phyogs bcur gzigs pa'i don dang / zhal gcig pa'i chos thams cad thig le nyag gcig tu rdzogs pa'i mtshan don no/ /zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung / phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag sku gcer bu rgyan med du bsgom/ de'i don skyil krung ni mtha' gnyis kyis mi g.yo ba/ mnyam gzhag ni 'khor 'das ro mnyam pa/ gcer bu ni gzung 'dzin gyi sgrib g.yogs bral pa'o/ /pang du yum chos dbyings kun tu bzang mo sku mdog ljang gu rdor dril 'dzin pas yab mgul 'khyud cing zhabs pad+ma'i skyil krung gis rol pa/ de yang yab snang ba dang yum stong pa ste zung 'jug gdod nas lhun grub gyi mtshan don no/ /de'i mdun du rgyal sras rdor sems dkar po/ shar du rnam snang mthing ga /lhor rin 'byung ser po/ nub tu snang mtha' dmar po/ byang du don grub ljang gu rnams/ rang rtags kyi phyag mtshan rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ rin chen/ pad+ma/ ral gri/ g.yon thams cad dril bu 'dzin pas yum dang 'khril ba longs bskyod rdzogs pa'i cha lugs can/ shar lhor phur pa/ lho nub badz+ra nye ru ka/ nub byang rta mgrin/ byang shar du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa rnams dpal dang dur khrod kyi chas can rang 'od kyi yum dang bcas pa dang / gzhan yang rigs gcig rigs lnga/ rigs gsum/ rigs brgya sogs zhi khro rab 'byams kyi tshom bu bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba gsal gdab/ spyan 'dren rgyas gdab mchod bstod sngar bzhin dang / gsol 'debs/ gzhan yang las dang rkyen gyi dbang gyur te: sogs dang /rgyun chags kyis gsol btab pa'i tshe/ kun bzang yab yum gyi thugs kar pad zlar ye shes rang 'od 'ja' sna lnga ldan rma bya'i mdongs lta bu'i lte bar yi ge/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ:gsal ba'i mthar/ 'a a sha sa ma ha:rnams kyis bskor ba dang / smin mtshams dang thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ de yang 'od zer me 'od lta bu 'phros/ rigs drug dang bar ma do ste srid pa bdun gyi 'gro ba thams cad kyi sna bug gam spyi bo nas zhugs/ 'khor ba'i rgyu'am rtsa ba rnam par shes pa'i tshogs bdun kun gzhi'i bag chags dang bcas 404

pa'i sdig sgrib ma lus pa bsregs shing sbyangs/ rnam smin gyi phung po thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs/ de dag thams cad kyi rig pa'i ngo bo rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du byin gyis brlabs te/ mi 'gyur ba bde ba chen po kun tu bzang po'i dbyings su sbyangs bar bsam/ dbang bzhi blangs nas rang la bsnyims te/rang nyid kun bzang yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs kar pad zlar ye shes 'od lnga'i thig le gong bzhin bsams la/ lte bar rdo rje'i rang sgra/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ 'a a sha sa ma ha: zhes pa'i 'bru dgu yas mar brtsegs pa la rig pa gtad cing 'phro 'du sngar bzhin byas te sems can thams cad kun bzang du gyur ba rnams kyis kyang sngags kyi rang sgra di ri ri sgrogs par bsam zhing bzlas pa bya/ rjes sdud 'od gsal du 'jug ljang gong ltar ro/ /rdzogs rim ni/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad kyi rgyu ni dngos por zhen pa'i 'dzin pa a 'thas dam pos byas la/ dngos 'dzin gyi 'khrul snang de zlog cing 'jigs par byed pa la/ lhun grub sgron ma bzhi'i man ngag nyams su blang dgos/ de yang lam gzhan gyi dbang du byas na khregs chod lta bas phyi rol snang ba'i yul la der 'dzin ma zhugs pas rang nyid mi 'ching tsam gyi don byed pa las 'khrul snang nyid rang grol du mi 'gyur/ rang sar grol nus pa la shes rab rang byung gi sgron ma dbang po'i spyod yul mngon sum shar bas nyams su myang dgos/ de'i lam gyi tshul ni man ngag rdzogs pa chen po gsang babs kyang ches gsang ba thod rgal mngon sum snang ba bzhi'i gdams pa nyams su blangs te/ de yang sdod pa gsum gyis tshad bzung ba/ thob pa gsum gyis gzer gdab pa/ gding bzhi'i 'bras bu mngon du byed pa sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i bla ma'i zhal gyi gdams pa las rtogs par bya'o/ /thun skabs su sangs rgyas sras gcig sa bon gyi rgyud dang / btags grol rgyud drugagaser gyi zhun ma'i rgyud dang / kun tu bzang po'i smon lam la sogs pa mang du bklag cing / de'i don la sems pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /de ltar gu ru kun tu bzang po'i sgrub pas 'khrul snang rang grol du byed pa yid bzhin nor bu dang 'dra ba'i man ngag le'u bcu gnyis pa'o/ /shur+ghaṃ/man ngag bcu gsum pa gu ru rtsa ba'i bla mar sgrub pa ste/ mdun gyi nam mkhar pad+ma 'dab stong rgyas pa'i ge sar nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng du sa bon āḥlas ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma/ rnam pa gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya'i steng na yid bzhin nor bu bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po bsnams pa/ yum mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal sku mdog dkar la sngo ba'i mdangs chags pa/ phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ yum zag med kyi bde ba mchog tu rgyas pa ye shes 'od lnga'i klong du bzhugs pa/ de'i shar du hūṃ las rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin dkar po rdo rje 'dzin pa/lhor ṭ+wā la tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin ser po 'khor lo/ nub tu oṃ las phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin 405

dmar po pad+ma/ byang du hā las lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin ljang gu rgya gram 'dzin pa bzhi ka mnyam gzhag /mtshams bzhir trī:las shes rab rgyud kyi slob dpon/ nyams chags skong ba'i slob dpon/ dam tshig dbang gi slob dpon/ man ngag lung gi slob dpon te brgyad ka cha lugs gtso bo dang mthun pa/slob dpon bzhi po mnyam gzhag gi steng na thod pa dang / bum pa 'dzin pa/ rang rang gi kha dog dang mtshungs pa'i yum dang sbyor ba/ gzhan yang grub thob bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba gsal gdab/spyan 'dren / mchod pa/ bstod pa sogs spyi ltar dang / 'gro drug sdug bsngal chen pos nyen pa dang :sogs ci mang dang / rgyun chags kyis gsol ba btab pas/ gu ru'i dpral ba nas sku mang du byon nas rang gi dpral bar thim/ ljags steng nas gsung yig 'bru mang du byon nas rang gi mgrin par thim/thugs ka nas phyag mtshan mang po byung rang gi snying gar thim/ lte ba nas thig le dang thig phran mang po byung rang gi lte bar thim/ gsang gnas nas me rlung chu gsum byung / rang gi gsang bar thim pa de lta bu'i tshul gyis dbang blang ba phyi'i dbang bzhi/ 'khor rnams gtso bor 'dus/ gu ru rang gi spyi bor byon yab yum mnyam sbyor gyi byang sems rang gi spyi bo sems rim par gang ba'i dbang bzhi blang ba nang gi dbang bzhi/ bla ma yab yum spyi bo nas mar byon snying ga'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma 'bum ldan gyi lte bar nyi zla'i steng na gu ru'i sku mtshon gang ba mtshan dpe'i gaji byin ches cher 'bar ba zhig bsgom/ de'i thugs kar pad+ma nyi zla'i steng na rdo rje rtse lnga pa nas 'bru tsam gyi lte bar 'od lnga'i thig le'i dbus su yi ge ā: mtha' bskor 'od lnga lu gu rgyud kyi thig le re re'i steng du/ oṃ sar+ghaṃ gu ru tsā na ḍā ki bhā sirnyi pha la hūṃ: zhes pa'i yig 'bru re re gnas pa lu gu rgyud du 'khor ba'i 'phro 'du sngar bzhin gyi dmigs pa dang bcas sngags ci 'grub bzla/ de yang snang srid sku dang zhing khams su gsal ba dang / thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng gi 'phro 'dus rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi ye shes rang rgyud la skyes par bsam zhing bzla'o/ /thun mtshams rnams su bla ma'i mos gus gnad du bsnun te/ dran pa tsam gyis kyang 'gal rkyen sdug bsngal thams cad 'joms shing / dga' bde gnam sa 'thabs pa lta bu'i byin rlabs dang dngos grub char bzhin 'beb par dmigs la tshig bdun gsol 'debs le bdun sogs dang / rtsa ba'i bla ma'i mtshan bstod dung dung klog pa la 'bad do/ /rdzogs rim ni/ zab gsal bde ba chen po'i ye shes bsgom pa ste/ de la zab ces pa/ sems klong gsang skor sogs kyi don ni zab pa/ sbyor drug sogs dang khyad par rdzogs pa chen po thod rgal gyi don ni gsal ba/ nā ro ni gu lam 'bras sogs zhu bde'i lam bsgom pa ni bde ba ste/ de thams cad kyi don gyi 'gag ni bla ma'i mos gus la 'du/ de yang 'das ma 'ongs da lta'i rnam rtog gis ma bslad pa'i shes pa rig rig gyu gyu 'di la bstas tshe ngo bo ngos 406

bzung gang du'ang ma grub la/ gdangs mos gus su lhang nge ba'i dran rig de kha dran pas zin bzhin ma bcos par skyong ba/ bla ma'i thugs dang dbyer med pa'i ngang bsgom la bzla ba'i mnyam bzhag la bslab bo/ /des na sgrub thabs kyi snying po lta bu rtsa ba'i bla mar bsgrubs pas mchog thun gyi dngos grub thams cad bde blag tu 'grub par byed pa'i man ngag yid bzhin nor bu dang 'dra ba'i le'u bcu gsum pa'o/ /shur+ghaṃ/ /de ltar rtsa ba dang yan lag gi rnal 'byor gang gi tshe yang bskyed rim la sku mdog rgyan dang cha lugs phyag mtshan bzhugs stangs sogs rnam pa gsal thebs shing / de ka'i rgyal la gnas nyams brtan pa dang po'i brda don dag pa dran pa rnams nan tan gyis nyams su blang zhing / sngags kyi rim pa dag kyang chad lhag nor 'khrul du ma song ba ring thung sogs brda dag cing skyon dang bral bar dag bzlas grangs tshad rdzogs par bzla ba dang / rlung kha sbyor gyi ngang nas zla ba 'gog pa thun mong dang khyad par gyi rdor bzlas la brtson pas bslab pa dang / mtshan bcas dang mtshan med kyi rdzogs rim rnams kyang so so'i man ngag bzhin rtse gcig tu 'bad pas bsgom par bya'o/ /rjes thob rnams su'ang las 'bras kyi don la gzhig ste sgo gsum gyi blang dor mtha' dag byol nyog tu ma song ba rgyu dang 'bras bu phra zhing zhib par shan phye ste mi dge sdig pa mtha' dag spang ba dang / dge ba phra mo nas dang len gyis sgrub pa'i lan len gtso bor 'bad cing / nyams len gyi gnas skabs mnyam rjes thams cad du gegs sel dang bogs 'don thams cad kyi mthar thug bla ma'i mos gus kho na la gtso bor bya ba ste bzang ngan ci byung yang gu ru rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid sangs rgyas dngos su yid ches pas gsol 'debs kyis lam du bya ba las bzang po la dga' brod rlom zhe na/ dan pa la sems lhongs sogs gang la yang snyems 'phrigs yang sgyid lug gi dbang du mi btang bar rkyen thams cad rang sems rnam rtog rten 'brel gyi rol par shes par bya ba dang / mos gus dang dam tshig la ngo lkog med par srog las gces par bzung ste rang sems dbang du btsugs par bya zhing / mdor na kun gzhi'i rnam shes 'di la sgyu ma lta bu rig pa'i rgyas btab nas ma yengs dran pa'i rtsis zin par byas te/ mnyam rjes nyin mtshan gyi thun mtshams ma 'dres kyi bar du 'bad cing / thun thams cad kyi rjes kyi bya ba ni dge tshogs 'du byas pa thams cad chud mi za bar bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur bsngo bar bya ba yin la/ byang chub kyi bar du sems can gyi don du lhag bsam gyi 'dod don la smon pa ni smon lam yin te tshig tu smos nas 'dod don yid la gdung bas smon lam btab ste/ bsngo dang smon lam gyi byed las rang don byang chub dang gzhan don rgya chen po 'grub pa'o/ /gzhan yang gdams pa nyams len gyi kha skong 'gro dus bskor ba/ zas tshogs 'khor/ smra brjod 407

dam dbugs gsang sngags kyi rang sgra/ rig pa chos sku/ 'gyu dran rnam shes sgyu ma'i 'phrul du go ba dang /tshogs drug gi snang ba ci shar ci snang thams cad chos nyid kyi rol par shes pas lam du khyer ro/ /mdor na rgyal ba'i bka' la mi bslu bar yid ches pa'i dad pa brtan pos bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa rnams dgyes pa'i las sgo gsum bag yod brten pa dang / thun mong dang thun min gyi chos spyod mtha' dag la brtson pa dang / lhag bsam bzang pos gzhan la phan pa'i las dge ba mtha' dag 'bad pa ste/ rang gzhan mi bslu ba gtan gyi bde ba thar pa byang chub kyi lam bzang po la 'dzug pa la skyo ngal med pa'i spyod pa brtsams te bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi sdom pa rnam par dag pa la byang chub kyi lam thams cad yongs su 'du ba yin gsungs so/ /de dag gis dngos gzhi'i bye brag gi sgrub thabs yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i man ngag rnam grangs bcu gsum legs par bshad zin to/ /e ma ho/ deng dus gangs can ljongs 'dir thub bstan gyi/ /snying po rdo rje theg pa'i lam srol kun/ /mkhyen brtse nus mthus mi nub 'dzin mdzad mgon/ /gang de'i bka' drin dran pas slar yang 'dud/ /mchog de'i thugs bskyed rnam grol dwangs pa'i mtshor/ pad 'byung byin rlabs yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/gsal las 'dod dgu'i yon tan mchog mnga' ba'i/ /cha shas gu ru'i sgrub thabs ngo mtshar phul/ /yongs 'dus sgrub thabs sbya dang bye brag bcas/ /gnas skabs mthar thug 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i gter/ gsal byed lde mig zin bris btab pa'i dges/ bstan 'gro yongs kyi legs tshogs 'phel rgyas shog /rgyal bstan spyi dang rdo rje theg pa yi/ /lam srol mtha' dag dar rgyas yun gnas zhing / /skyes mchog zhabs brtan bshad sgrub phrin las 'phel/ /skye dgu yongs la bde skyid dpal bar shog /rigs drug 'khor ba'i ma rgan sems can rnams/ /bla ma'i sgrub thabs lam mchog 'dir zhugs nas/ /tshogs gnyis mthu rgyas sku gnyis mngon gyur te/ /don gnyis bsam don lhun grub bkra shis shog /bla ma'i mos gus gsol 'debs kyi sgrub thabs bsam pa lhun grub yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu'i man ngag 'di ni/ shing yos lor shad sa stag rnam bdag sogs skal ldan lnga tsam la bka' gsang zhib rgyas su gnang ba'i dus rang nyid kyi dran pa'i gzungs su zin bris su btab pa las slar yang rgyas 'grel phreng yig lta bu bris shig ces khyab bdag rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bkas gnang bar brten/ chu pho spre'u lo nag pas nya ba'i yar ngo'i dus chen bzang po la rje bla ma rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs gang gi zhabs rdul spyi bos mchod cing gsung gi gsang bas dbugs dbyung ba thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa o rgyan ngag dbang ye shes kyis g.yas ru shangs kyi ri khrod bde chen 'ba' ra brag gi yang dgon bla brang du sug bris su btab pa'i dge bas gangs ri'i khrod kyi bstan 'gro mtha' dag la phan bde'i legs tshogs rgya chen po 'byung ba 408

dang / dpal ldan bla ma'i bstan pa rin po che sa steng thams cad du nyi ma dang zla ba ltar yongs su grags shing phyogs dang dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas pa'i rkyen mchog tu gyur cig lam 'dir thos bsam sgom byed rnams/ nyer 'tshe kun zhi bsam dgu 'grub/ /byang chub bar du ma hā gu rus/ /rjes bzung don gnyis lhun grub shog /sarba maṅga lo/ dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /rang nyid dpal chen po rdo rje gzhon nu bskyed rdzogs che 'bring chung gsum gang rung snang stong rig pa'i rang mdangs tsam du gsal ba'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba sku mdog mthing nag rdo rje mthing nag rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams pa gcig tu gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i lte ba khong gseng gi dbus su: r+ghaṃ sngon po spus bris pa tsam gyi mtha' skor du: oṃ badz+ra tī li tī la ya sogs kyis bskor ba las 'od zer gyis 'khor lo g.yas skor du kyi li li 'khor bar dmigs: r+ghaṃ gi thig le las 'od zer byung nas rang gi zhal nas thon yum gyi zhal du zhugs sku'i dbyibs brgyud yum gyi pad+mo nas rang gi rdo rje'i spubs su zhugs: thugs ka'i rgyu gi zhabs kyu la thim par dmigs: yang skabs su sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi thugs dam kyi rgyud bskul nas: de rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs gzig byin nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi tshul du rang nyid la thim pas rang nyid 'od phung gzig bajid mthu stobs nus rtsal dang ldan par bsam pa'i ngang nas bzlas par bya'o: gzhan yang khro rgyal rigs bzhi dang : tī la bzhi khro rgyal bcu la sogs pa rang gi phung po khams dang skye mched kyi rtsa 'khor rnams su gsal btab la: de rnams kyang tī lā ya'i sgra 'brug ltar du ldir bar bsams la: yang skabs su sngags phreng las 'od zer tsha la tsub pa mgar gyi tsha tsha ltar 'phros nas 'jig rten khams kyi gnod byed gdug pa can thams cad dbang du bsdus bran du bkol: srog snying phul nas ci bgyis bka' nyan par bsams la bzlas par bya'o: zhes pa 'di yang bya phu lcags phur can gyi gnas rtsa ru: bdag kun bzang khyab gdal lhun grub kyis rig 'dzin chen po la zhus/ /phur pa'i 'dzab dgongs dmigs pa'i 'khrul 'khor zhes bya ba rje tshe dbang nor bu'i mdzad pa bzhugs so/ /rang nyid skad cig gis snang stong 'dzin pa med pa shrī badz+ra ku mā ra bskyed rdzogs che 'bring chung du gang mos/ rang mdangs rig pa'i klong du gsal ba'i ye shes chen po shes rab nyi ma'i gdan la ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba rgyan med gcer bu mthing ga rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin gyi sems dpa' sur+ya'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje sngon po rtse dgu ba nas 'bras tsam gyi lte bar phra mo'i ting nge 'dzin sku gsum thabs shes dbyer med kyi pad nyi zla gdan 409

gyi dbus su ye shes lnga'i mtshon bya'i rgyu yig rab tu mtsher ba cha lnga pa mthing nag spus bris pa lta bu kho rang gi mdun phyogs su bstan pa'i mtha' skor bdun phyogs su dbu oṃ nas brtsam pa'i dbu can btso mo'i mdog lta bu yi ge brtswa lnga ba g.yas su 'khor ba las/ 'od zer gyi phreng ba g.yas su 'khyil li li 'khor ba las/ 'od zer spos ring kyi dud pa ltar r+ghaṃ yig gi thig le'i na dā'i rtse nas yar byung yab kyi zhal nas thon: yum gyi zhal du zhugs sku'i dbyibs brgyud de gsang ba'i pad+mor bcud dang nus pa 'khyil ba la/ rang gi rdo rje'i spub kyi rngubs nas yar byung rang gi snying ga'i r+ghaṃ de gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur/yang skabs su/ sngags phreng las 'od zer 'gar gyi sal me ltar 'phros nas phyogs bcu rgyal ba'i zhing dang / rang bzhin lhun grub dpag tu med par bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba rnams la phog sku gsung thugs la mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs rje dang byin rlabs gzi bajid nus mthu thams cad bsdus rab tu mchod pa'i 'od dang 'bru gsum mirnam par spyan drangs nas rang gi spyi bor thim pas sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i dbang thob phrin las nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i rdu las 'od zer 'phros pas rang gi lus kyi gnas su gsal ba'i khro rgyal rigs bzhi tī la ya bzhi khro bcu khra thabs rnams la phog thugs rgyud bskul de rnams kyi drag sngags sgrog pas 'jig rten khams kun khro tshogs mang pos khengs nas rgyu phaṭaḥ'abrug stong ldir ba ltar gyur nas mtshon cha'i char phab gnod byed gdug pa can kun dbang du bsdus dam la bzhag ci bgyis bka' nyan srog gi snying po phul 'da' ba'i skabs med par byas te/ slar khro tshogs 'dus nas rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon la thim nas dmigs med du bzhag go/ /bdag gi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi rang mdangs 'od zer phyogs bcu kun tu 'phros pas snod thams cad rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor 'od kyi rang bzhin/ bcud thams cad rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur snang ste kun gyi tī la ya zhes bsgrag pas dus gcig 'brug khri 'bum ldir ba ltar gyur nas phyogs dus kyi rgyal ba thams cad badz+ra ku mā ra'i sku yungs kar 'bru tsam bgrang 'das su byon te/ mtsho la kha ba babs pa ltar ba spu'i bu gar sib sib thim pas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thob ste/ dpal chen po'i sku gsung thugs mnyam dang bar bsam/ oṃ badz+ra li tī la ya sarba bhig nan bam r+ghaṃ phaṭaḥ dza r+ghaṃ āḥ oṃ badz+ra tī li tī la ya dzaḥr+ghaṃ baṃ hoḥ ka te ka ye/ dza ye gi dza yeḥ a dzi teḥ a pa ra dzi teḥ ma ra sa ni pra mar ta niḥ sarba bisnan baṃ rgyu phaṭaḥ ces pa'o/ /phur pa'i 'dzab dgongs dmigs pa'i 'khrul 'khor 'di nyid rang bzo'i dri mas spu tsam ma bslad par gzhung don sor bzhag gsal bar gnas te bdag tshe dbang nor bu'i dpal gyis so/ / 410

༄sha /gurushayasasnatayatra: pūrbagatadharmatsar+ya.aṅgasap+tamulabhar+hanismitakasnyibitaratisma/༄ga /bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa las: sngon du 'gro ba'i chos spyod yan lag bdun pa sgo 'byed 'phrul gyi man ngag bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru dhe wa dhākhri ni rgyu: bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa las: yan lag dang po'i chos spyod ni: 'di ltar rnal 'byor pas shes par bya: yan lag dang po spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol yan lag go: oṃ āḥhūṃḥ 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa'i tshogs: yi dam zhi khro dhāk+ki chos skyong dang : bka' srung dam can pho mor bcas pa kun: oṃ ā r+ghaṃḥ rnam dag dbyings nas gshegs bzhugs mi mnga' yang / /khams gsum srid gsum 'gro drug 'dren slad du+oḥ bde chen yangs pa'i pho brang chen po 'dir/ /thugs rjes yud tsam cig gis gshegs su gsol: oṃ āḥhūṃ/ thabs shes dri med nyi zla pad ma'i gdan: lhod 'bol dar zab rin chen brtsegs pa'i khri: spyi gtsug bde chen dag pa'i gdan steng du: 'gro ba'i don du brtan par bzhugs su gsol: oṃ āḥphroṃḥ lus kyi dngas bas spyi bor thal sbyar zhing : bde mnyen 'khyug bcas mal lnga sa la phab: 'greng ldang ldan par gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: rtsa gsum sku yi gzi mdangs lus la phob: oṃ āḥr+ghaṃḥ ngag snyan 'gyur dbyangs gus par ldan pa yis: sku gsung thugs kyi che ba'i yon tan dang : mdzad pa'i phrin las brjod bcas phyag 'tshal lo: 'gags med gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la stsol: oṃ āḥrgyuḥ lhag bsam rnam dag gdung shugs ldan pa yis: dus gsum bde gshegs rtsa gsum yon tan rnams: skad cig dran rdzogs bsam pas phyag 'tshal lo: bde gsal mi rtog yid la bskyed du gsol: oṃ āḥrgyuḥ lhan cig skyes sbyor me tog bdug spos dang : mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo'i sgra: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs: lus ngag yid gus ldan pas 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ āḥrgyuḥ gling bzhi gling phran ri rab ri bdun dang : rol mtsho nyi zla skar phran 'bab chur bcas: lding ka ko mgo yan lag brgyad ldan kun: mchod pa 'bul gyis 'gro ba'i don du bzhes: oṃ āḥr+ghaṃḥ gser dngul g.yu dang mar gad in+d+ra nyil: mu tig pad ma ra ga rdo yi snying : baiḍūr+ya dang me shel bye ru sogs: rat+na'i rigs 'bul thugs rjes bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥr+ghaṃḥ ga phur tsan+dan gur gum si la dang : dzā ti rnam rgyal snying po zho sha'i tshogs:nyon mongs nad 'joms sman gyi rigs rnams kun: sgo gsum mos blos rtsa ba gsum la 'bul: oṃ āḥ 411

hūṃḥ gro 'bras khre dang so ba yungs dkar dang ཿོ til nas sran mar bcas te 'bru yi rigs: lhag pa'i bsam pas nye bar 'bul lags na: thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥrduḥ bla ma yi dam zhi khro ḍāki yi: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams pa kun: rang gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags: oṃ āḥr+ghaṃḥ srog gcod ma byin blangs dang mi tshangs spyad: rdzun tshig phra dang tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal dbyen: brnabs sems gnod sems log par lta la sogs: mi dge bcu po bgyis rnams mthol lo bshags: oṃ āḥr+ghaṃḥ gzhan yang bdag sogs 'gro ba rnams kyis ni: 'das dang ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum du: lus ngag yid kyis mi dge ci bgyis pa: mthol zhing bshags nas slan chad mi bgyid sdom: oṃ āḥr+ghaṃḥ dus gsum 'phags pa'i dge ba ci bgyis pa: zag bcas zag med bgyis dang bgyid bstsal ba: bgyid gyur gang yin de dag thams cad la: bdag sogs dngas bas rjes su yi rang ngo : oṃ āḥrgyuḥ dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba sras bcas dang : sa bcu'i dbang phyug 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams kyis: phyi nang bla med theg chen chos 'khor lo: 'khor ba ma stongs bar du bskor bar bskul: oṃ āḥrgyuḥ de dag mkha' klong yangs pa'i ngang nyid las: thugs rje'i zer ldan smon 'jug ldan pa pos: sdul 'dam du bying rnams skyabs slad du: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs: oṃ āḥr+ghaṃḥ de ltar phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul sdig pa bshags: dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba sogs: de dag thams cad byang chub chen por bsngo: oṃ āḥrduḥ de ltar sgo gsum dngas pas dus drug tu: yan lag bdun sogs dge ba bgyis pa dang : bgyis gyur bgyis par gyur pa'i bsod nams kyis: 'gro drug sems can thar lam bsgrod par shog: oṃ āḥrgyuḥ gnas skabs su yang yul ris rgyal khams su: bkra shis bde legs dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs: dkar po dge ba'i phyogs rnams dar nas kyang : 'gro rnams theg chen chos la spyod par shog: oṃ āḥnuḥ de yi rgyu rkyen 'bras bur bcas pa yis: nag po bdud kyi phyogs rnams pham pa dang : nyes dgu zhi zhing legs dgu dar nas kyang : sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūṃḥ khyad par theg chen chos la spyod pa'i tshe: bka' srung rnams kyis ru nga mi bgyid cing : mthu dpal ldan pa'i dge bsnyen khyod rnams kyis: chos byed sgrub pa po yi grogs mgon gyis: oṃ āḥr+ghaṃḥ de ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ni:dmigs bcas dmigs med zung 'jug ci bsags pa: bla med rdo rje theg pa bsngo bar bgyi: 'gro drug rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas thob par shog: e ma ho/ phyi rabs rjes 'jug skal ldan pho mo rnams: thun 'og lam ni nyin mtshan dus drug tu: dam chos spyod pa'i tshe na 'di bzlas shing : bsam gtan dang pos rtag tu dran gyur na: rtse 412

ba 'di yis bsod nams ci mchis pa: sangs rgyas stong gi yon tan rdzogs pa dang : sa lam rim gyis bsgrod nas theg chen sar: bla med rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang bsgrod: gnas skabs su yang shes rab phun tshogs shing : mi brjed gzungs thob ci bsam chos bzhin 'grub: de yi phyir na phyi rabs skal ldan kun: 'di la 'bod rtsol ldan pas nyams su longs: snying po lon nas gzhan la ston cig spel: sgo 'byed 'phrul gyi lde mig 'phrul gyi snying po zhes bya ba:o rgyan gyi mkhan po pad ma 'byung gnas kyi phyi rabs kyis don du mdzad pa ni: mtsho rgyal bdag gis zin ris su btags nas gter du sbas: skyes bu las can shes rab can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma yaḥ rgya rgya rgya: su ri phug mo che nas nas bdag 'dra sangs rgyas gling pas bton pa'o: gu ru pad+ma sirnyi rdu trī: mchod g.yogs pas bsangs chu 'bor zhing : gtor ma la chab byung mdzad par zhu zer/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje gsor cing : oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa r+ghaṃ: lan gsum mo/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭaḥswā hā: oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shurnyo3haṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las mchongs/ bskang rdzas/ brten rdzas/ bsgrub rdzas/tshogs rdzas 'di rnams la dang po che si bsam nas phar bcad pa/ chung si bsam nas tshur bsnan pa/nyes sgrib ser sna brlam sems rngams sems 'bag 'khril 'phang 'khril/ rme mug nal gsum: snga than tshig gsum/ lha mi bar gyi bsgren 'dre 'dra ba: sgro smyug bar gyi dri ma 'dra ba/ srid pa'i 'dre dgu/gtsug lag khang gi gdon bcu la sogs pa mthos bsgom dmas bcag ci song ba thams cad dang :phyi'i yul ma dag pa dang : nang gi bcud ma dag pa dang : rang gi sems ma dag pa thams cad gtsang pa le si le ye swā hā: ram̐ pa le si le ye swā hā: yi sa le si le ye swā hā: khaṃ sa le si le ye swā hā: mchod g.yogs pas gtor ma la skyems mchod med pa zhu zer/ mchod do byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba brgyud pa dgu ldan gyi bla ma rnams mchod: bsnyen bsgrub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs mchod: dngos grub kyi rtsa ba ma dang mkha' 'gro mchod: bstan pa bsrungs pa'i chos skyong srung ma mchod: 'khor 'das rgyal ba'i zhing khams thams cad la dbang bsgyur zhing skyong ba: zhing skyong chen po nya mgon gzi ldan yab yum bka' 'khor bran g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mchod: dzam+bha la dang rnam thos sras la sogs pa'i gnod sbyin nor lha rgya mtsho'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la mchod: bka' bsrungs gter bsrung gnas bsrung gi rigs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams mchod: bdud rtsis man gyis mchod: bha ling rgyan gyis mchod: rak+ta dmar gyis mchod: sku gsung thugs rtsa ba yan lag gi dam tshig nyams chags 'gal 'khrul du gyur pa thams cad sor chud nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol: e rda ba li ta rak+ṣa rak+ṣa r+ghaṃ srungs shig: yang mchod g.yogs pas spos spor thogs la 'di skad zhu:gtor ma la spos sbyangs mdzad par zhu zer: tshul khrims dri ldan spos ྾ sogs/ tsam dan bzang po'i sogs/oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta dhuspe pra ti dza pū dza me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye ā r+ghaṃ: ces pa 'di yang rig 413

'dzin chen pos sbyar ba'o/ maṅga lo/༄gi /hamarkyemahādharmashayaparisaṃghatapuragabadzitasugramasarbabiharatisma/༄ga /bka' rdzogs pa chen po dam chos dgongs pa yangs 'dus las sngon 'gro gtor ma'i rim pa bzhugs so/ /badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi rgyu trī: 'di 'bad mtha' bral klong yangs las: brang rig rtsa gsum lha la 'dud:oṃ āḥr+ghaṃḥ zhes pas/ rnam smin sha khrag gi phung po thul gyis bsregs nas: pad dkar zla ba'i steng du rang nyid skad cig gis rang rang gi 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs nam mkha'i rgyal po gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag la dbang bskur bar stsal du gsol: zhes gsol ba btab pa: oṃ badz+ra bha wa a sgyi ṣ+peñtsa r+ghaṃ: zhes gsungs shing : bum pa'i chus spyi bor nas dbang bskur: sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las: 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge 'bru bzhi pa'i mtha' skor du sngags thams cad rang sgra ldir zhing g.yas bskor du 'khod par gyur: oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me rdzu: lan gsum: r+ghaṃ trīḥ phyag stong 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po stong : spyan stong bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong : gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pa'i: 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod: zhes pas bstod: oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa r+ghaṃ: oṃ badz+ra a sbo ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na rdu hūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa swā hā: oṃ su bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shusto3haṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po gser skyems mi dmigs pa: zag pa med pa: nam mkha' las 'phangs mtho ba: sa gzhi las rgya che ba: rgya mtsho las gting zab pa: rtsi shing las lhun stug pa: nyi zla las 'od gsal ba: ri rgyal las rgyud brtan pa: so so'i 'dod dgu yon tan phun sum tshogs pa stong gsum nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur: zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyis phyag rgya nas brtsams: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba tad khang ut+pa te spa ra ṇa hi me ga ga khaṃ swā hā: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na r+ghaṃ phaṭa swā hā: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta dzñā na a wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūṃ:oṃ dzñā na a wa lo te na maḥs man+ta spa ra ṇa rasmi bha wa sa ma ya ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru trī da ya dz+wa la dzñā na 414

r+ghaṃ: oṃ na maḥs man+ta bhud+dha rna gra he shwa ri pra bha dza ti sa ma ya swā hā: na ma sa man+ta bud+dha rna swā hā: oṃ āḥr+ghaṃḥ lan gsum/ oṃ r+ghaṃ tram̐ hrī āḥ lan gsum: zhes gser skyems phyi rol du dor la: dril bu bsil zhing 'di skad do: na moḥ sangs rgyas rkang gnyis gtso ste bden pa'i mchog: chos nyid chags dang bral te bden pa'i mchog: dge 'dun 'dus pa'i gtso ste bden pa'i mchog: bden pa'i mchog ni dkon mchog gsum gyis bka': bden pa'i bka' la mi nyan gang yang med: 'chi ba'i srog la mi 'dzems gang yang med: skye 'gro rlung la mi brten gang yang med: 'byung ba chu la mi 'thung gang yang med: 'tsho ba'i zas la mi chags gang yang med: smras pa'i tshig la mi nyan gang yang med: zab mo'i don la mi sems gang yang med: bzlas pa'i sngags kyi mi 'grub gang yang med: ma lus thams cad bden pa'i bka' la nyon: hūṃ trīḥ nga ni dus gsum dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang : nga ni che mchog khro bo dbang chen rgyal: nga ni ma mo mkha' 'gro kun gyi yab: nga ni rig 'dzin rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: nga ni dgra bgegs 'byung po kun gyi gshed: nga ni lha srin sde brgyad yongs kyi rje: nga yi bka' la thams cad 'da' ma yin: gal te nga yi bka' la 'da' byed na: che mchog dbang chen thod phreng khros nas ni: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par gdon mi za: de bas thams cad bden pa'i bka' la nyon: r+ghaṃ trī: lha klu gnod sbyin rgyal po gza' btsan dang : dri za grul bum mi 'am ci la sogs: bdud dang srin po ma mo gze sman dang :rmu dang the'u rang grong srin 'dre mor bcas: yul lha gzhi bdag gnas bdag gter bdag dang :dkor bdag la sogs lha srin 'byung po'i tshogs: bka' dang dam la gnas pa'i dge bsnyen rnams:gtsang sbyar bdud rtsi'i gser skyems 'di bzhes la: gnod cing gdug pa'i bsam pa rab zhi nasoḥrtag tu bdag gi dge ba'i sdong grogs mdzod: yul ri rgyal khams sa phyogs 'di dag ru: bdag gi bla med byang chub mchog bsgrub cing : sems can rnams kyi don rab brtson pa la: khyod rnams bdag gi mthun rkyen bsgrub tu gsol: sa yi lha mo brtan ma la sogs pa'i: sa bdag rje blon 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: gtsang sbyar bdud rtsi'i gser skyems 'di bzhes la: bdag gi bsam pa'i don 'di ma 'grub par: ko long ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad par: rin chen gter gyi sa 'di stsal du gsol: khyed cag bsam pa bsgrub la re ba skongs: bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: oṃ rbu pa ti sa pā ri wa ra pra ti di wi lo kā ta ra: e rda ba li ta la kha kha khā hi khā hi: ar+ghaṃ nas/ shari'i bar du mchod: de nas chos kyi sbyin pa ni: dril bu a brdung bya zhing : na moḥ bdag gis bsam pa'i stobs dag gis: de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang : chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis: 'phags pa rnams la mchod pa dang : sems can rnams la phan gdag phyir: don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun: de dag 415

thams cad ci rigs pa: 'jig rten khams 'dir ma lus pa: thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig:de nas dril bu sum brdungs bya zhing : chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung ཿོ de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs: rgyu la 'gogs pa gang yin pa: dge sbyong chen pos 'di skad gsungs: sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing : dge ba phun sum tshogs par shog: rang gi sems ni yongs su dul: gzhan gyi sems ni dkrug mi bya: 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin: lus kyi sdom pa legs pa ste: ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin: yid kyi sdom pa legs pa na: thams cad du ni sdom pa legs: thams cad bsrung ba'i dge sbyong dag: sdug bsngal kun las nges grol lo: de nas dkar gtor ni: rin po che'i snod du dkar gtor rgyan ldan dkar gsum mngar gsum gyis brgyan pa bshams la: rang nyid skad cig gi rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas su gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dpal mgon bdun cu la sogs pa gzhi bdag bdag gi tshogs rnams thams cad mdun du 'khod par bsam zhing : dril bu dkrol la: r+ghaṃ trīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi: bka' dang dam la btags pa yi: 'jig rten chos skyong dam tshig can: tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang : rgyal chen bzhi dang phyogs skyongs bcu: lha chen brgyad dang klu chen brgyad: gza' chen brgyad dang nor srung brgyad: rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad lha: bod khams skyong ba'i skyong ma dang : brtan ma chen mo bcu gnyis dang : ma mo 'byung po sha za'i tshogs:srin po yi dwags smyo byed dang : yul phyogs 'di la gnas pa yi: gzhi bdag tshogs rnams thams cad dang : lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas: 'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol: de nas dril bu sum brdungs bya: mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi: nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang : dpal dang grags dang bskal ba bzang : longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing : zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi: las kyis dngos grub bdag la stsol: dam tshig can gyi bdag la bsrungs: dngos grub kun stsol sdongs grogs mdzod: dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang : gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod: rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan: bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod: 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang : 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba: bde legs thams cad 'byung ba yi: nyams pa thams cad med par mdzod: yid la bsam pa kun 'grub shog:drin chen rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang : sems can thams cad rdzogs pa chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par bya ba'i phyir du: sa yi phyogs 'dir bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di nyid bzhengs shing bsgrub pa la: bsgrub pa mtha' ma phyin gyi bar du: bar du gcod pa thams cad bsrung ba dang : dngos nas kyang byang chub ma thob kyi bar du 416

bar chad thams cad bsrung ba'i phrin las dang sdongs grogs rgya chen po mdzod cig: de nas gzhi bdag dkar gtor la mi dgyes pa'i rigs rnams la dmar gtor bsngo ba ni: oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa r+ghaṃ: lan gsum/ a mṛ tas brda bya: swa bhā was sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas bhan dha'i snod yongs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtsang ma dmar gyi gtor ma rgya chen po nam mkha' la 'phang mtho ba: sa gzhi las rgya che ba: rgya mtsho las gting zab pa: rtsi shing las lhun stug pa: nyi zla las 'od gsal ba: ri rgyal las rgyud brtan pa: so sor 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur: oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ ha ho trī: ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum: dril bu dal brdungs bya zhing : sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di:bsngo zhing sbyin pa'i gnas su gyur pa ni: gzhi bdag dkar mchod la mi dgyes shing dmar mchod la dgyes pa'i sde tshogs: bka' srung gter bdag gnas srung gi rigs su gyur pa: pho nya las mkhan dam tshig can gyi srung ma: dam nyams rnams kyi shan pa: sha la dgyes shing khrag la rngams pa sde brgyad drag byed gdug rtsub can: bdud btsan rgyal po dmu the'u rang gza' sman ma mo g.ya' spangs/gangs brag chu gling / ljon shing / nags tshal la gnas pa la sogs pa gzhi bdag mthu bo che rnams dang : sa la ngas che: gnas la ngas bdag zor ba'i rigs su gyur pa rnams dang : gzhan yang i mchod: i bstod: i bsgrub: i bsnyen bsam pa: ma bos: ma mchod: ma bsnyen: ma sgrub rang 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang tshe rabs sngon nas las 'bral yod pa'i lha srung gnyen po khyod rnams la mchod do: bstod do: gsol lo: bzhes su gsol lo: khyed rnams la mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di nyid kyi dgyes shing tshim nas sngon tshe kun che mchog ho ru ka dpal chen po pad ma dbang chen bar du u rgyan chen po pad ma 'byung gnas rdo rje gshog rgod rtsal: tha ma rig 'dzin bdud 'dul rdo rje 'dus pa rtsal la sogs rgyal ba gong ma rnams kyi bka' dang dam la ma 'da': bka' gter gyi bstan pa srungs: rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rjes 'jug chab srid mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la thugs zhi ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa'i ngang nas gang bcol gyi las rnams thams cad thogs pa med par myur du 'grub par mdzad du gsol: badz+ra sa ma yā: de nas bgegs gtor ni: rin po che'i snod du bgegs kyi gtor ma mar me/ gtor chung / chang bu/ sha dum/ zan chang / 'bras chen dar gyis brgyan pa: rgyan ldan skyems phud dang bcas pa bshams la: spros pa la dga' na: pad+ma dbang chen gyi sku bskyed thugs rje chen po las 'byung ba bzhin khol du phyung ngo : oṃ trīḥpad+ma ta krita sogs/ r+ghaṃ trīḥ phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi steng 'og thams cad dang : sa 'og sa steng sa blar rgyu ba yi: bgegs dang log 'dren lan chags 'byung po'i tshogs: dbang chen khro rgyal 'bar ba'i bka' byung gis: skad cig yud tsam 417

gcig gis 'dir 'dus shig: bdag gis bsgo ba'i bka' la nyan par gyis: oṃ badz+ra ta ki ra tsa r+ghaṃ:'dir bden stobs bkugs pa ni: na moḥ drin chen rtsa ba dang rgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas ྾ chos ྾ dge 'dun ྾ gsang sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo rnams kyi ྾ gzungs sngags kyi rgyal mo khro mo rnams kyi ྾ lha las khyad par du 'ongs dpal chen po pad ma dbang chen seng ge sgra sgrogs che mchog rdo rje khro lod rgyal ba'i bstan srungs chen po zhing skyong kun dga' gzhon nu yab yum las mkhan bam ro pho mo las byed bka'i shan pa lha srin sde brgyad kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas gsang sngags bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyen po 'di nyid bzhengs shing sgrub pa la gsang spyod lta ba la ma dbang ba: sgrib gnyis kyi shun ma dag pa: gsang sngags bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyen po zab mo bsgom pa la bar gcod par byed pa'i 'byung po mi min mi ru rdzu ba: lha min lha ru badzu ba:legs su mi ster zhing nyes su dga' ba: skabs lta zhing klag tshol ba: chos byang chub bsgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa: nyams ting nge 'dzin la bar du gcod pa: sa lam yon tan la bar du gcod par byed pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi rigs su gyur pa: nad bdag yams bdag: nad rims bgegs kyi bdag po: tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da lta la thug gi bar du: lan chags pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad skad cig rang dbang med par lan chags glud kyi gtor ma 'di nyid len pa la khug cig: na moḥ sangs rgyas kyi bden pas khug cig: chos kyi ྾ dge 'dun gyi ྾ gu ru rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi bden pa chen pos khug cig: bstem cig: oṃ badz+ra i gu sha dza dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha rdu r+ghaṃḥ oṃ badz+ra sbo ṭa baṃ baṃ: oṃ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa ho ho: a bṛ tas bsangs: su bhā was sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las rgyu las rin po che'i snod yongs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags glud kyi gtor ma rgya chen po:'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pas nam mkha' las 'phang mtho ba: sa gzhi las rgya che ba: rgya mtsho las gting zab pa: rtsi shing las lhun stug pa: nyi zla las 'od gsal ba: ri rgyal las rgyud brtan pa: so sor 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur: zhes pa'i bar byas la: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te sogs lan gsum mo: dril bu dal brdungs bya zhing : mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid: bsngo zhing 'bul ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni: gang 'dir dkar po dge ba'i las bsgrub pa la 'tshe zhing bar du gcod par byed pa: 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi rigs su gyur pa: nam mkha' la 'phyo ba: sa gzhi la brtan pa: sa 'og tu 'grim pa: 'byung ba la gnas 418

pa: skyabs grib la gab pa la sogs pa bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyen po bzhengs shing bsgrub pa la: gsang spyod blta ba la mi dbang ba: dkyil 'khor gyi mdangs 'phrog pa: mar me'i 'od 'phrog pa: rol mo'i sgra bcag pa: spos kyi dri snoms pa: rak+ta'i bcud 'jib pa: dpal gtor gyi dbal snoms pa: dong ba bzhin du bla ma btags pa: rta rnga bzhin du byin la 'khril ba: khyi mo bzhin du rjes 'brang ba: bya nag bzhin du glad na lding ba: mi brdzu dgu brdzu: tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du lan chags pa'i 'byung po za re ba: 'thung snyams pa rnams dang gzhan yang 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi rigs su gyur pa: nad gdon ngos ma zin pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi rigs su gyur pa rnams la sbyin no: rang rang so so'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i longs spyod mi zad pa'i gter chen po 'byung zhing tshim par gyur cig: tshims nas kyang zhi ba byang chub sems dang ldan par mdzod la 'dir skad cig yud tsam du'ang 'tshe bar ma byed cig: so so rang rang gi gnas su byer cig: bud cig: dngos shig: sarba gigha rna gats+tsha: zhes dkyil 'khor gzhung lugs kyi bka' bsgo bya'o: de nas srungs 'khor bsgom pa ni: ye shes kyi rang snang las grub pa'i steng rdo rje'i 'khor lo'am gur khang : 'og thams cad rdo rje'i 'khor lo'i sa gzhi: de yi phyi rol du ma lam dkar po g.yas su 'khor ba'i gur khang : de'i phyi rol du kā li dmar po g.yon du 'khor ba'i gur khang : de'i phyi rol du rlung spu gri reg gcod kyi gur khang : de'i phyi rol du 'ja' 'od dang yig 'bru mtshon cha rnams kyi rig byed thams cad nyi rdul ltar du 'khrigs pa'i gur khang : de'i phyi rol du ye shes kyi me ri me phung kha dog sna lnga 'bar ba'i gur khang chen po cig tu gyur: me phung gi klong na bzlog byed kyi khro bo rnams kyi zhal phyir brgyus nas bh+yo bzlog dang rdu phaṭa kyis sngags sgra rnyi ri ri sgrogs pa: bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du bsrung byed kyi khro mo rnams kyi zhal nang du gyus nas: rgyu dang tu lu'i sngags sgra 'brug stong ldir ba lta bur gyur: de dag rnams kyi dbus su ye shes kyi rang 'od 'khrigs pa'i klong du: bdag nyid dang bsrung bya thams cad yi dam lha yi nga rgyal gyis gnas par gyur: oṃ ye dharmā sogs/ 419

༄ga /bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje phur pa'i las byang rdo rje rab 'bar zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /oṃ swaste/ rdzogs chen zhi khro nges don snying po las byung ba'i phur pa'i las byang rdo rje rab 'bar zhes bya ba/ bla ma dpal kun bzang rdo rje gzhon nu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam kun mchog ldan rdo rje gzhon nu che/ /lhag pa'i lha der rtag tu phyag byas nas/ /gang gi las byang ngag 'don snying po nyid/ /'dir bkod lha des dbugs dbyung byin brlabs stsol/ /de yang sngon du 'gro ba'i rim pa la/ /skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ: dus 'di nas bathung byang chub ma thob bar: skyabs gnas mchog gyur rnams la skyabs su mchi'o: sems bskyed pa ni/ yang gsang bla med lam zab 'di bsgrub pas: rang byas las kyi mnar ba'i pha ma rnams: sdug bsngal kun bral bde ba'i sa la bkod: 'gro kun 'khor ba dong sprug sems bskyed do: yan lag bdun pa ni/ oṃ āḥrgyu: chos rnams thams cad bya rtsol 'dzin bral la:thams cad rol gcig ngang du phyag 'tshal lo: spang blang 'dzin bral klong yangs ngang du mchod: rang rig chos skur ma rtogs mthol lo bshags: chos gsung bskul zhing mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs: rang gzhan dge bsngo tshogs rdzogs sangs rgyas shog: bgegs bskrad pa ni/ r+ghaṃ/ nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs: nga yi bka' la 'da' ma byed: gal te 'das par gyur pa na: rdo rje 'dzin rgyal thugs khros nas: brlag par 'gyur bar gdon mi za: de bas da lta phyir dengs shig: oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha rgyu:groṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍa r+ghaṃḥ groṇ+ḍa pā ya groṇ+ḍi pā ya rgyu: ā na ya ho: bha ga wan bibyarā tsa rgyu phaṭaḥ mtshams bcad pa la lta bas ni: oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta sto na badz+ra swā bha wa at+ma ko3haṃ: stong pa la yun ci rings su bzhag:bsgom pa ni: r+ghaṃ/ chos dbyings stong nyid dag pa'i ye shes mkha': rgya chad phyogs lhung bral ba'i gnas mchog 'dir: chos sku gting gsal bkrag mdangs nyi 'od bzhin: phyi nang med par khyab gdal gzhal yas khang : rig pa rang byung ye shes 'od gsal gyi: rang mdangs lhun grub pho brang 'od gur 'khyil: sku gsum rim gyis brgyan pa'i dkyil 'khor mjos: kun kyang rang rig gzi brjid 'od 'bar klong : snang srid dag snang zhi khro'i rol pa las: ma rig gnyis 'dzin 'khrul rtog bgegs dang bral: mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor ye nas ngang gi gsal: ma rtogs bgegs kyang slar yang rang grol dengs: rgyu rgyu r+ghaṃ: dzñā na badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa rgyu r+ghaṃ: bshags pa ni/ r+ghaṃ/ bla ma kun bzang rigs lnga 'khor 420

dang bcas: yi dam zhi khro dhā ki chos skyong dgongs: bdag cag ma rig dbang gi bag med tshul: sku gsung thugs dang yan lag dam tshig rnams: nyams gyur mi 'chab mi sbed mthol lo bshags: klong yangs chen po'i ngang du bzod par gsol: sā mā yā: a a a: byin dbab pa ni: rgyu/ rang snang sgrib med chos dbyings zhing khams nas: chos skur rnam dag dam tshig dkyil 'khor 'dir: rig pa ye shes lha mchog gshegs su gsol: dus kun dbyer med zangs thal byin dbang bskur: yul dang lus sems 'khrul pa'i bar chad sol: stong gsal 'dzin med gdengs thob dngos grub stsol: badz+ra sa ma yā a we sha ya a āḥ mchod pa byin brlabs ni: r+ghaṃ/ 'jig rten dag pa'i gzhal yas pho brang 'dir:'dod yon lnga rnams dngos 'byor yid sprul ste: phyi nang gsang sogs mchod pa'i bye brag kun: lha tshogs dgyes bskang mchod spyin byin gyis rlobs: oṃ r+ghaṃ ṭ+wāṃ trīḥlhu sarba pu dza āḥr+ghaṃḥ de ltar skyabs sems yan lag bdun/ /bgegs bskrad mtshams bcad bshags pa dang / /byin dbab mchod pa byin brlabs pa/ /sngon 'gro rnam pa brgyad yin no/ /don gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa la/ /lha bskyed pa ni/oṃ swā bha wa shurnya sarba dharmā su bhā wa shurjo3haṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i rang gdangs las: rang byung lhun grub kyi gzhal yas khang thig le 'od gong khyab gdal chen po'i klong yangs las rang gsal rig pa'i ngo bo bdag nyid kun bzang yab yum chos sku mtshan ma med pa'i ngang nas zhal phyag gi rnam pa can gsal ba'ang bum sku'i tshul mkhyen pa ma 'gags pa sa le snang la rang bzhin med pa lam me gsal bar gyur: rgyu/ 'khor 'das gnyis med chos dbyings mkha' ltar gdal: mchog gi 'od gsal rgya chad phyogs lhung bral: rang byung ye shes lhun grub gzhal med khang : mi 'gyur chos sku'i pho brang nyid du gsal: rnam dag dri med zang thal rin po che: ma skyes gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i klong : sangs rgyas kun mes rang rig chos kyi sku: kun tu bzang po zhal ni phyogs bcur gzigs: yum gyi bha ga bde klong gcig tu 'khyil: sku mchog yid bzhin nor bu rin po che: shes rab 'gag med rang bzhin 'od gsal ba: dngos po'i mtshan ma bral ba'i phyag rgya can: rang byung 'od sku khyab gdal mkha' dbyings su: stong gsal bkrag mdangs thig le'i gong bur smin: rgyu/ bdag nyid kun bzang 'od du zhu ba las: bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu ni: sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing spyan dgu bsgrad:phyag g.yas dang po rdo rje rtse dgu dang : bar bas rtse lnga g.yon gnyis me dpung dang : kha ṭ+wāṃ ka bsnams mtha' gnyis phur pa 'dril: zhabs bzhi ru tra pho mo'i steng du rdzis: sku smad khro phur rang bzhin dpal chas brgyan: dbu skra gyen brdzes khrag 'thung rigs lngas brgyan: yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs 421

mthing nag brngams: phyag gnyis rdo rje thod pa yab la 'khyud: rgyan cha yab mthun yab yum me dpung bzhugs: de yi phyi rim khrag 'thung bzhi bcu bzhi: bsrung ma bcu gnyis pho bdud nyi shu gcig: ging chen bco brgyad ging phran 'bum dang bcas: mdor na rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams: 'jigs rngams 'od zer 'bar ba'i skur gsal gyur: oṃ badz+ra tī li tī la yaḥsarba bisne baṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa: phyogs mtshams pad 'dab bum thod ye shes kyi: bcud kyi yongs bkang bde stong mched pas bskor: bar 'khyams phyi nang mu khyud sgo rnams dang : khor yug kun tu dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: bstan bsrung dam can gnas srung bzhi bdag sogs: bka' nyan dkar phyogs mched 'os sgrub 'os kun: ma lus til gyi gang bu rgyas ltar khong : mchog mthun dngos grub byin 'bebs tshul du bzhugs: gzhan yang phyogs dus bde gshegs ma lus kun: sprul pa yang sprul 'khor bcas sprin bzhin 'thibs:mdor na phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor ni: rab 'byams dpag med nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i:zangs thal chen po mkha' la 'ja' 'od bzhin: snang la rang bzhin med par bkrag mdangs gsal:bkra dpung 'ja' 'od thibs se gsal bar bsgom: spyan 'dren pa ni: lha tshogs de dag thams cad kyi thugs kar rang rang gi srog yig dang : gnas lnga'i sa bon las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas:dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur gzhengs nas nyi zer la rdul 'khrigs pa lta bur zer thag bsgrengs ba'i sna la dpung dpung byon par gyur: r+ghaṃ/ rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang : rang gdang rol pa'i cho 'phrul phur pa'i tshogs: 'gro ba'i don du so sor sku phrul ste:yab yum sras dang bcas te gshegs su gsol: badz+ra sā mā dza: bzhugs su gsol ba ni: rgyu/ rang byung lhun grub ye shes gzhal yas khang : ye nas ma bcos rang babs dkyil 'khor 'dir: ru tra bdud bzhi bam dang nyi zla'i steng : rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs bzhugs su gsol: sa ma ya a be sha ya tiṣ+ṭha ldan: phyag 'tshal ba ni: rgyu: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las ni: snang stong grags stong gsal stong rig stong ngang : bde stong dbyer med a 'thas sdug bsngal bral: rdo rje phur pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: a ti gu hoḥ pra ti dza ho: ya mi na mo: mchod pa ni: r+ghaṃ trī: mchod yon brgyad dang rgyal srid rin chen bdun: 'dod yon lnga ldan phyi mchod sna tshogs 'bul: lha mo bcu drug sman rag bdud rtsi dang : dug lnga ye shes sbyor sgrol nang mchod 'bul: oṃ lhar+ghaṃḥsarba pū tsa ho: /rnam shes tshogs brgyad dga' bzhi bde stong gsal: phyi nang snod bcud 'dod yon phyi gtor dang :dug lnga phung po sha lnga nang gtor dang : ye shes lnga ldan ting 'dzin gsang gtor 'bul: oṃ badz+ra tī li tī la ya: sarba big nan baṃ rgyu phaṭa: badz+ra ar+ghaṃ paṭ+wāṃ puṣ+pe dhu pe ā lo ke ghadhe nai wi bya shardi pra 422

tīts+tsha āḥhūṃḥ ru pa shardo ghadhe ra su sparnye pu tsa āḥhūṃḥ oṃ badz+ra tī li tī la yaḥsarba big nan baṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭaḥ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha ram̐ khā hi: ma hā rak+ta la kha ram̐ khā hi: ma hā bha ling ta kha ram̐ khā ti: bstod pa ni: rtsu/ ma g.yos chos mchog sku gsung thugs kyi bdag /gang la ci 'dul rgyal bas tshul ston pa'i//yon tan rdzogs pa rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ /gdug pa mthu chen khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyogs bcu'i khro bo'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sgrol byed phur pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rgyu/ kun bzang thugs kyi 'od zer cho 'phrul las: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor shar: mtha' yas dpag med ye shes me 'od 'bar: bar chad sdig sgrib bsreg la phyag 'tshal bstod: rgyu/ yang dag bla med dkyil 'khor rol pa las: thams cad mnyam nyid byang chub sems kyi ngang : spros pas mtha' 'das bsdus pas rang bzhin klong : lhun grub phur pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: rdo rje'i gdung 'tshob rnal 'byor tshogs rnams kyi: 'gal 'khrul nyams chags deng 'dir bskong gyur cig: gsol ba gdab pa ni/ r+ghaṃ/ thugs dgongs chos dbyings yangs pa'i klong nas ston: rab 'bar bskal pa'i me 'od 'khrigs pa'i klong : r+ghaṃ phaṭa drag sngags 'brug stong ldir ba yi: rdo rje phur pa bla brgyud bcas rnams la: gsol ba 'debs so rnal 'byor bdag cag gi: 'di bzung byang chub snying po ma thob bar: rang rig rtogs pa'i gdeng dang mi 'bral zhing : mchog mthun dngos grub thob par byin gyis rlobs: de nas 'dzab kyi rim pa la/ thog mar dzab bskul ba ni: r+ghaṃ/ skye med ngang las 'gag med skur bzhengs te: thugs srog rgyu las grags stong gsung gi sgra: rang byung thugs las lhun grub dbyings kyi ngang : sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las 'dzab kyis bskul: de nas 'dzab dmigs gsal zhing bzlas pa dngos ni: gtso bo'i thugs kar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems: de yi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng : thugs srog rgyu mthar sngags 'phreng bskor ba las: 'od 'phros ma rung gdug pa tshar gcod bsgom: oṃ badz+ra tī li tī la yaḥsarba bisnan baṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa: bzlas pa ji nus su bya zhing mthar ā li kā li rten 'brel snying po yang bzlas la/ mchod bstod dang tshogs bskang yang spro zhing nus na bya'o/ /rdzogs rim ni: r+ghaṃ/ phyi nang snod bcud ye nas gzhal yas lha: bdag gi lus ngag yid kyang lha tshogs kyi: sku gsung thugs su ye nas gnas pa la: bsgrub dang bsgrub bya las 'das don gyi dbyings:dbyer med ye shes dkyil 'khor rang gsal ngang : r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ: zhes lha sngags chos nyid kyi don la mnyam par bzhag cing : rjes su lam du khyer bar bya'o: de ltar bsnyen bsgrub la 'bad pas rab dngos/'bring nyams/ tha ma rmi lam du phyi nang gsang ba'i grub rtags rnams spyi gzhung dang mthun par 'byung ngo : zab rgya: bsnyen pa them pas las kyi kha tshar bsrung bzlog gi rim pa ni/ rang nyid sems dpa' 423

gsum brtsegs su gsal ba'i thugs ka'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūṃ yig gi klad kor du bla ma slob dpon/ khog par rang sems kyi ngo bo dz+ra'am thig le'i rnam pa/ g.yas su bsrung bya pho rigs/ g.yon du mo rigs/ mdun du gang gces pa/ 'og tu rta phyugs yul mkhar sa zhing 'khod pa/ snying kha'i hūṃ gi 'od kyi phyogs bcu'i zhing nas rang dang bsrung bya'i bla tshe 'thor nyams yar ba/ sde brgyad gdug pas brkus 'phrog gzhom pa thams cad a dz+ra rgyu sogs kyi rnam par bkug snying ga'i bsrung bya rnams la bstim pas bkrag mdangs gzi brjid 'bar zhing / thugs ka nas spros pa'i khro bcu/ mtshon cha/ rdo rje sa ba/zhi/ra gur/ me dpung 'bar ba'i bsrung 'khor gyis 'khor yug tu bcing bar bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra tī li tī la yaḥsarba big nan baṃ hūṃ phaṭa: dz+ra rgyu r+ghaṃ dzaḥbadag cag mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hāḥzhes bzla ba ni bsrung ba'o/ /yang snying hūṃ las me lce dang sprul pa'i khro tshogs nyi zer gyi rdul bzhin spros/gnod byed byad ma lha bsrung dang bcas pa rang gshed du phabs te sha zos khrag 'thung lhag ma rnams kyang mes bsreg rdul du brlag par bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra tī li tī la yaḥsarba big nan baṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa: oṃ a kro te ka ya ma rā tsa bzlog: oṃ e ka du na bzlog: oṃ ma hā du na bzlog: oṃ sa ga du na bzlog: oṃ rā tsa du na bzlog: oṃ sum̐ tri rak+ṣa du na bzlog: oṃ rak+ṣa ti phor du na bzlog: oṃ r+ghaṃ trig khro bh+yoḥ ma ni mā ra ni bh+yo: ma ra du na bh+yo: raklo rak+kan ting ya rak+ka bh+yo: mā ra ya ya ma rā dza tī la ma bh+yo bzlog: bdag cag mi nor 'khor bcas la gnod par byed pa'i byad phur rbod gtong rbad 'dre sogs 'gal rkyen bar gcod thams cad mā ra ya bh+yo bzlog: ces bzla zhing mthar bden stobs spyi ltar brjod de bzlog pa zab pa'i mthar thug pa'o/ /sdom ni/ bskyed dang spyan drangs bzhugs gsol ba/ /phyag dang mchod bstod gsol gdab dang / /dzab kyi bskor ste las rim brgyad/ /dngos gzhi'i bya ba nyid yin no/ /zhes so/ /skabs 'dir tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa dang / rjes kyi las rim ni/ zhi khro rang gzhung ltar byas pa kho nas grub mod/ de yang rjes kyi las rim rnams dkyus 'dir bkod na/ bskul ba ni: r+ghaṃ/ma bcos lhun grub dbyings rig dbyer med las: rig rtsal cho 'phrul rdo rje phur pa'i tshogs: sprul pa dam can bsrung mar bcas pa rnams: mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje'i sku gzhengs shig: r+ghaṃ/rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag gi grogs la byon: ma rungs gdug pa'i dgra bgegs tshar gcod la:dus ngan sems can 'dul ba'i dus la babs: phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med grub par mdzod:sharnying / puṣ+ṭi/ wa shaṃ/ mā ra ya phaṭa: chad tho bstan skyong ni: rgyu bh+yo: sngon tshe bar dang tha ma'i bskal pa dang : lha mi'i gnas dang snyigs ma rtsod ldan dus: sku gsum bka' brgyud rnams kyi rim bzhin du: rgyud gsung gter du sbas bton zhal phyes tshe: spyi dang bye brag bsrung ma thams cad kyi: so so'i sku 424

gsung thugs mchog bstan nas kyang : ji ltar khas blang dam bcas de bzhin du: mchod gtor bzhes la 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod: r+ghaṃ bh+yo: 'das dang ma byon da lta'i mtshams shed na: 'jig rten 'das kyang 'khor ba'i cha lugs 'dzin: ye shes grub kyang las kyi dbang mo mdzad: gdos bcas gzugs spang 'od lus 'phrul mo che: 'khor ba'i tshogs spang rang rang brda' skad 'don: dran rtog sems spang dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong : kau ri sing ha phra man dbang phyug sogs: bstan ma bcu gnyis ging dang lang ka dang : ma bdun sring bzhi shul le bzhi bdag rnams: sngon tshe o rgyan chen po'i spyan snga ru: khas blang dam bcas khyed rnams 'khor bcas kyi: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di longs la:thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod: ma ma hri hri bhadzi ta khā nyiḥ gtor gzhong sbrubs pa'i 'og tu dgra bgegs bkug nas 'di skad do:r+ghaṃ/ rang byung rang shar rang grol dkyil 'khor 'dir: sku lnga lhun grub ye shes rol pa'i bra:ma rig nyon mongs dug lnga'i mgo la brdung : rgyu drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dbyings su dag: oṃ badz+ra tī li tī la yaḥ sarba big nan baṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa: bar chad dam sri ste bha ya nan: bsrung 'khor bsgom: lhag chad kha bskang ba ni: ho: bdag rmongs legs spyad 'di la nyes gyur gang : bskyed rim sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin g.yel: lhag chad nor 'khrul rgyu chung phud nyams rnams: lha tshogs drung bshags bzod gsol tshangs par stsol: ces yig brgya sogs kyi kha bskang ngo : de nas dngos grub blang ba ni:r+ghaṃ/ ye nas rnam dag rang byung rang shar dbang : sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las dngos grub ni:sgrib gnyis dag cing sku gnyis lhun gyi grub: rdo rje gzhon nu rab 'byams dbang thob shog: kā ya sirnyi oṃ: wāk+ka sirnyi āḥ tsit+ta sirnyi rgyu hoḥ bkra shis brjod pa niḥ rgyu/ ye shes lnga ldan 'od lnga'i pho brang na: dus gsum mi 'gyur lhun grub bkod pa'i rgyan: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams kun nas bkra: sgyu 'phrul rdo rje phur pa'i bkra shis shog: bsdu rim ni: r+ghaṃ/ snang srid 'od zhu sgyu lus dkyil 'khor thim: dkyil 'khor rim bzhin dbus kyi gtso bor thim: gtso bo ye sems thugs ka'i r+ghaṃ la thim: sa bon dmigs med chos dbyings klong du a: zhes rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang la bcas bcos med par ci nus su bzhag go: de nas bsngo ba smon lam ni: na mo: rgyal ba rgya mtsho gsan cing dgongs su gsol: 'di ltar lha mchod bsnyen bsgrub bgyis pa yi: dge ba'i rtsa bar gyur pa ci mchis pa: bdag gzhan bla med byang chub thob phyir bsngo: ho: bdag gzhan dge ba 'di dang dus gsum du: bsags pa'i mthu yi 'khor ba dong sprugs te: 'gro kun phyag gcig rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du: ye grol khyab gdal klong du lhun grub shog: gzhan yang smon lam ci rigs btab bo: rjes 425

la bskul dang chad bstan skyong / /gtor bro lhag chad kha bskang ba/ /dngos grub blangs dang shis pa brjod/ /bstu rim bsngo smon brgyad yin no/ /des ni sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi rjes kyi las rim bstan grub pa'o/ /gang zhig bar chad bdud dpung kun 'joms mdzad/ /lha yi lha mchog rdo rje phur pa yi/ /phrin las zhi khro rgyud kun nying khu las/ /gu ru'i bka' ltar 'di ru 'khrigs su sdebs/ /de tshe dge mtshan bzang pos dbugs dbyung bas/ /nyes pa'i skyon gyi gos pa med par sems/ /gal te nyes na mthol bshags tshangs dbang stsol/ /dge mchis 'gro kun dpal chen nyid 'grub shog /de ltar rdzogs chen zhi khro'i las byang rgyud thams cad kyi snying khu nges don snying po'i gzhung nas phur pa'i dkyil 'khor khol du phyungs ba'i ngag 'don rdo rje rab 'bar zhes bya ba 'di yang lhag pa'i lha 'dir mos pa'i las bskal bzang po ldan pa rdo rje slob ma spyi dang bye brag du mas nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor rgyal mchog gu ru pad+ma'i byin brlabs kyi mthus rang gzhan grub mthar ma rmongs pa'i blo mig cha tsam thob pa bod kyi dzo ki rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu rdo rje'i gzi brjid kyis bal yul sa yi thig le yam bu rgyal po'i khab yid 'ong skyed mos tshal lha chen sred med bu yi rten 'brel khang khrus kyi rdzing bu dang ljon shing gi ra ba bya rigs du mas gang ba'i khang bzang asbal du chu sprel nag zla'i dkar phyogs rgyal ba gsum pa la bkod grub pa'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /de nas de ltar tshogs zhing gi dkyil 'khor la tshogs skong 'bul ba ni gsum ste: tshogs mchod phul zhing bshags skong gi rim pa dang : rnal 'byor pas tshogs la rol zhing glu len pa dang : lhag ma'i cho ga dang gsum mo:de nas dang po tshogs rdzas sha mar thud dang chang la sogs te: rnal 'byor pas bza' btung longs spyod dpag tu med pa gtsang ma dngos po dang dag pa rnams bsham mo: de nas lha'i nga rgyal gyis bgegs la bka' bsgo ba ni: r+ghaṃ: nga ni kun bzang che mchog rigs lnga'i gtso: dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus kun mchod kyis: mchod pa'i mdangs 'phrog nyon mongs bar chad bgegs: gnas 'dir skad cig ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: r+ghaṃ ju u tsa ta ya rgyu phaṭa: ces bskrad do: mtshams bcad pa ni: r+ghaṃ: nga ni khro rgyal thams cad 'dus pa'i sku: dpal chen rab 'jigs bdud 'dul rdo rje 'chang : sangs rgyas kun gyis byin brlabs dbang bskur cing : gdug pa thams cad 'dul bar rab bsngags pa: me ri mtshon cha rdo rje'i ra ba dang :khro tshogs rab tu 'bar bas mtshams chod cig: badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ: de nas tshogs bsang sbyang ni: a mṛ tas chu 'thor la: su bhā bas stong par sbyang : hūṃ: bdag nyid kun bzang che mchog thugs ka nas: r+ghaṃ las yi ge ram̐ yo khaṃ gsum 'phros: me rlung chu yis tshogs kyi dngos 'dzin dri: bsreg gtor bkrus nas gtsang la rnyog med gyur: ram̐ yi khaṃ: zhes lan gsum brjod pas tshogs kyi nyes skyon thams cad dag par bsam: de nas byin rlabs ni: r+ghaṃ: slar yang dpa' bo 'bru lnga tshogs la k+ṣ-iraphros: sgra dang bcas par 426

tshogs rnams 'od du zhu: ye shes bdud rtsi 'od phung ldems se ldem: 'dod yon mchod sprin nam mkha'i khams gang gyur: oṃ r+ghaṃ ṭ+wāṃ trī:a: ces brjod pas tshogs rdzas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du bsam: tshogs kyi yul spyan drangs pa ni: rgyu: skye med chos sku kun bzang klong yangs nas: ma 'gags gzugs kyi skur bzhengs phur bu'i tshogs: khro chen bcu bcas gzhan yang bskang 'os mgron: ma lus tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: 'dod pa'i yon tan lhun grub tshogs khang 'dir: tshogs mchod bdud rtsi bzhes slad bzhugs su gsol: sa ma ya dza:r+ghaṃ baṃ ho+oḥ tiṣ+ṭha lhan: de nas tshogs phung rim gsum du bcad la dang po phul la: r+ghaṃ: kun bzang zhi khro rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro phur: gzhan yang bka' brgyad dpal mgon bcas rnams loḥ phyi nang gsang mchod bdud rtsi sman rag gtor: rnal 'byor longs spyod 'dod yon tshogs mchod 'bul: thugs dam gnyen po bskang phyir bzhes nas kyang : dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub stsal du gsol: oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī ga ṇa tsakra pu tsa khā nyi: bar pa tshogs bshags ni: hūṃ: bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis: bag med tshul gyis dam las 'gal gyur te:rgyal ba zhi khro'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba: longs spyod 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pas bshags: oṃ ga na tsakra sa ma ya: ma nu pā la ya: ga na tsakra te no pa tiṣ+ṭha: dṛ ḍho me bha wa: su to ṣ+yo me bha wa: su po ṣ+yo me bha wa: a nu rak+to me bha wa: sarba sirnyi m+me pra yats+tsha: sarba karma su tsa me tsit+t+waṃ shrī yam̐ ku ru r+ghaṃ: ha ha ha ha ho: bha na wān: sarba ta thā ga ta trī da ya: ga na tsakra mā me muñtsa ga na tsakra bha wa: ma hā sa ma ya ga na tsakra satwa ā: ces brjod: tha ma bsgral ba ni: bdag nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i mdun tu tshogs snod de nyid las kyi rnam smin las grub pa'i gru gsum lcags khang 'bar ba'i nang du: tshogs rdzas dgra bgegs dngos su gsal ba la: bdag cag gi sngon las 'phral rkyen gang yang rung ste: lus ngag yid la gnod 'tshe bar chad dgra bgegs thams cad gcig tu dril nas gzugs ling la thim par gyur: bden stobs kyis bkug la: hūṃ: bdag cag rnal 'byor byang chub sgrub pa la: bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs 'byung po kun: bla ma dkon mchog rtsa gsum bden pa'i mthus: skad cig tsam gyis gzugs phung 'di la khug: dza:rgyu baṃ ho: bsgral ba ni: hūṃ: dug lnga'i las kyis bsags pa'i bag chags rnams: sku gsum sku lnga'i klong du da lta sgrol: ma rig bdag 'dzin a 'thas ru dra 'di: rang shes rig pa'i dbyings su mā ra ya phaṭa: zhal du bstab pa ni: r+ghaṃ: nyon mongs dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: phung khams skye mched bla tshe rnam shes bcas: zhal du stobs shig zhi khro'i lha tshogs kyi:chos dbyings bde chen mnyam pa'i thugs su stems: oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī: amu ka dri tri shartu mā ra ya ma hā māṃ sa khā nyi: ma hā rak+ta khā nyi: ma hā tsit+ta khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi: ma hā ba su ta khā 427

hi: ma hā ki ni ri ti khā hi: skabs 'dir ru zung bzhi'i bshags pa rnams bya: gnyis pa rnal 'byor bas lta ba'i ngang nas longs spyod tshogs la rol ba ni: r+ghaṃ: rang gi gzugs ni 'khor 'das gnyis kyi yul: dang po rgyu drug 'khor ba sbyang bar bya: lus la nyon mongs rigs drug sa bon yod: tshogs kyi 'od zer gdangs 'od zer gsum gyis: 'bru drug bag chags bcas pa dag par gyur: r+ghaṃ: rgyu drug gnas sbyangs 'das pa'i sangs rgyas yin: phung lnga yab lnga 'byung lnga yum lnga'i ngang : 'khor lo lnga la rigs kyi mkha' 'gro lnga: rtsa phran dpa' bo mkha' 'gro til gong rgyas: hūṃ: snying gar zhi ba mgrin par rig 'dzin dang :spyi bor khrag 'thung lte bar mkha' 'gro ma: gsang gnas rdo rje phur ba'i lha tshogs bzhugs: bder gshegs rgyal ba'i pho brang dam pa 'dir: zag med ye shes chen po'i mchod pa 'buloḥ a la la ho:bzhes shing dgyes par rol: de ltar dgongs pa gsal ba'i ngang nas: sarba sirnyi r+ghaṃ: zhes lag gnyis pad skor dang bcas pas zhal zas blangs te: r+ghaṃ: nga nyid ye nas sangs rgyas rigs lnga yin: lag g.yas dpa' bo lag g.yon mkha' 'gro lnga: yar rkan snang mtha' mar rkan gos dkar mo: ljags ni me lha'i gun+da mid pa ni: byang chub sems lam zhal zas 'byung lnga'i bcud: kha dog dkar la dwangs pa ro nyid bda': rgyu nyid bdud rtsi 'od mdangs si li li: lta ba chos nyid klong du rab tu thim: rtsa gsum nang nas gyen du ye shes spar: ye shes lha rnams ye shes chen por rol: zhes spyod do: de nas rdo rje'i glu 'di su thug gis gar thod du blang mi rung ste: gnas dur khrod chen po: rgyal bas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas chen: gter gnas sgrub gnas la sogs gnas khyad par can: mdor na 'jig rten pa'i gnas las 'das pa'i ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su: rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor ba 'khrul ba dag nas rang rig lta ba'i gdengs dang ldan pas: dgos pa drug tu bab pa'i dus su rdo rje'i glu drug mgur du blang ba ni: dur khrod brtul zhugs spyod pa la 'gro na 'gro ba'i dus su yan lag mthil bzhi sa la btsug la gcan sbyang ri zur la 'grim pa lta bur byas te blangs so:tshogs kyi dus su lus la rus pa'i rgyan btags rgyug pa dang mchong pa dang gyad kyi 'dor thabs su byas te blangs so:mi rtog pa rgyud la brten pa'i dus su lus drang srong lta bu thal mo 'gram pa la sbyar te blangs so: lta sgom spyod pa'i dus su lus drang por bsrangs te thal mo snying gar sbyar nas blangs so: e ma kyi ri ki ri: smas ta bha li bha li: sa mi ta su ru su ru: kudha li ma su ma su: i ka ri li su bhasta ye: tsa ka ra bha li ta lce ye sa mun ta: tsa t+yasu gha ye: gi tis na bya ghu li: ke ra ke ra: du ba na ma ta le be te ni: pa ra li ha saṃ na saṃ bhu ra ta: me gha tsar ta ba sa t+ya bh+ya ta ra: e bha sha na sa: ran ba ti ba gu li ya: snu ra ghu ra: sa ga ga rad na lo:na ra na ra i thar bhu tha chi: sha sa kye gi pa ra ri ri ma le sad tra: ma saun bho sa: lha sa ra sa pa lo: i e ma ma ra ra a: ma ma ki ri ki ri: smas ta sa li sa mi ta su ru su ru: kudha li ma su: i ka ri ba le tsa kha bhu li ta lce ye sa mun ta: tsat+ya su gha rnyi ti san rgya ku ye: ke ra dhā tī dhā ka ma hā ri se dha na pa ra li 428

te: sa rna kha ra ta khe la sa na bhud ra ta ka tsa ra haṃ ma hā ba su t+ya gha ha ra a: sa na ma sa na sa ra bhi hi tis: ghur lam min sa lhu tis ta ya ghur ghur: glang kha la ran lo nar pa lo: i ta ral ta lo: sir rna be sar lo bha sa ge lo pa: sa sa ri ri li li: i i ma ma ra ra: zhes tha mal gyi tshul ma yin pas skabs su bab pa'i dus su: gnas khyad par can du rnal 'byor bas lta ba'i ngang nas: sgra dag pa:tshig gsal ba: dbyangs snyan pos blang ngo : gsum pa lhag ma'i cho ga ni: yar gnas mar gnas gnyis las: yar gnas gtsang lhag gtor mar bran la: r+ghaṃ: sku gsum lhun grub rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams: tshogs phud dgyes pa chen pos yar bzhes la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub dus 'dir stsol: zhi rgyas dbang drag thogs med sgrub par mdzod: hūṃ: dang por rdo rje phur ba phud kyis mchod: bar du rnal 'byor pho mosak+ṣitshogs la rol: tha mar lhag la dgyes pas lhag la rol: so so'i thugs dam gnyan po bskang gyur cig: de nas phud lhag bsres nas 'di skad do: r+ghaṃ: bar du gnyis med gcig tu mi bsre ru: chos dbyings rnam dag ye nas rgyu 'bras gcig: tshogs lhag la rdo rje slob dpon lhar gsal bas bdud rtsi'i zhal phrus btab nas: rgyu: tha ma tshogs lhag kha chus mi 'debs su: khyod dang nga gnyis rdo rje'i tha tshig gcig: sngon tshe dpal chen khrag 'thung spyan snga ru: dbus na mi 'tshal dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong : phud la mi 'tshal lhag ma'i zhal chab zhu: ci bgyi'i bka' nyan bsgrub ces khas blangs bzhin: lhag ma'i bshal thu gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khas blangs dam bca' bzhin tu phrin las mdzod: de nas tshogs lhag mar gnas bskul ba ni: r+ghaṃ bh+yo: dpal gyi bka' nyan rol ba'i lhag sdud ma: dbang phyug ging dang lang ka mkha' 'gro ma: 'bar ma ma bdun srin bzhi pho nya'i tshogs: gnas bzang dur khrod 'grim zhi tshogs khang nyul: gos bzang g.yang gzhi gon nas bhad+dha thogs: skom bzang rak+ta 'thung zhing ro la za: dam tshig srung mar rgyu zhing mkha' la 'gro: zas su nyams pa'i sha dang khrag la dgyes: las su dgra bgegs gsod dang gcod la rngams: lhag gtor bzhes la phrin las grub par mdzod: urtsoṣ+ṭa b.li ta kha ram̐ khā hi: zhes dor ro:phur ba'i smad las bsdus pa/ de nas tha bsgral ba'i las byas te: tshogs rten nya bo'i snying gar ming rus gzhug: mdun du rtsang ldan gru gsum nang du brub: de nas bsgral ba'i rim pa dang po ni: gser skyems mchod la mkhyen gsol gzu dpang bcol: r+ghaṃ: thams cad mkhyen gzigs ye shes lha mchog rnams:ma nyes rnal 'byor bdag gi dbang du gzhug: byang chub sems ldan rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: lus ngag dkar po dge la 'bung bsam yang : dgra bgegs gnyis kyis byed pa'i dbang ma ster: de ring bden rdzun shan 'byed gzu dpang mdzod: dam ldan bu la phan pa'i dgongs pa skyed: dam nyams dgra 429
