la bka' chad drag po phob: sngon nas bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i lha rnams kyang : don dam nus pa yod na dus la babs: dgos pa'i dus 'dir phrin las mi mdzad na: rnal 'byor yi chad kyed kyang thugs dam nyams: sngon gyi zhal bzhes dam tshig gnyan dgongs la: thugs dam bzhin du ma g.yel dgra bgegs sgrol: de nas bskyed cing bden stobs bkug pa ni: r+ghaṃ: bdag nyid skad cig che mchog gsal ba'i mdun: las kyi rnam smin las grub dug lnga 'khrugs: lcags khang gru gsum thar med btson dong nang : dam nyams dgra bo sdig can de nyid ni: gcer bu mgon bral mya ngan phyag rgya can: lan lag lcags bsdam 'dar phril ngu cir gyur: bdag cag sngon las 'phral rkyen byang chub bgegs: dgra bgegs 'byung po za 'dre phung sri kun: ma lus gcig dril phung khams skye mched rnams: dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs gzugs la dril zhing bstem:na mo: drin chen rtsa brgyud bla ma dkon mchog gsum: yi dam zhi khro sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha:chos skyong dpal mgon ma ning 'khor bcas dang : ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya'i byin rlabs dang :rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i nus mthu sogs: bden pa'i byin rlabs mthu rtsal rten 'brel gyis: bdag gzhan lha dang mched lcam thams cad la: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad mi dang mi min tshogs: gang dag ma rungs log 'dren drag shul can: bstan pa bshig cing sgrub pa'i bar chad byed: bsgral ba'i zhing gyur dam nyams gdug pa can: gsang sngags lam gyi mchog las 'da' byed pas: do bsdo phod btsugs bsam ngan sbyor rtsub can: sku la brnyas shing dkor la rngams byed kyi: rnam par shes pa bla tshe srog dang bcas: ri rtse mtsho gting srid gsum gar gnas kyang : rang dbang med par ma lus gcig sdus la: skad cig tsam gyis gzugs ling 'di la khug: badz+ra i ku sha dza: badz+ra pā sha r+ghaṃ: badz+ra sbo ṭa bo: badz+ra ā be sha ya ho: de nas lha dang phral sogs las drug ni: ju: mngon spyod las drug myur mdzad mthu stobs can: dpal chen pho nya'i lha tshogs dus la bab: byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad ru dra 'di:skad cig tsam gyis srung skyob lha dang phrol: mnyam por 'ong ba'i 'dre bdud kun dang sprod: zungs shig rgyab cig lus ngag yid gsum chings: smyo 'bog rengs shing g.yo 'gul med par mdzod: phung po rnam shes rten dang myur du phrol: gzugs phung rdul rlog sha khrag zhal du stob: r+ghaṃ: khro bo sprul pa'i 'od zer rab tu 'khrugs: lcags kyu sprul pas mkha' la skar ltar 'khrug: zhags pa sprul bas bar snang sprin ltar 'thibs: lcags sgrog sprul bas sa gzhir glog ltar 'khyug: dril bu sprul bas phyogs mtshams thog ltar 'bebs: 'khor 'das lag mthil dgra bgegs shor mi 'tshal: r+ghaṃ: pho nya las mkhan char sprin bzhin 'thibs nas: dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dus la bab: ma rig 430

rmongs pa'i las ngan sdig can 'di: de ring tshe dang bsod nams zan grangs them: 'di phyi gnyis kyi so mtshams da lta yin: grogs med gcig pur pha rol 'gro dgos na: 'jig rten phyi ma zhes bya de ring slebs: sngar byas las rnams 'gyod dam snying re brtse: mi tshe sdig zad las ngan rang phung khyod: da ni bsgral ba'i zhing bcur las la sbyar: r+ghaṃ: bdag nyid dpal chen sgrol mkhas thugs ka nas: smyo 'bog 'khrul ba'i pho nya rab sprul bas: khyod kyi sdug bsngal rang sar zhi nas kyang : dbang po bag nyal tshor ba bde bar gyur: de nas bskul zhing thun gyis gdab pa ni: r+ghaṃ: chos kyi dbyings nas rang byung grub pa'i lha: khro bo rol pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po nas: shin tu mi bzad rab 'jigs skur ston pa:dpal chen yongs rdzogs drag po'i phrin las mdzod: rgyu: nga ni dpal chen che mchog he ru ka: sras 'khor sprul bas 'jig rten khams kun khengs: rab 'jigs pho nya 'gyed pa'i dus la bab: phyag g.yas phur ba g.yon na lcags kyu bsnams: lcags kyus zung la phur bas da thob cig: gnod byed dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog: hūṃ: phur thun thog ltar nyungs thun rbab ltar bsgril: khrag thun mtsho ltar mtshe thun skar ltar 'khrugs: dug thun rlung ltar mtshon cha bu yug 'tshubs: mda' rdo'i thun char gtor zor me ltar 'bar: gnod byed dgra bgegs gzugs phung rdul du rlog: ces pas thun rnams rim bzhin gdab: de nas tshe lung khrus lung dgongs pa ni: gsal ba bdag nyid dpal chen du/ phyag gi phur pa rdo rje gzhon nu/ liṅga dgra bgegs dngos su gsal/ gsum gyi ngang las 'di skad bya: hūṃ: phur ba las phur ba phar bsgril ba las/ byung ye shes me rlung chus: khyod lus sgrib sbyangs shel sgong lta bur gyur: tshe bsod 'ub kyis tshur 'dus bdag nyid kyi: lus ngag yid thim mthu byin cher rgyas gyur: dgra bgegs kyi snying khar rnam shes dz+ra:la phur rtses reg: dug lnga'i bag chags zhi nas/ ā:dkar gcig gyur rgyal ba'i thugs tshur dril bas/ kar phaṭa: bsgral ba dngos ni chu srin rnam grol gyi: phyag rgyas las phur blangs la 'di skad do: r+ghaṃ: nga ni dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu ste: mi bzad 'jigs gzugs me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro: sku stod khro bo'i gzugs kyis gnam sa khengs: phyag na gnam lcags 'bar ba'i phur ba 'dril: sku smad ye shes phur bu'i dbal dang ldan: zur gsum nam mkha'i mthong nas 'dril zhing 'debs: drag por gyur pa'i mthu ldan phur ba 'dis: btab pa tsam gyis lha yang brlag gyur na: gnod byed dgra dang bgegs la smos ci dgos: gzir ba tsam gyis ma rungs rdul du brlag: r+ghaṃ: nga ni dpal chen badz+ra ku ma ra: phyag mtshan gnam lcags 'bar ba'i phur ba 'di: mgo bo rgya mdud dbyings nas 'brug stong ldir: rked pa changs zung mtshams nas glog stong 'khyugs: rtsa ba chu srin kha nas sbrul nag skyugs: dbal gsum rtse nas mtshon cha'i tshwa tshwa 'phro: 'gran zla med do badz+ra tī la ya: gnod byed dgra bgegs 'byung po'i steng du 431

gzir: gnyis 'dzin 'khrul snang bag chags mā ra ya: khams gsum rigs drug 'khor ba'i rgyun lam gcod: mnyam nyid rang grol chos kyi dbyings su bsngo: bsgral bya sgrol byed nga bdag ka nas dag: oṃ badz+ra tī li tī la ya: sarba big nān bam̐ r+ghaṃ phaṭa: badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭṛ trig nan che ge mṛ hur sum̐ dza: mā ra ya dza: de nas phung po dum bur gtub pa ni: r+ghaṃ: gnod byed dgra bgegs ru dra bdud dpung la: 'bar ba'i mtshon cha lnga yi char phab pas: 'joms byed tho ba gcod byed ral gri dang : brdungs pa'i dbyugs to 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu dang : gcod pa'i sta re lnga la sogs pa yis: bsam pa'i snying la phog na dum bur gtong : sdug pa'i lus la phog na phye ma brgya: smra ba'i lce la phog na lkugs su bcug:gzugs phung rnam shes gzhob tu bsregs nas kyang : rdul phran bzhin du phye mar brlag par gyis: rdul phran rdul phran: phye ma phye ma: dum bu dum bu: shag shag: mā ra ya: tshal ba tshal ba rbad: oṃ badz+ra tīk+ta kha the: oṃ badz+ram hā kro dha: pad+ma gro dhī shwa ri: badz+ra tī li tī la ya: ma hā yak+ṣa: kā la rū pa: karma ram̐ re: dz+wa la ram̐: gnod byed gdon bgegs 'byung po'i snying la dusgyi mā ra ya r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa: de nas dgra bgegs sha khrag rus pa rnams: bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas bstab pa ni: rtsu: rdo rje phur ba'i lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: gnam sa'i zhal gdangs gangs ri'i mche ba gcigs: bar snang ljags brkyangs stong gsum mid pa ru: bstab po dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: nyon mongs dug gsum bla med mchod pa 'di: gsol lo lhag ma ma lus dgyes par rol: bzhes nas bdag cag g.yar dam sor chud cig: thugs dam bskangs nas 'dod pa'i dngos grub stsol: 'gal rkyen mi mthun bar chad bzlog tu gsol: dgra bgegs rnam shes he ru ka thob shog: oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ: bo snyi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dha tu ā: oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā shrī ho ru ka r+ghaṃ phaṭa: ma hā kro dhī shwa ri s+t+waṃ: oṃ ru lu ru lu r+ghaṃ bh+yo hūṃ phaṭa: oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ha na ma tha bhardzo r+ghaṃ phaṭa: oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta badz+ra kro dha ha yagli wa hu lu hu lu r+ghaṃ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra tī li tī la ya sarba big nān bo r+ghaṃ phaṭa: oṃ gu h+ya tsā na ho ru ka gu h+ya dzñā na kro dhī shwa ri s+t+waṃ: ma ma yo gi nī ru lu ru lu r+ghaṃ bh+yo hūṃ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba r+ghaṃ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭṛ r+ghaṃ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra sarba duṭ+wāṃ.e dza:bh+yo r+ghaṃ phaṭa: khro ga ru ḍa hūṃ phaṭa: sarba dhā ki gli sa ma ya trīng trīng rgyu phaṭa: ma hā māṃ sa la khā nyi: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta la khā nyi: ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi: ma hā ba su ta la khā hi: ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pu tsa khā hi: i rda badzi ta khā hi: sarba pañtsa amṛ ta kha ram̐ khā hi: 432

༄ga /lha mo mo rgyud mtha' dag gi gartso bo sngags kyi srung ma drag po sum bsgril gyi lam khyer las kyi byang bu bzhugs so/ /lha mo mo rgyud mtha' dag gi gtso mo dpal ldan sngags kyi srung ma drag po sum bsgril gyi lam khyer las kyi byang bu ni: bdag nyid dbang chen yab yum gsal ba yi: mdun du sngags srung e ka tsā ti ma: smug nag ral gcig spyan gcig nu gcig ma: khro mo mi bzad dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: zhing dbyug bharnya brkyangs bskums mi ro mnan: drang srong gza' mchog sku mdog dud pa kha: dbu dgu kha gdangs sku smad du 'khyil: shin tu mi bsrun mgo lus mig gis gang : phyag bzhi chu srin sbrul zhags mda' gzhu 'gengs: rdo rje legs pa dmar nag khros pa'i zhal: sku la sug zhu ber gsol 'khor gsum bskor: rdo rje dgra snying dmar bsnams seng ge'i chibs: pho nya las byed sprul pa g.yog 'khor bcas:thams cad ma lus tshur byon dam la 'dus: r+ghaṃ: rang nyid chos sku 'gyur med dag pa'i klong : 'du 'bral med pa'i dbyings mchog rab 'byams nas: dpal chen sku la gnyis med 'khril sbyor ma: e ka tsā ti ghu h+ya gsang ba'i yum: dpal gyi 'khor tshogs ye shes rol pa las: chos kyi dbyings nas sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs la: ye shes mthong phyes ma rig mun pa sol: mnyam nyid rdzogs pa'i don rnams so sor byed: oṃ badz+ra bh+rag dzaḥru lu ru lu ma rdu bh+yo r+ghaṃ: snang srid zil gnon pad+ma khrag 'thung gis: dbang bskur dam phog dam can kun gyi gtso: e ka gza' dang badz+ra thig le rtsal: 'dir gshegs khyed kyi thugs dam dus la babs: hūṃ: bskal pa rlung nag 'tshubs ma'i dkyil 'khor nas: las dang ye shes tshogs kyi rje mo ni: dpal ldan gtso mo e ka tsā ti ma: bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed 'khor dang bcas:ru lu'i sgra skad nam mkha'i 'brug ltar sgrogs: lho sprin 'thibs tshul sku mdog sna tshogs ston: glog ltar 'khyug cing gang la'ang thogs pa med: dus bzhir nyul zhing brten pa'i dam rdzas srung : rnal 'byor skyong zhing re ba bskang ngo zhes: zhal bzhes gang lags rjes su mthun dgongs la: dad pas spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: bdag la byin rlobs dkyil 'khor gnyan po srungs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod yon 'di bzhes la: 'dod pa'i don dgongs phrin las rdzogs par mdzod: nyi zla pad+ma rin chen gdan steng du: dgyes zhing mi g.yo brtan par bzhugs su gsol: oṃ ma ma ra tri ru lu ru lu r+ghaṃ bh+yo rdzu: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: rgyu: deng nas byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar: g.yar dam gcig pas 433

thugs rjes dgongs su gsol: sku mdog phyag mtshan mos pas gsal bar bya: lus ngag yid gsum gdung ba dam pa yis: lha mchog nyid dang ji srid gnas kyi bar: bdag dang mi 'bral sems kyis bsgom par bgyi: bdag ni khyod mthong dngos su bltar med pas: mun pa'i tshogs dang 'dra par mchis mod kyi: gdung sems dam pas yid ches dngos ji bzhin: re zhing ltos so byams ldan thugs rje'i yum: khyod ni ye shes sgrib med zhal mnga' bas: dus 'dir byin rlobs thugs rje'i zhal bzang ston: rdo rje mchog gsum sgrub pa'i dam tshig mchog: deng nas brtsams te bdag gis gzung bar bgyi: dpal gyi yum chen dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: ma lus 'khor bcas ga san cing dgongs su gsol: bdag ni sgrub mchog nges pa'i rnal 'byor pa: gsang chen bla na med pa'i lam zhugs te: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig mnos pa la: 'gal 'khrul nyams chags thams cad mthol zhing bshagasoḥ sngon tshe dpal chen 'bar ba'i spyan snga ru: nyams chags skong zhing bstan pa bsrung ngo zhes: zhal bzhes gang lags dus 'dir sgrub lags kyis: bdag gi 'gal 'khrul nyams chags sbyang du gsol: bem po'i rang bzhin nor bu 'bar ba yang : lha mi'i re 'dod yid bzhin stong mdzad na: khyed ni bsam 'phel yid bzhin cis mi mdzad: bdag gi mngon 'dod re ba bskang du gsol: rdu bh+yo: sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs bzhin: g.yel med dam ldan sgrub pa'i grogs mdzad cing : dam nyams dgra bgegs bla tshe srog dbugs sdus: bdag dang bdag gi 'khor du gtogs pa yi: rdzogs chen snying thig bka' yi zab gtad 'di: bskyed rdzogs sgom sgrub mthar phyin 'bras bur bar: phyi nang bgegs dang gol sa bar chad srungs: rnal 'byor tshe srings mthun rkyen bsod nams spel: snang srid dbang sdus gdug pa'i dgra bgegs tshom: byad kha rbod gtong mi mthun rkyen ngan zlog: dam rdzas sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags bstan pa dar rgyas phrin las mdzod: mar tri sa ma ya hūṃ dza: oṃ ma ma traglu ra tri ru lu ru lu r+ghaṃ bh+yo:r+ghaṃ dza dza dzaḥ i dam ma hā ba lin ta kha kha khā hi: rdo rje bka' dpal gyi dam la gnas pa: bu bzhin skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa: ma sring dbang phyug 'bar ma 'khor bcas tshur gshegs: e h+ye nyi rnal 'byor pa bdag gi phrin las gnyan po sgrubs shig: ma: dpal ldan gtso mo e ka tsā ti ma: zhal gcig phyag gnyis ru lu'i sgra skad sgrogs: kun tu bzang mo dbyings kyi ma mo mchog: las dang ye shes tshogs kyi rje mor bstod: ra: drang srong chen po gza' mchog rā hu la: sku mdog dud kha dbu dgu spyan stong 'bar: phyag bzhi mda' gzhu ral gri rgyal mtshan bsnams: srid bzhi sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas la bstod: tri: dam can skyes bu dmar nag thig lo rtsal: zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dgra snying bsnams: thod phreng g.yang gzhi stag gi sham thabs can: mched zla brtan ma 434

'khor dang bcas la bstod: hūṃ: 'bar ba'i 'khor na bskal nyan srung ma'i tshogs: bstan pa srung zhing bka' yi bya ra mdzad: rnal 'byor skyong zhing bdud 'dul drag po'i sku+oḥ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: sngon tshe rang byung pad+ma'i spyan snga ru: thugs dam zhal bzhes dam tshig ma 'gal bar: sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: ma ra tri dgra bgegs hur sum̐ dzaḥ mā ra ya sod: ces dpal kun tu bzang mo bstan srung gi skur snang ba/ dbyings kyi ma mo mu kha le rdo rje ral gcig ma lcam dral drag po gsum bsgril 'di nyid bka' gter spyi dang /khyad par rdzogs chen 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi'i srung ma gcig pu ste/ dbyings kyi ma mo mu kha le rdo rje ral gcig ma snying thig nyams len mkhan kun gyis gsol mchod gal che la/ 'di'i sgrub thabs rgya mtshor gyur kyang 'di ni gsang ba snying thig ya bzhi'i srung mar kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer gyis mdzad pa dang / klong gsal ḍā ki snying thig gi gter srung gsol mchod gnyis pa sres nas tshe dbang nor bus rang lo nyer bzhi chu stag dbo zlar bkod pa'i yi ge'i ris byed rab 'byams pas bgyis pa'o/ /spyir ma mo'i bye brag bsam las 'das kyang don gyi ngo bo gcig pas 'dir ma 'dus pa med do/ /maṅga lo/ / 435

༄ga /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i man ngag pad dkar phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//na mo gu ra we/ legs gsung rin chen char gyis 'gro rgyud la/ /rnam grol thar pa'i lo 'bras rab bskyed pa/ /rgyal ba kun dngos dpazlo ldarno bla ma yi/ /zhabs la mi phyed dadi pas phyag bgyi'o/ /spang rtogs yon tan mar+shar phyin rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zhi bsil chags bral theg mchog dam pa'i chos/ /byang sems nyan rang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun zhes/ /bslu med dkon mchog rnam gsum gtsug tu mchod/ /shes bya'i mkha' la mkhyen brtse'i rta bdun gyis/ /lung rtogs bstan pa'i pad tshal rgyas mdzad pa/ /bdag blo'i mun sel rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /rnam kun dad pa chen po'i phyag bgyi'o/ /mdo sngags dgongs gsang byis blo'i spyod yul min/ /kho bo sbyangs pa'i mthu zhan shes brtson chung / /de phyir zab don 'grol nus skal ba phra/ /'on kyang dran pa mchog khyod dgyes pa'i slad/ /blo gros gser ldan smin legs ltor smin pa'i/ /dam pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsis rab bskyed pa'i/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i man ngag pad dkar tshal/ /mchod sprin tshig gi phreng ba 'di na spel / /mi mjed zhing 'di'i ston pa zas gtsang sras/ /dang po shākya thub pa chen po'i drung / /byang chub mchog sems bskyed cing bskal pa ni/ /grangs med gsum du tshogs gnyis rab bsags te/ /gzhi dang snying po me tog brgyan pa zhes/ /'og min chen po'i zhing du mngon 'tshang rgyas/ /sprul pa'i rnam rol 'dzam gling bye brag brgyar/ /mdzad pa bcu gnyis tshul gyis gdul bya rnams/ /theg gsum 'bras bur 'god phyir mdo sngags chos/ /rgya cher gsungs pa 'gro ba'i blo rim dang / /mthun pa'i theg pa bgrang las 'das na yang / /rgyu 'bras theg pa gnyis su 'dus zhes gsungs/ /rgyu yi theg par nyan thos theg chen gnyis/ /nyan thos bye brag smra dang mdo sde pa/ /dang por chog shes 'phags pa'i rigs su 'dod/ /gzung yul rags pa stong kyang rdul phra rag/gzhig cig gzhom du med phyir mi stong zhing / /g.yag rnga ne'u seng gi rtsa bzhin du/ /reg la ma 'byar tshul du las rlung gis/ /bsdus nas rags pa'i snod bcud grub par 'dod/ /shes pa phra ba skad cig don dam pa'i/ /bden par 'dod cing nyan thos mdo sde pa/ /sems kyi sa bon zag med ye shes kyi/ /'byung rung nus pa 'dod cing phyi rol yul/ /rdul phran cha med 'dod phyir snga ma las/ /'di nyid cung zad tsam gyis 'phags par 'dod/ /gnyis kas 'khor ba me 'obs ltar mthong nas/ /rang nyid gcig 436

pu zhi ba don gnyer blos/ /so thar rigs bdun sdom pas rgyud sdom zhim/ /kun 'byung sdug bsngal 'gog pa lam bden bzhi/ /sgom nas lhag med dgra bcom thob par 'dod/ /theg pa chung ngu las 'phags chen po yi/ /lta ba sems tsam pa dang dbu ma gnyis/ /sems tsam pa ni rang bzhin gnas pa'i rigs/ /thog ma med nas sems rgyud la gnas pa'i/ /zag med chos rnams bskyed par byed pa yi/ /nus pa chos nyid dag gis thob par 'dod/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis med rang rig rang gsal dang / /yongs grub gzhan dbang kun btags la sogs pa/ /don snang shes par 'dod dang mi 'dod pas/ /rnam pa bden rdzun gnyis su grags pa yang / /rnam shes don dam 'dod phyir dngos smra lugs/ /dbu ma pa la rang stong gzhan stong gnyis/ /dang po rang rgyud thal 'gyur rnam pa gnyis/ /shel phyin 'khor lo bar pa'i dngos bstan lugs/ /dpal mgon klu sgrub kyis mdzad rig tshogs dang / /'phags pa lha yis mdzad pa'i bzhi brgya pa/ /thal rang ma bye gnyis ka'i thun mong gzhung / /legs ldan 'byed kyi shes rab sgron ma dang / /'bral pa spyan ras gzigs kyi brtul zhugs sogs/ /rang rgyud zhes grags zhi 'tsho yab sras rnams/ /de yi rjes 'brang rngog lo chen po dang / /sa lugs gong ma rnams dang rang ston sogs/ /tshul 'di'i srol 'byed mkhas grub mang du byon/ /sangs rgyas bskyang gi bud+dha pā li ta/ /dpal ldan zla ba'i tshig gsal 'jug pa sogs/ /thal 'gyur gzhung yin pa tshab lo tsas spel/ /bo dong paṇa chen 'jigs med grags pa dang / /go rams la sogs sa lugs phyi ma phal/ /klog pa'i grwa pa mang zhig 'di nyid la/ /rtsa ston mdzad phyir shin tu dar bar byung / /gnyis ka'i thun mong rang bzhin gnas pa'i rigs/ /chos dbyings rang bzhin rnam par dag pa ni/ /'khor 'das gnyis kas go skabs ma 'gag par/ /phye ba 'byung bzhi nam mkhas go phye bzhin/ /rkyen gyis bsgyur las 'khor 'das phyogs gcig tu/ /ma lhung stong rkyang med dgag cha ma bzhed/ /lam dus tshogs gnyis bsags las chos gzugs sku/ /grub pas bskyed bya skyed byed rgyu 'bras su/ /rnam smin yon tan rgyas 'gyur rigs su bzhed/ /gnyis snang mtshan 'dzin gzhig dka' de'i gnyen por/ /gcig dang du bral rdo rje'i zegs ma dang / /yod med skye 'gog mu bzhi skye 'gog gi/ /gtan tshig bzhi yis chos dang gang zag bdag /bdag gzhan gnyis dang gnyis ka min pa dang / /rgyu med dag las ma skyes skye ba med/ /de yis yod pa sgro 'dogs mtha' sel zhing / /chos rnams rang rang ngo bo stong par bstan/ /don dam gshis la med kyang rgyu 'bras kyi/ /tha snyad med pa min phyir yod med mtha'i/ /spros pa gcod pa rten 'brel rigs pa ste/ /rang rgyud pa rnams kun rdzob tha snyad du/ /sgyu mar ltar bur grub cing snang ba yis/ /don byed nus 437

dang mi nus khyad par gyis/ /yang dag log pa'i kun rdzob gnyis su dbye/ /thal 'gyur bas ni spros kun 'gog pa ste/ /kun rdzob gnyis kyi dbye ba 'dir mi bzhed/ /chos kun stong nyid rten 'brel rang bzhin med/ /bden gnyis sgyu ma'i rang bzhin nyid sgom nas/ /bsam pa'i sgro 'dogs legs par chod rjes su/ /sgom tshe zhi gnas myong ba thon pa'i rjes/ /lhag mthong bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis/ /gzung 'dzin spros pa'i rtsa ba bcad pa la/ /ci yang mi dmigs stong nyid sgom pa dang / /ci yang ma mthong ba la de kho na/ /rtogs par 'chad pa nges don med dgag lugs/ /bden gnyis sgyu ma'i rang bzhin nyid sgom nas/ /'bras bu'i ye shes tsam du'ang ma grub phyir/ /mkha' lding mchod bstod drang srong dmod pa'i dpes/ /rten can rten med dag gis 'gro ba'i don/ /smon lam dbang gis mdzad par 'dod pa dang / /ye shes sgyu ma'i chad par bzhed pa sogs/ /nang gses dbye ba bsam mi khyab par byung / /nges don mthar thugs dbu ma gzhan stong ni/ /zab mo 'khor lo tha ma'i dgongs pa'i don/ /lang gshegs sor phreng myang 'das snying po'i mdo/ /dgongs pa nges 'grel gser 'od dam pa dang / /gzungs dbang dpal phreng seṅge'i nga ro smras/ /zhus pa la sogs nges don mdo bcu gsum/ /rgyal tshab byams pas bkral ba'i byams chos gzhung / /'phags pa thogs med rjes 'brang bcas pas 'debs/ /btsan los bsgyur nas kun mkhyen dol bu ba/ /karmā rang byung zhabs dang klong chen pa/ /la sogs mkhas grub mang pos rgyas par mdzad/ /bar skabs paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan dang / /phyi dus rje btsun tā ra nā tha yis/ /snga na med pa'i bstan bcos khyad 'phags mdzad/ /khyad par chos kun de nyid legs gzigs pa/ /rje btsun gter bdag gling pa'i bzhed pa'i don/ /lnga rigs paṇa chen ngag dbang chos dpal dang / /pad+ma dgyes pa 'gyur med rgya mtsho yis/ /nges don srog 'thud legs bshad bstan bcos kyis/ /gsal bar mdzad cing bstan pa'i me ro gsos/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / /mchog gi don gzigs bi ma mi tra sogs/ /rgya bod grub chen rtsod med phal mo ches/ /sngags kyi lta ba 'di nyid kho nar bzhed/ /de phyir 'di yi gzhung lugs bshad pa ni/ /sems nyid ye nas rang bzhin rnam dag pa//thog ma med nas rab zhi spros pa med/ /snang stong dbyer med grub bsal 'gro 'ong med/ /kun khyab 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ngo bo ni/ /yon tan lhun grub ye nas ldan pa'i phyir/ /bsal bzhag med pa'i chos nyid byang chub sems/ /rgyu mtshan gsum gyis yod tshul bstan pa ni/ /lus can kun la sangs rgyas chos skus khyab/ /'khor 'das chos nyid dbyings su rnam dbyer med/ /dri bcas chos nyid 'gro kun rgyud la bzhugs/ /de nas rnam bzhag bcu yis gtan la phab/ /dag bya'i ngo bo chos sku nor bu ltar/ /bsam pa'i don kun grub pa'i mthu dang ldan/ /chos nyid nam mkha' dang mtshungs 'gyur ba med/ /rigs ni 438

chur mtshungs snying rje'i rlan gyis khyab/ /glo bur dri ma dag par byed pa'i rgyu/ /theg chen chos la mos dang theg dman las/ /lhag pa'i bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab dang / /ting 'dzin la gnas bde ba tshad med pa/ /sems can la dmigs snying rje tshad med pa'i/ /bral 'bras chos sku gtsang ma'i pha rol phyin/ /mthar 'dzin spros las rab grol bdag dam pa/ /de nyid bde ba'i pha rol phyin pa ste/ /sdug bsngal ma lus de'i rgyu nyon mongs dang / /de bskyed ma rig bag chags las thams cad/ /zad nas zag bcas chos rnams spang ba'i phyir/ /de nyid rtag pa yin te srid dang zhi'i/ /mnyam pa nyid rtogs don gnyis rgyun mi chad/ /las ni 'khor 'das sdug bde'i spang blang chos/ /'bras bu thob byed las kyi don yin te//sdug la yid 'byung zhi ba myang 'das la/ /smon pa khams kyi byed las yin pa'i phyir/ /gser 'dod rdo ba gser khams ldan pa la/ /rko yis shing gser med la mi rko bzhin/ /dbyings yod pas na bdag nyid sangs rgyas su/ /'gyur bar shes nas tshul khrims la sogs bsrung / /dbyings med legs par spyad kyang don mi mthong / /dbyings ni rgyu yi yon tan dang ldan te/ /rgya mtsho chen po nor bu'i 'byung gnas bzhin/ /de la 'bras bu'i yon tan mngon shes lnga/ /la sogs mar me snang dang dro ba dang / /kha dog dag ni rnam dbyer med dang mtshungs/ /gang zag dbye ba so so skye bo dang / /'phags pa slob pa rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams la/ /gnas skabs de bzhin nyid dbye'i 'jug pa las/ /brtsams re rgyal bas snying po 'di bstan to/ /chos nyid ngos nas dbye ba byar med kyang / /rten gyi gang zag la ltos gnas skabs kyi/ /tha snyad gsum ste lam du ma zhugs la/ /ma dag sems can zhes bya tshogs lam nas/ /slob ma'i lam bzhir dag la ma dag pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' zhes brjod glo bur gyi/ /dri ma mtha' dag bral la sangs rgyas su/ /btags kyang mkha' ltar kun tu khyab pa yi/ /sems nyid rang bzhin 'od gsal dri med dbyings/ /gnas skabs gsum so kun khyab 'pho 'gyur med/ /rdza dang gser bum nang gi nam mkha' bzhin/ /rang gi ngo bo bzang ngan med pa'i phyir/ /glo bur nyon mongs dag gi sgrib na'ang / /stobs dang mtshan dpe la sogs yon tan tshogs/ /gyad kyi nor bu'i dpe bzhin yod par gsungs/ /nyi dang zer bzhin yon tan dbyer med pa'i/ /dbyings kyi rang bzhin sgrib g.yog kun bral ba/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas las gzhan nyan rang gi/ /dgra bcom 'bras bu'i yon tan ma rdzogs phyir/ /myang 'das tshad ldan min ces mdo las gsungs/ /de ltar chos nyid bde gshegs snying po gang / /dri mas sgrib tshul dpe yis bstan pa ni/ /rgyud bla las/ sangs rgyas pad ngan sbrang rtsi sbrang ma la/ /sbun pa snying po mi gtsang nang na gser/ /sa la gter dang myug sogs 'bras chus dang / /gos hrul nang na rgyal ba'i sku dang ni/ /bud med ngan ma'i lto na mi bdag dang / /sa la rin chen gzugs yod ji lta bar/ /glo bur nyon mongs dri 439

mas sgrib pa yi/ /sems can rnams la de bzhin khams 'di gnas/ zhes gsungs/ /de dag dpe don phye ste bshad pa ni/ /pad+ma bu pa sbun dang mi gtsang pa/ /'bras shun gos hrul mngal dang sa'i sbub nang / /sangs rgyas sbrang rtsi 'bras gser gter dang ni/ /ljon pa rin chen sku dang 'khor los bsgyur/ /gser gzugs ji bzhin bde gshegs snying po gnas/ /dri ma'i dbye ba bye brag bshad pa ni/ /pad+ma gnas skabs mdzes pa'i dga' ba bskyed/ /snyigs tshe yid du mi 'ong de bzhin du/ /'dod chags bag la nyal gyis de ltar sgrib/ /bung ba gzhan gyis sbrang rtsi blang gyur na/ /khros nas mdung brdeg ji bzhin zhe sdang gi /bag nyal sbun pas 'bras la sgrib pa bzhin/ /gti mug bag nyal gyis sgribs sam gzugs su/ /'phen byed bag nyal sgrib pa rnam pa gsum/ /ljan ljin mi gtsang phung po yid mi 'ong / /de bzhin 'dod khams sgrub byed dug gsum gyi/ /kun dkris drag po'i sgrib pa de bzhin no/ /dbul po'i khyim gyi sa 'og 'dod dgu'i gter/ /ngo mi shes bzhin 'phags pa dgra bcom gyi/ /rgyud la yod pa'i yid kyi rang bzhin lus/ /sgrub byed ma rig bag chags pa yis brdus/ /sngon shing myu gu sdong bu la sogs pa/ /rim bzhin skye las sa bon shun pa rnams/ /gcod bzhin theg dman slob rgyud mthong spang sgrib/ /gos hrul zad cing dri ma dang bcas bzhin/ /theg dman slob rgyud sgom lam spang bya'i sgrib/ /ji ltar mngal sbub mthong bya la sgrib bzhin/ /ma dag sa bdun byang 'phags rgyud kyi sgrib/ /sa 'dam gyis gos gser gzugs tsheg chung dus/ /sbyang bar nus bzhin dag pa sa gsum gyi/ /'phags rgyud cha gnas dbyings la sgrib byed dpe/ /de ltar bag nyal la sogs dri ma dgus/ /snga ma bzhi yi so skye lnga pa yis/ /dgra bcom drug bdun dag gi theg dman gyi/ /slob lam la gnas brgyad pa'i sa bdun la/ /dgu pas dag pa sa gsum la gnas pa'i//'phags rgyud yod pa'i sgrib byed dri ma'i dpe/ /de ltar sgrib byed nyon mongs la sogs pa/ /dri ma rnams ni rang bzhin rnam dag la/ /ma 'bral glo bur nyid phyir chos dbyings dang / /lhan cig thog mar med nas nye bar gnas/ /de phyir de dag gang na yod pa der/ /sems nyid rang bzhin dri ma med pa gnas/ /ji ltar sa yi nang na gnas pa'i chu/ /dri ma med pa yang dag nyid du gnas/ /nyon mongs sbub nang 'thums pa'i ye shes kyang / /de bzhin dri ma med cing dag par gnas/ /chos nyid chos gzhan gyis stong gzhan stong dang / /'khor 'das 'byung gnas byed pa'i gzhi zhes bya/ /rtag chad mtha' las 'das pa'i dbu ma dang / /gnas lugs yin phyir don dam bden pa dang / /spros las 'das phyir shes rab pha rol phyin/ /dri mas sgrib phyir bde gshegs snying po sogs/ /du ma'i ming gis 'bod kyang snying po'i khams/ /'pho 'gyur med pa'i rtag brtan theg sdug ru/ /bshad pa stong bzhi 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /spros pa'i mtshan ma rab zhi blo'i yul las/ /'das phyir tha mal shes pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /yin phyir gzhi 'bras dbyer 440

med chos kyi sku'i/ /snang cha sku dang zhing khams la sogs 'char/ /ma gtogs 'khrul snang bag chags gsum nyid las/ /yul gyi bag chags snod kyi 'jig rten dang / /don gyi bag chags rnam shes tshogs brgyad dang / /lus kyi bag chags 'gro drug so so'i lus/ /ma rig gnyis kyi bskyed las 'khor ba 'khyams/ /de ltar 'khrul pa med snang glo bur ba/ /sgyu ma rmi lam chu zla lta bu ru/ /snang nyid ngo bo bden par ma grub kyang / /kun rdzob snang ngor las 'bras mi bslu ba'i/ /kun rdzob bden pa zhes su grags na yang / /'khor ba'i chos rnams spang bya rnam shes dang / /'bral bas chos nyid gshis la med pa'i phyir/ /don dam rang bzhin snang stong dbyer med ni/ /bden pa gnyis kyi gnas lugs dam pa ste/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa nges don mthar thug yin/ /dbyings nyid stong pa chos sku'i bral rgyu ste/ /rin chen gter bzhin dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /sku dang ye shes 'char ba'i go 'byed pa/ /rang bzhin gnas rigs yin te de nyid las/ /shar bas ye shes snang cha gzugs sku yi/ /bral rgyu 'bras bu can gyi ljon shing bzhin/ /rkyen gyis bral stobs rang gnas yon tan ni/ /mngon du gyur la rgyas gyur rigs zhes bya/ /rigs de gnyis las bral smin 'bras bu'i chos/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs mthar phyin las byung / /sna tshogs grub mtha'i dbye ba du ma rnams/ /shing rta'i srol 'byed so so'i dgongs pa'i don/ /blo yi bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab phyir/ /thams cad gnas lugs ngos nas bshad mod kyi/ /dmus long lnga brgyas glang chen bltas pa bzhin/ /yongs rdzogs ma mthong phyogs res kha 'dzin byed/ /'di ni nges don la brton mkhas dang grub/ /tshad ldan mang po'i lta ba'i mthar thug tu/ /bzhed pa'i tshul 'dir mos pa skye ba yang / /sngon bsags legs byas mthu las gzhan du ci/ /rnam mang grub mtha'i chu klung ji snyed pa/ /mthong lam chos nyid rgya mtshor ro gcig 'dres/ /mthar thug don la grub mtha'i khas len med/ /ci'i phyir blo yi 'dzin zhen zad pa'i phyir/ /grub mtha'i kha 'dzin srin gyi kha chu yis/ /lta ngan mthar 'dzin gzeb tu ma mchis bar/ /spros pa'i mtha' grol chos nyid thang yangs por/ /bgrod pa'i bgo skal rnam dpyod mthu las grub/ /de ltar lta ba rnam dag dang 'bral bar/ /byang chub mchog sems bskyed la stong pa nyid/ /snying rje'i snying po can re ma nor lam/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i gshegs shul theg pa che'i/ /sems bskyed ngo bo byams dang snying rje yis/ /gzhan don sangs rgyas thob 'dod nyes spong sems/ /dbye ba mang yang smon 'jug gnyis su 'dus/ /byang chub thob 'dod smon dang tshogs gnyis kyis/ /lam la sbyor ba 'jug pa'i sems bskyed de/ /'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba'i bye brag bzhin/ /len tshul klu sgrub thogs med so so'i srol/ /bde gshegs las blang rten la'ang rung bar bshad/ /slob bya nyes spyod sdom dang dge chos bsdud/ /sems can don byed tshul khrims rnam gsum re/ /nyes spyod sdom pa so thar rigs 441

bdun ste/ /klu sgrub lugs la rgyal por nges pa lnga/ /blon por nges pa lnga dang phal pa la/ /'byung nges brgyad sogs ming du bco brgyad po/ /rdzas su bcu bzhir 'du zhing thun mong du/ /smon 'jug btang ba rtsa ba'i ltung bar bzhed/ /thogs med lugs la rtsa ba'i ltung ba bzhi/ /bsrung zhing dge ba'i chos bsdud phar phyin drug /sems can don byed tshul khrims bsdu dngos bzhir/ /bslab cing nyams na stobs bzhi'i bshags par 'bad/ /phan yon rgyal sras ming thob sdig pa dag /dge 'bras mi zad gong 'phel ngan 'gro'i 'jigs/ /grol zhing gnas skabs mngon mtho'i chos rnams dang / /mtha' thug lam dang 'bras bu'i yon tan thob/ /rdzi bo gnyan pa rgyal po lta bu yi/ /blo yi stobs las grangs med gsum dang bdun/ /pho bdun sogs kyi mi slob lam mthar phyin/ /kun tu 'od bsnyes rdzogs sangs rgyas thob pa/ /rgyu la lam byed phar phyin theg pa'i lugs/ /'bras bu lam byed rdo rje'i theg pa ni/ /kun bzang rdo rje 'chang chen ston pa des/ /'og min gnas su sa mtha'i rig 'dzin la/ /gsang chen rgyud sde rgya mtsho dus rtag par/ /gsungs pa gsang bdag la sogs 'khor gyis bsdus/ /dga' ldan gnas dang 'bras spungs ri rab rtse/ /ma ya ma ru zhi dang khro bo yi/ /dkyil 'khor sprul nas gang 'dul mos pa dang / /mthun pa'i rnam mang rgyud sde bzlas te gsungs/ /lha dang mkha' 'gro o rgyan gnas sogs su/ /bzhugs pa 'dzam gling mi yul dar ba'i tshul/ /rang lugs snga 'gyur bzhed pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /mya ngan 'das nas dam pa'i rigs can gyi/ /dra ma lnga po so so'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /ma la yar 'dus gdung ba'i tshig bton pa/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal bas lag na rdo rje bskul/ /ma la yar byon gdung ba gsal ba'i ched/ /gsang ba sngags kyi rgyud sde bgrang yas gsungs/ /de dag srin po blo gros thabs ldan gyis/ /gser gyi shog bur baiḍūr zhun mas bris/ /de ltar chos 'khor bskor ba'i byin rlabs kyis/ /za hor yul du skal ldan rgyal po dzaḥ /ngo mtshar mi ltas bdun mthar pho brang dang / /a nu ku ṭa'i ri la ma hā dang / /a nu'i rgyud sde'i glegs bam char du babs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhal mthong le'u rtogs/ /sgrub pas gsang ba'i bdag po rjes su bzungs/ /rang gi sras nas go ma de wi'i bar/ /ma hā'i tshogs sgrub sgo nas rig 'dzin sar/ /gshegs pa kho na yin la sras mo yi/ /slob ma sangs rgyas gsang ba sgeg rdor gnyis/ /gnyis ka'i slob ma bi ma mi tra ni/ /bod du byon nas lo tsā rma gnyags la/ /gsang ba sgyu 'phrul dbang dang gdams ngag dang / /bshad bka' ma lus bkrol nas rjes su bzung / /de la rim mched bshad sgrub dar zhing rgyas/ /a nu yo ga lus pa mdo yi skor/ /lo tsā gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi/ /rgya dang bal po bru sha'i yul nas bsgyur/ /a ti yo ga dga' rab rdo rje la/ /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje yis/ /rdzogs pa chen po sems klong man ngag rgyud/ /gsungs pa slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen nas/ /shrī sirnya 442

las brgyud pad 'byung dang / /bi ma mi tra be+e ro tsa na yis/ /bod kyi skal ldan ma spel brgyud pa'i srol/ /nyang lugs a ro lugs sogs sems sde dang / /klong sde'i rgyud srol rnam pa mang du byung / /sgrub sde'i rgyud rnams phyag na rdo rje yis/ /mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang mo che la gtad/ /de yi mchod rten bde byed brtsegs pa ru/ /gter du sbas nas nyid kyis phyi dus su/ /sgrub sde'i bka' babs rig 'dzin brgyad la gtad/ /spyi rgyud slob dpon chen po pad+ma la/ /bka' babs gangs can rje 'bangs nyi shu lnga/ /zhi khro bka' brgyad sgo nas smin grol mdzad/ /snga 'gyur bka' la so zur gnub gsum dang / /sems klong bye brag rgyud 'dzin mang po ni/ /chos nyid don rtogs grub pa'i sar gshegs pa/ /bgrang las 'das pa byon zhing gter ma ni/ /pad 'byung bi ma bai ro gnub chen gyis/ /smon lam gtad brgyas sbas pa phyi rab kyi/ /dus rtags dang bstun pa thob rje 'bangs kyi/ /yang srid res bton skal ldan gdul bya rnams/ /smin cing grol nas bshad sgrub rgyun bzang pos/ /bla rdzogs thugs gsum sgrub ste spyi bye brag /bstan bsrung la sogs las bzhi sgrub pa yi/ /zab chos mang po dar zhing rgyas par gyur/ /gsar ma'i lo rgyus rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /o rgyan rgyal po in+d+ra bhu tī yis/ /'dod yon ma spang thar pa'i thabs zhus pas/ /gsang 'dus dkyil 'khor sprul nas dbang bskur bas/ /rgyal po sa chen rtogs mngon du gyur/ /rgyud rnams glegs bam bris nas gsang sngags chos/ /gsungs pa'i yul dus srog chags phra mo yan/ /'ja' lus thob nas yul stongs mtshor gyur nang / /klu gang ba la gsang ba'i bdag po yis/ /sngags kyi rgyud gsungs smin nas mtsho 'gram du/ /grong bcas nyams su blangs pas grub pa thob/ /de rnams rigs brgyud mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro mar/ /gyur la o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling zhes grags/ /mtsho ska gtsug lag khang zhig rang byung bar/ /he ru ka yi lha khang dkor mdzod du/ /rgyud sde glegs bam rnams bzhugs de nyid las/ /phyis su rgyal po bi su kalpa dang / /klu sgrub ku ku ri pod sogs grub thob kyis/ /rgyud sde shas cher zhig blang sham+bha la/ /la sogs yul gzhan nas kyang dar ro zer/ /phyi dus 'phags yul paṇa grub mang po la/ /rin chen bzang po 'brog mi mar 'gos dang / /rwa 'bro sogs kyis gtugs nas bde dgyes dang / /dus 'khor la sogs phyi 'gyur mang du byung / /de ltar gsar rnying dbye ba 'phags yul la/ /med kyang bod kyi yul 'dir 'gyur pa la/ /snga phyi'i dbang gis de ltar grags pa yin/ /de yang mdo dang sngags kyi khyad par ni/ /sngags dang sbyor ba'i bya ba gtso bo ru/ /ston pa sngags dang mi ston mdo yin te/ /mdo las gsang sngags khyad par gsum gyis 'phags/ /myur zhing bde dang thabs la mkhas pas so/ /myur ba mdo las bskal pa grangs med gsum/ /la sogs phar phyin rang lam nyid kyis 'gor/ /'dir ni mtha' yas mi yi tshe bdun nam/ /ring mtha' bskal pa myang dang u pa 443

yas/ /mi tshe lnga'am bskal pa gcig gi gsum/ /yo gas tshe la brgya pa'i tshe gsum mam/ /bcu drug dag gi byang chub thob par gsungs/ /bla med skye ba 'di'am bar do dang / /phyi mar grol bas shin tu myur ba ste/ /de'i rgyu sngags cho ga'i khyad par gyis/ /lha rnams dngos su mchod pa len pa dang / /sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad bla ma'i skur/ /zhugs nas sgrub pos mchod pas mngon spyad kyi/ /bsod nams 'byung zhing sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthus/ /chu thig re yang gaṅga'i rdul snyed du/ /'phel bas de snyed bsod nams 'byung ba dang / /ma dag snang ba 'khog cing zhing sbyong dang / /sngags rgya ting 'dzin khyad par re res kyang / /sems can mtha' yas smin nus rgyu'i khyad par/ /chos 'di'i theg par zhugs tsam nyid nas yod/ /lus dang sems la mi bzod pa'i sdug bsngal/ /mgo dang lag pa sbyin pa la sogs pa/ /tshor ba rtsub mo med pa 'dod yon lnga/ /lam du khyer zhing skal pa drug ldan lus/ /'di yis bde blag nyid du 'grub par nus/ /rdzu 'phrul ring 'dzin mngon shes mang po thob/ /sngags mthus bde bar gshegs rnams mngon sum du/ /bzhugs shing 'gro ba'i yid la 'dod pa'i don/ /sgrub par nus pas bde ba'i khyad par 'phags/ /thabs la mkhas pas sngon byon rig 'dzin dang / /tshul khrims mnyam pa'i lha rnams dgyes pa bskyed/ /spyod yul khyad par can dang yongs 'bral ba'i/ /ting 'dzin shes rab rmad du byung ba yis/ /snod bcud dag mnyam chen por gtan la phab/ /snang grags rigs gsum lha sngags chos nyid du/ /sgom pa la sogs rmad byung thabs mkhas kyis/ /'phags par ma zad mdo lugs nas bshad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas thob par gsungs pa sa bcu pa'i/ /rgyal tshab thob nas skabs der sngags lam la/ /zhugs nas sangs rgyas go 'phang thob dgos phyir/ /bgrod gcig lam du gyur pas khyad par 'phags/ /de 'dra'i gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa ni/ /sde snod gsum po gang du 'du zhe na/ /mngon par phyi nang gnyis las sngags nang par/ /bzhed dang zab mo'i don rnams mdor bsdus nas/ /ston pas mdo sder bzhed pa la sogs pa/ /mang mdo rang lugs rig 'dzin sde snod ces/ /sngags kyi rgyud rnams sde snod bzhi par bzhed/ /dbye ba bya spyod rnal 'byor bla med kyi/ /rgyud sde bzhi ru gsungs pa'i dgos ched ni/ /mi rigs bram ze blo dman dus rdzogs ldan/ /bltas pas 'dod chags sbyang zhing gti mug can/ /tshangs pa gtsang sbra can 'dul bya ba'i rgyud/ /chu dang cod paṇa dbang gi smin byas nas/ /gtsang sbra dka' thub spyod pa la gnas nas/ /mdun du lha bskyed rje dang rang nyid bran/ /'du shes bzhag nas bzlas brjod mchod bstod gyis/ /bsnyen pa tsam po yin la khyad par ba/ /bdag bskyed la brten bdag lha bzlas pa dang / /bsam gtan de kho na bzhin sgrub pa las/ /rigs gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang thob/ /rje rigs dang ni dbang 'bring dus gsum ldan/ /rgod pa'i 'dod chags sbyang zhing lha khyab 'jug /'dul phyir 444

gsungs pa spyod rgyud smin byed ni/ /chu dbang cod paṇa steng du rdor dril dang / /ming dbang bskur zhing spyod pa bya ba dang / /lta ba yo ga bzhin las bdag dang lha/ /spun grogs bzhin bltas mchod bstod bzlas pa yis/ /dngos grub blang tshul yi ge phyag rgya dang / /gzugs kyi lha gsum gnyis su phye ba las/ /don dam snang cha kun rdzob zla dkyil la/ /bzla bya'i sngags phreng rang sgra sgrog bzhin gnas/ /de rnams yongs gyur rang nyid lhar sgom pa/ /sngags rgyas rlob cing rang gi mdun du lha/ /bskyed pa'i thugs kar zla dkyil sngags phreng bkod/ /srog bsdams rtse gcig sbyor bas ring ngam 'dzin/ /brtan pa mtshan bcas yin la mtshan med kyi/ /rnal 'byor phung sogs mtha' bzhis rnam dpyad nas/ /skye ba med par rtogs pa 'jug pa'i sems/ /de'i ngang rnam par mi rtog gnas pa'i sems/ /ma rtogs 'gro la snying rje ldang pa'i sems/ /gsum gyis khyad byas don dam byang sems sgom/ /grangs dang mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin nas/ /rdzas sngags 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor rlung sbyor gyis/ /rigs 'dzin grub nas mthar thug 'bras bu ni/ /rigs bzhi rdor 'dzin sa thob mngon 'tshang rgya/ /khengs ldan rgyal rigs dbang 'bring la ltos pa'i/ /dbang rnon gnyis ldan dus dang lag bcang gi /'dod chags sbyang zhing nga rgyal can brgya byin/ /rjes su 'dzin phyir gsungs pa rnal 'byor rgyud/ /chu dang cod paṇa rdor dril ming gi dbang / /brtul zhugs rdo rje slob dpon dbang rjes gnang / /mtha' rten bcas pa bskur bas smin byas nas/ /dam tshig ye shes bzang ngan med lha ba'i/ /sgrub pa'i tshul la thabs dang shes rab gnyis/ /thabs ni phyag rgya bzhi 'bral lha'i rnal 'byor/ /sgom pa sku gsungs thugs dang phrin las bzhi/ /rim bzhin phyag chen dam tshig chos dang ni/ /las kyi phyag rgyas rim bzhin kun gzhi dang / /nyon yid yid shes sgo lnga'i dri ma sbyangs/ /me long mnyam nyid bya grub sor rtogs kyi/ /ye shes bzhi po mngon byed chos dbyings kyi/ /ye shes de kun rang bzhin nyid du gnas/ /lha yi rnal 'byor sgom pa'i rim pa la/ /dbang rnon sngon byung ston pa sangs rgyas ni/ /dkyil 'khor sprul bshad mdzad dang rjes mthun par/ /ting 'dzin rnam pa gsum la brten nas sgrub/ /dbang brtul rnal 'byor bzhi yis nyams su len/ /shes rab sems kyi rang bzhin de kho na/ /rtogs pa so so rang rig ye shes re/ /dbang rnon byin rlabs stobs dang sgom byung gis/ /dbang brtul thos sogs brgyud de rim gyis rtogs/ /ting 'dzin bzlas brjod la brtan 'das pa dang / /gnyis ka'i dngos grub sgrub cing rang gi lha/ /mchod pas mnyes byas gzhan don phyag rgya sgrub/ /tshogs sgrub bya zhing bhor bzlas tshig bzlas kyis/ /thun mong mkha' spyod mthar thug rigs lnga'i pa/ /stug po bkod par mngon byang lngas sangs rgyas/ /de ltar dka' thub rig byed phyi rgyud gsum/ /snang grag rigs gsum lha sngags chos nyid kyi/ /lam khyer rdo rje'i lus la gnad bsnun pa'i/ /rdzogs rim 445

med phyir 'bras bu bla dang bcas/ /rdol pa'i rigs dang shin tu dbang po rno/ /rtsod ldan dus dang dbang po gnyis sbyor gyi/ /'dod chags sbyang zhing chags can lha dbang phyug /gdul phyir gsungs pa gsang sngags bla med rgyud/ /gnyis su med pa'i don la blo 'byor bas/ /kri yo la sogs theg pa 'og ma rnams/ /kun rdzob rdzas yod rtags yod du lta bas/ /bzang ngan blang dor byed las khyad 'phags pa/ /'dir ni chos rnams mig gnyis blo ldan pas/ /'bras bu'i ngo bo snang stong zung 'jug gi/ /chos skur rtogs nas de dang rjes mthun par/ /rim gnyis sgom pas goms pas byed pa ste/ /de yang smin byed bum dbang dag gi stengs/ /mchog dbang gong ma gsum bsnan dbang bzhir bskur/ /rgyud sde'i dbang gis rnam grangs 'dra min du/ /byung yang ngo bo dbang bzhir ma 'dus med/ /sa bon 'debs la zhing sa sbyang ba ltar/ /sku bzhi'i rten 'brel sgrig nas smin par byas/ /ma dag snang zhen sbyong zhing bskyed rim sgom/ /snod bcud gzhal yas khang dang ltar sgom zhing / /grag stong gzhom med sngags dang gang shar gyi/ /rtogs pa chos nyid ngo bo nyid du len/ /thun mtshams su yang snang ba lha ru sgom/ /dbang dang bskyed rim gnyis kar sbyang gzhi dang / /sbyang bya sbyang byed sbyang 'bras zhib mor sbyor/ /rdzogs rim rdo rje'i lus la gnad bsnun pa/ /sems yid rlung rnams dbu mar thim pa las/ /srog gzugs rtags snang 'char zhing mngon shes dang / /bde stong las byung zung 'jug lha sku 'grub/ /spyod pa gsum gyi nye rgyu la brten nas/ /mthong sgom mthar lam tshe 'dir mngon du byed/ /de ltar bla med rgyud la pha ma dang / /gnyis med rgyud dang rnam pa gsum du dbye/ /pha rgyud zhi ba lha pho'i rnam pa mang / /yab kyi lha sngags cho ga gtso che zhing / /dar dang rin chen gyis brgyan bzhugs pa'i tshul/ /mkha' 'gro'i rnam pa chang zhing bzhengs stabs can/ /gcer bu dur khrod rus pa'i rgyan cha can/ /yum kyi sngags dang cho ga rtsal bton pa/ /ma rgyud yin la thabs kyi de kho na/ /rgya cher ston pa pha rgyud shes rab kyis/ /zab par ston pa rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud/ /de dag mnyam par ston la gnyis med du/ /gsung yang ngo bo rdzogs rim gyis phye bas/ /gsang dbang rlung gi rnal 'byor gtsor ston pa/ /pha rgyud 'dus pa rdor bzlas sems dben dang / /sgyu lus 'od gsal zung 'jug rim pa lnga/ /ma rgyud las dang dam tshig chos dang ni/ /phyag chen phyag rgya bzhi dang gzhan yang ni/ /nā ro chos drug bsre 'pho dril bu pa'i/ /rim lnga la sogs bde dgyes ma ya dang / /gdan bzhi'i rdzogs rim rnam pa mang du byung / /gnyis med rgyud la dus kyi 'khor lo yi/ /sbyor ba yan lag drug sogs sngags gsar ma'i/ /mkhas grub so so'i man ngag bgrang las 'das/ /snga 'gyur rang lugs thun mong ma yin pa/ /ma hā a nu a ti yo ga gsum/ /nang rgyud sde gsum dag tu grags pa la/ /ma hā'i smin byed sgyu 'phrul drwa ba la/ /phan pa'i dbang bcu nus dbang lnga bco lnga/ /bum pa'i dbang ster zab mo'i 446

dbang gsum gyi/ /rnam grangs bco brgyad bskur ba zhi ba'i dbang / /khro bo gdan dang phyag mtshan lha dbang dang / /chas bcu sgrub rdzas bco lnga phan dbang la/ /nyer brgyad phyi bas sum cu rtsa drug bskur/ /a nu yo ga dag la mdo rtsa ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor la brtan rgyud kyi dngos bstan ltar/ /chu bo bzhi rdzogs dbang sna so drug dang / /theg rim dgu 'dus rtsa ba mdo yongs rdzogs/ /yan lag dkyil 'khor so sor phye ba la/ /rtsa ba so drug yan lag brgyad brgya dang / /so gcig lha mi nas brtsam a ti'i bar/ /dbang rim bcu po theg dgu'i tshul du bskur/ /a ti gsum pa'i dpe yi ye shes la/ /ltos mi dgos par don dam byang sems kyi/ /dkyil 'khor nyid du 'jug rung skal ldan la/ /rdzogs pa chen po rig pa'i rtsal dbang bskur/ /khyad par mchog gsang man ngag snying thig la/ /spros bcas spros med shin tu spros med dang / /rab tu spros med rnam bzhis smin par byed/ /yang phur la sgrub sde'i bye brag 'gar/ /sgrub dbang zab khyad kyis phye mi 'dris gnad/ /yod kyang spyi ldog dbang bzhir ma 'dus med/ /de ltar dbang gis rgyud smin gzhi'i gnas lugs/ /'ching grol med pa'i bde gshegs snying po ni/ /dri mas sgrib g.yogs gsal phyir bskyed rdzogs kyi/ /rnal 'byor nyams su len pa ma hā ni/ /sgong skyes sbyang phyir bdag sras gzhan sras dang / /mngon byang lnga dang lnga skyes sbyang ba la/ /cho ga gsum bskyed dbang brtul spros can don/ /stong chen snying rje sgyu ma phyag rgya gcig /phyag rgya spro bcas tshogs sgrub bskyed rim gyis/ /'chi ba skye gsum bag chags rags pa sbyong / /rdzogs pa'i rim par grol lam thabs lam gnyis/ /lta bas thag chod stong chen rnal 'byor gyis/ /snying rje sgyu mas drangs pa'i stong gzugs lha/ /phyag rgya gcig spros brten nas tshogs sgrub kyi/ /nye rgyu'i spyod pas mthar dbyung rig 'dzin thob/ /thabs lam steng sgo gtum mo 'og sgo ni/ /phyag rgya la brtan dbab bzung ldog khyab kyis/ /dga' bzhi dpe yi ye shes la brten nas/ /don gyi ye shes lhan skyes mngon du byed/ /a nu bskyed rim rtsa sngags tsam brjod nas/ /snod bcud dkyil 'khor bskyed pas drod gsher skyes/ /sbyang zhing dbang rab spros med dag gi don/ /rdzogs rim thabs lam steng 'og sgor brten pa/ /ma hār phyogs mtshungs khyad par thabs lam gyi/ /sems bcu skabs bcu dpe rtogs bcu dang sbyar/ /don dam byang sems nyams len dren can ni/ /snying ga'i thig ler rlung sems dngas ma bstim/ /dmigs pa brtan pas dbyings rig gnyis med pa'i/ /bde chen ye shes 'char bas khams gsum po/ /bde ba chen po'i ngo bor grol bar byed/ /rten med mi gso gsum ldan la brten nas/ mi rtog ngang bskyangs don dam chos nyid kyi/ /ye shes yul dang yul can gzhi'i chos sku'i/ /ye shes dbyer med dbyings rig zung 'jug gi /rtsa ba byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor ces/ /mngon du rtogs thub don gyi rjes 'jug pa'i/ /ting 'dzin sgom thabs gdams ngag rgyas par bshad/ /a ti yo 447

gas snang srid gzhir bzhengs kyi/ /dkyil 'khor rgyu rkyen ma ltos skad cig bskyed/ /rdzus skyes sbyang zhing dbang po yang rab kyi/ /gang zag shin tu spros pa med pa'i don/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa shin tu rnal 'byor mtha'/ /bla med rgyud sde kun gyi dbang bzhi pa'i/ /rdzogs rim mthar thug shin tu skal ldan gyi/ /spyod yul yin te snang srid snod bcud chos/ /snang ba thams cad sems nyid rang byung gi /ye shes smra bsam las 'das chos kyi skur/ /thag chod rang babs skyong ba sems kyi sde/ /rang byung ye shes de la gang shar gyi/ /chos kun ye grol rang sar dag pa yi/ /chos dbyings kun tu bzang mo'i mkha' klong du/ /nub chub 'gro sa gzhan med bya rtsol dang / /bral ba'i ngang du skyong ba glong gi sde/ /sems nyid gzhi med rtsa bral ka dag tu/ /gtan la phab pa khregs chod nyams len dang / /lhun grub thod rgal snang ba bzhi yi lam/ /mthar phyin sku bzhi thob pa man ngag sde/ /dam tshig spyod pa'i nye rgyu la sogs pa/ /rgyas par gzhi lam 'bras gsum 'og tu ston/ /rnam dpyod gdengs can dbang po'i yongs bzung ba'i/ /ming tshig yi ge'i sprin chen spros pa las/ /legs bshad dam chos char pa 'di bab pas/ /'gro rgyud dge ba'i lam 'bras smin par shog /ces pa bshad bya chos kyi rim par phye ba spyi'i don te dang po'o/ /na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni ye/ khyod mtshan thos pa yis kyang srid dang zhi'i/ /gdung ba rab gsal rnam grol lam mchog la/ /'god nas grub gnyis stsol mdzad pad 'byung dang / /dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs sen gtsug bston nas/ /bla med rgyud sde'i rnam grol khang bzang du/ /dang po'i las can bde blag 'jug pa'i sgo/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gnad gsang lde mig gis/ /phye la rtsa ba gsum gyi gnang ba stsol/ /thar 'dod rnams kyis bslab par bya ba'i chos/ /gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu gsum du 'dus/ /gzhi ni shes par bya zhing lam sgrub bya/ /'bras bu thob bya yin phyir de'i gnas lugs/ /'chad la dang po 'khor 'das spyi yi gzhi/ /cha med kun 'gro gdod ma'i ye shes nyid/ /sems can khams rgyud sems nyid rang bzhin gyis/ /'od gsal bar ste khyad chos bzhi dang ldan/ /sku dang zhing khams ye shes la sogs pa/ /'bras bu'i chos dang mthun cing de'i rang bzhin/ /bde ba chen po de nyid sems can nas/ /sangs rgyas bar la rang bzhin mi 'gyur bar/ /rgyun chags su gnas chos nyid kyis thob pa/ /'gyur med bde dang rnam kun mchog ldan gyi/ /stong nyid rnam dbyer med pa'i rang bzhin can/ /ye nas sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa ni/ /lhun grub dkyil 'khor chen po nyid du bzhugs/ /de yang ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum//ngo bo 'khor 'das gang du'ang ma chod pa'i/ /chos nyid mkha' ltar spros bral stong pa nyid/ /chos sku yin te de yi rang bzhin gyi/ /rang gdangs rnam pa thams cad par gsal ba'i/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang zhing khams so/ /thugs rje rig pa'i ye shes mkhyen cha yi/ /rten 'brel rang rtsal ma 'gags rnam 448

'byed pa/ /ye shes 'char gzhi byed de sprul pa'i sku/ /de ltar sku gsum rang chas bzhugs pa yi/ /bde gshegs snying po kun gzhi ye shes de/ /srid zhi kun khyab 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir/ /rgyal ba'i rang bzhin gdod nas dri bral yang / /sgrib gnyis ma grol bar du sangs rgyas su/ /mi 'gyur sa 'dam gyis g.yogs nor bu bzhin/ /dri bcas de bzhin nyid ces khams kyi don/ /dri ma de nyid med snang glo bur ba/ /yin phyir ngo bo gos ma myong ba ni/ /sa yi nang na gnas pa'i chu bzhin te/ /rang bzhin rnam par dag pa byang chub don/ /gdod nas rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rnams/ /gzhi la yod kyang lam gyis ma sad na/ /mngon par mi nus bum nang mar me bzhin/ /lus can kun la ris med kun khyab kyi/ /bcud du bzhugs las gnas skabs mthar thug gi/ /sdug bsngal sel zhing bde ba bskyed pa yi/ /'phrin las lhun gyi grub kyang bya byed kyi/ /rtog pa med pa 'phrin las nyid kyi don/ /de ring rtog ge'i yul las rab 'das pa'i/ /blo 'das bsam mi khyab pa'i gnas bzhi ste/ /de yi rgyun ldan rten gyi gang zag la/ /ltos nas snang ba shes bya thun mong la/ /snang tshul gsum ste ma dag sems can la/ /snod bcud 'khrul pa'i snang ba rang dgar 'char/ /dag la ma dag mo gnas rnal 'byor la/ /'khrul snang dag rim dang bstun nyams snang 'char/ /shin tu rnam dag bde bar gshegs rnams la/ /mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i snang ba 'char/ /de ltar khams kyi ngo bo bzang ngan dang / /bral yang rigs kyi sad tshul la ltos nas/ /theg gsum rigs can nyan rang dgra bcom dang / /byang sems sangs rgyas 'phags pa bzhi 'byung ba/ /nam mkha' snod kyi ris su bcad dang mtshungs/ /gnas lugs rgyu rgyud de yi byed las ni/ /rkyen gyi rjes 'gro ma rtogs 'khor ba yi/ /rgyud drug la 'khrul bde sdug sna tshogs 'char/ /thabs rgyud lam gyis zin gyis rtogs pa las/ /myang 'das sku dang zhing khams 'phrin las kyi/ /mdzad pa dang bcas snang ba'i 'char gzhi byed/ /thog ma med pa'i dus nas 'khor ba'i rgyud/ /'di las byung yang 'khor ba'i chos rnams kyis/ /ma gos nam zhig dri ma zad pa'i tshe/ /myang 'das gyur kyang gsar theb ma yin te/ /gdod nas rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ /nor bu 'dam gyi dri ma bkrus pa bzhin/ /rgyu rgyud sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /ngo bo cha med kun 'gro nyid yin kyang / /ldog cha sku gsung thugs dang ye shes kyi/ /thig le'i tshul du gnas shing sgo gsum gyi/ /dngas ma chos nyid yin pas thig ler brjod/ /de yang don dam rdo rje bzhi'i snang ba/ /mtha' yas 'char phyir snang med mi 'jog pas/ /'bras rgyud sku bzhi 'am ni rdo rje bzhi'i/ /rgyu rgyud ces bya zhib tu phye ba na/ /gzhi 'bras gnyis su med pa'i thig le bzhi/ /don du sku bzhi yin yang sems can la/ /lus ngag yid sogs snang ba 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /sbyang gzhi rgyu rgyud thig le bzhi po de/ /sbyang bya 'khor ba'i chos dang 'dzom pa las/ /sbyong byed lam gyi rnam par shar ba yin/ / 449

gzhan yang snying ga'i rtsa 'dab brgyad kyi dbus/ /'byung lnga'i dang ma'i dbus su mi shig pa'i/ /thig le waṃ gyi rnam par gnas pa dang / /rdzogs chen snying thig rgyud las snying gi nang / /kun rdzob thig ler zhi ba bzhi bcu gnyis/ /dung khang khrag 'thung zhi khro gzhi gnas lha/ /bzhugs pa ngo bo ka dag rang bzhin las//lhun grub 'dus ma byas pa bshad pa yang / /gzhi rgyud gong gi thig le bzhi dang gcig /de las 'khor ba ji ltar 'byung ba'i tshul/ /chos nyid ldog cha thig le bzhi po des/ /g.ya' ltar gyur ba glo bur dri ma ni//nyon mongs shes bya snyom 'jug dri ma gsum/ /rags pa yin te phra ba khu rdul dang / /rlung sems bzhi po 'pho ba'i bag chags las/ /sad mi gnyid 'thug 'khrig pa'i gnas skabs bzhis/ /rnam shes dang 'bral 'khor ba'i chos rnams bskyed/ /sems nyid thig le'i dngas mar gnas pa las/ /de dang 'dres pa ltar snang glo bur gyi/ /dri ma bag chags gyis bsgos kun gzhi yi/ /rtsa ba'i sems byung rang ngo ma shes pas/ /lhan skyes ma rig de las kun brtags kyi/ /gzung 'dzin rtog bcas yid kyi rnam shes byung / /de las sgo lnga'i shes pa yul bcas su/ /a 'thas kun 'byung sdug bsngal thams cad du/ /lam dang 'bras bu'i chos byung bden pa bzhi/ /de la bdag rtog blo ni nyon yid dang / /gzhan du snang ba yid kyi rnam shes te/ /des bskyed phung lnga 'byung bzhi zhen rgyun byung / /sems nyid rdul mun snying stobs dang 'grogs pas/ /snang ba gsum 'char zhe sdang las gyur pa'i/ /rtog pa po gsum 'dod chags bzhi bcu dang / /gti mug bdun te rang bzhin brgyad cu sogs/ /byung zhing de yis las ni 'du byas pas/ /snang 'gyur thun mong las kyi phyi snod dang / /myong gyur las kyi nang bcud sems can grub/ /'khor ba sgyu ma lta bur med bzhin du/ /gzung 'dzin dbang gis thag khrar sbrul mthong ltar/ /las nyon dbang gis 'khrul snang sna tshogs 'char/ /de yi gnyen por mi rtog ye shes kyi/ /phung po dngos rnams ye stong sgyu ma ltar/ /mthong nas bag chags rlung dang rnam shes dag /byang sems 'ba' zhig gyur nas grol ba'o/ /lus kyi gnas tshul bye brag bshad pa ni/ /khams gsum gang du skye bar 'gyur ba yi/ /las kyi bag chags kyis bgos rtsa ba'i sems/ /'du byed las kyi g.yo ba sred pa yis/ /mtshan nyid can gyi srog rlung gis drangs nas/ /skye ba'i nying 'tshams sbyor ba gsungs pa las/ /dzasbu gling du skyes pa'i mi yi lus/ /khams drug ldan pa'i mtshan nyid bshad pa ni/ /dri ma dang bcas sems kyis 'du byas shing / /las ni mngon par bsgrub pa'i rgyu byas te/ /pha ma'i 'du 'phrod rkyen byas tshogs pa las/ /nyi zla'i nang du sgra gcan 'thum pa las lus ngag yid gsum bskyed par byed pa de/ /mngon byang lnga yi sbyang bya sbyang byed dang / /'bral bar gsungs shing mngal zhugs rnam shes kyi/ /pha ma gnyis kyis rig pa phra ba de/ /nyams su myong ba'i sa yi khams 'grub cing / /de bzhin khu ba gsher ba chu'i rang bzhin/ /bskyod las drod skye me yin rtsa gnas las/ / 450

byang sems g.yo ba rlung yin rjes chags kyi/ /bde ba nam mkha'i khams te rnam par shes/ /'byung lnga ye shes khams dang drug 'dus pa'i/ /dbang po yan lag rdzogs pa'i lus grub byed/ /mngal du bdun phrag re re'i rim pa bzhin/ /mer nur rar gor bzhi por nag nyer brgyad/ /de nas bdun phrag lnga bar 'khrang 'gyur gyi/ /zhag ni dang po ma dang 'bral ba yi/ /lte ba las ni rang sor bcu gnyis dang / /phyed kyi tshad dang ldan pa'i dbu ma chags/ /nang du srog rlung yas mar sna gnyis su/ /dkar dmar thig le dang bcas zhag gnyis par/ /rlung bcu'i dran 'gyur snying ga'i rtsa 'khor chags/ /de nas nyin zhag re bzhin rtsa nyis brgyad/ /chags pa'i mngal gyi zla brgyad phyi rol gyi/ /zla ba bzhi ste zla ba bcu gnyis bar/ /'phel bas ro skyang dbu gsum rigs 'dzin pa'i/ /stong phrag nyi shu rtsa bzhi re sdoms pas/ /stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis rtsa yi grangs/ /de dag gtso bor gyur pa 'khor lo'i rtsa/ /snying ga'i rtsa 'khor rjes su rim pa bzhin/ /lte ba mgrin pa spyi bo gtsug tor rnams/ /snying ga'i 'khor lo nas 'phros steng du chags//gsang 'khor 'og tu lte ba nas zur chags/ /de ltar gsang gnas nas bzung gtsug tor bas/ /a wa bhu ta'i srog shing ltar gnas par/ /yas sna gtsug tor zug pa'i rtse mo gnyis/ /gyes pa'i yal ga snom pa smin mtshams dang / /phra ba tshangs bug la zug dbu ma'i g.yas/ /ro ma dmar po g.yon du rkyang ma dkar/ /kun 'dar ma las ldab 'gyur gyis phra ba/ /spyi bo'i 'khor lo nas bzung gsang gnas bar/ /sum gzhibs ro rkyang yas sna gnyis po de/ /thur du sna bug la zug rtsa gsum gyi/ /mas sna gsang 'khor 'og tu 'dres pa las/ /dbu ma'i las sna dung can ma g.yas dang / /ro ma g.yon phyogs song nas de gnyis so/ /mdun du 'khyong nas chu mam dag la zug /khu ba bshang gci 'phen sdom bdag por 'gyur//'khor lo so so'i thad du ro rkyang gnyis/ /dhū ti la thim nang khong 'bral pa ste/ /de ltar rtsa gsum la brten 'khor lo ni/ /spyi bo bde ba chen po'i rten gyur pa'i/ /kun rdzob byang sems haṃ gi rnam pa ru/ /gnas pa'i spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo dang / /ro drug myong bas sgo nas longs spyod pas/ /mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo rnam par shes/ /yul la mchod cing rgyas byed skye mched la/ /chos su btags te snying ga chos 'khor lo/ /lus ni thog mar bskyed cing sprul pa'i gnas/ /lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo zhes bya zhing / /yab kyi nor bu bde ba myong byed pas/ /gsang gnas bde skyong 'khor lo lnga po yi/ /lte bar dhū ti dag las phyogs bzhi ru/ /'byung bzhi'i nus pa 'dzin pa'i rtsa 'dab ste/ /gyes pa'i gsang ba'i 'khor lo 'dab ma bzhi/ /snying gar de mas gnyis gnyis gyes pa las/ /phyi bskor la brgyad mgrin pa'i 'khor lo la/ /de las gnyis gnyis gyes pa'i bar bskor la/ /brgyad dang phyi bskor bcu drug spyi bo ru/ /de las gnyis re gyes pa'i bar bskor gyi/ /nang ma bcu drug phyi bskor sum cu gnyis/ /lte bar snying ga ltar gyes 451

'dab brgyad kyi/ /bzhi las gnyis re gyes shing brgyad po las/ /lnga lnga gyes shing ma gyes pa'i bzhi las/ /drug drug gyes pa'i bar bskor bcu gnyis dang / /phyi bskor drug cu rtsa bzhi spyi mgrin dang / /snying lte'i 'khor lo bzhi yi bar stag la/ /rang sor phyed dang bcu gsum lte ba nas/ /sor brgyad gzhal bar gsang ba'i 'khor lo gnas/ /de yang spyi bo dpral bas ban kan nad/ /mgrin snying mkhris pa lte gsang dag gis rlung / /gsang ba'i nang rim gyis ni 'dus pa'i nad/ /bskyed cing dpral ba gtsug gtor 'khor lo yangs/ /don la yod cing rtsa gnas de dag las/ /'khor lo'i rtsa rnams 'bring po ro rkyang dang / /dbu ma gsum por phra ba dbu ma'i nang / /'khor lo'i lte ba rnams ni shin tu phra/ /de las gzhan ma rnams ni rags pa'i rtsa/ /de yang lte 'khor chags nas ka'i rnam par/ /'gyur zhing de nas yan lag lnga dod nas/ /rkang lag rdzogs pa'i gnas skabs gcig po la/ /rus sbal sbal pa rnam pa gnyis su dbye//de nas bzung ste ji srid btsa' ba'i bar/ /phag pa'i gnas skabs zhes bya de yang ni/ /rim par tshigs rnams la gnas rtsa'i 'khor lo/ /sha khrag rus pa tshigs dang bcas pa chags/ /de yan snang med brgya bzhin du gnas/ /zla ba drug nas yid kyi rnam rig skye/ /sngon gyi skye dran tshor ba bde sdug myong / /mun pa nas ni skra dang ba spu skyes/ /dbang po'i rten rnams rdzogs cing brgyad pa la/ /dbang po rdzogs pas bkres skom bshang gci 'byung / /dgu pa'i mtha' nas sdug bsngal skyo ba skyes/ /lus rdzogs nas ni btsa' ba'i nyin zhag bar/ /mi yi seṅge'i gnas skabs zhes bya ste/ /gtsas nas 'chi ba'i bar la mi'u thung / /dgra sta dga' byed nag po sangs rgyas dang / /rigs ldan zhes bya'i gnas skabs drug tu bshad/ /de ltar phra rab rdul gyi chos can gyi/ /lus la gnas pa rigs pa rtsa'i rnam bzhag /rnal 'byor pa la nye bar mkho ba tsam/ /brjod las gzhan yang rtsa phran gyis pa ni/ /ba spu'i grangs mnyam de snyed yod ser gsungs/ /de las chos nyid don dam ye shes kyi/ /rtsa ni rang rig rnam par thams cad par/ /shar phyir tha ma rtsa kun gyes byed la/ /bzhugs pa ye shes dbu ma chen por grags/ /kun rdzob rtsa yang de yi rjes 'gro ba'i/ /rnal 'byor sems kyi rnam pa de gar gtad/ /tha mal btsas kyang de dang 'dra ba'i las /byed phyir rgyud sde tha dad las bshad pa'i/ /rtsa yi rnam bzhag mi 'dra'i bye brag rnams/ /don la mi 'gal gnad gcig shes par bya/ /de ltar gnas pa'i rtsa la rgyu ba yi/ /g.yo ba rlung gi rnam bzhag bshad pa ni/ /spyir ni lus can rnams kyi ngag gi chos/ /phyi rol dbugs srang chu tshod zhag la sogs/ /dus tshig rnams kyi 'char gzhir gyur pa ni/ /don dam ye shes rlung ngam srog chen po'i/ /rlung zhes bya ste las dang ye shes kyi/ /rlung kun gshis ma rgyun mi chad khyab pa/ /rgyu rgyud rten du gyur pa nyi zla yin la/ /de yi glo bur dri ma kun gzhi yi/ /rnam shes rang bzhin yul la g.yo ba ni/ /las kyi rlung ste phung lnga'i rten byed pa/ / 452

srog 'dzin thur sel mnyam gnas gyen du rgyu/ /khyab byed rtsa ba'i rlung lnga srog 'dzin ni/ /lte ba man chad dbu ma'i nang du gnas/ /de las steng gi sna sgo'i lam gnyis nas/ /rgyu zhing chu khams gtso che kha dog dkar/ /byed las srog gnas pa dang nga'am bdag /'dzin cing rnam rtog sna tshogs skyed par byed/ /gnas gzhan log na dran pa nyams pa nas/ /brgyal 'bog 'chi ba'i bar 'byung 'di nyid ni/ /dus sbyor kun gyi cha shas la 'dres nas/ /'bab kyang kho rang 'bab zhig 'bab pa ni/ /'chi ba'i zhag la nyis khri chig stong dang / /drug brgya 'bab cing thur sel lte ba man/ /gnas la 'og sgo gnyis po dag nas rgyu/ /sa'i khams kha dog ser po bshang gci dang / /khu ba gsum po 'phen sdom bya ba byed/ /log na grang ba smad kyi nad rnams skyed/ /mnyam gnas lte ba'i me dang mnyam du gnas/ /rtsa yi sgo phyogs kun rgyu rlung gi khams/ kha dog sngon po pho ba bza' btung gi /dngas snyigs 'byed cing dngas ma lus la 'grems/ /snyigs ma 'og 'dor log na pho ba'i nad/ /bskyed cing gyen du rgyu ba mgrin par gnas/ /me khams kha dog dmar po smra brjod dang / /srog 'dzin gyi rlung kha sna nas 'dren cing / /zas med skyug pa sna khrag 'phen pa sogs/ /byed cing mog na tsha ba stod nad skyed/ /khyab byed ro ma dang 'bral lus spyi dang / /khyad par tshig rnams la gnas nam mkha'i khams/ /kha dog ljang khu yan lag brkyang bskum dang / /bsgul bskyod 'gro lo 'deg 'jog las byed cing / /log na zhwa 'khum yan lag nad rnams bskyed/ /dbang po lnga'i rten yan lag rlung lnga ni/ /rgyu ba rab tu rgyu ba shin tu rgyu/ /mngon par rgyu ba yang dag rgyu ba ltar/ /ming gi rnams grangs klu dang rus sbal dang / /rtsangs pa lhas byin dang ni gzhu las rgyal/ /rim par mig dang rna ba sna lce dang / /lpags pa dbang rten lngar gnas rna shes lnga'i / /rten byed gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya yi/ /yul lnga 'dzin pa'i bya ba rab byed cing / /log na dbang po de dang de yi nad/ /skyed cing yid kyi shes pa'i gzhon pa'i rlung / /snying la gnas nas yan lag rlung lnga dang / /'dres nas rgyu las rang dbang rgyu ba nyid/ /med pas logs su ma bstan de'i byed las/ /yid la chos kyi skye mched 'phar la dbang / /yang dag rgyu ba ben rig bral nas kyang / /lus kyi cha shas ma 'thor bar du gnas/ /yan lag rlung lnga srog 'dzin las byung phyir/ /der bsdu sna bug gnyis nas rgyu ba'i rlung / /lte ba'i rtsa 'dab drug cu re bzhi las/ /drug tu gyes pa'i ya gyal bzhi po ni/ /dbu ma'i 'pho ba yin phyir dkyil 'khor ni/ /mi 'bab de phyer stong pa'i rtsa bzhi zer/ /de lhag drug cu dag nas rgyu ba'i tshul/ /ba spu'i mthar thug rtsa lam nas rgyu ba'i/ /rtsa 'khor rlung rnams lte ba'i rlung dang 'dres/ /ro rkyang lam nas sna yi sgo ru 'bab/ /g.yas nas sa chu me rlung nam mkha' yi/ /rlung rgyu 'byung ba sdud pa'i rim pa yi/ /glang sogs mnyam pa'i dus sbyor drug gi rlung / /g.yon nas mkha' rlung me chu sa'i rim pas/ /'byung ba bskyed rim dang mthun 453

lugs la sogs/ /mi mnyam pa yi dus sbyor drug gi rlung / /dus sbyor re rer 'byung ba lnga lnga yi/ /bdag nyid yin la 'pho chung 'byung ba rer/ /sum brgya drug cu'i dbugs te chu tshod gcig /'pho chen gcig tu rdzogs tshe dus sbyor rer/ /dbugs stong brgyad brgya re ste chu tshod lnga/ /de nyid bcu gnyis longs pa'i zhag re la/ /dbugs stong nyi khri chig stong drug brgya re/ /chu tshod dag tu sdoms na drug cu 'bab/ /de dag ye shes thob skal dbu ma'i dbugs/ /de las logs su med kyang so so yi/ /steng nas brtsi ste dbugs gcig dag gi steng / /de nyid phyed bcas so gnyis bsil ba'i cha/ /gcig de bsags pa'i 'pho chung gcig longs tshe/ /bcu gcig rkang bcas de nyid dus sbyor gcig /longs pa'i dus su nga drug rkang bcas te/ /zhag gcig drugabargya bdun cu rtsa lnga po/ /bsags pas lo gcig nyin zhag bcu gcig dang / /zhag gi bcu gsum cha gcig lhag pa las/ /zla ba phyed dang bcas pa'i so gnyis la/ /zla ba ril po longs pa'i zla lhag 'byung / /de yang rim gyis lo brgyar longs pa'i cha/ /bsags pas lo gsum phyogs gsum 'ong ba yin/ /'di ni phyir 'gro 'phel ba'i 'chi ltas dang / /nang du zin pas 'chi med grub par bshad/ /'pho chung rlung ni g.yas g.yon gang yin kyang / /sna bug gnyis kyi dbus mkha' steng nas rlung / /gshog pa nas me ka ba'i ngos nas chu/ /'og nas sa rlung rgyu zhing kha dog kyang / /sa yi rlung ser chu dkar me dmar po/ /rlung gi rlung ljang mkha' rlung sngon po ste/ /tshad kyang lte 'og nas brgyud sna rtse nas/ /'byung khams lci yang dbang gi sor bcu gnyis/ /bcu gsum bcu bzhi bco lnga bcu drug bar/ /sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i rlung rnam 'gro/ /rlung de rnams las sna sgor rgyu ba dang / /lus ni bsgul bskyod byed pa'i rlung rags pa/ /lus nang mi g.yo 'khor ba'i rang bzhin gyi/ /'byung lnga'i rlung dang rnam 'gyur bcu yi rlung / /rnam rtog g.yo ba'i bzhon pa rnams 'bring po/ /snang bzhi'i bzhon par gyur pa'i rlung phra ba/ /'od gsal bzhon pa shin tu phra ba'i rlung / /de phyir man ngag tha dad gzhung rnams las/ /rlung gi rnam bzhag mi 'dra'i rnam bzhag kun/ /ye shes rlung gi rnam pa thams cad par/ /yin phyir de yi rjes 'gro gnad du gcig /de bas bkod pa byang sems thig le ni/ /don dam ye shes thig le rtsa ba'am /bdag por gyur pa rgyu rgyud nyid kyi rten/ /ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum gyi bdag /stong gsal 'gag pa med pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /mi shigs pa yi thig le chen po zhes/ /de tshe rang mdangs rnam par shes pa dang / /rjes 'bral rang bzhin can gyi thig le ni/ /lte 'og rtsa gsum 'dus mdor rak+ta yi/ /dngas ma nang gi nyi ma ngam shad dam/ /gtum mo zhes bya drod dang rnam shes bdag /shes rab rang bzhin yin phyir yum gyi sgras/ /kun tu bzang mo nyi ma'i thig ler brjod/ /spyi bo'i 'khor lo'i steng du khu ba yi/ /dngas ma nang gi zla ba haṃ yig gi/ /rnam pa dpyid ces dkar cha thams cad kyi/ /bdag po zhu 454

bde thabs kyi rang bzhin can/ /kun tu bzang po zla ba'i thig le zhes/ /de gnyis dbu ma'i yas mar sna la gnas/ /'chi tshe gyen thur log nas snying gar 'dres/ /snang mched thob gsum 'chi kha'i 'od gsal 'char/ /rnam shes rten byed thig le thams cad kyi/ /bskyed bzhi yin cing de dang rjes 'bral bar spyi mgrin snying lte'i 'khor lo bzhi'i lte bar/ /sku gsung thugs dang ye shes bzhi'i ngo bo/ /chu me rlung sa'i khams kyi thig le bzhis/ /sad mi gnyid 'thug snyom par 'jug pa yi/ /ma dag gnas skabs bzhi bskyed lam dus su/ /dga' bzhi'i ye shes 'char ba'i rgyu byed la/ /sbyangs bya gnas skabs bzhi yi 'khrul pa de//sbyangs te dag pa'i sbyangs 'bras don dam pa'i/ /chos nyid thig ler mngon gyur sku bzhi thob/ /de bzhi'i khyab byed gtsug tor nam mkha'i khams/ /gsang bar ye shes khams te thig le drug /'di gnyis sngar bshad a haṃ gnyis dang gcig /yang na lte ba yan chad 'khor lo lnga'i/ /thig le khyab bya khyab byed gsang 'khor gyi/ /thig ler bzhag na lte gsang nor bu yi/ /dbye bas lus ngag yid gsum thig le ni/ /grol ba gsum gyi ngo bo gnas pa rnams/ /de yi bdag por gyur pa lus khams kyi/ /dngas ma grub gnas 'pho ba'i tshul gsum las/ /grub tshul mngal du ma'i rtsa dang 'bral su/ /bskyed cing btsas nas bza' btung rnams pho par/ /bad kan gyis kyang mkhris pas mdog 'gyur zhing / /me mnyam rlung ste nang gi mes gsum gyis/ /thar bzhu sbyangs pas dngas ma mchin pa ru/ /khrag tu 'gyur ro rtsa la brgyud nas ni/ /rim par sha tshil rus rkang byang sems dang / /mdangs stobs rnams su 'gyur la de rnams kyi/ /snyigs ma'ang rim bzhin be snabs gci ba dang / /mkhris pa lpags pa smin spu so phen dang / /rkang sbubs dri ma dang ni khu ba la/ /lus zungs dngas ma bdun po zhes bshad cing / /gzhan yang mkhris pa'i dngas ma chu ser dang / /snyigs ma chu yi ku ya la sogs te/ khams rnams sna tshogs 'grub par 'gyur bas mtshon/ /lus gnas rnams su dngas bcu gnyis dang / /snyigs ma nyer bzhi khyab byed mi shigs pa'i/ /thig le chen po nyid de khams so bdun/ /gzhan las de yi steng du yan lag gi /rlung lnga'i rtsa dang rtsa gsum 'dus pa nang / /gyen du rlung dang thur du dngas snyigs su/ /rgyu ba bsnan pas sum cu so gnyis te/ /de steng rtsa ba'i rlung lnga rgyu ba la/ /srog chen ma gtogs bzhi bsnan so drug tu/ /bshad pa la sogs dbye bsdu'i rnam grangs mang / /gnas pa'i tshul la dngas ma bcu gnyis las/ /khyab bya bcu ni snying ga'i rtsa bcu yi/ /phyogs bzhi steng gi rtsa gsum gcig sdoms pas/ /phung lnga'i dngas ma 'bab cing mtshams bzhi dang / /'og gi dri chu'i rtsa las khams lnga yi/ /dngas ma 'bab cing khyab byed rnam gnyis ni/ /dung can ma dang bshang ba'i rtsa dag las/ /ye shes khams gnyis 'bab ste bcu gnyis so/ /snying ma mi phyed pu li ra las ni/ /so sen phra mo dza mad+dha ra nas/ /skra dang kha spu rtsibs g.yas o rgyan nas/ /pags pa rtsibs 455

g.yon ma 'ongs gunu ta/ /rgyab sogs sha dang dkar cha rtag tu gnas/ /go ta wa ri thung ngu ma las rgyus/ /ro mi shwa ri rus sbal skyes rus pa/ /de bi ko ṭa sgom pa mo mchin sha /dbang bskur ma la wa las snying gi sha /bskyed byed rtag tu gnas dang nye ba'i gnas/ /skyon ma ma ru las ni mig 'bras sha /'jug ma o ḍi ma las mkhris pa dang / /ma mo tri sha ku na glo ba dang / /mtshan mo ko pa la ni rgyu ma'i phreng / /'bab pa longs spyod zhing dang nye zhing brjod/ /bsil sbyin ka lika nas bgrod pa dang / /cho ba ma ni lo pa ka gnye ma/ /gzhol ma kañtsi bshang ba rangs sa ni/ /hi ma la ya sa 'tshams dbus 'gongs pa'i/ /rgyungs sa 'bab cing dngas snyigs 'dres pa ni/ /tsharnyo nye ba'i tsharnyo zhes su grags/ /pre ta pū ri gzugs can ma las rnag /gro ha de ba thun mong ma bad kan/ /bu sbyin so so raṣ+ṭam khrag nus bskyed/ /pho ṇa dī pa sbyor bral ma rngul 'bab/ /dngas snyigs lus las 'du dang nyer 'dur gsungs/ /stu gu nā ga ra las tshim 'bab cing / /grub ma sirtsas mchi ma bskyed par byed/ /ma rla 'tshed mas lud pa mchim bskyed 'bab/ /ku ta la ni yid bzangs sna chu 'bab/ /bde mod dur khrod nye ba'i dur khrod do/ /de ltar phyi gnas chen nyer bzhi dang / /lus rtsa nyi shu bzhi las khams nyer bzhi/ /'bab pa khams kyi dngas ma'i ngo bo ru/ /gnas pa rnams re dngas ma bcu gnyis la/ /ltos nas snyigs ma zhes ni brjod pa las/ /lus kyi chos dngos la ltos so sen kyang / /dngas mar gnas la de ltar nyer bzhi po/ /de nyid thim long bdag po gsum re yis/ /phye bas bdun cu rtsa gnyis de re rer/ /rtsa gnas so so dag las 'bab tshul ni/ /stong phrag re re khams kyi bye ba la/ /stong phrag bdun cu gnyis dag gi grangs/ /'pho tshul ye shes rjes 'bral 'khor lo bzhir/ /dga' bzhi'i 'gros kyis 'pho zhing rnam shes dang / /rjes 'bral lus zungs gnad kyi ngo bo ru/ /'pho bar bla gnas zhes grags mdor bsdu na/ /thig le mtha' dag khu rdul mun gsum du/ /'du zhing de yi chags sdang rmongs gsum bskyed/ /de las rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa dang / /de yis las bsags 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang gi /sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong zhing thig le gsum/ /'pho med bcings pas 'khor ba ldog par 'gyur/ /thig le kun gyi rtsa ba mi shigs pa'i/ /thig le rnam pa thams cad pa yin pas/ /brtags dang ma brtags thig le'i rnal 'byor kun/ /dngos brgyud gang rung sgo nas yang dag pa'i/ /lam du 'gro ba'i gnad kyang shes par bya/ /rtsa rlung thig le bshad pa'i dgos pa ni/ /phra ba'i lus ngag yid gsum gdod ma nas/ /rdo rje mi shigs gsum gyi lhar dag la/ /de yang don gyi rgyal ba rigs drug gi /yab yum lha yi bdag nyid 'byung ba lnga/ /sems kyi dngas ma drug po gnyis gnyis so/ /zung 'jug sa chu'i dngas ma sku rdo rje/ /me rlung gsung la mkha' sems thugs rdo rje/ /de gsum ldog chas phye las don dam par/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje mnyam pa nyid/ /sbyang gzhi'i de yi rang mdangs 456

kun rdzob kyi/ /snang ngo'i cha nas ro rkyang dbu ma gsum/ /khu rdul rlung gi rten yin rlung dang sems/ /'jug pa gcig pas sems kyi rten yang yin/ /de nyid rags pa grub pas rtsa las lus/ /rlung la sa ngag dang thig le dag las ni/ /sems kyi chos 'grub pa ni sbyang bya yi/ /'khrul pa'i sgo gsum yin cing de sbyong byed/ /zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor khyad 'phags kyi/ /thabs dang ldan pas rten gyi rtsa bcings pas/ /de yi rlung 'ching de yi thig le ni/ /bcing las rnal 'byor rtog pa 'ching byed pa'i/ /byed bcings rdo rje'i lus la gnad bsnun pas/ /don dam rdo rje gsum gyi rten gyur pa'i/ /rtsa rlung thig le'i gnad la red gyur pas/ /glo bur dri ma mtha' dag gdod ma yi/ /ye shes dbyings su thim nas sbyang 'bras kyi/ /sgrib bral rdo rje gsum 'grub de yi phyir/ /mchog gi dgos pa dang 'bral khyad par 'phags/ /de nyid snying por dril na 'di yin te/ /sems nyid bden la dbyer med spyod yul ngang / /bral ba don dam dbyings ye 'bras bu gsum/ /dbyings ni stong pa spros bral mkha' lta bu/ /me long g.ya' rdul bral ltar stong zhing gsal/ /de la sgrib g.yog med pa'i cha shas ni/ /ye shes don dam yin te de nyid la/ /gzugs brnyan 'char rung nus pa yod pa ltar/ /sems nyid dngas gsal sgrib g.yogs med klong du/ /sku dang ye shes yon tan 'char rung du/ /ma 'gag gnas pa 'bras bu don dam ste/ /de la sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las las/ /phye ba don dam dkor bdun ngo bo nyid/ /lhun grub lhag pa don dam bden pa dang / /de yi rtsal snang sku dang ye shes kyi/ /dkyil 'khor du shar lhag pa kun rdzob kyi/ /bden pa spang bya las 'das don dam pa/ /snang stong gser dang gser gyi ser po bzhin/ /dbyer med bden gnyis ngo bo gcig tu ston/ /blo las 'das gang gshis kyi gnas lugs te/ /kun rdzob bden pa sku dang ye shes su/ /'char ba 'khrul snang min phyir dag bya min/ /'di don ma rtogs rang bzhin rnam dag ni/ /stong rkyang med 'gag la bzhed gzhi rgyud du/ /'dod pa phal gyis gsang sngags zab don gyi/ /gnad la ma red rtog ge'i tshig gis sgrib/ /de ltar sems nyid 'gyur med gzhi yi rgyud/ /pad 'byung bi ma la yi bstan pa bzhin/ /bshad pa 'di las bsod nams gang 'phel bas/ /ma gyur 'gro kun gdod ma'i dbyings grol shog /ces pa gzhi rgyud bstan pa'i skabs te gnyis pa'o/ /ma nor lam ston mtshungs med bla ma dang / /lhag pa'i lha la gus pas phyag 'tshal nas/ /gzhi nyid 'bras bu smin byed lam gyi gnad/ /bla med rgyud don ji bzhin bshad par bya/ /gzhi rgyud bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po de/ /glo bur dri ma bral bar byed pa'i thabs/ /shes 'jug byed rtsol dang bcas thabs kyi rgyud/ /gang gi gang du bgrod par bya ba'i rten/ /yin phyir lam rgyud zhes bya grags pa ste/ /de yi ngo bo shes rab rnam gsum gyis/ /sems sogs skyes pa yin la de skye tshul/ /gzhi gnas skye bar rnam 457

par grol ba yi/ /theg pa gang la'ang ma zhugs thog ma nas/ /rdo rje'i theg pa rigs sad skal ldan mchog/'di nas zhugs pa nye rang lam zhugs sogs/ /rang 'bras ma thob sngon du 'dir 'jug pa/ /'bras bu nas 'jug nyan rang dgra bcom dang / /rgyu yi theg pas kun tu 'od brnyes shing / /phyi rgyud gsum gyi rang 'bras mthar phyin pa'ang / /snang gsum sgrib pa spang phyir 'dir 'jug dgos/ /de ltar 'jug tshul bstan nas sems lnga yi/ /skye tshul thun mong khyad par rnam gnyis las/ /khyad par theg pa 'og ma'i skyon mthong nas/ /'di yi yon tan mthong nas 'jug 'dod kyi/ /sems ni dang po 'go ldong tshul skyes pa/ /g.yo ldang byang chub sems yin theg pa de'i/ /yon tan thob 'dod smon pa byang chub sems/ /smon sems tsam du ma lus der 'jug pa/ /'jug pa byang chub sems re der gnas pa/ /gnas pa byang chub sems yin de'i 'bras bur/ /nye bar thob pa mthar phyin byang chub sems/ /thun mong theg pa dag la'ang skye 'gyur zhing / /thabs kyi khyad 'phags mchog gi sems lnga po/ /bla med theg pa 'di ru zhugs pa yi/ /dbang rnon gcig char skye zhing brtul po la/ /rim gyi nyams su blang nas skye ba'o/ /dbye nye ring rnams gnyis las ring ba'i lam/ /mdo sde las gsung nges 'byung theg pa bzhi/ /bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud gsum 'di nyid la/ /ltos nas ring lam zhes bya nye lam ni/ /bla med thabs rgyud 'di yin de yang ni/ /blo dman rim 'jug lam stegs theg pa la/ /slob dgos dbang po khyad kyis thog pa'i sgo/ /gang nas bstan kyang go sla'i skal ldan de/ /sngon du grub mthas blo kha ma bsgyur bar/ /rang bzhin gnas pa'i mun pa'i shes pa de/ /dge ba'i rigs sad dad pa cung zad 'bog /g.yo ba'i tshul du dge rtsa phra mo la/ /'jug blo phal pa'i sems brgyad skye ba ni/ /dge ba phra mos smyang ba gnas pa sogs/ /dka' spyad cung zad la 'jug sa bon tshul/ /nye du tsam la sbyin pa myu gu dang / /mdza' bshes min la'ang ster ba sdong bu ltar/ /sbyin pa'i snod yongs 'tshol zhing ster ba ni/ /lo ma bzhin te bla ma nas bzung ste/ /rol mo mkhan bar yon tan can 'tshol nas/ /sbyin pa me tog lta bu yid dga' bas/ /gzhan la ster ba 'bras bu lta bu dang / /mtho ris skye phyir khrims bsrung gsos lta bu/ /gzhan yang lha chen mchod cing bla ma yi/ /bstan pa khong du chud pas bdag 'dzin gyis/ /kun bslang rang bzhin bdag nyid gcig pu ni/ /sdug bsngal thar 'dod stobs su gyur pa'i sems/ /brgyad po de dag gcig dang lnga re re/ /rim par dka' thub sbyin pa tshul khrims dang / /ma chags dge rtsas bsdus pa phra mo steng / /'khor ba'i yid ma 'byung zhing 'di phyi yi/ /bde ba don gnyer skyes bu chung ngu'i blo/ /de 'og dbyugs dbyung rnam pa drug 'byung ste/ /mi dge'i las spang dge ba blo byang ba/ /dge bas dbugs phyin bdag gi de kho nar/ /brtan re sems ni rtse gcig byas pa na/ /bdag la brtan nas dbugs phyin phung po la/ /rnam par dpyad pas bdag med gsal snang 458

nyid/ /thob tshe bdag med dbugs phyin chos tsam la/ /dmigs nas phung sogs rags pa mi dmigs pa/ /chos kyis dbugs phyin chos rnams rab spangs nas/ /skye ba med pa'i don la sems gnas pa'i/ /chos bdag med pas dbugs phyin stong nyid la/ mngon zhen 'ga' che mnyam pa nyid kyis ni/ /dbugs phyin zhes bya de las dang po gnyis/ /phyi rol pa dang thun mong lha ma'i theg /bar pa gnyis ni theg dman nyan rang dang / /thun mong bar ste skyes bu 'bring gi blo/ /tha ma gnyis ni byang chub sems dpa' dang / /thun mong skyes bu chen po'i bsam pa'o/ /de nas gsang sngags phyi nang kun slob nas/ /mthar thug khyad 'phags bla med lam 'dir 'jug /de yang rnam par grol ba'i rgyu 'bras kyi/ /theg pa kun kyang gzhi yi gnas lugs nyid/ /ma rig pa yi sgrib pa tsam zhig la/ /'dod pa mthun par gyur kyang ma rig pa'i/ /ngos 'dzin ma mthun dbang gis gnyen po'ang / /tha dad gyur ste 'di ltar ma rig pa'i/ /ngos 'dzin lugs kyang nyan thos 'jig tshogs la/ /lta ba dang 'bral sems rmongs sems tsam pas/ /gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan 'dzin cing dbu ma pa/ /spyi yi mtshan 'dzin spros pa dbu ma che/ /mdo yi theg par grags pa'i bag chags pa/ /dbu ma chen po gsang sngags bla med pas/ /'gyur bde'i 'pho ba'i bag chags ma rig pa/ /phra bar bzhag nas de dang de'i gnyen por/ /rim bzhin gang zag bdag med bzung ba ni/ /rang bzhin med lta ci yang ma yin pa'i/ /stong pa nyid dang rang rig rang gsal ba/ /don dam dbyings su bzhed cing dbang bzhi pa'i/ /lam gyi ngo bo rang rig zung 'jug gi/ /ye shes sgom pa 'dod pa rnams yin no/ /de ltar skal dman gang zag rim 'jug la/ /dgongs te rgyu 'bras theg pa thun mong par/ /slob pa sngon du btang nas bla med kyi/ /lam la dkri dgos gsungs pa mtha' gcig tu/ /ma nges skal pa mchog ldan gang zag gi/ /gsang sngags bla med thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /zab lam snod du rigs nges dbang rnon rnams/ /dang po nyid nas lam 'dir 'jug tu rung / /'on kyang skyes bu gsum gyi blo rigs ni/ /sngags lam ma zhugs gong nas byang zin na/ /smos ma dgos shing de ltar ma yin kyang / /rim gnyis ye shes skye ba'i sngon rol du/ /de rnams myong thon rgyud la skyes zin zhig /nges par dgos zhes gsung phyir nan tan gces/ /lam gyi yon tan skye la thos bsam gyi/ /rgyud sbyangs sgom pas gtan la phab dgos pas/ /dang po gang la thos pa bya ba'i yul/ /thams cad mkhyen pa thob par byed pa'i rgyu/ /shes bya kun la slob cing khyad par du/ /sgra dang tshad mas rgol ba tshar gcod cing / /bzo dang gso ba'i gzhan dag rjes su 'dzin/ /bdag nyid kun shes bya phyir nang don gyi/ /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi la bslab/ /mang du thos pas gti mug mun pa sel/ /blang dor gnas gsal blun sgom 'ching las grol/ /ma nor lam rnyed dpal dang grags pa thob/ /de sogs phan yon bsam mi khyab pas phyir/ /rgyal bas 459

mang du thos pa yang yang bsngags/ /'on kyang thos pa bsam pas ma skyong na/ /dran pas zungs mi thub phyir the tshom gyi/ /sgra 'dogs legs bcad bsreg bcad brdar ba yi/ /gser bzhin zhun bar chod pa gnad du che/ /de yang sgra tshad la sogs tha snyad kyi/ /rig pa'i gnas rnams da lta snyigs dus kyi/ /tshe thung 'di la bya long med pas na/ /thar pa 'dod rnams nges don lam mchog mtshol/ /de yang theg kun mthar thug sngags kyi lam/ /sgrub la dang po bla ma bsten pa gces/ /de yi mtshan nyid dbang gis thugs rgyud smin cing / /dam tshig la gnas phyi nang de nyid bcu/ /tshang zhing zab mo'i lam gyi de nyid don/ /rtogs pa'i dgongs pa mnga' zhing thabs mkhas kyis/ /slob bu rjes su 'dzin pas thugs rjer ldan/ /tshig gis gdam pa'i sgro 'dogs gcod nus shing / /ngo sprod don gyi rtogs pa bskyed nus pa/ /byin rlabs ma dag snang ba 'gog nus dang / /nyams myong gis ni gegs sel nyams rtogs kyi/ /bogs 'byin nus pa mtshan nyid bzhi ldan te/ /gzhan yang brtan cing dul la g.yo rgyu med/ /gsang sngags rgyud
