kyi sbyor ba rab shes shing / /dkyil 'khor bri ba la mkhas theg chen la/ /rtag par gnas shing byams dang snying rje che/ /yul yid bzhin mdzod las don dang rgyang bsring mi chos rgyab tu bor/ /dgos med rang bzhin nor rdzas zhen pa chung / /las 'bras yid ches dge sdig blang dor byed/ /theg chen don ldan 'gro don thabs mkhas spyod/ /gong la mnyes byas grub thob rgyud pa 'dzin/ /thugs mdzod lon pa'i snyan rgyud gdams pa ldan/ /phyag bzhes mthong ba'i don gnyis sgrub la mkhas/ /sgrub la brtson pas dngos grub brnyes/ /mdo rgyud bka' babs dam tshig gtsang gyur pa zhes gsungs/ de sogs yon tan kun ldan bla ma ni/ /thar lam 'dod la sangs rgyas dngos dang mtshungs/ /cha shas ldan pa'ang bsten rung rtsod dus 'dir/ /skyon bral yon tan kun tshang rnyed par dka'/ /gal te sprul pa'i skyes chen sa lam la/ /gnas pa yin kyang gdul bya'i las sgrib kyi/ /skyon du skyong ba legs pa'i skar ma yis/ /rgyal ba'i mdzad par skyon mang mthong ba bzhin/ gzhan du dug gsum shas che rang rgyud ngan/ /thos chung gzhan nor la rloms khengs dregs can/ /chos brgyad che zhing che 'di'i khe dang grags/ /lhur len dam pa gzhan la sdang zhing gshegs/ /'khor bar nges 'byung chung zhing sgrub la g.yel/ /de 'dre'i mi dge'i bshes gnyen sdig pa'i grogs/ /log 'tshos sgrub pas 'byor pa'i 'khor slob dang / /blun por bkur bas chen po'i go sa ru/ /'gying yang dad ldan thar pa don gnyer gyi/ /byang chub sgrub pa'i gegs yin ring du spangs/ /de ltar legs brtags bstan bya'i bla ma de/ /bstan par bya ba slob ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ /dad btson ldan zhing gtong phod shes rab che/ /sgom sgrub dam tshig dag la yid brton cing / /bla ma la gus dad ldan ngang rgyud ring / /blo khog yangs zhing theg chen chos la mos/ /g.yo zog chung zhing snying rje nges 'byung che/ /zhi 460

dul ldan zhing blo brtan dkyel che ba/ /de lta'i mtshan nyid ldan pa'i slob ma des/ /'chi gsos sman bzhin 'bral ba med par bsten/ /khong pa'i snying ltar gzu lum ras chod spangs/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bu bsnyen bkur la/ /tshad bzung mi bya rnyed dang bkur bsti dang / /rim gro sgrub pa'i sgo nas bstan par bya/ /ci'i phyir zhe na sangs rgyas thams cad las/ /rang la bla ma drin che dkyil 'khor gyi/ /gtso bo nyid dang tha dad med par blta/ /de yang bum dbang lam gnas slob ma yis/ /bla ma'i phung khams skye mched dkyil 'khor lha'i/ /'khor lo rags par shes pa'i mos gus dang / /gsang dbang lam la gnas pas bla ma yin/ /rtsa yi khams rnams gsal stong lha'i rang bzhin/ /sher dbang de'i steng 'khor 'das chos so cog /bde ba chen po'i ye shes rang bzhin du/ /gzigs pa'i bdag nyid can du mos pa dang / /bzhi pa'i lam gnas chos kun rang bzhin gyi/ /gnas lugs bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po de/ /bla ma nyid dang gnyis su med lta zhing / /rang rig tha lam shes pa skad cig ma/ /'dzin pa'i ma slad gdod ma'i ye shes de/ /bla ma'i thugs kyi bde stong ye shes dang / /dbyer med bla ma rang sems du shar bas/ /mos gus bya zhing dbang bzhi de dang de'i/ /nyams rtogs skyes tshe mos gus de dag kyang / /bcos min 'byung zhing gzhan du dbang bzhi po/ /thog nas de dang 'bral ba'i mos gus kyi/ /rnam pa rjes mthun 'bad pas sgom par bya/ /de ltar bla ma bsten nas lam gyi gzhi/ /dad pa la rags na dad mi rnams la/ /dkar po'i chos kun skye ba mi 'gyur te/ /sa bon mes tshig myu gu ji bzhin no/ /dang 'dod yid ches mi ldog dad pa bzhi/ /dang ba'i dad pa yul mchog dag las skye/ /'dod pa'i dad pa thar lam gnyer las skye/ /yid ches dad pa rgyu 'bras thos las skye/ /mi ldog dad pa dge rtse'i stobs las skye/ /de lta'i dad pa gong du 'phel ba'i thabs/ /dam pa bsten cing mdo rgyud thos bsam bya/ /mi rtag rgyud bskul las 'bras yid ches shing / /sgom pa'i stobs kyis gong 'phel 'grib pa'i rkyen/ /bla ma'i skyon rtogs sdig pa'i grogs sam bsten/ /'dod yon la chags le lo'i dbang du shor/ /bdud kyis byin rlabs chos min spyod pas 'grib/ /rkyen las skyes pa sdug bsngal can mthong dang / /sdug bsngal thog babs gong ma'i ngo mtshar gyi/ /mdzad pa thos las skye zhing phan yon ni/ /sa gzhi bzang 'dra dge ba'i lo thog bskyed/ /gru gzings dang 'dra bskul chu bo ba sgrol/ /skyel ma dang 'dra nyon mongs dmag dpung bzlog /bzhon pa dang 'dra thar pa'i gling du phyin/ /nor bu'i rgyal ltar ci bsam 'grub pa ste/ /dpa' bo dang 'dra sdig to zil/ /klong chen pas kyis gnon zhes gsung / bsod nams tshogs 'phel 'phags pa'i nor gyi mchog /legs pa'i yon tan mtha' dag 'byung ba'i gnas/ /de phyir skal ldan thar pa 'dod pa rnams/ /dad pa 'phel ba'i thabs la brtson par mdzod/ /de ltar dad pas rgyud bskul 'chad nyan tshe/ /bla mas slob ma dbang 461

po rno brtul gyis/ /rim pa dang mthun thabs mkhas tshul gyis 'khrid/ /dper na sman byis kha zas so so bzhin/ /dang po'i las can rnams la rgyu 'bras kyi sogs/ /'khor bar yid 'byung thabs la nan tan bya/ /lam du zhugs la lta sgom spyod 'bras kyi/ /nang bstan gzhan don spyod la rgya che ba'i / /mdo rgyud theg pa'i rnam grangs thun mong gi/ /sgra tshad la sogs rigs pa'i gnas rnams bshad/ /de yi gegs gyur phyi nang 'du 'dzin dang / /rnyed bkur zang zing chang dang gnyid rmug gis/ /g.yengs gyur 'chad pa'i bar chad gyur rnams spangs/ /khri bstan mchod pa maṇ+ḍal sogs pa'i/ /bkod pas legs brgyan tshe 'di'i khe grags sogs/ /tshul min yid byed spang la snying bra yis/ /kun slang gzhan phan blo dang rgyal ba yi/ /bstan pa gnas phyir lhag bsam rnam dag gis/ /tshig gsal don bzang ngag snyan tshul gyis 'chad/ /cang rjes dag rtsa bson la/ /de la pha rol phyin pa drug tshang phyir/ /yid bzhin mdzod las tshig don legs bshad chos kyi sbyin pa ste/ /nyon mongs med bshad tshul khrims pha rol phyin/ /skyo ngal bzod pa spro ba'i brtson 'grus te/ /ma yengs bsam gtan 'byed pa shes rab bo/ /rjes la sems dpa'i don la bsngo ba bya/ /bka' drin bsam pa'i dam chos gus pa bskyed/ /de yi phan yon dran dang ting 'dzin dang / /nyon mongs rnyog bral spobs pa zad mi shes/ /chos mdzod 'dzin dang bder gshegs chos thos dang / /lha ma'i bstod cing grags dang bsam rgu 'grub/ /tshe rabs kun tu chos dang mi 'bral zhing / /myur du bder gshegs chos la spobs pa thob/ /de nas nyan byed slob ma'i chos tshul ni/ /skyon rnams spangs la gus par nyan par bya zhes gsungasatsho/ de yang sgrims te mi nyan snod kha sbub/ /skyon yin nyan kyang myur du rjed pa ni/ /dran pas zungs mi thub pa zhabs brdol dang / /kun slong ngan 'dres bug can lta bu ste/ /snod skyon gsum yin nga rgyal ma dad dang / /don gnyer chung zhing phyi rol yul la yengs/ /gnyid rmug sogs kyis rtog pa nang du bsdus/ /sgyid lug skyo ba nyan pa'i dri ma drug /spang zhing spyod lam sngas dang rgyab zur bstan/ /ma gus rnam 'gyur spang zhing thal sbyar gyis/ /dma' ba'i stan la dul ba'i dpal bskyed 'dug /dga' ba'i mig gis zhal lta tshig don gyi/ /bdud rtsi 'thung bzhin ma yengs gus pas gnas/ /kun slong mkha' mnyams sems can ma lus pa/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi go 'phong thob pa'i ched/ /dam chos nyan la tshul bzhin nyams len bsam/ /rgyu yi theg par bshes gnyen sman pa dang / /rang la nad pa chos la sman dang ni/ /nyams su len la nad 'tsho'i 'du shes kyis/ /nyan cing dbang dang rgyud bshad khrid la sogs/ /sngags kyi chos la slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi/ /gtso bor blta zhing sems bskyed rab ldan pas/ /rang rang skabs thob dmigs pa gsal btab nas/ /gus pas nyan cing khri stan la sogs pa/ /rang 'byor dang bstun ser sna bral bar 'bul/ /de la pha rol phyin pa 462

rnam drug tshang / /me tog kun mkhyen chos rjes stan sogs 'bul ba sbyin pa ste/ /sgo gsum rab bsdoms tshul khrims pha rol phyin/ /gnod pa bzod pa spro ba brtson 'grus te/ /ma yengs thob pa 'dzin pa bsam gtan nyid/ /the tshom sgro mdog chod pa shes rab mchog /rjes la chos dang ston pa'i bka' drin bsam//sgyu ma'i ngang nas byang chub bsngo bar bya/ /de'i phan yon shin tu tshad med de/ /chos rnga sgrag pa thos pa'i sems can yang / /ngan song las grol nyan pa smos ci 'tshal/ /shes rab ting 'dzin dran pas gzungs thob cing / /spangs blang mtshams phyed dge 'phel sdig kun srab/ /lha ma'i bstod cing ma rig mun pa sangs/ /pad+ma'i steng mdzes rgya chen chos thob cing / /myur du chos rgyal mya ngan med thob 'gyur zhes gsungs/ /de ltar mtshan ldan bla ma dam pa la/ /skal ldan slob mas rtse gcig gus pa bstan/ /dbang dang gdams ngag thun mthar legs par bcad/ /gzhan du thos bsam bral bas sgom pa la/ /zhugs kyang blun sgom mun rdo'i shes pa la/ /yang dag thar lam snang ba'i go skabs bral/ /lag rdum brag 'dzeg dmus long thang 'khyams bzhin/ /gar 'gro'i rdol med 'bad kyang 'bras bus dben/ /de phyir dang po'i las can 'jug pa'i sgo/ /thos bsam nyid las gzhan med thar lam gyis/ /byang chub sgrub la thos bsam mchog tu gces/ /de skad legs bshad ke ta kas drungs pa'i/ /'gro khams ma dag rnyog bral dad pa'i mtshor/ /bshes gnyen zla gzugs rtag 'char sa lam gyi/ /yon tan chu gter gong du 'phel bar shog /ces pa lam la 'jug tshul spyir bstan pa'i skabs te gsum pa'o/ /de nas chos bsam snying po sgom pa la/ /'jug dgos de yang skal ldan las dang po'i/ /rigs can sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyi/ /rim pas khrid ma thun gyi sngon 'gro ni/ /bsam gtan tsher ma med pa'i sa phyogs du/ /bde ba'i stan la lus gnad drang por 'dug /rlung ro bsal nas nad gdon sdig sgrib tshogs/ /rlung dang mnyam du song kyis dag par bsam/ /ma gyur 'gro rnams 'khor ba las grol phyir/ /zab lam nyams su blang bar bya snyam nas/ /sems bskyed rang gi spyi bor pad zla'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma dgyes 'dzum rnam pa ru/ /bzhugs la zab lam rtogs pa khyad par can/ /rgyud la skye ba'i gsol btab bla ma nyid/ /'od zhu rang la bstem pa thun kun gyi/ /'go ma gtong ba lugs 'di'i brgyud pa'i bsrol/ /lam gyi sngon 'gro ma chag rnam gsum la/ /brten gnas don gnyer rnam gsum skye ba ni/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka' de nyid mi rtag pa/ /bsam pas tshe 'di'i chags zhen las grol nas/ /phyi ma mtho ris bde ba don gnyer ba/ /skyes bu'i chung ngu'i lam yin 'khor ba yi/ /sdug bsngal las 'bras smin tshul blo sbyang bas/ /'khor bar chags zhen bral nas rang nyid ni/ /thar pa'i lam 'tshol de nyid don gnyer blo/ /bcos min skyes pa skyes bu 'bring gi lam/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems sgom 463

nas/ /rang don chags zhen bral nas gzhan don du/ /sangs rgyas thob 'dod bcos mi skyes pa'i tshe/ /skyes bu chen po'i lam yin 'di gsum po/ /rgyud la ma skyes lha sgom sngags bzlas sogs/ /brtson kyang byang chub thob la yid kyi ni/ /kun slong kho na gtso che de yi phyir/ /gar 'gro'i gtad so rnyed dka' 'khor ba las/ /yid 'byung sems bskyed kyis zin dge rtsa kun/ /yang dag lam du 'gro phyir tshul 'dir 'bad/ /gzhan yang dge bshes sgom chen la sogs pa/ /chos par rlom kun phugs su tshogs 'di yi/ /'dun ma lhur len mi chos so tshams kyi/ /gros kyi gtso dang grong chog rnam g.yeng gis/ /bral bas g.yengs rnams tshul 'di rang rgyud la/ /ma skyes blo rgod ngan dred song 'dis lan/ /yin la dang po dal 'byor rnyed dka' sgom/ /sdug bsngal bzod dka' can gyi 'khor ba 'dir/ /mi skyes thabs la 'bad dgos de sgrub pa'i/ /rten ni dal 'byor yin la 'di ltar bsam/ /bdag ni sems dmyal yi dwags dud 'gro dang / /kla klo tshe ring lha dang log par lta/ /sangs rgyas kyis stong lkug pa mi khoms kyi/ /skyon bral dal ba brgyad po legs par thob/ /mi yi lus thob dbus skyes dbang po tshang / /mtshams med ma byas srid zhi'i yon tan kun/ /'byung gnas gsung rab la dad rang 'byor lnga/ /legs 'byor sangs rgyas byon dang des chos gsungs/ /bstan pa ma nub gnas dang de rjes 'jug /gzhan phyir snying brtse gzhan 'byor lnga tshang zhing / /de lta'i dal brgyad 'byor bcu tshang ba'i rten/ /shin tu rnyed dka' ngan song sa chen gyi/ /rdul bzhin grangs mang de ltos mi'i 'gro ba/ /dkon cing khyad par chos ldan mi yi lus/ /srid mtha' tsam ste de ltar rab nyung bas/ /grangs kyi sgo nas gzhig tshe rnyed par dka'/ /sngon bsags tshul khrims rgyu las dal 'byor lus/ /thob par gsungs pa'i rgyu yi sgo nas dka'/ /dpe ni mtsho dbus g.yengs pa'i gnya' shing gi/ /bu ga gcig par rus sbal mgrin chud ltar/ /chos ldan mi lus shin tu rnyed dka' gsungs/ /rnyed dkar rnyed der dgos pa ci yod na/ /gnas skabs mtho ris dpal dang phun tshogs kun/ /sgrub nus ma zad nyan rang myang 'das dang / /bla med sangs rgyas sgrub nus rten gyi mchog /'di ma thob na thar pa lta ci smos/ /mngon mtho'i go 'phang tsam yang 'grub par dka'/ /khyad par gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i rten/ khams drug ldan pa'i mi lus kho nas 'grub/ /de phyir lha bas lhag pa'i lus zhes bya/ /'di nyid thob nas dam chos ma sgrub na/ /rin chen gling nas stong log byas pa bzhin/ /phyis nas gar skyes bdag la gtad so ci/ /tshul de bsam nas snying la rus pa bcug /'byongs pa'i tshad ni dkon pa'i 'du shes kyi/ /'phongs pas gter rnyed bzhin tu dga' ba'i blo/ /tshad med ma skyes bar tu nan tan sgom/ /de ltar bshad 'dis dal rten gru chen gyis/ /rab 'jigs 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mtsho sgral nas/ /rnam grol rin chen gling du don gnyis kyi/ /nor bu'i dpal la 'bad 464

med spyod par shog /de nas 'chi ba mi rtag sgom pa ni/ /nam zhig 'chi snyams blo de mtha' 'khob kyi/ /kla klo tshun la 'byung mdo re zhig la/ /mi 'chi'i blo ngan des sgrib tshe 'di yi/ /rnam g.yeng ma shor dam chos phyir shol lus/ /de phyir mi rtag sgom dgos 'di ltar bsam/ /rnyed dka'i dal 'byor de nyid thob zin kyang / /gtan du sdod pa'i nges med mtho ris dang / /ngan song gnas lus grogs dang bde sdug gi/ /'bras bu gang la spyad kyang 'chi ba las/ /ma 'das sa steng 'gro ba sngar byung dang / /'byung 'gyur da lta yod pa 'di dag kun/ /'chi bar nges shing rang re btsas nas kyang / /dgra gnyen bar mi 'gro ba ji tsam shi/ /de nas bdag la mi 'chi'i gdengs ci yod/ /mdo las/ 'byung dang 'byung bar gyur pa ji snyed pa/ /kun gyi lus 'di btang nas 'gro ba dang / /de kun 'jigs par mkhas pas rtogs bgyi ste/ /chos la gnas bgyi nges par spyad pa spyod/ /slob spring las/ gang du phyin kyang 'chi bas mi tshugs pa'i/ /sa phyogs de ni gang na'ang yod min te/ /nam mkha' la med rgya mtsho'i gting na'ang med/ /ri bo kun gyi phugs su zhugs kyang med/ /tshe la bsnon pa med cing 'grib pa can/ /skad cig res kyang 'chi la je nyer 'gro/ /bdag ni gzhon dus chos la blo ma 'gul/ /don med gyis 'das rgan nas lus sems kyi/ /stobs sgrub lo byas kyang bskyed mi thon no/ /bar 'dir gnyid dang rnam g.yengs sna tshogs kyis/ /dbang po tshe 'di'i phun tshogs bslu brid kun/ /gnyid thun gcig gi rmi lam bde ba bzhin/ /mi rtag don chung tshe 'di'i rnam g.yengs spangs/ /de yang re shig mi 'chi snyams pa na/ /spyir yang sgra mi snyan pa ma gtogs pa/ /'gro ba gzhan gyi tshe la nges pa med/ /khyad par 'dzam gling tshe la nges med de/ /dang por dpag med thub mod phyi ma'i dus/ /lo bcu ring mtha' byed dgos da lta yang / /rgan gzhon bar ma'i go rim nges med 'chi/ /gal te legs byas mthu yis ring po'i tshe/ /'tsho ba'i las kyis 'phen pa yod srid kyang / /da snga phan chad lo grangs de tsam 'das/ /de dag dgung nyi'i grib so yol dang mtshungs/ /mi yi 'gro ba glo bur 'chi ba 'ga'/ /mthong tshe rang yang de bas ma 'das bsam/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ tshe 'di mi rtag 'jim pa'i bum pa 'dra/ /sang dang 'jig rten phyi ma'i snang ba gnyis/ /sngon la gong 'ong nges pa med pas na/ /de ring nyid nas dam pa'i chos mdzod cig /klus tshe 'dir gnod mang rlung gis btab pa yi/ /chu yi chu bur bas kyang mi rtag na/ /dbugs dbyung dbugs rngub gnyid kyis log pa las/ /sad khom gang lags de ni ngo mtshar che zhes gsungs/ rgyal sras pas/ de ring tsam mi 'chi ba'i gdengs med kyang / /gtan du sdod grab byed pa'i ngang ring po zhes gsungs/ /lus ni chu yi chu bur ltar nyams nyung / /dbugs ni ston ka'i na bun yal dang 'dra/ /rang dbang ma thob sems ni gar 'gro'i brdol/ /me 'chi'i dmus long thang 465

la 'khyams dang mtshungs/ /'chi ba'i rkyen mang rlung nang mar me ltar/ /phyi rkyen dgra dang dud 'gro gdon bgegs kyi/ /'tsho dang me chu g.yangs sa lhung ba'i gdon/ /nang rkyen nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi dang //'tsho rkyen re ba'i zas gos sman sogs kyang / /spyod lam log pas 'chi ba'i rkyen dag tu/ /mi 'gyur nges pa med phyir 'chi rkyen ni/ /bu yugs 'tshub pa lta bu'i dbus su bdag /gnas phyir nam 'chi cha med de bsam nas/ /yengs med brtson pa'i lcags kyis rab tu bskul/ /klus mgo'am gos la glo bur me shor na/ /de dag bzlog slad bgyi ba btang nas kyang / /yang srid med par bgyid slad 'bad 'tshal te/ /de bas ches mchog dgos pa gzhan ma mchis gsungs/ bdag ni 'chi ba'i gnas skabs mngon gyur tshe/ /dam chos ma gtogs cis kyang mi phan te/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i sha dang rus pa 'bral/ /bsags pa'i nor rdzas mang yang khyer dbang med/ /gnyen bshes gdung bas bskor kyang 'gro dbang med/ /btsan po'i mkhar la 'khras dang dpa' bo yi/ /dpung gis 'thab pas mi thub zas nor gyis/ /mi bslus shed stobs rigs sngags kyis mi bzlog /tshe 'di'i phun tshogs rnams dang rab bral nas/ /rgyus med yul du sa tshugs med pa ru/ /dkar nag las kyi bkul nas gcig pur 'gro/ /tshul de bsam nas rang dbang yod dus 'dir/ /shes ldan yod na snying la rus pa chug /don chung tshe 'di'i 'dun ma rgyab tu skyur/ /gcig tu phan pa dam pa'i lha chos sgrub/ /de ltar mi rtag nan tan sgom pa yis/ /'byongs pa'i tshad ni yongs med rgyud la skyes/ /tshe 'di'i phun tshogs dpal 'byor gnyen bshes la/ /mngon zhen ma chung bar du 'bad pa'i sgom/ /de ltar bshad pa'i dge ba rnga chen sgras/ /'gro kun ma rig gnyid las rab sad de/ /mi rtag chos kyi sgra chen 'di thos nas/ /'chi ba snying zug brtson 'grus mthar phyin shog/de nas 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs sgom pa ni/ /blo kha nang du bkug ste 'di ltar bsam/ /shi nas cang med mi 'gro dkar nag gi/ /las kyi 'phen pa'i skye ba len dgos te/ /sngon bsags dbang gis mtho ris ngan song du/ /skye las bdag la rang dbang ma mchis pas/ /mi dge'i las kyis ngan 'gror skyes gyuran/ /tsha grang bkres sgom glen lkug dag gis mnar/ /de las dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal 'di ltar bsam/ /tsha dmyal lcags bsregs sa gzhi ri rong can/ /ngom grog me lce khru gang rtag tu 'bar/ /zangs zhun dag dang 'gyur byed khu ba 'bab/ /lcags sdong me 'bar gtams gdug pa'i bya/ /gcan gzan mi bsrun gshed du mas gang / /lcags bsregs rtsigs pa rab 'jigs me 'obs kyis/ /kun nas yongs bskor bskal pa'i me las tsha/ /de bas 'og ma bzhi 'gyur nyid kyi tsha/ /der skyes las bsags bar do'i sems can rnams/ /char rlung gis ded grang bas nyams thag nas/ /tsha dmyal gnas mthong dro bar sred pas rgyug /der tshud skad cig gnyid sad ltar du skye/ /rig pa tshor ngas skyon zhing lus 'jam mnyen/ / 466

lus sems gnyis dka'i cha nas bzod sran chung / /de yi stabs kyis sdug bsngal lhag pa che/ /yang sos ma nyams phan tshun dgra'i 'du shes/ /skye ba'i mdo la las ngan dbang gis ni/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs lag byung gcig gis gcig /zhe sdang dbang gis bsnun ris byas pa las/ /shin tu sdug bsngal brgyal zhing sa la 'gyel/ /mkha' las yongs sos sgra ru grag pa'am/ /rlung phog slar sos sngar bzhin sdug bsngal myong / /thig nag lus la dmyal bsrung rnams kyis thig /bzhi dang brgyad la sogs pa btab pa'i steng / /sog le sta re la sogs mtshon rnon pos/ /'bral dang gshog gcod sdug bsngal bsam mi khyab/ /bsdus 'joms pa rnams gcig tu 'dus pa na/ /dmyal bsrung gshin rje gtum pos lcags kyi ri/ /ra lug stag seng dgong can bar du 'thag /lcags kyi tho gtun pha bong chen po yis/ /'chir dang brdung bas sdug bsngal pha mtha' yas/ /ngu 'bod 'jigs skrag gis bros lcags khang mthong / /phyin ma thag tu sgo zums phyi nang kun/ /rab 'bar tsha zhing bsregs nas ngu 'bod sgras/ /rab 'bod skyabs bral sdug bsngal drag po'i gzer/ /ngu 'bod chen po gzhan rnams snga ma bzhin/ /lcags khang gnyis rim du tshud rab sdug bsngal/ /tsha ba sa rnams lcags kyi phru ba ni/ /dpag tshad du ma yod pa me 'bar ba'i/ /nang du nya bzhin bsreg cing 'bar ba yi/ /lcags kyi gsal shing dag gis bshang lam nas/ /spyi bor phug pas nang khrol thams cad 'tshig /ba spu'i khung bu kun nas me lce 'bar/ /lcags bsreg sa gzhi la bsgyel tho bas brdungs/ /rab tu tsha ba sa rnams gsal shing ni/ /rtse mo gsum pa me 'bar dag gis 'bigs/ /lcags kyi leb las lus dkri zangs lcags kyi/ /'gyur byed khol ma'i nang du spyi tshugs su/ /'bras bzhin rab 'tshe lhag ma keng rus su/ /lus pa lcags bsregs gzhir bkram sha khrag skye/ /slar 'tshed sdug bsngal drag po'i rab tu gdung / /mnar med pa rnams lcags kyi sa gzhi las/ /phyogs kun mer 'bar pags pa sha rus pa/ /bsreg cing mar me'i snying po ji bzhin tu/ /lus dang me lce dbyer mi phyed par 'bar /smre sngags 'byin las sems can yod par shes/ /lcags kyi sla ngar rngod dang lcags bsregs kyi/ /ri la 'bab 'dzeg byed 'jug lce phyung ste/ /lcags bsregs sa brgyangs nas phur pas 'debs/ /pags bshus rab 'bar sa gzhir gan bsgyel/ /kha phye lcags kyi tho lum zangs zhun blud/ /nang khrol tshig ste ro smad nas phyir thon/ /sdug bsngal bzod dka' yun ring des drag kyang / /ji srid mi dge de zad ma gyur bar/ /de srid srog dang bral bar mi 'gyur ro/ /tshe tshad mi rnams kyi lo lnga bcu la/ /rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i gnas kyi nyin zhag gcig /rtsis pa'i rang lo lnga brgya de'i tshe tshad/ /de nyid yang sos zhag gcig tu byas pa'i/ /rang lo lnga brgya yang sos tshe yi tshad/ /'og ma rim bzhin gong ma'i zhag lo'i grangs/ /bzhi 'gyur 'phel bas gong ma gong ma yi/ /bzhi 'gyur 'og ma 'og mar shes par bya/ /grang dmyal gnas kyi 467

khyad par nyi zla yi/ /snang ba med pa gangs khrod 'khyag pa'i sbub/ /gcong rong rlung dang bu yug rab 'tshub pa'i/ /shin tu grang ba'i gnas su lus ngag gi/ /sgra don mthun par gong la gong ma las/ /'og ma 'og ma bdun 'gyur dag gi grang / /der skyes bar do me nang 'tshig pa yi/ /snang shar tshe grang dmyal ba nas mthong nas/ /de la sred pas rgyug nas de ru skyes/ /sdug bsngal grang grag lus la chu bur 'byung / /de brdol de nang skyes pa'i lcags kyi 'bu/ /mchu rnon dag gis pags 'dral zhag chu ser/ /'dzag pa 'khyag par 'gro bas rab tu sdug /a chu zer zhing smre ngag nib sor 'don/ /grang ches de'i sgra nyams kye hud sgrog /so tham byed las ngag gis skad mi thon/ /pags pa sngon po gyur te lnga'am drug /gas pa ut+pal ltar gyis sngo ba las/ /dmar po gyur nas bcur gas pad+ma ltar/ /gyes pa zhes bya shin tu grang ba yi/ /mthar thug rab dmar brgya'am stong dag tu/ /gas pa pad+ma ltar chen gyes pa zhes/ /rab tu grang ba'i sdug bsngal bzod par dka'/ /tshe tshad ma ga ta'i khal brgyad bcu/ /shong ba'i snod sbyangs til gyis byur bur bkang / /lo brgyar til 'bru re phyung zad pa na/ /chu bur can gyi tshe tshad 'og ma rnams/ /nyi shu 'gyur gyi 'gros brtsis dus ring por/ /grang bas nyen pas shin tu rab sdug bsngal/ /nye 'khor tsha dmyal brgyad kyi phyogs bzhi ru/ /me mar mus nub nang tshud sha pags tshig /bteg tshe slar 'tsho de las thar na yang / /ro myags 'di rdzas shin tu dri nga bar/ /mus bying srin bu mchu rnon dag gis phug /de las thar tshe spu gri so rnon gyi/ /lam sleb rkang pa dum bur gcod cing 'thor/ /tshal sngon mthong nas der rgyug rlung langs nas/ /yal ga ral grir gyur nas char du babs/ /lus gcod 'gyel tshe ma dur khyi yi za/ /de las thar snang skyes tshe gcan gzan gyis/ /dad nas lcags kyi shal ma mi'i sdong por/ /'bab 'dzeg byed cing lcags kyi tsher rnon gyis/ /khrol tshags bzhin phugs lcags mchu can gyis byas/ /mig 'bru sha 'thogs de las thar na yang / /chu rlung 'bab mthong phyin pas zhun khol gyi/ /chu bo rab tu tsha ba'i nang du lhung / /gting du bying nas rus pa dkar seng 'gro/ /steng thon sha skyes slar nub 'bros 'dod tshe/ /dmyal bsrung gtum po mtshon thog 'jigs rung gis/ /'bros su mi ster gzigs skrag sngangs shing sdug /nyi che'i gnas ni dmyal ba'i nye 'khor dang / /rgya mtsho'i 'gram sogs ma nges sna tshogs su/ /sdug bsngal gang rung res gdung tshe tshad la/ /nges med gro bzhin skyes sogs rtogs brjod las/ /'byung ba ji bzhin bde sdug 'gyur bas mnar/ /de ltar sems can dmyal bar skye bar skye ba'i las/ /zhe sdang dbang gis gsod gcod brdeg rtags sogs/ /sdig pas tshe 'dir bde bas ci zhig bya/ /bshes sprin las/ sdig can dbugs 'byung 'gag pa tsam zhig gis/ /dus kyi bar du chod rnams dmyal ba yi/ /sdug bsngal gzhal pas thos rnams stong du/ /mi 'jigs gang lags rdo rje rang bzhin no/ /dmyal ba bris pa mthong dang 468

thos pa dang / /dran dang bklag dang gzugs su bgyis rnams kyang / /'jigs par skye bar 'gyur na mi bzad pa'i/ /rnam smin nyams su myong rnams smos ci 'tshal/ /'di na nyin gcig mdung thung sum brgya yis/ /rab tu drag btab sdug bsngal gang yin pa/ /des ni dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal chung ngu la'ang / /'ol yang mi 'chi char yang mi phod do/ /de nas yi dwags sdug bsngal bsam pa la/ /gnas ni 'dzam gling 'di'i 'og dpag tshad ni/ /lnga brgya 'das par yi dwags grong khyer na/ /phal cher gnas shing kha 'thor mi yul sogs/ /nges med gnas su khyab pa'i tshul du yod/ /rigs ni so drug la sogs mang bshad kyang / /bsdu na gsum 'dus phyi yi sgrib pa can/ /bkres skom gyis nyen kha dang lus thams cad/ /ske ring mgrin pa yan lag rab tu phra/ /skra 'dzing zas skom 'tshol phyir rab rgyug kyang / /mi rked gal lte rgyang ring ljon 'bras dang / /zas kyi phung po chu rlung sogs mthong yang / /phyin tshe zas yal chu rlung rnag khrag dang / /ljon shing 'bras bu med pa'i sdong sdum mthong / /de ltar ma song na'ang skyes bu ni/ /mtshon thogs du mas bsrung nas spyad dbang med/ /nang gi sgrib can kha mig tsam gyi kha/ /lto ba ri yi ltos tsam zas dang skom/ /cung zad rnyed kyang kha ru tshud dka' zhing / /tshud kyang 'gram phugs su stor skom rnams ni/ /kha yi dug gyis skam zhing mgrin pa nas/ /mi thar nyung ngu thar yang lto che bas/ /mi 'grang bkres pas sdug bsngal dag gis gzir/ /zas skom grib can bza' btung khong song tshad/ /mer 'bar nang khrol tshig cing mi gtsang bar/ /bshang gci rnag khrag dug sogs kha zas gyis/ /sdug bsngal bskyed pa za dgos yi dwags spyi/ /bkres skom sdug bsngal bzod klag med pa'i steng / /gos bral tshad sang gdung zhing grang bas ngal/ /sos ka zla bas bsregs shing dgun nyi las/ /grang bar byed la dbyar ni char sprin kyang / /'di la me char du 'bab dus tshig log /rtag tu 'tshol 'gros gyis ngal nyams srog chung / /phan tshun dgrar gyur 'chings bdeg gsod pas 'jigs/ /gtad med 'jigs sngangs sdug bsngal ni/ /dos drag yun ring myong dgos tshe yi tshad/ /mi yi zla ba zhag gcig tu brtsis pa'i/ /rang lo lnga brgya thub cing kha cig ni/ /lnga stong dag dang khrir yang 'chi mi 'gyur/ /de 'dra'i sdug bsngal ser sna 'jur gegs sogs/ /'dod chags las kyis bskyed pas bsgrims te spang / /dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal bsam bying gnas ni/ /rgya mtsho chen po na yod skyob pa yi/ /rten dang gnas med chu rlabs kyis 'das te/ /nges med du 'khyams phan tshun gcig gis gcig /za zhing che bas chung ba mid pa dang / /chung ba mang pos che ba'i lus phug za/ /klu rnams bye tshan char gyis nyin re bzhin/ /rab bsreg mkha' lding gis za dus rtag tu/ /dgra byung dogs pas 'jigs skrag dag gis mnar/ /kha 'thor mi yul yod pa 'di dag kyang / /gzhan gyis gtsos pa'i sdug bsngal bzod dka' ste/ /bshes spring las/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas na gsod pa dang / /'ching dang 469

brdeg sogs sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong / /zhi 'gyur dge ba spang ba rnams la ni/ /gcig la gcig za shin tu mi bzad 'byung / /kha ci mu tig bcas dang rus pa grag /sha dang pags pa'i ched du 'chi bar 'gyur/ /dbang med gzhan dag rdog pa lag pa dang / /lcag dang lcags kyu rnams kyis btab te bkol/ /tshe tshad ring nos bskal pa thung ngu ni/ /ma nges sna tshogs mdo la dud 'gro spyi/ /glan cing gti mug bkres skom ngal dub kyis/ /yi dwags dang mtshungs sdug bsngal rab myong ste/ /der skyes las ni gti mug dag gis/ /kun slong mi dge spyad las dud 'gror ltung / /de ltar ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal bsam pa na/ /me na mdzub mo bcug dang dgun dus su/ /gcer bur bsdad cing nyin zhag kha shas su/ /zas bral lus la 'byi shig sa btab tsam/ /bzod par bka' na dmyal ba yi dwags dang / /dud 'gror skyes tshe sdug bsngal ji ltar bzod/ /snyams du da lta'i rang nyams la dpag nas/ /'jigs skrag skyo shas nges 'byung drag po yis/ /bskul nas dal 'byor don yod dge la spyod/ /mtho ris skyes kyang bde ba'i skabs med de/ /bsod nams cha mthun dge ba'i las lam gyis/ /chung 'bring chen po bsags las mngon mtho yi/ /mi dang 'dod lha bsam gtan gzugs med kyi/ /lhar skye de dang de yi gnas skabs kyi/ /bde 'bras spyod du yod pas chog snyam nas/ /lha mir skye ba'i thabs la 'bad gyur kyang / /'khor ba thams cad sdug bsngal rang bzhin yin/ /snying po med cing mi rtag 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /mtho ris dag na'ang bde ba 'ga' med do/ /de la mi yi sdug bsngal bsam pa ni/ /skyes tshe ma yi mngal dog mun nag cing / /dri dang mi gtsang tsha grang 'gyur ldog gis/ /bzod pa'i gnas der zla ba bgrang nas sdod/ /de nas mgo mjug ldog te 'gyur mig nas/ /gu drangs pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal reg pa na/ /tsher lcags brab 'dra lag tu blang pa na/ /bye'u khras khyer lta bu'i 'jigs skrag myong / /rgas tshe mdog nyams lus kyi mdang mi sdug /mdog dkar dbang po'i bkrag shor lus dbyibs nyams/ /so gog lus sgur yan lag rab tu 'khyogs/ /sha skam pags lhod gdong byad gnyer mas gang / /stobs nyams sdang dka' 'gro na gom pa 'khyor/ /'dug na bub cing smra ba ldab ldib 'gyur/ /dbang po'i rten nyams mig 'grib rna ba 'on/ /longs spyod nyams pas kha zas nyung na bkres/ /mang na mi 'ju 'dod yon spyad du med/ /kun gyis sdang zhing sngon las 'phral rkyen gyis/ /'byung 'khrugs nad kyis btab tshe zug rngus mnar/ /lus rgyud gnyid dang bza' btung spyad dbang med/ /mi 'dod sman dpyad bstan cing 'chi dogs pa'i/ /sdug bsngal mtha' med myong zhing zug zer gyis/ /tshabs cher gdung tshe 'chi smon kho na 'debs/ /ngan song skyes 'dre'i sdug bsngal bzod par dka'/ /'chi tshe sman dpyad rim gros la bslus par/ /gnam sa 'gre ldog 'chi bdag gis zin tshe/ /yun ting 'grogs pa'i mdza' bshes so sor 'bral/ /'bad pas sgrub pa'i nor rdzas shul 470

du lus/ /lus kyi mgron khang rnam shes mgron pos 'bor/ /ma du gnyen bshes brtse ba'i mtha' bskor kyang / /srog chad sdug bsngal rang nyid gcig pu yis/ /myong nas 'jig rten pha rol nyid du 'gro/ /de ltar skye rga na 'chi sdug bsngal bzhi/ /spyi khyab myong dgos ma zad bye brag gi/ /bzhi po de nyid shas chung bar skabs su/ /tshe 'di'i dpal 'byor phra mo sgrub pa'i tshe/ /lus srog brdos nas sgrub kyang ma 'grub pas/ /sdug bsngal tsha grang bkres skom dgra 'dre sogs/ /mi sdug dang 'phrad gnyen bshes 'dza' grogs dang / /longs spyod 'khor 'das 'byor bral dag gis sdug /'byor ldan bsrung dang dbul po 'tshol ba yis/ /sdug bsngal gyis mnar mngon du gyur 'di'o/ /lha min lha yi phun sun tshogs pa'i dpal/ /mthong bas phrag dog yid la mi bzod pa'i/ /gdung bas rab mnar lha dang 'thab pa las/ /lha min bsod nams mthu chung gsod pa dang / /'ching brdeg yan lag gcod 'dral sdug bsngal myong / /lha rnams mgo dang rkad pa ma chad na/ /gnad du phog kyang lhar 'tsho lha min rnams/ /gnad du phog tshe 'chi la de'i gzugs brnyan/ /kun snang mtshor shar dmag ma bdog pa yi/ /gong nas nye du mya ngan drag pos gdung / /lha min phal cher chos la mi dga' zhing / /gal ste gos kyang rnam smin sgrib pa yis/ /khyad par rtogs pa'i skal ba ches cher phra/ /'dod khams lha rnams bag med 'dod yon la/ /spyad pas brid de tshe zad ma tshor bar/ /'chi tshe lus kyi mdog mi sdug pa dang / /stan la mi dga' me tog phreng ba snying / /gos la dri ma nag po dag gis bgos/ /lus la sngon med rngul 'byung 'chi ltas lnga/ /lha yi zhag bdun gong 'byung 'chi ltung gi/ /sdug bsngal dos drag yun ring de yi tshe/ /rang gi lha mo 'khor rnams kyis spangs nas/ /lha gzhan drung song rgyu des yid la ni/ /mi bde'i zug rngu cher spyad khyad par du/ /lha yi dpal la yid ni rab 'phring yang / /dbang med 'bral bar shes shing shi ba'i rjes/ /lhar skye srid mtha' tsam ste mi nyid du'ang / /skyes pa cher dkon phar cher ngan song du/ /skyes nas sdug bsngal bzod dka' yun ring por/ /myong bar shes phyir 'chi ltung sdug bsngal ni/ /dmyal bar skyes pa'i lus can dag la 'gran/ /gzhan yang bsod nams che ba'i dpal mthong nas/ /chung ba bag 'khums mthu ches chung ba rnams/ /gnas nas skrod cing rgyal chen rigs bzhi dang / /sum rtsen pa rnams lha min dang 'thab las 'chi dang smas pa'i sdug bsngal dag gis mnar/ /de phyir 'dod lha'i bde bar thar pa yi/ /go 'phang gnyer rnams chags par mi rigs te/ /brgya byin 'jig rten mchod 'os gyur nas kyang / /slar yang las kyi dbang gis sa steng lhung / /bsam gzugs lha la sdug bsngal mngon gyur ba/ /med kyang khyab pa 'du byed sdug bsngal las/ /ma 'das bdag rtog bag nyal ma spangs gsungasakyang / /ting 'dzin gyis myos chang gi ra ro bzhin/ /gyur phyir so skyer yon tan gong 'phel med/ /ting 'dzin ror chags de dang bral mi phod/ /'dod chags 471

bral ba'i bde thob de yi las/ /zad tshe gnam la 'phangs pa'i mda' bzhin tu/ /slar yang 'dod khams skyes nas bde sdug gi/ /tshe bas gdung phyir bsam gtan gzugs med lha'i/ /go 'phang dag la'ang yid brtan 'gags med de/ /klutshangs nyid tshang bral bde ba thob nas slar/ /mnar med me yi bud shing gyur pa yi/ /sdug bsngal rgyun mi chad par bsten 'tshal lo/ /de phyir me ba'i rang bzhin tsha ba las/ /ma 'das de bzhin khams gsum 'khor ba 'di/ /sdug bsngal gsum dang brgyad kyi rab tu mnar/ /gnas grogs longs spyod thams cad sdug bsngal gyi/ /yo lang mi gtsang ba la dri zhim nyid/ /med bzhin 'gror lngar bde ba'i go skabs bral/ /de yang rgyu 'bras gnyis la 'khor longs spyod/ /phun sum tshogs kyang mi dge spyod pa rgyu/ /'bras bu ngan song gsum dang mtho ris su/ /skyes kyang nad sogs duḥkhās mnar ba rnams/ /bsdu na sdug bsngal 'gyur dang 'du byed gsum/ /dang po rma khar dug btab lta bu ste/ /gtso bor ngan song gsum na shas cher myong / /gnyis pa grang tshe me la brten pa bzhin/ /tshang dang longs spyod bsam gtan bde ba tshun/ /tshor ba bde ba dag kyang mi brtan phyir/ /bag ma bsu nyin khang pa rdib pa bzhin/ /mi dang 'dod lha gyur pa'i zug rngu'i gdungs/ /gsum pa skom nad can la lan tshwa'i chu/ /'thung bzhin sdug bsngal gong ma gnyis kyi rgyu/ /'du byed nye bar len pa'i phung po 'di/ /sdug bsngal kun gyi gzhir gnas 'di las ni/ /skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal rim bzhin 'byung / /gang 'di tshor ba btang snyoms kho na dang / /ldan tshe 'du byed sdug bsngal dag tu brjod/ /gtso bor bsam gzugs lha de gang de nyid/ /so skyes sdug bsngal mi mthong 'phags pa yis/ /sdug bsngal du gzigs lag mthil spu nyag gis/ /zug rngu mi bskyed mig gis nang song na/ /gdung ba bskyed bzhin so skye lag mthil 'dra'i/ /'du byed sdug bsngal mi mthong 'phags pa ni/ /mig 'dras 'du byed sdug bsngal nyid du gzigs/ /'di las ma thar sdug bsngal gzhan gnyis las/ /mi thar shing sdong rtsa ba ma phyungs na/ /lo 'dab bcad kyang lhar skye dag dang mtshungs/ /de ltar srid bde lha ma'i dpal 'byor la/ /zhen log ma skyes bar du tshul 'di sgom/ /'byongs pa'i tshad ni 'khor ba'i phun tshogs la/ /skyug nad can gyi zas bzhin dgos med skye/ /de skad bshad pa'i legs byas gaṅga'i chus/ /'gro rgyud 'khor bar zhen pa'i dri ma'i tshogs/ /rab skrus srid la dga' ba'i blo spangs te/ /bcos min yid 'byung thar pa'i lam zhugs shog /de nas las 'bras smin tshul bsam pa ni/ /dge ba'i las kyi 'bras bu bde ba dang / /mi dge'i las kyi 'bras bu sdug bsngal bskyed/ /de phyir snga ma'i las gtso da lta ni/ /bdag gis bde las sdug bsngal mi 'dod kyang / /las kyi dbang las bdag la gdam dbang med/ /dkar nag las 'bral so so smin pa'i tshul/ /bsam mi khyab phyir rgyu dus chung ngu yang / /'bras bu chen po 'byung ba nas la sogs/ / 472

'bru yi sa bon ches cher 'phel ba bzhin/ /rang gi bsags pa'i las gang byed pa po/ /ma gtogs gzhan la mi smin de yang ni/ /gnyen pos ma bcom de srid chud mi za/ /tshul de bsam nas mi dge cha bcas spangs/ /dug gsum ma sogs rtsa nyon nye nyon gyis/ /kun slong sgo gsum nyes par spyod pa ste/ /su yis spyad kyang sdig par 'gyur ba la/ /rang bzhin kha na ma tho ba zhes brjod/ /nyon mongs kyis bskyed khas blangs sdom pa dang / /'gal la bcas pa'i kha na ma tho zhes/ /rnam grangs mang mod skabs 'dir che long tsam/ /las lam bcur mu gsungs phyir de 'chad pa/ /srog gcod bsad bya ma nor bsam bzhin bsad/ /gzhan gyi nor la bdag pos ma byin rku/ /'dod log gzhan gyis bdag bzung bud med spyod/ /rdzun smra shes bzhin pha rol bslu ba'i tshig /phra man mthun gnyis 'byed phyir dkrugs tshig sems smras/ /tshig rtsub pha rol zher 'debs spyod pa'i ngag /ngag 'khyal bstan bcos ngan dang sre mo'i gtam/ /rnal 'byor gzhan gyi 'byor pa dpal la skam/ /gnod sems gzhan la zhe 'gras mnar ba'i blo/ /log lta las 'bras chad lta dkon cog spangs/ /'di dag las lam rdzogs la shin tu lci/ /phyogs mthun rnams kyang dug bzhin spangs ba gces/ /ma spangs rnam smin kun slong drag zhan gyi/ /dbang gi dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro ltung / /tsha grang bkres skom glen lkug sdug bsngal myong / /myong ba rgyu mthun bsang ba'i tshe thung la/ /rkus pas nor dbul log g.yem dgra dang 'phrad/ /rdzun gyis yi kha sdang zhing phra ma yis/ /grogs dang 'khon la tshig rtsub mi snyan thos/ /ngag 'khyal ngag mi btsan zhing brnab sems kyis/ /re 'bras mi 'grub gnod sems 'jigs pa bskyed/ /log ltas blun cing gti mug lkug par 'gyur/ /byed pa rgyu mthun sngar gyi mas 'phro yis/ /mi dge spyod la rab dga' sdig la rngam/ /bdag 'bras phyi rol yul la smin 'gyur te/ /srog gcod las kyis 'bru dang sman mthu chung / /kun gyis lo nyes 'dod log gis sa phyogs/ /rdul dang kha char na bun dag gis gtibs/ /rdzun gyis dri dang mi gtsang dag gis gang / /phra mas g.yang sa rad rod can du 'gyur/ /tshig rtsub thang skya tsher ma tsha sgo can/ /kyal pas dus tshig log cing tshul min 'gyur/ /brnab sems 'bru phra ba dang ngan pa dang / /gnod sems ro bcud bzang po ngan par 'gyur/ /log ltas zug rngu nas bzung gtan med 'gyur/ /de ltar rgyu mthun bdag po'i 'bras bu rnams/ /skye ba 'di dang phyi ma'i gnas skabs 'gar/ /ma nges 'byung la gzhan yang ches lci ba'i/ /pha ma dgra bcom pas dang dge 'dun dbyen/ /bde gshegs sku la ngan sems khrag phyung ba/ /tshe 'di nyid dang dmyal bar skye ba la/ /bar mtshams med phyir mtshams med ces su grags/ /de yi phyogs mthun nye ba'i mtshams med lnga/ /dang po sems bskyed byang sems slob dpon gsod/ /dge slong ma log zhugs mchod rten bshig /dge 'dun 'du sgo 'phrog sogs shin tu lci/ /bcas pa'i kha na ma tho zhes pa ni/ / 473

sdom gsum gang blangs bcas 'gal nyes pa rnams/ /yin la tshe 'di'i chags sdang dag gi phyir/ /slob dpon chen po/ sdig pas tshe 'dir bde bas ci zhig bya/ /tshe 'di yun thung lo zla 'ga' zhig yin/ /'jig rten phyi mar tshad bzung med pa'i phyir/ /skye ba gzhan du sdug bsngal mi 'byung ba'i/ /bde ba'i thabs su dge sdig blang dor gces/ /dge ba chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong sogs/ /thar pa'i go 'phang sgrub byed lam gyi chos/ /bsam mi khyab kyang sngar bstan mi dge bcu/ /spong sems lus ngag dag gis slar log pa'i/ /spyod lam rang bcas dge ba bcu yin la/ /lus ngag las bdun gnyis ka tshang dgos la/ /yid kyis las gsum yid kyis spangs pas mthus/ /spong sems dran shes ma 'khrul sdig pa yi/ /gnyen por gyur pa tshul khrims ngo bo yin/ /de ltar dge ba bcu la legs gnas shing / /de las gzhan yang phyag bskor mchod pa dang / /bzlas brjod chos kyi gtam smra dge ba yi/ /kun slong lus ngag bya spyod dge ba'i las/ /yid kyi dad gus nges 'byung byams snying rje/ /byang chub sems gnyis sgom dgos bsod nams dang / /ye shes tshogs gnyis bsags la gcig tu 'bad/ /rnam smin gnyis las bsod nams cha mthun gyis/ /yul dang kun slong dbang las chen po yis/ /bsam gzugs dbang gis 'dod lha chung ngus mir/ /skye zhing bsam pa ma dag pa'i dge bas/ /lha ma yin du skye ba mdo las gsungs/ /thar pa cha mthun sbyor ba byang chub sems/ /dngos gzhi 'khor gsum dmigs med shes rab dang / /rjes la bsngo bas zin pa'i dge ba yis/ /bsod nams tshogs kyis sangs rgyas gzugs sku dang / /ye shes tshogs kyi chos sku thob par byed/ /lha mi'i dpal gyi mngon mtho zhar las 'byung / /myong ba rgyu mthun tshe ring 'byor dang ldan/ /dgra yis mi 'tshe gzhan gyis bstod cing bkur/ /grogs mang snyan pa'i gtam thos tshig kyang btsun/ /bsam pa 'grub cing yi bde blo gros 'phel/ /byed pa rgyu mthun las 'phro bzang po'i mthus/ /rtag par sdig spang dge la rnam par spyod/ /bdag 'bras mthu che lo legs nyams dga' zhing / /sa gzhi mtho dman rab snyam zhing sa bzang / /rtswa shing rgyas shing dus tshigs mtho ris ldan/ /'bru bzang ro zhim 'bras bu rab du rgyas/ /mdor na gnas skabs mthar thug bde ba kun/ /dge ba'i las kyi 'bras bur thub pas gsungs/ /za nyal 'chag sogs lung ma bstan gyis las/ /don med mi btang dge sems kyis zin pas/ /gang byed rigs mthun tshig gi smon lam 'debs/ /las 'bras 'gag bsdus bden pa bzhi ru 'du/ /kun 'byung sdug bsngal lo dang 'gog bden bzhi/ /rang 'bras bslu ba med phyir bden pa zhes/ /kun 'byung bde gshegs snying po'i gnas lugs la/ /ma rig gis sgrib nga bdag gzung 'dzin las/ /rtswa nyon nye nyon bdag gis las 'du byas/ /bsod nams bsod nams ma yin mi g.yo ba'i/ /las kyis khams gsum skyes nas bde sdug myong / /de phyir kun 'byung spang byar shes byas nas/ /nyon 474

mongs skyes tshe gnyen pos zin pa gces / /sdug bsngal bden pa'i rgyu ni kun 'byung gis/ /mi dge'i las bsags ngan song rnam gsum dang / /mtho ris skyes kyang 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal gyis/ /rab gdung 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mtha' yin/ /lam bden kun 'byung spang zhing sdug bsngal las/ /rnam grol thar pa'i lam yin de yang ni/ /bdag rkyen bshes gnyen la rten sgrub bya'i lam/ /thabs shes zung 'bral ma nor lam mchog bsten/ /'gog bden 'gog zhing bde gshegs snying po zhes/ /chos nyid dbyings su chos can gzung 'dzin gyi/ /mtshan ma'i spros kun nyer zhing myang 'das thob/ /de nyid dpe yis mtshon na nad bskyed pas/ /zas dang spyod lam bstan pa kun 'byung la/ /nad kyis zug rngus mnar ba sdug bsngal yin/ /de sel sman pa sman la brten pa lam/ /nad med bde bar sor chud 'gog bden ste/ /tshul des rgyu 'bras 'gros kun shes par bya/ /de lta'i sdig spang dge sgrub tshul la 'bad/ /'byongs pa'i tshad ni sdig la dug bzhin lta/ /dge la ngoms tshad med pa'i spro ba skye/ /'di lta'i sngon 'gro gnad du thebs pa na/ /chos kyi gzhi things chos brgyad 'khri ba chod/ /ci byed chos 'gro sgrub pa mtha' ru 'don/ /dngos gzhi'i nyams myong dka' tshegs med par skye/ /de ltar 'gyur med dge dang sdig pa'i 'bras/ /'khyug med lung bzhin rab tu bstan pa 'dis/ /tshad med 'gro rgyud dge tshogs rnam 'phel nas/ /dpag med bzang po'i spyod la 'jug par shog /de nas log pa'i las ldog bya'i phyir/ /dkon mchog skyabs gnas 'tshol dgos skyabs 'gro'i rgyud/ /'khor ba'i 'jigs pas skrag nas sdug bsngal las/ /skyobs phyir dkon mchog skyabs su bstan pa gces/ /gzhan du phyi rol pa rnams tshangs pa dang / /khyab 'jug drag po la sogs mthar thug gi/ /skyabs su bzung nas re ltos 'cha' na yang / /'khor ba'i 'jigs pa mtha' dag skyobs mi nus/ /de phyir dkon mchog skyabs 'gro skyabs yul la/ /rgyu 'bras gnyis las rgyu'i yul gzhan rgyud la/ /byon zin sangs rgyas sogs yin 'bras bu'i yul/ /rang gi sems nyid gdod nas mchog gsum gyi/ /rang bzhin bzhugs pa de nyid mngon gyur phyir/ /rgyu yi skyabs 'gror 'bad cing dge la spyod/ /de la rgyu yi skyabs yul bshad pa ni/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun rnam pa gsum/ /de yis 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad las/ /skyobs par nus shing gnas skabs mngon mtho dang / /mthar thug thar pa bla na med pa la/ /'god par nus pa sangs rgyas dkon mchog ni/ /sku gsum bdag nyid dag pa gnyis ldan pa/ /don gnyis mthar phyin yon tan drug dang ldan/ /de la chos sku'i yon tan rnam pa gsum/ /'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub pa dang / /gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs min gzugs sku'i gsum/ /mkhyen rtse nus mnga' spang rtogs mthar phyin pa/ /chos ni 'gog lam gyis bsdus zag med kyis/ /rnam byang bden pa 475

rtogs pa'i dam chos dang / /de nyid brjod byar ston pa'i gsung rab ni/ /ming tshig yi ger grags pa lung gi chos/ /'gog bden gtso bor ldan pa'i yon tan gsum/ /rtog ges yul 'das bsam du med pa dang / /las dang nyon mongs dag gi dri ma bral/ /rnam rtog dngos yul dag las 'das pa'o/ /lam bden la ldan yon tan rnam gsum ni/ /ngo skal sgrib pa spang nus dag pa dang / /bdag med don nyid rtogs pas gsal ba dang / /mi mthun phyogs 'joms gnyen po'i yon tan no/ /dge 'dun rig grol yon tan drug ldan te/ /rig pa'i yon tan rnam gsum ji ltar dang / /ji snyed nang don rig pa grol ba'i gsum/ /chags thogs gnyis dang dman pa rnam gsum gyi/ /sgrib pa las grol rgyal sras 'phags pa dang / /rjes mthun theg chen tshogs sbyor la gnas dang / /theg dman nyan rang dge sbyong 'bras bu bzhir/ /zhugs gnas gnyis gnyis phye ba'i gang zag brgyad/ /mthar thug skyabs gnas sangs rgyas kho na ste/ /de nyid chos dang dge 'dun kyang yin la/ /yul gyi go 'phang yul can gyis thob tshe/ /dag pa gnyis ldan chos skur rnam dbyer med/ /de ltar spyi khyab dkon mchog gsum gyi steng / /sngags las rtsa ba gsum bsnan drug skor du/ /byed pa bla ma dkon mchog kun 'dus dang / /yi dam sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams/ /dge 'dun la 'du 'on kyang sger du ni/ /rtsal du bton nas skyabs 'gro'i dgos pa ni/ /gsang sngags lam 'dir byin rlabs rtsa ba ni/ /bla ma yin la dngos grub zhu ba'i yul/ /yi dam nyid yin 'phrin las sgrubs pa'i grogs/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong ye shes pa rnams kyis/ /byed phyir rgyu mtshan de yis gtso cher byas/ /de rnams nyid kyis ji ltar skyobs pa'i tshul/ /sangs rgyas ston pa zhu la des bstan pas/ /dam chos nyams su blangs pas 'jigs pa kun/ /thar phyir chos la skyabs dngos dge 'dun la/ /lam sna 'dren pa'i zla grogs tshul gyis zhu/ /sngags su kun go gcig chod bla ma yis/ /mdzad phyir skyabs gnas kun 'dus ngo bo yin/ /mdor na thun mong rgyu yi skyabs 'gro yis/ /thun min 'bras bu'i skyabs 'gro 'grub pa'i rgyu/ /byed pas dkon mchog khas blangs skyabs su bstan/ /ji ltar skyabs su 'gro tshul dngos bshad pa/ /mdun mkhar dpag bsam sdang po'i yal ga ltar/ /dbus su bla ma mdun du dkyil 'khor lha/ /g.yas su sangs rgyas rgyab tu dam pa'i chos/ /g.yon du dge 'dun mtha' bskor mkha' 'gro dang / /chos skyong ye shes pa rnams gsal bar sgom/ /bdag gi mtha' bskor mkha' khyab sems kyis/ /byang nyid rang gis drangs tshul rtse gcig gis/ /mos gus drag pos re ltos ling sgyur gyis/ /som nyi spangs la mgrin gcig gdangs snyan pos/ /skyabs 'gro'i tshig nyid brgya stong la sogs brjod/ /ched du bya ba mkha' khyab sems can rnams/ /skyobs pa'i snying rje chen pos kun bslangs te/ /'di rnams 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las/ /da lta nyid du skyobs par mdzad du gsol/ /skams pas dus ni 476

sangs rgyas ma thob bar/ /skyabs su 'gro zhing thun mthar skyabs yul las/ /'od zer 'phros pas mtha' bskor sems can gyis/ /sdig sgrib sbyangs nas dag pa'i zhing du song / /skyabs yul bdag thim brjod bral ngang du bzhag /dge ba bsngo ba skyabs 'gro'i nyams len te/ /de yang dkon mchog yon tan shes pa dang / /rang gzhan dkon mchog skyabs gnas yin min shes/ /dkon mchog nang gses phan tshun khyad par shes/ /yon tan shes nas skyabs 'gror dam bcas pa/ /skyabs gnas gzhan mi 'tshol ba'i khyad chos bzhi/ /tshang na skyabs 'gro rnam dag nyid du 'gyur/ /de yis nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i gral du/ /tshud cing bslab pa'i gzhi 'dzin yon tan gyi/ /rten du gyur cing phyi nang 'jigs kun sel/ /tshe 'dir 'dod don 'grub cing phyi ma ru/ /mtho ris mthar thug thar pa'i bde ba thob/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu ru 'gyur/ /bslab bya nyin mtshan dus drug skyabs 'gro bzla/ /bla mar skyabs song gshes gnyen la gus shing / /sdig grogs mi bsten sangs rgyas skyabs song nas/ /'jig rten lha la phyag dang skyabs mi 'tshol/ /chos la skyabs song sems can gnod 'tshe spong / /dge 'dun skyabs song mu stegs can dang ni/ /las 'bras skur 'debs log lta'i grogs po spong / /sku gzugs glegs bam la sogs rten rnams la/ /dad pas phyag mchod bya zhing gus pa bskyed/ /'byongs pa'i tshad ni srog dang bya dga' sogs/ /ci la thugs kyang dkon mchog mi spong zhing / /skyid sdug rkyen gyis mi 'phrog blo khel 'byung / /'gyur bcas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal grol nus pas/ /bslu med dkon mchog skyabs su bsten pa'i tshul/ /lung bzhin bstan las dge tshogs gang 'phel des/ /'gro kun bzang po'i skyabs kyis skyong bar shog /de nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa/ /mkha' khyab 'gro la byams dang snying rje ni/ /bcos min gyis bskyed gzhan don sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang thob 'dod rgyu ni ma gyur 'gror/ /rlabs chen byams dang snying rje de'i grogs/ /sems can ma lus khur chen rang nyid kyis/ /khyer ba'i snying stobs lhag bsam dang ldan pas/ /'gro kun sgrol nus sangs rgyas thob 'dod pa'i/ /dbye ba klu sgrub mnga' ri paṇa chen sdom gsum las/ thogs med srol gnyis grags/ /re re'ang gcig nas drug bar gnyis gnyis te/ /dang po stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ /tshogs gnyis bslab pa kun rdzob don dam gnyis/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab bslab gsum dang / /tshogs sbyor mos pas spyod pa'i sems bskyed dang / /ma dag sa kun lhag bsam dag pa dang / /dag pa sa gsum rnam par smin pa dang / /thugs rje chen po sgrib pa spangs pa ni/ /sangs rgyas sa yi sems bskyed dag dang bzhi/ /lnga ni lam lnga drug ni phar phyin drug /sa gser zla ba me sogs nyer gnyis ni/ /sa mtshams kyis phye sa bcu'i bar du'o/ /kun kyang bsdu na smon 'jug rnam pa gnyis/ /kun kyang bsam pas smon dang sbyor bas khyab/ /'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba ji 477

bzhin no/ /dang po sdom pa ma thob thob tshul ni/ /len tshul sdom gnas dge ba'i bshes gnyen la/ /theg chen snod gyur dad ldan slob ma yis/ /yan lag bdun mthar smon 'jug stabs gcig tu/ /len cing rang gzhan dga' ba bsgom pa rnams/ /klu sgrub lugs yin thogs med bzhed pa ni/ /smon sems len la so thar mi dgos kyang / /yang dag blangs pa rigs bdun sngon song nas/ /bar chad dri dang slob pa khas len sogs/ /smon 'jug cho ga so so'i sgo nas len/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la'ang rung ba srol gnyis mthun/ /thob mtshams brjod pa gsum gyi mtha' la'o/ /don dam sems bskyed cho gas blangs thob pa/ /gsang sngags lugs yin mdo las bshad srid na/ /dam bca' nyid yin sgom pa'i stobs las skye/ /nyams len bdag gzhan mnyam dang brje ba gnyis/ /bdag gzhan gnyis ka gces pa mnyam pa yis/ /bdag nyid sangs rgyas thob nas sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas sa la 'god 'dod mnyam pa dang / /brje ba de yi gegs sel bogs 'don te/ /bdag las gzhan gces bdag bde gzhan la ster/ /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bdag gi len pa ste/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste 'di ltar sgom/ /sems can thams cad rang gi tshe rabs kyi/ /drin can pha ma ma gyur 'ga' med de/ /ma yi thug mtha' rgya shug tshig gu tsam/ /ri bur bgrang kun sa yi long mi 'gyur/ /de phyir da lta'i ma 'dis bdag nyid la/ /drin gyis bskyangs bzhin skye gzhan gyi/ /mas kyang de bzhin bskyang phyir drin che snyam/ /byams pas kun nas bslang bzhin ma gyur gyi/ /'gro ba 'di kun bde 'dod sdug bsngal dang / /bral bar 'dod kyang de yi thabs la rmongs/ /sdug bsngal gyis gdung 'gro bar tshad med pa'i/ /snying rje'i blo yis 'di rnams sdug bsngal las/ /drangs nas thar pa bla na med pa yi/ /go 'phang nyid la bdag gis 'god par bya/ /de yis nus pa da lta bdag la med/ /'gro kun sgrol nus rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang thob par bya snyam smon pa dang / /de thob chad du gsang sngags lam zab mo/ /nyams su blang bar bgyi snyam 'jug pa'i sems/ /bskyed la ngag tu sems bskyed tshig phyir du/ /don bsam brgya stong ma sogs ci nus brjod/ /rlung gi ldang 'jug dang sbyar gtong len bya/ /thun mthar yul dang kun slong dmigs med kyi/ /ngang la bzhag pa don dam sems bskyed kyi/ /nyams len yin rjes su bsngo ba bya/ /de la nyams len snying po'i don nyid tshang / /tshad med bzhi po sgos su sgom 'dod na/ /'gro 'di sngar med bde dge gsar pa dang / /'phrad 'dod byams pa 'di rnams da lta la/ /yod pa'i sdug bsngal dang bral de yi rgyu/ /'gog 'dod snying rje da lta'i bde dang / /ldan la spro dga' yi rang gis drangs pa'i/ /yid bde dga' ba de gsum bdag gi rgyus/ /zhe sdang med pa'i mtshungs ldan ma chags pa'i/ /sems kyis khyad par dang ldan btang snyoms so/ /tshad med bzhi po nyon mongs sa bon ni/ /spong byed gnyen po min ces 'ga' smra yang / /byang chub sems dpa' thabs 478

mkhas kyis zin pa'i/ /tshad med bzhi po chos kyi bdag med pa'i/ /rnam pa can min nyon mongs sa bon dang / /bag chags dang bcas 'joms pa'i gnyen po byed/ /bar du mi nyams bshags pa'i thabs bshad pa/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims gsum yin te/ /nyes spyod sdom dang dge ba chos sdud dang / /sems can don byed gsum las dang po ni/ /dkon cog dkor 'phrog dang ni chos spangs las/ /tshul ldan tshul 'chal khrims gcod bslab 'bebs sogs/ /'tshams med las byed log lta lnga rgyal po/ /grong ljongs grong khyer grong brdal yul 'khor rnams/ /'joms par byed pa'ang blon por nges pa lnga/ /ma sbyangs stong nyid brjod sngas nyan thos smon/ /rdzogs byang phyir ldog theg dman sems bskyed 2dang / /so thar spangs nas theg chen slob 3pa dang / /nyan thos theg pas chags sogs mi bzlog pas/ /de bzlog de yi 'bras bu med par byas ri /rnyed dang bkur sti'i ched du bdag 5'tshong dang / /dge slong chad pas gcod 6'jug sug 'bul dang / /spong ba'i longs spyod kha ton pa la byin/ /zhi gnas 'dor bcug phal 'byung nges brgyad/ /de dang 'byung nges bzhag gi kun la kun/ /ming du bco brgyad rjes su bcu bzhi ste/ /smon 'jug sems btang de rnams rtsa ltung yin/ /yan lag nyes byas brgyad cu la sogs pa/ /phra phyir 'dir ni ma bshad bslab btus lta/ /thogs med lugs kyi smon pa'i bslab bya la/ /sems can blos mi btang dang phan yon dran/ /tshogs bsags byang sems sbyangs la brtson pa dang / /dkar nag chos brgyad blang dor smon pa'i yin/ /rnyed bkur lhag zhen bdag bstod gzhan smod dang / /ser sna zang zing nor dang chos mi ster/ /khro bas gzhan 'tsho shad sbyang gis mi ldog /g.yo las chos ltar bcos mos nyon pa bzhi/ /rtsa ltung bzhi ste 'jug pa'i bslab bya'o/ /nyes pa phra ba zhe drug gzhan du shes/ /dge ba chos bsdud phar phyin drug slob ste/ /dbul ba sel phyir chos nor mi 'jigs sbyin/ /spangs ba'i sems kyi tshul khrims rnam gsum spyad/ /khong khro zab mo sdug bsngal bzod par bya/ /go cha dge bsdud gzhan phan brtson 'grus brtsams/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i bsam gtan sgom/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab zab mo spyad/ /sems can don byed tshul khrims bsdu dngos bzhi/ /thog mar sbyin pa'i gdul bya rab bsdus nas/ /nyan par smra ba'i gtam gyis yid rab drangs/ /theg pa rim dgur dkri ba don spyod de/ /de dag 'dren phyir rang yang don de spyod/ /mthun phyogs kun slob mi mthun mtha' dag spangs/ /rtag tu dran dang shes bzhin bag yod bsten/ /'gro 'dug za nyal spyod lam rnam pa bzhi/ /spyod yul yongs su dag pa'i mdo sde ltar/ /gang byed rigs mthun tshig gis smon lam 'debs/ /mkhyen rab dbang phyug klong chen rab 'byams ni/ /smon pa'i bslab bya tshad med bzhi sgom zhing / /'jug pa'i bslab bya pha rol phyin drug spyad/ /bsdu na dkar nag chos brgyad 'du zhes gsungs/ /'dir ni phan dang bde 479

ba rnams byed cing / /'dir yang mi phan phyir ma gnod pa spangs/ /srol gnyis bslab byar ma lus med ces smra/ /skye ba'i rten ni lha klu 'phrog ma sogs/ /sdig can dag la'ang skye ba klu sgrub lugs/ /thogs med de'i steng so thar dgos zhes gsungs/ /spyir na sangs rgyas chos la dad byed cing / /'bras bu bla med byang chub la dad dang / /rgyal sras spyod pa rgya mtshor dad byed na/ /byang sems skye ba dkon cog tā lar gsungs zhes gsung / /tha ma nyams na gso tshul gzhan du blta/ /phan yon gnas skabs mngon mtho mthar thug tu/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob cing dge ba'i 'bras/ /spyad kyang mi zad gong 'phel sdig kun zhi/ /de sogs phan yon pha mtha' yas par gsungs/ /sems bskyed brtson pas bsgom nas 'byongs pa'i tshad/ /bdag gzhan mnyam dang bdag las gzhan gces 'byung / /de ltar snying stobs chen po'i 'gyur med du/ /sems bskyed bstan pa'i rtsa bar bshad pa'i dges/ /ma gyur 'gro rgyud dge tshogs rab 'phel nas/ /bzang po'i lam 'dis 'bad med grol bar shog /ces pa thun mong gi sngon 'gro bstan pa'i skabs te bzhi pa'o/ /de nas thun mong ma yin sngon 'gro la/ /sdig sgrib dag byed rdor sems sgom bzlas ni/ /nyes ltung dag phyir bya dgos de'i rgyu mtshan/ /snum ldan rab la tshos mi 'go ba bzhin/ /rang rgyud sdig pas sgrib la ting nge 'dzin/ /rnal ma mi skye cung zad skyes na yang / /gegs ldang ba dang thar mi phyin pa sogs//sgom gyi nyams myong skye ba'i gegs che shos/ /sdig sgrib yin kha de sbyangs gnyen po ni/ /bya brgya 'ur thog gcig gis brdas pa lta'i/ /thabs mchog bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /sgom dang bzlas par yid gnyis spangs te 'bad/ /sbyangs bya'i sdig pa chags sdang gti mug gis/ /rgyu byas des bskyed sdig to'i mi dge'i las/ /yin la de yang las kyi ngo bo ni/ /sems pa yin la de dang mtshungs ldan gyi/ /shes pa 'du byed sems pa dag gis ni/ /kun nas bslangs pa'i lus ngag rnam 'gyur dang / /'bral ba'i yid kyis las dang lus ngag gi/ /las zhes bya zhing lus ngag las gnyis kyang / /yid sngon 'gro dgos yid kyi las rkyang dang / /lus ngag las zhes gsum du rnam par dbye/ /skyes kyang de yi sdug bsngal cha rnams bskyed/ /des na nyes dmigs dran pas bshags thabs la/ /phyi bshol le lor mi shol 'phral du brtsams/ /de yang nyams myong skye la gegs byed stig /tshe 'dir bsags rnams dus nye sgrib tshab che/ /khyad par so thar byang sems nyes ltung dang / /sngags kyi dam tshig 'gal 'khrul nyams pa dang / /dkor dang sku bslus zos sogs ches lci ba'i/ /sdig pa'i las kyi nyams rtogs skye la sgrib/ /de nyid sbyong byed yi ge brgya pa yi/ /bsgom bzlas sngags shing sgrib sbyang yig brgya la'ang / /dam tshig gsum bkod rgyud las gsungs pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa dang / /so so'i mtshan sngags spos na rgyud sde'i lha/ /du ma'i yig 480

brgyar 'gyur ba rdor sems kyi/ /yig brgyar rtsa ba zhi khro rnam pa gnyis/ /snga mar rgyu sde 'og mar yab rkyang dang / /bla med yum can kha sbyor ldan skyes su/ /bskyed tshul gnyis dang dam ye bskyed bsnyim dang / /rigs bdag rgyas 'debs mched bstod la sogs pa/ /rgyas pa'i phyogs su bshad kyang gnas bsdus lugs/ /bla ma rdor sems sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi/ /ngo bor sgom pa dam ye dbyer med dang / /ngo bo nyid kyi rigs la rang rigs kyi/ /mtshon byed rgyas gdab ma'i dgos mchod bstod sogs/ /spros pa spangs te 'di ltar sgom par bya/ /rang 'dra'i gter chen gyis rang nyid tha mal spyi steng pad zla'i steng / /hūm̐ dkar 'phro 'du'i rdor sems dkar gsal 'tsher/ /rdor dril 'dzin cing longs sku'i rgyan gyis mdzes/ /yum 'khyud mtshan dpe'i gzi byin 'bar/ /sems dkyil gyis bzhugs thugs kar pad zla'i steng / /dkar gsal rdo rje rtse lnga'i lte ba hūṃ/ /mtha' bskor badz+ra sa twa'i sngags phreng rnams/ /g.yas su rang sgra dang bcas 'khor ba yis/ /sngags phreng sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung gri ma sbyangs par bsam/ /ma yengs dad pa brtan po'i rtse gcig tu/ /yig brgya gsol 'debs tshul gyis ci mang bzla/ /thun mthar bshags tshig bton mthar rdo rje sems/ /'od zhu rang thim 'khor gsum dmigs med ngang / /ci bu mnyam bzhag bya zhing dge ba bsngo/ /de yang nyes rtsang gsang shing sbas gyur na/ /sdig pa'i sa bon g.yo rgyu'i chu lud kyis/ /bskyed pa'i 'phel che man ngag dka'i sdug bsngal myong / /ma gsang skyon du shes pas bsgrag gyur na/ /cung zad yang zhing mang por 'phel mi 'gyur/ /de phyir bshags yul rnams kyi spyan snga ru/ /ma sbas drang por brjod pa mthol ba ste/ /rang gi nyes ltung skyon du khas blangs nas/ /ngo tsha gnong 'gyod dang bcas sdig pa rnams/ /gsong por smras pas bshags pa'i yul rnams kyi/ /brtse bas rjes bzung sdig sgrib nyes ltung 'di/ /dag par mdzad du gsol zhes snying thag pas/ /yig bzlas pas don gyi snying po tshang / /de la khyad chos stobs bzhi tshang tshul ni/ /bshags yul rdor sems sgom pa rten gyi stobs/ /rang rgyud rten ni skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yin/ /gnyen po kun spyod stobs ni lha sgom zhing / /sngags bzlas sdig sgrib bkru ba'i dmigs pa yin/ /sun 'byin stobs ni nyes pa spyod pa la/ /khong bar song ba'i dug bzhin 'gyod pa'o/ /slar ldog stobs ni srog la babs 'gyur kyang / /phyin chad mi bgyid snyams du sdom pa'i sems/ /yin kyang gnong 'gyod med na bshags pa'i blo/ /mi skye 'gyod pa gsha' la zhig skyes phyin chad/ /sdoms sems shugs la 'byung ba chos nyid de/ /mjug tu bshags tshig ston pa nyid la tshang / /de ltar 'bad pas sdig sgrib dag pa'i rtags/ /mkha' la 'phur dang khrus byas chu bo brgal/ /lus la rnag khrag zag dang 'phru skyug sogs/ /dngos sam rmi lam dag tu lan mang 'byung / /dngos su sngar las rig pa dngas pa dang / /dmigs pa gsal zhing lus yang dad 481

dang / /snying rje nges 'byung la sogs cher song zhing / /gnyid rmugs le lo chags ldang tshe 'di yi/ /'khri ba chung rnams sdig sgrib dag pa'i rtags/ /de ltar sgom bzlas la 'bad phan yon ni/ /nyams chags skong zhing ngan song ltung las thar/ /bde gshegs sras kyi dam pa rab dgongs nas/ /bsrung skyabs mdzad sogs phan yon bsam las 'das/ /sgo gsum rnam 'gyur mi dge sdig pa'i las kyis/ /'bras bu ngan song skye bar bslu med pa/ /sbyangs thabs rdor sems sgom bzlas bstan pa'i dges/ /nyes las rnam rgyal dge tshogs cher 'phel shog /gcig nas mthun rkyen tshogs bsags maṇ+ḍal khrid/ /spyir ni theg chen lam zhugs byang sems kyi/ /sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i rgyu gtso bsag bya'i tshogs/ /bsod nams ye shes gnyis med de yang ni/ /pha rol phyin pa drug gis bsdus pa ste/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bsod nams tshogs yin la/ /shes rab ye shes tshogs yin de la yang / /gnyis ka'i cha shas yod de bzod pa la/ /gnod par ji mi snyam dang sdug bsngal ba/ /dang du len pa bsod nams tshogs yin la/ /chos la nges par sems pa ye shes tshogs/ /brtson 'grus tshogs gnyis so sor rtsol ba gnyis/ /yon tan kun rdzob don dam dmigs pa yi/ /dbye bas tshogs gnyis zung 'bral de yang ni/ /sher phyin gyis zin pha rol phyin pa lnga/ /ye shes tshogs su 'gyur la shes phyin las/ /bsod nams 'bras bu 'phel phyir tshogs gnyis po/ /ngo bo'i sgo nas gcig tu rnam par bzhag /de yang bsod nams tshogs kyi sgos 'bras ni/ /rgyal ba'i sras rnams 'khor ba'i gnas skabs su/ /gzhan don spyod la mthu ldan mngon mtho'i chos thob cing mthar thug gzugs sku rnam gnyis thob/ /ye shes sgo 'bras gnas skabs gzhan don du/ /'khor bar spyod tshe nyon mongs med pa dang / /thabs la mkhas pa'i ye shes dag la 'jug /mthar thug chos sku'i go 'phang 'grub par byed/ /khyad par sngon 'gro'i skabs 'dir maṇ+ḍal gyi/ /sgo nas tshogs gnyis bsag la 'bad dgos te/ /tshogs gsog dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor nyid yin kyang / /snga ma'i bsag rgyab khyad par can yod na/ /ma gtogs rang rgyud dge tshogs bsag pa yi/ /gzhi rten med na dge ba'i bag chags nyid/ /yod kyang 'phral du sad par mi nus pas/ /dngos gzhi'i nyams myong 'phral du skye ba'i thabs/ /zhes pa 'di grub pa'i dbang phyug kun bzang rin chen rnam grol chos kyi rgyal po mchog gi spyan sngar thun mong dang thun min gyi zab chos gdams pa longs su spyod pa'i skabs zin bris bgyis pa ste dngos gzhi'i nyams myong 'phral du skye ba'i thabs zhes pa'i 'phro nas snyan brgyud las tshig gcig kyang dkyus gcig tu yi ger 'bri bar bkas ma gnang pas man ngag gud du yod pa las shes dgos zhes tshe dbang nor bu 'gyur med bstan 'phel dga' ba'i rdo rje bdag gis smra'o/ /dge bar gyur cig shu r+ghaṃ/ 482

༄ga /'jam dpal nag po yang zab thugs kyi nying khu'i phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ suste/ na mo ma hā gu ru kro dha rā dza ya mā ri tsa ra ṇa ya/ /rgyal kun mthu stobs nus byin 'dus pa'i dpal/ /'jam dbyangs gzi 'od 'bar ba'i zhugs chen gyis/ /bdud tshogs tshang tshing cig car bsregs nas slar/ /phan bde yongs 'du bskyed des bkra shis stsol/ /log 'dren 'dul phyir mi bzad khro chen po/ /yang dag bde chen dbyings su rtag par zhi/ /zhi dang khro 'dus 'jam dpal gdod ma'i mgon/ /khyed la phyag 'tshal rtag par byin gyis rlobs/ /gang gi sgrub thabs mdor byas pa/ /rnal 'byor gsal ba man ngag bzhin/ /'di ru bkod la 'jam dpal gyis/ /dge legs nyid du dbugs dbyung mdzod/ /de la/ lhag pa'i lha 'di nyid kyi dbang bskur byin rlabs thob cing / dam tshig la brtson pa'i sgrub pa pos nyams su len par bya ste/ de yang bsnyen sgrub kyi thog mar/ sngon 'gro gtor ma btang ba ni/ oṃ a kro dhe ka ya mān+ta ka r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum gyis/ bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed du gsal btab/ gtor ma ya mān+ta kas bsang / swa bhā was sbyang / oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ ha ho trī:sa byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ in+d+ra ya trīḥ ya mā yajiḥ wa ru ḍā ya bi/ ku be rā ya kri/ sī shwa nā ye ta/ asna ye a/ nirla h+ye na/ wa ya we na/ brat+pā ye hūṃ/ ba su na dhā ra ṇa ye phaṭa/ sarba bhū te bh+yoḥ ha ha hi hi r+ghaṃ hūm̐ tse tse phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ lan bzhis phyogs skyong ba bsngos/ a kā ro gsum mam/ bdun gyis sa lha gzhi bdag la phul nas/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la/ /sa 'di bdag gis slong bar bgyi/ /dkyil 'khor don du khyed kyis stsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas rol mo'i sgra dang bcas phyi rol du dong ngo / /bgegs la bka' bsgo ba ni/ r+ghaṃ/lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs kun nga la nyon/ /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /srung ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor byed/ /rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba 'dis/ /lus srul las skyes 'gas par bya/ /gal te kha cig bdag las 'das/ /'jigs par 'gyur gyis gzhan du min/ /zhes a kro dhe ka dang / sum bha ni sogs drag sngags drag tu bzla/ rol mo dang bcas/ gu gul bdug yungs kar 'thor la bgegs la bskrad do/ /phur bu bsang sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las r+ghaṃ las byung ba'i khro bo bgegs mthar byed rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa lte ba man chad phur bu'i rnam pa can du gyur/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba dusgyimā ra ya phaṭa phaṭa/ tī li tī la ya sarba pā paṃ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ/ badz+ra tī la tī la ya badz+ra dha rod ādzñā pa ya te sarba bisnan kā ya 483

wāgyit+ta badz+ra tī li tī la ya r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ ces bgegs kyi spyi bor phur bu btab/ oṃ badz+ra gro dha ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ces tho bas brdung / phur bu khro bo las 'od zer 'phros te bgegs kyi lhag ma thams cad tshar bcad/ rdo rje'i ra ba drwa ba gur bla bra me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas pa grub par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa r+ghaṃ hūm̐ r+ghaṃ phaṭa swa hā/ ces bsrung ste/ phur ba dngos su gdab na skub pa ma grol bar de tshun chad mtshams bzung / yi dam la gtor ma 'bul skabs yid kyis phul ba'i lha la yang mchod pa'o/ /de nas bsnyen pa la/ nar ma rgyun gyi bsnyen pa dang /sgrub pa dus kyi bsnyen pa gnyis so/ /dang po nar ma rgyun gyis bsnyen pa ni/ bsam gtan dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas su/ sgo gsum lha sngags ye shes nang gi rnal 'byor kho nas nyams su len pa'o/ /thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ /ji srid snying po byang chub bar/ /sangs rgyas la ni skyabs su mchi/ /dam pa'i chos la bdag skyabs mchi/ /dge 'dun la ni mi phyed dad/ /sems bskyed pa ni/ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la/ /yin par shes pa'i bdag nyid du/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /tshogs bsag pa ni/ ya mān+ta ko3haṃ/ rang nyid skad cig gis 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed du gsal ba'i snying gar nyi steng hūṃ mthing nag las 'od zer 'phros/ mkha' khyab kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ /badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gsum bsten pa'i zhing gyur la/ /gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs/ /nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/ /phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos/ /ma chags spyod pa rjes yi rang / /dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la/ /dag pa gsum gyi lus dbul lo/ /tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i las rnams kun/ /bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ /tshogs zhing rnams dzaḥhūṃ bam̐ hoḥs/ /rang la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur/ /oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shurjo3haṃ/oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra su bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ gzung 'dzin gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med de bzhin nyid kyi rang du mnyam par bzhag /de ltar ma rtogs 'khrul pa'i sems can sgyu ma lta bu la snying rje chen po kun tu snang bar bya'o/ /de nas srung 'khor ni/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis/ r+ghaṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar/ r+ghaṃ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu g.yas su 'khor ba'i nang / dbus su nyi mar/ r+ghaṃ las rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba ser po/ dbu steng gdugs dkar po can g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ phyi rim rtsibs bcur nyi steng r+ghaṃ las khro bo bcu thams cad mthing nag be con dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ 'khor lo'i phyi rol du rdo rje'i sa gzhir gur drwa ba bla bra dang / de'i phyi rol phyogs mtshams steng 'og kun tu phyag mtshan sna tshogs kyi gur khang dang / me dpung 484

rab tu 'bar ba/ nang gi lha tshogs rnams kyi gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas khro bo'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bskor ba spyan drangs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ de la ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ r+ghoṃḥ khro bo zhe sdang gnas las skyes/ /gsod pa la sogs rtag tu brtson/ /bdud bzhi 'joms shing gdul dka' 'dul/ /'khor bcas rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces bstod/ dam tshig pa la thim/ ye shes dang dbyer med 'dres/dzaḥrtsu bam̐ hoḥ slar yang dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu rma/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ o āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/zhes dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag yar lud rigs so so la so sos dbu brgyan/ gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi steng hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ khro bo rnams la phog pas de rnams kyis sngags bzlas/ 'khor lo drag tu 'khor bas gnod byed thams cad phye ma dum bur gyur par bsams la/ o āḥ.usmi ṣa badz+ra tsakra warti sarba lo tī ka lo kot+ta ra yan+t+ra man+t+ra pra yo ga di ni sarba bi ṣa bi tsur+ṇa ya bi tsur+ṇa ya/ ma ma kri te ye na ke na tsi ta kri tan+t+ra ni ka ni ta ni sarba bighān/ tshin+da tshin+da/ bhin+da bhin+da/ kai pa ya/ rka pa ya/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bi dh+wan+ma ya bi dh+wasmri ya/ sha ta sa ha sra/ sarba bi khya bi tsur+ṇa ya/ bi tsur+ṇa ya/ usmi ṣa badz+ra tsakra warti r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes ci nus su bzlas/ rjes gong bzhin mchod bstod bya ste/ de srung ba dam pa'o/ /de nas dngos gzhi nyams su len pa la/ sku bskyed pa'i rim pa ni/ srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus kyi gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba 'od gsal du bsdus/ de nas skad cig gis srung 'khor dbus der/ rten gzhal yas khang me ri rdor bcas par/ brten pa gshin rje gshed lha lnga tshig 'dis gsal btab pa ste/ o swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shurnyo3haṃ/ stong ngang r+ghaṃ las gzhal yas khang / /pho brang rta bab sgo khyud bcas/ /phyi rim rdo rje me ris bskor/ /phyi bltas rin chen gzhal yas khang / /mdzes shing yid 'ong 'od zer 'phro/ /nang ni dur khrod gzhal yas khang / /'jigs shing khro yang gzi brjid 'bar/ /rgya khyon dbyings dang mnyam par dmigs/ /de dbus rdo rje pha lam las/ /grub pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi ni/ /rno ngar ldan pa gsal ba'i dbus/ /pad+ma nyi ma ro steng du/ /thod dbyug ya yis mtshan pa las/ /'od 'phros bde gshegs 'phags pa mchod/ /'gro drug skye 'gro'i sgrib gnyis sbyangs/ /bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad btul/ /tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ /rang rig khro rgyal gshin rje'i sku/ /dbyar kha'i char sprin 'khrigs 'dra'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis gzi brjid can/ /zhal gdangs mche gcigs rkan sgra sgrogs/ /smin ma ag tshom me ltar 'bar/ /se yan ral ba kham nag tshogs/ /gyen du 'phyo zhing thur du 'phyang / /spyan gsum sdang mig glog ltar 'khyug /phyag g.yas thod dbyug nam mkhar gdengs/ /g.yon 485

pas thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin/ /zhabs gnyis dor stabs brkyang bskum bsgrad/ /dbu la thod skam rin chen spras/ /snyan cha mgul chu phyag zhabs rnams/ /rin chen gdug pa sbrul gyis brgyan/ /thod rlon skra 'phyang do shal can/ /glang lpags stod g.yogs stag sham dkris/ /zhing g.yang sked dkris khrag zhag gi/ /thig le zo ris thal chen tshom/ /rab brgyan bskal pa'i me dpung klong / /srin po khros tshul 'gying ba yi/ /phyogs kyi rtsibs bzhi la gnas pa'i/ /rigs bzhi gshin rje 'bar ba ni/ /shar du zhe sdang gshin rje mthing / /phyag gnyis rdo rje thod dbyug g.yas/ /lho phyogs nga rgyal gshin rje ser/ /phyag g.yas rin chen be con 'phyar/ /nub tu 'dod chags gshin rje ni/ /dmar nag phyag g.yas pad+ma yi/ /be con bsgrad thabs tshul gyis 'phyar/ /byang du phrag dog gshin rje ljang / /phyag g.yas rgya gram be con 'phyar/ /kun kyang g.yon pa thod khrag 'dzin/ /cha lugs thams cad gtso dang mthun/ /de ltar gsal ba'i lha rnams kyi/ /gnas gsum yig 'bru o āḥr+ghaṃ/ /gtso bo'i thugs kar ya mthing nag /yig 'bru rnams las 'od 'phros pas/ /rang bzhin gnas nas dngos 'dra ba'i/ /ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs gyur/ /na mo bud+dhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥsat+ta bh+yaḥ gro dha ba yi ri sa/ sa ma ye na/ ā gats+tsha ya ā gats+tsha ya/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ/si ta pre ta a sa ma rna/ pre tor ka ṭa na/ ra sha yā r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ ces pas ye shes pa spyan 'dren/ yang gsur chen dud pa rol mo bcas/ gdung ba'i dbyangs bcas 'di skad do/ / r+ghaṃ/ 'jigs pa'i skur ston 'jam dpal nag po'i sku/ /khro rgyal 'bar ba chos nyid 'gyur ba med/ /zhi ba'i ngang las drag po'i tshul snang zhing / /cir yang bsgyur ba'i rnam 'phrul du ma yis/ /dgra bgegs bar chad log 'dren 'dul bar mdzad/ /'dod pa'i don rnams ma lus bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /'khor dang bcas pa bdag gis spyan 'dren na/ /phrin las stobs 'gyed gang yang thogs pa med/ /bdag gi bsam pa bsgrub phyir gshegs su gsol/ /dzaḥrtsu bam̐ hoḥ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ de ltar ye shes pa dngos su byon pa bdag gis bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor la gnyis su med par bzhugs par bsams la/ hūṃ/ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du//'byung ba rnam lnga 'khrug pa'i pho brang dbus/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba khrag gi klong rum na/ /dregs pa khro chen dur khrod gzhal yas khang / /dgra bgegs pho mo bsnol ba'i khri steng du/ /bam ro gsar rnying nyi ma'i gdan khri la/ /dpal chen khro rgyal 'khor bcas bzhugs su gsol/ /sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ r+ghaṃ/ dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /sku yi dbang phyug 'phags pa 'jam dpal te/ /ngang nyid chos dbyings zhi bde klong nas/ /gdul dka' 'dul phyir drag po'i skur bzhengs shing / /khro bo'i cha lugs dgra bgegs log 'dren 'dul/ /thugs rje ye shes 'bar ba'i me dpung gis/ /nyon mongs log rtog gzhob tu sreg mdzad pa/ /khro rgyal 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sa ma ya mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka 486

e h+ye hi/ zhes gdung shugs ldan pas phyag 'tshal nas/ mchod cing bstod pa ni/ hūṃ: sgo lnga'i longs spyod phyi yi mchod pa dang / /dug lnga rnam dag rang byung nang gi rdzas/ /bde chen rang grol gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams/ /gshin rje gshed po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /o ā ha ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā ju puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gadhe nai wi r+ya shardo pū dza hoḥ pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pū dza hoḥ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta ba lin+ta khā hi/ ma hā badz+ra pad+ma yo gi nī a ho su kha hoḥ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po ni/ /dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la/ /longs spyod yul du du mar snang / /shel la tshon chen ji bzhin du/ /'dod yon lnga dang chos rnams la/ /rnal 'byor rtag tu spyod par shog /a la la ho/ /rol du gsol/ bsnoms par mdzod/ mi 'dzin sgyu ma lta bu la/ dges pa'i gar gyis rol par mdzod/ /reg bya 'gag pa med pa la/ /mi g.yor bzhin du rol du gsol/ /ho/ chags pa med cing chags par mdzod/ /o sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ r+ghaṃ/ dur khrod rgyan gyis rnam brgyan pa'i/ /zhe sdang rdo rje gshin rje gshed/ /spros med nam mkha' lta bu las/ /snying rje thabs kyis skur sprul pa/ /ye shes khro rgyal rab 'jigs pa/ /dud kha mun can sku la 'dud/ /gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa yi/ /gti mug rdo rje gshin rje gshed/ /skye med don dam ngang nyid las/ /thabs kyis sprul pa'i skur bstan pa/ /'jigs byed drag po'i cha lugs can/ /zla ba nya 'dra khyod la 'dud/ /bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba yi/ /ser sna rdo rje gshin rje gshed/ /'dzin pa po las grol ba yis/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bor sprul/ /gter 'chang ser sna khrol mdzad pa/ /btsog ma gser 'dra khyod la 'dud/ /chags pas ma lus dbang mdzad pa'i/ /'dod chags rdo rje gshin rje gshed/ /skye med rnam dag chos dbyings las/ /khams gsum pa dag khro bor sprul/ /ma chags spyan ldan thugs rje can/ /bad+dha lta bu'i sku la 'dud/ /shes rab thabs ldan he ru ka /phrag dog rdo rje gshin rje gshed/ /rnam grol dpe dang bral ba las/ /thugs rje sprul pa'i khro bo ni/ /'gro don brtson pa'i ral gri can/ /sna tshogs mdog can khyod la 'dud/ /ces pas mchod cing bstod do/ /gsung bzlas pa sngags kyi rim pa dzab bskul ba/ r+ghaṃ/ skye med ngang las 'gag med skur bzhengs te/ /thugs srog r+ghaṃ las grags stong gsung gi sgra/ /rang byung thugs las lhun grub dbyings kyi dang / /sku gsung thugs yon phrin las dzab kyis bskul/ /dzab kyi dgongs pa/ de nas gtso bo'i thugs ka ru: nyi steng ya mthar sngags phreng 'khod: de la ma yengs rig pa gtad: ngag nas gsang sngags bzlas pa'i tshe: yig 'bru rnams las sngags rang sgra: 'ur 'ur g.yas bskor 'od zer 'phros: phyogs bzhir 'khor gyi thugs kar phog: rgyud bskul gtso 'khor thams cad kyis: sngags sgra ldir sgrogs rgyal kun gyi: rgyud bskul sems can sdig sgrib bsal: bdag gi tshe bsod ye shes rgyas: dgra bgegs byad ma thams cad zhi: oṃ shrī mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka rgyu phaṭa: ces bzla/ 487

thun dngos gzhir mi tshig gis bar ma chod pa sngags kyi skyon lnga spangs la bzla'o/ /thugs ye shes kyi rol par bzla ba rang rig lha'i skur snang ba de la sems ma yengs rtse gcig tu gtad/ phyi nang rtog tshogs kyi rjes su mi 'brang / dran rig lha dang dbyer med hrig ge ngo bo ngos bzung dang bral ba de ga zab gsal dbyer med yin/ de'i ngang la sngags bzla/ thun mtshams su yang / spyir yengs med dgos kyang / re zhig nam dran du de ka'i ngang du ci gnas su bskyang /lha sku la sems 'dzin pa rang bab bzhag pa nyid dang / skabs su res bsgrim res lhod nas 'jog /de rnams sems la gang bde gtso bor bya/ don dam par sems nyid skye med kyi ngang las/ rang gdangs 'gag med lha'i sku zung 'jug bde ba chen por grub pa nyid du shes bzhin skyong ba'o/ /de ltar lha sangs ye shes ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pas grangs dang rtags kyi bsnyen pa'i tshad ni/ /gzhung las/ grags stong ngang las ngar bskyed cing : 'bum phrag bcu gcig them par bzloḥ de bar gzhan tshig ma 'dres gces: zhes dang / yang na rtags rdzogs par du ste: de la nges med rab 'bring klos: khyad par ci bzhin shes par bya: rtags ni thod mkhar me 'bar dang : glang smyon mi nag thog ser 'bab: dar nag phyar dang ral nag bsil: char mun 'khrigs sogs 'jigs pa'i ltas: phal cher blo yis dpyad par bya: 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' bag dro dang : 'od dang gzi brjid 'bar ba na: grub rtags yin pas shes par bya: zhes pa'o/ /thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor ni/ nar ma rgyun gyi bsnyen pa'i skabs 'dir/ rtsa gzhungs su lha'i nga rgyal las mchod gtor rdzogs rim sogs ma dgos pa ni/ rnal 'byor la shin tu brtson pa dang drag sngags tshig shur gyi sgrub tshul du yang snang rung de ltar mi lcogs pas ni/ thun mtshams su gtor ma sogs bya ba yang yin no/ /gtor ma ni/thod tshal sogs sam snod bzang po gzhan yang rung ste/ der sha khrag zan chang sogs bldag gzhib spungs pa lang tshar la/ rak+ta bdud rtsis bran/ rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ gtor ma la stegs mdzub gtad la/ o badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ o swa bhā wa bi shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa bi shurjo3haṃ: de dag ngag tu brjod pas/ nyes skyon rnams bsangs shing sbyangs te stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ 'og tu yo las rlung gi dal gzhu'i dbyibs can changs zung yi gis mtshan pa/ de'i steng ram̐ las me'i dal gru gsum/ de steng ke las thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum/de'i steng du snod ka pā la a las skye med yangs shing rgya che ba phyi dkar nang dmar chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam par gsal/ de'i nang du sngags kyi ngo bo rnams/ dbus su shu las byang chub sems/ na las mi yi sha /shar du ma las sha chen gyi dwangs ma klad pa/ da las rta'i sha /lhor ra las rak+ta ha las glang po che'i sha /nub tu bi las dri chen/ go las ba glang gi sha /byang du mu las dri chu/ ku las khyi'i sha /de ltar rdzas rnams dpag tu med par bsams la/ de la lag mthil g.yon bstan la/ lag g.yon mthil du o las zla ba oṃ dkar gyis mtshan pa de las 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ nyes skyon dri ma sbyangs/ o o oṃ/lag mthil g.yas bstan/ lag g.yas mthil du āḥlas nyi ma āḥdamar po mtshan pa de las 'od zer dmar po 'phros snod gang zhing rgya tshar 'phel/ āḥ.āḥ.āḥ lag gnyis ka'i lag mthil du hūṃ 'od zer sngon po byung / r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ/ rlung g.yos me sbar thod pa dros sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zhu zhing khol/ nyes skyon lbu ba lud/ 488

rlangs pa 'od zer gyis ye shes bdud rtsi bkug /dbyer med 'dres zag med bdud rtsir gyur/ o āḥhūm̐/ mang du brjod/ tse tse/ zhes 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ gtor mgron ma lus pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ de rnams ljags r+ghaṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje sbu gus gtor ma'i bdud drangs te dgyes par gsol bar bsams la/ gtor ma dbus kyi g.yas mar dmigs te/ gu ru zhi drag phur pa rta mgrin phyag rdor sogs bla ma yi dam gyi snying po la gtor sngags/ i rda ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ btags la 'bul/ gtor ma dbus mar dmigs te/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi sngags la gong gi gtor sngags btags pa'am/ yang na/ o ya mān+ta ka te dzo ba lin+ta swā hā/ zhes btags pa lan bdun las mi nyung bas phul/ dbus kyi g.yon mar dmigs la/ legs ldan lcam dral lta bu rang gis brten pa'i srung ma 'jig rten 'das pa bye brag dang / spyi la yang dmigs te phul/g.yas kyi g.yas de/ gong gi/ oṃ in+d+ra ya hrīḥsogs phan bzhis phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs dang / rang gis brten pa'i srung ma 'jig rten pa la'ang dbul/ g.yon gyi g.yon te/ 'gro ba khams gsum rigs drug thams cad par dmigs te/ a kā ro lan brgyad kyis bsngos bas tshim par bsam/ mgron de thams cad kyang khro chen gshin rje gshed kyi rol par bltas la/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ gis nang mchod 'bul/ ar+ghaṃ sogs pas kyang mchod/ hūṃ/ thugs rje chen po'i dbyings nas skur sprul pa/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad khro bo kun gyi rje/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med chos kyi sku/ /khro rgyal gshin rje 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /hūṃ/ bcom ldan gshin rje gshed la sogs/ /bla ma bde gshegs ma lus dang / /ya ma rā tsa la sogs te/ las kyi gshin rje gdug pa can/ /gtum po 'jigs byed pho mo'i tshogs/ /bye ba ther 'bum 'khor dang bcas/ /dam rdzas gtor ma 'di longs la/ /bka' yi bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /rnal 'byor bdag gis phrin las mdzod/ /gzhan yang 'dod don gang yin gyi gsol ba drag tu gdab/ slar yang mgron thams cad la dmigs mchod pa bsdus pa gcig byas la/ bcom ldan dpal chen 'jam dpal khro chen po: khams gsum skye 'gro 'jam dpal dkyil 'khor cher: gus
