pas mchod bstod gsol btab byin rlabs kyis: blun rmongs blo yi rab rib bsal ba dang : bdud dang log 'dren bar chad thul ba dang : grib dang mi gtsang gcong nad zhi la sogs//'dod pa'i don kun 'grub par mdzad du gsol: tshe ring nad med longs spyod 'phel ba dang : mthu dang rdzu 'phrul nus stobs che ba dang ཿོ 'jig rten snang srid zil gyis non pa dang : ngan song thams cad stong par gyur la sogs: dpal chen khyed dang mthu rtsal mnyam par shog: ces dngos grub zhu/ yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang / oṃ ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra muḥ sarba lo ka gats+tshaḥ gtor mgron gshegs su gsol/ thun mtshams spyod lam kun lha sku sgyu ma lta bu dang mi bral ba'i lam khyer gsum la bslab pa dang / thun kun gyi thog mthar/ srung 'khor gyi dmigs pa dran cing sngags ci rigs bgrangs la/ ltas 'tshubs pa'i skabs su bgegs drag tu bskrad srung 'khor dang gtor ma la 'bad pa yang zhal gyi gdams pa'o/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya ba ni/ sgrub 489

pa'i skabs su 'jug che yang / 'dir bshad na stabs bde bas/ de yang tshogs rdzas yo byad 'du byas la/ o ya nān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang / oṃ sarba bisnan ta kṛta a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ ces pas bdud rtsi rdo rje'i chu 'thor la/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid 'jam dpal khro bo'i thugs ka nas/ /hūṃ las yi ge ro yi khaṃ gsum 'phros/ /me rlung chu yis tshogs kyi dngos 'dzin dri/ /bsregs gtor bkrus nas gtsang ma rnyogs med gyur/ /ram̐ yo khaṃ/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas tshogs kyi skyon thams cad dag par bsam/ de nas byin rlabs ni/ hūm̐/ slar yang dpa' bo 'bru lha tshogs la 'phros/ /sgra dang bcas pas tshogs rnams 'od du zhu/ /ye shes bdud rtsi 'od phung ldems se ldem/ /'dod yon mchod sprin nam mkha'i khams gang gyur/ /o hūṃ ṭ+wāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ zhes brjod pas tshogs rdzas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin bsam/ tshogs kyi yul spyan drangs ba ni/ hūm̐/ skye med chos sku kun bzang klong yangs nas/ /ma 'gag gzugs kyi skur bzhengs 'jam dpal lha/ /zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor gzhan yang bskang 'os mgron/ /ma lus tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lhun grub tshogs khang 'dir/ /tshogs mchod bdud rtsi bzhes slad bzhugs su gsol/ /sa ma ya dzaḥr+ghaṃ bam̐ hoḥtiṣ+ṭha lhan/ de nas tshogs phud rim bcad la/ dang po phul la/ hūṃ/ bcom ldan gtum chen gshin rje gshed kyi 'khor/ /gzhan yang bka' brgyad dpal mgon bcas rnams la/ /phyi nang gsang mchod bdud rtsi sman raka gtor/ /rnal 'byor longs spyod 'dod yon tshogs mchod 'bul/ /thugs dam gnyan po bskang phyir bzhes nas kyang / tsho/dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ shrī mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka r+ghaṃ/ gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ bar pa tshogs bshags ni/ hūṃ/ bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis/ /bag med tshul gyis dam las 'gal gyur te/ /'jam dpal zhi khro'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba/ /longs spyod 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pas bshags/ /o shrī mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka sarba sa ma ya sogs brjod/ tha ma bsgral bstab ni/ bdag nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i mdun du/ /tshogs snod de nyid las kyi rnam smin las grub pa'i gru gsum lcags khang 'bar ba'i nang du/ tshogs rdzas dgra bgegs dngos su gsal/ bdag cag gi sngon las 'phral rkyen gang yang rung ste/ lus ngag yid la gnod 'tshe bar chad dgra bgegs thams cad gcig tu dril nas gzugs liṅga la thim par gyur/ bden stobs kyis bkug la/hūm̐/ bdag cag rnal 'byor byang chub sgrub pa la/ /bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs 'byung po kun/ /bla ma dkon mchog rtsa gsum bden pa'i mthus/ /skad cig tsam gyis gzugs ling 'di la khug /dzaḥr+ghaṃ bam̐ hoḥ bsgral ba ni/ hūṃ/ dug lnga'i las kyis bsags pa'i bag chags rnams/ /sku gsum sku lnga'i klong du da lta sgrol/ /ma rig bdag 'dzin a 'thas ru dra 'di/ /rang shes rig pa'i dbyings su mā ra ya phaṭa/ /zhal du bstab pa ni/ r+ghaṃ/ nyon mongs dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus/ /phung khams skye mched bla tshe rnam 490

shes bcas/ /zhal du stobs shig gshin rje'i lha tshogs kyi/ /chos dbyings bde chen mnyam pa'i thugs su bstem/ /o shrī mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka kā la rū pa hūṃ bh+yoḥ.a mu ka dz+ra triḥsha rtsu mā ra ya/ mahā māṃ sa khā hi/ mahā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta khā hi/ ma hā ki ni ri ti khā hi/ de nas tshogs la rol pas/ brda dang brda yis len pa sngon du 'gro bas rdzas la longs spyod/ gsang ba'i mchod pas kyang dgyes pa'i dam tshig bzung tshogs lhag 'bul ba/ zhal chab bdud rtsi bran la/ o āḥhūṃ ha ho trīḥ brjod nas byin brlabs la/ r+ghaṃ/ sbyor dngos rjes tshang 'dod yon phung po'i tshogs/ /dang po phud bdag dpal chen lha la 'bul/ /bar du 'khor tshogs lhag la dgyes pas mchod/ /tha ma chos rnams rgyu 'bras gcig phyir bsre/ /nga khyod dam tshig 'dres phyir kha chus bran/ /dpal gyi bka' nyan lhag sdud bran 'khor ni/ /dregs pa pho mo ma sring ging la / /dur khrod bdag byed brtan dang zhing skyong tshogs/ /sngon tshe khas blangs dam bca' ma 'da' bar/ /lhag gtor 'di longs bcol ba'i phrin las sgrubs/ /usgyiṣ+ṭa ba lin+ta khā hi/ zhes byang shar gtsang ma'i gnas su bstab/ gshin rje gshed po'i dkyil 'khor du/ /tshogs kyi 'khor los mchod pa yis/ /bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /'jam dpal go 'phang myur thob shog /ces sogs smon lam btab bo/ /da ni spyi don gnyis pa/ sgrub pa dus kyi bsnyen pa ni/ gong gi nar ma'i bsnyen pa la go ba chags na/ sgrub gzhung nyid shin tu kha gsal bas/ de kho na ltar nyams su blangs pas 'grub pa'o/ /'dir sa bcad tsam smos na/ bris sku rab gnas can bkram pa'i mdun du/ dkyil 'khor bris pa'i dbus/ rkang gsum khar thod pa gya ril thun rdzas kyis bkang ba'i steng / ag rtse ra pur bu lha sngags can 'dzugs/ dar nag gi gur phub/ mtha' bskor drag po'i mchod rdzas spyan gzigs bag dro bsham/ bcas 'di rnams gong gi bsnyen pa'i skabs nyid nas bca' na legs/ zhes man ngag las 'byung / de nas sngon 'gro gtor ma bgegs bskrad mtshams bcad dang / skyabs sems tshogs bsags srung 'khor rnams gong nas bshad buzhin mthar/ gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba 'od gsal ru bsdus pa'i bar bstar chags su byas la/ de nas skad cig dran pa'i rig par ngar bskyed la/ oṃ ma hā shu dzñā tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma kolhahaṃ/zhes pa nas mchod 'bul bar gzhung bzhin bya/ 'on kyang 'dir/ bdag dang mdun gyi phur pa de lha ru lhan cig bskyed dgos/ de nas bstod pa gzhung nas 'byung ba/ hūṃ/ ya las byung ba'i gshin rje nag po ni/ /sogs kyis bstod pa'am/ yang bsdu na spyan 'dren man chad gong du bshad bzhin pas rung / de nas bzlas pa'i rim pa rtsa ba bdag bskyed kyi dzab dgongs shas che zhing / de yang mdun bskyed dang sngags lhan cig bzlas par bsams pa thun gsum gyi cha gnyis bya/ thun gcig mdun bskyed dang 'od zer mgal me klad 'khor ltar bya/ de'i mdun bskyed kyi nus pa phar pa dang rdzas la bstem/ gang ltar dmigs pa'i ngo bo gter gzhung nas gsungs pa 'di lta ste/ bdag nyid gtso mchog thugs kar nyi ma'i steng / /gnam lcags mchod rten khri 'phang dgu pa'i dbus/ /bra yi nang du rdo rje r+ghaṃ gis mtshan/ /bum pa'i nang du be con ya yis mtshan/ /ri rab nang du thod dbyug bh+yoḥ 491

yis mtshan/ /mchod rten phyi skor sngags bru 'di dag rnams/ /oṃ shrī mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka kā la rū pa hūṃ bh+yoḥgasal 'tsher gzi brjid ldan par dmigs nas kyang / /ngag tu brjod pas sngags rnams skad dang bcas/ /g.yas su 'khor zhing sngags las 'od 'phros pas/ /phyi nang snang srid yongs la phog pa yis/ /nus mthu bcud bsdus sngags la thim pas kyang / /bkrag dang nus mthu 'od zer 'bar dmigs shing /yig 'bru bskor la bzlas pa drag tu bya/ /de ltar phyogs kyi gshed chen bzhi la yang / /bzlas pa'i 'khrul 'khor gtso dang mthun par bya/ /de ni bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i rim pa ste/ /mdun bskyed dag kyang tshul lugs de ltar las/ /thod pa dur khrod gzhal yas khang du bskyed/ /sngags kyi rnal 'byor 'gal me'i 'khrul 'khor bya/ /thun gsum la ni lha tshogs phur pa dang / /thod pa'i thun rdzas rnams la bstim par bya/ /de ltar rnams kyis bsnyen cing bsgrub la 'bad/ /ces pa ji bzhin pa'o/ /de ltar bsgrubs pa'i rtags kyi rim pa/ spyir bsnyen pa'i skabs dang 'dra la/ byed brag tu yang 'di ltar gsungs te/ de ltar rim pas bsnyen cing bsgrub pa yis: rtags dang mtshan ma'i rim pa 'di ltar 'byung :dngos dang nyams snang rmi lam la sogs par: rab 'bring tha ma'i blo dang mthun rnams la: zhal ston nyams 'bar sngags kyi sgra sgrogs dang : lung ston chos smra phur pa 'phur ba dang : thod pa 'tshegs dang thun 'khor 'od chen 'bar: thog dang ser ba bab snyams 'jigs skrag sngangs: bag dro byin chags rang snang 'gyur ba dang : khrom tshogs dmag 'dus dar phyar dung 'bud dang : nyi zla 'char dang khrus byas gos gsar gyon: gcan gzan btul nas bran bkol bya gcan bzung : de sogs gzhan yang bsam gyis mi khyab 'byung : de dag rnal 'byor rang rang rig pas dpyad: ces pa nyid do/ /sgrub pa'i skabs 'dir/ thun mtshams rnams su tshogs gtor nges par gal che bas/ de yang grub na nyin mtshan gung gnyis zer gnyis su bya/ ma lcogs tshe gung gnyis gang rung gcig la btang / srod thun la tshogs bya ba yin no/ /bsnyen sgrub thems nas/ byad zlog gtor ma la brten pa'i bcas gzhung bzhin byas la/ gtor ma'i rjes sam khyad par dgongs mo dmar thag skabs gtor zor re nges par bya ste/ zlog sngags dmigs pa ngar bskyed de 'phang / gal te gtor zor 'phang ba mi byed na yang / nyi ma dmar thag gi skabs su zlog sngags brgya rtsa brgyad/ bden stobs lan gsum bcas thal mo bdeb pa ni ma chag par bya ste/ de ni gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i nus pa zla med pa'o/ /de rjes rang nyid 'khor bcas la srung 'khor bsgom zhing srung sngags ci ltar rigs pa bzla ba'ang man ngag go/ /rjes kyi rim pa ni/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya/ yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po ci nus bzlas la/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs nas/ bzod par gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis nongs pa bshags la/ gong bzhin gshegs su gsol dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i rdzogs rim ni/ snang srid gzhal yas tshogs dang bcas pa rnams/ /rang la bsdu zhing rang yang thugs ka yi/ /yig 'bru bcas pa mchod rten dag la ste/ /de nyid r+ghaṃ ya bh+yoḥgasum dag la bsdu/ /de gsum dag kyang rim gyis mas rim bzhin/ /gcig la gcig thim r+ghaṃ la thim nas ni/ /r+ghaṃ nyid dmigs med mkha' la 'ja' yal ltar/ /zhen med rtog bral khyab bdag rol par blta/ /zhes rnams par mi rtog pa de kho na nyid la ci nus su mnyam par gzhag slar yang sngags kyi rang sgras 492

'jam dpal dpa' bo'i sgrar ldang / 'jam dpal dpa' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa dang / /kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin te/ /de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag slob cing / /dge ba 'di dag thams cad yongs su bsngo/ /dus gsum gshegs pa rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ /bsngo ba gang la mchog tu bsngags pa der/ /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di kun kyang / /bzang po spyod phyir rab tu bsngo bar bgyi/ /zhes sogs bsngo smon bzang pos rgyas btab/ bkra shis pa'i tshig ngag gi sbyor ba rgya cher spel lo/ /lha mchog gshin rje gshed nag po'i/ /bsnyen pa'i rim pa gsal phyes shing / /sgrub pa'i gnad kyang ji snyed bcas/ /dbang phyug dam pas bzhed bzhin bkod//bcom ldan 'jam dpal nag po sgrub pa'i thabs/ /gshor dang kha thun tshe bdag kun gyi bcud/ /zla med gcig chog rdo rje pha lam che/ /thugs kyi yang zhun yin ces kun tu bsngags/ /gang gi tshul 'di cung zad bshad pa yi/ /dge bas kyang ni rgyal bstan snying po dar/ /sa dbang thugs bzhed dam pa'i chos bzhin 'grub/ /skye dgus 'jam dpal go 'phang myur thob shog /ces pa 'di yang / gangs can dbyig 'dzin la dbang bsgyur ba ma'i lha gcig pu bla med pa stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba chen po chos kyi rgyal po 'gyur med phyogs las rnam rgyal mi 'jigs dbang po'i sde'i zhal snga nas bka' lung yang yang stsal ba la brten me yos smrin drug zla ba'i sher phyogs dga' ba dang bzang po gnyis par bod kyi tshe brag dpal chen chu bo rir rig 'dzin rgyal khams pa tshe dbang nor bu rdo rje gzi bajid kyis grub par sbyar ba/ sarba maṅga lo bha waskyo ṭ+wā hā/ dge'o/ / 493

༄ga /'jam dpal nag po yang zab thugs kyi nying khu'i sgom bzlas la nyer mkho'i dris lan mtshon byed bzhugs so/ /oṃ susti/ bla ma dang 'jam dpal gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang dge ba'i yid can nyid kyis 'jam dpal nag po'i bsnyen sgrub dogs gcod kyi skor rgyas par brir ma long yang mtshon byed tsam smos na/ rang rang gi yi dam gang byed kyi rgyun bsnyen gsham du mu mthud nas bsnyen kyang shin tu rung la/ de tshe skabs 'dir skyabs sems byas kyang legs la/ ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon du mi 'gyur/rang lus stong par sbyangs nas sems nyid lha skur bsgom pa ni/ tshul 'di tsam du ma zad sngags bla med kyi bskyed rim thams cad kyi dgongs pa yin kyang / deng sang phal cher gyis gnad de lta bu ma go ba ni bla ma'i zhal lung ma thos pa'i skyon du snang / gzhan yang gzhung 'gar/ rabyo lus yi dam lha bsgom zhing /gsungs pa yang / tha mal bem po'i lus 'di ni ma yin te/ de yang gnyug ma'i lus ngos bzung dgos pa brgyud pa'i man ngag yang dag pa yin/ lus 'di ka lhar gnas bsgyur ba tsam kyis chog na/ swa bhā wa dang / shu n+ya tā sogs kyis stong par sbyangs mi dgos pas/ sngags des kyang lus 'di stong par sbyangs nas gnyug ma'i lus lha sku bsgom dgos pa ni shin tu gsal ba lags/ des na tshul des mig dang rna ba sna lce la sogs pa lhar bsgom pa dang / de bzhin mgo bo spyi gtsug ltag pa la sogs pa'i gnas su lha bsgom pa rnams kyang / tha mal lus 'di sbyang bya dang / de'i sbyang gzhi gnyug ma'i lus la bsgom dgos pa ni/ gsang sngags gsar rnying ris su ma chad pa'i bskyed rim gyi man ngag spyi chos yang dag pa yin/yang bye brag dmigs bsal gyi tha mal kyi lus 'di ka gnas bsgyur gyis bsgom dgos pa yang yod pas/de dag gcig la gcig 'gal ba can du ni bsam bar mi bya ste/ 'di ni go don la phan phyir cung zad spros pa ste/ rgyas par ni bla ma'i zhal lung nyan pa las 'dir bri ma long / rtsibs bzhir rigs bzhi'i gshen rje gshed ni/ zhe sdang nga rgyal 'dod chags phrag dog gshin rje gshed du nges te/ de bzhi po'i ngo bo mi bskyod rin 'byung 'od dpag med don grub bzhi dang gtso bo 'jam dpal rnam par snang mdzad kyi ngo bor shugs kyis bstan pa'o/ /thugs ka'i sa bon ya la ni tsheg drag mi 'tshal gyi sngags 'bru bcu gcig po long khyab dang bstun rgyun bzlas nges par rung ba yig thun mtshams lha sku stong par sbyangs shing / slar lhar ldang ba dang / dge ba bsngo ba sogs spyi mthun bya/ skabs su gshin rje rang gzhungs 494

srung 'khor sgom tshul mang du yod kyang de dag ma nges tshe/ gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba'i srung 'khor dgongs 'dus sgrub gzhung nas bshad pa ltar nyams su blang bas 'thus/ sgrub gtor ni zangs lcags sogs snod gtsang mar/ zur gsum thog ma de'u lta bu 'khor bzhi/ thod dbyug mar tshon gyis mdzes par brgyan pa/ mchod gtor sman raka gi gtor ma spyi 'gro/ thun mtshams rgyun gtor zur gsum la ba lin bzhis brgyan pa/ srung zlog bsad gsum kyi 'khor lo dpe'u ris zur gsal ma mthong la/ kho rang nang du kha shin tu gsal gshis de kas bde blag tu rtogs par snang / zlog pa'i skabs/ mdun gyi sha dum la 'gugs gzhug rgyas bsdus gang byas 'dra/ lha dbye bsgral las mi dgos/ sngags kyi skabs/gnod byed byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa mā ra ya/ zhes pa las sarba sha rtsu 'jug mi dgos/ gtor ma la brten cing rū pa phur bur bsgral ba sogs 'grub tshe/ sha dum la 'gug gzhug sogs gang ltar byas kyang mi 'gal yang / phal cher de byas na nus pa che/ zlog gtor ni/ zur gsum rtse mo dang dpal shin tu rno ba skyer rtsang gis brgyan pa yin/ zlog sngags bzla ba'i dus ni nyi myur yin mod kyang / de ltar ma grub tshe skabs nam du bzlas kyang rung ba lags/ bsnyen sgrub kyi ngag 'don rgyun khyer zhig kyang slad mar bri nas 'bul rtsis zhu/ zhes dad ldan slob mas bskul bas 'jam dpal nag po'i sgom bzlas la nyer mkholidris lan mtshon byed 'di yang dkar phyogs bzang po gnyis par dpal rig pa 'dzin pas kong yul ljon pa lung du bris pa sarba maṅga lo/1111 2222 3333 4444 5555 6666 7777 88 1 941234 1234 1234 1234 1234 1234 1234 12 31 471 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 32 3ka kha ga nga / ca cha ja nya/ ta tha da na/ pa pha ba ma/ tsa tsha dza wa/ zha za 'a ya/ ra la sha sa/ ha a/ ka kha ga nga / ca cha ja nya/ tsa tsha dza wa/ zha za 'a ya/ ta tha da na/ pa pha ba ma/ ra la sha sa/ ha a/grib srung rdzas kyi tho gsal bar bkod pa bzhugs so/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed khro mchog sme ba brtsegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grib srung rdzas kyi tho gsal bar bkod pa la/ thog mar bsag pa'i rdzas dgu tshan dgu ste/ dkar po dgu/ nag po dgu/ dmar po dgu/ zag pa dgu/ skra sen dgu/ rus pa dgu/ sman sna dgu/ chu sna dgu/ 'bru sna dgu ste/ de ltar dgu tshan dgu'o/ /dang po dpar po dgu la dung 1 srin med/ mgron bu sbrum 2ma/ dkar gong 3srin med/ tsan+dan 4dkar po/ ga bur 5/ spos dkar 6/ shu dag 7dkar po/ mkhan pa 8dkar po/ bal dkar 9me tog dang dgu'o/ /gnyis pa nag po dgu ni/ gu gul 1nag po/ gla ba nag 2po'i rtsi/ chu dag 3nag po/ 495

bong nga 4nag po/ mu zi nag 5po/ rta nag 6po'i bon/ yug sa 7nag po'i skra shad/ rgya snag 8 /spu dkar 9med pa'i khyi nag gi brun dang dgu'o/ /gsum pa dmar po dgu ni/ pad+ma rak+ta 1/ rgya mtshal 2/pha wang kha byang bstan gyi dreg pa dmar 3po/ tsā ri tra'am gnas chen gyi sirtse 4ra/ seng ldeng dmar 5po/tsan+dan dmar 6po/ grir shi ba'i snying khrag 7 /yug sa ma'i sna 8khrag /bshan pa'i khrag 9ste dgu'o/ /bzhi pa zag rdzas dgu ni/ grub pa thob pa'i dri chen 1/ spyang ki'i brun 2/ bya rog brun 3/ phag nag brun ri byi la nag po'i brun 5/ ba dmar ser gyi lci ba/ 6 klo mon gyi brun 7/ lkugs pa'i brun 8/mu to 'chi ba'i ro brun 9dang dgu'o/ /lnga pa ni/ mi rigs rus dang lo mi gcig pa dgu'i skra dang sen mo'o/ /drug pa rus pa dgu ni/ btsun pa 1/ sngags pa 2/ bon po 3/ rje bo ri phal pa 5/ bud med 6/ bshan pa 7/ byis pa 8/ sprang po 9ste de ltar rigs rus kyang mi gcig pa yi phung po bsregs pa'i rus pa dgu'o/ /bdun pa sman sna dgu ni/ a ru 1ra/ dzā ti 2/ sug 3smel/ li shi ri gur 5gum/cu gang 6/ ka ko la 7/ shing kun 8/ ru rta 9dang dgu'o/ /brgyad pa chu sna dgu ni/ gangs kyi chu 1/khron pa'i chu 2/ lu ma'i chu 3/ shing chu ri 'dam chu 5/ chu dron gyi chu 6/ lam chen du 'khyil ba'i chu 7/chu chen gyi dkyil nas blangs 8pa'i chu/ char gyi 9chu ste dgu'o/ /dgu pa 'bru sna dgu ni/ til dkar 1/til nag 2 /yungs kar 3/ yungs nag 4 /ke tshe 5/ shangs 6tshe/ bra 7bo/ sran 8ma/ zir nag 9 po dang dgu'o/ /de ltar dgu tshan dgu'i kha tshar du de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung / bdud rtsi chos sman/ rma bya'i mdongs te de rnams shin tu zhib par btags la gong gi chu dgu dang / chang shin tu gar ba'i snying khus ril bu yungs kar 'bring po'i tshang tsam dril nas rul sung med pa gal che la/ de yang gong gi rdzas kha cig nus ldan du bsregs pa sogs phyag len mthong ba brgyud pas kyang shes par bya dgos so/ /zhes 'jam dpal nag po'i sgrub thabs kyi las tshogs grib srung rdzas kyi rim pa 'di yang rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus gsal bar byas pa sarba maṅga lo/ 496

༄ga /bka' rdzogs pa chen po yang zab dkon mchog sbyi 'dus kyi khrid yig gu ru'i dgongs rgyan las sngon 'gro'i 'don cha zur bkol thar pa'i bde lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru pad+ma ka rā ya/ dge ba'i las 'phro dang zab lam gyi skal pa ldan pa dag thog mar sngon 'gro'i rim pa la 'jug par spro na/ 'di la gnyis su shes par bya ste/ rim gnyis spyi'i sngon 'gro dang / rdzogs chen sgos kyi sngon 'gro'o/ /dang po la'ang spyi dang bye brag gnyis las/ spyir thun thams cad kyi mgor bar chad zhi zhing byin rlabs 'jug pa'i gsol 'debs bya ba ni/ gnas dben par bde ba'i gdan la lus gnad bsrang / rlung ro lan gsum bsal ba'i tshe lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag par mos la/ mdun mkhar pad nyi zla steng pad 'byung dang / /bla ma dbyer med rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying / /paṇa zhu chos gos gsum gsol phyag gnyis kyis/ /rdo rje phur gdengs shangs sgor a dkar gsal/ /'ja' tshon gshog par khro bo khro mo spro/ /skyil mo krung bzhugs gnas gsum 'bru gsum mtshan/ /ye shes 'od zer rab 'phros byin brlabs gyur/ /bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bla ma chos kyi sku la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bla ma la gsol ba ྾ bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la ྾ bla ma la gsol ba ྾ bla ma sprul pa'i sku la ྾ skyabs mchog kun 'dus bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa myur du stsal du gsol/zhes lan grangs ci 'grub mthar/ spyoḥ ma bcos lhun grub ka dag rang byung sogs rig 'dzin nyid kyi zhal gsungs gsol 'debs 'di'ang dgos pa dang phan yon mchog tu che bas lan gcig gam gsum la sogs pa brjod/ /de nas sku'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum la sems gtad de/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ/ zhes bzlas pa'i mthar dmigs med du bzhag go/ /bye brag rim gnyis spyi'i sngon 'gro la gsum/ thun mong dang / thun mong ma yin pa dang / khyad par gyi sngon 'gro'o/ /dang po blo chos su skul ba la dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam pa ni/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka'/ /skyes bus don grub thob par gyur pa la/ /gal te 'di la phan pa ma bsgrubs na/ /phyis 'di yang dag 'byor pa ga la 'gyur/ /'chi ba mi rtag pa bsam pa ni/ srid gsum mi rtag ston ka'i sprin dang 'dra/ /'gro ba'i skye 'chi gar la lta dang mtshungs/ /'gro ba'i tshe 'gro nam mkha'i glog 'dra ste/ /ri gzar 'bab chu bzhin tu myur mgyogs 'gro/ /las rgyu 'bras bsam pa ni/ dus kyis bsnyen nas rgyal po 'gro 'gyur na/ /longs spyod mdza' dang gnyen bshes rjes mi 'brang / /skyes bu dag ni gar gnas gar 'gro yang / /las ni grib ma bzhin du rjes su 'brangs/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa ni/ sred srid ma 497

rig dbang gis skye bo rnams/ /mi dang lha dang ngan song rnam gsum po/ /'gro ba lnga po dag tu mi mkhas 'khor/ /dper na rdza mkhan 'khor lo 'khor ba bzhin/ /srid gsum rga dang nad kyi sdug bsngal 'bar/ /'di na 'chi me rab 'bar mgon med de/ /srid las byung la 'gro ba rtag tu rmongs/ /bum par chud pa'i bung ba 'khor ba bzhin/ /ces rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' dri ma med pa ste 'don bsgom nan tan du bya'o/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la bzhi/ dang po theg pa che chung thams cad kyi gzhi rten skyabs su 'gro ba ni/dag pa'i zhing gi mkha' la 'ja' sprin gyis/ /btags pa'i rin chen pad brtsegs rim pa gsum/ /dbus kyi ze'u 'brur sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /bla ma pad 'byung 'od phung 'dzum bcas bzhugs/ /de mthar pad+ma'i sa gzhi dang po la/ /rtsa ba yan lag brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor/ /gnyis par rgyud sde bzhi drug yi dam lha/ /gsum par mkha' 'gro ye shes chos skyong tshogs/ /de rgyab phyogs bzhir pad sdong rab rgyas steng / /mdun tu shāka thub phyogs dug sangs rgyas bcas/ /g.yas su spyan ras gzigs dbang byang sems tshogs/ /rgyab tu lung rtogs dam chos glegs bam tshul/ /g.yon tu shā ri'i bu la nyan rang bskor/ /sprin gseb lha dang lha mos mchod rdzas 'bul/ /de mdun bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can kun/ /dus 'di nas bzung byang chub snying po'i bar/ /sgo gsum gus pa chen pos skyabs su 'gro/ /zhes gsol ba btab la/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ: skyabs gnas dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi: zhes grangs bsags la mthar/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun nyid/ /bla ma dpal chen he ru ka /kun byed rgyal po bla ma yin/ /dkon mchog rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i gtso/ /gu ru rat+nar skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes pa'ang ci nus brjod/ 'dir sngon 'gro bsags skabs gong gi tshig rkang gcig po phyag re re dang spugs nas phyag dang skyabs 'gro 'bum ther mnyam thon mdzad pa'i phyag srol yod do/ /thun bsdu ba'i tshe/ skyabs yul rnams las 'od zer dkar po byung / /bdag sogs 'gro ba'i sgrib dag 'od du zhu/ /skyabs yul la thim 'khor rnams gtso bor 'dus/ /de yang spros bral chos dbyings brjod med do/ /gnyis pa ci byas byang chub kyi lam du bsgyur ba sems bskyed pa ni/ mkha' khyab 'gro kun bdag gi pha ma ste/ /bde ba 'dod kyang sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig sgrub/ /thar med 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje/ /de rnams bdag gis ci nas bsgral bar bya/ /de yi phyir du zab lam bla sgrub kyi/ /rim gnyis rnal 'byor mtha' ru phyin par bgyi/ /zhes mos la/ rgyu drug 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i pha ma rnams: bzod med gdung bas sangs rgyas 'thob bya'i phyir: kun kyang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: zhes grangs gsog /bar skabs rnams su dbugs phyir 'gro ba dang mnyam du bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad 'od zer zla zhun lta bur song nas sems can thams cad la phog pas bde ba chen po dang ldan/ dbugs tshur rngubs pa dang lhan cig sems can rnams kyi sdig sgrib sdug bsngal ma lus pa nag 'ubs kyis 'dus nas bdag la thim/ bdag gis lam zab mo yid la byas pa'i de ma thag tu sang gis dag par bsams te btang 498

len dmigs pa ci nus bya zhing / tshad med bzhi la blo bzhag ste/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dam pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig /ces pa'ang lan gsum la sogs pa brjod do/ /gal te rgyun gyi nyams len lta bur bsdu na/ skyabs sems dmigs pa gong smos thel/ 'don bya'ang skyabs 'gro tshig rkang gcig dang /sems bskyed tshig rkang gsum ste gter gzhung blo ka gcig sbrel nas grangs bsags pa'i mthar/ skyabs yul bsdus nas rdor sems la 'jug pas chog go/ /gsum pa sdig sgrib dag par byed pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas ni/ rang nyid tha mal spyi gtsug tu: rigs 'dus rdor sems 'od kyi sku: dkar 'tsher rdor dril rin chen brgyan: skyil krung zhal 'dzum brtse ba'i nyamasoḥ thugs kar r+ghaṃ:la yig brgyas bskor: 'o rgyun lta bu'i bdud rtsi bab: spyi gtsug rkang mthil yan chad kyi: nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dag: shel bum zho yis bkang ba ltar: gsal stong 'od kyi rang bzhin gyur: oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya: ma nu pā la ya:badz+ra satwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha: dṛ ḍho me bha ba: su toṣ+yo me bha ba: su po ṣ+yo me bha ba: a nu rak+to me bha ba: sarba sirnyi smo pra yats+tsha: sarba karma su tsa me tsit+t+waṃ: shrī yaḥku ru r+ghaṃ: ha ha ha ha ho: bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta:badz+ra mā me muñtsa: badz+rī bha ba: ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥr+ghaṃ: zhes bzla/ sngon 'gro ched du bsags skabs pad dkar 'dab ma 'bral pa nam mkha' khebs pa'i 'dab ma re re'i steng du rdor sems sngags 'khor bcas re re 'og tu sems can re re gnas pa dang / thugs ka'i sngags 'od kyis don gnyis byas nas byin rlabs bsdus/ bdud rtsi 'debs spyod sogs kyi dmigs pa gzhung gsal ltar la/ mthar yang / rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /rdo rje dang po kun tu bzang / /phyag 'tshal rdo rje sems dpa' la'o/ /zhes pas bstod/ mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos bskyab mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ni/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes bdag gzhan thams cad kyi nyes ltung bshags pas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal nas rigs kyi bu khyod kyis gtsor byas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dus de ring nas dag go zhes bka'i gnang ba stsal bar gyur/ /sku yi 'od kyis bdag sogs sdig sgrib dag /rdor sems skur gyur spyi bor bla mar thim/ /kun kyang 'od zhu gtso bo nyid la 'dus/ /de yang mtha' nas dbul yal stong nyid do/ /rgyun khyer skabs su de dag mi dgos pas yig brgya bzlas pa'i 'phros su/ rdor sems 'od du zhu rang la bsdu/ /zhes pa tsam gyis chog go/ /bzhi pa tshogs myur du rdzogs pa maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba la/ tshogs zhing gsal gdab pa ni/mdun gyi bar snang rin chen sa gzhi'i dbus/ /seng khri pad nyi zla steng pad+ma 'byung / /de'i steng spyan ras gzigs dbang gangs chen mtsho/ /de steng dang po'i sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur/ /dgongs brda snyan 499

khungs mkha' 'gro gtad rgya dang / /bka' babs dbang bskur rtogs pa don gyi brgyud/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs rgya mtshos bskor/ /de rgyab phyogs bzhir sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun/ /ye shes chos srung thams cad bzhugs par gyur/ /zhes mos la/ thog mar bsags sbyang bya ba ni/ bdag sogs 'gro kun bya byed spyod lam mthun pas yan lag bdun pa tshul bzhin bgyid par bsams la/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ: chos rnams thams cad sku gsum rang bzhin la: gnyis med klong yangs chen por phyag 'tshal lo: ma bcos mtha' bral mnyam pa nyid kyis mchod: rang sems sangs rgyas ma rtogs mthol lo bshagasoḥ gnas lugs rang rig ngang du yi rang ngo : 'dzin med khyab brdal rol pa'i chos 'khor bskor: 'khor 'das dbyer med bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs: chos dbyings lhun grub chen por bsngo bar bya: zung 'jug kun khyab bde chen mchog thob shog: ces bdun rnam dag grangs ci rigs bya/ de nas maṇ+ḍal dngos la spyir 'bul ba na/ lag len rnams khrid yig ltar byas la/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi rnam par dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūṃ/ phyi lcags ri khor yug gi ra bas yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su/ hūṃ/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab ces sogs tshom bu so bdun ma yongs grags ltar bkod cing so so'i dmigs pa gsal bas 'bul la/ sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis/ /'gro kun rnam dag shing la spyod par shog /ces lan grangs ci ltar rigs pas mchog rtsa gsum spyir 'bul/ bye brag bla ma sku gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal ni rdzogs chen sgom pa'i sngon 'gro lta bur shes shing spro na tshe sgrub gnam lcags rdo rje'i chos sde bi ma la'i chos brjod dpag bsam rab rgyas las 'gyur ba ltar tshigs bcad lhug rnams kyis ci nus su phul na 'bral chags shing shin tu legs la/ 'dir dkyus su bstan pa ni/ 14ba.oṃ āḥrdu: chos dbyings maṇ+ḍal rig pas brgyan pa 'di: bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku la 'bul: rang lus maṇ+ḍal dbang pos brgyan pa 'di: bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la 'bul/ /rin chen maṇ+ḍal gser g.yus brgyan pa 'di: bla ma thugs rje sprul pa'i sku la 'bul/ /ces 'bul/ /'bum ther bsags skabs grangs kyi gtso bo 'di las byung ngo / /mthar/ thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /gu ru rat+na maṇ+ḍal rka nir+ya ta yā mi/ tshogs zhing rnams las 'od 'phros 'gro kun la/ /phog pas sgrib byang dag pa'i zhing du gshegs/ /sku gsum 'khor bcas 'od zhu rang nyid la/ /thim pas tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ /gsum pa khyad par gyi sngon du 'gro ba bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ e ma hoḥ rang lus 'od phung rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /mdangs gsal me 'od gsal stong lhag ge'i ngang / /phyogs mtshams nam mkha' 'ja' 'od zer gyi klong / /spyi bor bla ma gu ru yid bzhin nor/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma pad 'byung spyan ras gzigs/ /rigs kyi bdag po snang ba mtha' yas dang / /gzhan yang mdo rgyud bstan bcos man ngag sogs/ /rgya bod mkhas grub bla ma thams cad bzhugs/ /zhes brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams tho brtsegs dang rtsa 500

gsum spyi khrom tshogs su bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum bcas gsal btab la/ mos gus gdung shugs rtse gcig pas/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ/ thog ma'i sangs rgyas kun bzang snang mtha' yas/ /gangs can mgon po kha sar pa ṇi dang / /'ja' lus snang srid dbang sdud pad+ma 'byung / /yang sprul rig 'dzin snying po'i mtshan can la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /ka dag lhun grub gzhi thog phebs pa dang / /khregs chod thod rgal mal la rtsal 'byongs te/ /sku dang ye shes dbyer med mngon gyur zhing / /mtha' yas 'gro kun sprul pas 'dren par shog /ces gsol 'debs tshig rkang dgu ma 'di nyid grangs gsog /'bum ther 'phral sogs dgos pa lta bus mi nus na/ de nyid ci 'grub dang / snang mtha' spyan gzigs pad 'byung srong btsan sgam/ /bka' brgyud gtsug rgyan dwags po lha rje sogs/ /kun gyi rnam 'phrul 'ja' tshon snying po la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes pa la grangs bzung yang rung ba ste snga phyi gnyis ka rig 'dzin chen po nyid kyi zhal gsungs byin rlabs che mnyam yin no/ /thun mthar zur du gsal ba'i brgyud 'debs rgyas bsdus rnams kyang 'don/ rgyun khyer lta bur 'di nas dbang len la 'jug pas cho ga la sngon 'gro bsags skabs sogs su/ mos gus stobs kyis brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams/ /'od zhu rim thim rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid/ /gzi brjid 'od du 'bar zhing thugs rje ches/ /bdag la dgongs te byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ /rgyu/ o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: zhes tshig bdun gsol 'debs dang / oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsidhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ zhes dang / oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi r+ghaṃ: zhes pa rnams kyang thog mar gsol 'debs kyi bsnyen pa'i don tu 'bum ther la sogs pa'i grangs cha mnyam du gsag go/ /mthar dbang len pa ni/ bla ma gu ru yid bzhin nor bu yi/ /dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od dkar skar mda' ltar/ /rang gi dpral bar thim pas bum dbang thob/ /lus kyi sgrib dag sa brgyad mi g.yo non/ /'bras bu sprul sku 'thob pa'i sa bon bzhag /bskyed rim ma hā yo ga bsgom la dbang / /mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od dmar mar me ltar/ /rang gi mgrin par thim pas gsang dbang thob/ /ngag gi sgrib dag legs pa'i blo gros non/ /'bras bu longs sku 'thob pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ /a nu'i rdzogs rim rang byin brlab la dbang / /thugs ka'i r+ghaṃ 'od mthing ga spos dud ltar/ /rang gi snying gar thim pas sher dbang thob/ /yid kyi sgrib dag sa bcu chos sprin non/ /'bras bu chos sku 'thob pa'i nus pa smin/ /a ti dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgom la dbang / /gnas lnga'i 'od zer lnga ldan 'ja' tshon ltar/ /gnas lngar thim pas ye shes dbang chen thob/ /sgo gsum sgrib dag bcu gcig kun 'ong non/ /ngo bo nyid sku 'thob pa'i skal can byas/ /rtsol bral ka dag lhun grub bsgom la dbang / /bla ma tshangs bug nas byon snyi~X ḍibus

bzhugs/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs bdag lus gang / /bde chen 'od zhu bdag gi sgo gsum dang //gsang ba gsum po dbyer med ro gcig gyur/ /ces mos gus kyi rang so ma nyams pa'i bzo med lhug pa'i rang ngo ci gnas su bskyangs la mthar/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /bdag gi snying gar pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru la/ /'bral ba med par rtag par bzhugs nas kyang / /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma sogs dang / dge ba 'di yis lo dpal ldan bla ma sogs bsngo smon rnam par dag pa'ang bya'o/ /gnyis pa rdzogs chen sgos kyi sngon 'gro thun mong ma yin pa rnams ni khrid yig gi dkyus ltar la/khyad par bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang lus snang stong 'od kyi rang bzhin nang / /rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga po sgrib bral dbus/ /spyi bor bud+dha thod phreng yab yum dkar/ /mgrin par pad+ma thod phreng yab yum dmar/ /snying gar badz+ra thod phreng yab yum mthing / /lte bar rat+na thod phreng yab yum ser/ /gsang bar karma thod phreng yab yum ljang / /'khor lo rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang / /rgya gram dril 'dzin 'khor los sgyur ba'i chas/ /pad zla'i gdan la rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs/ /'ja' tshon 'od zer thig le thig phran 'khrigs/ /gdod nas rang gsal lhun grub chen po yi/ /'od kyis bskul bas o rgyan thod phreng rtsal/ /dbyings nas spyan drangs mdun mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ /tshig bdun gsol 'debs lan gsum gyis byin dbab/ ting nge 'dzin gyis sprul pa'i phyi nang gsang mchod yid kyis 'bul la/ hrīḥ dus gsum gyi bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bor gyur cing mdzad pa'i phrin las la tha dad mi mnga' bar gyur pa/ o rgyan chen po gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs so/ /lus ngag yid gsum smin cing grol bar mdzad du gsol/ ces sogs gnas lugs rtogs pa'i gsol ba'i phur tshugs su btab pa'i mthar/ bla ma'i sku las byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /lnga ldan 'ja' 'od rnam pa lhug lhug bab/ /rang lus 'khor lo so so'i lha la thim/ /'od gsal ye shes chen po rgyud la 'phos/ /phyi nang bla ma 'khor lo so sor thim/ /stong gsal ngos bzung bral ba'i rang rig pa/ /sku gsum dbyer med bla ma pad 'byung ngo / /zhes mnyam par bzhag go/ /nang gi ru shan dbye ba rigs drug gnas spyod dkyus su bstan pa des kyang 'thus mod/ khyad par ba'i nyams len 'di nyid gzhung khrid ma rdzogs pa'am rgyun tu nyams len lta bur byas kyang shin tu zab cing legs pas 'di ltar/ rang lus rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i/ /lus nang dbu mar rdu mthing ro mar āḥ dmar gsal rkyang mar oṃ dkar 'od zer 'bar/ /rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor gdod nas bzhugs/ /spyi bor a dkar mgrin par su ser po/ /snying gar ṣ+ṭṛ ljang lte bar tro mthing ga /gsang bar pre dmar rkang mthil du dud ka /rigs drug skye 'gyur las dang bag chags kun/ /sa bon drug la 'ubs kyis 'dus pa la/ /'bru gsum dag pa 502

ye shes me phung gis/ /rigs drug sa bon thul gyis bsregs par gyur/ /oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ ma ma kolo sā man+ta/ zhes pa ngag bcad bdun 'bum bzla mthar/ phaṭa/ drug brjod pas 'bru gsum las ye shes kyi rlung byung bsregs pa'i thal pa 'og sgor bun bun gtor bar bsam/ de nas/ 'bru gsum mtha' ru yig brgya'i sngags phreng ni/ /dkar dmar mthing gsum bskor las bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /babs pas dri ma cha shas bcas te bkrus/ /rang lus dri med shel gong 'ja' tshon ltar/ /rang byung gdod ma'i sangs rgyas nyid du gyur/ /ces pa'i yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzlas pas sdig sgrib dag pa'i rtags spyi dang mtshungs par 'byung ngo / /mdor na rigs drug gi gnas bde blag tu sbyong ba dang / myur du 'tshang rgya ba sogs phan yon tshad med pa rgyud las gsungs pas nan tan tu bya'o/ /'dis kyang lam zab phrin las rgyun/ /thub bstan ji srid dar zhing rgyas/ /lus can mtha' dag chos 'di yi/ /gdul byar gyur nas rnam grol shog /ces pa'ang zab mo'i gnas la durnapa bla ma karma bkra shis dge legs dang karma bsod nams zung gis bskul ngor/ pad+ma'i sngags rig 'dzin pa pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug rtsal gyis tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi sgrub gnas su sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// //

dze /snyan brgyud bla ma yang gsang pad+ma 'od 'bar gyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs yid bzhin tog gi phreng ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ trīḥ khyab brdal phyogs bral chos dbyings zhing khams su/ /rang byung ye sangs rgyas pa gdod ma'i mgon/ /rgyal kun mes po kun bzang yab yum la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs/ /r+ghaṃ rgyu rgyu/ bde chen 'dus ma byas pa'i zhing khams su/ /sku lnga'i bdag nyid gsung gi rdo rje chos/ /pad+ma rgyal po 'od dpag med mgon la/ /gsol ba ྾ r+ghaṃ ྾ 'od lnga'i thig le 'dus pa'i zhing khams su/ /rigs rnams kun 'dus sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i tshogs/ /rig pa ye shes rdo rje sems mchog la/ /gsol ba ྾ r+ghaṃ ྾ 'gyur med pad+ma 'od kyi zhing khams su/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas yongs kyi ngo bo nyid/ /mtsho skyes sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ /gsol ba ྾ r+ghaṃ ྾ 'pho med dga' bzhi'i dngas ma'i zhing khams su/ /rgyal kun skyed mdzad shes rab pha rol phyin/ /bde chen rgyal yum ye shes mtsho rgyal la/ /gsol ba ྾ hūm̐ ྾ zag bral gnyug ma rang gsal zhing khams su/ /rig pa'i rtsal rdzogs rgyal ba kun gyi sras/ /bdud 'dul nus ldan rdo rje rtsal 'chang la/ /gsol ba ྾rgyu ྾ ma tshogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i zhing khams su/ /'gro ba yongs 'dul brtul zhugs nus pa'i bdag /pad+ma nor bu rdo rje gzi brjid la/ /gsol ba ྾ r+ghaṃ ྾ bskal bzang smin cing grol ba'i zhing khams su/ /rig 'dzin chen po yongs kyi 'khor los sgyur/ /dran chog dngas ma pad+ma bde chen la/ /gsol ba ྾ r+ghaṃ྾ phyogs med 'gro don skyong ba'i zhing khams su/ /'bral tshad don ldan mchog gi sprul pa'i sku/ /rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu la/ /gsol ba ྾ r+ghaṃ ྾ spyi gtsug bde chen dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /bka' drin gsum ldan 'khor lo'i dbang phyug che/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen la/ /gsol ba ྾ r+ghaṃ ྾ snang ba dag pa chos kyi zhing khams su/ /rdo rje slob dpon dbang khrid lta spyod mthun/ /dam tshig gcig 'dres rdo rje mched lcam la/ /gsol ba ྾ hūm̐ ྾ 'ja' 'od me phung thig le'i zhing khams su/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso bo mchog /gtum drag me phreng rdo rje gro lod la/ /gsol ba ྾ r+ghaṃ ྾ gnas gsum dag pa lha yi zhing khams su/ /sgrub mchog rtag tu skyong la g.yel med pa/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro dpa' bo'i tshogs bcas la/ /gsol ba ྾ r+ghaṃ ྾mkha' spyod rngam pa sgra sgrog zhing khams su/ /las dang ye shes srung ma kun gyi mthu/ /gcig bsdus nye 504

mgon gzi ldan yab yum la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs/ /r+ghaṃ hūm̐ r+ghaṃ/ de ltar snying thig bla sgrub brgyud pa yi/ /bla ma lha dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong la/ /rtse gcig gus pa drag pos gsol btab mthus/ /khyod kyi brtse chen thugs rje gzi byin gyis/ /nus pa'i shugs phyung skad cig da lta 'dir/ /bdag gi nyon mongs 'khrul rtog kun bcom nas/ /'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das dngos grub kun/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i byin rlabs yongs zhugs te/ /a ti rdzogs chen nyams rtogs rtsal rdzogs shing / /phung khams 'pho chen 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku/ /mngon gyur ye shes yon tan yongs rdzogs shog /de ltar ma thob bar du skye ba kun/ /khams drug mngon mtho nges legs rten thob cing / /'jigs zhi 'byor rgyas chos min rnam rtog 'gag /dam tshig sel med bla ma'i dgyes dgu 'grub/ /sa lam yon tan gong nas gong 'phel shog /snang srid thams cad 'od gsal gzhom med zhing / /sgra grags nā dā dran rtogs lung 'dzin bral/ /'ub chub kun bzang dgongs pa'i dbyings nyid du/ /khams gsum 'gro 'dren byed por bdag gyur shog /ces pa snying thig snyan rgyud bla sgrub kyi gsol 'debs 'di nyid dad ldan gyi sbyin bdag dbon drung tshe dbang dpal 'byor rab rgyas dang chos mdzad ye shes pad dkar chos nyid dang snyan grags lngas yang yang bskul ngor / mdo khams kaḥthog lho phyogs su 'od gsal lha rigs skyes pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu 'gro ba yongs 'dul rtsal gyis stod mnga' ris glo bo smad rgya gar dang bod kyi mtshams gnyag pa'i bar mtha'/bsam 'grub chos sdebs su bya rgyal zla dmar phyogs nya la bla ma'i mchod skabs su thun bar gcig tu bris pa'o// //'jam dpal nag po thugs kyis yang zhun gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs so/ /oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ/ kun bzang 'jam dpal pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /mnga' bdag yab sras ye shes mtsho rgyal ma/ /zab gter mnga' bdag o rgyan sangs rgyas gling / /rang sras bdun brgyud bde chen dar rgyas dang / /bka' drin mtshungs med bde chen rab gsal zhabs/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma dran chog 'khor lo'i mgon/ /'jam dpal yang zhun smin grol brgyud pa yi/ /bla ma rnams dang yi dam lhag pa'i lhar/ /rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /las bzhi lhun grub grub pa che brgyad thob/ /khyad pa tshe dbang phyag rgya che mchog grub/ /'jam dpal go 'phang tshe 'dir thob byin rlobs/ /zhes 'jam dpal nag po thugs kyi yang zhun gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'di yang rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus sbyar ba'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/ /505

༄ga /bde ldan bkod pa'i mdo don ji bzhin pa'i smon lam thar pa'i sgo 'byed zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo budha bo dhi satwe bh+yaḥ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ rig pa zhabs ldan bde gshegs 'jig rten mkhyen pa skyes bu 'dul/ kha bsgyur bla med lha ma'i ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /gzi bajid tshe dang ye shes 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /'di skad bdag thos dus gcig bcom ldan thub mchog gnyan yod du/ /rgyal bu rgyal byed tshal gyur mgon med zas sbyin kun dga' rar/ /nyan thos 'phags pa shā ri'i bu dang mong gal bu dang ni/ /'od srungs chen po ka t+ya'i bu dang ka bi na chen po/ /gsus chen nam gru lam phran brtan pa dga' bo kun dga' bo/ /bha ra dh+wa dza 'char byed nag po ba kulu sgra gcan 'dzin/ /ba glang bdag dang ma 'gags pa sogs dge 'dun chig stong dang / /nyis brgya lnga bcus bskor ba de la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus der gzhan dag byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyis bskor gyur pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal gzhon nu dang / /mi pham pa dang spos kyi glang po rtag tu brtson pa dang / /brtson pa mi 'dor ba sogs byang sems 'khor tshogs dpag med dang / /gzhan yang dbang po brgya byin mi mjed bdag po tshangs pa che/ /de sogs bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag mang por gyur pa yi/ /lha yi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor te bzhugs pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /shākya thub pa 'khor dang bcas pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de tshe shā ri'i bu la bka' stsal mchog tu bsngags pa'i gnas/ /zhing 'di'i nub phyogs sangs rgyas zhing khams bye ba khrag khrig 'bum/ /'das pa de na tshe dpag med bzhugs zhing khams bde ba can/ /ci'i phyir der gnas sems can rnams kyi lus dang sems la ni/ /sdug bsngal med cing bde rgyu tshad med ldan pas bde ba can/ /sangs rgyas zhing de zhing gi yon tan bkod pa rnam mang pos/ /legs par brgyan pa kun kyang shin tu bkra shing lta na sdug /zhing der bdag ni lus 'di 'phos ma thag tu skye bar shog /zhing de kha khyer rim bdun tā la'i phreng ba rim bdun ldan/ /dril g.yer drwa bas yongs bskor zhing kun rin chen bdun gyis brgyan/ /rin chen bdun rdzing brgyad ldan chus gang rin chen pad+mos khebs/ /bya rog btung rung kha nga cang gyur gser gyi bye ma brdal/ /rdzings kyi phyogs bzhir them skas bzhi bzhi gser dngul be+eḍūr shel/ /rdzings 'grams be+eḍūr+ya dang gsel dngul shel dang rdo 506

snying spug /mu tig dmar ste rin chen padun gyi ljon shing kun tu rgyas/ /zhing der bdag ni lus 'di 'phos ma thag tu skye bar shog /rdzings kyi pad+mo de kun shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam du skyes/ /gser mdog gser gyi 'od 'byung gser ltar ston dang de bzhin du/ /sngo ser dkar dmar mdog dang sna tshogs bkra bas yongs khengs shing / /tā la'i phreng dang dril g.yeng phreng rnams rlung bskyod sgra yid 'ong / /rol mo mkhan gyur yan lag bye ba 'bum ldan lha'i sil snyan/ /blang 'dra byang chub chos sgra der skyes sems can gyis thos pas/ /sangs rgyas dam chos dge 'dun dran pa lus la gnas par byed/ /zhing der bdag ni lus 'di 'phos ma thag tu skye bar shog /zhing der lha yi sil snyan sgra dbyangs rang bzhin rtag 'byung zhing / /sa gzhi gser gyi kha dog ji bzhin shin tu nyams dga' gsal/ /de na dmyal ba gshin rje byol song skye gyur ming yang med/ /sprul pa'i bya tshogs ngang pa khrung khrung rma bya la sogs pas/ /nyin mtshan thun drug rnams su rang rang skad kyi chos bgro ba/ /dbang po stobs dang byang chub yan lag rab tu snyan pa'i sgra/ /thos pa'i sems can kun kyang dkon mchog rjes su dran la sbyor/ /zhing der bdag ni lus 'di 'phos ma thag tu skye bar shog /nyin mo lan gsum mtshan thun gsum du me tog man+da ra'i/ /char chen bab pas sa gzhi kun nas yongs su mdzes bkra byed/ /der gnas sems can kun kyang sangs rgyas mthu yis snga gro bzhin/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams gzhan du 'dong nas sangs rgyas bye ba phrag /'bum la phyag byas sangs rgyas re la'ang me tog skon bu bcas/ /bye ba 'bum gyis mngon par mchod cing dgyes byas chos nyan te/ /slar yang rang gi gnas su nyi ma de la 'dong bar byed/ /zhing der bdag ni lus 'di 'phos ma thag tu skye bar shog /de bzhin gshegs de'i nyan thos dgra bcom tshad med grangs med pa'i//grangs ni 'phags pa rdzu 'phrul chen pos yang ni brjod nus min/ /gzhan ni sangs rgyas zhing der skyes pa'i sems can gang su yang / /skye ba gcig gis thog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dam pa che/ /phyir mi ldog pa 'ba' zhig las ni gzhan yod ma yin ste/ /de lta'i byang chub sems dpa' ji snyed tshad dang grangs dag ni/ /brjod pa sla ba ma yin sangs rgyas zhing khams kun khyab byed/ /zhing der bdag ni lus 'di 'phos ma thag tu skye bar shog /zhing de'i rgyal ba de ni sku tshe dpag tu med pas na/ /bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med pa zhes su bya/ /de bzhin 'od snang dpag med sangs rgyas zhing kun thog med khyab/ /de phyir de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med pa zhes bya mtshan/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas grangs med kun gyis dus rnams rtag bsngags mdzad/ /gang de bla med yang dag rdzogs byang mngon par chub nas yun/ /zhing 'di'i bskal pa bcu lon da lta 'tsho gzhes chos ston mdzad/ /zhing der bdag ni lus 'di 'phos ma thag tu skye bar shog /ngan ngon tsam min dag pa'i dge rtsa thams cad gus pa 507

yis/ /yongs su bde chen zhing gi skyes bu che de mjal bar bsngo/ /tshe 'od dpag med de'i mtshan thos nas yid la byed pa'i sems/ /nub mo gcig nas bdun bar g.yeng med byas pas 'chi ba'i tshe/ /phyin ci ma log sems kyis dus byas de tshe 'od dpag med/ /nyan thos dge 'dun gyis bskor byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bcas pa/ /mdun du blta ba'i mdun na mngon sum bzhugs mthong gyur pa yi/ /zhing der bdag ni lus 'di 'phos ma thag tu skye bar shog /bdag cag ston mchog yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thub dbang gis/ /sems can gang dag 'od dpag med pa'i zhing khams bde ba can/ /sems kyis smon nga/ra byed dam byas pa byed 'gyur de thams cad/ /bla med yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub las ni phyir mi ldog /phyir ma ldog cing phyir mi ldog 'gyur don chen yongs gzigs nas/ /sangs rgyas zhing der gus pas smon lam gdab zhes ches bsngags pa'i/ /ljags kyi dbang pos zhing kun khyab byas bden pa'i mthu des bdag /lus 'di bor thag nyid du bde can skye bar shog /thub pas ji ltar gsung bzhin shar phyogs bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs/ /mi 'khrugs pa dang lhun po'i rgyal mtshan lhun po lhun po che/ /lhun po che snang 'jam sgra 'jam dbyangs la sogs sangs rgyas ni/ /gaṅgā'i klung gi bye snyed kun gyis dzun med bden gsung ljags/ /rang rang zhing khams kheb par byas te tshe 'od dpag med kyi/ /yon tan bsam yas yongs brjod sangs rgyas kun gyis yongs bzung ba'i/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la yid ches gyis gsung bden des bdag /lus 'di bor thag nyid du bde can zhing der skye bar shog /de bzhin lho phyogs sangs rgyas zhing na bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs/ /nyi zla'i sgron ma dang ni grags pa grags pa'i 'od zhes dang / /'od 'phro'i phung po lhun po'i sgron ma brtson 'grus mtha' yas sogs/ /gaṅgā'i klung gi bye snyed kun gyis rdzun med bden gsung ljags/ /rang rang zhing khams kheb par byas te tshe 'od dpag med kyi/ /yon tan bsam yas yongs brjod sangs rgyas kun gyis yongs bzung ba'i/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la yid ches khrid gsung bden nges bdag /lus 'di bor thag nyid du bde can zhing der skye bar shog /de bzhin nub kyi phyogs na sangs rgyas tshe dpag med pa dang / /phung po dpag med rgyal mtshan dpag med 'od chen 'od zer snang / /rin chen tog dang 'od zer dag sogs nub phyogs sangs rgyas ni/ /gaṅgā'i klung gi bye snyed kun gyis brdzun med bden gsung ljags/ /rang rang zhing khams kheb par byas te tshe 'od dpag med kyi/ /yon tan bsam yas yongs brjod sangs rgyas kun gyis yongs gsung pa'i/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la yid ches gyis gsung bden des bdag /lus 'di bor thag nyid du bde can zhing der skye bar shog /byang phyogs de bzhin gshegs pa 'od 'phro'i phung po chen po dang / /thams cad sgrol dbyangs rab tu thul dka' nyi ma 'byung zhes dang / /drwa 508

ba can gyi 'od dang 'od kyi 'byung gnas sogs sangs rgyas/ /gaṅgā'i klung gi bye snyed kun gyis brdzun med bden gsung ljags/ /rang rang zhing khams kheb par byas te tshe 'od dpag med kyi/ /yon tan bsam yas yongs brjod sangs rgyas kun gyis yongs bzung ba'i/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la yid ches gyis gsung bden nges bdag /lus 'di bor thag nyid du bde can zhing der skye bar shog /de bzhin 'og phyogs bzhugs pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas seng ge dang / /grags pa dang ni grags 'od chos shes chos 'dzin ces bya dang / /chos kyi rgyal mtshan la sogs sangs rgyas bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs/ /gaṅgā'i klung gi bye snyed kun gyis rdzun med bden gsung ljags/ /rang rang zhing khams kheb par byas te tshe 'od dpag med kyi/ /yon tan bsam yas yongs brjod sangs rgyas kun gyis yongs bzung ba'i/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la yid ches gyis gsung bden nges bdag /lus 'di bor thag nyid du bde can zhing der skye bar shog /stengs nas tshangs dbyangs skar rgyal spos mchog spos 'od spos phung po/ /rin chen me tog shin tu rgyas rigs sa la'i dbang po'i rgyal/ /rin chen ut+pa la'i dpal mthong ba don yod lhun ltar sogs/ /gaṅgā'i klung gi bye snyed rgyal kun rdzun med bden gsung ljags/ /rang rang zhing khams kheb par byas te tshe 'od dpag med kyi/ /yon tan bsam yas yongs brjod sangs rgyas kun gyis yongs bzung ba'i/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la yid ches gyis gsung bden des bdag /lus 'di bor thag nyid du bde can zhing der skye bar shog /'od dpag med zhing bkod dang bcom ldan sangs rgyas de rnams mtshan/ /thos gyur thos pa thos 'gyur de kun sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /rnams kyis yongs su bzung bar 'gyur zhes bden gyur dam pas gsung / /thub des sangs rgyas de dag yon tan bsam mi khyab brjod bzhin/ /sangs rgyas de dag kun gyis shākra thub yon tan de bzhin bsngags/ /snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus su sangs rgyas gzhan gyis mdzad dka' kun/ /yongs su bzung mdzad thub dbang de la snying nas skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag ni lus 'di bor thag bde can zhing der skye bar shog /bcom ldan rgyal ba'i bka' la nyan thos byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha mi lha min dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten kun yi rangs/ /sangs rgyas bka' stsal mngon bstod nam yang mi bslu shin tu bden/ /bden pa mchog gsum phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas bden mthu dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med dang shākra thub byin rlabs kyis/ /bdag sogs lus 'di bor ma thag tu bar mtshams gzhan med par/ /sangs rgyas zhing mchog 'jig rten khams gyur bde ldan bkod pa ru/ /skye bar gyur cig dus gsum dge ba kun kyang de'i phyir bsngo/ /bdag ni so skye mos spyod sa la gnas pa'i skabs nyid nas/ /mthong thos dran reg gyur dang de rnams kyis kyang rlung rtsi phyogs/ /phog gyur 'gro kun lhag bsam smon 509

lam stobs gang rgyal ba'i mthus/ /kun kyang phyam cig bde ldan bkod pa'i zhing du skye bar shog /ces pa/ bde ba can gyi bkod pa'i mdo don tshang ba'i smon lam tshigs su bcad pa thar pa'i sgo 'byed zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rnam 'dren dpa' bo sprul pa'i sku rin po che gtsug lag dga' ba'i zhal snga nas kyi gsung gis bskul ba la brten/ bod yul kha ba can gyi dbus gyur lha ldan rang byung sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang jo bo 'od zer lha brgyad kyi spyan sngar snying nas gus pas/ /phyogs med rgyal khams pa rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus/ /me yos rab byung bcu gsum pa chu stod zla ba'i dkar phyogs gang ba la grub par bris pa'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /shus+t+waṃ/ de ltar/ tshigs la mi ston don la ston pa'i lung la brten nas/ gang zag ci rigs pa'i ngor skabs 'gar tshig zol yangs zhing brjod pa bde bar dgongs te/ 'phags yul gyi slob dpon chen po dpa' bos mdo sde tshigs lhug pa 'ga' zhig tshigs bcad du sdebs par mdzad ces bka' gdam gyi gsung bsgros khung mar byung ba dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dam pa 'gas kyang sngags rgyud la la rgya skad lhug par bod skad tshigs bcad bsgyur ba dang 'dra bar/ 'di yang ye shes dam pa brnyes pa'i skyes bu ches che ba mchog gis bde ba can gyi zhing gi bkod pa'i mdo tshigs lhug pa'i don tshigs su bcad par sdebs nas smon lam du kha bsgyur bar gnang ba yin phyir/ yid rtse gcig tu kha 'don bgyis na/ de bzhin gshegs pa yi bka' mdo sde rin po che de nyid bton pa'i phan yon 'byung thog /kha bsgyur smon lam mthu yi lus 'di 'phos ma thag tu zhing der nges par skye ba the tshom med pas/ smon lam khyad par can 'di la kun gyis nan tan du 'bad 'tshal lo/ /yang dam pa mchog rnams kyis ngo bo rnam pa gnyis ka sangs rgyas bka' rma med pa'i don las nam yang mi 'da' bzhin thabs mkhas zab mos mdzad pa de ltar bstan pa la/ tha snyad mkhan dang rag gan gser brdzus ba tshos mgran ste stag gis phyong sar was phyongs pa'i dpe bzhin rgyal ba'i bka' rnams rang 'dod kyis bzo bcos phri bsnan 'dra min sna tshogs kyis bslad nas ngom ngom byed pa ni/ phral snang yin yin 'dra yang byin rlabs med cing don gnad khyogs pa yi nyes pa'i g.yang sa chen por lhung ba 'gyur bas nam yang dor dgos su shes pa gal che'o/ /ces pa'ang rigs 'dzin bla ma rje yi bka' 'bang tha shal gtsug lag dga' ba'i dbang pos 'di nyid par du bsgrub skabs smras pa lags so/ /sarba maṅga lo/ /ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tudhe ṣān+ta thā ga ho h+ya ba da ta te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ wā rī ma hā shra ma naḥ 510

༄sha /gaskyiramārgaṭ+wāṃsāmān+yagran+d+rabishiṣ+ṭagrobadzātsār+yasādhanopadeshamarmasaṃp+taban+d+rakarād+dhatadharmatheṣ+ṭhasāmān+yasidhirasabāharnanāmabartate/ /༄ga /lam zab mo kun gyi spyi gzhung khyad mchog rdo rje slob dpon sgrub pa'i man ngag gnad dril lam khyer smar chos mchog thun dngos grub bcud 'bebs ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo ma hā gu ru mū la badz+ra dhā ra shrī wan/ rgyal kun thugs ye mnyam ro chig bzlum pa/ /spros bral chos dbyings stong nyid rdo rje 'chang / /sna tshogs thugs rje kun snang sems dpa' che/ /dran mchog gsang bdag bla mar phyag byas nas/ /dus gsum rgyal kun bsgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ /gsang ba bsam mi khyab dpag mi long ba/ /mthar thug don gcig de bzhin gshegs pa'i shul/ /mngon du byed pa'i gnad mtha' yas pa las/ /snying por gyur pa myur thabs gsang theg pa/ /yang gsang tshe gcig byang chub byed pa'i don/ /nyams len mthil dril kun zhun chos bzhi'i ṭika /byin rlabs bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgrub pa mchog /'di snang zhen log chos la brtson 'grus can/ /skyid sdug ro snyoms bla mar mas gus dad/ /dam ldan gcig pur ri khrod 'grims pa'i chos/ /gcig chog gdams pa zab mo 'dir ston to/ /de yang las dang skal bar ldan pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis tshe 'dir rnam grol byang chub mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'dod pas na/ chos kyi bye brag zab zab legs legs snyan snyan du gyur pa rnams/ 'di yang legs 'di yang legs snyam nas cung zad re nyams su blangs nas mthar ma phyin te/ 'chi khar chos gang la yang grub rtags ma thon par don med stong las kyi ngang du 'chi ba yang shes pas/ thog mar chos zab mo gang rung zhig gi dgongs don mngon sum rtogs phyin chad/ gcig shes kun grol gyis chos yongs la byan tshud par 'gyur te/ des na dang po mtshan ldan bla ma yang dag pa'i drung du/ /gdams pa thob lo nyan lo bsgom lo bsgrub lo tsam du ma yin par/ /bla ma zhabs tog gis mnyen par byas shing /chos kyi gzhung don man ngag gab skyibs med par mtha' rgya chod par zhus shing / /dam sel spu tsam med par byas nas/ 'jig rten tshe 'di'i khri ba chos brgyad btsan thabs su bcad la/ zas gos la chog mi shes pa dang / bag med le lo rnam g.yengs gnyid kyis dus 'da' ba rnams rgyang bsrings shing / zhen log dang dgos med brtson 'grus kyis dpa' bskyed/ ri khrod dben sa brten nas spros bcas kyi dge 511

sbyor la mi g.yengs pas/ byams snying rje byang sems kyi gzhi bting nas/ rang gi rdo rje slob dpon la dad pa mos gus dang dam tshig srog phur du btsug te/ rtag tu nyams su len pa'i thil pur/ gcig pur ri khrod 'grims pa'i ri chos mthar thug mchog thun dngos grub ma lus pa'i bcud 'bebs par byed pa/blo bde gcig chog lam zab mo bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po kun gyi spyi gces rgyal ba thams cad kyi bsgrod pa gcig pa'i gzhung srol khyad par rmad byung mchog gi gdams pa yongs kyi rgyal po chen por gyur pa rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje slob dpon bsgrub pa'i man ngag gnad bsdus chig dril lam du khyer bde zhing shin tu rmar ba'i snying po yang zhun dam pa'i chos 'di lta nyams su len par spyi don chos bzhi las/ thog mar blo chos su 'gro bar byed pa la blo ldog rnam ba bzhi ni/ kyai ma soms dang grangs med bskal pa ru/ /rnyed dka' dal 'byor lan gcig thob pa 'di/ /rab tu 'jig sla 'chi rkyen bsam mi khyab/ /gces bskyong lus 'di de ring nyid 'chi srid/ /mi dge log lci 'tshams med sdug bsngal rgyu/ /'khor ba'i bya ba thams cad spangs byas shing / /cung zad long yod dus 'dir lus ngag yid/ /thar pa'i phan yon bsam nas chos bsgrub 'tshal/ /gnyis pa chos lam du 'gro bar byed pa la skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na mo r+ghaṃ/ 'gro la phan mdzad sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun rtsa rgyud bla ma yi dam dhā ki'i tshogs/ /sku gsum rang rig 'du 'bral med pa'i lhar/ /rtag par skyabs mchi mgon pos bdag bzung mdzod/ /byang chub sems bskyed pa ni/ mkha' mnyam 'gro la phan dang bde ba'i phyir/ /smon 'jug byang chub sems mchog cher bskyed de/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor rjes su bdag 'jug slob/ /sdom rnams brtan bgyis thugs rjes byin gyis rlobs/ /tshogs bsags maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ ri gling rdul snyed mchod sprin lha mi'i rdzas/ /rang lus phung khams skye mched dbang po bkra/ /sems nyid ka dag 'od gsal lhun grub brgyan/ /bla ma sku gsum zhing 'bul tshogs rdzogs shog /sgrib sbyangs rdor sems bsgom bzlas ni/ /r+ghaṃ/ bdag nyid spyi gtsug pad zlar rdo rje sems/ /dkar gsal zhi tshul rdor dril rol stabs bzhugs/ /thugs kar zla steng r+ghaṃ mthar yig brgyas bskor/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs bdag lus sgrib gnyis sbyangs/ /māṃ āḥr+ghaṃ ṭ+wā hā/oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya badz+ra sa twa twe no pa tiḥṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa su to ṣ+yo me bha wa su po ṣ+yo me bha wa a nu raka to me bha wa sarba sirnyi me pra yaḥtsa sarba karma su tsa me tsita tai shri ya ku ru hūṃ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga wan sar ba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me mun tsa badz+rī bha wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa aḥrdu phaṭaḥ rjes su rdor sems rang gis snying kar byon/ /sku dang sngags phreng rim bzhin rdu la 'dus/ /rtsu nyid 'od zhu bdud rtsis rang lus khyab/ /sgo gsum chig 'dres rang rig ngo bor āḥ.a ti a ti/ de nas gsum pa lam gyi 'khrul pa zhi bar byed pa byin rlabs kyi gnad kun gyi yang snying srog gi dngas ma bla ma mos gus khrid rim gyi rtsa ba 512

bsnyen pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni/ rmā ā+oṃḥhūṃ trīḥ bdag lus zhen med snang stong rta phag gi/ /spyi bo'i nam mkhar 'ja' gur sna lnga'i dkyil/ /mi 'jig seng ge brgyad kyis btegs pa'i khrir/ /pad dkar 'dab stong nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor dbus/ /skye med āḥyig dkar 'tsher lam me ba/ /blta bas mi bzod 'od zer mchog tu 'bar/ /'od 'phros mdangs kyis yongs su rab khyab pas/ /rigs drug sgrib sbyangs snod bcud dag par bsgyur/ /dgu ldan rgyal ba sras rig grub bla rabs/ /rtsa gsum rab 'byams kun 'dus āḥr thim pas/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma pad 'byung rdo rje sems/ /dkar gsal rigs lnga'i phrogs zhu dar dpyang 'phur/ /rdor dril rol 'dzin zhi tshul longs sku'i chas/ /rdzogs gsol zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil mor bzhugs/ /de yi spyi mgrin thugs ka lte gsang bar/ /khrag 'thung rig 'dzin zhi ba mkha' 'gro phur/ /sgal tshigs dbang mo nyer brgyad gzhan yang skur/ /til gang phyes ltar rgyal ba rgya mtshos khengs/ /mdzes sdug mtshan dpes rab brgyan gzi brjid 'bar/ /yid la dran tsam 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sel/ /mthong bas zag med bde ba la sbyor zhing / /gsol btab mchog thun dngos grub myur ster ba'i/ /sku rgyab 'od kor bsgyur pa'i bla ma dang / /mdun du theg rim rgyud sde'i yi dam lha/ /g.yas su kun bzang rdzogs sangs rgyas grangs med/ /rgyab tu phar phyin yan lag bcu gnyis chos/ /g.yon du rigs gsum dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /bar mtshams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos zhing skyong / /dpag med sprin dpung gtibs 'dra byin thibs se/ /dam ye dbyer med mos snang ngor shar sku/ /dgyes zhal brtse spyan bdag la rab gzigs shing / /bag dro byin chags lhan ne lhang bzhugs pa'i/ /mdun du bdag mos gus shugs cher g.yos te/ /dbang med dad pa'i mchi ma 'khrug bzhin du/ /snang srid snod bcud bdag lus longs spyod dang / /gtan gyi 'dun mar bcas pa'i yongs mchod cing / /thugs dam bskul nas bdag rgyud byin brlabs phyir/ /ma yengs phur tshugs drag pos gsol ba 'debs/ /oṃ māṃḥrgyu ma hā gu ru dzñā na badz+ra satwa r+ghaṃ/ /gsol 'debs thun mong gi sgo nas bsnyen pa ni/ oṃ r+ghaṃḥr+ghaṃ hoḥ kun bzang rigs lnga ston pa bcu gnyis sogs/ /dgongs rgyud bla mar gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs/ /dga' rab 'jam sing pad 'byung bi ma la/ /brda rgyud bla mar gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs/ /be+e ro nam snying mtsho rgyal rje 'bangs tshogs/ /snyan rgyud bla mar gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs/ /ldang lhun lce btsun klong chen gter ston brgya/ /gter rgyud bla mar gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs/ /'dren pa yongs gtso pad 'byung bde chen gling / /sdom mdzad mchog gyur karmā rig pa 'dzin/ /rigs kun khyab bdag rje btsun chos kyi rje/ /thugs rje'i dbang phyug bla med 'gro ba'i mgon/ /bka' drin mnyam bral dpal chen gsang ba'i bdag /dran mchog 'khor lo'i mgon po ho ru ka /byin rlabs bcud byin tshe dbang nor bu 513

dpal/ /rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs/ /theg kun rtse rgyal bka' gsang rdzogs pa che/ /tshe gcig 'od skur gshegs byed smin grol chos/ /snying thig brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam lha/ /mkha' 'gro srungs mar rtse gcig gsol btab mthus/ /mi rtag 'chi dran chos brgyad zhen pa log /ri khrod dka' spyad nges 'byung dag snang rgyas/ /gdams ngag goms 'dris bslab gsum mi nyams brtan/ /nyams myong gong 'phel rtogs pa klong du gyur/ /phra ba gting slad nyin mtshan 'od gsal 'dres/ /drod tshad myur brnyes sa lam yon tan rdzogs/ /snang bzhi zad skyol gdengs bzhi mtha' ru phyin/ /gdan 'dir grub pa thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes dang / thun mong ma yin pa bla ma 'bod dbyangs kyi bsnyen pa ni/ bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so/ /mchog gsum kun 'dus kyi ngo bo/ /rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor gyi spyi dpal/ /sku gsum lhun grub kyi bdag nyid/ /'gran bral bla ma rang mkhyen no/ /'o/ 'o bla ma/ 'o sangs rgyas/ bka' brgyud bla ma yi rgyal po/ /zab dgu gdams mchog mdzod 'dzin/ /smin sgrol snying po yi don ster/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rang mkhyen no/ /'o/'o bla ma/ 'o sangs rgyas/ bslu med thugs rje yi mnga' bdag /gtan bde byang chub kyi ded dpon/ /'di phyi 'dren mdzad kyi drin can/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rang mkhyen no/ /'o/ 'o bla ma/ 'o sangs rgyas/ gdung yus ni/ bdag 'dra'i las ngan gyi sems can/ /skyid sdug ci byung yang khyed las/ /blo phugs gtad sa gzhan ma mchis/ /mtho dman gar gtang yang khyed shes/ /snying nas gsol 'debs kyi bu la/ /thugs rjes g.yel med du gzigs shig /zhes pa dad pas mchi ma blugs shing gdung shugs drag po'i dbyangs kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i mtshan nas 'bod pa yang nges par bya la/ khyad par gyi bsnyen pa rjes kyis gsol ba gdab pa ni/ /rgyud las/ bsnyen dus bla ma spyi bor bsgom/ /gsol 'debs tshul du 'dzab 'di bzlas/ /zhes pa'i don rang gi spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' bzhugs pa la yid gzhan du ma yengs par dad mos hril dril phur tshugs su gsol 'debs snying po'i 'dzab 'di la nan tan gtso bor bya ba ste/oṃ āḥhūṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi r+ghaṃḥ zhes bsnyen no/ /de nas nang gi rnal 'byor nye bar bsnyen pa byin rlabs la brten nas man ngag gi dbang gzhi mos gus ting 'dzin stobs kyis blangs pa ni/ de nas 'khor rnams bla mar yongs 'dus/ /bla ma'i gnas bzhir oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ trīḥ de las rab 'tsher 'od zer lug rgyud/ /dkar dmar mthing ljang bdag gnas bzhir zhugs/ /lus ngag yid shes 'pho bcas sgrib dag sgrib bzhi/ /rtsa rlung thig le rtsa brgyud bzhi byang sems rgyud smin/ /dbang bzhi bum gsang shes rig don dam dbang thob/ /lam bzhi bskyed rdzogs sa cad rdzogs chen lam 'byongs/ /dus dgra'i gshed nag rgyud kyi rdzogs rim la li ta'i lugs/ dang po rjes rdzogs rnam 'byor chen po/ /snying gsang sna rtse gsang 'dus 514

man ngag gi rdzogs rim ye shes zhabs kyi lugs thig le ye shes/ /gsang 'dus rgyud lugs rdzogs rim klu sgrub kyi srol lus ngag sems dben sgyu lus 'od gsal/ /phra thig mig nu snye bum bsam bral rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud nas bshad pa'i rdzogs rim man ngag gis spras pa/ kye rdor sogs rgyud spyi'i man ngag birlu pa'i lam 'bras su grags pa bskyed rim bdag byin dkyil 'khor rba rlabs/ /ma ya dang sangs rgyas thod pa'i rdzogs rim sa ra ha dang ku ku ri ba'i lugs dbyibs lha phra sngags chos thig dmigs med/ /bde mchog gi rdzogs rim lu dril nag gsum las nag po ba'i srol rim bzhi rgyud sngags ye shes gsang ba'i rim pa/ /sgrol ma 'byung ba bla med rgyud nas bshad pa'i rdzogs rim zhe sbas lugs rnal 'byor dang rjes shin tu chen po/ /bla med dgyes bde mnyam sbyor thig le sogs dang sngags yo ga ba spyi'i lam srol chos dam las rgya phyag rgya chen po/ /rgyud a li ka li sogs kyi lam rim deng dus dzo ki rnams la grags che ba rtse gcig spros bral ro gcig bsgom med/ /tasgro sde bco brgyad kyi rtsa ba sgyu 'phrul gsang snying rdzogs rim sangs rgyas gsang ba'i bzhed pa kun bzang bzang mo sbyor dag khyab brdal/ /sor bsam srog 'dzin rjes dran ting 'dzin dus 'khor sogs bla med kyi rdzogs rim khyad par can sa bcu pa'i lugs/gnas nyams rdzogs chen sems klong gi nyams rim bzhi dga' rab rdo rjes bkral ba mi g.yo mnyam nyid lhun grub/ /mngon sum gong 'phel tshad pheb chos zad rdzogs chen yang gsang bla med kyi lam kun bzang rdo rje 'chang gi rdo rje'i gsung gi shin tu gsal ba/ /dga' mchog khyad dga' lhan skyes dga' ba bla med spyi'i lam rim rtogs tshul dga' ba bzhi dang / /snad mched thob pa nyer thob snang tshul ye shes bzhi ye shes/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las bsgrub bya phrin las bzhi dbang bsgyur/ /tshogs sbyor bsgrod bya lam bzhi mthong bsgom yon tan yongs rdzogs/ /rnam smin tshe dbang phyag rgya lhun grub tshul rig 'dzin bzhi grub/ /sku gsung thugs mchog ye shes rdo rje/bral 'bras rdo rje bzhi/ /sprul longs chos sku ngo bo mthar thug gi go 'phang sku bzhi'o/ /nyid grub/ /dus bzhi'i dpal mgon bla ma'i mthu yis/ /dbang bzhi'i lam 'bras yon tan ma lus/ /bdag gis nges myur thob par mdzod cig /oṃ ur+ghaṃ trīḥsarba sid dhe shā la rgyu lha de ltar lam dbang ting nge 'dzin gyi skabs 'dir rdo rje theg pa'i lam rim che long kha shas smos pa'i don sngags bla med rgyud sde'i man ngag khyad par can 'di dag phal che ba zhig ni tsha tsa ma shes pa lta zhog mtshan yang nub par nye na/mtshan tsam thos te mos pa'i phan yon yang bsam mi khyab pa yi dge ba'i bag chags bzhags pa'i thabs dang / bstan rgyun la yang phan par sems pas yin la/ thams cad kyi mthar thug bskyal so snying por gyur pa ni theg pa'i rtse rgyal a ti rdzogs pa chen po ste/ de don ji bzhin rtogs pa'i ched du dmigs nas dbang bzhi len pa'i dmigs pa spro bsdu la rtse gcig bya ba shin tu gces shing gal che ba'o/ /de nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsang ba bsgrub pa'i rim pa ni/ de nas bla ma 'bru bzhi tshangs bug nas/ /mar byon 515

bdag snying pad ma 'dab brgyad du/ /gyur dbus tshon gang gzi brjid 'od 'bar ba/ /thugs kar r+ghaṃ mthing 'od dpung 'bar mtshan gsol/ /zhes bla ma rang la thim nas/ rang lus bla med kyi rgyud sde'i lha/ /zhi ba rigs lnga yab yum dang / /khro bo bka' brgyad sogs rang gis gang mos sam/ khyad par rigs 'dus rdo rje sems dpa'i skur bsgom pa dam tshig sems dpa' dang / de'i snying kar rtsa ba'i bla ma bsgom pa ste/ ji skad du/ rgyud las/ bsgrub dus bla ma snying kar bsgom/ zhes pa'i don ltar de yang bla ma pad 'byung rdo rje sems dpa' mthing nag yum mtsho rgyal rdo rje snyems ma dmar gsal dang kha sbyor du zhi ma khros dgyes shing gcer bu rjen cer gsal ba ye shes sems dpa' ste/ de'i thugs dbyings su yi ge r+ghaṃ mthing rab tu 'tsher ba ting 'dzin sems dpa'/ de'i mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar bsam la mchog gi dngos grub la yongs su dmigs te dzab kyi dgongs don dang ldan pas rang gi thugs dam rtsa gsum rab 'byams gang mos kyi 'dzab dang / yang snying rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya dang / yi ge drug pa 'di nyid nan tan hril dril du bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūṃ/ zhes pa nyid dus grangs rtags tshad mthar phyin par phyi nang gsang ba'i bzlas lugs gang mos kyis bskyal zhing / khyad par lha'i sku dang de kho na nyid rjes su dran te gnas pa dang / lhag pa'i lha'i sngags sam/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes 'bru gsum kha sbyor rdo rje'i bzlas pa yi rtsa rlung thig le dag byed rdo rje mchog la shin tu 'bad brtson drag po g.yel ba med par bya'o/ /de nas yang gsang gi rnal 'byor bsgral ba chen po ni/ de mthar bla ma'i sku nyid yi ge rtsu/ /mthing nag gsal 'tsher ye shes 'od 'bar zhing / /snang ba phyi nang bdag gzhan mtha' dbus khams/ /mi dmigs rig grag gsal stong dbyer med gyur/ /zhes snying gar bla ma r+ghaṃ du bsgyur ba la rig pa gtad cing 'dzin zhen med par ku yangs khro le shes ba hu re ba'i ngang nas rgyu gi glu dbyangs len par bya'o/ /de nas bzhi pa 'khrul snang ye shes su 'char bar byed pa la/ rgyud las/ las sbyor bla ma rang gsal gdab/ ces pa ltar de kho na nyid kyi rnal 'byor bla ma rang rig gnyis su med par khregs chod thod rgal gyi don nyams su len pa ni/ /rjes su rdu mthing thig 'od lnga'i mdangs/ /rab 'tsher 'od mched rang lus/ /'od phung yal/ /bla ma'i thugs nyid rang rig ye shes khams/ /gdod nas dbyer med lhan skyes bde chen dbyings/ /ngo bo ka dag stong ba sing nge ba/ /rang bzhin lhun grub gsal ba lhag ge ba/ /thugs rje gnyis med rig pa sa le ba/ /rang byung spros pa'i mtha' bral kun tu bzang / /chos sku'i ngang gdangs dgongs pa shar grol gdengs/ /ltos med blo bral ye yin rdzogs pa che/ /dmigs gtad yid gnyis blo snyems las 'das pa/ /gnas lugs rang so rig dang zang thal le/ /rang gsal dag pa rdor sems gsang lam mkhar/ /chos dbyings rnam dag 'od gsal zhing khams su/ /ye shes rang gdangs thig le'i 516

dkyil 'khor dbus/ /brjod bral shes rab rang rig don dngos sku/ /zhen med snang ba rdo rje lu gu rgyud//dmigs med mngon sum shar ba'i lta ba la/ /bsgom med yongs grol rang rig don goms pa/ /yongs med bla ma'i dgongs spyod yangs par bzhag /de ltar bla ma'i thugs dang rang rig dbyer med pa stong nyid rang byung gi shes rab smra bsam brjod 'das chen po rig gdangs rtsal shar skye 'gag med par mnyam par bzhag go/ /'aḥ.aḥshaḥsaḥmaḥhāḥ zhes nyams su len par dbye dbab gzhugs gsum gyi srang la gcun te gnas lugs kyi don shor sa dang gol sar ma lhung ba/ mno bsam dpyad bsgom yengs rtog gis ma sbags pa/ rig rig pos ma bcings/ tur tur pos ma bslang / rjen rjen pos ma bcos pa ste/mnyam bzhag gi mtshan nyid/ dngas ba/ gsal ba/ phra ba mi rtog pa'i ngang nyid rtag tu bskyongs pas chos thams cad kyi gdod ma'i gnas lugs spros pa'i mtha' rnams kyis dben pa/ sangs rgyas kun gyi chos sku rang bzhin 'od gsal bde ba chen po'i ngo bo gtan la 'beb par byed pa ni dam pa'i chos sgo ma lus pa'i snying por gyur pa ste/ nyams su len pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /de nas rjes kyi rim pa ni/ /snang rnams gzung 'dzin las 'das bla ma'i sku/ /grag kun zhen 'khris yongs bral bla ma'i gsung / /rtog tshogs blo 'das rig grol bla ma'i thugs/ /dbyer med mnyam pa'i dbyings su rtag gnas so/ /de ltar chos kun bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi rol par shes shing / /rnam rtog nyon mongs lha 'dre sdug bsngal na tsha 'chi ba kun stong gsal sgyu ma lta bur ro snyoms shing lam du khyer bar bya'o/ /phaṭa phaṭa phaṭaḥ yang dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /bdag gi snying ka don gyi 'og min dbyings/ /rang rig chos kyi sku dang dbyer med par/ /rtag par bzhugs nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /bdag sogs skye kun bla ma dam pa yis/ /rjes bzung dad gus dam tshig mchog tu brtan/ /thugs yid tshig 'dres sa lam yon tan rdzogs/ /tshe gcig nyid la yang dag sangs rgyas shog /'khrul zad gdos zad blo zad chos kun zad/ /kun bzang gzhon nu bum skur gshegs par shog /'chi srid 'char sgo rjes dran mngon shes kyis/ /thim lugs brgyad thim 'od gsal dbyings grol shog /srid par rigs drug mngal du mi 'jug cing / /rigs bzhi'i zhing skyes byang chub thob par shog /rang don chos sku gzhan don gzugs sku gnyis/ /bsam mi khyab pas 'gro kun 'dren par shog /ces sogs smon lam bzang po ci rigs pa btab cing /spyod lam kun rtsa ba'i bla ma yid dang mi 'bral ba'i mos gus dang dam tshig gis bsrung bsgom las 'da' ba med par rtag tu rgyu 'bras shan 'byed cing / 'gro la snying rje'i rol pas brtse bas rjes shes su spyod do/ /de nas thun mtshams su dge ba 'gro la bsngo ba ni/ /'di ltar bdag gis dpal mchog bla ma la/ /dad gus gsol ba 'debs pa'i dge tshogs kun/ /mkha' mnya' 'gro la yongs su bsngo ba'i 517

mthus/ /thams cad phyam gcig rdzogs sangs rgyas thob shog /dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po/ /khyed sku gsung thugs yon tan ji snyed dang / /'khor tshogs zhing khams phrin las bzang po gang / /ji bzhin bdag gis myur ba nyid thob shog /de ltar bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun drug gam bzhi tha ma yang lan gnyis su mi chag par nyams su blangs la thun gyi dngos gzhi stong nyid du mnyam par bzhag te rgyu 'bras kun der la bzlas la/ thun mtshams rjes thob sgyu ma lta bur chos spyod bcu sogs rgyu 'bras shan 'byed par dge ba la 'bad do/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho legs gsungs gsang ba che/ /drang dang nges par ston gyur sgo rab 'byams/ /gdul bya'i dbang khams rigs dang mthun pa ru/ /bsam mi khyab bstan mtha' dag mdo 'dus par/ /rang rig rtog thabs gcig pu kho na ste/ /tshul de thabs gzhan gyis ni rtogs nus min/ /dpal dang ldan mchog bla ma mnyes byas nas/ /rtag tu gus pas brten nas 'byung shes byos/ /srid pa'i chu klung skye rgas na 'chi yi/ /rba rlab cher 'khrug sdug bsngal gyis gang ba/ /'di sgrol gtan bde byang chub snyegs 'dod kun/ /thar pa'i grub mnyen bla mar gus gyis la/ /mdzad spyod phrin las bzhi yi rjes mthun du/ /zhi khro rnam 'gyur tshul dang tshul ma yin/ /gang la gang 'dul dpag dka'i mdzad spyod kun/ /log par mi blta brda yi chos su soms/ /deng sang snyigs dus 'gro la phan gdags phyir/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mi yi gzugs sprul nas/ /chos ston rdo rje slob dpon nyid snang ste/ /'di ni sangs rgyas las lhag bka' drin che/ /gang ltar rang la shes bya'i yon tan dang / /sdom 'bogs sems bskyed dbang lung rgya mtsho che/ /nos pa'i yul de drin chen bla ma yin/ /rtag tu bsnyen bskur byed la rab 'bungs kyis/ /smin dbang gnad phur nyams su len pa'i chos/ /snying thig mngon sum lta ba'i man ngag mchog /rang gi rgyud la 'dom mdzad gang yin de/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma zhes su rab grags 'di/ khyim pa dge bsnyen dge slong byang chub sems/ /sangs rgyas sems can lha 'am bdud du rung / /gang ltar yin kyang rang gis sangs rgyas dngos/ /blta zhing dam tshig snying srog ltar bsrung gnad/ /deng dus dam chos sgor zhugs mang lag kyang / snying po'i don ster bla ma brten pa gces/ /dam pa'i gdams ngag brtson pas snying nas dril/ /gsang sngags chog kun rtsa ba dam tshig yin/ nyams na mar gyi zang thal thar med pa/ /rdo rje dmyal bar rab rtsang phyir mi ldog /des na 'di nyid bag yod dran pa yis/ /ma nyams rtag bsrung rgyal ba'i go 'phangs thob/ /dus kun drin ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma ni/ /mi brjed spyi bor rtag tu mchog byed cing / /spyod pa tshul ldan dul bcas thugs kyi rgyud/ /rab tu dgyes par byed pa'i las la brtson/ /de dgyes dus gsum rgyal kun dgyes las lhag /yon tan dpag med 'byin pa'i gter mdzod ste/ /gtan bde byang chub sar skyol 'dren pa yin/ /des na bya ba 'di la tsher 'bungs gyis/ /sgyu ma'i lus de 518

nam 'chi cha med kyi/ /mi rtag dran mdzod 'dir snang sgyu ma la/ /ma zhen 'jig rten bya spyod rgyang bsrings nas/ /'chi khar phan byed gtan bde'i lam mtshol cig bla mar dad mos ma yengs nyams len chos/ /'gro la snying rje mi nyams gsang sngags dam/ bslu med rgyu 'bras bag yod tshul khrims dang / /nges 'byung zhen log gnad rnams ma 'chal bar/ /gnas lugs rang rig don gyi nyams len gang / /ma go ma shes don nor don 'khrul pa'i/ /tshul la ma shor ka dag chos nyid kyi/ /ngo bo nyid la rtag tu ltas mor stos/ /spangs blangs dgag sgrub re dogs blos byas la/ /ma zhen gang shar ma bcos rang sor klong / /ma yengs ma bsgom dran pa'i bya ra thongs/ /brjod 'das khregs chod don gyi dbyings skyol mdzod/ nyams rtogs shan dbyes rtogs pa rdo rus sprod/ /zhi la ma rnal lhag mthong rang zhal gzigs/ /lhun grub 'od gsal rol par rtse mdzod la/ /tshe 'dir don gnyis 'grub pa'i gzhi thing zhig /thos dang bsam pas mang po rtogs min gyi/ /bsgom la brtson pas gcig shes kun grol bas/ /thos bsam spros tshogs nam phugs phan yon tsam/ /spros med chig dril bsgom pas tshe 'dir grol/ /da lta chos tshul ji bzhin spyod pa ni/ /nyin mo'i skar 'dra tshul min las byed pa/ /ches mang de 'dra'i spyod pa'i tshul 'dres nas/ /chos la sems kyang chos min gyur mang bas/ /des na rtag tu ri khrod dben pa'i sar/ /rang nyid chig pur ri dwags smas ma bzhin/ /chos min tshul la nam yang mi 'jug par/ /chos tshul snying nas soms la 'grims pa dang / /mtshan dang bla ma yun nas yun brten te/ /thabs la mkha' pas thugs su sdug pa dang / /dad brtson shes rab ting 'dzin gyis mnyes shing / /dam sel med par rtag tu 'bad gces so/ /kye ma deng dus snyigs ma'i sems can tshe bsod dman/ /khyad par da lta tshe lo sum bcu'i dus/ /nam 'chi cha med tshe la long yang med/ /dal bar sdod du khom pa'i dus min gyi/ /rnam g.yengs 'di ni dgra yin ring du bros/ /chos brgyad btson ra yin no thar thabs 'bad/ /le lo'i rkun bur ma shor so pas non/ /bag med gnyid chang dbang du ma shor bar/ /yang nas yang du nan tan chos la wig /'chi khar mi brad bar dor ma 'jigs pa'i/ /gdeng zhig da lta long khom cung yod dus/ /ma 'bad bem rig bral nyer 'jigs skrugs shing / /gdong par mchis gang lus 'dar sems rab zhum/ /ci bya ltas med mgon skyabs bsrung bzlog dang / /sman rtsis rim gro gang gis mi bzlog par/ /sleb dus dam chos dran kyang ci byar yod/ de bas rang gis rang la snying rjes ltos/ /thos bsam 'chad rtsod brtsams sogs spros tshogs la/ /ma 'byams bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i gnad/ /chig dril spros med don gyi ra ba ru/ /chub mdzod kho bos kha chams snying por gdams/ /yang khyad snying po las snying po yi gtam/ /bla mar sangs rgyas las lhag mos gus bskyed/ /ci mdzad legs par mthong ba'i dag snang sbyangs/ /nam yang 'gyur 519

ldog med pa'i dad pa dril/ /zab snyan chos tshul bye ba phrag brgya stong / /du ma'i 'bru gu 'thar ba'i snying po'i zhun/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di yin de nyid la/ /rab 'bad nyin mtshan med par kha lo bsgyur/ /chos min nyams pa'i grogs dang mi 'grogs pa/ /chos brgyad snying po med par zhen log cing / /'di snang dgos pa med pa rgyud la sbyor/ gtan chis nges don gnas lugs nyid la brtson/ /khyad par rdo rje'i dam tshig gnyan po 'di/ /skyid rung sdug rung srog la babs kyang rung / /ma nyams 'da' med dus rnams kun tu ni/ /mi brjed rtag tu dran shes 'bad pas bsrung / /rtsa ba'i dam tshig sdong po me 'bras 'dra/ /de nyams thar pa'i sa bon nges par tshig /yan lag dam tshig yal ga lo ma 'dra/ /phra bcas bsrung ba'i las la rab brtson 'tshal/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma dran mchog dam pa'i bkas/ /pha song ma g.yems sems can stong gi srog /chod ces gnang dang dgyes par gyur pa na/ /spro bzhin spyod ces gzhung kun mthun gsungs pas/ /des na rtag tu rab 'byams rgyal kun las/ /'di nyid shin tu gnyan par gyur pas na/ /bsrung sdom dam tshig las la 'da' med par/ /'jigs dang phan yon chen po'i sgo nas bsrung / /sku mdun dgyes par byed pa'i las spyod cing / /gsungs gnang mi gcog phra'u bcas la 'bad/ /thugs la mnyes gyur bya ba tsheg chung zhig /gyur kyang rang gi brtson pa ches 'bungs gces/ /'di yis tshul da rgyal bas gsungs pa'i bka'/ /yongs nas bshad don gcig pa'i don 'grel nas/ /slob mar bla mas nan tan legs su gdams/ /slob mas srog phyir mi 'da' khas blangs dril/ /e ma/rang gi srog las bla ma gces su bzung / /rdo rje mched la brtse gdung gus pas bton/ /ris med 'gro la rtag tu sems bskyed brtson/ /sems la nyams myong rtogs pa'i rdo rus sprod/ /gegs sel bogs 'don bla ma'i gsol 'debs kyis/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba 'dod zhen rgyang du skyur/ /phyi ma'i brtul zhugs blo phugs mchog gsum gtod/ /bsgrub la dka' spyod skyid sdug ro snyoms gyis/ /chos kyi snyan tshig thos bsam dper ma bzhag /nyag gcig don dril rang rig ngo bor myong / /rang gzhan don gnyis gter sgo tshe 'dir phyes/ /gtan chis grub mdzod kha tshams yin no longs/ /e ma ho/ 'di ltar gcig tshogs bskyed rdzogs kun dril bcud/ /gnad gdams zab yang zhun mchog rgyal ba kun/ /gshegs shul snyegs byed chos bzhi'i nyams len thil/ /snying por gyur pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di/ /snyigs ma'i dus skyes shākya'i dge bsnyen ni/ /sngags lam la zhugs rnal 'byor gzugs 'chang ba/ /thos bsam bsgom pas rab dben snyoms las mkhan/ /tshe dbang nor bu dpal gyi
