su brdzus te skye zhing /o rgyan rdo rje 'chang dang rigs lnga'i rgyal ba sogs de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi zhal mthong gdams pa nod pas nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba kun las grol nas mthar thug steng gi nam mkha' mi mdzed brtsegs pa'i dur khrod me ri 'bar bar khro bo'i zhing khams mthong ste gdod ma'i gzhi la skad cig de nyid la grol nas nang gsal sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i dgongs pa dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med par bzhugs nas nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i gdul bya gang la gang 'dul gyi phrin las 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du dpag bsam gyi shing ltar lhun gyis grub la/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar rtog med rgyun mi chad pa'i thugs rje 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /lnga pa khrid kyi dbye bsdu bshad pa ni/ shes rab mos gus brtson 'grus gsum dang ldan pa'i skyes bu chos 'di'i lam srol rkang tshugs par 'dod pa dag la/ sngon 'a gro thun mong dang thun min rtags thon/ bskyed rim phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang de bzhin nyid sgrub las mtha' rgyas dang bcas pa dus rtags grangs kyi bsnyen pa sngon du song nas/ thabs lam gtum mo'i rnal 'byor gyis rlung sems rang dbang thob par byas nas/ gzod rdzogs chen gyi sngon 'gro thun mong ma yin pa rtags thon tu sbyangs nas khregs chod kyis rig pa'i ngo bo rjen par mthong ba dang / thod rgal la rtse gcig tu dril te de'ang 'grub tu rung na gtso bor mun pa'i rnal 'byor la brtson/ zhar byung rna ba'i sgra sbyor bla ma dgongs 'dus sogs rdzogs chen gzhan las 'byung ba'am sbyar/ dbyings snang smin mtshams las bral zhing nyin mtshan khyad med du gyur pa'i tshe snang mun sogs la ched du mi ltos par rdo rje lu gu 551

rgyud a ra la gtad de 'pho ba chen po'i sku bsgrub par bya'o/ /dad pa yod la sher brtson dman pa dag gis lam rim dum bu ba nyams su len na/ de'ang bskyed rim kho nar mos na bsnyen sgrub kyi rim pa kho bos byas pa'i bsnyen yig pad+ma'i zhal lung ltar bya/ gtum mo bsgom par 'dod na sngon 'gro dang bskyed rim rgyas bsdus gang rung sngon du song nas gtum mo bde drod 'od 'bar la 'jug /rdzogs chen kho na bsgom par 'dod na sngon 'gro bzhi skor grangs thems dang / bskyed bzlas gang 'grub sngon du btang nas rdzogs chen nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro ru shan dbye ba sogs legs par btang nas khregs chod dang thod rgal gyi gdams pa ston/ blo nus cher dman pas de tsam yang mi nus na/ sngon 'gro rgyas pa bzhag la nang gi ru shan dbye ba/ rigs drug gnas sbyong gi dmigs bzlas rtags thon byar gzhug la dngos gzhi'i khrid 'chad do/ /gzhung 'di shin tu bsdus pa'i dbang gis rtsa tho tsam las ma gsungs par rdzogs chen gzhan du kha 'phangs par mdzad pa dang / dom tshang gter byon chos 'di'i cha lag rdzogs chen khrid gzhung ma gzigs pa sogs kyis kha cig gis thun min sngon 'gro ga la chung du bzhag pa dang / khregs chod kyi khrid zhi lhag thun mong ba dang bstun pa sogs snang yang / rdzogs pa chen po'i lam nas phung po 'od lus su dengs pa'i gnad ni thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro'i rim pa rnams la yod cing / bskyed rim dang gtum mo sogs ni dbang bzhi'i lam rim cha tshang pa'i rkang bsgrigs pa yin gyi rdzogs chen bsgom pa la med ka med kyi go rim khrigs chags min pa go bar gyis shig khrid kyi mjug sdud pa'ang / skal ba dang ldan pa la rtsa gsum chos srung dpang du bkod de gtad rgya bya ba dang /des kyang rab tshe gcig ma mthas lo zlas mtha' rten pa'i nyams len dam bca' bya ba dang / de ltar skye kun tu mtshan tsam thos par dka' theg dgu'i rtse rgyal a ti gsang ba bla med kyi khrid grol ba bzhi ldan 'chad cing nyan pa'i dge ba'ang 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i lam las gdod ma'i sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur ba mtsho skyes rdo rje'i go 'phang tshe gcig gis mngon tu byad pa'i rgyur bsngo bar bya'o/ /de dag gis khrid kyis mjug don rgyas par bshad zin to/ /de ltar bla sgrub kun gyi yang snying rdzogs chen dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi bskyed rdzogs khrid tshul sngar dus shin tu dar rgyas su byung yod 'dug kyang / deng sang dus kyi dbang gis dbang dang gter gzhung gi bklag lung tsam las smin khrid kyi rgyun dkon par gyur cing / de las kyang bskyed rim lha khrid rje rig pa 'dzin pa'i yig cha las khrid lung gi rgyun tsam 'dug mod/ rdzogs rim gyi khrid tshul nges 'drongs dkon par ma zad/ 'di nyid gzhung chung bas gra gshog pa'i 'chad nyan tu mi 'gyur ba'i stabs don gnyer mkhan kyang dkon par snang ba dang / lhag par rje rig pa 'dzin pa'i khrid yig le 552

tshan gnyis po khyad par du 'phags kyang / rdzogs rim khrid yig yod kyang sa bcad sogs mthar chags shig ma byung bar dgongs/ rdzogs rim yig cha dgongs pa lam lus su gyur pa ma zad/ byis su rje bla mas mdzad par grags pa 'di'ang gzhan ngor dang gzhan mthu la brten pa'i dgongs gzhi dang dgos pa'i dbang gis/ rje nyid kyi rang bzhed mthil phyin pa ma yin par rtogs pa'i skyes chen 'ga' zhig gis yig cha gsar du bskrun par yang nas yang du bskul ba las/ kho bos chos 'dir thos bsam sgom pa mkhos lcogs bgyis shing dbang lung gi rgyun khyad par 'phags pa'ang 'ga' nos/ lhag par rdzogs rim yongs rdzogs kyi khrid yig ye shes rgya mtsho kun khyab kyis mdzad pa'i steng nas nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu/ rta nag pa pad+ma 'od gsal/ dpa' bo gtsug lag dga' ba/ kun mkhyen chos kyi dbyung gnas/ karma tshe dbang kun khyab/ mchog sprul karma rat+na/ mchog gzigs nā tha'i mtshan can/ rje bla ma 'od gsal 'gyur med kyis bka' drin tu bstsal/ sngon 'gro bskyed rim rdzogs chen khregs thod kyi lam tshang ba'i khrid yig man ngag gsal sgron rje btsun ma mi 'gyur dpal sgron gyis mdzad pa las nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'ja' tshon snying po/ khrag 'thung nam mkha' 'jigs med/ gsang bdag phrin las lhun grub/ o rgyan gter bdag gling pa/ lha btsun 'jigs med dpa' bo/ rje btsun mi 'gyur dpal sgron/ mkhan chen au ḍi yan/ khri chen phrin las rnam rgyal rje btsun phrin las chos sgron/kun mkhyen mañdzu gi ṣa'i zhal snga nas thugs rjes gzigs te bstsal ba dang / lhag par chos 'di'i rdzogs rim gyi khrid gzhung snying thig chos dbyings rang gsal dus rtags ma 'grigs pas spel bar ma gnang yang / de'i snying po lta bu khregs thod sngon dngos gzhi'i rjes kyi khrid yig gsal la tshang ba mon stag sgro dom tshang shel gyi phug pa nas gsang gter du bzhes te bka' bab bstan pa dar rgyas la gnang ba nyid rim par brgyud de/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa ngag dbang blo gros las lung khrid kyi tshul du thos pa'i yi ge de dag gi dgongs don rtsa bar bzung / rta nag pad+ma 'od gsal kyi zin bris yin nam snyam/ gang ltar rig chen po'i zhal slob rdzogs pa chen po la mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa zhig gis mdzad pa nges pa'i dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi rdzogs khrid gsham ma tshad pa'i dpe zhig 'byor pa dang yang sgo bstun nas/ klo yul du bzhugs pa'i rdzogs rim khrid yig kha 'thor gyi mthug tu rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus rdzogs rim gyi bcud phyungs pa lags so/ /zhes 'khod/ yig tshogs la ma 'dzem par 'dus gsal gyi tshul du bris pa'o/ /nyi zla bye ba phrag brgya'i 'og rol na/ /rdul snying skye bas rin thang med pa'i nor/ /btsal ba'i rin tu mi khug theg dgu'i rtse/ /gdod ma'i mgon po'i bstan pa 'di rmad do/ /yang ti'i mkha' 'dir gsang ba rnams kyang / /blo gros gnyis skyes bzhin tu rtsal chung na/ /byis pa sprang bu las kyang nyam chung 553

bas/ /dpyod nyes gang mchis sras bcas rgyal la bshags/ dkar po rnam par 'phel ba phra mo'i chas/ /chos 'di'i snang ba zhing kun khyab pa dang / /des kyang gdod ma'i grol sar skye bo kun/ /rang grol 'khor ba dong nas sprugs gyur cig /ces pa 'di'ang rang slob shes bya la blo yangs shing dad dam lhag bsam gser bzang gi rang bzhin mi 'gyur ba karma 'gyur med nas thugs rje chen po'i zhal thang spus legs dang sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal bcas nan tan chen pos bskul zhing yi ge'i mthun rkyen sbyar ba dang / chos 'dir mos pa'i las 'phro can pad+ma rnam rgyal sogs don gnyer gzhan gyis kyang sngo rjes bskul ba'i ngag mi gcog pa'i slad du/ pad+ma'i zhal tshab pad+ma dbang chen sogs rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams kyi 'bangs su gyur pa'i rgyal khams pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug rtsal gyis dpal spungs sgrub khang chen por bris pa dge legs 'phel 554

rog /dmar nag khros pa phur bu'i sgrub pa yang zab rnams bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs lags so/ /skye med chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang : thabs kyis skur ston ma rungs tshar gcod cing :phrin las dpag yas mi zad mkha' dang mnyam: khrag 'thung phur bu'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: phyogs dus rgyal ba gcig bsdus thod phreng rtsal: phyi ltar dpal chen pad+ma he ru ka: nang ltar dbang drag rta mgrin khros pa'i lha: gsang ltar dmar nag me yi phreng ba can: drag tu khros pa badz+ra tī la ya: sku gsum khro rgyal 'dus pa'i brda rtags ston: chos sku rab khros dbus zhal dmar ba'i mdangs: ngo bo pad+ma 'byung gnas 'dus pa'i brda: sku smad gnam lcags phur bu'i dpal dang ldan: phyogs bcu'i khro rgyal ma lus 'dus pa'i brda: phyag drug mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams pa ni+oḥ rigs drug so sor 'gro don mdzad pa'i brda: g.yas g.yon mtshon cha'i gshogs pa gdengs pa ni: thabs dang shes rab zung du 'jug pa'i brda: spyan dmar dgu pho sdang mig bsgrad pa ni: theg pa rim dgu yongs su rdzogs pa'i brda: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sku mchog 'dus pa'i phyir: dung khang gnas su 'jam dpal gshin rje sprul: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas gsung mchog 'dus pa'i phyiroḥ mgrin pa'i gnas su h+ya shrī wa rdzul:phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thugs mchog 'dus pa'i phyir: tsit+ta'i gnas su phyag na rdo rjer sprul: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas yon tan 'dus pa'i phyir: lte ba'i gnas su mkha' 'gro sde lnga sprul: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas phrin las 'dus pa'i phyiroḥ gsang ba'i gnas su yak+ka me dpal sprul: zhi rgyas dbang drag lhun gyis grub pa'i phyir: phyogs mtshams brgyad du khro bo khro mor sprul: mthu stobs rtsal chen shugs dang ldan pa'i phyir: nam mkha'i dbyings su mkha' lding khyung chen sprul: kun 'dus khro rgyal drag po tī la ya: gsang chen rol pa'i dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grub: 'di nyid bsgrub na sa lam bar chad zhi:mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus thob: dregs pa'i lha srin sde brgyad bran du khol: gang brtsams las rnams thogs med 'grub par 'gyur: sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya: 'di nyid nyams len byed 'dod 'di lta ste: dang po dbang zhu dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung : de nas dben par bde ba'i stan la 'dug:skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song nas ni: srung 'khor bsgom zhing yan lag bdun pa byoḥ dngos gzhi ting 'dzin rnam gsum gsal ba'i ngang : rang rig ma 'gags stong pa'i rang rtsal las: bde 555

gshegs kun 'dus khro rgyal 'di ltar bsgom: o swa bhā ba shud+dhaḥsarba dhad+maḥsu bhā ba shurnyo phohaṃ: bdag dang snang ba thams cad stong par gyur: stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis pad+ma dang nyi ma dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i steng du: rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo r+ghaṃ dmar nag gcig tu bsam: de yongs su gyur pa las:rang nyid khro rgyal thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid: drag po tī la ya sku mdog dkar nag la me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro ba: zhal gsum phyag drug spyan dgu sdang mig bsgrad pa: zhal g.yas dkar g.yon mthing dbus zhal dmar nag tu 'bar ba: g.yas g.yon du mtshan cha 'bar ba'i gshog rtsal ldan zhing me 'bar bas dgra bgegs thams cad sreg pa: zhal cher gdangs shing mche ba bzhi gcigs pa: smin ma dang ag tshom dmar ser la thog gi tshwa tshwa 'phro ba: dbu skra kham nag gyen du bskyod cing ral pa'i gseb nas khro chung mang po skar ltar 'khrugs pa: lte ba man chad kyi sku smad gnam lcags phur bu zur gsum pa: rno ba'i dpal ldan pa: tsha ba'i zer dang ldan pa: mtshon cha dang thog ser 'phro zhing dgra bgegs kyi snying dkar nag mtshams su gzir ba: chu srin sros pa'i kha nas sbrul nag gi zhags pa dang dug thun nag po ser ltar 'bebs pa: phyag g.yas kyi dang po na rdo rje: bar pa na tho ba: tha ma na bskal ba'i me dpung 'dzin pa: g.yon gyi dang po na thod khrag: bar pa na sdig pa: tha ma na gnam lcags kyi phur bu 'dril pa'o+oḥ thod pa skam po lngas dbu brgyan cing rlon pa lnga bcus do shal byas pa: rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gis spras shing ཿོ sprul rigs lngas se ral kha mdud poḥ glang chen gyi ko bas stod g.yogs: mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhis sked dkris pa: stag lpags rlon pas sham thabs byas pa: sku la khrag gi thig le zhag gi zo ris thal chen gyi tshom bus rab tu brgyan pa: zhal nas ā ralbi ho zhes dang hūṃ dang phaṭa kyi sgra chen 'brug ltar sgrogs pa: sku'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas rdo rje'i thog ser mtshon cha'i bu yug sprul pa'i bya khyung dpag tu med pa 'phro ba: ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i klong na khams gsum dbang du sdud cing srid gsum 'dzin zil gyis gnon pa: sgeg cing dpa' ba mi sdug pa: rgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung ba: snying rje rngam gtum dang ldan pa'o: de'i spyi bor pad+ma he ru ka yab yumoḥ dpral bar 'jam dpal gshin rje yab yumoḥ mgrin par rta mgrin dmar po yab yum: thugs kar phyag na rdo rje yab yum: lte bar ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro sde lnga: gsang gnas su yak+ka me dpal yab yumoḥ spyi bor sprul pa'i bya khyung dmar nag la sogs pa thams cad rab tu khros pa'i cha byad can: rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa gsal bar gyur: de thams cad kyi dpral bar o: mgrin par ā: thugs kar phroṃ dang rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas: rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rang 'dra ba'i ye shes skad pa cig gis spyan drangasoḥ oṃ badz+ra gī li tī la ya shrī pad+ma he ru ka sa ma ya dzaḥh+ya shrī wa badz+ra pā ṇi/ 556

ḍā ki nī ha ri ni sa yak+ṣa kro dhakhro ga ru ḍā sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dza: dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho: dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par 'dres: slar yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rigs lnga yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs nas sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlabs ye shes lnga'i dbang bskur: dbang rtags su rang rang gi rigs bdag rnams kyis dbu brgyan par gyur: rang gi thugs kar phyag na rdo rje: de'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang tsam rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa: de'i thugs kar rdo rje nas 'bru tsam gyi lte bar nyi gdan nyung 'bru phyed bkas rtsam gyi steng du r+ghaṃ dmar nag ba spus bris pa lta bu'i mthar sngags kyi phreng bas g.yas su 'khor ba las 'od zer me yi kha dog dang ldan pa dpag tu med pa 'phros nas lus thams cad khengs:sdig pa dang sgrib pa 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs: 'od zer ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros: phyi snod 'jig rten thams cad gzhal yas kyi khang pa: nang bcud sems can thams cad he ru ka'i rang bzhinoḥ sgra grags thams cad drag po sngags kyi 'ur sgra di ri ri sgrogs par bsam: oṃ āḥhūṃ a rtsig ni rtsig na mo bha gi wa te dzñā na badz+ra karma tī li tī la ya sarba bisna na baṃ rgyu r+ghaṃ phaṭa: āḥtrīḥr+ghaṃ bh+yo phaṭa: bde gshegs 'dus pa'i rtsa sngags spyi dril 'di: bskyed rims gsal zhing bye ba'i grangs dang sbyar: sems ni yul la chags shing kun tu rgyu: g.yengs shing bzlas pas 'bras bu 'byung mi 'gyur: ma yengs rtse gcig ngang du bzlas par bya: rtags dang cho 'phrul dpag tu med pa 'byung ཿོ mchog dang thun mong gnyis kyi dngos grub thob: sa dang lam gyi 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi:dregs pa'i lha srin sde brgyad 'byung po thul: gzhan tshig ma 'dres pa ni gnad yin no: thun bsdu'i dus na phyi snod 'jig rten kun: srung ba'i 'khor lo nyid la thim par bsamoḥ srung ba'i 'khor lo rang gi lus la bstem: rang lus 'od du zhu nas r+ghaṃ la bsdu: de nyid nā da thig le'i bar du bsdu: thig le yal ba spros med ngang du bzhag: thun 'jug dus na chu las nya lnga tshul: skad cig gcig la drag po'i sku ru bsam: rgyun du snying gar hūṃ yig dmar gsal gdang : sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya: maṅga lo/ /557

rog /bde gshegs yongs 'dus drag po ṅgā la yakhri byin rlabs thugs kyi dbang bskur mtshams smyor gyis brgyan pa gnam lcags zhun thigs ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba che'i/ /ye shes rol ba'i rdo rje can/ /pad+ma'i rgyal tshab der btud nas/ /zab don dbye la gnang stsol/ /yang zab khro rol phur bu'i snying po don gyi dbang bskur thun mong ma yin pa bgyid pa la gsum/ /sbyor dngos rjes so/ /dang po ni/ gzhung mthun dkyil 'khor ras gris yod na bkram/ med na rang dbang gzhung du gsal ba bzhin maṇ+ḍal la 'bru tshom bu gtso 'khor lnga bkod pa steng mañdzi la rnam bum so lnga'i bcud ldan mgul chings dmar po kha rgyan gyis spras pa bzhag /rgyab ngos su gtor chen zur gsum me ri sku tsaka dar gdugs kyis rgyan pa/ g.yas g.yon rnams su rak+ka 'am thod phreng / rgya gram/ rdo rje rtse dgu dang thod khrag /tho ba pa me dpung lcags sdig lcags phur bzhi'i tsakli rnams bkod/ sman rag gtor gsum/ phyi mchod rnams spyi ltar dang / nyer mkho'i tshogs gtor dang yo byad rnams kyang tshogs par bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i dbang don bsgrub mchod ni/ rgyas par grub na khro rol las byang / bka' gter srung ma'i gtor 'bul/ tshogs skong bshags rnams grub na ci nas gal che/ mgyogs dbang lta bur bsdu na gter ston nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rtsa gsum spyi'i las byang nang du sgrub thabs gter gzhung btsud nas bdag mdun dbyer med dam tha dad gang du bsgrub kyang rung la bsnyen bzlas ci 'tshub dang / bum bzlas zur du spro na bya/ de nas gter bdag spyi gtor/ tshogs mchod dang rtsa gsum gyi spyi skong tsam btang / dbang dngos la/ slob ma gsum mam bdun las me mang pa la las bum pa'i chus khrus bya bgegs gtor bsngos la bgegs bskrad cing srung 'khor bsgom/ me tog bskye bsdu dang sems bskyed gsal btab la/ de'ang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na sangs rgyas gnyis par yongs su grags pa o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas nyid/ ngo bor rab 'byams dkyil 'khor ma lus pa'i dbang phyug dpal he ru ka dang rnam dbyer med cing / gang 'dul sprul pa'i rol gar sna tshogs pas nam mkha'i khams dang 'khor ba ji srid de srid du bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las kyis lus can ma bsgral ba mtha' dag gdod ma'i dbyings su phya ma gcig sgrol ba dang / khyad par sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las 'jug pa'i yul du ma gyur pa shin tu ma rung zhing log 558

sred gdug pa can gyi gdul bya rnams kyi gnyen por rgyal ba kun gyi stobs bcu'i rtsal shugs gcig tu bsdus pa lta bu/ srid zhi'i khams na che btsan 'gran zla dang bral ba'i bdud 'dul 'bar ba chen po'i phyag rgya'i cho 'phrul cir yang ston pa las/ snyigs dus kyi bdud 'gong dam sri ma rungs pa rnams kyi gnyen por lhag pa'i lha gzhan las kyang byin rlabs kyi tshan kha dang mthu stobs kyi rtsal shugs khyad par du 'phags pa bde gshegs yongs 'dus drag po tī la ya 'di ni/ rang gzhung las/ phyogs dus rgyal ba gcig bsdus thod phreng rtsal: phyi ltar dpal chen pad+ma ho ru ka: nang ltar dbang drag rta mgrin khros pa'i lha: gsang ltar dmar nag me yi phreng ba can: drag tu khros pa badz+ra tī la ya: gsang chen rol pa'i dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grub: 'di nyid bsgrub nas lam bar chad zhi: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus thob: dregs pa sde brgyad ma lus bran du khol: gang brtsam las rnams thogs med 'grub par 'gyur: ces sogs bsngags par mdzad pa 'di nyid kyi sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa gu ru rin po ches skal pa dang ldan pa'i rje 'bangs rnams la gdams par mdzad cing snyigs ma'i gdul bya la brtse bas dgongs te mdo khams rgyam rgyal gnod sbyin chen po'i mdun zhol/ /'gyur med gtan 'khyil g.yu mtshor rgyas btab pa las/ phyis dus smon lam gyi dbang btsan pa las 'khon ston klu dbang srung ba'i thugs sprul rig 'dzin rol pa'i rdo rjes ngo mtshar rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pas spyan drangs te rtsa ba tsam gtan la phab/ chos sde phal cher rten 'brel gyi dbang gis slar yang 'dab gter du sbas pa las gnubs ban nam mkha'i snying po'i thugs sprul rig 'dzin chen po tshe dbang nor bu rdo rje dpal 'bar gyis kha shas zhig spyan drangs par mdzad pa las byon pa'i smin byed yongs kyi snying po byin rlabs thugs kyi dbang bskur ba la sogs kyis mtshams sbyar nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug slob dpon dang pad+ma drag po dbyer med la dad gus drag pos gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ ho: bde gshegs rgyal ba thams cad kyi: ngo bo rigs 'dus thod phreng rtsal: bdag cag 'dir 'dus dad ldan la: byin rlabs dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol: lan gsum/ de ltar gus pas gsol ba btab pa'i snod du rung ba de la rdo rje theg pa'i che ba brjod pas spro ba bskyed cing gnod pa sbyin pa ni 'di lta ste/ ho+oḥ skal ldan skyes bu khyed rnams kun: dal 'byor thob pa grangs mang yang : gsang sngags zab mo'i sgor zhugs dkon:deng 'dir bsod nams tshogs las byung : slar yang zab mo'i gdams ngag nyon: de la dbang gis smin par byed pa la thog mar rgyud rnam par dag pa gal che bas: thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig ltung bag chags dang bcas pas rang rgyud dri ma can du byas pa la gnong zhing 'gyod pas snying nas bshags shing / bla ma yi dam dbyer med pa la blo gtad cig chog tu bcas te sgo gsum bran du 'bul pa'i 'dun 559

pa rtse gcig pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ na moḥ bde gshegs rigs 'dus spyan snga ru: sngon chad bag chags las nyon rnams: deng nas byang bar mdzad du gsol: phyin chad sgo gsum nyid la 'bul:legs nyes thams cad khyed rang shes: bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha bde gshegs yongs 'dus drag po tī la ya rtsa gsum chos skyong rgya mcho'i tshogs dang bcas pa mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs pa la bdag sogs mkha' khyab kyi 'gro ba thams cad byang chub snying po'i bar du skyabs su mchi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzad/ hoḥbade bar gshegs pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs: ma lus 'dus pa'i bdag nyid drag po rtsal:bdag cag lus ngag yid gsum gus pa yis: mi phyed dad pa'i ngang du skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/gdon bgegs 'byung po ma rungs pa rnams kyis gtsor byas pha ma sems can thams cad che mchog gu ru drag po'i go 'phang la 'god pa bya ba'i phyir du/ drag po chen po'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas lam rgyud la bsten par bgyi'o snyam du sems bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ hoḥbla med drag po 'jigs byed dkyil 'khor du: skal ldan bdag gis 'gro ba ma lus kun: ma bsgral bsgral dang ma grol dgrol bar bgyi:rgya chen byang chub mchog thob sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ tshogs kyi zhing mchog khyad par can de rnams kyi spyan sngar tshogs bsags yan lag bcu pa tshul bzhin bya ba'i bdun pas so so'i dmigs pa tshig dang rjes su mthun par gsal thob la 'di'i rjes zlos/ rdu: khro bo rol pa'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: dregs pa bsnol ba'i gdan la brtan par bzhugs: brkyang bskum srin po'i gar gyis phyag 'tshal lo+oḥ dug gsum sha rus khrag gi mchod pa 'bul: dam tshig 'gal 'khrul nyams chags mthol lo bshags: log 'dren drag pos bsgral la rjes yi rang : dregs pa ma lus 'dul ba'i chos 'khor bskor: phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub la gsol ba 'debs: mngon spyod las bsgrub dge ba yongs la bsngo: lan gsum bya/ de nas dbang gi gzhi dgod pa ye shes dbab pa la khyed rang rnams sgo gsum gyi gnad legs par gcun la dmigs pa 'di ltar rtse gcig bsgoms shig /oṃ swā bhā ba sogs bsgrub thabs kyi mngon rtogs tshang bar brjod pas gsal gdab/ thugs kar hūṃ dang rang rang gis sa bon gyis mtshan pa dang / slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas kyang 'od zer 'char kha'i zer thag lta bu chos kyi dbyings kun tu khyab par 'phros/ 'og min gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod/ lho nub rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang sogs sangs rgyas kyi zhing dpag tu med pa na bzhugs pa'i bde gshegs yongs 'dus drag po tī la ya'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ thams cad kyang dgyes pa chen po'i ye shes kyi rol pa'i sku yig 'bru phyag mtshan sna tshogs pa'i rnam pa nam mkha'i dbyings dang bar snang gi khams gang ba char chen drag tu babs pa ltar byon nas khyed rang gi sgo gsum la dbyer med du thim pas byin gyis 560

brlabs par mos shig 'bebs pa'i rdzas bdug /dbyangs dang rol mos bskul te/ rdu hūṃ hūṃ:bzhengs shig pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: bdag cag mos pa'i bu rnams la: byin rlabs 'bebs phyir gnas 'dir byon: 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs mgon rje: khyad par thugs rjes bod la dgongs: las ngan rnam smin mnar ba yi: bdag cag rjes 'jug bu slob rnams: thugs kyis 'dor ram gu ru rje: thugs rjes yal yol btang snyoms na: yang sangs rgyas pa'i dgos pa ci: bdag cag bu rnams mchi ma 'khrugs: gsol 'debs snying nas 'o dod 'bod: pha mchog khyed kyi yon tan dran: bu la gzigs shing thugs rje can: byin gyis rlobs shig sprul pa'i sku: lus la sku yi byin phob cig: bde ba spor cig ḍā ki'i tshogs: ngag la gsung gi byin phob cig: nus skyed cig yi dam lha: sems la thugs kyi byin thob cig: rtogs pa spong cig gu ru rje: 'dir 'tshogs mos pa'i bu rnams la: yon tan phrin las byin phob cig: lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa sbyongs: rtsa gsum dam tshig nyams pa skongs: sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis rlobs: dug lnga'i rnam rtog zhi bar mdzod: ye shes lnga yi dbang mchog bskur: lha srin sde brgyad dam la thogs: mi mthun rkyen sol mthun par sgrubs: mchog dang thun mong byin phob cig: ces dang / r+ghaṃ gsum bsgril dang mdun bsgril mang du brjod/ rtsa sngags mthar/ dzñā na ā we sha ya a ā/brtags pa'ang drag tu brjod la dbab/ ye shes pa'i byin rlabs kyi rgyun sgo gsum la rab tu gnas shing brtan par byas par mos mdzod/ me tog 'thor la/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badzā ya swā hā: zhes brjod/ de nas dbang dngos gzhi bskur ba la/ rtsa ba bum pa'i dbang dang / rjes 'brel sku gsung thugs mtha' rten dang bcas pa rim par sbyin pa ste/ de'ang bum pa 'di nyid khro bo rol ba bdud 'dul tī la ya chen po'i brda don rtags kyi 'khor yongs su rdzogs pas dbang bskur ba'i tshe bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis khyed rang gi sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa bkrus/ dbang bzhi'i ye shes rgyud la smin / pad+ma drag po tī la ya dang dbyer med du gyur mos shig / rnam bum mgor bzhag la/ hūṃḥ brda don bum pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: sgo gsum dri ma bag chags dag: tī la yang dang dbyer med shog: rtsa sngags dang r+ghaṃ gsum bsgril bdun bsgril brjod/ bum chu sbyin/ rjes 'brel gyi dang po sku'i dbang bskur ba ni/ gtor snod dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang du gtor ma sku gzugs dang bcas pa bde gshegs yongs 'dus gu ru drag po tī la ya'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs yongs su rdzogs par gsal ba'i sku las byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas gdos bcas su 'dzin pa'i dri ma dag /snang stong ye shes lha'i skur gyur par mos/dpal gtor spyi bor bzhag la/ r+ghaṃ: sgyu 'phrul sku gzugs ba lo dbang : rigs kyi bu la byin 'bebs na:561

snang stong rdo rje'i sku 'grub nas: kun khyab kun byed dbang thob shog rtsa sngags dang rdu gsum dang bdun bsgril brjod/ des sku phyag rgya'i dbang thob/ lus kyi sgrib bdag /bskyed rim lha 'khor lo bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu sku rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /gnyis pa gsung bzlas pa'i lung sbyin pa yin pas dmigs pa 'di ltar mdzod/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pa'i thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje'i thugs kar rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte ba nyi ma'i gdan la r+ghaṃ dmar nag gi mthar sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor ba/ slob dpon la mos gus drag tu byas pa'i rkyen gyis thugs ka'i sngags phreng las sngags phreng gnyis pa 'phros/ zhal nas thon te khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar ye shes sems dpa'i zhal nas brgyud/ de'i thugs kar rdo rje'i lte bar nyi steng hūṃ dmar nag gi mthar 'khod/ bzlas pa'i rkyen gyis sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor ba las 'od zer me dpung kha dog lnga ldan dpag tu med pa 'phros nas lus thams cad gang /sdig sgrib 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs/ 'od zer phyir 'phros pas snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang / bcud kyi sems can pad+ma he ru ka /sgra skad thams cad tī la ya'i rang sgra 'ur dir gyis sgrog par mos la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ phreng ba sprel la/ o ā:r+ghaṃ a cig na mo bha ga wa te dzñā na badz+ra karma tī li tī la ya sarba bin+nin bam̐ r+ghaṃ phaṭa: a trīḥr+ghaṃ bh+yo ju phaṭa: lan gsum/phreng ba mgrin par bzhag la/ de nyid brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ r+ghaṃ brjod bya'i tshig dbang gsang sngags 'di: bde gshegs kun gyi yang snying bcudoḥ rigs kyi bu la bstem pa yis:grags stong gsung dbyangs dbang thob shogoḥ rtsa sngags hūṃ rnams brjod/ des gsung sngags kyi dbang thobs/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag /bsnyen sgrub bzlas brjod kyi rnal 'byor la dbang / 'bras bu gsung rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /gsum pa thugs rig pa rtsal gyi dbang bskur ba ni/ sna tshogs rdo rje snying gar bzhag pas 'khor 'das sku bzhi'i ngo bor gdod nas rdzogs pa'i du ma ro gcig gi rang rtsal 'gag pa med pa cir yang 'char bas phrin las bzhi sogs lhun gyis grub pa mtshon pa'i don du shes pas rang rig rang gsal gyi ngang du mnyam par zhog cing / rgya gram snying gar gtugs la/ rgyu phrin las bzhi sgrub rgya gram dbang : rigs kyi bu la 'di gtad pas: rig pa'i rtsal dbang thob gyur nas: tī la ya dang dbyer med shogoḥ rtsa sngags r+ghaṃ rnams brjod/ mtha' rten rtsa ba'i phyag mtshan rdo rje rtse dgu pa dang thod khrag las g.yas g.yon tu gtad pas thabs bde ba chen po dang shes rab stong pa nyid du zung du 'jug pa'i dbang bskur thob par mos shig rdo rje dang thod khrag lag g.yas g.yon tu gtad la/ r+ghaṃ rdo rje rtse dgu thod khrag 'di: nam yang 'bral med 'chang bar bya: don la rang rig rtsal 562

dbang brda: thabs shes dbyer med dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags hūṃ rnams brjod/ ye shes kyi rang bzhin 'bar ba'i phyag mtshan bzhi gtad cing mnga' gsol bas dug gsum dang gdon bgegs ma lus pa tshar bcad cing phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dbang chen brnyes par mos shig thob me dpung g.yas dang lcags steg phur bu g.yon tu gtad la/ hūṃḥ bdud bzhi kun bcom tho ba me: bgegs 'joms lcags kyi sdig pa 'bar: sku gsum rang bzhin lcags phur 'di: rigs kyi bu la 'di gtad pas: phyi nang bar chad rdul du rlog: dug gsum bsgral ba'i dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags dang rgyu gsum dang bdun bsgril gyi dbyangs bya/ shis brjod/ des sprul pa'i gter ston chen po rig 'dzin rol pa'i rdo rje zab gter drag po khro rol phur bu'i sger dbang thun mong ma yin pa legs par grub pa ste/ gzhung las/ dbang bskur rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las: 'di ni byin rlabs thugs kyi dbang : lan cig thob pa tsam gyis ni: sdig sgrib dag cing bar chad sel: tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor 'phel: byang chub mchog gi lam sna zin: zhes sngags pa la dad mos yid ches dang ldan pas dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung ba dang 'di nyid yi dam lhar 'dzin snyam pas rjes zlos/ gtso bos ji ltar/ gtong rag maṇ+ḍal sogs dbang mjug dang / tshogs la rol cing lhag ma gtor ba nas bsngo smon shis brjod kyi bar las byang rjes chog rnams gsang ba spyi dang mthun par bya'o/ /snyigs mas bskyed rim pa'i gdugs can mun/ mthu stobs kyi zer 'bar bab bcom/ phan bde'i snang bas sa gsum las/ /rtag tu skyob pa'i btsas su shog /smin byed 'di'i rgyun dkon cing bka'i gcigs su bsdams kyang chos rgyun la phan par lhag bsam bzang pos gter mdzod rin po chen che'i dbyig gi snying po sdud pa'i skabs pad+ma gar dbang phrin las 'gro 'dul rtsal gyis rdzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i pho brang du mtshams sbyor brjod bder spel ba dge legs 'phel/ /563

༄ga /'phags ma'i sgrub thabs mi mthun kun sel lung byang dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ / sa ma ya rgya yoḥ na maḥ.ā r+ya tā rā yi+oḥ 'gro rnams sdug bsngal thams cad skyob byed pa: rtsa gsum thugs rje'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag 'dra o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: mi mthun 'dum par byed pa'i gdams du mchog: bslu med nges ster yang gang gsang ba'i gnad: ma 'ongs don du rin chen gter du sba: las can gzhan don spyod dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de la rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das sku mdog dmar mo longs spyod rdzogs pa'i cha lugs can dar dmar po'i stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs 'chang ba: zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa'i stabs kyis pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa: phyag gnyis mchog sbyin dang mtheb srin kyi bar dag na u la dmar po 'dzin pa: 'od zer dmar po 'phro zhing 'du ba'i gnas gsum du yi ge oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ gsum gyis mtshan par bsgomoḥ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'phags ma spyan drangs la bstim: yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs: mchod pas mchod: dbang bskur bar gsol ba btab: de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis ye shes kyi chus dbang bskur bas sku gang dri ma dag: chu lhag ma yar lud pa las: 'od dpag med sprul sku'i cha lugs can gyis dbu brgyan par bsamoḥ de nas rang gi smin mtshams su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sen gang pa'i dbus su t+t+waṃḥdamar po'i mthar bskor du yi ge bcu pa dmar sgor re yod pa las: 'od zer dmar po 'phros pas: bdag dang mi mthun pa de la phogoḥ de yang rang 'dra ba'i sgrol mar gyur: yang bdag gi smin mtshams nas 'od zer 'phros nasoḥde yi snying khar phog pasoḥ de nyid kyi gdug sems zhi nas: byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur te+oḥde yi yid zla ba nya gang ba lte ba bu ga can du gyur: bdag gi snying kha'i zla steng r+ghaṃ yig las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu sna sgo nas thon: zla ba'i bu gar zhugs te kho yi sna sgo nas drangs: rang gi sna sgor zhugs nas snying ga'i zla bar thim: bde ba'i ro byang chub sems kyis myong shing : bdag la gus shing 'dun par bsam: de lta bu'i dmigs pa yang yang bskyar zhing : sngags ni/ oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re swā hā: che ge mo a kar+ṣa wa la shad ku ru ye hring dzani.asku sha ya r+ghaṃ dzoḥ zhes bzla'o: de ltar zhag bdun la sogs pa byas pasoḥ pha rol po de nges par yid mgu nas bdag la gus pa'i spyod 564

lam ston par 'gyur ro: pha rol bsod nams dang gdug sems che chung dang bstun te sgrub pa gnyug bsring bar yang bya'o: sgrub pa'i dus su mtshams dam par bya la: des ni ma dad pa nges par bsgyur nus so: spyir yang rgyun du yi dam nar mar bya ste yan yon dpag tu med do: gzhan la byed na de gnyis sgrol mar gsal ba la: rang gi smin mtshams nas 'od 'phros: de gnyis la phog pas: dbyer med du 'dres par bsam la bzlas pa bya'o: 'dis ni ma 'ongs pa noḥ mtha' yi rgyal po dang / bod kyi sde dpon bsam sbyor ngan pa byed pa rnams kyang zhi bar byed cing : dpon slob dang yon mchod nang gi sems mkhon yang mi 'byung ba'i man ngag gdams pa'o: thun mtshams rnams su mchod pa 'bul: phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'i bstod pa mang du 'don: bsdu na: phyag 'tshal rab tu dga' bar brjid pa'i:dbu rgyan 'od kyi phreng ba spel ma: bzhad pa bar bzhad tut+ta ra yi: bdud dang 'jig rten dbang du mdzad ma: zhes ci nus su 'don no: mthar pha rol po de rang la thim: rang nyid kyang mi dmigs par rdzogs rim gyi ngang la bzhag go: e ma ho: 'phags ma'i man ngag gdams pa'i mthar thug bcud: gzhan blo dbang med sgyur ba'i gdams pa 'di: pad+ma 'byung gnas bdag gi snying gi nor:spel bar phongs rkyang rje grogs la la gdams: ma 'ongs don dus la gter du sbos: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shogoḥ 'phrad nas bod yul 'gro kun bde byed shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya:gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: de tshe mnga' bdag shin tu dgye 'gyur te: pad+ma rā ga 'od zer 'bar ba yis: kha brgyan gser bum 'bras chang gis bkang ba: phul nas gus pas phyag byas 'di skad gsol: e ma gu ru rat+na 'od dpag medoḥ man ngag 'di nyid gter du sbab na: sa phyogs gang du gter des su yis thon: dus der dgos pa'i gtso bo gar la dgongs: kun mkhyen chen pos bdag la bka' 475 cig: zhes gsol ma hā gu rus bka' stsal pa: byang sems chen po brtse ba'i blo gros kyi+oḥrnam 'phrul mnga' bdag chen po snyan gsan 'tshal: gzhan gyi gdug sems zhi ba'i gdams pa mchog: 'di ni gter kha gnyis su sba bar bya: gcig ni dus gnad gsal ba'i me long dang : lhan cig yer pa gru bzhi phug par sbosoḥ nga sprul gar gyi dbang phyug gis bton nas: dus de'i 'gro phan sgrub pa'i btsas su byed: gcig ni kong yul me btsa' bu chu ru+oḥ gter sgrub zhal gdams lung byang le'u gsum dang : lhan du sbas na rtsod ldan mthar nye dus: thugs kyi grub chen nam snying yang sprul zhig: mdo khams bu 'bor nye ba'i phyogs su 'byung : ma ṇi badz+re 'gro 'dul snying stobs ldan: rten 'brel ma 'chug mchog gi gter lnga spyod: 'dzam gling 'gro ba 'dren pa'i sgron me 'dra: 'on kyang sngon 'phral rten 'brel 'ga' zhig gis: de lta ji bzhin 'grig par ma gyur tshe: dgongs gter bka' 565

babs bkang dang gter rnying sbyor: dus der phan pa'i sa bcos lung byang dang : ches zab gdams phran kha yar bton par 'gyur: de tshe rig pa'i 'dis kyang don chen 'grub: da lta mnga' bdag rgyal po'i thugs bskyed mthus: phrin las byin rlabs sgyu ma'i rang 'od zhig: mdo khams shar nas thag gam byi ba'i lo: rgyal lam mtsho zhes sme dkar do shal can: snyan grags ldan pa mtha' nas dbus su 'byung : bod yul yongs kyi bstan pa'i bdag po byed: de la sngon las dbang gi rkyen kha mang : mi dang mi min du mas 'tshe bar 'gyur: khyad par nyer gcig nyer dgu zhe drug dang : rang keg bdun zur lo dang de'i snga phyir: rtsub ldan zlog thabs rten 'brel ma 'khrul 'bad: gdams pa 'di 'phrod dus tshigs gang yin de'i: bar chad ji rigs smon lam dbang gis sel: the tshom yid gnyis ma gyur shin tu gces: rtag tu dad gus chen pos nyams len pas: mi mthun 'gal 'khrul mang zhig 'di yis grol: ci phyir pad+ma bdag gi smon lam dang : 'phags ma'i dam bca' bden pas bslu mi 'gyur: sgrub thabs gzhan gyis mthong na nus pa 'grib: de phyir lung 'dzin skyes bu kho na las: tshig gi zur tsam su lam spel cig: pad+ma bdag gis dus gsum sa ler mkhyen: lung byar 'di yang yi ger bkod pa noḥ ma 'ongs spro ba bskyed pa'i rgyu ru 'gyur: 'di nyid bu yis gegs med thon nas kyang : mnga' bdag sprul pa'i bar chad sel bar shog: ces o rgyan mkhan pos gsung bzhin mtsho rgyal bdag gi zangs shog mar po'i ngos su bsnan nas gter bdag brtan ma lcam dral la gnyer du gtad de gter du sbas pa dus su gu ru'i lung bstan bu dang 'phrad par shog: sa mā ya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: ces pa tshe dbang nor bu rdo rje dpal 'bar gyis kong po bu chu lha khang nas gter nas bton te zangs shog dmar po'i ngos nas dag par phab pa'o/ /

thug /sgrol ma dmar mo mi mthun kun sel gyi 'don 'grigs bklags chog tu bkod pa bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ra we/ dbang byed myur mdzad 'phags ma dang / /tshe dbang mtshan can nor bu'i dpal/ /rab 'dzin gu ru mchog la 'dud/ /'don sgom bde phyir mngon rtogs dgod/ /rang 'don 'dzin chags nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang du ma gyur cing bstan pa dang gzhan la phan 'dod lhag pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas dbang mdzad sgrol ma shin tu zab pa'i bskyed bzlas nyams su len pa la/ /thog mar skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed pa ni/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar rje btsun sgrol ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mngon sum bzhin tu bzhugs par dmigs la/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog bcas la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis bsnyen sgrub bgyis pa 'di dag gis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum/ tshogs bsags pa ni/ /rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma dang / sogs/ dpal mos mdzad pa'i yan lag bdun pa byas tshogs zhing mi dmigs par bzhag / sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu sogs tshad med rgyud la 'dre nges su bsgom/dngos gzhi la bskyed bzlas rdzogs gsum las/ /dang po bskyed pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das ma sku mdog dmar mo longs spyod rdzogs pa'i cha lugs can: dar dmar po'i stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs 'phyang ba: zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa'i stabs kyis pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa: phyag gnyis mchog sbyin dang mtheb srin gyi bar dag na ut+pal dmar po 'dzin pa: 'od zer dmar po 'phro zhing 'du ba'i gnas gsum du yi ge oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ gsum gyis mtshan par gyur: thugs ka'i r+ghaṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'phags ma spyan drangs: spro na/ po ta la yi gnas mchog nas: tāyig dmar po las 'khrungs shing : yig 'od kyis 'gro ba sgroloḥ 'phags ma sgrol ma gshegs su gsol: ār+ya tā re badz+ra sa mā dza: de brjod min gang ltar/ dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par thim/ dzaḥhūṃ bam̐ ho: yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhu pe ā lo ke gadhe rna wī bya shardo pra tīts+tsha āḥr+ghaṃ: khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol: de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis ye shes kyi chus dbang bskur bas sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag mar yar lud pas 'od dpag med sprul sku'i cha lugs can 567

gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ gnyis pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi smin mtshams su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sen gang ba'i dbus sum̐ ṭ+wāṃ dmar po/ /mtha' skor du yi ge bcu pa dmar sgor re yod pa las 'od zer dmar po 'phros pasoḥ bdag dang mi mthun pa de la phog: de yang rang 'dra ba'i sgrol mar gyur:yang bdag gi smin mtshams nas 'od zer 'phros nas de'i snying gar phog pas de nyid kyi gdug sems zhi nas byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur te: de yi yid zla ba nya gang ba lte ba bu ga can du gyur:bdag gi snying kha'i zla steng hūṃ yig dmar po las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu 'phros: rang gi sna sgo g.yas nas thon: de yi sna bug g.yas brgyud nas zla ba'i bu gar zhugs te kho yi sna sgo g.yon nas tshur drangs pas: rang gi sna g.yon pa'i sgor zhugs nas snying kha'i zla bar thimoḥ bde ba'i ro byang chub sems kyis myos: bdag la gus shing 'dun par gyur: de lta bu'i dmigs pa yang bskyar zhing / o tā re tuja re tu re swā hā: che ge mo/ ā kak+ṣu ya wa shaṃ ku ru ye hring dza: ni ang ku shā ya r+ghaṃ dza: zhes bzla/'di las sbyor gyi sgrub thabs khol bton tsam yin pas thog ma nas rtsa bsnyen las sngags sbrel mar bzla ba yin la/ spyir sgrol ma gang rung gi rtsa bsnyen zhig sngon du song na ches legs/ yul khams dbang du bya ba'i yul spyi khyab la dmigs na/ che ge mo'i mal du/ sarba lo ka sbyar/ dmigs bya kha shas yin na/dmigs yul thams cad/ ces sam/ sarba kā ma sbyar/ dmigs bsal skye bo pho mo re re lta bu la de nyid kyi ming spel dgos so/ /thun 'jog pa na/ oṃ ār+ya tā re badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha swā hā: ar+ghaṃ gyi sar pā bye sbyar ba dang /oṃ ār+ya tā re badz+ra puṣ+pe ā r+ghaṃ swā hā: de bzhin du/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke/ gadhe/ nai wī r+ya/ shalda āḥhūṃ swā hā:bar gyis mchod pa 'bul/ phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'i bstod pa mang du 'don/ /bsdus na/ phyag 'tshal rab tu dga' ba brjid pa'i: dbu rgyan 'od kyis phreng ba spel ma: bzhad pa rab bzhad tudhā ra yis: bdud dang 'jig rten dbang du mdzad ma: ci nus su brjod pas bstod/ bcom ldan 'phags ma sgrol mas bdag gi rlung sems snang ba thams cad rang dbang du 'du bar mdzad du gsol/ khyad par yid la dmigs pa'i yul thams cad thogs pa med par dbang du 'du bar mdzad du gsol/ / ces 'dod don gsol/ yig brgyad dbyangs gsal rten snying rnams lan gsum gsum brjod do/ /gsum pa rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor ni/snang yul thams cad dam dmigs bya pha rol po de rang la thim/ /rang nyid kyang mi dmigs pa stong nyid du gyur bar mos la spros bral gnyug ma'i ngang du ci gnas mnyam par bzhag /slar yang snang grags rtog tshogs lha sngags bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur/ ces mos/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'phags ma sgrol ma 'grub gyur nas/ sogs bsngo smon dang shis brjod bya'o/ /snyigs dus gdug can 'byung po yis/ /skye bo'i gyur rlom bstan pa dang / /der 'dzin rnams la 'tshe byed pas/ /gnyen po gdams pa 'di nyid za~X/8/'doms kyang log zhugs yid can kun/ /snang ba dam pa'i chos la sgyur/ /dge chos sgrub la bar chad kyi/ /

'tshe bral 'dod rgu'i dpal rgyas shog /ces gter gzhung nyid la gsung rgyun ltar kha gsal phran bus brgyan te pad+ma gar dbang rtsal gyis bklag chog tu bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel/ /tshog /dgongs gter bsam pa lhun grub brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dngos grub char 'bebs ces bya bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru sarba sisnyi hūṃ/ kun bzang gdod ma'i mgon po snang mtha' yas/ /nges pa lnga ldan rnamyo/ snang spyan ras gzigs/ /rang byung rgyal kun spyi dpal pad+ma 'byung / /rigs 'dus sku gsum bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /chos skyong rgyal po tshangs pa lha'i me tog /mkhar chen mtsho rgyal dge slong nam mkha'i snying / /rdo rje bdud 'joms lha sras mu khri btsan/ /las can dag pa'i 'khor lngar gsol ba 'debs/ /zab gter sgo 'byed mang lam bzang po grags/ /'od 'bangs skyabs gcig rgod kyi ldem 'phru can/ /'gro 'dul bka' babs brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan sogs/ /rtsa ba'i gter brgyud rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /pad+ma dbang rgyal ye shes rol pa rtsal/ /chos kyi rgyal tshab rin chen phun tshogs zhabs/ /chos bdag rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po sogs/ /bka' 'dus phyi ma'i brgyud par gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs kyi rigs 'chang la li ta badz+ra/ / 'od gsal bde gshegs snying po gter bzhed rtsal/ /thugs kyi sras lnga nye ba'i bu brgyad sogs/ /byin rlabs dgongs gter brgyud par gsol ba 'debs/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra ma hā gu ru rje/ /gang 'dod dngos grub stsol ba'i skur ston pa/ /gtum drag me phreng dregs pa'i sde dpon brgyad/ /bcom ldan sman bla de bzhin gshegs pa brgyad/ /drwa ba sdom pa gnod gnas dbang po brgyad/ /rdo rje gzhon nu yi dam sgrub sde brgyad/ /zil gnon drag rtsal gzhi gnas skyong ba brgyad/ /gsang bdag seng sgrog dpa' bo ging chen bzhi/ /pad+ma badz+ra khrag 'thung rdo rje brgyad/ gu ru rta mgrin gsar ye phyag rgya bzhi/ /rdo rje gro lod bdud 'dul khro bo bcu/ /pad+ma rgyal po nye sras sems dpa' brgyad/ /'od dpag med mgon mi 'khrugs dpa' bo bdun/ /kun bzang rdor sems rigs bzhi bdud 'dul bzhi/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rig 'dzin slob dpon bzhi/ /rgyal ba kun 'dus bla ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba thams cad kyis/ /mi phyed rtse gcig gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /chos kyi sdom bzhis srid zhir nges par 'byung / /bsags dang sbyangs pas zab mo'i snod du rung / /gzhi lam dbang bzhis sgo gsum rdo rjer smin/ /dkyil 'khor rnam gsum 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /byang chub sems dang sgyu lus zab gsal 'byongs/ /bstan 'tshe'i dmag dpung sdang sems rgyu bcas zhi/ /mi 569

g.yo bzhir gnas nyams bzhis bdag med rtogs/ /'byung 'khrugs bdag 'dzin choms par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhen med mchod dang sbyin sogs bsdu dngos kyis/ /dbul phongs zhen chags ser sna'i mdud pa khrol/ /yon tan kun 'byung bde gshegs snying po'i gter/ /gcer mthong rig pas thon par byin gyis rlobs/ /dpyid thig kha sbyor srog rtsol dab mar thim/ /'khrul rtog gis dbe+en bde chen sbas yul ༄gyen/ /thos bsam sgom pas rtog bcas 'pho ba 'gags/ /'brog chen bar dor grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mtshan nyid bzhi ldan rang bab mnyam gzhag la/ /brtan thob phyi nang 'byung ba'i gegs las rgyal/ /tshogs drug kun rtog chom po phra sbom rags/ /spang gnyen gshis thog pheb par byin gyis rlobs/ /nyon mongs lam lhongs ci snang ye shes 'char/ /rdo rje go chas dug lnga'i mtshon rtse gzhom/ /'od gsal rnam bzhir goms 'dris brtan thob nas/ /'chi ba chos skur grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rmi lam bar do chos nyid sgyu mar rtogs/ /las rlung gzhir thim gzhi snang dbyings su dag /snang bzhi'i lam nas yid chos 'khrul pa'i tshogs/ /lhun grub sbubs su 'pho bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs snying la zhugs/ /'khor 'das kun kyang ye shes chen por shar/ /'bral par bcas kun 'di nas 'phos ma thag /bde ba can du skye ba byin gyis rlobs/ /gnas skabs su yang mi mthun 'gal rkyen zhi/ /tshe bsod dpal 'byor nyams rtogs yon tan rgyas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'bad med mtha' ru phyin/ /bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /ces pa 'di'am mkhyen pa'i gter chen rje dpon 'chi med mchog sprul rin po ches bskul gnang mdzad ngor pad+ma na re shwa ra sa yang khrod kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gling du tshes bzang por bris te gsol ba btab pa dge legs 'phel/ / 570

༄ga /dgongs gter bsam pa lhan grub ma'i dbang bshad zab don dgongs dril zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas khyab bdag gdod ma'i mgon po kun bzang rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par bya snyam pa'i thugs bskyed dang ldan pas gsan 'tshal/ de yang theg pa'i 'jug sgo bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig mchis pa las khyad par 'phags pa/ bka' gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba/ myur lam gtan bde 'bad med du stsol ba ni/ a ti rdzogs pa chen po'i man ngag kho na las gzhan du ma gyur cing / de la'ang gzhi smin byed kyis sa bon legs par ma thebs na/ lam zab mo bsgom yang 'dod pa'i 'bras bu thob par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ smin byed zab mos rgyud brlan pa gal che zhing / smin byed lam gyi 'jug sgo de la'ang dpag tu med kyang / mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'dod pas lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor la brtson dgos tshul sngags gsar rnying yongs kyi brjod don gcig tu nges te/ bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ lha sku 'bum phrag bsgoms pa bas/ bla ma gcig pu bsgom pas mchog ces sogs lung 'byams klas shing / de la dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas las lhag pa'i bla ma ni gzhan du ma mchis te/ tshul ji ltar zhe na/ gdod nas skye 'chi 'gyur med rdo rje'i sku'i phrin las rab 'byams la mnga' dbang bsgyur zhing dus gsum dus med thams cad 'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgyar 'gro don mdzad tshul bsam gzhig gi yul las 'das kyang cung zad tsam zhig brjod na/sngon sangs rgyas rnam gzigs kyi bstan pa la pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sprul pa yon tan brtsegs pa'i rgyal po zhes bya bas rgyal srid chos kyi khrims kyis 'gro don dpag tu med pa mdzad pa dang / de dang dus mtshungs par bdud rtsi sman sbyin chen po zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpar sprul pa dang / de bzhin du sangs rgyas gtsug tor can gyi dus rgyal po shing rta can dang / byang sems snying stobs chen po zhes pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad skyob kyi dus su chos rgyal gser gyi dbang lag dang / sangs rgyas log par dad sel gyi dus chos skyong lha'i dbang phyug ces bde ba can gyi zhing nas sprul pa'i tshul du byon pa'i rgyal po dang / 'khor ba 'jig gi dus byang sems chu'i 'khor lo zhes bya bas 'gro ba'i don mdzad/ sangs rgyas gser thub kyi dus chos rgyal sbyin pa la dga' ba dang / 'od srung gi bstan pa la chos rgyal stobs 571

ldan drag po zhes bya bar sprul zhing / dus der byang chub sems dpa' kun snyoms dge ba can bya bar yang sprul pa dang / sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyi bstan pa la dhad+ma hu la zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' zhig dang bcas byung ste 'gro ba'i don rgya cher mdzad do/ /sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i bstan pa 'di la 'phags pa shā ri'i bu dang kun dga' bo sogs kyi skur bstan nas bstan pa spel ba dang / de nas ston pa zhing 'di'i gdul bya rdzogs pa'i skabs su myang 'das kyi mdo las/ da ni mya ngan 'das 'og tu/ /lo ni bcu dang gnyis tsam na/ /dha na ko ṣa'i mtsho gling du/ /nga bas lhag pa'i skyes bu 'byung / /zhes dang / mdo sde gser 'od las kyang / rgyal bstod pad+ma 'byung gnas de 'dra ba/ tshe rabs de dang der ni rnyed gyur cig /ces gsungs bzhin bdud dang mu stegs 'dul ba'i phyir dang / gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i ston pa por/ dha na ko kha ste bod skad du nor gyi mdzad ces bya ba'i gling du/ rang byung pad+ma ge sar dur khrod brgyad du brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa bskyangs/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang / grub chen brgyad sogs bsten nas gsang sngags kyi chos rnams gsan/ 'dzam gling yul gru thams cad zhabs kyis bcags shing byin rlabs mdzad/ gu ru sprul pa'i mtshan brgyad kyi skur bstan nas 'gro mang smin grol la bkod/ /khyad par mā ra ti kar tshe la dbang ba dang / yang le shod du phyag rgya chen po sogs rig pa 'dzin pa'i dngos grub thams cad brnyes/ dgung lo sum stong nyer brgyad bzhes pa na bod yul 'dir chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyis spyan drangs/ dpal gyi bsam yas sogs mtha' dbus kyi gtsug lag khang rnams la rab tu gnas pa mdzad/ lha srin mi srun pa thams cad btul nas dam la bzhag /rje 'bangs nyer lnga sogs grub thob kyis sa steng bkang / rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che nyin mor byed pa'i phrin las mkha' khyab tu brdal zhing / bod yul 'dir chos gter dang nor gter grangs med pa sbas/de nas 'dzam gling 'gro ba'i don du dgongs pa khyad par can gyis lho nub rnga yab gling du srin po'i kha gnon gyi ched du zangs mdog dpal rdzu 'phrul gyis pheb ste/ srin rgyal rak+ka thod phreng rtsal gyi skur bzhengs nas srin tshogs chos la bkod pa dang / thugs rje sprul pa gsol ba 'debs shing tshes bcu'i mchod pa la 'bad pa rnams kyi don du rab dngos/ 'bring nyams snang / tha ma rmi lam du 'byon nas rjes su 'dzin par mdzad de/ nges pa'i don du dang po'i sangs rgyas kun bzang pad+ma 'byung gnas nyid gnas gzhan du ma gyur te/ de ltar rnam thar mdzad phrin ngo mtshar bsam las 'das pa rigs kun khyab bdag pad+ma rgyal po nyid kyis/ gangs can bod kyi gdul bya rnams la rjes su gdams pa'i rig 'dzin bla ma'i sgrub thabs gu ru tsin+ta ma ṇi'i skor brgya rtsa tsam zab mo'i gter du btsas pa las/ snying por gyur pa slob dpon chen po rnga yab gling du gshegs kar/ gung thang la thog tu lha sras mu khri btsan por thugs 572

brtse'i zhal chems tshul du gsungs pa'i gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun grub mar grags pa 'di nyid lha sras kyis ru lag rgyang gi lha khang du sbas pa sprul sku ri khrod pa bzang po grags pas gter nas bton/rig 'dzin rgod ldem can gyis shog ser mkha' 'gro'i brda yig las bod yig tu 'bebs par mdzad de/sangs rgyas dngos snang rig 'dzin gtso mchog rnams las rim par snyan du brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang 'bral ba'i dbang bskur zab mo bgyid pa skabs su bab pa yin te/ mnga' ris pan chen pad+ma dbang rgyal gyi gter byon rig 'dzin yongs 'dus dang shog ser dgongs gter gyi khyad tsam las bka' bab gcig tu gyur cing / lha sngags rdzogs rim sogs ngo mtshar du mas khyad du 'phags pa'i chos bka' 'di ni o rgyan 'ja' tshon snying po'i gter lung las/ kaḥthog lho ru nor bu'i ming : ya mtshan shes rab snying rjer ldan: dpal mgon chos dang 'phrad srid na: dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur:ces dang / rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gter byon lung bstan du/ kaḥthog phyogs nas nga yi sprul pa yis: stag ra klu gang sprul pa bzlog kyang srid: ces dang / gter chen rol pa'i rdo rje'i brag gter phyag rdor gyi lung byang las/ nga yi gter gnas gro lod nye ba na: dpal lam dbang po'i mtshan can sme ba yi: ga shal can 'byung de la gtad rgya dgos: zhes dang / stag tshang gro lod kyi gsang ba'i lung bstan las/ pad+ma nga sprul nag pos byin brlabs shing : nam snying thugs kyi 'od zer zhugs gyur pa:kaḥthog lho phyogs btsan ri'i nye 'dabs su: dbang ngam nor bu'i ming can snying stobs can: mi che mi chung sgeg pa rdo rje'i lus: rtsa rlung thig ler skyon med mkha' 'gro 'du: zhes sogs tshad grub gter lung mang por sngags pa'i rig 'dzin yongs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba/ dpal rdo rje tshe dbang nor bu'am 'od gsal bde gshegs snying po gter bzhed rtsal zhes 'phags yul gyi slob dpon chen po nag po pa dang gnubs nam mkha'i snying po'i sprul pa'i rol pa gcig bsdus/ 'phags yul gyi shing chen po rnams dang spang rtogs yon tan mnyam pa nyid kyi dgongs gter zab mo'i bka' srol yin te/ de yang rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gter byon ye shes gsang ba las/ kha ba can gyi rgyal khams 'dir: gter chen gter phran bye ba sbasoḥ las can 'phrad par smon lam btab: 'gro drug smin par sems bskyed nas:'ga' zhig nam mkha'i lha la gtad: 'ga' zhig sa bdag klu la gtad: 'ga' zhig dam ldan slob ma la: mgo bor ye shes rdo rje bzhag: dam tshig bdud rtsi blud byas nas: tha tshig mi brjed smon lam btab: kun gzhi'i mtsho la gter du sbas: zhes gsungs bzhin rig 'dzin chen po de nyid kyis rgyal dbang pad+ma 'byung gnas dang yang yang mjal zhing dbang bskur byin brlabs rjes su gnang ba'i dgongs gter thun mong ma yin pa 'di nyid kyi dbang ni rig 'dzin nyid dang ye shes sprul rgyud gcig 573

pa'i gter ston rol pa'i rdo rjes 'gyur med gtan 'khyil mtsho las khrom gter du spyan drangs pa'i bla ma rgyal ba kun 'dus dang byin rlabs chu bo gcig 'dres kyi lugs su thob pa'i phan yon ni/ gzhung rnam rdo rje'i tshig las: bla ma'i sgrub thabs kun 'dus nor bu lugasoḥ de yi bskyed sngags rdzogs rim rtsa ba yin: sgrub thabs bcu gsum me phreng sman gyi bla: rmugs 'dzin dag gis dmag dang nad mug bzlog:rdo rje thod phreng zin gnon seng ge sgra: gter dang sbas yul sgo 'byed 'brog chen sgrol: pad+ma badz+ra rta nag khro bo lod: 'byung bzhi'i gnod pa ar dzag dgra bo zhi: spyan ras gzigs dang snang mtha' kun bzang gis: 'chi dang bar do'i duḥkha drag po sel: kun gyi ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma ste: de bsgrubs gu ru'i thugs rjes 'pho med gzigs zhes dang : gu ru'i thugs sgrub gzhan las kyang : chos 'di zhal phyes pa tsam gyis mtha' dmag phyir bsring nus: sa phyogs der yang lo phyugs legs shing rlung 'tshubs chung :dang 'dun byed pa'i dud 'gro yan chad bde chen dag pa'i zhing du 'gro'o: zhes dang / nga sgrub sangs rgyas thams cad 'grub: nga mthong sangs rgyas thams cad mthong : nga ni bde gshegs 'dus pa yin:zhes sogs gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab par gsungs so/ /de ltar byin rlabs kyi tshan kha khyad par 'phags pa/ chos bdag las can skyes bu mchog rnams kyi zhal nas zhal dang / snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa/ lam zab bla ma'i snying thig /mkha' 'gro'i zhal gyis drod rlangs ma yal ba'i dbang bskur zab mo bgyed pa la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams song nas/ slob ma'i bya bar 'os pa maṇ+ḍal phul/ zhes pa 'di'ang / si tu pa pad+ma'i ming can kyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rgya na ni rma kā ya zhes pas bgyis pa'o/ /maṅga lo// 574

༄ga /dgongs gter bsam pa lhan grub ma'i rtsa ba'i dbang bskur zab gsang bcud 'dus ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru pad+ma ka rā ya/ 'dir rig 'dzin yongs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba nges pa don gyi slob dpon chen po dpal rdo rje tshe dbang nor bu'i dgongs gter gu ru'i gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun grub ma'i sgrub thabs yid bzhin nor bu'i man ngag bcu gsum rtsa ba'i dbang bskur gyis skal smin par byed pa'i rim pa la/ sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ dpon slob gnas dus rten 'byung 'dzom pa'i skabs su/ rgyal ba gong mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i sgrub gnas sam/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su stegs bzang po'i khar maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du tshom bu dri bzang gis sbags pa bcu gsum bkod/de'i steng du mardzi'i khar rnam rgyal bum pa lnga phrag lnga'i rdzas dang 'o mas sum gnyis dgang / sna tshogs dar gyi mgul chings dang / kha rgyan dung chos gzungs rdor bkod pa'i steng du dbang gtor dpe'i sa bzhin bshams/ de dang nye bar gang bder 'khor lo'i tsagli bzhag /las bum mgul chings dmar po can zhig kyang bsham/ shar du sku gzugs tsagli/ lhor dbu rgyan cod pan dang rin chen phreng ba/ nub tu rdo rje dar dmar btags pa dang me tog phreng ba/ byang du dril bu dar ljang btags pa/ shar lhor shel gyi phreng ba/ lho nub tu thod pa bdud rtsi ril bu dang ldan pa/ nub byang du gzungs ma'i tsagli/ byang shar du rgya gram dang me long / mdun du sman raka gtor gsum/ nyer spyod mchod pa phreng tshar/ bka' srung rnams la gtor 'bul dmar gtor drug dkar gtor gnyis/ gter drung la gser skyems dkar gtor sman leb dang / mtsho sman la bu khur/ klu bdud la zur gsum sprul dkris can bsham/ chad mdo'i dmar gtor/ brtan ma'i gtor ma sum tshom can/ las phur/ tshogs kyi yo byad gang 'byor/sngon 'gro bgegs gtor glud gzugs/ gzhan yang mig dar/ me tog /dam chu/ spos dang / gu gul/slob dpon gyi mdun du ḍā dril 'thor nas nyungs dkar/ maṇ+ḍal sogs mchod rdzas rnams tshang zhing yid 'ong bsham dgod spel legs byas la/ dngos gzhi la/ slob dpon dang dbang rdzas lha'i rnal 'byor gyis nus ldan du bsgrub pa dang / slob ma dal du bcug ste rgyud smin par byed pa gnyis kyi dang por/ rdo rje slob dpon zhal lho nub bam dkyil 'khor la phyogs pas bstan bde ba la 'khod nas/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs dang / drag khros gzhung ltar bgegs gtor btang / de nas rgyal ba kun 'dus kyi las 575

byang bka' bsgo mtshams gcod bsnyen pa'i bar mthar chags su 'don cing bdag mdun gnyis ka gyer tshig gcig gis bskyed cing bsnyen pa rnams so sor ci 'grub re bzla'o/ /de nas bsam pa lhun grub ma'i gong gi gsol 'debs tshan lnga bton nas de phyin man ngag bcu gsum gyi lha rnams mdun bskyed kyi tshul du rim pas gsal gdab tshul gter gzhung ji bzhin nges par byas nas/ so so'i gsol 'debs tshar kha shas bton mthar/ mdun bskyed las lha gnyis pa spros rang la thim par bsgoms pa skabs 'di'i dmigs bsal lo/ /rang lhar gsal ba'i ngang sngags rnams bzla/ de nas bum bskyed rgyal kun 'dus pa'i dbang gzhung sor bzhag ni/ hūṃ: chags med pad+ma zla ba'i steng : rgyu las byung ba'i rin chen bumoḥ kha g.yel zhabs zhum mgrin pa phra: mchu 'phyang lto ba yangs shing zlum: nang ni sna tshogs bcud kyis bkang : dpag bsam shing gi kha brgyan dang : mgul ching sna tshogs dar las byasoḥ de dbus chu las skyes pa yi+oḥ pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i gdan steng du+oḥ zla dkyil r+ghaṃ gi 'phro 'du las: bla ma chen po rdo rje 'chang : be+e ḍūr+ya yi mdog ltar sngo: zhal gcig phyag gnyis longs spyod rdzogs: rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnol: rigs lngas dbur brgyan thugs srog hūm̐: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes: zhi 'dzum rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs: pang du rdo rje phag mo sngo: phyag rgya lnga ldan gri thod 'dzinoḥ chags pa'i nyams can yab la 'khril: zung 'jug bde stong ngang du bzhugs: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i 'khor lo dang :rtsa gsum zhi khro rab 'byams tshogasoḥ dpag med sprin ltar gtibs pas bskoroḥ snang stong chu zla lta bur gsal: thugs ka'i r+ghaṃ las 'od 'phros pas: rigs kyi bdag po 'khor bcas rnams: skad cig nyid la spyan drangs te: dam tshig pad dang dbyer med gyur: oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ ma hā gu ru badz+ra dhā ra sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥr+ghaṃ bo ho: pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ: zhes brjod ye shes lha tshogs rnams: dam tshig pa dang dbyer med par: 'dres shing gcig tu gyur par bsam: lha dbang mi dgos pad 'byung bka': r+ghaṃ: rigs rnams kun bdag che ba'i mchog: rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo: mchod yon me tog bdug spos me:dri mchog zhal zas rol mo dbyangs: bcom ldan bum pa'i lha la 'bul: brtse ba chen pos bzhes nas kyang : 'gro ba'i don chen mdzad pa dang : min cing grol ba'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+pe sogs/ shardo pū dza ā hūṃ: r+ghoṃḥmakha' khyab mi g.yo rdo rje can: kun 'dus phrin las rdo rje'i bdag:thog mtha' med pa'i rdo rje 'chang : gsang gsum rdo rje khyod la bstod: ces brjod rang gi thugs ka nas: 'od zer gzungs thag gzhon nas 'phros: bum bskyed lha yi thugs kar phog: rgyud bskul zhal shas bdud rtsi babs: bum pa khengs te bdud rtsi'i nang : rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang : rgya gram gzugs brnyan 'char nas ni: 'od zer sna lnga 'phros par bsam: oṃ ma hā gu ru badz+ra dhā ra r+ghaṃ: ḍā ki nī badz+ra wā rā tī tsit+ta sikhyi ma bh+yo dza:brgya sto~X zlo sogs skabs dang bstun: mthar ni lha rnams 'od du zhu: bum pa'i chu dang dbyer med 'dres: de nyid

nus mthu ldan par bsam: las bum nang du rta mgrin dmar po bskyed la: o badz+ra kro dha ha ya hṝ wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa: ces bzla zhing bgegs bzlog pa'i phrin las bcol/ de nas bdag 'jug ni las byang gi/ trīḥbla ma lha dang ḍā ki'i tshogs: zhes sogs thugs dam bskul tshig sngags bcas 'don cing / bum pa/ gtor ma/ tsakhri thod chang gnas gsum gtugs la dbang bzhi len pa'i dmigs pa bya/ skabs 'dor tshogs 'khor 'bul la/ zhal bstab tshar ba dang / bka' srung gtor 'bul byed/ slob dpon la tshogs drang / de nas slob ma rnams gral du 'khod la/ji ltar bltams pa sogs las bum gyis khrus bya/ me tog bkram bsdu dang / bgegs gtor btang zhing / bka' bsgom mtshams bcad bya/ dbang gi lo rgyus brjod la/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ da khyed rnams dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i don du thog mar gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: ho: khyab bdag bstan pa rin po che: rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: bdag cag ldan skal smin grol mdzod: rdo rje'i dam tshig dus 'dir stsol: lan gsum/ de nas rgyun bshags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: ho: dgongs shig rdo rje slob dpon dgongs: bdag cag ma rig dbang gyur pas: so sor thar pa'i sdom pa nyamasoḥ byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed 'khrul: rdo rje theg pa'i dbang bskur gyi: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig chags: phyag rgya chen po go ba log: rim pa gnyis kyi gsang tshig bsgrags: mdor na tshor dang ma tshor pa: gnong 'gyod drag pos mthol lo bshags: tshangs dbang mchog gi dngos grub stsol: ces lan gsum/ byang chub sems bskyed pa 'di'i lad mo mdzod/ hoḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas byang sems kyis: sems can rnams kyi don sgrub phyir: byang chub mchog gi sems bskyed ltar: deng 'dir bdag gis sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ khyed rnams sngon chad gsang chen bla na med pa'i dal du ma zhugs pa'am/ zhugs kyang bskyar te 'jug pa la gsang sgrog nyes pa mi 'byung ba'i phyir gdong g.yogs dmar po bcings pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ tsak+ṣa bhad+dha bhad+dha swā hā: mig dar dang me tog gtad/ de nas dam la bzhag pa ni/mgo bor rdo rje bzhag byas nas: dbyangs dang bcas pa 'di skad do: rgyu: nyon cig skal ldan rigs kyi bu: bla ma chen po rdo rje 'chang : khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs: de phyir rdo rje'i dam tshig ni: ji ltar stsal bzhin srung dgos so: mi 'da' gnyan gyi dam tshig mchog: bsrung na dngos grub gzhi yin te: nyams na nyes pa kun gyi gzhi: de phyir snying nas khro bor la: srog la bab kyang ma 'da' zhig: ye shes rdo rje'i dam tshig ni: de ring khyod la sbyin par bya: ma hā sa ma ya badz+ra greṇ+ḍi rak+ṣa rak+ṣa i rda: de nas mna' 'chu sbyin pa ni: r+ghaṃ: 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i chu: slob ma khyod la sbyin par bya:bsrung na bdud rtsi nyams na dugoḥ bla med gsang ba'i byin rlabs 'di: gnas khang 'di yi phyi rol du: dam med 'ga' la smras gyur na: chu 'dis khyod rang bsgral nas ni: phyi ma dmyal bar ltung ba 577

yin: oṃ badz+ra u da ka' ṭha swā hā: sa ma ya na ra ka i rda si r+ghaṃ: de nas ye shes dbab pa'i phyir: slob ma'i ngo bo 'di ltar bsgom: hūṃ: phung khams skye mched stong pa'i ngang : pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i khrir:slob ma'i ngo bo pad+ma 'byung : dkar gsal rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: longs spyod rdzogs sku'i cha lugs can: dar dang rin chen sna tshogs bklubs: gnas gsum oṃ āḥrgyu gis mtshan: phyed skyil dgyes pa'i gar stabs rol: bdag gi thugs ka'i rgyu yig dang : slob ma'i snying ga'i sa bon las: 'od zer sna tshogs phyogs bcur 'phros: dpag med mtha' klas zhing khams nas: rab 'byams rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs: mtsho la kha char 'bebs pa ltaroḥ slob ma'i spyi bor sib sib thim: sku gsung thugs kyis byin brlabs gyur: hūṃ: khyab brdal bde chen klong yangs nasoḥ kun bzang yab yum byin phob cig: stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams nas: rdo rje 'chang chen byin phob cig: nub phyogs bde chen zhing khams nas: snang ba mtha' yas byin phob cigoḥ ri bo ta la'i pho brang nas: thugs rje chen pos byin phob cig: rnga yab gling gi zhing khams nas: pad+ma 'byung gnas byin phob cigoḥ bde stong sgyu ma'i pho brang nas: ye shes mtsho rgyal byin phob cig: rang bzhin gzhal yas thams cad nas: rgyal ba rgya mtsho dpag med dang : bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob cig: hūṃ:rang bzhin dbyings las ma g.yos kyang : thabs mkhas thugs rje'i sprul sgyur bgyed: zhi dang khro bo'i sku gzugs 'char: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob cig: snang srid sku yi bkod pas khyab: slob ma'i lus la byin gyis rlobs: chos nyid rang sgra 'brug ltar ldiroḥ slob ma'i ngag la byin gyis rlobs: dbyings rig thig le sna tshogs 'char: slob ma'i yid la byin gyis rlobs: sgra 'od zer gsum bsam las 'das: slob ma'i phung khams byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī sarba ta tha ga badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ: tse dze+oḥ rā rā rā rā: tsa lā ya tsa lā ya: do sha ya do sha ya: ā we sha ya a a: de nas snying po bzlas nas ni: byin 'debs byed cing dmigs pa gsal gdab: rngul dang bde drod 'bar ba dang : ba spu g.yo ba 'bebs rtags yin: brtan phyir spyi bor rdo rje bzhag: de wa tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra r+ghaṃ: kā ya tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra r+ghaṃ: wā ka tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra r+ghaṃ: tsit+ta tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra rgyu: gu ru maṇ+ḍal tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūṃ: de nas rang rig lha zhal bstan: ma rig pa nyon shes kyi sgrib pa dang mig dar lhan cig tu bsal bar mos shig: hūṃ: ma rig gti mug chu bur mig: shes rab gsal ba'i thur ma yis: thabs shes dbyer med ngang du dbye: rang rig dkyil 'khor lha la ltos: oṃ badz+ra pa sh+ya ho: badz+ra tsak+ṣu:prawe sha ya phaṭa: r+ghaṃ: rang sems cir yang ma grub pa: chos sku kun tu bzang po yin: stong pa phyal chad ma song ba: bde stong kun tu bzang mo yi: ngo bo stong stong la rang bzhin gsal: 'gag med rig rtsal sna tshogs shar: sku gsum bla ma'i dkyil 'khor yin: rgyal 578

ba'i dkyil 'khor gzhan na med: de nas rdul tshon dkyil 'khor bstan: r+ghaṃḥ'adi ni bskyed pa dbyibs rdul te: phrin las bla ma'i dkyil 'khor yinoḥ ltos shig 'di la 'jug par byos: smin grol zab mo thob par 'gyur: de nas khyed rnams kyis dkyil 'khor lha tshogs drung du phyag 'tshal zhing : phyag rten me tog re 'bul mdzod: dngos gzhi dbang bskur 'di lta ste: chu dang cod pan rdor dril dang :'khor lo rgya gram sku gzugs dang ཿོ shel phreng me long bdud rtsi bum: de dag rnams kyis bskur bar bya: zhes gsungs bzhin rig pa'i dbang lnga rim bzhin bskur ba la: thum pa thogs la/ r+ghaṃ: phrin las rdul tshon dkyil 'khor 'dir: bla ma sprul sku 'ja' ltar shar: snang srid 'khor 'das sku yis gang ཿོ'od zer dkar pos phyogs mthar khyab: r+ghaṃ: nga ni rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: sku mdog sngon po rdor dril bsnol: bum pa lha yi gzhal yas khang : bdud rtsi nyon mongs dag byed chu: slob ma khyod la dbang bskur ro: zhe sdang 'joms shing rnam shes 'jigasoḥ me long ye shes mngon gyur nas: rdo rje rigs kyi sku thob shog: hūṃ: mdun bskyed lha yi thugs ka nas: mkha' 'gro sngon mo dbang bum thogs: slob ma khyod dang gnyis med thim: khyod rang rdo rje thod phreng gyur: hūṃ: khro bo rnams kyis log 'dren bcom:byang chub sems dpas bkra shis brjod: rdo rje ma yis glung dbyangs len: lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul: oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī badz+ra a sgyi ṣiñtsa r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ hūṃ: zhes dbang bskur bkra shis brjod/ cod pan rin chen phreng ba thogs: hūṃ: nga ni rat+na thod phreng rtsal: sku mdog ser po rdor dril bsnams: cod paṇa bsam 'phel yid bzhin nor: rin chen phreng ba zang med rgyunoḥ slob ma khyod la dbang bskur ro: ser sna 'joms shing tshor phung gcod: mnyam nyid ye shes mngon gyur nas: rin chen rigs kyi sku thob shog: rgyu: mdun bskyed lha yi lte ba nas: mkha' 'gro ser mo cod pan thogasoḥ slob ma khyod dang gnyis med thim: khyod rang rin chen thod phreng gyur: rgyuḥkhro bo rnams kyis log na bcom: byang chub sems dpas bkra shis brjod: rdo rje ma yis glu dbyangs len: lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul: oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī rat+na a gi ṣiñtsa ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ: de nas rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba ni: hūṃ:nga ni pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: sku mdog dmar po rdor dril bsnams: rdo rje nyon mongs 'joms pa'i rdzas: me tog phreng ba chags pa med: slob ma khyod la dbang bskur ro: 'dod chags 'joms shing 'du shes dag: sor rtog ye shes mngon gyur nas: pad+ma rigs kyi sku thob shogoḥ rgyu: mdun bskyed lha yi mgrin pa nas: mkha' 'gro dmar mo rdo rje thogs: slob ma khyod dang gnyis med thim: khyod rang pad+ma thod phreng gyur: rdzu: khro bo rnams kyis log 'dren bcom: byang chub sems dpas bkra shis brjod: rdo rje ma yis glu dbyangs len: lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul: oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki 579

nī pad+ma a bhi ṣi ñtsa trīḥtrīḥtrī: de nas dril bu ral gri thogs la: rtsu: nga ni karma thod phreng rtsal: sku mdog ljang gu rdor dril bsnol: dril bu btang snyoms gnyis med rdzas: ral gris gzung 'dzin khri ba gcod: slob ma khyod la dbang bskur ro: phrag dog 'joms shing 'du byed 'thor: bya grub ye shes mngon gyur nas: las kyi rigs kyi sku thob shogoḥ rgyu: mdun bskyed lha yi gsang ba nas: mkha' 'gro ljang mo dril bu thogs: slob ma khyod dang gnyis med thim: khyod rang karma thod phreng gyur: rtsu: khro bo rnams kyis log 'dren bcom: byang chub sems dpas bkra shis brjod: rdo rje ma yis glu dbyangs lenoḥ lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul: oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī karma a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ.āḥ.āḥ de nas 'khor lo gtor ma thogs: r+ghaṃ: nga ni bla ma rdo rje 'chang : sku mdog sngon po rdor dril bsnoloḥ 'khor los 'khor ba'i btson ra 'joms: gtor ma thams cad lhun grub rdzas: slob ma khyod la dbang skur ro: gti mug dag cing ngar 'dzin zhi: chos dbyings ye shes mngon gyur nas: de bzhin rigs kyi sku thob shog: r+ghaṃ: mdun bskyed lha yi spyi bo nas: mkha' 'gro dkar mo 'khor lo thogs: slob ma khyod dang gnyis med thimoḥ khyod rang rdo rje 'chang du gyur: hūṃ: khro bo rnams kyis log 'dren bcom: byang chub sems dpas bkra shis brjod: rdo rje ma yis glu dbyangs len: lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul: oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ oṃ o+oṃḥ slob ma lha ru gsal ba yis: rnam bzhis gzhan don bsgrub pa'i phyir: rgya gram thogs la 'di skad do: r+ghaṃ: 'di ni rdo rje rgya gram ste: zhi rgyas dbang drag lhun gyis grub: slob ma khyod la dbang bskur bas: phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro don gyis: oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī sarba karma a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: ces bskur: de ltar rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur bas/ nyon mongs pa lnga dag /phung po lnga gnas gyur/ ye shes lnga mngon du gyur/ thod phreng rtsal lnga'i go 'phang thob/phrin las rnam bzhir dbang bsgyur ba'i skal ba dang ldan par byas so/ /de nas smin byed zab mo'i dngos gzhi dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ da yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i man ngag bcu gsum gyi rtsa bar gyur pa rgyal ba kun 'dus o rgyan rin po che'i smin dbang gi don du slob dpon dang mdun bskyed gnyis ka 'di ltar gsal thob/ mdun gyi nam mkha' bdud rtsi'i rgya mcho1re sngo zhing dwangs rgya khyon dang gting mtha' 'byams klas pa'i klong nas 'thon pa'i pad+ma'i sdong po 'dab ma 'bum dang ldan pa yal ga lo 'bras phun sum tshogs shing / ge sar mngon par mtho ba'i steng du nyi ma zla ba'i gdan la dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can zhi 'dzum yid tsam khro ba'i rnam pa/ phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar bsnams shing / g.yon mnyam gzhag gi steng na ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa'i gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga rtse gsum bsten pa/ 580

dbu la she'u'i snyan zhu pad 'dab can rtse mor rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang / rma bya'i mdongs dang rgod ldem gyis brgyan cing / me long dang gser gyi nyi zla dar gyi cod pan gyis spras pa gsol zhing / sku la mdo dang mthun pa'i cha lugs chos gos dmar po gser gyi ri mo can dang / sngags kyi cha lugs na bza' phod mthing ga dang gsang gos/ 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyi chas zab chen ber smug gter gyi ha ris can gsol ba/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung du bzhugs pa'i sku'i cha shas re re yang bskal par bltas kyang chog mi shes shing blta bas mi ngom pa'i mtshan dpe mchog tu rgyas pa'i gzi brjid nyi ma 'bum dang mtshungs shing / mthong thos dran pa tsam gyis byang chub kyi 'bras bu 'grub nus pa zhig tu byin thibs se bzhugs par bsgoms la/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: hūṃ: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyi:byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gu ru pad+ma sirnyi hūṃ: zhes tshar gsum/ de nas khyad par gyi gsol ba 'debs pa don gnyis bsam pa lhun gyis grub pa'i don du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: e ma ho: nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams su: snang ba ྾ sprul sku ྾ 'dzam bu ྾ 'gro don ྾o rgyan ྾ bsam pa ྾ rgyal po ྾ chos rgyal ྾ dus gsum ྾ bod kyi ྾ rgyal po ྾ o rgyan ྾bsam pa ྾ sku ni ྾ thugs rjes ྾ mar rig ྾ nyon mongs ྾ brtse gdung ྾ o rgyan ྾bsam pa ྾ dus ngan ྾ nang re ྾ nyi zer ྾ yar ngo ྾ 'gro don ྾ o rgyan ྾ bsam pa ྾lnga brgya tha ྾ sems can ྾ nyon mongs ྾ de 'dra'i ྾ dad ldan ྾ o rgyan ྾ bsam pa lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs: lan gsum/ de nas sku gsung thugs kyis dbang bskur ba ni/ sku gzugs thogs la 'di skad brjod: r+ghaṃ: 'di ni pad+ma 'byung gnas te: dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku: slob ma khyod la dbang bskur ro: bskyed rim ldan pas 'gro don gyis: shel phreng thogs la 'di skad do/ hūṃ: 'di ni gu ru'i snying po ste: dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i gsung : slob ma khyod la dbang bskur ro: sngags rim ldan pas 'gro don gyis: sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sikhyi rgyu: lan gsum/ me long thogs la 'di skad doḥ rgyu: 'di ni gu ru'i ye shes te: dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i thugs: slob ma khyod la dbang bskur ro: rdzogs rim ldan pas 'gro don gyis: de nas man ngag dang po gu ru drag po me phreng can gyi dbang gi don du mdun bskyed dang slob dpon 'di ltar gsal thob: mdun gyi nam mkhar pad+ma dmar po'i steng du zla nyi srin po pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan la ngo bo gu ru pad+ma la rnam pa che mchog pad+ma drag po zhal gsum g.yas 581

dkar g.yon ljang dbus dmar ba/ phyag drug gi g.yas na rdo rje tho ba me dpung / g.yon na thod khrag lcags stig phur pa bsnams pa/ zhabs bzhi 'dor stabs su bgrad pa/ dpal dang dur khrod kyi chas rdzogs shing yum rdo rje phag mo mthing nag gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud cing / sku la me dpung khro tshogs lcags steg 'phro ba/ 'khor sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs kyis bskor bar bsgoms la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hor sogs 'jigs pa'i ྾ chos 'khor gnyen ྾ yid gnyis ྾ o rgyan lha srin ྾hor sogs ྾ bsam pa ྾ lan gsum/ sku gzugs thogs 'di skad brjodaḥ hūm̐: 'di ni pad+ma 'byung gnas te: dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku: slob ma khyod la dbang bskur ro: bskyed rim ldan pas 'gro don gyis: shel phreng thogs la 'di skad do/ / rdu: 'di ni gu ru'i snying po ste: dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i gsung : slob ma khyod la dbang bskur ro: sngags rim ldan pas 'gro don gyis:sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: o āḥr+ghaṃ a rtsig ni rtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūṃ phaṭāphaṭā: āḥhūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭā phaṭā+oḥ lan gsum/ me long thogs la 'di skad do: hūṃ: 'di ni gu ru'i ye shes te: dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i thugs: slob ma khyod la dbang bskur ro: rdzogs rim ldan pas 'gro don gyisoḥ da man ngag gnyis pa gu ru na bla'i dbang gi don du mdun bskyed dang slob dpon 'di ltar gsal thob/mthun gyi nam mkhar pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du ngo bo gu ru pad+ma la rnam pa sangs rgyas sman gyi bla sku mdog sngon po/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na a ru ra rigs lnga bsnams pa/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi steng na baiḍūr+ya'i lhung bzed 'chi med bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams shing / zhabs rdor skyil gyis bzhugs pa/mtshan dpe yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku la chos gos rnam gsum bklubs pa/ 'khor bde gshegs brgyad dang / bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong rtsa/ sman gyi lha mo/ drang srong rig 'dzin dpag tu med pas bskor bar bsgoms la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sems can sgyu lus ྾ mi bzod ྾ yid gnyis ྾ o rgyan sman ྾ tshe zad ྾ o rgyan ྾ bsam pa ྾ lan gsum/ sku gzugs thogs la 'di skad doḥr+ghaṃ: 'di ni pad+ma 'byung gnas ྾ sogs nas/ 'gro don gyis: shel phreng thogs la 'di skad do:r+ghoṃḥ 'di ni gu ru'i snying po ྾ sogs nas/ 'gro don gyis: sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo bha ga wa te n+ta kha rdzu gu ru be+e ḍūr+ya pra bha rā dzā ya: ta thā ga tā: ar+ha te samya kle bud+dhā ya: ta bya thā: oṃ hai kha rdzu hai kha rdzu ma hā hai kha rdzu rā dza sa musga te swā hā: lan gsum brjod: me long thogs la 'di skad do: r+ghaṃ:'di ni gu ru'i ye shes ྾ sogs nas/ 'gro don gyis: de nas man ngag gsum pa gu ru dzam bha la'i dbang gi don du mdun bskyed dang slob dpon 'di ltar gsal thob/ mdun gyi nam mkha' pad zla la gter gyi bum pa zung dang nyi dkyil steng du ngo bo gu ru pad+ma la rnam pa rmugs 'dzin sku mdog dmar po 582

zhal gcig pa gzhon sha rgyas shing brjid pa/ phyag g.yas yid bzhin gyi nor bu thugs kar 'dzin cing /g.yon pas ne'u le dkur brten ba/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis bzhengs stabs su bzhugs pa'i pang du yum bde rgyas ma dmar mo g.yas nor bu/ g.yon thod khrag bsnams pas 'khyud cing / yab yum gnyis ka dar dang rin chen du mas brgyan pa/ 'khor nor la yab yum brgyad sogs ye shes las dang 'jig rten gyi nor lha bye ba 'bum gyis bskor bar sgoms la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: 'byung ba dgrar langs྾ sems can ྾ yid gnyis ྾ o rgyan mkha' ྾ dbul phongs ྾ o rgyan ྾ bsam pa ྾ lan gsum brjod/ sku gzugs thogs la 'di skad do: 'di ni pad+ma 'byung gnas ྾ :sogs nas/ 'gro don gyis: shel phreng thogs la 'di skad do: r+ghoṃḥ 'di ni gu ru'i snying po sogs nas 'gro don gyis: sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: o dzam+bha la dza lan+d+ra ya dha na me dhi trī: ḍā ki nī dza la sasba ram̐ swā hā: lan gsum brjod/ me long thogs la 'di skad do: r+ghaṃ: 'di ni gu ru'i ye shes sogs nas 'gro don gyis: de nas man ngag bzhi pa gu ru yi dam lha'i dbang gi don du mdun bskyed dang slob dpon 'di ltar gsal thog mdun gyi nam mkhar pad+ma 'dab ma 'bum ldan gyi lte bar zla nyi bdud bzhi'i gdan la ngo bo gu ru pad+ma la rnam pa dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu mthing nag zhal gsum g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing / phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu dang rtse lnga/ g.yon kha ṭ+wāṃ dang me dpung / mtha' gnyis phur pa 'dril ba/ zhabs bzhi'i mdun gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang / rgyab gnyis g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum gyis bzhugs pa gsang ba nas phur bu brgyan gyi tshul du 'phyang bas bgegs kyi snying gar zug pa/ dur khrod dpal gyi chas rnams rdzogs pa/ yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs dril bu thod khrag bsnams pas 'khril zhing / 'khor dpal chen he ru ka yab yum brgyad sogs yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor bar sgoms la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ las can 'gro ba'i don ྾dam tshig ྾ yid gnyis ྾ o rgyan yi dam ྾ pha nor ྾ o rgyan ྾ bsam pa ྾ lan gsum brjod/ sku gzugs thogs la 'di skad do: hūṃ: 'di ni pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs nas 'gro don gyis: shel phreng phogs la 'di skad do: r+ghaṃ: 'di ni gu ru'i snying po sogs nas 'gro don gyis: sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: oṃ badz+ra tī li tī la ya sarba birgyubaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa: oṃ āḥhūm̐ trī: badz+ra gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki nī sarba sirnyi pha la rdu ā+oḥ lan gsum brjod/ me long thogs la 'di skad do: hūṃ: 'di ni gu ru'i ye shes sogs nas 'gro don gyis: de nas man ngag lnga pa gu ru zil gnon drag po rtsal gyi dbang gi don du mdun bskyed dang slob dpon 'di ltar gsal thob/ mdun gyi nam mkhar pa da nyi'i steng du gu ru pad+ma zil gnon drag po rtsal sku mdog dkar dmar khro la 'dzum pa/ dbu la pad zhu khyung ldem can gsol 583

zhing / zab ber gsang gos dang chos gos gsol ba/ g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu rwa gdengs pa 'phyar zhing /g.yon snying phreng bsnams pa/ zhabs 'khor stabs su bzhugs pa'i dpral bar 'jam dpal/ mgrin par rta mgrin/ thugs kar gsang bdag lte bar ye shes mgon po/ gsang bar khyab 'jug rā hu la/'khor du zhing skyong seng ge'i gdong can sogs dge bsnyen brtan ma sde brgyad yul lha'i tshogs kyis bskor bar bsgoms la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sbas yul ྾ kha char ྾ yid gnyis ྾ o rgyan gzhi bdag ྾ chos mdzad ྾ o rgyan ྾ bsam pa ྾ lan gsum brjod/ sku gzugs thogs la 'di skad do: hūṃ: 'di ni pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs dang / 'gro don gyisoḥ shel phreng thogs la 'di skad do: rgyu: 'di ni gu ru'i snying po sogs nas/ 'gro don gyis: sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hūm̐ a ka ya ha a ma ra: a ya ma du ru tsa shan: trig nan: rburatho dzaḥdzoḥ dha lo sha bu wa ma: a dz+ra tri sirnyi pha la dzaḥdzaḥdza: lan gsum/ me long thogs la 'di skad do: r+ghaṃ: 'di ni gu ru'i ye shes sogs nas 'gro don gyis: de nas man ngag drug pa gu ru seng ge sgra sgrogs dbang gi don du mdun bskyed dang slob dpon 'di ltar gsal thob/ mdun gyi nam mkhar pad zla nyi ma'i steng du dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i gdan la ngo bo gu ru pad+ma rnam pa gsang
