bdag seng ge sgra sgrogs sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu 'phyar zhing / g.yon stigs mdzub thugs kar mdzad pas yum bdud 'dul drag mo seng gdong ma dmar nag gri thod 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ khro gtum 'jigs pa'i gzugs can/ dbu skra'i gseb nas seng zhal phyung ba/ dpal dang dur khrod kyi chas can/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ dpa' bo dpa' mo ging chen sde bzhi sogs 'khor bye ba grangs med kyis bskor zhing dril g.yer ḍā ma ru sogs rol mo'i sgra 'ur dir dang bcas gsal bar sgoms la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ stag gzigs dom dred྾ 'brog chen ྾ yid gnyis ྾ o rgyan dpa' bo ྾ gdug pa'i ྾ o rgyan ྾ bsam pa ྾ lan gsum mdzod/ sku gzugs thogs la 'di skad do: rtsu: 'di ni pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs nas/ 'gro don gyis: shel phreng thogs la 'di skad do: rgyu: 'di ni gu ru'i snying po sogs nas 'gro don gyis: sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra gu ru si ha gaṇ+ḍi dharmā dhā tu rgyu r+ghaṃ rgyu: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba dusnye ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa r+ghaṃ phaṭa: aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥ lan gsum/ me long thogs la 'di skad do: r+ghaṃ: 'di ni gu ru'i ye shes sogs nas 'gro don gyis: de nas man ngag bdun pa gu ru pad+ma badz+ra dbang gi don du mdun bskyed dang slob dpon 'di ltar gsal dzo ba/ mdun gyi nam mkhar theg pa rim dgu mtshon pa'i gdan gyi steng du/ ngo bo gu ru pad+ma la rnam pa sangs rgyas thod pa rtsal/ sku mdog dmar po zhal gsum g.yas dkar g.yon mthing 584

dbus dmar spyan dgu khro 'dzum dang ldan pa/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rdor dril/ bar pa gnyis ral gri bhad+dhoḥ tha ma gnyis tshe bum dang kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams pa/ zhabs bzhi 'dor stabs su bgrad pa/ dpal dang dur khrod kyi chas rnams rdzogs shing / gtsug tu rigs bdag 'od dpag med bzhugs pa/ yum gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo ḍā ru bhad+dha bsnams pa sku la 'khril zhing / 'khor de bzhin gshegs pa he ru ka'i chas can yab yum brgyad dang 'byung ba bzhi'i lha mo rnams kyis bskor bar sgoms la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sa chu me rlung ྾ sgyu lus ྾ yid gnyis ྾ o rgyan 'byung ba ྾ 'byung ba ྾ o rgyan ྾ bsam pa ྾ lan gsum brjod/ sku gzugs thogs la 'di skad do: r+ghaṃ: 'di ni pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs nas/ 'gro don gyis/ shel phreng thogs la 'di skad do: hūm̐: 'di ni gu ru'i snying po sogs nas/ 'gro don gyis: sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: oṃ āḥhūṃ gu ru shrī pad+ma badz+ra trī: dhū ma gha ye ḍā ki nī na ma swā hā: oṃ āḥhūṃ trī ma ha ri ni sa: ra tsa hri ya dzoḥr+ghaṃ: o āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki nī swā hā+oḥ dz+rī ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya a dz+ra tri dzaḥ sarba e ku sha dzoḥ tsit+ta trī hri sarba ba su sidhi ku ru swā hā:lan gsum/ me long thogs la 'di skad do: rgyu: 'di ni gu ru'i ye shes sogs nas 'gro don gyis: de nas man ngag brgyad pa gu ru rta mgrin nag po'i dbang gi don du mdun bskyed dang slob dpon 'di ltar gsal thob: mdun gyi nam mkha' mkhar rgya mtsho chen po sngo la dwangs pa'i dkyil du me dpung 'bar ba/de steng keng rus stag dang ru dra pho mo brtsegs pa'i gdan dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ngo bo gu ru pad+ma la rnam pa dpal chen rta mgrin sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis seng ldeng gi rnga pus mo g.yon pa'i steng du brdungs pa/ zhabs gnyis mi'u thung gel pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ keng rus kyi snyan cha dang / ral pa'i gseb nas rta mgo ljang zhur mtsher ba/ spyi bor pad+ma thod phreng dmar nag ḍā dril 'dzin pas/ yum rdo rje phag mor 'khyud pa'i/ 'khor mkha' 'gro sde bzhis bskor ba/ /yum khros ma sngon mo gri thod can gyis 'khyud pa/ dpal dang dur khrod kyi chas rnams rdzogs shing / phyogs bzhir phyag rgya rnam bzhi 'dzin pa'i mkha' 'gro bzhi sogs khro bo khro mo'i tshogs kyis bskor bar sgoms la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzad/ lam srang 'jigs pa'i ྾ bsad khyer ྾ yid gnyis ྾ o rgyan phyag ྾ tso ra ྾ o rgyan ྾ bsam pa ྾ lan gsum brjod/ sku gzugs thogs la 'di skad do: rgyu: 'di ni pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs nas 'gro don gyis: shel phreng thogs la 'di skad do: r+ghaṃ: 'di ni gu ru'i snying po sogs nas 'gro don gyis: sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: o āḥr+ghaṃ gu ru gro dha ha ya shrī wa kro dha ha ri ni sa ma ya dza: kā le shwa ra sikhyi pha la r+ghaṃ: lan gsum brjod/ me long thogs la 'di skad do: hūṃ: 'di ni gu ru'i ye shes sogs nas 'gro don gyisoḥ de nas man ngag dgu pa gu ru rdo rje gro lod rtsal gyi smin dbang 585

don du mdun bskyed dang slob dpon 'di ltar gsal thob/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rdo rje'i gur khang ye shes kyi me klong du pad nyi'i gdan la ngo bo gu ru pad+ma la rnam pa khro rgyal lo kot+ta ra sku mdog dmar smug khro bo 'chol ba'i sku can zhal gdangs mche gcigs ljags 'dril hūṃ sgra sgrogs pa/ spyan gsum nam mkha' gzigs pa/ thod skam dbu rgyan dang / thod rlon do shal/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pas gar stabs ling ling mdzad pa/ sku la za 'og mthing ka'i ber phod dang / chos gos dmar po/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang / dung gi snyan rgyan/ phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje/ g.yon gnam lcags phur bu'i bsgril ba/rngam brjid khros pa ye shes me yi tshwa tshwa 'khyug cing 'khor du bdud 'dul khro bo'i bcu yab yum dang khro chung mang pos bskor bar sgoms la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gang zhig gshed ྾ mtshon cha ྾ yid gnyis ྾ o rgyan rdo rje'i ྾ gshed ma ྾ o rgyan ྾ bsam pa ྾ lan gsum brjod/ sku gzugs thogs la 'di skad do: r+ghaṃ: 'di ni pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs nas/ 'gro don gyisoḥ shel phreng thogs la 'di skad do: r+ghaṃ: 'di ni gu ru'i snying po sogs nas 'gro don gyis: sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ ma gu ru bi ru kro dha lo ko t+ta ra sarba sikhyi r+ghaṃ hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra gu ru khro bo lo ta lo ka sarba sidhi r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ hūṃ: lan gsum brjod/ me long thogs la 'di skad do: rgyu: 'di ni gu ru'i ye shes sogs nas/ 'gro don gyis: de nas man ngag bcu pa gu ru pad+ma rgyal po'i dbang gi don du bdun bskyed dang slob dpon 'di ltar gsal thob/ mdun gyi nam mkhar ye shes 'od lnga'i klong du pad+ma 'dab ma 'bum ldan gyi steng du ngo bo gu ru pad+ma la rnam pa pad+ma rgyal po gangs chen mtsho ste/ de'ang sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis thal sbyar ut+pal dmar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor 'od dpag med dang / thugs kar rdo rje sems dpas mtshan pa/ yum gsang ba ye shes dmar mo gri thod can gyis 'khyud pa/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa 'khor nye ba'i sras brgyad dang / gzhan yang sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pas bskor bar sgoms la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ /nam zhig tshe ྾ gnad gcod ྾ yid gnyis ྾ o rgyan snang ba ྾ bde ba can ྾ o rgyan ྾ bsam pa ྾ lan gsum brjod/ sku gzugs thogs la 'di skad do: rtsu: 'di ni pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs nas 'gro don gyis: shel phreng thogs pa 'di skad do: r+ghaṃ: 'di ni gu ru'i snying po sogs nas 'gro don gyis: sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ trī: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me r+ghaṃ: lan gsum brjod/ me long thogs la 'di skad do: rtsu: 'di ni gu ru'i ye shes sogs nas/ 'gro don gyis/ de nas man ngag bcu gcig pa gu ru snang mtha'i dbang gi don du mdun bskyed dang slob dpon 'di ltar gsal thob/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bde ba can gyi zhing bkod pa yongs su rdzogs par gsal ba'i dbus 586

su pad zla'i gdan la ngo bo gu ru pad+ma la rnam pa sangs rgyas 'od dpag med sku mdog dkar po mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgyas lhung bzed 'dzin pa zhabs skyil krung / chos gos rnam gsum sogs sprul pa'i sku'i cha lugs can/ 'khor mi 'khrugs pa sogs sangs rgyas rabs brgyad dang / gzhan yang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyis bskor bar sgoms la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sgyu lus g.yar po ྾'khrul snang ྾ yid gnyis the ྾ o rgyan dus gsum྾ 'khrul snang ྾ o rgyan ྾ bsam pa ྾ lan gsum/ sku gzugs thogs la 'di skad do: r+ghaṃḥ'adi ni pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs nas 'gro don gyisoḥ shel phreng thogs la 'di skad do: r+ghaṃ: 'di ni gu ru'i snying po sogs nas/ 'gro don gyis: sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ a mi ta bhā trī: na ma sarba ta thā ga ta skṛ da ya/ a nug te/ oṃ kun sum̐ gi ni swā hā: na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ kai ka ka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa ni tro ṭa ni/ tā sa ni tā sa ni/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/ sarba karma pa ram̐ pa ra ṇi me sarba sa twa nāñtsa swā hā+oḥ lan gsum brjod/ me long thogs la 'di skad do: r+ghaṃ: 'di ni gu ru'i ye shes sogs nas/ 'gro don gyis: de nas man ngag bcu gnyis pa gu ru kun tu bzang po'i smin dbang gi don du mdun bskyed dang slob dpon 'di ltar gsal thob/ mdun gyi nam mkhar ye shes lnga yi rang 'od 'ja' zer gyi klong du pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la ngo bo gu ru pad+ma la rnam pa chos sku kun tu bzang po sku mdog mthing gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag mdzad pa/zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung can/ gzung 'dzin gyi sgrib g.yogs bral phyir sku gcer bu rgyan cha spangs pa/yum mchog dbyings kun tu bzang mo ljang gu rdor dril 'dzin pas 'khyud cing / 'khor rgyal ba rigs lnga zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor bar sgoms la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/gzhan yang las dang ྾ 'khrul snang ྾ yid gnyis ྾ o rgyan bde chen ྾ sdug bsngal snang brtsed nas ྾ o rgyan ྾ bsam pa ྾ lan gsum brjod/ sku gzugs thogs la 'di skad do: r+ghaṃ:'di ni pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs nas/ 'gro don gyis: shel phreng thogs la 'di skad do: r+ghaṃ: 'di ni gu ru'i snying po sogs nas 'gro don gyis: sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ 'a a sha sa ma ha: lan gsum brjod/ me long thogs la 'di skad do: r+ghaṃ: 'di ni gu ru'i ye shes sogs nas 'gro don gyis: de nas man ngag bcu gsum pa gu ru yid bzhin nor bu'i dbang gi don du mdun bskyed dang slob dpon 'di ltar gsal thob/ mdun gyi nam mkhar pad+ma 'dab stong rgyas pa'i ge sar nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng du ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam pa gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi yid bzhin nor bu bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po bsnams pa/ yum mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal sku mdog dkar la sngo ba'i mdangs can gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ zag med kyi bde ba mchog tu rgyas 587

shing / ye shes lnga'i 'od klong du bzhugs pa'i 'khor du rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin sogs rig 'dzin bzhi/ shes rab rgyud kyi slob dpon sogs slob dpon bzhi ste brgyad ka'ang yum dang 'khril zhing /gzhan yang grub thob pho mo brgyad cu rtsa bzhi/ rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga/ gter chen brgya dang rtsa brgyad/gter phran stong dang rtsa gnyis sogs gsang sngags gsar rnying gi rig 'dzin bye ba 'bum gyis bskor bar sgoms la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ 'gro drug sdug bsngal ྾ khyad par ྾ dad gus ྾ yid gnyis ྾ o rgyan thugs rjes ྾ o rgyan ྾ bsam pa ྾ lan gsum brjod/ sku gzugs thogs la 'di skad do: r+ghaṃ: 'di ni pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs nas 'gro don gyis: shel phreng thogs la 'di skad do:r+ghoṃḥ 'di ni gu ru'i snying po sogs nas 'gro don gyis: sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ o āḥrgyu gu ru dhā ki nī dzñā na sarba sirnyi pha la rgyu: lan gsum brjod/ me long thogs la 'di skad do: hūm̐: 'di ni gu ru'i ye shes sogs nas/ 'gro don gyis: zhes bcu gsum rdzogs nas/ de nas khyad par du'ang mchog dang gong ma gsum zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ de nas gsang ba'i dbang bskur ni: bdud rtsi thogs la 'di skad do:hūṃ: kun rdzob byang sems dkyil 'khor 'dir: longs sku'i bla ma sprin ltar gtibs: yig 'bru sna tshogs char ltar 'bebs: 'od zer dmar pos phyogs mtha' khyab: hūṃ: nga ni bla ma kun tu bzang :bde stong kun tu bzang po 'khril: thabs shes zung 'jug nyams rtsal 'bar: bde chen sgra yis phyogs bcur g.yo: rgyal ba rab 'byams kun 'dus nas: yab yum sbyor ba'i spyi bor zhugs: a ba dhū ti'i lam brgyud de+oḥ yab yum mkha' nas bdud rtsi 'babasoḥ slob ma khyod kyi spyi bor thim: 'khor lo bzhi rim mer gyis khengs: dga' bzhi ye shes dbang thob shog: bdun rtsi blud/ de nas shes rab dbang bskur ni: gzungs ma thogs nas 'di skad do: r+ghaṃ: ye shes bha ga'i dkyil 'khor 'diroḥ chos sku'i bla ma mkha' ltar dag: gnyis med 'od gsal 'khor yug bskor: 'od zer mthing gas phyogs mtha' khyab: hūṃ:'di ni shes rab gzung ma ste: rten 'brel bcu gnyis ye nas dag: khyod kyis bsten byar sangs rgyas gsungs: thabs lam sna tshogs zhen chags bral: 'khor lo'i rim pa'i sbyor ba yis: bde ba chen por spyod par gyis: 'bras bu bla na med pa yi: sangs rgyas myur du thob par shog: de nas tshig gi dbang bskur ba ni/ rgyas pa ye shes snying por shes: bsdu na 'di bzhin bya ba yin: mnyam gzhag byas la 'di skad do:r+ghaṃ: don dam 'od gsal dkyil 'khor 'di: ci yang med pa'i ngo bo nyid: gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med: gzung du med cing brjod du med: a a a: a ni skye ba med pas a: ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i lus: don dam 'od gsal gzhom gzhig bral: smra bsam brjod 'das e ma ho: bu khyod rang sems rang zhal ltos:gzugs med mthong ba'i yul dang bral: sgra med thos pa'i yul dang bral: dri med tshor 588

bu'i yul dang bral: ro med myong ba'i yul dang braloḥ lus med reg pa'i yul dang bral: sems med bsam pa'i yul dang bral: 'di nyid ltos shig gzhi rtsa chod: bu khyod sems kyi ngo bo ltos: bltas kyang mi mthong stong pa yinoḥ rig pa phyogs mtha' khyab par mthong : 'gro ba ma yin khyab brdal yin:sems kyi kha dog ngo bo brtag: cir yang ma grub rang bzhin gsal: gsal stong zung 'jug ngang du bzhag: bdag 'dzin med pa'i bya ra gyis: bu khyod sems kyi ngo bo ltos: rig pa brjen pa dri med la: 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ga la gos: shes pa 'jog len ma byed par: yengs med ma bcos ngang la bzhag: rang sems dngos med stong pa 'di: skye ba med pa'i chos sku yin: rang bzhin gsal la dag pa 'di: 'gag pa med pa'i longs sku yin: ma 'gag cing yang shar ba 'di: g.yo ba med pa'i sprul sku yin: sku gsum rang chas rig pa'i gdangasoḥ 'di don lta zhing 'di nyid bsgom: bu khyod sems kyi ngo bo bltos: bltas bas mi mthong ngang la bzhag: zhe sdang ngo bo blta bar bya: ngo bo stong pas zhe sdang bral: de ni me long ye shes yin: gti mug ngo bo blta bar bya: ngo bo stong pas gti mug bral: de ni mnyam nyid ye shes yin: 'dod chags ngo bo blta bar bya: ngo bo stong pas 'dod chags bral: de ni sor rtog ye shes yin: phrag dog ngo bo blta bar bya: ngo bo stong pas phrag dog bral: de ni bya grub ye shes yin: nga rgyal ngo bo blta bar bya: ngo bo stong pas nga rgyal bral: de ni chos dbyings ye shes yin:dug lnga rnam dag ye shes lnga: rang rig stong pa'i rang rtsal yin: 'di don brtags shing 'di nyid bsgom: tshe gcig sangs rgyab 'grub na: rang rig rtsal dbang thob par 'gyur: 'jigs skrag yang de la med: sdug bsngal zhi ba smos ci dgos: zhes pas tshig dbang bskur ba'o: de ltar dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par bskur bas sku bum pa'i dbang gis lus kyi sgrib pa dgawaṃng / lam ma hā yo ga bsgom par dbang / 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku 'grub/ gnyis pa gsung gsang ba'i dbang gis ngag gi sgrib pa dgalam a nu yo ga bsgom par dbang / 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub/ gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gis yid kyi sgrib pa dag /lam a ti yo ga bsgom par dbang / 'bras bu chos kyi sku 'grub/bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po ches sgo gsum cha mnyam kyis sgrib pa dag /lam rdzogs chen ka dag lhun grub kyi ye shes bsgom par dbang / 'bras bu sku gsum dbyer med dam ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal ba dang ldan par byas so/ /de ltar bla ma'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs stan thog cig tu thob pa yin pas de yang gsang sngags kyi rtsa ba dbang / dbang gi rtsa ba dam tshig ste/ de yang rgyas par phye na sa ma ya 'bum sder gsungs pa'i bsdus don rdo rje theg pa las rigs lnga spyi'i dam tshig dang /rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi gal mdor gyur pa sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig ste/ bla ma sangs rgyas su lta ba'i 589

mos gus ni kun gyi snying por gyur par/ gzhung rtsa ba rdo rje tshig rkang las/ ji phyir yi dam bsgrub kyang byin rlabs sgo: bla ma las gzhan ma yin chos thams cad: bla ma'i mos gus ltem kyang med la 'du:khyad par rdo rje theg pa'i srog snying ste: 'di yod srog yod 'di med srog med 'gyur: des na dka' sla skyid sdug ci byung yang : bla ma'i mos gus dam tshig 'bral mi rung / rang la bab bka' drin che ba'i bla ma de: sangs rgyas kun 'dus pad 'byung ngo bor bsam: zhes gsungs phyir bsrung sdom mtha' dag gi rtsa ba bla ma'i dam tshig srog ltar gces pas gzhir byas/ bsam sbyor 'gro ba'i don du gang 'gyur bya zhing sngags kyi lam du zhugs na rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang tshe gcig lus gcig la thob pa gsang sngags zab mo'i khyad chos yin pas/ rdo rje'i slob ma khyed rnams kyis deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob kyi bar du gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas lha dang bla ma dbyer med du bzung zhing gsol 'debs dang snying po sngags bzla/ khyad par tshes bcu'i dus mchod sogs nges pa dang len spro ba'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ /gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ de ltar o rgyan chen po'i thugs tig lam zab bla ma'i byin rlabs dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag gi don du maṇ+ḍal/ zhes brjod/ de nas slob ma rnams tshogs la rol/ gsang chen man ngag rgya mtsho'i snying po bla ma rig 'dzin gyi bsnyen sgrub dang smin grol 'chad spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod cig bsod nams 'di yis ྾ sogs brjod/ slob ma rang gnas su btang / de nas las gzhung gi lhag ma dang chad brtan gtor ma 'bul/ gtor bro bkra shis la sogs mthar chags bya'o/ /lha tshogs rnams la a kā ro brjod bzhin bsdu/ gsang sngags gsang ba'i phyir las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ /de ltar gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun grub ma'i smin dbang bskur pa'i thabs ni/ rig pa 'dzin dbang chen po de nyid kyi dgongs gter zab mo'i man ngag rtsa ba dang zhal lung gis gzhir byas/ bka' bas chos bdag skyes bu'i khrid yig dang bstun bklags chog mar bkod pa 'di'ang gter chen sangs rgyas gling pa'i gter lung nas chos kyi spyan can drug gi rjes su pad+ma'i ljags ldan drug tu lung bstan pa'i thog ma/ si tu pad+ma dbang tshan zhes grags pas dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling du sbyar ba'i dge bas 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /thugs kyi rdo rje'i dgongs gter sgrol ma dmar mo'i skor bzhugs so/ /gsang sgrub sgrol ma'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so/ /kun tu bzang po'i nam mkha' la/ /'od snang mtha' yas nyin mor byed/ /snying rje'i pad+ma rgyas pa'i phyag /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub stsol/ /srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol ba'i yum/ /'dab brgya'i dbus 'khrungs o rgyan rje/ /tshangs pa lha yi me tog la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub stsol/ /drin chen bla ma baiḍūr ya/ /dad pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser mchod na/ /tshe gcig byang chub 'dod pa 'jo/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub stsol/ /de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i 590

mthus/ /rang don 'phags ma'i go 'phang thob/ /'gro kun 'jigs brgyad 'khor lo las/ /sgrol nas rnam mkhyen la 'god shog /ces pa dad ldan bla ma tshe ring ngor rdo rje drag pos bris pa dge/ /'phags ma sgrol ma'i gsang skub gu ru'i thugs bcud bzhugs so/ /'phags ma sgrol ma'i gsang sgrub ni: skyabs sems yid la 'dres nges bya: rnam par rtog pa'i chos thams cad: gdod nas mtshan bral stong pa'i ngang : pad+ma zla nyi gdan gyi khar: ṭ+wāṃ yig dmar po yongs gyur las: rang nyid bcom ldan sgrol ma'i sku: pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar zhing : mtshan dang dpe byang gsal zhing rdzogasoḥphyag g.yas lcags kyu g.yon pa yis: mtheb srin ut+pal dmar po 'dzin: dbu skra gnag sdum zur phud rtser: nor bu dzam bu chu bo'i gser: rin chen phra tshom mdzes pa yi: dbu snyan phyag zhabs sked skabs spras: ut+pal dmar po'i do shal spud: dar dmar stod g.yogs sna tshogs gsol: smad dkris zhabs gnyis g.yas cung zad: brkyang zhing g.yon bskums bgying bcas bzhugs: 'od dpag rigs kyi cod pan can: gnas gsum 'bru gsum sa bon tsā: 'od 'phros ye shes spyan drangs gyur: po ṭa la yi gnas mchog nas: t+t+waṃ yig dmar po las 'khrungs shing : t+t+waṃ yig 'od kyis 'gro ba sgrol: sgrol ma 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dza: dzaḥhūṃ bo ho: phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad kun: dbang gi lha yi rnam par byon: dbang bskur byin brlabs dbang rtags su:'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan gyur: zhing khams rab 'byams gang ba yi: me tog bdug spos mar me dri+oḥ zhal zas rol mo 'dod yon drug: mchod pa'i bye brag mtha' yas pa: rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma mchod: gtso gyur rgyal ba sras bcas la: bdag gis gus pas rab 'bul na: thugs rje'i mthu yid bzhes su gsol: oṃ ār+ya tā re sarba ta thā ga ta bo dhe sa twe bh+yaḥ.ar+ghaṃ nas shalda pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā:rgyas par phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gam yang na/ tshangs dang dbang po biju dang : drag po bdud dang 'jig rten gsum: ma lus dbang du mdzad pa yi: 'phags ma sgrol mar phyag 'tshal bstod: thugs kar ut+pal dmar po'i dbus nyi ma la t+t+waṃ dmar po: mthar yig bcu zhal nang bstan bkod: oṃ tā re tut+na re tu re swā hā: zhes 'bum phrag bcu'am lnga bzla: dbang du byed pa'i sngags yin bcu'i mthar:sarba tre+e lo ka de wa nā ga na ra ā yur purtse shrī gu na wā shaṃ ku ru dza r+ghaṃ: zhes pa spyi khyab dang : bye brag ming dang : ma ma wā shaṃ ku ru dzaḥr+ghaṃ mtha'i tī dang sngags phreng las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu'i dbyibs su shin tu rno ba grangs med pa 'phros phyi snod: nang bcud: rgyal ba sras bcas kyi thugs kar phog: rgyal ba'i thugs rje brtan g.yo'i dwangs bcud thams cad rdo khab len la lcags phye 'byar ba ltar bur 'ub kyis 'od kyi lcags kyu'i rtser blangs rang gi thugs ka'i sngags phreng la thim pas rang dbang du byas par 591

bsam: yang dmigs bsal 'od zer gong ltar la: pho yi snying ga dang : mo yi skye gnas 'od kyi lcags kyus btab pas yid bsgyur rang la rjes su chags: de yi dwangs bcud pho mo so so thig le dkar dmar gyi rnam pa thugs ka'i 'dog la thim pas dbang du gyur par bsam: sngags yungs kar la sngags nas gtor ba dang : zas kha dog dmar po'i rigs la sngags nas byin na dbang du 'gyur: mi mthun pa sems nye bar byed na: rang nyid sgrol ma'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng las 'od zer dmar po 'phros: pha rol po'i snying khar dwangs ma dkar po 'od kyi rang bzhin nang dz+ra yig gnas pa la phog: nga rgyal drag po'i gdug rtsub zhi: byams pa'i sems dang ldan: dwangs ma de rje btsun sgrol ma rang gis bsgoms pa ji lta ba tshon gang pa dang sen gang par gyur: 'od zer dang 'grogs te rang gi snying gar thim par bsamoḥ che ge mo ā kār+ṣa ya dza wā shaṃ ku ru swā hā: zhes bzla: gzhan gnyis 'dum par byed na sngags dmigs bsgyur ba'o: dbang du byed pa'i 'khor lo gos chen dmar po'am shog dmar la: mtshal dang li khri gzhon nu ma'i ti la ka sbyar ba'i snag tshas mu khyud brgyad bskor: dbus su tā de rgyab ut+pal dmar po 'dab brgyadoḥ mdun nas zhal nang bstan du yi ge bcu: de'i phyir dbang du byed pa'i sngags spyi dang bye brag: de'i phyir dbyangs yig: de'i phyir gsal byed: de'i phyir rten 'brel sngags: de rgyab lcags kyu dang ut+pal: de rgyab me ri bri: cu gang : brag zhunoḥ gla rtsi: dri bzang : tsaṇ+ḍan dmar po:byi ru: shel la a bris pa: g.yu la dz+ra: pha waṃ long bur tri: gser la rdza dang bo+oḥ mtsho klu gnas pa'i rde'u la nā bris pa nang du bzhag: 'bru lnga: sman sna bcas ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi zung re bzhag:'khor lo de sgrol mar bsgom: rab gnas bya: 'dod don gsol ba btab: mchod pa byas na re ba myur du 'god: yan na lus la bcad na'ang kun gyis 'dud cing khyad par dmigs bya nges par dbang du 'du: sgrol ma'i phyag mtshan ut+pal las mtshan pa'i lcags kyu zangs la bzos: rtse shin tu rno ngar bya'o: dar dmar la yig bcu dang sngags gong gi spyi dang bye brag dbang du byed pa de gser gyis bris la 'dog: sgrol mar bsam: rab tu gnas: las la sbyar dus dmigs bya la 'debs tshul cung zad byoḥ yang rū pa skye mched dod pa dbang du bya ba de 'dra ba byas: snying khar dz+ra: yan lag bzhi la dza:bzhi bri: gsang gnas la ying tseg tseg 'gul 'gul zhes bri: dmigs pa gong ltar la: lcags kyus dz+ra mig dang gsang bar 'debs: gzhung ltar dmigs pa drag tu bya'o: phyag mtshan 'di rang gis bcad dgos: rū pa de dbang gi sbyin sreg bya'o: yang mtshal dang li khri rgya skyegs la yig brgyad sham ru: sarba wa shaṃ ku ru swā hā: zhes bzlas stong phrag gi grangs su sngags: rang gi snying gar thig le'am dga' ba 'khyil pa bris na gang mthong dga' zhing byams par 'gyur: shwa rgyan rgyal ba la yig brgyad 592

mthar: sarba arba sidhi re 'dod mu na ye swā hā: zhes nyer gcig gis rgyal bar 'gyur: char pa dbab na rang nyid sgrol mar bsgom: gzhung ltar bskyed bstem mchod stod byas la: yig bcu bzla:spra tshil lam bag zan la klu'i gzugs stod lta bu smad sbrul mjug rin po ches brgyan pa: dar gyi na bza' gsol ba sor bzhi pa bya: snying khar dar sngon po'am dug shog ma yin pa'i shog bur: phu dza ya bi dza ya wa ru ṇa: ā nan+ta: tak+ṣa ka: ku li ka: bā su ki: shang kha pā la: pad+ma: ma hā pad+ma: sarba nā ga nā gi dza: zhes bcug pa ste: de yang shog dril smyug spug tu bcug: klu sman ril bu yang brdzang : kha spra tshil gyis bcad la bzhag pa'o: mtsho chu mig kha shar du blta ba byu khyis mi gnod sar sbas: sgrol ma'i snying por gong gi klu bcu 'khor bcas kyi sngags dang : 'bebs sngags: ma hā me gha swā hā: nā gā nā gi char phob: nā ga rāwo sa ma ya bha ri sha ya phob ya: zhes drag tu bzla: rang nyid sgrol ma'i thugs srog sa bon las 'od 'phros: klu rgyal 'khor bcas spyan drangs 'phags ma'i phyag gi mchod sbyin las klu sman gyi mchod sbyin bab: glu yis khrus byas longs spyod pas: na ba gsos: 'chi ba bslong : sdug bsngal zhi: sdig sgrib dag: bde ba dang ldan par byas: de dag gi gdengs ka kha snan nas rlangs pa sprin du gyur pas: char pa drag tu 'bebs par bsam: gtsang sbra dang ldan pas gzugs klu chen bcu 'khor bcas bsam: klu gtor btang shin tu zab: sad bsrung noḥ zangs snod du sa sna rde'u bcas chu snas bkang : lcags kyi martsil lta bur bkod: gsham nas mar me sngar: nang du gong gi klu gzugs ba chu: sngags rgyun mi chad pa'am: thun drug nyin nub med par 'badoḥ char chog ci lta ba'o: chu sna rlangs ma yal ba gal che: sri'u gson: 'khor lo mu khyud gsum: lte bar rta: steng nas sngags yig bcu dang : byis pa: chung sri byis pa'i gdon bco lnga'i gnod pa las srung shig: rak+ṣe ku ru hūṃ: de rgyab 'khor lo rtsibs bzhir: sarba ha ri raklo pi sha tsa tu tri kā ya wā ka ma na bhad+dha r+ghaṃ phaṭa: ces re re dang : rtsibs mchan la: chung sring dang gdon bco lnga'i gnod pa bh+yo zlog: yig mgo nang la bstan nas bri: de rgyab me ri: yungs kar gu gul li khri bzhag: srung 'khor sgrol mar bsgom: rab tu gnas: ci bder lte ba ma nyams par lteb: mgul tu btags na chung sri thub par the tshom med:gzhan yang thal chen nyung kar sngags 'dis btab la: yig bcu dang ཿོ sarba ha ri raklo bisna na ha na shārnyi ku ru rgyu: zhes brgya stong bzlas khong du btang : gu gul bdug: yungs kar gyis brab pas byis pa'i gdon zhi bar 'gyur ro: ser ba gdong bzlog la: yig bcu dang : sarba trī mā ra ya rbad nan bh+yo: zhes pas yungs kar la sngags nas: gtor na ser bzlog: phyugs nad gang la yang yig bcu'i mthar: sarba trī shu la nā ga rbad: du du rbad: shi du rbad: 'gro ba'i nad la rbad: ces bris pa gi waṃ 593

li khri byug: yig bcus rab gnas byas na thub: rbod gtong bzlog na: sāts+tsha'am mchod rten nag po'i nang: sarba duṭaṃ be ga bh+yo: sarba sha thu rū pa da ha pa tsa man+t+ra r+ghaṃ phaṭa: ces shog dril byas nas bcug:yungs kar 'bru dgur yig bcu stong bzla: rab gnas byas: byad ma gnas pa'i phyogs su sbas na thub bo: dbang thang rgyas par: zangs ma'i bum par byin brlabs gnas chen dang : bkra shis pa'i sa sna: 'bru sman gyis bkang ba'i dkyil du: tsan+dan dmar po'i byang bu'i rtser nyi zla dang nor bu dbang rgyal gyi lte bar yig brgyad mthar: ma ma purtse ā yu ra tiṣ+ṭha sarba puṣ+ṭi ku ru swā: zhes gser gyis bris sham bu dkris: sgrol mar bsam: rab tu gnas: zhabs su pad ma 'dab brgyad dang : kha chod la gser gyi 'khor lo dang : dar dmar gyis gtum: bum pa la phyogs bzhir rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan bris khyim gyi spug tu mchod na don thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro: tshe spel na yig brgya mthar: ma ma ā yu pukhye dzñā na sarba sikhyi puṣ+ṭi ku ru swā hā: zhes bzla: nor bsgrub na bum pa gong dang 'dra: nang du phyugs po stobs 'byor can gyi rdzas rin chen lnga: 'bru lnga: sman lnga sogs kyis bkang : dbus su tsan+dan byang bur: rin chen dbang rgyal lte bar yig bcu dang : dha na me dhi sarba ba su sidhi puṣ+ṭi ku ru rgyu: rnam sras dang : dzi la'i snying po bri: bkra shis rtags rdzas rgyal srid bdun gsham du bris la gzhan gong dang 'dra: mdzod du sbas sgrol mar bsam: rab gnas byas pas longs spyod rnam thos sras kyi bu ltar rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung : rdzogs rim ni/ rang nyid 'phags ma mi dmigs par bsam: ka dag ngang du mnyam par bzhag: slar chu la nya 'phar ba'i tshul lta bus 'phags ma'i skur ldang : dge ba sngo:bkra shis brjod: 'phags ma sgrol ma'i gsang sgrub zab pa'i snying po gu ru'i thugs bcud 'di: dbus nas smon lam 'bral ba yi: mi chen zhig gi bskul ma 'byung : shes pa'i lung don ltar 'dod dpal mkhan rin po che'i sku zhabs su bka' gnang bzhed pa bsgrub slad dus mtha'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa dbang gi rgyal po nus ldan drag po rtsal gyis lha ldan 'phrul snang gi shākya'i rgyal po'i pho brang dang nye bar g.yu thog khang sar du dgongs pa'i gter las yi ger phab pa dge bas 'gro kun rgyal yum sgrol ma'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig /sgrol ma gsang skub kyi dbang sku bzhi'i byin rlabs byur 'bebs bzhugs so/ /sgrol ma'i dbang la maṇ+ḍal dmar po pad+ma 'dab brgyad dbus su mardzir bum pa rgyun 'babs chu yis sum gnyis bkang bum rdzas sbyaroḥ ku sha dang rma bya'i mdongs kyis kha brgyan: rdo rje gzungs thag bcas:thod pa'i bdud rtsir ka ra sprang rtsi btab: me long sirtse ra yis byi dor byas: chos 'byung sgrol ma'i sngags sa bon bcas pas kha bkab: sku dang sngags phreng shes rdo gtor ma dar dmar gyi gdugs phub 594

pa bsham: gzhan yang mchod rdzas nyer spyod sman phud tshogs la sogs mkho ba'i yo byad 'du bya: khrus dang maṇ+ḍal: dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'dzin: srid pa'i 'jigs las sgrol ba po: khyod kyi zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis: dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: lan gsum: gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags dang : bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye: rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa: mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po: rdo rje rnal 'byor las 'byung ba: ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che: mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod: 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du: bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs: zhes khyad par gyis gsol ba gdab: dam tshig bskyed spyan drangs ye shes pa bstim: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: gyis brtan par bya'o: bum pas dbang bskuroḥ bum pa dag pa chos dbyings gzhal yas su+oḥ bum rdzas longs sku 'phags ma sgrol ma yi: sprul sku bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur bas: snang stong sku yi byin rlabs dbang thob shog: yi bcu'i mthar: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye r+ghaṃ: bum chu blud:thod pa'i bdud rtsi mgrin par bzhag: 'phags pa mchog dang dam tshig sgrol ma yum: sbyor ba'i mkha' gsang byang chub sems rgyun gyis: gsang ba'i dbang mchog dam pa 'di bskur bas: grags stong gsang ba'i gsung gi dbang thob shog: yig bcu'i mthar: gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: a ho ma hā su kha ho:dam chu blud: sid+dha ras thig le gnas gsum du dga' ba 'khyil pa bris la: bde ba snying rje chen po thabs kyi gsang : rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid yum gyi mkha': mnyam sbyor byang sems lugs 'byung lugs ldog gi: dga' bzhi'i shes rab ye shes dbang thob shog: yig bcu'i mthar: e waṃ dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa r+ghaṃ: sgrol ma'i sku spyi bor bzhag: rgyal kun yum gyur 'phags ma 'khor los sgyur: phrin las rang gzugs dam tshig sgrol ma yi: lha sku phyag rgyas khyod la dbang bskur bas: sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dbang thob shog: yig bcu'i mthar: kā ya wā tsit+ta sarba sikhyi a giṣiñtsa rgyu: bzlas lung 'bog: sngags dang phreng bas dbang bskur: bskyed rim snang stong sgyu ma'i skur gsal ba'i: grags stong rig sngags chu bo'i rgyun ltar zlosoḥ sgra ru grags kun 'phags ma'i gsung rdo rje: mngon gyur byin rlabs nus pa'i dbang thob shog: yig bcu shel rma bya'i mdongs bstan la: a: rang rig mtshan bral ka dag stong pa nyid: lhun gyis grub pa'i ye shes 'ja' tshon bzhin: snang stong dbyer med bde chen 'dus ma byas: rig pa rtsal gyis dbang mchog thob par shog: yig bcu'i mthar: dharma dhā tu a gi ṣiñtsa a: gtor ma'i bka' bsgo bya: dam tshig khas blang maṇ+ḍal phul: de ltar dbang 'di lcags grong mkhan rin chen skal bzang phrin las yar 'phel smon lam 'bral pas chos 'dir dbang bas thog mar dbang phul skabs su/ rdo rje drag po'i kun gzhi'i mtsho las byung ba/ de bas khams gsum dpal kun 595

rang dbang spyod cing bstan 'gro'i phan byed rgyas par gyur cig sa ma ya rgya:sgrol ma gsang sgrub kyi las byang dngos grub 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so: rgyal dbang mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang chen po/ /'phags ma sgrol ma mchog la gus btud nas/ /gang gi gsang sgrub las byang dpag bsam shing / /dngos grub 'dod 'jo 'di na bshad par bya/ /sgrol ma gsang sgrub kyi nyams su len pa don du gnyer ba'i gang zag gis gnas yid dang mthun par/ bris 'bur gyi rten bkram la/ de'i mdun du stags la maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad la kha dog dmar po dbus su tshom bu bkod/mthar rdor me ri bcas rdul tshon ras bris sam 'bras rdul tshon gyis kha dog bsgyur ba gang rigs bya/ /mthar skor mchod dam/ sbrengs tshar gang rigs su chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga/ nang mchod gtor ma zlum po'am yang na kha zas bzang rgu rin po che'i snod du bsham: dung chos dang dri bzang gi chu/ /ku sha'i 'thor g.yab sngon 'gro gtor ma bcas pa dang / gzhan yang mchod rdzas tshogs kyi yo byad 'du bya/rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu/ cang te'u/ nas ze/ bzed zhal sogs nyer mkho'i yo byad 'tshogs par bya/ bde ba'i gdan la 'khod de/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyis mchog rnams la/ nas/ sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /bar gyi skyabs sems lan gsum/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma dang / sogs/'dren pa'i dpal du bdag gyur cig/ bar gyi/ yan lag bdun pa brjod/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭoḥ zhes bzla/ bsangs chu bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags kyi rang bzhin bsam/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ o badz+ra a mṛ tas bsang / swā bhā was sbyang / o āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab: lha klu gnod sbyin srin po dang / /yi dwags 'byung po'i tshogs ma lus/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di khyer la/ /zhi ba'i sems kyis gnas par gyis/ /ā kā ro sngags bcas phul/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams rig sngags 'khor lo dang / /'od zer drug pa rdo rje ra ba gur/ /ye shes me dpung rab tu 'bar ba yi/ /srung ba'i 'khor los bar mtshams med par gtams/ /oṃ tā re badz+ra rak+ṣa swā hā: zhes srung 'khor bsgom/ gnas khang / oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsang / swā bha was sbyang / gnas khang rgyu las thar pa chen po yi/ /gzhal med khang du āḥlas pad snod du/ /sman dang gtor ma mchod pa'i bye brag kun/ /rnam pa der 'char ngo bo bdud rtsir gyur/oṃ r+ghaṃ ṭ+wāṃ trīḥ.ā: byāṭ+wāṃ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ: bdud rtsi la dmigs lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas/ shardo āḥr+ghaṃ: zhes pas byin gyis brlab: oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra su bhā wa āt+ma kolha haṃ: rnam par rtog pa'i chos thams cad/ /gdod nas mtshan bral stong pa'i ngang / zhes pa nas/ bdag mdun bcom ldan sgrol ma'i sku/zhes 'don pa spos la/ /'od kyis ye shes spyan drangs gyur/ /bdag mdun tshig ris gcig gis so sor bskyed la/ /po ṭa la yi gnas mchog nas/ sogs nas/ dzaḥr+ghaṃ bo ho: phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams 596

cad nas: sogs/ 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan gyur/ /zhing khams rab 'byams gang ba yi/ /me tog bdug spos mar me dri/ /sogs nas/ shab pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ rgyas par spro na/ zhing khams rab 'byams gang ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /'phags ma sgrol ma 'khor bcas la/ /bdag 'bul thugs rje'i mthu yis bzhes/ /oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: de bzhin du/ lha rdzas dam pa'i zhabs bsil 'di/ pā ju/ lha rdzas dam pa'i me tog 'di/ puṣ+pe/ lha rdzas dam pa'i bdug spos 'di/ dhu pe/ lha rdzas dam pa'i mar me 'di/ ā lo ke/ lha rdzas dam pa'i dri chab 'di/ gadhe/ lha rdzas dam pa'i zhal zas 'di/ rna wi r+ya/ lha rdzas dam pa'i rol mo 'di/ shardo pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ thog mtha' 'dra bas mchod/ tshangs dang dbang po biju dang / /drag po bdud dang 'jig rten gsum/ /ma lus dbang du mdzad pa yi/ /'phags ma sgrol mar phyag 'tshal bstod/ /chags bral thabs shes pad+ma nyi zla'i steng / /bcom ldan khyed sku pad+ma rā ga'i mdog/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi chags 'dres pa'i nyams/ /longs spyod mtshan dpe rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhal bzhad smin legs shangs dkyus lta na sdug /spyan zur pad+ma rgyas pa'i 'dab ltar mdzes/ /dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag ltag par bcings/ /nu rgyas sked skabs phra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyag g.yas lcags kyu g.yon pas ut+pal 'dzin/ /dga' ba'i cha rdzogs bcu drug lon pa'i tshul/ /zhabs gnyis g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums 'gying bcas bzhugs/ /srid zhi'i mdzes pa'i phul khyed phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'dzam bu'i gser dang mu tig la sogs pa'i/ dbu rgyan snyan mgul phyag zhabs mdzes par byas/ sta zur sked du nu 'bur phreng ba dang / /ut+pal dmar pos spras la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dri med lha rdzas dmar po'i stod g.yogs dang / /sna tshogs dar gyi smad dkris cod pan g.yon/ /yid 'ong chu shel dbang po'i rgyab yol can/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gyur phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bdag sogs skye dang tshe rabs phreng kun du/ /'phags ma khyed kyis dge ba'i bshes mdzod la/ /'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug las sgrol nas/ /'gro ba mgon med rnams kyi mgon gyur cig /rang rig gdod nas chos kyi skur bzhugs kyang / /rang ngo ma shes ma rig gis nongs pa/ /gang gi mthu las bde chen skad cig la/ /'char nas zung 'jug go 'phang myur thob shog /gnas skabs nad gdon bgegs sogs mi mthun zhi/ /tshe bsod dpal 'byor legs byas rab tu rgyas/ /khams gsum mos bzhi 'bad med dbang du 'dus/ /gzhan don byang chub chen spyod pa mthar phyin shog /bstan pa dar zhing bstan 'dzin zhabs brtan zhing / /rgyal khams bde zhing chos bzhin spyod pa dang / /'bral bcas 'gro kun rdo rje 'chang gi sar/ /'god nus 'phags ma'i thugs rjes skyong gyur cig /rang gi snying khar ut+pal dmar po zla nyi'i gdan la ye shes sems dpa' dang / de'i lte bar t+t+waṃ dmar po dang 597

ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'/ de mthar yig bcus bskor ba zhal nang bstan gsal btab la/ oṃ tā re tut+ta tu re tu re swā hā: zhes bzlas tshogs rdzas kha na ma tho med pa ji ltar 'byor ba bsham/ tshogs kyi ma dag nyes skyon kun/ /ro yo khaṃ gi bsregs gtor bkrus/ /oṃ lhuhūṃ gi ye shes kyi/ /zag med bdud rtsi'i ngo bor gyur/ /chos dbyings rnam dag zhing khams nas/ /rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma la/ /rgyal ba sras bcas 'khor gyis bskor: 'di gshegs dam rdzas byin gyis rlobs/ /dam tshig sgrol ma yum dang sras/ /rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtsho la/ /'dod yon mi rtog bde chen rdzas/ /tshogs kyi mchod pa dam pa 'bul/ /tshogs dang po phul/ /bdag cag ma rig 'khrul dbang gis/ /'phags ma sgrol ma 'khor bcas kyi/ /thugs 'gal nyes skyon sgrib pa'i tshogs/ /tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags/ /yig brgya brjod/ /bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams la/ bar gcod dgra bgegs ma lus pa/ /tshogs 'dir bstims nas khyod zhal bstab/ /byang chub bsgrub bgegs med par mdzod/ ā r+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra ma tram̐ ru tra mā ra ya sarba sha tū khā hi: lhag la dbang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /rdzu 'phrul thog med mkha' la 'gro/ /skal ldan rjes 'dzin skal med sgrol/ /lhag gtor bzhes la phrin las sgrubs/ /ḍā ki ḍā ki ba li ta khā hi/ zhes lhag ma phul/ thog ma bar dang tha ma'i bskal pa la/ /kun bzang sgrol ma pad+ma thod phreng gis/ /dgongs pa gtad dang rgyud gsungs gter sbas tshe/ /ye shes las kyi mkha' 'gro dam can rnams/ /rang rang gzugs bstan rang rtags srog snying phul/ /ci ltar dam la btags shing khas blangs ltar/ /gtor ma 'di bzhes bar chad bzlog pa dang / bcol ba'i phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrubs par mdzod/ /da dus bskal par skal ldan chos bdag gis/ /dgongs pa zab mo'i gter kha 'byed pa'i tshe/ /srung ma so sos khas blangs ci bzhin du/ /gtor ma 'di bzhes bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /chad tho phul/ /slob dpon pad+ma'i dka' nyan brtan ma'i tshogs/ /'dir gshegs bka' yi gtor ma 'di longs la/ /nang kha chod la mtshon bskal thul pa dang / /bod khams bde ba'i sdong grogs mdzad du gsol/ /ma mā li lī kha khā te te ma ma sring 'gro ma ba lo ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ brtan ma phul/ mthar mchod bstod bsdus pa bya/ yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs sho lo ka gnyis kyis bzod gsol bya/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'phags ma sgrol ma 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yis sa la 'khod par shog /rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma yi/ /thugs rjes bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /'bral med rtag par skyong gyur nas/ /bkra shis bde legs 'phel bar shog /dge bsngo dang bkra shis brjod/ de ltar 'phags ma sgrol ma gsang sgrub kyi las las byang dngos grub 'dod 'jo 'di yang 'dod dpal mkhan rin po che skal bzang phrin las yar 'phel gyis bka' gnang ba ltar rdo rje drag pos 'og min 598

mtshur mdo bo lung gi gtsug lag khang du bris pa mkha' mnyam 'gro kun 'phags ma'i go 'phangs la 'god par gyur cig /shur+ghaṃ/oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ/ rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan ye shes kyi/ /rang gzugs bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol mdzad yum/ /rgyal ba sras bcas bla ma yi dam dang / /ḍā ki chos skyong thugs dam bskong ba'i rdzas/ /me tog spos mchog snang gsal dri zhal sogs/ /lha mo bcu drug sman raka gtor chen dang / /bde stong mnyam sbyor dga' bzhi 'dzin bral sogs/ /phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi/ /dgyes rdzas srid zhi'i dngos po ma lus pa/ /rnam pa 'dod pa'i yon tan ma tshang med/ /ngo bo zag med rmad byung bskyed pa 'dis/ /rtsa bar brgyud pa'i bla ma'i thugs dam bskang / /yi dam rgyal ba rgya ma tsho'i thugs dam bskang / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi thugs dam bskang / /chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang / /khyad par sgrol ma 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /gter srung drag po'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang / /dkar phyogs skyong ba 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /yul lha gzhi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /bskang bar 'os pa kun gyi thugs dam bskang / /stong pa chos kyi dbyings su thugs dam bskang / /snang ba 'dzin med klong du thugs dam bskang / /snang stong zung 'jug chen por thugs dam bskang / /ka dag kun bzang klong du bskang gyur cig /ces pa'ang lha bzo rdo rje dbang phyug gi ngor rdo rje drag pos brjod pa'o/ /shur+bha/ 599

rog /sgrol ma'i gsang sgrub dbang gi sbyin sreg khams gsum yid 'gugs ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /na ma ā r+ya tā rā ya/ sgrol ma dmar mo'i dbang gi sreg blugs bya bar/ stegs bu ji ltar 'tshams par dbang gi thab zla gam rdo ra 'od phreng gi dbus su pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad lte bar lcags kyus mtshan par bya/ dbang gi bud shing / tsan+dan rgya shugs dmar po sogs zla gam du brtsegs/slob dpon gyi g.yas su yon chab nyer spyod lnga/ /myos byed kyis sgrus pa'i gtor ma ril bu sogs mchod rdzas/ g.yon ngos su me tog dang 'bras bu dmar po/ li khri/ star bu/ dbang du bya ba'i rū pa yid sgyur rdzas sogs ma tshang ba med pa dang / rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu dgang gzar blugs gzar bsangs chu rnams bkod / bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar btang / las bum la dmigs/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta r+ghaṃ phaṭa: brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ mchod gtor rnams las byang ltar byin brlab/ thab/ a mṛ tas bsang /swā bhā was sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du dbang gi thab khung mtshan nyid dang ldan pa ye shes kyi me 'bar bar gyur/ trīḥdz+wa la ro wā shaṃ ku ru ho+oḥ me 'bar ba'i dbus su dbang gi me lha drang srong chags pa'i nyams can phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis ho ma gzar dang me dpung / 'og mas lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa rgyan gos mchod phyir thogs kha dog dmar po can ra skyes la pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis gnas pa/ spyi bor o/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar rgyu/ de las 'od 'phros ye shes pa spyan drangs asna ye badz+ra sa ma ya dza: spro na/ dad pa dang ni sogs kyi mthar/ dzaḥhūṃ bo ho: dam ye dbyer med bsam/dgang blugs byon skyes mar khu lan bdun 'bul/ /oṃ agha ya/ a di pya/ ā we sha ya/ ma hā shri ye ha bya ka bya ma hā na ye swā hā/ me lha thab kyi kha khyer la 'khod par bsam/ me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su gsang sgrub ltar bskyed/ spyan drangs/ dbang bskur/ rgyas gdab kyi snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ zhes pa yan song nas mchod/ oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re asne dhe wa sarba tre+e lo ka shrī gu na la smi wā shaṃ ku ru swā hā/ thun mong dag gi rdzas rnams re re bzhin nam/ bsres pa brgya lnga bcu/ nyer gcig sogs phul ba ste/ de yang gtso bo sgrol ma dang me lha bka' sdod kyi tshul thun mong du 'phul/ khyad par rdzas/ gang dbang du bya ba'i rū pa gzhung gsal ltar bris la che ge mo/ /bdag gi yid bsgyur nas rjes su chags dbang du 'du bar mdzad du gsol/ /che ge mo wa shaṃ ku ru ṭ+wā hā: li khri/ chags bskyed dha dhur yid 600

bsgyur sogs rdzas 'bul/ /las byang ltar sgrol ma'i bstod pa dang / /me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha/ /drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs/ /bcas la/ mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ces bstod/ sgrol ma'i bzlas pa cung zad bya/ gong gi dmigs pa gzhung ltar cung zad 'phrul shes par bya/ 'dod gsol/ hoḥ bcom ldan 'das 'phags ma sgrol ma me lha'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa la phrin las su gsol ba ni khams gsum brtan g.yo'i yo byad dpal dang yon tan phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bdag gi dbang du 'du bar mdzad du gsol/ /dang khyad par dmigs bya 'di yi lus ngag yid gsum zas nor thams cad bdag gi dbang du sarba wā shi ku ru ho: zhes brjod sgrol ma dang me lhar byon skyems/ o tā re tut+ta re tu re agha ye swā hā+oḥ lan bdun nyer spyod sngar tsam gyis mchod/ yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang / ma 'byor pa dang / sogs kyis bzod gsol bya/ mdun gyi bcom ldan 'das ma ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying khar bsdu/ /oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun sogs brjod/ 'jig rten me lha sarba gats+tshas gshegs/ dbang du bya ba'i ngo bo thig le dkar dmar rang gi sna bug nas rlung rngubs pa dang 'grogs te/ ro rkyang gi lam nas mar zhugs lte bar gtum mo'i me la thim par bsam/ bkra shis brjod/ rdzas lhag ma rang gi mdzod dus sba/ sol ba'i mtho sar rlung la bskyal/ chu la'ang phul/ de ltar sgrol ma gsang sgrub kyi sbyin sreg 'di yang 'dod dpal mkhan rin po che'i bzhed pa ltar/ rdo rje drag pos mtshur phu'i gzim pa chung bka' rgya mar bris pa dge'o/ /sgrol ma'i rlung 'khor/ mu khyud brgyad bskor: lte bar t+t+waṃmu khyud la: oṃ tā re tudhā re tu re swā hā: tshar gang tshud: de rgyab rtsibs bzhir: oṃ tā re sarba sidhi wā shaṃ ku ru swā hā: de rgyab mu khyud la: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru dhe wa ḍa ki ni kā ya wāka tsit+ta sirnyi wa shaṃ ku ru dzaḥr+ghaṃ: de rgyab sarba tre+e lo ka de wa nā ga sogs/ wā shaṃ ku ru dzaḥr+ghaṃ: khyad par dmigs bya che ge mo wa shaṃ ku ru ho: zhes bri/ de rgyab dbyangs gsal: de rgyab lcags kyu: ut+pal zhags pa sbrel/ phyi ru rlung bri: steng 'khor yig 'go phyir lta steng nas brtsams te bri+oḥ 'od 'khor yig 'go nang bstan: gzhan gong dang 'dra: bar du rtse gsum mu khyud bzhi pa: lte bar rū pa ming bri+oḥ yan lag bzhir dza: mu khyud la che ge mo ā kar+sha ya dza: wā shaṃ ku ru ho: zhes gang mang dang : de'i phyir dbang du byed pa'i sngags: de rgyab che ge mo bdag gi dbang du 'dus par gyur cig: yid bsgyur rjes su chags nas mdza' grogs dang mnga' 'bangs su gyur cig bri: phyir dzaḥr+ghaṃ gis bskor: 'khor lo gnyis kyi bar du 'di bcug: kha dog dmar po li khri+oḥ pho la pad+ma rak+ta: mo la byang sems: chags skyed rdzas dang : yid 'khrul thang phrom 'bru: spyir li khri bzhag: shing zlum po la 'khor lo bug pa dang srog shing mi dgos par rlung la bskor bas las myur: maṅga lo bha wan+tu/ 601

sgrol ma gsang thab kyi sad srung jin phreng gzhon nu phan bde'i gru char byur tsul zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /'phags ma sgrol mar gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: dgongs gter sgrol ma gsang sgrub kyi lo tog la phan phyir sad bsrung ba la: bris sku bkram pa'i mdun: stegs rim pa gnyis kyi steng la maṇ+ḍal la rdul tshon gyis pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i dbus su: nyi gdan tshom bu dmar po bkod pa'am: yang na maṇ+ḍal steng 'bras dkar rgya skyegs kyi se kha dog bsgyur ba'i tshom bu brgyad bkod: de'i steng du mardzi la bum pa chas su bcug: chu snas sum gnyis bkang : mdun du gtor ma nyer spyod bdun: chad tho: brtan ma: tshogs: sngon 'gro gtor ma sogs 'du bya: stegs 'og ma'i khar lcags kyi mardzi lta bu'i khar zangs snod gtsang ma'i nang la sa sna rde'i sogs blugs la chu snas bkang / nang du spra tshil lamoḥ rdo la klu gzugs sor bzhi: nang du klu bcu'i sngags sham du: ma hā me gha swā hā: zhes sprin sdud sngags dar ram rgya shog la bri: mjug nas yar dril: smyug spub tu klu sman bcas bcug: kha spra tshil gyi bsdam: de klu'i nang du bcug chu mi 'gro bar bya: klu gzugs chu nang du mgo zhabs ma ldog pa drang por gzhug: zangs kyi zhabs su mar me sbar: rlangs pa ma chad par bya: de nas skyabs sems nas bzung las byang bzlas pa'i bar btang : bzlas pa zin nas: mdun bskyed/a mṛ tas bsang / su bhā was bas sbyang / rang nyid 'tsho4gas ma sgrol mar gsal ba'i mdun: rat+na'i brag ri bya skyibs byang shar lta: de yi mdun ngos pad+ma chen po yi: de yi lte bar dbus dang phyogs mtshams dang : steng 'og phuḥyig rang rang mdog gnas pa: yongs gyur lte bar chu lha zla ba'i mdog:sbrul zhag rin chen 'bar ba 'dzin pa dang : shar du mtha' yas dkar po ut+pal 'dzin: lho ru 'jog po dmar po dgra sta 'chang : nub tu stobs rgyu nag po sbrul zhag 'dzin: byang du rigs ldan dkar po nor rkyal 'dzin: shar lho nor rgyas ser po bum pa thogs: lho nub dung skyong ser po dung 'dzin pa:nub byang pad+ma dmar po puṣ+pe 'dzin: byang shar pad+ma chen po ku mud 'dzin: steng du rgyal ba ljang gu nor bu 'dzin: 'og tu rnam rgyal sngon po sbrul 'dzin pa: kun kyang sku stod lha yi bu lta bu: nor bu rin chen sna tshogs rgyan du ma: dar zab rab tu mdzes pa'i na bza' can: sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun ldan sbrul mjug 'khyil: rang rang chung ma bu dang bu mo dang : ma dros sogs ma med sogs klu yi 'khor:bye ba khrag khrig dpag tu med pas bskor: rang gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis mdun bskyed bskul: de rnams thugs ka'i phuḥlas 'od 'phros pas: klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs nas: mdun gyi rten dang dbyer med gyur par bsam: spyan drangs pa: oṃ: gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ni:sa 'og mun pa ma lus sel mdzad pa: bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab: klu rgyal 'khor 602

bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: nā ga rā dza sarba nā ga nā gi sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dza: dza:hūṃ bam̐ ho: mchod pa: gtsang zhing yid 'ong lta na sdug: lha rdzas mchod yon zhabs bsil dang : me tog spos dang snang gsal mchog: dri chab zhal zas rol mo dang : khang bzang skyed tshal khrus kyi rdzing ཿོyid mthun 'dab chags ri skyes dang : rta dang dre'u ba phyugs khyu+oḥ nor bu rin chen rmad byung rnams:'bru sna klu sman sna tshogs pa: dar zab dkar gsum mngar gsum dang : gdan khri mal stan gos dang rgyan: bzhed pa'i 'dod yon rnam pa drug:rin chen gter gyi bum pa bzang : dngos su ji ltar 'byor ba dang : yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod sprin tshogs: klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: oṃ nā ga rā dza sarba nā ga nā gi sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nasoḥ shardo pu dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ: bstod poḥ thub pa'i spyan sngar bstan pa bsrung ba dang : 'gro ba'i phan bde spel ba'i g.yar dam can: dam ldan bu bzhin skyong ba'i klu rgyal tshogs: yab yum sras 'khor bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces bstod: de nas klu rgyal bcu gcig 'khor bcas kyi thugs kar rang mdog phu:yig re re gnas pa de mthar sngags phreng me long nang du gzugs brnyan shar ltar bsam pa la oṃ phuḥdza li ka swā hā: oṃ phuḥ.ā nan tā swā hā: oṃ phuḥtak+ṣa ka gā hā: oṃ phuḥkarko ṭa swā hā: o phuḥku li ki swā hā: oṃ phuḥbā su ka swā hā: oṃ phuḥshakho pā la swā hā: oṃ phuḥpad+ma swā hā: oṃ phuḥm hā pad+ma swā hā: oṃ phuḥdza ya swā hā: oṃ phuḥbi dza ya swā hā: oṃ phuḥsarba nā ga nā gi dzaḥswā hā: sprin chen sngags 'di btags: sarba ma hā me gha swā hā: zhes bzla:dmigs pa 'og gzhi 'byung ba rlung g.yos me'i dkyil 'khor cher sbar rgya mtsho dros: de'i rlangs pas sa gzhi drod dang ldan par bsgom: rang nyid sgrol ma'i thugs ka'i t+t+waṃ las 'od 'phros: mdun gyi klu rgyal 'khor bcas kyi sa bon sngags phreng la phog: rgyud bskul dam tshig brtan nas so so'i sa bon sngags dang : kha sna gdengs ka nas rlangs pa sprin chen por gyur: nam mkha'i khyon khebs par bsam mo:skabs su gzhung gi dmigs pa yang sbyar: dgongs mo sprin byer na sprin sdud sngags bzla: thun mtshams su: sprin chen mdo bklag: dkar gsum mngar gsum sbyar ba'i gtor ma lha grangs gcig gis rung :oṃ a mṛ tas bsang : swa bhā was sbyang : stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i: snod du gtsang sbyar gtor ma ni: rnam pa dkar gsum mngar gsum la: ngo bo zag med bdud rtsir gyur: oṃ dza li ka nā ga rā dza nā gi sa pa ri wā ra i dam bhā li ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan bdun gyis 'bul: klu rgyal 'khor bcas gtor ma ni: bzhes la sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs: 'gro la bde skyid 'byung ba dang : bdag la dgyes bzhin las rnams sgrubs: nam mkha' 'di la sprin cig sdus: bar snang 'di la mdangs shig phyangs: sa gzhi 'di la drod cig phobasoḥ lo thog 'bru la bcud gcig phobs: sad kyi gnod pa zhi ba 603

dang : 'bru rnams 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod: 'gal rkyen kun las srung ba dang : mthun rkyen thams cad sgrub mdzod cig: gzhi bdag la gtor ma bsngo ba ni gzhan ltar ro: skabs su bden pa brjod pa ni: shākya thub pa la sogs pa: phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bden pas nam mkha' byin gyis rlobs shig: bar snang la sprin sdus shig: sa gzhi la drod phobs shig:thugs rje chen po la sogs pa: phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bden pas nam mkha' byin gyis rlobs shig: bar snang la sprin 'dus shig: sa gzhi la drod phobs shig: nyan thos chen po mchog brgyad: gnas brtan bcu drug la sogs pa dgra bcom pa thams cad kyi bden pas nam mkha' byin gyis rlobs shig: bar snang la sprin sdus shig: sa gzhi la drod phobs shig: lha chen po brgyad: klu chen po brgyad: gza' chen po brgyad: phyogs skyong bcu:rgyal po chen po bzhi la sogs pa dkar phyogs skyong ba thams cad kyi bden pas nam mkha' byin gyis rlobs shig: bar snang la khrin sdus shig: sa gzhi la drod phob shig: ces dang : na mo: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro: chos skyong srung ma'i bka' bden nga dang : khyad par 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang : 'phags ma sgrol ma'i bka' bden pa dang : rgyal po chen po sde bzhi: lha chen po brgyad: klu chen po brgyad: gza' chen po brgyad: rgyu skar nyer brgyadoḥ phyogs skyong bcu: 'jigs byed dgu: dregs pa'i sde dpon rnams dang : lha srin sde brgyad yul lha sa bdag klu gnyan dkar po'i phyogs skyong ba thams cad kyi bden pas rlung non: sprin gtibs la sa gzhi la drod phobs: ba mo grang reg gi gnod pa mi 'byung zhing : lo legs 'bru 'phel skye 'gro bde skyid dang ldan par gyur cig: ces brjod: mthar nyer spyod dang : bstod pa gong ltar bya: sgrol ma'i tshogs sogs rjes chog bya: de ltar rab thun drug: bzhi sogs 'bad na sad kyis mi tshugs so: sgrub pa tshar nas rjes mi mngon par bya: smras pa: deng sang dus kyis bslad pa'i gang zag 'gasoḥ tshad thub rgyud dang bla ma'i man ngag bzhin: nyams su mi len bcos pa'i gdol chos dang : ci dran lag tu bkal nas gzhan sems bslu: 'di ni pad+ma 'byung gnas byin rlabs kyi: mthus bskrun rmad byung dgongs gter rtsod med de0 nyams sa blangs tshe yid ches nges shes 'charaX dgos 'don 'byung ba yid bzhin //rdo ri ring ////nor bu 'dra: de phyir skal ldan gus pas don gnyer gyi: re ba bskang slad gzhan phan bsam pa yis:yi ger bris 'di nongs na 'phags mar bshags: dge bas 'gro kun byang chen la reg shogoḥ ces don gnyer 'gas bskul kyang snyom las kyis g.yeng bas/ slar yang 'gyur med pa bde chen nas bskul ngor rdo rje drag pos bris pa bkra shis dge legs 'phel/ 604 —

rlung non rdzas la rlung lha dpe'u ris ltar bzo: so btang : nang du: oṃ yam̐ yo bā yu de wa char ya chur cha stam bha ya nan: char ya nan: chur ya nan: bā yu nan swā hā: tshag med par bri: mgo nas dril: snying khar bcug: dong gru gsum nang du mnanoḥ de'i zhabs ling ga spyi ltar la 'gugs gzhug bya: dong kha bcad: 'jig rten gyi rlung thams cad mnan par bsam: de steng sāts+tsha bzhagoḥphyag na rdo rje bsgom mo: zab/dgongs gter sgrol ma dmar mo'i las tshogs rlung 'khor gyi zin bris dngos grub myur stsol bzhugs so/ /su ste/ pad 'byung rdo rje drag po dbyer med pa/ /rang sems gdod nas lhun grub nges pa la/ /gsol 'debs sngon chad bka' rgyas btab na yang / /'gro ba'i don chen zin tho gzhan phan gyi/ /ched du bkod la bka' gnang byin rlabs stsol/ de'ang dang po rgya shog 'dra dug shog ma yin par gtsang ma la rgya snag gtsang mas bri ba'am/ spar btab la/ phreng gong mar rnam 'joms kyi nye snying dang / oṃ a mṛ te r+ghaṃ phaṭa: bar chad bgegs rnams u tsa ya phaṭa: oṃ a ka ni/ ni ka ni/ a byi la/ man dha la/ maṇ+ḍal le swā hā/ 'khor lo 'di bskor ba la lo zla zhag dus mi rung ba dang phog phub 'gram 'khrug thabs cad shārto ku ru swā hā: zhes phreng gcig de 'og sgrol ma'i sngags yi ge bcu pa phreng gang shod bri/ de 'og klu chen bcu'i sngags la sprin sdud sarba ma hā me gha swā hā/ sbyar ba dang / na mo/sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun sogs bden stobs brjod pa phreng gcig bcas dag par bri bkod byas la/ srog thur la mjug nas yig ngo phyir bstan dril/ g.yogs dkar po byed nas rlung 'khor dang chu 'khor sogs gang bde chog par g.yas su bskor dgos/ gza' skar bzang po bgegs bskrad dang rab gnas bya/ gzhi bdag la dkar gtor spyi ltar 'bul/ klu gtor dang / klu bsang btang / sprin chen mdo bklag /bkra shis brjod la legs par 'dzug pas rang gzhan thams cad phan bde'i btsas su 'gyur bar nges/ tshul 'dir nyes bshags dge ba byang chub bsngo/ /'dir 'bral sems can 'byung bzhi'i gnod pa zhi/ /tshe 'dir bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa dang / phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /ces pa'ang rig 'dzin rje'i zhal slob gu ru ma ṇi zhes pa'i rgyal khams pas yongs la sman phyir/ skal ldan mos pa can rnams kyi ngor bkod pa dge'o/ /shur+ghaṃ/ /dgongs gter sgrol ma gsang skub kyi dbang mchog kun phan snying gi bdud rtsi zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru ār+ya tā ra ye/ kun rtog ye shes thig le yis/ /'khor 'das dbang byed myur mdzad ma/ /rgyal ba'i yum der gus btud nas/ /kun phan dbang gi mtshams sbyor dgod/ /sgrol ma gsang sgrub kyi smin byed zab mos skal ldan rjes su 'dzin pa la/ sbyor ba yo byad kyi gshom/ 605

dngos gzhi dbang gi lam rim gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gnas dben par bris 'bur gyi rten bkram pa'i mdun du stegs bu dri bzang dang / myos byed kyis chag chag btab pa la maṇ+ḍal/ pad+ma dmar po rdor me ris bskor ba'i lte bar tshom bu dmar po gcig bkod/ de steng mardzi bum pa nyer lnga'i rdzas ldan mgul chings dmar po kha rgyan gzungs thag ldan pa bkod/ mdun tu sku gzugs dngos sam tsagli/g.yas su bhan dhar chang la sbrang dang ka ra sbyar ba'i khar me long sisnu ras byugs pa la chos 'byung lte bar t+t+waṃ yig dang mthar bskor yig bcu bris pas bkab/ g.yon tu sngags byang / byu ru'am tsan dan phreng ba/shel rdo/ rma bya'i sgra mdongs/ rgyab tu dbang gtor dmar po dar dmar gyi gdugs phub pa/ mdun du mchod gtor zlum po dang nang mchod/ nyer spyod sbreng tshar ram skor bsham/ gzhan yang las bum/tshogs kyi yo byad/ sngon gtor sogs phrin las la dgos pa rnams 'du bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i don du bdag mdun sgrub mchod bya ba ni/ rig 'dzin nyid kyis mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs dang / lam byang dngos grub 'dod 'jo'i skyabs sems tsam mthar chags su btang / bdag mdun so sor dmigs pa'i spro bsdu bcas bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ bum bzlas zur du byas nad dmigs rnam phyed cing legs pas/ bum pa rang byung gi gzhal yas khang gi nang du 'phags ma sgrol ma dmar mo skad cig gis gsal bar gyur/ bdag bskyed kyi thugs srog las 'od 'phros thugs rgyud bskul/ sku las bdud rtsi dmar po'i rgyun babs bum pa gang bar gyur/ ces pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pas gzungs thag blangs la yig bcu bzlas/gzhung 'dir gtor 'bul bya ba ma gsungs pas spro na skabs 'dir spyi mthun sbyar/ mthar mchod bstod bya zhing yig brgya bzla/ oṃ āḥrgyu gis mchod yon phul bas bum lha 'od du zhu ba bum chu dang dbyer med du gyur/ ces dmigs/las bum du rta mgrin bskyed bzlas bya/ tshogs byin rlabs nas bsgral bstabs yan btang / spro na tshogs par ba'i dbur skong bshags zur gsal sbyar/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang blangs la slob ma gzhug par gnang ba nod do/ /de nas dbang dngos kyi thog mar slob ma rnams la khrus bya/ bgegs gtor btang / bka' bsgo bgegs bskrad srung 'khor bsgom pa bcas song nas/ sems bskyed gsal gdab/ chos bshad lo rgyus ci rigs pa dang khyad par/ 'dir skabs su babs pa'i 'chad bya/ /rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma 'di nyid nges pa'i don du 'phags bzhi skyed yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang tha dad mi mnga' yang / gdul bya drang ba'i don du 'jig rten gyi khams sna tshogs 'od du rgyal ba'i sras mo ye shes zla ba zhes bya ba'i skye srid bzung nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnga sgra las thugs bskyed cing 'khor ba ji srid bar du bud med kyi lus rten kho nas 'gro ba rnams sgrol zhing bdud rnams 'dul bar dam bca' pa'i thugs bskyed dang byang chub kyi spyod pa'i tshul phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras bcas kun las khyad par 'phags pa dang / 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs kyi ye shes chen po'i cho 'phrul las byung bar bstan pa sogs bsam gyis mi khyab 606

pa'i rnam par rol pa mtha' yas pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing / sgrol ma'i sngags rgyud bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis rim par gsungs shing / da lta bdag cag gi ston pa'i bstan pa la'ang mdo rgyud rtogs pa'i rigs mang du byon pa bde dang 'bral ba'i sgrub thabs slob dpon rnams kyi bka' srol las byung ba 'phags bod gnyis su mtha' yas pa byon pa las/ 'dir 'od dpag med dngos gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mda' bdag rje 'bangs rnams la bstsal ba'i gdams zab rnams ma 'ongs gdul bya'i don tu gter rigs bco brgyad du sbas pa dus phebs gter ston sprul pa'i skyes mchog rnams kyis rim par bton cing 'gro don mdzad pa las/ mnga' bdag chos rgyal chen po skye ba bcu bzhi'i mthar bcom ldan pad+ma'i spyan tu mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas nas ljongs 'dir gter kha gong 'og gtsos sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las lnga phrag lnga/ de las yang sbrul nyid sprul dpag tu med pas gang la gang 'dul gyi phrin las rgyun mi 'chad par mdzad pa'i nang tshan/ rig 'dzin rdo rje drag po phrin las 'dus pa las rab bde ba rtsal gyi dgongs pa'i klong nas brdol ba'i zab chos byin rlabs kyi tshan kha mchog dang ldan pa sgrol ma gsang sgrub bka' gter chu bo gcig dril gyi smin byed zab mo bsgrub pa la sogs kyis mtshams sbyor nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug /slob dpon dang bcom ldan 'das ma dbyer med pa'i spyan sngar thal mo me tog dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ /dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje can: srid pa'i 'jigs las sgrol ba po: khyod kyi zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis: dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du: bla ma 'phags ma sgrol ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar rgyun bshags sngon tu 'gro ba can gyi skyabs su 'gro ba dang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum/ de nas dad mos gus pa'i gdung shugs bskyed la khyad par gyi gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye: rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa: mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po: rdo rje rnal 'byor las byung ba: ji ltar khyed ni bdag nyid che:mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod: 'khor ba 'dam gyi mtsho nang du+oḥ bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyob: lan gsum/ de nas dbang gi gzhi dgod cing ye shes pa dbab pa yin pas khyed rang rnams lus ngag yid gsum gyi gnad gcun la gzhan tu ma yengs par dmigs pa 'di rtse gcig tu bsgom shig /rnam par rtogs pa'i chos thams cad: sogs gzhung ltar brjod/ 'od dpag rigs kyi cod pan can: de ltar gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar r+ghaṃ sngon po/ /thugs dbus zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la tsā yig dmar pos mtshan pa dang / slob dpon gyi thugs ka 607

nas kyang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas g.yu lo bkod dang po ṭa la sogs sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab 'byams na bzhugs pa'i 'phags ma sgrol ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs rgyud bskul/ sku gsum thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad phyag rgya sngags phreng phyag mtshan 'od zer gyi rnam par char babs pa ltar byon nas khyed rang rnams kyi sgo gsum la thim pas dam tshig ye shes dbyer med du gyur pa'i mos pa brtan po mdzod cig: po ṭa la yi sogs dang / yig bcu'i sham du/ badz+ra ā be sha ya a ā: btags pa brjod/ spos dud rol mo bcas byin dbab/ mgo bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag la/ ye shes pa'i byin rlabs kyi rgyun brtan par byas par mos shig /tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ de ltar dbang don gyi ye shes skyed par byed pa'i dbang bzhi rim par bskur ba'i bum pa'i dbang gi don du/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis gdan sum tshang ba'i lha nam mkha' gang ba spyan drangs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i phrin las mdzad cing / rdo rje'i gtor blugs kyi cho ga sbyin par mos shig rnam dum gyis dbang bskur la/ /bum pa dag la chos dbyings gzhal yas khang / /bum rdzas longs sku 'phags ma sgrol ma yi: sprul sku bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur bas: snang stong sku yi byin rlabs dbang thob shog: yig bcu'i mthar/ o sarba ta thā ga ta a sgyi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye r+ghaṃ/ bum chu blud/ des phyi mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ rags pa phung khams skye mched kyi dri ma sbyang / snod bcud dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu sku rdo rje thob pa'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no/ /gnyis pa gsum pa'i dbang gi slad du/ bla ma dam tshig sgrol ma rang 'od kyi yab 'jig rten dbang phyug dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i lhag pa byang chub kyi sems sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo mkha' gsang nas phyung lte thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang ro gcig tu sbyar nas ljags la byin par mos shig thod pa'i bdud rtsi mgrin par bzhag cing khar sbyin la/ 'phags pa mchog dang dam tshig sgrol ma yum: sbyor ba'i mkha' gsang byang chub sems rgyun gyisoḥ gsang ba'i dbang mchog dam pa 'di bskur bas: grags stong gsang ba'i dbang mchog thob par shog: yig bcu'i mthar/ gu h+ye a gi ṣiñtsa r+ghaṃ: sngags 'di'i rjes zlos bcas te myang bas gsal stong rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par mos shig /a ho ma hā su kha ho: des nang lus kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ phra ba rtsa dang rlung gi dri ma sbyong / rang byin brlabs kyi thabs lam bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu gsum rdo rje thob pa'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no/ /gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi slad du/ sikhyu ra'i dkyil 'khor las mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rig ma dam tshig sgrol ma'i ngo bor spros pa/ khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug tu gsal ba dang snyoms par zhugs pas yas babs rgyu dang mas brtan 'bras bu'i dga' ba bcu drug gi mthar 608

lhan skyes dpe'i ye shes mngon tu mthong bar mos shig /sid+dha ra'i thig gis gnas gsum du dga' ba 'khyil ba bris la/ bde ba snying rje chen po'i thabs kyi gsang : rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid yum gyi mkha': mnyam sbyor byang sems lugs 'byung lugs ldog gi: dga' bzhi shes rab ye shes dbang thob shog: yig bcu'i mthar/ e baṃ dzñā na a gi ṣiñtsa r+ghaṃ: des gsang ba sid+dha ra'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ shin tu phra ba theg le'i sgrib pa sbyang / gzhan lus pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la dbang /'bras bu thugs rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no/ /bum dbang gi mtha' rten du sku'i byin rlabs bya ba la/ mdun bskyed kyi sku la ye shes kyi phyag rgya gnyis pa spros spyi bo nas thim par mos shigasgrol ma'i sku spyi bor bzhag /rgyal ba kun yum 'phags ma'i 'khor los sgyur: phrin las rang gzugs dam tshig sgrol ma yi: lha sku phyag rgyas khyod la dbang bsku bas: sku gsung thugs kyi byin brlabs thob par shog: yig bcu/ kā ya wā ka tsista sarba sirnyi a bhi ṣiñtsa r+ghaṃ: deng nas bzung ste 'phags ma'i bskyed rim rtag tu bsgom pa dang 'di ltar snang ba thams cad lha sku phyag rgya'i gzer gyis thebs par gyis shigagasang dbang gi mtha' rten gsung bzlas pa sngags kyi lung sbyin pa la dmigs pa 'di ltar mdzod/mdun bskyed bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng las sngags phreng gnyis pa chad/ zhal nas thon khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs srog tī yig gi mthar 'khod/ /'od zer spro bsdus don gnyis sgrub par mos la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos/ phreng ba sbrel la yig bcu lan gsum/ de nyid brtan par byas par mos shig /sngags byang dang phreng ba mgrin par bzhag la/ bskyed rim snang stong sgyu ma'i skur gsal zhing / grangs stong rig sngags chu bo'i rgyun ltar zlos: sgra ru grags kun 'phags ma'i gsung rdo rje: mngon gyur byin rlabs nus pa'i dbang thob shog: deng nas bzlas pa chu bo'i rgyun ltar brtson pas grags pa thams cad snying po sngags dang 'phro 'du ting nge 'dzin gyis thebs par gyis shig /sher dbang gi mtha' rten du rang byung don dam pa'i ye shes ngo sprad pa ni/ shel gzhi ka dag nang gsal gyi dbyings/ rma bya'i mdangs ni lam lhun grub 'od gsal gyi gdangs/ yig bcu zung 'jug dbyings rig 'du 'bral med pa ste/ brda 'di dag gis mtshon nas rang rig ka dag spros bral 'od gsal lhun rdzogs phyam brdal chen po'i dbyings su mnyam par zhog cig yig bcu shel rdo rma bya'i mdangs bstan ā: rang rig mtshan bral ka dag stong pa nyid: lhun gyis grub pa'i ye shes 'ja' tshon bzhin: snang stong dbyer med bde chen 'dus ma byas: rig pa'i rtsal gyi dbang mchog thob par shog: yig bcu'i mthar/ dharmā dha tu dzñā na a snyi ṣiñtsa a: deng nas gnas lugs kyi don la mnyam par 'jog ste rtog tshogs thams cad la dgongs pa mi g.yo ba'i gzer gyis thebs par gyis shig /des snang srid rdzogs pa 609

chen po'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ rab tu phra ba 'pho ba'i dri ma sbyang / khregs chod thod rgal gyi lam bsgoms pa la dbang / 'bras bu ye shes rdo rje thob pa'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no/ /mtha' rten gtor ma'i bka' bsgo bya bar gsungs pas dbang gtor thogs la/ gtor snod pad+ma dbang gi gzhal yas khang chen por gtor ma nyid myur mdzad 'phags ma sgrol ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas bskor te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor byon/ sku gsung thugs las 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/spyi bo nas zhugs te lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas sgrib pa bzhi dag dbang bzhi stan thog gcig tu thob par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod cig bcom ldan 'das 'phags ma sgrol ma/ gu ru pad+ma saṃ bha wa/mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ mnga' bdag tshangs pa lha'i me tog /rig 'dzin thugs kyi rdo rje la sogs pa rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang / yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong ba'i srung ma dang bcas pas/ rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams la dbang bskur bar mdzad du gsol/ nad gdon bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang tshe bsod dpal 'byor dge legs kyi yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ snang srid 'khor 'das rlung sems snang ba thams cad dbang du 'du ba dang dgra gdon bgegs tshogs thams cad tshar gcod par mdzad du gsol/ mdor na thun mong dang mchog gi las dang dngos grub bde blag tu 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi byin brlabs shing / /dngos grub rnam gnyis 'byung ba'i gnas/ /gtor ma'i dbang bskur chen por sbyin/yig bcu'i sham du/ kā ya wā ki tsit+ta a gyi ṣiñtsa oṃ āḥhūṃ trīḥ zhes gtor ma gnas bzhir bzhag gtor ma'i lha 'od du zhu nas khyed rang rnams la thim par mos shig mtshams sbyor spyi mthun bcas shis brjod spel/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dam bzung ba/ gtong rag maṇ+ḍal/ lus 'bul/ dge bsngo byas pas dbang rim grub/rjes slob dpon gyis tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma btang nas dge bsngo bkra shis kyi bar yang las byang gi dkyus ltar bya'o/ /gsar rnying bka' srol mang mchis kyang / /'di nyid byin nus myur bar grags/ deng sang 'di don gnyer mang bas/ /de don 'jug sgor bsam nas bkod/ /snang ba'i g.yeng bas phyi ru mi bslu bar/ /nar du bdag 'dzin rtsad gcod bdag med rtogs/ /rang snang dbang du 'dus nas gzhan dag kyang / /sgrol la dbang mdzad sgrol ma 'di mtshungs shog /ces dgongs gter bdag dbang gi mtshams sbyor yab sras gong mas mdzad pa mang la 'di la bzhugs pas rgyal ba sras pad+ma dbang drag gis ring nas gsung bskul mdzad kyang snyoms las su lus pa slad nas nyer mkho'i ched du/ pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug phrin las 'gro 'dul rtsal gyis rdzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i ngo thad du bgyis pa dge 610

legs 'phel/ /gag /sred med bus zhus pa'i gzungs sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad sangs rgyas klu byin gyi gzungs bzhugs//rgya gar skad du/ nā rā ya ṇa pa ri mṛ tshwa ār+ya ma hā mā yā bi dza ya bā ti nī ma dhā ra tsā/ bod skad du/sred med kyi bus zhus pa 'phags pa sgyu ma chen mo rnam par rgyal ba thob par byed pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na bcom ldan 'das gser gyi rwa zhes bya ba'i ri bo'i rtse na rnam thos bu'i khang pa na bzhugs te/ lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang dri za dang lha ma yin dang nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci dang lto 'phye chen po dang rig pa 'dzin pa dang chu skyes ma la sogs pa mang po rnams kyis bstod par byed pa'i chos snang ba'i sgo zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs bstan par mdzad do/ /de nas lha ma yin rnams kyis bcom pa pha ma kun tu nyams pa gzi bajid kyi stobs dman pa'i sred med kyi bu gang de bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du nye bar 'ongs so/ /nye bar 'ongs nas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos mngon par btud nas mtha' gcig tu 'dug go/ /mtha' gcig tu 'dug nas de nyid du gsol ba/'di ltar bcom ldan 'das thams cad mkhyen pa thams cad gzigs pa sems can thams cad la rjes su brtse ba can/ chos kyi rnam grangs gang gis lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang srin po la sogs pa rnams sam mi rnams kyang rung ste g.yul 'khrugs pa'i tshe mtshon cha chen ltung ba 'am nye bar 'tshe ba'am rtsod pa thams cad las thams cad du rnam par rgyal bar 'gyur ba de lta bu bstan par mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal ba/ sred med kyi bu sgyu ma 'chang ba khyod/ sred med kyi bu sgyu ma dang ldan pa/stobs chen po mchis pa g.yo sgyu mang pos sems can rnams bslu bar byed pa khyod 'dir 'jigs nas g.yul du rnam par rgyal ba 'dri zhing yongs su 'dri bar byed pa ci yin/ sred med kyi bus 'di skad gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das 'dod pa'i lha ma yin gyi dbang pos lha ma yin gyi sgyu ma 'dir bdag bcom ste lha rnams 'ga' zhig ni 'chi bar gyur/ 'ga' zhig ni pham par gyur/ 'ga' zhig ni bcoms par gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs gang gis sems can rnams g.yul du rnam par rgyal bar byed par 'gyur ba/ lha ma yin rnams pham par byed par 'gyur ba/ lha ma yin gyi dregs pa snyil bar byed par 'gyur ba de lta bu bstan du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sred 611

med kyi bu/ sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus su ma ga dhā ro hi ta'i ril chen dpal zhes bya ba'i rgyal po byung ngo / /de'i tshe de'i dus na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa bla na med pa skyes bu 'dul ba kha lo sgyur ba lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad dbang phyug ces bya ba byung ngo / /bcom ldan 'das thams cad dbang phyug de'i zhal snga nas sgyu ma chen po rnam par rgyal ba thob par byed pa zhes bya ba'i rig sngags kyi tshig 'di rnams bdag gis legs par mnos te 'dzin pa dang klog pa dang kun chub pa dang rjes su yi rang bar byas te gzhan rnams la'ang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu bstan to/ /sred med kyi bu gzungs 'di'i mthus nam du'ang dgra'i 'jigs pa med pa dang mi 'phrod pa'i 'jigs pa med pa dang chom rkun gyi 'jigs pa'ang 'byung ba med par lo stong phrag brgya'i bar du chos bzhin gyi rgyal srid byas nas/ slad mar yang grong khyer dang grong khyer gzhan dang skyed mos tshal rnams su gzungs kyi mthus ltad mo bzhin du bde bar rgyu bar bye da do/ /skye ba rjes nas mā dh+wa tā zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa' 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po rin po che bdun dang yang dag par ldan pa/'jig rten gsum po mtha' dag la bka'i lung bsgyur ba byung ngo / /sngon du sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa nyams pa ma sems can thams cad la ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du phan 'dogs par byed pa'i phyir phun su ma tshog pa'i skal ba can rnar gyi na 'baibs par byed pa/ sems can thams cad bde bar byed pa/thams cad la phan 'dogs pa ra byed pa byung ngo / /sred med kyi blo/ de ltar gzungs 'di'i mthus bskal pa brgya phrag mang po sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pas tshogs yongasasu rdzogs par byas so/ /gang yang lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang dri za dang lha ma yin dang nam mkha'i lding dang mi 'am ci dang lto 'phye chen po dang rig 'dzin dang mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams bka' bzhin du gnas par byed de/ de rnams bka' las phyir phyogs par mi byed do/ /bskal pa stong phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi rnams su sngon phyogs bar byas te phyi nas skye ba gcig tu mkha' lding gi 'jigs pa las thar pa'i klu'i dbang po yang dag par gnas pa bzhin du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten na bla na med pa'i dgra bcom pa lha'i bla mar gyur to/ /sred med kyi bu/ de'i phyir sgyu ma chen mo rnam par rgyal ba thob par byed pa zhes bya ba'i gzugs sngags kyi tshig rnams khyod kyis zungs shig tabyathā/ na ma sna dh+wa nu ga ha pra tikhri te bh+ya:sarba budha bo dhi sa twa bh+ya: sarba mu drwa ma n+t+ra pa de bh+ya: oṃ mā ye ma hā mā ye ma hā mā yā dhā ra ṇi i i sā ma hā mā yā man+de ṇa ma hā mā yā rā pe ṇa/ bhā ma bhā ma ma ma sarba sa twa nāñtsa ye bi ṣ+pe dha kai dzin+ta yarnyi sa tha duṣ+ṭa sa tā stun+ta/ ma ya ma ya/ mo ha ya mo ha ya/ mu myu ya mu myu ya/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ biṭ+wāṃ sa ya biṭ+wāṃ sa ya/ ma ra ma 612

ra/ ma hā mā ye a la la la la ma hā mā yā dzā las ha sra mu khi sa ha sra shi ri sa ha sra bhu dze dz+wa li ta ne tre sarba tā thā ga ta hri da ya gadhe/ a si dha nu pa ra shu pā sha to ma ra ka na ya shalti mu guṇ+ḍi ta ste muṅga ra tsa kra ha ste e h+ye hi bha ga ba ti/ sarba ta thā ga ta sa tre na de pa rnyi ga ṇa sa tre na ma hā mā yā bi dza ya bā hi nī/ sma ra sma ra sarba ta thā ga ta dzñā na rū pe ṇa/ gats+tsha gats+tsha sar+pā ba ra ṇa k+ṣa yam̐ ka ri pa ra si n+ya bi drwa ba ṇi mo ha ya mo ha ya ma ma sarba satā ḍāṣ+ṭa sarba duhān/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa māṃ sarba sa tāñtsa saspu bha yo pa dra be bh+yaḥswā hā/ oṃ ma hā mā yā dhā ra tsā ye swā hā/ oṃ ma tī maṇ+ḍa lā dhi gle nā rnyikhri te swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dha ra brnyi ta pū dzi tā ye swā hā/ oṃ pad+ma yā ṇi pri yā la swā hā/ oṃ sarba de ba na ma skṛ te swā hā/ oṃ mā tram̐ ga ṇa badhi ta pū dzi tā ye swā hā/ oṃ dza ye swā hā/ oṃ bi dza ye ṭ+wā hā/ oṃ swā hā/ oṃ a bi dhi te swā hā/ oṃ a pa rā dzi te swā hā/ oṃ mo ha rī ye swā hā/ oṃsta m+bha nī ye swā hā/ oṃ dzam+bha nī ye swā hā/ oṃ dza yatī ye swā hā/ oṃ bh+ra ma tsā ye ṭ+wā hā/ oṃ bh+ra ma tsā ye swā hā/ oṃ sablo su ra da nī ye swā hā/ oṃ ma hā kā la brnyi ta pū dzi tā ye swā hā/ oṃ kā ma rū pi tsā ye swā hā/ oṃ mā yā rāk+ṣa sī ye swā hā/ oṃ ra ra swā hā/ oṃ rū rū r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭā ho dza ye mā yā bha ga ba ti ma hā mā yā bi dza ya pā hi nī grosna grosna shī gh+ra mā bi lasba sā ma ma sarba sa tā nāñtsa sarba kāshāku ru ku ru r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phatā phatra swā hā/ sred med kyi bu/'di ltar sgyu ma mo rnam par rgyal ba thob par byed pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi gsang sngags kyi tshig rnams zungs shig klogs shig gzhan rnams la'ang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston cig sred med kyi bu/ de nas g.yul 'gyed pa de'i tshe dmag dpung gnyis kyi bar du gnas lnga rnams su gzungs 'di'i 'khor lo shing rta'i dbyibs su sbyar bar bya'o/ /sred med bu/ gang gi tshe gnyis ka'i nang gi dbus su pha rol gyi dpung gi spyi bor shing rta'i dbus der sgyu ma chen po rnam par rgyal ba thob par byed pa zhes bya ba'i rig pa'i rgyal mo brgya stong phrag du ma'i gzugs dang brgya stong phrag du ma'i phyag dang ldan pa spyan gsum pa dmar nag 'bar ba'i zhal bzhi rnams kyis pha rol gyi dmag dpung za bar byed pa bzhin du bsam par bya'o/ /rang nyid 'khor los sgyur ba'i rnam par byas nas gdugs la gzungs gur gum gyis bri bar byas te rgyal po dang pha rol gyi dmag dpung rang bzhin gcig pa sgyu ma lta bus rab tu sgrib par byed cing snying po du mas rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /sred med kyi bu/ pha rol gyi dmag dpung rnams bcoms shing pham ste kha cig ni brgyal nas sa gzhi ltung bar smra'o/ /sred med kyi bu/ de ltar ltung ba'ang ji ltar mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam gyi chad pas drang par bya ba ste/ de rnams kyi 'tsho ba la bar du gcod pa'i 'bras bu can ni ma yin no/ /sred med kyi bu/ bsngags par 'os pa'i gzungs kyi mthu ni de lta bu'o/ /sred med kyi bu/ yang gang zhig gzungs sngags kyi tshig 'di rnams gtsang bar byas pas sam gtsang bar ma byas pas kyang rung / bskung bar byas bas sam bskung bar ma byas pas kyang rung nyi ma so so la lan 613

gsum du brjod par byed pa de nyid ni mtshams med pa lnga byas pa'ang sdig pa'i phung po zad par byas nas bsod nams kyi phung po thob cing skye ba dran par 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad kun tu khyab pa'i nor la nye bar longs spyod cing dge ba'i chos rnams mngon par dga' ste mi dge ba log par ltung ba rnams la ni ma yin no/ /sred med kyi bu/ yang gang zhig rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo'am dge slong ngam dge slong ma'am dge bsnyen nam dgi bsnyen ma'am rgyal po'am rgyal po'i bu'am bram ze'ang rung gzungs 'di 'dzin par byed pa 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa na dam pa'i chos kyi snang ba can du 'gyur zhing tshig pa'am thal bar gyur pa la'ang skyes pa'am bud med gang la la zhig gis reg par bgyid pa de nyid nges par skye ba dran par 'gyur ro/ /de nas sred med kyi bus byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la kye ma'o zhes ngo mtshar bar byas nas dung dang 'khor lo dang dbyug pa dang me tog gi phreng ba rnams bzhag ste stan las langs nas bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum du bskor zhing phyag byas te rab tu 'dzum pa dang bcas pa'i bzhin gyis bcom ldan 'das tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis bstod pa/ e ma lha dang lha min 'jig rten gyi/ /gtso bo mchog gyur bla na med pa ste/ /zhi ba zhi bar gyur pa legs bzung nas/ /'jig rten 'das la phyag 'tshal bstod par bgyi/ /chos rnams thams cad dngos med par/ /byung ba'i chos ni rab tu ston/ /chos dang chos min rnam par grol/ /chos bden khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de nas sred med kyi bus bcom ldan 'das la rab tu btud nas bcom ldan 'das khyed ni bdag gi khyab bdag go zhes byas nas song bar gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa 'di thos pa'i lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang dri za dang lha ma yin dang nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci dang lto 'phye chen po dang rig pa 'dzin pa dang chu skyes ma la sogs pa thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de rnams dang / lha
