dang mi dang lha ma yin dang na ma mkha' lding dang dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rang ste bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /sred med kyi bus zhus pa'i 'phags pa sgyu ma chen po rnams par rgyal ba thob par byed pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so/ / 'di ni sngar bod du bsgyur bar ma grags pa'i gzungs rig byed kyi lo rgyus la brten pa'i log rtog sel byed khyad par du 'phags pa ste rab byung bcu gsum pa'i dngos po'i lor/ rje btsun bla ma dpal rig pa 'dzin pa gang gis ne pā la'i yul nas rgya dpe btsal te bsgyur dgos pa'i bka' lung rta zam brgyud pheb par brten lo de'i khrums zla'i yar tshes bzang por mdo smad sde dge'i mnga' ris dpal spungs dgon par chos smra ba bstan pa'i nyin byed kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa shu r+ghaṃ dza skyo//rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya tā rā bha ṭ+wā ri kā nā mā ṣ+ṭa sha ta kai/ bod skad du/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol 614

ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa zhes bya ba/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan yid 'ong po ṭa la/ /sna tshogs khams kyis rnam par spras/ /sna tshogs ljon pa 'khri shing bkram/ /'dab chags du ma sgra 'byin pa/ /'bab chu sna tshogs lhung lhung sgrogs/ /ri dwags mang pos kun tu dkris/ /me tog sna tshogs rigs rnams kyis/ /kun tu dri yis bkang ba ste/ /sna tshogs yid 'ong 'bras bur ldan/ /rkang drug pa rnams glu sgra 'byin/ /mi'am ci rnams dbyangs snyan len/ /glang po myos pas rab tu gtams/ /grub pa rig 'dzin tshogs dang ni/ /dri ba rnams kyis glu blangs pa/ thub pa 'dod chags bral rnams kyis/ /rtag tu legs par bsten pa na/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs gzhan dang / /sa bcu'i dbang phyug rnams kyang ste/ /'phags ma sgrol sogs lha mo rnams/ /rig pa'i rgyal po stong rnams dang / /khro bo'i rgyal po'i tshogs gzhan dang / /rta mgrin la sogs kyis bskor ba'i/ /sems can kun la phan brtson pa/ /bcom ldan 'das ni spyan ras gzigs/ /bzhugs te de nas dpal dang ldan / /pad+ma'i snying po'i gdan bzhugs pa'i/ /dka' thub chen po dang ldan pa/ /byams dang snying rje ldan pa yis/ /lha yi 'khor ni rin po la/ /de yi chos ni ston par bzhengs/ /lag na rdo rje stobs chen po/ /der ni nye bar 'ong nas su/ /mchog tu snying rje dang ldan pa/ /des ni spyan ras gzigs la zhus/ /rkun po sbrul dang seṅge me/ /glang po stag dang chus dkrigs par/ /'phyan pa'i sems can 'di dag rnams/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor bying ba rnams/ /'khor ba'i zhags pas bcings pa rnams/ /chags sdang gti mug rang bzhin las/ /gang gis sems can grol byed pa/ /thub chen bdag la de gsungs shig dpal ldan de ni spyan ras gzigs/ /'jig rten mgon pos 'di skad gsungs/ /phyag na rdo rjes rtogs byed pa/ /snyan pa'i tshig ni gsungs pa'o/ /nyon cig gsang ba'i rgyal dbang po/ /skyobs pa 'od dpag med pa yi/ /smon lam dbang gis byung ba ste/ /bdag gi bka' yis 'jig rten ma/ /snying rje che dang ldan pa yis/ /'gro ba 'don par brtson pa po/ /nyi ma shar ba dang 'dra ba/ /zla ba nya 'dra byad kyi 'ong / /lha dang lha min mir bcas pa/ /'di rnams sgrol zhing snang bar byed/ /'jig rten gsum po g.yo bar byed/ /gnod sbyin srin po 'jigs par byed/ /lha mo ut+pal sngon po'i phyag/ /ma 'jigs ma 'jigs zhes brjod ma/ /'gro ba yang dag bsrung don du/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis bdag bskyed pas/ /'brog dgon mtshon cha ltung ba dang / /sna tshogs 'jigs pa 'khrugs pa'i tshe/ /ming rnams dran pa nyid kyis ni/ /bdag gis rtag tu sems can bsrung / /sna tshogs 'jigs pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis bsgral/ /des na bdag la 'jig rten du/ /thub pa'i tshogs kyis sgrol mar sgrogs/ /de nas gus bcas legs gnas shing / /thal mo sbyar bar byas nas ni/ /'bar bzhin bar snang la gnas te/ /'di skad tshig ni gsol 615

bar gyur/ /gang zhig rgyal dang sa bcu yi/ /dbang phyug mgon po byang chub sems/ /rdzu 'phrul che rnams sngon bsgrags pa'i/ /sdig kun 'phrog cing bsod nams dang / /bkra shis grags pa 'phel byed pa/ /nor dang 'bru dang dpya nyid dang / /nad med 'byor pa 'phel bar byed/ /tshe dang nad med bde skyid pa/ /sems can thams cad bde la thob cing / /sems can kun gyi dpal dang ni/ /shis pa 'jog cing rnam spel ba/ /mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gsungs shing / /sems can rnams la byams mdzad nas/ /thub pa chen po de sgrogs shig/ /'di skad zhus la bcom ldan 'das/ /spyan ras gzigs ni rab tu bzhad/ /byams pa 'phro ba'i spyan ras kyis/ /phyogs rnams kun tu rnam gzigs nas/ /bsod nams mtshan gyis brgyan pa yi/ /g.yas pa'i phyag ni bskyod mdzad nas/ /de gsungs shes rab shin tu che/ /legs so legs so dka' thub che/ /sems can kun la gcig tu brtse/ /bskal pa chen po'i ming rnams nyon/ /mi rnams gang zhig 'di sgrogs pa/ nor gyi dbang phyug yang dag 'gyur/ /nad rnams kun las rnam par grol/ /dbang phyug yon tan thams cad ldan/ /dus min 'chi ba nges par bsregs/ /she ba bde ba can 'gro ba/ /de rnams bdag gis bshad par bya/ /lha yi dge 'dun bdag la nyon/ /'dir khyod rjes su yi rang byos/ /legs par bsdams pa mchis par mdzod/ /oṃ lo tsa ni su lo tsa ni/ tā re/ tā ro dha be/ sar+bha sa tā nu kaspi ni/ sasba sa two t+ta ri ṇi/ sa ha sra bhu dze/ sa ha sra ne tre/ oṃ na mo bha ga ba tī a pa lo ka ya/a ba lo ka ya/ māṃ sarba sa rta sh+tsa r+ghaṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ sidhe su sidhe/ su ga tā t+ma dze mi tī kṛ pā ni smra le/ byā me byā ma rū pe ma hā pralha ba ra ba ra be bhū ṣi te/ oṃ a pa rā dzi tā ma hā ro dz+rī bi shwa rū r+pā ma hā ba lā/ oṃ saḥshrī ta r+ya thā/ oṃ dge ba ma ni gzi brjid che/ /'jig rten gso byed snyan pa che/ /mtsho ldan ma dang spyan yangs ma/ /shes rab dpal dang blo 'phel ma/ /brtan sbyin gso sbyin ma swā hā/ /oṃ yig 'dod pa'i gzugs can ma/ /sems can kun la phan brtson ma/ /g.yul las sgrol byed rgyal ba mo/ /lha mo shes rab phar phyin ma/ /'phags ma sgrol ma yid 'ong ma/ /gang ma rnga chen dung can ma/ /rig pa'i rgyal mo tshig snyan ma/ /zla ba'i gdong can dkar mo che/ /mi pham ma dang gos ser ma/ /sgyu ma chen mo dkar chen mo/ /stobs chen pha rol gnon pa mo/ /drag mo chen mo gtum chen mo/ /sdang ba'i sems can rlag byed ma/ /rab tu zhi ma zhi gzugs ma/ /rnam par rgyal ma 'bar 'od ma/ /glog gi phreng ma rgyal mtshan ma/ /ral gri 'khor lo gzhu thogs mtshon/ /rmugs byed rengs byed nag mo dang / /dus mtshan ma dang mtshan spyod ma/ /srung byed rmongs byed zhi ba mo/ /zhu ma dge ma su sgrol ma/ /tshangs rig ma dang rig byed yum/ /gsang len ma dang phug gnas ma/ /bkra shis bde byed zhi byed ma/ /skyes pa rig byed yid mgyogs ma/ /thod pa can ma shugs chen ma/ /mtshams ma bden ma gzhan las rgyal/ /ded dpon chen mo snying rjes 'jug / 616

chud mi za ba/ nyams la lam ni rab ston ma/ /mchog ster 'chos byed ston pa mo/ /bud med gzugs la dpag med gnon/ /grub ma ri khrod rnam 'byor ma/ /gdol ma nges ma bdud rtsi ma/ /nor can bsod nams skal chen ma/ /skal bzang ma dang grogs ston ma/ /gshin rje skrag byed 'jig byed ma/ /drag shul drag shul dka' thub che/ /'gro la gcig tu phan brtson ma/ /skyob ma gus la mnyen gshin ma/ /zhi ma phra mo ngag dbang phyug /rtag ma kun ci mar gyur ma/ don kun sgrub byed bzang ngo ma/ /sbas ma ma ma nor sbyin ma/ /'jigs med go ta mā rab bshad/ /dpal ldan 'jig rten dbang sras mo/ /yon tan mtha' yas sgrol ma'i mtshan/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs byed pa'o/ /oṃ tā re kṛ pā pa lo ba na/ mi t+yā twa ke shra pa tsā ye swā hā/ mtshan rgya brgyad 'di dag ni/ phan par 'dod pas bskrags pa ste/ /gsang ba las ni mchog tu gsang / /lhas kyang rnyed par shin tu dka'/ /skal bzang skal ba can du byed/ /sems can thams cad bde bar 'jug /sdig pa kun 'phrog bsod nams te/ /nyes pa thams cad 'joms byed pa'o/ /blo ldan gang zhig gtsang byas nas/ /mnyam bzhag dus gsum klog byed pa/ /de ni mi ring dus nyid du/ /rgyal srid dpal ni thob par 'gyur/ /sdug can rtag tu bde bar 'gyur/ /dbul po rnams ni nor ldan 'gyur/ /'dir ni blun po shes rab che/ /yid gzhungs can 'gyur the tshom med/ /bcings pa 'ching las grol bar 'gyur/ /tha snyad las ni rgyal bar 'gyur/ /dgra bo rnams ni bshes su 'gyur/ /rwa can dang ni mche ba can/ /bgrod dka' dogs dang 'thab mo yang / /sna tshogs 'jigs pa 'khrugs pa'i tshe//mtshan ni 'di rnams dran pa yis/ /'jigs pa thams cad sel bar 'gyur/ /dus min 'chi las sgrol bar byed/ /snyan grags rol mo 'thob par 'gyur/ /de gcig pus ni bdag nyid che/ /mi rnams skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ /gang zhig mi ni sngar langs nas/ /'di nyid sgrogs par byed pa de/ /dus ring por yang tshe dang ldan/ /mi yi dpal yang rnyed par 'gyur/ /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang / /de bzhin dri za lus srul po/ /sha za srin po 'jigs rung dang / /ma mo drag po'i sems ldan pa/ /gnon po 'gro ma yi dwags/ /skem byed smyo byed gza' de bzhin/ /ro langs sems sgyur sbod gtong gang / /gdug pa'i sems ldan gzhan gyis kyang / /grib ma yang ni 'god mi nus/ /slar yang de yi smos ci dgos/ /sems can gdug pas gsod mi 'gyur/ /grib gnon dang ni brjed byed nyid/ /gshed byed byad ltem la sogs dang / nad rnams kyis kyang theb mi 'gyur/ /lha dang lha min 'thab pa yang / rdzu 'phrul chen pos nyams su myong / /longs spyod dbang phyug yon tan ldan/ /bu dang tsha bo rnam par 'phel/ /blo ldan skye ba dran par 'gyur/ /rigs dang ldan zhing mthong na dga'/ /gnyen dang ldan zhing smra mkhas che/ /bstan bcos kun la 'jigs pa med/ /dge ba'i bshes la yang dag bsten/ /byang chub sems kyi rgyan dang ldan/ / 617

rtag tu skye ba gang gang du/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang mi 'bral lo/ /rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa rdzogs so/ /zhes pa 'di ni rje btsun bla ma rig pa 'dzin pa chen pos ne pā la'i yul nas byung ba'i rgya dpe stsal nas gser gyi kāk+ṣu pa ṇa'i gnang skyes dang bcas te sgyur cig ces mnga' ris stod nas bya ma rta'i lam brgyud de bka' pheb pa bzhin si tu pa bstan pa'i nyin byed kyis dpal gdong gi lo tha skar can gyi yar tshes brgyad kyi nyin mdo smad sde dge'i mnga' ris thub bstan chos 'khor gling gi gtsug lag khang du bsgyur ba ste/ sngar bsgyur pa rnams dang mi mtshungs pa dang lhag pa 'ga' zhig 'dug kyang tshig don gyi char 'di nyid legs tshang phul du byung bar rtogs so/ /maṅga lo/ /rgya gar skad du/ nā ga dat+ta dhā ra ṇi nā ga skṛ ya nā ma/ bod skad du/ klus byin pa'i gzungs klu'i snying po zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klus byin rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /gsungs pa'i rig pa klog byed gang / /skyes bu de la klu tshogs kyis/ /'jigs pa cung zad 'byung mi 'gyur/ /tabya thā/ oṃ a ri ba ri bi bā ra/ sha ba ri/ sharba ri/mā ri/ mā ma ṭi/ ṭi ṭa/ mā mā ma ṭi/ mā bi ṣa mā/ ban+d+ra ga phuḥ phuḥ sha ba rī yi/ phuḥphuḥ gu mā rā/ sha ba rī ye/ phuḥphuḥ ku mā rā/ sha ba rī ye/ phuḥphuḥ ki rā ta/ sha ba rī ye/ phuḥphuḥ ṭhaḥṭhaḥswā hā/ oṃ sha ba ri/ sha ba ri/ ma hā sha ba ri/ bin+dha parba ta/ bā si ni/ ka tha ya ti/ sarba nā gā ṭ+wāṃ bā su ki sh+tsa/ ba tso ya thā/mā māṃ hirlu skyo/ ban+d+ra gāḥ.i dasbyo ṣ+ṭa sa ma yi nā gwa dz+dza nī ya kai/ oṃ baṃ nā ga rā dzā māṃ/ nā gā dz+dza no/ dzñā pa ya ti/phuḥphuḥṭhaḥṭhaḥswā hā/ oṃ a ṭi ma ṭi ma hā bi bye pi na te bi bya rū pi ṇi ha na ha na sarba bi ṣā na de bi su tra ga sna/ ga ti rū paṃ phuḥphuḥ ṭhaḥthaḥswā tra bā oṃ sru tra bāt+tasu ti ṣe swā hā/ i h+ye baṃ kā sh+ya bo tsā ba oṃ ti/ a na ku li na ku li ma hā na ku li sab su mu khaṃ bad+dha bad+dha/ bi ṣe bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa phuḥphuḥṭhaḥṭhaḥswā hā/ oṃ ka dru nā gā ṭ+wāṃ/mā te ma hā bā she saṃ ha ra sarba bi ṣā na de bi bhu ta/ swā ba ra dzaṅga mā phuḥphuḥṭhaḥṭhaḥswā hā/ oṃ na ku li na ku li ma hā na ku li ha ra bi ṣe/ agle māṃ/ nā ga ta dzñā ṭ+wāṃ/ na bā māṃ/ gho ṇa sā tsā/ kho ḍa shā māṃ/ tsi tre kā māṃ/e ka dzi sha ti byan+ta rā tsā tu/ ā ha ra bi ṣe bha k+ṣa ya bi ṣe hrīḥ k+ṣe me ka ri r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kru saḥ o bā su ki/oṃ a nan+ta/ oṃ tak+ṣa ka/ oṃ karko ṭa ka/ /oṃ pad+ma/ oṃ ma hā pad+ma/ oṃ shaṃ kha pā la/ oṃ ku slo ka/ oṃ ā ste ka /oṃ bi na te ya kha ra buts+tsha/ draṣ+ṭa sto ṇa sa kharba rī ya ka/ harla mā lā tsi lu ra sau ṇ+ḍa su baṇ+ḍi re kha/ nā ga rā dzā pu tā tsā ṣa ḍa bir+sha ti nā ma gra ha tsā tra bi ṣa nā ste/ kā la be lā nā ste phuḥphuḥṭhaḥṭhaḥswā hā/ gal te nyin dang mtshan mo ru/ /kun tu gnas pas 'jug pa na/ /gang zhig rtag tu 'di dran ba/ /sbrul gyi 'jigs pas 'jigs mi 'gyur/ /klus byin pa'i gzungs klu yi snying po rdzogs so/ /klu sgrub zhabs kyis sa 'og nas spyan drangs/ /ces pa'ang kun khyab kyis bskul ba ltar bstan pa'i nyid byed kyis bsgyur ba'o/ / 618

rog /smon lam bzang po thar pa'i sgo 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /o su sti/ zang pad 'byung nam mkha' snying po yis/ /smon lam dbang gi 'gro 'dul bla ma mchog /'khor lo'i mgon po tshe dbang nor bu la/ /snying nas phyag 'tshal gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gi 'khor ba thog med nas brtsams te /bye brag tshe 'dir so thar byang sems dang / khyad par gsang sngags dam tshig gnyen po la/ /nyams chag ral dang pham ltung gyur pa kun/ /snying nas 'gyod pas bshags so dag par shog /dus 'di nas bzung byang chub snying po'i bar/ /mgon po khyed dang tshom bu gcig tu 'grogs/ /sgo gsum rtag tu bag yod dran pa yis/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma dgyes dgu'i bsgrubs par shog/ /byang sems nor bzang dag gi 'jam dpal dang / /rtag tu ngu yi chos 'phags bsten pa bzhin/ /thar pa'i srog rtsa bla ma bsten pa la/ /g.yel med bdag gi rtag tu bsnyen par shog /de bzhin na ro ta pas ti slo dang / /zhi ba sbas pas ye shes bshes gnyen zhabs/ /bsten bzhin bla ma dgyes pa'i las bzang po/ /tshe rabs sku ngal med pa bsgrubs par shog / mdor na kun bzang pad 'byung nam mkha' snying / /bka' drin gsum ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma yis/ /theg chen thugs bskyed smon lam bzang po'i mtha'/ /ji tsam de kun bdag gi'ang 'grub par shog /skye kun bla ma'i thugs kyi sras su gyur/ /'gro la phan gdags byas pa drin tu bzo/ /g.yo sgyu med par dam tshig la 'bad pas/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas dges la rtag spyod shog /de ltar bdag gi smon lam bzang po 'di/ /bslu ba med cing nges pa nyid 'grub par/ /dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa gsum rab 'byams/ /dpang gyur tshad mar gyur pas mdzad du gsol/ /zhes snyigs dus kyi 'gro ba nyon mongs rags par gyur pas na smon lam 'di lta bu phan che bar mthong ba dang mched grogs rnam pa tshos kyang nan tan bskul bar brten bla ma'i bka' 'bangs pa rnal 'byor zhi ba rdo rjes lhag pa'i bsam pas bris pa don dang ldan pa'o/ /'di la rtag tu kha 'don byas na phan yon bsam gyi mi khyab pa thob cing lhag par 'chi kha mar lan gsum bklags par nus na thar pa'i lam sna zin zhes rtsa ba'i bla ma kun bzang 'phrin las 'gro 'dul rtsal gyi dam bcas pa'o/ /gang zhig nyams chags can bsog 'jog can yod na rtsa ba'i bla ma dang rdo rje sems dpa' gnyis su med par bsgom ste nyin re bzhin yig brgya rmer brgya re nyung mthar byas shing smon lam 'di nyid lan gsum brjod na nyams chags dag pa la kun bzang po'i khrus chu yin no/ /sarba maṅga lo/ /swā sti/ kun bzang 619

pad+ma thod phreng zhi dang khro/ /mchog gsum rtsa gsum rab 'byams bdag la dgongs/ /dge ba 'di sogs dus gsum bsags kun gyi/ /bla ma'i dgongs rdzogs pha ma'i drin lan 'khor/ /tshe dbang nor bu'i theg chen smon lam kun/ /bslu med bgegs med nyid du 'grub par shog /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ tabyathā/pāñtsa pri ya a wa bho dha na ye swā hā/ /༄ga /kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer la gsol 'debs gzhom med rdo rje'i smrin sgra bzhugs so/ /a ho/ gangs can mkhas grub kyi dbang po/ /kun mkhyen dri med kyi 'od zer/ /'od gsal rdo rje snying po/ /rtsol med theg mchog gi bdag por/ /gsol 'debs bu mchog la dgongs dang / /ka dag spros bral gyi lta ba/ /gzhi thog rig stong gi ngang du/ /gang shar gsal stong du rang grol/ /lhun grub 'od gsal gyi gzigs mo/ /sgron ma bzhi ldan gyi 'phrul 'khor/ /snang stong gong 'phel dang tshad phebs/ /sku dang zhing khams kyi snang ba/ /ye nas 'du 'bral du med pa/ /a la la ho/ rdu sirnyi/ don dam rang rig gi rtsal dbang / /skad cig dus 'di ru stsol cig /zhes rtsod med gter ston rig 'dzin chen po chos rje gling pa yis kun mkhyen rgyal ba dri med 'od zer la gsol 'debs a ti rdzogs par gyi rang skad ci lta ba thol byung rdo rje'i gsung byin brlabs kyi mtshan kha rmad du byung ba ste/ /thog ma'i tshig 'bru gnyis dang mtha'i sh+lau ka yi kha bskang tshigs rkang phyed gsum kaḥthog sprul sku rig pa 'dzin pas so/ /sarba maṅga lo bha waskyo/ /༄ga /'jam dpal nā ga rak+ṣa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i snyan brgyud zhal shes bzhugs so/ /dang po phyag rgya'i rgyas gdab pa la ye shes phyag rgya lha la gdab/ /dam tshig gi phyag rgya rang la gdab/ /las kyi phyag rgya klu la gdab/ /klu'i phyag rgya dgra la gdab pa'o/ /de la dang po ye shes phyag rgya lha la gdab pa la/ bskyed rim ma byas par gnas lugs kyi ngang nas 'bru bzhi sa ya tsam 'grub na rab/tha ma'ang 'bum phrag gcig bzla/ gnyis pa bskyed rim gsal zhing / ye shes sems dpa' su war+ṇa tāspyaḥde'i thugs kar pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i sgrubs su rdo rje rtse lnga phyed pa/ lte bar/ phe/ nag po'i mthar 'bru bzhi bkod/ 'dab brgyad la'ang klu'i srog sngags thun mong min pa spro na bkod de sa ya'am 'bum 620

phrag sogs bzlas pas/ aṣ+ṭa se nā rnams ādzñā'i 'og tu 'dus so snyam pa dang / pad ta la za ba dang /mūrti tsha zhum dang drod skye ba'o/ /de las thal nas dam tshig gi phyag rgya dngos su theb rtags 'ong gsum pa ni/ rang 'jam dpal gyi zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i 'og tu ru spal chen po zhig bsam/ de la gnod byed klu rigs thams cad bstems nas rang gi lus las klu'i dug rnams de la bstem/ bzhi pa ni/ de nyid rang gi dgra bo la bstem par bya/ thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag gi gnad gal po che/ sgang sap+ta tī thi bar+ya dzā pra/ gshong sap+ta tī thi kirtsi ta dzā pra/ 'then pa sap+ta tī thi ya dzā pra/ rnams shin tu gal che/'di'i phyi ma'i skabs/ a haṃ tsa nā ga de'i spyi bor rdor sems bsgoms nas nad gdon bskru ba'i dmigs pa la 'bad do/ /klu rgyal rigs spyi gtsug na/ nor bu dbang / rje'u rigs kyi phrag pa g.yas su nor bu 'bar ba/ bram ze'i nu ma g.yas su khrus kyi bum pa/ rmongs rigs kyi byin pa dang gdol pa'i gsang ba rnams su klu gtad byas kyang dgra la mi gnod par bzang bar 'gyur ba yin/ /

rog /dreg 'dul nag po gnam lcags 'khor lo las: gtum po nā ga rak+ṣa'i sgrub yig snying byang dmar khrid bzhugs so/ /thugs dam gsang ba'i lha la 'dudoḥ gsang sgrub rdo rje me 'bar gyi+oḥ sgrub yig snying byang dmar khrid bstan: gzhung ltar bskyed rim gsal btab nas: dzab khang dbye dus mdun bskyed ni: sku smad dbal sham can du bskyed: rlung ri mi shigs rgya gram mtshams: tsha grang 'khrugs pa'i e dbyings su:gnod byed sde brgyad mi ma yin: byad ma'i snying khar gzir zhing bsnun: bdag mdun gnas gzhi'i lha rnams kyi: thugs kar nyi steng rang mdog gi: khrotrīḥr+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ mtha' ma ru: drag sngags spu gris gtams bzhin gsal: rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: 'od 'phros mdun bskyed thugs dam bskul: drag sngags 'brug sgra ltar sgrogs pa: g.yas su 'khor las 'od zer 'phros: phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams: drag gtum 'bar ba'i thugs dam bskul: zhing kun me 'bar kun nas g.yos: r+ghaṃ sgra thog chen bu yug 'tshubs: nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi byin mchedoḥ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad nas: 'jigs gzugs rngams sgra stobs ldan rnamasoḥ gnam lcags thog char ltar babs nas: mdun du bskyed pa la thim pas: de yang sku che yan lag rags: stong khams zil gnon ye shes 'bar:thugs srog rnams las 'od 'phros pas: bdag gi gnas bzhir thim pa yis: 'od 'bar gzi byin cher mched pasoḥ yig 'bru'i rang bzhin rtsa khams khyab: rang sgras 'brug ltar me phung 'bar: ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas: rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa zhugs su 'phro: lus gdon thams cad gzhob tu btul: khrag 'thung bye bas go tshad gtams: lcags steg bya khyung tshwa tshwa khol: bdag mdun 'od zer drwa ba yis:snod bcud 'byung khams ma lus pa: ye shes mthu stobs rdzogs par dmigs: rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bcu+oḥ le lo tshig bar ma chod par: dam par mtshams bcas bzlas pa'i rtags: rdo rje'i go gyon nyi zla sharoḥ mchod rten brtsegs dang rdzong btsan bzung : dung 'bud gter rnyed rol mo 'khrol: me tog thu dang phyag mtshan rnyed: chu bo brgal dang mkha' la 'phuroḥ gru zam 'dzug dang mi mang 'dud:rgya mtsho rngubs dang ri bo 'phen: ri chen phan tshun zhabs 'og brdzis: nyi zla mtshon cha khong du mid:khyad par sgo gsum bde ba dang : rig rtsal phyogs med 'bar ba sogasoḥ yi dam lha yis rjes bzung rtags: mon pa 'bag seng gar mkhan dang : rta drel ra lug gnag phyugs sogasoḥ gyen du phyogs 622

dang tshur la rgol: 'ja' tshon zug dang mtshon cha phog: thog ser rbab dang gzhan gyis ded: chus khyer mun gling 'khyams pa sogs: byad gdon 'tsho dang slong ba'i rtags: thog mar cho 'phrul zar zir mar: ci ltar 'tshub cing rtags myur zab: dar du dbang 'dus bka' nyan rtags: mi mang 'khol dang gus 'dud sogs: cho 'phrul lha rtags ci byung yang : re dogs med pa'i ngang nas bzla: legs nyes rten 'brel so mtshams pa: rmi lam nyams su gang 'byung ba: nyams rtogs bral ba'i thog rdzis kyis: bcad gtub bsad gtor dmigs med gzhom: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: thashaṣapashaṭaḥ sgrub pa'i skabs su ting 'dzin gsar: sgrub rdzas nus sbar stobs bskyed de+oḥ 'od kyis srid gsum gdug pa btul: snod bcud 'bar ba'i bcud kun bsdus: zhing kun gcig tu rdzogs par dmigs: gsang sngags 'bum phrag gsum bzla'o+oḥ sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: las sbyor skabs su dgra bgegs gnyis: dgra 'dul lcog brdung gung du bkod: byang stems rbod gtong gshed dbab na: 'od zer sprul pa'i pho nya yis: bsrung bya'i gur bcom r+ghaṃ du gyuroḥ yo las rlung gis dmigs med gtor: don po'i tshe bsod yi dam lha: 'od zhu r+ghaṃ gyur bdag la thim: mgon med skyabs bral 'dar med par: nad mtshon dug char bu yug gtibs: snying nang dz+ra la spu gri bsnol: de las rtsibs ldan grangs med 'phros: shugs drag 'khor bas srog rtsa gtubs: sha rus nang khrol dbang por bcas: lha dang dam can rnams kyis rol: rnam shes tshe bkrag bdag la bsdu: skabs su dgug gzhug thun char dbab: khrohrī:hūṃ gi sngags sham du: byad stems pho mo'i snying la ram̐: rtsal rbad: srog la brang : sha la myog: khrag la thun bh+yo: mā ra ya rbad nanoḥ phas kyi rtags dang sbyar la bzla: rtags rdzogs bsreg mnan las mjug bsdu: de ni spyi ru bstan pa yin: bye brag sde brgyad rang gcod loḥ gshin rje mkhan dang nang 'gras na: snying khar ya nang dz+ra yig gzhug: ya las 'od zer spu gri 'phros: rtsa bsreg gtubs sogs gong bzhin la: ya ma du: ya ma sad: ya ma nan: ya ma ge che mo e gu sha dza dzoḥ mā ya nadoḥ ces btags bzlas shing ma mo la: ma ma ru lu du sogs 'gre: mu stegs mkhan la ti rti ka du: gza' gdon mkhan la raklo du: lha rabs mkhan la dhe ba du: gnod sbyin mkhan la yak+ṣa du: rgyal po mkhan la rā dza du: lha btsan mkhan la rā tsa du: the'u rang mkhan la sā dhu du: rig 'dzin mkhan la rū tra du: phug bdag mkhan la ru tri du: sngags mjug gong dang 'gre bar sbyar: thun mthar sprul pa'i sde brgyad bskuloḥ lus kyi gnas brgyad gshed chen bskor: des ni phas kyi byas pa bshigoḥ 'byung ba bzlog par the tshom med: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gnyis pa sde brgyad mi ma yin: sa bdag klu gnyan byad gdon la: bdag mdun 'khor lo'i 'od zer las: bya khyung phag sdig dug sbrul sogs: mtshon cha'i tshwa tshwa dpag med 'phros: phyogs 623

bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gyi: 'jig rten srid pa mtha' nas sdud: gnod byed rnams kyi snying rtsa nang : lcags kyus bzung zhing spyi nas brdungs: de dag las kyang 'od zer gyis: sa chu me rlung 'byung ba'i khams: kun kyang rang gshed pho nyar gyur: drag par stobs dang ldan pa yis: byad gdon sa bdag klu gnyan dang : sde brgyad mi min 'dre rgod sogs: hab hab tshim tshim bzung zhing 'cha':skad ngan cir dir dgug gzhug bstem: srid pa khro chu khol ma'i bzhin: gnam lcags tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrug: gzhom gzhig bral ba'i ngang du lta: bsnyen pa'i sngags kyi sham bu ru: trig khro ga ru ṇa gnod byed pho mo'i srog la rbad: khrag la rbad: rus la rbad: klad la rbad: rtsa rgyus la rbad: yid la rbad:trig khrog ru ṇa gnod byed pho mo'i tsit+ta zung : tsit+ta rmugs: tsit+ta phyungs: tsit+ta rdzubs: tsista myogs:tsit+ta sum̐ ri li la ya bh+yo: trig khro ga ru ṇa gnod byed pho mo'i srog rtsa chod: snying rtsa phyungs: khaṃ khaṃ lo lo rbad: du ma bur rbud: nā ga rā tsa gnod byed mā ra ya rbad sod: myog baṃ ril mā ra ya rbad sod:ces bzlas sbal sbrul glang dmar bsang : shing chen bcad dang nags me sngar: rdzing brtol chu stam mkhar snyel dang : rbab sgril brag gshog rol mo brdung : mgo snying sha khrag nang khrol spyod: bsad bcad rtags ni dpag med 'byung : khri phrag la sogs skabs dang sbyar: de ltar thul ba'i rtags rdzogs nas: bdag mdun gnyis med ngar bskyed la: chu srin kha nas 'brug stong ldir: dpal sham ngoms las mtshon tshogs dang : spu gri 'bar ba'i 'khor lo 'phros: gnod byed snying la gzir zhing bsregs:las dang rgyu rkyen drung nas phyung : srid pa'i spyi gnon dgongs pa nyid: ma yengs rtse gcig 'dzin phur gdab: sgrub pa'i sngags kyi sham bu ru: oṃ tsakra du na gnod byed pho mo mgo la chom chom: nā ga'i mgo la chom: zhe sdang sha la myogs: 'dod chags khrag la rbud: nga rgyal tsit+ta la gzer: dbang po yan lag zung : nā ga'i yan lag zung : 'grim 'grim/ nā ga'i dbang po yan lag 'grim: rtsa thang rtsa thang :nā ga'i snying rtsal thang : rtsa rgyus dbugs la sum̐ ril: nā ga'i dbugs la sum̐ ril: rtag byed rus la khri khye:nā ga'i rus la khri:'ching byed srog la rbad rbad:nā ga'i srog la rbad: rgyal byed srog la rbud rbud: nā ga'i srog la rbud:nā ga rā tsa sod sod:bying bying thib thib myogs myogs rbad rbad:nā ga rā tsa'i srog la thim thim:phob phob snying steng la thob:spu gri 'bar bas gnod byed pho mo'i snying drongs:nā ga rā tsa sum̐ ril dza:mā ra ya baṃ ril: mā ra ya rbad: khri phrag gcig bzla rū pa thun gyis phrab: skabs su mchod bstod thugs dam gnad nas bskul:phur gdab tshe khrus gnas lung spyi bzhin bya: mtha' sdud hom bsreg thal ba zhabs su mnan: mdze nad can la byugs pa'i rdzas la bsngags: sdig srin byang nag sbrul sha gla rtsi dang : shug pa seng ldeng mar khu nyid du sbyar: ha sa ha sa ki li ha sa: sho tri pho phing : 624

tsadaḥ ha sa ha sa ha r+ghaṃ: sman chen nas 'bru phyed tsam la: brgya rtsa re bzlas longs spyod sbyinoḥ sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e ma: shin tu zab pa'i snying byang ste: dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'i bu ma gtogs: ma 'chal dpe kha dam du chings: las can bu yi snying la brnag: bka' srung dam can thub par srungs:sa ma ya: gu h+ya: kha the: rgya rgya rgya:༄sto /nā ga rak+ṣa'i dmigs pa'i man ngag zhal rgyun shin tu zab pa bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāste/ bla ma dang 'jam dpal rdo rje gnyis su med pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mo dri ma med pa la dus dang rnam pa thams cad du phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs mchi'o/ /'dir 'jam dpal nā ga rak+ka'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bzlas dmigs snyan brgyud zhal shes zin bris su bkod par/ /phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas btab pa la/ye shes kyi phyag rgya lha la btab pa/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya rang la 'debs pa/ las kyi phyag rgya klu la 'debs pa/ klu'i phyag rgya dgra la 'debs pa dang bzhi'o/ /de la dang po ye shes kyi phyag rgya lha la btab pa ni/ /bskyed rim ma byas par gnas lugs kyi ngang nas 'bru bzhi sa ya tsam 'grub na rab/ tha ma'ang 'bum gcig bzla/ gnyis pa ni/ bskyed rim gsal zhing / ye shes sems dpa' gser gyi bya khyung /de'i thugs kar pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i sbubs su rdo rje rtse lnga phyed pa/ lte bar yi ge dze nag po'i mthar 'bru bzhi bkod/ 'dab ma brgyad la'ang klu'i srog sngags thun mong min pa spro na bkod de/ sa ya'am 'bru 'bum phrag sogs bzlas pas sde brgyad thams cad bka' 'og tu 'dus so snyam pa dang / rkang mthil za ba dang / lus la tsha zhum pa drod skye ba'o/ /de las tha na dam tshig gi phyag rgya dngos su thebs rtags 'ong / gsum pa ni/ rang 'jam dpal gyi zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i 'og tu ru sbal chen po zhig bsam/ de la gnod byed klu rigs thams cad bsnyims nas rang gi lus las klu'i dug rnams de la bstem/ bzhi pa ni/ de nyid rang gi dgra bo la bstem par bya/ thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag gi gnad gal po che sgang gshod 'then gsum las/ dang po zhag bdun gyi ring la shin tu brtson pas sngags bzla ba ni sgang / de nas zhag bdun gyi ring sngags cung zad las mi bzla ba ni gshod/ de nas zhag bdun gyi ring sngags ye nas mi bzla bar rang dang klu gdon gnyis ka'i spyi bor rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom nas yig brgya bzlas te nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bkru ba'i dmigs pa la 'bad pa ni 'then pa ste/ tshul de bzhin du 'bad pa shin tu gal che/ 'di'i sgo nas klu gtad byed skabs su klu 625

rgyal rigs kyi spyi gtsug nor bu dbang rgyal/ rje'u rigs kyi phrag pa g.yas su nor bu 'bar ba/ bram ze'i nu ma g.yas su khrus kyi bum pa/ dmangs rigs kyi byin pa dang / gdol pa'i gsang gnas rnams su klu gtad byas kyang dgra la mi gnod bar bzang bar 'gyur bas spang bar bya dgos/ zhes pa de rnams dpal rig pa 'dzin pa chen po rdo rje tshe dbang nor bu'i zhal snga nas ji ltar stsal ba rnams ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtshos zin bris su btab pa maṅga lo/ /rog /rdzogs pa chen po gsang ba snying thig yang zab bsdus pa'i snying po lasaḥ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ /rgya gar skad du: ār+ya tā rā a mā ra ṇi ye sā dha na nā moḥ bod skad du: 'phags ma sgrol ma 'chi ba med pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba: bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med pa la phyag 'tshal lo: skal ldan lam zhugs brtson 'grus can: tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa'i phyir: rje btsun sgrol ma bsgrub 'dod na: dben zhing dang ba'i sa phyogs su: rang nyid bde ba'i stan la 'dug: 'di nyid rten dang mchod rdzas bsham: bum pa bum rdzas chus bkang ba: mchod pa'i 'dun du bshams par bya: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yan lag bdun: sngon 'gro'i chos rnams rdzogs par bya: de nas ma hā shu dzñā ta: dzñā na'i sngags kyis mi dmigs pa'i: stong pa nyid du bsam par bya: stong dang snying rje'i ngang nyid las:rang mdun nam mkhar pad+ma dkar: 'dab brgyad steng du zla ba'i gdan: ā yig dkar po 'od zer 'phro: kha dog lnga dang ldan pa las: 'phro 'dus skad cig dran rdzogs su: 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sku: sku mdog man shel mdog ltar dkaroḥ g.yas pa'i phyag ni mchog sbyin dang : phyag g.yon me tog ut+pal 'dzin: zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs: zhal 'dzum 'od 'phro spyan gsum ldan: phyag zhabs mthil du spyan rtsa re: ut+pal zhi ba'i spyan bdun ldan: rin chen rgyan brgyad rnam par mjes: dar la'i stod g.yogs smad sham can: de thugs zla ba'i dal dbus su: t+t+waṃyig dkar po ring cha can: mtha' skor rtsibs brgyad yig 'brus mtshanoḥ de las 'od zer 'phros pa las:'phags ma ye shes sems dpa' la: sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs kyis bskor: chos kyi dbyings nas byon par bsam: ār+ya tā re badz+ra sa ma ya dza: oṃ ār+ya tā re e h+ye hi a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ye shrī hūṃ: pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ: ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod: rgyu+oḥ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma: tudhā re yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol: tu res na ba rnams la yang : sgrol ma khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces bstod lha mo de 626

nyid kyi: sku las 'od zer dpag med 'phros: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams: rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas rnam par byon: lha mo de nyid sku la thim: mdun gyi 'phags ma 'od du gyur: rang gi lus la thim pa yis: rang nyid 'phags ma'i skur gyur pa'i: snying gar pad dkar 'dab brgyad kyi:dbus su zla gdan de yi dbus: t+t+waṃ yig dkar po ring cha can: 'dab brgyad cung zhig kha zlum pa'i:rtsibs brgyad yi ge 'bru brgyad po: mar me'i phreng ba ltar 'khor bas: de las 'od ljang dpag med 'phros: mi shigs rdo rje'i gur khang gyur: 'od zer dkar po dpag med 'phros: nad gdon bgegs dang bar chad zhi+oḥ 'od zer dmar po dpag med 'phros: 'khor 'das tshe bsod thams cad bsdus:'od zer ser po dpag med 'phrosoḥ tshe dang bsod nams thams cad spel: 'od zer mthing ga dpag med 'phros: gnyen pos mi shig rdo rje'i sku: gzhom gzhi med pa'i sku nyid bsam: de nyid rtse gcig ma yengs bzla: thugs ka'i sngags phreng dmigs gtad la: oṃ tā re tu re swā hā: o tā re tut+ta re tu re ma ma hā a yutsā na pusbyi tiṣ+ṭha ku ru ye swā hā: yengs med rtse gcig 'bum phrag gcig: bzlas na tshe yi rig 'dzin thob: rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa ni: snang srid 'khor 'das ma lus pa: 'od dpung chen pa'i klong du gyur: rdo rje'i gur khang nyid la thim: gur khang 'od du ltem gyis zhu: 'od zer dkar po nyid la thim: dkar po dmar thim dmar po ser: ser po mthing ga nyid la thim: mthing ga 'phags ma'i sku la thim: sku yang 'khor lo lnga ldan loḥ sngags phreng srog yig t+t+waṃl thim: t+t+waṃyig spyi bor zla tshes la: zla tshes thig le'i klong du thim: thig le dmigs med chos kyi sku: gzhom gzhig med pa'i ngang la bzhag: dge tshogs 'gro ba'i don du bsngo+oḥ smon lam btab cing bkra shis brjodoḥ bdag 'dra bye ma mu dra yang : tshe yi rig 'dzin 'di yis thob: shin tu zab pa'i yang bcud do: 'di bkod dge bas 'gro ba kun: 'chi med rig pa 'dzin pa thob shog: 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs 'chi ba med pa zhes bya ba kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta bye ma mu dras mdzad pa rdzogs so: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag nyid nyang ban kyang yi dam 'di nyid la bgyis pas: paṇa chen dang 'dra bar 'chi med rig 'dzin thob nas nyang ban bdag gis yi ger bkod pa: phyi rabs las can gsung gi sras dang 'phrad par shog: khwa'i mgon po dam can gyis thub par srungs: brda thim: kha the: bdag 'dra 'od gsal sgyu mas dbu ru zhwa'i lha khang nas spyan drangs pa'i shog ser leb nas dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni khro bo dpal gyis zhus so/ / (tshe dbang nor bu'i yang gter du bzhes so/ /) 627

thug /'phags ma yid bzhin zla ba tshe sbyin ma'i sgrub thabs snying po dril ba 'chi med bdud rtsi'i gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /na ma sta ri/ /gang gi mtshan thos pas kyang 'jigs kun sgrol/ /'khor ba'i duḥkha ma lus sel mdzad ma/ /'od dpag med 'chang rgyal ba kun skyed yum/ /'chi med gter 'chang 'phags mar phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus dgra'i dang du 'joms mi shigs dwangs ma'i tshe/ /bsgrub phyir bcom ldan 'das ma nyer bsnyen pa'i/ /man ngag kun spyod bdud rtsi zab mo ni/ /lam bzang snyigs la kho bos 'dir bstan bya/ /de yang gnas dben zhing gtsang la yid du 'ong bar/ /dus yar ngo'i tshes brgyad dam gza' skar bzang por shis pa'i sa la maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi/ dbus su zla ba sna tshogs rdo rje pad dkar 'dab brgyad mu khyud lnga ldan mdzes shing yid du 'ong bar bri/ de steng bum pa mtshan ldan dar dkar chings ldan nang gtan 'khyil mtsho'am rgyun 'babs gangs chu bu mo gtsang mas blangs la lnga tshan lnga'i rdzas bcas blug kha rgyan shing gis byas pa'i gseb la 'phags ma'i sku'i mo'am 'bur du 'dod pa bsham/ de'i mdun du gtor ma/ g.yas su tshe ril/ g.yon du bdud rtsi/ rgyab ngos mda' dar sna lnga/ mthar mchod pa'i bye brag gis legs par bskor/ de ltar gal te ma lcogs na/ ras dkar gyi gzhi ma'i steng du 'bru dkar gyi tshom bu dgu pa'i dbus su/ /gtor ma gus pa sku gzugs gang rung gcig gi mthar/ mchod pa lngas bskor nas bshams kyang 'thus la/ de tsam gyi spros pa med na sgrol ma'i phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi dpe la mchod pa bshams kyang sa rung shing / spyir spros pa med pa ting nge 'dzin kho nas kyang yong ngo / /de ltar sta gon grub nas/ gzhi bdag 'byung po'i cho gas gtor mas brngan la srung 'khor zab mo bsgom/ dri bzang gi chus gdong bkrus shing bde ba'i gdan la snyoms par 'dug nas lhag pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pas/ na mo r+ghaṃ/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /'gro ba'i don du 'phags ma bsgrub par bya/ /tshogs zhing bla na med pa'i tshogs rnams la/ /phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul sdig gshags dger yi yang / /chos 'khor bskor bskul rgyal ba bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /dge bsags 'gro kun byang chub thob phyir bsngo/ /ro yo khaṃ/ saṃ ha ra ṇa r+ghaṃ/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ trīḥṭ+wāṃ/ spar na phaṭa/ 'dir bshams pa dang yid kyis mchod pa'i rdzas/ /rin po che'i gzhal med khang kho lag yangs shing rgya che bar phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba nam mkha' mdzod kyi rang bzhin rgyal ba'i 628

zhing khams thams cad khyab par gyur/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+pa te spa ra ṇa i rma ga ga na khaṃ/ ar+ghaṃ/ pāju/ sogs nas/ shaja pū dza ā:rgyu/ oṃ āḥrgyu sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ba dzi ta r+ghaṃ gliḥthā: zhes pas byin brlab/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra su bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ chos sku spros bral stong pa chen po'i ngang / /kun khyab snying rje'i rol pa bsam yas spro/ /rang sems ye shes ngo bo t+t+waṃ du shar/ /'phros pa'i 'od kyi khams gsum dri ma sbyangs/ /steng 'og khor yul rdor gur me ris gtams/ /de dbus 'jig rten chu shel gzhal yas khang / /'dod yon phun tshogs bde ba can gyi dbus/ /rang mdun nam mkhar pad dkar 'dab stong steng / /gser gyi rgya gram zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /rgyu yi sa bon t+t+waṃ las rgyal kun gyi/ /thugs rje phrin las yongs 'dus ut+pal dkar/ /yongs gyur yid bzhin zla ba tshe sbyin ma/ /dkar dwangs chu shel zla ltar rab tu 'tsher/ /zhi 'dzum sgeg chags lnga ldan 'od zer 'phro/ /rin chen rgyan rdzogs me tog phreng bas spras/ /dar dkar stod g.yog sna tshogs smad g.yog gsol/ /dpral ba phyag zhabs zhi spyan bdun gyis brgyan/ /ut+pal dkar po cher rgyas sdong bu ni/ phyag g.yon mtheb srin dag gis thugs kar 'dzin/ /pad+ma dkar po mchog sbyin phyag rgya g.yas/ /dbu skra thor cog ltag zar rnam par g.yo/ /'od ni dpag med rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs/ /gzhon nu 'gying tshul zla rgyas rgyab yol mdzes /dpral mgrin snying gar zla ba pad nyi la/ /oṃ dkar āḥdamar r+ghaṃ mthing gsum gyis mtshan/ /thugs kar pad zla'i steng du rtsibs brgyad dkar/ /lte bar zla steng tsāyig 'od dpag med/ /rtsibs brgyad sngags phreng bcas las 'od 'phros pas/ /ye shes sems mar sangs rgyas byang chub sems/ /ma lus bskor te mdun gyi mkha' la byon/ /mchod cing bstod par dbang bskur gsol btab pas/ /ye shes 'khor dang bcas pas bum pa'i chus/ /dam tshig pa la dbang bskur sku lus khengs/ /phyi nang sgrib gnyis dri ma thams cad dag /chu lhag yar lud 'od dpag med dbu brgyan/ /dam tshig ye shes dbyer med ngo bor gyur/ār+sā tā re badz+ra sa ma ya dzoḥ oṃ ārtswa tā re e h+ye hi a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī r+ghaṃ/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/oṃ ār+sā tā re sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pāju swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du/ dhu pe/ā lo ke/ gadhe/ rna wi byā/ oṃ badz+ra shardo ā r+ghaṃ/ sarba pu tsa me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥrdzu/ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma/ /tudhā re yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol/ /tu res na ba rnams la yang / /sgrol ma la ni phyag 'tshal bstod swā hā/ brtse ldan lha mo tshe dbang myur stsol ma/ /bdag yid rtse gcig gus pas gsol 'debs kyi/ /'chi med tshe dbang longs spyod dpal 'byor dang / /phrin las rnam bzhi ci 'dod stsal du gsol/ /'di phyi bar do gnas skabs thams cad du/ /ma khyed 'bral med rtag tu thugs rjes zung / /skye ba 'di nas byang chub mchog gi bar/ /lung bstan chos gsung 'bral med 'grogs su gsol/ /rtag tu 629

nyams len skyo dub med pa dang / /gzhan don lhur len bde legs phun tshogs shing / /tshe dang sgrub pa rlabs chen mthar phyin nas/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'khor ba dong sprugs shog /ces bstod gsol ba btab pas sgrol mdzad ma'i/ /sku las 'od zer dpag med 'phros pa yis/ /sangs rgyas byang sems ma lus rigs lnga yi/ /rnam par spyan drangs 'phags ma'i skur thim zhing / /mdun gyi 'phags ma 'od phung gyur nas ni/ /rang gi lus la thim pas skad cig der/ /rang nyid 'phags ma'i skur gyur rgyan cha lugs//sku mdog phyag mtshan ma 'dres lam mer gsal/ /snying gar pad dkar 'dab brgyad cung kha zlum/ /de dbus zla steng rtsibs brgyad yig 'bru brgyad/ /lte bar zla gdan steng du tsā yig dkar/ /cung zad kha zlum ring cha tshegs drag brgyan/ /phyi rim mu khyud sngags phreng spel tshig bskor/ /sngags kyi 'od zer chos 'khor lnga ldan 'phros/ /lngang gus mi shig rdo rje'i gur khang spras/ /dkar pos 'jig rten khyab byas bdag sogs kyi/ /nad gdon bar chad dgra bgegs mtha' dag zhi/ /de bzhin dmar pos 'khor 'das tshe bsod bsdus/ /ser pos tshe bsod dpal 'byor mnga' thang 'phel/ /mthing gas gnyen pos mi 'jigs rdo rje'i sku/ /gzhom gzhig med skur gyur pas rtse gcig tu/ /thugs ka'i sngags phreng sa bon dmigs gtad la/ /yengs med ngang las rlung sngags dbyer med par/ /bzlas pa'i skyon lnga spangs la dag par bzla'o/ /oṃ tā re tudhā re swā hā/ oṃ tā re tut+na re tu re ma ma ā yutsā na puṣ+yo puṣ+ṭi ku ru swā hā/ zhes gong ma rtsa snying 'bru brgyad pa dang 'og ma las sngags spel tshig dang bcas pa ste/ bsnyen pa'i skabs su gong ma gtso bo dang spel tshig can de'i drug cha tsam du bzla la/ sgrub dang rgyun gyi bzlas pa la ni spel tshig gtso bor bya'o/ /thun mthar rdzogs pa'i rim pa dang lhar ldang mnyam par bzhag pa'i rim pa ni/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad 'od phung chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur nas rdo rje'i gur la thim/ de yang 'od zer dkar po thim/ dkar po yang dmar por thim/ dmar po ser por thim/ ser po mthing gar thim/mthing ga 'phags mar thim/ /'phags ma yang thugs ka'i 'khor lo lnga ldan la thim/ lnga ldan rtsibs phreng sngags/ sa bon de yang tā/ khog pa/ mgo/ zla tshes/ thig le/ nā da yal te zab zhi 'od gsal la zhugs/slar yang sngags rkyen gyis sad de 'phags mar ljang bar 'bru gsum gyis brgyan par gyur/ de ltar yang ngo bo stong nyid chen po gang gi yang spros pa med par rtogs pa rdzogs rim/ rang bzhin lhar snang sgyu ma lta bur lam khyer bskyed rim/ thugs rje zung 'jug rim pa'i ngang la ro gcig pa bskyed rdzogs gnyis med de/ der ma zad chos kun chos kyi skur ro gcig pa'o/ /dge 'dis bdag gi tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ /myur du sgrol ma'i ma mchog brnyes/ /'gro kun sgrib pa gnyis spangs te/ /'chi med rig 'dzin thob par shog /ces rim gnyis dge ba 'gro la bsngo bas rgyas gdab pa'o/ /de nas thun mtshams skum gtor ma'i rnal 630

'byor ni/ dkar gsum gtso bor byas pa'i zlum gtor mar khus byugs la ma thebs kyu'i mtha' skor can snod gtsang mar chang ngam chu dang snod gcig tu bshams nas/ oṃ a mṛ te r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod las chus bsang zhing / ro yo khaṃ gtor ma rdzas ma gad pa thams cad sbyangs/ stong par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis gtor ma snod bcud phun sum tshogs shing 'dod yon du mas brgyan pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs chonas/ 'khor 'das kyi snod thams cad bde ba can gyi zhing khams/ /bcud ma lus shing lus pa med pa bcom ldan 'das ma'i rang bzhin 'khor lo gsum du gyur cing / /de thams cad kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bas dgyes shing tshim par bsams la/ oṃ tā re tudhā re tu re i rda ba lo ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa lan bdun nam nyer gcig gis 'bul mthar gong du bstan pa'i bstod pa'am/ spro na phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gis rab tu bstod cing yid la 'dod don gang yin pa de 'grub par gsol ba drag tu gdab bo/ /gzhan yang mdun bskyed mchod bstod maṇ+ḍal gyi bya ba gzhan nas byung ltar shes shing spro bas bgyis kyang legs la ma grub kyang rung ngo / /mthar yig brgya ci nus kyi nyes byas bshags shing lhag chad gso/ /ak+ṣa dang rten 'brel snying po yang bklags la 'khor 'das dag pa 'od gsal gyi 'khor lo rdzogs pa'i rim pa la bsdu'o/ /spros bcas kyi cho ga dang rjes mthun dam pa ye rnams ye shes rten la bstem pa'am gshegs su gsol ba dang / dam tshig bsdus kyang 'gal bar mi 'gyur la/ gang yang mthar bsngo smon bkra shis kyi rgyas gdab par bya'o/ /de yang bcom ldan 'das ma bsnyen pa'i tshad ni/ dus zhag gcig nas gsum 'dun nyer gcig dang zla ba lo sogs gang yang rung zhing / grangs ni spyir sngags yi ge bcu pa 'bru 'bum gyi dbang du byas te bye bas las dang dngos grub rnams bsgrub pa la dbang zhes rgyud don ltar bshad kyi/ 'dir ni rtsa sngags kyi yi ge brgyad pa dang 'bru bcu pa las sngags spel ba sprags ma dag par 'bum phrag drug yid gzhan du ma yengs bar rtse gcig par bzlas pas/ tshe'i rig 'dzin thob par kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta 'od kyi lus can bye mal mu dra'i man ngag las/ yengs med rtse gcig 'bum phrag gcig: bzlas na tshe yi rig 'dzin thob: ces gsungs pas de yang skal pa dang blo yi rim pas dus min 'chi rkyen mtha' dag sel nas tshe chad la bskyal ba dang tshe tshad lhag par bsring ba dang / 'chi med rig 'dzin thob pa rnams 'gyur ro/ /rtags kyi bsnyen pa ni dbang po'i go rim bzhin/ dngos nyams rmi lam gyi snang bar 'phags ma'i zhal mjal lung bstan gdams ngag 'bogs pa rnams 'byung zhing / gzhan yang nyi zla shar pa dang / me tog dkar po 'thus pa dang / shing thog zos ba dang / bdud rtsi 'thung ba dang / mchod rten sāts+tsha bzhengs pa dang mang po mthong ba dang / bu mo dkar mo yid du 'ong bas rgyan phreng dkar po byin pa rnams tshe 'grub pa'i ltas yin no/ /de ltar 'phags ma'i dus bsnyen grub pa'i skabs sam/ gzhan yang gnas skabs ci rigs par byin rlabs 'jug phyir dbang len par 'dod na/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor gtor ma bum pa nyid 'phags mar bltas shing gzungs thag rdo rje 'dzin nas sngags brgya stong khri 'bum ci rigs bzlas nas/ mthar oṃ āḥrgyu zhes lha 'od du zhu nas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du rdzas dang gnyis su med par gyur par bsam zhing / de nas ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gtso bo tha mi dad pa rdo rje slob dpon dang / de'i thugs gnas rig rtsal sprul pa'i lhas rgyal thebs mdzad par mos nas/ rang glo 631

bur zhu ba po'i tshul gyis phyag dang bcas maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ e bla ma rin po che/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag rdo rje 'dzin/ /nyon mongs dri ma rab dben phyir/ /dpal ldan yid bzhin 'khor lo yi/ /'chi med dbang bskur stsal du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab cing / /de nas skyabs sems sdom bzung gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar ram/ gong gi skyabs sems yan lag bdun pas kyang 'grub par rjes zlos lan gsum byas la/ slar dkyil 'khor dngos la 'jug pa'i don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ slobadze dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ces bya ba'i lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das ma'i dang ngam ma lus pa bskur du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pa'i mthar ye shes dbab par ni/ slob ma las chus bsang / su bhā was stong par sbyangs nas 'phags ma'i sku mngon rtogs ltar gsal btab cing gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ slob ma'i gnas gsum dang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis rgyal ba'i zhing khams thams cad g.yos te sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs ma lus shing lus pa med par spyan drangs/ 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i skur slob ma'i spyi bo nas sib sib thim par bsams la/ rdor dril gsor 'khrol 'jam rol spos dud bcas te/ rtsa sngags la ā re sha ya a āḥ zhes btags pas nyer gcig nas brgya rtsa'i bar du ye shes bster zhing / mda' dar g.yab cing khams gsum snod bcud kyi tshe bcud sdud pa'i dmigs pas gsol 'debs las sngags bzla zhing slob ma'i snying gar bstem/ rdo rje spyi 'or reg cing su pra tiṣ+ṭhas brtan par byas nas/ de nas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis nam mkha' gang ba'i sangs rgyas spyan drangs/ ting nge 'dzin gyis mchod cing dbang bskur bar gsol ba btab pas lha rnams kyis bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bar bsams la/ oṃ/ bum pa bzang po lha yi gzhal yas khang / /'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis rab tu gang / /kun bzang rigs lnga rigs gsum mgon po dang / /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba ma lus thams cad kyis/ /ye shes bdud rtsi mchog gi dbang bskur bas/ /lus ngag yid gsum smin cing grol ba dang / /'chi med tshe yi dbang mchog thob par shog /oṃ ā r+sā tā re ā yutsā na sarba bud+dha ka lā sha a gi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ badz+ra ka lā sha a gi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ rat+na ka lā sha a gi ṣiñtsa ṭ+wāṃ/ pad+ma ka lā sha a gi ṣiñtsa trīḥ karma ka lā sha a gi ṣiñtsa ā: zhes bum pa gnas lngar reg cing bum chu myangs pas chus lus khengs sgrib pa dag /chu thigs spyi bor blugs pa'i chu lhag yar lud pas rigs bdag gis mtshan par bsam/des ni sku bum pa'i dbang thob cing de yi sbyangs rtogs smin pa'i bya ba mtha' dag 'grub pa'i nges pa bskyed do/ /de nas slob dpon dkyil 'khor lha dang slob ma'i snying gar pad zla tsakra sa bon sngags phreng spel tshig bcas gsal zhing / slob ma'i mos gus kyi rkyen gyis slob dpon thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis mdun bskyed rgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas sa bon sngags phreng bcas mar me gcig las gnyis mched 632

tshul du byung / lha'i zhal nas slob ma'i khar zhugs/ snying ga'i sngags 'khor la jim par bsam zhing / rtsa sngags la sngags rjes zlos tshar bdun dang / dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po yang rjes zlos bya'o/ /de nas phreng ba mgrin par bzhag cing lag tu byin/ āḥ 'gag med tshangs pa'i gsung dbyangs bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /grags stong brjod 'dzin rtog pa bral ba'i ngang / /tshangs dbyangs skye 'gag med pa tshangs pa'i gsung / /skal ldan bu mchog khyod la yongs rdzogs shog /oṃ tā re tusgyu re swā hā/ oṃ tā re tudhā re tu re ā yutsā na puni ku ru swā hā/ wāka a gi ṣiñtsa ā: zhes gtad nas mtheb gung gis bgrang / des ni gsung gi gsang dbang thob cing de yis sbyangs rtogs smin pa'i bya ba mtha' dag 'grub pa'i nges par bskyed do/ /de nas slob gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis phyogs dus rgyal ba'i thugs kyi ye shes ma lus pa'i rang bzhin phyag mtshan ut+pal dkar po dri med 'od rab 'tsher ba'i rnam par spyan drangs/ slob ma'i spyi bo nas zhugs/ snying ga'i t+t+waṃl sib sib thim pas bde ba chen po'i ye shes mngon du gyur par bsams la/ ut+pal dkar po'am shel rdo snying gar bzhag pa/ r+ghaṃ/ mtshan ldan rgyal yum 'phags ma thugs rje can/ /'khrul med spros bral thugs kyi sgo phyes la/ /'khrul med 'ub chub blo 'das thugs kyi dbang / /skal ldan bu mchog yid la bskur du gsol/ /oṃ tā re tusgyu re swā hā/tsista a bhi ṣiñtsa r+ghaṃ/ zhes brjod/ des ni thugs ye shes kyi dbang thob de yi sbyangs rtogs sbyin pa'i bya ba mtha' dag 'grub pa'i nges pa bskyed do/ /de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer mdun bskyed 'phags mar phog /de slob ma'i snying gar zhugs pa dang snang srid 'od kyi gong bur zhu nas thim zhing sku yang thugs kar sa bon la thim zhing / de yang nā dar yal nas sems skye 'gag gnas bral ma bcos so ma rang thog khyab gdal rig pa ka dag chen po re mnyam par bzhag go/ /slob dpon gyis/ a a āḥ zhes ring bar brjod/ des ni de kho na nyid don dam pa'i dbang thob pa ste dbang kun gyi mchog tu gyur cing de yi sbyangs rtogs smin pa'i bya ba thams cad 'grub pa'i nges pa bskyed do/ /de nas gtor ma lhar gsal ba slob ma'i gnas gsum du bzhag par 'phags ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi dbang dang dngos grub thams cad thob cing / slar gtor ma spyi bor bzhag pas 'od zhu nas slob mar thim par bsam la/ trīḥ gtor ma spros bral zlum po'i pho brang nas/ rje btsun yid bzhin 'khor lo'i lha tshogs bzhugs/ /byin rlabs klong yangs thugs rje'i 'od phung 'bar/ /sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las yongs rdzogs nas/ /skal ldan rigs kyi bu mchog la/ 'chi med tshe yi dbang mchog bskur du gsol/ /nad med bde ba'i dbang mchog bskur du gsol/ /rtsa sngags las sngags bcas pa'i gsham du/ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ āḥhūṃ ho:zhes pas gtor dbang bskur zhing brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyang bya/ des ni dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs byin 633

rlabs mchog thun gyi dngos grub chen po la dbang bar byed do/ /mthar gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du shes nas cung zad re myang bar bya zhing / de nas tshe ril dang tshe chang pang rigs mthun tshigs bcad blangs te sbyin pa'am/ yang na lam sngags spel tshig can gyis tshe ril g.yas tshe chang g.yon du ster la rol lo/ /de mthar mda' dar rdo rje rgya gram du spel la/ shis brjod bden stobs dang dbyangs sasal rten 'brel snying po ye shes brtan pa'i sngags rnams brjod cing spyi bor bzhag /me tog kyang gtor/ spro na/ rgyal srid sna bdun dar bkra shis rdzas brgyad kyang sbyin no/ /rjes dam tshig khas blangs/ maṇ+ḍal yon 'bul/ bkra shis bsngo smon rnams spyi mthun bya/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ/ zhes lha dang bla ma rang sems dbyer med gnyug ma brjod bral ngang du bzhag go/ /de ltar bdag 'jug lam dbang la brtson na nyes byas dag cing sngags sdom gong du 'phel ba dang / tshe bsod rgyas pa sogs thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan mtha' dag myur du thob par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan la bskur na khrus dang bgegs bskrad/ srung 'khor sngon du 'gro zhing / chos bshad rgyas bsdus ci rigs pas spro ba bskyed cing / de nas/ gsol 'debs nas bzung khas blang /maṇ+ḍal yon 'bul bar du dkyus su bstan pa de nyid rdo rje slob dpon dngos grub kyi bdag pos slob ma la nye bar ston pa de kas 'grub bo/ /de yang dkyus 'di zab par bstan pa ste/ gzhan du ni/ bum pa/ bzlas lung / sngags phreng /phyag mtshan byin mthar gtor ma spyi bor bzhag nas/ lha mo'i gnas gsum gyi 'od zer slob mar bstem pa las lha bstem pa mi dgos so/ /gzhan yang gnas skabs rkyen sel byin rlabs tshe dbang la ni/ bum pa/ gtor ma/ tshe ril/tshe chang byin pa de yis grub/ 'di la brgya rtsa sogs bsags kyang de ltar bya'o/ /lugs gzhan gyi rjes gnang ltar byed na/ ye shes dbab pa sku'i rjes gnang / bzlas lung dang me tog 'thor ba gsung gi rjes gnang / phyag mtshan bstim pa thugs kyi rjes gnang / de mthar khas blang yon 'bul la 'jug pas kyang rung ngo / /de nas dkyil 'khor rjes kyi bya ba mchod pa gso/ /byin gyis brlabs nas sngags phyag rgyas phul zhing bstod/ de nas nyes bshags bzod gsol ye shes pa rten yod na der bstim/ med na gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ bsngo smon lam bkra shis spyi dang mthun par bya'o/ /de ltar bcom ldan tshe dbang lha mo yid bzhin gyi/ sgrub thabs rnam mang rin chen 'dus pa'i phung po'i dbus/ /'chi med 'od gsal rdo rje'i sku can gdams ngag chog /bsam 'phel nor bu bdag blo'i rgyal mtshan rtse mor mdzes /'di bkod nongs kun 'phags mas bzod bzhes dbugs dbyung zhing / /legs tshogs gyur pas srid pa'i chu klung sgrol gyur nas/ /bde chen bya ba yongs grub 'gyur med ye shes khams/ /'phags ma'i go 'phang bdag sogs 'gro bas myur thob shog /ces 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs 'di nyid rang gi yid la'ang bkod 'dod pa zhig byung la/ skabs der gser bzang sprul pa'i sku mchog pad+ma 'gyur med nor bu'i sdes yang yang gsung gis bskul ba dang / gzhan yang mchog don gnyer ba du ma la phan pa'i lhag bsam 'ba' zhig gis man ngag rtsa ba 'chi med 'od kyi lus can paṇ+ḍi ta bye ma mu tra'i gsung man ngag srog tu bkod/ yan lag gzhan rnams dang smin byed kyi gzhung 'od dpag med pa tshe yi rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshul du snang ba pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i gdams pa bslad med bla ma dam pa'i phyag len gyis gsal bar byas te/ nor 'khrul gyi skyon med cing zab la khyer bde ba 'di nyid mdo khams kaḥthog lho phyogs pa shākya'i dge bsnyen tshangs par spyod cing gsang sngags nang gi dge slong du phyogs tsam gtogs pa rig sngags 'dzin pa 634

tshe dbang nor bus stod mnga' ris mang yul dbus ri bod dpal 'bar bdud rtsi phug tu phur bu zhes pa sa sprel hor zla lnga pa'i dus tshes bzang por bris pa 'gro kun 'chi med dwangs ma 'phags ma'i sku 'grub 'bar gyur cig /dge legs 'phel/ /༄gi /badz+ra gu ru nyams su len pa'i thabs man ngag yid bzhin nor bu tog gi blo gros ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru badz+ra ma hā mu drwa ya/ rgyal kun mtshan dpe gcig 'dus pa'i dpyid/ /rgyal gsung rab 'byams rgya mtsho 'dus thig le/ /rgyal kun ye shes ngo bo kun tu bzang / /rgyal mchog pad+ma thod phreng rtsal la 'dud/ /tshe gcig byang chub mchog gi don/ /gcig chog blo bde zab pa'i bcud/ /badz+ra gu ru'i nyams len tshul/ /rang gi 'dod bzhin brjod par bya/ /de yang dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang mi rtag 'chi ba las rgyu 'bras 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs thar pa'i phan yon rnams kyis blo rgyud khol zhing 'khor bas dub pa dang myang 'das la nges par 'byung ba'i bsam pa dang khyad par lhag pa'i bsam pa mi dman pa snying thag pa nas skye ba gal che zhing / de nas rdo rje theg pa'i 'jug ngogs dbang bskur gang rung zhig legs par thob cing de'i dam tshig bcas pa ma nyams pas lam nyams su len pa'i snying po spyir 'dul dka' ba'i 'gro ba mtha' dag dang / khyad par gdong dmar bod kyi gdul bya rnams kyi bla ma dang dkyil 'khor lha'i ngo bo tha mi dad pa sangs rgyas gzi brjid 'od dpag tu med pa'i ngo bo o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po'i tshul bstan pa gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas su nges shing grub la/ de'i sgrub thabs kyi rim pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa las/ 'dir tshig bdun gsol 'debs kyi man ngag dang mthun par nyams su len pa'i tshul ni/ thog mar bdag dang mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad skyabs gnas dkon mchog rtsa gsum kun 'dus kyi ngo bo gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas la skyabs su mchi'o snyam zhing / ngag nas/oṃ s+dzargyu/ dus 'di nas bzung byang chub ma thob bar/ skyabs gnas mchog gyur rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes brjod/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can 'di rnams 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bzod blag med pa nyams su myong dgos pa snying re rje/ kun drin che ba pha ma'i rang bzhin yin pas bdag gis ci nas kyang sangs rgyas kyi sa la bkod dgos/ de'i ched du yang zab bla ma'i sgrub pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /snyam nas/ sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don du/ /yang gsang bla ma bsgrubs nas ni/ /gang la gang 'dul phrin las kyis/ /'gro drug bsgral bar dam bca' 'o/ /zhes brjod cing dbugs 635

btang rngubs dge sdig btang len gyi dmigs pa yang ci nus bya'o/ /de nas mkha' khyab rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor kun gyi ngo bo gu ru'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung / des bdag gi sdig sgrib dag par bsams la/oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya sogs nas/ satwa āḥ mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes brjod/ bla ma bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du bdag la thim/ /bdag gi ma dag pa'i phung po khams dang skye mched kun btags kyi rten dang brten par bcas pa rnams bdag med pa rang bzhin gyis stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las sems nyid rang mdangs gnyug ma'i lus yi dam lha'i skur gyur/ de yang rgyud sde bzhi drug gi yi dam lha gang 'dod pa zhig gsal gdab/ de'i mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas sam yan lag drug gi mchog dang snying ga'i dbus sogs gang yang rung bar skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer ma mchis pa gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi rnam pa sku'i cha lugs spyi dang mthun par tshig 'dis gsal btab ste/ chos dbyings mkha' khyab ye shes 'od snang dbus/ /seng khri pad+ma stong ldan nyi zla'i gdan/ /rgyal kun sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje sems/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas sangs rgyas 'od dpag med/ /sku mdog dkar dmar mtshan dpe yongs su rdzogs/ /phyag gnyis rdo rje thod pa tshe bum bsnams/ kha ṭ+wāṃ gru 'khyud zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil/ /gsang phod chos gos za 'og ber phyam klubs/ /dbu la pad zhu ḍā ki'i sprin phung gsol/ /rgyan tshogs bsam 'phel nor bu du mas spras/ /gnas gsum rdo rje gsum gyur oṃ ā hūṃ/ /lte bar ye shes rdo rje trīḥyis mtshan/ /de ltar gu ru'i gnas gsum dang lte ba'i trīḥlas 'od zer lcags kyu'i dbyibs can 'phros te/ mkha' khyab kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs ma lus mi lus lus pa med pa thams cad dpung gis byon te gu ru'i sku la thim par bsams nas tshig bdun gyis gsol ba gdab pa ni/ r+ghaṃ/ o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams/ /pad+ma ge sar sdong po la/ /ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags/ /'khor du mkha' 'gro mang po bskor/ /khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis/ /byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol/ /gu ru pad+ma sirnyi r+ghaṃ/ /zhes tshar grangs ci lcogs brjod/ de nas skyabs yul kun 'dus gu ru'i drung du rang gi yid las skyes pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mchod pa'i sprin gyis kun nas mchod par bya ste/ de yang / mkha' khyab kun bzang rol pa'i sprin dpung nyid/ /dgyes mchod spyi dang khyad par dam tshig rdzas/ /bde stong kha sbyor rol pa'i mchod par bcas/ /zab gsal bde chen dbyings su mchod par bgyi/ /zhes dang / khyad par du gdung shugs drag por bskyed de/ bdag gi 'khor gnyen 636

gces pa'i lus don dbang / /tshe srog bsod nams dus gsum dge tshogs bcas/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus gu ru mchog la 'bul/ /thugs rjes brtse bas kun tu bzhes su gsol/ /zhes snying thag pa nas mchod pa 'bul ba dang / yang / gang zhig mi srun spyi dang khyad par du/ /theg mchog bstan dang ston la snang ba yi/ /log sred can kun bdag mthu nus pas btul/ /gu ru'i bka' bzhin 'bangs su 'bul lo bzhes/ /zhes phrin las kyi ched du smon lam gyis mchod par bya'o/ /de nas mchod rdzas mchod yul la thim dgyes shing tshims mchod pa'i lha mo rang la thim pas dngos grub thob/ mchod pa mchod yul mchod byed dmigs med kyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag /de nas slar yang gdung shugs kyis bla ma la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ kye kye bla ma rin po che/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /'gro ba kun gyi gnyen gcig po/ /mgon med bdag la thugs rjes zung / /bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' che/ /re zhing ltos pa'i gnyen gcig po/ /bdag la re sa gzhan na med/ /sdug bsngal 'dam nas drang du gsol/ /rje btsun pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /khyed la bdag nyid bran du 'bul/ /skyid sdug re ltos khyed shes pas/ /bla med mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ /bla ma sangs rgyas phrin las mdzad/ /bdag la dbang bskur gyin gyis rlobs/ /mtha' yas sems can ma lus kun/ /'dren pa'i bla mar bdag gyur cig /oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi r+ghaṃ/ zhes phur tshugs kyis mchi ma 'khrug 'khrug ci ltar nus pa gsol ba gdab cing / de nas ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang blang ba ni/ gu ru'i sku yi 'bru bzhir 'od zer bzhi/ /dkar dmar mthing ljang bdag gnas bzhir thim pas/ /dbang thob sgrib dag lam 'byongs sku bzhi smin/ /gu ru pad+ma'i go 'phang myur thob shog /oṃ āḥrgyu trīḥsarba sirnyi pha la rgyu āḥ zhes pas dbang bzhi len pa'i dmigs pa ci nus bya/ de nas rnam rtog gzhan du ma 'phros pas yid yul du gu ru sku lam mer snang ba de la rig pa hrig ge gtad bzhin pa'i ngang du/ ngag nas gzhom med nā da'i sgra dbyangs kyi ngo bo phyogs dus rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs kyi yang snying gcig dril yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i yi ge bcu gnyis pa bzla bar bya ste/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi r+ghaṃ/ zhes ci nus su bzlas pa'i mthar gu ru 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan gyi rnam par gyur te rang gi snying gar thim/ /gu ru'i thugs kyi ye shes dang rang gi sems nyid dbyer mi phyed par gyur te stong gsal bde ba chen po'i ngang du sems ci gnas su mnyam par gzhag de las ldangs nas/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /gu ru pad+ma 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'khod par shog /rang bzhin dag pa'i dge ba 'dis/ /'khor ba ngan song dong sprugs te/ /srin na 'ga' yang mi gnas par/ /thams cad sangs rgyas nyid thob shog /ces bsngo smon gyi rgyas gdab cing slar yang spyi bo'i gtsug gi nam mkhar gu ru wal gyis skad cig dran rdzogs kyis gsal gdab 637

cing bdag gi rigs bdag gi tshul du rtag tu 'bral med du bzhugs te byin gyis brlab par bsam la/de ltar bskyed rim rang sems kyi mdangs gu ru'i sku ru lam mer shar ba'i gsal cha de'i ngo bo la gcer gyis bltas pas der 'dzin gyi shes pa rtsis gdab dang bral ba dus gsum rnam rtog gi spros pas ma bslad pa wal le seng nge ba de ka'i ngang du sems ci gnas mnyam gzhag mu mthud kyin bsgom pa ni rdzogs rim thams cad kyi rtsa ba ste gnyug bsrings te bsgoms na dge sbyor nyin mtshan 'khor yug tu 'char bar yang 'gyur ro/ /gzhan spyod lam la 'jug pa na bla mar mos gus sems can la snying rje ma yengs pa'i dran shes dang mi 'bral bar/ 'gro ba'i skabs su 'phrag pa g.yas kyi nam mkha' la gu ru bzhugs te de la bskor ba'i tshul dang / zas za ba'i skabs su mgrin pa dang / gos gon pa'i skabs su snying gar bsgoms te de la mchod par bsam pa des kyang tshogs 'khor 'gyur zhing tshogs bsags pa dang / gnyid log pa'i skabs su smin mtshams nas spyi gtsug dbu ma'i lam brgyud snying 'od lnga srab dwangs shel gyi bum pa lta bu'i nang du bzhugs par bsams te gnyid log /nam sad pa'i skabs dran pas rang zin gyis gsal re btab pas rmi lam ngos zin cing 'od gsal 'char/ ldangs pa'i skabs su snying ga'i bla ma dbu ma'i lam nas yar byon/ tshangs bug nas spyi bo'i nam mkha' la bzhugs par bsams pas 'pho ba yang ngang gis 'byongs shing nam zhig 'chi ba'i skabs su rig pa mdung tshugs der gtad pas 'chi kha'i 'pho ba khyad par 'phags par 'gyur la/ gzhan yang zhi rgyas dbang gi bya ba mtha' dag mos pas kha bsgyur nas badz+ra gu ru bzlas pas 'grub cing / khyad par tshe sgrub la/ spyi bo'i gu ru'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung / rang gi lus mer gyis khengs par bsams nas badz+ra gu ru bzlas shing tshe bsring bar gsol ba gdab na tshe sgrub kyi mchog dam pa yin no/ /de ltar chu bo'i rgyun bzhin nyams su len na ring por mi thogs par grol ba 'thob par 'gyur zhing nyams su len ma nus par chos tshul mang po mthong thos su gyur kyang rgya mtsho'i 'gram du yi dwags skom grir 'chi ba dang 'dra bas des na chos thos thos mang pos ci zhig bya ste nyams len la 'bad pa kho na gal che ba dam pa mchog rnams kyis mgrin gcig dang dbyangs gcig tu gsungs pas thun drug gi rnal 'byor sogs ci ltar nus pa 'bad pas nyams su len par gces so/ /'dir smras pa/ de skad dam pa'i gdams pa gang / /rang gi ci ltar thos gyur cing / /mos pas nyams su len tshul dang / /bstun te 'di ru mdo tsam smras/ /de yi dge tshogs mchis gyur ma lus kun/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas 'gro la yongs bsngo'i mthus/ /kun kyang kun bzang pad+ma thod phreng gi/ /go 'phang ring min myur thob rgyur 'gyur shog /ces pa 'di yang rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus dga' dbang ngam mig dmar yang brjod pa shing byi lo nyi ma lug gi ba gam du rtsen pa nag zla'i bzang 638

po gnyis pa la kong yul gyi cha nyang kha gu ru'i gnas chen ljon pa lung gi mdo thod mkhar dgon bsam gtan spyil por spel ba ste gzhan phan rgya che'i bcas su 'grub par gyur cig /sarba maṅga lo/ /༄ga /sgrol ma lhan skyes kyi rgyun gyi nyams len zab mo bzhugs so/ /oṃ swaste/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog las/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab 'grub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyis/ /oṃ shu n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra su bha wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ chos rnams stong pa'i ngang nyid la/ /pad zla nyi mar t+t+waṃ yig ljang 'od 'phros don byas rang rig pa/ /bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma ljang / /zhal gcig mdzes 'dzum spyan gsum pa/ /phyag gnyis g.yon pas skyabs sbyin gyi/ /rab rgyas ut+pal sngon po 'dzin/ /g.yas pas mchog sbyin zhabs sems skyil//rang dang rin chen rus rgyan spras/ /rab 'bar 'od mtshon 'phro dbus bzhugs/ /spyi bor rigs bdag tshe dpag med/ mnyam bzhag rdor dkyil mchog sprul chas/ /rang gi gnas gsum oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ/ /snyigs dbus haṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ /ye shes spyan drangs gnyis med 'dres/ /snying kar nyi zla kha sbyor dbus/ /te la sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor/ /oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ thun mthar ar+ghaṃ sogs kyi mchod/ lha dang lha min cod paṇa gyis/ /zhabs kyi pad+mo la btud do/ /'phong pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma/ /sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rjes su lha sku yang snying ga'i sa bon gyi bar du bsdus shing / /de yang stong pa'i ngang du ci nas mnyam par bzhag /slar yang sngags kyi sgras lha sku sgyu ma lta bur ldang / /dge ba 'di yi myur du ni/ /'phags ma sgrol ba 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'khod par shog /kha zas kyi bya ba nam byed pa na/ /phud bcad de oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ ho yi bdud rtsir byin gyi rlabs/mdun gyi nam mkha' bcom ldan 'das ma bzhugs par bsam te 'bru bcu'i mthar e rda ba lid+dha kha kha khā hi khā hi btags pa lan bdun gyis phul/ mchod bstod gong ltar bya/ 'dod don gsol ba btab/mdun gyi lha rang gi snying gar thim par bsam/ lha yi nga rgyal gyi kha zas la spyod pas gtor ma tshogs 'khor kha zas kyi rnal 'byor bcas gcig tu 'dus par sems pa'o/ /nyams su blangs ni 'di gcig pus mchog thun gyis dngos grub kun 'grub par nus la/ nyams su ma blang na gzhung chen pos yang ci zhig byar yod/ zhes pa yang mnga' ris mar yul rje blon dad pa can rnams kyi ngor rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i blo mtsho nas byung ba'i pad+ma ste dad ldan rnams kyi rna ba'i rgyan du bzung / ces rab byung bcu gsum pa'i dpal gdong mgo zla'i tshes nyi shu gnyis la wam le bde chen rnam rgyal du bris pa'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/ 639

༄ga /mar mi dwags po jo bo rje yab sras sogs dam pa 'ga' zhig gi rnam thar sa bon dus kyi nges pa brjod pa dag ldan nyung gsal bzhugs so/ /swaste/ bod yul gangs can 'dir bka' brgyud pa zhes snyan par grags pa mtha' dag gi 'byung khungs rje btsun lho brag pa chen po zhes pa mar ston lo tsā ba chos kyi blo gros gang de dus nam tsam du byon 'khrungs lo gang yin legs par brtag na 'khrungs pa'i lo ni mkhas pa rnams kyi bzhed pa mi mthun pa mang du byung ste/ de yang lo tshigs mang nyung go rim ltar smos pa/ dang po ni/ mar pa'i dngos slob drug gi gsung rgyun zin bris kyi don rje sgam po khu dbon brgyud pa nas jo bo btsun pas bsdeb par grags pa las ni/ chu pho rta yi lo/ dpyid zla ra ba stag gi tshes bco lnga nyi ma 'brug gza' spen pa/skar ma rgyal/ dus tshod nyi shar la 'khrungs/ brgyad cu rtsa brgyad chu bya dpyid 'bring cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhir gshegs zhes zer na/ jo bo chu rta yin tshe de dang 'khrungs lo cig par khums/ gnyis pa mkhas pa pad+ma dkar po'i gsung sgros kha cig tu lcags yos la 'khrungs par bzhed ltar na/ grub thob khyung po las lo gcig gi gzhon pa tsam dang / gsum pa tshal pa'i deb dmar du/ de las lo drug gi nyung ba me bya la 'khrungs brgya brgyad bar du bzhugs par bzhed cing / lho rong ba'i chos 'byung du 'khrungs lo de ltar la brgya dgu shing glang rta pa zla ba'i tshes bcur gshegs pa byas pa dang / bzhi pa yang lho rong chos 'byung der sa phag la 'khrungs brgya drug la gshegs pa gzhan gyi 'dod tshul bkod pa dang / lnga pa rje mi bskyod zhabs dang dpa' bo gtsug lag 'phreng bas mtshur phu ba'i bka' brgyud gdung rabs dang re mig gsal bar lcags byir 'khrungs brgya drug shing glang bar bzhugs bzhes yod pa dang / rngog pas byas pa'i rnam thar rim bzhi mar grags pa las byi ba lor 'khrungs zhes pa yang 'di dang 'grigs par 'dod la slar zhib tu dpyad de da dung lo'i tshad brgyad cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo mthong / bya lo cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la gshegs pa 'thad par mdzad do/ /'on kyang lo rgyus rin chen spungs par rngog byang chub dpal bas mdzad pa'i rnam thar rim bzhir pa'i 'khrungs lo 'byung khams mi gsal yang lo bdag bya byas shing brgya dgu glang lo yos zla'i tshes bcu dgu bya yi nyi ma la gshegs zhes yod zer bas rje gtsug lag phreng bas gzigs pa'i rngog lugs rnam thar rim bzhi de dang gcig gam slar brtag par 'os so/ / 640

drug pa lo rgyus the tshom sel byed bya ba zhe sdang rdo rje dang mi bskyod rdo rje'i sbyar byang yod pa gnyis dang /ngam rdzong lugs gnyis sogs rnam thar bdun tsam du 'khrungs lo chu stag yin par gsung ba mthun cing dgongs lo'i tshad don brgyad du byas pa yang yod zhes zer la/ rje mkha' spyod dbang pos yang chu stag la 'khrungs nas brgyad cu lcags byi bar bzhugs par bzhed do/ /bdun pa rnam thar dpe rnying pa gnyis na chu stag nas lo bzhi'i nyung ba me rta la 'khrungs/ brgya brgyad dam brgya drug bzhugs bzhes yod par grags la/ brgyad pa 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal bas ni/ chu byi la 'khrungs te grwa pa mngon shes dang 'khrungs lo gcig brgya drug me glang bar bzhugs par gsungs shing dus phyis phal cher 'di khas len par mdzad do/ /dgu pa 'brug pa pu re sha ma ri'i gdan dus kyi rtsis gzhir chu byi las lo dgu yi dman pa lcags bya la 'khrungs brgya dgu pa sa glang bar du bzhugs zhes dang / bcu pa rlang lha gzigs ras pas lcags bya las lo gsum gyi dman pa shing bya la 'khrungs brgyad cu rtsa bzhi me phag bar bzhugs zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar lo tshigs mi 'dra ba bcu las rje mkha' spyod dbang po'i gsung 'di yig cha mang po gung mthun byung ba dang / gang zag gzhan gyi dus snga phyi bsgrigs tshul 'grigs pa sogs kyi don la shin tu gnas par mthong mod/ rje mi bskyod yab sras kyi bzhed pa yang de dang khyad cher mi zhug pas de gnyis gang re lo shing 'thad la/ 'on kyang re zhig phyi ma ltar khas blang ba bde bar mthong bas des na rje mar pa lcags byi la 'khrungs shing brgyad cu rtsa gnyis lcags bya lo rgyal zla'i tshes bco lnga la gshegs pa ste/de tshe mnyam med sgam po pa sa lugs la 'khrungs pa'i lo gnyis lon pa'o/ /grwa pa mngon shes can chu byi la 'khrungs bar nges tshe mar pa'i bco lnga'i skabs su bltams pa dang / skar rtsis mkhan rnams kyi me mkha' rgya mtsho la bsre bar rab byung dang po mar pa'i nyer brgyad dang grwa pa mngon shes kyi bcu drug skabs su yin par 'thad do/ /de yang rje btsun mar pa 'khrungs pa'i yul ni dbus gtsang ru bzhi las g.yo ru'i rgyud lho brag chu khyer ru dgu yi nang tshan pe sar du yin par grags la/ gdung ni rngog pa'i yi ge las yar lung nas mar sa sha ru rtse zhes pa'i rgyud yin gsung zhing / kha cig ru stod mar yul nas chad pa'i mar pa dkar nag gnyis las mar pa dkar po yin zhes gsung zhing / gang ltar yab dbang phyug 'od zer dang yum blo gros lcam gyi sras lnga tshigs su 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i skabs su dpon slob klu brgyad zhig la ka kha nas 'bri klog bslab/ dgung lo bco lnga'i skabs shed du byang lha rtse myu gu lung du lo tsā ba 'brog mi shākya ye shes kyi thad du byon te rgya dkar 'phral skad dang legs sbyar skad bslab pa'i ched du lo gsum tsam bzhugs/ de yang mar pa rang nyid kyi gsung mgur las/ dpal myu gu lung gis dgon pa ru/ /sgra bsgyur 'brog mi lo tsā la/ /sgra thad klog skad kyi yig tshangs bslab/ /khong 641

bka' drin mi chung che bar khum/ /zhes so/ /dgung lo bco brgyad par rgya dkar du 'gro ba'i blo skyes te yo byad thams cad gser du dril bas srang bco lnga byung nas smyos lo tsā ba dang stabs su 'grogs ste dgun der bal por phebs/ der yang skad dang tshad pa la goms su bcug shing lo gsum bzhugs/ de yang mgur las/ lo bcu gnyis lon nas chos dang phrad/ /de sngon sbyangs kyi bag chags sad pa 'dra/ /nga dang por yig tshangs ka kha bslab/ /bar du sgra bsgyur lo tsā sbyangs/ /tha ma lho bal brgya la phyin/ /lo gsum bal po'i mthil du sdad/ /zhes so/ /de tshe bal po'i spyi ther ba rnam rgyal dbang po la gdan bzhi'i dbang dang bshad dka' man ngag bcas legs par nos de yi mched sen+da ba dang shin tu mdza' bcug chen por gyur pas dpal nā ro pa'i drung du sbyor bar mdzad/ de nas dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gcig gi mthar rgya dkar du phebs te bal po sku mched kyi gsung bzhin dge tshul shes rab seng ge la gnas mal zhus/bi kra ma shī la'i gtsug lag khang gi mkhas pa sgo drug phal che bzhugs pa'i dus yin pas cung zad bzhugs nas sgo drug mkhas pa gzhan rnams kyi zhal yang mjal de skabs jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha yang dgung lo so dgu pa dbus kyi ka chen gnyis pa bsod snyoms pa dzñā na shrī mi tra'i nye gnas mdzad kyi yod par grags/ de nas mi ring bar byang put+pa ha rir dpal nā ro ta pa'i zhabs la bsnyen re de yi dus su jo bo na ro zhabs nas thun bzhir bsgom thun mtshams su chos 'chad pas rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dgyes pa rdor rje rtsa bshad man ngag dang bcas pa gzhan yang 'dus pa ma yā sogs khyad par 'phags pa'i gdams pa ci rig gsan/ rtsa ba'i bla ma 'di ma mdzad thugs rjes shin tu 'dzin pas snga phyir dgyes rdor gyi dbang bskur yang lan bdun tsam thob/ lo kha shas song nas bod du gser 'tshol mdzad par dgongs bal por sleb skabs phyag dpe yang chu rgyas par shor zhing lam yang mi bde bas bal por grogs zhig la gser zho bzhi skyis ri rgya gar du log pa rje nā ro pa'i zhal nas khyod bod du phyin nas gser blang pa bas 'dir chos kyi sgro 'dog gcod du 'ongs ba shin tu dga' gsungs sngar ma thob pa'i gdams ngag ngo mtshar can mang du gnang zhing lo gcig nye tsam bzhugs/ de res khyon dril rgya gar du lo bcu gnyis bzhugs zer yang lam zhugs bal po dang bcas sdom pa ste rgya dkar du lo bdun tsam bzhugs par snang / de lta yang mgur las/ rgya gar gyi nā ro paṇa chen dang / nga bod kyi mar pa lo tsā gnyis ljongs me tog rgyan pa'i grong khyer dang / ri bo gser gyi dgon par mjal/ /de tshe rabs kyi smon lam dag pa 'dra/ /gnas byin rlabs can du grags pa der/ /sku snyan pa can gyi rje btsun la/ /lo drug dang zla ba bdun du bsten/ /dbang yongs su rdzogs pa lan bdun zhus/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /de nas bla ma rnams la bka' drin gyi btang rag phul ba'i ched du dgung lo nyer dgu'i mgor bod du gser tshol 642

phebs/ de yang kha rag smyos lo bod du log pa dang lhan du byon zer yang cung zad snga phyir phebs pa mngon/ rje mar par smyos lo yi rgya bal du gser la sogs pa'i phan thogs legs par mdzad pa'i bka' drin rjes dran tshul du phyis bde mchog rdo sku nā ro pa'i thugs dam rten dang rgya dpe sogs thugs su byon pa'i 'phags yul gyi yo byad kha shas mar pas smyos la phul bar grags la/ nā ro'i thugs dam rdo sku ni da lta yang gye re lha sa'i nang rten du bzhugs pa kho bos kyang mjal/ tshul de ltas smyos los phrag dog gi mar pa'i dpe chu la bskyur tshul deng sang mar pa'i rnam thar rnams su khyab che yang yi ge la slad zhugs pa'am gzhan gcig dang 'phrul ba las smyos los byas pa bden bden mi 'dra'o/ /de res mar pa bod du lo gsum bzhugs/ la stod byang dgyes bu zlog skya bas ne len bsnyen bskur bcas slob ma byas shing / byang du gser tshol phebs pas nam ra'i gser rdol dang thug cing mar pa mgo legs kyi zhabs rog che bar byas/ slar rgya dkar du ci myur byon pas de skabs nā ro zhabs ni spyod pa skyong ba'i dus su gyur pas phyag tu ḍa ma ru dang thod pa tsam las ma bzung bar yo byad thams cad slob ma rnams la dkyes nas mar pa'i rten skal he badz+ra gyi thang ka zhig 'dug skad/ dus der slob ma rnying pa rnams kyi tshogs dkon tsam re mdzad cing / de bzhin byin brlabs tsam re dang dogs sel the tshom gcod pa las gzhan dbang bskur rgyud bshad sogs cher mi snang / grong 'jug gi rol rtsed mang po dang / chom rkun gyi spu gri ka pā lar phul ba mar ltar bzhugs nas gsol ba sogs rdzu 'phrul dang / las dang blta stangs kyi sems can dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad par snang / de skabs mnga' bdag mi tri pa chen po dpal gyi ri nas 'khor ste 'gro don mgo tshugs tsam pa'i dus yin pas rje nā ro pa'i lung bstan bzhin mar pas de yi zhabs la 'di re thug par snang / de la 'di skabs dang phyi ma phebs skabs bcas su dgyes rdor brtag gnyis/ /rdo rdo gur sangs rgyas thod pa/ mtshan brjod dang snying po don gyi skor dwo ha sogs man ngag mang du gsan cing phyag rgya chen po'i dgongs pa ji bzhin nam mkha' mnyam pa shar/ de yang mgur las/rje mnga' bdag chen po'i bka' drin gyis/ gzhi chos nyid skye ba med par rtogs/ sems stong pa nyid la sbar zin byas/ mi kho bos spros pa de nas chod/ zhes gsungs pa nyid do/ gzhan yang rgya dkar du phebs pa snga phyi de rnams su nag po zhi ba bzang por grags pa dang / paṇ+ḍi ta ye shes snying po mkha' 'gro ma mi rus rgyan can sogs grub pa thob pa lnga dang / snang ba 'gyur nges kyi bla ma bcu gsum sogs yongs su grags pa dang / ma grags sbas tshul du bzhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo ku sā la'i bla ma mang du bsten/phyis zhig nā ro pas lung bstan pa la brten dug mtsho'i 'gram du dka' dpyad chen pos byon te slob dpon chen po ku ku ri pa yang dngos su mjal bar snang mod/ zhi ba bzang po ni/ 'gos khug pa lha 643

btsas kyis kyang bla mar brten pa yin la/ de bzhugs pa'i gnas 'gos los rgyal po'i khab dang / mar pas ser skya'i grong na'o/ /gsung pa ltar ste/ rje 'brug pas chos 'byung pad+ma rgyas par/ rje nā ro'i slob ma che brgyad kyi nang mtshan shan+ta zhes bsgrangs shing / de la mar pas chos gsan zhing / gsung las/rgyud snyan po rnams kyi gter bdag po/ dpal zhi ba bzang po dngos dang mjal/ zhes drangs pa ltar ste/ku ku ri pa ni teslo pa'i kyang bla ma yin pas zhi ba bzang po dang / ku ku ri pa gcig tu 'phrul bar mi bya'o/ /da res rgya dkar du lo rgyus kha cig tu lo bdun bzhugs zer yang lo lnga bzhugs par gsal te/de yang mgur las/ sangs rgyas nā ro paṇa chen dang / sems can mar pa lo tsā gnyis/ ri bo gser gyi dgon par mjal/ lo ni bcu gnyis bar du bsten/ zhes rgya dkar du phebs pa phyi ma'i skabs nā ro pas spyod pa skyongs ba'i dus yin yang skabs skyabs su zhal mjal lung bstan dang byin rlabs nod cing /dge chos ci rigs byar yod pa yi lo lnga yang nā ro pa brten pa'i khong du byas par snang la/ des na lo drug zla ba bdun nye bar bsten cing cha shas kyi sgo nas lo bcu gnyis la phyogs pa tsam ni don la gnas kyi gzhan de las ches mang bar byas pa yang mi 'grig la/ yang kha cig gi mar pas nā ro pa dngos su ma mjal te dus mi mtshungs la/ mar pas mjal ba ni nā ro'i ming can gzhan zhig go smra ba byung mod/ de ni shin tu mi rigs te/ de skad smra ba po rang gi tshig nang 'gal bas mtshon nus kyi/ ji phyir mar pa slar rgya dkar du 'gro ba dang jo bo bod du phebs pa'i lam bar du mjal bar phyed rang kyis 'dod na/nā ro zhabs jo bo bod du phebs la nye skabs zhi bar gshegs pa jo bo'i lo rgyus chen mor 'byung bzhin don la gnas pa dang / jo bo bod du ma phebs pa'i lo du ma'i snga rol nyid du mar pa rgya dkar phebs pa mar do chos dbang ba'i lo rgyus kyis kyang shes par 'gyur na mngon sum 'gal ba'i dam bca' 'di la su zhig yid ches/ don du tshig de ltar rgya yang phra dog gi zin pa'i gang zag zhig gi skyes mchog dam pa'i gsung du brdzus te byas pa kho nar nges shing / spyir g.yel ma smu cor gyi rgyal zhes pa ltar/ bod 'dir khungs dang mi 'bral ba'i g.yo sgyu'i tshig gi skye bo rmongs pa bslu bar byed pa mang du mthong ste/de yang lus med pos brlam pa'i gang zag steg can cig kho nas bod 'di ru rgya bal gyi pad+ma 'byung gnas che chung gnyis byung ngo zhes rdzun du smras pa la phyugs lta bu'i skye bo kha cig gi de rjes zlos su byed pa dang tshul 'di 'dra bas so/ /des na tshig 'di ltas the tshom su myur pa ni smos kyang ci 'tshal te/ dgos don med par rjes zlos byed pa yang bdud kyi byin gyis non pa shes par bya'o/ /de phyir log par 'dren pa'i gtam de lta bu gang du snang yang grong khyer gyi bshungs pa'i khungs bu mi bster bar bya rigs so/ /zhes pa yang gzhan gyi dge ba'i bar chad sel ba'i slad du skabs su smras pa ste/ de yang lho brag mar pa 644

bod du byon pa 'di skabs/ yar 'brog mar do chos kyi dbang phyug rgya dkar byon pa dang bal por mjal nas gser zho gang gi phyag rten byas pas gser se ba re la yang 'thogs 'ongs pas khyod rang khyer nga bod du gser 'chag ru 'gro ba yin gsung zhing nā ro pa spyod pa la gshegs nas med pas nā ro pa'i slob ma bzhi la chos nyon zhes gsung ba mar do rang nyid kyi rnam thar du grags pas/ de tshe mar pa bod du byon pa 'di res su mjal bar nges so yang mar dos rong zom pa chen por lo tsā bslab zhes ngag sgros kha cig tu yod snang yang / rong zom pa'i rnam par de yi thugs sras g.yag rdo rje 'dzin pas mdzad par mar dos rong zom pa theg mar brtsod par yongs ba slar gus ste slob mar byas zhes gsung ba 'thad par go'o/ /mar dos ti ra nu tir nā ro'i zhal yud tsam mjal zhing byin gyis brlabs/ de nas nā ro'i dngos slob rnams la gdams pa gsan pa yin no/ kha cig gi lho brag mar pa'i lo gcig mar do 'khrungs zhes 'ol phyi dpyad kyang mi 'grigs kyi lho brag pa las lo bcu skor lhag tsam gyi gzhon pa nyid du nges so/ /'gos khug pa lha btsas kyang rag tsam du mar pa rgya dkar du bar res byon dus tsam du rgya dkar la byon par mngon/ mar pa bod du phebs nas sleb ma mchog mes rngog sogs kyang 'dus/skal ldan gyi tshogs ci rigs bskyangs kyin bzhugs pa na mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i brda' dgrol gri glu yi mthar/ te los lung bstan nā ro'i bu/ lhun grub chos kyi blo gros khyod/ /su la ha ri'i dgon pa na/ /rnal
